src: Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le dintlha tsa bohlokwa maemong a ha jwale.
tgt: Tincumo teKhabhinethi mayelana netindzaba letigcamile kulesimo sanyalo.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le setjhaba le ba matjhabeng bakeng sa ho rapella ntate wa setjhaba, Mopresidente wa mehlengNelson Mandela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlanganyela nesive kanye nemmango wemhlaba ekuthandazeleni babe wesive, Mengameli wangaphambilini Nelson Mandela.

src: Nakong ena e boima, ha re bontsheng lerato le kutlwelobohloko mme re etse Madiba motlotlo.
tgt: Ngalesikhatsi lesimatima, sonkhe asikhombise lutsandvo neluvelo sente Madiba abe nekutigcabha.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho ketekwa ha selemo sa bo 58 sa ho tekenwa ha Tjhata ya Tokoloho e neng e tekenwe ka la 26 Phuptjane 1955 e leng motheo wa demokerasi le Molaotheo wa rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yatiswe ngekugujwa kweminyaka lengema-58 yekusayinwa kweMculu Wenkhululeko lokwentiwa mhlaka tingema-26 Inhlaba 1955 lokusisekelo sentsandvo yetfu yelinyenti kanye neMtsetfosisekelo wetfu.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa oohle ho ‘Bapala karolo ya lona’ mabapi le ho isa naha haufiufi le pono ya Aforika Borwa e kopaneng, e hlokang semorabe, e hlokang kgethollo ka bong, ya demokerasi le e tswetseng pele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibita tonkhe takhamiti taseNingizimu Afrika kutsi ‘Tidlale Indzima Yato’ ekusondzeteni lelive kumbononchanti weNingizimu Afrika lebumbene, lengacwasi ngekwebuve, lengacwasi ngekwebulili, lenentsandvo yelinyenti nalenenchubek’elembili.

src: Kabinete e amohela boitlamo bo botjha ba Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle, mmoho le bafuputsi bakeng sa ho tobana le dintlha tse hlahisang diphepetso bakeng sa mekutu e kopanetsweng ya ntwa kgahlanong le HIKabinete hape e amohela boitokisetso ba Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle ba ho hlahisa boikenyako bo atisitsweng ho mefuta e teng e kenyeletsang tlhokomediso e ekeditsweng mabapi le HIV le AIDS, le mehato bakeng sa ho fokotsa kotsi ya tshwaetso ya HIKabinete e lebisa matshediso ho Kompone ya Setjhaba e Mogadishu ho la Somalia ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) ho latela tlhaselo e mpe ya ka la 19 Phuptjane 2013 eo ho yona ho shweleng batho ba 15 ho kenyeletswa maAforika Borwa a mabedi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukela kutibophetela lokuvuselelwe kabusha kweLitiko Letemphilo, kanye nebacwaningi ekubukaneni netindzaba letiphosa inselele emtameni loyinhlanganisela wekulwa neSandvulelangculazi (HIV).

src: Re etsa boipiletso ho dihlopha tsohle tsa dipolotiki tse ka thoko ho ditsamaiso tsa dipolotiki ho la Somalia ho nyahlatsa dikgoka le ho hlahisa ditletlebo tsa yona Mmusongwa Bofederale wa Somalia ka tsela e bopang le e nang le moya wa poelano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphindze yemukele emalungiselelo eLitiko Letemphilo ekwetfula kungenelela lokusha etinhlelweni letivele tikhona letifaka ekhatsi kwatisa lokwandzisiwe nge-HIV neNgculazi (AIDS), kanye netindlela tekunciphisa bungoti bekwesuleleka nge-HIIKhabhinethi yendlulisela emavi endvudvuto ngemuva kweluhlaselo lolwetfusako Lwesizindza Samhlabuhlangene eMogadishu, eSomalia mhlaka tili-19 Inhlaba 2013 lokushiye bantfu labali-15 bashonile kufaka ekhatsi takhamiti taseNingizimu Afrika letimbili.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa oohle ho ithaopa ka metsotso e 67 ya nako ya ona ka Letsatsi la Nelson Mandela (18 Phupu) bakeng sa ho thusa ho tlisa phethoho dibakeng tsa ona le Aforika Borwa bakeng sa ntlafatso ya bophelo.
tgt: Sibita onkhe emacembu etembusave langekho eluhlelweni lwetembusave eSomalia kutsi ayekele ludlame nekutsi avete kukhatsateka kwawo kuHulumende Lowodvwa waseSomalia ngendlela leyakhako nalenekubuyisana.

src: Ketsahalo ya selemong sena e tla tswela pele tlasa sehloho se reng “Etsa ho hong tlisa phethoho etsa letsatsi ka leng ebe Letsatsi la Mandela” maikutlo a tsepamisitswe ho hlahiso e sa haelleng ya dijo, bodulo le ho tseba ho bala.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibita tonkhe takhamiti taseNingizimu Afrika kutsi tinikele ngemaminitsi langema-67 esikhatsi sato ngeliLanga laNelson Mandela (18 Kholwane) kute tisite tigucule imimango yato kanye neNingizimu Afrika ibe ngulencono.

src: Kabinete e lemohile hore, jwaloka karolo ya Letsatsi laNelson Mandela, ho tla thakgolwa mokgahlelo wa pele wa Karete ya Boitsebiso.
tgt: Umcimbi walomnyaka utakwenteka ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi “Tsatsa sinyatselo gcugcutela luntjintjo yenta emalanga onkhe abe Lilanga laMandela” ngekugcila ekubeni khona kwekudla, indzawo yekufihla inhloko kanye nekukwati kufundza nekubhala.

src: Ho thakgolwa hona ke karohano ya bohlokwa mehleng ya rona e fetileng le ho qetello ya mehla ya ho jara dipasa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yatiswe kutsi njengencenye yeliLanga laMandela, kutawetfulwa luhlelo lwaboMatisi bemakhadi lolutakwentiwa ngetigaba letehlukene.

src: Karete ya Boitsebiso ke karete e sa hlokeng ho hlahiswa mme e nang le bokgoni ba ho tshwara tlhahisoleseding e tswang ho bankakarolo ba fapafapaneng ba ha jwale le ba isao.
tgt: Lokwetfulwa kwalabomatisi kusinyatselo lesibalulekile sekwehlukanisa sikhatsi sangaphambilini lesandlula kuso kanye nekucedza iminyaka yabobhukwana eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Letona la Merero ya Lehae le tla fana ka dintlha tse batsi pitsong e tlang ho tshwarwa haufinyana.
tgt: Lelikhadi lamatisi lilikhadi lelisebentisa buchwepheshe betekuchumana lolutawukwati kufaka lwati loluvela kulabatsintsekako labehlukahlukene esikhatsini sanyalo nasesikhatsini lesitako.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa ha letsholo la Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo le bitswang Diprojeke tse 94+ bakeng sa Madiba ho keteka letsatsi la tswalo la Nelson Mandela le lefa la hae.
tgt: INdvuna yeLitiko Letasekhaya itawunika lolunye lwati esigcwanini lesihleliwe sabetindzaba lesitakuba khona madvute nje.

src: Sepheo sa letsholo lena ke ho ntlafatsa meralo ya motheo dikolong tse fetang 94 hore e be dibaka tsa mankgonthe tsa ho ithuta le tsa boleng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukela kwetfulwa kwemkhankhaso weLitiko Letemfundvo Lesisekelo lobitwa Imiklamo lengema-94+ yaMadiba yekubungata lilanga lwekutalwa kanye nemlandvo waNelson Mandela.

src: Letsholo lena le fana ka tshepo le seriti dikolong ho phatlalla le naha.
tgt: Lomkhankhaso uhlose kwenta ncono sakhiwonchanti etikolweni letingetulu kwema-94 kutsi tibe tikhungo tebuchwepheshe besimanje letiniketela ngemfundvo lesezingeni lelisetulu.

src: Nakong ya Kgwedi ya Mandela ho tloha ka Phupu 2013, lefapha le tla be le eteletse pele phano ya sekolo se setjha se phethetsweng beke ka nngwe e le karolo ya boitlamo ba ho ntlafatsa boleng ba thuto ya motheo.
tgt: Ngenyanga yaMandela kusukela ngaKholwane 2013, litiko litakube lihola kwendluliselwa kwetikolo letinsha lesetiphotfuliwe kwakhiwa njalo ngeliviki njengencenye yekutibophetela ekwenteni ncono lizinga lemfundvo lesisekelo.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho phethelwa le phano ya Borokgo ba Lefa la Morena Dalibhunga Mandela ho badudi ba Mvezo ba eteletsweng pele ke Morena Mandla Mandela, e leng setloholo sa Mopresidente wa mehleng Nelson Mandela, ka la 18 Phupu 2013.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukela kuphotfulwa nekuniketelwa kweLibhuloho Lemlandvo weNkhosi Dalibhunga Mandela kummango waseMvezo loholwa yiNkhosi Mandla Mandela, umtukulu waMengameli wangaphambilini Nelson Mandela, mhla tili-18 Kholwane 2013.

src: Phano ena e tla tsamaelana le letsatsi la tswalo la Mopresidente wa mehleng Monghadi Nelson Mandela, eo a tla beng a qeta dilemo tse 95 ka letsatsi lena.
tgt: Lokuniketelwa kwalelibhuloho kutawucondzana nelusuku lwekutalwa lwaMengameli Wangaphambilini Nelson Mandela, lotakube acedza iminyaka yebudzala lengema-95 ngalolo lusuku.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho hopola hwa Aforika Borwa hwa Letsatsi la Matjhaba a Kopaneng le kgahlanong le Tshebediso e mpe ya Dithethefatsi le ho Rekiswa ha batho ho seng Molaong ka la 26 Phuptjane 2013, ho la Kimberley.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yatiswe ngekugujwa kweLusuku Lwamhlabuhlangene Mhlabawonkhe Lwekulwa Nekungasetjentiswa kahle Kwetidzakamiva neKushushumbiswa Lokungekho Emtsetfweni mhla tili-26 Inhlaba 2013, eKimberley, eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Letsatsi lena le ile la sebediswa ho toboketsa bohlokwa ba ho sebetsana le diphephetso tse tobileng lefatshe, tse kenyeletsang botlokotsebe, HIV le AIDS, boitshwaro bo hlephileng, dikgoka tsa malapeng le ho ima ha barwetsana.
tgt: Lolusuku lwasetjentiselwa kugcizelela kubaluleka kwekubukana netinselele letibukene nemhlaba wonkhe, letifaka ekhatsi, bugebengu, i-HIV ne-AIDS, kulahleka kwesimilo, ludlame lwasemakhaya kanye nekutetfwala kwalabasebancane.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho tshwarwa ha Seboka sa Saense, Theknoloji le Ntjhafatsose tla tshwarwaho tloha ka la 20 ho ya ho la 21 Phupu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukela kubanjwa kweMhlangano weSayensi, iThekhnoloji neKucamba Kabusha lotawubanjwa kusukela mhla tingema-20 kuya mhla tingema-21 kuKholwane.

src: Seboka se tla shebana le kgothaletso ya tlaleho ya Komiti ya Tekolo ya Matona, kgokahano e ntlafetseng le kopanelo ka hara Mokgwa wa Naha wa Ntjhafatso le dipuisano tse matlafaditsweng mahareng a mmuso, indasteri le borathuto.
tgt: Lomhlangano utawubhunga ngetiphakamiso tembiko weLikomiti leNdvuna Lekubuyeketa, kuhlela nekusebentisana lokwentiwe ncono ngekhatsi eLuhlelweni Lwavelonkhe Lwekucamba Kabusha kanye netinkhulumiswano letinemandla emkhatsini wahulumende, tetimboni kanye nemkhakha wemfundvo lephameke.

src: Kabinete e amohetse tlaleho mabapi le tswelopele e entsweng motsaneng wa Muyexe ho la Giyani, Profenseng ya Limpopo, ho kenngweng tshebetsong ha boitlamo ba mmuso ba ho ntlafatsa bophelo ba batho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukela umbiko lomayelana nenchubekel’embili leseyentiwe kummango waseMuyexe eGiyani, esifundzeni saseLimpopo ekwetfulweni kwekutibophetela lokwentiwa nguhulumende ekwenteni ncono timphilo tebantfu.

src: Ho feta moo, Kabinete e phetile ngongoreho ya Mopresidente ya hore makala oohle a mmuso a lokela ho potlakisa phano ya ditshebeletso ho ya ka meralo eo ho dumellanweng ka yona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphindze yevakalisa kukhatsateka kweMengameli kwekutsi onkhe emazinga ahulumende kumele anonophise kwetfulwa kwetinsita kulandzela tinhlelo lokuvunyelenwe ngato.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa ha Projeke ya Mawala a Meralo ya Motheo ya bo 18 ka Moqebelo, 29 Phupu 2013 e tsamaelanang le mabaka a meralo ya motheo bakeng sa ho fana ka metsi le bohlweki ba ona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukela kwetfulwa kweLuhlelo Lwesakhiwonchanti Semanti Nemangcoliso (SIP-18) ngeMgcibelo mhla tingema-29 Inhlaba 2013 lolumayelana netindzaba letitsintsa sakhiwonchanti ngenhloso yekwetfula emanti kanye nendlela yekuhanjiswa kwemangcoliso.

src: Projeke e tla netefatsa phano ya ka nako e telele ya metsi bakeng sa ho kgotsofatsa ditlhoko tsa kahisano le ho tshehetsa kgolo ya moruo.
tgt: Lomklamo utawucinisekisa kuniketelwa lokusimeme kwemanti kute kuhlangatjetanwe netidzingo tetenhlalo kuphindze kwesekelwe kukhula kwemnotfo.

src: Kabinete e amohetse lesedi leo e le fumaneng mabapi le diketso tsa mmomori wa lekala la tsa kaho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukela umbiko lewutfolile mayelana netivumelwano tekusebentisana emkhakheni wetekwakha.

src: Kabinete e amohela sephetho sa diphuputso tse hlahisitseng bopaki ba ditheko tse fosahetseng, mmomori le bobodu indasteringya kaho ya poraefete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukela umphumela weluphenyo lolute nebufakazi bekugucuguculwa kwemanani, emachinga ekuntjintja emanani kanye nenkhohlakalo embonini yetekwakha yangasese.

src: Sekgahla sa mmomori se batla letsoho le matla la ba ka sehloohong ho tsa phehisano.
tgt: Lizinga lekuguculwa kwemanani lidzinga kutsi kutsatfwe tinyatselo leticinile ngulabo labasemagunyeni etekuncintisana.

src: Kabinete e emetse tsamaiso ya sephethosa Lekgotla la Diphehisano empa e lemohile hore bopaki bo supa hore ho bile le tshenyo e kgolo kgahlehong ya setjhaba ka lebaka la ditheko tse phahamisitsweng tseo mmuso o di lefileng ka lebaka la mmomori ona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilindzele umphumela weLuhlelo Lweluphenyo Lwetekuncintisana kepha yatiswe kutsi bufakazi buveta umonakalo lomkhulu kuloko lokutimfuno tesive mayelana nemanani lantjintjiwe lakhokhelwe nguhulumende ngenca yemachinga alokuguculwa kwemanani."

src: Dipuisano le Diqeto tsa bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Tinkhulumiswano netincumo teKhabhinethi letihamba embili.

src: Kabinete e tjhaeletse monwana Moralo wa Mankgonthe wa Naha wa Dithethefatsi (2013-2017) le hore o kenngwe tshebetsong bakeng sa dilemo tse hlano tse tlang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukele Luhlelo Lolukhulu Lwavelonkhe Lwetidzakamiva (2013-2017) kanye nekwetfulwa kwalo kuleminyaka lesihlanu letako.

src: Moralo o sebetsa jwaloka lewa la mmuso bakeng sa ho thibela le ho fokotsa tshebediso e mpe ya tahi le dithethefatsi le ditlamorao tse tsamaelanang le tsona tsa bophelo ba kahisano le moruo setjhabeng sa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Loluhlelo luluhlaka lwalelive lwekuvimbela nekunciphisa kusetjentiswa kabi kwetjwala netidzakamiva kanye nemtselela wako kutenhlalo nakutemnotfo emmangweni waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e tjhaeletse monwana Ho tshwarwa ha Seboka sa Naha sa Matlafatso Moruong e Pharaletseng ya Batho ba Batsho ka Mphalane 2013.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukele Kubanjwa kweMhlangano Wavelonkhe Wekuhlonyiswa Lokubanti Kwalabamnyama Kutemnotfo ngeMphala 2013.

src: Seboka sa Naha se tla bontsha dipale tsa katleho le ho namalatsa boikenyako ba mmuso tshehetsong ya bonkakarolo bo hlwahlwa le phumantsho ya batho ba batsho ho tsa moruo ka hara moruo o phatlaletseng, ka tsela e tlang ho nyehela moruong o kopanetsweng.
tgt: Lomhlangano Wavelonkhe utawukhombisa tindzaba letibe yimphumelelo uphindze ucacise kungenelela kwahulumende ekwesekeleni kubamba lichaza lokuphumelelisako nalokusimeme kutemnotfo kanye nekufinyelela kwalabamnyama eluhlelweni lolukhulu lwetemnotfo, ngendlela letawufaka sandla ekukhuleni lokuhlanganisako.

src: Kabinete e tjhaeletse monwana hore Aforika Borwa e tshwarisane le Lenaneo la Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng la Bodulo ba Batho (UN-HABITAT) ka ho tshwara Khonferense ya “Ho etella pele Phethoho ya Motsemoholo”ka la 5 le 6 Loetse 2013.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukele kubanjwa ngekuhlanganyela kweNgcungcutsela “Yekuhola Ingucuko Edolobhenikati” kanye neluhlelo Lwamhlabuhlangene Lwekuhlaliswa Kwebantfu (UN-HABITAT) mhla tisi-5 namhla tisi-6 Inyoni 2013.

src: Tabakgolo ya khonferense e hodima bonkakarolo ba basadi bophelong ba motsesetoropo ho la Aforika.
tgt: Lengcungcutsela itakube igcile ekubambeni lichaza kwabomake emphilweni yasetindzaweni tasemadolobheni e-Afrika.

src: Khonferense e tla fana ka lepatlelo bakeng sa Aforika hore e tobane ka botlalo le diphephetso tsa ho dula ditoropong le ho qhaneha ho dula ditoropong bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya batho.
tgt: Lengcungcutsela itawunika i-Afrika inkhundla yekubukana netinselele tekutfutseleka emadolobheni iphindze ihlanganise kutfutseleka emadolobheni kute kutfutfukiswe bantfu.

src: Kabinete e tjhaeletse monwana Pampiri e Tshweu ya Moralo mabapi le Malapa le Moralo wa ho kenngwa Tshebetsong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume Luhlaka Lwemculu Wemgomo lomayelana Nemindeni kanye Nekwetfulwa kwawo.

src: Pampiri e Tshweu ya Moralo Mabapi le Malapa e tla kgontsha Mmuso le bankakarolo ba bang ho sebedisa lelapa e le motheo wa ho fihlella bophelo ba mankgonthe ba setjhaba.
tgt: Luhlaka Lwemculu Wemigomo lomayelana Nemindeni lutakwenta kutsi Hulumende kanye nalabanye badlalindzima basebentise umndeni njengesisekelo sekufezekisa kuphila ngalokufanele kwemmango.

src: Pampiri e Tshweu e sisinya mawala a mararo a ka sehloohong, Kgothaletso ya bophelo bo botle ba lelapa, matlafatso ya Lelapa le paballo ya Lelapa.
tgt: Lomculu Wemigomo uphakamisa emasu lahamba embili lamatsatfu, Kukhutsatwa kwekuphila ngalokufanele kwemndeni, Kuciniswa Kwemndeni kanye Nekulondvolotwa Kwemndeni.

src: Kabinete e tjhaeletse monwana phethelo le ho kenngwa lesedinyaneng la molao ha Lewa la bobedi la Mohlodi wa Naha wa Metsi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume kuphotfulwa kanye nekufakwa kumculu wahulumende Kwelisu Lavelonkhe Lensita Yemanti lesibili.

src: Lewa lena le ahelletswe hodima Lewa la Mohlodi wa Naha wa Metsi la 2004.
tgt: Lelisu lakhela etukweLisu Lavelonkhe Lensita yemanti langa-2004.

src: Lewa la bobedi la Mohlodi wa Naha wa Metsi le fanaka mohlophollo ho karolo eo metsi a e bapalang moruong le ho hlwaya diphephetso tse teng, menyetla ya ntshetsopele le diketsahalo tse supisang moralo o dumellanweng ka ona bakeng sa dibaka tsa bohlokwa tsa naha.
tgt: Lisu Lavelonkhe Lensita Yemanti lesibili linika luhlatiyo mayelana nendzima yemanti kutemnotfo liphindze livete tinselele letitsite, ematfuba entfutfuko kanye netinyatselo letilandzela luhlaka lokuvunyelenwe ngalo etincenyeni letisembili talelive.

src: Lewa la bobedi hape le batla ho netefatsa boteng ba metsi ba nako e telele, a lekanang bohle le a bolokehileng bakeng sa bophelo bo betere le tikoloho e betere bakeng sa bohle le hore metsi a laolwa hantle le ka makgethe bakeng sa kgolo e lekanang ya nako e telele le ntshetsopele.
tgt: Lelisu lesibili lifuna futsi kucinisekisa kusimama, kulinganisa nekutfolakala kwemanti ekwenteni imphilo nendzawo lencono yawo wonkhe umuntfu kanye nekutsi emanti aphatfwa ngalokufanele nangalokuphumelelisako ngenhloso yekukhula nekutfutfuka lokulinganako nalokusimeme.

src: Kabinete e tjhaeletse monwana tlaleho ka Diphetho tsa kopano ya bo 16 ya Khonferense ya Mekga bakeng sa Seboka sa Kgwebo ya Matjhaba bakeng sa Dibopuwa tse Kotsing tsa Diphoofolo le Dimela tse Hlaha (CITES CoP 16), e neng e tshwaretswe Bangkok, ho la Thailand ho tloha ka la 3 – 14 Hlakubele 2013.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume umbiko Wemiphumela yemhlangano weli-16 weNgcungcutsela Yetihlangano eNgcungcutseleni Yemave Emhlaba lemayelana Nekuhwebelana Ngetinhlayiya Tasendle Teluhlobolunye Tetitjalo Letisengotini (CITES CoP 16), lobewubanjelwe eBangkok, eThailand kusukela mhla titi-3 – 14 Indlovulenkhulu 2013.

src: Ho feta moo Kabinete e tjhaeletse monwana hore Aforika Borwa e lokise le ho kenya tshisinyo e lokelang ho tsepamisetswa maikutlo kopanong ya CITES CoP 17 ka 2016 ho la Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphindze yavuma kutsi iNingizimu Afrika ilungise ibuye ifake siphakamiso sekuhwebelana kute kukhulunywe ngaso ku-CITES CoP 17 eNingizimu Afrika nga-2016.

src: Kabinete e ananetse memo e tswang ho Banka ya Ntshetsopele ya Aforika bakeng sa Aforika Borwa ya ho ba setho sa Lemulwana la Dikaho tsa Motheo bakeng sa Aforika (ICA) le ileng la thakgolwa Sebokeng sa G8 ho la Gleneagles ka 2005.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukele simemo lesivela eBhange Lentfutfuko LaseNingizimu Afrika sekuba lilunga Lelicembu Lesakhiwonchanti le-Afrika (ICA) lelatfulwa Emhlanganweni wemacembu emave e-G8 nga-2005.

src: Letsete le leholo la Aforika Borwa ho dikaho tsa motheo bakeng sa nako e mahareng le tla ntlafatswa ke ho ba setho sa ICA haholoholo tlhahisong ya tshedimosetsole dihlahiswa tsa tsebo le kgokahano ya maano a ntshetsopele pakeng tsa dinaha tsa G20 le tsa Aforika.
tgt: Kusisa lokukhulu kweNingizimu Afrika kusakhiwonchanti esikhatsini lesisemkhatsini lesitako kutawukhutsatwa ngebulunga bayo ku-ICA ikakhulukati ekusungulweni kwemininingwane nemikhicito yelwati kanye nekuhlelwa kwetinchubomgomo tentfutfuko emkhatsini wemacembu emave e-G20 kanye nemave ase-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e tjhaeletse monwana ho hlahiswa ha Protokhole ya Setjhaba sa Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tsa Borwa ba Aforika (SADC) bakeng sa Kgwebisano Ditshebeletsong Palamenteng bakeng sa tshekatsheko, ho ya ka karolo ya 231 ya Molaotheo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume siphakamiso Semgudvu Wekutfutfukiswa Kwemmango waseNingizimu Afrika kuTekuhwebelana Ngetinhlelo lesetfulwe ePhalamende kute sivunywe ngekulandzela sigaba sema-231 seMtsetfosisekelo.

src: Merero ya Protokhole ke ho lokolla kgwebo ya ditshebeletso ka hara mabatowa ho itshetlehilwe hodima tekatekano, botsitso le ho kgola molemo mmoho.
tgt: Tinhloso taloMgudvu kukhulula kuhwebelana ngetinhlelo emkhatsini wetigodzi talelivekati lokusekelwe etukwekulingana kanye nekuzuza lokulinganako emkhatsini wawo.

src: Protokhole ena hape e qaqisa moralo bakeng sa tokoloho ya kgwebisano ditshebeletsong pakeng tsa dinaha tseo e leng ditho tsa SADC le ho sebetsa e le motheo wa ditherisano.
tgt: Lomgudvu uphindze ubeke luhlaka lwekukhululwa kwekuhwebelana ngetinhlelo emkhatsini kwemalunga embuso Wemave Latfutfukako ase-Afrika leseNingizimu uphindze ube sisekelo setinkhulumomphikiswano.

src: Kabinete e ananetseho thakgolwa ha lengolo la thuto la Batjhela ya Ntshetsopele ya Dibaka tsa Bodulo tsa Batho (BHSD) kakopanelo le Lefapha la Thuto le Thupello e Phahameng le Yunivesithi ya Nelson Mandela Metro.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yatiswe ngekwetfulwa kweSicu Semfundvo Setekutfutfukisa Kuhlaliswa Kwebantfu (BHSD) ngekubambisana emkhatsini weLitiko Letemfundvo Lephakeme Nekucecesha kanye ne-Nelson Mandela Metro University.

src: Lengolo lena la thuto la BHSD morero wa lona ke ho ntshetsapele balaodi le bahlanka ba hlwahlwa ba Dibaka tsa Bodulo ba tla ba le tsebo le bokgoni bo hlokahalang bakeng sa ho bopa, ho ntlafatsa le ho potlakisa ntshetsopele ya bodulo ba batho bakeng sa nako e telele Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lesicu i-BHSD sihlose kutfutfukisa ngalokuphumelelisako baphatsi netisebenti Tetekuhlaliswa Kwebantfu labatakuba nelwati kanye nemakhono lafanele naladzingekako ekwakheni, ekutfutfukiseni nasekunonophiseni kwetfulwa kwetindzawo tekuhlalisa bantfu eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho mafapha oohle a mmuso, bomasepala le makala a mmuso a sebetsang Gauteng ho ngodisa dipalangwang tsohle tsa mmuso bakeng sa dipapetlwana tsa di e-tag.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibita onkhe ematiko ahulumende, bomasipala tinkampani letingaphasi kweluphiko lwahulumende letisebenta eGauteng kutsi tibhalise tonkhe timoto tembuso eluhlelweni lwemigwaco lengutselawayeka lekhokhelwako.

src: Kabinete e tjhaeletse monwana mehato ya ho kenngwa tshebetsong e sisintsweng bakeng sa ho thehwa ha Lekala la Bolaodi ba Meedi (BMA).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume kwetfulwa kwetinyatselo letiphakanyisiwe tekusungulwa kweLuphiko Lwekuphatfwa Kweminyele (BMA).

src: BMA e tla laola phallo, madiboho le ho laola metjha e naheng ya ditshebeletso tsa meedi le ho hokahanya tshebeletso ya mafapha oohle madibohong a ho kena.
tgt: I-BMA itawusingatsa tindzaba tekutfutseleka kwebantfu, imphahla lengena eliveni kanye netinhlelo tekulawula indzawo yasemnyeleni kanye nekuchumanisa ngalokuphumelelisako tinhlelo tawo onkhe ematiko emachwebeni ekungena.

src: Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae e tla ba Lefapha le eteletseng pele ho thehwa ha BMKabinete e tjhaeletse monwana dibili tse latelang bakeng sa ho hlahiswa Palamenteng:.
tgt: Litiko Letasekhaya kutakuba ngilo leliholako ekusungulweni kwe-BMIKhabhinethi ivume leMitsetfosivivinywa lelandzelako kutsi ingeniswe ePhalamende:.

src: Bili ya Taolo ya Madiboho, Bili ya Lekgetho la Madiboho, ya 2013 le Sehlomathiso sa Molao wa Madiboho le Ditefello, wa 2013 – Dibili tsena di fana ka motheo bakeng sa tsamaiso ya kgwebo ya matjhaba le tshireletso ya moruo le setjhaba, kahoo di bopa botsitso pakeng tsa taolo ya madiboho le tsamaiso ya kgwebo.
tgt: Umtsetfosivivinywa Wekulawulwa Kwemphahla Lengena Eliveni, Umtsetfosivivinywa Wekukhokhelwa Kwemphala Lengena Eliveni, 2013 kanye Nesichibiyelo seMtsetfo Wemphahla Lengena Nalephuma Eliveni, 2013 – Lemitsetfosivivinywa iniketa sisekelo sekuchutjwa kwekuhwebelana kwemave emhlaba nekuvikelwa kwetemnotfo kanye nemmango, ngaleyo ndlela kwakhele kusimama emkhatsini wekulawulwa kwemphahla lengenako kanye nekuchutjwa kwetekuhwebelana.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Diphuputso tsa Metsi – Sepheo sa Sehlomathiso sena ke ho se matahanya le diphethoho tse kgolo ho diinstitjute, leano, saense ya metsi le tikoloho ya tsa molao hape le ho eketsa nyehelo ya Khomishene ya Diphuputso tsa Metsi bakeng sa ditlhoko tsa diphuputso tsa metsi tsa Aforika Borwa le ho netefatsa hore naha e eme hantle bakeng sa ho arabela ditlhoko le diphephetso tsa naha e nang le bothata ba metsi jwaloka Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Sichibiyelo Semtsetfosivivinywa Welucwaningo Lwemanti – Lesichibiyelo sihlose kucondzisa lomtsetfosivivinywa kutsi uhambisane netingucuko letinkhulu etikhungweni, kunchubomgomo, kusayensi yetemanti nakutemtsetfo uphindze wandzise sandla lesifakwa yiKhomishini Yelucwaningo Lwemanti etidzingweni telucwaningo lwemanti taseNingizimu Afrika kanye nekucinisekisa kutsi lelive linelisu lekubukana netidzingo kanye netinselele telive lelingenawo emanti lanele lelinjengeNingizimu Afrika.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Melao ya Naha ya Taolo ya Tikoloho, sa 2013 –Bili ena e sisinya dihlomathiso dipehelong tse itseng tlasa Molao wa Taolo ya Tikoloho, wa 1998 (Molao wa 107 wa 1998) le ho feta moo ho netefatsa hore mehlodi ya naha ya tlhaho e tshireleditswe bakeng sa moloko wa jwale le o tlang jwaloka ha ho labalabelwa ke Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha.
tgt: Sichibiyelo Semtsetfosivivinywa Wemitsetfo Yekuphatfwa Kwemvelo, 2013 – Lomtsetfosivivinywa uphakamisa tichibiyelo kutihlinteko letitsite ngaphasi kweMtsetfo Wavelonkhe Wekuphatfwa kwemvelo, 1998 (Umtsetfonombolo 107 wanga-1998) uphindze ucinisekise kutsi imitfombolusito yemvelo yalelive ivikelelwa situkulwane sanyalo nesitukulwane lesitako njengobe kubekwe eLuhlelweni Lwavelonkhe Lwekutfutfukisa.

src: Moralo wa Naha wa Taolo ya Tikoloho: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Boleng ba Moya, sa 2013 – Bili ena e fetola dipehelo tse itseng tlasa Taolo ya Tikoloho ya Naha: Molao wa Boleng ba Moya, wa 2004 o laolang boleng ba moya ka hara naha bakeng sa ho tshireletsa tikoloho ka ho fana ka mekgwa e kgonehang bakeng sa thibelo ya tshilafatso le ho thefula maemo a tlhaho ho ntse ho kgothaletswa ntshetsopele e lokileng ya moruo le kahisano.
tgt: Luhlaka Lwavelonkhe Lwekuphatfwa Kwemvelo: Sichibiyelo Semtsetfosivivinywa Welizinga Lemoya, 2013 – Lomtsetfosivivinywa wenta tichibiyelo kutihlinteko letitsite ngaphasi kweLuhlaka Lwavelonkhe Lwekuphatfwa Kwemvelo: Umtsetfo Welizinga Lemoya, 2004 lolawula lizinga lemoya eliveni kute kuvikelwe imvelo ngekuta netindlela letivakalako tekuvimbela kungcoliseka kanye nekonakaliswa kwetinhlelo talokuphila emvelweni ngakulolunye luhlangotsi kube kukhutsatwa kutfutfuka kwetemnotfo netenhlalo lokufanele.

src: Taolo ya Naha ya Tikoloho: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Matlakala, sa 2013 – Bili ena e fetola Taolo ya Naha ya Tikoloho: Molao wa Matlakala, wa 2008 (Molao wa 59 wa 2008) o laolang taolo ya matlakala bakeng sa ho tshireletsa bophelo bo botle le tikoloho.
tgt: Kuphatfwa Kwetemvelo Kuvelonkhe: Sichibiyelo Semtsetfosivivinywa Wemfucuta, 2013 – Lomtsetfosivivinywa uchibiyela Kuphatfwa Kwetemvelo kuvelonkhe: Umtsetfo Wemfucuta, 2008 (Umtsetfonombolo 59 wanga-2008) lolawula kuphatfwa kwemfucuta kute kuvikelwe temphilo kanye nemvelo.

src: Taolo ya Naha ya Tikoloho: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Dibaka tse Tshireleditsweng, sa 2013 – Bili ena e fetola Taolo ya Naha ya Tikoloho: Molao wa Dibaka tseTshireleditsweng, wa 2003 (Molao wa 57 wa 2003).
tgt: Kuphatfwa Kwetemvelo Kuvelonkhe: Sichibiyelo Semtsetfosivivinywa Setindzawo letivikelekile, 2013 – Lomtsetfosivivinywa uchibiyela Kuphatfwa Kwetemvelo kuvelonkhe: Umtsetfo Wetindzawo letivikelekile, 2003 (Umtsetfonombolo 57 wanga-2003).

src: Diphethoho di kenyeletsa taolo ya Dibaka tsa Lewatle tse Tshireleditsweng mokgweng wa taolo ya dibaka tse ding tse Tshireleditsweng le ho fana ka sefutho ho Diphatlalatso tsa Mopresidente tse arolang mesebetsi pakeng tsa mabaka a botshwasi ba ditlhapi le taolo ya tikoloho.
tgt: Tichibiyelo tihlanganisa kuphatfwa Kwetindzawo Letinemanti Letivikelekile eluhlelweni lwekuphatfwa kwaletinye Tindzawo letivikelekile kanye nekulandzela Timemetelo taMengameli letehlukanisa imisebenti emkhatsini wekuphatfwa kwetetinhlanti kanye netemvelo.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Banka ya Poso ya Aforika Borwa – Sepheo se seholo sa Molao wa Banka ya Poso ya Aforika Borwa, wa 2010 (Molao wa 9 wa 2010) ke ho theha setsha sa ditjhelete bakeng sa ho kgothaletsa batho ka bongata ho boloka le ho tsetela le ho bopa banka ya kgetho ya mantlha bakeng sa sehlopha se fumanang meputso e tlase.
tgt: Sichibiyelo Semtsetfosivivinywa Wetemaposi aseNingizimu Afrika – Inhloso lemcoka yeMtsetfo Wetemaposi aseNingizimu Afrika, 2010 (Umtsetfonombolo 9 wanga-2010) kusungula sikhungo setetimali lesitakwatisa bantfu ngekonga nekusisa kanye nekwakha libhange labangatikhetsela lona bantfu labahola kancane.8 IKhabhinethi ivume Sichibiyelo Semtsetfosivivinywa Wemshwalense Walabaphelelwe Ngumsebenti 2012 kutsi bantfu baphawule ngawo nekutsi kuchunyanwe neBalingani Betenhlalo beMkandlu Wavelonkhe Wekutfutfukiswa Kwetemnotfo Netebasebenti.

src: Kabinete e tjhaeletse monwana Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Inshorense ya Tlhoko ya Mosebetsi sa 2012 bakeng sa ho nonya maikutlo a setjhaba le bakeng sa tjhebisano le Bomphato ba Kahisano ba Lekgotla la Naha la tsa Moru le Mesebetsi.
tgt: Lomtsetfosivivinywa uchibiyela Umtsetfo Wemshwalense Walabaphelelwe Ngumsebenti, Nombolo 63 wanga-2001.

src: Bili ena e fetola Molao wa Inshorense ya Tlhoko ya Mosebetsi, wa 63 wa 2001.
tgt: Lesichibiyelo silungisa ludzaba lwetisebenti letikhishelwe ngaphandle kuloMtsetfo siphindze sente ncono kukhokhelwa kwetimbuyeketo kulabo labekadze batikhokhela, selule sikhatsi sekukhokhelwa kwetimbuyeketo kulabatikhokhelako kusukela etinyangeni letisiphohlongo kuya kuletilishumi nakubili siphindze sivumele kukhetfwa kwalabatawutfola imali yembuyeketo nakwenteka kushona lokhokhako.9 IKhabhinethi ivume setfulo Sesichibiyelo Semtsetfosivivinywa Wetelukhetfo, 2013 ePhalamende.

src: Sehlomathiso sena se tobana le ntlha ya basebetsi bao mothating wa jwale ba teetsweng ka thoko Molaong ona le ho ntlafatsa ditefello tsa menyetla ho ba nyehelang, ho eketsa nako ya tefo ya menyetla ho ba nyehelang ho tloha dikgweding tse robedi ho ya ho tse leshome le metso e mmedi le ho fana ka kgetho ya bakgolamolemo haeba ho lokelwa ho fanwa ditlhapiso ha lefu le ka hlaha.
tgt: Lesichibiyelo Semtsetfosivivinywa sihlose kuniketa emavoti lakhetsekile elukhetfweni Lwelibandla Lavelonkhe, kanye nekwenta kutsi bavoti labangephandle kweRiphabhlikhi bakwati kubhalisela kuvota kute batewukwati kuvota ngalokukhetsekile.

src: Dithonyo.
tgt: Kucashelwa etikhundleni.

src: Kabinete e dumellana le ho thonngwa ha MonghadiRomeo Adams maemong a Motlatsa Motsamaisi-Kakaretso: Ditshebeletsong tsa Kgwebo ho Lefapha la Toka le Ntshetsopele ya Molaotheo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumelana nekucashwa kweMnuRomeo Adams esikhundleni seLisekela Lemcondzisijikelele: Tinhlelo Temabhizinisi eLitikweni Letebulungiswa Nekutfutfukiswa kweMtsetfosisekelo.

src: Kabinete e dumellana le ho thonngwa ha Mofumahadi Irene RofhiwaSingo maemong a Mohlanka ya ka Sehloohong wa Ditjhelete ho Lefapha la Mehlodi ya Diminerale.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumelana nekucashwa kwaNks Irene Rofhiwa Singo esikhundleni Sesikhulu Setimali Lesisetulu eLitikweni Letetimbiwa.

src: Kabinete e dumellana le ho thonngwa haMofumahadi Kalayvani Pillay maemong a Motlatsa Motsamaisi-Kakaretso: Ntshetsopeleng ya Theramelao ho Lefapha la Toka le Ntshetsopele ya Molaotheo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumelana nekucashwa kwaNks Kalayvani Pillay esikhundleni seLisekela Lemcondzisijikelele: Kutfutfukiswa Kwemtsetfo eLitikweni Letebulungiswa Nekutfutfukiswa kweMtsetfosisekelo.

src: Kabinete e dumellana le ho thonngwa ha Ngaka Bismark Tyobeka maemong a Mohlanka ya ka Sehloohong wa Phethahatso wa Taolo ya Naha ya Matla a Nyutlelere ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumelana nekucashwa kwaDkt.

src: Kabinete e dumellana le ho thonngwa botjha hape ha Monghadi Tsietsi Mokhele jwaloka Mohlanka ya ka Sehloohong wa Phethahatso wa Bolaodi ba Polokeho Mawatleng bakeng sa nako ya dilemo tse hlano ho tloha ka la 1 Mmesa 2013.
tgt: Bismark Tyobeka esikhundleni seMphatsi Lomkhulu kuMlawuli Wavelonkhe Wenyukla eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e dumellana le ho thonngwa botjha hapeha ditho tseo e seng tsa phethahatso tse latelang ho boto ya Mekgwa ya Ditumello ya Naha ya Aforika Borwa, bao nako ya bona ya tshebetso e tla fela ka la 30 Pudungwana 2013, ho sebetsa lekgetlo la bobedi ho tloha ka la 1 Tshitwe 2013 ho ya ka la 30 Pudungwana 2018.• Monghadi Vernon Roderick Seymour• Monghadi PhakamisaZonke.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumelana nekucashwa lihlandla lesibili kwaMnu Tsietsi Mokhele njengeMphatsi Lomkhulu Wesikhungo Lesengamele Tekuphepha Kutaselwandle eNingizimu Afrika sikhatsi lesiminyaka lesihlanu kusukela mhla lu-1 Mabasa 2013.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho thonngwa botjha hape ha ditho tse leshome le metso e meraro ho Lekgotla la Aforika Borwa la Merero ya Sepakapaka ho tloha ka la 24 Phuptjane 2013 ho ya ho la 24 Phuptjane 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumelana nekucashwa lihlandla lesibili kwelamalunga lalandzelako langasito Tikhulu Letisetulu ebhodini Leluhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwekugunyata eNingizimu Afrika, le sikhatsi sawo sekuphatsa siphela mhla tingema-30 kuLweti 2013, kutsi achubekele esikhatsini sekuphatsa lesilandzelako kusukela mhla lu-1 Ingongoni 2013 kuya mhla tingema-30 kuLweti 2018.• MnuVernon Roderick Seymour• MnuPhakamisa Zonke.

src: Kabinete hape e ananetse ho thonngwa ha baemedi ho tswa ho Lefapha la Tshireletso, Lekgotla la Diphuputso tsa Saense le Indasteri (CSIR) le Lefapha la Dikamano le Tshebedisano ya Matjhaba ho tloha ka la 24 Phuptjane 2013 ho ya ho la 24 Phuptjane 2015.a.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yatiswe ngekucashwa lihlandla lesibili kwemalunga lalishumi nakutsatfu Emkhandlu Wetindzaba Tasemkhatsini eNingizimu Afrika kusukela mhla tingema-24 Inhlaba 2013 kuya kumhla tingema-24 Inhlaba 2015.
