src: Kabinete e thoholeditse batho ba Zimbabwe le mekga ya dipolotiki ka ho tshwara dikgetho tse hlophisitsweng hantle tsa palamente le tsa dibaka.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ihalalisele bantfu baseZimbabwe kanye nemacembu etepolitiki ngekubamba lukhetfo lwephalamende nelwendzawo ngekuthula, ngekuvumelana nangemphumelelo.

src: Kabinete e rorisitse matsapa a Mopresidente Jacob Zuma e le Monamodi ya emetseng Selekane sa Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tsa Borwa ba Aforika Ditherisanong tsa Zimbabwe, ho netefatseng hore mekga yohle ya dipolotiki e ikitlaelleditse dikgetho tse nang le kgotso.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi income imitamo yaMengameli Jacob Zuma njengeMchumanisi Wemmango Lotfutfukako We-Afrika LeseNingizimu kutiNgcoco Nekubonisa neZimbabwe ekucinisekiseni kutsi onkhe emacembu etepolitiki atinikele kulolukhetfo lolunekuthula.

src: Kabinete e seollotse tlhaselo ya qhomane moahong o sebediswang ke basebetsi ba Boqosa ba Turkey mane Mogadishu, Somalia, ya ba ya fetisa melaetsa ya matshediso Mebusong ya Somalia le Turkey.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi igceke kuhlasela ngebhomu kusakhiwo bekuhlaliswe kuso tisebenti teLihhovisi Lemancusa aseTurkey eMogadishu, Somalia, labuye futsi lalilela boHulumende kanye nebantfu baseSomalia nebaseTurkey.

src: Selemong se etellang pele phethelo ya Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho, kabinete e ikamahanya le setjhaba ho ketekeng Kgwedi ya Basadi tlasa mookotaba o reng “Dilemokgolo tsa ho Sebetsa Mmoho Matlafatsong ya Basadi ya Nako e Telele le Tekano ya Bong.”Dilemokgolo di tlotla dintwa tsa tokoloho tse lwannweng ke basadi haesale ho tloha ha moitseki ya qollehang, Charlotte Maxeke, a ile a etella pele sehlopha sa basadi mohwantong wa Bloemfontein o neng o hanana le melao ya dipasa ka 1913.Seabo se entsweng ke basadi twantshong ya melao ya dipasa esita le dikarolong tse ding tsa ntwa ya tokoloho ke ntho ya bohlokwa ya kgothatso Kareteng ya Boitsebiso e sa tswa thakgolwa.
tgt: Ngembi kwekuba Yiminyaka lengema-20 Yenkhululeko, Ikhabhinethi ihlanganyele nesive ekugubheni Inyanga yaBomake ngaphansi kwalesihloko “Umnyakalikhulu Wekusebentisana Kute Kuzuzwe Kuhlonyiswa Kwabomake Ngemakhono Nekulingana Ngekwebulili”.Lomnyakalikhulu uhlonipha kuzabalaza lokwentiwa bomake kusukela lapho sidlamlilo lesigcamile, Charlotte Maxeke, sahola litsimba labomake eBloemfontein emshucweni wekulwa nemitsetfo yekuphatfwa kwemapasi nga-1913.Ligalelo lelentiwa bomake ekulweni nemitsetfo yekuphatfwa kwemapasi futsi ngakuletinye tinhlangotsi talomzabalazo wenkhululeko tiyincenye lebalulekile lefake inshisekelo ekubeni khona kwaboMatisi labangemaKhadi labasandza kwetfulwa.

src: Jwaloka ha setjhaba se keteka basadi, Kabinete e boela e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho satalla kgahlanong le tlhekefetso efe kapa efe ya basadi le bana esita le ho hlompha ditokelo tsa basadi jwaloka ha di fuperwe ke Molaotheo.
tgt: Njengoba sive sigubha imphumelelo yabomake, Ikhabhinethi nayo imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi batsatse luhlangotsi balwe nekuhlukunyetwa kwabomake nebantfwana babuye bahloniphe emalungelo abomake njengoba agcinwe kumtsetfosisekelo.

src: Kabinete e ile ya pheta teboho ya pejana ya Mopresidente Jacob Zuma setjhabeng esita le matjhabeng ka ho etsa Letsatsi la Matjhaba la Nelson Mandela hore e be letsatsi le leholohadi ho fihlela jwale la keteko ya matswalo a Madiba.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi nayo iphindze livi laMengameli Jacob Zuma laphambilini lekubonga sive kanye nemmango wemhlaba ekwenteni Lusuku Lwemhlaba LwaNelson Mandela kutsi lube lusuku lolukhulu lolungatange selube khona lwekugubha kutalwa kwaMadiba.

src: Mohla la 18 Phupu, diketekete tsa batho Aforika Borwa ka bophara le lefatsheng di ile tsa ipha nako ya ho ya thusa batho ba sotlehang.
tgt: Mhla ti-18 kuKholwane tinkhulungwane tebantfu eNingizimu Afrika nasemhlabeni jikelele batinika sikhatsi sekusebenta basite bantfu labeswele.

src: Kabinete e ipileditse ho maAforika Borwa ho tshehetsa tlhomamiso ya Letsatsi la Dipapadi le Botjhaba la Nelson Mandela Lebaleng la FNB, Johannesburg, mohla la 17 Phato.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi imeme bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi besekele kwetfulwa nekumiswa kweLusuku LwaNelson Mandela Lwemidlalo Netemasiko eNkhundleni Yetemidlalo i-FNB, eJozi, mhla tili-17 Ingci.

src: Di-Springbok di tla bapala le Argentina, Bafana Bafana yona e tla thulana le Burkina Faso athe sehlopha sa bolo ya maoto sa Mekaubere sa Aforika Borwa se tla bapala le sa Italy, ho tla latela khonsarete ya mmino e tletseng dikgalala tsa dibini ka phirimana.
tgt: Emabhokobhoko atawudlala ne-Argentina, Bafana Bafana batawudlala neBurkina Faso bese kutsi Licembu lalabakhulile leliBhola laseNingizimu Afrika lona lidlale neTaliyane, bese kutsi ntsambama sekulandzela ikhonsathi yemculo wabososatiwako.

src: Tjhelete yohle e bokelletsweng moo e tla iswa projekeng ya kaho ya sepetlele sa Bana sa Nelson Mandela.
tgt: Yonkhe imali letawutfolakala lapho itawuyiswa kumklamo wesibhedlela sebantfwana iNelson Mandela.

src: Kabinete e ile ya boela ya pheta kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa ho “Nka Kgato ho Kgothalletsa Phetoho (le) ho Etsa hore Letsatsi le leng le le leng e be Letsatsi la Mandela”.Kabinete e tswelapele ho ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ohle hore a tswelepele ho bea Mopresidente wa mehleng Nelson Mandela menahanong le merapelong ya wona jwaloka ha a ntse a hlaphohelwa tshebedisong ya meriana ya kalafo.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi nayo futsi iphindze yamema bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi " Batsatse Tinyatselo Bashisekelele Ingucuko (futsi) Bente Tonkhe Tinsuku Tibe Lusuku LwaMandela".Ikhabhinethi iyachubeka nekumema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bachubeke bacabange babuye bathantazele Mengameli wayitolo Nelson Mandela njengoba elulama ekwelashweni nje.

src: Kabinete e mahlonokong ka ho hlokahala ha Moahlodi e Moholo wa mehleng Pius Langa, ya bolokilweng ka la 3 Phato nakong ya Lepato le Kgethehileng la Semmuso.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyadzabuka ngekusishiya emhlabeni kwaloyo bekaLijaji Lelikhulu Pius Langa lobekwe endlini yakhe yekugcina mhla titi-3 Ingci 2013 ngekuNgcwatjwa Ngendlela Lekhetsekile Yembuso.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso ho lelapa la hae, metswalle le basebetsimmoho.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iletsa emavi endvundvuto emndenini, kubangani kanye nakulabo bekasebenta nabo.

src: Moahlodi e Moholo wa mehleng Pius Langa o tla hopolwa ka seabo sa hae Ntweng ya tokoloho, tshireletso ya hae ya demokrasi ya rona e tataiswang ke molaotheo, athe morao tjena, le ka mosebetsi wa hae Khomisheneng ya Bolokolohi ba Ditaba.
tgt: Loyo bekaLijaji Lelikhulu Pius Langa utawukhunjulwa ngeligalelo lakhe lalifaka eMzabalazweni Wenkhululeko, kuvikela kwakhe intsandvo yelinyenti yemtsetfosisekelo wetfu kanye, nalakwente kamuva nje, umsebenti wakhe kuKhomishini Yekukhululeka Kwemaphephandzaba.6 Ikhabhinethi iyatibona tingucuko letinhle letentiwe kumkhakha wetemfundvo, ikakhulu kuciniswa kweSitatimende Senchubomgomo Yekharikhulamu Nekuhlola kanye nekwesekela kwabothishela lokuchubeka njalo ekuphunyelelisweni kwato.

src: Kabinete e hlokomela boteng ba dikgatelopele tse ntle lekaleng la thuto, haholoholo matlafatsong ya Setatemente sa Leano la Kharikhulamo le Tekanyetso esita le tshehetso e ntseng e tswelapele ya matitjhere ho kenngweng tshebetsong ha sona.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi yemukele kusungulwa kweLitsimba Lekusebenta lelimiselwe kulawula kuphunyeleliswa Kwekharikhulamu Yelulwimi Lwetimphawu LwaseNingizimu Afrika nga-2014 kusukela kuLibanga R kuya kuleli-12, ngekuhambisana nesimemo saMengameli sekutsi lulwimi lwetimphawu lutsatfwe njengelulwimi lolusemtsetfweni.

src: Kabinete e amohetse ho thewa ha Setlamo sa Tshebetso se filweng mosebetsi wa ho tsamaisa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha kharikhulamo ya Puo ya Matsoho ya Aforika Borwa ka 2013 ho tloha Kereiting ya R ho isa ho ya 12, ho ya ka kgoeletso ya Mopresidente ya hore puo ya matsoho e ananelwe e le ya semmuso.
tgt: Lekharikhulamu lensha itawenta bonkhe bantfu bakwati kutfola ematfuba etemfundvo.7 Ikhabhinethi imema labo labenta matikuletjeni nyalo nga-2013 kutsi babhalise nyalo etikhungweni tetemfundvo lephakeme kute bakwati kungena nga-2014 ngekuhambisana nemkhankhaso iKhetha weLitiko Letemfundvo Lephakeme Nekucecesha lotsi Bhalisa Nyalo!Bafundzi bakhutsatwa kutsi bacabangisise ngetinhlobo temisebenti labayifunako babese bahlola tidzingo tabo tetimali.

src: Kharikhulamo e ntjha e tla fana ka phihlello etomanyana menyetleng ya thuto bakeng sa bohle.
tgt: Bafundzi bakhunjutwa ngeSikimu Sekusita Bafundzi Ngetimali Savelonkhe lesisita ngetimali bafundzi labafanele ngekwemfundvo nalabaswele.8 Ikhabhinethi ihalalisa kwetfulwa kweshaneli yetindzaba tamabonakudze letawusakata ema-awa langema-24 letfulwe Yinhlangano Yetekusakata yaseNingizimu Afrika lephendvula kukhula kwelizinga lekufunwa kwetindzaba takamuva letimayelana nemikhosi noma-ke tehlakalo letibalulekile kuvelonkhe noma emhlabeni wonkhe lebuye futsi inikete bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika livi nenkhundla.9 Ikhabhinethi ihalalisela babhukushi Cameron van der Burgh, Chad le Clos naGiulio Zorzi lebente lelive latigcabha ngekutsi bawine timendlela eNhlanganweni Yemhlaba Yetekubhukusha Yebushampeni Bemhlaba ye-15 (FINA) eBarcelona.10 Ikhabhinethi ifisela eMasulumane aseNingizimu Afrika tilokotfo letinhle ekugubheni umkhosi wawo we-Eid.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho ba qetileng materiki ka 2013 ho ingodisa hona jwale ditheong tsa thuto e phahameng bakeng sa 2014 ho ya ka Letsholo la Khetha la Etsa Kopo Hona Jwale!
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ibuye futsi ifisele Ummango weMajuda waseNingizimu Afrika tilokokotfo letinhle tenyanga lenenjabulo ye-Elul.

src: la Lefapha la Thuto e Phahameng le Thupelo.
tgt: Tinkhulumiswano netincumo teKhabhinethi letihamba embili.

src: Baithuti ba kgothalletswa ho ba sedi ha ba kgetha seo ba batlang ho ithutela sona, ba be ba sekaseke ditlhoko tsa bona tsa ditjhelete.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ivume kutsi kucalwe inchubo yetingcoco tekubonisana mayelana Nekuma Kwenchubomgomo Yemanti Avelonkhe teLitiko Letemanti.

src: Baithuti ba hopotswa ka Sekema sa Setjhaba sa Thuso ya Baithuti ka Ditjhelete, se fanang ka thuso ya ditjhelete ho ba tshwanelehileng ho ya ka mesebetsi ya bona e metle dithutong esita le baithuti ba hlokang ditjhelete.
tgt: Inhloso yekubuyeketwa kwalenchubomgomo kutfola nekulungisa nanome nguyiphi imiphumela lengakahloswa kanye netikhala letikutinchubomgomo temanti tamanje.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa thakgolo ya kanale ya ditaba tsa thelevishene tsa ka nako tsohle ya Lekgotla la Kgaso la Aforika Borwa e rarollang tlhokeho e dulang e eketseha ya kgaso ya ditaba tsa moraorao diketsahalong tsa bohlokwa tsa naha le tsa matjhaba ebile e fa maAforika Borwa ohle lepatlelo la ho hlahisa maikutlo.
tgt: Loku kucondziswe ekuzuzeni Umgomo waHulumende wekufinyelela emanti ngalokukulinganako nalokuchubekela embili ngalokungenamkhawulo.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Cameron van der Burgh, Chad le Clos le Giulio Zorzi disesi tse entseng hore naha e be motlotlo ka ho hapa dikgau Ditlhodisanong tsa Lefatshe tsa 15 tsa Mokgatlo wa Matjhabatjhaba wa ho Sesa Barcelona.
tgt: Letimo letibuyeketiwe talenchubomgomo titawusita ekucondziseni kabusha emanti, emkhatsini walokunye, kubasebentisi bemanti labebancishwe emanti phambilini.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho thakgolwa ha mosebetsi wa dipuisano wa Lefapha la Merero ya Metsi bakeng sa Maemo a Maano a Naha a Metsi.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ivume kushicilelwa kweNchubomgomo Yemphahla Yengcondvo Yavelonkhe, kute kutsi bantfu bente tiphakamiso ngayo sikhatsi lesingemalanga langema-30.Lenchubomgomo ihlose kwenta kuhambisana ngalokuphelele nekulungisa tonkhe tinkinga letiphatselene nemphahla yengcondvo, letikhona kuyo yonkhe imikhakha, kufaka ekhatsi: tekuhweba, isayensi, tekulima kanye netemphilo.

src: Sepheo sa tjhebolobotjha ya leano lena ke ho fumana le ho lokisa ditlamorao dife kapa dife tse sa rerwang esita le dikgeo maanong a jwale a metsi.
tgt: Ngako-ke, kunesidzingo sekusebentisa inchubomgomo yinye emazingeni avelonkhe newemhlaba levela kuHulumende.

src: Sena se reretswe ho fihlella sepheo sa Mmuso sa phihlello e lekanang ya metsi ebile e le ya nako e telele.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ivume luhlakamsebenti lolumiselwe kulandzelela takhamuti lolubitwa ngekutsi “Ikhabhinethi ivume luhlakamsebenti lolumiselwe kulandzelela takhamuti lolubitwa ngekutsi vela kuHulumende.

src: Maemo a lekotsweng botjha a maano a tla thusa ho ajweng botjha ha metsi ho basebedisi ba metsi ba neng ba kotetswe nakong e fetileng.
tgt: Ematiko ahulumende labandzakanyeka ekwetfulweni kwetinsita kubantfu, adzingwa kutsi, alungise tinhlakamsebenti tawo telulandzelela nekuhlola kute tifake ekhatsi tindlela tekufaka ekhatsi imibono naloko takhamuti letihlangabetene nako mayelana nekwetfulwa kwetinsita.

src: A tla boela a netefatsa hore ha ho meralo ya motheo ya metsi e tla kwekwetla setjhaba, haholoholo setjhaba sa mahaeng se hlokang mehlodi metsi.
tgt: Loko kwakha sisekelo sekufaka ekhatsi kulandzelela lokumiselwe kutakhamuti kundlela yahulumende yekulandzelela.

src: Kabinete e ananetse phatlalatso ya Leano la Naha la Boithuelo ba Thepa, bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba ka nako ya matsatsi a 30.Leano le habile ho amanya le ho rarolla kahohlehohle dintlha tse fapafapaneng tse amanang le boithuelo ba thepa, bo phopholetsang hohle dinthong tse fapafapaneng, ho akga: kgwebisano, saense, temo le bophelo bo botle.
tgt: Kuloluhlakamsebenti, kulandzelela lokumiselwe kutakhamuti kuchaza indlela yekulandzelela kusebenta kwahulumende lokugcile kuloko takhamuti letetayelekile letihlangabetene nako kute kuciniswe kutiphendvulela kwebantfu kubuye futsi kuchube kwentiwa kancono kwetfulwa kwetinsita.

src: Kahoo ho na le tlhokeho ya mokgwatshebetso o le mong wa leano boemong ba naha le ba matjhaba ho tswa Mmusong.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ivume iMitsetfotimiso Yekuphatfwa Kwetimali Tahulumende Nematsimba Ekuphatsa Timali.

src: Kabinete e ananetse moralo wa leano bakeng sa tiso eo motheo wa yona e leng baahi ka sehlooho se reng “Moralo wa ho Matlafatsa dilekane tsa Baahi le Mmuso bakeng sa Tiso Phanong ya Ditshebeletso tsa Mantlha”.Mafapha a mmuso a amehang phanong ya ditshebeletso setjhabeng, a lebelletswe ho fetofetola tiso ya wona le meralo ya tlhahlobo ho kenyelletsa mekgwa ya ho kopanya maikutlo le malebela a baahi phanong ya ditshebeletso.
tgt: Lemitsetfotimiso iniketa inkhombandlela lemayelana nekutsi emandla eSiphatsimandla Lesiphetse abelwa kanjani Sisebenti Lesitiphendvulelako nekwendlulela kutimiso letincane njengoba kubekiwe kuMtsetfo Wetinsita TaHulumende kanye nakuMtsetfo Wekuphatsa Timali TaHulumende.

src: Sena se rala motheo wa ho kopanya tiso eo motheo wa yona e leng baahi le mokgwa wa tiso wa mmuso.
tgt: Lemitsetfotimiso yenta inchubo yekuphakela emandla ibe lula, lokutawukhutsata kwetfulwa kwetinsita kahle nangemphumelelo.

src: Sena se rala motheo bakeng sa ho kopanya tiso eo motheo wa yona e leng setjhaba mokgweng wa tiso wa mmuso.
tgt: Indvuna Yetemisebenti Yahulumende Nekuphatsa itawuchubeka ichaze leMitsetfotimiso kanye naloko letikucondzako esikhatsini lesitako.

src: Moralong ona, tiso eo motheo wa yona e leng baahi o hlalosa mokgwa wa tiso tshebetsong ya mmuso e tsepamisang maikutlo malebeleng a baahi ho matlafatsa boikarabelo ba setjhaba le ho sututsa dintlafatso phanong ya ditshebeletso.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ivume letivumelwano letilandzelako kutsi tivunywe ePhalamende ngekwemibandzela yeSiganba 231 seMtsetfosisekelo weRiphabliki yaseNingizimu Afrika: Kwekucala, Kufinyelela kweNingizimu Afrika eSivumelwaneni sekusungulwa kwe-Indian Ocean Tuna Commission (IOTC), Kwesibili Sivumelwano i-Conservation of Southern Bluefin Tuna (CCSBT) kanye neKwesitsatfu Sivumelwano Setindlela Letibukene Netikhumulo Temikhumbi tahulumende Tekuvikela Nekucedza Nya Kudvweba Tinhlanti Lokungekho Emtsetfweni, Lokungabikwa naLokungalawulwa (IUU) Kwenhlangano Yamhlabuhlangene Yekudla Netekulima (FAO).Indvuna Yetekulima, Temahlatsi Netinhlanti nayo iwungenele lomhlangano kute ichaze kabanti ngekubaluleka nemali lokutawuyiletsa kumboni yekudweba neligalelo lekutawulifaka ekukhuliseni umnotfo wetfu.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Mekgwatsamaiso ya Tsamaiso ya Setjhaba le Dithomo tsa Bolaodi ba Ditjhelete.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iphasise kutsi iNingizimu Afrika itawemukela ingenise Inkomfa Yemacembu (COP) ye-11 kuNkomfa ye-Abidjan eKapa kusukela mhla tingema-24-28 Indlovulenkhulu 2014.Inkomfa ye-Abidjan ingulesinye seTivumelwano Tetilwande Tetigodzi letili-18 lapho khona tinhlelo tekusebenta tentiwa Luhlelo Lwesimondzawo Lwamhlabuhlangene njengencenye yekuphumelelisa i-Ajenda ye-Stockholm ya-1972.Lenkomfa iniketa luhlakamsebenti lwetemtsetfo lwekubambisana kwesigodzi emkhatsini wemave latsintsekako kutsi asebentisane ekusombululeni tinkinga letihlangene tesimondzawo selugu nelwandle lanato.

src: Mekgwatshebetso e fana ka tataiso ya kamoo matla a Tshusumetso ya Phethahatso a neanwang ka teng ho Mohlanka ya Ikarabellang esita le ho ya boemong bo tlasenyana jwaloka ha ho hlakisitswe Molaong wa Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba le Molao wa Tsamaiso ya Ditjhelete tsa Setjhaba.
tgt: Umtimba lophakeme lotsatsa tincumo weSivumelwane se-Abidjan yiNkomfa Yemacembu ngumhlangano lobanjwa njalo ngeminyaka lemibili lohlanganisa Tindvuna Tesimondzawo kanye netingweti tebucwepheshe temacembu lanemaKontileka, kanye nemave labukelako, nalamanye ema-ejensi aMhlabuhlangene kanye netinhlangano letingekho ngaphansi kwaHulumende.

src: Kabinete e se e ananetse ditumellano tse latelang hore di amohelwa Palamenteng ho ya ka Karolo ya 231 ya Molaotheo wa Aforika Borwa: Ya pele, phihlello ya Aforika Borwa Tumellanong ya ho thewa ha Khomishene ya Tjhuna Lewatleng la India (IOTC), Ya bobedi ke Seboka se Seholo sa Poloko ya Tuna ya Bluefin ka Borwa (CCSBT) le Ya boraro, e leng Mokgatlo wa Dijo le Temo (FAO) wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng Tumellanong ya Mekgwatsamaiso ya Lediboho la Naha ho Thibela, ho se Kgothalletse le ho Fedisa Botshwasi ba Ditlhapi bo seng Molaong, bo sa Tlalehwang bo bile bo sa Laolwe (IUU).Letona la Temothuo, Meru le tsa Ditlhapi le lona le se le ikamahantse le kopano ena e le ho thatoloha ka boleng bo tla tliswa ke sena indastering ya botshwasi ba ditlhapi le seabo sa yona ho hodiseng moruo wa rona.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi yatiswa ngalombiko wekuhlanganyela kweLitsimba laseNingizimu Afrika kuKhomishini Yemhlangano waMhlabuhlangene Lemayelana Nesimo Sabomake yema-57, lebewubanjwe mhla titi-4 kuya kumhla tili-15 Indlovulenkhulu 2013.Umhlangano wema-57 bewubanjelwe eNhlokohhovisi yaMhlabuhlangene eNew York, futsi indzikimba lebeyihamba embili beyitsi eKucedvwa Kwebudlova lobentiwa kuBomake neMantfombatana”eKwentiwa kutinikela lokunyenti kwabuye futsi kwemukelwa njengetincumo ngulabo labahlanganyele ekucedzeni budlova lobentiwa kubomake nemantfombatana.

src: Setheo se hodimodimo sa Seboka se Seholo sa Abidjan se etsang diqeto, ke COP, e leng kopano ya ka morao a dilemo tse pedi e kgobokanyang Matona a Tikoloho le ditsebi tsa dintho tse sa utlwisiseheng habobebe tse tswang mekgatlong e Dumellanang, esita le dinaha tsa bolemohi, dieijensi tse ding tsa Matjhaba a Kopaneng le mekgatlo eo e seng ya mmuso.
tgt: Lombiko uphendvula Sifungo Setepolitiki lesimayelana nalokucondziwe lokulishumi kweLigciwane Lesandvulelangculazi Nengculazi lokususelwe kutinkhomba letibalulekile letibekiwe.

src: Kabinete e ile ya kumelwa ka tlaleho ya seabo sa borumuwa ba Aforika Borwa Mmokeng wa 57 wa Khomishene ya Matjhaba a Kopaneng ho tsa Maemo a Basadi, o neng o tshwerwe ho tloha ka la 4 ho isa ho la 15 Hlakubele 2013.Mmoka wa 57 o ne o tshwaretswe Ntlokgolo ya Matjhaba a Kopaneng New York, mme mookotaba o ka sehloohong e ne e le “Phediso ya Dikgoka kgahlanong le Basadi le Banana.”Boitlamo bo tomanyana bo ile ba etswa ba ba ba ananelwa ke ba neng ba nka seabo phedisong ya dikgoka kgahlanong le basadi le banana.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi income Litiko Letemphilo ngembiko lokhombisa kutsi iNingizimu Afrika isendleleni lefanele yekuzuza tinkhomba letinyenti letibalulekile nakufika sikhatsi semncamulajucu lesibekiwe, 20.9 Ikhabhinethi yatiswa ngekuphunyeleliswa kweSigaba 100 (1)

src: Kabinete e rorisitse Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle ka tlaleho e bontshang hore Aforika Borwa e motjheng wa ho fihlella bongata ba matshwao ka nako e sehilweng ya 20.9 Kabinete e ile ya kumelwa ka ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Karolo ya 100 (1)
tgt: Mhla tingema-31 Kholwane 2013 sikweleti lebesisele bekungu-R3,3 wetigidzigidzi kumalisikweleti lengu-R1,7 wetigidzigidzi ngesikhatsi icashelwa ngeliso lelibukhali ngeNgongoni 2011.Ngemuva kwekudvumisa tindlela tekulungisa letihleliwe kulamatiko lasihlanu lalawulwako, Ikhabhinethi ivumile kutsi Likomidi Letindvuna lingachubeka licale inchubo yetinyanga letisitfupha yekwendlulisa kulawulwa kweLimpopo likwendlulisele kuNdvunankhulu kunye neSigungu sakhe Lesiphetse lesisha.

src: Ba ile ba hlokomediswa ka diphumano tse ka sehloohong tse tlalehong ya tlhahlobo, mehato ya thusetso e sisintsweng le kgatelopele e seng e entswe ho fihlela jwale.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ivumile kutsi kuchutjwe neluphenyo lwetintfo letifuna kwenta tintfo tingahambi kahle nalapho futsi kutfolakele kutsi bantfu abakahambisi ngendlela lefanele tinchubo tekutfola tintfo letidzingekako, kutawubese kusetjentiswa tinchubo letifanele tekucondzisa tigwegwe.

src: Ba ile ba boela ba hlokomediswa ka dintho tse ntseng di salletse tse ntseng di tshwanela ho phethelwa.
tgt: Kutawubuye kube nalomunye umhlangano ngesikhatsi lesifanele lapho khona Likomidi Letindvuna litawubika kabanti.

src: Kabinete e dumetse hore dipatlisiso tse tomanyana di tshwanela ho tswelapele dinthong tse tobaneng le ho utolla mesebetsi e mebe mme moo batho ba fumanwang ba ile ba sitisa mekgwatsamaiso ya phumantsho, dikgato tse tshwanelehileng tsa kgalemo di tla nkuwa.
tgt: Ikhabinethi ivume kungeniswa kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekukala Ng`emtsetfo ePhalamende.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya tsa Molao ya Meteroloji Palamenteng.
tgt: Lomtsetfosivivinyo wentelwe kukhombindlela konkhe lokwentiwe yimboni nayihweba isebentisa tikali, emamitha kanye netisetjentiswa tekukala kutsi kuyanemba.

src: Bili e reretswe ho tataisa ho metha ho entsweng ke indasteri ha ho hwebisanwa ho sebediswa dikala, dimithara le disebediswa tse ding tsa ho metha ho botsekeng.
tgt: Lomtsetfosivivinyo uhlose kukhutsata kuhweba lokufanele, kuvikela temphilo yebantfu nekuphepha kanye nesimondzawo.

src: Sepheo sa Bili ke ho kgothalletsa kgwebisano e hlokang leeme, le ho tshireletsa bophelo bo botle le polokeho le tikoloho setjhabeng.
tgt: Lomtsetfosivivinyo utawubuye ulungise tinkinga temagebe eMtsetfo Wekukala Wetimboni wanga-1973 okhona nyalo.

src: Bili ena e tla boela e rarolla pherekano e Molaong wa jwale wa Meteroloji ya Kgwebisano (1973).Bili ena ke ntho ya bohlokwa tshebedisong e ntlehadi ya meralo ya motheo ya setekgeniki e fupereng Maemo, Tiiso ya Boleng, Kamohelo le Mekgwatshebediso ya meteroloji (SQAM) Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lomtsetfosivivinyo ubaluleke kakhulu ekwenteni kancono Simiso setebucwepheshe baseNingizimu Afrika lokufaka ekhatsi Emazinga, Kuciniseka Ngekhwalithi, Kufaneleka neNchubo yekukala (SQAM).

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya Sehlomathiso ya Meriana le Dithethefatsi tse Amanang le yona, 2012 Palamenteng.
tgt: Ikhabinethi ivume kungeniswa kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibiyela Temitsi Nalokusamitsi Lokuphatselene Nayo wanganga-2012 ePhalamende.

src: Bili e hlomathisa Molao wa Meriana le Dithethefatsi tse Amanang le yona, 1965 (Molao wa 101 wa 1965) jwaloka ha o hlomathisit swe ke Molao wa 72 wa 2008.
tgt: Lomtsetfosivivinyo uchibiyela Umtsetfo Wetemitsi Nalokusamitsi lokuphatselene nayo, wanga-1965 (Umtsetfo Nombolo.

src: Bili e habile ho thea setheo sa taolo ya meriana se matla, se setle se bile se sebetsa ka bokgabane.
tgt: Lomtsetfosivivinyo ufuna kusungula siphatsimandla sekulawula imitsi lesikahle nalesiphumelelako futsi lesinemandla.

src: DithonyoKabinete e ananetse dithonyo tse latelang:.
tgt: Kubekwa etikhundleniIkhabhinethi ivume kubekwa etikhundleni kwanaba labalandzelako:.

src: Moprofesara Edith Veronica Vries o hirilwe e le Motsamaisi e Moholo Lefapheng la Temo, Meru le tsa Ditlhapi.
tgt: Phrofesa Edith Veronica Vries ubekwe waba nguMcondzisi Jikelele weLitiko Letekulima, Temahlatsi Netinhlanti.

src: Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le dintlha tsa bohlokwa maemong a ha jwale.
tgt: Tincumo teKhabhinethi etindzabeni letigcamile kulesimo sanyalo.

src: Kabinete e amohetse ho kgakolwa phatlalatsa ha kgatiso ya botshelela ya Matshwao a Ntshetsopele ke Letona la Bopresidenteng la Bodisa le Tlhahlobo ya Tshebetso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukele kwetfulwa esiveni kwelushicilelo lwesitfupha lweTinkhomba tekuTfutfukisa lwetfulwa yiNdvuna eHhovisi leMengameli Letekucaphela Nekulinganisa Kusebenta kwaHulumende.

src: Jwaloka ha setjhaba se hlophisetsa ho keteka Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho, maAforika Borwa a tshwanela ho ba motlotlo ka hore bophelo bo fetohile ba ba ba ntlafala haesale ho tloha ka 1994.Matshwao a bontsha ntlafalo dinthong tsa bohlokwa athe a boela a supa mosebetsi o boima o ntseng o tshwanela ho etswa ho sebetsana le tse ding tsa diphephetso tsa rona tse ntseng di iphetapheta.
tgt: Njengoba sive silungiselela kugubha umkhosi weMinyaka yeNkhululeko lengema-20, bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bafanele batigcabhe ngekutsi imphilo seyagucuka yaba ncono kusukela nga-1994.Letinkhomba tinkhombisa kutfutfuka etindzaweni letibalulekile tibuye futsi ngesikhatsi sinye tinkhombise kusebenta kamatima lokusadzingekako kute kubukwane naletinye tinselele tetfu letisaphikelela.

src: Ho feta moo, matshwao a kgothalletsa ngangisano ka diphephetso tseo naha ya rona e tobaneng le tsona mme a boela a sebetsa ho thusa leetong la rona la kgatelopele ya moruo le phedisano.
tgt: Ngetulu kwaloko, letinkhomba tikhutsata inkhulumomphikiswano mayelana netinselele live letfu lelibukene nato futsi tisebenta njengetikhonkhwane endleleni yetfu yenchubekela embili kutenhlalo netemnotfo.

src: Kabinete e rorisitse 41% (115) ya bomasepala ba fumanweng ba se na diphoso ditsamaisong tsa ditjhelete ha ho ne ho etswa bahlahlobi ba dibuka tsa ditjhelete ba 2011/2012.
tgt: IKhabhinethi income ema-41% (115) wabomasipalati labatfola titatimende tetimali letihlobile kuluhlomabhuku lwetimali lwanga-2011/12.

src: E boetse ya ananela ntlafalo e entsweng ke bomasepala ba 21 bao nakong e fetileng ba ileng ba fumana ditsheollo tse amanang le selemo se fetileng.
tgt: Ichubekile futsi yabonga kwenta kancono lokwentiwe bomasipalati labange-21 lekwatsi phambilini emnyakeni lowendlulile batfola titatimende tekuhlolwa kwemabhuku letingasitinhle noma titatimende tekuhlolwa kwemabhuku lebetingakhombisi sitatimende lesimayelana nesimo setimali.

src: Kabinete e ananela mosebetsi o entsweng ke Kantoro ya Mohlakisi Kakaretso ka ho thusa bomasepala ho ntlafatsa ditlhoko tsa bona tsa boikamahanyo pusong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawutfokotela umsebenti lowentiwe nguMhlolimabhuku Jikelele ekusiteni labomasipalati kutsi bente kancono ekuhambisaneni netidzingo tekwengamela.

src: E ile ya boela ya ananela boikitlaetso bo entsweng ke boetapele ba bomasepala hore ba tswele pele ho sebeletsa ntlafalo dinthong tse hlakisitsweng ke Kantoro ya Mohlakisi Kakaretso.3 Kabinete e lebohile maAforika Borwa ohle ka ho tshehetsa Letsatsi la Dipapadi le Botjhaba la Nelson Mandela le neng le tshwaretswe ho thusa projeke ya Sepetlele sa Bana sa Nelson Mandela.
tgt: Ibuye futsi yabonga kutinikela kwebaholi babomasipalati ekuchubekeni nekusebenta kute kwentiwe kancono letindzawo letigcizelelwe nguMhlolimabhuku Jikelele.3 IKhabhinethi ibonge bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika ngekwesekela Lusuku LwaNelson Mandela Lwetemidlalo Nemasiko lolwentelwe kusita umklamo weSibhedlela Sebantfwana iNelson Mandela.

src: MaAforika Borwa a kgothalletswa ho tswelapele ho sebetsa dibakeng tsa bona le ho sebedisana le mmuso ho ntlafatsa maphelo a baahi esita le ho kenya tshebetsong mehopolo eo Madiba a ileng a nyehela bophelo ba hae ka lebaka la yona.4 Kabinete e nketse hloohong leeto le tlang la Mopresidente Jacob Zuma la ho ya Rephaboliking ya Russia.
tgt: Bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bayakhutsatwa kutsi bachubeke basebente emimangweni babuye futsi babambisane nahulumende kute kwentiwe kancono timphilo tetakhamuti kubuye futsi kufezekiswe emagugu Madiba lanikela imphilo yakhe kuwo.4 IKhabhinethi yatiswe ngeluhambo lolutako lwaMengameli Jacob Zuma lwekuvakashela iRiphabliki yaseRashiya.

src: O tla be a ya Sebokeng sa Setlamo sa 20 (G20) St Petersburg mohla la 5 le 6 Loetse 2013 e le karolo ya ho phahamisa ditabatabelo tsa Aforika Borwa tsa sepolotiki le tsa moruo.
tgt: Utawube ayohlanganyela kuNgcungcutsela Yelicembu LaMave langema-20 (G20) e-St Petersburgmhla tisi-5 namhla tisi-6 Inyoni 2013 njengencenye yekutfutfukisa nekukhutsata timfuno tetepolitiki netemnotfo taseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Aforika Borwa e tswelapele ho tshehetsa morero wa G20 wa ntshetsopele o ntshetsang pele botsitso ba moruo lefatsheng esita le kgolo le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi tse tla itjara ka nako e telele.5 Kabinete e rorisitse kopano ya pele ya Lekgotla la Kgwebo la Brazil, Russia, India, China le Aforika Borwa (BRICS), moo baetapele ba kgwebo ho tswa dinaheng tsena ba neng ba kgobokana Aforika Borwa.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika iyachubeka nekwesekela i-ajenda yekutfutfukisa ye-G20 letfutfukisa inchubekela embili lengenamkhawulo yemnotfo wemave emhlaba kanye nekukhula ngalokungenamkhawulo kwesikhatsi lesidze nekuvuleka kwemisebenti.5 IKhabhinethi income umhlangano wekucala weMkandlu weBhizinisi weBrazil, iRashiya, i-Indiya, iShayina kanye neNingizimu Afrika (BRICS), lowente kutsi baholi bemabhizini lababuya kulamave bahlangane eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kopanong ena ho ile ha boela ha eba teng baetapele ba bohlokwa ba kgwebo ba tswang dinaheng tse ding tse 19 tsa Aforika.6 Kabinete e amohetse tiisetso e fanweng Foramong ya bo12 ya Molao wa Kgolo le Monyetla wa Aforika (AGOA) ya ho ntjhafatsa AGOA pele e fellwa ke nako ka 2015.
tgt: Lomhlangano bewungenelwe futsi nabaholi bebhizinisi labagcamile lababuya kulamanye emave ase-Afrika lali-.6 IKhabhinethi yemukele sicinisekiso lesaniketwa eNkhundleni yemnyaka ye-12 yeMtsetfo Wekukhula Nematfuba we-Afrika (AGOA) kute kuvusetelwe i- AGOA ngembi kwekutsi iphelelwe sikhatsi nga-2015.

src: AGOA e foletse molemo ho tswa nahakgolo ya Amerika le ya Aforika ya ba ya tshehetsa kgwebisano ya naha tse pedi dipakeng tsa Aforika Borwa le Amerika e ntseng e hola ebile e tsitsa.
tgt: I-AGOA izuzise iMelika nelivekati lase-Afrika futsi icinise nesisekelo sekuhwebelana lokukhulako nalokusimeme lokusemkhatsini weNingizimu Afrika neMelika.

src: Aforika Borwa e dumela hore AGOA ke moralo o nepahetseng wa ho aha dikamano tse matla, tumellano ya kgwebisano ya dinaha tse pedi le matsete mme e matlafatsa tshebedisanommoho dipakeng tsa Amerika le nahakgolo ya Aforika ka bophara..7 E le karolo ya naha ka bophara ya ho keteka Kgwedi ya Basadi, Motlatsi wa Mopresidente Kgalema Motlanthe o tla etela Motsaneng wa Gombani o Masepaleng wa Mutale, Limpopo, ka Labohlano mohla la 23 Phato 2013 ho ya neelana ka matlo setjhabeng.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika ikholelwa ekutsini i-AGOA iniketa luhlakamsebenti lolufanele lwekwakha kuhwebelana lokuzuzisa lamave omabili kanye nebudlelwane belutjalomali nekucinisa kusebentisana emkhatsini weMelika kanye nelivekati lase-Afrika ngebubanti balo.7 Njengencenye yemgubho wavelonkhe weNyanga YaboMake, Lisekela laMengameli Kgalema Motlanthe ngaLesihlanu, 23 Ingci 2013 utawuvakashela Sigodzi saseGombani kuMasipala iMutale, eLimpopo, kuyowetfula tindlu kulommango.

src: 05 Sep Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le dintlha tsa bohlokwa maemong a ha jwale.
tgt: 05 Sep Tincumo teKhabhinethi etindzabeni letigcamile kulesimo sanyalo.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa ha Tokomane ya Tshebetso ya Setjhaba ebile e thoholetsa mekgatlo ya basebetsi tshebeletsong ya setjhaba esita le Mmuso e le mohiri boikitlaetsong bo entsweng Tokomaneng ena.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyakwemukela kwetfulwa kweMculu Wetemisebenti Yahulumende ubuye futsi uncome tinyonyane tebasebenti bahulumende kanye neMbuso njengemcashi kulokutinikela lokwentiwe ngaloMculu.

src: Tokomane e teka maemo a tshebeletso kahara tshebeletso ya setjhaba moo mekgatlo ya basebetsi tshebeletsong ya setjhaba e itlamang ho tshehetsa maemo a tshebeletso.
tgt: Lomculu ungenisa emazinga ekusebenta kutetinsita tahulumende lapho khona tinyonyane tebasebenti bahulumende tifunga ticinisekisa kutinikela kwato ekwesekeleni lamazinga ekusebenta.

src: Kabinete e hlokomela hore hajwale makala a mangata a kene kapa a ile a kena ditherisanong tsa meputso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakubona kutsi imikhakha leminyenti kwamanje noma-ke beyiloku ikhulumisana ngemiholo.

src: Kabinete e amohela ditumellano tse fihlelletsweng makaleng a mang mme e a tseba ka ditherisano tse ntseng di tswelapele makaleng a mang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyatemukela tincumo letentiwe kuleminye imikhakha futsi iyaticaphela tingcoco tekubonisana ngemiholo letisachubeka kuleminye imikhakha.

src: Kabinete e a ananela hore moo demokrasi e leng teng, basebetsi ba na le tokelo ya ho ipelaetsa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kutsi entsandvweni yelinyenti, tisebenti tinalo lilungelo lekutelega.

src: Kabinete e thasisetsa hore tokelo e jwalo e tlameha ho etswa ka mokgwa o se nang dikgoka ebile e le o ikamahanyang le molao ka hohlehohle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakugcizelela kutsi lilungelo lelinjalo lifanele lisetjentiswe ngendlela lete budlova kanye nekuhambisana nemtsetfo ngalokuphelele.

src: Ho na le boikarabelo baetapeleng ba mekgatlo ya basebetsi, bahiri le ditshebeletso tsa naha tsa tshireletso ho netefatsa hore molao ha o tlolwe, ho qojwa diketso tsa ho e lata letailana le hore mehwanto e etswe ka kgotso.
tgt: Baholi betinyonyane, bacashi kanye netinsita tetekuvikela tembuso tinesibopho sekwenta siciniseko sekutsi umtsetfo uyagcinwa, tento letibhebhetsela budlova tiyagwenywa nekutsi futsi titelega tentiwa ngekuthula.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa mekgatlong yohle ho sebedisa matsapa a yona ho phethela ditherisano kapelepele esita le ho qoba diqhwebeshano tsa nako e telele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema onkhe emacembu kutsi asebentise imitamo yawo ekusombululeni tingcoco tekubonisana ngemiholo ngekushesha kute kutsi kungwenywe tincabano letitsatsa sikhatsi lesidze kusonjululwa.

src: Ditumellano tseo tsa kapelepele di tla thusa ho fokotsa ditjeo moruong di be di kgothaletse katleho ya naha sepheong sa mesebetsi le kgolo.
tgt: Tisombululo letifinyelelwa masinyane titawusita ekunciphiseni tindleko kutemnotfo kanye nekukhutsata kuzuzwa kwemisebenti yalelive nemigomo yekutfutfuka.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Lekgotla la bobedi la Merafo la Selemo le selemo le neng le tshwerwe bekeng e fetileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukele umhlangano lobitwa ngekutsi pheceleti, Lekgotla Wekumbiwa Kwetimbiwa Wemnyaka lebewubanjwe kuleliviki leliphelile.

src: Lekgotla le hlahisitse monyetla o mong bakeng sa ba ka sehloohong ba amehang indastering ya merafo ho tswelapele ho fumaneng ditharollo tsa nako e telele diphephetsong tse thefulang lekala lena.
tgt: Le-Lekgotla letfule lelinye litfuba lekutsi badlalindzima lababalulekile kulemboni yekumbiwa kwetimbiwa bachubeke nekukhulumisana mayelana nekutfola tisombululo talomphela taletinselele lemboni lebukene nato.

src: Tlasa boetapele ba Motlatsi wa Mopresidente Kgalema Motlanthe, mmuso le wona o tswelapele ho tshehetsa tumellano ya moralo esita le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha lekala la merafo le nang le boitjaro ba nako e telele le bile le tsitsitse.
tgt: Ngaphansi kwebuholi beLisekela LaMengameli Kgalema Motlanthe hulumende naye uyachubeka nekwesekela luhlakamsebenti lwesivumelwane kanye nekuphunyeleliswa kwalo kumkhakha wekumbiwa kwetimbiwa lonenchubekela embili lengenamkhawulo nalesimeme.

src: Ditokisetsong tsa Tokoloho ya Dilemo tse 20 mohla la 27 Mmesa 2014, Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho hopola nalane ya rona le ho keteka botjhaba ba rona bo kopaneng ka ho se tshwane nakong ya Kgwedi ya Letlotlo la Setjhaba.
tgt: Kusachutjekwa kucondvwe kuMinyaka yeNkhululeko lenge-20 mhla tinge-27 Mabasa 2014, iKhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi sikhumbule umlandvo wetfu sibuye futsi sigubhe kwehlukahlukana kwemasiko etfu ngeNyanga Yetemafa Nemagugu.

src: Mekete ya monongwaha e tla tshwauwa tlasa mookotaba o reng: “Ho tseka botjha, ho Kgutlisa le ho Keteka Letlotlo la rona la Setjhaba le Phelang”.Mekete ya Letsatsi la Letlotlo la Setjhaba e tla tshwarelwa Lebaleng la Dipapadi la Sisa Dukashe le Mdantsane, Masepaleng wa Toropokgolo ya Buffalo, Porofenseng ya Kapa Botjhabela mohla la 24 Loetse 2013.E le karolo ya Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho, selekane sa dikgokahanyo tsa naha se tla etella pele ho kgakolwa ha ‘Labohlano la Tokoloho’ mohla la 20 Loetse 2013, se tla fanang ka lepatlelo ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho baballa tokoloho e lwanetsweng ka thata, ho netefatsa hore meloko e tlang e kgona ho fola molemo demokrasing ya rona e ntseng e hola.
tgt: Imigubho yalomnyaka itawube igujwa ngaphansi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Kubuyisa Emasisweni, Kubuyisela Endzaweni Lefanele kanye nekuGubha Temafa Nemagugu Etfu Laphilako”.Imigubho yemikhosi yeLusuku Lwetemafa Nemagugu itawentiwa eNkhundleni Yetemidlalo eSisa Dukashe eMdantsane, kuMasipala loMkulu i-Buffalo City, eSifundzeni saseMphumalanga Kapa mhla tinge-24 Inyoni 2013.Njengencenye yemkhankhaso weMinyaka yeNkhululeko lenge-20, tebudlelwane betekuchumana bavelonkhe butawetfula ‘Lesihlanu weNkhululeko’ mhla tinge-20 Inyoni 2013, lokutawuniketa bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika inkhundla lapho khona batawutfokotela inkhululeko yetfu lesayilwela sayitfola kamatima kute kucinisekiswe kutsi titukulwane letitako tikhone kuzuza kuntsandvo yetfu yelinyenti letfutfukisako.

src: Nakong ya Loetse, ho tshehetsa matsapa a bahahlaudi ba rona ba kahare, Kabinete e kgothalletsa maAforika Borwa ho etela ditsha tsa Letlotlo la naha ho re hopotsa ka leeto la rona la ho ya tokolohong.
tgt: NgeNyoni, ngekusekela imitamo yetfu yetekuvakasha kwangekhatsi eliveni lakitsi, iKhabhinethi ikhutsata bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bavakashele tindzawo temagugu kute sitikhumbute ngeluhambo lwetfu lwekuya enkhululekweni.

src: Hape, ho tshehetsa letlotlo la rona la tlholeho ka ho etela dipaka tsa naha mahala ho tloha mohla la 9 ho ya ho la 13 Loetse 2013 e le karolo ya borobedi ya selemo le selemo ya Beke ya Dipaka tsa Naha tsa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Phindze futsi, kwesekelwe emafa nemagugu etfu emvelo ngekutsi kuvakashelwe tindzawo tekungcebeleka nekukhibika tavelonkhe mahhala kusukela mhla tiyi-9 kuya kumhla ti-13 Inyoni 2013 njengencenye yemkhosi wemnyaka wesiphohlongo weLiviki Letindzawo Tekungcebeleka Nekukhibika Tavelonkhe taseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa batswadi le bahlokomedi bohle ho tshehetsa bana ba bona ditlhophisetsong tse tlang tsa Ditekolo tsa Naha tsa Selemo le Selemo (ANA), mokgahlelong wa ho bala le ho ngola esita le dipalo, tse tla tshwarwa dipakeng tsa mohla la 10 le 13 Loetse 2013.Batswadi le bahlokomedi ba tlameha ho netefatsa hore ba henahenana le diphetho tsa ANA tsa 2013 jwaloka ha di sebetsa e le sesebediswa sa bohlokwa sa tlhahlobo ya baithuti ya moo ba leng matla kapa moo ba fokolang teng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhutsata bonkhe batali nebalondvoloti bebantfwana kutsi besekele bantfwababo mayelana nemalungiselelo eKuhlolwa Kwavelonkhe Kwemnyaka (i-ANA) letitako kutekukwati kubhala nekufundza kanye netekubala letitawentiwa emkhatsini wamhla ti-10 namhla ti-13 Inyoni 2013.Batali nebalondvoloti bebantfwana bafanele bente siciniseko sekutsi bayayibuka imiphumela ye-ANA yanga-2013 njengoba loku kulithulusi lelihle lekutfola emandla nebutsakatsaka bebafundzi.

src: Boitlhophisetsong ba ANA e tlang batswadi, bahlokomedi le baithuti ba kotjwa ho sebedisa disebediswa tseo ba di filweng ke Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo.
tgt: Mayelana nemalungiselelo ale-ANA letako batali, balondvoloti bebantfwana kanye nebafundzi bayacelwa kutsi basebentise lamathulusi laniketwa Litiko Letemfundvo Lesisekelo.

src: Tsena di ka fumanwa websaeteng ya Lefapha (WEBTOKEN).
tgt: Lamathulusi atfolakala kuwebhusayithi yeLitiko letsi: WEBTOKEIKhabhineti yendlulisa umlayeto wekwesekela emasotja Embutfo Wetekuvikela Wavelonkhe waseNingizimu Afrika latfunyelwa emphumalanga yeDemocratic Republic of the Congo kusukela mhla ti-13 Inhlaba 2013 kuya kumhla tinge-31 Indlovulenkhulu 2014.

src: MaAforika Borwa a kopjwa ho tshehetsa le ho ananela masole ana a etsang mosebetsi wa bohlokwa o phethahatsang boikitlaetso ba Aforika Borwa ba kgotso, botsitso le matlafatso ya demokrasi kontinenteng ya Aforika.
tgt: Kumenywa bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi besekele babuye bahloniphe lamasotja latikhali tekucinisekisa kutinikela kweNingizimu Afrika kutekuthula, kusimama kanye nekucinisa intsandvo yelinyenti kulelivekati le-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa dikgiro tsa Mopresidente tsa Ntate Mxolisi Sandile Oliver Nxasana e le Motsamaisi e Moholo Botjhotjhising ba Setjhaba ba Naha le Vasantri Soni (SC) e le Hlooho ya Yuniti e Ikgethileng ya Dipatlisiso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idvumisa kubekwa esikhundleni lihhovisi laMengameli kweMnu Mxolisi Sandile Oliver Nxasana sekuba Mcondzisi waVelonkhe weTekushushiswa naVasantrai Soni njengeNhloko yeLuphiko Lwekuphenya Lolukhetsekile.

src: Kabinete e lakaletsa setjhaba sa Majuda a Aforika Borwa Rosh Hashanah e monatenate (5-6 Loetse 2013).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ifisela Ummango weMajuda waseNingizimu Afrika tilokotfo letinhle tekugujwa kwemkhosi wawo we-Rosh Hashanah (kusukela mhla tisi-5 kuya kumhla tisi-6 Inyoni 2013).

src: Rosh Hashanah e na le tshusumetso ya bohlokwa setjhabeng sa Majuda hobane e bontsha qalo ya mosebetsi wa boitlhahlobo le boitekolo eo sethatho sa yona e leng Yom Kippur, Letsatsi la Tshwarelano.
tgt: I-Rosh Hashanah ibaluleke kakhulu kuMmango weMajuda ngoba ikhombisa kucala kwenchubo yekutihlolisisa nekubuyeketa lokufikela ku-Yom Kippur, Lusuku Lwekungcweliswa.

src: Kabinete e fetisa molaetsa wa matshediso ho Letona Mthethwa le ba lelapa labo ka ho hlokahallwa ke mmae, Mme Nurse Gumbi ka la 03 Loetse Dipuisano le diqeto tsa bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ililela Indvuna Mthethwa nemndeni wakhe mayelana nekushona kwamake wakhe Nks.

src: Kabinete e amohetse tlaleho ka diphetho tsa Sesebediswa sa Ditekolo tsa Tshebetso ya Bolaodi (MPAT) sa mafapha a naha le a diporofense bakeng sa selemo sa ditjhelete sa 2012/13.
tgt: Nurse Gumbi mhla titi-3 Inyoni Tinkhulumiswano netincumo teKhabhinethi letibalulekile.

src: Tlaleho ke sesebediswa se seng se habileng ho ntlafatsa boleng ba ditshebeletso tseo mafapha a fanang ka tsona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi itfole umbiko mayelana nemiphumela yeLithulusi Lekuhlola Kusebenta Kwebaphatsi bematiko avelonkhe newetifundza ngemnyaka wetimali 2012/13.

src: E lekola dibaka tse nne tse batsi tsa bolaodi e leng bolaodi ba phano ya disebediswa bolaodi ba basebetsi merero ya mawa mmoho le ntlafatso ya phano ya ditshebeletso.
tgt: Lombiko ungulelinye lithulusi lelihlose kwenta kancono lizinga letinsita letiniketwa ngulamatiko.

src: Tekolo e etswa mehatong e meraro, boitekolo ka bowena ho latele tlhahlobo ya mosebetsi ya bohlakisi ba kahare ba dibuka tsa ditjhelete ho qetelwe ka ya ho lekolwa ke sehlopha se ikemetseng sa balekodi.
tgt: Lihlola tindzawo letibanti letine letiphetfwe lekukutsengwa nekutfolakala kwetintfo netinsita letidzingwako kuphatfwa kwebasebenti kuhlela ngekwelisu kanye nekwentiwa kancono kwetfulwa kwetinsita.

src: Tlaleho e tla boela e tsenkollwa ke Lefapha la Bodisa le Tlhahlobo ya Tshebetso nakong ya ho thakgolwa ho seng ho hlophisitswe ha MPAT bekeng e tlang Cape Town.
tgt: Loluhlolo lwentiwa ngetigaba letintsatfu, kutihlola inchubo yekulungisa leyentiwa ngumhlolimabhuku wangekhatsi bese kutsi ekugcineni kulungisa litsimba lalabalungisi labatimele.

src: Kabinete e amohetse ya ba ya ananela ditlaleho tsa kotare ya pele ya 2013/14 ho kenngweng tshebetsong ha Ditumellano tsa Phano bakeng sa Diphetho.
tgt: Lombiko utawubuye ucaciswe kabanti Litiko Letekucaphela Nekulinganisa Kusebenta Kwahulumende nakwetfulwa i-MPAT eKapa kuleliviki lelitako.

src: Ditlaleho tsena di tla tsenkollwa nakong ya lethathamo le rerilweng la dipuisano le ba mehlodi ya ditaba bakeng sa se seng le se seng sa Diphetho tse Kabinete e bone tlaleho e tswang ho ‘Projeke ya ho Tloswa ha Lesedi le Lebe la Sekoloto’ mme ya ananela ditshisinyo tsa Komiti e Kgethehileng ya Kgwebisano le Dikamano tsa Matjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi itfole yabuye yemukela imibiko yekota yekucala yanga-2013/14 yekuphunyeleliswa kweTivumelwane Tekusebenta teMiphumela.

src: Bana ke bareki bao e ka nnang yaba ba qetile ho lefa dikoloto tsa bona ka botlalo mme ba boemong boo ba ka kgonang sekoloto empa hajwale, phihlello ya bona e hakureditswe ke lesedi le lebe la sekoloto direkotong tsa bona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi itfole umbiko lovela ‘kuMkamo Wekususa Lwatiso Lolunga Nemtselela Lomubi Ekutfoleni Sikweleti’ yabuye futsi yavuma tincomo teLikomodi Lemkhandlu Wetifundza Wavelonkhe kuTekuhweba Nebudlelwane Bemave Emhlaba.

src: Sena se habile ho netefatsa hore Molao wa Naha wa Sekoloto (Molao 34 wa 2005) o sebetsa ho ya kamoo o rerilweng ka teng ho netefatsa hore bareki ba ka kgonang sekoloto ba se ke ba kolotelwa.
tgt: Loku kucondze kulungisa ludzaba lwekufinyelela kutfola tikweleti kwalabo bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labangakhona kutfola tikweleti.

src: Sekoloto se sa fihlelleheng kapa se turang se sithabetsa kgolo.
tgt: Loku kungaba batsengi labakhokhele tonkhe tikweleti tabo ngalokuphelele futsi sebasesimeni sekutsi banganikwa lesinye sikweleti kepha kufinyelela kwabo leso sikweleti kuvinjwe lwatiso lwetikweleti lolungaluhle kumarekhodi abo.

src: Phihlello mmarakeng wa sekoloto wa nako e telele e a hlokeha sepheong sohle sa ntshetsopele.
tgt: Loku kumayelana kakhulu nekucinisekisa kutsi Umtsetfo Wetikweleti Wavelonkhe (Umtsetfo 34 wanga-2005) usebenta njengobe kuhlosiwe mayelana nekucinisekisa kutsi batsengi labangakhona kunikwa sikweleti, bayakhona kusifinyelela.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Pampiri e Tshweu ya ho Busetsa Ditlamong esita le ho tekwa ha yona Palamenteng.
tgt: Kungafinyeleleki noma kubita kakhulu kwesikweleti kukhinyabeta kukhula.

src: Moralo wa nakwana wa Pampiri e Tshweu o habile ho ntlafatsa ho laolwa ha mokgwatshebetso wa ho emela ho bua nyewe motho a le ditlamong ditjhankaneng tsa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Kufinyeleleka kwemakethe yetikweleti lechubekela embili ngalokungenamkhawulo kubaluleke kakhulu kuyo yonkhe imigomo yekutfutfukisa.

src: Pampiri e hlakisa mekgwatshebetso e tla susumetsa bolaodi ba ditlamong ba ho busetsa ditlamong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume Umtsetfosihlongoto lomayelana nekuBuyiselwa Emuva Kwelicala Uboshiwe kanye nekungeniswa kwawo ePhalamende.

src: Tlaleho e tla ntshuwa ho ya ka metjha ya Palamente.
tgt: Luhlaka lweMtsetfosihlongoto luhloso kwentiwa kancono kwenchubo kumela kutekwa kwelicala uboshiwe emajele aseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e dumetse hore Mmoka wa Sehlopha sa Dihlomo o romelwe Palamenteng bakeng sa kananelo.
tgt: Lomtsetfo lohlongotwako uniketa emabalengwe emitsetfosimiso lotawuchuba kulawulwa kubuyiselwa emuva kwelicala uboshiwe.

src: Kabinete e tshehetsa ho senngwa ha thepa ya sehlopha sa dihlomo e le ho ikamahanya le Mmoka ona.
tgt: Lombiko utawukhiswa ngenchubo yePhalamende.

src: Ka Pudungwana ya 2006 seboka sa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) ha se a ka sa fihlella tumellano ya kamoo sefutho sa botho sa ho rarolla bothata ba dihlomo tsena se leng kateng.
tgt: NgeLweti 2006 inkhomfa yaMhlabuhlange ayikhonanga kufinyelela sivumelwane lesimayelana nekutsi kufanele kubukwane kanjani nemphumela lomubi lowenteka kubantfu lobangelwa nguletikhali.

src: Sena se ile sa lebisa moo sehlopha sa dinaha tse 46, ho akga le Aforika Borwa, se ileng sa eba motjheng o mong o kathoko ho UN, o bitswang Mosebetsi wa Oslo, ho kwala sehlopha sa dihlomo.
tgt: Loku kwaholela ekutsini kube nelicembu lemave lange-46, lelifaka ekhatsi iNingizimu Afrika, lelacala inchubo ngaphandle kwaMhlabuhlangene, lelibitwa ngekutsi pheceleti Oslo Process, lavala kusetjentiswa kwetikhali letitichumane.

src: Aforika Borwa mmoho le dinaha tse ding tse 93 e tekenne Mokgwatshebetso ka Tshitwe ya 2008.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika kanye nalamanye eMave lange-93 asayina Sivumelwane ngeNgongoni 2008.

src: Mohla la 1 Phato 2010 Mokgwatshebetso o ile wa kenngwa tshebetsong.
tgt: Mhla lu-1 Ingci 2010 leSivumelwane sacala kusebenta.

src: Mokgwatshebetso o kwala tshebediso, tlhahiso, poloko ya thepa le phetiso ya mofuta o itseng wa sehlopha sa dihlomo.
tgt: LeSivumelwane sala kusetjentiswa, kukhicitwa, kugcinwa kwesitoko kanye nekwendluliswa kwemikhakha letsite yetikhali letitichumane.

src: Kananelo ya Mokgwatshebetso e tsamaisana le boikitlaetso ba Aforika Borwa ba ho boloka ditokelo tsa botho le molao wa botho ha e sebetsana le dintwa.
tgt: Kuvunywa kwaleSivumelwane kuyahambisana nekutinikela kweNingizimu Afrika kugcina emalunga eluntfu kanye nemitsetfo lebukene nebantfu nakuliwa.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha tlaleho ya Tlhahlobo ya Dibuka tsa Ngodiso ya Mobu wa Mmuso le tshekatsheko e sa tebang ya Boithuelo ba Poraefete ba Mobu Aforika Borwa, e entsweng ke Mohlahlobikakaretso e Moholo wa tsa Mobu, Palamenteng.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ivume kungeniswa kwembiko mayelana nekuHlolwa Kwemhlaba Wembuso Lobhalisiwe kanye nekucutjungulwa Kwekuba Ngumninimhlaba Wangasense eNingizimu Afrika, nguMhloli Lomkhulu Jikelele, ePhalamende.

src: Lesedi le mabapi le mobu le bohlokwa haholo dintshetsopeleng tsohle tse amanang le mobu naheng.
tgt: Lwati mayelana nemhlaba lubaluleke kakhulu ekuphumeleleni kwato tonkhe tintfutfuko letenteka eveni.

src: Sepheo sa tlhahlobo ya dibuka tsa ngodiso ya mobu wa mmuso ke ho fumana hore na mmuso o na le mobu o mokae, o sebedisetswa eng le hore na basebedisi ba wona ke bomang.
tgt: Inhloso yaloluhlolomabhuku lwemhlaba wembuso lobhalisiwe kutfola kutsi ungakanani umhlaba longewembuso, usetjentiselwa ini nekutsi futsi bobani labahleti kuwo nome labawusebentisako.

src: Sena se tla sebedisetswa ho ntlafatsa botshepehi ba rejistara ya mobu, e tla sebetsa e le motheo bakeng sa thero le tsamaiso tsa mobu tse ntlafaditsweng, ho akga le mesebetsi e meng e amanang le bolaodi ba tshebetso ya thepa esita le phano e ntlafaditsweng ya ditshebeletso.
tgt: Loku kutawenta kancono bucotfo berejista yemhlaba, lokutawuba sisekelo sekwentiwa kancono kuhlelwa kwemhlaba nekuwulawula, kufaka ekhatsi leminye imisebenti lephatselene nekulawulwa kwephothifoliyo yemphahla leyitakhiwo) kanye netinsita letentiwe ncono.

src: Kabinete e ananetse metako ya Khamphane ya Popo ya Tjhelete Aforika Borwa bakeng sa lethathamo la sehopotso sa tjhelete e lewana ya 24 ct ya kgauta ya R2 ya 2013 (1/4 oz) le lethathamo la sehopotso sa tjhelete e lewana ya 24 ct ya kgauta ya R1 (1/10 oz).Motako wa tjhelete e lewana ya kgauta ya R2 ya 2013 o tla ngolwa ka puo ya Sekgothu athe motako wa tjhelete e lewana ya kgauta ya R1 ya 2013 e tla ba tlhoka ya boraro – Mohlampepe wa Ditholwana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume emadizayini eNkampani Lekhicita Imali YaseNingizimu yanga-2013 ya-R2 (1/4 oz) weluchungechunge lwelunhlavumali lwesikhumbuto lolungu-24 ct weligolide kanye na-2013 R1 (1/10 oz) weluchungechunge lweluhlavumali lolungu-24 ct weligolide.

src: Metako ya tjhelete e lewana mmoho le Mahlalosi a tsona di tla hatiswa Koranteng ya Melawana ya Mmuso.
tgt: Idizayini yanga-2013 ya-R2 loluhlavu loligolide itawufaka ekhatsi lulwmi lwema-San bese kutsi idizayini yanga-2013 ye-R1 leliyinhlavu leligolide itawuba yi-pollinator yesitsatfu – i-Fruit Bat.

src: Kamorao ho moo, di tla etswa mme di rekiswe ka metjha e tlwaelehileng.
tgt: Lokudizayinwa kwalemali letinhlavu kanye neTimemetelo kutawubhalwa kuGazethi yaHulumende.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha ditlaleho tse tharo tse amanang le kgatelopele e entsweng tshireletsong ya ditokelo le bophelo bo botle ba bana Komiting ya Matjhaba a Kopaneng ya Ditokelo tsa Ngwana le Komiti ya Boqhetseke ya Kopano ya Aforika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume kungeniswa kulikomidi laMhlabuhlangene lelibukene neMalungelo eMntfwana kanye nakuLikomidi Letingcweti Tetinyonyane tase-Afrika imibiko lemitsatfu lephatselene nenchubekela embili leyentiwe ekugcineni emalungelo nekuphila kahle kwebantfwana.

src: Ditlaleho di fana ka monyetla wa bohlokwa o nang le ponaletso bakeng sa Aforika Borwa ho sekaseka kgatelopele eo e seng e e entse dintlheng tsenaa) Tlaleho ya Naha ka Prothokhole e sa Tlameng ka Thekiso ya Bana, Bootswa ba Bana le ho Nyweka ha Bana.
tgt: Lemibiko iniketa iNingizimu Afrika litfuba lekubeka tintfo ebaleni nalelibalulekile lekuhlola inchubekela embili leliyentile kuletindzawoa) Kubika Kwelive mayelana nePhrothokholi Yekutikhetsela yeKutsengiswa kweBantfwana, Kwengisa Ngemitimba Yebantfwana kanye Nekwenta Imibukiso Yetemacansi Yebantfwana.

src: b) Tlaleho e akaretsang ya bobedi, ya boraro le ya bone ka Mmoka wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng ka Ditokelo tsa Ngwana.
tgt: b) umbiko lohlanganisiwe wesibili, wesitsatfu newesine mayelana neSivumelwane SaMhlabuhlangene mayelana neMalungelo eBantfwana.

src: c) Tokomane ya Aforika ka Ditokelo le Thekolohelo ya Ngwana: Tlaleho ya Pele ya Naha Komiting ya Boqhetseke ya Kopano ya Aforika Ditokelong le Thekolohelong ya Ngwana.
tgt: c) Umculu wase-Afrika lemayelana neMalungelo Nekondleka Kahle kweBantfwana: Umbiko Welive wekucala lobhekiswe kuTingcweti TetiNyonyane Tase-Afrika mayelana neMalungelo Nekondleka Kahle Kwemntfwana.

src: Kabinete e leboha lethathama la mekgatlo ya setjhaba ka boikitlaetso esita le balekane ba matjhaba ba ikopantseng le mmuso ka ho hlokomela boikitlaetso bo entsweng ke Molaotheo wa rona baneng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibonga imimango lehlukahlukene letinikele kanye nalekusetjentiswana nabo bemave angaphandle lababambisene nahulumende ekuphumeleliseni lokutinikela ekuvikeleni bantfwana lokususelwa kuMtsetfosisekelo wetfu.

src: Dibili.
tgt: Imitsetfosivivinyo.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya Sehlomathiso ya Pusetso ya Ditokelo tsa Mobu Palamenteng.
tgt: Ikhabinethi ivume kungeniswa ePhalamende kwekweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibiyela Emalungelo Ekubuyiselwa Kwemhlaba Kubanikati Bawo Labafanele.

src: Bili e hlomathisa Molao wa Pusetso ho eketsa letsatsi la ho qetela bakeng sa ho kenngwa ha ditseko tsa pusetso ya mobu ho ya fihla ho la 31 Tshitwe 2018 ho etsetsa hore e be tlolo ya molao ho kenngwa ha tseko ka bolotsana nolofatso ya tsamaiso bakeng sa ho kgethwa ha Baahlodi Lekgotleng la Ditseko tsa Mobu esita le ho hlomathiswa ha dikarolwana tse itseng tse reretsweng ho kgothalletsa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Molao ka bokgabane.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uchibiyela Umtsetfo Wekubuyiselwa Kwemhlaba Kubanikati Bawo Labafanele kute kuchutjelwe embili lusuku lwekufaka ticelo tekubuyiselwa umhlaba kumhla tinge-30 Ingongoni 2018 kwentiwa kube licala lebugebengu kufaka sicelo sekubuyiselwa umhlaba lesingesilo liciniso kwentiwa kube lula inchubo yekubekwa etikhundleni kweMajaji eNkantolo Yeticelo Tekubuyiselwa Umhlaba kanye nekuchitjelwa kwemigomo letsite lecondze kukhutsata kuphunyeleliswa kahle kwaloMtsetfo.

src: Ho bulwa botjha ha ho kenngwa ha ditseko ho tataiswa ke tjhebelopele ya Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP) esita le Lenaneo le Phethahetseng la Ntshetsopele ya Dibaka tsa Mahaeng le mawa a mang a kgolo a reretsweng ho kgothalletsa poelano ya setjhaba le momahano ya setjhaba.
tgt: Lokuvulwa kabusha kwekufakwa kweticelo tekubuyiselwa umhlaba kucondziswa ngumbononchanti weLuhlelo Lwekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe (i-NDP) kanye neLuhlelo Lolubanti Lwekutfutfukiswa Kwetindzawo Tasemaphandleni kanye nelamanye emasu ekutfutfukisa lekuhloswe ngawo kutsi kutfutfukiswe kubuyisana nekubumbana kwetenhlalo kuvelonkhe.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya Sehlomathiso ya Melao ya Saense le Theknoloji, 2013 Palamenteng.
tgt: Ikhabinethi ivume kungeniswa ePhalamende kweMitsetfo yeteSayensi neteBucwepheshe, Umtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibiyela.

src: Bili ya Sehlomathiso e sebetsana le dihlomathiso tsa lethathama la Melao e laolang tshebetso ya ditheo (makgotla a saense) tse neng di thewe ho ya ka Melao eo.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo wekuChibiyela ubukene nekuchibiyela Imitsetfo yetikhali temphi leyengamele kusebenta kwemitimba (imikhandlu yetesayensi) leyasungulwa ngekuya kwaleMitsetfo lekukhulunywa ngayo.

src: Bili e habile ho nolofatsa mosebetsi wa ho thonngwa le ho kgethwa ha ditho esita le ho kwalwa ha dikgeo Dibotong kapa Makgotleng a ditheo tseo.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uhlose kwenta kube khona kuhambisana kwenchubo yekuphakamisa, kubekwa esikhundleni kwemalunga, kanye nekuvalwa kwetikhala temisebenti kumaBhodi noma kumiKhandlu yalemitimba.

src: Bili e ntlafatsa tshebetso e ntle le tshwano mosebetsing le taolong ya ditheo tsa setjhaba tse tlalehang ho Letona la Saense le Theknoloji.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo wenta kancono lokwenetisako nangalokungagucuki ekusebenteni nasekwenganyelweni kwemitimba yahulumende lebika eNdvuneni yeteSayensi neTebucwepheshe.

src: Ho matlafatseng seabo sa tekolo sa Palamente, Bili e habile ho lokolla Palamente boikarabelong bo itseng ba phethahatso bo amanang le ho kgethwa ha ditho esita le ho kwalwa ha dikgeo Dibotong tseo kapa Makgotleng ao.
tgt: Ekuciniseni indzima ledlalwa yiPhalamende emisebentini leyengamele, loMtsetfosivivinyo uhlose kukhulula iPhalamende kuleminye imisebenti yetekuphatsa letsite lephatselene nekubekwa kwemalunga ePhalamende nekugcwalisa tikhala temisebenti kumaBhodi nakuMikhandlu.

src: Sena se dumellana le mokgwatshebetso wa molaotheo wa ho arolwa ha matla.
tgt: Loku kuhambisana nemtsetfomgomo wemtsetfosisekelo wekwehlukaniswa kwemandla.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho phatlalatswa ha Bili ya Ditaba tsa Setso Koranteng Melawana ya ya Mmuso bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba.
tgt: IKhambinethi ivume kushicilelwa kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wetendzabuko kuGazethi yaHulumende kute kutsi kwentiwe tiphakamiso.

src: Bili e fana ka dintlha tsa molao bakeng sa kananelo ya Bakgothu ebile e rarolla bothata ba ho kgoneha molaong o seng o le teng o amanang le boetapele ba setso le puso.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo wenta kutsi emaKhoi-San emukelwe ngalokusemtsetfweni ubuye futsi ulungise imikhawulo lekumitsetfo lekhona yebuholi bendzabuko nekwengamela.

src: Haesale ho tloha ka 1994 mmuso o ile wa nkela hloohong diphephetso tse amanang le Bakgothu, haholoholo kananelo ya setjhaba sa bakgothu le baetapele.
tgt: Kusukela nga-1994 hulumende ubukene netinselele emaKhoi-San labukene nato futsi ikakhulu, kunakwa nekwemukelwa kwemimango yemaKhoi-San nebaholi.

src: Bili e tla thusa pehelong ya bohlokwa ya NDP e amanang le ho etswa batsi ha momahano ya setjhaba le kopano, ha ka lehlakoreng le leng e ntse e rarolla bothata ba nako e fetileng ba ho se lekane.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo utawufaka ligalelo kulokubalulekile kakhulu lokuhloswe yi-NDP lephatselene nekukhulisa kuvana nekubumbana kwetenhlalo ube futsi ulungisa kungalingani kwaphambilini.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Moralo wa Tjhebobotjha ya Leano la Molao wa Naha wa Sekoloto le Bili ya Sehlomathiso ya Naha ya Sekoloto bakeng sa ho tekwa Palamenteng.
tgt: Ikhabinethi ivume kungeniswa ePhalamende kweLuhlakamsebenti Lwekubuyeketwa KweMtsetfo Wetikweleti Wavelonkhe neMtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibiyela Umtsetfo Wetikweleti.

src: Molao wa Naha wa Sekoloto, 2005 (Molao 34 wa 2005) o kene tshebetsong ka botlalo ka la 1 Phuptjane 2007 mme wa hlahisa boemo bo botjha ba ditaolo tsa sekoloto tshebetsong ya molao ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Umtsetfo Wetikweleti Wavelonkhe, 2005 (Umtsetfo 34 wanga-2005) wacala kusebenta ngalokuphelele kusukela mhla lu-1 Inhlaba 2007 wangenisa sikhatsi lesisha sekulawulwa kwetikweleti kunchubo yetemtsetfo yaseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Sepheo sa Bili ke ho matlafatsa bokgoni ba Molaodi wa Naha wa Sekoloto (NCR) ho rarolla diphephetso tse itseng haholoholo mabapi le mesebetsi ya lekgotla la dinyewe esita le ho matlafatsa ho qobella le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha dikateng tsa Molao wa Naha wa Sekoloto wa 34 wa 2005.Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Indasteri (dti) le lona le qetile ka hore moralo wa leano wa Sekoloto sa Bareki, moo Molao wa Naha wa Sekoloto wa 34 wa 2005 o fumanweng teng, o motle ebile o nepahetse.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uhlose kucinisa Umlawuli Wetikweleti Wavelonkhe kute abukane netinselele letitsite ikakhulu mayelana netinchubo tenkantolo nekucinisa kusentjentiswa nekuphunyeleliswa kwemigomo yeMtsetfo Wetikweleti Wavelonkhe 34 wanga-2005.Litiko Letekuhwebelana Netetimboni (i-dti) nalo liphetse ngekutsi inchubomgomo yeluhlakamsebenti kuBatsatsi Tikweleti, lokususelwa kubo Umtsetfo Wetikweleti Wavelonkhe 34 wanga-2005, ibhadlile futsi ifanele.

src: Sena se latela tjhebobotjha e phethahetseng ya 2012, e entsweng ke dti.
tgt: Loku kulandzela lubuyeketo lolukhulu, lwanga-2012 lolwentiwa yi-dti.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya Sehlomathiso ya ho Nka Qeto ka Tefo ya Meputso ya Ditho tsa Ditaba tsa Ditheo tsa Molaotheo, 2013.Sepheo sa Bili ke ho thea tshwano mabapi le ho nka qeto ka tefo ya meputso, melemo e fumanwang mosebetsing le melawana e meng le dipehelo tsa kgiro ya ditho tsa ditheo tsa Kgaolo ya 9, moo e matlafatsang tshebetso e ntle le tshwano mesebetsing ya puso ditheong tsena tsa bohlokwa.
tgt: Ikhabinethi ivume kungeniswa ePhalamende kweTintfo teMtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibiyela Kwekuncunywa Kwemholo Wemalunga Wetikhungo ngokweMtsetfosisekelo, 2013.LoMtsetfosivivinyo uhlose kwenta kutsi kube khona kufanana mayelana nekuncunywa kwemholo, imbasha kanye naleminye imibandzela netimo tekucashwa kwemalunga eTikhungo teSehluko 9 Letesekela Intsandvo Yelinyenti, ngaleyo ndlela-ke kutawuba khona kuphumelela lokuncono nekungagucuki ekusebenteni nekwengamela kwaletikhungo letibaluleke kakhulu.

src: Dithonyo.
tgt: Kubekwa etikhundleni.

src: Kabinete e ananetse kgiro ya Ntate Mokutule Joseph Kgobokoe mosebetsing wa Motlatsi wa Motsamaisi e Moholo: Hlahisong e sa Kgaelleng ya Dijo le Ntlafatso ya Temo Lefapheng la Temo, Meru le Botshwasi ba Ditlhapi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume kubekwa kweMnu Mokutule Joseph Kgobokoe esikhundleni sekuba Lisekela Lemcondzisi Jikelele: Kuciniseka Ngekudla Nekulungiswa Kwetekulima kuLitiko Letekulima, Temahlatsi Netinhlanti.

src: Kabinete e ananetse kgiro ya Mme Zandile Yvonne Mathe mosebetsing wa Motlatsi wa Motsamaisi e Moholo: Meralo ya Motheo ya Mehlodi ya Metsi ya Naha e Lefapheng la Merero ya Metsi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume kubekwa kwaNks.

src: Kabinete e ananetse kgetho ya ditho tse latelang Lekgotleng la Diphuphutso tsa Temo ho ya ka karolo 9(1) ya Molao wa Diphuphutso tsa Temo, 1990 Molao wa 86 wa 1990 nakong e sa feteng dilemo tse tharo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume kubekwa etikhundleni kwanaba bantfu labalandzelako njengemalunga ebhodi Ye-Ejensi Yekutfutfukisa Emabhange Labambisene:a) Sethe Patricia Makhesha (Sihlalo)b) Peter Koch (uyaphindvwa futsi kukhetfwa kuba Lisekela laSihlalo)c) Venete Jarlene Kleind) Lufuno Nevondwee) Thabo Vaughan Shenxanef) Samuel Senalor Akrongg) David Ginsburgh) Renganayagee Kisten.

src: Kabinete e dumellana le ho kgethwa ha batho ba latelang Lekgotleng la Matla a Taolo ya Indasteri ya Tshireletso ya Poraefete, nakong e sa feteng dilemo tse tharo:a) Ntate Daniel Claude Mojalefa Rathebe (Motlatsi wa Modulasetulo)b) Brigadier Cynthia Lindiwe Philison (Molekgotla)c) Ntate Benjamin Somangamane Ntuli (Molekgotla)d) Mme Nontokoza Mthembu (Molekgotla).

src: Kabinete e ananetse keketso ya nako ya konteraka ya kgiro ya Ngaka Vuyelwa Nhlapo e le Mohlanka e Moholo wa Phethahatso wa Eijensi ya Ntshetsopele ya Naha, bakeng sa sehla sa dilemo tse pedi ho tloha mohla la 1 Loetse 2013 ho ya ho la 31 Phato 2015.
tgt: Sibusiso Vil-Nkomo (uphindze uyakhetfwa futsi)d) Dkt Joyce Chitja (uphindze uyakhetfwa futsi)e) Nks.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho hirwa ha Ntate Mokadi Max Mathye e le Mohlanka e Moholo wa Phethahatso wa Lekala la Matla a Thuto le Thupelo la Dijo le Dino.
tgt: Wilna Jansen Van Rijssen (uphindze uyakhetfwa futsi)f) Nks.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho kgethwa hape ha ditho tseo tse tiisitseng ka boteng ba tsona ho tswelapele ho sebetsa Lekgotleng la Ntshetsopele ya Basebetsi la Aforika Borwa ho tloha ka Loetse 2013 ho ya ho Phato 2018.Motlatsi wa Mopresidente Kgalema Motlanthe ke modulasetulo wa lekgotla lena la boeletsi le makala a mangata le nang le Matona a 13 a dulang ka nako tsohle a bile a emetse mmuso.
tgt: Dudu Msomi (uphindze uyakhetfwa futsi)g) Mnu Mzolisi Dyasi (uphindze uyakhetfwa futsi)h) Phrof.

src: 23 Sep Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le dintlha tsa bohlokwa maemong a ha jwale.1 Tlasa boetapele ba Mopresidente Jacob Zuma, mmuso o sebetsa ka lenaneo la naha la meralo ya motheo ya setjhaba la ditrilione tse ngata ngata tsa diranta le reretsweng ho utolla menyetla ya mesebetsi le ho tlisa ditshebeletso ho maAforika Borwa ohle.
tgt: 23 Sep Tincumo teKhabhinethi etindzabeni letigcamile kulesimo sanyalo.1 Ngaphansi kwebuholi baMengameli Jacob Zuma, hulumende ucala kusebentisa luhlelo lwetakhiwo tahulumende lolubita tigidzigidzi tetigidzi lokuhloswe kutsi luvute ematfuba emisebenti lubuye futsi luletse tinsita kubo bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Ka mananeo ana, mmuso o tsitlallela boikitlaetsong ba wona ba ho thea mesebetsi e mengata le ho feta.
tgt: Ngekwetfula letinhlelo, hulumende wenta umsebenti wakhe wekutinikela ekwakheni ematfuba emisebenti leminyenti.

src: Haesale ho tloha kananelong ya Mokgwa o Motjha wa Kgolo mesebetsi e eketsehile ka 750 000, mme katlasenyana ho halofo ya mesebetsi ena e hlahisitswe tshebeletsong ya setjhaba, haholoholo basebetsing ba tsa bophelo bo botle, matitjhere le mapolesa.
tgt: Kusukela kwemukelwa Indlela Yekutfutfukisa Lensha kucashwa sekukhule nge-750 000, ngaphansi nje kwehhafu yalemisebenti, lecalwe kutemisebenti yahulumende, ikakhulu etikhundleni talabasebenta ngetemphilo, bothishela kanye nemaphoyisa.

src: Mananeo ana a bea ntshetsopele ya dikgwebo tse nyenyane ka sehloohong, e leng ntho ya bohlokwa ya ho utolla menyetla ya moruo.
tgt: Letinhlelo tibeka embili kutfutfukiswa kwemabhizinisi lamancane lokuyincenye lebalulekile yekuvula ematfuba etemnotfo.

src: Kabinete e leboha makala ao a ikamahanyang le mmuso ho kenya tshebetsong lenaneo lena le leholohadi la ntshetsopele ya meralo ya motheo mme e etsa kgoeletso tshebedisanong ya ho potlakisa matsapa a ho thea mesebetsi le ho fetola moruo esita le setjhaba sa habo rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphakamisa kubonga kwayo imikhakha lebambisene nahulumende ekuphumeleliseni loku lokuchuba lesimiso lesikhulu kangaka ibuye futsi icela lokunye kubambisana lokuchubekako ekulandzeleleni imitamo kwakha ematfuba ekucashwa nekugucula umnotfo kanye nemmango wetfu.

src: Mopresidente Jacob Zuma o tla bula Seteishene sa Motlakase sa Grootvlei ka la 20 Loetse 2013 a be a hlahlobe le setsha sa kaho ya seporo sa terene kwana Mpumalanga, e le karolo ya boikitlaetso ba neelano ya meralo ya motheo ya setjhaba.
tgt: Njengencenye yekucala kusebentisa lesakhiwo semmango Mengameli Jacob Zuma mhla tinge-20 Inyoni 2013 utawuvula siteshi sekuphehla gezi i-Grootvlei Power Station abuye futsi ahlolo jantji wesitimela lowakhiwako eMpumalanga.

src: Kabinete e ananetse kaho ya Yunivesithi e ntjha ya Sol Plaatjie Kimberly, Kapa Leboya, e lebeletsweng ho qala pele ho mafelo a Loetse 2013.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukele kwakhiwa kwenyuvesi lensha iSol Plaatje University eKimberley, eNyakatfo Kapa lelindzeleke kucala kwakhiwa ekupheleni kweNyoni 2013.Leli ligcatsi lelikhulu ekukhuleni nasekutfutfukeni kwemkhakha wetemfundvo lephakeme eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Ena ke katleho e kgolo kgolong le ntshetsopeleng ya lekala la thuto e phahameng Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lesehlakalo lesiyincalisakuvela sakhombisa kucala ngalokusemtsetfweni kwakhiwa kwalekhempasi.

src: Ketsahalo ya ho phethelwa ha mobu e bile sesupo sa ho thakgolwa ha kaho ya khamphase semmuso.
tgt: Kwakhiwa kwenyuvesi lensha kuboniwe kwabuye kwabekwa embili kuMiklamolisu Lehlanganisiwe (i-SIP 14) Likomidi Lekuchumanisa Tekwakha leLihhovisi laMengameli (i-PICC).2 Mengameli Jacob Zuma kanye neKhabhinethi yakhe utawuhlonipha takamuti letikhulile taseNingizimu Afrika eSefako Makgatho Endlini Yetvakashi teLihhovisi laMengameli ePitoli mhla tinge-29 Inyoni 2013.

src: Kaho ya yunivesithi e ntjha e ile ya hlwauwa yaba ya bewa ka sehloohong kahara Diprojeke tsa Lewa le Momahantsweng (SIP 14) ke Khomishene ya Mopresidente e Hlophisang Dikaho tsa Motheo (PICC).2 Mopresidente Jacob Zuma hammoho le Kabinete ya hae ba tla be ba tlotla metsofe ya Aforika Borwa Tlung ya Baeti ya Mopresidente ya Sefako Makgatho e Pretoria ka la 29 Loetse 2013.
tgt: Loku kwenta incenye yekugubha ligalelo lelifakwa takhamuti letikhulile/dzala ekutfutfukiseni imimange yetfu nalelive.

src: Sena e tla be e le sesupo sa qalo ya Beke ya Batho ba Baholo, e tla fela ka la 6 Mphalane, e leng Letsatsi la Bonkgono le Bontatemoholo.3 Mopresidente Jacob Zuma o tla tshetleha puo Ngangisanong e Akaretsang ya Phutheo ya bo68 ya Sebokakakaretso sa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UNGA68) New York ka la 24 Loetse 2013.
tgt: Loku kutawuba kutawukhombisa kucala kweLiviki Lebantfcu Labadzala, lelitawuphela mhla ti-6 Imphala, lokuLusuku LwaboGogo NaboMkulu.3 Mengameli Jacob Zuma utawetfula inkhulumo kuNkhulumomphikiswano Jikelele Yekuhlangana Kwe-68th Kwemhlangano Jikelele Wamhlabuhlangene (i-UNGA68) eNew York mhla tinge-24 Inyoni 2013.Ingcikitsi yalomnyaka itsi: “I-ajenda Yekutfutfukisa Yangemuva Kwa-2015: Lokuvula Inkhundla!” kubuye kugcile elusukwini lolucondziwe lweMigomo Yemnyakankhulungwane (ema-MDG) lwanga-2015, kanye ne-Ajenda Yekutfutfukisa kuchubekela embili.

src: Mookotaba wa monongwaha ke: “Lenanetsamaiso la Ntshetsopele la Kamora 2015: Ho Bula Sebaya!” mme o habile nakong e beilweng ya 2015 ya Maikemisetso a Ntshetsopele ya Dilemokete (MDGs), esita le Lenanetsamaiso la Ntshetsopele kamorao ho moo, ho ya pele.
tgt: I-UNGA68 iniketa iNingizimu Afrika inkhundla yekusebentisa indlelalisu yetfu yekuzuza lama-MDG kanye ne-Ajenda Yekutfutfukisa Yangemuva Kwa-2015.

src: UNAG68 e fa Aforika Borwa lepatlelo la ho ntshetsapele mokgwa wa lewa la rona la ho fihlella di-MDG le Lenanetsamaiso la Ntshetsopele la Kamora 2015.
tgt: Kuhlanganyela kwetfu kutawubuye kumiselwe kutmfuno tavelonkhe teNingizimu Afrika nalokuphuma embili, kanye nekutinikela kwetfu kwesigodzi nekwelivekati.4 IKhabhinethi iyasigceka kakhulu sento sekwentela phansi igridi yagezi bangeneli besitelega lesingekho emtsetfweni lokwaholela ekucisheni kwagezi kuletinye tincenye teJozi.

src: Seabo sa rona se tla boela se susumetswa ke ditabatabelo le dintho tse ka sehloohong tsa Aforika Borwa, esita le boikitlaetso ba rona ba lebatowa le ba kontinente.4 Kabinete e seolla kahohlehohle ditshitiso tsa marangrang a motlakase, tse entsweng ke batho ba neng ba le seteraekeng se seng molaong, tse ileng tsa baka ho kgaoha ha phepelo ya motlakase dikarolong tsa Johannesburg.
tgt: Sento lesinjena ngesikhatsi lapho khona lelive lisondzela ekusimamiseni kupakela kwalo gezi angeke singanakwa sendlule singajeziswa futsi kunale kubukwane naso ngekwemtsetfo ngalokuphelele.5 Kukhululwa Kwetibalobalo Tebugebengu Tavelonkhe TaseNingizimu Afrika temnyaka 2012/13 kucinisekisa kukholelwa kwetfu ekutsini uma sisebentisana sitawufinyelela umgomo wetfu wemmango lokhululekile lote bugebengu, loheha lutjalomali kucinisekisa kuthula nekusimama emimangweni yetfu.

src: Diketso tse jwalo di ke ke tsa tlodiswa mahlo hodimo nakong ena eo naha e hahamallang botsitsong ba phepelo ya yona ya motlakase, mme di tlameha ho thibelwa kahohlehohle ka tshebediso ya molao.5 Ho ntshuwa ha Dipalopalo tsa selemo le selemo tsa 2012/13 tsa Ditlolo tsa Molao Aforika Borwa ho boela ho thasisetsa boitshepo ba rona ba hore ha re sebetsa mmoho re tla fihlella sepheo sa rona sa setjhaba se sa angweng ke ditlolo tsa molao, se hohelang matsete a netefatsang kgotso le botsitso dibakeng tsa rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonkhe labantsintsekako kutsi bachumane ngalokwakhako naloko lokutfoliwe.

src: Mmuso o ntsha dipalopalo tsena hang ka selemo ka sepheo sa ho fa setjhaba lesedi la moraorao twantshong ya ditlolo tsa molao, esita le ho sheba botjha mawa a jwale a ho lwantsha ditlolo tsa molao.
tgt: Hulumende ukhipha letibalobalo kanye ngemnyaka kute kutsi, ikakhulu, anikeke ummango lwatiso lwakamuva mayelana nekulwa nebugebengu kulelive, kanye nekubuyeketa letinye tetindlela tekubukana nebugebengu.

src: Dipalopalo tsa ditlolo tsa molao di boela di sebediswa kamehla e le sesebediswa sa ho tataisa merero ya ho sebetsa ya Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa sa Aforika Borwa (SAPS).Kabinete e thoholetsa matsapa a matla a SAPS le mekgatlo yohle e ipopileng esita le setjhaba ka ho sebedisana le mmuso twantshong ya ditlolo tsa molao.
tgt: Tibalobalo tebugebengi tibuye futsi tisetjentiswe onkhe malanga njengendlela yekulawula kukhonjwindlela kwetinhlelo teLuphiko Lwemaphoyisa LwaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS).IKhabhinethi iyayincoma imitamo lengaphelimandla ye-SAPS kanye nayo yonkhe imitimba lehlelekile neyemmango lebambisene nahulumende ekulweni nebugebengu.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho ikamahanya le twantsho ya ditlolo tsa molao.
tgt: IAKhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bahlanganyele ekulweni nebugebengu.

src: Ha re sebetsa mmoho re tla netefatsa boteng ba Aforika Borwa moo moAforika Borwa a tla ikutlwa a bolokehile a bile a tshireletsehile.6 Kabinete e bontshitse ho ngongoreha ho hoholo ka dikotsi tsa moraorao tsa mebileng tse mpempe.
tgt: Ngekusebentisana sisonkhe sitawucinisekisa iNingizimu Afrika lapho khona iNingizimu Afrika itiva iphephile futsi ivikelekile.6 IKhabhinethi ivakalise kukhatsateka kakhulu ngaletingoti temgwaco letishwacisa lugogo levele ngekulandzelana.

src: Dikotsi tse jwalo di siile malapa a mang a saretswe ebile di thefula moruo haholo.
tgt: Letingoti taloluhlobo tishiye leminye imindeni indzindza futsi tinelifutse nemphumela lomubi kutemnotfo.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho beng bohle ba makoloi ho netefatsa hore makoloi a bona a boemong bo amohelehileng ba ho tsamaya mebileng ba be ba kganne ka boikarabelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonkhe mashayeli betimoto kutsi bente siciniseko sekutsi timoto tabo tisesimeni lesifanele kutsi tingaba semgwacweni nekutsi futsi bashayele ngalokufanele lokunesibopho.

src: Kahoo Kabinete e ipiletsa ho balaola sephethephethe ho tswelapele ka ho se amohele ho hang makoloi a seng boemong bo amohelehileng ba ho tsamaya mebileng esita le ba kgannang ba tahilwe.
tgt: Mayelana naloko iKhabhinethi imema tiphatsimandla temgwaco kutsi tichubeke nekugcina umgomo wekungakubeketeli nakancane kushayelwa kwetimo letingekho esimeni lesifanele kutsi tibe semgwacweni kanye nekunatsa tjwala ube ushayela.

src: Kabinete e boela e ipiletsa ho ditaaso ho hlompha melao ya tsela.7 Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho keteka Letsatsi la Letlotlo la Botjhaba, 24 Loetse 2013, ka ho etela dibaka tse fupereng letlotlo la botjhaba bo sa tshwaneng naha ka bophara e le ho keteka Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho ya rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibuye futsi imema nalabahamba ngetinyawo kutsi nabo bayihloniphe imitsetfo yemgwaco.7 IKhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bagubhe umkhosi weLusuku Lwemafa Nemagugu, 24 Inyoni 2013 ngekutsi bavakashele tindzawo tetfu letinotsile temafa nemagugu kulo lonkhe lelive bagubhe Iminyaka lenge-20 satfola Inkhululeko.

src: Ho kopjwa maAforika Borwa ohle, dikolo, dikgwebo le dibaka tsohle ho phahamisa folakga ya rona e le sesupo sa rona sa ho keteka Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho esita le ho tshehetsa letsholo la ‘Bolabohlano ba Tokoloho’ le kgakolwang ka la 20 Lwetse 20.8 Kabinete e thoholetsa Lucas Sithole ka ho hapa papadi e bapalwang ka bonngwe ke ba sebedisang dituloteti ya Thonamente ya Tenese ya Amerika New York.
tgt: Bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika, tikolwa, bemabhizinisi nemimanga imenywa kutsi kutsi iphephetelise etulu umjeka wetfu njengeluphawu lwetfu lwekugubha Iminyaka lenge-20 yeNkhululeko kanye nekwesekela umkhankhaso ‘waleSihlanu weNkhululeko’ lotawetfulwa mhla tinge-20 Inyoni 20.8 IKhabhinethi ibongisa u-Lucas Sithole lophumelele kutfola umklomelo we-quad singles ku-US Open Tennis Tournament eNew York.

src: Maemo a Sithole a lefatshe a nyolohile ka kgato e le nngwe hore e be wa bobedi kamora tlholo ena, eo e neng e le ya pele ya maemo a hodimo ya Setlamo sa Tenese ya Matjhaba bakeng sa moAforika ebile e le moAforika Borwa.
tgt: Kukhuphuka kwaSithole kusuke kumunye umdlalo kwaya kulandzela kuncoba, lokwaba Sicoco lesikhulu sekucala se-International Tennis Federation kwemuntfu wase-Afrika newaseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ho tshehetse baatlelete ba rona ba holofetseng, ba tswelang pele ho etsa hore naha ya rona e be motlotlo ka ho intsha sehlabelo le ho re kgothatsa bohle hore re fihlelle ditabatabelo tsa rona.9 Kabinete e ananela Seboka sa Naha sa Motheo o Batsi wa Matlafatso ya ba Batsho Moruong (BBBEE) se tla tshwarwa ho tloha ka la 3 ho ya ho la 5 Mphalane tlasa mookotaba o reng: “Selemoshome sa Matlafatso Moruong”.Sesebediswa sa leano la Matlafatso ya ba Batsho Moruong hantlentle ke lewa la kgolo le reretsweng ho etsa hore motheo wa moruo wa naha o be batsi ka ho tsepamisa maikutlo tlhokehong ya tekano, e leng bofokodi bo boholo ba moruo wa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi besekele ema-athilethi etfu lakhubatekile lachubeka nekwenta live letfu litigcabhe ngekudla umdlalo wemhlaba nekusifaka sonkhe inshisekelo yekutsi sifinyelele emazinga lasetulu.

src: Seboka se tla sekaseka kgatelopele ya ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha BBBEE kamora ho ketekwa ha dilemo tse 10 haesale ha na ho kgakolwa Molao wa BBBEE ka 2003.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukela Ingcungcutsela Yekuhlonyiswa Kwalabamnyama Ngemakhono (i-BBBEE) letawube ibanjwe kusukela mhla titintsatfu kuya kuma tisihlanu Imphala 2013 ngaphansi kwalengcikitsi: “Umnyakalishumi Wekuhlonyiswa Ngemnotfo”.Lithulusi lenchubomgomo yeKuhlonyiswa kwalabamnyama Ngemnotfo lilisu lekukhula lekuhloswe kutsi likhulise sendlalelo semnotfo walelive ngekucondza kungalingani lokunguloku kuyindzawo lebutsakatsaka kumnotfo waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Setlamo sa ba amehang, baemedi ba mekgatlo ya basebetsi, mekga ya dipolotiki le mekgatlo ya setjhabeng ba tla ba le seabo ho kutlweng ha thasisetso ya boraro ya matlafatso ya ba batsho moruong ya Aforika Borwa, ka Molao wa BBBEE o hlomathisitsweng le Mekgwa e ntlafaditsweng ya Tshebetso e Ntle.10 Kabinete e thoholetsa Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba leanong la lona le letjha le ntlafaditsweng la phano ya ditshebeletso le bitswang Projeke ya Mikondzo, le tla atolla phihlello ya ditshebeletso tsa setjhaba ho ya bafutsaneng esita le bao ba kotsing dikgutlwaneng tsohle tsa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: LeNgcungcutsela itawuhlola inchubekela embili ye-BBBEE ngemuva kwe kwemkhosi weminyaka le-10 kusukela kwashaywa umtsetfo we-BBBEE nga-2003.

src: Nakong ya Kgwedi ya Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba, Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba hammoho le ditheo tsa yona, Ejensi ya Tshireletso ya Setjhaba ya Aforika Borwa le Eiensi ya Ntshetsopele ya Naha, di tla tswelapele ho neelana ka ditshebeletso tsa Projeke ya Mikondzo mabatoweng a 1 300 a futsanehileng ka ho fetisisa ho Bomasepala ba Ditereke ba 23 jwaloka ha ba hlwailwe ba bile ba beilwe ka sehloohong ke Kabinete.11 Kabinete e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa ho ba le seabo Bekeng ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo ya Imbizo e tla ba dipakeng tsa la 7 le la 13 Mphalane 2013.Kamora katleho ya Beke ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo ya Imbizo e neng e le ka Phuptjane, Beke ya bobedi ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo e tla fana ka sebaya ho Dikokonono tsa Dipolotiki hore di boele di bontshane le setjhaba.
