tgt: Labatsintsekako betemabhizinisi, bameleli betinhlangano tetisebenti, emacembu etepolitiki netinhlangano temmango titawuhlanganyela ekuphindvweni kwesitsatfu kwemculu wetetsembiso teNingizimu Afrika tekuhlonyiswa kwalabamnyama ngemnotfo neMtsetfo we-BBBEE lochitjelwe kanye neKhodi e-BBBEE lentiwa aba sezingeni lelisetulu ekuSenta Ngalokufanele.10 IKhabhinethi ihalalisela Litiko Letekutfutfukisa Kwetenhlalo ngelisu lalo lekwenta kancono kwetfula tinsita kwalo letingumklamo lobitwa ngekutsi pheceletiProject Mikondzo lelitawukhulisa kufinyelela kwetinsita tetenhlalo kulabaphuyile nalabasengotini kuwo onkhe emakhona aseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Nako ena e fana ka monyetla o mong ho baahi hore ba buisane ba shebane mahlong le Ditho tsa Phethahatso, ho keteka dikatleho esita le ho rarolla diphephetso tsa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha mananeo a mmuso.
tgt: Ngesikhatsi seNyanga Yetekutfutfukiswa Kwetenhlalo, Litiko Letekutfutfukiswa Kwetenhlalo kanye nemitimba yalo, i-Ejensi Yekucinisekisa Ngekudla YaseNingizimu Afrika kanye ne-Ejensi Yetekutfutfukisa yavelonkhe, itawuchubeka nekwetfula i-Project Mikondzo kumawadi ebantfu labaphuye kakhulu laba-1 300 kuboMasipalati beTigodzi labange-23 njengoba bakhonjwe babuye babekwa embili yiKhabhinethi.11 IKhabhinethi ikhutsata bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bahlanganyele kuLiviki Lembizo Lekugcilwe Kulo lelitako enkhatsini wamhla tisikhombisa namhla ti-13 Imphala 2013.Ngemuva kwekuphumelela kweLiviki Lembizo Lekugcilwe Kulo langeNhlaba 2013, leLiviki Lekugcilwe Kulo lesibili litawuniketa inkhundla leBahlanganyeli labaTikhulu tetePolitiki kutsi tichubeke tichumane nemmango.

src: Dibaka tseo ho tla kopanelwa ho tsona esita le lenaneo la beke di tla tsebiswa ha nako e atamela.
tgt: Lesikhatsi siveta lelinye litfuba lapho khona takhamuti ttawuwuchuma buso nebuso neMalunga eSigungu Lesiphetse, kute kugujwe umkhosi wekuphumelela nekubukana netinselele letiphatselene nekuphunyeleliswa kwetinhlelo tahulumende.

src: Dipuisano le diqeto tsa bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.1 Kabinete e ananetse ho kena dipakeng ha Leano la Naha Tshireletsong ya Dijo le Phepo, Lewa la Tshireletso ya Dijo le Phepo ya Malapeng esita le ho kena dipakeng ha Tlhahiso ya Dijo ya Fetsa Tlala.
tgt: Indzawu lekutawuhlanganelwa kuyo kanye neluhlelo lwaeloViki kutawumenyetelwa nasekusondzele sikhatsi.2 Tinkhulumiswano netincumo teKhabhinethi letibalulekile.1 IKhabhinethi ivume Inchubomgomo Yavelonkhe Yekucinisekiswa Ngekudla Nekuvikeleka, Lisu Lekudla Kwemndeni Nekucinisekiswa Ngekudla Nekuvuikeleka nekungenelela kwemkhicito lobitwa ngekutsi pheceleti, Fetsa Tlala (Kukhicitwa Kwekudla Lokucedza Indlala).Lenchubomgomo Yavelonkhe ifuna kuphendvula kuletinselele letiyenti letiphatselene nekuciniseka ngekudla eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Leano la Naha le habile ho arabela diphephetsong tse ngata tse amanang le ho se be teng ha tshireletso ya dijo Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Yesekelwa ngemasu ngco latsite ekungenelela kute kubukwane netinselele tekweselakala kwekudla emindenini nekukhuphula lizinga lekukhicitwa kwekudla kute kucedvwe indlala nga-2030.

src: Le tsheheditswe ke mawa a totobetseng a ho kena dipakeng e le ho rarolla diphephetso tsa dikgaello tsa dijo malapeng hammoho le ho eketsa tlhahiso ya dijo, ka sepheo sa ho fedisa tlala ka 2030.
tgt: Lelisu kanye nemkhicito we-Fetsa Tlala tinhlelo letichumanisa ematiko angekhatsi lesekele leNchumbomgomo.

src: Lewa mmoho le Tlhahiso ya Fetsa Tlala ke mananeo a ho matlafatsa Leano a Kopanetsweng ke Mafapha.
tgt: Kutawuba khona kwetfulwa lokutawucacisa leTinhlelo taleNchubomgomo.2 IKhabhinethi ivumeLuhlakamsebenti LweNingizimu Afrika lwekuchumana neNhlangano Yekubambisana Kutemnotfo Nekutfutfuka (i-OECD) lwalesikhatsi: 2013/14 – 2016/17.INingizimu Afrika ifuna kubusenentisa lobudlelwane kute izuze imigomo lemikhulu lemitsatfu:i) kutfutfuka ngalokusezingeni leliphakeme kwetemnotfo lofaka konkhe ekhatsi, lokubaluleke kakhulu ekubukaneni kungacashwa, buphuya nekungalinganiii)a tisebenti leticeceshekile naletikhonako, kwesekelwa kwetfulwa kwalokuhlosiwe kwekutfutfukisa kwavelonkhe kanyeiii)neKuphumelelisa i-ajenda ye-Afrika, lapho khona iNingizimu Afrika itawufuna kufaka umtselela we-ajenda yemhlaba lapho khona iminotfo yase-Afrika ingazuza khona.

src: Dinaha tsa OECD di dula e le tsona balekane ba bohlokwa ba kgwebisano le matsete ho Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Emave e-OECD aloku abalingani lababalulekile kutekuhweba nelutjalomali e-Afrika.

src: Ho hakanngwa hore dinaha tsa OECD di kentse letsoho ka sekgahla se fetang 65% ho Motjha wa Ntshetsopele ya Kgolo ka 2011 lefatsheng.
tgt: Kutfolwe kutsi emave e-OECD afake ligalelo lelingetulu kwa-65% we-GDP yemhlaba nga-2011.Lendlela iniketa ematiko ahulumende luhlakamsebenti lwekulawula kuchumana kwawo ne-OECLoluchumano lwelontiwe labancuno kuhulumende lutawenta tinzuzo letisezingeni lelisetulu titfolwe ekusebentgisaneni.3 Imitsetfosivivinyo.1 IKhabhinethi ivume Umtsetfosivivinyo Wesikhutsato/Sifakamdlandla Wemtselo Wekusebenta kutsi ukhishwe kute sive sitewenta tiphakamiso ngawo.

src: Mokgwa ona o fana ka moralo bakeng sa mafapaha a mmuso ho laola dipuisano tsa wona le OECTlhophiso ena e ntlafaditsweng mmusong, e tla thusa hore ho folwe melemo e metle ka ho fetisisa selekaneng sena.
tgt: Lomtsetfosivivinyo wetfula sikhutsato/sifakamdlandla lesihlose ikakhulu kukutsata/kufaka umdlandla bacashi kutsi baashe bantfu labafuna umsebenti labasesebancane futsi labanesipiliyoni semsebenti lesincane.

src: Dibili.1 Kabinete e ananetse Bili ya Meropotso ya Lekgetho la Mesebetsi e tla ntshwa hore setjhaba se tshwaele ka yona.
tgt: Lesikhutsato singulesinye kuletinyenti lesitawungena ngaphasi kwesambulelo saHulumende selisu lekucashwa kwelusha futsi sitawugcwalisela tinhlelo tahulumende letikhona.

src: Bili e teka meropotso haholoholo ka sepheo sa ho kgothaletsa bahiri ho hira batjha ba tsomang mesebetsi ba bile ba se na boiphihlelo bo bokaalo.
tgt: Sikhutsato sentsela yekucasha bantfu labasesebancane labangena emakete yetisebenti futsi labahola ngaphasi kwelizinga lemali lengenako umuntfu lakhokhiswa intsela kuyo.

src: Moropotso ke enngwe ya dintho tse ngata tse welang tlasa bonamelo ba lewa la Mmuso la mesebetsi ya batjha mme le tla thusa ho tshehetsa maano a mmuso.
tgt: Ngekwenta njalo, sihloso emakhona laphasi, umholo lomncane webantfu labanematfuba lamancane ekutfola umsebenti.

src: Meropotso ya lekgetho la mesebetsi ya batjha e tobile batho ba batjha ba qalang ho sebetsa mme ba amohela meputso e katlase ho sekepele sa lekeno la motho ka mong le pukutlwang lekgetho.
tgt: Letikhutato titawakha timo letivula ematfuba emsebenti tibuye futsi tente kancono ematfuba ekucashwa etisebenti leticisheka ematfuba.

src: Ka ho etsa jwalo, e tobile ba nang le tsebo e fokolang, ba amohelang meputso e tlase ba bile ba na le menyetla e fokolang ya ho fumana mesebetsi.
tgt: Kutawubanjwa umhlangano lohleliwe wekucacisa loMtsetfosivivinyo.2 IKhabhinethi ivume Luhlaka LweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekhomishini Lelawula Umhlaba, 2013 kutsi ukhishwe kute sive sitewenta tiphakamiso ngawo.

src: Meropotso e tla thea maemo a matle a ho hlahisa mesebetsi le ho ntlafatsa menyetla ya mesebetsi bakeng sa basebetsi bao ba kotetsweng.
tgt: Emkhatsini waleminye, Umtsetfosivivinye Wekhomishini Lelawula Umhlaba, 2013 ufuna kusungula iKhomishini Letawulawula Umhlaba.

src: Ho tla tshwarwa pontshano e reretsweng ho qhaqholla Bili.2 Kabinete e ananetse Bili ya Moralo wa Khomishene ya Bolaodi ba Mobu, 2013, e tla ntshuwa bakeng sa hore setjhaba se tshwaele ka yona.
tgt: Lekhomishini Lelawula Umhlaba itawudzingeka kutsi itsatse tincimo mayelana netincabane tebuniyo bemhlaba lapho kukhona kungenteka kutsi kuniketwe ematayitela lamabili noma ngetulu emhlaba munye.

src: Ho tse ding, Bili ya Khomishene ya Bolaodi ba Mobu, 2013, e habile ho thea Khomishene ya Bolaodi ba Mobu.
tgt: LeKhomishini itawuphindze indzingeke kutsi isungule ibuye igcine idathabhesi lenkhulu yagulumende yawo wonkhe umhlaba wembuso lobhaliswe ngaphasi kweligama lelitiko kufaka ekhatsi noma ngabe ngumuphi lomunye umhlaba wembuso lotfolakale ungakabhaliswa.3 Ikhabhinethi ivume kungeniswa kweMtsetfosivivinyo Welusito Lwetemtsetfo, 2013 ePhalamende.

src: Khomishene ya Bolaodi ba Mobu e tla lebellwa ho diya kahlolo qhwebeshanong ya boithuelo ba mobu moo e ka nnang ya ba mangolo a mabedi kapa a fetang bobedi a boithuelo ba thepa a ntshitswe bakeng sa setsha se le seng.
tgt: NgaloMtsetfosivivinyo kuhlolwe kucitfwa Umtsetfo Welusito Lwetemtsetfo, 1969 (Umtsetfo 22 wanga-1969) ingekuhambisana netimo letikhona, ikakhulu umtsetfosisekelo lomusha, nekulinganisa kusetjentiswa kwawo.

src: Khomishene e tla boela e lebellwa ho thea le ho boloka lesedi la motheo le batsi la mmuso la mobu ohle o ngodisitsweng e le wa mmuso lebitsong la lefapha, ho akga le mobu ofe kapa ofe o hlahlobilweng wa mmuso mme o sa ngodiswa.3 Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya Dithuso tsa Molao, 2013, Palamenteng.
tgt: NgaloMtsetfosivivinyo kuhloswe kwenta kancono kusebenta ngalokwenele nalokunemphumelelo kweLusito Lwetemtsetfo LwaseNingizimu Afrika, lokutawuba nembuyiselo lenhle kumiphumela kummango jikelele.

src: Bili e reretswe ho hlakola Molao wa Dithuso tsa Molao, 1969 (Molao wa 22 wa 1969) ho ya ka maemo a renang, haholoholo tshebetso e ntjha ya molaotheo, esita le ho ntlafatsa tshebediso ya wona e ntle.
tgt: Ungcachunyaniswa nalokucondziwe lokubalulekile kwekujulisa inchubo yekuciniseka yekuvikeleka kwetenhlalo, ubuso lokhonako nalosebenta ngenkhambo lelungile lophetse takhamuti tawo ngesizotsa.4 IKhambinethi ivume kushicilelwa kweMtsetfosiviviso Wekulawula Temphilo Temhlaba Jikelele, 2013 kuGazethi yaHulumende kute kutsi ummango wente tiphakamiso.

src: Bili e reretswe ho ntlafatsa tshebetso e ntle ya Dithuso tsa Molao Aforika Borwa, moo kgabareng e tla ba le ditlamorao tse ntle setjhabeng ka kakaretso.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uhlose kucitsa Umtsetfo Wekulawula Tetemphilo Jikelele, 1974 (Umtsetfo 28 wanga-1974) kanye nekufaka ekhatsi Imitsetfosimiso Tetemphilo Yetemhlaba Jikelele, 2005 kumtsetfo wavelonkhe.

src: E ka nna ya amanngwa le dipehelo tsa mokgwa wa tshireletso ya setjhaba ka kakaretso le tshireletso ya setjhaba bakeng sa bafutsana le dihlophana tse ding tse e hlokang ka sebele, le kelohloko ya naha e ntseng e thuthua, e nang le bokgoni le boitshwaro bo botle ebile e tshwara baahi ba yona ka seriti.4 Kabinete e ananetse phatlalatso ya Bili ya Ditaolo tsa Matjhaba ho tsa Bophelo bo Botle, 2013, Koranteng ya Mmuso bakeng sa hore setjhaba se tshwaele ka yona.
tgt: Imitsetfosimiso yetemphilo Yemhlaba Jikeleke (2005) ngumtsetfo wemhlaba losita emave kutsi abambisane ekusindziseni bantfu nalabatiphilisa ngako kutehlakalo lotibangelwa kusabalala kwetifo/kugula kwemave emhlaba nalokunye lokuyingoti kutemphilo.5 Ikhabhinethi ivume kwetfulwa kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibela Lokutidzakamiva Nalokuhambisana Nato, 2012 ePhalamende.

src: Bili e habile ho hlakola Molao wa Ditaolo tsa Matjhaba ho tsa Bophelo bo Botle, 1974 (Molao wa 28 wa 1974) esita le ho kenyeletsa Ditaolo tsa Matjhaba ho tsa Bophelo bo Botle, 2005, ketsong ya melao ya naha.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibela uchibela Umtsetfo Lophatselene Nemitsi Nalokuhambisana Nayo, 1965 (Umtsetfo 101 wanga-1965) njengoba uchitjelwe nguMtsetfo 72 wanga-2008.Kufinyelela kulingana, imitsi lengabiti kakhulu nalephephile netisetjentiswa tetekwelashwa kuyinsika labaluleke kakhulu kutemphilo yemmango futsi kufaka ligalelo ekuzuzeni umgomo waHulumende wekukhulisa iminyaka yekuphila yebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika.6 IKhabhinethi ivume kushicilelwa kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekulawula Kutsengiswa Kwetjwala, 2013 kuGazethi yaHulumende kute kutsi ummango wente tiphakamiso.

src: Ditaolo tsa Matjhaba ho tsa Bophelo bo Botle (2005) ke molao wa matjhaba o thusang dinaha ho sebedisana e le ho pholosa maphelo le boiphediso kgahlanong le diketsahalo tse bakwang ke ho phasalla ha malwetse le dikotsi tse ding tsa bophelo bo botle matjhabeng.5 Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya Sehlomathiso sa Meriana le Meriana e Meng e Jwalo ka Yona, 2012, Palamenteng.
tgt: Tjwala buyinkinga lenkhulu levimba kufinyelela imiphumela yemigomo yahulumende yemphilo lendze nalekahle yabo bonkhe bantfu.

src: Bili ya Sehlomathiso e hlomathisa Molao wa Meriana le Meriana e Meng e Jwalo ka Yona, 1965 (Molao wa 101 wa 1965) jwaloka ha o hlomathisitswe ke Molao wa 72 wa 2008.Phihlello merianeng ya boleng, e fihlellehang ebile e bolokehile mmoho le disebediswa tse thusang ho ntlafatsa bophelo bo botle ke tshiya ya bohlokwa bophelong bo botle ba setjhaba, mme e thusa ka ho kenya letsoho phihlellong ya maikemisetso a Mmuso a ho eketsa tebello ya ho phela halelele ha maAforika Borwa.6 Kabinete e ananetse ho phatlalatswa ha Bili ya Taolo ya Thekiso ya Dino tse Tahang, 2013, Koranteng ya Mmuso bakeng sa hore setjhaba se tshwaele ka yona.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uhlose kunciphisa kulimala lokuphatselene netjwala ngekulawula kutsengiswa kwetjwala.

src: Jwala ke tshita e kgolo phihlellong ya sephetho sa mmuso sa bophelo bo bolelele bo bile bo le botle bakeng sa bohle.
tgt: Njengoba hulumende akakwati kutsi angavala tjwala futsi angeke avumele kukhutsata kunatfwa kwetjwala ngekutsi avumele ummango ikakhulu lusha kutsi lokholelwe ekutsini imphilo itawentiwa ncono kantsi ecinisweni kulabanyenti itawuba nemphumela lowehlukile kulowo.

src: Bili e habile ho fokotsa thefuleho e amanang le jwala ka taolo ya thekiso ya dino tse tahang.
tgt: Lokungenelela kufanele kubonakale kuseceleni kepha kube kuyincenye yesinyatselo lesikhulu sahulumende sekunciphisa kulimala lokuphatselene netjwala.

src: Leha e le hore mmuso o ke ke wa kwala thekiso ya jwala, o boela o ke ke wa dumella kgothaletso ya ho nowa ha jwala ka ho dumella setjhaba, haholoholo batjha, ho dumela hore maphelo a bona a ka ntlafala haele hore bonneteng ho tla ba le ditlamorao tse mpe ho ba bangata.
tgt: Kutawubanjwa umhlangano lohleliwe wekucacisa loMtsetfosivivinyo.7 IKhabhinethi ivume kufakwa kugazethi iMitsetfosivivinyo lemibili, lechibele Umtsetfo Lophatselene Nebantfwana, 2005 (Umtsetfo 38 wanga-2005) njengoba uchitjelwe nguMtsetfo 41 wanga-2007 ngekwemibandzela yaSigaba 75 seMtsetfosisekelo neSigaba 76 , kute ummango wente tiphakamiso.

src: Ho kena dipakeng hona ha ho a tlameha ho bonwa e le pudumo ya seemanosi, empa e le karolo ya mekgwa e momahantsweng ke mmuso ho fokotsa thefuleho e amanang le jwala.
tgt: Lomtsetfosivivinyo uhlose kufaka inchazelo welicala letemacansi kutsi nanoma ngabe ngubani lobekwe licala letemacansi njengobe kuchaziwe kuMtsetfo Webugebengu (Emacala Etemancansi netindzaba Letiphatselene Nawo) Umtsetfo Wekuchibela, No.

src: Ho tla tshwarwa pontshano e reretsweng ho qhaqholla Bili.7 Kabinete e ananetse ho phatlalatswa ha Dibili tse pedi, tseo ka bobedi ba tsona di hlomathisang Molao wa Bana, 2005 (Molao wa 38 wa 2005) jwaloka ha o hlomathisitswe ke Molao wa 41 wa 2007 ho ya ka Karolo ya 75 ya Molaotheo le Karolo ya 76, hore setjhaba se tshwaele ka tsona.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo ubuye futsi uhambisane neMtsetfo nesincumo seNkantolo yeMtsetfosisekelo kute kubuyeketwe kusebenta kwemajaji kwesincumo sekususa nekubeka umntfwana endzaweni yesikhashana yekuphepha ngemyalelo wenkantolo noma ngaphandle kwemyalelo wenkantolo ngesikhatsi lesitsite.

src: Bili e habile ho kenya tlhaloso ya tlolo ya molao ya motabo ho netefatsa hore motho ofe kapa ofe ya tshwaretsweng tlolo efe kapa efe ya molao ya motabo jwaloka ha e hlalositswe Sehlomathisong sa Molao wa Ditlolo tsa Molao (Ditlolo tsa Molao tsa Motabo le dintho tse Amanang le tsona), wa 32 wa 2007, o nkuwa a sa tshwaneleha ho sebetsa le bana.
tgt: Umtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibela Umtsetfo Lophatselene Nebantfwana Wesibili, 2013 ucinisekisa kutsi bonkhe bantfwana batfola tinsita betinzuzo leticondze kuchuba kufinyelela kunakeelwa ngetenhlalo nekuphepha nekwenta inchubo yekunakekelwa ngetenhlalo lesebentako.

src: Bili e boetse e amanya Molao le kahlolo ya Lekgotla la Molaotheo e le ho fana ka tjhebobotjha ya molao ya qeto ya ho tlosa le ho bea ngwana tlhokomelong e bolokehileng ya nakwana ho le teng kapa ho le siyo taelo ya lekgotla la dinyewe ka nakwana e totobaditsweng.
tgt: Ubuye futsi ufune kuniketa indzawo lephephile nalenekucamba yekubeka bantfwana labatfolakala badzinga kunakekelwa nekuvikelwa.4 Kubekwa etikhundleni.1 IKhabhinethi ivume kubekwa etikhundleni teLitiko Letemanti kwanaba labalandzelako.

src: Bili ya Sehlomathiso ya Bobedi ya Bana, 2013, e reretswe ho netefatsa hore bana bohle ba fumana ditshebeletso le melemo e reretsweng ho nolofatsa phihlello tlhokomelong le polokeho setjhabeng, esita le ho thea mokgwa o sebetsang hantle wa thekolohelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: a) Mnu Johannes David Mahlangu esikhundleni seLisekela leMcondzisi Jikelele: Tinsita Tekubambisanab) Mnu Anil Bijman Singh esikhundleni seLisekela leMcondzisi Jikelele: Imitsetfosimiso Nekuhambisanac) Nkts.

src: E boetse e habile ho fana ka tikoloho e nang le tshireletso bakeng sa ho bewa ha bana ba fumanwang ba hloka tlhokomelo le tshireletso.
tgt: Deborah Gabaakelwe Mochotlhi LIsekela leMcondzisi Jikelele: Kuhlela neLwatiso.2 IKhabhinethi ivume kubekwa etikhundleni teLitiko Letetisebenti kwanaba labalandzelako.

src: 10 Oct Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le dintlha tsa bohlokwa maemong a ha jwale.
tgt: 10 Oct Tincumo teKhabhinethi etindzabeni letigcamile kulesikhatsi sanyalo.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho tekenwa ha Bili ya Tlhomathiso ya Melao ya Dipalangwang le Dintho tse Amanang le Yona hore e be molaong, esita le ho qhalwa ha maipiletso a e-toll (tefiso ya tshebediso ya mebila) a Setlamo se Hanyetsanang le Tefiso ya Tshebediso ya Mebila Ditoropong (Outa) kgahlanong le Eijensi ya Mebila ya Naha ya Aforika Borwa (Sanral) ho entsweng ke Lekgotla le Phahameng la Maipiletso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kusayina kwaMengameli Jacob Zuma, kusayinela kutsi Umtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibela Umtsetfo Wetitfutsi Naletinye Tintfo Letiphatselene Nawo ube ngumtsetfo nesinyatselo lesitsetfwe yiNkantolo Lenkhulu Lekwendluliselwa Kuyo Emacala sekucitsa licala lelendluliselwe kuyo Lubumbano Loluphikisana Nekukhokhelwa Kwemigwaco Lemikhlu lolubitwa ngekutsi pheceleti, Opposition to Urban Tolling Alliance (Outa) kunselele yayo yekuphikisana nekukhokhelwa kwemigwaco kwe-South African National Roads Agency Limited (Sanral).IKhabhinethi ikholelwa ekutsini letintfutfuko manje tivumela bantfu baseGauteng nebaseNingizimu Afrika ngalokwetayelekile kutsi bagcile kutinzuzo lesevele sititfolile – naletisetawutfolwa – ekwentiweni kanco kwemigwaco lemikhulu/lebotsela wayeka enhlitiyweni yemnotfo waseNingizimu neNtansi neNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e kgolwa hore jwale dikgatelopele tsena di dumella batho ba Gauteng le maAforika Borwa ka kakaretso ho tsepamiso maikutlo melemong eo re seng re e fumane – esita le eo re leng boemong ba ho e fumana – dintlafalong tsa mebila e meholo kgubung ya moruo wa Aforika Borwa le Aforika e ka Borwa.
tgt: Lenchubo yekukhokhelwa kwemigwaco ngulenye incenye yeMkamo Wekwenta Kancono Imigwaco yaseGauteng Lebotsela Wayeka leseyente kancono kuhamba kwebantfu nekutfutfwa kwemphahla futsi itawenta umnotfo wesifundza newavelonkhe ube nemandla nakusasa.

src: Mokgwa wa tefiso mebileng ke ntho e le nngwe ya Projeke ya Ntlafatso ya Mebila e Meholo Gauteng e nolofaditseng ho tsamaya ha batho le thepa mme e tla etsa hore moruo wa porofense le wa naha o sebetse hantle kamoso.
tgt: Imali lekhokhelwa imigwaco yehlisiwe ngenhloso ekuphendvula tiphakamiso letentiwe ngummango bagibeli labaphuyile banakekelwe ngekutsi kungakhokhiswa banikati betitfutsi temmango kwetfulwe luhlelo lwekungakhulisi silinganisomali semali lekhokhwa ngenyanga, futsi kukhona nenchubo yetinkampani tetitfutsi yekubuyiselwa imali nangabe bakhokhe kakhulu.

src: Ditefiso tsa mebileng di fokoditswe ka lebaka la ditshwaelo tse entsweng ke setjhaba bapalami bao e leng bafutsana ba nketswe hloohong ka hore beng ba dipalangwang tsa setjhaba ba teelwe ka thoko ditefisong tsa mebileng sekepele sa tefiso ya kgwedi le kgwedi se se se entswe, mme ho teng mokgwa wa phokoletso bakeng sa dikhamphane tsa dipalangwang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu labasebentisa imigwaco yaseGauteng lengutsela wayeka kutsi balandzele umtsetfo, bakhombise kuba takhamuti letikahle babuye futsi bafake sandla ekwenteni iNingizimu Afrika lencono ngekutsi babhalisele kutfola tigcebhezana labatawukhokhiswa ngato, letatiwa ngekutsi pheceleti, e-tags babuye futsi bafake sicelo sekusebentisa lemigwaco leyincalisakuvela.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho basebedisi ba mebila e meholo ya Gauteng ho ikamahanya le molao, ho bontsha moya o motle wa boahi le ho kenya letsoho ntlafatsong ya Aforika Borwa ka ho ingodisetsa ditekete tsa boitsebahatso mme ba lefelle tshebediso ya mebila ena ya maemo a hodimo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi basebentisane kute bente Umklamo Wekwenta Kancono Imigwaco YaseGauteng Lebotsela Wayeka ube yimphumelelo kanye nekutfokotela lentfutfuko lemangalisako yetetitfutsi netekuchumana tesimanje kulelive.

src: Kabinete e kopa maAforika Borwa ho hulela hlakoreng le le leng esita le ho sebetsa mmoho ho etsa hore Projeke ya Ntlafatso ya Mebila e Meholo Gauteng e be katleho, mme ba tsebe ho leboha kgolo e babatsehang ya kaho ya meralo ya motheo ya sejwalejwale naheng.
tgt: Indvuna Yetekutfutsa itawumemetela lusuku lekutawucala ngalo kukhokhelwa kwemigwaco.

src: Letona la Dipalangwang le tla etsa tsebiso ka letsatsi leo tefiso ya mebileng e tla qala ka lona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bashayeli betimoto labavamise kusebentisa imigwaco yaseGauteng lengutsela wayeka kutsi babhalise futsi batsenge ema-e-tag kute bakwati kutfokotela tinzuzo tetephulelo.

src: Kabinete e kopa beng ba makoloi bohle ba sebedisang mebila e meholo ya Gauteng kgafetsa ho ingodisa tsamaisong esita le ho reka ditekete tsa boitsebahatso ho etsetsa hore ba be boemong bo botle ba ho fumana ditheolelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibabata luhlelo lwetetitfutsi nekuchumana lwemmango lolubita tigidzigidzi tetigidzi tetimali lolwetfulwa njalo, ngaphasi kwebuholi baMengameli Jacob Zuma, lolufaka ekhatsi kwetfulwa lokusandza kwentiwa kwemigwaco iR71 neR81 lechumanisa iPolokwane nelidolobha laseGiyani kanye nekuvulwa kwemiklamo yeBridge City neRail Link KwaZulu-Natal mhla ti-19 Imphala 2013.

src: Kabinete e rorisa phano e ntseng e tswelapele ya ditshebeletso tlasa boetapele ba Mopresidente Jacob Zuma, ya lenaneo la meralo ya motheo ya setjhaba ya diterilioneterilione tsa diranta, e akgang le ho kgakolwa ha moraorao ha mebila ya R71 le R81 e kopanyang Polokwane le toropo ya Giyani esita le ho bulwa ha projeke ya Borokgo bo Boholo le Seporo sa Lehokela e KwaZulu-Natal ka la 19 Mphalane 2013.
tgt: Buchakachaka bemigwaco lobuhlanganisiwe buyintfo lebalulekile ekuheheni lutjalomali kulelive nakulelivekati.

src: Marangrang a kopantsweng a mebila ke ntho ya bohlokwa ho hoheleng matsete naheng le kontinenteng.
tgt: Lapho siphucula imigwaco kulo lonkhe lelive, iKhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu labasebentisa lemigwaco kutsi bacaphelisise nabayisebentisa lemigwaco.

src: Jwaloka ha re ntlafatsa mebila naha ka bophara, Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho basebedisi bohle ho ba sedi ha ba sebedisa mebila.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inelunako mayelana nekukhula kwetehlakalo letifaka ekhatsi bantfu labahamba ngetinyawo kulemigwaco lemikhulu.

src: Kabinete e ngongorehile ka keketseho ya diketsahalo tse amanang le ditaaso mebileng.
tgt: Bantfu labahamba ngetinyawo benta-46% webantfu labafako emigwacweni.

src: Ditaaso di etsa 46% ya batho ba shwellang mebileng.
tgt: Bashayeli betimoto kanye nebantfu labahamba ngetinyawo banesibopho sekutsi bacaphelane emigwacweni.

src: Kabinete e kopa maAforika Borwa ohle ho ba karolo ya Selemoshome sa Matjhaba a Kopaneng sa ho nka Kgato bakeng sa Polokeho ya Mebileng (2011-2020) e etelletsweng pele ke Lefapha la Dipalangwang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi babe yincenye yeMinyakalishumi YaMhlabuhlangene Yekutsatsa Tinyatselo Tekuphepha Emgwacweni (2011-2020) leholwa Litiko Letetitfutsi.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho ba le seabo Bekeng ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo ya Imbizo eo ha jwale e tswelang pele, ho fihlela ka la 13 Mphalane 2013.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bahlanganyele kuLiviki Lekugcila Lembizo lelichubekako kwamanje, kute kube ngumhla ti-13 Imphala 2013.

src: Sena se fa setjhaba monyetla wa ho buisana le ba Phethahatso ka dintho tse sa se tshwarang hantle esita le ka hore mmuso o tsebise setjhaba ka mosebetsi wa wona.
tgt: Loku kuniketa bantfu litfuba lekukhulumisana neSigungu lesiphetse mayelana netintfo letibatsintsako kanye nekuniketa hulumende litfuba lekwatisa bantfu ngemsebenti wakhe.

src: Bohatong ba batho ba Aforika Borwa, Kabinete e leboha Letlole la Lefatshe Lohle bakeng sa tshehetso ya lona ho Aforika Borwa nakong eo ho neng ho e na le tlhokeho e kgolo ya keketso ya ditjhelete.
tgt: Egameni lebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika, iKhabhinethi ibonga Sikhwama Semhlaba Jikelele ngekwesekela iNingizimu Afrika ngesikhatsi sesimo lesibucayi sekudzinga kusitwa ngetimali letengetiwe.

src: Ena ke thuso ya ditjhelete e kgolo ka ho fetisisa e tsamayang e le nngwe bakeng sa HIV le TB e tswang mofaning wa ntho tse ngata nalaneng ya dithuso tsa AIDS.
tgt: Lena yimali yinye yesibonelelo se Sandvulelangculazi (i-HIV) ne-TB lesivela kumesekeli ngetimali lomphacanyenti emlandvweni wetekubukana Nengculazi (i-AIDS).Ngetudlwana nje kwehhafu (52%) wa-R3 wetigidzi utawunikwa Litiko Letemphilo Lavelonkhe.

src: Ho a mang mananeo, ditjhelete tsena di tla sebedisetswa tse latelang: phumantsho ya meriana ya antiretrovaerale bakeng sa bakudi ba 350 000, ditjhelete tsa pulamadiboho phanong ya meriana ya antiretrovaerale ka khoriya ho ya malapeng a bakudi kapa dibakeng tseo ba ka e amohelang ho tsona setjhabeng, ditshebeletso tsa ho shebisisa boteng ba TB ho batshwaruwa bohle ditjhankaneng tsohle Aforika Borwa, le ho shebisisa TB le HIV bakeng sa basebetsi ba merafong ba 100 000 merafong e menyane e se nang ditshebeletso tsa yona tsa bophelo bo botle.
tgt: Emkhatsini waletinye tinhlelo, letimali titawusetjentiselwa naku lokulandzelako: kutsengwa kwemitsi yetidzambisigciwane yetigulane leti-350 000, kwesekela ngetimali kuniketwa kwemitsi yetidzambisigciwane, ihanjiswe ngemakhoriya ayiyise emakhaya etigulane noma etindzaweni lapho tigulane tingayilandza kuto emmangweni, tinsita tekuhlolwa i-TB kwato tonkhe tiboshwa kuwo onkhe emajele aseNingizimu Afrika, kanye nekuhlolwa i-TB ne-HIV kwebavukuti basemigodzini/etimayini labange-100 000 etimayini letincane letite tinsita tato tatetemphilo.

src: Kabinete e rorisa dikatleho tse ntseng di tswelapele tsa Selekane se kgahlanong le HIV le AIDS, se ketekileng sehopotso sa bo 15 ka la 9 Mphalane 2013.Ha jwale Aforika Borwa e kenya tshebetsong lenaneo le leholohadi lefatsheng la kalafo ya diantiretrovaerale.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibabata kuzuza lokuchubeke njalo kweluhlelo lweKubambisana ekulweni ne-HIV ne-AIDS, lolugubhe umkhosi weminyaka le-15 solo lwabakhona loluhlelo mhla ti-09 Imphala 2013.Kwanje iNingizimu Afrika iphumelelisa luhlelo lolukhulu kakhulu emhlabeni lwetekwelashwa ngetidzambisigciwane.

src: Selekane se ile sa boela sa eba le seabo se seholo ntshetsopeleng ya Morero wa Lewa la Naha (NSP) 2012-2016.
tgt: Lolubanjiswano lubuye lwadlala indzima lebalulekile ekuhlelweni kweLisuluhlelo Lwavelonkhe 2012-2016.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa moya oo ditherisano tsa meputso di neng di tshwerwe tsa ba tsa phethelwa ka wona makaleng ao a amehileng, moo ditharollo tsa kutlwisisano ebile e le tsa ka potlako di ileng tsa fihlellwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi incoma indlela lekuchutjwe ngayo kukhulumisana nekubonisana ngetemiholo tabuye futsi taphetfwa kuleyo mikhakha lekwatfolwa kuyo tisombulelo letinesizotsa naletisheshako.

src: Dipuisano tsa setjhaba moralong wa ketso ya melao ya tsa basebetsi di dula di le bohlokwa thibelong ya merusu e amanang le boipelaetso.
tgt: Kuchumana ngetenhlalo mayelana neluhlakamsebenti lwemtsetfo lolucondzene netisebenti kusolo kusesebaluleke kakhulu ekuvimbeni budlova lobuphatselene netitelega.

src: Jwaloka ha basebetsi ba kgutlela mosebetsing, Kabinete e kopa bahiri le bahiruwa ho sebetsa mmoho, haholoholo jwaloka ha moruo wa lefatshe o dula o le tebetebeng, ho etsa hore moruo wa Aforika Borwa o sebetse hantle, o be le tlhahiso o be o boloke mesebetsi e metle ka nako tsohle.
tgt: Lapho tisebenti tibuyela emsebentini, iKhabhinethi icela bacashi netisebenti kutsi basebentisane, ikakhulu ngoba umnotfo wemhlaba usesecindzetelekile, ekwenteni umnotfo weNingizimu Afrika usebente ngalokunemandla, ukhicite kanye nekugcina ngalokunenchubekela embili lengenamkhawulo imisebenti lenesitfunti.

src: Kabinete e ananela Seboka sa Naha sa Thibelo ya ho ipolaya Tshebeletsong ya Sepolesa sa Aforika Borwa (SAPS) se tla tshwarwa ka la 16 ho ya ho la 18 Mphalane.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukela Ingcungcutsela yaVelonkhe lemayelana neKuvimba Kutibulala Kwemaphoyisa kuLuphiko Lwemaphoyisa Lwavelonkhe LwaNingizimu Aifrika (e-SAPS) letawubanjwa mhla ti-16 kuya kumhla ti-18 Imphala.

src: Mosebetsi ona o reretswe ho ntshetsa pele Morero wa Naha wa Thibelo ya ho ipolaya bakeng sa SAPMopresidente Jacob Zuma o tla amohela Mopresidente Francois Hollande wa Rephaboliki ya France bakeng sa Ketelo ya Naha Meahong ya Kopanong ho tloha ka la 14 ho ya ho la 15 Mphalane 2013.Ketelo ya Naha e tla tebisa dikamano tsa rona le France tsa sepolotiki le moruo e matlafatse tshebedisanommoho ya Leboya-Borwa esita le ho ntshetsa pele maikemisetso a rona a seAforika.
tgt: Lenchubo ihlose kwenta Lisu Lavelonkhe Lekuvimbela Kutibulala kwemaphoyisa e-SAPMengameli Jacob Zuma utawemukela Mengameli Francois Hollande waseRiphablikhi yaseFulansi eKuvakasheni Kwakhe Lokuhlelekile Nalokusemtsetfweni e-Union Buildings kusukela mhla ti-14 kuya kumhla ti-15 Imphala 2013.Lokuvakasha Lokuhlelekile Nalokusemtsetfweni kutawucinisa buhlobo betfu neFulansi betepolitiki netemnotfo bucinise kusebentisana kweNshonalana neNingizimu kanye nekuchubekisela embili i-Ajenda yetfu yase-Afrika.

src: Dipuisano le diqeto tsa bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.1 Kabinete e ananetse Melawana ya Setekhinikale ya ho Fuputsa le ho Honya Peteroliamo e tla phatlalatswa koranteng ya Mmuso bakeng sa ditshwaelo.2 Kabinete e ananetse ho tshwarwa ha Wekshopo ya Setlamo sa Neanotaba ya Tlhodisano ya Matjhaba (ICN) ke Khomishene ya Tlhodisano ya Aforika Borwa ho tloha ka la 16 ho ya ho la 18 Mphalane, Motsekapa.
tgt: Tingcoco letibalulekile netincumo teKhabhinethi.1 IKhabhinethi ivume kuLawula Ngekwebucwepheshe Kufunwa Kwaphethiloli Nekusetjentiswa Budlabha kutsi kushicilelwe kuGazethi yahulumende kute kuphawulwe ngako.2 IKhabhinethi ivume kutsi kubanjelwe kuleli lakitsi umhlanganosikolwa i-International Competition Network (ICN) Cartel Workshop ingeniswe yiKhomishini yetekuchudzelana yaseNingizumu Afrika kusukela mhla ti-16kuya kumhla ti-18 Imphala 2013, eKapa.

src: Wekshopo ya Setlamo ya ICN e thusa ka phapanyetsano ya maikutlo le neanotaba dinthong tse amanang le ditlamo hara ditho tsa yona tse nkang seabo le Dieijensi tseo e Seng tsa Mmuso lefatshe ka bophara.3 Kabinete e ile ya bewa sehlohlolong sa ditaba ka kgatelopele e entsweng kotareng ya pele ya 2013/14 ka Selekane sa Kgiro ya Batjha se tekennweng ka la 18 Mmesa 2013.Dintho tse tsheletseng tse ka sehloohong tsa Selekane sena ke (1) thuto le thupelo, (2) malebela a mosebetsi, (3) mekgatlo ya batjha, (4) pehelo ya batjha e teetsweng ka thoko, (5) bohwebi le dikoporasi tsa batjha esita le (6) dikgato tse nkwang ke lekala la poraefete.
tgt: Umhlanganosikolwa i-ICN Cartel yenta kube khona kwabelana ngemibono netindzaba tekuhlangana letiphatselene netinhlangano temalunga ayo lahlanganyelako kanye nema-Ejensi emhlabeni wonkhe jikelele langesiwo aHulumende.3 IKhabhinethi yatisiwe ngenchubekela embili leyentiwe ngekota yekucala ya-2013/14 yeSivumelwano Sekucashwa Kwelusha lesasayinwa mhla ti-18 Mabasa 2013.Tindzawo letisitfupha letibalulekile taleSivumelwano nguleti (1) temfundvo nekuceceshwa, (2) kuvetwa kumatfuba emsebenti, (3) emavulandlela elusha, (4) lokuhlosiwe kwelusha lokubekwe eceleni, (5) emabhizinisi elusha ntinhlangano lebomasibambisane kanye (6) nemitamo yemikhakha yangasense.

src: Katleho e kgolokgolo bakeng sa kotare ya pele e fupere tlhahlobo ya sethathong ya dibuka tsa ditjhelete ya diketsahalo le dikgato tsa batjha tse nkilweng ho phunyeletsa le naha yohle esita le kgato enngwe e nkuwang lekaleng la poraefete.
tgt: Lokuzuziwe lokuphuma embili kukota yekucala kufaka ekhatsi luhlolomabhuku lwekucala lwemisebenti nemitamo yelusha kuwo wonkhe umbuso kanye netinyatselo letitsatfwako /kumkhakha wangasense.3 Imitsetfosivivinyo.1 IKhabhinethi ivume kushicilelwa kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibela Kuba Ngumnikati Welitayitela Weluhlaka Lolweluliwe kute kutsi ummango wente tiphakamiso.

src: Dibili.1 Kabinete e ananetse ho phatlalatswa ha Moralo wa Bili ya Tlhomathiso ya wa Katoloso ya Netefaletso ya Bodudi bakeng sa hore setjhaba se tshwaele.
tgt: Lomtsetfosivivinyo wekuchibela uchibela Kwelulwa Kwemtsetfo Wekucinisekisa Kuba Ngumnikati Welitayitela, 1997 (Umtsetfo No 62 wanga-1997) kute ucinise, ucacise ubuye uvikele emalungelo ekuhlala emhlabeni (labahlala emapulasini).Lomtsetfosivivinyo uhlose kutfola sisombululo sekuba nematayitela emhlaba ngekuhlanganisa tindlela tekwabiwa kabusha kwemhlaba lokunetindlela letisebentako tekuvikeleka ngekwemtsetfo nekusombulula tincabano.

src: Bili ya Tlhomathiso e fetola Molao wa Katoloso ya Netefaletso ya Bodudi, 1997, (Molao wa 62 wa 1997) ho matlafatsa, ho hlakisa le ho tshireletsa ditokelo tsa bodudi tsa ba dulang sebakeng seo (badudi ba mapolasing).Sepheo sa Bili ke ho fumana tharollo ya nako e telele ditlhokehong tsa tshireletso ya bodudi ka ho kopanya mekgwa ya kabobotjha ya mobu le tshireletso ya molao, esita le mekgwa ya tharollo ya dikgohlano.
tgt: Lomtsetfosivivinyo ufuna kwenta kancono emalungelo etisebenti tasemapulasini kanye nalabahlala khona.

src: Bili e habile ho ntlafatsa ditokelo tsa basebetsi le badudi ba mapolasing.
tgt: Labanye labahlala emapulasini kuvamise kuba bomake nebantfwana.2 IKhabhinethi ivume kushicilelwa kweLuhlaka lweMtsetfosivivinyo weMtsetfo Wetemphilo Yasemayini kanye Nekuphepha, 2013 kuGazethi yaHulumende kute kutsi ummango wente tiphakamiso.

src: Badudi ba mapolasing bao e seng basebetsi e atisa ho ba basadi le bana.2 Kabinete e ananetse ho phatlalatswa ha Moralo wa Bili ya Tlhomathiso ya Molao wa Bophelo bo Botle le Polokeho Merafong, 2013, Koranteng ya Mmuso bakeng sa hore setjhaba se tshwaele.
tgt: Lomtsetfosivivinyo uhlose kuchibila Umtsetfo Wetemphilo Nekuphepha eMayini 29 wanga-1996 kute kubuyeketwe kulandzelwa kwawo, kwenta kubelula tinchubo tekuhlawulisa nekucinisekisa tinhlawulo.

src: 24 Oct 2013Kabinete e ile ya tshwara kopano ya yona e tlwaelehileng Motse Kapa ka la 23 Mphalane Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le dintlha tsa bohlokwa maemong a ha jwale.
tgt: 24 Oct 2013IKhabhinethi ibambe umhlangano wayo lowetayelekile eKapa mhla tinge-23 Imphala Tincumo teKhabhinethi etindzabeni letigcamile kulesimo sanyalo.1 IKhabhinethi yemukele lenchubekela embili lesiyibonako kumkhankhaso wekwetfulwa kwetakhiwonchanti temmango walelive lochunyaniswa yiKhomishini Yekucondziswa Kwesakhiwonchanti YeLihhovisi laMengameli (i-PICC).

src: Kabinete e amohetse kgatelopele eo re e bonang letsholong la kaho ya meralo ya motheo ya setjhaba e hlophiswang ke Khomishene ya Moporesidente ya Tlhophiso ya Meralo ya Motheo (PICC).
tgt: Mengameli Jacob Zuma usandza kwetfula imiklamo leminyenti leseyiphotfuliwe njengencenye yeLuhlelo Lwekutfutfukiswa Kwesakhiwonchanti.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o sa tswa kgakola diprojeke tse ngatanyana tse phethetsweng e le karolo ya lenaneo la Kaho ya Meralo ya Motheo.
tgt: Ifaka ekhatsi imigwaco i-R81 ne-R71 eLimpopo, siteshi sesitimela iBridge City lesitawuba yinsita e-Umlazi eDurban nemgubho wekusika lisoyi eMayini iDe Beers Venetia eVhembe, eLimpopo.

src: Tsena di akga mosebetsi o entsweng mebileng ya R81 le R71 Limpopo, seteishene sa terene sa Bridge City se tla thusa batho ba Umlazi, Durban, esita le mokete wa setletle o neng o le Morafong wa De Beers wa Venetia o Vhembe, Limpopo.
tgt: Mengameli futsi usatawetfula letinye tinhlelo tetakhiwonchanti njenge Kutfutfukiswa Kwendzawo Yetimboni (IDZ) eSaldanha Bay eNshonalanga Kapa ahambe ayobona Lidamu i-De Hoop Dam, eLimpopo, etfule timoto tekucala letakhiwe eNingizimu Afrika eMphumalanga Kapa, letatiwa ngekutsi pheceleti automotive wagons abuye futsi avule ngalokusemtsetfweni Sibhedlela i-Ladybrand eFreyistata.

src: Moporesidente o boetse o mathuleng a ho kgakola mananeo a mang a meralo ya motheo a kang Lebatowa la Ntshetsopele ya Diindasteri le Koung ya Saldanha (IDZ) Kapa Bophirima ho etela setsha sa Letamo la De Hoop, Limpopo, ho kgakola makoloi a pele a entsweng Aforika Borwa kwana Kapa Botjhabela, le ho bula semmuso Sepetlele sa Ladybrand Foreistata.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibuye yemukela inchubekela embili yetinhlelo temabhasi asedolobheni lolwatiwa kakhulu ngekutsi pheceleti, Rapid Bus Transit (BRT) lwaseJozi, Tshwane, eKapa naseRusternburg.

src: Lenaneo lena la meralo ya motheo la diterilioneterilione tsa diranta le bopa botjha moruo le mokgwatsamaiso wa dipalangwang naheng ya rona.
tgt: Loluhlelo lwesakhiwonchanti lolubita tigidzigidzi tetigidzi lumisa kabusha umnotfo walelive kanye nenchubo yetetitfutsi kulelive.

src: Diprojeke tsena di bile le sephetho sa ho bea moruo motjheng wa kgolo e hodimo mme di tla tswelapele ho kenya letsoho ntshetsopeleng ya moruo le tlhahisong ya mesebetsi.2 Kabinete e amohela Pehelo ya Leano la Ditekanyetso tsa Nako e Bohareng e takilweng ke Letona la tsa Ditjhelete.
tgt: Lemiklamo ibenemphumela wekumisa kahle umnotfo, ukhule kakhulu futsi itawuchubeka ifake sandla ekutfutfukeni kwemnotfo nasekuvuleni ematfuba emisebenti.2 IKhabhinethi yemukela Sitatimende Senchubomgomo Yelwabiwomali Lwethemu Lesemkhatsini lolwetfulwe yiNdvuna Yetetimali.

src: Kabinete e tshehetsa mehato e matla ya tokiso e sisintsweng bakeng sa mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yesekela tindlelasisombululo letiphakanyisiwe hulumende langacedza ngato kwehla kwelizinga lekuphila letemnotfo.

src: Mehato ena e tla thusa ka nako e telele phokotsehong ya tshenyo efe kapa efe tshebedisong ya tjhelete ya mmuso.
tgt: Letindlelasisombululo titawenta umsebenti lomkhulu ekunciphiseni nanoma ngukuphi kusetjentiswa budlabha kwetimali tahulumende.

src: Mehato eo e tla netefatsa hore mmuso o sebedisa disebediswa tsa wona ka bokgabane.
tgt: Letindlelasisombululo titawenta siciniseko sekutsi hulumende usebentisa imitfombolusito yakhe ngalokunemphumelelo nangalokuceceshekile.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho mafapha ohle a naha le a diporofense, bomasepala, ditheo tsa setjhaba le ditheo tsa molaotheo ho kenya mehato ena tshebetsong.3 Kabinete e ikamahantse le Moporesidente Jacob Zuma mmoho le setjhaba sa Aforika Borwa ho seolleng tlhekefetso, dikgoka le ho se tsotelle bana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema onkhe ematiko avelonkhe newetifundza, bomasipalati, imitimba yahulumende kanye netikhungo temtsetfosisekelo kutsi tisebentise letindlelasisombululo.3 IKhabhinethi ijoyine Mengameli Jacob Zuma kanye nemmango waseNingizimu Afrika ekugcekeni kuhlukumeta, budlova, kanye nekunganakwa kwebantfwana.

src: Kabinete e thoholeditse sepolesa ka mekgahlelo ya sona ka ho nka dikgato tse potlakileng ditlolong tsa molao tse sa tswa tlalehwa haufinyane.
tgt: IKhabhinethi income kakhulu ema-ejensi etekucinisekisa kugcinwa kwemtsetfo ngekutsatsa tinyatselo ngekushesha kulamacala lasandza kubikwa.

src: Jwaloka ha re tla be re e na le Letsatsi la Naha la Bana ka la 2 Pudungwana, Kabinete e kopa maAforika Borwa ohle ho sireletsa bana jwaloka ha e le baetapele ba rona ba kamoso.
tgt: Njengoba sihlonipha Lusuku Lwebantfwana Lwavelonkhe mhla titi-2 Lweti, iKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bavikele bantfwana ngoba babaholi betfu bakusasa.

src: Kabinete e boela e etsa kgoeletso setjhabeng ho tswelapele ho sebedisana le sepolesa twantshong ya ditlolo tsa molao kahara WEBTOKEN tshwanela le ho ba sedi ka taba ya hore tshireletso ya bana ke boikarabelo ba batswadi le setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphindza futsi imema yonkhe imimango kutsi ichubeke isebentisane nema-ejensi etekucinisekisa kugcinwa kwemitsetfo ekulweni nebugebengu emimangweni.

src: Re tshwanela ho thusa bomme ba hlokang thuso ya ho hodisa bana ba bona.4 Kabinete e amohetse tsebiso e entsweng ke Umalusi ya hore naha ke malalaalaotswe bakeng sa ditlhahlobo tsa Materiki ho tloha ka la 28 Mphalane ho sia ho la 29 Pudungwana 2013.
tgt: Sifanele kutsi sikhumbule kutsi kuvikelwa kwebantfwana kusibopho sebatali kanye nemimango.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho Sehlopha sa 2013 ho etsa naha hore e be motlotlo.5 Kabinete e ananetse ho kgakolwa, ke Moporesidente, ha lenaneo la tshireletso ya dijo la Fetsa Tlala Kuruman Kapa Leboya ka la 24 Mphalane 2013.
tgt: Sifanele sisite bomake labadzinga lusito ekukhuliseni bantfwababo.4 IKhabhinethi yemukele simemetelo lesentiwe ngu-Umalusi sekutsi lelive selililungele Luhlolo Lwekuphela Kwemnyaka Lwamatikuletjeni Lwavelonkhe kusukela mhla tinge-28 Imphala kuya kumhla tinge-29 Lweti 2013.

src: Lenaneo le tla thusa setjhaba ho hlahisa dijo mobung wa setjhaba esita le o mong o sa sebedisweng hakaalo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ifisela bonkhe bafundzi lababhalako labati-707 136, kufaka ekhatsi labati-130 000 labebafundza ngetikhatsi letitsite, kutsi babhale kahle baphumelele eluhlolweni lwabo.

src: E tla tshehetsa borapolasi ba banyenyane ka meralo ya motheo, kaho ya disebediswa tsa tlhahiso ya dihlahiswa tsa temo esita le kaho ya mebaraka e metjha, ho akga le phumantsho ya mmuso.6 Kabinete e ananela ho hlomamiswa ha Indaba ya Mawatleng a Aforika e tla ba Sandton, Johannesburg, ka la 24 le 25 Mphalane 2013.
tgt: Batali nebalondvoloti bebantfwana bayacelwa kutsi basite bantfwababo lapho basalungisela luhlolo lwabo.

src: Seboka se tla fana ka lepatlelo bakeng sa banka karolo ba fapafapaneng ho kutla tsela ya ntshetsopele bakeng sa diindasteri tsa mawatleng a Aforika se be se thee Selekane sa Dinaha Tsohle tsa Aforika bakeng sa kaho ya moruo o tswetseng pele wa Aforika.7 Kabinete e tsebile ka Ketelo ya ho Emela Naha ya Moporesidente Zuma ya ho ya Rephaboliki ya Demokrasing ya Congo (DRC) ka la 29 le la 30 Mphalane 2013.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela Liklasi langa-2013 kutsi lente lelive litigcabhe.5 IKhabhinethi yemukele kwetfulwa kweluhlelo lwe-Fetsa Tlala (Cedza Indlala) lwekucinisekisa kubakhona kwekudla lokwanele nguMengameli Jacob Zuma eKuruman eNyakatfo Kapa mhla tinge-24 Imphala 2013.

src: Ketelo e tla matlafatsa maemo a rona a sepolotiki sa naha tse pedi le dikamano tsa moruo le DRC, ho feta moo e ntlafatse boikitlaetso ba rona ba matsapa a ho boloka kgotso esita le lenaneo la Kahobotjha le Ntshetsopele Kamora Dikgohlano (PCRD) naheng eo.8 Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho tshehetsa Kgwedi ya Naha ya Tlhokomediso ya Ditokelo tsa ba Holofetseng ho tloha ka la 3 Pudungwana ho ya ho la 3 Tshitwe, e boelang e ba Letsatsi la Matjhabatjhaba la Batho ba Holofetseng.
tgt: Loluhlelo lutawusita imimango kutsi ikhicite kudla emhlabeni wemmango nakuleminye imihlaba lengasetjentiswa.

src: Kgwedi e tla ketekwa tlasa mookotaba o reng: “Tlosa ditshita, bula menyetla: bakeng sa setjhaba se kenyeletsang bohle”.9 Kabinete e tsebile ya ba ya ngongorehiswa ke tsosoloso ya merusu le dikgoka Rephaboliking ya Mozambique.
tgt: Itawusita balimi labancane ngetakhiwonchanti, kutfutfukiswa kwekuchutjwa kwetekulima kanye nekuvetwa nekutfutfukiswa kwetimakethe letinsha, kufaka ekhatsi lokutsengwa ngumbuso.6 IKhabhinethi yemukela kuba khona kwekucala kwemhlangano wase-Afrika lomayelana netindzaba taselwandle lobitwa ngekutsi pheceleti African Maritime Indaba lotawubanjela eSandton, eJozi, mhla tinge-24 kuya kumhla tinge-25 Imphala 2013.

src: Kabinete e batla ho thasisetsa hore Mozambique e na le mmuso o molaong mme ho tsohela matla hofe kapa hofe ho nyatsa boipuiso ba mmuso wa Mozambique le batho ba yona.
tgt: Lomhlangano utawube uphetfwe Tiphatsimandla Tetekuphepha Taselwandle TaseNingizimu Afrika kanye nemboni yetaselwandle.

src: Kabinete e seolla kahohlehohle ditlhaselo tsa ho tsohela mmuso matla.2 Dipuisano le diqeto tsa bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.1 Kabinete e ananetse kamohelo ya Sehlomathiso sa Doha ho Porothokhole ya Kyoto.
tgt: Lenkhomfa itawuvula inkhundla yebadlalindzima labanyenti kutsi bakhe tindlela tekutfutfukisa timboni tetaselwandle ibuye futsi isungule Budlelwane Bawo Onkhe Emave ase-Afrika kute kutfutfukiswe umnotfo we-Afrika wetaselwandle.7 IKhabhinethi ivume Luhambo Lwekuvakasha Lolusemtsetfweni lolutako lolutawungenelwa nguMengameli Zuma alibhekise eDemocratic Republic of Congo (DRC) mhla tinge-29-30 Imphala 2013.

src: Dihlomathiso tsena di bopa karolo ya matsapa a phokotso ya ho kunkela ha gase lefatsheng a reretsweng ho thibela phetoho e kotsi ya tlelaemete ha ka ho le leng di tshireletsa dintho tse ka sehloohong tsa ntshetsopele dinaheng tse ntseng di thuthua.2 Kabinete e ananetse hore Ditlaleho tsa Sethathong tse Kopantsweng tsa ba tsa Hakuretswa tsa Aforika Borwa tlasa Selekane sa Matjhabatjhaba Ditokelong tsa Setjhaba le tsa Sepolotiki di fetisetswe Matjhabeng a Kopaneng.
tgt: Lokuvakasha kutawucinisa budlelwane betfu ne-DRC kutepolitiki netemnotfo lobumphacambili kwendlule futsi kwente kancono kutinikela kwetfu kumitamo yekugcina kuthula kanye neluhlelo lwalelive (i-DRC) lweKwakha Kabusha Ngemuva Kwetibhelu kanye Nekutfutfukisa (PCRD).8 IKhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi basekele Inyanga Yekwatisa Emalungelo Alabakhubatekile Yavelonkhe kusukela mhla titi-3 Lweti kuya kumhla titi-3 Ingongoni 2013, lokuphindze futsi kube Lusuku Lwalabaphila Nekukhubateka Lwavelonkhe.

src: Tlaleho ke tshekatsheko ya dikatleho le diphephetso tse amanang le ho fanwa ha sephetho ditokelong tsa setjhaba le tsa sepolotiki tse fuperweng ke Selekane esita le Molaotheo wa rona.
tgt: Lenyanga itawugujwa ngaphansi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Susa tihibe, vula iminyango: yemmango wawonkhe wonkhe”.9 IKhabhinethi icaphele ngelunako kucubuka kabusha futsi kwebudlova bebutsa eRepublic of Mozambique.

src: E tsepamisitse maikutlo seriting sa botho le tokelo ya tekano haesale ho tloha qalong ya demokrasi ka 1994.3 Dibili.1 Kabinete e ananetse ho phatlalatswa ha moralo wa Bili ya Kgothaletso le Tshireletso ya Matsete, ya 2013, bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ifisa kugcizelela kutsi iMozambique ibahulumende losemtsetfweni nekutsi futsi nanoma ngukuphi kucubuka kabusha kwebudlova kubukela phasi bukhulu bahulumende waseMozambique kanye nebantfu bakhe.

src: Bili e fana ka moralo wa molao bakeng sa matsete ebile e bua ka tshireletso ya molao ya boramatsete bohle ho ya ka ditlhoko tsa Molaotheo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igceka ngalokunemandla kuhlaselwa lokucubuka kabusha.2 Tinkhulumiswano netincumo teKhabhinethi letibalulekile.1 IKhabhinethi ivume kuciniswa kweLuchitjelo lweDoha kuPhrothokholi yeKyoto.

src: Molao o lohothwang o tla ntlafatsa bokgoni ba rona ba ho hohela matsete a tswang kantle esita le kgolo ya diyantle le ho kgothaletsa kgolo ya nako e telele ya ntshetsopele Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lokuchibela loku kwenta incenye yemitamo yemnyaka wanga-2013-2020 yekunciphisa kutfunyiswa kwemoya longcolile leyentelwe kuvimbela kugucuka kwesimo selitulu lokuyingoti kube futsi kuvikelwa tintfo letibekwa embili tekutfutfukisa emave lasatfutfuka.2 IKhabhinethi ivume kutsi Imibiko yeNingizimu Afrika Yasekucaleni Lehlanganisiwe Neyetikhatsi Ngetikhatsi Lengaphasi Kwesivumelwano Semhlaba Semalungelo Etakhamuti Newepolitiki kutsi yetfulwe kuMhlabuhlangene.

src: Moralo wa Bili, kahoo, o habile ho fihlella botsitso bo itseng dipakeng tsa ditokelo le ditlamo tsa boramatsete bohle Aforika Borwa, tlhokeho ya ho fana ka tshireletso e lekaneng ebile e le e lekanang ya boramatsete ba tswang kantle ho naha esita le ba lapeng.2 Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya Sehlomathiso ya ho Rentwa ha Matlo Palamenteng.
tgt: Kubika kukuhlola kuzuza kanye netinselele letihambisana nekusebenta kwemalungelo etakhamuti netepolitiki lacuketfwe kuSivumelwano nakuMtsetfosisekelo.

src: Bili e rarolla dintho tse ding tsa ho hlakisa le ho kenya tshebetsong tse ropohileng haesale ho tloha ka tsebiso ya Molao wa ho Rentwa ha Matlo, wa 1999 (Molao wa Nomoro ya 50 wa 1999) (jwaloka ha o hlomathisitswe ka 2008).
tgt: Inekugcila lokutsite kusitfunti semuntfu kanye nelilungelo letekulingana kusukela kwabakhona umbuso wentsandvo yelinyenti nga-1994.3 Imitsetfosivivinyo.1 IKhabhinethi ivume kushicilelwa kweluhlaka lweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekukhutsata Nekuvikela Lutjalomali, 2013, kute kutsi ummango wente tiphakamiso.

src: Sepheo sa ketso ya molao ke ho kgothaletsa mmaraka o tsitsitseng o bile o hola mme o kgahlanyetsana le tlhokeho e kubutehileng ya matlo a fihlellehang a rentwang bathong ba neng ba kotetswe ke kgethollo e leeme.3 Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya Sehlomathiso Bontamolane, ya 2013, Palamenteng.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uniketa luhlakamsebenti lwetemtsetfo lwelutjalomali ubuye futsi ulungise kuvikeleka ngekwemtsetfo kwabo bonkhe batjalimali ngekuhambisana netidzingo teMtsetfosisekelo.

src: Bili e hlomathisa Molao wa Bontamolane wa 1979 (Molao wa 53 wa 1979), e le mohato wa nakwana, ho emetswe ho tekwa le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Bili ya Tshebetso ya Molao.
tgt: Lomtsetfo lolindzelwe utawenta kancono likhono letfu lekuheha lutjalomali lwangaphandle, lwalamanye emave nekukhula kwekutsengiswa ngaphandle kwemphahla kute kukhutsatwe kukhula lokunenchubekela embili lokungenamkhawulo nekutfutfuka eNingizimu Afrika.

src: E rarolla ho se lekane ho amanang le bontamolane esita le bomaithutwana ba bontamolane ebile e nyahlatsa mekgatlo ya tsa molao e theilweng ho ya ka meedi ya boahlodi mokgwatsamaiso wa mahae a seng a fedisitswe (Transkei, Bophuthatswana, Ciskei le Venda).
tgt: Loluhlaka lweMtsetfosivivinyo luhlose kuzuza kusimama lokumbalwa lokusemkhatsini wemalungelo netibopho tabo bonkhe batjalimali eNingizimu Afrika, sidzingo sekuniketa kuvikeleka lokwanele nalokulinganako kwebatjalimali bakulamanye emave nebaseNingizimu Afrika.2 Ikhabinethi ivume kungeniswa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo Lochibela Kucashiswa Kwetindlu, 2013.

src: Dihlomathiso di tla netefatsa boteng ba taolo e tshwanang ya porofeshene ya bontamolane naha ka bophara ebile di tla matlafatsa taolo ya porofeshene ya tsa molao dibakeng tse phanyaotsweng.4 Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya Sehlomathiso Ntamolane e Moholo wa Mmuso, ya 2013 Palamenteng.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo ulungisa kuhunyushwa lokutsite kanye netindzaba tekuphumelelisa letivele kusukela kwamenyetelwa Umtsetfo Wekucashiswa Kwetindlu, 1999 (Umtsetfo Nombolo 50 wanga-1999) (njengoba wachitjelwa nga-2008).

src: Sepheo sa Bili ke ho hlomathisa Molao wa Ntamolane e Moholo wa Mmuso, wa 1957 (Molao wa 56 wa 1957).
tgt: Lomtsetfo uhlose kukhutsata imakethe lesimeme nalekhulako lehlangabetana nekuchubekela embili kwekufunwa ngemandla kwetindlu tekucashisa letingabiti kakhulu kubantfu labebancishwe ematfuba phambilini ngekubandlululwa ngalokungafanele.3 Ikhabinethi ivume kungeniswa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo Lochibela Tebameli, 2013.

src: Dihlomathiso di fana ka lewa la boetapele bakeng sa bookamedi le tekolo tsa Ditshebeletso tsa Molao tsa Mmuso.
tgt: Lomtsetfosivivinyo uchibela Umtsetfo Webameli, 1979 (Umtsetfo 53 wanga-1979), njengesimiso samanje sesikhashana, kuseselindzelwe kushwaywa nekuphunyeleliswa kweMtsetfosiviviyo Webasebenti Betemtsetfo.

src: Sepheo sa Bili ke ho nolofatsa ho thonngwa ha Ntamolane-Kakaretso ya tla tshwara Bontamolane bohle ba Mmuso a be a fane ka dintho tse amanang le hoo, e le kgato ya pele ho kenngweng tshebetsong ha Moralo wa Leano bakeng sa Phetoho ya Ditshebeletso tsa Molao tsa Mmuso.5 Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha moralo wa Bili ya Tekolo ya Boleng ba Thepa ya 2013 Palamenteng.
tgt: Ulungisa kungalingani kwebameli kanye nebameli labangemakhandidethi ubuye futsi ucitse imikhandlu yetemtsetfo leyasungulwa ngekuya kwemincele yebuphatsimandla yenchubo lefile yetabelo (Transkei, Bophuthatswana, Ciskei neVenda).

src: Bili e hlekela ho thewa ha Kantoro ya Molekodi-Kakaretso wa Thepa.
tgt: Lokuchitjelwa kutawucinisekisa kulawula lokufanako kwebungcweti bebumeli kulo lonkhe lelakitsi futsi kutawucinisa kwenganyelwa kwebungcweti betemtsetfo kuletindzawo letibaliwe.4 Ikhabhinethi ivume kungeniswa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo Lochibela Tebameli Bembuso, 2013.

src: Kantoro ena e tla fana ka tshebeletso ya tekolo ya boleng bakeng sa thepa e hlwaetsweng mabaka a kamoho ya thepa molemong wa setjhaba le kabobotjha ya mobu, esita le tshebeletso ya boithaopo ya tekolo ya boleng ba thepa mafapheng a ka nnang a kopa kantoro ho etsa ditekolo tse jwalo tsa boleng.6 Kabinete e ananetse ho shejwa botjha ha moralo wa Bili ya Kaho ya Meralo ya Motheo Palamenteng.
tgt: Lokuchibela kuniketa kuhola ngalokunelisu kwekuphatfwa nekwenganyelwa kweLuphiko Lwetinsita Tetemtsetfo Lwembuso.

src: Bili e thea ka ho ya ka molao, PICC le Morero wa Naha wa Meralo ya Motheo e le mekgwa ya bohlokwa ho hlophisa le ho sututsa kaho ya meralo ya motheo Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Uhlose kuchuba kubekwa kweMmeli Jikelele lotawulawula bonkhe Bameli Bembuso abuye futsi abuke tindzaba letiphatselene naloko, njengesinyatselo sekucala sekuphunyeleliswa Kweluhlakamtsetfo Lwenchubomgomo yekuGuculwa kweLuphiko Lwetinsita Tetemtsetfo Lwembuso.5 Ikhabhinethi ivume kungeniswa ePhalamende kweLuhlaka Lwemtsetfosivivinyo Wekuhlola Tindlu, 2013.

src: Bili ya Kaho ya Meralo ya Motheo e fana ka moralo wa molao bakeng sa lenaneo la kaho ebile e thusa ho ntlafatsa diphetho tsa yona tsa ntshetsopele le ho sebetsa ka bokgabane.7 Kabinete e ananetse moralo wa Bili ya Matlafatso ya Basadi le Tekano ya Bong, 2013, bakeng sa hore o hlahiswe Palamenteng.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo wenta kutsi kusungulwe Lihhovisi Lemhloli Jikelele Wetindlu.

src: Bili e habile ho thea moralo wa ketso ya molao bakeng sa boleng bo sa kgetholleng mmala, bo sa kgetholleng bong mme e le ba tekano jwaloka ha ho thasiseditswe ho Molaotheo.
tgt: Lelihhovisi litawuniketa tinsita tekuhlolwa kwetindlu letikhonjwe njengetindlu nemhlaba lekufanele kutsi hulumende awabe kabusha, kanye netinsita tekuhlola tindlu ngekutinikela kumatiko langacela lelihhovisi kutsi lente njalo.6 Ikhabhinethi ivume kungeniswa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekutfutfukiswa Kwetakhiwonchanti.

src: E boetse e habile ho kgothaletsa matlafatso ya basadi, boemedi ba bona bo lekanang ditheong tsa ketso ya diqeto esita le tshireletso ya bona jwaloka ha ho utollwa ho Karolo ya 9 (2) ya Molaotheo.8 Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya Bolaodi ba Tsamaiso ya Setjhaba ya 2013, Palamenteng.
tgt: LoMtsetfotfosivivinyo usungula ngekwemtsetfo i-PICC kanye neLisu Letakhiwonchanti Lavelonkhe njengetindlela letibalulekile tekuchumanisa nekuchuba kutfutfukiswa kwetakhiwonchanti eNingizimu Afrika.

src: 07 Nov Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le dintlha tsa bohlokwa maemong a ha jwale.1 Kabinete e amohetse tlaleho ya Goldman Sachs, Dilemoshome tse Pedi tsa Tokoloho, e leng tlhakisetso e tebileng ya dibaka tse leshome tseo Aforika Borwa e entseng dikgatelopele tse bonahalang haesale ho tloha ka 1994, esita le dikarolo tse 10 moo naha e tshwanelang ho nka dikgato ho tsona.
tgt: 07 Nov Tincumo teKhabhinethi etindzabeni letigcamile kulesimo sanyalo.1 IKhabhinethi yemukele umbiko weGoldman Sachs, weNkhululeko Yeminyaka Lengemashumi Lamabili, lelandzisa kabanti ngemikhakha lelishumi iNingizimu Afrika leyente kuyo inchubekel’embili kusukela nga-1994 kanye nemikhakha lelishumi lelive lelifanele liyitsatsele tinyatselo.

src: Tlaleho ena ke tiiso ya kamohelo ya boitekolo ba mmuso ba tshebetso ya naha ebile e ananela dintlha tse ka sehloohong bakeng sa bokamoso, bo tekilweng Morerong wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha.
tgt: Lombiko usiciniseko lesemukelekako seluhlolo lolwentiwe nguhulumende lucobo lwakhe lwendlela lelive lelisebente ngayo futsi icinisekisa tintfo letitawubekwa embili esikhatsini lesitako letibekwe kuLuhlelo Lwekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe.

src: Tlaleho ena ke mohlodi wa tshepo le kgothatso mme ke seabo sa bohlokwa puisanong le setjhaba ka nako ena eo Aforika Borwa e seng e qadile ho keteka Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho.
tgt: Lombiko ungumtfombo welitsemba nenshisekelo futsi uligalelo lelibalulekile enkhulumeni yemmango esikhatsini lapho khona iNingizimu Afrika icale kugubha umkhosi weNkhululeko Yeminyaka lenge-20.Hulumende ucela bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi basebente ngekubambisana futsi basebente ngekutikhandla kute kwentiwe iNingizimu Afrika iphumelele kwendlula loku futsi basebentise imidlandla yabo kuletindzaba nekukhuluma kwabo kugcile kuletindzaba.2 IKhabhinethi yemukela kwakhiwa kwemanyuvesi lamabili eNyakatfo Kapa naseMpumalanga, ekucala ngca kwakhiwa solo kwatfolwa inkhululeko.

src: Yunivesithi ya Mpumalanga e tla bulwa ka Pherekgong ya 2014.
tgt: Inyuvesi yaseMpumalanga itawuvula ngaBhimbidvwane 2014.

src: Katleho ena e bontsha bohlokwa boo mmuso le maAforika Borwa ohle a e beang thutong e le karolo ya ntshetsopele ya naha.
tgt: Lemphumelelo ikhombisa kubaluleka hulumende nabo bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labakufaka kutemfundvo njengencenye yekutfutfuka kwalelive.

src: Khamphase ena e ntjha e tla thusa baithuti ba Mpumalanga ka ho ithuta haufi le mahabo bona mme e tla hlahisa menyetla e mengatanyana ya moruo e tla be e reretswe ho sebeletsa yunivesithi le setjhaba sa yona.
tgt: Lenyuvesi lensha itawenta bafundzi baseMpumalanga bakwati kufundza dvute nasekhaya futsi itawenta kubekhona imisebenti leminyenti yetemnotfo letawubukana nekuniketa lenyuvesi nebantfu bayo tinsita.

src: Aforika Borwa e entse dikgatelopele tse kgolo phanong ya ditshebeletso le ditheo tse ntjha setjhabeng se kotetsweng ebile e le se hlokang haholo.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika yente umsebenti lomuhle wekuniketa imimango lencishwe ematfuba naledzingako tinsita netikhungo letinsha.

src: Tshenyo ya ditheo tsena e kgutlisetsa morao dikatleho tsa bohlokwa tseo bohle re di fihlelletseng nakong ya demokrasi ya rona e ntjha.3 Kabinete e boela e ananela tsebiso ya hore ditsi tsa motlakase tsa Eskom, e leng Kusile le Medupi, di tla fepela motlakase ka 2014.Ho fehlwa ha motlakase ke ditsi tsa motlakase tsa Kusile le Medupi isao e tla ba katleho e kgolo ntshetsopeleng ya naha mme e tla bontsha katleho ya mmuso ya ho kenya tshebetsong lenaneo la kaho ya meralo ya motheo e meholo, e bopang botjha moruo le setjhaba sa rona.
tgt: Kubhidlitwa kwaletikhungo kubuyisela emuva loko lokubalulekile lesesikuzuzile sonkhe ngesikhatsi senkhululeko yetfu lensha.3 IKhabhinethi iyachubela yemukela simemetelo sekutsi Tiphehlagezi taka-Eskom iKusile neMedupi titawucala kukhicita gezi nga-2014.

src: Motlakase o itjarang ka nako e telele o bohlokwa bakeng sa bareki ba malapeng le ba diindasteri mme o bula menyetla bakeng sa ho hodisa moruo – e leng ntlha e bileng ka sehloohong haesale ho tloha ka 2009.
tgt: Kuphehlwa kwagezi kulomnyaka lotako Tiphehlagezi iKusile neMedupi kutawuba ngulelinye ligcatsi lekutfutfuka kwalelive futsi kutawukhombisa kuphumelela kwahulumende ekusebentiseni luhlelo lwekutfutfukisa sakhiwonchanti lesitawusebentela indzawo lenkhulu lokumisa kabusha umnotfo wetfu netenhlalo.

src: Ka diprojeke tse ngata hakaalo tsa mofuta ona tse ntseng di tswelapele naha ka bophara, Aforika Borwa e se e nkile dikgato tse ngatanyana tsa bohlokwa tseleng ya yona e ntjha ya kgolo, kahoo maAforika Borwa ohle a tshwanela ho keteka dikatleho tsa rona.4 Kabinete e thoholetsa ho tekenwa ha Selekane sa Projeke e Kgolo ya Inga ya Phehlo ya Motlakase, nakong ya Ketelo ya moraorao ya Mopresidente Jacob Zuma Rephaboliking ya Demokrasi ya Congo.
tgt: Emandla agezi lachubekela embili ngalokungenamkhawulo abaluleke kakhulu kumakhasimende asekhaya newetimboni futsi avula ematfuba lamasha emnotfo lokhulako – lebekuyintfo lebekwe embili yalolulawulo kusukela nga-2009.

src: Projeke ena e tla atolla phihlello ya motlakase Aforika e be e fane ka menyetla e metle haholo ya temo, merafo le Makala a mang lebatoweng la Dinaha tse Tswelang pele tsa Aforika e ka Borwa (SADC).Hang ha ho se ho phethetswe mekgahlelo yohle, projeke ena e tla tlisa phepelo e ntjhafatsehang ya motlakase kontinenteng ya Aforika.
tgt: Ngenca yalemiklamo lengaka leyentiwa kulo lonkhe lelive lakitsi, iNingizimu Afrika seyihambe tinyatselo letibalulekile endleleni yayo yekukhula, futsi bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bafanele bagubhe lomkhosi wetfu wemphumelelo.4 IKhabhinethi itfokotele kusayinwa kweSivumelwano Semklamo We-Grand Inga Hydropower, ngesikhatsi seLuhambo Lwembuso lwaMengameli Jacob Zuma lasandza kulungenela lwekuya eDemocratic Republic of Congo.

src: Projeke ena e tla qholotsa tlhahiso ya mesebetsi, ntshetsopele ya bokgoni le phetisetso ya theknoloji dinaheng tse nang le seabo mme e tla thusa basebedisi ba malapeng le ba diindasteri.
tgt: Lomklamo utawukhulisa kufinyelela emandla e-Afrika ubuye futsi uletse tinzuzo letinyenti kumikhakha yetekulima, timbiwa kanye naleminye esigodzini se-SADKutawutsi nasekuphele tonkhe letigaba, lomklamo utawuletsa emandla lentiwa kabusha kuhhafu yelivekati lase-Afrika.

src: Sena se bohlokwa haholo kgolong ya moruo le qothisano ya lehlokwa lebatoweng la SADC ka bophara.5 Kabinete e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa ohle, haholoholo batjha le bao ba tla be ba vouta kgetlo la pele, ho sebedisa tokelo ya bona ya demokrasi ka ho nka kgato ya pele ya ho ingodisetsa ho vouta ka la 9 le la 10 Pudungwana 2013.Ntwa ya rona ya tokoloho e tshireleditse tokelo ya moAforika Borwa e mong le e mong ya ho ba mahlahahlaha seabong sa tsamaiso ya demokrasi.
tgt: Lomklamo utawuvula imisebenti, utfutfukise emakhono nekwendluliswa kwetebucwepheshe emaveni latawube ahlanganyela futsi utawuzuzisa labatawusebentisa emakhaya nasetimbonini.

src: Re etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho tlotla nalane ya rona le ho tswelapele ho matlafatsa nepahalo ya demokrasi ya rona.
tgt: Loku kubaluleke kakhulu ekutfutfukeni kwemnotfo kanye nekuncintisana kuso sonkhe sigodzi se-SADC.5 IKhabhinethi ikhutsata bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulu lusha nalabavota kwekucala, kutsi basebentise lilungelo labo lentsandvo yelinyenti ngekutsi batsatse sinyatselo sekucala sekubhalisela kuvota mhla ti-9 namhla ti-10 Lweti 2013.Umzabalazo wetfu wekulwela kutfola inkhululeko watfolela wonkhe umuntfu waseNingizimu Afrika lilungelo lekuba ngumhlanganyeli lokhutsele kunchubo yetfu yentsandvo yelinyenti.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho bakgethi bohle ho netefatsa hore dikgetho tsa 2014 di fihlella lenane le leholo la bakgethi, jwaloka ha re bone dikgethong tse ding le tse ding haesale ho tloha ka 1994.
tgt: Simema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bahloniphe umlandvo wetfu nekutsi futsi bachubeke bacinise kuba semtsetsetfweni kwentsandvo yetfu yelinyenti.

src: Dikantoro tsohle tsa Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae di tla be di butswe ka matsatsi a boingodiso ho nolofatsa mosebetsi wa boingodiso ka ditokomane tse hlokehang.6 Kabinete e thoholetsa balefi ba lekgetho ba fetang dimilione tse ba ileng ba kenya dipusetso tsa bona tsa Lekgetho, ba thusang mmuso ho fana ka ditshebeletso tse hlokehang haholo tsa ho ntlafatsa maphelo a maAforika Borwa ohle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonkhe bavoti kutsi bente siciniseko sekutsi lukhetfo lwanga-2014 lutfola bavoti labanyenti, njengoba sibonile kuletinye tinkhetfo kusukela nga-1994.

src: Kajeno Aforika Borwa ke naha e betere ho feta seo e neng e le sona ka 1994, ka lebaka la lenane le holang la dikhamphane le batho ba ikemiseditseng ho kenya letsoho kotleng ya mmuso moo ditshebeletso le disebediswa di lefellwang ho tswa ho yona.
tgt: Onkhe emahhovisi eLitiko Letasekhaya atawuvula ngaletinsuku tekubhalisela kuvota kute bavoti batfole emadokhumenti lafanele ekubhalisela kuvota.6 IKhabhinethi incoma bakhokhintsela labangetulu kwa-3,6 wetigidzi labagcwalise emafomu ekukhokha intsela kute kube ngumanje, basita hulumende kutsi etfule tinsita letidzingeka kakhulu ekwenteni timphilo tebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika tibe ncono.

src: Kabinete e hopotsa balefi ba lekgetho ba ntseng ba lokela ho kenya dipusetso tsa bona tsa lekgetho hore mohla la 22 Pudungwana 2013 ke letsatsi la ho qetela la ho kenya dipusetso ka mokgwa wa elektroniki bakeng sa pusetso ya motho ka mong ya selemo sa ditjhelete sa 2012/13, mme letsatsi leo le ntse le atamela ka potlako.7 Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe sewa sa moraorao sa merusu, tshenyo ya thepa ya poraefete le ya setjhaba esita le ho hapa thepa ka mahahapa Gauteng, Kapa Botjhabela le Kapa Bophirima.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika iyindzawo lencono kakhulu lamuhla kunaloku beyingiko nga-1994, ngenca yelinani lelikhulako lebantfu netinkampani letivumako futsi letikhonako kufaka sandla esipatjini sesive lesikhokhela tinsita kanye netisetjentiswa netakhiwonchanti tetenhlalakahle.

src: Tshenyo ya thepa ya setjhaba e tima dibaka ditshebeletso tsa setjhaba tse hlokehang haholo ebile e thea keketseho ya morwalo wa disebediswa tse tshwepholelwang ho lokisweng ha ditshebeletso tsena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhumbuta bakhokhintsela labasengakangenisi emafomu abo ekukhokha intsela kutsi umhla tinge-22 Lweti 2013 longumncamulajucu wekungenisa emafomu ekukhokha intsela ngekwe-elekhthroniki emnyaka wentsela wanga-2012/13 usondzela ngemandla.7 IKhabhinethi igceka loluchungechunge lwebudlova lolusandza kwenteka, kubhidlitwa kwemphahla yebantfu bangasense neyahulumende nekwebiwa kwemphahla eGauteng, eMphumalanga Kapa naseNshonalanga Kapa.

src: Mmuso o ke ke wa dumella batlodi ba molao ho senya meaho le disebediswa moo ditshebeletso tsa bohlokwa di etsetswang teng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi incoma emaphoyisa ngekutsi angenelele aphindze acedze lesimo.

src: Tshenyo e mpempe ha e thuse mang kapa mang, ebile ha ho moelelo tabeng ya ho senya tshebeletso enngwe ha ho tsekwa enngwe.
tgt: Kubhidlitwa kwemphahla yemmango kuncisha imimango tinsita temmango letidzingeka kakhulu kubuye futsi kwente umtfwalo lowengetiwe wekutsi kutsatfwe leminye imitfombolusito isetjentiselwe kubuyisela esimeni futsi ime esikhundleni saletinsita.

src: Setjhaba se tshwanela ho lwantsha matsapa ohle a diketso tsa ditlolo tsa molao tsa ho thopa thuto ya bana ba rona ka ditshoso tsa ho sitisa WEBTOKEN tshwanela ho aha dibaka moo re hlomphanang re bile re thusana, ho e na le ho tshabana.8 Kabinete e hlahisitse ngongoreho ya yona ka dipolelo tse etswang phatlalatsa mabapi le Majuda a Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Hulumende angeke avumele tigebengu tibhidlite takhiwo netakhiwonchanti netisetjentiswa lapho kuniketwa khona tinsita letibalulekile.

src: Kabinete e hlompha tokelo ya batho ba Palestina ya boipuso esita le tokelo ya Isiraele ya ho phedisana le naha ya Palestina.
tgt: Kubhidlitwa nekulinyatwa kwemphahla akusiti muntfu, futsi kuyintfo lengenangcondvo kutsi ubhidlite yinye insita nawufuna lenye.

src: 21 Nov Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le dintlha tsa bohlokwa maemong a ha jwale.
tgt: 21 Nov Tincumo teKhabhinethi etindzabeni letigcamile kulesimo sanyalo.

src: Kabinete e amohela lenane le leholo la bakgethi ba tshwanelehileng ba ileng ba sekehela tsebe kgoeletso ya ho ingodisa nakong ya boingodiso ba pele ba mohla la 9 le 10 Pudungwana 2013.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukela linani lelikhulu lebavoti labafanelekile labalalele babuye futsi benta njengekuya kwesimemo sekubhalisela kuvota ngesikhatsi sekucala sekubhalisa umhla ti-9 kuya kumhla ti-10 Lweti 2013.

src: Bakgethi ba tshwanelehileng ba e so ka ba ingodisa ba hopotswa hore nako ya boingodiso e tswelapele ho fihlela tsebisong ya letsatsi la dikgetho tse latelang tsa naha.
tgt: Bavoti labafanelekile labasengakabhalisi bakhunjutwa kutsi sikhatsi sekubhalisa siyachubeka kute kube ngulapho sekumenyetelwa lusuku lwelukhetfo lwavelonkhe lolulandzelako.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa mosebetsi wa Khomishene e Ikemetseng ya Dikgetho, mme e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho nka monyetla wa tokelo ya bona ya demokrasi ya ho kgetha, e bileng teng ka lebaka la ntwa ya rona ya tokoloho le demokrasi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi incoma umsebenti weKhomishini Yelukhetfo Letimele, futsi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi basebentise lilungelo labo lentsandvo yelinyenti lekuvota.

src: Letsholo la Boitseki la Matsatsi a 16 la Phediso ya Dikgoka kgahlanong le Basadi le Bana le tla qala mohla la 25 Pudungwana ho ya ho la 10 Tshitwe tlasa mookotaba o reng: VIKELA MZANSI – Kwanele: Ditjhaba di kopane ho thibela dikgoka kgahlanong le basadi le bana”.Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho sebedisa nako ena ho ntjhafatsa boikitlaetso ba rona, ho fedisa boitshwaro bo soto bo bile bo hlabisa dihlong bo etswang ke ba bang setjhabeng sa rona re be re tsosolose boitlamo ba naha ya rona ditokelong tse ke keng tsa phephetswa tsa basadi le bana.
tgt: Umkhankhaso Wemalanga la-16 Wekulwa Nebudlova Lobentiwa kuBomake neBantfwana utawentiwa kusukela mhla tinge-25 Lweti kuya kumhla ti-10 Ingongoni 2013 ngaphansi kwalengcikitsi: “VIKELA MZANSI – Kwanele: Imimango ihlangane ekuvikeleni budlova lobentiwa kubomake nebantfwana.

src: Motlatsi wa Mopresidente, Ntate Kgalema Motlanthe o tla etellapele sehopotso sa Letsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDS Mkhondo, Seterekeng sa Gert Sibande, Mpumalanga, ka la 1 Tshitwe 2013 tlasa mookotaba o reng: “Hlalefa.
tgt: "IKhabhinethi imema bonkhe batfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi basebentise lesikhatsi bavusetele kutinikela kwabo, kucedza lendlela yekutiphatsa lenelunya nalesusana sitfunti kanye nekwenta lelive letfu litinikele kabusha kulilungelo labomake nebantfwana labangeke balemukwe ngumuntfu.

src: Pukutlwa leeko.”Lepatlelo le tla sebedisetswa ho tsebisa setjhaba ka matsapa a mmuso a ho lwantsha sewa sena, ho eketsa tlhokomediso, esita le ho tiisa matsapa a ho matlafatsa bokena dipakeng ba ho kgina sewa sena.
tgt: Lisekela laMengameli Kgalema Motlanthe litawuhola kukhunjulwa kweLusuku Lwengculazi Lwemhlaba eMkondo, Gert Sibande District, eMpumalanga, mhla lu-1 Ingongoni 2013 ngaphansi kwalengcikitsi: “Hlakanipha.

src: Sena se amana le Morero wa Lewa la Naha wa HIV le AIDS wa 2012-2016.Letsatsi lena la Lefatshe la AIDS le tla boela le sebediswa ho tsosolosa letsholo la Ho Thoba Maikutlo le Diteko tsa HIV (HCT) le ho thakgola letsholo la Pukutlo ya Leeko Ditsing tsa Bophelo bo Botle.
tgt: Lesikhatsi lesi sitawusetjentiselwa kubuyeketa sive mayelana nemitamo leyentiwa nguhulumende kulwa nalolubhubhane, kwandzisa kucaphelisa, kanye nekucinisa imitamo yekunciphisa lolubhubhane.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho etsa thobalano e bolokehileng ho etsa diteko tsa HIV bonnyane hanngwe ka selemo e le ho etsa diqeto tse susumetswang ke thuo ya lesedi ka mehato ya thibelo, kalafo, tlhokomelo le tshehetso le hore banna le bashanyana ba ikakgele ka setotswana ditshebeletsong tsa pukutlo ya leeko ditsing tsa bophelo bo botle.
tgt: Loku kuhambisana neLuhlelolisu Lwavelonkhe lwesandvulelangculazi Nengculazi 2012-2016.Lolusuku Lwengculazi Lwemhlaba lutawuphindze lufake emandla lamasha kumkhankhaso weKwelulekwa Nekuhlolelwa Sandvulelangculazi kanye nekwetfula umkhankhaso Wekusokwa Kwalabadvuna eMtfolamphilo nobe Esibhedlela.

src: MaAforika Borwa a tlameha ho ba le seabo ba kopanye lewa la ho se Ikamahanye, ho tshepahala, ho sebedisa khondomo (ABC).
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi baye emacansini ngalokuphephile kutsi bahlolelwe sandvulelangculazi lokungenani kanye ngemnyaka kute batsatse tincumo letibhadlile mayelana netindlela tekuvikela, kwelashwa kunakekela nekwesekela kanye nekutsi emadvodza nebafana basebentise tinsita tekusokwa kwalabadvuna tasemitfolamphilo nobe tasesibhedlela.

src: Kabinete e hlakisitse qobello e matla ya melao ya sephethephethe e le karolo ya Letsholo la Sehla sa Keteko ya Mafelo a Selemo – Arrive Alive – tlasa mookotaba o reng: ‘Mmoho re ka Boloka Dimilione tsa Maphelo’, mme e ipiletsa ho basebedisi bohle ba tsela ho ipopela tlwaelo e nang le kutlwisiso e phethahetseng ya hore ho swahlamana ha makoloi ho ruthutha maphelo.
tgt: Bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bafanele badlale indzima yabo babuye futsi bahlanganise lisuluhlelo lwe-ABC (Kungayi emacansini, kwetsembeka, kusebentisa ikhondomu) njengendlela yekuphila.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa kgatelopele e entsweng, ka mokgwa wa dieijensi tse ngata, e ileng ya ananelwa mabapi le bokena dipakeng ba Mopresidente ka Motsheanong 2013 Eldorado Park, ho lwantsha dikgoka tse bakwang ke dithethefatsi le dihlopha tsa dinokwane esita le diphephetso tse amanang le moruo setjhabeng.
tgt: IKhambinethi igcamise kucinisekiswa kwemacala etemgwaco njengencenye yeMkankhaso Walesikhatsi Semaholide lobitwa – Fika Uphila (Arrive Alive) – ngaphansi kwalengcikitsi ‘Sibambisene Singasindzisa Tigidzi Tetimphilo’, futsi imema bonkhe basebentisi bemigwaco kutsi babe nesimongcondvo lesinesibopho kakhulu lesivisisa ngalokuphelele kutsi kushayisana kwetimoto kubulala bantfu.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa setjhabeng hore se tlohele ho inkela molao matsohong kapa ho ipatlela toka ka thoko ho tsamaiso ya molao, kaha sena se se molaong se bile se na le seabo boitshwarong ba ditlolo tsa molao.
tgt: IKhabhinethi incoma inchubekela embili leyentiwe ngekusebentisa ema-ejensi lamanyenti lokwentiwa mayelana nekuphendvula kungenelela kweLihhovisi laMengameli ngeNkhwenkhweti 2013 e-Eldorado Park, kubukana nekusebentiswa kabi kwetidzakamiva nebudlova bemagenge kanye netinselele temnotfo netenhlalo letihambisana nako.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa setjhaba ho sebedisana le sepolesa ho fothola dikokonono le barekisi ba dithethefatsi ba mpefatsang diketsahalo tsa ditlolo tsa molao.
tgt: Loku sekuholele ekuboshweni kwebantfu laba-1 431, lapho khona laba-1 098 balindzele kutekwa kwemacala abo laba-1 095 batfole ibheyili, labatsatfu basesejele bese kutsi labange-289 balahlwa ngemacala ebugebengu.

src: Kabinete e fetisitse matshediso ho beng le metswalle ya bao ba hlokahetseng ka lebaka la ho heleha ha moaho o ntseng o ahwa setsheng se Tongaat, KwaZulu-Natal mme e lakaletsa bao ba lemetseng hore ba fole ka potlako.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela imimango kutsi iyekele kusebentisa tindlela letingekho emtsetfweni tekujeziza tigebengu, ngoba loku akukho emtsetfweni kantsi futsi kufaka ligalelo ekutiphatseni ngekwebugebengu.

src: Kabinete e thasiseditse hore ho na le melao ya tsa mesebetsi e tshireletsang ditokelo tsa basebetsi ya ba ya seolla bao ba ikarabellang koduweng eo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhutsata imimango kutsi isebentisane nemaphaphoyisa kute kushanyelwe emakhosi ekushushunjiswa kwetidzakamiva nebashushumbisi labenta imisebenti yebugebengu ibe nemandla kakhulu.

src: Setsi se bolokile tse ding tsa disebediswa tsa bohlokwahlokwa tsa letlotlo la botjhaba tse phetang ka bophelo le dinako tsa Ntate Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ililele imindeni nebangani balabo labashone ngenca yekudzilika kwesakhiwo besakhiwa eTongaat, KwaZulu-Natal ibuye futsi ifisele kwelulama ngekushesha labo labalimele.

src: Mmuso o tla tswelapele ho tlotla Ntate Nelson Mandela le baetapele ba moloko wa hae ka seabo se seholo seo ba se entseng tokolohong ya rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igcizelele kutsi kunemitsetfo yetisebenti levikela imitsetfo yetisebenti yabuye futsi yagceka labo labatsintsekako ekubeni khona kwalenhlekelele.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa kaho ya lenaneo la meralo ya motheo ya setjhaba ya diterilione tsa diranta e etswang ke Khomishene ya Tlhophiso ya Meralo ya Motheo ya Mopresidente e etelletsweng pele ke Mopresidente Jacob Zuma.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukele kuvulwa kweSikhungo SeSesikhumbuto saNelson Mandela.

src: Pulo ya Letamo la Spring Grove ka Mopresidente e raletswe ho thusa phepelong e ntseng e ata ya metsi ho ya bomasepaleng ba tsheletseng, e leng Toropokgolo ya eThekwini, Setereke sa uMgungundlovu, Masepala wa Sebaka sa Mmeunduzi, wa Sebaka sa Ugu, esita le Bomasepala ba Dibaka tsa Sisonke le iLembe.
tgt: Lesikhungo siphetse leminye yemicebo yemagugu lebaluleke kakhulu lecuketse imphilo yaBabe Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela.

src: Sena se tla akga le ketelo Mthatha ho ya lekola dintlafatso tsa boemafofane le diprojeke tse ding tsa meralo ya motheo ya mopresidente tikolohong eo.
tgt: Hulumende utawuchubeka ahloniphe Nelson Mandela kanye nesitukulwane sakhe sebaholi ngenca yeligalelo lelikhulu kakhulu labalifakile ekukhululekeni kwetfu.

src: Mthatha e ile ya etswa Sebaka se Thefulehileng sa Bokena dipakeng bo Potlakileng ba Mopresidente ka 2009, mme bokenadipakeng bo reretswe ho rarolla diphephetso tsa tshallomorao ya kaho ya meralo ya motheo le phano ya ditshebeletso, ka sepheo sa ho ntjhafatsa Mthatha kahohlehohle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalelisela kuphunyeleliswa lokuchubekako kweluhlelo lwetakhiwonchanti temmango lolubita emathriliyoni lweKhomishini Yekucondziswa Kwetakhiwonchanti yeLihhovisiLaMengameli (PICC) leholwa nguMengameli Jacob Zuma.

src: Mopresidente o tla boela a sekaseka ka boyena kgatelopele e entsweng diprojekeng tsa meralo ya motheo ya mmuso mabapi le phumantsho ya metsi, motlakase le mebila tikolohong eo.
tgt: Lidamu i-Spring Grove lelivulwe nguMengameli lentelwe kufaka ligalelo ekwandzisweni kusatjalaliswa kwemanti kubomasipalati labasitfupha, lekungulaba Masipalati Welidolobha laseThekwini, uMgungundlovu District, Masipalati Wendzawo Msunduzi, Masipalati Wendzawo Ugu, kanye naBomasipalati Bendzawo iSisonke ne-iLembe.

src: Ho kgantshwa ho tla etswa ke Mopresidente Jacob Zuma ha seteishenana sa motlakase sa Thornhill ho tla fana ka bokgoni ba marangrang a ho rarolla tshallomorao ya malapa a ka bang 25 000.
tgt: Hulumende wente lutjalomali lolungetulu kwa-R1 wesigidzigidzi, lolwentelwe kutsi luvete imisebenti.

src: Mopresidente Jacob Zuma o tla kena Leetong la ho Emela Naha Accra, Ghana, ho tloha ka la 26 ho isa ho la 27 Pudungwana 2013.
tgt: Mengameli Jacob Zuma utawuvakashela Masipalati i-King Sabatha Dalindyebo, Sifundza saseMphumalanga Kapa, mhla tinge-22 Lweti 2013 njengencenye yeLuhlelo Lekucaphela Kusebenta Kwelihhovisi LaMengameli iSiyahlola.

src: Leeto le tla tiisa dikamano tsa rona tse matla le Ghana le be le ntshetsepele kgwebisano e momahaneng kontinenteng.
tgt: Loku kutawufaka ekhatsi kuvakashela eMthatha kuyewuhlola kwentiwa kancono kwesikhumulo setindizamshini kanye naleminye imiklamo lekulendzawo yelihhovisi laMengameli.

src: Mopresidente Jacob Zuma o bile modulasetulo wa Khomishene ya Dinahapedi tsa Aforika Borwa le Botswana (BCN) ka la 21 Pudungwana 2013.
tgt: UMthatha wamenyetelwa njengendzawo yekuChumanisa Kungenelela Kwelihhovisi LaMengameli Lokunelifutse Lelinemandla Lelinesivinini Lesikhulu nga-2009 futsi lokungenelela kubukene nekusombulula tinselele tekusalela emuva kwetakhiwonchanti nekwetfulwa kwetinsita, kute kutfutfukiswe uMthatha.

src: Sena se tla ntlafatsa dikamano le tshebedisano mmoho dipakeng tsa dinaha tse pedi tse ahisaneng.
tgt: Mengameli utawubuye futsi ahlole ngco, yena matfupha inchubekela embili leyentiwe kutakhiwonchanti tahulumende mayelana nekubakhona kwemanti, gezi kanye nemigwaco kulendzawoSiteshi lesincane se-Thornhill lesivulwe nguMengameli Jacob Zuma sitawuniketa buchakachaka bemandla ekubukana nekusalela emuva kwekwakhiwa kwetindlu leti-25 000.

src: BNC ena ya selemo le selemo boemong ba Dihlooho tsa Dinaha e ile ya thewa ngwahola ho phahamisa boemo ba Khomishene ya Moshwelella ya Kopanelo bakeng sa Tshebedisanommoho le Khomishene ya Moshwelella ya Kopanelo bakeng sa Tshebedisanommoho ya Tshireletso.
tgt: Mengameli Jacob Zuma utawungenela Luhambo Lwekuvakasha Lolusemtsetfweni loluya e-Accra, leseGhana, kusukela mhla tinge-26-27 Lweti 2013.

src: Sena se netefatsa botjha boikitlaetso ba rona phihlellong ya ditokelo tsa botho bakeng sa baahi bohle, baahi ba kontinente ya Aforika esita le baahi ba lefatshe lohle.
tgt: Lokuvakasha kutawujulisa budlelwane betfu lesinabo neGhana kubuye futsi kutfutfukise kuhwebelana kwangekhatsi kulelivekati.
