src: Kabinete e ikamahanya le baahi ba matjhaba ka ho ntsha maikutlo a kutlwelobohloko thorisong ya Mekgatlo eo e seng ya Mmuso, e kentseng letsoho thusong ya matjhaba ya tshohanyetso bakeng sa bao ba anngweng ke Lehodiotswana la Haiyan kwana Phillipines.
tgt: Mengameli Jacob Zuma bekangusihlalo weKhomishini Yemave Lamabili iNingizimu Afrika neBotswana (BNC) mhla tinge-21 Lweti 2013.

src: Moya wa Botho o tla thusa ho kokobetsa mahlonoko a batho ba Phillipines nakong ena ya mathata.
tgt: Loku kutawundlondlobalisa budlelwane nekusebentisana kwalamave lamabili.

src: Kabinete e ananela tsebiso ya katleho e nngwe hape botenng ba Projeke ya Ntlafatso ya Mebilaphara ya Gauteng, moo ditefello tsa mebila dikarolong tse kgethilweng tsa Mebila e Meholo ya Gauteng di qalang ka la 3 Tshitwe 2013.Beng ba makoloi ba e so kang ba ingodisetsa ditefello tsa mebila ba kgothalletswa ho etsa jwalo, ho netefatsa hore ba lokelwa ke ditheolelo.
tgt: Le-BNC yemnyaka lesezingeni yeTinhloko Tembuso yasungulwa kulomnyaka lophelile kute kuphakanyiswe simo seKhomishini Lehlangene Yalomphelo yeKubambisana kanye neKhomishini Lehlangene Yalomphelo yeKusebentisana kuTekuvikela neKuvikeleka.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Mafapha a Saense le Theknoloji le Thuto le Thupelo e Phahameng hammoho le Yunivesithi ya Theknoloji ya Hlohleng ya Kapa ka ho etsa nalane ka ho thakgola CubeSat ya pele ya naha ena, kajeno, mohla la 21 Pudungwana 2013, kwana Russia.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukela kuKhetfwa kweNingizimu Afrika kutsi ibe kuMkandlu Wemalungelo Eluntfu waMhlabuhlangene (mhla ti-12 Lweti 2013).

src: Satalaete ena, e tla fana ka lesedi la bohlokwa la maemo a lehodimo sepakapakeng, e bontsha bokgoni ba Aforika Borwa lekaleng la saense le theknoloji ya sepakapakeng.
tgt: Loku kucinisekisa kutinikela kwetfu ekuzuzeni emalungelo eluntfu ato tonkhe takhamuti tetfu, takhamuti tase-Afrika kanye netakhamuti temhlaba.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho kgethwa ha Letona la Thuto ya Motheo Mme Angie Motshekga e le modulasetulo wa Sehlopha sa Aforika e ka Borwa le e ka Botjhabela ya Bodisa ba Thuto ya Boleng (SACMEQ) nakong ya Seboka Kakaretso sa bo37 sa UNESCO sena se matlafatsa boitshepo mokgweng wa thuto ya rona le ditheo tsa rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlangana nemmango wemave emhlaba ekubongeni Tinhlangano Letingekho ngaphasi kwaHulumende letifake sandla elusitweni lwekuhhamula simo lesiphutfumako semave emhlaba lwalabo labatsintfwe Sivunguvungu selwandle i-Haiyan ePhilippines.

src: Sepheo sa SACMEQ ke ho thakgola diketsahalo tse kopantsweng tsa diphuputso le thupelo tse tla eketsa menyetla bakeng sa ba rerang le bafuputsi ho fumana thupelo ya bokgoni bo hlokehang ba setekgeniki ba ho disa, ho hlahloba, le ho bapisa maemo a akaretsang a dikolo le boleng ba thuto ya motheo.
tgt: Umoya weBuntfu utawuchubeka wehlise lusizi lwebantfu basePhilippine ngalesikhatsi lesimatima.

src: Kabinete e thoholeditse Letona la Thuto le Thupelo e Phahameng, Blade Nzimande, ka ho etellapele kopano ya Matona a Thuto a BRICS moo ho nkilweng diqeto tse ntle haholo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukela lokunye futsi kumenyetelwa kweligcatsi emphilweni yeMkamo Wekwentiwa Kancono Kwemigwaco yaseGauteng Lebotselawayekela, lenetindzawo tekuyihlawulela kuletinye tincenye taleMigwaco Lemikhulu yaseGauteng lokutawucala mhla ti-3 Ingonngoni 2013.Bashayeli betimoto labangakabhaliseli kukhokhela lemigwaco bakhutsatwa kutsi babhalise, kute bente siciniseko sekutsi bayafaneleka kutfola tilinganisomali letinesephulelo.

src: Kopano e ne e hlophisitswe mabapi le diqeto tsa Seboka Kakaretso sa bo37 sa UNESCDintlha tse neng di tshohlwa di ne di akga: ho matlafatsa tshebedisano dipakeng tsa diyunivesithi tsa BRICS, dilekane le thakelano ya tsebo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi incoma Litiko Letesayensi Netheknoloji neleMfundvo Lephakeme Nekucecesha kanye neNyuvesi yeTheknoloji i-Cape Peninsula ngekwetfula i-CubeSat yekucala kulelive, lamuhla, tinge-21 Lweti 2013, eRussia.

src: Matona a ile a dumellana ka tlhokeho ya ho thea mokgwa o boemong bo hodimo ba sepolotiki le setekgeniki ka sepheo sa ho hlophisa le ho kenya tshebetsong dibaka tse hlwailweng tsa tshebedisanommoho tse tla hlophiswa ke Aforika Borwa jwaloka Modulasetulo wa BRICHo ile ha boela ha eba le tumellano dipakeng tsa dinaha tsohle tse hlano tseo e leng ditho ka bohlokwa ba ho tiisa tshebedisanommoho dipakeng tsa BRICS le UNESCO thutong.
tgt: Lesathelayiti, letawuniketa idatha yesimo selitulu yendzawo lebalulekile, ikhombisa likhono leNingizimu Afrika kumkhakha wesayensi yemkhatsi netheknoloji.

src: Kabinete e hlokometse tlaleho ya naha ya Aforika Borwa ho UNESCO ya hore batho ba baholo ba dimilione tse ba Aforika Borwa ba phethetse dithuto tsa Letsholo la Kgoro la Koqo la ho Bala le ho Ngola la Kha Ri Gude.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukele kukhetfwa kweNdvuna Yetemfundvo Lesisekelo Angie Motshekga abe nguSihlalo weNhlangano Yeningizimu Nemphumalanga Afrika yeKulandzelela Imfundvo Lenguyona Yona (SACMEQ) ngesikhatsi kubanjwe Inkomfajikelele ye-UNESCO Yeminyaka lenge-37 loku kucinisa kutetsemba kunchubo yetfu yetemfundvo netikhungo.

src: Sena se bea Aforika Borwa mathuleng a ho fihlella sepheo sa yona sa Matjhaba a Kopaneng: boikitlaetso ba Thuto ya Bohle ba ho fokotsa sekgahla sa naha sa ho se tsebe ho bala le ho ngola ka 2015.
tgt: Umgomo we-SACMEQ kwenta lucwaningo loluhlanganisiwe nemisebenti yekucecesha letawukhulisa ematfuba ebahleli betemfundvo nebacwaningi kutsi batfole kuceceshwa kutemakhono etebucwepheshe ladzingeka kutekulandzelela, kukala, kanye nekucatsanisa timojikelele tekufundza nebungibo bemfundvo lesisekelo.

src: Letsholo le thakgotswe ka Hlakola ya 2008, ka maikemisetso a ho thusa batho ba baholo ba dimilione tse 4,7 ba kahodimo ho dilemo tse 15 ho tseba ho bala le ho ngola ka e nngwe ya dipuo tsa semmuso tse Kabinete e thoholetsa bahlodi ba Dikgau tsa Makgabane a Naha a Batho Pele tse thusang ho tiisa boporofeshenale, ho hlokomela, ho putsa, ho ananela le ho kgothaletsa makgabane Tshebeletsong ya Setjhaba esita le ho netefatsa hore e fihlella boemo bo phahameng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibonge Indvuna Yetemfundvo Lephakeme Nekucecesha, Blade Nzimande ngekuhola umhlangano weTindvuna Tetemfundvo we-BRICS lowente tincumo letingemavulandlela.

src: Kabinete e rorisitse papadi e kgabane ya Bafana Bafana, Dikila le Ditshephe ya ba ya thoholetsa Itumeleng Khune, ya ileng a kgethwa e le Kgalala ya Dipapadi ya 2013 ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Tindzaba lekwakhulunywa ngato tafaka ekhatsi: kucinisa kusebenta ngekubambisana emkhatsini wemanyuvesi wemave e-BRICS, kusebenta ngekubambisana nelwati lwekuntjintjiselana.

src: Tiisong ya hore re setjhaba se hlolang, Kabinete e hlokometse hore ka Laboraro hoseng Aforika Borwa yohle e tsohile e le morolo kamora hore Bafana Bafana e hlole Spain ka 1-0.
tgt: LeTindvuna tivumelene ngesidzingo sekusungula indlela lesezingeni lelisetulu letepolitiki netebucwepheshe kute kucondziswe kubuye kuphunyeleliswe tindzawo letikhonjiwe lekufanele kusetjentwe ngekubambisana kuto letitawucondziswa yiNingizimu Afrika njengaSihlalo wamanje we-BRICOnkhe lamave langemalunga lasihlanu abuye avumela kukhulisa kusebenta ngekubambisana emkhatsini wemave e-BRICS ne-UNESCO kutemfundvo.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho ba le seabo tshehetsong ya dihlopha tsa naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yetfule umbiko welive laseNingizimu Afrika ku-UNESCO kutsi 3,3 wetigidzi tabantfu labadzala baseNingizimu Afrika baphotfulile kuMkankhaso Wekufundza Nekubhala Welinyenti we-Kha Ri Gude.

src: Kabinete e ile ya kumelwa ke Setlamo sa Toka ya Tshireletso le Thibelo ya Ditlolo tsa Molao (JCPS) ka tlaleho ya Mosireletsi wa Setjhaba mehatong ya tshireletso lehaeng la Mopresidente Jacob Zuma le Nkandla.
tgt: Loku kusondzeta iNingizimu Afrika dvute nekuzuza Mhlabuhlangene wayo: Kutinikela eMfundvweni yaWonkhe Wonkhe lokukutinikela ekunciphiseni ngehhafu silinganiso salelive sekungakwati kufundza nekubhala ungekafiki mnyaka wa-2015.

src: Kabinete e ile ya kumelwa hore dipuisano tsa mmuso le Mosireletsi wa Setjhaba ntlheng ena di ne di tsepamisitswe tshireletsong ya Hlooho ya Naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela labaphumelele batfola Imiklomelo Lekhetsekile Ye-Batho Pele Yavelonkhe Yekucala Ngca leyentelwe kujulisa kusebenta ngekwebungcweti, kuhlonipha, kuklomelisa, kwatisa nekukhutsata kusebenta ngalokukhetsekile ekubeni Sisebenti Seluphiko Lwemisebenti Yahulumende nekwenta siciniseko sekutsi ifika emazingeni lasetulu kakhulu.

src: Kabinete e ile ya boela ya kumelwa hore tlaleho ya sehlopha sa tshebetso sa mmuso ntlafatsong ya tshireletso Nkandla e fetiseditswe Komiting ya Kopanelo ho tsa Boutlwela eo le yona e phatlaladitseng Tlaleho ya yona e Ikgethileng ka taba ena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idvumise kudlala ngekwelikhetselo lokusandza kwetiwa yiBafana Bafana, ema-Proteas kanye neMabhokobhoko yabuye futsi yahalalisela Itumeleng Khune, lowetsiwe kuba Sihlabani Setemidlalo yaseNingizimu Afrika sanga-2013.

src: Sehlopha sa tshebetso sa mmuso se tlalehetse Komiti ya Kopanelo ho tsa Boutlwela hore ha ho bopaki ba hore Lefapha la Mesebetsi ya Setjhaba le lefelletse kaho ya matlo a Mopresidente.
tgt: Igcizelela kutsi sisive lesiphumelelako, iKhabhinethi icaphele kutsi sive saseNingizimu Afrika savuka ngaLesitsatfu ekuseni moya waso umnandzi ngemuva kwekutsi Bafana Bafana bashaye Spain 1-0.

src: Matona a Setlamong sa JCPS a memilwe makumaneng ana a Kabinete mme a tla ba teng ho tla araba dipotso tabeng ena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi badlale indzima yabo ekwesekeleni emacembu etfu etemidlalo avelonkhe.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Pampiri e Tshweu ya nakwana ya kamora ho Qeta Sekolong ya Thuto le Thupelo e reng: “Ho Aha Mokgwa wa Thuto le Thupelo wa Kamora ho Qeta Sekolong o Atolotsweng, o Sebetsang Hantle o bile o Momahantswe”.Pampiri e tshweu ya nakwana e rala mawa a ho atolla phanong ya jwale ya thuto le thupelo Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yatiswe yiKlasta Yetebulungiswa Betebugebengu Nekuvikela (JCPS) kumbiko weMvikeli Wemmango lomayelana netindlela tekuvikeleka ekhaya laMengameli Jacob Zuma eNkandla.

src: E habile ho ntlafatsa boleng, ho momahanya mekgwa e fapaneng ya kamora ho qeta sekolong, esita le ho rala mawa bakeng sa mekgwa eo bahiri makaleng a poraefete le setjhaba ba ka kenyang letsoho ka teng ho theweng ha bokgoni le boqhetseke ba basebetsi.
tgt: IKhabhineti itjeliwe kutsi kukhulumisana kwahulumende neMvikeli Wemmango mayelana naloludzaba bekungekuvikeleka kweNhloko yeLive.

src: Pampiri e thasisetsa kgolo le mesebetsi e kenyeletsang bohle e hlokehang bakeng sa Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP).Lefapha la Thuto le Thupelo e Phahameng le tla fana ka makumane a tomanyana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibuye yatjelwa kutsi umbiko welitsimba lelisebentako lahulumende lomayelana nekutfutfukiswa kwetekuphepha eNkandla wendluliselwe kuLikomitinhlanganisela Lanomphela leteBunhloli lelashicilela walo Umbiko Lokhetsekile mayelana naloludzaba.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka tlaleho ya Komiti ya Matona e mabapi le Tjhebobotjha ya Ditjhelete tse Fuwang Diyunivesithi ya ba ya ananela hore tlaleho eo e phatlalatswa bakeng sa hore diyunivesithi di tshwaele ka yona.
tgt: Lelitsimba lelisebentako lahulumende labika kuLikomitinhlanganisela Lanomphela kutsi bekute bufakazi bekutsi Litiko Letemisebenti Yesive likhokhele kwakhiwa kwetindlu taMengameli.

src: Taba ya ditjhelete tse fuwang diyunivesithi ha e a fapana le diphephetso tse ding tseo naha e tobaneng le tsona ka kakaretso, mme e akga tharollo ya ditshita tsa diyunivesithi tse ka mosing ha ka lehlakoreng le leng ho ntse ho netefatswa hore diphetoho tse etswang kabong ya disebediswa ha di sitise bokgoni ba diyunivesithi tse boemong bo botle hore di dule di hlompheha di bile di le boemong ba ho qothisana lehlokwa lefatsheng.
tgt: Tindvuna letikuKlasta ye-JCPS timenywe emhlanganweni wekuniketa lwatiso lolubanti futsi tikhona kute tiphendvule imibuto mayelana naloludzaba.

src: E boetse e habile dikamano tse hlokolotsi le indasteri ho netefatsa hore bayo-theknoloji le tshibollo ya tlhaho di tsamaisana le mebaraka le hore di sebediseha habobebe Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume luhlaka lweMtsetfo Lohlongotwako lomayelana neMfundvo Lephakeme Nekucecesha: "Kwakha Inchubo Lekhulisiwe, Nemfundvo Lephakeme Nekucecesha Lehlanganisiwe .

src: Lewa la Bayo-ikonomi la Aforika Borwa le fana ka kgubu ya moruo bakeng sa moruo o motjha o tla fana ka motheo wa kgolo ya kamoso.
tgt: "Luhlaka Lwemtsetfo Lohlongotwako, lubeka emasu ekukhula kumigomo leniketwa temfundvo nekucecesha eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Tshisinyo ya Mokgahlelo wa 3 wa Lenaneo le Atolotsweng la Mesebetsi ya Setjhaba (EPWP) bakeng sa ho kenngwa tshebetsong.
tgt: Lubeka imigomo yekwenta kancono bunjalo, kuhlanganisa imikhakha leyehlukene yenchubo yangemuva kwekucedza imfundvo yasesikolweni, kanye nekubeka tinchubo tetindlela tisebenti kumikhakha yomibili letimele neyahulumende tingadlala indzima lebalulekile ekwakheni tisebenti letinemakhono.

src: Pehelo ka kakaretso ke menyetla ya mesebetsi e dimilione tse 7,5 nakong ya dilemo tse hlano (2014/15 – 2018/19) e itshetlehile pehelong ya Mananeo a Tlhahiso ya Mesebetsi ya Setjhaba ho NDP.
tgt: Lomtsetfo ugcizelela kukhula lokufaka konkhe ekhatsi nekucashwa lokubalulekile kuLuhlelo Lwekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe (NDP).Litiko Letemfundvo Lephakeme Nekucecesha litawusatisa ngalokuchubekako.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho thewa ha Khomishene ya Mopresidente ya Tlhophiso ya Tlhahiso ya Mesebetsi Setjhabeng ho hlophisa le ho tlaleha ka mananeo a tlhahiso ya mesebetsi ya setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yadvunyiselwa kumbiko weLikomiti LeTindvuna mayelana Nekubuyeketwa Kwekunikwa Imali Kwemanyuvesi yabuye futsi yavuma kutsi lombiko ukhishwe kute ummango utewenta tiphakamiso ngawo.

src: EPWP e habile ho eketsa seabo sa yona sa ho rarolla diphephetso tse tharo tsa bofuma, leqeme la mesebetsi le ho se lekane.
tgt: Kuniketwa imali kwemanyuvesi akukehluki kuletinselele letibanti lelibukene nato, futsi kufaka ekhatsi kubukana nesimo lesibucayi setikhungo letincishekile kube kucinisekisa kutsi tingucuko letentiswa kumitfombolusito ativimbi likhono letikhungo letingakancisheki kutsi tihlale tibonakala njengaletincintisanako mhlabawonkhe.

src: Ho nyotobela ha jwale ha moruo ho thefutse tlhahiso ya mesebetsi kahara naha ha ba ha eketsa bohlokwa ba EPWP e le kgato e ka sehloohong ya mmuso ya ho kenya letsoho tswelopeleng le phokotsong ya leqeme la mesebetsi.
tgt: Lisu le-Bio-economy lisu lelimiselwe kutesayensi lekwenta kucamba kwetesayensi kube yincenye lebalulekile kumatiko lamanyenti.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Sesebediswa sa Sehlomathiso sa Molaotheo wa Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa tsa Mesebetsi (ILO), wa 1986, Palamenteng bakeng sa hore o tjhaellwe menwana.
tgt: Kuphindze futsi kudzinge budlelwane lobuhlangene kute kucinisekiswe kutsi i-biotechnology kanye nema-bio innovation ahambisana kakhulu netimakethe kangangobe kutfola kusetjentiswa lokulula eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Sepheopheo sa sehlomathiso se sisintsweng ke ho etsa botho ba Karolo ya Bolaodi ba ILO hore bo be le boemedi bo tomanyana ka ho fana ka mokgwa wa thonyo o nkela hloohong taba ya dibaka tse fapafapaneng, moruo le ditabatabelo tsa setjhaba dihlopheng tsa mabatowa a tsona.
tgt: Lisu le-Bio-economy yaseNingizimu Afrika liniketa injini yetemnotfo umnotfo lomusha lotawutsi ngalokulandzelako unikete sisekelo sekukhula kwakusasa.

src: Mabapi le ho ntshetsapele maikemisetso a Aforika le haeba Sehlomathiso sa Molaotheo wa 1986 se ka phethahala, Aforika Borwa e tla fola molemo ho ya ka makgetha a ikgethileng jwaloka ha ho hlalositswe sesebedisweng, hore e kgethwa setulong sa moshwelella.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume Luhlelo Lwekwandzisa Imisebenti Yemphakatsi (EPWP) Lizinga Leliphakeme Lesiphakamiso lelizinga lesiTsatfu (2014-2019) kute luphunyeleliswe.

src: Kabinete e tsebile ka kananelo ya Ditshisinyo tsa Boemo ba Tshireletso ya Setjhaba bo etswang ke ILO mme ya tjhaella menwana ho tekwa ha Tshisinyo ya Tokiso e tswang Palamenteng.
tgt: Lokuhlosiwe sekukonkhe ngu-7,5 wetigidzi tematfuba emisebenti esikhatsini seminyaka lesihlanu (2014/2015 – 2018/2019) amiselwe kuTinhlelo Tekucashwa Kumisebenti yaHulumende lokushiwo ku-NDP.

src: Mokgwa wa Boemo ba Tshireletso ya Setjhaba ke lethathama la maano a momahantsweng a setjhaba a ralletsweng ho netefatsa tshireletso ya lekeno le phihlello ya ditshebeletso tsa setjhaba tse hlokehang bakeng sa bohle, ho tsepamisitswe maikutlo dihlopheng tse kotsing le ho tshireletsa le ho matlafatsa batho mafapheng ohle a bophelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume kusungulwa kweKhomishini Lecondzisa Temisebneti Yahulumende Yelihhovisi LaMengameli kanye nekubika mayelana netinhlelo tekucashwa kutemisebenti yahulumende.

src: Tsepamiso ya maikutlo ya Leano ke ho kgothaletsa tshwano, bosiyo ba leeme, ponaletso le phihlello ya tekano bakeng sa batho ba neng ba kotetswe ke kgethollo e nang le leeme nakong e fetileng.
tgt: I-EPWP ihlose kukhulisa ligalelo layo ekubukaneni netinselele letiphindzeke katsatfu tebuphuya, kungacashwa kanye nekungalingani.

src: Bolaodi ba Makgotla a Phahameng a Dinyewe dikantorong tse fapaneng tsa Balaodi nakong e fetileng di ne di na le boikemelo ba ho nka diqeto ho ya kamoo di neng di utlwisisa molao ka teng mabapi le tshebetso le motjha o latelwang dikantorong tsa bona.
tgt: Kwehla kwemnotfo kwamanje kube nemtselela lomubi kutekucashwa kulelive futsi sekukhuphule kubaluleka kwe-EPWP njengemtamo lomkhulu wahulumende ekufakeni ligalelo ekutfutfukiseni nasekunciphiseni kungacashwa.

src: Kabinete e ananetse kamohelo ya ho tloha ka la 3 Pudungwana ho ya ho la 3 Tshitwe e le Kgwedi ya Naha ya Tlhokomediso ya Ditokelo tsa Kgolofalo ya ba ya tsebisa semmuso hore mohla la 3 Tshitwe ke Letsatsi la Naha la Batho ba Holofetseng.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ivume kwetfulwa kweLithulusi lekuChitjelwa kweMtsetfosisekelo weNhlangano yetisebenti Yemave Emhlaba, 1986, ePhalamende kute liciniswe.

src: Kgwedi ya Naha ya Tlhokomediso ya Ditokelo tsa Kgolofalo, e susumeditsweng ke Letsatsi la Naha la Batho ba Holofetseng, e fana ka nako ya hore naha e bontshe e be e keteke kgatelopele e entsweng ya ho fa batho ba holofetseng phihlello e lekanang thutong, mesebetsing e metle, bophelo bo botle, ntshetsopele ya mahae le tikoloho e sireletsehileng, ho tse ding.
tgt: Inhloso lenkhulu yalokuChitjelwa lokuhlongotwako kutsi kwentiwe bulunga beMtimba Lowengamele weNhlanganano Yetisebenti Yemave Emhlaba bumelwe kakhulu ngekuniketa indlela yekukhetsa lefaka ekhatsi emacembu emalunga awo etindzawo letehlukene, temnotfo netintfo tetenhlalo.

src: Kabinete e ananetse moralo wa tjhelete o entsweng ke Khamphane ya Minte ya Aforika Borwa bakeng sa sehopotso sa 2013 sa pokello ya tjhelete e lewana le ho ntshuwa ha R2 ya tshepe.
tgt: Mayelana nekuchubekisa i-ajenda yase-Afrika futsi nangabe kuchitjelwa kweMtsetfosisekelo kwanga-1986 kucale kusebente, iNingizimu Afrika isematfubeni ekuzuza ngekwemibandzela yetimphawu letikhetsekile letibekwe kulelithulusi, kutsi ikhetfwe itfole sihlalo salomphelo.

src: a) Ho ntshuwa ha R2 ya tshepe: “Keteko ya Dilemo tse 100 ya Meaho ya Kopanong”b) R2 ya Tjhelete ya Tshepe ya Sehopotso sa Tlokola ya Silifera: “Keteko ya Dilemo tse 100 ya Meaho ya Kopanong”c) Lethathama la Tjhelete ya Tshepe la Sekila la 2013: “Bophelo ba Mohale: NR Mandela” (bongwaneng).
tgt: Lizinga Lekucala Lekuvikela Tenhlalo yisethi yetinchubomgomo letihlanganisiwe leyentelwe kucinisekisa kuciniseka ngekwemali lengenako kanye nekufinyelela tinsita letibalulekile tawonkhe wonkhe, linake ngalokukhetsekile emacembu lasengotini kanye nekuvikela nekuhlomisa bantfu ngemakhono kuwo wonkhe umjikeleto wekuphila.

src: Kabinete e boetse ya ananela meralo ya sehopotso sa 2014 sa pokello ya tjhelete e lewana le ho ntshuwa ha meralo ya R2 ya tshepe:a) Lethathama la Tjhelete ya Tshepe la Sekila la 2013: “Bophelo ba Mohale: NR Mandela” (thutong)b) Lethathama la Tjhelete ya Tshepe ya Natura: “Ditsomi tsa Bosiu”c) Lethathama la Tjhelete ya Tshepe ya R1 ya Kgauta: “Bafetisi ba Aforika Borwa”d) Lethathama la Tjhelete ya Tshepe ya R2 ya Kgauta: “Tshibollo ya Kgauta Aforika Borwa”e) Lethathama la Tjhelete ya Tshepe ya Dikorone le Diteke tsa Silifera: “Diterene tsa Aforika Borwa”f) Lethathama la Tjhelete ya Tshepe ya Seteling ya Silifera: “Dibaka tse Tshireleditsweng Mawatleng a Aforika Borwa”g) R200 ya Tjhelete ya Tshepe ya Sehopotso sa Kgauta: “Dilemo tse 20 tsa Demokrasi”h) R2 ya Tjhelete ya Tshepe ya Sehopotso sa Korone: “Dilemo tse 20 tsa Demokrasi”i) Ho Ntshuwa ha R5 ya Tshepe: “Dilemo tse 20 tsa Demokrasi”.Meralo ya ditjhelete tsa tshepe le Tsebahatso ya tsona di tla phatlalatswa Koranteng ya Mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume kutsi iNingizimu Afrika ingenise Inkomfa Yesine Yemchudzelwano Wemave Emhlaba we-BRICS nga-2015.Lenkomfa iniketa inkhundla yekuntjintjiselana imibono kuma-ejensi etekuchudzelana kanye nebeluleki labangesibo bahulumende labavela emaveni e-BRICLoku kucinisisa kuchumana kwetikhungo lokuholela ekusebentisaneni ngekubambisana emaveni emhlaba emkhatsini walamalunga.

src: Kamorao ho moo ditjhelete tsa tshepe di tla botjwa di be di rekiswe ka ho latela metjha e tlwaelehileng.
tgt: Lenkomfa ibanjwa njalo nje ngeminyaka lemibili futsi ingeniswa Tiphatsimandla Tekuncintisana temibuso yemalunga e-BRICIKhabhinethi ivume kwetfulwa kweNchubomgomo Yekukhetfwa Kwetisebenti Letibukana Nekwehluleka Kukhokhela Tikweleti yiNkhosi Yenkantolo Lephakeme ePhalamende nekushicilelwa kuGazethi yaHulumende.

src: 05 Dec Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le dintlha tsa bohlokwa maemong a ha jwale.
tgt: 05 Dec Tincumo teKhabhinethi etindzabeni letigcamile kulesimo sanyalo.

src: Kabinete e thoholeditse Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo, dihlooho tsa dikolo, matitjhere le barutwana ka ho phethelwa ka katleho ha dihlahlobo tsa Naha tsa Setifikeiti se Phahameng tsa 2013.Kabinete e amohela ho ntshuwa ha Ditekolo tsa Naha tsa Selemo le Selemo tsa 2013 kajeno, la 4 Tshitwe 2013, e leng sesebediswa se babatsehang sa tshekatsheko e thusang Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo ho fofonela kgatelopele ya diphetho tsa ho ithuta esita le ho ntlafatsa boleng ba thuto.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisele Litiko Letemfundvo Lesisekelo, bothishelanhloko, bothishela kanye nebafundzi kucedza ngemphumelelo luhlolo Lwamatikuletjeni lwanga-2013.IKhabhinethi yemukela kukhishwa kweTinhlolo Tavelonkhe Temnyaka ka-2013 lamuhla, mhla ti-4 Ingongoni 2013, lekulithulusi lelihle kakhulu lekuhlola lelisita Litiko Letemfundvo Lesisekelo kutsi lilandzelele inchubekela embili yemiphumela yekufundza libuye futsi lente kancono bungibo betemfundvo.

src: Kabinete e boela e thoholetsa Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo le Khomishene ya Mopresidente ya Tlhophiso ya Meralo ya Motheo (PICC) ka boemo bo hatetseng pele phanong ya dibuka tsa ho bala, dibuka tsa ho ngolla, fenetjhara, le neelano ya sekolo se le seng ka beke haesale ho tloha ka la 22 Phupu 2013, e le karolo ya Morero wa Naha wa Meralo ya Motheo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyachubeka futsi incoma Litiko Letemfundvo Lesisekelo kanye neKhomishini Yekucondziswa Kwesakhiwonchanti yeLihhovisi laMengameli (i-PICC) ngelizinga lelisembili lekwetfulwa kwetincwadzi tekufundza, tincwadzi tekusebentela, ifenisha, kanye nekuniketa sikolwa sinye ngeliviki kusukela mhla tinge-22 Kholwane 2013, njengencenye yeLisu Lwetakhiwonchanti Lwavelonkhe.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho thakgolwa ha Morafo wa Tlhahiso wa Stanley Nkosi wa khamphane ya manganese ya Kgalakgadi, Hotazel, Kapa Leboya, eo e leng setsi se seholo ka ho fetisisa sa tlhahiso ya manganese lefatsheng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukele kwetfulwa kweStanley Nkosi Sinter Mine yeNkampani yeKalagadi Manganese, Hotazel, eNyakatfo Kapa, lekusikhungo lesikhulu semhlaba sekukhicita i-manganese sinter.

src: Sena se bopa karolo ya pokello ya diprojeke tse hlophisitsweng ke PICC, e etelletsweng pele ke Mopresidente Zuma.
tgt: Loku kuyincenye yemiklamo lechunyaniswa yi-PICC, leholwa nguMengameli Jacob Zuma.

src: Ka projeke ena, ho bile le tjhelete e kaalo ka R.5 bilione e keneng Kapa Leboya, ka nako ya dilemo tse nne, moo ho theilweng mesebetsi e 3 000 ka kotloloho, mme le tsebo ya ho etsa mesebetsi e ntse e ntshetswa pele kahara batjha.
tgt: Ngenca yalomklamo, iNyakatfo Kapa seyitfole kusitwa ngemali yekusungula ibhizinisi lebalelwa ku-R6,5 wetigidzigidzi, eminyakeni lemine, lokuholele ekubeni khona kwemisebenti ngco lokungenani le-3 000, kanye nekutfutfukiswa kwemakhono elusha lwendzawo.

src: Mopresidente Jacob Zuma o tla thakgola Letsatsi la Poelano ka la 16 Tshitwe Meahong ya Kopanong tlasa mookotaba o reng: “Kaho ya Setjhaba, Momahano le Poelano ya Setjhaba”.Keteko e thulana le sehopotso sa dilemo tse 100 tsa Meaho ya Kopanong e le setsi sa mmuso.
tgt: Mengameli Jacob Zuma utawuhlonipha Lusuku Lwekucolelana Nekubuyisana mhla ti-16 Ingongoni e-Union Buildings ngaphasi kwalengcikitsi: “Kwakha Sive, Kuvana Kwemmango Nekubuyisana”.Lomgubho wenteka ngesikhatsisinye nemkhosi wekugubha iminyaka le-100 ye-Union Buildings njengesihlalo sahulumende.

src: Seemahale sa Mopresidente wa mehleng Ntate Nelson Mandela, senatla tokolohong le poelanong ya naha ya rona, se tla kgurumollwa Meahong ya Kopanong e le karolo ya sehopotso.
tgt: Kutawuvulwa sitfombe lesibatiwe saMengameli waphambilini Nelson Mandela, lichawe lenkhululeko nekubuyisana lelive letfu, e-Union Buildings njengencenye yekukhumbula.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa ho sebedisa letsatsi lena ho hetla morao ho bona dikgato tseo re di tsamaileng re le setjhaba, ho phela le ho sebetsa mmoho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi basebentise lelilanga kubuyeketa emabanga lavelele lesiwahambile njengesive mayelana nekuphila nekusebenta ndzawonye.

src: Motlatsi wa Mopresidente Ntate Kgalema Motlanthe o tla etela pele Seboka sa Bobedi sa Boetapele ba Mmuso Setsing sa Diboka tsa Matjhaba sa Lekgotla la Diphuputso tsa Saense le Indasteri, Pretoria ho tloha ka la 10 ho isa ho la 12 Tshitwe 2013.
tgt: Lisekela LaMengameli Kgalema Motlanthe utawuhola Ingcungcutsela Yebuholi Yahulumende Yesibili e-CSIR International Convention Centre, ePitoli kusukela mhla ti-10 kuya kumhla ti-12 Ingongoni 2013.

src: Seboka se tla kgobokanya baokamedi ba baholo ba tswang makaleng ohle a mararo a mmuso, ka sepheo sa ho ntlafatsa kutlwisiso e abelanweng ka seabo sa Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba ho fihlelleng ditlhoko tsa mantlha tsa maAforika Borwa esita le ho etela pele ntshetsopele ya moruo wa rona.
tgt: Lengcungcutsela itawuhlanganisa ndzawonye baphatsi labakhulu labavela kuyo yomitsatfu imikhakha yahulumende, ngenhloso yekwenta kancono kuvisisa lokwabelwanako mayelana nendzima ledlalwa Temisebenti Yahulumende ekuhlangabetaneni netidzingonchanti tebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nekuhola kutfutfuka kwemnotfo wetfu.

src: Mopresidente Jacob Zuma o tla amohela Kgosi ya Setlamo sa Malaysia, Tuanku Abdul Halim Mu’adzam Shah, Meahong ya Kopanong bakeng sa Ketelo ya Naha ka la 10 Tshitwe 2013.
tgt: Mengameli Jacob Zuma utawemukela angenise Inkhosi yaHulumende weMave ase-Malaysia, Tuanku Abdul Halim Mu'adzam Shah, mayelana nekuVakasha kwembuso Lokusemtsetfweni e-Union Buildings mhla ti-10 Ingongoni 2013.

src: Ketelo ya Naha e tla tiisa maqhama a rona le Malaysia a sepolotiki le moruo esita le ho sebetsa e le monyetla wa ho ntshetsapele Ditabatabelo tsa rona tsa Aforika.
tgt: Lokuvakasha Kwembuso Lokusemtsetfweni kutawujulisa buhlobo betfu ne-Malaysia betepolitiki netemnotfo kanye nekusebenta njengelitfuba lekuchubekisela embili i-Ajenda yetfu yase-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e tshohlile puo e entsweng ke Letona la Mesebetsi ya Setjhaba ka tlaleho ya Setlamo sa Matona a Kopantsweng mabapi le dintlafatso tsa tshireletso matlong a Mopresidente a Nkandla.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icocisene yabonisana ngalokujulile ngekwetfulwa kwembiko yiNdvuna yeLitiko Letemisebenti Yesive mayelana neLitsimba Lelimisiwe Lekusebenta Emkhatsini Wetindvuna mayelana nekutfutfukiswa kwetekuphepha etindlini taMengameli taseNkandla.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ditshisinyo yaba ya laela hore tlaleho e fetisetswe setjhabeng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume tincomo yabuye yakhipha sicondziso sekutsi lombiko awetfulwe esiveni.

src: Matona a Setlamo sa Tshireletso le Letona la Mesebetsi ya Setjhaba ba tla bua le boraditaba ka Labobedi, mohla la 10 Tshitwe 2013.
tgt: Sigungu seTindvuna Setekuphepha kanye neNdvuna Yetemisebenti Yahulumende itawucatsatela betindzaba ngaLesibili, 10 Ingongoni 2013.

src: Kabinete e ananela sephetho sa Foramo ya bobedi sa BRICS sa Keketseho ya Setjhaba Ditoropong le Foramo ya boraro ya Ditoropokgolo tse nang le Setswalle esita le Tshebedisanommoho ya Mmuso wa Dibaka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukela imiphumela yeForamu yesibili ye-BRICS Yetekutfutfukiswa kwetindzawo tasemadolobheni kanye neForamu yesitsatfu Yebudlelwane Bemadolobha Lamakhulu Nekubambisana Kwabohulumende Bendzawo.

src: Foramo e tsepamisitse maikutlo tlhokehong ya mehato e fapaneng ya mmuso hore e matlafatse puisano le tshebedisanommoho dikarolong tsa meralo ya motheo, ntshetsopele ya dibaka tsa ditjhaba, moruo o sa senyeng tikoloho, phapanyetsano ya botjhaba, matsete le phetisetso ya thekenoloji.
tgt: LeForamu yagcila kutidzingo temazinga ahulumende lehlukene kucinisa kukhulumisana nekubambisana kutindzawo tetakhiwonchanti, kutfutfukiswa kwemmango, umnotfo lonenchubekela embili longatfuncisi intfutfu lengcolisa simondzawo, kuntjintjiselana kwemasiko, lutjalomali nekwendluliswa kwetebucwepheshe.

src: Kabinete e amohela dinaha tsa Aforika tse 16 le batshehetsi ba tsona tse tla ba le seabo Ditlhodisanong tsa boraro tsa Orange African Nations Championship (CHAN) dipakeng tsa la 11 Pherekgong le la 1 Hlakola 2014 Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukela emave ase-Afrika la-16 kanye nebalandzeli bawo labahlanganyela kuMchudzelwano wesiTsatfu we-Orange African Nations Championship (CHAN) emkhatsini wamhla ti-11 Bhimbidvwane namhla lu-1 Indlovana 2014 eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Ho tshwara dipapadi tsena ho tla fa Aforika Borwa monyetla wa ho aha hodima lefa le letle la Mohope wa Lefatshe wa FIFA wa 2010 le Mohope wa Dinaha tsa Aforika wa 2013, e boele e matlafatse momahano ya setjhaba le motlotlo wa setjhaba.
tgt: Kusingatsa lomchudzelwano webhola letinyawo kutawenta iNingizimu Afrika yakhele kumshiyandvuku longuwo weNdzebe Yemhlaba ye-FIFA yanga-2010 kanye neNdzebe Yemave Ase-Afrika yanga-2013, ibuye futsi ijulise ngalokuchubekako kuvana kwemimango neligcabho lavelonkhe.

src: Tlhodisano e boela e fana ka monyetla bakeng sa maAforika Borwa hore a bapatse naha ya rona e le sebaka se hlaphohetsweng sa bohahlaudi, kgwebisano le matsete.9 Nakong ya sehla sena sa phomolo, mmuso o etelletse pele matsholo a fapafapaneng ka tshebedisanommoho le makala ohle a setjhaba ho netefatsa polokeho le boikarabelo boitshwarong.
tgt: Lomchudzelwano webhola letinyawo ubuye futsi uvete litfuba lekutsi bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bakhangise ngelive letfu njengendzawo levakashelwa kakhulu, yetekuhwebelana kanye neyelutjalomali.

src: Tse ka sehloohong ho tsena ke Matsholo a Mekgwa ya ho phela Bophelo bo Botle, Fihla o Phela moo o yang, Matsatsi a 16 a Boitseko le Letsatsi la AIDS la Lefatshe.
tgt: Kulesikhatsi semaholidi, hulumende uhola imikhankhaso leminyenti ngekubambisana nayo yonkhe imikhakha yemmango kute acinisekise kutiphatsa ngalokunesibopho nangalokuphephile.

src: Nakong ena keketseho e bonahalang ya bahlanka ba qobello ya molao dithibelleng tsa mebileng esita le ditshebetso tsa ho phenyekolla naha ka bophara di tla netefatsa hore maAforika Borwa a bolokehile.
tgt: Imikhankhaso lehamba embili emkhatsini wayo yonkhe Tindlela Tekuphila Letikahle, Fika Uphila, Imikhankhaso Yemalanga la-16 Ekulwa Nebudlova Lobentiwa Kubomake Nebantfwana neLusuku Lwengculazi Lwemhlaba.

src: Bao ba fumanweng ba le molato wa ho tlola melao ba tla sebetswa ka phethahalo ho ya ka molao.10 Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho ba sedi ho netefatsa hore bana ba rona ba a hlokomelwa mme ba bolokwa hole le kotsi.
tgt: Kulesikhatsi kubonakala ngalokwengetiwe kwetisebenti leticinisekisa kulandzelwa kwemtsetfo lapho bakanekise khona emigwacweni kanye nemisebenti yekuphenya leyentiwa kulo lonkhe lelive kutawucinisekisa kutsi bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika baphephile.

src: Ke boikarabelo ba batswadi, bahlokomedi le setjhaba ho netefatsa hore bana ba rona ba bolokehile, haholoholo nakong ena eo re lebileng ho yona.11 Jwaloka ha e le kopano ya ho qetela ya Kabinete ya 2013, ditho tsa Phethahatso di lakaletsa maAforika Borwa ohle phomolo e monate, kgotso le polokeho sehleng sena sa keteko.
tgt: Basebentisi bemigwaco bakhunjutwa kutsi banganatsi bese bashayele, futsi banganatsi bese bahambe ngetinyawo.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho rona bohle ba ka kgonang, ho etsa Botho ka ho thusa batho le malapa a sa kgoneng ho iphedisa, le ho bontsha kutlwelobohloko re le setjhaba se hlokomelanang se bile se hlomphana.
tgt: Labo labatawutfolakala banelicala lekwephula umtsetfo kutawubukwana nabo ngekuya kwemtsetfo ngalokuphelele.10 IKhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bacaphele ngalokwengetiwe kute baciniseke kutsi bantfwabentfu bayanakekelwa futsi bagcinwa khashane netingoti letingabalimata.

src: Diqeto tsa bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.1 Kabinete e ananetse Leano, Lewa le Morero tsa Maqhubu a Dikgokahanyo a Naha a bitswang ka hore ke Hokahanya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Kungumsebenti nesibopho sebatali, bagcini bebantfwana kanye nemmango kucinisekisa kuphepha kwebantfwana, ikakhulu kulesikhatsi lesitako.11 Njengoba kungumhlangano weKhabhinethi wekugcina ku-2013, emalunga eSigungu Lesiphetse afisela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika, sikhatsi semaholidi nemigubho sekuphumula, lesinekuthula nekuphepha.

src: Sena se tla thusa haholo kgolong ya moruo, ntshetsopele le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isimema sonkhe tsine lesingakhona, sikhombise Buntfu ngekutsi sisite bantfu nemindeni lengakhoni kutisita, nekukhombisa lutsandvo neluvelo njengesive lesinakekelanako nalesihloniphanako.

src: Dipehelo di boetse di lokiseditswe ho hokelwa dikolong, ditleliniking le lekaleng la setjhaba ka kakaretso.
tgt: Loku kutawufaka ligalelo lelikhulu ekutfutfukeni kwemnotfo, kutfutfuka nasekuvuleni ematfuba emisebenti.

src: Kgolo e potlakileng ya theknoloji ya maqhubu a dikgokahanyo e bolela hore dipehelo tsena di tla shejwa botjha selemo le selemo.2 Kabinete e ananetse ho kenngwa ha Pampiri e Tala ya Leano la Theknoloji ya Lesedi la Dikgokahanyole Kopantsweng (ICT) la Naha koranteng ya mmuso bakeng sa ho bontshana le setjhaba.
tgt: Injongo lenkhulu lapha kuzuza sivinini sekudawunloda lesifananako lesisemkhatsini se-100 mbps ungekafiki unyaka wanga-2030.Kute kufinyelelwe kulenjongo lehlosiwe ngendlela lenenchubekela embili, kunetinjongo letihlosiwe letingabuyeketwa kucalwe ngesivinini semsebentisi lonelwati lolusemkhatsini lwe-5 mbps lesifanele sifinyelelwe nga-2016 futsi sitfolwe bantfu labange-50% welinani lebantfu ne-90% nga-2020.

src: Pampiri e Tala e sebetsana le tlhokeho ya ho fetolwa ha maano le melawana ho nkela hloohong diphetoho tse potlakileng ho ICT dilemong tsa moraorao.
tgt: Kubuye kwabekwa tinjongo letihlosiwe tekuchunywa kwetikolwa nemitfolamphilo nemkhakha wahulumende jikelele.

src: Ho tse ding tsa dintho tseo e tsepamisitseng maikutlo ho tsona ke ditshebeletso tsa dikgokahanyo tsa mehala, tsa kgaso le tsa poso.
tgt: Ingcucuko leyenteka ngesivinini lesikhulu kutebucwepheshe be-broadband isho kutsi letinjongo letihlosiwe titawubuyeketwa njalo ngemnyaka.

src: Dipitso tsa nonyo ya maikutlo a setjhaba di tla tshwarwa diporofenseng tsohle qalong ya selemo se tlang.3 Kabinete e ananetse diphetolo tsa Leano la ho Fetolwa ha mokgwa wa Kgaso le amanang haholo le taba ya hore na ebe Mabokoso a Kenngwang Hodimo (STB) (didikhouda) di tshwanela ho ba le mokgwa wa ho laolwa kapa tjhe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume kutsi kufakwe kuGazethi Luhlakamtsetfo Lwenchubomgomo Yelwatiso Loluhlanganisiwe Lwavelonkhe kanye Netebucwepheshe Betekuchumana (i-ICT) kute ummango ubonisane ngalo.

src: E meng ya mekgwa e sebedisitsweng ho nka qeto ho sena ke e latelang:tlhokeho ya ho fetola mokgwa wa kgaso ka potlako, haholoholo ho ntsha mefutafuta ya maqhubu a seyalemoyaho netefatsa hore ditjhelete tsa ditshehetso tsa mmuso di sebediswa hantleho qholotsa indasteri ya lapeng ya dielektroniki le tlhahiso ya mesebetsihore borakgwebo ba thuthuang ba fole molemoho fokotsa kgonahalo ya hore mebaraka ya Aforika Borwa e subuhlellwe ke di-STB tsa theko e tlase tse sa sebetseng hantleho tshireletsa ditabatabelo tsa SABCho ba hlokolotsi diphetohong tse potlakileng tsa lekala la kgaso le ICT ka kakaretsoho fokotsa sekgahla sa ho kotela ba bang mme ho kgothaletswe tlhodisano ka ho thea lepatlelo bakeng sa ditlabotjha mmarakeng wa dithelevishene tse lefellwang ntle le leeme la ho fola molemo dithusong tsa ditjhelete tsa mmusoho fokotsa sekgahla sa dikgato tsa molao tse nkwang ke bahasi le bahwebi ba tla henahenana le mosebetsi wa ho fetola mokgwa wa kgaso.
tgt: Loluhlakamtsetfo lubukene nesidzingo sekuchibela tinchubomgomo nemitsetfosimiso kute ifake ekhatsi tingcuko letetenteka njalo nje ngesivinini lesikhulu ku-ICT kuleminyaka lesikuyo.

src: Ho kopanya mokgwa ona le e meng, Kabinete e qetile ka hore tshebediso ya ho laola mokgwa wa kgaso ha e a tshwanela ho tlama.
tgt: Lenye yetintfo legcile kuto tekuchumana ngetincingo, i-broadband kanye netinsita tetekuposa.

src: Leha ho le jwalo, di-STB di tla ba le mokgwa wa taolo ho tshireletsa matsete a Mmuso mmarakeng le indastering ya dielektroniki tsa lapeng tsa STB tse tsheheditsweng ka ditjhelete tsa mmuso, mme ka diphetoho tse potlakileng ho tsa theknoloji, bakeng sa tshebediso ke bahasi ba ka nnang ba batla ho e sebedisa hona jwale.
tgt: Kutawubanjwa imihlangano yekulalelwa kweluvo lwemmango kute tonkhe tifundza nakusuka lomnyaka lotako.

src: Ho qoba boingodiso bahasi ba folang molemo ka leeme mokgweng wa tsamaiso wa STB, ho tla hulwa ditjhelete ho bahasi bao ba ingodisitseng empa ba kgetha ho sebedisa mokgwa wa Taolo wa STB.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume kuchitjelwa kweNchubomgomo Yekuntjintjela Kutekusaka Tedijithali lokuphatselene kakhulu nekutsi ingabe Libhokisi Langetulu Lesethi (STB) (emadekhoda) ngabe afanele abe nenchubo lewalawulako yini noma cha.

src: Kabinete e kopa mekgatlo yohle hore e tlohele diphapang tsa yona tsa nako e fetileng mme e sebetse mmoho le mmuso ho thakgola mokgwa o motjha wa kgaso ka potlako molemong wa naha.4 Kabinete e ananetse mekgwa e reretsweng ho thusa malapa a tetebetseng dikolotong esita le ho matlafatsa botsitso ba tsa ditjhelete.
tgt: Letinye tetindlela letisetjentisiwe nakutsatfwa sincumo ngunati letilandzelako:sidzingo sekusheshisa kuntjintjela kudijithali, ikakhulu kwetfula bubanti bekusebenta kwemagagasi ekuhogela kwemsakato wemoyakucinisekisa kutsi selekelelo sahulumende sisetjentiswa kahle ngalokukhicitakokwenta imboni yema-elekthroniki isebente futsi yakhe ematfuba emisebentikuzuzisa bosomabhizinisi labasafufusakunciphisa simo lapho khona lokubonakala kungaba timakethe teNingizimu Afrika, kutfolakale sekugcwaliswa ngema-STB lashiphile langasebenti ngalokuphelelekuvikela tifiso teNhlangano Yetekusakata yaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SABC)kuba neluvelomiva kutingucuko letenteka ngesivinini lesikhulu kutekusakata nemkhakha we-ICT ngekuphelela kwayokunciphisa umgamu wekugodlwa ngumuntfu munye kanye nekukhutsata kuchudzelana ngekutsi kwakhiwe indzawo yebadlali labasha emakethe yethelevishini lekhokhelwako ngaphandle kwekuzuza kuHulumende ngalokungafanele.

src: Matona a tsa Ditjhelete le Kgwebisano le Indasteri a ne a filwe matla a ho kenya tshebetsong mekgwa ya thibelo ho fokotsa kotsi ya ho tetebela ka ho fetisisa dikolotong ka dikadimo tsa kamoso tsa ditjhelete.
tgt: kunciphisa kutsatselwa tinyatselo temtsetfo lokungentiwa basakati nabosomabhizinisi labangakhinyabeta lenchubo yekuntjintja.

src: Sena se akga ho fana ka lenaneo le kopaneng la dikgato tse sebetsang hantle la ho thusa malapa ao e bang hona jwale a se a ntse a le tebetebeng ya dikoloto hore a se ke a tetebela ka ho fetisisa dikolotong kamoso.
tgt: Nakuhlanganiswa ndzawonye letindlela kanye naletinye, iKhabhinethi incume kutsi kungasetjentiswa inchubo yekulawula.

src: Letona la tsa Ditjhelete le tla boela le nka dikgato tsa ho kgothatsa bahiri ho thusa bahiruwa ba bona ba tetebetseng haholo dikolotong ka ho fuputsa ditokomane tsa qobello ya tefo ho bona hore na ke nnete ho le hokae, esita le ho fa bahiruwa mekgwa ya dikeletso ka tsa ditjhelete.5 Kabinete e ananetse Pampiri e Tshweu ya Leano la Naha la Bolaodi ba Tikoloho ya Mawatleng.
tgt: Nanoma kunjalo, le-STB, itawuba nenchubo yekulawula letawuvikela lutjalomali lwaHulumende etimakethe te-STB letelekelelwako futsi nemboni yema-elekhthronki futsi, ngetingucuko tetebucwepheshe letenteka ngemandla, letitawusetjentiswa basakati esikhatsini lesitako lekungenteka bangafuni kuyisebentisa manje.

src: Leano le teka mokgwa wa bolaodi bo hlophisitsweng ba lekala ho ya bolaoding ba tikoloho ya mawatleng.
tgt: Kugwema kutsi basakati lababhalisile bazuze ngalokungafanele kunchubo yekulawula ye-STB, lutjalomali lwaHulumende kuNchubo Yekulawula i-STB lutawutfolwa kubasakati lababhalisile labakhetsa kusebentisa inchubo Yekulawula i-STB.

src: Sena se tla dumella Aforika Borwa ho rarolla ka bokgabane diphephetso tse holang tse bakwang ke tshenyo e etswang ke batho tikolohong ya mawatleng, ha ka lehlakoreng le leng e thusa kahohlehohle bokgoning ba ntshetsopele ya moruo boo mawatle a fanang ka bona.6 Kabinete e ananetse Maemo a makgaolakgang a Leano la Naha la Metsi yaba ya ela hloko mesebetsi ya dipuisano tsa setjhaba e entsweng ho phethelaTjhebobotjha ya Leano la Naha la Metsi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela onkhe emacembu kutsi ayekele kungevani kwawo kwaphambilini futsi asebentisane nahulumende ekusebentiseni luhlelo lwekuntjintjela kudijithali masinyane ngendlela lekungakhonwa ngayo kutifiso telive.

src: Maemo a matjha a Leano la Metsi a amohela ntlha ya ntshetsopele ya bolaodi ba metsi, e rarollang dikgohlano dipakeng tsa bolaodi ba metsi le ntshetsopele esita le sepheo sa mmuso sa diphetoho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume tindlela lekuhloswe kutsi tisetjentiswe ekwelekeleni emakhaya lacwile etikweletini kanye nekucinisa kusimama kutetimali Indvuna Yetetimali neyeTekuhweba neTimboni tigunyatwe kuphumelelisa tindlela tekuvikela kute kuncishiswe bungoti bekucwila etikweletini ngekusebentisa timalimboleko tesikhatsi lesitako.

src: Sena se lekodisisa boleng ba tsamaiso ya metsi ka kakaretso mabapi le kamoo metsi a ka thusang ka teng ntshetsopeleng ya tekano, ya ho fola molemo le ya nako e telele naha ka bophara.7 Kabinete e ananetse mosebetsi wa ho amahanya botjha Diboto tsa Metsi ho ba Ditheo tsa Mabatowa tsa Metsi tse robong.
tgt: Loku kufaka ekhatsi kuniketa luhlelo loluhlanganyelwe lwetinyatselo letisebenta ngemphumelelo kusita emakhaya kwamanje lacwile kakhulu etikweletini, kanye nekuvikela emakhaya kutsi angacwili kakhulu etikweletini esikhatsini lesitako.

src: Sena se latela tlaleho ya ho qetela kahong botjha e sisintsweng ya Diboto tsa Metsi.
tgt: Indvuna Yetetimali itawubuye itsatse tinyatselo tekukhutsata bacashi kutsi basite tisebenti tabo leseticwile kakhulu etikweletini ngekutsi baphenye kute bacinisekise timali letikhokhiswa tisebenti ngulabo lababakweletako, bese baniketa letisebenti tindlela tekuphila mayelana nekusetjentiswa kwemali.

src: Mosebetsi wa bohlokwahlokwa wa Ditheo tsa Mabatowa tsa Metsi e tla ba ho aha le ho laola moqeqeko wa meralo ya motheo ya mabatowa (phepelo ya metsi le mohlodi wa metsi) ho akga le ditjhelete, ntshetsopele ya projeke le mesebetsi e tswelang pele le poloko ya disebediswa di le maemong a matle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume Umtsetfo Lodzingidvwako mayelana neNchubomgomo Yavelonkhe Yekulawulwa Kwesimondzawo Selwandle.

src: Sena se tla thusa ka phano e betetshana ya tshehetso mmusong wa dibaka, e leng tlhokeho ya bohlokwa ya popobotjha ya lekala ka kakaretso.8 Kabinete e ananetse ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha ho entelwa Kokwanahloko ya Papiloma Bathong, eo tsamaiso ya yona e tla laolwa ka dikgwedi tse tsheletseng tse qadikaneng, ka 2014, bananeng ba dilemong tse pakeng tsa tse robong le tse 10 ka Lenaneo la Kopantsweng la Bophelo bo Botle Dikolong.
tgt: Lenchubomgomo ibeka indlela lechumene yekulawula umkhakha ekulawulweni kwesimondzawo selwandle.

src: Sepheo ke ho fokotsa kotsi ya ho ba le mofetshe wa popelo hamorao bophelong ba banana, mme e tla thusa ntlafalong ya bophelo ba boleng basading e be e eketse tebello ya dilemo tsa bona tsa ho phela, athe e boetse e fokotsa haholo boteng ba mafu a diqebo.
tgt: Loku kutawenta iNingizimu Afrika ikwati kubukana netinselele letikhulako letibangwa lifutse lebantfu kusimondzawo selwandle ngalokunemphumelelo kakhulu, kube kutsi ngaso sona leso sikhatsi kube kukhulisa emandla ekutfutfuka kwemnotfo lokuvetwa lwandle.

src: Dibili.1 Kabinete e ananetse ho kenngwa koranteng ya mmuso ha Bili ya nakwana ya Agrément ya Aforika Borwa, ya 2013 le Memorandamo o mabapi le sepheo sa Bili hore setjhaba se tshwaele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume Timo tekugcina Tenchubomgomo Yemanti Avelonkhe yabuye futsi yacaphela inchubo yekubonisana nemmango leyentiwa mayelana nekuphetsa kuBuyeketwa Kwenchubomgomo Yemanti Avelonkhe.

src: Bili ya nakwana e hlekela kananelo ya Agrément ya Aforika Borwa e le setheo.
tgt: Timo Tenchubomgomo Yemanti letinsha temukela simo sekulawulwa kutfutfukiswa kwemanti, lokubukana nekuchumana emkhastini wekulawulwa kwemanti kanye nemigomo yahulumende yekutfutfukisa nekwenta tingucuko.

src: Boto ya Agrément ya Aforika Borwa e filwe thomo, ho tse ding, ya ho hlahloba ho lokela mosebetsi ha dihlahiswa tse sa amohelwang semmuso tse amanang le kaho kapa mekgwa ya ho di sebedisa indastering ya kaho, moo e bang ho hang ha ho maemo a naha a beilweng.
tgt: Loku kubukela lonkhe luchungechunge lwekubaluleka kwemanti mayelana nekutsi emanti angalifaka kanjani ligalelo ekuzuzeni kutfutfuka lokulinganako, lokuzuzisako nalokunenchubekela embili kulo lonkhe lelive.

src: Sena se tla thusa ho theweng ha indasteri ya kaho e hatelang pele ebile e le ya maemo e tla thusa tlhahisong ya mesebetsi ha ka ho le leng e tla be e kenya letsoho mererong ya meralo ya motheo ya Mmuso.2 Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya Sehlomathiso ya Banka ya Ntshetsopele ya Aforika e ka Borwa, ya 2013 Palamenteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume inchubo yekuphindza kwentiwe eMabhodi Emanti ahambisane naletintfo letiyimfica Tesigodzi Letisebentisa Emanti.

src: Bili e hlomathisa Molao wa Banka ya Ntshetsopele ya Aforika e ka Borwa, wa 1997.Leqheka la tjhadimo ya Bili ya Sehlomathiso ke ho kgontsha katoloso ya Banka ya Ntshetsopele ya Aforika e ka Borwa ho ya naheng efe kapa efe e kontinenteng ya Aforika esita le dihlekehlekeng tse mawatleng a yona.
tgt: Umsebenti lomkhulu Wetintfo Tesigodzi Letisebentisa Emanti kutawuba kutfutfukisa nekulawula sakhiwonchanti lesibanti (kuniketa emanti nemitfombo yemanti) kufaka ekhatsi kuniketa timali, kutfutfukiswa kwemiklamo kanye nekusebenta nekukugcina kusesimeni lesifanele lesichubekako.

src: Sena se tla kgontsha Banka ho ba le seabo meralong e meholo ya motheo le diprojeke tse ding kantle ho lebatowa la Dinaha tse Tswelang pele tsa Aforika e ka Borwa tse nang le bokgoni ba ho ntlafatsa kgwebisano le kgolo ya moruo kontinenteng esita le ho tshehetsa boitelo le boikitlaetso ba naha tse pedi momahanong ya -3.3 Kabinete e ananetse hore Bili ya nakwana ya Bolaodi ba Lekala la tsa Ditjhelete e ntshuwe bakeng sa hore setjhaba se tshwaele ka yona, ho thusa boikitlaetsong ba Aforika Borwa ba G-20.Sepheo sa Bili ke ho etsa hore lekala la tsa ditjhelete le bolokehe ka ho kenya tshebetsong mokgwa wa taolo wa ‘tlhoro pedi’ e leng ho thewa ha balaodi ba babedi: e mong o ikarabela polokehong le botsitsong ba ditheo tsa ditjhelete ha e mong a ikarabela mokgweng oo ditheo tsa ditjhelete di etsang mosebetsi wa tsona ka teng.
tgt: Loku kutawenta kutsi kuniketwe lusito kancono kuhulumende wasekhaya, lokusidzingo lesikhulu sekuhlelwa kabusha kwawo wonkhe lomkhakha.

src: Dithonyo.1 Kabinete e ananetse ho thonngwa ha Esther Sarah Makau mosebetsing wa Mohlanka e Moholo wa tsa Ditjhelete Lefapheng la Bonono le Botjhaba.2 Kabinete e ananetse dithonyo tse latelang Lefapheng la Dokgokahanyo:a) Reneva Fourie mosebetsing wa Motlatsi wa Molaodikakaretso: Lesedi la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba le Diphuputsob) Tinyiko Moses Ngobeni mosebetsing wa Motlatsi wa Molaodikakaretso: Kaho ya Meralo ya Motheo ya ICTc) Sibongile Vulikhaya Makopi mosebetsing wa Motlatsi wa Molaodikakaretso: Tekolo ya Dikhamphane tseo e leng tsa Mmuso le Kaho ya Dikgwebo tsa ICT.3 Kabinete e ananetse ho thonngwa ha Siyakhula Paradise Simelane mosebetsing wa Mohlanka e Moholo wa tsa Ditjhelete Lefapheng la Ntshetsopele ya Dibaka tsa Mahae le Tlhabollo ya Naha.4 Kabinete e ananetse ho thonngwabotjha ha Siyabulela Thomas Tsengiwe mosebetsing wa Mokomishenara e Moholo wa Khomishene ya Tsamaiso ya Kgwebisano ya Matjhaba.5 Kabinete e ananetse ho thonngwa ha Mme Thezi Rosemary Mabuza e le Motlatsi wa Mokhomishenara wa Khomishene ya Naha ya Bareki.6 Kabinete e ananetse ho thonngwa ha Ntate Themba Thomas Cyril Dlamini e le Mohlanka e Moholo wa Phethahatso (CEO) Botong ya Dipapadi ya Naha.7 Kabinete e ananetse ho thonngwa ha Moadvokheiti Solomon Makhosini Msibi e le CEO ya Koporasi ya Taolo ya Sephethephethe Mebileng.8 Kabinete e ananetse dithonyo tse latelang tsa ditho tseo e seng sa Phethahatso Botong ya Koporasi ya Taolo ya Sephethephethe Mebileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukele kuphunyeleliswa kwekugonyelwa i-Human Papiloma Virus, lokutawentiwa ngemkhawulo wetinyanga letisitfupha, nga-2014, kumantfombatana laneminyaka leyimfica kuya kulelishumi budzala ngekusebentisa Luhlelo Lwetemphilo Lwesikolwa Loluhlanganisiwe.

src: Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le dintlha tsa bohlokwa maemong a ha jwale.1 Polelo ya Maemo a Naha ya bo 24 (SoNA) esale ho ba le demokrasi e fane ka tekolo ya bohlokwa ya pheletso ya nako mabapi le ho kengwa tshebetsong ha maikemisetso a mmuso bakeng sa 2009-2014.
tgt: Tincumo teKhabhinethi etindzabeni letigcamile kulesimo sanyalo.

src: Tsebiso ya sistimi ya diphetho ka 2009 e dumelletse hore ho be le tshalomorao e thehilweng hodima bopaki le diphetho ya ho kenya dintho tshebetsong ho netefatsa hore mmuso o sebetsa hantle le ka tokelo.
tgt: Inkhulumo ye-24 Letfulelwa Sive (SoNA) kusukela kwangena intsandvo yelinyenti yente kwaba nekuhlolisiswa kwethemu yekugcina ekwetfulweni kwetinhlelo tahulumende letisembili tanga-2009-2014.

src: Kamora Polelo ya Maemo a Naha le Ngangisano mabapi le Polelo ya Maemo a Naha, letoto la hajwale la ditsebiso tsa Matona ho boraditaba le fana ka monyetla bakeng sa puisano le Matona a fapaneng a tla hlalosa Polelo ya Mopresidente.
tgt: Kwetfulwa kweluhlelo lwemiphumela nga-2009 kwente kutsi kube nekulandzelela lokusekelwe ebufakazini futsi lokugcile emiphumeleni yekuphumelelisa lokwenta kube nekuciniseka kutsi hulumende wenta kahle nangemphumelelo.

src: Tlaleho ya pheletso ya nako bakeng sa 2009 ho isa 2014 e tla tlatseletswa ka Tlaleho ya Tekolobotjha ya Dilemo tse 20 e thehilweng hodima bopaki e leng karolo ya letsholo la rona la ketekelo ya Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho.
tgt: Kulandzela Inkhulumo Letfulelwa Sive kanye neNkhulumophikiswano ngeNkhulumo Letfulelwa Sive, luchungechunge lwanyalo lwetinkhulumo teTindvuna nebetindzaba lutawuniketa litfuba lekukhulumisana neTindvuna letehlukene letitawuchaza kabanti ngeNkhulumo yaMengameli.

src: MaAforika Borwa ohle a kotjwa ho Bapala Karalo ya Bona ho fetoleng lefa ka kgethollo ka ho keteka Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho, ho bontshang hore Aforika Borwa ehlile ke naha e betere hona le kamoo e neng e le ka teng ka 1994.
tgt: Umbiko wethemu yekugcina yesikhatsi lesisukela ku-2009 kuya ku-2014 utawengetwa bufakazi lobusekelwe Embikweni Wekubuyeketa Iminyaka lenge-20 loyincenye yemkhankhaso wekugubha umkhosi weNkhululeko Yeminyaka lenge-20.

src: Jwalo ka MaAforika Borwa re na le boikarabello mmoho ba ho aha setjhaba se hlomphang molao, se hlomphanang hape se hlomphang bophelo le thepa.
tgt: Bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bayamenywa kutsi Dlala Incenye Yakho ekubuyiseleni emuva lifa lelubandlululo ngekugubha umkhosi weNkhululeko Yeminyaka lenge-20, ekuboniseni kutsi iNingizimu Afrika seyilive lelincono kakhulu kunalelo lebeyingilo nga-1994.

src: Kabinete e tiisetsa setjhaba hore tahlehelo ya maphelo ka bohlaswa ba sepolesa nakong ya ho sebetsana le boipelaetso e ke ke ya lebalwa kapa ya amohelwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihambe emagameni aMengameli Jacob Zuma ngembhikisho.

src: Ka tsela e jwalo, baipelaetsi ba nang le dibetsa kapa ba fumanwang ba tjhesa meaho ya setjhaba kapa ba beha maphelo a batho ba bang kotsing ba tla ahlolwa ka matla a felletseng a molao.
tgt: Umbhikisho losongela timphilo nemphahla futsi lolimata sakhiwonchanti lesiligugu lesentelwe kusita imimango, wentela phansi yona kanye intsandvo yelinyenti levikela lilungelo lekubhikisha.

src: Mmuso o tla sebetsa le ditjhaba ho ntlafatsa maemo a bophelo dikarolong tsohle tsa naha mme ditjhaba di kgothaletswa ho buisana le makhanselara tekong ya ho rarolla mathata a phano ya ditshebeletso mmoho le ka kgotso.
tgt: Njengebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika sonkhe sinesibopho sekwakha ummango lohlonipha kusebenta kwemtsetfo, lohloniphanako nalohlonipha imphilo kanye nemphahla.

src: Ditshekatsheko mabapi le mekgolo pakeng tsa dimmaene tsa polathinamo le Mokgatlo wa Basebetsi ba Dimmaene le Yunione ya (AMCU)) di ntse di tsamaiswa ke CCMCCMA e beile makhomishenara a maholo hore a tsamaise tshebetso eo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icinisekise sive ngekutsi kulahleka kwemphilo ngebudedengu bemaphoyisa ngesikhatsi abhekene nemibhikisho ngeke kunganakwa nobe kushalatelelwe.

src: Kabinete e na tle tshepo ya hore mahlakore ohle a tla hlahisa tumellano e molemo ho bohle e tla sireletsa ditokelo tsa basebetsi le ho sireletsa moruo wa naha.
tgt: Kanjalo, nebabhikishi labaphatsa tilimato nobe batfolakale bashisa takhiwo temmango nobe babeke engotini timphilo talabanye batawubhekana nengalo yemtsetfo.

src: Kabinete e amohela boingodiso ba bakgethi ba tshwanelehang ba fetang 80% ka lebaka la letsholo le atlehileng la boingodiso la Khomishene e Ikemetseng ya Dikgetho (IEC).
tgt: Hulumende utawusebenta nemimango ekutfutfukiseni timo tekuphila kuto tonkhe tincenye telive.

src: Moyeng wa ho keteka le ho hopola Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho, Kabinete e rorisa IEC, mekgatlo ya dipolotiki le ditho tsa setjhaba tseo mesebetsi ya bona e kopaneng e netefaditseng hore bakgethi ba bangata le ho feta ba tshwanelehang baa ingodisa.
tgt: Imimimango icelwa kutsi ikhulumisane nemakhansela ekwetameni kusombulula ndzawonye futsi ngekuthula tinkinga tekutfulwa kwetinsita.

src: Kabinete e boetse e rorisa bonkakarolo ba baahi ba netefaditseng hore mabitso a bona a teng lenaneng la bakgethi.
tgt: Tinkhulumo tekucocisana ngemaholo emkhatsini wetimayini te-platinum kanye ne-AMCU tilanyulwa yiKomishini Yekulamula Nekucocisana Ngetemiholo (CCMA).

src: Bakgethi ba tshwanelehang ba ntseng ba hloka ho netefatsa dintlha tsa bona tsa ngodiso le ba ntseng ba hloka ho ya ngodisa ba lokela ho etela diofisi tsa bona tsa lehae tsa IEC pele lenane la bakgethi le kwalwa.
tgt: I-CCMA ibeke bokhomishini labakhulu kutsi balekelele etingcocweni.

src: Kabinete e bitsa baetapele bohle ba dipolotiki hore ba hatelle taba ya boitshwaro dipolotiking hara mekga le batshehetsi ba bona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inelitsemba lekutsi letinhlangotsi titawufinyelela esivumelwaneni lesitawuvikela emalungelo etisebenti futsi sivikele nemnotfo welive.

src: Kentelo kgahlano le mofetshe wa popelo e tla fuwa banana ba pakeng tsa dilemo tse 9 le Batswadi le bahlokomedi ba banana ba sekolo ba Kereite ya 4 ba kgothaletswa ho tshehetsa letsholo lena ka ho fana ka tumello ya bona le ho buisana le bana ba bona ka bohlokwa ba ente ena.
tgt: Ngekuhambisana nekubungata kanye nemgubho weNkhululeko Yeminyaka lenge-20, iKhabhinethi incoma i-IEC, emacembu etepolitiki kanye nemalunga emmango ngemitamo yabo lehlangene lecinisekise kutsi bavoti labanyenti labafanelekile bayabhalisa.

src: Kgatelopele ena ya bophelo bo botle ba setjhaba, e tsamaisanang le kgothaletso ya Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Bophelo bo botle, ho lebelletswe hore e tla fokotsa mofetshe wa popelo hara basadi le ho fokotsa ho shwa ho tsamaisanang le hona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ichubeka incoma kutibandzakanya ngemandla kwaleto takhamiti leticinisekisile kutsi emabito ato akhona eluhlwini lwebavoti.

src: Hape Kabinete e amohetse tsebiso ya Molawana o shebilweng botjha wa Thero ya Dithibelapelehi le ho Tswala le Ditataiso tsa Phano ya Tshebeletso ka la 27 Hlakola 2014 ke Letona la Bophelo bo botle.
tgt: Bavoti labafanelekile labasadzinga kucinisekisa imininingwane yekubhalisa kuvota kwabo kanye nalabo labasadzinga kubhalisela kuvota kufanele bavakashele emahhovisi e-IEC lasetindzaweni tabo ngaphambi kwekuvalwa kweluhlu lwebavoti.

src: Letona la Bophelo bo botle le boetse le tla tsebisa kenyo ya ka tlaase ho letlalo e leng sesebediswa sa ho thibela pelehi se setjha se sebetsang ka nako e telele bakeng sa basadi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema baholi betepolitiki kutsi bakhutsate kubeketelelana kutepolitiki emacenjini abo kanye nakubalandzeli.

src: Mopresidente Jacob Zuma, jwalo ka Kgosi e ka Sehloohong ya Sesole sa Tshireletso sa Aforika Borwa (SANDF), o tla ba teng ho Letsatsi la Mabotho a Hlometseng ho la Lejwe Leputswa ka la 21 Hlakola 2014.Ketsahalo ena ya selemo le selemo e tlotla tshebeletso ya boinehelo ya banna le basadi ba rona ba yunifomo hape e rorisa ba weleng ba le tshebetsong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamukela sigaba sekucala semkhankhaso wekujova Ngemjovo we-Human Papillomarivus (HPV), lesitawucala mhla ti-7 Indlovulenkhulu 2014.

src: E boetse e fana ka monyetla ho ditho tsa setjhaba hore di ithute di le haufi ka mosebetsi le boikarabello ba SANDF.
tgt: Umjovo wekuvikela ikhensa yesibeletfo utawuniketwa emantfombatane lasemkhatsini weminyaka leyimfica kanye nalelishumi.

src: Kabinete e thabetse palo ya matsholo a atlehileng ao SANDF e a entseng kontinenteng ka bophara, jwalo ka ho la Burundi eo kajeno e nang le mmuso o tsitsitseng DRC e botjhabela, moo SANDF, jwalo ka karolo ya Force Intervention Brigade (FIB), e thefutseng dihlopha tse hlometseng, le neelano ya yona ho pholoseng maphelo a makgolo a dikete sebakeng sa Darfur, Sudan.
tgt: Batali kanye nebanakekeli bemantfombatane lafundza Libanga 4 labaneminyaka leyimfica kanye nalelishumi bakhutsatwa kutsi basekele lomkhankhaso ngekutsi banike imvume futsi bacoce nebantfwana babo ngekubaluleka kwalomjovo.

src: Ho feta moo, Kabinete e ananetse thibelo e atlehileng ya bophaerete bo atamelang Aforika e Borwa ke SANDF ka ho lebela le ho paterola Lebopo la Mozambique.
tgt: Leligcatsi lemphilo yesive, lelivumelana nesincomo seNhlangano Yetemphilo Yemhlaba, kulindzeleke kutsi lifake ligalelo ekunciphiseni ikhensa yesibeletfo kubantfu labasikati futsi linciphise tehlakalo tekufa letihlobene nayo.

src: Mopresident Jacob Zuma o tla nka leeto la mosebetsi ho ya United Kingdom ho tloha ka la 2 ho isa la 4 Hlakubele 2014, moo a tlang ho ya ho Tshebeletso ya Naha ya Teboho ho ketekela bophelo le mesebetsi ya Mopresidente wa mehleng Nelson Mandela ho la Westminster Abbey, London ka la 3 Hlakubele 2014.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphindze yamukela kwetfula Inchubomgomo lebuyeketiwe Yeluhlelo Lekuvikela Intalo Nentalo kanye Neticondziso Tekwetfula Tinsita mhla tinge-27 Indlovana 2014 yiNdvuna Yetemphilo.

src: Kabinete e lebohisa batho ba Riphaboliki ya Federale ya Nigeria ka ketsahalo ena ya boiphihlelo e etsahalang ka selemo se le seng le ha Aforika Borwa e keteka Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho.
tgt: Indvuna Yetemphilo itawuphindze yetfule kufakelwa (ngaphasi kwesikhumba) kwangaphasi kwesikhumba lokusha, lokuyintfo lesebenta sikhatsi lesidze yekuvikela intalo kulabasikati.

src: Kgwedi ya Ditokelo tsa Botho e tla ketekelwa tlasa tema ya: “Ho keteka dilemo tse 20 tsa ho fetola maphelo ka ditokelo tsa botho”.Mopresidente Jacob Zuma o tla fana ka puo ya sehlooho bakeng sa Letsatsi la Ditokelo tsa Botho (21 Hlakubele 2014) ketsahalong ya sehlooho ho la Sharpeville.
tgt: Mengameli Jacob Zuma, njengeMekhuti Lomkhulu Wembutfo Wetekuvikela WaseNingizimu Afrika (SANDF), utakuya emcimbini weLusuku Lwemabutfo Emphi eBloemfontein mhla tinge-21 Indlovana 2014.

src: Lenaneo la mmuso le tla matlafatsa letsholo la Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho ka ho toboketsa ditaba tse ahang le ho ntlafatsa kopano ya setjhaba, kaho ya naha le bonngwe setjhabeng sa rona sa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lomgubho waminyaka yonkhe uhlonipha kusebenta ngekutiniketa kwalabadvuna nalabasikati bakitsi emsebentini futsi uhlonipha nalabo labasishiye basemsebentini.

src: Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Moruo, Setsi sa Naha sa Ntshetsopele ya Batjha (NYDA) le Bopresidente di tla tshwara Indaba ya Bopresidente ya Batjha e mabapi le Mesebetsi le Bokgoni ho Setsi sa Dikopano sa Birchwood, Boksburg, ho tloha la 28 Hlakola ho isa la 3 Hlakubele 2014 tlasa tema ya: “Ho sebetsa mmoho ho matlafatsa le ho fana ka tshepo ho batjha ba Aforika Borwa.”Dilemong tse 20 tse fetileng mmuso o kentse tshebetsong moralo o makala a fapaneng ho sebetsana le tlhokeho ya mosebetsi batjheng.
tgt: Uphindze uniketa litfuba emalunga emmango kutsi afundze ngalokucondzile ngemsebenti kanye nesibopho se-SANDF.

src: Ditumellano tsa Bokgoni ba Naha, Thuto ya Motheo le Matlafatso ya Batjha di ananela boitlamo bo matla ba balekane ba setjhaba, hammoho le ba Mananeo a fapaneng a Khiro ya Setjhaba le molao jwalo ka Molao wa Kgohelo ya Lekgetho la Khiro No 26 wa 2013.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ijabulile ngemisebenti leyimphumelelo leminyenti leyentiwe yi-SANDF kulivekati, njengaseBurundi lamuhla lese inahulumende losimeme emphumalanga ye-DRC, lapho i-SANDF iyincenye yeMbutfo Logadze Kuthula (FIB), lobhekane nekuhlaselwa lokumatima ngemacembu lahlomile, kanye nekufaka sandla kwawo ekusindziseni timphilo temakhulu etinkhulungwane esifundzeni saseDarfur eSudan.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho kopana ha balekane bohle ba makala a setjhaba Kopanong e Atolositsweng ya Mesebetsi ya Setjhaba (EPWP) ya Makala a Setjhaba ho lekola tswelopele ya EPWP le hore na e ka atoloswa jwang le ho feta.
tgt: Ngetulu kwaloko, iKhabhinethi icaphele imphumelelo yekuvimbela kuphangwa kwemikhumbi lokwentiwa yi-SANDF letjalwe kutsi igadze Elugwini lwaseMozambique.

src: Kopano e tla tshwarwa tlasa tema ya: “Ho kopana tshebetsong ho potlakisa boteng ba mesebetsi ka lekala la setjhaba la EPWP.”EPWP e thehilwe ka 2004 mme e ntse e le morero wa bohlokwa wa mmuso o hlahisang menyetla ya mesebetsi bakeng sa dimilione tsa maAforika Borwa nakong e kgutshwane ho isa ho e mahareng.
tgt: Mengameli Jacob Zuma utawutsatsa Luhambo Lwekuvakasha Ngekwemsebenti e-United Kingdom kusukela mhla ti-2 kuya kumhla ti-4 Indlovulenkhulu 2014, ngalesikhatsi utakuya emcimbini Wekubonga Kusebentela Sive kuyogubha imphilo kanye nemsebenti waMengameli wangaphambilini Nelson Mandela lotakuba seWestmister Abbey, eLondon mhla ti-3 Indlovulenkhulu 2014.

src: Kabinete e lakaletsa sehlopha sa Bafana Bafana katleho papading e tlang ya bolo ya setswalle ya matjhaba le batshwari ba Mohope wa Lefatshe Lebaleng la FNB ka la 5 Hlakubele 2014.Kabinete e kopa maAforika Borwa ohle ho amohela baeti ba rona ka kamohelo e mofuthu ya Ubuntu, le ho tshehetsa sehlopha sa rona sa naha.
tgt: Lisekela laMengameli Kgalema Motlanthe litakuya emcimbini wemnyaka weLikhulu Wekugubha Kuhlanganiswa kweNshonalanga kanye neNingizimu Nigeria lotakuba se-Abuja mhla tinge-27 Indlovana 2014.

src: Kabinete e amohetse ntshetsopele ya molawana wa Tshebeletso ya Naha ya Ntshetsopele ya Mesebetsi, ho kengwa tshebetsong ha morero le tshebetso ya puisano makaleng ohle a mmuso.
tgt: Luhlelo lwahulumende lutawucinisa umkhankhaso weMinyaka lenge-20 yeNkhululeko ngekugcamisa tindzaba letikhutsata futsi titfutfukise kubumbana kwemmango, kwakhiwa kwesive kanye nebunye emmangweni webantfu bakitsi eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Tshebeletso e hokahantsweng ya ntshetsopele ya mesebetsi e hlokahala ka potlako ho netefatsa hore batjha, baithuti, le basebetsi ba sa sebetseng le baahi ba se nang mesebetsi ba na le phihlello ho tlhahisoleseding ya maemo ya mesebetsi le ditshebeletso tse amanang le mesebetsi.
tgt: Litiko Lekutfutfukiswa Kwemnotfo, Luphiko Lwavelonkhe Lwekutfutfukisa Lusha (NYDA) kanye neLihhovisi LaMengameli atawubamba i-Youth Indaba Lehlelwe Lihhovisi laMengameli lemayelana neMisebenti kanye Nemakhono eBirchwood Conference Centre, eBoksburg, kusukela mhla tinge-28 Indlovana kuya kumhla ti-3 Indlovulenkhulu 2014 ngaphansi kwengcikitsi: “Kusebenta ndzawonye ekunikeni emandla kanye nekuniketa litsemba bantfu labasha baseNingizimu Afrika.”Kuleminyaka leyengcile lenge-20 hulumende usebentise emasu lamanyenti ekubhekana nekungasebenti kwebantfu labasha.

src: Sena se tla ba dumella hore ba etse dikgetho tse ntle ho feta hape tse nang le tsebo tsa mesebetsi tse fanang ka maemo a hodimo ho feta a mesebetsi hape e thuse ho eketsa kgolo ya nako e telele ya moruo kahare ho naha.
tgt: Emakhono Kuvelonkhe, Imfundvo Lesisekelo kanye Nekunika Bantfu Labasha Umsebenti lokudzinga kutinikela lokukhulu kubalingani betenhlalo, lokuhlanganisa Tinhlelo Tekucasha Tahulumende letehlukene kanye nemitsetfo lenjengeMtsetfo nombolo 26 wanga-2013 Umhlomulo Wemtselo Wekusebenta.

src: Kabinete e tshehetsa ho kengwa tshebetsong ha sistimi ya eDisclosure Ditshebeletsong tsa Setjhaba ho tloha ka Mmesa 2014, e nkang sebaka sa sistimi ya matsoho ya phano, tshebetso le netefatso ya ditsebiso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukela kubanjwa kwemhlangano webalingani bayo yonkhe imikhakha yetenhlalo kuNkhomfa Yemkhakha Wetenhlalo Yekwandzisa Imisebenti Yemphakatsi (EPWP) letako kute ihlole inchubekelembili ye-EPWP nekutsi ingandziswa njani ngalokwengetiwe.

src: eDisclosure ke ngodiso ya elektroniki e amohelang le ho laola ditsebiso tsa ditjhelete tsa bahiruwa ba kgethilweng (ditho tsa SMS) ba hlokwang hore ba tsebise dikgahleho tsa bona tse ka ngodiswang ho ba Boholong ba Phethahatso ka la 30 Mmesa selemo le selemo.
tgt: Lenkhomfa itawubanjwa ngaphansi kwengcikitsi: “Kusebenta ngebunye ekusheshiseni kwakha imisebenti ngemkhakha wetenhlalo we-EPWP.”I-EPWP yetfulwa nga-2004 futsi solomane iyindlela lebalulekile yahulumende yekwakha ematfuba emisebenti kubantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labatigidzi kusukela kuyesikhashana kuya kuyesikhatsi lesiphakatsi nendzawo.

src: Sistimi ya eDisclosure e fumanwa leqepheng la lehae la webosaete ya Lefapha la Ditshebeletso tsa Setjhaba le Tsamaiso – WEBTOKEN - mme e hokahantswe le didathabeise tse ding tse teng tse jwalo ka Khomishene ya Dikhamphani le Thepa ya Kelello, diofisi tsa ngodiso ya ditokomane tsa semolao le eNatis bakeng sa mabaka a netefatso le tiisetso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ifisela licembu leBafana Bafana lokuhle emdlalweni welibhola lemave emhlaba webungani lotako lelitawudlala nalabatawubamba iNdzebe Yemave Emhlaba Yelibhola Letinyawo iBrazil eNkhundleni Yetemdlalo ye-FNB mhla ti-5 Indlovulenkhulu 2014.

src: Sepheo sa sistimi ke ho matlafatsa boikarabello tatellong ya leano la mmuso la ho se mamelle bomenemene le ho bo fedisa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi babonise umoya weBuntfu wekwamukela tivakashi tetfu, futsi basekele licembu lesive lakitsi lebhola.

src: Setsi sa Dipatlisiso sa Banamolli ba Aforika se tla tshwara kopano tlasa tema ya: “Ho Matlafatsa Puso e Ntle Aforika ka Mosebetsi wa Monamolli”.Sepheo sa Kopano ke ho sibolla ditlatsetso tseo ditsi tsa Banamolli di di etsang ho kopanya demokrasi le puso e ntle, mme kahoo ba tlatsetsa kgotso le botsitso kontinenteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume kutfutfukiswa kwenchubomgomo Yekutfutfukisa Indlela Yekwenta Umsebenti Kuvelonkhe, kusebentisa lisu kanye nenchubo yekucocisana kuto tonkhe tigaba tahulumende.

src: E boetse e fana ka sebae sa ho buisana ka ho matlafatsa mohopolo wa Monamolli ho la Aforika.
tgt: Kudzingeka masinyane kutfutfukiswa kwendlela yekwenta umsebenti lokuhlangene kucinisekisa kutsi lusha, bafundzi, tisebenti letingenawo umsebenti lokahle kanye netakhamiti letingasebenti tifinyelele elwatini lwemsebenti losezingeni kanye nasetindleleni tekwenta umsebenti.

src: Kopano e tla ka nako eo ka yona ho bewang kgatello e fetang hodima puso e hlwekileng, boikarabello le phano e loketseng ya ditshebeletso ho batho ba tlwaelehileng ba dinaha tsa Aforika.
tgt: Loku kutawukwenta tikwati kwenta kukhetsa lokuhle futsi tibe nelwati lolwengetiwe ngekukhetsa umsebenti lowenta kutsi kube nekwetfulwa kwemazinga lasetulu emsebenti futsi kusite ekusimamiseni kukhula kwemnotfo eveni.

src: Kabinete e amohetse Molao wa Tokiso wa Dikepe tsa Thekiso, 2014 o tlo hlahiswa Palamenteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isekela kusebentisa luhlelo lwekudzalula i-eDisclosure eMisebentini Yahulumende kusukela ngaMabasa 2014, lolungena esikhundleni seluhlelo lolwentiwa ngesandla lwekufaka, kwenta kanye nekucinisekisa kudzalulwa.

src: Molao o rera ho lokisa Molao wa Dikepe tsa Thekiso, wa bo 57 wa 1951 o tlang pele ho Molaotheo, 1996 o etsang hore ho be bohlokwa ho matahanya boleng le dipehelo tsa Molaotheo le ho matahanya Ditumellano tsa hajwale tsa Matjhaba.
tgt: I-eDisclosure iyirejista ye-elekthronikhi yekubamba kanye nekuphatsa kudzalulwa kwetimali tetisebenti letikhetsiwe (emalunga e-SMS) lokudzingeka tidzalule tinshisekelo tato letidzinga kubhaliswa kuSiphatsimandla Lesicondzisako sawo mhla tinge-30 kuMabasa njalo ngemnyaka.

src: Molao wa Tokiso le ona o fana ka matla ho Tumellano ya Mosebetsi wa Mawatleng, 2006 le Tumellano ya Tshebetso Tshwasong ya Dihlapi, 2007.
tgt: Luhlelo lwe-e-Disclosure luyatfolakala kuwebhusayithi yeLitiko Letemisebenti Yahulumende Nekuphatsa – WEBTOKEN – futsi luchunywaniswe nalamanye emadathabhesi lakhona lanjengeKhomishini Yebunikati Bemphahla kanye Netinkampani, emahhovisi ekubhalisa bunikati betintfo kanye ne-eNatis ngetinjongo tekucinisekisa kanye nebufakazi.

src: Matahanyo ya molao wa lehae le Ditumellano ho fa Aforika Borwa sesebediswa sa matjhaba sa ho netefatsa tshireletso ya matjhaba ya ditokelo tsa basebetsi ba mawatleng le maemo a hantle a tshebetso le bophelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume kubanjwa Kwengcungcutsela Yebavikeli Beluntfu base-Afrika kanye nemigubho lehlobene nako eGauteng kusukela mhla tinge-24 kuya kumhla tinge-27 Indlovana 2014.

src: Sena se tla dumella Aforika Borwa ho kena dikgetsing tseo ho tsona dikepe tsa kantle tse kenang boemakepe ba rona di hataketseng ditokelo tsa basebetsi ba dikepe.
tgt: Sikhungo Selucwaningo Lwebavikeli Beluntfu base-Afrika sitawubamba Ingcungcutsela ngaphansi kwengcikitsi: “Kucinisa Kuphatsa Kahle e-Afrika ngeNdzima Yebavikeli Beluntfu”.Inhloso yeNgcungcutsela kucwaninga ngeligalelo lelentiwa tikhungo Tebavikeli Beluntfu ekuciniseni intsandvo yelinyenti kanye nasekuphatseni kahle, lokwenta kube nekuthula kanye nekusimama kulivekati.

src: Ho kengwa tshebetsong ha Molao ho boetse ho tla ntlafatsa tshebetso le tjhebeho ya indasteri ya mawatle, ho leng bohlokwa bakeng sa kgwebo ya matjhaba le moruo wa lefatshe.
tgt: Iphindze futsi inikete litfuba lekucoca ngekucinisa umbono Webuvikeli Beluntfu e-Afrika.

src: DithonyoKabinete e amohetse dithonyo tse latelang mesebetsing:.
tgt: LeNgcungcutsela ifika ngesikhatsi lapho kugcizelelwa khona kakhulu kuphatsa lokuhlantekile, kuba nesibopho kanye nekwetfula kahle tinsita kubantfu labavamile kubohulumende base-Afrika.

src: Diqeto tsa Kabinete mabapi le dintlha tsa ha jwale le diketsahalo tse tlang.1 Kabinete e hatella kgoeletso ya Mopresidente Jacob Zuma ho mmuso, kgwebo le mesebetsi ho sebetsa mmoho ho hodisa moruo wa rona ka sekgahla se kgonang ho hlahisa mesebetsi e meng.
tgt: Tincumo teKhabhinethi etindzabeni tanyalo netentakalo letitako.1 IKhabhinethi igcizelele simemo saMengameli Jacob Zuma kuhulumende, kumabhizinisi kanye nasetisebentini kutsi basebente ndzawonye ekwakheni umnotfo wetfu ube sezingeni lelingakwati kwakha imisebenti leyengetiwe.

src: Puo ya Boemo ba Naha le Puo ya Ditekanyetso di beile motheo bakeng sa ho kengwa tshebetsong ho potlakileng ha Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha nakong ya kotara e tlang ya tsamaiso e ntjha.
tgt: Inkhulumo Letfulelwa Sive kanye neNkhulumomcombelelo tibeke sisekelo sekucinisa kuphumeleliswa kweLuhlelo Lwentfutfuko Yavelonkhe kulethemu letako yekuphatsa lokusha.

src: Tekanyetso ya bo 21 ya Naha ya tsamaiso ena ya demokrasi efeela e hlahisa pale e monate ya hore na re fetola naha jwang le ho tswelapele kgahlano le mathata a bohlokwa a bofuma, tlhokeho ya tekatekano le tlhokeho ya mesebetsi – mme, hwa bohlokwa, re etsa jwalo ka disebediswa tsa rona tse fokolang.2 Kabinete e hlahisitse ho nyahama ha yona ho ho holo mabapi le dipolao tsa bacha ba babedi ba banana bakeng sa diketso tse ho thweng ke tsa boloi.
tgt: Kwabiwa kweLiphakelo Lavelonkhe le-21 lalentsandvo yelinyenti kucoca indzaba lenhle mbamba yendlela lesintjintje ngayo live futsi sachubeka silwa netinsayeya letibalulekile tebuphuya, kungalingani kanye nekungasebenti – futsi, lokubalulekile, sikwenta loko ngemitfombotinsita lelinganiselwe lesinayo.

src: Diketso tse tjena ha di amohelwe naheng ya rona.
tgt: Tento letinjalo atinandzawo eveni letfu.

src: Ka hore Molaotheo o hatella tokelo ya bophelo, motho mang kapa mang ya fumanwang a tlotse molao o tla qoswa ka matla a felletseng a molao.3 Kabinete e leboha maAforika Borwa ohle le dikhamphani bakeng sa diteko tsa bona tsa poloko ya motlakase, haholo ha phepelo ya naha e le tlasa kgatello.
tgt: Ngetulu kwaloko Umtsetfosisekelo uvikela lilungelo lekuphila, nobe ngumuphi umuntfu lotawutfolakala anelicala kutawubukwana naye ngekuya kwemtsetfo ngalokuphelele.

src: Leha naha e na le bokgoni ba ho kgotsofatsa tlhoko ya ha jwale, basebedisi bohle ba motlakase ba kgothaletswa ho kenyeletsa poloko ya motlakase jwalo ka mokgwa wa bophelo.4 Kabinete e lebohela dikolo le matitjhere ohle ba thongweng bakeng sa Dikgau tsa Naha tsa ho Ruta 2013: Dikgau tsa Via Afrika People's Choice tse tla tshwarwa ka la 6 Hlakubele 2014 Setsing sa Dikopano sa Birchwood se Gauteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibonga bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye netinhlangano ngetinyatselo tekonga emandla, ikakhulu ngesikhatsi luhlelo lwagesi lwesive lungaphansi kwekucindzeteleka.

src: Dikgau tsena ke tsela e le nngwe feela eo ka yona Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo le tlotlang le ho kgothaletsa matitjhere a kgothetseng a tsotellang ditekong tsa bona tsa ho ntshetsapele baithuti jwalo ka baahi ba nang le boikarabello ba Aforika Borwa e nang le demokrasi, e se nang kgethollo ya morabe kapa ya bong.
tgt: Nanobe live linemandla ekuhlangabetana netidzingo talo tanyalo, bonkhe basebentisi bagesi bacelwa kutsi bemukele konga emandla njengendlela yekuphila.

src: Kabinete hape e thatisella ditokelo tsa bana tsa ho ithuta tikolohong e bolokehileng hape e kgothaletsang thuto.5 Kabinete e amohela tshehetso e tswellang ya Lefapha la Saense le Theknoloji ya Mokete wa Naha wa Saense, o bitswang Scifest Africa, o tla tshwarwa ho tloha ho la 12 ho isa ho la 18 Hlakubele 2014 ho la Grahamstown e Kapa Botjhabela tlasa tema ya “Ho kena Sebakeng.” Ketsahalo ena ya selemo le selemo e tsebahatsa saense, theknoloji, boenjineri le mmetse jwalo ka menyetla ya mesebetsi ho batjha ba rona hape e theha kutlwisiso e ntlafetseng ya mafapha ana hara maAforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela tonkhe tikolwa kanye nabothishela labakhetselwe Imiklomelo Yekufundzisa Yavelonkhe yanga-2013:Ye-Via Afrika People’s Choice Awards letakuba mhla ti-6 Indlovulenkhulu 2014 eBirchwood Conference Centre eGauteng.

src: Mmuso o tswelapele ho beha kapele le ho tsebahatsa kgetho ya Mmetse le Disaense tsa Tshwaro jwalo ka karolo ya ho ntshetsapele bokgoni ba bohlokwa bo hlokwang ke moruo wa rona o ntseng o hola.6 Kabinete e amohela phatlalatso e entsweng ke Mokgatlo wa Setsha sa Lenaneo la Dipatlisiso tsa AIDS ka hare ho Aforika Borwa ka tshibollo ya dianthibodi tse matla tsa HIPatlisiso e mabapi le kamoo mmele wa mosadi wa KwaZulu-Natal o ileng wa arabela tshwaetso ya hae ya HIV ka ho etsa dianthibodi tse matla.
tgt: Le miklomelo ingulenye yetindlela Litiko Lemfundvo Lesisekelo lelibonga futsi likhutsata ngayo kutinikela kanye nekunakekela kwabothishela emitameni yabo yekutfutfukisa bafundzi njengetakhamuti letinesibopho teNingizimu Afrika lenentsandvo yelinyenti, lengabandlululi ngebuhlanga nangebulili.

src: Phuputso, e hatisitsweng ho jenaleng ya maemo a hodimo ya saense e bitswang, Nature, e hlalosa kamoo sehlopha sa patlisiso se fumaneng sa ba sa supa dianthibodi tseo mading a mosadi eo ya ba ba etsa dianthibodi tse tshwanang le tseo hantle ka laborathoring.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphindze yagcizelela emalungelo ebantfwana ekufundzela endzaweni lephephile kanye nalekahle.

src: Dianthibodi tsena tse iketseditsweng di ile tsa sebediswa letotong la diteko ka laborathoring ho hlakisa tsela e latetsweng ke masole a mmele wa mosadi eo ho etsa dianthibodi tsena tse matla.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukela kusekela lokuchubekako kweLitiko Letesayensi Netheknoloji Umgubho Wesayensi Wavelonkhe, lowatiwa ngekutsi yi-Scifest Africa, lotakuba mhla ti-12 kuye kumhla ti-18 Indlovulenkhulu 2014 eRhini eMphumalanga Kapa ngaphansi kwengcikitsi: “Into the Space”.

src: Ditsebo tse ntjha tse fumanweng ho tswa ho mosadi enwa wa KwaZulu-Natal mabapi le dikarabelo tsa masole a mmele kgahlano le HIV di tlisa tshepo bakeng sa thibelo ya HIV le maano a kalafo a nako e tlang.
tgt: Lomgubho waminyaka yonkhe utfutfukisa isayensi, itheknoloji, bunjinyela kanye netibalo njengematfuba emsebenti kulusha lwetfu futsi wakha kucondza lokuncono ngalemikhakha kubantfu baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Tshibollo ena ha se pheko ya HIV/AIDS ka tsela efe kapa efe mme kahoo mmuso o kopa maAforika Borwa ho tswelapele ho etsa diteko bakeng sa HIV kapa ho tswelapele ka kalafo ya dianthiretrovaerale e fuwang batho bao diteko tsa bona di hlahisang hore ba na le HIV.7 Mopresidente Jacob Zuma o tla bua ketekelong ya Letsatsi la Ditokelo tsa Botho tsa selemo sena ka la 21 Hlakubele 2014 tlasa tema ya “Ho ketekela Dilemo tse 20 tsa ho fetola maphelo ka ditokelo tsa botho!” Lebaleng la Kirikete la Sharpeville le Gauteng.
tgt: Hulumende uchubeka nekubeka embili kanye nekukhutsata kwentiwa kweTibalo neSayensi Yefiziksi njengencenye yekutfutfukisa emakhono labalulekile ladzingekako ekutfutfukiseni umnotfo wetfu.6 IKhabhinethi yemukela simemetelo lesentiwe yi-CAPRISA Consortium sekutfola emasotja ekuvikela umtimba lamasha lanemandla.

src: Kabinete e kopa maAforika Borwa ho ketekela ho phela naheng e netefatsang hore le ka mohla botho ba rona bo ke ke ba nkuwa ho moAforika Borwa ofe kapa kapa, ho sa natswe morabe, bong, bodumedi kapa tshekamelo ya ho ratana.
tgt: Lolucwaningo lubuka indlela umtimba wemfati waKwaZulu-Natal losabele ngayo ekwesulelekeni ngeSandvulelangculazi (i-HIV) ngekwenta emasotja ekuvikela umtimba lanemandla.

src: Kaofela re na le boikarabello ba ho netefatsa hore rekote ya rona ya ditokelo tsa botho le nalane di bolokwa le ho matlafatswa bakeng sa meloko e tlang.8 Beke ya Naha ya Metsi e tla phatlalatswa ho la Bushbuckridge ka la 14 Hlakubele mme e tla tswelapele ka diketsahalo tse mmalwa ho fihlela la 23 Hlakubele 2014.
tgt: Lucwaningo, lolushicilelwe kuyijenali lesembili, i-Nature, luchaza indlela licembu lelicwaningako lelitfole futsi labona ngayo lamasotja lavikela umtimba engatini yalomake futsi labese lakha emasotja ekuvikela umtimba elabhorethri.

src: Ketsahalo ya phatlalatso e tla be e le mabapi le ho theolwa ha dipompo Mokoting wa South Vertical e leng mmaene wa kgale wa ERPM ho sebetsana le taba ya Phallo ya Asiti ya Mmaene ho Central Witwatersrand Basin.
tgt: Emasotja ekuvikela umtimba lakhiwe abese ayasetjentiswa ekwenteni luchungechunge lwekuhlola elabhorethri ekuhlahleni indlela leya embili leyalandzelwa luhlelo lwemtimba lwekutivikela lwalomake ekwenteni lamasotja ekuvikela umtimba lanemandla.

src: Matsatsing a mang a beke eo ho tla fanwa ka tshebeletso ya tlhwekiso ya metsi a ditshila le merero ya phepelo ya metsi ka bongata diporofenseng tse itseng.
