tgt: Loku kutawubese kuyise etikweni lelifanele bese kuletfwa imphendvulo.3 IKhabhinethi yatiswe ngembiko Wekuhlola Kwetfulwa kwemakethe Yekutfumela Imphahla Ngaphandle kanye Neluhlelo Lwekukhutsata Lwekusita Kusisa (i-EMIA) yaphindze yemukela kuphendvula kwebaphatsi kanye neluhlelo lwekwenta ncono lweLitiko Letekuhwebelana Netetimboni.

src: Sepheo sa yona ke ho ntlafatsa bohlwahlwa ba ho laola ho betjha, ho ntlafatsa kgokahano le tshebedisanommoho le diporofense le ho fetola maemo botjha a Boto ya Naha ya ho Betjha jwaloka molaodi bakeng sa sebetsana ka bokgabane le ho betjha ho seng molaong.5 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya moralo wa Leano la Tahi bakeng sa dipuisano tse pharaletseng le setjhaba.
tgt: Loku kube yincenye Yeluhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwekuhlola lwanga-2013/14 kute kuhlolwe kusebenta kahle kweLuhlelo ekwesekeleni bakhiciti kanye nebatfumelimphahla baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Hara dintlha tse ding, ditshisinyo di tobane le kgahlamelo ya tahi ho moruo wa kahisano le ditholwana tsa tshebediso e mpe ya tahi mmoho le diphethoho indasetering ya tahi.6 Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka diphetho tsa tlhatlhobo e tebileng ya Ntlafatso ya Kgodiso ya Bana moo ditlhatlhobo tse tebileng di ileng tsa etswa bakeng sa Kereiti ya R le boitshunyako ba tsa phepo bakeng sa bana ba ka tlasa dilemo tse hlano.
tgt: I-EMIA isite emabhizinisi ekutfumela imphahla emaveni angaphandle la-6 766 kuto tonkhe tifundza yaphindze yakhokhela ticelo letibita tigidzi leti-R510 kusukela nga-2009/10 kuya ku-2012/13.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ntshetsopele ya Moralo o Kopanetsweng wa Naha wa Phepo bakeng sa Aforika Borwa, oo ka kakaretso o sebetsanang le phepo, ho kenyeletsa nako ya pele ho tswalo, matsatsi a 1 000 a pele a ho phela, ntlafatso ya kgodiso ya bana le Kereiti ya Moralo wa ntlafatso ho tloha ho tekolo mabapi le “Kgahlamelo ya ho Hlahiswa ha Kereiti ya R hodima Diphetho tsa ho Ithuta” o toboketsa ho ntlafatswa ha boleng ba Kereiti ya R bakeng sa ho phahamisa kgahlamelo ya ona ho bana ba futsanehileng le diporofense tse sa sebetseng hantle.
tgt: Luhlolo lwalababandzakanyekako luveta kutsi kusetjentiswa lokubalulekile elukhutsatweni lwe-EMIA kwentiwa ikakhulukati Bantfu Labebancishwe Ematfuba Phambilini kanye netinkampani letiphetfwe ngulabasikati.4 IKhabhinethi ivume luhlaka Lwemculu Wenchubomgomo Yavelonkhe Wekugembula lotawushicilelwa kuGazethi yaHulumende kute ummango uphawule ngawo.

src: Sena se kenyeletsa thupello le ntshetsopele ya matitjhere a Kereiti ya R le ho nkela hloohong thonyo ya batho ba nang le mangolo a phahameng (maemo a NQF a bo5) a amehang bakeng sa morero ona.
tgt: Inhloso yalomculu kwenta ncono kusebenta kahle kwekulawula kugembula, kwenta ncono kuchuba kanye nekubambisana netifundza nekubeka kahle iBhodi Yavelonkhe Yekugembula njengemlawuli kute kubukanwe ngalokuyimphumelelo nekugembula lokungekho emtsetfweni.5 IKhabhinethi ivume kushicilelwa kweluhlaka Lwenchubomgomo Yetjwala kute ummango uphawule ngalo.

src: Dibili.1 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho lokollwa ha Bili ya Inshorense, ya 2015 bakeng sa dipuisano le setjhaba.
tgt: Loluhlaka Lwenchubomgomo Yetjwala lutakwenta ncono kusebenta kwekulawula kutsengiswa kwetjwala kuphindze kucedze kutsengisa tjwala lokungekho emtsetfweni.

src: Bili ena e matahantswe le Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha, e netefatsa lekala le hlwahlwa le laolwang hantle la inshorense, le ho hodisa botsitso ho tsa ditjhelete bo tla tshehetsa kgolo ya moruo ya moshwelella ka ho fana ka kgahlamelo ho maemo a phahameng a toka a hlahisitsweng ha ho shejwa koduwa ya ditjhelete ya 2008.
tgt: Phakatsi kwalokunye, tiphakamiso tibukana nemtselela kutenhlalo netemnotfo wetjwala kanye naletinye tindleko tekungasetjentiswa kahle kwetjwala kanye neluntjintjo embonini yetetjwala.6 IKhabhinethi yatiswe ngemiphumela yeluhlolo Lwemfundvo Lekutfutfukisa Bantfwana Labasebancane (i-ECD) lapho kubukwe khona luhlolo lweLibanga R kanye nekungenelela ekudleni kwebantfwana labangaphansi kweminyaka lesihlanu.

src: Bolaodi ba Tekolo ya Bokgoni ba Paballo ya Tjhelete le Taolo bo batla ho hlahisa katamelo e ntjha, e nang le tjhebelopele e itshetlehileng hodima dikotsi tsa ho tjhona ka ho matahanya ditlhoko tsa tjhelete tse teng le dikotsi tsa ya fanang ka inshorense.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume kutfutfukiswa Kweluhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwekudla lweNingizimu Afrika loluhlanganisile, lolubukana ngalokuphelele nekudla, lokufaka ekhatsi sikhatsi sangembi kwekutetfwala, tinsuku tekucala leti-1 000, i-ECD kanye neLibanga Luhlelo lwekwenta ncono kusukela eluhlolweni “Lwemtselela Wekwetfulwa kweLibanga R Kumiphumela Yekufundza” lugcizelela ekwenteni ncono lizinga lemfundvo yeLibanga R kute kwandziswe umtselela walo kubantfwana labaphuyile etifundzeni letingasebenti kahle.

src: Hape e fana ka ditsiane ho beng ba inshorense ho imatahanya le mekgwa e hlwahlwa ya ho beha leihlo le ho laola.
tgt: Loku kufaka ekhatsi kuceceshwa nekutfutfukiswa kwabothishela beLibanga R kanye nekubhekela kwebantfu labaneticu tetitifiketi letiphakeme letifanele (i-NQF lizinga 5) letilungele lenhloso.

src: Mekgwa ena e batla ho netefatsa tshireletso e betere ya beng ba dipholisi le bakgolamolemo le ho nyehela ho botsitso ho tsa ditjhelete.2 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya moralo wa Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Setsi sa Merero ya Mautlwela a tsa Ditjhelete, sa 2014 bakeng sa dipuisano le setjhaba.
tgt: Imitsetfosivivinyo.1 IKhabhinethi ivume kukhishwa kweMtsetfosivivinyo weMshwalense, 2015 kute ummango uphawule ngawo.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili se sisinya dihlomathiso ho Molao wa Setsi sa Merero ya Mautlwela a tsa Ditjhelete (Molao wa 38 wa 2001).
tgt: Lomtsetfosivivinyo uhambisana ne-NDP, ucinisekisa umkhakha wemshwalense lolawulwa kahle, uphindze ukhutsate kusimama kutetimali lokutakwesekela kukhula lokusimeme ngekuba nemtselela kumazinga lavakalako lasetulu latfutfukiswe ngekubuka simo sekuhhohloka kutetimali kwanga-2008.

src: Sena ke ho sebetsana le ditshoso tsa botsitso ba tsamaiso ya rona ya tsa ditjhelete tse hlahiswang ke dikadimo tse bohlaswa tsa ditjhelete le thuso ya boferekanyi ka ditjhelete ka ho netefatsa boimatahanyo le mekgwa ya matjhaba le dipehelo, ka hara moralo wa melao ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Luphindze lwente kube neluhlaka loluvakalako lolusha lwemkhakha wemshwalense.

src: Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le Dintlha tsa Hajwale.1 Kabinete e lemohile ka ngongoreho keketseho e bohale ya mafu a mebileng nakong ya mafelo a beke ya Paseka, moo re boneng dikotsi tse 208 tse bakileng mafu a 287, ha ho bapiswa le palo ya mafu ya selemo se fetileng, e neng e eme ho mafu a 193 ho tswa dikotsing tse 148.Boipaballo mebileng ke boikarabelo ba maAforika Borwa oohle mme katleho ya matsholo a rona a boipaballo mebileng a itshetlehile ho basebedisi bohle ba mebila ba bapalang karolo ya bona.
tgt: Luhlelo Lwekuhlola Nekulawula Kukhokhela Tikweleti luhlose kwetfula indlela lensha lebheke embili lebuka bungoti bekwehluleka kukhokhela tikweleti ngekwenta tidzingo temali tihambisane nebungoti lobungaba khona kuloyo loniketa umshwalense.

src: Bakganni ba lokela ho latela melawana ya tsela, ba seke ba nwa le ho kganna, ba imatahanye le lebelo le lekanyeditsweng le ho netefatsa hore dipalangwang tsa bona di loketse tsela.2 Lebitsong la batho ba Aforika Borwa, Kabinete, e hlahisa matshediso a yona a tebileng ho mmuso le batho ba Rephaboliki ya Kenya, haholoholo malapa a mahlatsipa a hlokahetseng tlhaselong e hlokang kelello Kholetjheng ya Yunivesithi ya Garissa ka la 2 Mmesa 2015.Kabinete e kgema le Moporesidente Jacob Zuma tabeng ya ho tshwela ka mathe ketso ena ya boferekanyi le ho boeletsa hore Aforika Borwa e tshehetsa Kenya le mekutu ya baahi ba matjhaba ya kgotso, botsitso le demokerasi le kaho ya setjhaba ka hara Somalia.3 Kabinete e thoholetsa batho ba Nigeria bakeng sa ho tshwara dikgetho tse nang le kgotso, ponaletso, botshepehi le tse lokolohileng ka la 28 Hlkubele 2015, jwaloka ha di tiiseditswe ke Khomishene ya Naha ya Dikgetho ya Nigeria.
tgt: Letindlela tihlose kucinisekisa kuvikeleka lokuncono kwebaniyo bemapholisi kanye nalabazuzako tiphindze tifake sandla ekusimameni kutetimali.2 IKhabhinethi ivume kushicilelwa kweluhlaka Lwemtsetfosivivinyo Lesichitjiyelwe Sikhungo Sekusetjentiswa kahle Kwetimali, wanga-2014 kute ummango uphawule ngawo.

src: Lebitsong la maAforika Borwa, Kabinete e thoholetsa Mokgenerale Muhammad Buhari ho kgethweng ha hae jwaloka Moporesidente wa Rephaboliki ya Bofederale ya Nigeria.4 Kabinete e thoholetsa Marlene van Niekerk bakeng sa ho ba moAforika Borwa wa pele ho ba letotong le lekgutshwane bakeng sa Moputso wa Matjhaba wa Man Booker.
tgt: Lesichibiyelo Semtsetfosivivinyo siphakamisa kuchitjiyelwa kweMtsetfo Wetikhungo Tekusetjentiswa Kahle Kwetimali (Umtsetfonombolo 38 wanga-2001).

src: O ananetswe bakeng sa phihlello e ipabotseng ya nako tsohle bongoding ba dipale, tse kenyeletsang mesebetsi e jwaloka Triomf le Agaat.
tgt: Loku kwentelwe kubukana nekwesabisa ekusimameni kweluhlelo lwetfu lwetetimali lokwentiwa kubolekisana ngemali kanye nebuphekula kutetimali ngekucinisekisa kuhambisana netindlela kanye nemazinga emave emhlaba, eluhlakeni lwemtsetfo waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Hape o amohetse Kgau ya Ikhamanga ka 2011 bakeng sa “nyehelo ya hae e ipabotseng ho bonono le botjhaba ho tsa dingolwa”.
tgt: Tincumo teKhabhinethi Etindzabeni Tanyalo.1 IKhabhinethi yatiswe yabese iveta kukhatsateka kwayo ngekwenyuka lokukhulu etingotini temgwaco ngeliviki Lephasika, lokube netingoti leti-208 letiholele ekushoneni kwebantfu laba-287, nakucatsaniswa nelinani letingoti tetimoto tangemnyaka lofile, kona lobekume e-193 etingotini leti-148.Kuphepha emgwacweni kungumtfwalo wabo bonkhe bahlali baseNingizimu Afrika kantsi imphumelelo yemikhankhaso yekuphepha emgwacweni incike kubo bonkhe basebentisi bemgwaco kutsi badlale indzima yabo.

src: Diketsahalo tse tlang.1 Kabinete e ananetse hore Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o tla be a araba dipotso Palamenteng ka Labone, 16 Mmesa 20.2 Kabinete e amohela Leeto la Puso ho ya Jakarta, Indonesia la Moporesidente Jacob Zuma ho tloha ka la 19 ho isa ho la 21 Mmesa 2015, le tla sheba botjha maemo a dikamano tsa bobedi bona ho netefatsa phihlello ya dilemo tse hlano tsa ‘Morero wa Tshebetso’, jwaloka ha o ile wa tshohlwa ke mahlakore ka bobedi Pretoria ka Pudungwana 2014.Moporesidente Jacob Zuma hape o tla kenela Seboka sa Asia-Aforika mahareng a la 22 ho isa ho la 23 Mmesa ho la Jakarta, se tla matlafatsa tshebedisanommoho ya dinaha tse ka borwa ba ekhweita e tla lebisa kgolong ya moruo wa kahisano bakeng sa mabatowa ka bobedi.
tgt: Bashayeli kumele bahloniphe imitsetfo yemgwaco, banganatsi bese bayashayela, batigcine bakumkhawulo welitubane lovumelekile nekutsi bacinisekise kutsi timoto tabo tikulungele kuba semgwacweni.2 Egameni lebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika, iKhabhinethi iveta kuvelana kwayo nahulumende kanye nebantfu baseRiphabhulikhi yaseKenya, ikakhulukati imindeni yalabashona ekubulaweni lokungenaluvelo eNyuvesi Kholishi yaseGarissa mhla ti-2 Mabasa 2015.IKhabhinethi ihlanganyela naMengameli Zuma ekugcekeni lesento sebuphekula iphindze ivete kutsi iNingizimu Afrika yesekela iKenya emitameni yemave emhlaba ekugcineni kuthula, luntjintjo, intsandvolinyenti kanye nekwakha sive eSomalia.3 IKhabhinethi ihalalisela bantfu baseNigeria ngekubamba lukhetfo lolunekuthula, lolungagodli, lolukhululekile nalolungavuni luhlangotsi ngamhla ti-28 Indlovulenkhulu 2015, njengoba lwadzalulwa Likhomishini Lelukhetfo Lelitimele laseNigeria.

src: Leeto lena le tla phethelwa ka Sehopotso sa bo60 sa Seboka sa Bandung sa 1955 le Sehopotso sa bo10 sa Bosemphato se Setjha sa Mawala (NAASP) ka la 24 Mmesa 2015, se tla tshwarwa Bandung, ho la West Java.
tgt: Egameni lebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika, iKhabhinethi ihalalisela Jenene Muhammad Buhari ekukhetfweni kwakhe njengaMengameli weRiphabhulikhi Yembuso Wetifundzafundza yaseNigeria.4 IKhabhinethi ihalalisela Marlene van Niekerk ngekuba wekucala umhlali waseNingizimu Afrika kufakwa eluhlwini lwalabagacele Umklomelo Webabhali Bemave Emhlaba, i-Man Booker.

src: E ne e le Bandung moo baetapele ba mokgatlo wa rona e leng Moses Kotane le Maulvi Cachalia ba ileng ba tlisa dipehelo tsa ho hloka semorabe le boikemelo lenaneong la lefatshe.3 Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa oohle ho kenela Mekete ya Kgwedi ya Tokoloho, e tlisang dilemo tse mashome a mararo tsa tokoloho ka ho kgothaletsa seriti sa botho le ho tsitlallela mohopolo o tshwanang o tla lebisa kahong ya Aforika Borwa e kopaneng le ho atleha.
tgt: Watiwa ngekuhamba embili ngemklomelo wekubhala tindzaba leticatjangwako, letifaka ekhatsi imisebenti lenjenge-Triomf kanye ne-Agaat.

src: Mokete wa rona wa naha o tla phethelwa ka Letsatsi la Tokoloho, 27 Mmesa 2015 tlasa mookotaba: “Re Keteka Qalo ya Dilemo tse Mashome a Mararo tsa Tokoloho ya rona ka ho Akofisa Diphethoho tse Matla tsa Moruo”.MaAforika Borwa a boela a hopotswa ka ho intsha sehlabelo ka matla ha batho ba bo rona le basadi ntweng kgahlanong le tsamaiso e soto ya kgethollo hore re tle re thabele tokoloho eo re nang le yona kajeno.
tgt: Waphindze watfola umklomelo i-Order of Ikhamanga nga-2011 “ngekufaka sandla kwakhe emibhalweni yebuhlakani webuciko nemasiko”.

src: Bakeng sa ho hlompha maAforika Borwa a nyehetseng ntshetsopeleng ya demokerasi ya rona, Moporesidente Jacob Zuma ka Letsatsi la Tokoloho o tla fana ka Dikgau tsa Naha moketeng o tla beng o tshwaretswe Meahong ya Kopano.
tgt: Imikhosi letako.1 IKhabhinethi yatiswe kutsi Mengameli Jacob Zuma utawube aphendvula imibuto ePhalamende mhla ti-16 Mabasa 20.2 IKhabhinethi yemukela Kuvakashela eJakarta njengeNhloko Yembuso kwaMengameli Jacob Zuma kusukela mhla ti-19 kuya kumhla ti-21 Mabasa 2015, lokutawubuyeketa simo sebudlelwane balamave lamabili kute kucinisekiswe kufezeka ‘kweLuhlelo Lwekwenta’ lweminyaka lesihlanu, njengoba kwadzingidvwa nguletinhlangotsi ePitoli ngaLweti 2014.Mengameli Jacob Zuma utawuphindze ahambele Ingcungcutsela yemave ase-Asia newase-Afrika emkhatsini wamhla ti-22 kuya kumhla ti-23 Mabasa eJakarta, lokutawucinisa kusebentisana kwemave laseNingizimu Nenkhabave lokutawuholela ekukhuleni kwetenhlalo netemnotfo talamavekati lamabili.

src: Kabinete e fetisa thoholetso ho baamohedi bohle le ho etsa teboho ya yona bakeng sa nyehelo ya bona.4 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana hore Aforika Borwa e tla tshwara Ho dula ho Setlwaeding ha bo25 ha Kopano ya Aforika ho Lefapha la Dikamano le Tshebedisano ya Matjhaba le Setsing sa Matjhaba sa Dikopano sa Sandton Johannesburg, ho tloha ka la 7-15 Phuptjane 2015.
tgt: Lokuvakasha kutawuphotfulwa Ngemgubho weminyaka lenge-60 weNkhomfa yaseBandung yanga-1995 kanye Nemgubho weminyaka le-10 Wekubambisana Lokusha Kwendlelalisu ye-Asia-Afrika (i-NAASP) mhla ti-24 Mabasa 2015 lotawubanjelwa eBandung, eWest Java.

src: Ditlhaselo tsa moraorao tjena tsa melata.
tgt: Kuhlaselwa kwebantfu bekufika lokusandza kwenteka.

src: Kabinete e ananela kgotso le kgutso e bonahalang e leng teng metseng e neng e anngwe ke ditlhaselo tsa moraorao tjena tsa melata.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kuthula nekuphela kwebugudlugudlu lesekucale kubakhona emimangweni lebeyitsintfwe kuhlaselwa kwebantfu bekufikalokusandza kwenteka.

src: Kabinete e thoholeditse mafapha a sebeditseng ka Setsi sa Naha sa Tshebetso sa Kopanelo bakeng sa ho fedisa diketso tsa merusu tse etsahetseng KwaZulu-Natal le Gauteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi income ematiko lasebente nge-National Joint Operation Centre kucedza tehlakalo tebudlova letenteke KwaZulu-Natal naseGauteng.

src: Kabinete e thoholeditse baetapele ba diporofense le bomasepala dibakeng tse neng di amehile bakeng sa karolo ya bona ya ho fana ka pebofaletso le ho etella pele morero wa ho kopanya botjha melata le badudi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi income baholi betifundza nabomasipala etindzaweni letitsintsekile ngendzima labayidlalile ekuhhamuleni nasekuholeni inchubo yekubuyisela bantfu bekufika emimangweni labebahlala kuyo phambilini.3 Kuleliviki leliphelile, Mengameli Jacob Zuma ubite imihlangano yalabatsintsekako labemelele emabhizinisi, emacembu etenkholo, tisebenti, tinhlangano temmango lowetayelekile nebantfu bekufika.

src: Dipuisano e ne e le tse ahang bakeng sa ho thusa tabeng ya ho ntshetsa tsamaiso ena pele.
tgt: Letingcoco betinguletakhako letitawusita ekuchubekiseleni lenchubo embili.

src: Bankakarolo bohle ba ile ba dumellana ka lentswe le le leng tabeng ya ho hlahisa ho tshwela ka mathe ditlhaselo tsena le ho itlama ho sebetsa le mmuso ho fumaneng tharollo ya moshwelella.
tgt: Bonkhe bahlanganyeli bavumelane ngelivi linye ekugcekeni lokuhlaselwa babuye futsi batinikela ekusebentisaneni nahulumende kute batfole sisombululo salomphelo.4 Likomidi Letindvuna (i-IMC) leTekuphuma Nekungena lelisandza kumiswa limatasatasa lifuna kutfola sisombululo salomphelo setindzaba letiphakanyiswe yimimango kanye nebantfu bekufika.

src: Diqeto tsa Bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Tincumo teKhabhinethi letibalulekile.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka kgatelopele e entsweng mabapi le Rejisetara ya Thepa e sa Sutheng ya Mmuso wa Naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yetfulelwe umbiko ngenchubekela embili leseyentiwe kuRejista Yetakhiwo Nemhlaba Yahulumende Wavelonkhe.

src: Lekala la Ditshebeletso tsa Boingodiso ba Matlo le se le thehilwe ho tloha ka la 01 Mmesa 2015.
tgt: Mhla lu-01 Mabasa 2015 kusungulwe Luphiko Lwetinsita Tekubhalisa Imphahla.

src: Lekala lena le tla laolwa ka hara Setheo sa Bolaodi ba Kgwebisano ya Thepa ya Bodulo mme le tla okamela thepa ya Puso e sa sutheng.
tgt: Loluphiko lutawulawulwa ngekhatsi ku-Property Management Trading Entity futsi lutawubukana netakhiwo nemhlaba weMbuso.

src: Le tla sebetsa jwaloka setsi sa poloko se le seng sa thepa e sa sutheng ya Puso, mme le tla fana ka bodisa, bolaodi le peho-leihlo ya Rejisetara ya Thepa e sa Sutheng ya Mmuso.
tgt: Lutawusebenta njengeluhlu loluphelele lwetakhiwo nemhlaba weMbuso, futsi lutawuniketa simiso sekulandzelela nekulawula kwengamela Irejista Yetakhiwo Nemhlaba Wembuso.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho lokollwa ha Moralo wa Leano mabapi le Lebollo la Setso bakeng sa hore setjhaba se tshwaele ka ona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukele kukhishwa kweLuhlakamsebenti Lwenchubomgomo Yelisiko Lekusoka kute kutsi ummango uphawule ngalo.

src: Morero wa leano lena ke ho batla ho tshireletsa, ho kgothaletsa le ho laola lebollo ka ho sisinya mekgwa le maemo a amohelehang mme hape le ho qala mekgatlo boemong ba naha le ba diporofense.
tgt: Lenchubomgomo ifuna kuvikela, ikhutsate ibuye futsi ilawule lisiko lekusoka ngekutsi iphakamise emazinga nemihambo leyemukelekako ibuye futsi ibonelele timiso emazingeni avelonkhe newetifundza.

src: Le tla netefatsa hore mabollo a etsahala ka hara tikoloho e laolehang.
tgt: Lutawucinisekisa kutsi kusokwa kwentelwa etindzaweni letilawulwako.

src: Sena se etsa karolo ya mehato e nkuwang ke mmuso ho hatella mekgwa e nepahetseng, e amohelehang ya mesebetsi ya setso le ho busetsa maemo a amohelehang a boikarabello ao esale a sebediswa bakeng sa dilemo tse telele.
tgt: Loku kwenta incenye yetinyatselo letitsetfwe nguhulumende tekucinisa emasiko nekwemukela kwentiwa kwemasiko lafanele kanye nekubuyisela esimeni lesifanele lizinga lekutiphendvulela lelente lelisiko kutsi lichubekele embili ngalokungenamkhawulo kuyo yonkhe leminyaka leminyenti.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Lenaneo le kopanetsweng la mmuso la Bodulo ba Batho bakeng sa Masepala wa Nelson Mandela Bay le tla sebedisa Lekala la Ntshetsopele ya Matlo jwaloka motjha wa ho kenya mesebetsi ya lona tshebetsong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukele Luhlelo Lwekuhlaliswa Kwebantfu lwabohulumende labahlangane lwaMasipala weNelson Mandela Bay lolutawusebentisa le-Ejensi Yekutfutfukisa Tindlu njenge-ejensi lephumelelisa loluhlelo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tshwarwa ha Seboka sa Matjhaba sa Mekgatlo ya Dilaeborari le Ditheo tsa Seboka sa Selemo le Selemo sa Tlhahisoleseding ya Dilaeborari tsa Lefatshe ho la Motse Kapa ho tloha ka la 15 ho isa ho la 21 Phato 2015 tlasa mookotaba "Dilaeborari tse Hlwahlwa: Phihlello, Ntshetsopele le Diphethoho".
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukele kubanjwa kweNkhofa Yemhlaba Yemnyaka Yelwatiso Lwemalayibrari yeTikhungo neTinhlangano Temalayibhrari Temave Emhlaba eKapa kusukela mhla ti-15 kuya kumhla tinge-21 Inyoni 2015 ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi "Emalayibhrari Lanemandla Nalagucugucukako: Kufinyelela, Kutfutfuka Nekuntjintja".

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tekwa ha Tumellano ya ho Fedisa Kgwebo e seng Molaong ya Dihlahiswa tsa Kwae.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukele kwetfulwa kweSivumelwano Sekucedza Kuhwebelana Ngalokungekho Emtsetfweni Ngemikhicito Yeligwayi.

src: Sena ke ho ya ka Seboka sa Moralo wa Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Bophelo bo Botle mabapi le Taolo ya Kwae oo Aforika Borwa e o tjhaelletseng monwana ka Mmesa 2005.
tgt: Loku kuhambisana neSivumelwano seLuhlakamsebenti lweNhlangano yeTemphilo yeMhlaba lesimayelana nekuLawulwa kweLigwayi lokwemukelwa yiNingizimu Afrika ngaMabasa 2005.

src: Tumellano e tla thusa dinaha ho nka mehato ya lefatshe kgahlanong le kgwebo eo e seng molaong ya dihlahiswa tsa kwae haholoholo dinaheng tse saenetseng Tumellano.
tgt: Lesivumelwano sitawusita emave kutsi atsatse tinyatselo temave emhlaba ekulweni tekuhwebelana ngalokungekho emtsetfweni ngemikhicito yeligwayi ikakhulu emave lasayine Lesivumelwano.

src: Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le dintlha tsa hajwale.
tgt: Tincumo teKhabhinethi etindzabeni tanyalo.

src: Kabinete e hlahisitse matshediso a yona ho malapa a bao ba hlokahalletseng dikotsing tsa dipalangwang tsa moraorao tjena tse ileng tsa kenyeletsa ho thulana ha dibese tse pedi Johannesburg bekeng e fetileng le ho thulana ha diterene bekeng ena Seteisheneng sa Denver ka borwa ho Johannesburg.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ililele imindeni yalabo labashone etingotini tetitfutsi letisandza kuba khona kufaka ekhatsi kungcundzana kwemabhasi lamabili eJozi kuleliviki leliphelile nekungcundzana kwetitimela kuleliviki eSiteshini eDenver eningizimu neJozi.

src: Kabinete e tshepa hore dipatlisiso ka mafapha a amehang di tla fatolla disosa tsa dikotsi tsena le ho netefatsa hore dikotsi tse kang tsena ha di etsahale.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inelitsemba lekutsi luphenyo lolwentiwa ngematiko lafanele lutawutitfola timbangela taletingoti abuye futsi ente siciniseko sekutsi letingoti atiphindzi futsi tenteke.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le Moporesidente Zuma ka ho fetisa matshediso a yona ho lelapa, metswalle le ho barati bohle ba bolo ya maoto ka ho hlokahala ha qhoku ya mehleng ya Bafana Bafana John “Shoes” Moshoeu ya bolokuweng ka Mantaha, 27 Mmesa 2015.
tgt: IKhabhineti ijoyina Mengameli Zuma ekwendluliseni emavi endvuvuto emndenini, bangani nemkhakha wonkhe wetelibhola letinyawo mayelana nekwendlula emhlabeni kwesigayigayi setelibhola letinyawo sebaBafana Bafana John “Shoes” Moshoeu lobekwe endlini yakhe yekugcina ngeMsombuluko, 27 Mabasa 2015.

src: O tla dula a hopolwa jwaloka sebapadi sa bolo se neng se na le talente e babatsehang haholo se bapetseng karolo ya bohlokwa tlholong ya rona ya Mohope wa Dinaha tsa Aforika wa 1996.
tgt: Utawuhlala njalo akhunjulwa njengesihlabani setelibhola letetinyawo lowadlala indzima lebalulekile ekuncobeni kwetfu Indzebe Yemave ase-Africa nga-1996.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le Moporesidente Zuma ka ho fetisa matshediso ho Mmuso le batho ba Rephaboliki ya Demokerasi ya Bofederale ya Nepal, ho latela ho reketla ha lefatshe ho matla ka Moqebelo, 25 Mmesa 2015, ho nkileng maphelo a batho ba dikete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ijoyina Mengameli Zuma ekwendluliseni emavi endvudvuto kuHulumende nebantfu belive laseNepal, mayelana nekutamatama kwemhlaba lokukhulu ngeMgcibelo, 25 Mabasa 2015, lokwendlule netinkhulungwane temiphefumulo.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa mekgatlo eo e seng ya mmuso ya Aforika Borwa eo e seng e rometse dithuso tsa botho Nepal.
tgt: IKhabhinethi incoma tinhlangano taseNingizimu Afrika letingekho ngaphasi kwahulumende lesevele setikhiphe lusito nebaphalali babhekisa emabombo khona eNepal.

src: Kabinete e hlahisitse matshediso a tebileng ho lelapa la Moborikadiri Mokgenerale Bita ya hlokahetseng a le dilemo tse 75 ho la Tanzania.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yendlulise emavi endvudvuto lajulile emndenini waBrigadier General Bita loshone aneminyaka lenge-75 eTanzania.

src: Moborikadiri Mokgenerale Bita o sebeditse jwaloka Mongodi wa Phethahatso wa Komiti ya Tokoloho ho Mokgatlo wa Kopano ya Aforika (OAU) wa mehleng.
tgt: Brigadier General Bita usebente njengaMabhalane Wesigungu Lesiphetse weLikomidi Lekukhululeka leNhlangano Yelubumbano Lwase-Afika (i-OAU).

src: E ne e le moamohedi wa Kgau ya Metswalle ya O. Tambo ya Gauta, e leng tlhompho e kgolohadi eo Aforika Borwa e fanang ka yona ho melata.
tgt: Waklonyeliswa ngemklomelo weliGolide we-Order of the Companions of OR Tambo, kuhlonishwa lokusezingeni leliphakeme kakhulu iNingizimu Afrika lengahlonipha ngako umuntfu wekuchamuka kulamanye emave.

src: Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: Imikhosi letako.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla kenela Sehopotso sa bo70 sa Tlholo e Kgolo ya Ntwa ya Lerato la Naha (Ntwa ya Lefatshe ya II) Red Square ho la Moscow ka la 9 Motsheanong 2015.
tgt: Mengameli Zuma utawuhambela Umgubho Weminyaka lenge-70 Yekuncoba Imphi Yemhlaba Yesibili eRed Square eMoscow mhla ti-9 Inkhwenkhweti 2015.

src: O tla boela a tshware dipuisano tsa dinaha ka bobedi le Moporesidente wa Russia Vladimir Putin.
tgt: Utawuphindze futsi abe netingcoco talamave lamabili neMengameli waseRussia Vladimir Putin.

src: Leeto lena le tla ahella hodima dikamano tsa hajwale tsa bobedi bona le Mokgatlo wa Russia bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa ho ya pele tshebedisanommoho dintlheng tse ngatanyana.
tgt: Lokuvakasha kutawakhela etu kwebudlelwane betfu nelive laseRussia lokutawuchubekisela embili lubanjiswano lwetfu kumikhakha leminyenti.

src: Bakeng sa ho keteka Letsatsi la Basebetsi (1 Motsheanong 2015), Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho basebetsi bohle ho kopana le ho aha moruo wa Aforika Borwa, le ho nehela ho kontinente le lefatshe.
tgt: Nasigubha umkhosi weLusuku Lwetisebenti mhla lu-1 Inkhwenkhweti 2015, iKhabhinethi imema tonkhe tisebenti kutsi tihlangane futsi takhe umnotfo waseNingizimu Afrika, tiphindze futsi tifake ligalelo kulelivekati nasemhlabeni.

src: Ho tloha ka 1994 mmuso o ntsheditse pele ditokelo tsa basebetsi e leng se bakileng hore basebetsi ba kgole molemo ho tloha tlhahisong ya basebetsi ba tswelang pele le tshireletso ya melemo ya kahisano.
tgt: Kusukela nga-1994 hulumende utfutfukise emalungelo etisebenti lesekuholele ekutsini tisebenti tizuze kutinzuzo tekusebenta lokuyimphumelelo nekuvikelwa kwetenhlalo.

src: Mafapha a Naha a tla teka dipuo tsa ona tsa ditekanyetso Palamenteng mahareng a la 5 le la 21 Motsheanong 2015 ho hlakisa mesebetsi ya ona e ka sehloohong bakeng sa selemo sa hajwale sa ditjhelete.
tgt: Ematiko avelonkhe atawetfula imicombelelotimali awo ePhalamende emkhatsini wamhla ti-5 nemhla tinge-21 Inkhwenkhweti 2015 kugcamisa imisebenti lefanele kutsi ibekwe embili kulomnyakamabhuku wamanje.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa oohle ho latela dipuo tsa ditekanyetso mapatlelong a fapafapaneng a boraditaba hore a tle a utlwisise betere ha Matona a hlahisa meralo bakeng sa Lenaneo la Tshebetso la Mmuso (PoA).
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi balandzele lomcombelomali kuyo yonkhe imikhakha yebetindzaba kute bavisise kancono ngesikhatsi Tindvuna tibeka emabalengwe etinhlelo teLuhlelo LwaHulumende Lwekusebenta (i-PoA).

src: Lefapha la Bohahlaodi mmoho le ba Bohahlaodi ba Aforika Borwa ba tla tshwara INDABA 2015 ho tloha ka la 9 ho isa ho la 11 Motsheanong 2015 Setsing sa Matjhaba sa Dikopano sa Inkosi Albert Luthuli ho la Durban.
tgt: Litiko Letekuvakasha neTekuvakasha taseNingizimu Afrika atawubamba umhlangano i-INDABA 2015 kusukela mhla ti-9 kuya kumhla ti-11 Inkhwenkhweti 2015 e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre eDurban.

src: Ketsahalo ena ya seAforika ke lepatlelo le hlokolosi bakeng sa ho hodisa dihlahiswa tsa rona tsa bohahlaodi mmarakeng wa matjhaba.
tgt: Lomkhosi Wemave ase-Afrika uyinkhundla yekukhutsata imikhicito yetfu yetekuvakasha emakathe yemhlaba.

src: Hape e tshehetsa pono ya mawala a Lekala la Naha la Mawala a Bohahlaodi bakeng sa ho hodisa palo ya baeti ba matjhaba ba kenang ka hara naha ho ya ho 15 milione ka 2020 mme kahoo ho hlahiswe mesebetsi e 225 000 e metjha.
tgt: Uphindze futsi wesekele umbononchanti lobalulekile weLisu Lemkhakha Wetekuvakasha Wavelonkhe wekukhulisa linani lebantfu labangena kuleli babe ngu-15 wetigidzi nga-2020 bese-ke kwakha imisebenti lemisha le-225 000.

src: Kabinete e ananela Seboka sa bo5 sa Bong sa Aforika, e leng sa pele ho tshwarelwa kontinenteng ya Aforika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukela Ingcungcutsela Yetebulili Yase-Africa yesihlanu, yekucala ngca kubanjelwa kulivekati i-Afrika.

src: Seboka se tshwaretswe Setsing sa Matjhaba sa Dikopano ho la Motse Kapa.
tgt: Lengcungcutsela itawube ibanjelwe eCape Town International Convention Centre.

src: Seboka ke lepatlelo bakeng sa dihlopha le mekgatlo ho parola le maemo oohle a diphuputso tsa saense bakeng sa ho sebetsana le dintlha tsa bong tse amang bohle.
tgt: Lengcungcutsela iyinkhundla yemacembu netinhlangano tayo yonkhe imikhakha yelucwaningo lwetesayensi lekutawulungiselwa kuyo tindzaba letimayelana nebulili letibatsintsa bonkhe.

src: Seboka sena se tshwarweng ke Lekgotla la Diphuputso tsa Disaense tsa Botho se matlafatsa lenaneo la Aforika la diphuputso hore saense, thekenoloji, dikaho tsa motheo, tjhelete, bokgoni le tlhahisoleseding di kgone ho tshehetsa betere ntshetsopele ya kontinente.
tgt: Lengcungcutsela lengeniswe nguMkandlu Wekucwaninga Wetesayensi Yebantfu icinisa i-ajenda yase-Afrika yekucwaninga kute kutsi isayensi, ithekinoloji, takhiwonchanti, imali yekusungula ibhizinisi, emakhono nedatha kwesekele kancono kutfutfukiswa kwalelivekati.

src: Lefapha la Metsi le Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere le tla tshwaya Beke ya Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere le Bohlweki ho tloha ka la 11 ho isa ho la 15 Motsheanong 2015 tlasa mookotaba “Ha se feela ka ho folasha”.Beke ena, e ileng ya kgakolwa la pele Foramong ya Global WASH e neng e tshwaretswe Dakar, ho la Senegal ka 2004, e reretswe ho hlahisa temoso ka bohlokwa ba tsamaiso ya dikgwerekgwere le ho hodisa ditshebetso tse hlwahlwa tsa tsamaiso ya dikgwerekgwere.
tgt: Litiko Letemanti Nekutfutfwa Kwendle litawugubha Liviki Lekutfutfwa Kwendle Nekuhlanteka kusukela mhla ti-11 kuya kumhla ti-15 Inkhwenkhweti 2015 ngaphasi kwengcikitsi,“Akusikutsi konkhe kumayelana nekuflasha”.Leliviki, leletfulwa kwekucala eGlobal WASH Forum lebelibanjelwe eDakar, eSenegal nga-2004, lihlose kwatisa ngekubaluleka kwekuhanjiswa kwendle nekukhutsata tindlela letiphuma embili lekubukwana ngato kuhanjiswa kwendle.

src: Dintlha tsa Bohlokwa ka hara tikoloho.
tgt: Tindzaba letibalulekile tanyalo.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o tla etella pele mekete ya Letsatsi la Aforika tlasa mookotaba: “Re Aforika – Re bula mamati a ho ithuta le botjhaba ho tloha Kapa ho ya Cairo” ka la 24 Motsheanong 2015 khemphaseng ya Mamelodi ya Yunivesithi ya Pretoria.
tgt: Mengameli Jacob Zuma utawuhola imigubho yeLusuku lwe-Afrika ngaphansi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Siyi-Afrika – Sivula iminyango yekufundza nemasiko kusukela eKapa kuya eCairo” ngamhla tinge-24 Inkhwekhweti 2015 ekhampasini leseMamelodi yeNyuvesi yasePitoli.

src: Ka moya wa Letsatsi la Aforika, Kabinete e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa, ka ho qolleha batjha, ho sebetsa mmoho bakeng sa ho matlafatsa bonkakarolo ba bona mererong ya naha ya rona.
tgt: Ngemoya weLusuku lwe-Afrika, iKhabhinethi ikhutsata bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulu bantfu labasha, kutsi basebentisane kute bacinise kutibandzakanya kwabo etindzabeni letitsintsa live letfu.

src: Kgwedi ya Aforika ke lepatlelo la ho hodisa kopano hara ditjhaba tsa Aforika le bana ba bo rona ba dulang ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Inyanga ye-Afrika iyinkhundla yekugcugcutela lubumbano emkhatsini wetive tase-Afrika kanye nabomnaketfu kanye nabodzadzewetfu base-Afrika labahlala eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kopano ya kontinente e kgannwa ke mananeo a Kopano ya Aforika a ho fihlella pono ya yona jwaloka ha e tekilwe ho Lenaneo la 2063.
tgt: Bunye balelivekati buchutjwa tinhlelo teLubumbano lwe-Afrika kute lufeze umbononchanti walo njengalokushiwo ku-Ajenda 2063.

src: Kontinente, e tataiswa ke baahi ba yona, e tla tsitlallela Aforika e momahaneng, e tswetseng pele le e nang le kgotso.
tgt: Lelivekati, ngekuholwa takhamuti talo, litawushisekela kutsi kube ne-Afrika lehlangene, lephumelelako nalenekuthula.

src: Letsatsi la Aforika hape le hlahisa monyetla bakeng sa maAforika Borwa hore a tsebane botjha le ho itlama botjha bakeng sa ho tshehetsa boitshunyako bohle ba mmuso ho ntshetsapele Aforika e betere le lefatshe le betere.
tgt: Lusuku lwe-Afrika luphindze lunike bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika litfuba lekutsi bachumane kabusha futsi baphindze batinikele ekwesekeleni tonkhe tento tekungenelela letentiwa nguhulumende ekutfutfukiseni i-Afrika lencono nemhlaba loncono.

src: Mookotaba wa Kgwedi ya Aforika, “Re Aforika”, ke pehelo ya tiisetso le ya keteko ya boikgantsho bo kgothaletsang kenyeletso ho tswa ho bankakarolo bohle.
tgt: Lengcikitsi yeNyanga ye-Afrika letsi, “Siyi-Afrika,” isimemetelo kanye nesitatimende sekugubha kutichenya lesifaka ekhatsi bonkhe labatsintsekako nalabadlala indzima letsite.

src: Hape ke kgoeletso ho batho ka bo mong le dihlopha ho tswa ka makgalo oohle a bophelo ho itahlela ka setotswana mohoong wa diphethoho.
tgt: Siphindze futsi sigcugcutele lowo nalowo kutsi kubekhona lakwentako kanye nemacembu lavela magumbi onkhe emhlaba kutsi ahlanganyele kulomkhankhaso wekuletsa ingucuko.

src: Kabinete e ananela welcomes Operation Fiela\Reclaim 2015, e leng tshebetso ya dintlha tse ngatanyana ka dipopeho tse fapafapaneng tsa mmuso ho netefatsa ho imatahanya ka matla le melao e fapafapaneng le melawana e laolang setjhaba sa rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayemukela i-Operation Fiela\Reclaim 2015, lengumkhankhaso wemkhakhamnyenti lowentiwa tinhlaka tembuso letehlukene kwenta siciniseko sekutsi imitsetfo yahulumende lehlukene lelawula ummango wetfu iyagcinwa ngalokuphelele.

src: Sepheo sa tshebetso ena ke ho sebetsana le dintlha tsa botlokotsebe tse kang dibetsa tse seng molaong, mahaha a dithethefatsi, maqulwana a bootswa le mesebetsi e meng ya botlokotsebe.
tgt: Lomkhankhaso uhlose kubukana netento tebugengu letifana netikhali letingekho emtsetfweni, tidleke tetidzakamiva, kutsengisa umtimba kanye naletinye tento letingekho emtsetfweni.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa hore tshebetso ena ha e ya lebiswa ho melata, empa diketsong tsa botlokotsebe ka hara naha ya rona jwaloka ha di utulutswe ka letoto la dipuisano le badudi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakuphindza futsi kukusho loku kutsi ngalomkhankhaso awukacondziswa kubantfu bekufika, kepha ebugebengwini lobukhona eveni letfu njengaloku kuvele kuluchungechunge lwemihlangano yekubonisana nemimango.

src: Tabeng ena, Kabinete e hanana ka matla le mohopolo wa hore tshebetso ena e lebisitswe ho melata.
tgt: Ngaleyondlela-ke, iKhabhinethi iwucitsa ngemavi lacinile umcondvo lotsi lomkhankhaso ucondziswe kubantfu bekufika.

src: Jwaloka naha e ikgantshang ka ho ba le Molaotheo o lokolohileng ka ho fetisisa lefatsheng, re nkile ketapele e bohareng mabapi le dintlha tsa ditokelo tsa botho, kahoo re keke ra dumella tshebetso e tla tlola melao ya ditokelo tsa botho tsa motho ofe kapa ofe ka dihlopha dife kapa dife.
tgt: Njengelive lelitichenya ngekuba neMtsetfosisekelo lophuma embili nalovulekile kakhulu emhlabeni, sitsatse indzawo legcamile etindzabeni temalungelo eluntfu, ngaleyo ndlela-ke ngeke sigunyate inchubo letakwephula emalungelo eluntfu anome ngabe ngubani nome ngabe awamaphi emacembu.

src: Kabinete e thabetse kgatelopele e entsweng ka Operation Fiela, eo esale e thakgolwa e entseng hore ho be le ho tshwarwa ho ho ngatanyana matsholong a ho kgwasa dibaka tse nang le mathata haholo ho parola le naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ijabulile ngenchubekelembili leyentekile ngenca ye-Operation Fiela, kusukela solo yacala kube khona lababanjiwe labanyenti kulokuhlasela lokwentiwe etindzaweni letahlukahlukene letivamise kuba nekukhatsata eveni lonkhe.

src: Kabinete e ananela karabelo ho tswa ho setjhaba se imatahantseng le bahlanka ba molao bakeng sa ho etsa bonnete ba hore bohle ba bolokehile le ho ikutlwa ba bolokehile ka hara naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kuphendvula ngekutinikela kwemalunga emmango ngekuhlanganyela netisebenti tekugcinwa kwemtsetfo kucinisekisa kutsi bonkhe bantfu baphephile futsi nabo bative baphephile kulelive.

src: Tshebetso ena, e matlafatsang ntwa kgahlanong le botlokotsebe, e thusa hape ho hodisa le ho bopa Aforika Borwa e batlang e bolokehile le ho tshireletseha.
tgt: Lomkhankhaso, ucinisa kulwa nebugebengu, uphindze futsi usite ekugcugcuteleni kuvikeleka kanye nekuphepha lokukhulu eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Komiti e Kopanetsweng ya Matona ya Bofalli e tla kopana le boraditaba ho ba beha sehlohlolong ka mosebetsi wa yona ohle, ho kenyeletswa le Operation Fiela.
tgt: Likomidi Letindvuna Letihlangene Letekutfutsa Kwebantfu litawubikela betindzaba ngalamafisha kulemphelasontfo mayelana nekusebenta kwalo konkhe, lokufaka ekhatsi i-Operation Fiela.

src: Ho Kenngwa Tshebetsong ha Mananeo a Bohlokwa a Mmuso.
tgt: Kufezekiswa kwetinhlelo tahulumende letibalulekile.

src: Kabinete e ananela dipuo tsa ditekanyetso tsa mafapha a fapafapaneng le ho thabela ditlaleho tse tebileng tseo Matona a fanneng ka tsona mabapi le kgatelopele eo a e entseng bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa bophelo ba batho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawamukela umcombelelo wematiko lahlukahlukene futsi iyayijabulela imibiko lebanti leyetfulwe Tindvuna lemayelana nenchubekelembili lesetiyentile ekutfutfukiseni timphilo tebantfu.

src: Ditsebiso di ile tsa hlalosa ho ya pele ka meralo ya mafapha a bona ka ho fapana bakeng sa selemo sena sa ditjhelete.
tgt: Lemibiko iphindze yenaba mayelana nemasu ematiko ato lahlukahlukene alomnyakamabhuku.

src: Kabinete e ananela ho thakgolwa ha Boikitlaetso ba Moetapele ke Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae kantorong ya lona ya Edenvale ka la 12 Motsheanong 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kwetfulwa kweMoetapele Initiative lokwentiwe Litiko Letasekhaya ehhovisi lalo lelise-Edenvale mhla ti-12 Inkhwekhweti 2015.

src: Sepheo sa Boikitlaetso bona ke ho fetolela tse ding tsa dikantoro ho ‘dikantoro tsa popota’ jwaloka dithuthuhiso tsa mosebetsi o hlwahlwa ka ho fetisisa.
tgt: Lomtamo uhlose kugucula lamanye emahhovisi kutsi abe ‘ngemahhovisi lasibonelo’ laphuma embili ngekusebenta.

src: Sena se tla matlafatsa phano ya ditshebeletso tse hlokolosi ho maAforika Borwa le ho ba thusa ho fumantshwa ditshebeletso tsa mmuso ka bokgabane.
tgt: Loku kutawukhutsata kuletfwa kwetinsita letimcoka kubantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kuphindze kubente kutsi bakhone kufinyelela kutfola tinsita tahulumende ngemphumelelo.

src: Kabinete hape e ananela ho thakgolwa ha Dikgau tsa Bofalli tsa Aforika Borwa tse tla tlotla bafalli ba hlahelletseng ka mahetla ka hara Aforika Borwa le maAforika Borwa a sebetsang dinaheng tsa Aforika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphindze futsi yemukela kusungulwa kweMkomelo Wetihambi taseNingizimu Afrika lotawuhlonipha tihambi letiphuma embili lapha eNingizimu Afrika kanye nebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labasebenta kulamanye emave ase-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e ipeletsa ho badudi ho kgetha ba ba nang le moya wa Botho e bile ba inehetse ntshetsopeleng ya kontinente ya Aforika ka ho romela imeile ho EMAILTOKEN di kwalwa ka la 20 Motsheanong 2015 mme bahlodi ba tla tsebiswa ka Letsatsi la Aforika (25 Motsheanong).
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela imimango kutsi ikhetse emagama alabo labagcugcutela umoya weBuntfu nalabatinikele ekutfutfukiseni livekati lase-Afrika ngekutsi bawatfumele ngencwadzigezi ku: EMAILTOKEN kwemagama kuvalwa mhla tinge-20 Inkhwekhweti 2015 kantsi labaphumelele emagama abo atawumenyetelwa ngeLusuku lwe-Afrika (mhla tinge-25 Inkhwekhweti).

src: Mokgahlelo o kgahlisang ka ho fetisisa wa dikgau tsena ke o tla ananela badudi ba Aforika Borwa ba atlehileng ho amohela melata ka hara bona le ho phela mmoho ka kgotso.
tgt: Munye walemikhakha lejabulisako yalemiklomela kutsi kutawuba wekuklomelisa ummango waseNingizimu Afrika lophumelele ekuhlanganiseni bantfu bekufika nemalunga emmango wabo futsi bakhona kuhlala ndzawonye ngekuthula.

src: Kabinete e ananela ho ntshwa ha dikantoro tsa hloma-o-hlomolle naheng ka bophara bakeng sa ho thusa bohle ba lokelang ho kenya dittseko tsa bona tsa mobu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kucala kwekusebenta kwemahhovisi abomahambanendlwana ekufaka ticelo tekubuyiselwa umhlaba lasakhona eveni lonkhe kute kusitakale bonkhe bantfu kutsi bafake ticelo tekubuyiselwa umhlaba.

src: Sena ke tlatsetso ya dikantoro tse 14 tsa ditseko tse teng diporofenseng kaofela.
tgt: Loku kwengeta kulamahhovisi ekufaka ticelo la-14 lakuto tonkhe tifundza.

src: Tsamaiso ena ke karolo e pharaletseng ya dikgokahanyo tsa naha tsa ho fihlella bohle ya ho kenya tshebetsong Sehlomathiso sa Molao wa Tlhabollo ya Ditokelo tsa Mobu wa 2014, se saennweng ho ba molao ke Mopresidente Zuma.
tgt: Lenchubo iyincenye yendlela lephelele yavelonkhe yekufinyelela ngekuchumana nebantfu kute kucale kusebente Umtsetfo Wekuchitjiyelwa Kwemalungelo Ekubuyiselwa Kwemhlaba Kubanikati Bawo Labafanele wa-2014, losayinwe wabangumtsetfo nguMengameli Zuma.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Molao wa Tlhabollo ya Ditokelo tsa Mobu se fana ka puseletso kapa tlhabollo e lekalekanang ho batho le badudi ba ileng ba nkelwa ditokelo tsa mobu kamora 19 Phuptjane 1913.MaAforika oohle a nang le tokelo a fetilweng ke nako ya letsatsi le neng le behilwe e le la ho qetela la 31 Tshitwe 1998 bakeng sa ho kenya ditseko a na le monyetla o atolositsweng ho fihla ka la 30 Phuptjane 2019.
tgt: LoMtsetfo Wekuchitjiyelwa Kwemalungelo Ekubuyiselwa Kwemhlaba Kubanikati Bawo Labafanele ugunyata kubuyiselwa nome kuncephetelisa ngalokulinganako bantfu nome imimango leyatsatselwa emalungelo emhlaba ngemuva kwamhla ti-19 Inhlaba 1913.Bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labafanelekako labaphonywa lusuku lwemncamulajucu wekucala lwamhla tinge-31 Ingongoni 1998 kutsi bafake ticelo tekubuyiselwa umhlaba, sebanelitfuba lelengetiwe kute kubemhla tinge-30 Inhlaba 2019 kutsi bafake ticelo tabo.

src: Kabinete e ananela kopano ya Letona la Mehlodi ya Diminerale le baemedi ba indaseteri ya merafo le bankakarolo ba bang ho tshohla sephetho sa Tekolo ya Tlaleho ya Tjhata ya Merafo ya 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kuhlangana kweNdvuna Yetetimbiwa nalabo labamele timboni tetimayini kanye nalabatsintsekako kutsi bacocisane ngemphumela weMbiko Wekuhlola Wemculu Wetetimayini wanga-2014.

src: Tlaleho ena e metha kgatelopele ya dintlha tse robong tsa bohlokwa tsa Tjhata ya Merafo.
tgt: Lombiko uhlola inchubekelembili yetinhlangotsi letimcoka letiyimfica teMculu Wetetimayini.

src: Tjhata ya Merafo e ile ya hlahiswa ka morero wa ho kganna lenaneo la diphethoho ka hara lekala le hlokolosi la moruo wa naha.
tgt: Umculu Wetetimayini wasungulwa ngenhloso yekugcugcutela luhlelo lwetingucuko kumkhakha wetetimayini, longumkhakha lomcoka wetemnotfo kulelive.

src: Dintlha tse tshwanetseng ho methwa di tobile ho hlabolla ho se lekalekane ha nako e fetileng ka bobedi karolelanong ya leruo le ba neng ba tinngwe menyetla pele le ntshetsopele ya mehlodi ya batho le thuo ya merafo.
tgt: Letinhlangotsi lekumele kutsi tihlolwe kuhloswe ngato kulungisa kungalingani kwasesikhatsini lesengca ekwabelaneni ngemnotfo nalabo bantfu labashiywa ngaphandle kanye nekutfutfukiswa kwebantfukanye nebunikati betimayini.

src: Diqeto tsa Bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Tincumo teKhabhinethi letibalulekile.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tshwarwa ha Kopano ya Lekgotla la Matjhaba la Boipaballo Diporong la bo-25 e tla tshwarwa ho tloha ka la 4 ho isa ka la 9 Mphalane 2015 Setsing sa Matjhaba sa Dikopano sa Sandton, Johannesburg.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumele kubanjwa Kwemhlangano we-25 Wemkhandlu Wemave Emhlaba Wetekuphepha Kujantji Wesitimela lotawuba kusukela mhla ti-4 kuya kumhla ti-9 Imphala 2015 lapha eSandton International Convention Centre, eJozi.

src: Foramo ena ya matjhaba e bokanya mmoho ditsebi ho tsa boipaballo diporong ho tswa lefatsheng ka bophara ho kgaogana tlhahisoleseding, diphihlello, dithuto le ditshebetso tse hlwahlwa ka ho fetisisa bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa boipaballo diporong.
tgt: Lenkhundla yemave emhlaba ihlanganisa ndzawonye bongcweti betekuphepha kubojantji betitimela labavela emhlabeni wonkhe kute bantjintjiselane ngelwatiso, bashiyelane ngebukadzebona, tifundvo kanye nekusebenta lokuncono ekutfutfukiseni tekuphepha kubojantji betitimela.

src: Ho tshwarwa ha ketsahalo ena ho na le monyetla wa ho hohela matsete a dinaheng tsa ka ntle, a ka matlafatsang moruo le ho akofisa matsete a dikaho tsa motheo tsa setjhaba.
tgt: Kuvumela kutsi lomcimbi wentelwe kuleli kutawuheha batjalimali bakulamanye emave, lokuyintfo lengacinisa umnotfo walelive kuphindze kukhutsate sakhiwonchanti selutjalomali lwemmango.

src: Sena se fuwa sekgahla ho feta ke matsete a haufinyana tjena a Aforika Borwa ho makala a diterene tsa batho le thepa, e leng se ntseng hore naha e kgone ho hohela matsete.
tgt: Loku kukhutsata futsi nalolutjalomali lolusandza kwentiwa yiNingizimu Afrika kumkhakha wetitimela letitfwala bantfu naletitfwala imphahla, lokwente lelive lahehana kutelutjalomali.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Tjhata ya Dipalangwang tsa Mawatle a Aforika hore e tliswe ka hara Palamente bakeng sa ho amohelwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kutsi Umculu wase-Afrika Wetekutfutsa taseLwandle ungeniswe ePhalamende kute uvunywe.

src: Sena ke tumellano ya matjhaba e fanang ka ho tsamaelana ha maano, bakeng sa ho hodisa kgolo ya moshwelella le ntshetsopele ya lethathama la dikepe tsa kgwebo tsa Aforika.
tgt: Lesi sivumelwane semave emhlaba lesiletsa kuhambisana kwetinchubomgomo, kute kugcugcutelwe kukhula lokusimeme nentfutfuko kubahwebi bemikhumbi base-Afrika.

src: Hape e tla kgothaletsa kgwebisano e kopanetsweng ya Aforika ho thusa bakeng sa momahano ho tsa moruo le moruo wa kahisano kontinenteng.
tgt: Sitawuphindza futsi sigcugcutele kuhwebelana ngekhatsi e-Afrika kute kube nekuhlangana kutenhlalo netemnotfo kulelivekati.

src: Kabinete tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa ha Sehlomathiso ho Tumellano ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa Dikgokahanyo tsa Mehala ya Disathalaete (ITSO) Palamenteng bakeng sa ho amohelwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kungeniswa kweKuchibiyelwa kweSivumelwane Setenhlangano Yekuchumana Ngesathelayithi (i-ITSO) ePhalamende kutsi isivume.

src: ITSO ke mokgatlo o kopanetsweng wa mmuso o netefatsang hore Intelsat Ltd, e leng motsamaisi wa disathalaete, e fana ka ditshebeletso tsa dikgokahanyo tsa mehala tsa setjhaba – ho kenyeletsa mantswe, tshedimoso le dividio – ka mokgwa o kenyeletsang bohle le o hlokang kgethollo.
tgt: I-ITSO yinhlangano lehlanganisa bohulumende leyenta siciniseko sekutsi i-Intelsat Ltd, lesebenta ngesathelayithi, yenta kutsi ummango utfole tinsita tetekuchumana – lokufaka ekhatsi liphimbo, idatha nevidiyo – emhlabeni wonkhe ngendlela lengabandlululi.

src: Sehlomathiso se tshireletsa tshebetso e hlwahlwa ya nako e telele ya Lefa le Tshwanang la Mekgatlo, le ho netefatsa kakaretso ya dikgokahanyo le lefatshe.
tgt: Lesichibiyelo sivikela kubakhona sikhatsi lesidze kweMagugu Lafanako eMacembu, kanye nekucinisekisa kutsi kuyachubeka kutsintsa umhlaba wonkhe kanye nekuchumanisa umhlaba wonkhe.

src: Ho tjhaellwa monwana hape ke karolo ya dintlha tse ka Sehloohong tsa Aforika Borwa bakeng sa ho nyehela lefatsheng le betere le ho ntshetsopele ya Aforika.
tgt: Lokuvunywa kuyincenye futsi yetintfo letibekwe embili iNingizimu Afrika kutsi idlale indzima ekwenteni kancono umhlaba kanye nekutfutfukisa i-Afrika.

src: Maemo a Kabinete Mabapi le Dintlha tsa Hajwale.
tgt: Tincumo teKhabhinethi etindzabeni tanyalo.

src: Kabinete e utlwisitswe bohloko ke lefu la Seaparankwe, Ngaka Ruth Segomotsi Mompati mme e fetisa matshediso a yona ho lelapa la hae le metswalle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idzabukile ngekundlula emhlabeni kwaSeaparankwe, Dkt.

src: Ngaka Mompati o nehetse bophelo ba hae bakeng sa ntwa ya tokoloho mme o ne a le teng ka hara mekutu e fapafapaneng ho kenyeletsa le Mohwanto wa Basadi wa hisetori wa Phato 1956.Ka 1954, o ile a kenela mokgatlo wa African National Congress (ANC) mme o ile a kgethwa ho Komiti ya Naha ya Phethahatso (NEC) ya Liki ya Mafumahadi a ANO ile a ya palehong ka 1962 moo a ileng a rupellwa ho tsa sesole mme e le mongodi le hlooho ya karolo ya basadi ya ANC, Tanzania.
tgt: Mompati wanikela imphilo yakhe kumzabalazo wenkhululeko futsi bekakadze atibandzakanye emikhankhasweni leyahlukahlukene lefaka ekhatsi Umshuco Wabomake loyinchophamlandvo wenyanga yeNgci nga-1956.Ngemnyaka wa-1954, wajoyina i-African National Congress (i-ANC) futsi wakhetfwa wabaseKomidini Yesigungu Savelonkhe (i-NEC) seMbutfo Wabomake we-ANWaya ekudzingisweni ngemnyaka wa-1962 wayoceceshelwa temphi waphindze waba ngumabhalane nenhloko yeluphiko lwabomake be-ANC eTanzania.

src: Jwaloka moemedi ya ka sehloohong wa ANC ho la United Kingdom e ile ya ba karolo ya kemedi e ileng ya bula dipuisano le mmuso wa nako eo wa Aforika Borwa Groote Schuur ka 1990.
tgt: Njengalomkhulu lomelele i-ANC e-United Kingdom wabayincenye yelitsimba lelavula tinkhulumiswano nahulumende waseNingizimu Afrika waphambilini lapha eGroote Schuur nga-1990.

src: Ka Phato 1992, o ile a tshetlehela puo Komiti e Ikgethang ya Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) kgahlanong le mmuso wa Kgethollo ho la New York mabapi le ntlha ya basadi.
tgt: Ngenyanga yeNgci ngemnyaka wa-1992, wetfula inkhulumo yakhe lemayelana nabomake kuLikomidi Lelikhetsekile Lamhlabuhlangene (i-UN) lelimelene neLubandlululo eNew York.

src: Letsatsi leo le ile nkuwa e le Letsatsi la Matjhaba la Kopano le Basadi ka hara Aforika Borwa ke UN.
tgt: Lolusuku lwamenyetelwa nguMhlabuhlangene kutsi lube Lusuku Lwemave Emhlaba Lwekuvelana Nabomake eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Jwaloka mosebeletsi wa nnete wa batho, o bapetse karolo e kekeng ya hlakoha ntshetsopeleng ya naha ya rona a sebetsa jwaloka Setho sa Palamente, Moambasatara wa Aforika Borwa ho la Switzerland ho tloha ka 1996 ho fihlela ka 2000 le Meyara wa Vryburg (Naledi) ho la Leboya Bophirima.
tgt: Njengesisebenti seliciniso sebantfu, wadlala indzima lengeke ize ilibaleke ekutfutfukiseni live lakitsi wasebenta njengeLilunga lePhalamende, wabaLincusa laseNingizimu Afrika eSwitzerland kusukela ngemnyaka wa-1996 kuya ku-2000 kanye nekuba nguSodolobha waseVryburg (eNaledi) eNyakatfo Nshonalanga.

src: O nehetse bophelo ba hae bakeng sa tokoloho ya naha ya rona le ho bontsha maikemisetso a sa thekeseleng a ho sebeletsa batho ba habo.
tgt: Wacitsa imphilo yakhe yonkhe alwela inkhululeko yelive letfu wakhombisa kutimisela lokukhulu ekusebenteleni bantfu bakubo.

src: Kabinete e utlwisitswe bohloko ke lefu la Moleftenente Mokgenerale Bongani Isidore Mbatha mme e fetisa matshediso a yona ho ba lelapa la hae le metswalle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idzabukile ngekundlula emhlabeni kwaLieutenant General Bongani Isidore Mbatha, iKhabhinethi ivakalisa kudzabuka kwayo kumndeni wakhe nakubangani.

src: Mokgenerale Mbatha o kenetse Umkhonto we Sizwe, e leng karolo ya sesole ya ANC ka 1978 mme a sebetsa maemong a fapafapaneng, ho kenyeletswa le ho ba hlooho ya tsamaiso le tlhophiso ya thepa.
tgt: Jenene Mbatha wajoyina Umkhonto weSizwe, luphiko lwetemphi lwe-ANC nga-1978 waphindze wasebenta etikhundleni letahlukahlukene, lokufaka ekhatsi kubayinhloko yetekulawula kuhanjiswa kwetimphahla.

src: Ka 1994, Mokgenerale Mbatha o ile a kenyeletswa ho Lebotho la Naha la Tshireletso la Aforika Borwa (SANDF) moo a ileng a kenela thupello e tebileng mafapheng a fapafapaneng.
tgt: Ngemnyaka wa-1994, Jenene Mbatha wahlanganiswa neMbutfo Wavelonkhe Wetekuvikela waseNingizimu Afrika (i-SANDF) lapho aceceshwa khona kabanti kumikhakha leyahlukahlukene.

src: O ile a nyoloha jwalo ka maemo ka hara SANDF, a sebetsa maemong a mangatanyana ho fihlela a phahamisetswa ho ba Moleftenente Mokgenerale ya ikarabellang ho tsa Taolo le Tlhophiso ya Thepa ka 2014, e leng maemo a ao tshwereng ho fihlela lefu le mo kgaoletsa.
tgt: Wanyuka ngemachuzu khona lapha ku-SANDF, asebenta etikhundleni letinyenti wadzimate wanyuselwa esikhundleni sekuba nguJenene Lomkhulu lowengamele teLuphiko Lwekulawula kuhanjiswa kwetimphahlai nga-2014, sikhundla lasibambe kwadzimate kwaba sekusishiyeni kwakhe emhlabeni.

src: Diketsahalo tse Tlang.
tgt: Imikhosi letako.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla kenela ho behwa setulong ha Morena wa AmaXhosa, Motlotlehi Morena Mpendulo Calvin Sigcawu (Ah!
tgt: Mengameli Zuma utawuhambela sibhimbi sekubekwa kweNkhosi yemaXhosa, Inkhosi Mpendulo Calvin Sigcawu (Ah!

src: Zwelonke) Motseng wa Borena wa Nqadu, Willowvale, Kapa Botjhabela ka la Motsheanong 2015.Kabinete e thoholetsa Morena Sigcawu ka ho behwa ha hae boreneng mme e ikemiseditse ho sebetsa le Borena ba AmaGcaleka bakeng sa ho aha metse e kganyang, e lekalekanang le ya moshwelella ya dibaka tsa mahae.
tgt: Zwelonke) eNqadu Great Place eWillowvale, eMphumalanga Kapa mhla ti-15 Inkhwekhweti 2015.IKhabhinethi iyayihalalisela Inkhosi Sigcawu kulokubekwa kwayo futsi inelitsemba lekusebentisana kahle neMbuso weMaGcaleka ekwakheni imimango yasemaphandleni lesimeme, lelingene nalenemphilo.

src: Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa o tla kenela Indaba ya Mekgwa e meng ya Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere e tla dula ka la 15 Motsheanong 2015 tlasa mookotaba: “ha se feela ka ho folaša”.
tgt: Lisekelamengameli Cyril Ramaphosa utawuhambela i-Indaba Yaletinye Tindlela Tekutfutfwa Kwendle letawuba mhla ti-15 Inkhwekhweti 2015 ngaphansi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Akusiko konkhe kutsi kumayelana nekuhambisa kungcola”.

src: Indaba hape e tla fana ka monyetla bakeng sa bafani ba ditshebeletso ba thekenoloji ya dikgwerekgwere mabapi le mekgwa e meng ya thekenoloji ho bapatsa dihlahiswa tsa bona.
tgt: Le-Indaba itawunika litfuba lekutsi betfulitinsita betindlela letinye tebuchwepheshe bekutfutfwa kwendle bakhangise ngemikhicito yabo.

src: Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba, ka tshebedisano mmoho le Lekala la Tshireletso ya Setjhaba la Aforika Borwa (SASSA) le Lekala la Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDA), le tla thakgola Beke ya Tshireletso ya Bana Lebaleng la Dipapadi la Franklin Kokstad, KwaZulu-Natal ka la 25 Motsheanong 2015 tlasa mookotaba: “Re sebetsa mmoho ho tshireletsa bana”.
tgt: Litiko Letekutfutfukiswa Kwetenhlalakahle, libambisene ne-Ejensi Yetekuphepha Kutenhlalakahle yaseNingizimu Afrika kanye ne-Ejensi Yavelonkhe Yetentfutfuko, litawetfula Liviki Lekuvikeleka Kwebantfwana lapha Enkhundleni Yemidlalo eFranklin eKokstad, KwaZulu-Natal mhla tinge-25 Inkhwekhweti 2015 ngaphansi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Kusebenta ngekubambisana kute kuvikelwe bantfwana”.

src: Beke ena e tla fella ka la 31 Motsheanong 2015 Gauteng.
tgt: Leliviki litawugcina mhla tinge-31 Inkhwekhweti 2015 eGauteng.

src: Letsholo lena la temoso le reretswe ho fihlella makala oohle a setjhaba bakeng sa ho hlokomela le ho tshireletsa bana.
tgt: Lomkhankhaso wekucaphelisa uhlose kuhlanganisa yonkhe imikhakha yemmango kutsi inakekele iphindze ivikele bantfwana.

src: Ho fetafeta moo, le rerile ho lemosa batho ba baholo le bana ka tshireletso ya molao e fuwang bana tlasa Molaotheo, melao, maano le disebediswa tsa matjhaba mabapi le sena.
tgt: Ngetulu kwaloko, uhlose kucaphelisa labadzala nebantfwana mayelana nekuvikeleka ngekwemtsetfo umntfwana lanako ngaphansi kweMtsetfosisekelo, kwemitsetfo, kwetinchubomgomo kanye nakumave emhlaba.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho batswadi le bahlokomedi hore kamehla ba behe tshireletso ya bana ba bona pele le ho netefatsa hore ba hlokometswe ke batswadi ba nang le boikarabelo.
tgt: IKhabhineti icela batali kanye nalabagadza bantfwana kutsi ngaso sonkhe sikhatsi babeke kuphepha kwebantfwababo embili futsi bente siciniseko sekutsi banakekelwa kahle ngebantfu labadzala labanekutibophelela.

src: Batswadi le Bahlokomedi ba kgothaletswa ho lemoha dibaka tse kotsi, ho kenyeletsa boitshwaro kapa diketso tsa batho ba baholo tse sa amoheleheng.
tgt: Batali nalabo labagadza bantfwana bayakhutsatwa kutsi bafundzise bantfwana kutsi bacaphele timo letingaba yingoti, lokufaka ekhatsi kutiphatsa lokungakamukeleki nome tento letingakamukeleki tebantfu labadzala.

src: Ke boikarabelo ba batswadi le bahlokomedi ho tseba moo bana ba bona ba leng teng le ho nka mehato e bonahalang ho netefatsa polokeho le tshireletso ya bona.
tgt: Kusemahlombe ebatali nalabagadza bantfwana kutsi bati kutsi bantfwababo bakuphi baphindze batsatse tinyatselo tekwenta siciniseko sekutsi bantfwababo baphephile futsi bavikelekile.

src: Letona la Lefapha la Dikaho tsa Motheo tsa Dikgokahano le Ditshebeletso tsa Poso, Ngaka Siyabonga Cwele, le tla tshwara Imbizo Musiamong wa Nelson Mandela Qunu, Kapa Botjhabela ho keteka Letsatsi la Setjhaba la Lefatshe la Dikaho tsa Motheo tsa Dikgokahano le Tlhahisoleseding ka la 17 Motsheanong 2015.
tgt: Indvuna Yetakhiwonchanti Tekuchumanisa Netinsita Teliposi, Dkt.

src: Imbizo e tshwarwa ka semphato le Mmuso wa Porofense wa Kapa Botjhabela, baetapele ba botjhaba le Foramo ya Dikgokahanyo ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Siyabonga Cwele, utawuba ane-Imbizo eNelson Mandela Museum eQunu, eMphumalanga Kapa kute agubhe Lusuku Lwemhlaba Lwetakhiwonchanti Tekuchumanisa Nemmango Lochumana Ngelwatiso mhla ti-17 Inkhwekhweti 2015.

src: Sepheo sa ketsahalo ena ke ho thusa ho hlahisa temoso ka dikgonahalo tseo tshebediso ya inthanete le dithekenoloji tse ding tsa tlhahisoleseding le dikgokahanyo di ka di tlisang ho setjhaba le meruo, le ditsela tsa ho ngotla ho se lekalekane ho tsa dijithale.
tgt: Lomcimbi wentelwa kutsi kukhutsatwe bantfu kutsi basebentise kakhulu tebuchwepheshe ekutfutfukiseni timphilo tabo.

src: DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di tla lokelwa ke ho netefatswa ha mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang.
tgt: Indvuna itawuchaza imininingwane kutsi hulumende wentani ngekusebentisa buchwepheshe kute kwentiwe ncono kuletfwa kwetinsita kubo bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulu labo labahlala etindzaweni tasemaphandleni.

src: Moatefokate Motlatjo Josephine Ralefatane jwaloka Modulasetulo wa Boto ya ZADNNgaka Thomas Kwadwo Gyedu-Ababio jwaloka Mohlanka e Moholo wa Phethahatso (CEO) ya Lekala la Bolaodi ba Mokgamo wa Metsi la Inkomati-Usuthu.
tgt: Le-Imbizo itawubanjwa ngekuhlanganyela naHulumende weSifundza saseMphumalanga Kapa, baholi bendzabuko kanye Nenkhundla yaseNingizimu Afrika Yetekuchumana.

src: Ngaka GV Andrews jwaloka Mohlanka e Moholo wa Ditshebetso: Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle.
tgt: Njalo ngemnyaka, mhla ti-17 Inkhwekhweti kugujwa kusayinwa kwekucala kwe-International Telegraph Convention kanye nekusungulwa kweNyonyana Yemave Emhlaba Yetekuchumana.

src: Monghadi NM Ratshoma jwaloka Motlatsi wa Motsamaisi e Moholo (DDG) wa Leano la Moruo: Lefapha la Matlotlo a Naha.
tgt: Inhloso yalomcimbi kucaphelisa bantfu kutsi kusetjentiswa kwe-Inthanethi kanye nalolunye lwatiso nalobunye buchwepheshe betekuchumana kungaletsa emimangweni nakutemnotfo, kanye netindlela tekuvala ligebe ledijithali.

src: Letsatsi la Aforika.
tgt: Lusuku Lwe-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e leboha maAforika Borwa kaofela a ileng a nka karolo meketeng ya Letsatsi la Aforika 2015, le bontshitseng boitlamo ba rona ba ho aha Aforika e kopaneng, ya kgotso le tswelopele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi itsandza kubonga bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labatimbandzakanye kumigubho yeLusuku Lwe-Afrika 2015, lolukhombise kutinikela kwetfu ekwakheni i-Afrika lebumbene, lenekuthula kanye nalephumelelako.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa boipiletso ba Moporesidente Jacob Zuma ho dikaho le dikhamphani kaofela tsa Aforika Borwa ho fofisa folakga ya Kopano ya Aforika (AU) mmoho le ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphindza simemetelo lesentiwe nguMengameli Jacob Zuma asicondzise kuto tonkhe tikhungo taseNingizimu Afrika kanye netinkampani kutsi tiphakamisele etulu umjeka weNhlangano Yelubumbano Lwe-Afrika (i-AU) kanye nemjeka waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Sena se tsamaelana le tlhokeho ya ho imatahanya le pono ya Aforika e kopaneng, ya tswelopele le kgotso.
tgt: Loku kuhambelana nesidzingo sekusekela umbononchanti we-Afrika lebumbene, lephumelelako nalenekuthula.

src: Ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha mananeo a bohlokwa a mmuso.
tgt: Kufezekiswa kwetinhlelo tahulumende letibalulekile.

src: Kabinete e hopotsa maAforika Borwa le melata e etang le bana hore Molao wa Dipaseporoto le Ditokomane tsa Maeto o tla qala ho sebetsa ho tloha ka la 1 Phuptjane 2015.
tgt: IKhabhineti ikhumbuta bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nebantfu bekuchamuka labahamba nebantfwana nabavakasha kutsi Umtsetfo Wephasipoti Nemadokhumenti Emvume Yekungena Eveni utawucala kusebenta mhla ti-1 Inhlaba 2015.

src: Tlasa molao o motjha, batswadi ba etang le bana ba ka tlase ho dilemo tse 18 ba tshwanela ho hlahisa mangolo a bona a tlhaho a sa kgutsufatswang.
tgt: Ngaphasi kwalomtsetfo, batali labahamba bavakasha nebantfwana labangaphasi kweminyaka le-18 budzala kudzingeka kutsi bavete titifiketi tabo tekutalwa letingakafishaniswa.

src: Sena ke karolo ya boitlamo ba mmuso ho tshireletsa dikgahleho tsa bana le ho thibela kgwebisano ka bana.
tgt: Lena yincenye yahulumende yekutinikela ekugadzeni lokufunwa bantfwana kanye nekuvikela kushushumbiswa kwebantfwana.

src: Diqeto tsa Bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Tincumo teKhabhinethi letibalulekile.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Leano la Naha la Dipalangwang tsa Baithuti, le fanang ka ditataiso mabapi le phano ya ditshebeletso tsa dipalangwang tsa setjhaba tse hlwahlwa, tse kgabane le ho bolokeha bakeng sa baithuti.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyivumile Inchubomgomo Yavelonkhe Yekutfutsa Bafundzi, lenika tinkhombandlela tekuletsa tinsita tetekutfutsa tahulumende letitfutsa bafundzi ngemphumelelo, ngelikhono nangekuphepha.

src: Ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha lona ho tla baka tshebeletso e kopanetsweng ya dipalangwang tsa baithuti e fanang ka maemo a mefuta ya dipalangwang tse lokelang ho sebediswa le dibopeho tsa ditefello tse tla sebediswa ho ditshebeletso tsa dipalangwang tsa baithuti.
tgt: Kucala kusebenta kwalenchubomgomo kutawuholela ekutseni kube netekutfutsa bafundzi letihlangene letinika lizinga lekutsi hloboluni lwetigitjelwa lekumele kutsi tisetjentiswe kanye netinhlaka temali lekhokhwako nakusetjentiswa tinsita tekutfutsa bafundzi.

src: Leano lena hape le matahantswe le Molao wa Dikolo wa Aforika Borwa, 1996 (Molao 84 wa 1996).
tgt: Lenchubomgomo iihambelana Nemtsetfo Wetikolo taseNingizimu Afrika, wa-1996 (Umtsetfo we-84 wa-1996).

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa ha Tlaleho ya Aforika Borwa ya 1994 ho isa ho 2014 mabapi le Kgatelopele ya ho Kenngwa tshebetsong ha Boitlamo bo Kgethehileng ba Dihlooho tsa Dipuso tsa Kopano ya Aforika (AU) mabapi le Tekatekano ya Bong ka hara Aforika ho Bongodi ba ATlaleho ena ke boitokisetso ba Seboka sa Dihlooho tsa Dipuso tsa AU se tla tshwarwa ka Phuptjane 2015.Tlaleho ena, e akaretsang nako ya ho tloha ka 1994 ho isa ho 2014, e hlahloba le ho lekola bohlwahlwa ba melao ya rona, maano le mananeo a ileng a hlahiswa bakeng sa ho eketsa boemedi, phano ya ditshebeletso tsa mantlha, tlhahiso ya mesebetsi, phokotso ya bofuma, phediso ya dikgoka, le tshireletso ya ditokelo tsa botho tsa basadi le banana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kungeniswa kweMbiko waseNingizimu Afrika wa-1994 kuya ku-2014 loya Kuhhovisi Lebubhalane Le-AU lomayelana Nenchubekelembili mayelana Nekucala kusebenta Kwesimemetelo Lesisemtsetfweni Setinhloko Tembuso Tenhlangano Yelubumbano Lwe-Afrika (AU) lesimayelana Nekulingana Ngebulili e-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Leano la Batjha la Naha la 2015-2020 (NYP2020).
tgt: Lombiko umayelana nekulungiselela Umhlangano Lomkhulu Wetinhloko Temibuso Te-AU lotawubanjwa ngeNhlaba 2015.Lombiko, ufaka ekhatsi sikhatsi kusukela ngemnyaka wa-1994 kuya ku-2014, uhlola uphindze ubeke ezingeni kuphumelela kwemitsetfo, tinchubomgomo kanye netinhlelo tetfu lesungulelwe kutsi tandzise linani labamele bomake, kudaleka kwematfuba emsebenti, kuncishiswa kwebuphuya, kucedvwa kweludlame kanye nekuvikelwa kwemalungelo eluntfu abomake nemantfombatana.

src: Leano lena le nkile sebaka sa Leano la Batjha la Naha la 2009-2014 leo nako ya lona e seng e fedile.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyivumile Inchubomgomo Yavelonkhe Yelusha Ya-2020 (i-NYP 2020).

src: Leano lena le ile la hlahiswa kamora ditsamaiso tsa ditherisano tse matla le batjha ba Aforika Borwa ho tswa diporofenseng kaofela tse robong.
tgt: Lenchubomgomo itsatsa sikhundla seNchubomgomo Yavelonkhe Ya-2009-2014 leseyiphelelwe sikhatsi.

src: Le tla bopa motheo bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya Lewa la Ntshetsopele ya Batjha le kopanetsweng.
tgt: Lenchubomgomo yasungulwa emva kwenchubo yekubonisana kabanti nelusha lwaseNingizimu Afrika loluvela kuto toyimfica tifundza.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka kgatelopele e entsweng bakeng sa ho theha Mokgatlo wa Bolaodi ba Kgwebisano ya Thepa (PMTE).
tgt: Lenchubomgomo itawubasisekelo sekusungula Indlelalisu lehlangene Yekutfutfukisa Lusha.

src: Mokgatlo ona o netefatsa bokgabane le bohlwahlwa ho tsa ditjeho bolaoding ba dipotefolio tsa thepa ya Puso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibikelwe ngalamafisha mayelana nenchubekelembili nekusungulwa kweSikhungo Sekulawulwa Kwemphahla Yekuhwebelana (i-PMTE).

src: Kabinete e kgotsofetse ka ntshetsopele le ho lokiswa botjha ha motlolo wa kgwebo wa PMTE, o tla ntlafatsa boleng ba meaho ya setjhaba.
tgt: Lesikhungo senta kutsi kube nesiciniseko sekutsi takhiwo tembuso tilawulwa ngemphumelelo futsi ngendlela lengabiti.

src: Kabinete hape e tjhaelletse monwana botlatsetsi ba Monghadi P Serote ho sebetsa jwaloka hlooho ya PMTE, Monghadi M Govender jwaloka hlooho ya Dikaho le Bolaodi ba Meaho le Mofumahadi BS Mathews jwaloka hlooho ya Ditshebeletso tsa Boingodiso ba Meaho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inetisekile ngekutfutfukiswa kanye nekwentiwa ncono kwalendlela yekuchuba temabhizinisi e-PMTE, lokuyintfo letakwenta ncono lizinga letakhiwo tahulumende.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla tshwara Seboka sa AU Setsing sa Dikopano sa Sandton ho tloha ka la 7 ho isa ka la 15 Phuptjane 2015 tlasa mookotaba: “Selemo sa Matlafatso ya Basadi le Ntshetsopele ho lebisa ho Lenane la Aforika la 2063”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakuvumela kucashwa kwaMnu P Serote kutsi abe yinhloko ye-PMTE, UMnu M Govender njengenhloko yeTisetjentiswa Nekulawulwa Kwemphahla Jikelele kantsi MkBS Mathews wayosebenta njengenhloko Yetinsita Tekubhalisa Imphahla Jikelele.

src: Diketsahalo tsa beke di tla qetella ka Kopano ya Dihlooho tsa Dipuso ho tloha ka la 14 ho isa ka la 15 Phuptjane 2015.Riphaboliki ya Zimbabwe, jwaloka ka modulasetulo wa AU bakeng sa 2015, e tla ba modulasetulo wa seboka le dikopano tsa yona tse amehang.
tgt: Umhlangano Lomkhulu we-AU utawube ubanjelwe eNingizimu Afrika lapha e-Sandton Convention Centre kusukela mhla ti-5 kuya mhla ti-15 Inhlaba 2015 ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Umnyaka Wekunika Bomake Emandla kanye Nentfutfuko lehambisana ne-Agenda 2063 Yase-Afrika”.

src: Se tla tsepamisa maikutlo ho kenngweng tshebetsong ha diqeto tse nkilweng sebokeng sa Pherekgong 2015, tse kenyeletsang Lenane la 2063 le Moralo wa ho le kenya Tshebetsong la dilemo tse 10 tsa Pele Maemo a Kgotso le Tshireletso a Kontinente, ho kenyeletswa Boferekanyi Matlafatso ya Basadi le Ntshetsopele Mehlodi e fapaneng ya Dithuso tsa Ditjhelete bakeng sa AU Kopano ya kontinente le ho etsa hore Setsi sa Aforika sa Taolo ya Mahloko le Thibelo se be se sebetsa ka 2015.Moporesidente Zuma o tla kenela ho behwa setulong ha Moporesidente ya sa tswa kgethwa wa Nigeria Moporesidente Mohammadu Buhari Abuja, Nigeria ka la 29 Motsheanong 2015.
tgt: Imicimbi yaleliviki itawuphetsa Ngemhlangano Wetinhloko Temibuso kusukela ngamhla ti-14 kuya mhla ti-15 Inhlaba 2015.IRiphabhliki YaseZimbabwe, njengasihlalo we-AU nga-2015, ngiyo letawuba ngusihlalo walomhlangano lomkhulu kanye naleminye imihlangano lehambelana nawo.

src: Foramo ya Moruo wa Lefatshe mabapi le Aforika e tla tshwarwa Motse Kapa ho tloha ka la 3 ho isa ho la 5 Phuptjane 2015 tlasa mookotaba: “Maoba le Kajeno: Re Hopola Botjha Bokamoso ba Aforika.”Kabinete e amohela baetapele bohle ba dipolotiki le kgwebo ho tswa kontinenteng ya Aforika ka bophara le dikarolong tse ding tsa lefatshe jwaloka ha kopano e tshwaya dilemo tse 25 tsa diphethoho ka hara Aforika.
tgt: Utawugcila ekutseni kucalwe kusetjentiswe tincumo letatsatfwa Kumhlangano Lomkhulu WaBhimbidvwane nga-2015, lokufaka ekhatsi i-Agenda 2063 kanye Neluhlelo Lwayo Lweminyaka Le-10 Yekucala Kulusebentisa, Simo Selivekati Setekuphepha Nekuvikeleka, lokufaka ekhatsi Buphekulasikhuni, Kunikwa Kwabomake Emandla kanye Nentfutfuko, Leminye Imitfombolusito Yekusekela i-AU Ngetimali, Kuhlanganiswa Kwelivekati kanye nekusebentisa Sikhungo Sase-Afrika Sekulawula Tifo Nekutivikela nga-2015.Mengameli Zuma utawuhambela kubekwa esihlalweni kwaMengameli waseNigeria lokhetsiwe Mohammadu Buhari e-Abuja, eNigeria mhla tinge-29 Inkhwekhweti 2015.

src: Aforika Borwa e ikemiseditse ho nka karolo dipuisanong tse mabapi le ho akofisa kgolo ya moruo e kenyeletsang le ntshetsopele ya Aforika.
tgt: Umhlangano Wenkhundla Yemhlaba Yetemnotfo mayelana ne-Afrika utawube ubanjelwe lapha eKapa kusukela mhla ti-3 kuya mhla ti-5 Inhlaba 2015 ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Itolo Nalamuhla: Kucabanga Futsi Ngelikusasa Le-Afrika.”IKhabhinethi iyabemukela bonkhe baholi betembangave nebemabhizinisi labavela kulolonkhe lelivekati lase-Afrika kanye nakuletinye tincenye temhlaba njengaloku lomhlangano uyobe ugubha iminyaka lenge-25 yetingucuko e-Afrika.

src: Kontinente e dula e le le leng la mabatowa a holang ka potlako e fetisisang lefatsheng le ho ba sebaka se hohelang matsete.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika ilindzele kutimbandzakanya kutinkhulumiswano tekusheshisa kukhula kwemnotfo lokufaka wonkhewonkhe kanye nentfutfuko e-Afrika.

src: Aforika Borwa e na le lenaneo le leholohadi la ARV lefatsheng, ka batho ba dimilione tse tharo ba sebedisang di-ARV ho tloha ka Tshitwe 2014.
tgt: Lelivekati lingulelinye letigodzi letikhula ngekushesha emhlabeni wonkhe kantsi futsi liyindzawo lenhle leheha lutjalotimali.

src: Sena se nyehetse ka matla bakeng sa ho fokotsa ditshwaetso tse ntjha tsa HIV le ho hlokahala ka lebaka la AIDS, le ho netefatsa ho pholoha ha bana le bophelo bo bolelele.
tgt: Lisekela Lamengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, njengaSihlalo Wemkhandlu WaseNingizimu Afrika Wavelonkhe Wengculazi (i-AIDS), utawukhuluma nakuvulwa Lomhlangano Lomkhulu We-7 WaseNingizimu Afrika We-AIDS lotawube ulapha eNkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre e-Durban kusukela mhla ti-9 kuya mhla ti-12 Inhlaba 2015 ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Kucabanga, Kugcila Nekuvusetela.”Lomhlangano lomkhulu lobanjwa njalo emva kweminyaka lemibili, sewugucuke wabasilinganiso sekukala sahulumende kanye nebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi ngaso bakhone kulandzelela inchubekelembili leseyentiwe ekulawuleni lufu Lwesandvulengculazi (i-HIV).

src: Meralo e hlwahlwa ke karolo e kgolo ya katleho ya lenaneo lena le tswang pele, le netefatsang ho ba teng ho lekaneng ha di-ARV dikahong tsa setjhaba tsa kalafo.
tgt: Uphindze futsi unikete bantfu labasebenta nge-HIV ne-AIDS, Tifo Temacansi (ema-STI) kanye neSifo Sesifuba (i-TB) litfuba lekushiyelana ngaloko labahlangabetane nako kanye nangelwatinzulu.

src: Aforika Borwa, ka Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji (DST), esale e tsetela diphuputsong tsa HIV ka dilemo tse ngata.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika ineluhlelo lolukhulu kakhulu lwesidzamisigciwane (i-ARV) emhlabeni, lolunebantfu labatigidzi letintsatfu labadla emaphilisi ema-ARV kusukela ngeNgongoni 2014.

src: Ho tsetela ha DST diphuputsong tsa HIV ho qadile ka 1999 ha mmoho le Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle, re thehile Boikitlaetso ba Aforika Borwa ba Kentelo ya AIDS.
tgt: Loku kudlale indzima lenkhulu ekunciphiseni kwesuleleka lokusha ngelufu lwe-HIV kanye nelizinga lekufa nge-AIDS, kwaphindze kwacinisekisa kusindza kwebantfwana kanye nekwenta kutsi imphilo ibe yindze.

src: Ka 2009, tshehetso ya DST bakeng sa diphuputso tsa HIV di ile tsa atoloswa hore di kenyeletse boitshunyako bo bong bo kang dipopolo, di-ARV, dibolaya dikokwanahloko, ho phaella hodima diente.
tgt: Kuhlela ngekukhutsala yincenye lenkhulu leyente kutsi loluhlelo lube yimphumelelo, ngekutsi kwentiwe siciniseko kutsi kunemaphilisi ema-ARV lanele kuleso nakuleso sisetjentiswa setemphilo sahulumende.

src: Re hlahisitse Lepatlelo la Ntlafatso le Diphuputso tsa HIV la Aforika Borwa (SHARP) bakeng sa ho tshehetsa ka matlole diphuputso tsa ho qala tsa HIV le AIDS le ho thusa ka ntshetsopele ya ditharollo tse ntlafetseng bakeng sa sewa sena.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika, ngekusebentisa Litiko Letesayensi Nebuchwepheshe (i-DST), beyisolo itjala kulucwaningo lwe-HIV iminyaka leminyenti.

src: Hajwale re tshehetsa diporojeke tse ngatanyana tse amanang le HIV mehatong e fapafapaneng ya ntshetsopele ka lenaneo le bitswang Bomphato ba Lewa la Ntlafatso ya Kalafo, bo kenyeletsang SHARP tlasa bodisa ba Lekgotla la Diphuputso tsa Kalafo la Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lutjalotimali lweLitiko Letesayensi Nebuchwepheshe ekucwaningeni nge-HIV lwacala nga-1999 ngesikhatsi lihlangana ndzawonye neLitiko Letemphilo sasungula Sichamukelo SaseNingizimu Afrika Semutsi Wekugoma i-AIDS.

src: Mosebetsi wa lenaneo lena ke ho thusa ka ho kopanya bafuputsi ba Aforika Borwa ba HIV le AIDS, le ho hlahisa Ditsi tsa Naha tsa Marangrang a Tshebedisano mmoho a Diphuputso mabapi le HIV le AIDS.
tgt: Ngemnyaka wa-2009, Litiko Letesayensi Nebuchwepheshe kwesekela kwalo lucwaningo nge-HIV kwandza kwafaka ekhatsi letinye tingenelelo njengekucilonga, ema-ARV, tibulalimagciwane (i-microbicides) ekungeteni kuleyo mitsi yekugoma.

src: Hajwale, palo e ngata ya dikaho tse fapaneng, mekgatlo e fapaneng, diporojeke tsa ntshetsopele tse akaretsang mesebetsi ya ho popola, diente le dibolaya dikokwanahloko di a latelwa bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa dipheo tsa SHARAforika Borwa e behile bohlokwa bo itseng bakeng sa ho lwantsha AIDS, mme thibelo e le motsong wa Moralo wa Lewa la Naha bakeng sa HIV, di-STI le TB (2012-2016).
tgt: Sisungule Inkhundla Lensha YaseNingizimu Afrika Yekucwaninga Nge-HIV (i-SHARP) kutsi sisekele ngetimali kucala kwelucwaningo nge-AIDS ne-HIV kanye nekusungula tisombululo letinsha talombulalave.

src: Letsatsi la Lefatshe la Mawatle ka la 8 Phuptjane le tla tshwarwa Bloemfontein, ho la Free State le balekane ba fapafapaneng ho kenngweng tshebetsong ha Moruo wa Mawatle wa Operation Phakisa ho arolelwana tlhahisoleseding le badudi ba lehae ka menyetla hara moruo wa mawatle le dibaka tse amehang.
tgt: Kwanyalo sisekela imiklamo leminyenti lehambisana ne-HIV etigabeni letahlukahlukene tentfutfuko ngekusebentisa luhlolo lolubitwa ngekutsi Budlelwane Lobusha Bendlelalisu Letemphilo, lobufaka ekhatsi i-SHARP ngaphasi Kwemkhandlu WaseNingizimu Afrika Wetekucwaninga Ngetemphilo.

src: Ka la 17 Phuptjane Aforika Borwa e tla keteka Letsatsi la Lefatshe la ho Lwantsha Kgoholeho motseng wa Nqutu, KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Umsebenti waloluhlelo kutsi lwente kutsi kube nekuchumana emkhatsini webacwaningi be-AIDS ne-HIV baseNingizimu Afrika, kanye nekusungula Tikhungo Tenethiwekhi Tavelonkhe Tekucwaninga Nekusebentisana nge-AIDS ne-HIV.

src: Matsatsi oohle ana a bohlokwa a tikoloho a reretswe ho phahamisa temoso ka tikoloho mme ka nqa e nngwe a tsebisa batjha diporofenseng tsohle tse tla tshwara mekete ena ka menyetla lekaleng lena.
tgt: Kwanyalo, kunemiklamo leminyenti yetikhungo letinyenti nemikhakha leminyenti yekusungula imikhicito lefaka ekhatsi kucilonga, imitsi yekugoma kanye netibulalimagciwane leyentiwa kute kuchutjelwe embili tinjongo te-SHARINingizimu Afrika ikutsatsela etulu kubaluleka kwekulwa ne-AIDS, kanye nekuvikela lokuyintfo lengumnyombo Kulisu Lendlelalisu Lavelonkhe Le-HIV, ema-STI kanye ne-TB (2012-2016).

src: Ho thakgolwa ha Dibaka tse Tharo tse Kgwebisanang Ntle le ho Lefisana Lekgetho la Kgwebisano (FTA) ho la Sharm-el-ShaikDibaka tse Tharo tsa COMESA-EAC-SADC Dinaheng tse Kgwebisanang Ntle le ho Lefisana Lekgetho la Kgwebisano (TFTA) tse tla thakgolwa ka la 10 Phuptjane 2015 Sharm-el-Shaik, Egepeta.
tgt: Siholwa Litiko Letemvelo embili, mhla ti-5 Inhlaba, sitawube sigubha Lusuku Lwemhlaba Lwetemvelo lapha e-Kimberley, eNyakatfo Kapa.

src: TFTA e tla hlahisa mmaraka wa dinaha tse 26, ka setjhaba se kopaneng se ka fetang 625 milione le Seelokaofela sa Dihlahiswa tsa Naha mo Selemong (GDP) se fetang $1 trilione.
tgt: Lusuku Lwemhlaba Lwelwandle mhla ti-8 Inhlaba lutawube lubanjelwe lapha e-Bloemfontein, eFreyistata ngekuhlanganyela nebalingani labahlukahlukene ekucaleni kutsi kusebente i-Operation Phakisa Temnotfo Taselwandle kwabelanwe ngelwatiso nemimango yendzawo mayelana nematfuba lasemnotfweni waselwandle nakuletinye tindzawo letihambelanako.

src: Thakgolo ena e tshwaya ho phethelwa ha ditherisano mabapi le Tumellano ya Kgwebisano e sa Lefisaneng Lekgetho la Kgwebisano e tekang melawana le moralo oo ka hara wona ho tla dumellanwang ka ditefello dife le boitlamo bofe tse tla kenngwang tshebetsong.
tgt: Mhla ti-17 Inhlaba iNingizimu Afrika itawube igubha Lusuku Lwemhlaba Lwekulwa Nekubanga Lugwadvule lapha esigodzini saseNquthu KwaZulu-Natal.

src: Ditherisano mabapi le ditefello le melawana ya sethathong di tla tswela pele jwaloka karolo ya lenane le ahelletsweng ka hara ditherisano.
tgt: Ngato tonkhe letinsuku temvelo letimcoka kuhloswe ngato kucaphelisa ummango mayelana nemvelo kanye nekuvetela lusha loluvela kuto tonkhe tifundza ematfuba lakhona kulomkhakha.5 Kwetfulwa Kwe-Tripartite FTA e-Sharm-el-ShaikI-COMESA-EAC-SADC Tripartite Free Trade Area (I-TFTA) itawube yetfulwa mhla ti-10 Inhlaba 2015 e-Sharm-el-Shaik, eGibhithe.

src: Thakgolo ya TFTA ke phihlello ya bohlokwa bakeng sa Kontinente ya Aforika le ho thehwa hodima Moralo wa Tshebetso wa Lagos wa AU le Tumellano ya Abuja tseo sepheo sa tsona e leng ho theha Kopano ya Moruo wa Aforika.
tgt: Le-TFTA itawudala imakhethe yemave lange-26, lanabantfu lebangengetulu kwetigidzi letinge-625 sebahlanganisiwe kanye nesamba semkhicito wasekhaya (i-GDP) lesingetulu kwetigidzigidzi letisigidzi sinye se- $1.Lokwetfulwa kusho kuphotfulwa kwetinkhulumiswano mayelana Nesivumelwane Sekuhweba Ngenkhululeko lesibeka imitsetfo neluhlelomsebenti lwemali lekhokhwako nalokunye lokutawucala kutsi asetjentiswe ngekulandzela lona.

src: Re dumela hore sena se romela molaetsa o matla wa hore Aforika e itelletse lenane la yona la ho kopanngwa ha moruo le ho bopa tikoloho e lokileng bakeng sa kgwebisano le matsete.
tgt: Kwetfulwa kwe-TFTA kuluphawu lolubalulekile Lwelivekati lase-Afrika futsi igcile Kuhlelo Lwekusebenta Lase-Lagos Le-AU kanye nakuSivumelwane Sase-Abuja lokuhloswe ngaso kusungula Ummango Wetemnotfo wase-Afrika.

src: Ditherisano tse lebisitseng ho TFTA di thakgotswe ka Phuptjane 2011 Sebokeng se neng se tshweretswe Aforika Borwa, Sandton.6 Thakgolo ya ditherisano bakeng sa FTA Sebokeng sa AU ka Phuptjane.
tgt: Sikholelwa ekutseni loku kutfumela umlayeto lonesisindvo lotsi i-Afrika itinikele kuluhlelo lwekuhlanganisa umnotfo wayo kanye nasekudaleni kutsi kube nesimondzawo lesihle sekuhwebelana nekutjala timali.

src: Ho thakgolwa ha dipuisano tsa Kontinente mabapi le ho Kgwebisana Ntle le ho Lefisana Lekgetho la Kgwebisano (CFTA) ke Seboka sa AU ho tla etsahala ka la 15 Phuptjane 2015 Johannesburg, Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Tinkhulumiswano mayelana ne-Tripartite Free Trade Area (i-TFTA) tatfulwa ngeNhlaba ngemnyaka wa-2011 kuMhlangano Lomkhulu lobewubitwe nguMengameli Jacob Zuma lapha e-Sandton eNingizimu Afrika.

src: CFTA e tla hlahisa mmaraka wa batho ba fetang bilione ka GDP e kopanetsweng e fetang $2 trilione.
tgt: Kwetfulwa kwetinkhulumiswano mayelana Nesivumelwane Sekuhweba Ngenkhululeko Kulelivekati eMhlanganweni Lomkhulu We-AU ngeNhlaba.

src: E tla thehwa hodima TFTA le kgatelopele e fihlelletsweng ka hara mabatowa a moruo wa badudi.
