tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kusungulwa kweLikomidi Lelihlanganisa Tindvuna (i-IMC) Lekubakhona Kwemanti sihlalo walo yiNdvuna yeTekubusa Ngekubambisana Netendzabuko Pravin Gordhan.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona a tebileng ho lelapa la Nqakula le metswalle.
tgt: Le-IMC yakhiwa Indvuna Yekutfutfukiswa Kwetindzawo Tasemaphandleni Netingucuko Kutemhlaba, Yetemanti Nekuhamnjiswa Kwekungcola, kanye neyeTekulima, Temahlatsi Netinhlanti.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona a tebileng ho lelapa le ba leloko la Letona la Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba le Tsamaiso Ngoako Ramatlhodi, ka ho hlokahala ha mme wa hae ya dilemo tse 95, Mmatlou Elizabeth Ramatlhodi.
tgt: LeLikomidi litawucocisana liphindze liphakamise tingenelelo kuleyo mimango lehlaselwe somiso.

src: DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di tla lokelwa ke ho netefatswa ha mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikubonile lokwenteka eNigeria mayelana nenhlawulo yetigidzigidzi le-US$5.2 baka-MTN labahlawuliswe yona iKhomishini YaseNigeria Yetekuchumana.

src: Monghadi Mogojare Richard Seleka jwaloka Motsamaisi e Moholo (DG) ho Lefapha la Dikgwebo tsa Setjhaba le.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakholwa kutsi letinkhulumiswano letisachubeka emkhatsini we-MTN netiphatsimandla taseNigeria titawuholela ekusombululeni ngekushesha letincabano kute kucinisekise kutsi baka-MTN bayachubeka nebhizinisi yabo ekutjaleni timali emnotfweni waseNigeria.

src: Monghadi Robert Moeketsa Ramasodi jwaloka motlatsi wa DG: Tlhahiso ya tsa Temo, Bophelo bo Botle le Polokeho ya Dijo ho Lefapha la Temo, Meru le Ditlhapi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idzabukile mayelana nekushona ngekutuma kwaChumani Nqakula, indvodzana yeNdvuna Yetekuvikela Netigayigayi Temphi Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula banaCharles Nqakula, Lilunga lePhalamende.

src: Ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha mananeo a bohlokwa a mmuso.
tgt: Kucala kwekusebenta kwetinhlelo letimcoka tahulumende.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Lefapha la Bodulo ba Batho bakeng sa ho fana ka matlo porojekeng ya Bodulo ba Batho e Kopanetsweng ya Savanna City ka hara Masepala wa Setereke wa Sedibeng ho dihlopha tse dikojwana di mahetleng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalidvumisa Litiko Letekuhlaliswa Kwebantfu ngekunika tindlu bantfu labaphuyile ngekusebentisa umklamo Lohlanganisiwe waseDolobheni laseSavanna Wekuhlalisa Bantfu kuMasipala weSifundza saseSedibeng.

src: MaAforika Borwa a itlhommeng pele a ile a ikopanya le bankakrolo ba diindaseteri, ho kenyeletswa le bomeyara le bahlanka ba tswang Masepaleng wa Setereke wa Sedibeng, mabapi le ho penta matlo a phethetsweng mmoho le ho thusa ka ditshingwana nakong ya ho thakgolwa.
tgt: Bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labadvumile bajoyina betimboni labatsintsekako, lokufaka ekhatsi bosodolobha kanye netiphatsimandla taMasipala waseSifundzeni saseSedibeng, tapenda leto tindlu leseticedziwe ngesikhatsi tetfulwa kanye nekuhlanganyela tingadze.

src: Ho ahilwe matlo a ka bang 18 000, a tswetseng molemo maqheku, batho ba qhwadileng, le malapa ao dihlooho tsa ona e leng bana le basadi.
tgt: Kwakhiwe tindlu letilinganiselwa kuleti-18 000, kwazuza labaluphele, bantfu labanekukhubateka, kanye nemindeni leholwa bantfwana naleholwa bafati.

src: Kabinete e boetse e amohela tsebiso ya hore selemong se tlang lefapha le tla thakgola porojeke, e tla etsa hore ho ahuwe matlo a 60 000.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphindze futsi iyasemukela simemetelo lesitsi kulomnyaka lotaka litiko litakwetfula umklamo, lotawusita ekwakheni tindlu leti-60 000.

src: Kabinete e amohela kgatelopele e entsweng ke porojeke ya Tshepo 10 000, e thusang ho fedisa tlhokeho ya mesebetsi bakeng sa batjha ka hara Motsemoholo wa Tshwane.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayemukela inchubekelembili leyentiwe ngumklamo i-Tshepo 10 000, lesita ngekucedza kuswela umsebenti kwebantfu labasha eDolobheni laseTshwane.

src: Porojeke ena ya dimilione-milione tsa diranta ya Motsemoholo, ka tshebedisanommoho le Yunivesithi ya Pretoria, e lebeletse ho rupella batjha ba 10 000 ba sa sebetseng ka ho ba neha maitsebelo le bokgoni tse batlehang bakeng sa ho etsa dikopo tsa ho fumantshwa diporojeke.
tgt: Lomklamo wetigidzigidzi temarandi lowentiwa Lidolobhakati, ngekuhlanganyela Nenyuvesi yasePitoli uhlose kucecesha bantfu labasha labangasebenti la-10 000 ngekutsi babanike emakhono nebungcweti lobudzingekako nawusungula imiklamo.

src: Kamora ho phethela thupello batjha ba theha le ho tsamaisa dikoporasi tse atlehileng.
tgt: Bantfu labasha nasebacedze kuceceshwa basungula tinhlangano tekusebenta ngekuhlanganyela batichube ngemphumelelo.

src: Ho fihlela mothating ona, dikoporasi tse fetang 190 di se di fanne ka menyetla ya mesebetsi ho batho ba batjha ba bangata.
tgt: Kute kube ngunyalo, kunetinhlangano letisebenta ngekuhlanganyela leti-190 lesetidale ematfuba emisebenti kubantfu labasha labanengi.

src: Hodima moo, mafapha a motsemoholo a hirile ba bang ba batjha ba rupelletsweng.
tgt: Kwengeta, ematiko elidolobhalakati acasha labanye balabantfu labasha labaceceshiwe.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho ntlafatswa ha tsela ya R25 (P6-1), e leng tsela ya dikilomithara tse 42 e kopanyang Gauteng le Limpopo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kwentiwa ncono kwemgwaco i-R25 (P6-1), umgwaco longemakhilomitha lange-42 lochumanisa iGauteng nesifundza saseLimpopo.

src: Porojeke ena, e tsamayang pakeng tsa Bapsfontein le Bronkhorstspruit, e hirile batho ba fetang 200.
tgt: Lomklamo walomgwaco, lodzabula emkhatsini weBapsfontein neBronkhorstspruit, ucashe bantfu labangetulu kwe-200.

src: Hape e tla tswela molemo makala a temo le merafo sebakeng seo ka ho hodisa motsamao o batlang o potlakile wa dilori tse tsamaisang thepa le ditshebeletso.
tgt: Kutawuphindza futsi kuzuze imikhakha yetekulima newetimayini lekulendzawo ngekutsi kugcugcuteleke kuhamba ngekushesha kwemaloli latfwala timphahla.

src: Diqeto tsa bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Tincumo TeKhabhinethi Letibalulekile.

src: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ke Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji, le tla tshwara beke ya saense ya setjhaba e kgolo: Foramo ya Saense ya Aforika Borwa 2015 tlasa mookotaba: “Re hotetsa moqoqo ka saense” ho tloha ka la 8 ho isa ka la 9 Tshitwe 2015, ho la Pretoria.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yabikelwa ngalamafishane Litiko Letesayensi Nethekinoloji, lelitawube libambe liviki letesayensi lemmango: Inkhundla Yetesayensi yaseNingizimu Afrika ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “kucala inkhulumiswano mayelana netesayensi” kusukela mhla ti-8 kuya mhla ti-9 Ingongoni 2015, ePitoli.

src: Ketsahalo ena e neha bankakarolo ba tswang Aforika Borwa, ka hara kontinente le bomphato ba matjhaba lepatlelo bakeng sa dingangisano le ho ithuta ka maano mabapi le ho tsamaelana pakeng tsa saense le setjhaba.
tgt: Lomcimbi unika labatsintsekako baseNingizimu Afrika, bakulelivekati kanye nebalingani bemave ngemave inkhundla yekubamba tinkhulumomphikiswano kanye nekufundza ngenchubomgomo lemayelana nesayensi nemmango.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana hore Ketsahalo ya Letsatsi le Tsamaelanang le tsa Mawatle ya Lefatshe ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa Mawatle (IMO) e tshwarelwe Aforika Borwa ka 2020.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile kutsi i-World Maritime Day Parallel Event ye-International Maritime Organisation (i-IMO) ibanjelwe eNingizimu Afrika nga-2020.

src: Lefapha la Dipalangwang ha ho le jwalo le tla fetisetsa qeto ena ya Kabinete ho kopano ya Lekgotla ya IMO e reretsweng ho etsahala ho tloha ka la 23 Pudungwana ho isa ka la 04 Tshitwe Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: Lihhovisi Lelitiko Letekutfutsa ngako-ke litawundlulisa lesincumo seKhabhinethi kuMkandlu we-IMO emhlanganweni lohlelwe kutsi ubanjwe mhla tinge-23 Lweti kute kube mhla ti-04 Ingongoni Imikhos letako.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o tla amohela wa mphato wa hae wa China Xi Jinping bakeng sa Leeto la Semmuso la matsatsi a mabedi ho tloha ka la 2 ho isa ka la 3 Tshitwe.
tgt: Mengameli Jacob Zuma utawube amukela umlingani wakhe waseChina Xi Jinping lotawuvakasha ngekwembuso emalanga lamabili kusukela mhla ti-02 kuya mhla ti-03 Ingongoni 2015.

src: Sepheo sa leeto ke ho phethela Moralo wa Tshebedisanommoho wa Dilemo tse 5-10 wa China-Aforika Borwa o tla thatiselletsa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha ditumellano tsa rona esale ho phethelwa Boitlamo ba Beijing ka 2010.
tgt: Lokuvakasha kuhlose kuphotfula Luhlaka Lweminyaka Le-5-10 LweChina neNingizimu Afrika lolumayelana neKusebentisana lolutawucinisa kucala kwekusebenta kwetivumelwane tetfu kusukela kwaphotfulwa Simemetelo saseBeijing nga-2010.

src: Hape le tla tsebisa le ho hodisa Bosemphato bo Pharaletseng ba Mawa bo arolelwanang ke dinaha ka bobedi.
tgt: Lutawuphindza futsi lujulise luphindze lwandzise Budlelwane Bendlelalisu Lobuphelele lamave lamabili labelana ngabo.

src: Dikamano tsa Aforika Borwa le China e dula e le bohare ba ho fihlella lenaneo la yona la ntshetsopele ka leano la yona la matjhabeng kaha le eketsa mekutu ya ho kenya tshebetsong Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP), tshebedisanommoho ho tsa temo, merero ya tsa tikoloho, kgwebisano le diindaseteri le tsa ditjhelete jwaloka ha naha e tswela pele ho kganna lenaneo la ho ntshetsa Aforika Borwa pele.
tgt: Budlelwane beNingizimu Afrika nelaseChina bumcoka ekufezekiseni luhlelo lwayo lwetentfutfuko ngekusebentisa inchubomgomo yayo yetangaphandle njengaloku yandzisa imitamo yekucalisa ngeLuhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwentfutfuko (i-NDP), kuhlanganyela kutekulima, kutemvelo, kutekuhwebelana netimboni kanye netetimali njengaloku lelive lichuba luhlelo lwekuchubela iNingizimu Afrika embili.

src: Hape le fana ka monyetla wa ho sheba botjha kgatelopele mabakeng a hajwale a kgwebisano le tshebedisanommoho pakeng tsa dinaha ka bobedi, le ho potlakisa le ho phethela dibaka tse ntjha tsa tshebedisanommoho.
tgt: Buphindze futsi budale litfuba lekubuketa inchubekelembili etintfweni letikhona tekuhwebelana kanye nekusebenta ngekuhlanganyela emkhatsini waletive letimbili, kanye nekuphotfula tindzawo letinsha tekusebenta ngekuhlanganyela.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla etella pele Kemedi e tla kenela ho dula ha bo-21 ha Khonferense ya Mekga ho Seboka sa Meralo ya Phethoho ya Tlelaemete sa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UNFCCC) le ho dula ha bo-11 ha Khonferense ya Mekga e sebetsang jwaloka Kopano ya Mekga ho Porothokhole ya Kyoto (CMP11) e tla tshwarwa ho tloha ka la 30 Pudungwana ho isa ka la 11 Tshitwe 2015 Paris, ho la Fora.
tgt: Mengameli Zuma utawuhola litsimba lelitawuya kuseshini yema-21 Yengcungcutsela Yemave yeLuhlaka Lwengcugcutsela YaMhlabuhlangene lemayelana neKuntjintja kweSimo Selitulu (i-UNFCCC) kanye neSeshini ye-11 yeNgcugcutsela yeMave lasebenta njengeKuhlangana kweMave kuSivumelwane saseKyoto (i-CMP11) letawubanjwa kusukela mhla tinge-30 Lweti kuya mhla ti-11 Ingongoni 2015 lapha eParis eFrance.

src: Ditherisano tsa matjhaba bakeng sa tumellano e ntjha ya semolao e tla hlophisa karabelo ho phethoho ya tlelaemete, e tla qala ho sebetsa ho tloha ka 2020 ho ya pele.
tgt: Tinkhulumiswano tekucocisana temave ngemave mayelana nesivumelwane lesisha lesisemtsetfweni lesitakwakha indlela yekuphendvula mayelana nekuntjintja kwesimo selitulu, lesitawucala kusebenta kusukela nga-2020 kuya embili.

src: Ho imatahantswe le ditabatabelo tsa naha tsa Aforika Borwa jwaloka naha ya Aforika e tswelang pele e tla batla tshehetso ya kamora 2020, Aforika Borwa e tla tswela pele ho tshireletsa dipehelo tsa mantlha tsa UNFCCC tsa tekatekano le phapantsho.
tgt: Ngekuhambisana naloko kwavelonkhe lokutsandvwa iNingizimu Afrika njengelive lelisatfutfuka lelitawudzinga kwesekelwa ngemuva kwa-2020, iNingizimu Afrika itawuchubeka ivikele tinchubomgomo te-UNFCCC letisisekelo tekulingana nekwehlukahlukana.

src: Ho Sehlopha sa 77 sa kopano ya China, Aforika Borwa e tla tsitlallela ho boloka le ho matlafatsa bonngwe ba dinaha tse ntseng di tswela pele bakeng sa ho fumana Tumellano ya Paris e hlokang leeme, e nang le maikemisetso, e thehilweng hodima tsa saense le e hlahisang sebaka sa ntshetsopele sa dinaha tse ntseng di tswela pele.
tgt: Emhlanganweni weMave lange-77 kanye neChina, iNingizimu Afrika itawuchubeka igcine iphindze icinise kubumbana kwemave lasatfutfuka kute itfole Sivumelwane saseParis lesingavuni muntfu, lesinenshisekelo lesisime kutesayensi nalesiveta litfuba lentfutfuko lemave lasatfutfuka.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla thakgola Letsholo la Matsatsi a 16 bakeng sa thibelo ya Dikgoka kgahlanong le Basadi le Bana ka la 25 Pudungwana 2015 Naauwpoort, ho la Mahikeng tlasa mookotaba: “Mpalle le nna: Mmoho re Ntshetsapele Aforika Borwa e hlokang Dikgoka.” Letsholo lena le hopolwa jwaloka karolo ya Matsatsi a 365 a Twantsho, leo e leng letsholo le tswellang le lemosang ka dikgoka kgahlanong le basadi le bana, le ho elellwisa batho hore ba balellwe twantshong ya selemo ho pota.
tgt: Mengameli Zuma utakwetfula Umkhankhaso Wetinsuku le-16 Tenshukumo Yekulwa Neludlame lolucondziswe kubomake nakubantfwana mhla tinge-25 Lweti 2015 lapha eNaauwpoort, eMahikeng ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Angingene Nami: Sisonkhe Sichubekisela Embili iNingizimu Afrika Lete Ludlame.” Lomkhankhaso.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho tshehetsa letsholo lena le ho sebedisa nako ena bakeng sa ho elellwisa badudi le ho imatahanya le mmuso ho fedisa dikgoka kgahlanong le basadi le bana - #Count me In.
tgt: ugutjwa njengencenye yeTinsuku Letinge-365 Tenshukumo, lokungumkhankhaso lochubekako lokhutsata kucaphela ludlame lolucondziswe kubomake nakubantfwana nekugcugcutela lowo nalowo kutsi ahlanganyele naye kulenshukumo yemnyaka wonkhe.

src: Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa o tla etella pele kemedi ya mmuso dipuisanong tsa yona tse setlwaeding le Foramo ya Bahlophisi ba Boraditaba ba Naha ya Aforika Borwa ka la 21 Pudungwana 2015 jwaloka boitlamo ba mmuso le lenaneo le tswellang la ho tiisa dikamano le boraditaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bawusekele lomkhankhaso nekutsi basebentise lesikhatsi kugcugcutela imimango kanye nekuhlanganyela nahulumende ekucedzeni ludlame lolucondziswe kubomake nebantfwana - #Count me In.

src: Mmuso o tla tsebisa bahlophisi ka dintlha tsa bohlokwa le meralo e motjheng ha ho ntse ho fuwa bahlophisi monyetla wa ho hlahisa dibaka tsa kgahleho le mmuso.
tgt: Lisekela laMengameli Ramaphosa utawuhola litsimba lahulumende ekucocisaneni kwabo lokubakhona njalo neNkhundla Yavelonkhe Yebahleli baseNingizimu Afrika (i-SANEF) mhla tinge-21 Lweti 2015 njengencenye yahulumende yekutinikela kanye neluhlelo loluchubekako lwekucinisa budlelwane nebetindzaba.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla tshwaya Letsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDS tlasa mookotaba - “Ho isa Molokong o Hlokang HIV: PHAHAMSEBETSTSHIRELETSLETHO – e leng kgoeletso ya ho sebetsa ho setjhaba.
tgt: Hulumende utawubikela bahleli ngalamafishane mayelana netindzaba letimcoka nangetinhlelo letitawkwentiwa ngaleyo ndlela bahleli batawutfola litfuba lekusho kuhulumende loko lokuyinshisekelo yabo.

src: Mookotaba wa selemong sena o tsamaelana le mookotaba wa Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng wa Letsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDS bakeng sa 2011 ho isa ho 2015 e leng: “Ho fihlella ho Letho”.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika itawugubha Lusuku Lwemhlaba Lwe-AIDS ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi - “Situkulwane Lesite i-HIV: PHAKAMA YENTVIKELKUTE – ngumkhankhaso wekutsi imimango kube khona lekwentako.

src: Letsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDS la 2015 le tla boela le matlafatsa puisano ka sekodi le kgethollo, le ho elelliswa ha badudi ka hore ba arabele le ho hodisa phumantsho ya thibelo, kalafo le tshehetso ya ditshebeletso.
tgt: Ingcikitsi yalomnyaka itsatselwe engcikitsini yaMhlabuhlangene yeLusuku Lwemhlaba Lwe-AIDS ya-2011 kuya ku-2015 letsi “Sente kutsi Kubete.” Lusuku Lwemhlaba Lwe-AIDS lwa-2015 lutawucinisa inkhulumiswano mayelana neluphawombi nekubandlululwa, kanye nekugcugcutela imimango kutsi ifinyelele ekuvikelekeni, ekwelashweni kanye nasekusekelweni.

src: Ketsahalo e kgolo ya ho hopola Letsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDS e tla tshwarelwa KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Umcimbi lomkhulu wekugutjwa kweLusuku Lwemhlaba Lwe-AIDS utawubanjelwa KwaZulu-Natali.

src: Sena se tla etsa motheo bakeng sa Aforika Borwa ho tshwara Khonferense ya Matjhaba ya AIDS ya bo- 21 Setsing sa Dikopano sa Matjhaba sa Inkosi Albert Luthuli ho la Durban ho tloha ka la 17 ho isa ka la 22 Phupu 2016.
tgt: Loku kutawuletsa umoya njengaloku iNingizimu Afrika kutawube kungiyo lemukela Ingcungcutsela Ye-21 Ye-AIDS Yemave Ngemave lapha e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention eDurban kusukela mhla ti-17 kuya mhla tinge-22 Kholwane 2016.

src: Aforika Borwa e tswella ho etsa kgatelopele ho ntwa kgahlanong le HIV le AIDS, ebile e se e atolositse lenaneo la naha la kalafo ya HIV, moo batho ba dimilione di le tharo ba tholang kalafo ya meriana ya HIV, e le mohato wa ho fokotsa tshwaetso ya ho tloha ho mme ho ya ho lesea le ho rekota matshwao a ntlafetseng a lefuba.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika iyachubeka ngekuba nemphumelo ekulweni ne-HIV ne-AIDS, njengaloku seyilwandzisise luhlelo lwalelive lwekwelapha i-HIV, lapho bantfu labangetulu kwetigidzi letintsatfu balshwa ngesidzambisigciwane, lokuyintfo lenciphisa kakhulu kwendluliseka kwesandvulelangculazi kumntfwana ngunina kanye netinkhomba letincono tesifo sesifuba.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa ho nka karolo diketsahalong tsa di-Imbizo tse rerilweng ho phatlalla le naha nakong ya Beke ya Imbizo ya Naha ya ho Tsepamisa Maikutlo ho tloha ka la 30 Pudungwana ho isa ka la 6 Tshitwe 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igcugcutela bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi batimbandzakanye emicimbini yeZimbizo letihlelwe kulo lonkhe lelive ngesikhatsi Seliviki Letimbizo Tavelonkhe kusukela mhla tinge-30 Lweti kuya mhla ti-6 Ingongoni 2015.

src: Lepatlelo lena le thusa baahi ho buisana le ditho tsa Phethahatso.
tgt: Letinkhundla tisita takhamuti kutsi ticocisane nemalunga eSigungu.

src: Beke ya Imbizo ya Naha ya ho Tsepamisa Maikutlo e tla tshwarwa tlasa mookotaba: “Mmoho re ntshetsa Aforika Borwa pele” mme e tla beha badudi sehlohlolong ka ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Moralo wa Dintlha tse Robong ke mmuso bakeng sa ho hotetsa kgolo ya moruo le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi, jwaloka ha o tekilwe ke Moporesidente Zuma Puong ya hae ka Maemo a Setjhaba ya Tlhakola 2015.
tgt: Liviki Lembizo Yavelonkhe litawukwentiwa ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Sisonkhe Sichubekisela iNingizimu Afrika embili” futsi sitayatisa imimango mayelana nekucala kwekusebenta kweLisu Lemaphuzu Layimfica lahulumende macondzana nekugcugcutela kukhula kutemnotfo kanye nekudala imisebenti, njengaloku kwasho nguMengameli Zuma eNkhulumeni Yakhe Lemayelana Nesimo Selive ngenyanga yeNdlovulencane 2015.

src: Ditho tsa Phethahatso di tla boela di sebedise monyetla ona ho kgothaletsa bonkakarolo ba badudi bakeng sa ho sebetsana le mathata a fapafapaneng a setjhaba, ho kenyeletswa dintlha tse tsamaelanang le dikgoka kgahlanong le basadi le bana.
tgt: Emalunga eSigungu atawuphindza futsi asebentise lelitfuba acinise kutimbandzakanye kwemmango ekusombululeni tinkinga tenhlalo letahlukahlukene, letifaka ekhata ludlame lolucondziswe kubomake nebantfwana.

src: Tshitwe ke Kgwedi ya Poelano mme Aforika Borwa e tla tshwaya Letsatsi la Poelano la 16 Tshitwe Port Elizabeth, ho la Kapa Botjhabela tlasa mookotaba: “Re ngotla karohano: Re aha bosetjhaba bo tshwanang ba Aforika Borwa ho isa pusong ya naha e tswelang pele”.
tgt: Ingongoni Inyanga Yekubuyisana ngaleyo ndlela iNingizimu Afrika itawugubha Lusuku Lwekubuyisana mhla ti-16 Ingongoni lapha ePort Elizabeth eMphumalanga Kapa ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Kuvala Ligebe Lekwehlukana: Kwakha buve baseNingizimu lobuvamile lobuholela kumbuso wavelonkhe lonentfutfuko.” Lenyanga inekubaluleka lokukhetsekile esiveni ngobe ikhutsata kubuyisana, lucolo kanye nekubumbana ngekwetenhlalo lokuyintfo intsandvo yelinyenti lensha lesekelwe kuyo.

src: Kgwedi ena e na le bohlokwa bo ikgethang bakeng sa setjhaba kaha e kgothaletsa poelano, kgotso le momahano ya setjhaba e leng motheo wa naha e ntjha ya tsamaiso ya demokerasi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igcugcutela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi basebentise lenyanga kutsi bafinyelele kulowo nalowo njengaloku lesive sichubeka sisebenta ngekubambisana ekwakheni sive lesibumbene nalesiphumelelako.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa kaofela ho sebedisa kgwedi ena bakeng sa ho atamelana ha naha e ntse e tswella ho sebetsa mmoho bakeng sa ho aha setjhaba se le seng se atlehileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhumbuta bakhokhi bentsela labangakangenise emafomu abo ekukhokha intsela anga-2014/15 kutsi lilanga lelingumncamulajucu lekuwangenisa ngumhla tinge-27 Lweti 2015.

src: Kabinete e leboha balefi kaofela ba lekgetho bakeng sa ho imatahanya le mmuso mabapi le ho fana ka ditshebeletso tse hlokahalang ka matla tse thusang ho ntlafatsa bophelo ba diketekete tsa badudi ho phatlalla le naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibonga bonkhe bakhokhi bentselo ngekuhlanganyela nahulumende ekunikeni ummango tisitakalo letidzingeka kakhulu letisa ekwenteni ncono timphilo tetinkhulungwane temimango lekhona kulo lonkhe lelive.

src: Kabinete thoholetsa Setsha sa Mehala sa Bolaodi ba Dikgoka tse Amanang le Bong sa Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba (GBVCC) ka ho hapa Kgau ya Lefatshe ya Setsha sa Mehala se Hlwahlwa ka ho Fetisisa Las Vegas, ho la Amerika, ka Labone, la 5 Pudungwana 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela Litiko Lekuntfutfukiswa Kwetenhlalakahle mayelana ne-Gender-Based Violence Command Centre (i-GBVCC) ngekuwina Umklomelo Wemhlaba wonkhe Wekuba Sikhungo Sekutsintsana Ngetincingo Lesiphuma embili lebewulapha eLas Vegas, eMelika ngaLesine ti-5 Lweti 2015.

src: GBVCC ke setsi sa mehala se sebetsang bosiu le motshehare se reretsweng ho fana ka tshehetso le boeletsi ho diphofu tsa dikgoka tse amanang le bong.
tgt: I-GBVCC isikhungo setincingo lesisebenta busuku nemini siletsa lusito lwekusekela nekululeka labo lavelelwe ludlame lwebulili.

src: Sena ke e nngwe ya pale ya katleho e bontshang mmuso o kgathallang o ikemiseditseng ntweng ya ho kgina dikgoka tse amanang le Bong.
tgt: Lena ngulenye yetindzaba letimnandzi lekhombisa kutsi hulumende uyanakekela futsi utimisele ekulweni nekucedza ludlame lwebulili.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Eskom bakeng sa ho sebetsa ka matsatsi a 100 ntle le ho kgaola phepelo ya motlakase.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela baka-Eskom ngekusebenta tinsuku leti-100 ngaphandle kwekuncamula emandla agezi (kucisha gezi ngenhloso yekuwonga).

src: Eskom e fihletse mokolokotwane ona ka Labobedi, la 17 Pudungwana 2015.
tgt: I-Eskom ifinyelele kulomgomo ngaLesibili, mhla ti-17 Lweti 2015.

src: Matsatsi a 100 a phepelo ya motlakase e sa sitisehang ha ho bolele hore re ka qhanolla.
tgt: Letinsuku leti-100 tekungatsikameteki kwagezi akusho kutsi sekufanele sidzembesele.

src: Empa, Kabinete e ipiletsa ho badudi ho tswella ho lekola boishunyako ba ho baballa eneji.
tgt: Esikhundleni saloko, iKhabhinethi icela imimango kutsi ichubeke ilandzele tingenelelo tekonga emandla agezi.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa bakgethwa ba Dikgau tsa Dipapadi tsa Aforika Borwa tsa 2015 tse tla tshwarwa ka la 22 Pudungwana 2015 Theatereng ya Sand du Plessis Mangaung, ho la Foreisetata.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela labo emagama abo lanyulwe kutsi bangene Umklomelo WaseNingizimu Afrika Wa-2015 Wetemidlalo lotawubanjwa mhla tinge-22 Lweti 2015 eSand du Plessis Theatre eMangaung, eFreyistata.

src: Dikgau tsena, tse hlophisitsweng tlasa mookotaba: “Boqhetseke ha se ho ba hlwahlwa ho fetisisa ke ho etsa ho fetisisang”, di keteka dilemo tse 10 tsa ho ananela le ho hlompha batho ba sebeditseng ka bokgabane ka hare le ka ntle ho mabala a dipapadi.
tgt: Lemiklomelo letawubanjelwa ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Kuphuma Ngemalengiso akusho kuba ncono kepha kusho kwenta kancono,” kugubha iminyaka le-10 yekunaka nekuhlonipha lowo nalo kanye nemacembu laphume ngemalengiso enkhundleni nangephandle.

src: MaAforika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho tshehetsa ketshalo ena ka ho kgetha Naledi ya Selemo ya Dipapadi ya Maemo a Kabinete Mabapi le Dintlha tsa Bohlokwa Maemong a Hajwale.
tgt: Bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bayagcugcutelwa kutsi basekele lomcimbi ngekutsi bavotele Inkhanyenti Yetemdlalo Yemnyaka wa-20.

src: Kabinete e imatahantse le Moporesidente Zuma le badudi ba matjhabeng ka ho tshwela ka mathe ka matla ditlhaselo tsa boferekanyi tsa moraorao tjena tse etsahetseng Beirut (Lebanon), Baghdad (Iraq), Yola (Nigeria) le Paris (Fora), tse bakileng tahlehelo ya bophelo ba batho ba se nang molato le tshenyo ya thepa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isho ngalivi linye naMengameli Zuma kanye nemmango wemave ngemave ekusoleni kakhulu kuhlasela kwemaphekula lokusandza kwenteka eBeirut (eLebanon) eBaghdad (e-Iraq), eYola (eNigeria) kanye naseParis (eFrance), lokuholele ekutseni kuphume imiphefumulo lete licala kanye nekucekelwa phasi kwemphahla.

src: Aforika Borwa e ema e tiile ho tshweleng ka mathe ha yona ha ditlhaselo kaofela tse tobileng badudi ba se nang molato mme e boeletsa mmono wa yona wa hore boferekanyi, ka sebopeho sefe kapa sefe le hore bo tswa hokae, bo keke ba amohelwa.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika ime icinile ekusoleni kwayo konkhe kuhlasela lokucondziswe kubantfu bemmango labangati lutfo isaphindza isasho leme kuko kutsi buphekulasikhuni nome ngabe baluphi luhlobo futsi bentiwa ngubani, ngeke bucolelwe.

src: Kabinete e tshehetsa diketso tsa Komiti ya Matona a Mmuso e mabapi le Kgaello ya Metsi le Komello bakeng sa ho bebofatsa kgahlamelo ya komello le ho kgothaletsa badudi ho sebedisa metsi ka polokeho bakeng sa ho tiisetsa phepelo ya kamoso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakweseka kwenta kweLikomidi Lahulumende Letindvuna Lekuswelakala Kwemanti Nesomiso kunciphisa umphumela lomubi wesomiso kanye nekugcugcutela imimango kutsi isebentise emanti ngekuwongela likusasa.

src: Mmuso o ekeditse ka R96,6 milione ho R352,6 milione ya sethathong ho tshehetsa mekutu ya naha ya ho imolla mathata a komello.
tgt: Hulumende sewengete tigidzi letinge-R96,6 kuleto takucala letinge-R352,6 etigidzi letibekelwe eceleni kutsi tisekele imitamo yalelive yekulwa nesomiso.

src: Sena se kenyeletsa ho rekwa ha ditanka tsa metsi tse 45 bakeng sa ho fuwa dibaka tse amehileng, ho epa dipetse le tlhabollo, papallo ya metsi le ho laola tlhokeho, le ho thusa ka mehlodi.
tgt: Loku kufaka ekhatsi kutsengwa kwemaloli emathangi emanti lange-45 kute aletse emanti kuleto tindzawo letitsintsekile, kugujwa kwemigodzi yekudvonsa emanti, kongiwa kwemanti nekulawula kufuneka kwawo, kanye nekungeta imitfombo lapho kudzabuka khona emanti.

src: Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Dibaka tsa Mahae le Tlhabollo ya Mobu le tla dumella hore ho falliswe mehlape ho tloha dibakeng tse thefulehileng ka ho fetisisa ho iswa mobung oo e leng wa mmuso moo ho ntseng ho na le makgulo a betere.
tgt: Litiko Letekutfutfukisa Kwetindzawo Tasemaphandleni Netingcuku Kutemhlaba kuleto tindzawo letitsintseke kakhulu litawuvumela kususwa kwemfuyo iyiswe emhlabeni wahulumende lapho kusanemadlelo khona lancono.

src: Hodima moo, Lefapha la Kopanelo ya Puso le Merero ya Botjhaba le hokahane le Bomeyara bakeng sa ho kenya tshebetsong ditsela tse fapafapaneng tsa ho baballa metsi tlasa tataiso ya Lefapha la Metsi le Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere.
tgt: Kwengeta kuloko, Litiko Letebusa Ngekubambisana Netendzabuko selichumane nabosodolobha kutsi kucale kusetjentiswe tinyatselo letahlukahlukene tekonga emanti ngaphasi kwekuholwa Litiko Letemanti Nekuhanjiswa Kwekungcola.

src: Tsena di kenyeletsa ho hlahisa dithibelo tsa tshebediso ya metsi ho disa boimatahanyo le dithibelo tsa tshebediso ya metsi ho fana ka dikotlo moo ho hlokahalang ho beha ka sehloohong tokiso ya ho dutla ha metsi ho kgothaletsa dithekenoloji tse hlwahlwa tse jwaloka matlwana a sa sebediseng metsi a mangata ha a hulelwa ho bokella metsi a pula le ho sebedisa metsi a sebeditseng bakeng sa ho nosetsa.
tgt: Loku kufaka ekhatsi imikhawulo yemanti kweluswa kwekutsi iyagcinwa yini imikhawulo yemanti kusetjentiswa kwetigwebo lapho kudzingeka khona, kubeka embili kulungiswa kwetindzawo letivutisa emanti kusetjentiswa kwemathekinoloji longa emanti njengemathoyilethi lasebentisa emanti lamancane, kukhongotela emanti emvula kanye nekusebentisa emanti lamphunga nakuniselwa.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o ile a etella pele kemedi ya Aforika Borwa ho Seboka sa Baetapele ba G20 Antalya, ho la Turkey ho tloha ka la 15 ho isa ka la 16 Pudungwana 2015.
tgt: Mengameli Jacob Zuma uhole litsimba laseNingizimu Afrika kuNgcungcutsela Yebaholi be-G20 e-Antalya eTurkey kusukela mhla ti-15 kuya mhla ti-16 Lweti 2015.

src: Mookotaba wa seboka e ne e le kenyeletso, matsete le ho kenngwa tshebetsong.
tgt: Ingcikitsi yalengcungcutsela bekukadze kubukhukhulelangoco, kutjala timali kekucala kusebentisa.

src: Aforika Borwa e hara dinaha tse 51 tse saenneng Tumello ya Phapanyetsano ya Tlhahisoleseding ya Lekgetho Berlin, ho la Jeremane ka Mphalane 2015.
tgt: Live laseNingizimu Afrika lisemkhatsini wemave lange-51 lasayine Sivumelwane Sekuntjintjiselana Ngekutentekela Ngelwatiso Lwentsela lapha eBerlin eGermany ngeMphala 2015.

src: Dinaha di tla qala ho fapanyetsana tlhahisoleseding ka 2017, e tla hlakiswa ke molao oo hajwale o tekilweng ka hara Palamente.
tgt: Emave atawucala antjintjiselane ngelwatiso nga-2017, lokuyintfo letawuciniswa ngumtsetfo njenganyalo losasePhalamende.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o amohetse qeto ya dintlha tsa tshebetso tse15 tsa G20/Mokgatlo bakeng sa porojeke ya Tshebedisanommoho le Kgoholeho ya Motheo wa Ntshetsopele le ho Suthiswa ha Phaello, tseo di neng di le hlokolosi bakeng sa ho netefatsa ho hloka leeme le ho tiisetsa motheo wa lekeno wa dinaha tse ka Borwa ho Sahara.
tgt: Mengameli Zuma wakwemukela kuphotfulwa kwetintfo lekumele tentiwe leti-15 temklamo we-G20/Inhlangano Yetekusebenta Ngekubambisana Kutemnotfo Nentfuntfuko Nekuntjintja Kwenzuzo, lebetikadze timcoka ekucinisekiseni kutsi imalingena yemave ase-Afrika aseningizimu neSahara iphatfwa ngalokufanele.

src: Ditho tsa Lekgotla la Matona a Kopano ya Makgetho a Madiboho a Aforika e Borwa (SACU) di kopane ka la 11 Pudungwana 2015 Windhoek, ho la Namibia letsatsing le eteletseng pele ho bulwa ha ntlokgolo ya SACU le dipuisano tseo e seng tsa semmuso tsa Dihlooho tsa Dipuso tsa SACU le Mmuso.
tgt: Emalunga Omkhandlu Wetindvuna we-Southern African Customs Union (i-SACU) ahlangana mhla ti-11 Lweti 2015 lapha eWindhoek eNamibia ngembi kwekubekwa ngalokusemtsetfweni kwenhlokohhovisi ye-SACU kanye nekucocisana ngalokungekho emtsetfweni kweTinhloko tembuso te-SACU kanye naHulumende.

src: Lekgotla le sebedisitse monyetla ona bakeng sa ho thuisa kgatelopele e entsweng mabapi le Moralo wa Dintlha tse Tsheletseng esale ho tshwere kopano ya ho qetela le ho toboketsa botjha boitlamo ba bona ho SACLekgotla le dumellane hore SACU e tshwanela ho sebetsa ho fihlella ka nqane ho karolelano ya lekeno ho ya boikitlaetsong ba ntshetsopele bo tla tshehetsa kopanelo ka hara lebatowa.
tgt: Lomkhandlu wasebentisa lelitfuba kutsi ucabange ngemphumelelo leyentiwe mayelana neLisu Lemaphuzu Lasitfupha kusukela kumhlangano wawo wekugcina kanye nekugcizelela kabusha kutinikela kwawo ku-SACLomkhandlu wavumelana ngekutsi i-SACU kufanele kutsi isuke ekwabelananeni ngemalingena iye kutichamukelo tetentfutfuko letitawusekela kuhlangana kulesifundza.

src: Ditho hape di amohetse mmapa le moralo wa dtshebetso o tla lebisa ho seboka se tla tshwarwa ka Phuptjane 2016.
tgt: Emalunga aphindza futsi amukela libalave kanye nelisu lekusebenta macondzana nengcungcutsela letawubanjwa ngeNhlaba 2016.

src: Kabinete e amohela Diphetho tsa Tlhatlhobo tsa 2014-15 tsa mmuso wa naha le wa porofense.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayemukela Imiphumela Yekuhlolwa Kwemabhuku Ya-2014-15 yahulumende wavelonkhe newetifundza.

src: Tlaleho e bontsha ntlafalo e tsitsitseng mabakeng kaofela a diphetho tsa ditlhatlhobo tsa mmuso wa naha le wa porofense.
tgt: Lombiko ukhomba intfutfuko lengantjintji cishe kuto tonkhe tinhlangotsi temiphumela yahulumende wavelonkhe newetifundza.

src: Di bontsha ho lebisa mokgweng o motle wa bolaodi le taolo e imametseng ya ditjhelete le ho matlafatsa bolaodi bo botle ka ha mafapha a mangatanyana a fumane ditlhatlhobo tse hlwahlwa.
tgt: Lombiko ukhomba indlelamkhuba lesimeme mayelana nekuphatsa lokuhle kanye nekuphatfwa kwetimali lokuhleCabine kantsi loko kucinisekisa kuphatsa lokuhle njengaloku ematiko lamanyenti atfole imibiko yetimali lete emacashati.

src: Ntlafalo ena e boela e supa hore mmuso o sebetsa ka thata bakeng sa ho netefatsa boikarabelo dibakeng tsa ona tsohle tsa mosebetsi wa ona.
tgt: Lentfutfuko ikhombisa futsi kutsi hulumende usebenta kamatima kucinisekisa kutilandza kuto tonkhe tindzawo temsebenti wakhe.

src: Ntle le ntlafalo ena, mmuso o entse qeto ya ho tswella ho tshehetsa mafapha a nang le diphuputso tse sa kgahliseng le ho netefatsa hore mafapha oohle a mmuso a sebetsa ho ya ka tebello.
tgt: Nanome kukhona lentfutfuko, hulumende uncume kutsi utawuchubeke asekele lawo matiko lanemibiko lengasimihle kanye nekucinisekisa kutsi wonkhe hulumende usebenta ngalokusezingeni lelisetulu.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho thonngwa ha Moahlodi Mandisa Muriel Maya jwaloka Motlatsi wa Moporesidente wa Lekgotla le Phahameng la Maipiletso ke Moporesidente Zuma ho ya ka karolo 174(4) ya Molaotheo wa Riphaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa the 1996 le Moahlodi Nonkosi Zoliswa Mhlantla jwaloka moahlodi wa Lekgotla la Dinyewe la Molaotheo ho ya ka Karolo 174(3) ya Molaotheo wa Rephaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa 1996 ka tatelano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kukhetfwa nguMengameli Zuma kweLijaji Mandisa Muriel Maya njengeLisekelamengameli Wenkantolo Lenkhulu Yesicelosikhalo ngekulandzela sigaba se-174(4) seMtsetfosisekelo waseRiphabhliki yaseNingizimu Afrika wa-1996 kanye naJustice Nonkosi Zoliswa Mhlantla njengelijaji leNkantolo yeMtsetfosisekelo ngekulandzela Sigaba se-174(3) seMtsetfosisekelo waseRiphabhliki yaseNingizimu Afrika wa-1996.Lokukhetfwa kucinisa kutinikela kweNingizimu Afrika mayelana nekulingana kwebulili ezingeni lelisetulu kantsi loko futsi kuchubela embili luntjintjo kutebulungiswa.

src: Dithonyo tsena di matlafatsa boitlamo ba Aforika Borwa ba tekatekano ya bong maemong a phahameng ka ho fetisisa le ho akofisa phethoho ya makgotla a dinyewe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawahalalisela omabili lamajaji iphindze futsi iwafisele lokuhle emsebenti wawo lobaluleke nakangaka kuTebulungiswa taseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Ngaka S’thembile Ngidi ya entseng nalane ka ho fumana mangolo a thuto ho tswa ho Koletjhe ya tsa Kalafo ya Aforika Borwa jwaloka ngaka ya pele e alafang mofetshe ya mosadi ho tswa KwaZulu-Natal ebile e le wa bobedi feela ka hara naha.
tgt: S’thembile Ngidi locophe umlandvo ngesikhatsi aba ngulomsikati lomnyama wekucala losati semhlata waKwaZulu-Natali lotfole ticu temfundvo takhe eKolishi Letekwelapha laseNingizimu Afrika aphindze futsi abe wesibili kulelive.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Moetsi wa difilimi wa Aforika Borwa Reina-Marie Loader eo tlhakisetso ya hae ‘Horn’ e fumaneng dithoholetso, ho kenyeletsa ho kgethwa bakeng sa Dikgau tsa Paballo ya Ditshukudu tsa 2015 ka Phupu mokgahlelong wa kgau ya Temoso, Thuto le Merero ya Ditjhelete e Hlwahlwa ka ho Fetisisa, le ho hapa kgau bakeng sa Filimi e Hlwahlwa ka ho Fetisisa ya Paballo ya Tlhaho ho Mokete wa Difilimi tsa Matjhaba wa 2015 New York City, ho la Amerika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela umenti wemafilimu waseNingizimu Afrika Reina-Marie Loader idokhumentari yakhe letsi ‘Horn’ lezuze imiklomelo leminyenti, lokufaka ekhatsi kukhetfwa kwayo kuMkomelo Wekongiwa Kwabhejane 2015 ngaKholwane kumkhakha we-Best Awareness, Education and Funding, yazuza umklomelo i-Best Conservation Film ku-2015 International Film Festival eNew York City, eMelika.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona ho lelapa le metswalle ya Motlatsi wa Letona la Metsi le Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere, Ms Pamela Tshwete, ka ho lahlehelwa ke mme wa hae, Mama Ruth Nomzi Zondeki.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa kudzabuka kwayo kumndeni nakubangani beLisekela Lendvuna Yetemanti Nekuhanjiswa Kwekungcola, MkPamela Tshwete, ngekushonelwa ngunina, MkRuth Nomzi Zondeki.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona ho mmuso wa New Zealand, lelapa, metswalle le Mokgatlo wa Rakbi wa New Zealand ka ho lahlehelwa ke kgalala ya rakbi, Jonah Tali Lomu, ya entseng kgahlamelo e matla papading ena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa kudzabuka kwayo kuhulumende waseNew Zealand, umndeni bangani kanye nakuNyonyana Yelicembu Lemboco yaseNew Zealand ngekushona kwesihlabani selibhola lembhoco, Jonah Tali Lomu, lobe nelifutse lelikhulu kulomdlalo.

src: DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di tla lokelwa ke ho netefatswa ha mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang.
tgt: Kubekwa etikhundleniKonkhe kucashwa kuya ngekucinisekiswa kweticu tabo kanye nekuvunywa lokufanele.

src: Katoloso ya Konteraka bakeng sa dilemo tse hlano ya Monghadi Maswahle Diphofa – Motsamaisi Kakaretso (DG): Lefapha la Tshebeletso le Tsamaiso ya Setjhaba.
tgt: Kunwetjwa kweNkontileka ibe minyaka lesihlanu yaMnu Maswahle Diphofa – Umcondzisi Jikelele (i-DG): Litiko Letemisebenti Yahulumende Nekuphatsa.

src: Katoloso ya Konteraka bakeng sa dikgwedi tse leshome le metso e mmedi ya Mofumahadi Nonkululeko Sindane – DG: Lefapha la Toka le Ntshetsopele ya Molaotheo.
tgt: Kunwetjwa kweNkontileka ibe tinyanga leti-12 taMkNonkululeko Sindane – I-DG: Litiko Letebulungiswa Nekutfutfukiswa Kwemtsetfosisekelo.

src: Monghadi Livhuwani Tommy Makhode jwaloka Motlatsi wa Motsamaisi Kakaretso (DDG): Meralo ya Ditheo le Tshehetso ka hara Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji.
tgt: Umnu Livhuwani Tommy Makhode njengeLisekela leMcondzisi Jikelele: Institutional Planning and Support kuLitiko Letesayensi Nethekinoloji.

src: Monghadi Rory Gallocher jwaloka Mohlanka e Moholo wa Phethahatso (CEO) wa Bolaodi ba Taolo ya Matlo a Kahisano.
tgt: Umnu Rory Gallocher njengeSisebenti Lesikhulu se-Social Housing Regulatory Authority.

src: Ngaka Pradish Rampersadh jwaloka Molaodi wa Phethahatso e motjha bakeng sa Lekgotla la Aforika Borwa la Diporofeshene tsa Saense ya Tlhaho.
tgt: Pradish Rampersadh njengeMcondzisi weSigungu lomusha weMkandlu waseNingizimu Afrika weTingcweti Tesayensi.

src: Monghadi Mark Barnes jwaloka CEO wa Sehlopha sa Kantoro ya Poso ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Umnu Mark Barnes njengeMphatsi Lomkhulu weTemaposi aseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Boto ya Banka ya Ntshetsopele ya Aforika e Borwa:i. Monghadi Jabulani Philip Moleketi – (o thontswe hape e le Modulasetulo)ii.
tgt: Ibhodi yeLibhange Lentfutfuko Yemave lase-Afrika lengaseNingizimu:i. Umnu Jabulani Philip Moleketi – (uphindze futsi wakhetfwa futsi unguSihlalo)ii.

src: Monghadi Msokoli Frans Baleni – (o thontswe hape e le Motlatsi wa Modulasetulo)iii.
tgt: Umnu Msokoli Frans Baleni – (uphindze futsi wakhetfwa futsi uLisekela laSihlaloe)iii.

src: Mofumahadi Martie Janse van Rensburg – (Molaodi eo e seng wa Phethahatso)iv.
tgt: MkMartie Janse van Rensburg – (Ungumcondzisi longasilo lilunga leSigungu Lesiphetse)iv.

src: Ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha mananeo a bohlokwa a mmuso.
tgt: Kucala kwekusebenta kwetinhlelo letimcoka tahulumende.

src: Kabinete e amohetswe ho saenwa ha ditumellano tse 26 tsa boleng ba R94 bilione nakong ya Leeto la Puso la haufinyane tjena la Moporesidente wa China Xi Jinping.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukele kusayinwa kwetivumelwane letinge-26 letilinani letigidzigidzi letinge-R94 ngesikhatsi Sekuvakasha Lokusemtsetfweni lokusandza kwentiwa nguMengameli Xi Jinping waseChina.

src: Ditumellano tse saennweng di kenyeleditse R12 bilione bakeng sa ho aha polante ya tlhahiso ya makoloi ka hara Aforika Borwa, thuso ya kadimo ya US$500 milione ho Eskom bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya meralo wa motheo le tiisetso ya thuso ya ditjhelete ya US$2.5 bilione bakeng sa Transnet ho tswa ho Banka ya Ntshetsopele ya China.
tgt: Letivumelwane letisayiniwe tifaka ekhatsi tigidzigidzi leti-R12 tekwakha sakhiwonchanti sekukhicita timoto eNingizimu Afrika, Emadola aseMelika (i-US$) lasigidzi lesinge-$500 esisetjentiswa semalimboleko lecondziswe ku-Eskom yekutfutfukisa sakhiwonchanti kanye nesigidzigidzi semadola aseMelika lange-$2.5 semali lecinisekisiwe yeTransnet levela eBhange Lekutfutfukisa laseChina.

src: Jwaloka karolo ya Foramo ya bo-2 e mabapi le Tshebedisano-mmoho ya China-Aforika (FOCAC), Moporesidente Xi Jinping o entse boitlamo ba US$60 bilione bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya Aforika.
tgt: Njengencenye yeMhlangano we-2 weLubanjiswano lweChi ne-Afrika (i-FOCAC), Mengameli Xi Jinping wetsembise sigidzigidzi semaDola aseMelika lange-$60 sekutfutfukisa i-Afrika.

src: Kamohelo ya Tumellano le Moralo wa Tshebetso wa (2016-2018) ho FOCAC o matlafatsa bosemphato bo ntseng bo hola ba kutlwano pakeng tsa Aforika le China, bo tla bula menyetla e metjha ya kgwebisano le matsete bakeng sa ho rotetsa kgolo ya moruo.
tgt: Kwemukelwa kweSivumelwano neLuhlelo Lwekusebenta lolusha (2016-2018) e-FOCAC kuyahlanganisa kubuye futsi kucinise lobudlelwane lobukhulako lobusemkhatsini we-Afrika neChina, lokutawuvula ematfuba lamasha ekuhweba nelutjalomali lokutawusita kubanga kutsi kukhule umnotfo.

src: Moruo o boetse o fumane matlafatso ya moruo ka tsebiso ya Mokgatlo wa BMW wa Aforika Borwa ya matsete a R6 bilione polanteng ya ona e Rosslyn, ho la Pretoria, e leng bopaki ba semphato sa bohlokwa se teng pakeng tsa dikgwebo le mmuso, le karolo e bapalwang ke dikgwebo ntshetsopeleng ya moruo.
tgt: Umnotfo uchubekile watfola kwesekelwa ngekwemnotfo ngebaka-BMW eNingizimu Afrika labamementele lutjalomali lwetigidzigidzi leti-R6 kusakhiwonchanti sabo lesiseRosslyn, ePitoli, lesibufakazi bekusebentisana lokusemkhatsini webhizinisi nahulumende, kanye nendzima ledlalwa yibhizinisi ekutfutfukiseni umnotfo.

src: Ka Labobedi la, 8 Tshitwe, Moporesidente Zuma o abile Ditlotlo tsa Naha ho baahi ba Aforika Borwa le melata e hlahelletseng ka mahetla ba nyehetseng bakeng sa matlafatso ya batho.
tgt: NgaLesibili, mhla ti-8 Ingongoni, Mengameli Zuma unike takhamuti taseNingizimu Afrika kanye nebekuchamuka emaveni angaphandle labahloniphekile Imiklomelo Yesive labafake ligalelo ekutfutfukisweni kwebantfu.

src: Ditlotlo tsa Naha ke motsotso wa ho sheba morao ho matla, ho keteka le ho ba motlotlo ka batho ba rona.
tgt: Lemiklomelo Yesive asikhatsi lesikhulu sekubuyeketa, sekugubha umkhosi kanye neligcabho lebantfu betfu.

src: Di keteka phihlello ya botho, ho intsha sehlabelo ha botho le maiteko a botho tse etsang hore naha ya rona e be tulo e betere.
tgt: Bagubha umkhosi wekuzuza kwebantfu, kutinikela kwebantfu kanye nemitabo yebantfu leyenta live letfu kutsi libe yindzawo lencono.

src: Re hlompha baamohedi ba Ditlotlo tsa Naha ba 2015.
tgt: Siyabahalalisela lababo laklonyeliswe leMiklomelo Yavelonkhe yanga-2015.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho sebedisa metsi ka paballo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi basebentise emanti ngekuwonga.

src: Sena ke bakeng sa ho tshehetsa mekgwa e nkuweng bakeng sa ho fedisa dikgaello tsa metsi, tse mpefaditsweng ke leqhubu la motjheso le fihlelletsweng ke naha dibekeng tse fetileng.
tgt: Loku kukwesekela tinyatselo letinyenti letitsetfwe kute kutsi kuncishiswe kweswelakala kwemanti, lokubhebhetseliswe ligagasi lekushisa lelive lelihlangabetene nalo kulamaviki lendlulile.

src: Ha dipula tsa moraorao tjena dikarolong tse ding tsa naha di fane ka kimoloho e itseng, kgaello ya metsi ya naha e dula e le phephetso mme e batla hore bohle re sebedise metsi ka paballo le ka boikarabelo.
tgt: Nanoma nje timvula letisandza kuna kuletinye tincenye talelive tiletse kuhhamuleka, kweswelakala kwemanti kulelive kuyachubeka nekuba yinsayeya mbamba futsi kudzinga kutsi sonkhe sisebentise emanti ngekuwonga nangalokunesibopho.

src: Kabinete e hlahisitse kananelo ya yona ho maAforika Borwa kaofela bakeng sa ho nka karolo ho letsholo la Matsatsi a 16 la Thibelo ya Merusu Kgahlanong le Basadi le Bana la selemong sena, le neng le fela ka la 10 Tshitwe 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise kubonga kubo bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika ngekutsi bahlanganyele kuMkankhaso Wemalanga la-16 Ekulwa Nebudlova Lobentiwa kuBomake neBantfwana, laphele itolo.

src: Diphuphutso tsa moraorao di bontsha dipalo tse phahameng tsa ditshwaetso tse ntjha tsa HIV, haholoholo ka hara basadi ba batjha le banana ka hara Aforika ba mahareng a dilemo tse 15 le tse 24.MaAforika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho tswela pele ka tshebetso ya twantsho ena letsatsi ka leng jwaloka karolo ya ho ba le kgahlanong le Merusu ho Basadi le Bana ya #365 Days Campaign le ya #CountMeIn le tla tswela pele ho phatlalla le selemo se tlang.
tgt: Lucwaningo lwakwamuva lukhombisa emanani lamakhulu etehlakalo letinsha tekungenwa yisandvulelangculazi (i-HIV), ikakhulu kubomake labasesebancane nemantfombatana e-Afrika labasemkhatsini weminyaka yebudzala le-15 nalenge-24.Bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bakutsatwa kutsi bachubeke nekulwa kwabo kube kwa-onkhe emalanga njengencenye yemklamo we#365 Days Campaign Wekulwa Nebudlova Lobentiwa kuBomake neBantfwana kanye nemklamo we- #CountMeIn lochubekela emnyakeni lotako.

src: Ka ho sebedisa #365 Days Campaign le #CountMeIn, naha e hloka ho tswela pele ho ngoka ditho tsa setjhaba, haholoholo banna, hore ba kopanye matsoho le mmuso bakeng sa ho sebetsana le koduwa WEBTOKEN boikarabelo ba setjhaba, bobedi ka bonngwe le ka kopanelo, ho kgina ho ata ha kokwanahloko ka ho ela hloko bophelo ba rona bo botle le ba ba bang.
tgt: Ngalomkhankhaso we-#365 Days Campaign kanye ne-#CountMeIn, lelive lifanele kutsi lichubeke ligcogce emalunga emmango, ikakhulu emadvodza, kutsi abambisane nahulumende ekubukaneni nalolubhubhane.

src: Kabinete e ananetse kgatelopele e seng e entswe ke Lekgotla la Diphuputso tsa Saense le Indaseteri bakeng sa ho ntshetsapele tsamaiso ya tlhahiso ya tsa tlhaho ya masole a lwantshang HIV.
tgt: Kusibopho sesive, semuntfu ngamunye nangekubambisana, kutsi kuvinjwe kwandza kwaleligciwane ngekutsi sinakekele temphilo yetfu kanye nentalabanye.

src: Sena se tlisa indaseteri ya kalafo haufi le pheko ya thibelo e sa bitsing tjhelete e ngata.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayitfokotela inchubekela embili leyentiwe nguMkandlu Welucwaningo Lwetesayensi Netimboni (i-CSIR) ekwenteni inchubo yekukhicita emasotja emtimba e-HIV kulokuphilako.

src: Ha naha e ntse e sokola ho fumana pheko ya HIV le AIDS, maAforika Borwa a ntse a lebeletswe ho etsa thobalano e bolokehileng le ho tsitlallela dipehelo tsa ABC (Abstain, Be faithful and Condomise) bakeng sa ho thibela ditshwaetso tse ntjha.
tgt: Loku kusondzeta imboni yetemphilo dvutane kakhulu nemakhambi ekwelapha ekuvikela langabiti kakhulu.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa kaofela baithuti, barutwana, matitjhere, barupelli, le dikolo le ditheo tsa thuto e phahameng ka ho phethela selemo se atlehileng sa dithuto, ho sa natswe diphephetso tse fihlelletsweng hara selemo.
tgt: Lapho lelive lisashikashikeka nekutfola likhambi lekwelapha i-HIV nengculazi (i-AIDS, bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika baseselindzeleke kutsi baye emacansini ngalokuphephile baphindze futsi bagcine imitsetfomgomo ya-ABC (Ungayi emacasini, Yetsembeka kanye neKufaka ikhondomu) yekuvikela tehlakalo letinsha tekungenwa ligciwane.6 IKhabhinethi incoma bonkhe bafundzi, titjudeni, bothishela, bothishela basemanyuvesi, tikolwa kanye netikhungo temfundvo lephakeme ngekuphetsa umnyaka wekufundza loyimphumelo, nanoma nje kube netinsayeya lekuhlangabetwene nato ekuhambeni kwemnyaka.

src: Kabinete hape e lakaletsa tse molemo ditlhatlhobong tse tlang tsa 2016 ho ba dumetseng hore ditlhatlhobo di tjhetjhiswe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi futsi ibafisela lokuhle eluhlolweni lwabo lolutako labo labavuma kuhlehlisa tinhlolo tekuphela kwemnyaka batihlelela kutsi tibhalwe nga-2016.

src: Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba, ka tshebedisano-mmoho le Lefapha la Tshireletso le Lekala la Naha la Ntshetsopele ya Batjha (NYDA), le tla tshwara Kampo ya Batjha ya bo-6.
tgt: Litiko Letekutfutfukiswa Kwetenhlalakahle, libambisene neLitiko Letekuvikela ne-Ejensi Yekutfutfukisa Lusha Yavelonkhe (i-NYDA), litawumba Inkhomfa Yelusha Yavelonkhe ye-6.

src: Sena ke lenaneo la ntshetsopele ya boetapele ba batjha le rerileng ho fetola boitshwaro, mmono wa bophelo le ho matlafatsa batjha ka menyetla e teng eo ba ka e tholang.
tgt: Lolu luhlelo lwekutfutfukisa baholi belusha lolufuna kugucula indlela yekutiphatsa, timongcondvo kanye nekuhlomisa lusha ngematfuba labangawasebentisa.

src: Kampo e thusa hape ka ho lekola le ho ruta bashemane ba batjha ho hola hore e be banna ba ananelang le ho hlompha basadi.
tgt: Lenkhomfa iphindze futsi isite ngekulandzelela nefundzisa bafana labancane mayelana nekutsi bakhule babe ngemadvodza labenta bomake ligugu babuye futsi babahloniphe.8 Sivumelwano lesihlanganyelwe lesisayiniwe lesisemkhatsini weNdvuna Yetemfundvo Lephakeme neKucecesha Indvuna, Dkt.

src: Tumellano e saenetsweng ka kopanelo pakeng tsa Letona la Thuto e Phahameng le Thupello, Ngaka Blade Nzimande, le bomphato ba BRICS – Brazil, Russia, India le China – e reretswe ho ntshetsapele moralo bakeng sa tshebedisano ya bokamoso thutong.
tgt: Blade Nzimande, nebahlanganyeli be-BRICS – iBrazil, iRussi, i-India neChina – sihlose ekwakheni luhlakamsebenti lwekubambisana kutemfundvo eskhatsini lesitako.

src: Tumellano e akaretsa thuto ya kakaretso, lewa la leano la thuto, Dikoletjhe tsa Thuto le Thupello ya Tekginiki le Mesebetsi (TVET) le thuto e phahameng.
tgt: Lesivumelwane sifaka ekhatsi imfundvo jikelele, indlelalisu yenchubomgomo yetemfundvo, Emakolishi Ekufundzela Umsebenti (TVET) netemfundvo lephakeme.

src: Dikoletjhe tsa TVET di na le bokgoni ba ho bula menyetla ya moruo bakeng sa batho ba batjha, ha ho ntse ho sebetsanwa le diphephetso tsa tlhokeho ya mesebetsi, ho se lekalekane, le bofuma bo amang badudi.
tgt: Emakolishi e-TVET anemandla ekuvula ematfuba etemnotfo ebantfu bentfu labasesebancane, kube kubukwana nensayeya yekungacashwa, kungalingani nebuphuya lobukhatsata imimango.

src: Tumellano ena, e tla ntlafatsa boleng ba thuto le thuto ya matitjhere, hape e tlama diyunivesithi tsa BRICS ho tshehetsa diporojeke tse kopanetsweng tsa diphuputso, ho kgothaletsa mananeo a tshebedisano-mmoho maemong a dithuto tsa kamora yunivesithi, a bongaka le a dithuto tsa kamora bongaka le ho phatlalatsa mmoho diphetho tsa merero ya tsa saense.
tgt: Lesivumelwane, lesitawuphucula lizinga lekufundzisa nemfundvo yabothishela, siphindze futsi sente kutsi emanyuvesi e-BRICS esekele imiklamo yelucwaningo yelubanjiswano, ikhutsate tinhlelo telubanjiswano emazingeni e-postgraduate, doctoral newe-postdoctoral kanye nekushicelelwa ngekubambisana imiphumela yetesayensi.

src: Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji le ne le tshwere Foramo ya Saense ya Aforika Borwa tlasa mookotaba “Re hotetsa dipuisano ka saense”.
tgt: Litiko Letesayensi Netheknoloji langenisa Umhlangano Wetesayensi YaseNingizimu Afrika ngaphansi kwengcikitsi: “Kulumeka tingcoco mayelana netesayensi”.

src: Dinaha tse fetang 45 di ile tsa kenela dingangisano tse mabapi le tshebedisano mahareng a saense, thekenoloji le ntlafatso le setjhaba, haholoholo ntlheng ya ntshetsopele.
tgt: Angetulu kwe-45 emave lahlanganyela kutinkhulumomphikiswano letimayelana nekuchumana kwesayensi, itheknoloji, kwenta lokusha kanye nemmango ikakhulu engcikitsini yetekutfutfuka.

src: Foramo hape e sebeditse bakeng sa ho matlafatsa lewa la saense, thekenoloji le semphato sa ntjhafatso la matjhaba la Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lomhlangano wabuye wacinisa budlelwane betendlelalisu yetesayensi yaseNingizimu Afrika, itheknoloji nekwenta lokusha.10 INingizimu Afrika itawumelelwa kuMkandlu Wetinhlangano Letibukene Netaselwandle.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla emelwa ho Lekgotla la Matjhaba la Mokgatlo wa Mawatle.
tgt: Lesi sinyatselo lesikhulu sekuzuza emandla lakhona kulelive kanye newalelivekati emkhakheni wetaselwandle.

src: Sena ke mohato wa bohlokwa ho isa moo re tla bonang bokgoni ba naha le kontinente lekaleng la tsa mawatle.
tgt: Lenhlangano inesibopho sekwemukela tincumo etindzabeni tetelwandle temhlaba, kusukela kuMnotfo Waselwandle, imitamo yekutakula kanye netindzaba tekuphepha nekuvikeleka elwandle.

src: Mokgatlo ona o ikarabella bakeng sa ho amohela diqeto tse mabapi le merero ya lefatshe ya tsa mawatle, ho tloha ho Moruo wa Mawatle, boikitlaetso ba pholoso le mabaka a polokeho le tshireletso lewatleng.
tgt: Kuhlanganyela kwalenhlangano kutawusita luhlelo lwahulumende ekuvuleni emandla etelwandle alelive ngekweNdlelalisu yeMnotfo weBlue Oceans ne-Operation Phakisa, lehlose kwakha imisebenti lengetulu kwesigidzigidzi nga-2033.‎1.11 Umbutfo Wetekuvikela Wavelonkhe waseNingizimu Afrika kuleliviki leliphelile ucale inchubo yekuphucula Siteshi Semphi Yaselwandle Sihlenge saseSalisbury eDurban kutsi sibe sikhungo setemphi yaselwandle lesisebenta ngalokuphelele.

src: Bonkakarolo setheong sena bo tla tshehetsa lenaneo la mmuso la ho bula bokgoni ba naha ka Lewa la Moruo wa Mawatle le Operation Phakisa, tse rerileng ho hlahisa mesebetsi e fetang milione ka 2033.‎.
tgt: Kuphuculwa kwalesikhungo kutawenta kancono emakhono etekuvikela kuphindze futsi kufake ligalelo ekutfutfukiseni umnotfo waselwandle.12 Litiko Letemphilo, libambisene neSoul City neTimes Media, letfule ishaneli yetemphilo neyendlela yekuphila i-The Good Life Network ku-DStv shaneli-199.

src: Lebotho la Naha la Aforika Borwa le qadile ka tsamaiso ya ho hlabolla Seteishene sa Sehlekehleke sa Lebotho la Lewatle sa Salisbury se Durban ho ba kampo ya lebotho la lewatle e sebetsang ka botlalo.
tgt: Leshaneli iniketa, kutijabilisa lokwehlukahlukene nekudlanchanti lokunemaseko lamatsatfu kwasekhaya, temphilo nemtimba locinile, emalungelo eluntfu, temacasi telusha, i-HIV nesifo semaphaphu (i-TB), kanye nemalungelo ebatsengi newebulili.

src: Thlabollo ya dibaka tsena e tla ntlafatsa bokgoni ba tshireletso le ho nyehela bakeng sa moruo wa mawatle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bayibukele leshaneli.

src: Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle, ka kopanelo le Soul City le Times Media, le thakgotse kanale e reretsweng tsa bophelo bo botle le mokgwa wa bophelo ya Good Life Network ho DStv kanaleng ya 199.
tgt: Tincumo teKhabhineti letibalulekile.1 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kweMtsetfo Lodzingidvwako lomayelana neMshwalwensi Wetemphilo Wavelonkhe (i-NHI) weNingizimu Afrika, kutsi ummango uphawule ngawo.

src: Kanale ena e fana ka dikateng tse fapafapaneng, tse thabisang le ho ba tse hlahisitsweng lapeng mabapi le phepo, bophelo bo botle le ho kwena, ditokelo tsa botho, tsa motabo ho batjha, HIV le TB, mmoho le ditokelo tsa bareki le tsa bong.
tgt: Itawutfola imali emalini lehlanganisiwe lekutawuphindze futsi kwentiwe kutsi iytfolwe nangulabasebenta ngetimphilo bangasese labafuna kuhlanganyela kulesikimu.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ho boha kanale ena.
tgt: Naseyiphetsiwe, lenchubomgomo itawetfulwa eminyekeni lemitsatfu futsi igcile kakhulu ekutsini icale etindzaweni letingatfoli tinsita.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho phatlalatswa ha Pampiri e Tshweu ya Inshorense ya Naha ya Bophelo bo Botle (NHI) ya Aforika Borwa, hore setjhaba se tshwaele.
tgt: Aaron Motsoaledi, lamuhla utawukhuluma nebetindzaba mayelana nekwetfulwa kwe-NHI.2 IKhabhinethi iyivumile Inchubomgomo Lehlanganisiwe Yekutfutfukisa Bokhewana (i-ECD).Lenchubomgomo yentiwa ngekubonisana nalabanye labatsintsekako kulomkhakha.

src: Leano lena le sisinya bokgoni ba mmuso ba ho fana ka ditshebeletso tsa bongaka ho bohle ba etelang dikaho tsa kalafo.
tgt: Lenchubomgomo ye-ECD lehlanganisiwe itawucinisekisa kutsi bonkhe bantfwana labancane kanye nebanakekeli babo bayakhona kufinyelela tinsita te-ECD letiphelele kusukela ekucaleni bate baye kuLibanga Lenchubomgomo ichubela lensita kubantfwana labaneminyaka lesiphohlongo labanebulukhunu bekukhula.

src: Le tla tshehetswa ka ditjhelete ka letlole la bohareng leo hape le tla ba teng ho dingaka tsa poraefete tse batlang ho nka karolo sekemeng sena.
tgt: Lenchubomgomo iyachubeka iniketa luhlakamsebenti lwekulandzelela nekuhlola kucinisekisa kutsi ifezekiswa ngalokuyimphumelelo kubo bonkhe bantfwana ngekunganaki buhlanga, bulili noma inkholo.3 IKhabhinethi iwuvumile Umtsetfo Lodzingidvwako lomayelana Nemalungelo Ebantfu Labaphila Nekukhubateka kanye neSimo Sekufezekiswa kwawo.

src: Hang ha ho se ho phethetswe tsohle, leano le tla kenngwa tshebetsong ho ya jwalo le dilemo le ho tsepamisa maikutlo haholo hore le qale dibakeng tse fumanang ditshebeletso tse nyane.
tgt: Loku kuhambisana neMigomo Yekutfutfukisa Lechubekela Embili Ngalokungenamkhawulo lefaka ekhatsi labakhubatekile, leyemukelwa nguMhlangano Jikelele Wamhlabuhlangene (i-UN) (i-UNGA) ngeNyoni 2015.Lenchubomgomo itawusheshisa tingucuko kanye nekulungisa mayelana nekufaka ekhatsi ngalokuphelele, kuhlanganisa kanye nekulingana kwebantfu labakhubatekile.4 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kweNchubomgomo Yekuhanjiswa Kwendle Yavelonkhe kute kutsi ummango uphawule ngayo.

src: Letona la Bophelo bo Botle, Ngaka Aaron Motsoaledi, kajeno le tla tsebisa boraditaba ka phano ya NHKabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Leano le Kopanetsweng la Naha la Ntshetsopele ya Thuto ya Qalo ya Bana (ECD).Leano lena le hlahisitswe ka ditherisano le bankakarolo ba fapafapaneng ka hara lekala lena.
tgt: Lenchubomgomo ibeka inhlalakahle yebantfu ekutfutfukeni lokubalulekile ngekwenta kutsi kube khona kusimama emkhatsini wekwabiwa kwemitfombolusito yekwesekela lutjalomali emazingeni laphakeme etinsita, inikete tinsita kumakhaya langatfoli tinsita, ibe futsi igcina esimeni lesifanele iphindze futsi ilungise takhiwonchanti tekuhanjiswa kwendle letikhona.5 IKhabhinethi ikuvume kutsi kwetfulwe ePhalamende yaseNingizimu Afrika Umbiko we-5 Wesikhatsi Lesibekiwe (2009-2014) lomayelana neKufezekiswa Kwenkhomfa lemayelana Nekupheliswa kwato tonkhe Tinhlobo Telubandlululo lolwentiwa kuBomake.

src: Le ile la sekasekwa ka ditherisano le setjhaba ka Tlhakola 2015.Leano le kopanetsweng la ECD le tla netefatsa hore bana bohle ba banyenyane le bahlokomedi ba bona ba kgona ho fihlella ditshebeletso tse pharalletseng tsa ECD ho tloha tswalong ho fihla ho Kereiti ya Leano lena le atolosetsa tshebeletso ho bana ba dilemo tse robedi ba nang le mathata a kgolo.
tgt: Lombiko uniketa sibutsetelo sekusebenta ngemphumelelo kwemitsetfo, tinchubomgomo netinhlelo letifezekisiwe nekugcamisa lokuzuzwe ngulelive ekuhlonyisweni kwabomake nekulingana ngebulili.

src: Leano ho ya pele le fana ka moralo wa peho leihlo le tekolo ho netefatsa hore le kenngwa tshebetsong ka bokgabane ho banabohle ho sa kgathallwe morabe, bong kapa bodumedi.
tgt: Lombiko uphindze futsi ubeke kutsi kusesenetinsayeya letingaphelimandla netihibe ekulweni kuncotjwe kungalingani kanye nelubandlululo kulelive.6 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kweLuhlaka lweLisu Lekusebenta Lavelonkhe leKulwa Nelubandlululo, Kubandlulula ngekwelibala, Kutondza bachamuki kanye neKungabeketelelani Lokuphatselene nako, kute kutsi ummango uphawule ngalo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Pampiri e Tshweu ya Ditokelo tsa Batho ba phelang ka Boqhwala le Moralo wa ho kenngwa tshebetsong.
tgt: Loluhlelo luyindlelalisu yavelonkhe lehlanganisiwe nalehlelekile lekuhloswe ngayo kutsi kuliwe nekubandlulula futsi kwakhiwe iNingizimu Afrika yentsandvo yelinyenti mbamba lengabandlululani futsi nalengabandlululani ngekwebulili.

src: Sena se matahantswe ho Merero ya Ntshetsopele ya Moshwelella e kenyeletsang ya boqhwala, e amohetsweng ke Kopano Kakaretso (UNGA) ya Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) ka Loetse 2015.Leano le tla akofisa diphethoho le ditokiso tse mabapi le kenyeletso e tletseng, kopanelo le tekatekano bakeng sa batho ba phelang ka boqhwala.
tgt: Luniketa luhlakamsebenti lwetinyatselo letichumene naletichubekela embili ngalokungenamkhawulo letifanele kutsi titsatfwe ngulelive lonkhe liphelele libukane nemshiyandvuku welubandlululo nekubandlulula ngekwelibala.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Leano la Naha la Dikgwerekgwere bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: Loku kusita iNingizimu Afrika kutsi ihlangabetane netibopho tayo temave emhlaba, tesigodzi netavelonkhe, ikakhulu Sifungo saseDurban neLuhlelo Lwekusebenta lolwemukelwa yi-UN kuNkhomfa Yemhlaba lwekulwa neLubandlululo nga-20.7 IKhabhinethi yatiswa ngenchubekela embili yeluhlelo lwekuntjintjela ekusakateni ngekwedijithali.

src: Leano lena le beha ho phela hantle ha setjhaba bohareng ba ntshetsopele ka ho tlisa botsitso mahareng a ho aba mehlodi ya ditjhelete bakeng sa ho tshehetsa matsete ho tshebeletso e phahameng, phano ya ditshebeletso ho malapa a sa sebeletsweng hantle, ha ka nqa e nngwe ho baballwa le ho ntlafatsa meralo ya motheo e ntseng e le teng.
tgt: Ikuvumile kucala kwesikhatsi lesifishane lapho khona tinkhomba tekusakata ngekwedijithali ne-analogi kutawusebenta kanyekanye ngembi kwekutsi kucishwe i-analogi eNingizimu Afrika mhla lu-1 ngeNdlovana 2016.Kusuka ekusakateni ngekwe-analogi kuyiwe kutinsita tekusakata ngekwedijithali kukhulula emagagasi emsakato wemoya ladzingeka kakhulu lafanele tinsita letihambako letisebenta ngekushesha.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana bakeng sa ho kenngwa Palamenteng ha Tlaleho ya Dinako tse itseng ya bo-5 ya Aforika Borwa (2009-2014) ya ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Khonvenshene e mabapi le Phediso ya Mefuta yohle ya Kgethollo kgahlanong le Basadi.
tgt: Loku kutawukhuphula lizinga lekucudzelana kwemnotfo waseNingizimu Afrika ngekutsi kwente kancono imboni yetekusakata, kucinise imboni lekhicita ema-elekthroniki, kwakhe imisebenti, kubuye futsi kwakhe lokunyenti lokucuketfwe kwendzawo nalokwehlukahlukene.8 IKhabhinethi yatisiwe ngalokutfolwe nguMbiko Wetesayensi, Tinkhomba Tekwenta Lokusha Netetheknoloji WaseNingizimu Afrika wanga-2014 kanye netindlela letikhona ekusebenteni kwenchubo Yalokusha Yavelonkhe (i-NSI), lokukhishwa njalo ngemnyaka nguMkandlu Webaluleki Wavelonkhe Kutekwakha Lokusha.

src: Tlaleho ena e fana ka kakaretso ya bohlwahlwa ba letoto la melao, maano le mananeo a kentsweng tshebetsong le ho hlakisa diphihlello tsa naha mabapi le matlafatso ya basadi le tekatekano ya bong.
tgt: Lombiko usebentisa tinkhomba letibalulekile kuhlola kusebenta neligalelo lelifakwa yi-NSI etintfweni tavelonkhe letihamba embili letibekwe kuLUhlelo Lwekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe (i-NDP) nalamanye emadokhumenti enchubomgomo lafaka ligalelo ekutfutfukiseni umnotfo netenhlalo.

src: Tlaleho hape e ananela hore ho na le diphephetso le ditshita tse ntseng di le teng bakeng sa ho hlola ho se lekalekane le kgethollo ka hara naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kuhlelwa kabusha kwetigodzi tamantji kute kutsi tisebente kancono eLimpopo naseMpumalanga, kanye nesikhundla seNkantolo Yamantji yaseLephalale njengesihlalo seDivishini yeLimpopo yeNkantolo Lephakeme, njengesilungiso sesikhashana kute kube ngulapho sekwakhiwe sihlalo lesehlukile sendzawo salomphelo saleDivishini.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Moralo wa Naha wa Tshebetso bakeng sa ho Lwantsha Bomorabe, Kgethollo ya Merabe, Lehloyo la Melata le ho hloka mamellano, bakeng sa hore setjhaba se tshwaele.
tgt: Lokuhlelwa kabusha kwenkantolo yesigodzi yamantji kanye netindzawo letingaphasi kwalamaDivishini eNkantolo Lephakeme kuyincenye yekulungiswa kwalenchubomgomo lekuhloswe ngayo kutsi ilungise umshiyandvuku loko lokungesibo bulungiswa bendzawo besikhatsi lesendlulile.

src: Moralo ona ke lewa le kopanetsweng le ho hlohlomiswa ka morero wa ho lwantsha bomorabe le ho aha Aforika Borwa ya demokerasi ya nnete e hlokang bomorabe le kgethollo ka bong.
tgt: Kuphindze futsi kube yincenye yesibophelelo lesikhulu seluntjintjo lsekwenta kancono kufinyelela bulungiswa, lokuhambisana neMtsetfosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika wanga-19.10 IKhabhinethi iwuvumile umbiko lomayelana nenchubekela embili macondzana nekufezekiswa kweticondziso temtsetfo teKhabhinethi eLimpopo ngekwemibandzela yeSigaba 100 (1)

src: E fana ka moralo bakeng sa mekgwa ya moshwelella o hokahantsweng o lokelang ho etswa ke naha ka bophara ho sebetsana le lefa la bomorabe le kgethollo ya merabe.
tgt: mhla tinge-31 Indlovulenkhulu 2016 kulamatiko aseLimpopo lalandzelako: Temphilo Tekutfutsa Temisebenti Yahulumende Temigwaco Nesakhiwonchanti neTemafa.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka kgatatelopele e seng e entswe mabapi le lenaneo la ho fallela ho mokgwa wa dijithale.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphindze yavuma kususwa ngalokunembandzela kweSigaba 100 (1)

src: E tjhaelletse monwna qalo ya nako ya ho kgantshwa habedi ha tumello ya kgaso ya dijithale ka hara Aforika Borwa ka la 1 Tlhakola 2016.Ho falla ho tloha ho ditshebeletso tsa kgaso tsa analoko ho ya ho tsa kgaso ya dijithale ho lokolla mokgwa o batlehang haholo wa maqhubu a radio a loketseng bakeng sa phano ya ditshebeletso tsa kgaso tse phatlaletseng.
tgt: kuTemfundvo kute kuvulele Umgcinimafa Wesifundza indlela yekutsi afezekise ngemphumelelo Sigaba 18 seMtsetfo Wekulawulwa Kwetimali Tesive, 1999 (Umtsetfo 1 wanga-1999) kuLitiko Letemfundvo laseLimpopo, ngekwelekelelwa litiko letemfundvo lavelonkhe.

src: Sena se tla eketsa bophehisani ba moruo wa Aforika Borwa ka ho tsoseletsa indaseteri ya kgaso, ho matlafatsa diindaseteri tse hlahisang disebediswa tsa elektroniki, ho hlahisa mesebetsi, le ho ntshetsapele dikateng tsa kgaso tsa lehae le tse fapafapaneng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi itivumile leticondziso letilandzelako kuNdvuna Yesifundza nebaphatsisatiko (abo-MEC) beteTimali neTemfundvo:a) Kwengeta tisebenti kumatiko esifundza ngekutsi kufunwe tisebenti letinemakhonob) Kuphetsa kubekwa etikhundleni kwebaphatsi labakhuli kanyec) Nekubukana ngemandla nangemphumelelo nekwehluleka kwebaholi nenkhohlakalo.11 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kutsi iNingizimu Afrika ingenise Inkhomfa yelizinga leliphakeme Yekulwa Netidzakamiva kusukela mhla ti-11 kuya kumhla ti-12 Indlovulenkhulu 2016, letawube ingaphansi kweLubumbano Lwe-Afrika (i-AU).Loku kutawusebenta njengesikhatsi sekulandzelela seMhlangano Wekulwa Netindzakamiva weRussia ne-Afrika, lohlose kwetfula simo lesihlanganene mayelana nekubukana nelenkinga yetidzalamiva yemhlaba.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka diphihlello tsa Tlaleho ya Matshwao a Ntlafatso ya Aforika Borwa ya Saense le Thekenoloji ya 2014 tse ntseng di etsahala tshebetsong ya Tshebeletso ya Naha ya Ntlafatso (NSI), e hlahiswang selemo ka seng ke Lekgotla la Naha la Boeletsi ka Ntlafatso.
tgt: Loku kutawetfulwa eMhlanganweni Lokhetsekile we-UNGA ngaMabasa 2016.Kulwa netidzakamiva letingekho emtsetfweni kuhambisana ne-NDP kantsi futsi loMhlangano utawuniketa inkhundla yekutsi kuchutjekwe kwentiwe kancono Luhlelo Lolukhulu Lwetidzakamiva Lwavelonkhe (2013-2017).12 IKhabhinethi imvumile kutsi Litiko Lekuhlaliswa Kwebantfu libambisane neLuhlelo Lwekuhlaliswa Kwebantfu Lwe-UN lingenise “Tingucuko Letihola Embili eDolobheni: Inkhommfa Yetekusuka Emikhukhwini Kuyiwe Etindzaweni Tekuhlalisa Bantfu Letifaka Ekhatsi Konkhe, Letiphephile, Letimela Tonkhe Timo, Naletichubekela Embili Ngalokungenamkhawulo, ngeNdlovana 2016.Lenkhomfa yesekela kokubili i-ajenda yekutfutfukisa yavelonkhe kanye ne-ajenda yekutfutfukisa emakhaya ngekucinisa kweselwa kweMgomo we-11 weMigomo Yekutfutfukisa Lechubekela Embili Ngalokungenamkhawulo.

src: Tlaleho e sebedisa matshwao a hlokolosi bakeng sa ho lekola tshebetso le nyehelo ya NSI ho dintlha tse ka sehloohong tsa naha jwaloka ha di hlahisitswe ho Morero wa Naha wa Ntshetsopele (NDP) le ditokomaneng tse ding tsa leano tse nyehelang ho ntshetsopele ya moruo wa kahisano.
tgt: Kwenta emadolobha lamakhulu nekuhlaliswa kwebantfu kufake ekhatsi konkhe aphephe, emelanine netimo tonkhe futsi achubekele emnbili ngalokungenamkhawulo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho hlophiswa botjha ha ditereke tsa bomakgiseterata bakeng sa Limpopo le Mpumalanga, le ho theha Lekgotla la Dinyewe la Makgiseterata la Lephalale jwaloka tulo ya Karolo ya Lekgotla le Phahameng la Limpopo, jwaloka mokgwa wa nakwana ho fihlela ho ahuwa Karolo ya tulo ya moshwelella sebakeng seo.
tgt: Lenkhomfa yenta incenye yetingcoco letimayelana nekufezekisa i-Ajenda Yekutfutfukisa Ye-UN yangemuva kwa-2015 kanye "ne-Ajenda Yasedolobheni Lensha” letawemukelwa yi-UN nga-20.13 IKhabhinethi ivumile kutsi Umkhandlu Welucwaningo Wetekulima ungenise Inkhomfa Yemave Emhlaba Lemayelana Nelucwaningo Kutekulima Kutekutfutfukisa ye-3 ngaMabasa 2016.

src: Ho hlophiswa botjha ha ditereke tsa bomakgiseterata le dibaka tsa tshebetso tsa Dikarolo tsa Lekgotla le Phahameng la Dinyewe ke karolo ya ho fetola maano ka morero wa lokisa botjha lefa la ho hloka toka la mehleng la ho aha dibaka tsa bodulo.
tgt: Lenkhomfa itawukhomba: lucwaningo lwemave emhlaba kanye nekwenta lokusha lokuhamba embili enchubeni yekwenta lokusha kute kutsi kuzuzwa kwemigomo yekutfutfukisa yesikhatsi lesitako, ikakhulu yemindeni lelimako nemimango lephuyile.

src: ya Molaotheo.
tgt: Imitsetfosivivinyo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho hulwa ha Karolo 100 (1)
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekuhlelwa Kwendzawo Yaselwandle wanga-2015 kute kutsi ummango uphawule ngawo.

src: ka 31 Tlhakubele 2016 mafapheng a porofense a Limpopo a latelang: Bophelo bo Botle Dipalangwang Mesebetsi ya Setjhaba Ditsela le Meralo ya motheo le la Matlotlo.
tgt: Lomtsetfosivivinyo uniketa luhlakamsebenti lwekuvula emandla emnotfo waselwandle ngekukhutsata kubambisana ekuhleleni indzawo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ditaelo tse latelang ho Tonakgolo le diMEC tsa Ditjhelete le Thuto:a) Matlafatso ya mafapha a porofense ka ho thaotha basebeletsi ba hlwahlwab) Ho phethela ho thonngwa ha batho bakeng sa mesebetsi ya batsamaisi ba ka sehloohong lec) Ho sebetsana ka matla le ho hloleha ha boetapele le bobodu.
tgt: Ubonakala sengatsi utfutfukisa kusebentisana kanye nekuhleleka kwekwengamela lwandle ngalokunesibopho.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana hore Aforika Borwa e tshware Khonferense ya Dipuisano tse Kgahlanong le Dithethefatsi ya maemo a hodimo ho tloha ka la 11 ho isa ka la 12 Tlhakubele 2016, e tla ba tlasa bolaodi ba Kopano ya Aforika.
tgt: Imikhosi letakoMengameli Zuma utawuhola Lusuku Lwemkhosi Wekucolelana Nekubuyisana mhla ti-16 Ingongoni ePort Elizabeth, eMphumalanga Kapa ngaphansi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Kuvala kwehlukana ekhatsi: Kwakha sive saseNingizimu Afrika lesibumbene ekubeni sive lesitfutfukako kuvelonkhe."

src: Sena se sebetsa jwaloka kopano ya ho tswellisa Dipuisano tse Kgahlanong le Dithethefatsi tsa Russia le Aforika, ka morero wa ho fana maemo a kopanetsweng mabapi le ho lwantsha bothata ba lefatshe ba dithethefatsi.
tgt: Indvuna Yetakhiwonchanti Tetekuchumanisa Netinsita Teliposi, Dkt.

src: Sena se tla tekwa ho Kopano e Ikgethang ya UNGA ka Mmesa 2016.Ntwa kgahlanong le dithethefatsi tse seng molaong e tsamaellana le NDP mme Dipuisano di tla fana ka lepatlelo la ho tswela pele ho matlafatsa Moralo Wa Naha o ka Sehloohong wa Dithethefatsi wa (2013-2017).
tgt: Siyabonga Cwele, utawuhola litsimba laseNingizimu Afrika ku-UNGA kuNgcungcutsela Yemhlaba Yenhlangano Yelwatiso (i-WSIS) kusuka mhla ti-15 kuya kumhla ti-16 Ingongoni 2015, lapho khona kutawetfulwa kuma kwelive laseNingizimu Afrika, ekufakeni ligalelo Ekungabini khona Kwemaphepha WSIS+.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana hore Lefapha la Bodulo ba Batho le tshware mmoho le Lenaneo la UN la Bodulo ba Batho Khonferense ya “Re etella pele Diphethoho ka hara Motsemoholo: Ho tloha Bodulong bo Bohlaswa ho ya ho Bodulo ba Batho bo kenyeletsang, bo bolokehileng, bo Hlwahlwa le ba Moshwelella”, ka Tlhakubele 2016.Khonferense e tshehetsa ka bobedi lenaneo la matjhaba la ntshetsopele le la ntshetsopele ya lehae ka ho matlafatsa tshehetso bakeng sa Morero 11 wa Merero ya Ntshetsopele ya Moshwelella: Ho etsa metsemeholo le bodulo ba batho hore e be e kenyeletsang, e bolokehileng, e hlwahlwa le ho ba ya moshwelella.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika ingenise ngemphumelelo Ingcungcutsela Yemadolobhakati Ase-Afrika ye-7 yemadolobhakati nabohulumende basekhaya base-Afrika eJohannesburg kusukela mhla tinge-29 Lweti kuya kumhla ti-3 Ingongoni 2015.

src: Khonferense e etsa karolo ya dipuisano tse mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Lenaneo la Ntshetsopele la UN la kamora 2015 le “Lenaneo le Letjha la Metse ya Ditoropo” le tla amohelwa ke UN ka 2016.
tgt: Ngaphansi kwalengcikitsi: “Kulungisa likusasa le-Afrika nebantfu: ligalelo letiphatsimandla tase-Afrika tendzawo ku-ajenda-2063 weBunye be-Afrika”, lengcungcutsela, ledvose baphatsidolobha laba-15 000 nemakhansela lange-500 000, ngulenye yemitamo lemikhulu kakhulu yekwakha bunye be-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana hore Lekgotla la Diphuputso tsa Temo le tshware Khonferense ya bo-3 ya Lefatshe ya Diphuputso tsa Temo bakeng sa Ntshetsopele ka Mmesa 2016.
tgt: Lengcungcutsela igcile ekuciniseni bohulumende basekhaya kulo lonkhe lelivekati lase-Afrika, ikakhulu kulawulwa kwetimali kanye nekutfola sisekelo lesivikelekile semali lengenako, kute kutfolwe i-Ajenda 2063 – i-Afrika lesiyifunako.

src: Khonferense e tla hlwaya: dintlha tse ka sehloohong tsa diphuputso tsa matjhaba le tsamaiso ya ntlafatso hore ho tle ho fihlellwe merero ya ntshetsopelo ya bokamoso, haholoholo ho borapolasi ba malapa le metseng e futsanehileng.
tgt: Lengcungcutsela yesekela imigomo ye-NDP lapho khona emadolobhakati nahulumende wasekhaya kudlala indzima lebalulekile ekutfutfukeni kwetfu konkhe.

src: Bili e fana ka moralo wa semolao wa ho bula bokgoni ba moruo wa Mawatle ka ho kgothaletsa moralo o kopanetsweng.
tgt: Kugucuka kwesimo selitulu kuyinkinga yemave emhlaba ledzinga sisombululo semave emhlaba, lokungabukwana nako ngemphumelelo ngekwemikhakha leminyenti, ngaphansi kwekufaneleka lokubanti kwe-UNFCCC ngekutsi futsi onkhe emacembu afake ligalelo.

src: Bili e tla thusa dibopeho tsa dikaho tse teng tsa Operation Phakisa.
tgt: ENingizimu Afrika, singasho ngekutigcabha kutsi sesihlelembise tinchubomgomo letinenchubekela embili, letinsha letakhako naletuphakamako, kanye nemasu ekubukana nesimo selitulu lesihlala njalo sigucuka.

src: E batla ho kgothaletsa tshebedisano le taolo ya tlhophiso e nang le boikarabelo ya mawatle.
tgt: Letinchubomgomo tesekelwa ngumtsetfomgomo lomkhulu wekutfutfuka lokuchubekela embili ngalokungenamkhawulo, lokusisekelo seMbonchanti 2030 njengoba ubekiwe ku-NDP.3 Njengoba lona ngumhlangano weKhabhinethi wekugcina wanga-2015, IKhabhinethi ifisela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika sikhatsi semaholide aKhisimusi lesihle.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla etella pele mekete ya Letsatsi la Poelano ka la 16 December Port Elizabeth, ho la Kapa Botjhabela tlasa mookotaba: “Re ngotla karohano: Re aha bosetjhaba ba Aforika Borwa bo tshwanang ho ya ho puso ya naha e tswelang pele”.
tgt: Kuwo umoya walesikhatsi kanye nekuhambisana nemoya webuntfu, iKhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi basite labo labeswele kanye nemindeni emimangweni yabo.

src: Letona la Dikgokahanyo tsa Mehala le Ditshebeletso tsa Poso, Ngaka Siyabonga Cwele, o tla etelle pele kemedi ya Aforika Borwa ho UNGA mabapi le Seboka sa Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Tlhahisoleseding (WSIS) ho tloha ka la 15 ho isa ka la 16 Tshitwe 2015, moo maemo a Aforika Borwa a naha, a nyehelang ho WSIS+10 a tla hlahiswa ka ntle le Pampiri.
tgt: Sisive lesinakekelanako, lesihloniphanako futsi leseseka labo labanenhlanhla lencane.

src: Maemo a Kabinete Mabapi le Dintlha tsa Bohlokwa Maemong a Hajwale.
tgt: LoMnyaka Lomusha lotako utawusinika sonkhe litfuba lekutinikela kabusha ekusebenteleni likusasa lelincono lawonkhe wonkhe.

src: Aforika Borwa e tshwere ka katleho Seboka sa bo-7 sa Africities sa metsemeholo le mebuso ya lehae ya Aforika Johannesburg ho tloha ka la 29 Pudungwana ho isa ka la 3 Tshitwe 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yendlulisa emavi ayo endvudvuto, kulila kanye nekuvelana nemndeni nebangani baMohamed Ismail (“Issy”) Dinat, loshone ngaLesibili, mhla ti-8 Ingongoni.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso le kutlwelobohloko ho lelapa le metswalle ya Mohamed Ismail (“Issy”) Dinat, ya hlokahetseng ka Labobedi, la 8 Tshitwe.

src: Monghadi Omega Shelembe jwaloka DDG: Taolo ya Dikgwebo tsa Mmuso le Ntshetsopele ya Dikgwebo tsa Dikgokahanyo tsa Tlhahisoleseding le Thekenoloji ho Lefapha la Dikgokahanyo tsa Mehala le Ditshebeletso tsa Poso (DTPS).
tgt: Loku kufaka ekhatsi Litiko lebeTemphilo, Tekulima, Temaphoyisa, teLitiko Letasekhaya Imininingwane iyatfolakala ku: www.

src: Moruo.
tgt: Umnotfo.

src: Kabinete e ile ya kopana ho sekaseka maemo a moruo le dintlha tse amanang le ditekanyetso tsa ditjhelete.
tgt: IKhabinethi ihlangene kute icocisane ngesimo setemnotfo kanye nangetindzaba letiphatselene nebhajethi.

src: Kabinete lemohile dintlha tse ngatanyana tse nang le kgahlamelo moruong wa naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibone kutsi kunemaphuzu lamanengi lanelifutse emnotfweni walelive.

src: Tjhebahalo ya lefatshe e theohile dikgweding tse sa tswa feta moraorao tjena.
tgt: Simo semnotfo emhlabeni wonkhe sibe ngulesibi kakhulu kuletinyanga letisandza kwendlula.

src: Kgolo e batlang e tsamaya butle ya moruo wa lefatshe e bontsha, ka ho qolleha, tshebetso e batlang e fokola le dikotsi tsa ho thefuleha ha moruo tse batlang di phahame ka hara dinaha tse itseng tse ntseng di tswela pele, ho kenyeletswa le China.
tgt: Kukhula komnotfo lokuhamba kancane emhlabeni wonkhe kukhomba kutsi, kahle hle kunebutsakatsaka emnotfweni kanye nebungoti lobusetulu kumave lamanyenti lasatfutfuka, lokufaka ekhatsi nelive lase-China.

src: Ho iphumana ho lemohilweng ho lebeletsweng ka hara Amerika ho ka nna ha baka ho phahama ha sekgahla sa tswala sa lefatshe.
tgt: Lokuvuka kwemnotfo lokulindzeleke e-USA kunawubanga kutsi kube nekwenyuka, emhlabeni wonkhe, kwemali loyikhokha nawuboleke imali.

src: Methamo ya kgwebisano e tetebetseng le ho tsukutleha ho teng ka hara mebaraka ya lefatshe ya ditjhelete e hlakisa tlhokeho ya ho aha botsitso le ho sebetsa ka hloko bakeng sa nako ena eo re e tobileng ka pele ho rona.
tgt: Kwehla kwemtsamo wekuhwebelana kanye nekungatinti etimakethe temhlaba tekutsenga nekutsengisa emasheya kusho kutsi kunesidzingo sekutsi tive ticine futsi tente tintfo ngekucophelela kulesikhatsi lesitako.

src: Kabinete e boetse e lemohile hore ho ne ho na le melemo e itseng ho tswa ho theko e tlase ya oli e tala.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphindze futsi yabona kutsi kube nekuzuza lokutsite ngekuba phasi kwentsengo yawoyela longakahlutwa.

src: Jwaloka moreki e moholo wa thepa e tswang mafatsheng a ka ntle, Aforika Borwa e ngongorehile ka ho fokola ho ntseng ho tswela dithekong tsa thepa.
tgt: Live laseNingizimu Afrika njengaloku lelive lelihweba kakhulu ngekutfumela timbiwa ngephandle, likhatsatekile ngalokuchubeka kwekwehla kwentsengo yekutsengwa kwetimbiwa.

src: Mmuso o tswelapele ho ahella hodima sebopeho sa naha se tswakatswakaneng sa moruo, mme kuno ya dihlahiswa tse romellwang dinaheng tsa ka ntle e tswela pele ho itshetleha haholo hodima ditshepe le thepa e tala e song ho lokiswe ka botlalo.
tgt: Hulumende uyachubeka ngekwakha etikwalesimo semnotfo salelive lesihlukahlukene, kantsi netinzuzo talokutfunyelwa ngephandle kuyachubeka ngekusima kakhulu kulokuyinsimbi kanye nasetintfweni letisengakaguculwa.

src: Ho wa ha ditheko tsa thepa ha ho bonahale e le ntho e tla tjhetjhang ka potlako.
tgt: Lokwehla kwentsengo yetimbiwa kutawuphindza futsi kubuyele esimeni sako ngekushesha.

src: Sena se tla ba le ditlamorao tsa nako e telele bakeng sa moruo wa Aforika Borwa le ho balekane ba rona kontinenteng ya Aforika.
tgt: Loko kutakwenta kutsi kube nemphumela losimeme emnotfweni waseNingizimu Afrika kanye nemave amanengi abalingani betfu elivenikati lase-Afrika.

src: Ho fokola ha Ranta dilemong tse mmalwa tse fetileng ho fana ka menyetla e batlang e ba betere bakeng sa kgolo ya thomello ya ka ntle ya thepa le, ha re kopanya le theko e batlang e ba tlase ya oli ya lefatshe, ho thusitse ho imolla kgatello hodima akhaonte ya rona ya hajwale ya matjhaba.
tgt: Kwehla kwemandla eLirandi kuleminyaka lembalwa leyengcile kunika ematsemba lancono ekukhula kwemtsamo wetimpahla letitfunyelwa ngephandle, kanye nekuhlangana nentsengo lephasi yawoyela, kusite ekutseni kwehlise kucindzeteleka kwisikhwama semali yelive.
