src: Leha ho le jwalo, kgolo e fokolang ho balekane ba ka sehloohong ba kgwebisano ba Aforika Borwa ho bolela tlhoko e fokotsehileng ya dihlahiswa tsa Aforika Borwa mose.
tgt: Noma kunjalo, lokukhula lokubutsakatsaka kumave labahwebelana neNingizimu Afrika kusho kudzingeka ngendlela lephasi kwemikhicito yaseNingizimu Afrika kumave angaphandle.

src: Tikoloho ya matjhabeng e nkuwa e le e nang le phephetso e matla bakeng sa dimmaraka tse ntseng di thuthua, ka ditheko tse tlase tsa thepa le ho tiisa lebanta ha leano la ditjhelete la Amerika ho beha kgatello ho phallo ya ditjhelete le ditebello tsa kgolo.
tgt: Simo semnotfo wemhlaba wonkhe sitsatseka njengalesinensayeya kumave lasafufusa, lokuhambisana nentsengo lephasi yetimbiwa kanye nekucina kwenchubomgomo yetemnotfo eMelika lokuyintfo leletsa kucindzeteleka kulutjalotimali nekukhula lokulindzelekile.

src: Sena se fetohetse ho tlhokahalo ya bohlokwa ya botsitso dimmarakeng tsa ditjhelete.
tgt: Loku kubange kutsi kube nekungatinti lokukhulu kutimakthe temhlaba tekutsenga nekutsengisa emasheya.

src: Ranta ya Aforika Borwa, eo e leng hara ditjhelete tse sebediswang haholo bakeng sa kgwebisano dimmarakeng tse ntseng di thuthua, e thefulehile haholo dibekeng tsa moraorao tjena.
tgt: Lirandi laseNingizimu Afrika, lelisemkhatsini wetimali temave lasafufusa lekuhwebelana ngato kakhulu, lishayeke kakhulu kulamaviki lengcile.

src: Ka hara maemo ana a thata a lefatshe, moo meruo kaofela e tobaneng le diphephetso tse boima, Kabinete e tiisitse botjha tlhokahalo ya mmuso ya ho tla ka mawa a boitshunyako le ho etsa ka matla hore e busetse morao lebelo la kgolo ya moruo.
tgt: Kulesimo semnotfo wemhlaba wonkhe lesimatima, lapho onkhe emave ebukene netinsayeya letimatima, Ikhabhinethi isicinisekisile sidzingo sekutsi hulumende angenelele ngezikhatsi lezithize kanye nangekutsatsa sincumo sekubuyisa litubane lekukhula kwemnotfo.

src: Lewa la Naha la Ntshetsopele (NDP) le fana ka ditsela tsena tsa boitshunyako.
tgt: Luhlelo Lwekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe (i-NDP) luniketa letinyatselo tekungenelela.

src: Mmuso o tla ikopanya le balekane ba kahisano, haholoholo dikgwebo le mekgatlo ya basebetsi, bakeng sa ho aha kutlwano mabapi le diketso tse kopanetsweng tse batlehang bakeng sa ho tlisa botsitso moruong, ho aha tshepo, ho phahamisa maemo matsete le ho kgutlisetsa Aforika Borwa motjheng wa kgolo ya moruo o kenyeletsang.
tgt: Hulumende utawufinyelela kubalingani, ikakhulu betemabhizinisi netinhlangano tebasebenti, kute kwakhiwe lokutawuvunyelwana ngako macondzana nalokutawukwentiwa ngekuhlanganyela kute kusimamiswe umnotfo, kwakha kutsembeka, kwenyusa lizinga lelutjalotimali nekubuyisela iNingizimu Afrika endleleni yekukhula lokungukhukhulelangoco kutemnotfo.

src: Puo ya Boemo ba Naha (SoNA) ka la 11 Tlhakola e tla nkela mosebetsi ona hloohong.
tgt: Inkhulumo Yebunjalo Belive mhla ti-11 Indlovana itawuchaza ngalowo msebenti.

src: Kabinete e thathiselleditse mekgwa e batlang e le matla bakeng sa ho busetsa morao motjha wa tshebediso ya matlotlo a mmuso wa moshwelella, ho ntse ho hlokometswe tjhebahalo e fokolang ya moruo wa lefatshe le ditlamorao tsa ona ka hara naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yesekele tinyatselo letimatima tekubuyisa indlela lesimeme yetimali tahulumende, ngekubuka lesimo lesibutsakatsaka setemnotfo wemhlaba wonkhe kanye nemphumela waso lapha kulelive.

src: Letona la Ditjhelete Pravin Gordhan le tla kgakola mekgwa e tla nkuwa ha a tla be a teka ditekanyetso tsa naha ka la 24 Tlhakola Matlole bakeng sa Thuto e PhahamengKabinete e tjhaelletse monwana dihlomathiso ho dikabo tsa ditekanyetso tsa naha tse tla suthisa mehlodi ya ho thusa diyunivesithi ka matlole ntle le ho tlola meedi ya tshebediso ya tjhelete e phatlaladitsweng pejana.
tgt: Indvuna Yetetimali Pravin Gordhan utawuchaza leto tinyatselo ngesikhatsi etfula ibhajethi yavelonkhe mhla tinge-24 Indlovana Kusitwa ngetimali Kwemfundvo LephakemeIKhabhinethi itivumile tichibiyelo kuluphakelo lwebhajethi yavelonkhe letitawugudluta imali kute kusitwe emanyuvesi ngetimali ngaphandle kwekuphula imikhawulo yencitfomali lemenyetelwe phambilini.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma le Letona la Thuto e Phahameng le Thupello Blade Nzimande haufinyana tjena ba tshwaile hore dikabo tsena di tla akaretsa ho se nyolohe ha ditefello hoo ho dumellanweng ka hona bakeng sa selemo sa hajwale sa dithuto, ho tlosa mokitlane oo esale o bokellana o kolotwang ke baithuti ba Sekema sa Naha sa Dithuso tsa Ditjhelete tsa Baithuti (NSFAS) le ho thibela ho bokellana ha mokitlane o jwalo bakeng sa nako e bohareng.
tgt: Mengameli Jacob Zuma neNdvuna Yetemfundvo Lephakeme Nekucecesha Blade Nzimande basandza kusho kutsi loluphakelo lwekubukana nekutsi timali tekufundza enyuvesi tingenyuki kulomnyakakufundza losetulu njengaloku kuvunyelenwe, kwesula sikweleti sebafundzi labakweleda Sikhwama Savelonkhe Sekusita Bafundzi Ngetimali (i-NSFAS) kanye nekuvikela kutsi lesikweleti singakhuli esikhatsini sethemu lesemkhatsini.

src: Mekgwa ena ya boitshunyako ke karabelo ho ditherisano tse ngatanyana tse qadileng ka Phato2015 mme di ntse di tswella.
tgt: Letinyatselo tekungenelela tingumphumela wemihlangano leminyenti lebekhona lecale ngeMphala 2015 kantsi nanyalo solo isachubeka.

src: Letona la Thuto e Phahameng le Thupello mmoho le sehlopha sa hae sa bolaodi ba tshwere dikopano tse ngatanyana le ketapele ya SASCO, Makgotla kaofela a Baemedi ba Baithuti, Foramo ya Diyunivesithi ya Aforika Borwa, Kopano ya Baithuti ya Aforika Borwa, diCEO tsadiSETA, Mokgatlo wa Diphethoho tsa Thuto e Phahameng le komiti ya Palamente e ikarabellang bakeng sa thuto e phahameng.
tgt: Indvuna Yetemfundvo Lephakeme Nekucecesha kanye nelitsimba lakhe letekulawula babambe imihlangano leminyenti nebaholi be-SASCO, Imikhandlu Lemele Bafundzi (ema-SRC), Inhlangano Yemanyuvesi aseNingizimu Afrika, Inyonyana Yebafundzi baseNingizimu Afrika, ema-CEO ema-SETA, Inhlangano Yeluntjintjo Kwetemfudvo Lephakeme kanye neLikomidi lasePhalamende lelibukene nemfundvo lephakeme.

src: Moporesidente hape o kopane le ketapele ya baithuti le ho phatlalatsa ho thehwa ha Khomishene e tla shebana le dintlha tse hlahisitsweng mabapi le Thuto e phahameng.
tgt: Mengameli uphindze futsi wabamba umhlangano nebaholi bebafundzi waphindze wamemetela kutsi utawusukumisa Likhomishana lelitawuhlola letinkinga letivele kuTemfundvo Lephakeme.

src: Dipuisano tsena di ntse di tswela pela kaha re dumela jwaloka mmuso hore re lokela ho sebeletsa ho fumana tharollo ya moshwelella.
tgt: Letinkhulumiswano tisachubeka njengaloku singuhulumende sifuna kutfola likhambi lesikhatsi lesidze.

src: Ditseko tsa baithuti di imatahantse le morero wa lenaneo la mmuso le mabapi le thuto.
tgt: Letimfuno tebafundzi tihambisana netinjongo teluhlelo lwahulumende lolumayelana netemfundvo.

src: Jwaloka mokgwa o potlakileng, R.33 bilione e abilwe bakeng sa ho rarolla kgaello e mabapi le matlole a tshebetso a diyunivesithi ka lebaka la tumellano ya keketseho ya ditefello tsa 0% bakeng sa Selemong sa ditjhelete sa 2016/17, mmuso o phetile botjha ho beha ka sehloohongR.543 bilione ya matlole a mmuso a tla abelwa NSFAS bakeng sa ho fana ka dikadimo ho thusa baithuti ba 71 753 ba hlwailweng ho tshwanelwa ke dithuso tsa NSFAS empa ka mohlomong ba ile ba thola thuso e haellang kapa ba sa e tholang ho hang dilemong tse tharo tse fetileng tsa dithuto.
tgt: Njengesinyatselo lesiphutfumako, sekukhokhwe tigidzigidzi le-R2,33 kute kusonjululwe kushoda kwemali mayelana netimali tekusebenta kwemanyuvesi ngenca yalesivumelwane sekwenyusa imali yekufundza yanga-2016 nga-0%.

src: Sena se bolela hore baithuti bana ba tshwanelwang ke thuso ba keke ba thibelwa ho tswela pele ka dithuto tsa bona hobane ba kolota diyunivesithi ditjhelete tse saletseng morao.
tgt: Ngemnyakamabhuku wanga-2016/17, hulumende ubeke embili R2,543 yetigidzigidzi temali yembuso yekusita kutsi yabelwe i-NSFAS kutsi inikete kubolekiswa kwemali kute kusitwe bafundzi labange-71 753 lababonakele kutsi bayafaneleke kutsi basitwe ngetimali i-NSFAS kepha bangasitwa ngalokugcwele nome abazange sebasitwe sanhlobo vele kuyo yonkhe leminyakakufundza lemitsatfu leyengcile.

src: Tlatsetso ya R.039 bilione e tla abelwa NSFAS selemong sa dithuto sa 2016/17 ho tshehetsa baithuti ba sa tholang thuso kapa ba thotseng thuso e haellang ba ntseng ba le ka hara tsamaiso ya diyunivesithi ka 2016 bakeng sa ho phethela mangolo a bona a thuto.
tgt: Loku kusho kutsi labo bafundzi labafanele kutsi basitwe ngeke bavinjelwe kutsi bachubeke netimfundvo tabo ngobe bakwelata emanyuvesi imali yekufundza lesilele.

src: Matlole ana ke tlatsetso ya R10 bilione eo NSFAS e tla e laolang selemong sa dithuto sa 2016.Mmuso o itlamme bakeng sa ho fana ka thuto ya kamora sekolo bakeng sa baithuti kaofela ba tshwanelehang e sa lefellweng moo e fuwang ba futsanehileng le ba sebetsang mesebetsi e tlase, ka hara meedi ya ditjhelete tsa mmuso ya moshwelella.
tgt: Letinye futsi tigidzigidzi leti-R.039 titawukwabelwa i-NSFAS ngemnyakamabhuku wanga-2016/17 kute kusekelwe ngetimali bafundzi labangakasitwa ngetimali nome labasitwe kancane kepha labasasenyuvesi nga-2016 kute baphotfule tifundvo tabo.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho baithuti bohle, basebetsi, dirutehi le batsamaisi ba diyunivesithi ho sebetsa mmoho le mmuso bakeng sa ho fihlella sepheo sena.
tgt: Letimali tengeta kuletigidzigidzi leti-R10 i-NSFAS letatisebentisa ngemnyakakufundza wanga-2016.Hulumende utimisele kunika imfundvo yamahhala ngemuva kwamatekuletjeni kubo bonkhe bafundzi labafanele ngekwetemfundvo labaphuyile nalabo bantfu labasebentako, ngekungengci imikhawulo lesimeme yetetimali tahulumende.

src: Diketso tse sitisang ho ithuta kapa tse bakang ditebello tse hlokang kellello le ho sa fihlellehe ha bonolo ha di na molemo wa letho.
tgt: Tento letitsikameta kufundza nome letidala kutsi kulindzeleke tintfo letingeke tifezeke tite imbuyiselo.

src: Dikgoka le ditshoso ha di batlehe.
tgt: Ludlame nekuwesabisa akwemukeleki.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho MaAforika Borwa oohle ho ananela hore ho na le maemo a phephetso nakong eo re lebaneng le yona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika babone kutsi kunetimo letiyinsayeya esikhatsini lesitako.

src: Maemo a moruo wa lefatshe a se a fokola.
tgt: Timo tetemnotfo temhlaba wonkhe tibutsakatsaka.

src: Kgahlamelo ya ditheko tsa thepa tse theohileng e se e utlwahala ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lifutse lelibi lentsengo lephasi yetimbiwa selivele liyavela eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Mathata a ka hara naha a jwaloka motlakase o sa le lekanang a ntse a le teng ka hara rona.
tgt: Kudvonsa kamatima kwalelive njengekunganeli kwekuphakelwa kwagezi solo kusekhona.

src: Komello e matla e baka mathata diporofenseng tse ding.
tgt: Lesomiso lesikhulu sibanga bumatima etifundzeni letinengi.

src: Kabinete e na le tshepo ya hore MaAforika Borwa a dula e le setjhaba se tsitsitseng se tsebang molemo wa ho sebetsa mmoho ka kgotso le kutlwano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inelitsemba kutsi bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika batawukhombisa kuba sive lesicinile lesikwatiko kubaluleka kwekusebenta ngekubambisana ngekuthula nangekuvana.

src: Ho pepeswa ha moraorao tjena ha batho ba nang le ditumelo tsa bosemorabe ho matlafaditse boitlamo ba rona bo kopanetsweng ba ho aha setjhaba se hlokang kgethollo ya merabe, kgethollo ya bong le se tswetseng pele.
tgt: Lokuvela kwalabo labanebuhlanga lokusandza kwenteka kucinise kutinikela kwetfu sonkhe ekwakheni sive lesite buhlanga, lesite kucwasana ngebulili nalesiphumelelako.

src: DithonyoKabinete e tjhaelletse monwana dithonyo tse latelang:.
tgt: Kubekwa etikhundleniIKhabhinethi ikuvumile kubekwa etikhundleni kwalaba labalandzelako:.

src: Ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha mananeo a bohlokwa a mmuso.
tgt: Kufezekiswa kwetinhlelo tahulumende letibalulekile.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Puo ya Maemo a Setjhaba ya Moporesidente Jacob Zuma eo a e entseng ka Labone, 11 Hlakola.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukele Inkhulumo yaMengameli Jacob Zuma Yebunjalo Belive layetfule ngaLesine, mhla ti-11 Indlov.

src: Puo ena e tekile motjha wa lewa la ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha lenaneo la tshebetso la mmuso.
tgt: Lenkhulumo ibe ngumhlahlandlela wendlelalisu lekucala kwekusebenta kwetinhlelo tahulumende.

src: Moporesidente o ipileditse ho mmuso, basebetsi le borakgwebo ho sebetsa mmoho bakeng sa ho fumana ditharollo bakeng sa kgolo ya moruo ya moshwelella.
tgt: Mengameli ucele hulumende, betemisebenti kanye nebetemabhizinisi kutsi basebentisane ekutfoleni tisombululo tekukhula kwemnotfo losimeme.

src: Kabinete e tshehetsa mekgwa ya ho fokotsa ditjeho e phatlaladitsweng ke Moporesidente, e tla hlaloswa ho ya pele ke Letona la Ditjhelete ka la 24 Hlakola.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyatisekela letinyatselo tekunciphisa tindleko letimemetelwe nguMengameli, Indvuna Yetetimali letawuphindza yenabe kabanti ngato mhla tinge-24 Indlovana.

src: Puo ya Ditekanyetso ya 2016/17 e tla boela e fana ka moralo wa ho abuwa ha mehlodi ho mananeo a fapafapaneng a mmuso jwaloka ha Moporesidente a tobokeditse.
tgt: Inkhulumo Yemcombelelo yanga-2016/17 itawuphindza futsi ichaze kabanti ngekuphakelwa kwemitfombolusito letawucondziswa etinhlelweni letahlukahlukene tahulumende njengaloku kugcizelelwe nguMengameli.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Indaba ya Merafo e atlehileng, e neng e tshwaretswe Motse Kapa ho tloha ka la 8 ho isa ka la 11 Hlakola.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukele imphumelelo yeMining Indaba, lebeyibanjelwe lapha eKapa kusukela mhla ti-8 kuya mhla ti-11 Indlovana.

src: Baemedi ba ka sehloohong ho tswa ho lekala la merafo le mebuso e seng mekae ho tswa Aforika ba ile ba arolelana mehopolo ya bona ya kamoo lekala lena le ka kgannang matsete le ho sebedisa lesoba la menyetla e teng ka hara Aforika.
tgt: Baholi labamelele umkhakha wetimayini kanye nabohulumende labanengi base-Afrika bashiyelene ngekuvisisa kwabo lokujulile mayelana nekutsi lomkhakha ungatihola kanjani tekusisa ngetimali kanye nekusebentisa lamatfuba lakhona lapha e-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e kgahlisitswe ke boitlamo bo entsweng ke mmuso wa Japane ba ho eketsa matsete ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuncomile kakhulu kutinikela kwahulumende waseJapani kutsi utawukhulisa tekusisa tawo lapha eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e tiiseditse botjha boitlamo ba yona ba lekala la merafo le tsitsitseng le ho atleha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphindze yakucinisekisa futsi kutinikela kwayo kutsi kube nemkhakha wetimayini losimeme nalochumako.

src: Moralo wa Tumellano bakeng sa Indaseteri ya Merafo ya Moshwelella e tshehetsa indaseteri ya Merafo tikolohong ena ya hajwale e boima.
tgt: Sivumelwane seLuhlakamsebenti Lwemboni Yetimayini Lesimeme sisekele imboni yetimayini kulesimondzawo lesikhona lesimatima.

src: Mmuso o tswela pele ho fana ka bonnete ba taolo mme o tla netefatsa ho phethelwa ha Bili ya Ntshetsopele ya Taolo ya Mehlodi ya Diminerale le Peterole, e tekilweng ka pela Palamente.
tgt: Hulumende uyachubeka nekunika siciniseko setekulawula futsi utawucinisekisa kutsi Umtsetfosivivinyo Wetimbiwa Nekutfutfukiswa Kwemitfombolusito Yephethroliyamu, losasetandleni tePhalamende uyaphotfulwa.

src: Diqeto tsa bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Tincumo teKhabhinethi Letibalulekile.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Leano la ho Kembola la ho qetela, le shebaneng le diphephetso tse sitisang bohlwahlwa ba Molao wa Naha wa ho Kembola, 2004 (Molao 7 wa 2004).
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyivumile Inchubomgomo yekugcina Yavelonkhe Yekugembula, lebukana netinsayeya letikhinyabeta kusebenta ngemphumelelo kweMtsetfo Wavelonkhe Wetekugembula, 2004 (Umtsetfo we-7 wa-2004).

src: Leano lena le se le ile la tekelwa setjhaba hore se tshwaele.
tgt: Lenchubomgomo seyivele seyihanjisiwe yayiswa kummango kutsi ucale inchubo yekubonisana ngayo.

src: Leano lena le sisinya dihlomathiso ho meralo ya dibopeho tsa taolo ya diboto tsa ho kembola le ho matlafatsa mekgwa ya taolo bakeng sa ho fokotsa tshebediso e mpe ya ho kembola.
tgt: Lenchubomgomo iphakamisa tichibiyelo kuluhlakamsebenti lwesakhiwo sekulawula semabhodi etekugembula kanye nekucinisa tindlela tekuphatsa kute kuncishiswe kusetjentiswa kabi kwekugembula.

src: E sebetsa ho dikhasino, bingo, metjhini e lekanyeditsweng tjhelete le ho dipetjho tsa mejaho ya dipere.
tgt: Loku kusebenta kumakhasino, kumabhingo, emishinini yekukhokha kanye nekubheja emahhashi.

src: Leano le tla kena bakeng sa Boto ya Naha ya ho Kembola le Bolaodi ba Naha ba ho Kembola bo tla tlaleha ka ho otloloha ho Lefapha la Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri.
tgt: Lenchubomgomo itakwenta kutsi Umlawuli Wavelonkhe Wetekugembula atsatse sikhundla seBhodi Yavelonkhe Yetekugembula lotawubika ngco kuLitiko Letekuhweba Netimboni.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa ha Tlaleho ya Tjhebo botjha ya Dilemo tsa ho Lokelwa ho Tshwarelwa Botlokotsebe ho Palamente, e batlehang ho ya ka Molao wa Toka wa Bana, 2008 (Molao 75 wa 2008).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kungeniswa kweMbiko Lomayelana Nekubuketwa Kwemnyaka Webudzala Lophasi Wekucala Kwenta Bugebengu ePhalamende, lokudzingekako kuMtsetfo Webulungiswa Bebantfwana, wanga-2008 (Umtsetfo we-75 wanga-2008).

src: Tlaleho e kgothaletsa hore naha e amohele ditshwanelo tsa matjhaba le tsa lebatowa tse mabapi le dilemo tsa ho lokelwa ho tshwarelwa botlokotsebe ha bana ba tlolang molao.
tgt: Lombiko uncoma kutsi lelive lemukele tibophelelo tetifundza kanye netemave ngemave mayelana nemnyaka lophasi webudzala wekucala kwenta bugebengu kubantfwana labaphambana nemtsetfo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa koranteng ya mmuso ha Dibaka tsa Ntshetsopele ya Eneji e ka Hlabollwang Botjha (REDZ).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kugazetwa Kwetindzawo Tekutfutfukisa Emandla Lavusetelelekako (i-REDZ).

src: Tsena di tla tsamaisa mekgwa ya taolo ka motjha o le mong, ho hlwaya dibaka tsa tlhaho moo dithekenoloji tsa ho sebedisa matla a moya le a letsatsi bakeng sa motlakase di ka qalwang le moo katoloso ya marangrang a ‘tebileng’ a ka lebiswang teng.
tgt: Loku kutawuhlela kahle inchubo yekulawula, kutfolwe tindzawo lapho umoya netheknoloji yekushisa kwelilanga i-Photovoltaic ingakhutsatwa khona kanye nalapho igridi ‘lejulile’ ingacondziswa khona.

src: DiREDZ di tla netefatsa ho fetohela ho moruo wa khabone e tlase, ho akofisa ntshetsopele ya meralo ya motheo, le ho nyehela ho moralo wa taolo o kopaneng le ho kgonahala o tla fokotsa bolaodi bo tomanyana bo amanang le ditjeho tsa boimatahanyo.
tgt: Lama-REDZ atawusicinisekisa kuntjintjela kumnotfo lonekhabhoni lephasi, kutsi kube nentfuntfuko yesakhiwonchanti lesisheshisako, kanye nekufaka ligalelo lelibumbene kanye neluhlakamsebenti lolulawulako lolucombelekako lolunciphisa indendende yekulandzela kuhleleka kwetintfo letiphatselene netindleko tekuhambelana.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka diphihlello tsa Tlaleho ya Ditshupane tsa 2014 tsa Saense, Thekenoloji le Dintjhafatso tsa Lekgotla la Naha la Boeletsi la Ntjhafatso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yatjelwa ngalamafisha mayelana naloko lokwatfolwa nguMbiko wa-2014 weSayensi yaseNingizimu Afrika, Ithekhinoloji Netinkhomba Tekwenta Lokusha weMkandlu Wavelonkhe Wetekweluleka mayelana Nekwenta Lokusha.

src: Tlaleho e fana ka diketsahalo ho tshebetso ya Tsamaiso ya Naha ya Dintlafatso (NSI).
tgt: Lombiko unika tindlelamkhuba ekusebenteni kweLuhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwekwenta Lokusha (i-NSI).

src: E hlahloba tshebetso le nyehelo ya NSI ho dintlha tsa bohlokwa tse ka sehloohong tse tekilweng ho Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP).
tgt: Ihlola kusebenta kanye neligalelo le-NSI etintfweni tavelonkhe letibekwe embili njengaloku kusho Luhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwentfuntfuko.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana tshebediso ya basebeletsi ba mmuso ba behileng meja fatshe le ba ntseng ba sebetsa jwaloka barupelli ho Sekolothupello sa Naha sa Mmuso (NSG).NSG e ile ya thakgolwa ka 2013, e nka sebaka sa Akhademi ya Boetapele ba Tsamaiso ya Setjhaba le Bolaodi (PALAMA), mme e romilwe ho hodisa temoho e tswetseng pele ya boleng le dipehelo tse laolang tsamaiso ya setjhaba le ho matlafatsa boleng, bophara le kgahlamelo ya ntshetsopele ya mehlodi ya bokgoni ba batho dikahong tsa mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kusetjentiswa kwebafundzisi bemfundvo lephakeme lesetitsatse umhlalaphasi kanye netisebenti tahulumende leticashwe ngalokugcwele kutsi tisebente eSikolweni Savelonkhe Sahulumende (i-NSG)I-NSG yatfulwa ngemnyaka wa-2013, kutsi itsatse sikhundla seBuholi Bekuphatsa Ummango Nekulawula Temfundvo (i-PALAMA), futsi igunyatwe kutsi itfutfukise emagugu lachubekela embili kanye nemitsetfomgomo lebusa kuphatfwa kwemmango kanye nekwenta ncono bunjalo, nekuchubekisela embili lifutse letentfutfuko yemtfombolusito lebantfu kuletikhungo.

src: Boikitlaetso bona bo tla lekwa ka ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Lenaneo le Tlamang la ho Rutwa Mosebetsi bakeng sa basebeletsi ba mmuso.
tgt: Lesichamkelo sitawulingwa kusebenta kanye nekucala kusetjentiswa kweLuhlelo Loludzingekile Lwekutayatisa tisebenti tahulumende.

src: Katamelo ena e thusa basebeletsi ba setjhaba ho eketsa boleng ho tshebeletso ya setjhaba.
tgt: Lendlela isita tisebenti tahulumende kutsi tibe nguletineligalelo emsebentini wahulumende.

src: Ba tla fana ka boiphihlelo ba bona, botsebi, maitsebelo le tsebo ya ho tataisa le ho kwetlisa basebeletsi ba setjhaba.
tgt: Titawundlulisa sipiliyoni sato, bungcwethi, emakhono kanye nelwati lwekufundzisa kanye nekucecesha tisebenti tahulumende.

src: Boikitlaetso bona bo tla ntlafatsa ho ya pele ka tsela e hlwahlwa e fokotsang ditjeho tsa boleng ba ditshebeletso tseo re di nehang setjhaba.
tgt: Lesichamukelo sitawuphindza futsi sente ncono kutsi kube nekuletfwa kwetinsitakalo kubantfu letisezingeni ngemiphumela futsi ngendlela lengabiti.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Tlaleho ya Qetelo ya Mokgahlelo 3 ya Aforika Borwa ya Naha ya ho Kenngwa Tshebetsong ya Mokgatlo wa Tshebedisano-mmoho le Ntshetsopele (OECD) (Khonvenshene e Kgahlanong le Tjotjo).Tlaleho e lokela ho kenngwa ho Sehlopha sa Tshebetso sa OECD sa Tjotjo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwuvumile Umbiko waseNingizimu Afrika Wesigaba Sekugcina se-3 Selive lomayelana Nekucala Kwekusebenta Kwenhlangano Yetemnotfo Yekusebenta Ngekubambisana kanye Nentfutfuko (i-OECD), (Ingcugcutsela Lelwisana Nekudiza).

src: Tlaleho e hlakisa kgatelopele e entsweng ke mmuso boitshunyakong ba ona ba ho thibela tjotjo dinaheng tsa ka ntle ka ho e fokisa, ho e fuputsa le ho e tjhutjhisa.
tgt: Lombiko utatakwetfulwa kuLicembu Lekusebenta le-OECD Lekudiza.

src: Tlaleho hape e hlakisa boikitlaetso bo nkuweng ho hlahisa temoso ka botlokotsebe bona.7 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana hore Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae (DHA) le kenyeletswe ka tlasa Lepheo la Toka, Thibelo ya Botlokotsebe le Polokeho.
tgt: Lombiko ukhombisa inchubekelembili leseyentiwe nguhulumende mayelana netingenelelo takhe tekulwa nekudiza lokwentiwa mave angaphandle ngekutsi akutfungatse akutfole, akuphenye aphindze ashushise labo labakwentako.

src: Thomo ya Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae ke ho boloka rejisatara e tshireleditsweng, e nepahetseng ya boitsebiso le maemo a bohle ba ka hara meedi ya naha ya bo rona, e leng sethusi se hlokolosi sa mesebetsi e meng kaofela ya puso.
tgt: Lombiko uphindze futsi ugcamise sichamukelo lesesentiwe sekucaphelisa ummango mayelana nalobugebengu.7 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kutsi Litiko Letasekhaya (i-DHA) lehlukaniswe libe ngephasi Kwebulungiswa, Kuvikela Bugebengu kanye Neliphiko Lekuphepha Ligunya leLitiko Letasekhaya kutsi ligcine bunguye bemuntfu lobuphephile, nekubhaliswa lokungiko kanye nesimo sabo bonkhe labangekhatsi kulomncele walelive, lokusinyatselo lesimcoka sekwenta yonkhe leminye imisebenti yembuso.

src: Hape le romilwe ho laola tsamaiso ya bofalli, bo nang le kgahlamelo e otlolohileng ho tshireletso ya naha, momahano ya kahisano le phihlello ya dipheo tsa ntshetsopele.
tgt: Liphindze futsi lagunyatwa kutsi lilawule luhlelo lwekungena nekufika kulelive, lokuyintfo lenelifutse ngco ekuphepheni kwavelonkhe, kubumbana kutenhlalo kanye nekufezekiswa kwetinjongo tentfutfuko.

src: Mehleng DHA e ne e nkuwa jwaloka tshehetso e akaretsang ya ditshebeletso tsa tsamaiso tlasa lepheo la Taolo le Tsamaiso.
tgt: Ngaphambilini i-DHA beyihleleke njengensitakalo letayelekile yekuphatsa yekusekela lengaphasi kweKulawula neLiphiko Letekuphatsa.

src: Dibili.1 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa ha Bili ya Tshireletso, Kgothaletso, Ntshetsopele le Bolaodi ba Tsebo ya tsa Lapeng ho Palamente.
tgt: Imitsetfosivivinyo.1 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kungeniswa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekuvikela, Kukhangisa, Kutfutfukisa kanye Nekulawulwa Kwelwati Lwendzabuko.

src: Bili ena, e reretswe ho tshireletsa, ho kgothaletsa ntshetsopele le bolaodi ba ditsamaiso tsa Tsebo ya ka Lapeng.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo, wekuvikela, kukhangisa, kutfutfukisa kanye nekulawula Lwati Lwendzabuko.

src: E fana ka ho thehwa le mesebetsi ya kantoro ya ditsamaiso tsa Naha tsa Tsebo ya ka Lapeng, bolaodi ba batshwari ba ditokelo tsa tsebo ya tsa lapeng, ho thehwa le mesebetsi ya moifo wa Boeletsi wa ditsamaiso tsa tsebo ya tsa lapeng.
tgt: Unika emandla ekusungula kanye nemisebenti yelihhovisi Lelwati Lwendzabuko Lwavelonkhe, kulawulwa kwemalungelo alabo labanelwati lwendzabuko, kusungulwa kanye nemisebenti yelitsimba lelilulekako macondzana nelwati lwendzabuko.

src: Hape e dumella phumantsho le dipehelo tsa phumantsho ya tsebo ya tsa lapeng le ho badudi ba lehae, ho thehwa ha tsamaiso ya naha ya direkoto tsa setjhaba tsa ditsamaiso tsa tsebo ya tsa lapeng, boingodiso, ho dumellwa le phano ya ditifikeiti tsa ditsebi tsa ka lapeng, thuso le kgokahanyo ya tsebo ya tsa lapeng e itshetlehileng hodima ntjhafatso.
tgt: Uphindze futsi uvumele kutsi ukhone kufinyelela kanye netimo tekuvunyelwakulwati lwendzabuko kanye nakumimango yendzawo, kusungulwa kwesilulu savelonkhe selwati lwendzabuko, kubhaliswa, kuvunyelwa ngekucinisekiswa kanye nekunikwa sitifiketi kwalabo labasebenta ngelwati lwendzabuko, kuhambisa nekuchumanisa lwati lwendzabuko lolweyame ekwenteni lokusha.

src: Bili e tla tlatseletsa Sehlomathiso sa Molao wa Thuo ya Thepa, 2013 (Molao 28 wa 2013).Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Dingodiso tsa Mangolo a Matlo ya 2015 bakeng sa ho tshwaela ha setjhaba.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo utawusebentisana Nemtsetfo Wekuchibiyela Imitsetfo Yemphahla Loticambele, 2013 (Umtsetfo we-28 wa-2013).IKhabhinethi iluvumile lushicilelo lweMtsetfosivivinyo wa-2015 Wekuchibiyela Kubhaliswa Kwematayitela kute ummango uphawule ngalo.

src: Bili e hlomathisa Molao wa Dingodiso tsa Mangolo a Matlo, 1937 (Molao 47 wa 1937).
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uchibiyela Umtsetfo Wekubhaliswa Kwematayitela, 1937 (Umtsetfo we-47 wa-1937) kute kusukwe kutindleleni tekusebentisa emaphepha kepha kuyiwe kutindlela telihhovisi lematayitela le-elekthroniki.

src: Bili e rerile ho hlomathisa Molao wa Dingodiso tsa Mangolo a Matlo, 1937 (Molao 47 wa 1937) bakeng sa ho falla ho tloha ho mekgwa ya pampiri ho ya ho ya elektroniki kantorong ya mangolo a matlo.
tgt: Ubukana netindzaba tekuphepha ngobe unika kutsi labandluliswa ematayitela babhalise njengalabasebentisa loluhlelo lwekubhalisa lwe-elekthroniki.2 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kungeniswa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo wa-2015 Wekuphila Kwetitfombo (i-Phytosanitary).

src: E shebana le dintlha tsa polokeho ka ho fana ka boingodiso ba boramolao ba matlo jwaloka basebedisi ba tsamaiso ya elektroniki ya boingodiso ba mangolo a matlo.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo wenta kutsi kushaywa kwemtsetfo waseNingizimu Afrika kuhambisane netibopho letifanele kanye nemazinga kute kube nekuhwebelana lokuphephile nalokungavuni licala kwemave ngemave kute kutsi kwehwebelana ngetitfombo nangemikhicito yetitfombo kwasekhaya nekwemave ngemave kwalelive kube ngulokuphephile.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa ha Bili ya Tshireletso ya Dimela (Bophelo bo botle ba dimela) ya 2015 ho Palamente.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo nasewuphasisiwe, live lase Ningizimu Afrika litawukhona kuvikela kungena kweluhlupho lolubuya emaveni langephandle kanye netifo letingabhebhetsekisa loluhlupho loluyingoti kanye netifo tetitfombo kulelive.

src: Bili e matahanya molao wa Aforika Borwa le ditshwanelo le maemo a amehang ho thusa ka kgwebisano ya matjhaba e bolokehileng le e hlokang leeme ho tshireletsa kgwebo ya naha ya ka lapeng le ya matjhaba ya dimela le dihlahiswa tsa dimela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kungeniswa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo wa-2015 Wekuchibiyela Umtsetfo Wetinkantolo.

src: Hang ha bili e se e pasitse, Aforika Borwa e tla kgona ho thibela ho kena ha dikokonyana le mafu a ka ntle a thibetsweng a ka hasanyang dikokonyana le mafu a kotsi ka hara naha.
tgt: LoMtsetfo uchibiyela Umtsetfo Wetimantji Tetinkantolo, 1944 (Umtsetfo we-32 wa-1944) kanye Nemtsetfo Wekuchibiyela Tinkantolo Letiphakeme, 2013 (Umtsetfo we-10 wa-2013).Letichibiyelo tihlose kudzambisa inhlupheko yalabakweletako labatikhandza sebachashatwa nguloluhlelo lwekugcogca tikweleti etinkantolo tetimantji kanye nekubandzakanya umklamo weLitiko Letekuhweba Netimboni wekususa lwatiso lolungasiluhle lwebatsengi.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa ha Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Molao wa Makgotla a Dinyewe wa 2015 ho Palamente.
tgt: LoMtsetfo uhlose kuchibiyela tigaba teMtsetfo Wetimantji Tetinkantolo, 1994 (Umtsetfo we-32 wa-1994) (I-MCA) kute kulungiswe kuchashatwa kuMtsetfo Wekuchibiyela Tinkhokhelo (i-EAO).

src: Bili e hlomathisa Molao wa Makgotla a Bomaseterata, 1944 (Molao 32 wa 1944) le Sehlomathiso sa Molao wa Makgotla a Maholo, 2013 (Molao 10 wa 2013).Dihlomathiso di rerile ho fedisa bothata ba boradikoloto ba iphumanang ba le lehlakoreng la tshebediso e mpe tsamaisong ya ho bokella mekitlane makgotleng a bomaseterata le ho amohela porojeke ya Lefapha la Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri ho tlosa tlhahisoleseding e tlontlollang ya mekitlane ya bareki.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uhlose kulungisa nekucedza tehlulelo letiphuma ngalokungemtsetfo, ikakhulu letikhishwa bomabhalane betinkantolo ngaphandle kweliso letebulungiswa, etikhatsini letinyenti ngekungabi nesipiliyoni nome ngekuvumelana nalabakweletwako, bameli babo nome bagcogci betikweleti.

src: Bili e rerile ho hlomathisa dikarolo tsa Molao wa Makgotla a Bomaseterata, 1994 (Molao 32 wa 1994) (MCA), ho shebana le tshebediso e mpe ho Taelo ya Kgapo ya Thepa (EAO).
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo utawucinisekisa kutsi labakweletako baniketwa tehlulelo letihambisana nemtsetfo wesitolimende nome Umtsetfo Wetinkhokhelo Nekudliwa letisemtsetfweni wekukhokha titolimende.

src: Bili e rerile ho shebana le, le ho fedisa dikahlolo tse fanwang ka tsela e seng molaong, haholo ke ditlelereke tsa makgotla a dinyewe ntle le ho laelwa ke lekgotla, boholo ba nako ka lebaka la ho hloka boiphihlelo kapa ho sebetsa mmoho le ba kolotwang, babuelli ba bona kapa babokelli ba mekitlane.
tgt: Imikhosi letako.1 Imphelasontfo yekucala yekubhaliswa kwebavoti babhalisela Lukhetfo Lwabohulumende Basekhaya lwa-2016 itawuba kusukela mhla ti-5 kuya mhla ti-6 Indlovulenkhulu 2016.

src: Bili e tla netefatsa hore boradikoloto ba fuwa kahlolo e imatahanyang le taelo ya setolomente kapa Taelo ya Kgapo ya Thepa e ka hara sekepele se molaong sa setolomente.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi balisebentise lelitfuba bahloniphe futsi lentsandvo yelinyenti leyatfolwa kamatima ngekutsi baphume bayowusebentisa lilungelo labo lentsandvo yelinyenti babhalise baphindze bavote kulolukhetfo lolutako.2 Mengameli Zuma utawube avakashele ngekwembuso e-Islamic Republic of Iran kusukela mhla tinge-28 kuya mhla tinge-29 Indlovana2016.Lokuvakasha kutawucinisa budlelwane betfu betepolitiki nebetemnotfo nelive lase-Iran kanye nekugcugcutela budlelwane emkhatsini weNingizimu Afrika ne-Iran.

src: Mafelo a beke a boingodiso ba pele ba bakgethi bakeng sa Dikgetho tsa Mebuso ya Lehae tsa 2016 bo tla etsahala ho tloha ka la 5 ho isa ka la 6 Tlhakubele 2016.
tgt: Lomcimbi lowentiwa minyaka yonkhe wekukhombisa kwesekela nekubonga bomake nabobabe labaseMbutfweni Wavelonkhe Wetekuvikela waseNingizimu Afrika.3 Mengameli Zuma utawukhuluma ekuvulweni Kwendlu Yavelonkhe Yebaholi Bendzabuko ePhalamende, eKapa mhla tinge-26 Indlovanae 2016.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho nka monyetla wa, le ho hlompha demokerasi ena e lwanetsweng ka thata ka ho tswa ho ya sebedisa tokelo ya bona ya demokerasi ya ho ingodisa le ho vouta dikgethong tse tlang.
tgt: Budlelwane emkhatsini wahulumende nebaholi bendzabuko bubalulekile njengaloku bonkhe basebentela kwenta ncono timphilo tebantfu.4 NgeMgcibelo mhla tinge-20 Indlovana2016, Lisekela Mengameli Cyril Ramaphosa utawube ahola litsimba Letindvuna lelitawuya eMbukisweni WaMengameli Wekutfutfukisa Lusha lotawubanjelwa lapha eGrace Bible Church ePimville, eSoweto.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla nka Leeto la Mmuso ho etela Rephaboliki ya MaIsilamo ya Iran ho tloha ka la 28 ho isa ka la 29 Hlakola 2016.Leeto le tla matlafatsa dipuisano tsa rona tse ntseng di tswela pele tsa sepolotiki le moruo le Iran le ho matlafatsa dikamano tsa rona tsa Dinaha tse Borwa ba Ekhweita.
tgt: Lombukiso wesekelwa ngematiko eTindzaba Tasekhaya, Lemisebenti, Lekutfutfukisa Tenhlalo kanye Neletekuvikela.

src: Jwaloka Molaodi-ya- ka-Sehloohong wa Lebotho la Naha la Tshireletso la Aforika Borwa (SANDF), Moporesidente Zuma e tla ba motshwara-marapo wa mekete ya karolo ya bohlano ya Letsatsi la Sesole Port Elizabeth, ho la Kapa Botjhabela, ka la 21 Hlakola 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu labasha kulendzawo kutsi baye kulombukiso, ngobe utawubanika lwatiso mayelana nekutsi bangatichuba njani tifundvo tabo, bangawasungula njani emabhizinisi nome yini labangakuzuza kuleto tichamukelo tekubasekela letentiwa nguhulumende.5 IKhabhinethi iwuvumile Umhlangano Wesifundza lomayelana Nekuvikela Bantfu ngalokuphatselene Nebulili Lobuguculiwe, Ngekwebulili kanye Nekukhuluma, lobitwe Ikhomishani yaseNingizimu Afrika Yemalungelo Eluntfu, kusukela mhla ti-3 kute kube mhla ti-5 Indlovulenkhulu 2016.Lomhlangano utawenta kutsi kube nekukhulumisana kute kube nekuvisisana lokukhulu netimbangela letisisusa kanye nekubonakala kwaletinsayeya kute kutfolakale tisombululo letiphatsekako kanye netindlela letikhona embusweni ekulungiseni nalokukuchashatwa.6 IKhabhinethi ibafisela lokuhle bonkhe bafundzi lababhala luhlolo Lwekuchibiyela libanga lamatekuletjeni.

src: Mokete ona wa selemo ka seng o bontsha tshehetso le teboho ho banna le basadi ba SANDMoporesidente Zuma o tla tshetleha puo pulong ya Ntlo ya Naha ya Baetapele ba Setso Palamenteng, Motse Kapa ka la 26 Hlakola 2016.
tgt: Bafundzi bayagcugcutelwa kutsi bafinyelele ekutfoleni loluhlelo lwelitfuba lesibili lolusha losandza kwetfulwa lwekusekela bakamatekuletjeni lolutfolakala kuto tonkhe tifundza lolusita bafundzi etifundvweni tabo ngemitfombolusito leyahlukahlukene.

src: Dikamano pakeng tsa mmuso le baetapele ba setso di hlokolosi kaha di sebetsa ho lebiseng ntlafatsong ya bophelo ba batho.
tgt: Injongo Yaloluhlelo Lwelitfuba Lesibili Lwamatekuletjeni kunika bantfu labasha labangakaphumeleli kutsi bakhone kuhlangabetana netidzingo Tesitifiketi Savelonkhe Samatekuletjeni (i-NSC) litfuba lesibili lekutsi batfole matekuletjeni ngaleyo ndlela bente ncono lizinga letimphilo tabo.

src: Ka Moqebelo, 20 Hlakola 2016, Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa o tla etella pele kemedi ya Matona ho Dipontsho tsa Boporesidente tsa Ntshetsopele ya Batjha Kerekeng ya Grace Bible Pimville, ho la Soweto.
tgt: Luhlolo lwekuchibiyela luyincenye Yeluhlelo lwelitiko Lwelitfuba Lesibili Lwamatekuletjeni futsi lunika bafundzi labahlulekile kutfola tindzingo letiphasi tekuphumelela netekutfola sitifiketi, kepha labadzinga tifundvo letimbili letisetulu kute batfole i-NSC.

src: Dipontsho di tshehetswa ke mafapha a Merero ya Lehae, Mesebetsi, Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba le la Tshireletso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasemukela simemetelo lesentiwe nguMengameli semagama emalunga eLikhomishani Yekuphenya Imfundvo Lephakeme.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho batho ba batjha sebakeng sena ho kenela dipontsho tsena, tse tla fana ka tlhahisoleseding ya kamoo ba ka tswellisang dithuto tsa bona, ba ka iqallang dikgwebo kapa kamoo ba ka kgolang molemo boikitlaetsong ba tshehetso ya mmuso.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi icela bonkhe labatsintsekako Kutemfundvo Lephakeme kutsi bafake ligalelo kulomsebenti welikhomishani kute kutfolakale sisombululo sesikhatsi lesidze saletinsayeya Imfundvo Lephakeme lebukene nato.

src: Kabinete tjhaelletse monwana ho tshwarwa ha Seminara ya Lebatowa la Aforika ya Tshireletso ya Batho e itshetlehileng ho Tshekamelo ya tsa Motabo, Boitsebiso ba Bong le ho Ipolela, ke Khomishene ya Ditokelo tsa Botho ya Aforika Borwa, ho tloha ka la 3 ho isa la 5 March 2016.Seminara e kgothaletsa dipuisano ho theha kutlwisiso e batlang e ba matla ya motso wa disosa le ho itjala ha diphephetso tsa hore ho tle ho fumanwe ditharollo tse kgonehang le mekgwa e meng e teng ho Puso ya ho sebetsana le ditlolo tsena tsa molao.
tgt: Lokushiwo yiKhabhinethi mayelana netindzaba letimcoka eveni.1 Indvuna Yetimbiwa Mosebenzi Zwane, Indvuna Yelihhovisi Lamengameli Susan Shabangu kanye Nendvuna Yetentfutfuko Yebantfu Bathabile Dlamini – labebakhetfwe nguMengameli kutsi basekele hulumende wesifundza, tisebenti tasemayini kanye nemindeni letsintsekile emva kwalengoti leyenteke eLily Gold Mine eBhabutini – babikela Ikhabhinethi kafishane mayelana nalokusha lokwentekako.

src: Baithuti ba kgothaletswa ho iphumanela Lenaneo la monyetla wa bobedi le sa tswa thakgolwa la tshehetso le fumanehang diporofenseng kaofela le ho thusa baithuti ka dithuto tsa bona ka mehlodi e fapafapaneng.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ihlanganyela kanye naMengameli ekuceleni sive kutsi sikhumbule letisebenti tasemayini letintsatfu letisolo tivaleleke ngephasi kwemgodzi kanye nemindeni yato sitithandazele sicabange ngato futsi.2 IKhabhinethi ikhatsatekile ngesomiso lesisolo sihlasele letinye tincenye talelive.

src: Sepheo sa Lenaneo la Monyetla wa Bobedi ke ho fa batho ba batjha ba sa filellang ditlhoko tsa Lengolo la Naha la Materiki (NSC) monyetla wa bobedi wa ho fumana lengolo la materiki mme kahoo ba ntlafatsa boleng ba bophelo.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyabonga kakhulu kulabo bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika, labasekela imitamo yekulwa nesomiso.

src: Dihlahlobo tsa Tlatsetso di etsa karolo ya Lenaneo la Tshehetso la Monyetla wa Bobedi la lefapha le ho thusa baithuti ba sa fihlellang matshwao a hlokahalang a ho pasa le ho thola setifikeiti, empa ba hloka palo ya dithuto tse pedi ho fumana lengolo la NSC monyetla wa ho etsa seo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi itsandza kuvakalisa kudvumisa kwayo kulabo labalalele lesicelo sekubika nome ngabe ngukuphi kuvuta kwemanti ngekusekela Umkhankhaso Wekulwa Nekuvuta loholwa yiNdvuna Yetemanti Nekuhanjiswa Kwekungcola Nomvula Mokonyane.

src: Kabinete e ananela phatlalatso ya Moporesidente ya mabitso a ditho tsa Khomishene ya Dipatlisiso ya Thuto e Phahameng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawudvumisa sibili lomoya weBuntfu lokhonjiswe ngulesichamkelo lebesiholwa i-Operation Hydrate lesente umehluko emimangweni lebeyihlukumetekile.3 IKhabhinethi ibambe tinkhulumomphikiswano yaphindze yawuphuma umphumela logcwele waloMtsetfo Wekuchibiyela Imitsetfo Yemtselo, 2014.

src: E ipiletsa ho bankakarolo bohle ba nang le kgahleho ho Thuto e Phahameng ho nyehela mosebetsing wa khomishene bakeng sa ho fumana ditharollo tsa moshwelella ho diphephetso tse tobileng Thuto e Phahameng.
tgt: Ngekusho kwalo Mtsetfo, kwentiwa umholo wempesheni kwetinzuzo tesikhwama semhlalaphasi kutawucala mhla ti-01 Indlovuylenkhulu 2016.

src: Letona la Mehlodi ya Diminerale Mosebenzi Zwane, Letona Kantorong ya Moporesidente Susan Shabangu le Letona la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba Bathabile Dlamini – ba thontsweng ke Moporesidente Zuma ho fana ka tshehetso ho mebuso ya diporofense, beng ba morafo le malapa a amehang ho latela koduwa ya Morafong wa Gauta wa Lily ho la Barberton – ba tsebisitse Kabinete ka diketsahalo tsa moraorao tjena.
tgt: Loku kusho kutsi kusukela ngalolo lusuku, tinzuzo tesikhwama sephrovidenti netinzuzo tesikhwama sempeshini titawuphatfwa ngalokufananako ngendlela yekutsi emalunga langaphasi kwesikhwama sephrovidenti atawutsi nakasatsatsa umhlalaphasi avunyelwe kutsi atsatse kunye kulokutsatfu etinzuzeni tesikhwama sawo sephrovidenti lokungukheshi njengenkhokhelo lesamba bese kutsi kubili kwalokutsatfu lokusele batawukusebentisela kutfola imiholo yenyanga nasetsatse umhlalaphasi.

src: Kabinete e imatahantse le Moporesidente kgoeletsong ya setjhaba ya ho dula se behile basebeletsi ba bararo ba morafo ba ntseng ba tshwasehile mokoting le ba malapa a bona menahanong le dithapelong.
tgt: Letingucuko kulomtsetfo titsintsa labo labahola kakhulu kanye nabo bonkhe labangaphasi kwalesikhwama sephrovidenti.

src: Kabinete e ntse e ngongorehile ka komello e ntseng e ama dikarolo tse ding tsa naha.
tgt: Tinhlangano letinyenti kanye nebantfu bavakalise kukhatsateka kwabo mayelana nekucala kusebenta kwaletingucuko letinsha ngaleyo ndlela base benta tetfulo kuhulumende ngaloko.

src: E hlahisitse teboho ya yona ho maAforika Borwa kaofela, a tshehetsang mekutu ya pebofatso ya maemo a komello.
tgt: Kuyabonakala kutsi nanome kube netinchubo tekubonisana kabanti ngembikwekutsi lomtsetfo uphasiswe, loko kukhatsateka kusasekhona nekutsi loko kukhala kufanele kutsi kubukwe ngekushesha kute kucinisekiswe kutsi ngesikhatsi letingucuko tetinzuzo kusikhwama sephrovidenti ticala kusebenta kufanele tenteke kahle futsi ngemphumelelo.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa kananelo ya yona ho ba mametseng kgoeletso ya ho tlaleha ho dutla hofe kapa hofe bakeng sa tshehetso ya Letsholo la Ntwa Kgahlanong le ho Dutla le eteletsweng pele ke Letona la Metsi le Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere Nomvula Mokonyane.
tgt: Ngaleso sizatfu-ke, Ikhabhinethi incume kutsi kube nekuchibiyelwa kwaloMtsetfo Wekuchibiyela Imitsetfo Yemtselo njengeludzaba loluphutfumako kuhlehliswe lusuku lwamhla lu-01 Indlovulenkhulu 2016 lwabekwa mhla lu-01 Indlovulenkhulu 2018 kute kube nekubonisana nalabatsintsekako labamcoka.

src: Kabinete e kgahliswa ke moya wa Ubuntu o bontshitsweng ke boikitlaetso bo eteletsweng pele ke Operation Hydrate bo entseng phapang ho badudi ba mathateng.
tgt: Lokubonisana kungaholela kulokunye futsi kuchibiyelwa kwalemitsetfo.

src: Pehelo yona ena e sebetsa ho ditho tsa letlole la pentjhene ya mmuso hajwale.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa kudzabuka kwayo ngekundlula emhlabeni kwaBhishobhi Glayton Modise we-International Pentecostal Holiness Church.

src: Diphethoho molaong ona di ama batho ba kgolang haholo le batho ba bang kaofela ba welang ho letlole la basebetsi.
tgt: Bhishobhi Modise uhole lelibandla lelinemalunga langetulu kwetigidzi letintsatfu eNingizimu ye-Afrika, alandzela ekushoneni kweyise nemsunguli walelibandla, uyise Comforter Frederick Modise nga-1996.

src: Mekgatlo e mengata le batho ka bonngwe ba hlahisitse ngongoreho ya bona ka ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha diphethoho tse ntjha mme ba hlahisitse ditletlebo tsa bona ka ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha sena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphindza futsi ivakalisa kudzabuka kwayo ngekundlula emhlabeni kwaMabhalane Jikelele waphambilini waMhlabuhlangene (i-UN) Shifu Boutros Boutros-Ghali.

src: Ho bonahala e ka ntle le dipuisano tse batsi tseo ho ileng ha kenwa ho tsona pele molao ona o fetiswa ho ntse ho na le dingongoreho mme dingongoreho tseo di lokelwa ho sekasekwa ka potlako ho netefatsa hore ha molao o qala ho sebetsa diphetho ho ditjhelete tsa letlole la basebetsi di tla kenngwa tshebetsong ha bobebe le ka bokgabane.
tgt: Wacala kusebenta nga-1992 ngesikhatsi lapho kunemtselela waMhlabuhlangene macondzana nemphi yaseGulf, wasebenta ithemu yinye yesikhatsi seminyaka lesihlanu.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona ka ho hlokahala haufinyana tjena ha Motlotsuwa Bishopo Glayton Modise wa Kereke ya International Pentecostal Holiness.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela Umnu Kevin Govender lobuya eHhovisi leliseKapa Lelwatitinkhanyenti kute kube Nentfutfuko kanye Nenyonyana Yemave Ngemave Yelwatitinkhanyenti yabosotinkhanyenti lotawuba aklonyeliswa ngekuhlanganyela Indondo yase-Edinburg ya-2016 ngekusungula Lelihhovisi Lelwatitinkhanyenti Kute kube Nentfutfuko leliseKapa.

src: Bishopo Modise o eteletse pele phutheho ena e nang le ditho tse fetang dimilione tse tharo ho phatlalla le Aforika e borwa, ho latela lefu la ntatae le mothehi wa kereke, Motlotsuwa Moemedi Frederick Modise ka 1996.
tgt: Govender uwekucala waseNingizimu Afrika kutsi atfole lomklomelo kutesayensi nethekhinoloji lefaka ligalelo ekuvisiseni nakutenhlalakahle yeluntfu.

src: Kabinete hape e fetisa kutlwelo bohloko ya yona e tebileng ka ho hlokahala haufinyana tjena ha Mongodi-Kakaretso wa mehleng wa Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) Morena Boutros Boutros-Ghali.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imshayela lihlombe umdansi webhaleyi loneminyaka le-16 budzala Leroy Mokgatle lozuze umklomelo Wekutsandvwa Tetsameli kanye nemfundzate e-Prix de Lausanne International Ballet Competition eSwitzerland.

src: O ile a nka marapo ka 1992 nakong eo kgahlamelo ya UN e neng e le matla bakeng sa karolo ya yona ho Ntwa ya Koung ya Persia, o sebeditse nako ya dilemo tse hlano.
tgt: Ungumuntfu wekucala waseNingizimu Afrika kutfola lomfundzate eminyakeni lenge-28 aphindze abe wesibili emlandvweni walelive.

src: O hlokahaletse sepetleleng sa Cairo ka Labobedi a le dilemo tse O tla hopolwa ka nyehelo ya hae ho tsa kgotso le demokerasi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlanganyela kanye naMengameli Zuma ekuhalaliseni labo labaphumelele kuMkomelo Wesibili Wemnyaka Webuntfu.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Monghadi Kevin Govender ho tswa Kantorong ya Thuto ya Dinaledi bakeng sa Ntshetsopele le Kopano ya Matjhaba ya Thuto ya Dinaledi e Motse Kapa ya tla abelwa ka kopanelo kgau ya maemo a hodimo ya Medale wa Edinburgh wa 2016 bakeng sa ho theha Kantoro ya Thuto ya Dinaledi bakeng sa Ntshetsopele ho la Motse Kapa.
tgt: Lemiklomelo ihlonipha bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika embonini yebaholi kanye nebantfu labatiwako ngeligalelo labo ekukhangiseni emhlabeni wonkhe lokutsandvwa ngulelive kanye nemagugu etfu avelonkhe.

src: Govender ke moAforika Borwa wa pele wa ho amohela kgau ena ya maemo a hodimo bakeng sa diphihlello tsa saense le thekenoloji tse nyehelang kutlwisisong le ho pheleng hantle ha batho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela umshayi wemfiliji Wouter Kellerman, i-cappella group Ladysmith Black Mambazo kanye nemculi wemculo welukholo Neville D ngekukhetfwa kwabo ku-2016 Grammy.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa setantshi se dilemo di 16 sa ballet Leroy Mokgatle ya hapileng kgau ya Audience Favourite le moputso wa ho ithuta ho Tlhodisano ya Matjhaba ya Ballet ya Prix de Lausanne ho la Switzerland.
tgt: Lamaciko abantfu labasivusela inshisekelo futsi baphakamisela etulu umjeka waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Ke moAforika Borwa wa pele wa ho hapa moputso wa ho ithuta dilemong tse 28 mme ke wa bobedi nalaneng ya naha ena.
tgt: Kubekwa etikhundleniKonkhe kucashwa kuya ngekucinisekiswa kweticu tabo kanye nekuvunyelwa lokufanele.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le Moporesidente Zuma bakeng sa ho thoholetsa bahlodi ba Dikgau tsa Bobedi tsa Selemo ka seng tsa Ubuntu.
tgt: Ibhodi Yemanti yaseNyakatfo neLepelle:a) Umhlonishwa Thovhele Tshivhase (Sihlalo)b) Umnu Matsebe Ivor Phasha (Lisekela Lasihlalo)c) Make Thandeka Thembekile Celiwe Hlongwa (lilunga)d) Umnu Boxing Phillemon Sebola (lilunga)e) Umnu Ntale Herold Matsepe (lilunga)f) Make Mankone Mabataung Ntsaba (lilunga)g) Make L Malamba (lilunga)h) Make Josephine Mampheri Letsoalo (lilunga) nai) Make Makgetsi Annabelle Mphahlele (lilunga).

src: Kabinete e ananetse Puo ya Ditekanyetso ya 2016 e entsweng ke Letona la Ditjhelete Pravin Gordhan ka la 24 Hlakola 2016.
tgt: Kucala kwekusebenta kwetinhlelo letimcoka tahulumende IKhabhinethi iyemukele Inkhulumomcombelelo ya-2016 letfulwe yiNdvuna Yetetimali Pravin Gordhan mhla tinge-24 Indlovana 2016.

src: Ditekanyetso tsena di bontsha bokgoni ba ho tsetsepela, boitlamo le malebaleba a rona jwaloka ha re itwanela ka hara nako e mpe ka ho fetisisa ya moruo nalaneng ya moraorao tjena.
tgt: LoMcombelelo ukhombisa kukhona kwetfu kumelana nebumatima, kutinikela kanye nekuhlakanipha njengaloku sikhona kubhukula kulesikhatsi sesimo semnotfo lesibi emlandvweni losandza kwendlula.

src: Ditekanyetso di arabela ho se hlokwang ke naha le ho hlahisa boitshepo moruong ka ho beha naha motjheng wa kgolo ya moruo o kenyeletsang o tshepehang, wa moshwelella le o kgonahalang.
tgt: Lomcombelelo uhlangabetana naloko lelive lelikudzingako uphindze udale kutsi siwetsembe lomnotfo ngekutsi sibeke lelive endleleni yetekukhula kwemnotfo longukhukhulelangoco, losimeme nalesingawetsemba futsi.

src: Kabinete hape e ananela mekgwa e matla ya ho thibela ditjeho le ho itlama ho sebetsa mmoho le makala oohle bakeng sa ho inehela ho mekutu e kopanetsweng ya naha bakeng sa ho kenya tshebetsong mekgwa e tekilweng ke ditekanyetso tsena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphindze futsi iyachubeka yemukela tinyatselo letimcoka letitsatsiwe tekunciphisa tindleko iphindze futsi iyatinikela ekusebentisaneni ngekuhlanganyela nayo yonkhe imikhakha ekufakeni ligalelo lemtamo wavelonkhe kutsi kucale kusebente letinyatselo letishiwo nakwetfulwa umcombelelo.

src: Kabinete e ananela ho thakgolwa ha Moifo wa Moporesidente wa Boraditaba (PPC) ke Moporesidente Jacob Zuma.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukela Licembu Lebetindzaba Lamengameli (i-PPC) leletfulwe nguMengameli Jacob Zuma.

src: PPC e tla thehwa ka bahlophisi ba ditaba tsa dipolotiki, bangolli ba ditaba tsa dipolotiki, baqolotsi ba ditaba tsa dipolotiki le boraditaba ba tsa moruo ba nang le tumello ya ho akaretsa ditaba tsa Boporesidente ka nako tsohle le maemong a tswelang pele.
tgt: Le-PPC itawakhiwa bahleli betepolitiki, bachumanisi betepolitiki, lababika ngetepolitiki kanye netintsatseli teteminotfo letigunyatwe kutsi tibike ngetindzaba letitsintsa Lihhovisi Lamengameli ngalokuchubekako kanye nangalokugcwele.

src: Sepheo sa PPC ke ho fana ka phumantsho ya tlhahisoleseding e ntlafaditseng ke boraditaba.
tgt: Inhloso ye-PPC kutsi betindzaba banike kufinyelela lokuncono kulwatiso.

src: Hape e tla ntlafatsa phihlello ya boraditaba ho Moporesidente le Kantoro ya Moporesidente, bakeng sa ho netefatsa hore baqolotsi ba ditaba le bona bo fumana tlhahisoleseding e tiileng le ditsamaiso ho matlafatsa kutlwisiso le botlalehi ba bona.
tgt: Itawuphindza futsi yente kube ncono kutsi betindzaba bafinyelele kuMengameli kanye naseHhovisi Lamengameli, kute kucinisekiswe kutsi tintsatseli nato titfola lwatiso lolwendvulelako kanye netinchubo kute tente ncono kuvisisa kwato kanye nekubika kwato.

src: Ditho tsa moifo wa boraditaba le tsona di tla fumana ditsebiso ho tswa ho Motlatsi wa Moporesidente le ho Letona lefe kapa lefe leo Moporesidente a le memang bakeng sa ho arolelana le tsona mananeo a bohlokwa a naha.
tgt: Emalunga elicembu labetindzaba lasisekelo nawo futsi atawutjelwa ngalamafisha Lisekelamengameli kanye nangunome ngabe nguyiphi Indvuna lemenywa nguMengameli kutsi yabelane ngetinhlelo telive letibalulekile.

src: Kabinete e hlahisitse kananelo ya nyehelo e entsweng ke Aforika Borwa mabapi le ho boloka kgotso ka hara Burundi, e ipapisitse le leano la rona la dinaha tsa ka ntle la boitlamo ba ho netefatsa kontinente e nang le kgotso le botsitso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise kudvumisa kwayo ngeligalelo leNingizimu Afrika lebenalo ekwenteni kutsi kube nekuthula eBurundi, lokuyintfo lehambisana nenchubomgomo yetfu yemave angephandle yekutinikela kutsi sicinisekise kutsi kunekuthula nekutinta kulelivekati.

src: Hape e ananetse sephetho sa Dipuisano tse kenyeletsang tsa Baahi ba Burundi ka kopanelo nakong ya leeto la Kopano ya Aforika (AU) ya kemedi ya maemo a hodimo ya Dihlooho tsa Dipuso le Mebuso Motsemoholong wa Bujumbura ho la Burundi, e neng e eteletswe pele ke Moporesidente Zuma.
tgt: Iphindze futsi Ikhabhinethi yayemukela imiphumela ye-inclusive Inter-Burundian Dialogue lebeyibanjiwe ngesikhatsi kuvakashe litsimba leliphakeme Letinhloko Tembuso kanye naHulumende teLubumbano Lwe-Afrika (i-AU) eBujumbura eBurundi, lebeliholwa nguMengameli Zuma.

src: Kabinete e ananela thonyo ya Moporesidente Zuma ke Mongodi-Kakaretso wa Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) Ban Ki-moon, ho ba modulasetulo wa Khomishene ya Maemo a Hodimo ya Bophelo bo Botle, Mesebetsi le Kgolo ya Moruo mmoho le Moporesidente François Hollande wa Riphaboliki ya Fora.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kukhetfwa kwaMengameli Zuma nguMabhalane Jikelele waMhlabuhlangene (i-UN) Ban Ki-moon, kutsi abe ngusihlalo ngekuhlanganyela weKhomishini Lephakeme Yetekucasha Kutemphilo kanye Nekukhula Kutemnotfo naMengameli François Hollande waseRiphabhulikhi yaseFrance.

src: Sena ha se lekgetlo la pele hore Moporesidente Zuma a thonngwe ke mokgatlo wa lefatshe ho sebetsa sethaleng sa lefatshe.
tgt: Loku akusiko kwekucala kutsi Mengameli Zuma akhetfwe ngumtimba wemhlaba kutsi ente umsebenti wemhlaba wonkhe.

src: Thonyo ena ke kananelo ya boetapele bo babatsehang bo bontshitsweng ke Moporesidente wa rona lepatlelong la matjhaba.
tgt: Lokukhetfwa kwakhe kuyindlela yekutsatsela etulu umsebenti webuhloli lobuhle lobentiwa nguMengameli wetfu esigabeni semave ngemave.

src: Khomishene e tla hlasimolla ho hlahiswa ha menyetla ya mesebetsi e metjha ka hara lekala la kalafo ho phatlalla le dinaha kaofela, haholoholo tseo ntshetsopele ya tsona e leng tlase ka ho fetisisa.
tgt: LeKhomishini itawukhutsata kudaleka kwematfuba emsebenti lamasha emkhakheni wetemphilo kuwo onkhe emave, ikakhulu emaveni lasengakatfutfuki kuyaphi.

src: Sena hape se matlafatsa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Lenaneo la 2030 bakeng sa Ntshetsopele ya Moshwelella, le tla etsa ho hongata bakeng sa ho shebana le boraro ba diphephetso e leng tlhokeho ya mesebetsi, bofuma le ho se lekalekane.
tgt: Loku futsi kuphindze kucinise kucala kwekusebenta kwe-Ajenda Ya-2030 Yentfutfuko Lesimeme, letawudlala indzima lenkhulu ekulungiseni lensayeya lemihiba lemtsatfu yekusweleka kwemsebenti, buphuya nekungalingani.

src: Kabinete e ananela ho thakgolwa ha Tekolo ya Naha ya Badudi ya 2016 Mamelodi, ho la Pretoria ke Letona Kantorong ya Moporesidente Jeff Radebe le Radipalopalo Kakaretso Pali Lehohla.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kwetfulwa kweLuklayo Lwavelonkhe Lwemmango Lwa-2016 eMamelodi lapha ePitoli lolwentiwe yiNdvuna yaseHhovisi Lamengameli Jeff Radebe kanye naSolubalo Jikelele Pali Lehohla.

src: Tekolo ya selemong sena e etswa tlasa mookotaba:“MaAforika Borwa ao ke a tsebang, lehae leo ke le utlwisisang” mme e reretswe ho fihlella malapa a fetang 1,5 milione – e leng e kgolo e phahameng ka ho fetisisa ho feta e neng e tshwerwe dilemong tse hlano tse fetileng e ileng ya fihlella malapa a 300 000 feela.
tgt: Luklayo lwalonyaka lwentiwa ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “INingizimu Afrika Lengiyatiko, Likhaya Lengilivisisako” futsi kuhloswe ngalo kufinyelela emakhaya langetulu kwetigidzi leti-1.5 – lolukhulu kakhulu nalucatsaniswa nalolo lolwentiwa eminyakeni lesihlanu leyengca lapho kwatsatfwa khona kuphela emakhaya la-300 000.

src: Tekolo e tla etswa ka Mmesa mme diphetho di tla tsebahatswa mafelong a Phuptjane 2016.
tgt: Loluklayo lutakwentiwa ngenyanga yaMabasa kantsi imiphumela yalo itakwatisa ekupheleni kwenyanga yeNhlaba 2016.

src: Kabinete e lemoha ka ngongoreho tlaleho e hlahisitsweng ke Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Bophelo bo Botle (WHO) le Mokgatlo wa Tshebedisano-mmoho le Ntshetsopele ho Dipatlisiso tsa Mmaraka wa Bophelo bo Botle e etellwang pele ke Moahlodi Sandile Ngcobo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhatsatekile ngembiko lowetfulwe yiNhlangano Yemhlaba Yetemphilo kanye neNhlangano Yetemnotfo Nekubambisana Nentfutfuko kuLuphenyo Lwemakethe Yetemphilo lobeluholwa nguJaji Sandile Ngcobo.

src: Tlaleho e supa hore Aforika Borwa e fana ka ditshebeletso tsa kalafo tse bitsang ka ho fetisisa ha e bapiswa le mafatshe a mang.
tgt: Lemibiko ikhomba kutsi iNingizimu Afrika inika bantfu tinsita tetemphilo letibita kakhulu nakucatsaniswa nalamanye emave.

src: Kabinete e tla emela qeto ya dipatlisiso pele e tshwaela tabeng ena.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi itawulindza kuphotfulwa kwaloluphenyo ngembikwekutsi iphefumule ngaloludzaba.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Lewa la Moralo bakeng sa Tshilafatso ya Moya Metseng e Teteaneng ya Badudi ba Lekeno le tlase ba Aforika Borwa bakeng sa hore setjhaba se tshwaele.
tgt: Tincumo letimcoka teKhabhinethi IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kweNdlelalisu Yesikhashana Yekulungisa Kungcoliseka Kwemoya eMimangweni Leminyene Lenemalingena Lencane yaseNingizimu Afrika kute ummango uphawule.

src: Lewa lena le reretswe ho fana ka katamelo e inehetseng ho tobana le ho sebetsana le boemo bophahameng ba tshilafatso dibakeng tse ding tse teteaneng ka badudi ba lekeno le tlase.
tgt: Lendlelalisu ihlose kunika indlela yekwenta tintfo legcilile kute kubukanwe nemazinga lasetulu ekungcoliseka kuletinye taletindzawo letiminyene temimango lenemalingena lencane.

src: Le fana ka katamelo e hokahanetsweng ho taba ya ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha mekutu ya ho fokotsa mello e beswang malapeng.
tgt: Lendlelalisu inika indlela yekwenta tintfo lechumene yekucala kusebenta kwalemitamo yekunciphisa kusha kwemafutsa asemakhaya.

src: Boitshunyako bo reretswe ho netefatsa hore dibaka tsena di imatahanya le Maemo a Naha a Boleng ba Moya o Sebakeng.
tgt: Lesingenelelo sekucinisekisa kutsi letindzawo tenta tintfo ngekuhambisana ne-National Ambient Air Quaity Standards.

src: Lewa lena le tjhorileng le tla tshehetsa lewa le ntseng le le teng la naha ho shebana le tshilafatso ka hara naha.
tgt: Lendlelalisu legcilile itawusekela indlelalisu yavelonkhe levele ikhona yekubukana nekungcoliseka kwemoya kulelive.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tshwarwa mmoho ha Khonferense ya bo-21 ya Matjhaba ya AIDS (AIDS 2016) pakeng tsa mmuso le Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa AIDS Setsheng sa Matjhaba sa Dikopano (ICC) Durban ho tloha ka la 18 ho isa ka la 22 Phupu 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kubanjwa ngekuhlanganyela kweNgcungcutsela Yengculazi Ye-21 Yemave Ngemave (i-AIDS 2016) emkhatsini wahulumende kanye neNhlangano Yemave Ngemave Ye-AIDS lapha e-International Convention Centre (e-ICC) eDurban kusukela mhla ti-18 kuya mhla tinge-22 Kholwane 2016.

src: Ho tshwarwa ha khonferense ho tla hodisa karabelo ya naha ya rona ho HIV le lefuba ha ka ho le leng e tla be e hahlamela hodima diphephetso tsa bohlokwa ka ho fetisisa ka hara Aforika Borwa, lebatowa le lefatshe.
tgt: Kubanjelwa kwalengcungcutsela kulelive kutakwenta kutsi kulwa kwalelive ne-HIV kanye nesifo sesifuba kube setulu kuphindze kube nelifutse kuyinye yetinsayeya letibaluleke kakhulu lapha eNingizimu Afrika, kulesifundza kanye nasemhlabeni wonkhe.

src: Khonferense e tla fana ka lepatlelo bakeng sa bafuputsi ho tswa lefatsheng ka bophara ho arolelana ditswelopele tsa moraorao ntlheng ena, ho rutana botsebi le ho ntshetsapele mawa bakeng sa ho tswellisa mekgahlelo kaofela ya mekutu ya rona e kopanetsweng ya ho alafa le ho thibela HIDibili.
tgt: Lengcungcutsela itawenta kutsi kube nenkhundla yebacwaningi labavela emhlabeni wonkhe kutsi bashiyelane ngelwati lolusha kulendzima, kufundziswane ngebungcweti balomunye kanye nekutfutfukisa tindlelalisu tekwenta ncono yonkhe imikhakha yemitamo yetfu lehlanganisiwe yekwelapha nekuvikela i-HIUmtsetfosivivinyo IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kungeniswa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo wa-2015 Wekuchibiyela Tekutfutsa Tavelonkhe Tendlela Yaseveni, lochibiyela Umtsetfo Wavelonkhe Wetekutfutsa Wendlela Yaseveni, wa-2009 (Umtsetfo we-5 wa-2009).

src: Kabinete tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa ha Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Naha ya Dipalangwang tsa Fatshe ya 2015 ho Palamente, e hlomathisang Molao wa Naha wa Dipalangwang tsa Fatshe, 2009 (Molao 5 wa 2009).
tgt: Letichibiyelo taloMtsetfo Wavelonkhe Wetekutfutsa Wendlela Yaseveni wa-2009 utawuchubela embili lenchubo yekuntjintja nekwakha kabusha luhlelo lwavelonkhe lwetekutfutsa lwendlela yaseveni.

src: Dihlomathiso ho Molao wa Naha wa Dipalangwang tsa Fatshe o tla tswellisa tsamaiso ya ho fetola le ho bopa botjha mokgwa wa dipalangwang tsa naha tsa fatshe.
tgt: Loku kutawuba neligalelo lelihle lelitawuholela ekutseni kube nensita yekutfutsa ummango lephephile, lenekufinyeleleka, lengabiti kanye nalephumelelako.

src: Bili e fana ka sebaka bakeng sa dintshetsopele tse ntjha lekaleng la dipalangwang tsa setjhaba.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo unika kutsi kube netintfutfuko letinsha kumkhakha wetekutfutsa.

src: Bili e fana ka tataiso ho, ha ra tse ding, dipalangwang tseo e seng tsa makoloi, ditshebeletso tsa dipalangwang tse hlophiswang ka inthanete le ho kenngwa dipapatso ho dipalangwang tsa setjhaba.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uyinkhombandlela, emkhatsini waletinye tintfo, tekutfutsa letingasito timoto tinsita tekutfutsa te-ehailing kanye nekutihlanganisa netekutfutsa temmango.

src: E boela e fana ka tlhakisetso ka matla ao ho fannweng ka wona le melawana e mabapi le ho ntshuwa ha dilaesense tsa tshebetso tsa dipalangwang tsa setjhaba.
tgt: Uphindze futsi unike kutsi kube nekuphatfwa lokukhanyako mayelana nemandla lanikiwe kanye nemitsetfo macondzana nekukhishwa kwetimvume tekusebenta kwetitfutsi temmango.

src: Bili ena hape e tla thusa ka phano ya Marangrang a Dipalangwang tsa Setjhaba a Kopanetsweng mme e bopa karolo ya Moralo wa Meralo ya Motheo ya Naha le Porojeke ya bo 7 ya Mawa a Kopanetsweng, o shebaneng le ho sebedisa ntshetsopele e hokahantsweng ya metse ya ditoropo le marangrang a dipalangwang a kopanetsweng bakeng sa ho theha metsemeholo jwaloka metjhini ya kgolo.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo utawuphindza futsi usite ekucaleni kwekusebenta kwe-Integrated Public Transport Networks kantsi futsi uyincenye yeLuhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwesakhiwonchanti kanye Nemklamo we-7 Wendlelalisu Lehlanganisiwe, lolugcile ekusebentiseni intfutfuko lechumanisiwe yasedolobheni kanye nenethiwekhi lehlanganisiwe kute kwentiwe kutsi emadolobhakati abe tinjini tekukhula.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla nka Leeto la Puso ho etela Riphaboliki ya Bofederale ya Nigeria ho tloha ka la 8 ho isa ka la 9 Hlakubele 2016.
tgt: Imikhosi letako Mengameli Zuma utawuvakashela e-Federal Republic of Nigeria ngekweLuhlelo Lwembuso kusukela mhla ti-8 kuya mhla ti-9 Indlovulenkhulu 2016.

src: Leeto lena la Puso le tla matlafatsa dikamano tsa bobedi bona tse ntseng di le teng le ho hodisa kgwebisano e kopanetsweng ya lebatowa.
tgt: Lokuvakasha ngekweLuhlelo Lwembuso kutawucinisa budlelwane lobukhona emkhatsini walamave lamabili kuphindze futsi kwente ncono kuhwebelana emkhatsini walesifundza.

src: Kgwedi ya Ditokelo tsa Botho ka Hlakubele 2016 e tla ketekwa tlasa mookotaba: “Aforika Borwa e kopane kgahlanong le semorabe.” Lefapha la Bonono le Botjhaba le se le hlophisitse lenaneo la kgwedi kaofela le kenyeletsang lethathama la dipuisano tse mabapi le ho sebetsa mmoho ho aha setjhaba sa demokerasi se hlokang kgethollo ka morabe, ka bong le se lekalekanang.
tgt: Inyanga Yemalungelo eLuntfu ngeNdlovulenkhulu 2016 itawugujwa ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “INingizimu Afrika ibumbene ekulweni nebuhlanga.” Litiko Letebuciko Nemasiko lidvwebe luhlelo lwenyanga yonkhe lolufaka ekhatsi luchungechunge lwetinkhulumiswano letimayelana nekusebenta ngekubambisana ekwakheni ummango wentsandvo yelinyenti longabandlululani ngebuhlanga, longabandlululani ngebulili kanye nalolinganako.

src: Kabinete e mema maAforika Borwa ho tshwaela ka Lewa la Naha la Tshebetso ho lwantsha Bosemorabe, Kgethollo ya Morabe, Lehloyo la Melata le Ho hloka Mamellano bakeng sa (2016-2021) pele ho la 30 Phuptjane 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi baphawule ngaLoluhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwekwenta lwekulwa neBuhlanga, Kubandlulula ngekweBuhlanga, Kutondza Bekuchamuka kanye Nekungabeketelelani Lokuhambisana naloko (lwa-2016-2021) ngembikwa mhla tinge-30 Inhlaba 2016.

src: Moralo o fana ka motheo bakeng sa leano la setjhaba kgahlanong le kgethollo ka morabe o tla thusa ka ho fana ka kgahlamelo ho boitlamo ba rona ba matjhaba ba ditokelo tsa botho.
tgt: Loluhlelo lunika kutsi kube nenchubomgomo yemmango yekulwa nekubandlululwa ngekwebuhlanga letawusita ekunikeni lifutse etibophelweni tetfu temave ngemave temalungelo eluntfu.

src: Puisano ya Russia-Africa e Kgahlanong le Dithethefatsi Durban ho tloha ka la 8 ho isa ka la 9 Hlakubele 2016 e fana ka lepatlelo ho matlafatsa Moralo o ka Sehloohong wa Naha wa Dithethefatsi (2013-2017).Ntwa kgahlanong le dithethefatsi tse seng molaong e tsamaelana le Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP) mme dipuisano di tlasa tataiso ya AU ho tsitlallela boitlamo ho ya kaDitumellano tsa UN tsa Botlokotsebe bo Hlophisitsweng ba Dithethefatsi ho Phatlalla le Dinaha, Moralo wa AU wa Tshebetso hodima Taolo ya Dithethefatsi (2013-2017) le ditumellano tsa BRICS (Brazil, Russia, India, China le Aforika Borwa).Khonferense ena e latelang ho dula ha Puisano ya Russia-Africa e Kgahlanong le Dithethefatsi, eo morero wa yona e leng ho fana ka boemo bo matlafaditsweng ba kamoo baetapele ba lefatshe ba ikemiseditseng ho sebetsana le bothata ba matjhaba ba dithethefatsi.
tgt: I-Russia-Africa Anti-Drug Dialogue letawuba se-ICC eDurban kusukela mhla ti-8 kuya mhla ti-9 Indlovulenkhulu 2016 inika kutsi kube nenkhundla yekwenta ncono Luhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lolukhulu Lwetidzakamiva (2013-2017).

src: Sena se tla tekwa ho Tulo e Ikgethang ya Kopano ya Kakaretso ya UN ka Mmesa 2016.
tgt: Kulwa netidzakamiva letingekho emtsetfweni kuhambisana neLuhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwentfutfuko kantsi lenkhulumiswano ingaphasi kweliso laMhlabuhlangene ngekulandzela tibophelelo teTingcungcutsela taMhlabuhlangene Tetidzakamiva kanye Nebugebengu Lobuhlelekile Bemave Ngemave, Luhlelo Lwamhlabuhlangene Lwekwenta lolumacondzana Nekulawula Tidzakamiva (2013-2017) kanye netincumo te-BRICS (iBrazil, iRussia, iIndia, iChina neNingizimu Afrika).

src: Mmuso – ka bomphato le Bongodi ba Mokgatlo wa Moruo o Tshwanang, Yunivesithi ya Aforika Borwa (UNISA) le Lekala la Naha la Ntshetsopele ya Batjha – o tshwara Khonferense ya bo-2 ya Mokgatlo wa Moruo o Tshwanang e mabapi le Mosebetsi wa Batjha khemphaseng ya UNISA Pretoria ho tloha ka la 8 ho isa ka la10 Hlakubele 2016.Khonferense e tshwarwa tlasa mookotaba: “Re kenyeletsa Batho ba Batjha ho Kaho ya Setjhaba: Karolo ya Mosebeletsi wa Batjha” mme e tla hlahloba botjha karolo ya mosebetsi wa basebeletsi ba batjha le dirutehi bakeng sa ho kenyeletsa batho ba batjha ntshetsopeleng ya dinaha tsa bona.
tgt: Lengcungcutsela inguMhlangano wekulandzelela we-Russia-Africa Anti-Drug Dialogue, lehlose kwetfula livi linye lelibumbene kutsi baholi bemhlaba bahlose kulwa njani nalenkinga yetidzakamiva yemave ngemave.

src: Maemo a Kabinete Mabapi le Dintlha tsa Bohlokwa Maemong a Hajwale.
tgt: Loku kutakwetfulwa kuSeshini Jikelele Lekhetsekile yaMhlabuhlangene ngaMabasa 2016.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa molaetsa wa Moporesidente Zuma mabapi le tlhokeho ya ho hlompha dikaho le ditsamaiso tse bopilweng ho ya ka Molaotheo wa Riphaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa 1996 le molao.
tgt: Hulumende – ngekuhlanganyela naMabhalane Wemave e-Commonwealth, Inyuvesi yaseNingizimu Afrika (i-UNISA) kanye ne-Sikhungo Savelonkhe Sekutfutfukiswa Kwelusha – batawube babambe Ingcungcutsela Yesibili Yemave e-Commonwealth lemayelana neMsebenti Welusha letawube ibanjelwe lapha ekhempasini yase-UNISA ePitoli kusukela mhla ti-8 kuya mhla ti-10 Indlovulenkhulu 2016.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o sebetsana le taba ya Mokhomishenara wa Tshebeletso ya Lekgetho ya Aforika Borwa le Letona la Ditjhelete ka metjha e nepahetseng ka ho sebedisa dipehelo tse nepahetseng tsa semolao.
tgt: Lengcungcutsela itawube yenteka ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Kumbandzakanya Bantfu Labasha eKwakheni Sive: Indzima Yelusha Yekusebenta” futsi itawuhlola kabusha indzima ledlalwa lusha lolusebentako kanye netifundziswa ekumbandzakanyeni bantfu labasha ekutfutfukiseni emave abo.

src: Moporesidente o hlophisa mekgwa ya ho sebetsana le mabaka ana ka boikarabelo le ka kutlwano molemong wa bohle.
tgt: Lokushiwo yiKhabhinethi mayelana netindzaba letimcoka eveni IKhabhinethi iyawuphindza umlayeto waMengameli Zuma wesidzingo sekuhlonipha tikhungo netinchubo letisungulwe ngekulandzela Umtsetfosisekelo waseRiphabhlikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika wa-1996 kanye nemtsetfo.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho bohle ba nang le thahasello ho theola moya le ho itshwara, mme ba fane ka sebaka sa hore mabaka a rarollwe ka ho sebedisa metjha e nepahetseng.
tgt: Mengameli Zuma ulungisa loludzaba lweKhomishana ye-SARS kanye neNdvuna Yetetimali ngekusebentisa tindlela letingito nekulandzela tindlela letisemtsetfweni.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho ingodisa bakeng sa Dikgetho tsa Mebuso ya Lehae tsa 2016 ka la 5 le la 6 Hlakubele 2016.
tgt: Mengameli uhlelembisa tinyatselo tekulungisa letinkinga ngekutibophelela nangendlela lekahle kute kuzuze wonkhe umuntfu.

src: Ho fapana le dikgetho tsa naha, dikgetho tsa mebuso ya lehae di batla hore o ingodise ka hara wate eo o dulang ho yona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela onkhe emacembu lanenshisekelo kuloludzaba kutsi asebentise kutitsiba nekutibamba, kanye futsi nekutsi avumele litfuba lekutsi letinkinga tisonjululwe ngekusebentisa tindlela letingito.

src: Dikantoro kaofela tsa Merero ya Lehae di tla bulwa ho tloha ka 08:00 ho ya ho 17:00 ka la 5 le la 6 Hlakubele 2016, e leng se tsamaelanang le dinako tsa tshebetso tsa Khomishene e Ikemetseng ya Dikgetho (IEC) matsatsing ao a mabedi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela kutsi bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika babhalisele Lukhetfo Lwahulumende Wendzawo lwa-2016 mhla ti-5 kanye namhla ti-6 Indlovulenkhulu 2016.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho batjha bohle le ba qalang ho vouta ho ingodisetsa dikgetho.
tgt: Akufani njenganakunelukhetfo lwavelonkhe, lukhetfo lwahulumende wendzawo ludzinga kutsi ubhalise kulelo wadi lohlala kulo.

src: Ka ho lahlela voutu ya hao o tla be o nkile mohato wa hore lentswe la hao le utlwahale diqetong tse amang wena le motse wa heno.
tgt: Kubalulekile kutsi ube namatisi (i-ID) – matisi wakho loluhlata lonebhakodi kanye neLikhadimatisi kokubili kutakwemukelwa – kanye futsi nekuhlola simo sakho sekubhalisa, inombolo yeliwadi kanye nesiteshi sekuvota.

src: Boipelaetso bona bo tima baithuti ba tshwanelehang monyetla wa ho ntshetsa dithuto tsa bona pele le ho ama tokelo ya bona ya thuto e phahameng.
tgt: Ngekuvota kwakho kusho kutsi utsatse sinyatselo sekutsi uvakalise livi lakho etincumeni letikutsintsako naletitsintsa ummango wakho.

src: Mmuso o butse metjha ya dikgokahanyo le bankakarolo bohle ba thuto e phahameng bakeng sa ditherisano le dipuisano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayisola kakhulu imishuco yebafundzi leneludlame ekhatsi, letsikamete kufundza kulamanye emanyuvesi lokuholele ekucekeleni phasi kwemphahla.

src: Sena se bakile hore ho be le ho busetsa dintho madulong le ho hodisa momahano ya kahisano ka hara diyunivesithi tsa rona tse batlang ditharollo tsa diphephetso tsa nako e mahareng le nako e telele tse amanang le diphethoho ho lekala lena jwaloka ha ho hlalositswe ho ditumellano tsa Seboka sa Diphethoho tsa Thuto e Phahameng tsa 2015.Kabinete e tshehetsa mekutu ya makala a ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha molao ho netefatsa hore tlwaelo ya ho ithuta e busetswa madulong, mme thepa le ditokelo tsa motho ka bo mong di a tshireletswa.
tgt: Lemishuco incisha bafundzi labafanele litfuba lekuchuba tifundvo tabo kanye nekukhinyabeta lilungelo labo lemfundvo lephakeme.

src: Tshebediso ya molao ke sa bohlokwa mme e lokelwa ho hlomphuwa ka dinako tsohle.
tgt: Hulumende uvule tindlela tekuchumana nabo bonkhe labatsintsekako emfundvweni lephakeme kutsi kucocisanwe futsi kube netinkhulumiswano.

src: Botsitso le kgutso di lokela ho kgutlela ka hara diyunivesithi tsa rona hore mananeo a dithuto a tswelepele ha diphephetso tsa nako e mahareng le ho isa ho nako e telele di ntse di sekasekwa.
tgt: Loku kuholele ekutseni simo sibuyele kulesingiso kanye nekugcugcutela kutsi kube nekubumbana kutenhlalo emanyuvesi etfu ngenhloso yekutfola tisombululo tesikhatsi lesisemkhatsini kuya esikhatsini lesidze taletinsayeya letilumbene nekuntjintjwa kwalomkhakha njengaloku kuchaziwe kutincumo teNgcungcutsela ya-2015 Yekuntjintja Imfundvo Lephakeme.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa baithuti ba emeng kgahlano le bosemorabe le bonkwapo bo kgahlanong le ba basweu e leng se sebetsang jwaloka mohlala wa hore re ka sebetsa mmoho ho ahella hodima kgatelopele le dikuno tse entsweng lekaleng la thuto e phahameng e le boitukisetso ba selemo sena sa dithuto.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayesekela imitamo yema-ejensi ekugcinwa kwemtsetfo kucinisekisa kutsi lisiko letekufundza libuyela esimeni salo, nekutsi imphahla iyavikeleka kanye nemalungelo alowo nalowo ayavikeleka.

src: Re lokela ho tshireletsa kgatelopele eo le ho dumella hore molao o busetswe le ho baballwa diyunivesithing tsa rona kaofela.
tgt: Kusebenta kwemtsetfo kungetulu kwako konkhe futsi kufanele kutsi kugcinwe ngaso sonkhe sikhatsi.

src: Kabinete hape e ipiletsa ho bankakarolo bohle ho sebetsa mmoho hore diyunivesithi tsa rona e be ketapele ya dipuisano tse kenyeletsang le ya diphethoho.
tgt: Kuthula nekuzotsa kufanele kutsi kubuyiselwe emanyuvesi etfu kute kutsi tinhlelo tekufundza tichubeke ngesikhatsi kusalungiswa letinsayeya tesikhatsi lesisemkhatsini netesikhatsi lesidze.

src: Kabinete e lemoha ho kopanngwa ha ditshebetso tse tharo tsa difeme tsa dinomaphodi tsa Khamphani ya Coca Cola ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibashayela lihlombe labo bafundzi labakhombise kubumbana bema balwa nebuhlanga kanye nemcondvo longamukeleki wekulwa nalabamhlophe, lokube sibonelo lesihle sekutsi singasebentisana sonkhe ngekuhlanganyela ekwakheni kulenchubekelembili kanye nakuloko lesesikuzuzile kulomkhakha wetemfundvo lephakeme ngekulungiselela lomnyaka wekufundza lesikuwo.

src: Kabinete e hlahisa ngongoreho ya yona ka tahlehelo ya mesebetsi e lohothwang le phokotso ya kgiro ditumellanong tsa ho kopanngwa ha dikhamphani.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphindza futsi icela bonkhe labatsintsekako kutsi basebente ngekubambisana kute kutsi emanyuvesi etfu abe baholi bekumbandzakanya wonkhe wonkhe kanye neluntjintjo.

src: Ka lebaka la maemo a hodimo a tlhokeho ya mesebetsi, Kabinete e ipiletsa ho dikhamphani ho netefatsa hore ha ho mesebetsi e lahlehang le hore maemo a palohare ya kgiro a ya baballwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasibona siphakamiso lesentiwe sekuhlanganisa ndzawonye kwetinkampani letintsatfu letisebenta ngekufaka emabhodleleni tinatfo tentela Inkampani Yaka-Coca-cola eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Moambasatara wa Aforika Borwa ho Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Kgwebo (WTO), Monghadi Xavier Carim, ya kgethilweng ho ba Modulasetulo wa Lekala la Ditharollo tsa Dikgohlano la Lekgotla la Kakaretso la WTLekgotla la Kakaretso ke lekala le phahameng ka ho fetisisa le nkang diqeto la WTO pakeng tsa Khonferense ya Matona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivile kutsi loludzaba lusatawulalelwa eNkhundleni Yetekucudzelana.

src: Thonyo ya Moambasatara Carim ke karolo ya kananelo ya karolo ya bohlokwa eo Aforika Borwa e e bapalang ka hara WTO mme ka ho le leng ke bopaki ba bokgoni ba mosebetsi o kgabane wa Moambasatara Carim.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa kukhatsateka kwayo ngekulahleka kwemisebenti lokutawubakhona kulesiphakamiso kanye nekuncipha kwemisebenti ngalokukuhlanganiswa.

src: Kabinete e lemohile tsebiso ya PLC ya Barclays mabapi le maikemisetso a yona a ho fokotsa 62.3% tsa diabo ho Barclay Africa Group Limited (BAGL) nakong ya dilemo tse pedi ho isa ho tse tharo tse tlang.
tgt: Ngekubuka lizinga lelisetulu lekuswelakala kwemisebenti, Ikhabhinethi icela kutsi leto tinkampani tente siciniseko sekutsi imisebenti ayilahleki kanye nekutsi nemazinga lasekhatsi emisebenti agcinwa anjalo.

src: Barclays PLC, haholoholo Mohlanka e Moholo wa Phethahatso (CEO), e buisane ka bobedi le Lefapha la Naha la Matlotlo le Banka ya Risefe ya Aforika Borwa kopanong e bulehileng, mme re ananela boitlamo ba khamphani ba ho kenya tshebetsong lewa la yona le letjha ka tsela eo le tla fokotsa kgahlamelo ho meruo eo BAGL e sebetsang ka hara yona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela Umnu Xavier Carim Lolincusa laseNingizimu Afrika eNhlanganweni Yemhlaba Yekuhwebelana (i-WTO), lokhetfwe kutsi abe ngusihlalo Wemtimba Losombulula Tinchabano weMkandlu Jikelele Wenhlangano Yemhlaba Yetekuhwebelana.

src: Banka ya Risefe ya Aforika Borwa e tla sebetsa le Barclays PLC le BAGL ho netefatsa hore dikotsi dife kapa dife tse ka nnang tsa hlaha ho tswa ho tumellano ena di a fokotswa mme mekgwa e nepahetseng e tla nkuwa bakeng sa ho laola phallo ya ditjhelete le thepa tse tla bakwa ke tumellano ena.
tgt: LoMkandlu Jikelele ungumtimba lophakeme lotsatsa tincumo we-WTO emkhatsini Wengcungcutsela Yetindvuna.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa ba kenetseng makgaolakgang le bahlodi ba Dikgau tsa Naha tsa Botitjhere tse etsahetseng ka la 27 Hlakola 2016.
tgt: Kukhetfwa kweLincusa Carim kuyincenye yekuvuma kubaluleka kwendzima ledlalwa yiNingizimu Afrika ku-WTO kuphindze futsi kube yincenye yebufakazi ngebunjalo lobuhle beLincusa Carim.

src: Matitjhere ana a itetseng a ntshetsa naha ya rona pele ka ho netefatsa hore diphaposi tsa ona tsa borutelo di hlahisa baithuti ba kgothetseng ba tla nyehela ntshetsopeleng ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isivile simemetelo se-Barclays PLC sekunciphisa emasheya ayo lange-62.3% eBarclays Africa Group Limited (i-BAGL) kuleminyaka lemibili letako kuya kulemitsatfu.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Market Theatre ka hara Johannesburg bakeng sa ho keteka selemo sa yona sa bo- 40th e le teng.
tgt: I-Barclays PLC, ikakhulu i-CEO, ichumane nelihhovisi leSikhwama Savelonkhe kanye neLibhangesilulu LeNingizimu Afrika ekukhulumisaneni lokuvulekile, futsi siyakwemukela kutinikela kwalenkampani kutsi icale kusebentisa indlelalisu lensha yayo ngendlela letawunciphisa lifutse kutemnotfo lapho i-BAGL isebenta khona.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa titjhere ya mmino, Monghadi Chad Hendricks, ho tswa Retreat ho la Cape Flats bakeng sa ho hapa Phehisano ya Maemo ya Batsamaisi ba Dikhwaere ya Len van Zyl Motse Kapa.
tgt: Libhangengodla litawusebentisana ne-Barclays PLC kanye ne-BAGL kucinisekisa kutsi nome ngabe ngubuphi bungoti lobungaba khona buvikelwe nekutsi tinyatselo letifanele titawutsatfwa kute kulawulwe kungena nekuphuma kwemali yekuchuba umsebenti.

src: Moputso wa hae o kenyeletsa ho ya ithuta bakeng sa dikgwedi tse tharo ho la Amerika mme nakong eo Monghadi Hendricks o tla ithuta ho Philadelphia Orchestra mme o tla rupellwa ke Moporofesara ya tsebahalang Victor Yampolsky ho la Chicago.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yetfulela sigcoko bonkhe labo labakhetsiwe nalabo labazuze imiklomelo emcimbini Wemklomelo Wavelonkhe Wabothishela lebewukadze umhla tinge-27 Indlovana 2016.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa mohlahisi wa difilimi, Monghadi Anant Singh, bakeng sa ho putswa ka maemo a boraro bakeng sa filimi ya Shepherds and Butchers Ho Dikgau tsa Babohi tsa Panorama bakeng sa Fiction Film ho Mokete wa Matjhaba wa Difilimi wa Berlin.
tgt: Laba bothishela labatinikele labachubela embili live lakitsi ngekucinisekisa kutsi emaklasi abo akhicita bafundzi labanenshisekelo labatawuba neligalelo ekutfutfukiseni iNingizimu Afrika.

src: Sena ke phihlello e kgolo kaha filimi eo e ne e phehisana le difilimi tse ding tse 51 ho tswa dinaheng tse DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di tla lokelwa ke ho netefatswa ha mangolo a thuto le tumellano e amehang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela i-Market Theatre eJozi ngekugubha iminyaka lenge-40 yaba khona.

src: Katoloso ya konteraka bakeng sa Monghadi Lionel October jwaloka Molaodikakaretso (DG) ho Lefapha la Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri, bakeng sa nako ya dilemo tse hlano.
tgt: Ngesikhatsi seminyaka yelubandlululo lenkhundla yetekukhombisa imidlalo yasesiteji yagucuka yaba luphawu Lwemzabalazo ngekutsi iteke indzaba lengiyo yaseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Thonyo ya Ngaka Mantlhake J Maboya jwaloka Motlatsi wa Molaodikakaretso (DDG): Leano la Kharikholamo le Bodisa ho Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela thishela wetemculo, Umnu Chad Hendricks, waseRetreat eCape Flats ngekuwina umklomelo Wemcudzelwano i-Len van Zyl Conductors eKapa.
