src: Thonyo ya Mofumahadi Shamilla Chettiar jwaloka DDG: Ditshebeletso tsa Leano le Tsebo ho Lefapha la Bohahlaudi.
tgt: Umklomelo wakhe ufaka ekhatsi umfundzate wetinyanga letintsatfu aseMelika lokutawutsi ngaleso sikhatsi Umnu Hendricks utawube afundza ePhiladelphia Orchestra futsi utawube aceceshwa nguSolwati lowatiwako Victor Yampolsky eChicago.

src: Thonyo ya Monghadi MbuleloTshangana jwaloka DG ho Lefapha la Bodulo ba Batho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela umkhiciti wemafilimu, UmnuAnant Singh, ngekulala kwakhe kwesitsatfu waklonyeliswa ngelifilimu lelitsi, Shepherds and Butchers ku-Panorama Audience Award for Fiction Film eBerlin International Film Festival.

src: Ho thonngwa hape ha Monghadi Kutoane Obed Kutoane jwaloka Mohlanka e Moholo wa Phethahatso (CEO) wa Koporasi ya Inshorense ya Mekitlane ya Thepa e Rekiswang ka Ntle ya SOC ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lena yimphumelelo lenkhulu ngobe lelifilimu belicudzelane nemafilimu lange-55 lavela emaveni lange-33.

src: Thonyo ya Monghadi Vuyo Mafata jwaloka Mokomishenara wa Ditlhapiso: Letlole la Ditlhapiso ho Lefapha la Mesebetsi.
tgt: Kubekwa etikhundleni Konkhe kucashwa kuya ngekucinisekiswa kweticu tabo kanye nekuvunyelwa lokufanele.

src: Diqeto tsa bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Tincumo teKhebhinethi letimcoka.

src: Kabinete e lekotse Ditlaleho tsa Diphetho tsa Kgatelopele ya Kotara ya Boraro bakeng sa nako ya Phato ho isa ho Tshitwe 2015.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyihlolile Imibiko Yemiphumela Yekota Yesitsatfu yesikhatsi senyanga yeMphala neNgongoni 2015.

src: Ditlaleho di bontsha kgatelopele ya bohlokwa mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha mananeo a mmuso a nang le kgahlamelo e otlolohileng hodima ntlafatso ya bophelo ba maAforika Borwa.
tgt: Lemibiko ikhomba inchubekelembili lemcoka ekucaliseni kwekusebenta kwetinhlelo tahulumende letinelifutse lelicondze ngco ekwenteni ncono timphilo tebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Ditlaleho tsa Diphetho tsa Kgatelopele di fana ka bopaki ba hore mmuso o entse kgatelopele mabapi le ho fihlella maikemisetso a behilweng ho Moralo wa Lewa la Nako e Bohareng wa 2014-2019.
tgt: Lemibiko Yemiphumela Yenchubekelembili ikhomba bufakazi bekutsi hulumende uphumelele ekufezeni tinjongo taloko bekuhlosiwe kuThemu Lesemkhatsini Yendlelalisu Yeluhlelomsebenti lwa 2014-2019.

src: Hape di re atametsa ho fihlelleng Tjhebelopele ya 2030, jwaloka ha e lohothwa ho Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP), o morero wa lona e leng ho mekamekana le bofuma, tlhokeho ya mesebetsi le ho se lekalekane.
tgt: Lemibiko iphindze futsi isisondzete edvute kutsi sifezekise Umbononchanti 2030, njengaloku kusho Lisu Lavelonkhe Lentfutfuko (i-NDP), lokuhloswe ngalo kulwa nebuphuya, kuswelakala kwemsebenti kanye nekungalingani.

src: Kabinete e lemohile kgatelopele e kgahlang e entsweng bakeng sa ho fihlella maikemisetso a bohlokwa le diphetho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyibonile inchubekelembili lebonakalako leyentiwe ekufezeni tinhloso letimcoka kanye nemiphumela.

src: Kabinete e lemohile hore ha kgatelopele ya bohlokwa e entswe mabapi le boholo ba ditshupane, ho ntse ho na le dibaka tse hlokang boitshunyako bo hokahanetsweng ke mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi nanome iyibonile imphumelelo lemcoka macondzana netinkhomba letinyenti, kusenetindzawo lapho kusadzingeka khona tingenelelo letichumanisiwe tahulumende.

src: Ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha mananeo a bohlokwa a mmuso.
tgt: Kucala kwekusebenta kwetinhlelo letimcoka tahulumende.

src: Kabinete e hlahisitse diteboho tsa yona ho maAforika Borwa kaofela a arabetseng boipiletšo bja Khomishene e Ikemetseng ya Dikgetho (IEC) ya hore batho ba ingodise, ba hlahlobe boemo ba boingodiso ba bona le ho lokisa dintlha tsa bona lenaneng la bakgethi mafelong a beke ya la 5 le 6 Hlakubele 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa kubonga kwayo kubo bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labalalele sicelo seKhomishini Letimele Yelukhetfo(i-IEC) kutsi bantfu babhalise, bahlole simo sabo sekubhalisa kanye nekwenta kutsi imininingwane yabo leseluhlwini lwebavoti ibe sesikhatsini ngalemphelasontfo yamhla ti-5 namhla ti-6 Indlovulenkhulu 2016.

src: Batho ba ka etsang dimilione tse tharo ba etetse diteishene tsa ho vouta naheng ka bophara mme tsa dingodiso tse ntjha tse 544 552 (78.6%) e ne e le tsa batho ba ka tlasa dilemo tse 30, e leng se bontshang boikemisetso ba maAforika Borwa ba ho nka karolo ho aheng demokerasi ya rona.
tgt: Kube nebantfu labalinganiselwa etigidzini letintsatfu labavakashele titeshi tekuvota eveni lonkhe kanye nebavoti labasha lababhalisile labange-544 552 (78.6%) bebangaphasi kweminyaka lenge-30, lokuyindlela yekukhombisa kutimisela kwebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika ekutimbandzakanyeni kutsi bakhe intsandvo yetfu yelinyenti.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa ho sebedisa tokelo ya bona ya demokerasi ka ho ingodisa le ho kgothaletsa ba ingodisitseng pele ho ya netefatsa dintlha tsa bona tsa boingodiso ba ho vouta kaha mabaka a mangatanyana a ile a etsa hore ho be le diphethoho lenaneng la bakgethi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi basebentise lilungelo labo lentsandvo yelinyenti ngekutsi bahambe bayewubhalisela kuvota iphindze futsi igcugcutele nalabo lababhalise phambilini kutsi bahambe bayewucinisekisa imininingwane yabo yekuvota ngobe kunemaphuzu lamanengi labange kutsi kube netingucuko kuluhlu lwebavoti.

src: Mafelo a beke a ho qetela a boingodiso a tla ba ka la 9 le 10 Mmesa 2016 ha diteishene tsohle tsa ho vouta di tla bulwa hape ho tloha ka 8:00 ho isa ka 17:00.
tgt: Imphelasontfo yekubhalisela kuvota itawuba mhla ti-9 kanye namhla ti-10 Mabasa 2016 lapho tonkhe tikhungo tekuvota titawube tivuliwe futsi kusukela ngensimbi ye-8:00 kuya ngensimbi ye-17:00.

src: Sena e tla be e le monyetla wa ho qetela wa bakgethi wa ho ingodisa le ho lokisa boemo ba bona ba boingodiso diteisheneng tsa bona tsa ho vouta.
tgt: Leli kutawube kulitfuba lekugcina lekutsi bavoti babhalise kanye nekwenta kutsi imininingwane yabo yekubhalisela kuvota ibe sesikhatsini, bakwente etikhungweni tabo tekuvota.

src: Leha ho le jwalo, boingodiso bo ntse bo tswela pele dikantorong tsa lehae tsa IEC nakong ya dihora tsa tshebetso ho tloha Mantaha ho isa ka Labohlano, ho fihlela lenane la bakgethi le kwalwa bakeng sa Dikgetho tsa Bomasepala bakeng sa 2016 ka letsatsi leo ka lona ho tla beng ho phatlalatswa letsatsi la dikgetho.
tgt: Nome kunjalo, kubhalisa kuyachubeka emahhovisi e-IEC endzawo ngesikhatsi sema-awa ekusebenta kusukela ngeMsombuluko kute kube ngaLesihlanu, kudzimate kufike sikhatsi lapho luhlu lwebavoti Lwelukhetfo Lwabomasipala lwa-2016 luvalwa khona ngelusuku lapho lukhetfo lumenyetelwa khona.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe merusu dibakeng tse ding e sitisitseng mafelo a beke a boingodiso haufinyana tjena le ho boeletsa hore ha ho motho ya ka thibelang moAforika Borwa ofe kapa ofe bakeng sa ho sebedisa tokelo ya hae ya demokerasi ya ho ingodisetsa ho vouta.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaluhlaba ludlame lolube khona kuletinye tindzawo lapho luvimbele khona imphelasontfo yekubhalisa lokusandza kwendlula iyaphindza futsi itsi kute umuntfu longavimbela nome ngabe ngumuphi umuntfu waseNingizimu Afrika kutsi asebentise lilungelo lakhe lentsandvo yelinyenti kutsi abhalisele kuvota.

src: Kabinete e boela e ipiletsa ho ba ikarabelang ho tlohela ho etsa diketso tse jwalo tsa botlokotsebe mme ba anngweng ke taba ena ba ba tlalehe makaleng a tiisetso ya molao.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyachubeka icela bonkhe labo labenta loko kutsi bahlukane nalemisebenti yebugebengu nekutsi labo labatsintsekile bakubike kuma-ejensi ekugcinwa kwemtsetfo loko.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho makala kaofela a tiisetso ya molao ho nka mehato e matla kgahlanong le batlodi ba molao.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela onkhe ema-ejensi ekugcinwa kwemtsetfo kutsi atsatsele labo labephula umtsetfo sinyatselo lesimatima.

src: Mopresidente Jacob Zuma o tla etela Port Elizabeth ka la 8 Mmesa 2016 ho hlahloba kgatelopele e entsweng mabapi le ho ntshetsapele meralo ya motheo ya dipalangwang tsa mawatleng jwalo ka boikitlaetso ba naha ba Moruo wa Mawatleng.
tgt: Mengameli Jacob Zuma utawuvakashela eBhayi mhla ti-8 Mabasa 2016 kuyowuhlola inchubekelembili mayelana nekutfutfukiswa kwesakhiwonchanti setekutfutsa ngemanti lokuyintfo leyiyincenye yesichamukelo salelive seMnotfo Waselwandle.

src: Moruo wa Mawatleng ke o mong wa metjha e meraro ya Operation Phakisa mme o atametsa naha haufi le ho bula bokgoni ba mawatle a Aforika Borwa, a nang le bokgoni ba ho nyehela se ka fihlang ho R177 bilione ho Tlhahiso Kakaretso ya Lehae (GDP) le ho hlahisa mesebetsi e metjha e fetang milione o le mong.
tgt: Umnotfo Waselwandle ungulomunye walenye yetingoni te-Operation Phakisa futsi isondzeta lelive ekuvuleni emandla lagcineke etilwandle taseNingizimu Afrika, Loku kungafaka ligalelo lelingafinyelela etigidzigidzini leti-R177 kusamba semkhicito welive kuphindze kudale imisebenti lemisha lengetulu kwesigidzi sinye.

src: Kabinete e ananela qeto e atlehileng ya Leeto la semmuso la Moporesidente Zuma Riphaboliking ya Bofederale ya Nigeria ho tloha ka la 8 ho is aka la 9 Hlakubele 2016, le matlafaditseng dikamano tse ntseng di le teng tsa bobedi bona tsa sepolotiki, moruo le kahisano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kuphotfulwa ngemphumelelo kuvakasha ngekwembuso kwaMengameli Zuma eFederal Republic of Nigeria kusukela mhla ti-8 kuya mhla ti-9 Indlovulenkhulu 2016, lokuyintfo legcugcutele budlelwane betembusave, betemnotfo nebetenhlalo lobebuvele bukhona emkhatsini walamave lamabili.

src: O mong wa mekolokotwane wa leeto lena e bile ho phahamiswa ha Khomishene ya Dinaha tse pedi ho ya ho boemo ba Hlooho ya Puso, e leng se behang ka sehloohong ntshetsopele ya moruo pakeng tsa dinaha tse pedi.
tgt: Lokunye lokuzuziwe ngalokuvakasha, kube kuphakanyiswa kweKhomishini Yetive Letimbili kutsi ibe sezingeni Lenhloko Yembuso, lebeka embili intfutfuko yetemnotfo emkhatsini walamave lamabili.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho buleha ha moruo wa Nigeria bakeng sa dikhamphani tsa Aforika Borwa makaleng a fapafapaneng a jwaloka a boenjinere, dikgokahanyo tsa mehala, kaho, bofofisi, boraditaba, boeti, dibanka, boithabiso, thepa, mabenkele, le ditshebeletso tsa ho tsonngwa ha oli le kgase.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kuvulelwa kwetinkampani taseNingizimu Afrika kutsi tingene emnotfweni waseNigeria emikhakheni lehlukahlukene lefana nebunjiniyela, tekuchumana khashane, tekwakha, tasemoyeni, betindzaba, tekuhlalisa tivakashi, tekutijabulisa, tetindlu, tekutsengisa, kanye newoyela kanye netinsita tegesi.

src: Kabinete e shebile ka tebello ho eketseha ha palo ya matsete a Nigeria ka hara Aforika Borwa a tla kgothaletsa kgwebisano ya metjha e mmedi pakeng tsa dinaha tsena tse pedi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilindzele kutsi kube nekukhula kwelutjalotimali lwaseNigeria lapha eNingizimu Afrika lolutawugcugcutela kuhwebelana lokutindlelatimbili emkhatsini waletive letimbili.

src: Diphetho tsa dipuisano pakeng tsa meruo e mmedi e meholo ka ho fetisisa ka hara kontinente di tla kopanya meruo ya lebatowa, kahoo e tla be e eketsa mmaraka o tshwanang le ho phahamisa boikitlaetso bo teng bakeng sa kgolo ya moruo le kgiro ka hara Aforika.
tgt: Imiphumela yalokuchumana emkhatsini weminotfo lemibili lemikhulukati kulelivekati kutawuhlanganisa iminotfo yetigodzi, ngaleyo ndlela kwandzise tetimakethe letivamile kanye nekuphakamisa tichamkelo tekukhula kwemnotfo letivele tikhona kanye nematfuba emsebenti e-Afrika.

src: Sena se bontsha hore Aforika Borwa e dula e le sebaka sa phehisano ya matsete ho sa natswe maemo a tsietsing a moruo wa lefatshe, se tla baka menyetla ya mesebetsi le ntshetsopele ya maitsebelo bakeng sa maAforika Borwa.
tgt: Loku kukhombisa kutsi live laseNingizimu Afrika liyindzawo yetekuncintisana kutemnotfo nanome temnotfo wemave emhlaba tingasitinhle nje, loko kutawudala kutsi kube nematfuba emisebenti kanye nekutfutfukiswa kwemakhono ebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e ananetse hore Aforika Borwa e tla nka karolo ho Tulo ya bo-60 ya Khomishene ya Maemo a Basadi (CSW60) ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) e tla etsahala New York, ho la Amerika ho tloha ka la 14 ho isa ka la 24 Hlakubele 2016 tlasa mookotaba: “Matlafatso ya basadi le ho amana ha yona le ntshetsopele ya moshwelella”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikubonile kutsi iNingizimu Afrika itawube itimbandzakanye kuSeshini Ye-60 Yamhlabuhlangene (i-UN) Yekhomishini Yesimo Sabomake (iCSW60) lese New York, eMelika kusukela mhla ti-14 kuya kumhla tinge-24 Indlovulenkhulu 2016 ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Kunikwa Emandla Kwabomake kanye Nekuchumana Kwako Nentfutfuko Lesimeme.” Leseshini yenteka ngemnyaka lobalulekile eNingizimu Afrika ngobe lelive lakitsi ligubha tintfo letibalulekile letintsatfu letentiwe, Kugutjwa kweminyaka lenge-20 Yemtsetfosisekelo waseRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika wa-1996, Kugutjwa Kweminyaka Lenge-40 Yelutfutfuva Lwelusha LwaseSoweto kanye Nekugutjwa Kweminyaka Lenge-60 Wemshuco Wabomake nga-1956.INingizimu Afrika yetfule umbiko ku-UN CSW60 kantsi loku kusinika litfuba lekukala imphumelelo lesesiyentile kusukela kwasungulwa intsandvo yelinyenti.

src: Tulo ena e etsahala ka selemo sa bohlokwa bakeng sa Aforika Borwa kaha e tshwaya mekolokotwane e meraro ya bohlokwa, e leng Sehopotso sa bo-20 sa Molaotheo wa Riphaboliki ya Aforika Borwa ya 1996, Sehopotso sa bo-40 sa Merusu ya Batjha ba Soweto le Sehopotso sa bo-60th sa mohwanto wa basadi wa 1956.Aforika Borwa e hlahisitse tlaleho ho UN CSW60 mme sena se re neha monyetla wa ho metha kgatelopele eo re e entseng esale ho tloha ka ho thwasa ha demokerasi.
tgt: Kubalulekile kutsi sicaphele kutsi kusukela nje kwaba nenchubo yentsandvo yelinyenti eNingizimu Afrika, emkhatsini waletinye tintfo, lelive lihambele Ingcungcutsela Yemhlaba Yesine Yabomake nga-1995, yaphindze futsi yasayina Simemetelo saseBeijing kanye Nenkhundla Yekwenta ngawo wona lowo mnyaka.

src: Ho bohlokwa ho lemoha hore esale ho tloha ka tsamaiso ya demokerasi ya Aforika Borwa, hara tse ding, e nkile karolo ho Khonferense ya Lefatshe ya Basadi ya bo-40 ka 1995, le ho saena Tumellano ya Beijing le Lepatlelo la Tshebetso selemong sona seo.
tgt: Ngekuhambisana nesincumo E/RES/2013/18 saMhlabuhlangene Kutemnotfo kanye Nemkhandlu Wetenhlalo, iNingizimu Afrika itimisele ngekuchubeka icale kusebentisa Simemetelo saseBeijing kanye Nenkhundla Yekwenta, lesiyinkhombandlela yekunika bomake emandla kanye nekubatfutfukisa.

src: Ho imatahantswe le qeto ya E/RES/2013/18 ya Lekgotla la Moruo le Kahisano la UN, Aforika Borwa e itlamme ho kenya tshebetsong Tumellano ya Beijing le Lepatlelo la Tshebetso, e leng moralo wa matlafatso ya basadi le ntshetsopele.
tgt: Imitsetfosivivinyo IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kungeniswa ePhalamende kwaHulumende Wasekhaya: Umtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibiyela Takhiwo Tabomasipala wa-2016.

src: Dihlomathiso di a etswa ho Mebuso ya Lehae: Molao wa Dibopeho tsa Bomasepala, wa 1998 (Molao 117 wa 1998), o kentsweng tshebetsong pele ho dikgetho tsa pele tsa mebuso ya lehae tsa demokerasi tse etsahetseng ka la 5 Tshitwe 2000.Dihlomathiso di tla ntlafatsa tsamaiso ya dikgetho tsa mebuso ya lehae mme hara diphethoho tse ding, di rerile ho:a) hlomathisa maemo a bomasepala ba Mokgahlelo Ab) tlosa ditshupiso ho dibaka tsa bolaodi ba diterekec) hlakisa letsatsi la ho qala mosebetsing ha mokhanselarad) ho tiisetsa hore Moporesidente o tshwanela ho beha le ho phatlalatsa letsatsi la dikgetho tsa bomasepalae) dumella bakeng sa katoloso ho phatlalatso ya sephetho sa dikgethof) hloka hore motsamaisi wa masepala a tsebise IEC ka dikgeo tsa mosebetsi watengg) tiisetsa hore Setho sa Lekgotla la Phethahatso se phatlalatsa le ho beha letsatsi la dikgetho tsa tlatsetsoh) hlakisa ditlhoko tsa khoramo bakeng sa kopano ya lekgotlai) hlakisa maemo a ho vouta a mokhanselara ya tshwereng marapo nakong ya kopano ya lekgotlaj) eketsa phapang ya palo ya bakgethi wateng ka nngwe nakong ya kopano ya lekgotla lek) eketsa phapang ya palo ya bakgethi wateng ka nngwe nakong ya tsheho ya meedi ho hlakisa kabo ya ditulo tse ngata ho feta tekano ka hara bomasepala.
tgt: Letichibiyelo tentiwa kuHulumende Wasekhaya: Umtsetfo Wetakhiwo Tabomasipala, 1998 (Umtsetfo we-117 wa-1998), lowaphasiswa ngembikwelukhetfo lwekucala lwentsandvo yelinyenti lwahulumende wasekhaya lolwabanjwa mhla ti-5 Ingongoni 2000.Letichibiyelo titawukwenta ncono kuphatfwa kwelukhetfo lwabohulumende basekhaya kanye naletinye tingucuko, ngekufuna:a) kuchibiyela sidzingosimo Semkhakha A wabomasipalab) kususa konkhe lokucondziswe kutindzawo tekulawulwa kwetifundzac) kuchaza lusuku lwekucala kungena ehhovisi kwelikhanselad) kuncuma kutsi Mengameli kufanele kutsi abeke aphindze amemetele lusuku lwelukhetfo lwabomasipalae) kuvumela kutsi kube nekungetwa kwesikhatsi ekumemetelweni kwemiphumela yelukhetfof) kudzinga kutsi imenenja yamasipala yatise i-IEC ngetikhala ewadinig) kuncuma kutsi Lilunga Lemkhandlu Wesigung limemetele liphindze lisho lilanga lelukhetfo lwekuvala tikhewuh) kuchaza ikhoramu ledzingekako kute kubanjwe umhlangano wemkhandlu i) kuchaza timo lapho kungavotwa khona nakubanjwe umhlangano wemkhandluj) kwandzisa umehluko welinani lebavoti kulelo nakulelo wadi nangabe kubanjwe umhlangano wemkhandlu kanyek) nekwandzisa umehluko welinani lebavoti kulelo nakulelo wadi ngekutsi kujutjwa iminyele kute achaze kwabiwa kwetihlalo letengcile kumasipala wendzawo.

src: Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: Imicimbi letako.

src: Moporesidente Zuma – jwaloka modulasetulo-mmoho le Moporesidente wa Fora François Hollande wa Khomishene ya Maemo a Hodimo ya Kgiro ya Bophelo bo Botle le Kgolo ya Moruo – o tla kenela thakgolo ya semmuso Lyon, ho la Fora ka Laboraro, 23 Hlakubele 2016.
tgt: Mengameli Zuma – njengasihlalo lohlanganyela naMengameli François Hollande waseFrance weKhomishini Lephakeme Yetekucashwa Kutemphilo kanye Nekukhula Kutemnotfo – utawuhambela kwetfulwa kwayo ngekwemtsetfo eLyon, eFrance ngaLesitsatfu, mhla tinge-23 Indlovulenkhulu 2016.

src: Khomishene e tsepamisetsa maikutlo ho tlhokeho ya diporofeshenale tsa ditaba tsa kalafo dinaheng tsa lekeno le mahareng le le tlase.
tgt: Lekhomishini igcila ekutseni kunesidzingo setingcweti tetemphilo kumave lanemalingena lesemkhatsini nalephasi.

src: Bikitlaetso bona ba UN bo lebeletswe ho eketsa polokeho ya kalafo lefatsheng ka bophara le ho hodisa kgolo ya moruo e kenyeletsang, e nyehelang bakeng sa ho kenngwa ha Lenaneo la 2030 la Ntshetsopele ya Moshwelella.
tgt: Lesichamkelo saMhlabuhlangene kulindzeleke kutsi ngayo kwandziswe kubakhona kwetemphilo mhlaba wonkhe kanye nekugcugcutela kukhula kutemnotfo lokungukhukhulelangoco, lokufaka ligalelo ekucaliseni kwekusebenta kwe-Ajenda ya-2030 yeNtfutfuko Lesimeme.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla nka Leeto la Puso ho etela Mmuso Borena wa Saudi Arabia ho tloha ka la 27 ho isa ka la 28 Hlakubele 2016, le tla matlafatsa dikamano tse ntseng di le teng pakeng tsa dinaha tse pedi.
tgt: Mengameli Zuma utawutsatsa luhambo lwembuso lwekuvakashela eKingdom of Saudi Arabia kusukela mhla tinge-27 kuya mhla tinge-28 Indlovulenkhulu 2016, lokutawucinisa budlelwane lobuvele bukhona emkhatsini walamave lamabili.

src: Moporesidente o tla kenela Seboka sa bo- 4th sa Tshireletso ya Nyutleleya Washington, ho la Amerika ho tloha ka la 31 Hlakubele ho isa ka la 1 Mmesa 2016.
tgt: Mengameli utawuhambela Ingcungcutsela Ye-4 Yekuphepha Kunozi eWashington eMelika kusukela mhla tinge-31 Indlovulenkhulu kuya mhla lu-1 Mabasa 2016.

src: Seboka se tla tshohla ditshoso tse ntseng di runya tsa boferekanyi ba nyutleleya le ho hlakisa mehato e ka nkuwang ke badudi ba matjhaba ho fokotsa tshebediso ya uraniamo e ntlafaditsweng ka matla, ho tshireletsa thepa e tsietsing, ho lwantsha ho mokolwa ha nyutleleya le ho sitisa, ho lemoha le ho qhaqha maiteko a boferekanyi ba nyutleleya.
tgt: Lengcugcutsela itawubhunga bungoti lobufufusako bebuphekulasikhuni bekusetjentiswa kwenozi kanye nekubuka tinyatselo letingatsatfwa ngummango wemave ngemave kunciphisa kusetjentiswa kweyuriyamu, kuvikela tintfo letisengotini yekuhlaseleka, kulwa nekushushumbiswa kwenozi kanye nekuvimba imitamo yebuphekulasikhuni benozi.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla etella pele mekete ya Letsatsi la Ditokelo tsa Botho Lebaleng la Dipapadi la Moses Mabhida KwaZulu-Natal ka Mantaha, 21 Hlakubele 2016 tlasa mookotaba: “Aforika Borwa e kopane kgahlanong le bomorabe.” Jwaloka ha ho phatlaladitswe ho Puo ka Maemo a Setjhaba ya 2016, Letsatsi la Ditokelo tsa Botho la selemong sena le tla beha motheo wa lenaneo la nako e telele la ho aha setjhaba se hlokang bomorabe.
tgt: Mengameli Zuma utawube ahola imigubho yeLusuku Lwemalungelo Eluntfu lapha eMoses Mabhida KwaZulu-Natal ngeMsombuluko, mhla tinge-21 Indlovulenkhulu 2016 ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “INingizimu Afrika ibumbene ekulweni nebuhlanga.” Njengaloku kumenyetelwe kuNkhulumo yaMengameli Lemayelana Nesimo Selive ya-2016, Lusuku Lwemalungelo Eluntfu lonyaka lutawubeka sisekelo seluhlelo lwesikhatsi lesidze lwekwakha ummango lote buhlanga.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa oohle ho kopana kgahlanong le ho tshweleng ka mathe ha bomorabe – e ka ba ka malapeng a rona, hara metse, dikopanong tsa kahisano, mesebetsing kapa ho marangrang a dikgokahanyo tsa kahisano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi babumbane balwe nebuhlanga – kungaba kusemakhaya etfu, emimangweni, emihlanganweni yetenhlalo, etindzaweni temisebenti nome etinkhundleni tekuchumana.

src: Re tshwanela hore kaofela re sebetseng mmoho ho fihlella demokerasi e kopaneng, e hlokang bomorabe le kgethollo ka bong.
tgt: Kufanele kutsi sonkhe sisebente ngekuhlanganyela kute sibe nentsandvo yelinyenti lebumbene lete buhlanga nalengabandlululi ngebulili.

src: Ditho tsa Phethahatso di tla ikopanya le maAforika Borwa ho parola le naha nakong ya Beke ya Imbizo ya Naha ya ho tsepamisa Maikutlo pakeng tsa la 4 le 10 Mmesa 2016, tlasa mookotaba: “Mmoho re ntshetsa Aforika Borwa pele: Hola Aforika Borwa.” Beke ena e kopana le Beke ya Kopano ya Palamente le Setjhaba le sehopotso sa Kgwedi ya Tokoloho.
tgt: Emalunga eSigungu atawuchumana nebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kulo lonkhe lelive ngesikhatsi seLiviki Lembizo Yavelonkhe emkhatsini wamhla ti-4 kanye namhla ti-10 Mabasa 2016, ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi “Sisonkhe Sichubela iNingizimu Afrika Embili: Yenta iNingizimu Afrika kutsi ikhule.” Leliviki lihambisana neLiviki LePhalamende Leya Etindzaweni Tebavoti kanye nekugutjwa Kwenyanga Yenkhululeko.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa ho nka karolo ka mafolofolo diketsahalong tsena le ho buisana le baetapele ba bona ba sepolotiki.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhutsata bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi batimbandzakanye ngemandla kulemicimbi baphindze futsi bachumane netiphatsimandla tetembusave.

src: Beke ya Imbizo ya ho Tsepamisa Maikutlo e tla hlakisa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Moralo wa Dintlha tse Robong oo morero wa ona e leng ho matlafatsa kgolo ya moruo le ho hlahisa mesebetsi e batlehang e le ka nnete.
tgt: Liviki Lembizo Yavelonkhe litawugcamisa kucala kwekusebenta kweLisu Lemaphuzu Layimfica lokuhloswe ngalo kugcugcutela kukhula kutemnotfo kanye nekudala ematfuba emisebenti ladzingeka kakhulu.

src: Hape e tla tsebisa ka dikatleho tsa mebuso ya lehae, ho kenyeletswa le diphihlello tse unnweng ka moralo wa ho hlasimolla botjha mebuso ya lehae – katamelo ya Ha ho Kgutlelweng Temeng.
tgt: Litawuphindza futsi likhombise hulumende wasekhaya laphumelele kukwenta, lokufaka ekhatsi kuphumelela lakufezile ngekusebentisa lisu lekuvusetela kabusha bohulumende basemakhaya – indlela Yekubuyela Kusicalonchanti.

src: Beke ena hape e tla kopana le boingodiso ba ho qetela bo eteletseng pele Dikgetho tsa Bomasepala tsa 2016, e le ho ya pele ho fana ka monyetla bakeng sa baetapele ho matlafatsa le ho thaotha maAforika Borwa ka matsholo a thuto ya dikgetho bakeng sa ho ingodisa le ho netefatsa dintlha tsa bona tsa ho vouta.
tgt: Leliviki litawuhambisana nemphelasontfo yekubhalisela kuvota kwekugcina ngembikweLukhetfo Lwabomasipala lwa-2016, lokutawunika futsi tiphatsimandla tetembusave litfuba lekubutsela ndzawonye bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika ngemikhankhaso yekubafundzisa ngekuvota kutsi babhalise baphindze bacinisekise imininingwane yabo yekuvota.

src: Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa o tla bula Seboka sa bo-2nd sa Lekgotla la Ntshetsopele ya Mehlodi ya Botho se tla tshwarelwa Setsing sa Dikopano sa Gallagher Midrand ka la 29 le la 30 Hlakubele 2016 tlasa mookotaba: “Bomphato bakeng sa maitsebelo – Kgoeletso ya ho Sebetsa”.
tgt: Lisekela Lamengameli Cyril Ramaphosa utawuvula Ingcungcutsela Ye-2 Yemkhandlu Wekutfutfukisa Umtfombolusito Webantfu letawube ilapha eGallagher Convention Centre eMidrand mhla tinge-29 kanye namhla tinge-30 Indlovulenkhulu 2016 ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Budlelwane Kutemakhono – Lubito Lwekutsatsa Sinyatselo”.

src: Seboka se bokanya mmoho bankakarolo ho phatlalla le lekala la thuto e phahameng bakeng sa ho thusa kgolong ya lona le ho fohla bomphato bo tla bopa dikaho tsa thuto tse tla ba malala-a-laotswe bakeng ho lokisetsa diindaseteri tse batlang di le matla.
tgt: Lengcungcutsela ihlanganisa ndzawonye labatsintsekako kumkhakha wetemfundvo lephakeme wonkhana ngenhloso yekusita entfutfukweni yayo kanye nekwakha budlelwane lobutawudala kutsi kube nebudlelwane lobucinile betikhungo temfundvo lephakeme kutsi tilungele timboni.

src: Beke ya Naha ya Metsi 2016 e tla qala ho tloha ka la 14 ho isa ka la 22 Hlakubele tlasa mookotaba: “Metsi bakeng sa batho, metsi ka batho”.
tgt: Liviki Lavelonkhe Lemanti La-2016 litawuba kusukela mhla ti-14 kuya mhla tinge-22 Indlovulenkhulu ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “ Emanti Ngewebantfu, Emanti ngebantfu.” Leliviki litawukhombisa kutsi emanti njengelilungelo leluntfu ngekutsi kucapheliswe ngenhlupheko yebantfu labangakhoni kufinyelela kutfola emanti lahlobile ekunatsa.

src: Beke ena e tla tsebahatsa metsi jwaloka tokelo ya botho ka ho phahamisa temoso ka mathata batho ba sa fihlelleng metsi a hlwekileng a nwehang.
tgt: Litiko Letemanti kanye Nekuhanjiswa Kwekungcola solo lisachubeka nekucedza luhlelo lwemabhakede kute kube ngunyalo selicedze luhlelo lwemabhakede lolunge-78.8% etindzaweni temikhukhu eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Lefapha la Metsi le tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere le ntse le le motjheng wa ho fedisa mokgwa wa mabakete mme ho fihlela mona le se le fedisitse 78.8% ya mokgwa wa mabakete dibakeng tsa mekhukhu ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Tifundza letisikhombisa tisebente kakhle kakhulu tacedza loluhlelo lwemabhakede nge-avareji lenge-90%.

src: Diporofense tse supileng di sebeditse ka bokgabane ka phediso ya palohare ya 90%.
tgt: Leto tifundza letilucedze nya luhlelo lwemabhakede yi-KwaZulu-Natal, eNyakatfo Nshonalanga eMpumalanga kanye naseGauteng.

src: Kapa Bophirima e fihlelletse phediso ya 99.8%.
tgt: Sifundza saseNshonalanga Kapa sona sine-99.8%.

src: Ho tloha ho maikemisetso a 26 120 bakeng sa Kapa Leboya, Kapa Botjhabela, Leboya Bophirima le Foreisetata, mekgwa e ka bang 11 650 e se e phethetswe ho fihlela kajeno.
tgt: Kusukela kuluhlelo lwemabhakede lolunge-26 120 eNyakatfo Kapa, eMphumalanga Kapa, eNyakatfo Nshonalanga kanye naseFreyistata, tinhlelo temabhakede leti-11 650 seticedziwe kute kube ngulamuhla.

src: Le ha dipula tsa haufinyana tjena di tlisitse kimoloho e itseng, kgahlamelo ya komello e tswela pele ho utlwahala dikarolong tse ding tsa naha.
tgt: Nanome letimvula letisandza kuna tiletse litsemba, lifutse lalesomiso lisachubeka ngekuvakala kuletinye tincenye talelive.

src: MaAforika Borwa a tshwanela ho tswela pele ho sebedisa metsi ka polokeho le ho kenya tshebetsong boikitlaetso ba ho baballa metsi.
tgt: Bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kufanele kutsi bachubeke basebentise emanti ngekuwonga bacalise ngekusebentisa tindlela tekonga emanti.

src: Mmuso o se o fane ka R1 bilione ho sebetsana le koduwa ya komello.
tgt: Hulumende ubekele eceleni sigidzigidzi sinye semarandi kubukana nenkinga yesomiso.

src: Kabinete e amohela kgatelopele e seng e entswe ke lenaneo la Ntwa ya ho dutla tlasa mookotaba: “Lerothodi ka leng ke la bohlokwa.” Lenanaeo le rerile ho thaotha, ho rupella le ho jala batho ba batjha ba 15 000 ba nang le bonyane Kereiti 12 kapa N3 jwaloka boradipeipi, ditsebi le baemedi ba metsi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayemukela lenchubekelembili leyentiwe luhlelo lweminyaka lesihlanu Lwekulwa Nekuvuta ngaphasi kwengcikitysi letsi: Lelo Nalelo Tfonsi Libalulekile.” Loluhlelo kuhloswe ngalo kuheha, kucecesha kanye nekunika bantfu labasha labaneticu temfundvo yamatekuletjeni nome N3 laba-15 000 ematfuba kutsi babe ngulabasebenta ngemaphayiphi emanti, labasebenta ngetandla kanye nema-ejenti emanti.

src: Maemo a Kabinete Mabapi le Dintlha tsa Bohlokwa Maemong a Hajwale.
tgt: Lokushiwo yiKhabhinethi mayelana netindzaba letimcoka kusimondzawo.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho baipelaetsi ho sebetsa ka ho itshwara ho phethahetseng mme ba hlahise ditletlebo tsa bona ka hara ho ikobela molao le Molaotheo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe labashucako kutsi bakwente loko ngekutitsiba lokukhulu futsi bavakalalise tikhalo tabo ngekulandzela umtsetfo kanye neMtsetfosisekelo.

src: Ho tjhwatla le tshenyo ya thepa di ka nqane ho tokelo ya ho ipelaetsa le ho ba mosebetsi wa botlokotsebe o tswileng tseleng.
tgt: Kucekela phasi kanye nekulimata imphahla sekungale kwemikhawulo yekushuca sekungumsebenti webugebengu.

src: Makala a tiisetso ya molao a tla boloka molao ka ho tshwara le ho ahlola ba senyang thepa diyunivesithing, ditsheng tse ding tsa thuto e phahameng, ka hara metse le nakong ya diketso tsa boipelaetso.2 Letona la Ditjhelete le tsebisitse Kabinete ka matsholo a ho eta a haufinyana tjena ao le a nkileng ho ya Amerika le Engelane le bankakarolo ba fapafapaneng, ba kennyeletsang baetapele ba dikgwebo.
tgt: Ema-ejensi lacinisekisa kutsi umtsetfo uyagcinwa atawusebentisa umtsetfo kubopha nekujezisa labo labacekele phasi imphahla emanyuvesi, kanye nakuletinye tikhungo temfundvo lephakeme, emimangweni kanye nalapho kushucwa khona.. Indvuna Yetetimali itjele Ikhabhinethi ngalamafishane mayelana nemkhankhaso wayo lesandza kuwenta wekuya eMelika naseNgilandi ahamba nalabatsintsekako labahlukahlukene, lokufaka ekhatsi baholi betemabhizinisi.

src: Kabinete e itlamme bakeng sa ho netefatsa hore naha e sebetsa mmoho hore re seke ra theolelwa maemo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi itimisele ekucinisekiseni kutsi lelive lisebenta ngekubambisana kute sicinisekise kutsi alehliselwa phasi lizinga lalo.

src: Leeto le neha mmuso monyetla wa ho arola mekgahlelo e mengatanyana e fapaneng ya boikitlaetso e kentsweng tshebetsong ho sebetsana le diphephetso.
tgt: Lokuvakasha kunika hulumende litfuba lekuchaza ngetichamkelo letinyenti lasacale kutisebentisa kubukana naletinsayeya.

src: Tsena di kenyeletsa diketso tsa tshebedisano mmoho ho akofisa kgolo e kenyeletsang, mekgwa ya ho potlakisa matlafatso ya maemo a ditjhelete, ho potlakisa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Lenaneo la rona la Matsete a Meralo ya Motheo la R870 bilione, kgatelopele e entsweng mabapi le ho rarolla mathata a eneji, ho kenyeletswa le eneji e ka hlabollwang botjha.
tgt: Loku kufaka ekhatsi kusebenta ngekubambisana ekwenteni kutsi kube nekukhula lokuphangisako lokungukhukhulelangoco, tinyatselo nekusheshisa kuhlanganiswa kwetimali tahulumende, kucalisa ngekushesha kusebentisa Luhlelo Lwelutjalotimali Lwesakhiwonchanti setigidzigidzi letinge-R870 kanye nenchubekelembili lesentiwe yekusombulula kusweleka kwemandla, lokufaka ekhatsi emandla lavusetelelwako.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho makala kaofela ho bua ka mananeo kaofela a lokileng le boitshunyako bo entsweng ho baballa moruo wa rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela yonkhe imikhakha kutsi yente tonkhe letinhlelo letinhle kanye netingenelelo lesetentiwe tekuvikela umnotfo wetfu.

src: Ho bohlokwa bakeng sa makala oohle ho netefatsa hore moruo wa naha o a itwanela.
tgt: Kubalulekile kuyo yonkhe imikhakha kutsi icinisekise kutsi umnotfo welive letfu ucinile.

src: Tabeng ena, Kabinete hape e laetse Komiti ya Kopanelo ya Matona ya Matsete ho akofisa diqeto tsohle tse amanang le moruo.
tgt: Ngaleyo ndlela-ke Ikhabhinethi itjele Likomidi Lelihlanganisa Tindvuna Letelutjalotimali kutsi lente kutsi tonkhe tincumo letihambelana netemnotfo tifezeke masinyane.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa hore ho itwanela ha moruo wa Aforika Borwa ho ahilwe hodima metheo e tsitsitseng le maano a kgonehang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaphindza itsi kucina kwemnotfo waseNingizimu Afrika kusime kutikhonkhwane temnotfo letingito kanye nakumitsetfomgomo lephatsekako.

src: Kabinete e lemohile nyewe ya lekgotla la dinyewe e ritetsweng ke Tjhemba ya Merafo bakeng sa hore Tjhata ya Merafo e nkuwe e sa imatahanye le molaotheo le ho hloka motheo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilibonile licala lasenkantolo lelifakwe yi-Chamber of Mines kutsi Umculu Wetimayini utsatfwe njengalongahambisani nemtsetfosisekelo nalongekho futsi emtsetfweni.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa ntlha ya hore dipehelo tsa Tjhata ya Merafo di reretswe ho fetola indaseteri ya merafo le ho lokisa botjha nalane ya ho se lekalekane ho bakilweng ke mmuso wa kgethollo hore indaseteri ena e kgeme le diphethoho tse teng ka hara Aforika Borwa tse akaretsang sebopeho sa kahisano, dipolotiki le moruo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isaphindza itsi imitsetfomgomo yeMculu Wetimayini ihlose ekuntjintjeni imboni yetimayini kutsi kulungiswe kungalingani kwasesikhatsini lesengca lokwabangwa lubandlululo kute kutsi lemboni ihambisane netingucuko lesetikhona ekuntjintjeni yonkhe iNingizimu Afrika kutenhlalo, tembusave netemnotfo.

src: Ntlafatso ya badudi le yona ke sebaka se tsepamiseditseng maikutlo ho netefatsa hore ntshetsopele ya merafo ha e qhelele ka thoko badudi ba amehang.
tgt: Kuphakanyiswa kwemimango kuyintfo lemcoka kute kucinisekiswe kutsi intfutfuko etimayini ayiyishiyi ngephandle imimango lefanele.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho basebedisi bohle ba mebila, haholoholo ba tla beng ba nka maeto nakong e tlang ya matsatsi a phomolo, ho bapala karolo ya bona ka ho nka boikarabelo bakeng sa polokeho ya bona le ya basebedisi ba bang ba mebila.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe labasebentisa umgwaco, ikakhulu labo labatawube basendleleni kulamaholide latako, kutsi badlale indzima yabo ngekutsi bente siciniseko kutsi baphephile nalabanye basebentisi bemgwaco nabo baphephile.

src: Phediso ya dikotsi tsa mebileng e ntse e le ntlha e ka sehloohong ya naha.
tgt: Kucedvwa kwetingoti temgwaco yindzaba yavelonkhe hulumende layibeke embili.

src: Bakganni ba lokela ho fadimeha, ho ikobela melawana ya mebila, ho se nwe ba ntse ba kganna, ho tsamaya ka lebelo le behilweng le ho netefatsa hore makoloi a bona a loketse tsela.
tgt: Bashayeli kufanele kutsi bacaphele, bahloniphe imitsetfo yemgwaco, banganatsi tjwala bese bayashayela, bagcine litubane lelinchunyiwe baphindze futsi bente siciniseko sekutsi tincola tabo tisesimeni lesiphilile.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa bahlodi bohle ba Dikgau tsa Naha tsa Ditokelo tsa ba nang le Boqhwala tse neng di tshwerwe ka la 11 Hlakubele 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela bonkhe labo labaphumelele kuMiklomelo Yavelonkhe Yalabakhubatekile lebeyikadze imhla ti-11 Indlovulenkhulu 2016.

src: Dikgau tsena di ne di ananela batho ba phelang ka boqhwala le balwanedi ba ditokelo tsa batho ba phelang ka boqhwala ba ipabotseng ka makgabane selemong sa 2015.
tgt: Ngalemiklomelo kuhlonishwe bantfu labanekukhubateka kanye netishikashiki temalungelo alabakhubatekile letente kahle kakhulu ngemnyaka wa-2015.

src: Kabinete e tlotla bahlodi bohle ba Dikgau tsa bo-3 tsa Naha tsa Selemo ka seng tsa Boqhetseke tsa Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa ya Aforika Borwa (SAPS), tse lebisang hlompho ho boqhetseke ba ditho tsa SAPS, maresefe le diforamo tsa badudi tsa sepolesa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela bonkhe labaphumelele kuMiklomelo Ye-3 Yembutfo Wemaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika(i-SAPS) Yemnyaka Yavelonkhe Yemalengiso lehlonipha lawo malunga e-SAPS, emarizefu kanye nemalunga emmango lasetinkhundleni temaphoyisa emmangweni.

src: Kabinete hape e thoholetsa bangodimmoho Mandla Dube le Leon Otto ba Pambili Media bakeng sa filimi Kalushi: The Story of Solomon Mahlangu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibashayela lihlombe boMandla Dube naLeon Otto basePambili Media ngekubhala ngekuhlanganyela lifilimu letsi Kalushi: The Story of Solomon Mahlangu.

src: MaAforika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho boha setlabolane sena sa dipolotiki ka ho fetohela ha mohlankana ya motjha ya dilemo di 19 ya hlahang Mamelodi, ka Botjhabela ho Pretoria, ho ba mohale wa Ntwa ya Tokoloho.
tgt: Bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bayakhutsatwa kutsi babukele lelifilimu letembusave lelimayena nekuntjintja kwelijaha lelincane lelineminyaka le-19 laseMamelodi, emphumalanga ePitoli, laba lichawe leMzabalazo.

src: Kabinete e boeleditse hore mmuso, ka Lefapha la Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri le la Bonono le Setso, o tla tswela pele ho tshehetsa kgolo ya indaseteri ya bonono bakeng sa ho keteka le ho pheta pale ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaphindza itsi hulumende utawuchubeka, ngekusebentisa Litiko Letekuhweba Netimboni kanye neLitiko Letebuciko Nemasiko, kuchubeka nekusekela kukhula kwemboni yetebuciko ngekutsi kugutjwe kuphindvwe kutekwe indzaba yaseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa molwanedi wa toka ya kahisano Moruti Michael Lapsley bakeng sa ho amohela Moputso wa Kgotso ya Setjhaba wa matjhaba wa 2016 mokgahlelong wa ‘Kgotso ya Lefatshe le Poelano – Mmopi wa Kgotso ya Babatswang ke Matjhaba’.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela sishikashiki sebulungiswa betenhlalo Father Michael Lapsley ngekuklonyeliswa ngemklomelo wemave ngemave wa-2016 Public Peace Prize kumkhakha ‘Kuthula Kwemhlaba Wonkhe kanye Nekubuyisana’ – Umdali Wekuthula Lodvume Emaveni Ngemave’.

src: Ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha mananeo a bohlokwa a mmuso.
tgt: Kufezekiswa kwetinhlelo tahulumende letibalulekile.

src: Kabinete e amohela diphihlello tse hlakisitsweng ke Moporesidente Jacob Zuma ha a ne a etetse setsheng sa Boemakepe ba Port Elizabeth ho la Kapa Botjhabela,ho lekola kgatelopele e entsweng ho kenngweng tshebetsong ha boikitlaetso ba Operation Phakisa: Moruo wa Mawatle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela lokuzuziwe lokugcanyiswe nguMengameli Jacob Zuma ngesikhatsi avakashele Sikhumulo Semikhumbi saseBhayi eMphumalanga Kapa, ayohlola inchubekelembili leyentiwe ekufezekiseni i-Operation Phakisa: Umtamo Wemnotfo Waselwandle.

src: Mmuso o butse matsete a ka fihlang ho se ka etsang R17 bilione ho Moruo wa Mawatle.
tgt: Hulumende sewudale tintjalomali letingu-R17 wetigidzi Emnotfweni Waselwandle.

src: Ho tloha esale e thehwa, ho se ho hlahisitswe mesebetsi e fetang 4500 makaleng a fapafapaneng.
tgt: Kusukela yacala, sekudaleke imisebenti lengetulu kwale-4 500 emikhakheni leyehlukene.

src: Tse pedi tsa diketswana tse hulang tse ntseng di ahuwa ke Southern African Shipyards bakeng sa Bolaodi ba Maemakepe a Naha ba Transnet (TNPA) Boemakepeng ba Durban di tla lebiswa Boemakepeng ba Port Elizabeth.
tgt: Tikebhe letimbili taleyimfica tekudvosa imikhumbi letakhiwe yi-Southern African Shipyards teSiphatsimandla Setikhumulo Temikhumbi Savelonkhe SeTransnet (i-TNPA) eSikhumulweni Semikhumbi yaseDurban iyiswa eBhayi.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o thakgotse seketswana sa pele se hulang ho la Port Elizabeth, se reheletsweng Mvezo, e leng tulo ya tswalo ya Moporesidente wa mehleng Nelson Mandela.
tgt: Mengameli Zuma wetfule sikebhe sekudvosa imikhumbi sekucala eBhayi, lesibitwa ngekutsi nguMvezo, lesetsiwe ngeligama lendzawo lapho kwatalelwa khona Mengameli waphambilini Nelson Mandela.

src: TNPA e beheletse ka thoko se ka fetang R7 bilione bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa maemakepe a rona.
tgt: I-TNPA seyabe ngetulu kwetigidzigidzi le-R7 tekuphucula tikhumulo tetfu temikhumbi.

src: Moporesidente o ile a sheba metjha ya dikepe e ntlafaditsweng le ho ahuwa botjha e kenang ka hara Boemakepe ba Port Elizabeth tse tla kgona ho amohela dikepe tse kgolo tse 12 ka hodimo papisong le tsa hajwale tse pedi.
tgt: Mengameli wehlwaye lugidzi lwekuhambisa nekwemukela tikebhe letincane loluphuculiwe nalolwakhiwe kabusha kanye netakhiwonchanti tesikhumulo semikhumbi tekuvikela imikhumbi eSikhumulweni Semikhumbi saseBhayi lesitawetfwala imikhumbi lengetulu kwale-12 kunalena lemibili lekhona kwamanje.

src: Kabinete e leboha balefi kaofela ba lekgetho ba ipapisitseng le mmuso selemong sa ditjhelete sa 2015/16 bakeng sa ho fihlisa pokeletso ya rona ya lekeno ho R1trilione lekgetlo la pele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibonga bonkhe bantfu labakhokha umtselo lababambisene nahulumende ngemnyakamabhuku wanga-2015/16 kwenta lugcogcomali lolwente tigidzigidzi tetigidzigidzi le-R1 kwekucala ngca.

src: Sena ke sesupo se hlakileng sa matla a moruo wa rona o hlabolohang le ka tlasa maemo a WEBTOKEN ka dinyehelo tsa lekgetho la maAforika Borwa a lokelang le pokeletso e hlwahlwa e etswang ke Ditshebeletso tsa Lekeno tsa Aforika Borwa hore mmuso o kgone betere ho fana ka ditshebeletso tse hlokahalang haholo tse nyehelang bakeng sa ntlafatso ya bophelo ba maAforika Borwa.
tgt: Lena yinkhomba lecaca kahle kamhlophe yemandla emnotfo wetfu lophumelelako ngisho nasetimeni letimatima.

src: Kabinete e amohela tsebiso ya Moporesidente Zuma ya la 3 Phato 2016 jwaloka letsatsi la Dikgetho tsa Mebuso ya lehae tsa 2016.
tgt: Kungenca yemtselo lokhokhwa bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labahambisana nemtsetfo kanye nekugcogca ngemphumelelo kweLuphiko Lwamalingena LwaseNingizimu Afrika lokwenta kutsi hulumende akhone kwetfula kancono tinsita letidzingeka kakhulu letifaka sandla ekuphuculeni timphilo tebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Mmuso o itumetse hore mafelo a beke a mabedi a boingodiso a la 5–6 Tlhakubele le la 9–10 Mmesa ho bonahetse ha batho ba ka nnang ba kgetha ba tlile ka bongata diteisheneng tsa ho kgetha,haholo-holo ba tla beng ba vouta lekgetlo la pele le batjha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasemukela simemetelo saMengameli Zuma sekutsi lusuku lwamhla ti-3 Ingci 2016 lube lusuku Lwelukhetfo Lwahulumende Wasekhaya Lwanga-2016.

src: Kabinete e leboha bohle ba arabetseng kgoeletso ya hore ba ingodise le ho hlahloba dintlha tsa bona lenaneng la bakgethi.
tgt: Hulumende uyatfokota kutsi letimphelansontfo letimbili tekubhalisa tamhla ti-5 – 6 Mabasa kanye nemhla ti-9 – 10 Mabasa kube khona emanani lamakhulu ebantfu labatawuba bavoti labavakashele titeshi tekuvota, ikakhulu bavoti labacala kuvota kanye nelusha.

src: Ke ka bonkakarolo ba rona ka kopanelo hore demokerasi ya rona e dule e matlafala.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibonga bonkhe bantfu labaphendvulile kulesimemo sekubhalisa baphindze futsi bahlola nemininingwane yabo eluhlwini lwekubhalisa.

src: Kabinete kgothaletsa baahi bohle ba so ka ba ingodisa kapa ho hlahloba dintlha tsa bona ho etela dikantoro tsa Khomishene e Ikemetseng ya Dikgetho ho bomasepala ba bona ho ya lokisa dintlha tsa bona lenaneng la bakgethi (fana ka diaterese) le ho ingodisetsa ho vouta dikgethong tsa la 3 Phato 2016.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi icela tonkhe takhamuti letisengakabhalisi nobe letisengakahloli imininingwane yato kutsi tivakashele emahhovisi eKhomishini Yelukhetfo Letimele kubomasipala bato bendzawo tilungise imininingwane yato eluhlwini lwebavoti ibe sesikhatsini samanje (tinikete emakheli ato) tibuye futsi tibhalisele kuvota nakuvotwa mhla ti-3 Ingci.

src: Bakgethi hape ba ka romela dimoro sa bona tsadi boitsebiso ka SMS ho 3281.0 kapa ba letsetse setsi sa mehala ho 0800 11 8000 ho netefatsa maemo a bona.
tgt: Bavoti bangabuye futsi batfumele tinombolo tabo tematisi nge-SMS ku: 3281.0 nobe bashayele sikhungo sekutsintsana ku: 0800 11 8000 kute bacinisekise simo.

src: Boingodiso bo netefatsa lebitso la hao lenaneng la bakgethi hore o tle o kgone ho vouta.
tgt: Kubhalisa kwenta kutsi ligama lakho libe khona eluhlwini lwebavoti kute kutsi ukwati kuvota.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho baahi ho sebedisa tokelo ya bona ya demokerasi e lwanetsweng ka thata ka ho vouta Dikgethong tsa Mebuso ya Lehae tsa 2016 ka la 3 Phato 2016.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi imema takhamuti kutsi tisebentise lilungelo lato lentsandvo yelinyenti leyatfolwa kamatima kutsi tivote eLukhetfweni Lwahulumende Wasekhaya lwanga-2016 mhla ti-3 Ingci 2016.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa semmuso ha Porojeke ya Teko ya eChannel ya Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae (DHA) ke Moporesidente Zuma.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyakwemukela kwetfulwa ngalokusemtsetfweni kweMkamo Wekufezekisa i-eChannel weLitiko Letasekhaya (i-DHA) nguMengameli Zuma.

src: Tsamaisong ena e ntjha ya ntlafatso e dumella baahi ho etsa dikopo tsa bona tsa dikarete tsa boitsebiso ka inthanete ho phema mela e melelele.
tgt: Lomtamo lomusha utawenta takamuti kutsi tikwati kufaka ticelo tabomakhadimatisi babo ku-inthanethi futsi tigweme kuma imigca lemidze.

src: Ka tshebedisano mmoho le dibanka tse nne tse kgolo – ABSA, FNB, Nedbank le Standard Bank – ho hlahisa lepatlelo la ho etsa dikopo tsa dikarete tsa boitsebiso le diphasepoto ho tla thusa basebedisi ho etela dintlwana tsa Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae ho fana ka dikgatiso tsa bona tsa menwana le dinepe kamora ho ba ba beheletse dibaka le ho lefa ka inthanete.
tgt: Kubambisana nemabhange lamakhulu lamane i–ABSA, FNB, Nedbank kanye neStandard Bank– kwetfula indlela yekufaka ticelo taBomakhadimatisi kanye nemapasipoti ku-inthanethi kutawenta emakhasimende kutsi avakashele ema-kiosks e-DHA kutsi angenise tinyatseliso teminwe ato kanye netitfombe ngemuva kwekuhlela tikhatsi tekwenta loko kantsi futsi sebakhokhele ku-inthanethi.

src: eChannel ke karolo ya lefapha ya kakaretso ya ho ntjhafatsa lewa la ho tlosa ditshebeletso ho tloha tshebedisong ya dipampiri ho ya ho tshebediso ya dijithale, e leng tsamaiso e tla kenyeletsa tlhwekiso ya rejisetara ya setjhaba.
tgt: I-eChannel iyincenye yendlelalisu yesimanje yekuphucula ngalokuphelele yekwenta kutsi tinsita tingasentiwa ephepheni kepha tentiwe ngekwedijithali, inchubo letawufaka ekhatsi kuhlantwa kwerejista yebantfu.

src: Kabinete e amohela katleho ya Beke ya Imbizo ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo e neng e etsahala haufinyana tlasa mookotaba ‘Mmoho re ntshetsa Aforika Borwa pele’, moo ho bonweng bahlanka ba mmuso ba ikopanya le badudi ho phatlalla le naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kuphumelela kweliViki Lekugcila KutiMbizo lesandza kubanjwa ngaphansi kwengcikitsi letsi ‘Sisonkhe sichubekisela iNingizimu Afrika embili’, lokwenta kutsi tikhulu tahulumende tikhulumisane nemimango kulo lonkhe lelive.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa maAforika Borwa a nkileng karolo ho mananeo a fetang 36 ho phatlalla le naha, e leng se netefaditseng hore mmuso o arabetse ho ditlhoko tse hlwailweng tsa badudi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi incoma bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labahlanganyele etinhlelweni letingetulu kwaletinge-36 kulo lonkhe lelive, labacinisekise kutsi hulumende uyaphendvula ekuboneni tidzingo temimango.

src: Beke ya Imbizo ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo e matlafaditse badudi ka tlhahisoleseding e mabapi le mananeo a mmuso.
tgt: LiViki Lekugcila kutiMbizo seyihlomise imimango ngelwatiso lolumayelana netinhlelo tahulumende.

src: Lefapha la Bodulo ba Batho le ne le tshwere seboka se atlehileng haholo sa Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) se sebetsanang le mekhukhu, se toboketsa sekgahla se matla sa kgolo ya metse ya ditoropo le kgolo ya mekhukhu.
tgt: Litiko Letekuhlaliswa Kwebantfu libambe inkhomfa yaMhlabuhlangene (ye-UN) lebe yimphumelelo lenkhulu lebeyibukene nekuhlala kwebantfu etindzaweni letingakahleleki (emikhukhwini), igcizelela lizinga lesivinini lekwenta letindzawo kutsi tibe tasemadolobheni kanye nekukhula kwemikhukhu.

src: Hona jwale batho ba etsang bilione e le nngwe lefatsheng ba dula mekhukhung.
tgt: Manje bantfu labasigidzi sinye emhlabeni bahlala emikhukhwini.

src: Aforika Borwa e se e ahile dimilione tsa matlo esale ho tloha ka 1994 jwaloka karolo ya ho netefatsa bophelo bo botle bakeng sa bohle.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika seyakhe tindlu letitigidzi kusukela nga-1994 njengencenye yekucinisekisa imphilo lencono yabo bonkhe bantfu.

src: DibiliKabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Dibili tsa moralo tse latelang:.
tgt: ImitsetfosivivinyoIKhabhinethi ivume tinhlaka taleMitsetfosivivinyo lelandzelako:.

src: Bili ya Tshireletso ya Meralo ya Motheo e Hlokolosi ya 2016 e tla phatlalatswa Koranteng ya Mmuso bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: Umtsetfosivivinyo Wekuvikelwa Kwetakhiwonchanti Letibalulekile wa-2016 kutsi ushicilelwe kuGazethi yaHulumende kute kutsi ummango uphawule.

src: Bili e fetola Molao wa Ditsi tsa Bohlokwa tsa Naha, 1980 (Molao 102 wa 1980), mme e batla ho matahanya tsamaiso ya ho hlwaya le ho hlahisa meralo ya motheo e hlokolosi ka mokgwa wa ponaletso le o nang le maikarabelo.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo ucitsa Umtsetfo Wetindzawo Tavelonkhe Letibalulekile, 1980 (Umtsetfo-102 wa-1980), futsi ufuna kwenta lenchubo yekukhomba nekumemetela takhiwonchanti letibalulekile kuhambisane futsi kwentiwe ngendlela lebeka tintfo ebaleni lebuye futsi ibe nekutiphendvulela.

src: Hape e tla netefatsa hore meralo ya motheo kaofela e hlokolosi e ya hlwauwa le ho tshireletswa ka tshwanelo bakeng sa polokeho ya naha.
tgt: Utawubuye futsi wente siciniseko sekutsi tonkhe takhiwonchanti tekuvikela tavelonkhe talelive tiyakhonjwa tibuye futsi tivikelwe ngalokwenele.

src: Bili e fana ka ho tekwa ha moralo wa ditsi bakeng sa ho beha leihlo le ho tsamaisa tshireletso ya meralo ya motheo e hlokolosi.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo wenta kutsi kwentiwe luhlakamsebenti lwesikhungo lwekulandzelela kanye nekulawula kuvikelwa kwetakhiwonchanti letibalulekile.

src: E boela e hlalosa mesebetsi ya lekala le tla eletsa Letona la Sepolesa tlhahisong ya meralo ya motheo e hlokolosi.
tgt: Luphindze futsi luchubeke luchaze imisebenti yemtimba lotaweluleka Indvuna Yetemaphoyisa ekumemeteleni takhiwonchanti letibalulekile.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Mekgatlo ya Thepa ya Bodulo bo Kopanetsweng ya 2016 e tla phatlalatswa bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: Umtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibiyela Tinhlangano Temphahla Yemmango wa- 2016 utawushicilelwa kute kutsi ummango uphawule.

src: Bili e fetola Molao wa hajwale wa Mekgatlo ya Thepa ya Bodulo bo Kopanetsweng,1996 (Molao 28 wa1996).Bili e tla matlafatsa tsamaiso ya taolo ya demokerasi ya Mekgatlo ya Thepa ya Bodulo bo Kopanetsweng e teng kapa dihlopha tsa Trust tse teng tse behang leihlo mobu wa bodulo bo kopanetsweng.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uchibiyela Umtsetfo weTinhlangano Temphahla Yemmango, wa-1996 (Umtsetfo we-28 wa-1996).LoMtsetfosivivinyo utawucinisa inchubo yekuhola ngekubambisana kwentsandvo yelinyenti weTinhlangano Temphahla Yemmango letikhona nobe tintfo te-Trust letengamele umhlaba wemmango.

src: Bili e fetotsweng e fana ka ho thehwa ha Morejisetara ka hara Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Dibaka tsa Mahae le Tlhabollo ya Naha, mme e hlalosa mesebetsi ya kantoro ena.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo lochitjelwe wenta kutsi kwentiwe kube neRejista kuLitiko Letekutfutfukiswa Kwetindzawo Tasemaphandleni kanye Netingucuko Kutemhlaba.

src: Hang ha Bili ena e fetisitswe ho ba molao, e tla matlafatsa taolo ya ditsi tsa puso le ho matlafatsa tshehetso ya Mmuso ho tsona.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo ungaphasiswa ube ngumtsetfo, utawucinisa kulawulwa kwetikhungo letenganyelwe ubuye futsi wente kancono kwesekelwa kwato nguMbuso.

src: E tla thusa badudi ho fumana, ho tshwara le ho laola thepa ya bodulo ka dihlopha tse hlwahlwa tse thehilweng semolao tse tshehetswang ke mmuso.
tgt: Utawenta imimango kutsi itfole, ibe nemphahla ibuye futsi iyilawule ngekusebentisa imitimba yetekulawula yetemtsetfo lesunguliwe lesekelwa nguhulumende.

src: Ho hlahiswa ha Bili ya Bonamodi ba Matjhaba ya 2016 ho Palamente.
tgt: Kwetfulwa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekulawula Wemave Emhlaba wa-2016.

src: Tsamaiso ya matjhaba ya bonamodi ke sesebediswa sa bohlokwa bakeng sa ho kena kgwebong ho parola le meedi ya naha.
tgt: Inchubo yekulamula yemave emhlaba ilithulusi lelibalulekile lwekwenta ibhizinisi nalamanye emave.

src: E tla ntlafatsa phumantsho ho ditshebeletso tsa toka bakeng sa dikhamphani tse nang le kgwebisano le tsa ka ntle ho naha le dikhamphani tsa melata tse ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Utawenta kancono tinsita tetebulungiswa tetinkampani letichuba ibhizinisi ngaphandle kweminyele yalelive kanye netinkampani talamanye emave letilapha eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Bili e fetola Molao wa Kananelo le Tiisetso ya Phano ya Bonamodi ba Matjhaba, 1977 (Molao 40 wa 1977) mme hape e fetola Molao wa hajwale wa Tshireletso ya Kgwebo, 1978 (Molao 99 wa 1978).
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo ucitsa Kwemukelwa kanye Nekucinisekiswa KweMtsetfo Wetincumo Temlamuli Temave Angephandle, wa-1977 (Umtsetfo we-40 wa-1977) uphindze futsi uchibele Umtsetfo Wekuvikelwa Kwemabhizinisi lokhona kwamanje, wa-1978 (Umtsetfo we-99 wa-1978).

src: Bili e sisintsweng e imatahanya le Molao wa Motlolo wa Bonamodi ba Matjhaba ba Dikgwebo, o amohetsweng ke Khomishene ya UN ya Molao wa Matjhaba wa Kgwebisano.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uhambisana neMtsetfo Loyimodeli Wekulamula Emabhizinisi Emave Emhlaba, lowemukelwe yiKhomishini ye-UN yeMtsetfo Wekuhweba Wemave Emhlaba.

src: Phatlalatso ya Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Moralo ya Motheo wa Naha wa Diphuputso ya 2016 ho Koranta ya Mmuso bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: Kushicilelwa kweluhlaka LweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibela Wesikhwama Selucwaningo Savelonkhe wa-2016 kuGazethi yaHulumende kute kutsi ummango uphawule.

src: Bili e fetola Molao wa Motheo wa Naha wa Diphuputso, 1998 (Molao 23 wa 1998).Bili e tla ntlafatsa bophehisani ba Aforika Borwa ntshetsopeleng le ntjhafatsong ya diphuputso ka tsamaiso e hlwahlwa, e nepahetseng le e hokahaneng ya boikopanyo ba setjhaba le tsa saense, le ho ntlafatsa le phumantsho ya meralo ya motheo ya diphuputso.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uchibela Umtsetfo Wesikhwama Selucwaningo Savelonkhe, 1998 (Umtsetfo we-23 wa-1998).LoMtsetfosivivinyo utawenta kancono kucudzelana kweNingizimu Afrika ekutfutfukiseni lucwaningo kanye nekwenta tintfo letinsha nelulawulo lolusebentako, lolwenele naloluhlangene lwekuhlanganyela kwemmango kutesayensi, kanye nekuniketwa kwesakhiwonchanti selucwaningo lesivunyiwe kanye nekufinyelelwa.

src: Hape e tla ntlafatsa karabelo le bohlwahlwa ba ntshetsopele ya diphuputso le phano ya ntjhafatso, ho ntlafatsa boleng ba bophelo ba maAforika Borwa ka boimatahanyo bo betere le dintlha tse ka sehloohong tsa mmuso.
tgt: Utawuphindze futsi wente kancono kuphendvula kanye nekusebenta ngemphumelelo kwekutfutfukiswa kwetelucwaningo kanye nekutsi kwentiwe lokusha, kute kwentiwe kancono lizinga lemphilo yebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika ngekuhambisana kancono netintfo tahulumende letibekwa embili.

src: Diqeto tsa bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Tincumo teKhabhineti letibalulekile.

src: Cabinet e amohetse Pampiri e Tshweu e Mabapi le Tshebetso ya Sepolesa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukele Umtsetfo Lodzingidvwako weTebuphoyisa.

src: Pampiri e Tshweu ya moralo e qadile ho phatlalatswa bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba ka Tlhakubele 2015.
tgt: Loluhlaka lweMtsetfo Lodzingidvwako lwashicilelwa kwekucala kute kutsi ummango uphawule ngawo ngaMabasa 2015.

src: Pampiri e teka ntlha ya sepolesa se sekametseng ka ho baahi ba itahlelang ka setotswana le ho arabela ho tikoloho e teng hajwale ya sepolesa.
tgt: Lomtsetfo lodzingidvwako wenta kutsi kubekhona temisebenti yemaphoyisa lekhetsa takhamuti letishukumako kanye nekuphendvula kusimondzawo lesigadvwako lesikhona kwamanje.

src: Hape e teka ntlha ya Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa ya Aforika Borwa le Sepolesa sa Metse Meholo se nang le boikarabelo le ho ba sa seporofeshenale.
tgt: Uphindze futsi wente kutsi kube khona Luphiko Lwetemisebenti Yemaphoyisa LwaseNingizimu Afrika kanye nemaphoyisa amasipala latiphendvulelako kanye nalatingcweti.

src: Pampiri e Tshweu e etsa boipiletso ba ho thehwa ha Boto ya Naha ya Sepolesa eo, hara mesebetsi e meng, e tla ikarabella bakeng sa ho tla ka mokgwa o se nang leeme wa ho thaotha, ho kgetha le ho thonya makolwane a matjha ka hara ditshebeletso tsa sepolesa.
tgt: LoMtsetfo Lodzingidvwako uphindze futsi wente simemo sekutsi kusungulwe Ibhodi Yemaphoyisa Yavelonkhe, emkhatsini waleminye imisebenti, utawuba nemsebenti wekusungula tinchubo letingavuni luhlangotsi tekutfolwa kwemaphoyisa, kukhetfwa nekubekwa etikhundleni kwemaphoyisa latfoliwe kutemisebenti yemaphoyisa.

src: Kabinete e amohetse Pampiri e Tshweu e mabapi le Polokeho le Tshireletso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yemukele LoMtsetfo Lodzingidvwako weTekuvikela Nekuphepha.

src: Pampiri ena e Tshweu, e seng e tswile bakeng sa tjhebisano le setjhaba ka Hlakola 2015, e tsepamisitse maikutlo hodima katamelo e kopanetsweng le ya ntshetsopele ya polokeho e shebileng ka nqane ho sepolesa.
tgt: LoMtsetfo Lodzingidvwako, lesewuvele uphumile kute kutsi kukhulunyiswane ngawo nemmango ngeNdlovana 2015, ugcile endleleni lehlanganisiwe neyekutfutfukisa tekuvikela kwendlula tebuphoyisa.

src: E batla ho fana ka tataiso bakeng sa mekgwa ya polokeho ya ba badudi.
tgt: Ufuna kukhombindlela kutekuvikela tekuphepha temimango.

src: Pampiri e Tshweu e hlwaya mafapha kaofela a amehang le mekgatlo ya badudi e nyeheleng bakeng sa polokeho ya badudi.
tgt: LoMtsetfo Lodzingidvwako uchaza onkhe ematiko lafanele kanye netinhlangano temmango letifaka sandla ekuphepheni kwemimango.

src: Kabinete e tjhaellese monwana moralo wa Leano o mabapi le Ketso ya Moetlo wa lebollo ka hara Aforika Borwa le ho tjhaella monwana hore Lefapha la Merero ya Setso le qale ho rala molao wa naha wa tsa lebollo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iluvumile luhlaka Lwenchubomgomo Yelisiko Lekusoka LaseNingizimu Afrika yaphindze futsi yavuma kutsi Litiko Lebaholi Bendzabuko licale lente luhlaka lemtsetfo wekusoka lwavelonkhe.

src: Leano lena le se le sebeditswe haholo ka tsamaiso ya dipuisano le setjhaba le bankakarolo ba amehang.
tgt: Lomtsetfomgomo sewuvele ungenele inchubo lenkhulu yekukhulumisana kwalabatsintseka labafanele.

src: Leano le fana ka ditataiso tse netefatsang tshireletso ya meetlo ya setso ya lebollo la selemo ka seng la bashemane ntle le ho beha polokeho ya bona tsietsing.
tgt: Lenchubomgomo iniketa tinkhombandlela leticinisekisa kuvikelwa kwelisiko lemnyaka lendzabuko lekusoka kwebafana labancane ngaphandle kwekutsi tekuphepha tabo tibe senkingeni.

src: Sena se etsa karolo ya mehato eo mmuso e e nkang ho hatella meetlo e amohelehang e nepahetseng.
tgt: Loku kwenta incenye yetinyatselo hulumende latitsatsela kucinisekisa emasiko lafanele kanye nalemukelekile.

src: Le ho busetsa boemo bo amohelehang ba maikarabelo ho ba tsamaisang mabollo le batswadi ba romelang bana ba bona mabollong ana.
tgt: Ubuyisela esimeni lesifanele lizinga lelemukelekako lekutiphendvulela kulabo labachuba tikolwa tekusoka kanye nebatali labatfumela bantfwana babo kuletikolwa.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana dikgothaletso tse entsweng ke Komiti ya Dipatlisiso e mabapi le kgwebisano ka manaka a ditshukudu e le e nngwe ya kgetho ya ho baballa mohlape wa naha wa ditshukudu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume tincumo letentiwe Likomidi Lekuphenta mayelana nekukhona kuhweba ngetimphondvo tabhejane njengalenye indlela yekulondvolota bobhejane balelive.

src: Dikgothaletso di ile tsa tshehetswa ke Komiti ya Boeletsi ba Setekginiki e Kopanetsweng ke Mafapha le Komiti e Kopanetsweng ya Matona e thontsweng ho batlisisa kgonahalo ya ho kenya molaong kgwebisano ya matjhaba ya manaka a ditshukudu.
tgt: Letincumo tavunywa Likomidi Letekweluleka Letebucwepheshe Lematiko Lahlangene kanye neLikomidi Letindvuna lelibekelwe kuphenya kutsi kungakhoneka yini kwenta kuhweba ngetimphondvo tabhejane etimakethe temhlaba kutsi kube semtsetfweni.

src: Dikgothaletso di tshehetsa lewa le kopanetsweng la Aforka Borwa la katamelo ya bolaodi ba ho rarolla ho tsongwa ho seng molaong ha ditshukudu le kgwebisano e seng molaong ya manaka a ditshukudu.
tgt: Letincumo temukela indlelalisu yekulawula lehlanganisiwe yaseNingizimu Afrika yekusombulula kutingelwa kubulawe bobhejane kanye nekuhweba ngabobhejane ngalokungekho emtsetfweni.

src: Komiti e kgothaletsa hore mokgwa wa hajwale wa ho boloka mohlape o ntseng o le teng wa naha kgahlanong le kgwebisano ka manaka a ditshukudu.
tgt: Lelikomidi lincoma kutsi lendlela lekhona kwamanje yekugcina emazinga emfuyo alelive agcinekile ayigcinwe kunekutsi kuhwetjwe ngetimphondvo tabhejane.

src: Lewa la katamelo la naha le kenyeletsa polokeho matlafatso ya badudi taolo ya tswadiso diphano tsa molao o tla kenngwang tshebetsong ka tsela e hlwahlwa le ho hatellwa le taolo ya ho batleha ha manaka a ditshukudu.
tgt: Indlelalisu yalelive yekubukana nalesimo ifaka ekhatsi kuvikeleka kuhlonyiswa kwemmango kulawulwa kwetilokatana lokuhlanganisiwe, imigomo yemtsetfo lephendvulako lefezekiswa ngalokuyimphumelelo ibuye futsi icinisekise kanye nekulawulwa kwekufuna.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana meralo ya dikhoine tsa 2016 tsa sehopotso tse latelang:a) Letoto la Naha la Khoine ya Tlhaho– Boikitlaetso ba BigCats : ‘The Cheetah’.b) Letoto la dikhoine tsa Sterling-silver crown le dikhoine tsa tickey ‘Ditshibollo tsa Aforika Borwa–‘Dolosse’.Meralo ya dikhoine,mmoho le diphatlalatso tsa tsona, di tla hatiswa Koranteng ya Mmuso, mme ebe di tla be se di hlahiswa ka metjha e tlwaelehileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume kudizayinwa kwetinhlavu tekukhumbula kwanga-2016:a) Luchungechunge Lwetinhlavumali Tekuma Kwemhlaba Lwavelonkhe – Imitamo Yemakati Lamakhulu: ‘Lihlosi’.b) Umchele weSterling-silver kanye neluchungechunge lweluhlavumali lwe-tickey coin ‘Kucamba kwaseNingizimu Afrika –‘i-Dolosse’.Lamadizayini aletinhlavumali, kanye nekumenyetelwa kwato, kutawushicilelwa kuGazethi yaHulumende, titawubese-ke tiyakhiwa tibuye futsi titsengiswe ngetindlela letetayelekile.

src: Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: Imikhosi letako.

src: Moporesidente Zuma dipakeng tsa la18 le 22 Mmesa 2016 o tla nka maeto a tshebetso ho ya mebusong ya ditho tsa Kopano ya Makgetho a Madiboho ya Aforika e Borwa (SACU) e kenyeletsang Namibia, Botswana, Lesotho le Swaziland.
tgt: Mengameli Zuma utawutsi emkhatsini wamhla ti-18 namhla tinge-22 Mabasa 2016 angenele kuvakasha ngekwemsebenti avakashele emave langemalunga eNyonyane Yekutselisa Imphahla Yemave Laseningizimu ne-Afrika (i-SACU) lokufaka ekhatsi iNamibia, Botswana, Lesotho kanye neSwaziland.

src: Maeto a tla ntlafatsa karolo ya bohlokwae bapalwang ke SACU bakeng sa ho hodisa momahano ya lebatowa le ntshetsopele ya moruo wa ditho tsa yona kaofela.
tgt: Lokuvakasha kutawenta kancono indzima lebalulekile ledlalwa yi-SACU ekutfutfukiseni kuhlangana kwetigodzi kanye nekutfutfukisa umnotfo wawo onkhe emalunga ayo.

src: Moporesidente o tla nka leeto la Puso ho etela Riphaboliki ya MaIsilamo ya Iran ka la 23 le 24 Mmesa 2016 ho matlafatsa maqhama a sepolotiki le a moruo pakeng tsa dinaha tsena tse pedi.
tgt: Mengameli utawungenela luhambo lweKuvakasha kweMbuso aye e-Islamic Republic of Iran mhla tinge-23 kanye namhla tinge-24 Mabasa 2016 ayocinisa tinchubo temnotfo netepolitiki letisemkhatsini walamave lamabili.

src: Moporesidente o tla etella pele mekete ya Naha ya Letsatsi la Tokoloho ka la 27 Mmesa 2016 Limpopo, Lebaleng la dipapadi la Giyani tlasa mookotaba: “Mmoho re aha metse e betere–Mebuso ya le hae ke taba ya mang le mang”.Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela le makala a mang ho bontsha lerato la naha ka ho nka karolo diketsahalong tse fapafapaneng tsa ho hopola Kgwedi ya Tokoloho.
tgt: Mengameli utawuhola Kugujwa Kwemigubho yeLusuku Lwenkhululeko mhla tinge-27 Mabasa 2016 eLimpopo, eNkhundleni Yetemidlalo yaseGiyani ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Sisonkhe sakha imimango lencono – Hulumende Wendzawo ngumsebenti wawonkhewonkhe”.IKhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nemikhakha kutsi bakhombise kutsandza live labo ngekutsi bahlanganyele kulemikhosi leyehlukene yekukhumbula Inyanga Yenkhululeko.

src: Dibekeng tse tlang,Palamente e tla be e tshwara Divoutu tsa Ditekanyetso tsa mafapa ka mafapha.
tgt: Kulamaviki latako, iPhalamende itawube ibambe Tinkhulumiswano Temcombelelo wematiko.

src: Ba Phethahatso ba mafapha ka ho latelana ba tla be ba hlopholla meralo ya bona ya tshebetso bakeng sa selemo sa ditjhelete sa 2016/17.
tgt: Labaphetse ematiko lahlukene batawendlala tinhlelo tabo tekusebenta temnyakatimali wanga-2016/17.

src: Ditho tsa setjhaba di tla tsebiswa ka mananeo a mmuso a phano ya ditshebeletso.
tgt: Emalunga emmango atawatiswa ngetinhlelo tahulumende tekwetfulwa kwetinsita.

src: Maemo a Kabinete Mabapi le Dintlha tsa Bohlokwa Maemong a Hajwale Kabinete e amohetse karabelo le kopo ya tshwarelo e ileng ya latela ka Moporesidente Zuma ho kahlolo ya Lekgotla la Dinyewe la Molaotheo mabapi le boimatahanyo le diketso tsa ditokiso tse tekilweng tlalehong ya Mosireletsi wa Setjhaba.
tgt: Tincumo teKhabhinethi etindzabeni letibalulekile tesimondzawo.

src: Kabinete e ntse e hlahloba kahlolo bakeng sa ho sheba haeba ho na le mehato e ka nkuwang ho matlafatsa mosebetsi wa Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyemukele imphendvulo nekucolisa lokwalandzela kwaMengameli Zuma kusehlulelo seNkantolo yeMtsetfosisekelo lesimayelana nekuhambisana netinyatselo tekulungisa simo letabekwa kumbiko weMvikeli Wemmango.

src: Kahlolo ya Lekgotla la Dinyewe la Molaotheo e thathiselletsa le ho mafiella demokerasi ya molaotheo ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isasibukisisa lesehlulelo kute itfole kutsi ingabe tikhona yini letinye tinyatselo letingatsatfwa kute kuciniswe Imisebenti yaHulumende.

src: Kabinete e lemohile ketso ya dibanka tse nne tse fanneng ka tsebiso ya ho kwala diakhaonte tsa banka tsa khamphani e nngwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi itivumile tinyatselo letitsetfwe ngemabhange lamane lakhipha satiso sekuvala ema-akhawunti asebhange enkampani letsite.

src: Leha Kabinete e ananela dipehelo le maemo a dibanka, diketso tsena di ka sitisa boramatsete ba ka nnang ba ba teng ba ka batlang ho tsamaisa dikgwebo ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Nanobe Ikhabhinethi iyitfokotela imibandzela netimo talamabhange, letento tingacedza emandla ebatjalimali labebangatsandza kwenta ibhizinisi neNingizimu Afrika esikhatsini lesitako.

src: Kabinete e tsheheditse ntlha ya hore Matona a Ditjhelete, Mesebetsi le Mehlodi ya Diminerale a tshwanela ho bula dipuisano tse ahang le dibanka bakeng sa ho fihlella tharollo ya nako e telele tabeng ena.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ivume kutsi Indvuna yeTetimali, Tetemisebenti kanye neTimbiwa tifanele kutsi tikhulumisane nalamabhange kute kutfolwe sisombululo lesingusonasona saloludzaba.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Letona la Bophelo bo Botle, Ngaka Aaron Motsoaledi, ya fumaneng kgau ya matjhaba ya Lefuba ya USAID-TB jwaloka kananelo ya boetapele ba hae mabapi le ntwa ya lefatshe kgahlanong le lefuba (TB) mmoho le ho etella pele boikitlaetso ba Aforika Borwa le ba lebatowa mabapi le ho hlahloba, kalafo le thibelo ya TB tshwaetso e kopaneng ya TB/HIV le TB e itwanelang ho meriana e mengata.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisele Indvuna yeTemphilo, Dkt.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho kgethwa ha Aforika Borwa ho ba moamohedi wa 2016 wa Kgau ya Tshebeletso e Ipabotseng ya Sedipolomate ke Lekgotla la Merero ya Lefatshe ho la Washington,DJwaloka naha ya pele ya Aforika ya ho amohela kgau ena, e ananela boitlamo bo babatsehang ba naha mabapi le thuto ya lefatshe, merero ya matjhaba le dikgokahanyo tsa lefatshe bakeng sa ho hodisa ditabatabelo tsa rona tsa naha.
tgt: Aaron Motsoaledi, lotfole umklomelo wemave emhlaba we-USAID-TB wekubona nekuhlonipha buholi bakhe ekulweni kwemave emhlaba nesifo sesifuba (i-TB) kanye nekuhola imitamo yesigodzi yaseNingizimu Afrika ekuhlolisiseni, kwelashwa kanye nekuvikela kungenwa yi-TB TB/HIV kanye ne-TB lelwa nekwelashwa ngemitsi leminyenti lehlanganisiwe.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Letona la Dikamano tsa Matjhaba le Tshebedisano, Mofumahadi Maite Nkoana-Mashabane, bakeng sa nyehelo ya hae ho dipuisano tsa matjhaba tsa Aforika Borwa, tse kgannwang ke pono ya “kontinente ya Aforika e kopaneng e nang le kgotso, ya demokerasi, e hlokang semorabe, e hlokang kgethollo ya bong le e tswelang pele, le ho ba e nyehelang ho lefatshe le nang le toka le tekatekano.”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kuphakanyiswa kweNingizimu Afrika njengalotawemukela Umklomelo Lokhetsekile Wekuchuba Nebudlelwane Lobuhle Nemave Emhlaba nga-2016 lotawuniketwa nguMkandlu Wetindzaba Temave Emhlaba eWashington, DNjengelive lekucala kutfola lomklomelo, uhlonipha kutinikela lokuvelele kwalelive kutemfundvo yemave emhlaba, tindzaba temave emhlaba kanye nekuchumana nemave emhlaba kute kutfutfukiswe tintfo letifunwa ngulelive.

src: Kabinete e amohela thonyo ke Moporesidente Zuma ya Moatefokate Jan Lekhoa Mothibi, jwaloka Hlooho ya Lekala la Diphuputso tsa Sepolesa le Ikgethang, le ho mo lakaletsa tse molemo boikarabelong ba hae bo botjha ba ho lwantsa bobodu le tsamaiso e mamphemphe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi incoma Indvuna yeLitiko Letebudlelwane Nekubambisana Nemave Emhlaba, Mk Maite Nkoana-Mashabane, ngekufaka ligalelo ekukhulumisaneni kweNingizimu Afrika nemave angaphandle, lokuchutjwa ngumbononchanti lotsi “livekati lase-Afrika lelibumbene lelinekuthula, lentsandvo yelinyenti, lelingabandlululi ngekwebuhlanga, ngekwebulili naleliphumelelako, kanye futsi nalelifaka ligalelo emhlabeni lolungile futsi lolinganako.”.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso a tswang botebong ba pelo ho lelapa la Makwetu le Pan Africanist Congress ka ho hlokahala ha Monghadi Clarence Makwetu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kutsi Mengameli Zuma abeke esikhundleni Advocate Jan Lekhoa Mothibi, njengeNhloko yeLuphiko Lwekuphenya Lolukhetsekile, futsi umfisela konkhe lokuhle emisebentini yakhe lemisha yekulwa nenkhohlakalo nekulawula ngalokungafanele.

src: Monghadi Makwetu o tla hopolwa ka nyehelo ya hae e matla le ho intsha sehlabelo bakeng sa mokgatlo wa tokoloho le ho thehwa ha Aforika Borwa e ntjha ya demokerasi.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi yendlulisa emavi ekudvudvuta umndeni wakaMakwetu kanye nePan Africanist Congress ngekushiywa emhlabeni nguMnu Clarence Makwetu.

src: Moporesidente o phatlaladitse Lepato le Ikgethang la Semmuso la Porofense bakeng sa mohale enwa wa ntwa ya tokoloho.
tgt: Makwetu utawukhunjulelwa ligalelo lakhe lelikhulu kanye nekutinikela kwakhe embutfweni wenkhululeko kanye nekusungulwa kweNingizimu Afrika yentsandvo yelinyenti lensha.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso a yona a tswang botebong ba pelo ho lelapa la Naidoo ka ho hlokahala ha Monghadi Kumaran Naidoo.
tgt: Mengameli umemetele Kungcwatjwa Ngekwelisiko Lelikhetsekile Letifundza Lekungcwatjwa Kwetikhulu taHulumende kwalelishanhlitiyo lenkhululeko lelasebenta ngekutimisela lokukhulu.

src: Monghadi Naidoo e ne e le Motsamaisi-Kakaretso ya Tshwereng Mokobobo wa Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Moruo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yendlulisa emavi ekudvudvuta umndeni wakaNaidoo ngekushiywa emhlabeni nguMnu Kumaran Naidoo.

src: Pele o ne a sebetsa jwaloka Mohlanka ya ka Sehloohong wa Ditjhelete wa Lefapha la Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri.
tgt: Naidoo bekaLibamba Lemcondzisi Jikelele weLitiko Lekutfutfukiswa Kwemnotfo.

src: Monghadi Naidoo o entse nyehelo e matla ho taolo ya ditjhelete ka hara Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba.
tgt: Phambilini bekasebenta njengeSikhulu Lesikhulu Setetimali seLitiko Letekuhwebelana Netetimboni.

src: Kabinete e hlahisa kananelo ya yona ka nyehelo e entsweng ke Monghadi William Smith, ya sebeditseng ho Bongodi ba Kabinete.
tgt: Umnu Naidoo ufake ligalelo lelikhulu ekulawulweni kwetemnotfo kuTemisebenti yaHulumende.

src: Monghadi Smith o behile meja fatshe mafelong a Tlhakubele kamora ho sebeletsa Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba dilemo tse 27.Kabinete e mo lakaletsa tse molemo phomolong ya hae.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise kubonga kwayo ligalelo lelifakwe nguMnu William Smith, lobekasebenta njengaMabhalane weKhabhinethi.

src: Jwaloka mmuso re amohela sephetho sa Khomishene.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi imfisela lokuhle ekutsatseni kwakhe umhlalaphasi.

src: Re hlakotswe bobe kaha esale re bolela ka dilemo tse ngata hore ha ho letho le lebe le etsahetseng le hore theko ena e ne e se na WEBTOKEN tshepa hore sephetho se tla kwala taba ena e nkileng nako e WEBTOKEN kgema mmoho le Moporesidente Zuma mabapi le ho leboha Moahlodi Willie Seriti le Moahlodi Thekiso Musi, dipaki kaofela, ho kenyeletswa le Moporesidente wa mehleng Thabo Mbeki, baetapele ba bopaki, dihlopha tsa semolao, basebeletsi le ba nyehetseng bakeng sa ho etsa hore mosebetsi wa Khomishene o atlehe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yatisiwe ngeMbiko weKhomishini Yekuphenya Ngetinsolo Tekukhwabanisa, Tenkhohlakalo, Kwehluleka Kugcina Emazinga Ekusebenta Ngekwetsembeka nobe Kungasebenti ngalokufanele Ekutsengweni Kwetikhali Tekuvikela (Ikhomishini Yekutsengwa Kwetikhali) lekhishwe nguMengameli lamuhla ekuseni.

src: DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di lokelwa ke ho netefatswa ha mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang.
tgt: LoMbiko utfole kutsi kute bufakazi bekusebenta ngalokungakafaneli, kudiza, kukhwabanisa nobe inkhohlakalo enchubeni yekutsengwa kwetikhali, SinguHulumende siyayemukela imiphumela yeluphenyo lweKhomishini.

src: Monghadi Siyabonga Gama jwaloka Mohlanka wa Phethahatso wa Sehlopha le Monghadi Garry Pita jwaloka Mohlanka ya ka Sehloohong wa Ditjhelete wa Sehlopha waTransnet.
tgt: Sitfolakele simsulwa njengobe besihlale sisho kuyo yonkhe leminyaka kutsi simsulwa kanye nekutsi letikhali tatsengwa ngalokusemtsetfweni.

src: Ho kenngwa Tshebetsong ha Mananeo a Bohlokwa a Mmuso.
tgt: Kufezekiswa Kwetinhlelo Tahulumende Letibalulekile.

src: Kabinete e amohela Leeto la Puso la Moporesidente Jacob Zuma la ho etela Rephaboliki ya maIsilamo ya Iran, le hodisang dikamano tsa moruo le kgwebisano dipakeng tsa dinaha ka bobedi, ka ho saenwa ha ditumellano le maitlamo a mmalwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kuvakasha kwaMengameli Jacob Zuma Kwembuso kwekuya e-Islamic Republic of Iran, lokukhulisa ngemandla budlelwane betemnotfo nekuhwebelana emkhatsini walamave omabili, ngekusayina tivumelwane letinyenti kanye nekutinikela.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma le Moporesidente Hasan Rouhani ba tiisitse tshebedisano-mmoho mapatlelong a kgwebisano, thuto le ntshetsopele ya maitsebelo saense le thekenoloji eneji, ho kenyeletswa le bokgoni ba ho tsoma kgase le ho e lokisetsa tshebediso temo merafo le bokgolamolemo ba diminerale ntshetsopele ya meralo ya motheo le dipalangwang ditjhelete, merero ya dibanka le inshorense le bohahlaudi.
tgt: Mengameli Jacob Zuma naMengameli Hasan Rouhani bacinise kubambisana emikhakheni yetekuhwebelana, temfundvo nekutfutfukiswa kwemakhono isayensi netebucwepheshe, emandla agezi, kufaka ekhatsi kuhlolisiswa kwegesi yemakhemikhala aphethroli nemakhono ekuwuhluta tekulima kumbiwa kwetimbiwa kanye nekuzuza kwakhiwa kwesakhiwonchanti netitfutsi timali, kubhanga nemshwalensi kanye netekuvakasha.

src: E leng kaofela tse nyehelang ho Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP).Boemong ba tsa Matjhaba, baetapele ba babedi ba dumellane ka ho matlafatsa kgoeletso bakeng sa tlhabollo ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng ka ho qolleha Lekgotla la Tshireletso la UN, molemong wa lefatshe le ntseng le tswela pele.
tgt: Konkhe loku kufaka sandla ekufezekisweni kweLuhlelo Lwetekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe (i-NDP).Mayelana netemave emhlaba, labaholi lababili bavumelene kutsi kuciniswe simemo sekulungisa Mhlabuhlangene (i-UN) ikakhulu Umkhandlu Wekuvikela we-UN, ngekuya kwetimfuno temave lasatfutfuka.

src: Diphetho tsena di matlafaditse Leeto la Tshebetso la Moporesidente ho ya United Arab Emirates (UAE) moo dipuso ka bobedi di ntjhafaditseng boitlamo ba tsona ho lebiseng matlafatsong le kgodisong ya dikamano tsa bobedi, ka ho qolleha kgwebisanong, matseteng le mapatlelong a moruo hore e be bolekane ba lewa le pharalletseng.
tgt: Lemiphumela icinise Kuvakasha Ngekwemsebenti kwaMengameli e-United Arab Emirates (e-UAE) lapho khona omabili lamave avusetele kutinikela kwawo ekuhlanganiseni nasekuphakamiseni budlelwanobubili emkhatsini walamave omabili, ikakhulu kutekuhwebelana, imikhakha yelutjalomali neyemnotfo kutsi ibe yelubanjiswano lolubalulekile lolukhulu.

src: Sena se ahella hodima Leeto la Puso la Moporesidente Jacob Zuma ka Pudungwana 2011 moo ho bonahetseng ho thehwa ha Khomishene e Kopanetsweng ya SA-UAE e akofisitseng lebelo la kgwebisano e phethahetseng dipakeng tsa dinaha tse pedi tsena ho tloha ho R13 bilione ka 2011 ho ya ho R27 bilione ka 2015.Aforika Borwa le UAE hape di dumellane ho eketsa tshebedisano-mmoho ho sebetsana le menyetla ho Moruo wa Lewatle, ho hodisa ho romellwa dinaheng tse ka ntle ha dihlahiswa tsa temo tsa Aforika Borwa, dihlahiswa tse entsweng difemeng mme ka ho qolleha theko ya tsa tshireletso le bomphato.
tgt: Loku kwakhele etukweKuvakasha Kwembuso kwaMengameli Jacob Zuma ngeLweti nga-2011 lokwaholela ekusungulweni kweKhomishini Lehlangene Ye-SA-UAE lokwasheshisa ngalokuphelele umdlandla nemandla ekuhwebelana emkhatsini walamave omabili kusuka kutigidzigidzi leti-R13 nga-2011 kuya kutigidzigidzi letinge-R27 nga-2015.INingizimu Afrika kanye ne-UAE baphindze bavuma kukhulisa kubambisana kwabo kute basebentise ematfuba lakuMnotfo waseLwandle, kute kukhutsatwe kutsengiswa kulamanye emave imikhicito letilimo yaseNingizimu Afrika, imikhicito leyakhiwe ikakhulu tintfo tetekuvikela nelubanjiswano.

src: Leeto hape le hodisitse bokgoni ba Aforika Borwa ba ho aha meralo ya motheo ho shebanwe le menyetla bakeng sa dikhamphani tsa Aforika Borwa ho EXPO 2020 ho la Dubai, hammoho le tshebedisano-mmoho lepatlelong la kgotso le botsitso.
tgt: Lokuvakasha kuphindze kwakhutsata emandla ekwakha sakhiwonchanti saseNingizimu Afrika sacondza ematfuba etinkampani taseNingizimu Afrika ekukhangiseni kwaseDubai lokubitwe ngekutsi pheceleti, EXPO 2020 in Dubai, kanye nekubambisana emkhakheni wetekuthula, tekuvikela kanye nekusimama.

src: Kabinete e amohetse mehato e tiileng e kentsweng tshebetsong ke Letona la Dipapadi le Boikgathollo Fikile Mbalula ho aha botjha maemo a qhetsohileng le ho ba le kgethollo e tebileng ho tsa dipapadi le boikgathollo ka tshebediso ya Tjhata ya Diphethoho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi itemukele tinyatselo leticatsa letihlelwe yiNdvuna yeTemidlalo Nekukhibika Fikile Mbalula tekwakha kabusha temidlalo nekukhibika letibhidlikile naletibandlula ngemandla ngekusebentisa Ishatha Yetingucuko.

src: Sena se tla akofisa diphethoho tse tla lebisang tsamaisong e kopaneng ya dipapadi e thehilweng hodima dipehelo tsa demokerasi, tekatekano, ponaletso le boemedi ho ya ka mekgahlelo e fapaneng ya setjhaba, phumantsho le bonkakarolo bo eketsehileng ho ipapisitswe le ditabatabelo tsa NDKabinete e amohela dipuo tsa ditekanyetso tse ntseng di tekwa ke mafapha a fapafapaneng le ditlaleho tse batsi tse supang kgatelopele e entsweng bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa bophelo ba maAforika Borwa.
tgt: Loku kutawusheshisa tingucuko tekutsi kube khona inchubo yetemidlalo lebumbene lesime etukwemitsetfomgomo yentsandvo yelinyenti, kulingana, kubekwa kwetintfo ebaleni, kumelelwa kwabo bonkhe bantfu, kufinyelela nekukhula kwemazinga ekuhlanganyela ngekuhambisana netimfuno teLuhlelo Lwetekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ho latela dipuo tsa ditekanyetso mapatlelong a fapafapaneng a boraditaba bakeng sa ho utlwisisa betere ka Lenaneo la Mmuso la Tshebetso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawemukela mcombelelo lowetfulwe ngematiko lehlukene lonemibiko lemikhulu lechaza inchubekela embili leyentiwe ekwenteni timphilo tebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi tibe ncono.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso bakeng sa boitlamo bo tswellang mabapi le diphetho tse bonahalang dibakeng tsa mosebetsi ho itshetlehilwe hodima diphetho ho tswa ho Tlaleho ya Selemo ka seng ya Khomishene ya bo-16 ya Tekatekano Mosebetsing bakeng sa bahiri ba tobilweng e thakgotsweng tlasa mookotaba “Diphethoho di bohlokwa kgwebong”.
tgt: Loku kukhombisa kufezekiswa kweLuhlakamsebenti Lwendlelalisu Lwethemu Lesemkhatsini lolusisondzeta dvutane nekuzuza Umbononchanti 2030 weLuhlelo Lwetekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe.

src: Tlaleho ena e thusa mmuso ho utlwisia maemo a tekatekano mosebetsing ka hara naha le kgatelopele ya yona ho diphethoho mosebetsing bakeng sa selemo sa 2015.
