tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi balandzele inkulumomphikiswano yomcombelelo etinkhundleni tekuchumana tebetindzaba letinyenti letehlukene kute bavisise kancono Luhlelo lwaHulumende lweKusebenta IKhabhinethi icela kutsi kube nekutinikela lokuchubekako kute kutsi kube netingucuko letingito tetindzawo tekusebenta letihambisana naloko lokutfolwe Ngumbiko Wemnyaka We-16 Wekhomishini Yetekucashwa Ngekulingana yabo bonkhe bacashi lababekiwe lowetfulwa ngaphansi kwengcikitsi letsi “Tingucuko tibalulekile”.

src: Kabinete e thoholeditse Lefapha la Bodulo ba Batho ka phano ya matlo a 4, 3 milione le menyetla ya matlo ho tloha mathwasong a demokerasi.
tgt: Lombiko usita hulumende kutsi avisise simo setekucashwa ngekulingana kulelive kanye nenchubekela embili yakho ekuguculeni simo sasemsebentini ngemnyaka-2015.

src: Menyetla ena e kenyeletsa matlo a tsheheditsweng ka botlalo a 2, 806 235 (matlo a BNG), matlo a hiriswang/kahisano a 121 784, a 6329 a Lenaneo le Hoketsweng ho Ditshehetso tsa Ditjhelete tsa ka Bomong le ditentshe tse nang le ditshebeletso tse 986 608.Mokolokotwane ona o etsang nalane o fane ka bodulo ho batho ba fetang 20 milione mme ho keteka phihlello ena mmuso o thakgotse letsholo la naha la ho bontsha katleho ya naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisele Litiko Letekuhlaliswa Kwebantfu ekwakhiweni kwetindlu letitigidzi leti-4, 3 kanye nematfuba ekuba netindlu kusukela kwaba khona intsandvo yelinyenti.

src: Ho thakgolwa ha morero ona wa naha ho etsahetse COSMO City, e leng e nngwe ya diporojeke tse kopanetsweng tse ka sehloohong ho potoloha le naha eo hape e ketekang dilemo tse leshome e le teng.
tgt: Lamatfuba afaka ekhatsi-2, 806 235 wetindlu letelekelelwa ngalokuphelele (tindlu te-BNG), 121 784 wetindlu tetenhlalo/tekurentwa, 6329 weteLuhlelo Lwekwelekelelwa Kwangamunye Loluchumene Netimali kanye nemasayithi latfola tinsita la-986 608.Leligcatsi lelingumlandvo selwente kutsi kube neluphahla lwebantfu labangetelulu kwalabatigidzi letinge-20 futsi-ke kugubha umkhosi walokuzuza lelitiko seletfule umkhankhaso wavelonkhe wekukhombisa timphumelelo talelive.

src: Kabinete e lebohile maAforika Borwa kaofela bakeng sa dinyehelo tsa ona, boitelo le mosebetsi o matla wa ho netefatsa hore seriti sa maAforika Borwa a hlokang se babaletswe ka bodulo ba batho.
tgt: Lokwetfulwa kwavelonkhe kwentiwe eCOSMO City, lomunye wemiklamo lehlanganisiwe lebekwa embili lekhona kulo lonkhe lelive nawo logubha umkhosi weminyaka lelishumi solo waba khona.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Mongodikakaretso wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng ka ho hlophisa Mokete wa Maemo a Hodimo wa ho Saena Tumellano ya Paris, e amohetsweng ke Mekga e 176 ka Tshitwe 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibonge bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika ngekufaka sandla kwabo, kutinikela kanye nekusebenta ngekutikhandla ekucinisekiseni kutsi siyabuyiswa sitfunti sebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labadzingako, ngekuhlaliswa kwebantfu.

src: Ho saenwa ha Tumellano ya Paris ho tshwaile mohato wa pele ho kenngweng tshebetsong ha yona o tla tataisa mekutu ya matjhaba ya ho fokotsa ho ntshwa ha dikgase tse kotsi le ho mekamekana le diphephetso kaofela tse amanang le ho fetofetoha ha tlelaemete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamncoma Mabhalane Jikelele waMhlabuhlangane ngekubamba Umkhosi Losezingeni Lelisetulu Kakhulu Wekusayinwa kweSivumelwane saseParis, lesemukelwa ngemave la-176 ngeNgongoni 2015.

src: Kabinete e lebeletse ka tshepo sephetho sa ditsamaiso tsa tiisetso tsa lehae, ke bohle, ho thusa hore ho be le ho kenngwa ka nako ka botlalo ha Tumellano ya Paris ka 2020.
tgt: Kusayinwa kwaleSivumelwano saseParis kwenta sinyatselo sekucala sekuphumelelisa lesitawukhomba indlela imitamo yemave emahlaba yekunciphisa kubhunyiswa kwemimoya lengcolile lengcolisa umoya lesiwuphefumulako kanye nekuhlangabetana nato tonkhe tinsayeya letivetwa kugucuka kwesimo selitulu.

src: Kabinete hape e ananetse hore Lefapha la Merero ya Tikoloho le entse semphato le Lefapha la Bohahlaudi bakeng sa ho fana ka dilaboratori tsa sehlooho se reng “Biodiversity Lab: Re hodisa nyehelo ya moruo ya mehlodi ya Aforika Borwa ya tlhaho” ho tloha ka la 10 Mmesa ho isa la 13 Motsheanong 2016.Sepheo ke ho elellwa bokgoni ba moruo ba diphapang tsa tlhaho tse ruileng tsa Aforika Borwa tse tekilweng ho moralo wa Lewa la Naha la Moruo wa Tlhaho o tjhaelletsweng monwana ke Kabinete ka Phupu 2015 hore setjhaba se nke karolo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilindzele kuphetfwa kwetinchubo tekucinisekiswa kwetekuhlala letifanele, ngubo bonkhe, kute ivumele sikhatsi lesifanele sekutsi leSivumelwane saseParis sifezekiswe ngalokuphelele nga-2020.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Moralo wa Tshebetso wa Leano la Diindaseteri (IPAP) 2016/17 – 2018/19, e leng tshiya ya bohlokwa ya Moralo wa Dintlha tse Robong wa Moporesidente o lebisang ho kenngweng tshebetsong ha NDP.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela futsi nekutsi Litiko Letemvelo libambisene neLitilo Letekuvakasha ekuhlanganiseni emalabhorekhthri ekwetfula labitwa ngekutsi ngemaLebhu Etitjalo netilwane Letehlukahlukene: Kukhuliswa kwemnotfo waseNingizimu Afrika ngemcebo wetitjalo netilwane” kusukela mhla ti-10 Mabasa kuya kumhla ti-13 Inkhwekhweti 2016.Inhloso kuzuza emandla emnotfo wetitjalo netilwane taseNingizimu Afrika letehlukahlukene lokubekwe ngalokucacile kuluhlaka Lwendlelalisu Yemnotfo Wetitjalo Netilwane Letehlukahlune Lwavelonkhe leyavunywa yiKhabhinethi ngaKholwane 2015 kute kutsi ummango uphawule ngalo.

src: Sena ke ho phetwa ka tatelano ha borobedi ha selemo ka seng ha meralo ya mmuso ya akofiso ya diindaseteri ho ahellang hodima diphihlello, mapatlelo a leano le mananeo a ho phetwa ho fetileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume Luhlelo Lwekusebenta Lwenchubomgomo Yetimboni (i-IPAP) lwanga-2016/17 – 2018/19, loluyinsika yeLuhlelo Lwemaphuzu Layimfica lwaMengameli futsi lufaka sandla ekufezekisweni kweLuhlelo Lwetekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe.

src: IPAP 2016/17 e rerile ho fihlella leano la diindaseteri le nang le kgahlamelo e batlang e phahame maemong a boima a moruo.
tgt: Loku ngumnyaka wesiphohlongo kuphindzeka kuphumelela kwetinhlelo tahulumende tekutfutfukisa timbono lokwakhela ekuzuzeni, tinkhundla tenchubomgomo kanye netinhlelo tekuphindzeka lokwendlulile.

src: Tsena di kenyeletsa dikgahlamelo tse ntseng di tswela pele tsa ho thefuleha ha moruo wa lefatshe ho kenyeletswa le koduwa ya diindaseteri tsa tshepe le ho putlama ha thepa hammoho le komello e matla le mathata a mang a ka lapeng.
tgt: I-IPAP 2016/17 ifuna kuzuza inchubomgomo yetimboni lenemphumela losezingeni leliphakeme etimeni temnotfo letimatima.

src: Diphihlello tsa ho tswa selemong se fetileng di kenyeletsa ho baballwa ha mesebetsi e ka bang 67 000 le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi e hlamatsehang e metjha e ballwang ho 7 000 lekaleng la Diaparo le Masela le Dieta.
tgt: Loku kufaka ekhatsi imiphumela yekwehla kwemandla emali emhlabeni wonkhe lokuchubekako kanye nesomiso lesibi kabi naletinye tintfo tetenhlalo letisikhinyabeto.

src: Lekala la tlatsetso la dihlahiswa tsa Temo ke le leng la makala a maholo a tlhahiso la phano ya mesebetsi, e ballwang ho mesebetsi e 216 090 ka 2015 ha ho bapiswa le e 208 822 ka 2014.Matsete a boleng ba R600 milione a ile a hohelwa ka 2015/16, mme a etsa motheo bakeng sa ho matlafatsa ntshetsopele ya kgwebo ho tsepamisitswe maikutlo hodima badudi ba mahaeng.
tgt: Lokuzuziwe emnyakeni lophelile kufaka ekhatsi imisebenti levikelwe lelinganiselwa kule-67 000 kanye nekuvetwa kwemisebenti lemisha lenesitfunti lengalinganiselwa kule-7 000 emikhakheni yeTimphahla, yeMayadi Etikhumba kanye neyeTicatfulo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Moralo o Kopanetsweng wa Ntshetsopele ya Ditoropo wa ho Phethela le Moralo wa ho Kenya Tshebetsong wa 2016/19.
tgt: Umkhakha lomncane wekwendlulisa imikhicito letilimo nguwona mkhakha locashe bantfu labanengi kwendlula yonkhe imikhakha yasekhaya lekhicitako, uniketa imisebenti lelinganiselwa kule-216 090 nga-2015 nakucatsaniswa kule-208 822 nga-2014.

src: Sephetho ka kakaretso sa Moralo o Kopanetsweng wa Ntshetsopele ya Ditoropo ke ho fetola qaqolohano ya dibaka tsa bodulo.
tgt: Lungetulu kwegidzi letinge-R600 telutjalomali lolwaba khona nge-2015/16, lokwakha sisekelo sekucinisa kutfutfuka kwemabhizinisi lapho khona bekugcilwe emimangweni yasemaphandleni.

src: Sena se tshwaya tsamaiso e ntjha ya metsemeholo le ditoropo tsa Aforika Borwa, sena se tla tataisetsa kgolo ya ditoropo ho lebiseng ho motlolo wa kgolo wa moshwelella o kopaneng, o hokahanyang le ho kopanya metsemeholo le ditoropo, tse bolokehileng, tse nang le mehlodi e hlwahlwa le ho ba dibaka tse ntle tsa ho sebetsa le ho dula ho tsona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iluvumile Luhlakamsebenti Lwekugcina Loluhlanganisiwe Lwekutfutfukisa Tindzawo Tasemadolobheni kanye neLuhlelo Lwekufezekisa lwanga-2016/19.

src: Sena se arabela ho taelo ya NDP la ho hodisa leano la ntshetsopele ya ditoropo le tla netefatsa moralo o nepahetseng, matsete a meralo ya motheo le taolo ya ho tshehetsa bokgoni ba kgolo le ho bula bokgoni ba moruo ba metsemeholo le ditoropo tsa rona.
tgt: Umphumela sewuwonkhe waloLuhlakamsebenti Lwekugcina Loluhlanganisiwe Lwekutfutfikisa Tindzawo Tasemadolobheni kutfutfukiswa kwendzawo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Moralo wa Leano la Naha la Ntshetsopele ya Ditshebeletso tsa Makala a Thuto – Re aha Tsamaiso e hlwahlwa le e Kopanetsweng ya Ntshetsopele ya Ditshebeletso tsa Makala a Thuto bakeng sa Aforika Borwa, Koranteng ya Mmuso bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: Loku kwenta sivumelwane setebhizinisi lesisha semadolobhakati aseNingizimu Afrika, lokutawucondzisa kukhula kwetindzawo tasemadolobheni tibe yimodeli yekukhula lokungenamkhawulo nemadolobha lahleleke kahle futsi lasondzelene nalachunyaniswako, laphephile, lanemitfombolusito kanye naletindzawo lekahle tekusebenta nekuhlala kuwo.

src: Moralo ona wa Leano hang feela ha o kentswe tshebetsong o tla fana ka katamelo e kopanetsweng bakeng sa ditshebeletso tsa ntshetsopele ya makala a thuto a boleng bakeng sa baahi kaofela.
tgt: Loku kuphendvula ticondziso teLuhlelo Lwetekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe lwekwakha inchumomgomo yekutfutfukisa tindzawo tasemadolobheni letawucinisekisa kuhlelwa ngendlela lefanele, kwakhiwa kwetakhowonchanti nekulawulwa kwato kute tesekele kukhula tibuye futsi tikhulule emandla emnotfo wemadolobhakati nemadolobha etfu.

src: Sena se tla ba thusa ho etsa diqeto tse kgabane tsa makala a thuto hore ba thole mesebetsi, ba nyehele setjhabeng le ho aha moruo wa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume kushicilelwa kuGazethi yaHulumende Inchubomgomo Yavelonkhe Yetekutfutfukisa Imisebenti – Kwakha Inchubo Yetinsita Yekutfutfukisa Imisebenti Lehlanganisiwe nalephumelelako yaseNingizimu Afrika, kute kutsi ummango uphawule ngayo.

src: Ditshebeletso tsa Ntshetsopele ya Makala a Thuto di bapala karolo ya bohlokwa mabapi le ho thusa mebaraka ya rona ya mosebetsi hore e sebetse le hore mekgwa ya thuto e fihlelle merero ya yona.
tgt: Loluhlaka lweNchubomgomo naselufezekisiwe lutawuniketa indlela luchunyanisiwe yekubukana netinsita tekutfutfukiswa kwemisebenti lenguyonayona yetakhamuti.

src: Sena se nyehela ho lebiseng ha phihlello ya dikgothaletso tsa NDP tsa ho hlasimolla kgolo ya moruo le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi, le ho matahanya basebeletsi le mesebetsi e loketseng eo ba e etsang le ho eketsa ntshetsopele ya maitsebelo le palo ya ba nang le mangolo a diyunivesithi.
tgt: Loku kutawubenta kutsi bakwati kukhetsa kahle tinhlobo temisebenti kute kutsi batfole imisebenti, bafake sandla emmangweni babuye futsi bakhe umnotfo waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Tsamaiso ya Naha ya Tekolo le ho tjhaella monwana Tlaleho ya Selemo ka seng ya 2014/15 le Moralo wa Naha wa Tekolo bakeng sa 2016/17 ho ya ho 2018/19, jwaloka karolo ya boikitlaetso ba ho ntlafatsa phano ya ditshebeletso.
tgt: Luphiko Lwetekutfutfukisa Imisebenti ludlala indzima lebalulekile ekusiteni timakethe tetisebenti kutsi tisebente kanye nekutsi tinchubo temfundvo tizuze imigomo yato.

src: Tsamaiso ya Naha ya Tekolo e tswa ho Moralo wa Leano la Naha la Tekolo o netefatsang hore bopaki bo tshepahalang le bo hlokang tshekamelo ho tswa ho ditekolo bo kenyeletswa tsamaisong ya ho etsa meralo, ho etsa ditekanyetso tsa ditjhelete, ntlafatso ya mekgatlo, tjhebo-botjha ya maano, hammoho le lenaneo le tswellang le taolo ya diporojeke ka morero wa ho ntlafatsa tshebetso.
tgt: Loku kufaka sandla ekutsini kuzuzwe tincomo teLuhlelo Lwetekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe tekukhutsata kukhula kwemnotfo nekucashwa, kucondzaniswe tisebenti nemisebenti kanye nekukhulisa lizinga lekutfutfukiswa kwemakhono kanye nelinani letitjudeni tasemanyuvesi letiphotfulile.

src: Ditekolo tse 47 di se di phethetswe kapa di motjheng, tse akaretsang R75 bilione ya ditjeho tsa mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yatiswa ngekufezekiswa kweNchubo Yekuhlola Yavelonkhe yabuye futsi yavuma Umbiko wemnyaka wa-2014/15 kanye neLuhlelo Lwekuhlola Lwavelonkhe lwa-2016/17 to 2018/19, njengencenye yemtamo wekwenta kancono kwetfulwa kwetinsita,Inchubo Yekuhlola Yavelonkhe ivela kuLuhlakamsebenti Lwenchubomgomo Yekuhlola Lwavelonkhe lolucinisekisa kutsi bufakazi lobungubobabona nalobungavunicala bekuhlola buyayakwa enchubeni yekuhlela, yelwabiwomali, ekwentiweni kancono kwenhlangano bubuye futsi bulinganisele kulawula kute kwentiwe kancono kusebenta.

src: Ditlaleho tsa tekolo tse15 di ile tsa tjhaellwa monwana mme tse 12 tsa tekelwa Kabinete ho fihlela mona.
tgt: Sekuphetfwe kuhlola lokunge-47 nobe kusatawentiwa, lokufaka ekhatsi lusetjentisomali lwahulumende lolutigidzigidzi letinge-Kuvunywe imibiko yekuhlola le-15 kanye nale-12 leyetfulwe kuKhabhinethi kute kube ngulamuhla.

src: Meralo ya ntlafatso e 14 e ntse e kenngwa tshebetsong mme kgatelopele ho tsena e bontsha diphethoho tse hlamatsehang, bakeng sa ho pharalatsa sekgahla.
tgt: Tinhlelo le-14 tekutfutfukisa tiyafezekiswa kwamanje futsi inchubekela embili yato ikhombisa tingucuko letinkhulu letibonakalako, letitawenabisa umphumela.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka diphetho tsa tekolo le ho tjhaella monwana dikgothaletso ka morero wa ho eketsa sekgahla ho tswa ho ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Lekala la Kahisano la Lenaneo la Katoloso ya Mesebetsi ya Setjhaba (EPWP-SS).Lenaneo lena le bapala karolo ya bohlokwa bakeng sa tshireletso ya kahisano bakeng sa batho ba baholo ba ntseng ba itekanetse ba sa sebetseng, ka ho ba hulela mosebetsing o nang le tlhahiso le ho amohela ditlhapiso tsa kgwedi ka palohare ya tjhelete e etsang R1 517.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yatisiwe ngemiphumela yabuye futsi yavuma netincomo ngenhloso yekukhulisa imiphumela ngekufezekiswa kweMkakha Wetenhlalo Weluhlelo Lwemisebenti Yahulumende Leyengetiwe (i-EPWP-SS).Loluhlelo ludlala indzima lenkhulu kutekuvikela kutenhlalo kwebantfu labadzala labangaguli ndzawo labangasebenti, ngekutsi bafakwe emisebentini lekhicitako nekutsi batfole umholombhasha welizinga lelisemkhatsini we-R1 517.

src: EPWP-SS e hotse ka potlako pakeng tsa mokgahlelo wa pele le wa bobedi, ho tloha ho mananeo a 5 ho isa ho a 22 a bakileng hore lekala le fihlelle menyetla ya mesebetsi e 175 769 mokgahlelong wa pele le menyetla e 866 246 mokgahlelong wa bobedi, e leng se ka nqane ho sepheo sa 750 000.Dikgothaletso di tsepamisitse maikutlo hodima ntlafatso ya ho kenngwa tshebetsong bakeng sa ho fokotsa dikgaello tabeng ya ho etsa diqeto, ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha (ditefello le ditlhapiso) le phano ya thupello, hammoho le kgokahano.
tgt: Linyenti letinhlelo temkhakha wetenhlalo linika batfu labasengotini nemimango lephuyile tinsita letikhetsekile I-EPWP-SS yakhula ngemandla emkhatsini wesigaba sekucala nesigaba sesibili, yesuka kutinhlelo leti-5 yaya kuletinge-22 letaholela ekuzuzeni ematfuba emisebenti le-175 769 esigabeni sekucala kanye nemisebenti le-866 246 esigabeni sesibili, lokungetulu kakhulu kulebeyihlosiwe le-750 000.Letincomo tigcile ekwenteni kancono kufezekiswa kunciphisa kubate kwemakhono ekutsatfweni kwetincumo, kufezekisa (kukhokhwa kwemiholombasha) kanye kekucecesha, kanye nekuchumanisa.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka diphetho le ho tiisetsa dikgothaletso tsa moralo le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha tekolo ya Thuso ya Ditjhelete ya Ntshetsopele ya Bodulo ba Ditoropong le Moralo wa Ntlafatso ya tsona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yatisiwe ngalokutfoliwe yabuye futsi yemukela netincomo tekuhlolwa kwedizayini nekufezekiswa kweSelekelelo Sekutfutfukisa Kuhlaliswa Etindzaweni Tasemadolobheni kanye neLuhlelo Lwekwenta Kancono.

src: Diphetho di tshehetsa ho baballwa ha Thuso ya Ditjhelete ya Ntshetsopele ya Ditoropo jwaloka thuso ya tshehetso e thusang ka matlole mohopolo wa bodulo ba batho ba moshwelella le bo lekalekanang molemong wa bafumanehi le malapa a lekeno le mahareng.
tgt: Loku lokutfoliwe kwesekela kugcinwa kweSelekelelo Sekutfutfukisa Kuhlaliswa Etindzaweni Tasemadolobheni njengesibonelelo sekugcwalisela lesisita ngetimali umbono lomkhulu wekuhlaliswa lokuchubekela embili ngalokungenamkhawulo kute kutsi kuzuze bantfu labaphuyile kanye nemakhaya latfola imali lengenako lesezingeni lelisemkhatsini.

src: Sena ke sa bohlokwa bakeng sa ho fihlella merero ho tswa ho Moralo wa Lewa la Nako e Bohareng phano ya menyetla e 1 495 milione ya bodulo ditikolohong tsa boleng ka 2019.
tgt: Loku kubalulekile ekuzuzeni imigomo lehlosiwe levela kuLuhlakamsebenti Lwendlelalisu Lwethemu Lesemkhatsini kuvetwa kwematfuba etindlu leti-1 495 etindzaweni tekuhlala letingutonatona nga-2019.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana tlaleho ya Ho kenngwa Tshebetsong le Tekolo ya Kgahlamelo ya Thekenoloji le Mehlodi ya Batho bakeng sa Lenaneo la Diindaseteri, karabelo ya botsamaisi ho tlaleho le moralo wa ntlafatso o kentsweng ke Lefapha la Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwuvumile umbiko weKufezekiswa neKuhlolwa Kwemphumela weTebucwepheshe neTisebenti teLuhlelo lweTimboni, kuphendvula kwebaphatsi kulombiko kanye neluhlelo lwekwenta kancono lolungeniswe Litiko Letekuhwebelana Netimboni.

src: Lenaneo lena le ile la hlahiswa ke Lefapha la Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri ka 1992 ho matlafatsa ntshetsopele ya maitsebelo ho tsa saense, boenjinere le thekenoloji.
tgt: Loluhlelo lwetfulwa Litiko Letekuhwebelana Netimboni nga-1992 kucinisa kutfutfukiswa kwemakhono kutesayensi, tebunjinela netebucwepheshe.

src: Le nyehela ho tlhahiso ya mesebetsi ka ho hlahisa phallo ya bafuputsi ba nang le maitsebelo a maholo le batsamaisi ba thekenoloji bakeng sa diindaseteri le ho ntlafatsa bophehisani ba mekgatlo ya kgwebo e nkang karolo.
tgt: Lufaka sandla ekwakhekeni kwematfuba emisebenti ngekutsi lukhicita kufika kwenabacwaningi labanelikhono lelisezingeni lelisetulu kanye nebaphatsi betebucwepheshe betimboni kanye nekutfutfukisa kucudzelana kwetinhlangano temabhazinisi letihlanganyelako.

src: Lenaneo lena ke la sebele, la bohlokwa le ho ba ntlha e hlwahlwa ya tshehetso ya ntjhafatso e fanang ka boleng ba tjhelete bo hlamatsehang ka bobedi mabapi le ntshetsopele ya thekenoloji le ho ntshetsapele mehlodi ya batho le maitsebelo a tsamaelanang le diindaseteri.
tgt: LoLuhlelo lungilo, lubalulekile futsi luyincenye leyenele yekwesekela lokusha lokuniketa lokulingana nemali ngekwekutfutfukiswa kwetebucwepheshe nekutfutfukisa tisebenti kanye nemakhono laphatselene netimboni.

src: Hape le bapiseha hantle le mananeo a mang a matjhaba.
tgt: Luphindze futsi lucatsiniseka kahle kakhulu naletinye tinhlelo temave emhlaba.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka diphetho tsa dipatlisiso tsa Tlaleho ya Moifo wa Tshebetso wa Matona mabapi le dipelaelo tsa ‘thekiso ya dikgeo tsa mosebetsi tsa matitjhere’ tse amang batho ka bo mong, mekgatlo ya matitjhere le bahlanka ba Mafapha a itseng a Thuto a Diporofense.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yatiswa ngalokutfolwe nguMbiko Welicembu Lekusebenta Letindvuna lebeluhlola tinsolo ‘tikhundla tabothishela letitsengiswako’ lokufaka ekhatsi bantfu labatimele, tinhlangano tabothishela kanye netikhulu teMatiko Etemfundvo Etifundza letitsite.

src: Kabinete e ile ya thathiselletsa dikgothaletso tsa ho sebetsa hantle le ho tobana le diphetho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi itivumile tincomo tekubukana naloko lokutfoliwe ngalokuhlelekile nangekwesekela.

src: Tlaleho ya ho Qetela ya Moifo wa Tshebetso wa Matona e fana ka thunthetso ya karolo e bapetsweng ke bankakarolo bohle tsamaisong ya thonyo le ho thaothwa ha matitjhere.
tgt: Embikweni wayo wekugcina leLicembu Lekusebenta Letindvuna liniketa luhlatiyo lwendzima ledlalwe ngubo bonkhe labatsintsekako kulenchubo yekukhetsa nekufuna bothishela.

src: Hape e ananela mathata a maholo tsamaisong ya hajwale ya dithonyo dikgeong tsa mosebetsi lekaleng la thuto ya motheo le ho fana ka dikgothaletso ho thusa Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo le lekala la thuto ya motheo ka kakaretso ho sebetsana le diphephetso tse hlwailweng.
tgt: Iphindze futsi yemukela tinkinga letinkhulu kulenchubo lekhona kwamanje yekubeka bothishela etikhundleni emkhakheni wetemfundvo lesisekelo libuye futsi libeke tincomo tekusita Litiko Letemfundvo Lesisekelo kanye nemkhakha wetemfundvo lesisekelo jikelele kute kulungiswe letinsayeya letitfoliwe.

src: Dibili.
tgt: Imitsetfosivivinyo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa ha Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Naha ya Meru Palamenteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume kwetfulwa ePhalamende Umtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibela Temahlatsi.

src: 84 wa 1998).Ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha dihlomathiso ho tla ntlafatsa taolo ya moshwelella ya meru le hape ho kgothaletsa bonkakarolo ba dihlopha tse kotsing, tse itshetlehileng hodima tjalo ya meru bakeng sa bophelo ba tsona, ka hara Lekgotla la Naha la Boeletsi la Meru.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uchibela Umtsetfo Wetemahlatsi Wavelonkhe, 1998 (Umtsetfo 84 wa-1998).Kufesekiswa kwaletichibelo kutawenta kancono kulawulwa kwemahlatsi lokuchubekela embili ngalokungenamkhawulo kubuye futsi kukhutsate kuhlanganyela kwemacembu lasengotini, laphila ngetemahlatsi, kuMkandlu Wekweluleka Ngetemahlatsi Wavelonkhe.

src: Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: Imikhosi letako.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o tla kenela mokete wa ho behwa le ho nkiswa kano ha Moporesidente wa Uganda Yoweri Museveni Kampala ka la 12 Motsheanong 2016.
tgt: Mengameli Jacob Zuma utawuhlanganyela emkhosini wekubekwa esihlalweni nekufungiswa kwaMengameli Yoweri Museveni wase-Uganda eKampala mhla ti-12 Inkhwekhweti 2016.

src: Leeto la ho tswa ka hara naha le tla boela le matlafatsa dikamano tsa bobedi bona pakeng tsa Aforika Borwa le Uganda.
tgt: Lukuvakasha lokutako kutawucinisa ngalokuchubekako budlelwanobubili lobusemkhatsini weNingizimu Afrika ne-Uganda.

src: Moporesident Jacob Zuma o tla di hula pele ho ketsahalo ya Letsatsi la Naha la Thapelo e tla tshwarelwa Lebaleng la Dipapadi la ABSA Durban ka la 29 Mmesa 2016.
tgt: Mengameli Zuma utawuhola Lilanga Lavelonkhe leKuthantaza lelitawubanjelwa eNkhundleni Yetemidlalo yase-ABSA eDurban mhla tinge-29 Mabasa 2016.

src: Baetapele ba Ditumelo le ba mekgatlo ya badudi ba tla imatahanya le mmuso bakeng sa ho rapella ho matlafala ho ya pele ha demokerasi, bonngwe ba setjhaba, momahano ya kahisano hammoho le Dikgetho tsa Mebuso ya Lehae tse atlehileng tsa 2016.
tgt: Baholi betenkholo kanye nebaholi betinhlangano temmango batawujoyina hulumende ekuthantazeleni kuhlanganiswa lokuchubekako kwentsandvo yelinyenti, kubumbana kwavelonkhe, kuchumana kwemimango yetenhlalo kanye neLukhetfo Lwahulumende Wendzawo lolunekuthula naloluyimphumelelo.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka meralo ya Lefapha la Bonono le Botjhaba ya ho tshwara mokete wa Kgwedi ya Aforika ka Motsheanong 2016 tlasa mookotaba: “Re aha Aforika e Betere le Lefatshe le Betere” jwaloka karolo ya kontinente ya ho keteka ho thehwa ha Kopano ya Mokgatlo wa Aforika, oo hajwale e leng Kopano ya Aforika le mosebetsi oo e o entseng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yatiswe ngeluhlelo lweLitiko Letebuciko Nemasiko kutsi litawungenisa Inyanga Ye-Afrika ngeNkhwekhweti-2016 ngaphansi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Kwakha i-Afrika Lencono neMhlaba Loncono” njengencenye yekugubha umkhosi kwalelive kugujelwa kusungulwa kweNhlangano Yekuhlanga kwe-Afrika (i-OAU), manje leseyibitwa ngekutsi Bunye Be-Afrika (i-AU) kanye nemsebenti leyiwentile.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o tla thakgola Kgwedi ya Aforika ka Letsatsi la Naha la Thapelo ka la 29 Mmesa 2016.Ka 2016 Kgwedi ya Aforika e tla tsepamisa maikutlo hodima boikitlaetso ba ntshetsopele ya basadi le batjha, ha re ntse re hopola selemo sa bo-60 sa Mohwanto wa Basadi le selemo sa bo-40 sa Merusu ya Batjha ya Soweto.
tgt: Mengameli Jacob Zuma utawetfula Inyanga Ye-Afrika ngeLilanga Lekuthantaza Lavelonkhe mhla tinge-29 Mabasa 2016.Nga-2016 Inyanga ye-Afrika itawugcila kubomake kanye nemitamo yekutfutfukisa lusha, sibe sikhumbula umnyaka we-60 weKushuca kwaBomake kanye nemnyaka we-40 weTibhelu Telusha taseSoweto.

src: MaAforika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho nka karolo lenaneong lena la dintlha tse ngata le kenyeletsang diketsahalo tse pharaletseng tse akgang ka hare bonono ba pono, theatara, mmino, dithuto le dipuisano hammoho le sehopotso sa bo-10 sa Letlole la Lefatshe la Lefa.
tgt: Bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bacelwa kutsi bahlanganyele eluhlelweni lwemikhakhaminyenti lolufaka ekhatsi imisebenti leminengi lefaka ekhatsi tebuciko lobubukwako, itiyetha, umculo, tifundvo kanye netingcungcutsela tetemfundvo kanye nemgubho we-10 wase-Afrika wekugubha Sikhwama Semagugu Emhlaba.

src: Kgwedi ya Aforika e sebetsa jwaloka lepatlelo la ho kopana botjha le ho itlama botjha ho boAforika le Tsoseletso ya Aforika ka ho etsa hore batho ba kontinente ba atamelane ho feta.
tgt: Inyanga Ye-Afrika iyinkhundla yekuchumana nekutinikela kabusha kwetfu kuMcondvo weKubumbana kwe-Afrika kanye neKuncoba Kwe-Afrika ekuhlanganiseni bantfu balalelivekati.

src: Ka la 20 Motsheanong 2016 mmuso o tla etella pele mokete wa naha wa dilemo tse lekgolo wa Yunivesithi ya Fort Hare khemapaseng ya Alice ho la Kapa Botjhabela.
tgt: Mhla tinge-20 Inkhekhweti 2016 hulumende utawuhola kugujwa kwemkhosi wavelonkhe weminyakalikhulu weNyuvesi yaseFort Hare kuluphiko loluse-Alice eMphumalanga Kapa.

src: Bakeng sa boitokisetso ba mokete o moholo, Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o thehile Komiti ya Matona (IMC) ho rera le ho hokahanya mokete ona o etsang nalane wa dilemo tse lekgolo.
tgt: Mayelana nekulungiselela lomgubho lomkhulu, Mengameli Jacob Zuma sewusungule Likomidi LeTindvuna (i-IMC) kutsi lihlele libuye futsi lichumanise lomgubho wemnyakalikhulu loyincophamlandvo.

src: Setheo sena sa thuto se etsang nalane se sebeditse jwaloka mokolokotwane nakong ya ntwa ya tokoloho mme hape e tsebahala jwaloka “pitsa ya boetapele ba Aforika” hape e le setsi sa thuto sa mehleng sa batho bao e neng e le bahale ba ntwa kgahlanong le mmuso wa kgethollo ba kang ZK Matthews, Nelson Mandela, Robert Sobukwe, Oliver Tambo le Govan Mbeki.
tgt: Lesikhungo sekufundza lesiyincophamlandvo sibe sikhonkhwane ngesikhatsi semzabalazo wekutfola inkhululeko sibuye futsi satiwe ngekutsi “libhodo lekuphekelwe kulo baholi base-Afrika” ngoba kwafundza khona bantfu labebalwa nelubandlululo, bantfu labakhulu labafanana nabo-ZK Matthews, Nelson Mandela, Robert Sobukwe, Oliver Tambo kanye naGovan Mbeki.

src: Ke yona feela yunivesithi ya Aforika e Borwa e hlahisitseng dihlooho tsa puso tse hlano: Nelson Mandela wa Aforika Borwa, Yusuf Lule wa Uganda, Robert Mugabe wa Zimbabwe, Ntsu Mokhehle wa Lesotho le Sir Seretse Khama wa Botswana.
tgt: Ngiyo kuphela inyuvesi yaseNingizimu Afrika lekhicite baholi bemibuso labasihlanu: Nelson Mandela waseNingizimu Afrika, Yusuf Lule wase-Uganda, Robert Mugabe waseZimbabwe, Ntsu Mokhehle waseLesotho kanye na-Sir Seretse Khama waseBotswana.

src: Jwaloka karolo ya ho keteka dilemo tse lekgolo tsa Yunivesithi ya Fort Hare Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho Baithuti ba Mehleng le ditho tsa setjhaba ho arolelana mehopolo ya bona ya Fort Hare bakeng sa letsholo la Re arolele Pale ya Hao ka ho sebedisa hashtag #MyFortHare.
tgt: Njengencenye yekugujwa kwemkhosi wemnyakalikhulu weNyuvesi yaseFort Hare iKhabhinethi imema titjudeni lebetifundza kulenyuvesi kanye nemalunga emmango kutsi babelane ngaloko labakukhumbulako ngeFort Hare bentele umkhankhaso weCoca Yakho Indzaba basebentisa #MyFortHare.

src: Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa o tla etella pele kemedi ya Aforika Borwa ho Foramo ya bo-26 ya Moruo wa Lefatshe (WEF) ya Aforika ho la Rwanda pakeng tsa la 11 le 13 Motsheanong 2016.
tgt: Lisekela laMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa litawuhola litsimba letitfunywa laseNingizimu Afrika liye kuForamu Yetemnotfo Yemhlaba (i-WEF) ye-Afrika ye-26 eRwanda emkhatsini wamhla ti-11 namhla ti-13 Inkhwekhweti 2016.

src: Foramo e tla tshwarwa tlasa mookotaba: “Re hokahanya Mehlodi ya Aforika ka Diphethoho tsa Dijithale”.Mmuso ka Moralo wa ona wa Dintlha tse Robong o ntshetsapele diphethoho tsa ona tsa dijithale.
tgt: Leforamu itawubanjelwa ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Kuchumanisa imitfombolusito yase-Afrika ngeTingucuko tekweDijithali”.Hulumende ngaloLuhlelo lwakhe Lwemaphuzu Layimfica utfutfukisa tigucuko tekwedijithali telive lakhe.

src: E fana ka mokgahlelo wa pele wa boikitlaetso ba marangrang a phatlaletseng a tla hokela ditheo tsa mmuso tse 5 000 ka hara bomasepala ba setereke ba robedi nakong ya dilemo tse tharo.
tgt: Wetfula sigaba sekucala semtamo wakhe we-inthanethi lesebenta ngekushesha letawuchumanisa tisetjentiswa tahulumende letingetulu kwaleti-5 000 kubomasipala besigodzi labasiphohlongo eminyakeni lemitsatfu.

src: Thuso ya ditjhelete e ka fihlang ho R740 milione e se abilwe bakeng sa ho tshehetsa phano.
tgt: Sekubekwe eceleni imali letigidzi letinge-R740 yekwesekela lokwetfulwa.

src: INDABA 2016 e tla tshwarwa Setsheng sa Dikopano sa Inkosi Albert Luthuli ho la Durban ho tloha ka la 7 ho isa ho la 9 Motsheanong 2016, ke lepatlelo la Bo-Aforika le tla kgothaletsa dihlahiswa tsa bohahlaudi ho bareki ba matjhaba.
tgt: INDABA 2016 eSikhungweni Senkhomfa sase-Inkosi Albert Luthuli eDurban kusukela mhla ti-7 kuya kumhla ti-9 Inkhwekhweti 2016, yinkhundla ye-Afrika Yonkhe letawukhutsata kutsengwa kwemikhicito yetfu yetekuvakasha bantfu bemave angaphandle.

src: Bohahlaudi, jwaloka e nngwe ya ditshiya tse tsheletseng tsa kgolo ya NDP, bo nyehetse R357 bilione ho GDP ya rona ka 2014 le ho tshehetsa diphesente tse 9 tsa mesebetsi ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Tekuvakasha, njengalenye yetinsika letisitfupha tekukhula kwemnotfo teLuhlelo Lwetekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe, tifake tigidzi letinge-R357 kuSambakhulu Semkhicito Wasekhaya (i-GDP) nga-2014 tabuye futsi tesekela i-9% yako konkhe kukhokhelwa kwaseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Lekgotla la Lefatshe la Boeti le Bohahlaudi le akanya hore bohahlaudi bo tla nyehela R560 bilione ho GDP ya rona ka 2025 mme e tla tshehetsa mesebetsi e fetang dimilione tse pedi.
tgt: Umkhandlu Wemhlaba Wetekuhamba kanye neTekuvakasha ulinganisela kutsi tekuvakasha titawufaka tigidzigidzi letinge-R560 ku-GDP yetfu nga-2025 kantsi futsi titawesekela imisebenti lengetulu kwaletigidzi letimbili.

src: Kgodiso ya kgahlamelo ya Bohahlaudi ho Moruo wa Mawatle ke tshiya e hlokolosi ya Moralo wa Dintlha tse Robong, ha ho shejwa hore ho na le bokgoni bo so kang bo sibollwa hantle ba mawatle a rona, bo ka nyehelang kgolong ya moruo.
tgt: Kukhulisa umphumela weTekuvakasha eMnotfweni Waselwandle kuyinsika lebalulekile yeLuhlelo Lwemaphuzu Layimfica, lokwesekelwa ngemakhono lasengakatsintfwa etilwandle tetfu, lokungafaka sandla ekukhuleni kwemnotfo.

src: Moruo wa mawatle le bohahlaudi di fana ka menyetla e matla bakeng sa kgolo ya moruo le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi.
tgt: Umnotfo waselwandle kanye netekuvakasha kuniketa ematfuba lamanyenti ekukhula kwemnotfo kanye nekwakheka kwematfuba emisebenti.

src: Bakeng sa ho hopola Letsatsi la Basebetsi ka la 1 Motsheanong 2016, Kabinete e boeletsa boitlamo ba naha ba ho tshireletsa ditokelo tsa basebetsi ka melao ya rona ya mesebetsi e tswetseng pele.
tgt: Mayelana nekukhunjulwa kweLilanga leTisebenti mhla lu-1 Inkhwekhweti 2016, iKhabhinethi ihamba etinyatselweni tekutinikela kwelive letfu ekuvikeleni emalungelo etisebenti ngekwemtsetfo wetisebenti lotfutfukako.

src: Ho tloha ka 1994 mmuso ka melao e kang Molao wa Dikamano tsa Basebetsi, Molao wa Maemo a Motheo a Kgiro, Molao wa Tekatekano ya Kgiro le wa Bophelo bo Botle le Polokeho Mosebetsing e hodisitse ditokelo tsa basebetsi.
tgt: Kusukela nga-1994 hulumende ngekusebentisa umtsetfo lefanana neMtsetfo Webudlelwane Betisebenti Nebacashi, Umtsetfo Wetimo Tekucashwa Letisisekelo, Umtsetfo Wekucashswa Ngekulingana kanye neTemphilo yasemsebentini neKuphepha yatfutfukisa emalungelo etisebenti.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa baithuti ba Kereiti 12 learners ho qala ho hula diforomo tsa kopo kapa ba etse dikopo ka inthanete ho ditsha tsa thuto e phahameng jwaloka karolo ya Letsholo la Apply Now/ Khetha Career Guidance.
tgt: IkKabhinethi icela bafundzi beLibanga le-12 kutsi bacale manje bakhiphe ku-inthanethi emafomu ekufa ticelo tetindzawo tekufundza etikhungweni tetemfundvo lephakeme nobe bafake ticelo ku-inthanethi njengencenye yeMkankhaso i-Apply Now/Khetha Career GuidanceLomklamo uchutjwa njalo ngemnyaka Litiko Letemfundvo Lephakeme Nekucecesha, utawuchutjwa kulo lonkhe lelive kute kube yiNyoni 2016 futsi usita bafundzi kutsi bakhetse kahle nabafaka ticelo tendzawo yekufundza etikhungweni temfundvo lephakeme.

src: Letsholo lena le nkuwang selemo ka seng ke Lefapha la Thuto e Phahameng le Thupello, le tsamaya naha ka bophara ho fihlela ka Loetse 2016 le ho thusa baithuti ho etsa kgetho e hlokolosi ha ba etsa dikopo ho ditsha tsa thuto e phahameng.
tgt: Bafundzi bakhutsatwa kutsi batsintse Sikhungo Setinsita Tekutfutfukisa Imisebenti nge-SMS nome batfumele “please call me” ku: 072 204 5056 nobe :086 999 0123, incwadzigezi: EMAILTOKEN, ku-Facebook ku: WEBTOKEN nobe ku-Twitter ku: WEBTOKEN Tincumo teKhabhinethi etindzabeni letibalulekile tesimondzawo.

src: Baithuti ba kgothaletswa ho ikopanya le Setsha sa Ditshebeletso tsa Ntshetsopele ya Makala a Thuto ka SMS kapa “please call me” ho 072 204 5056 kapa 086 999 0123, imeile EMAILTOKEN,Feisebukung ho WEBTOKEN kapa Twitter ho WEBTOKEN Maemo a Kabinete Mabapi le Dintlha tsa Bohlokwa Maemong a Hajwale.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhutsata labatsintsekako kutsi baphawule ngeluhlaka lolubuyeketiwe lwaseNingizimu Afrika lweShatha Yekuhlonyiswa Ngemandla Emnotfo Umkhakha Lobanti Webantfu Labamnyama kanye neMboni Yetimbiwa, lwanga-2016 lolwashicilelwa kuGazethi yaHulumende.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa bankakarolo ba amehang ho tshwaela ka moralo wa Tjhata e Shebilweng botjha ya Matlafatso e Pharaletseng ya Matlafatso ya Batho ba Batsho Moruong mabapi le indaseteri ya Aforika Borwa ya Merafo le Diminerale ya 2016 e ileng ya phatlalatswa Koranteng ya Mmuso.
tgt: Loluhlaka lolwabuyeketwa lweShatha Yetetimbiwa iyachubeka ihlanganise tinchubomgomo tahulumende tekutfutfukisa kanye nemtsetfo kute kutsi kuchutjwe emabhizinisi kalula, kwakheke kucaca kwekulawula, kucombeleleka kanye nekuciniseka.

src: Moralo o shebile botjha Tjhata ya Merafo le ho tswela pele ho kopanya maano a mmuso a diphethoho le melao bakeng sa ho matlafatsa bobebe ba ho kena kgwebong, ho hlahisa tlhakiso ya taolo, bokgoni ba tjhebelopele le bonnete.
tgt: Kuphindze futsi kuhambisane neMtsetfo Wekuhlomisa Ngemandla Emnotfo Umkhakha Lobanti Webantfu Labamnyama, 2003 (Umtsetfo No.

src: Hape e matahantswe le dipehelo tsa Molao wa Matlafatso ya Moruo o Pharaletseng wa Batho ba Batsho, 2003 (Molao No.
tgt: 53 wanga-2003) kanye neMakhodi Ekusebenta Ngalokufanele (Emakhodi e-DTI).

src: 53 wa 2003) le Dikhoutu tsa Tshebetso e Ntle (Dikhoutu tsa DTI).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwemukele kutsi kuvunywa kutfolwa kwe-SAB Miller yi-AB InBev lokuhlongotwako kubukwa tiphatsimandla temicudzelwano.

src: Kabinete e ananela ho tjhaellwa monwana ha kgapo e lohothwang ya SAB Miller ke AB InBev e ntseng e shebisiswa ke ba ka taolong ba diphehisano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayemukela indlela levunywe yiNdvuna Yekutfutfukiswa Kwetemnotfo kanye ne-AB InBev kutiphatsimandla temcudzelwano ngekwetintfo letinyenti letitsandvwa ngummango.

src: Kabinete e amohela katamelo eo ho dumellanweng ka yona ke Letona la Ntshetsopele ya Moruo le AB InBev le ba ka taolong ba phehisano mabapi le letoto la dintlha tse amang kgahleho ya setjhaba.
tgt: Lokutinikela kwalenkampani kusebenta njengenkhombandlela, yetindzaba letitsandvwa ngummango, kuletinye tinkampani letihlanganiswako kanye nekutfola etimeni letinjalo.

src: Boitlamo ba khamphani bo sebetsa jwaloka tataiso, hodima dintlha tsa kgahleho ya setjhaba, ho dikhamphani tse ding tse maemong a ho kopana le kgapo tse ikemiseditseng seo.
tgt: Loku kufaka ekhatsi kutinikela lokuvunyelwene ngako ngulenkampani kwekusebentisa sigidzigidzi si-R1 kuleminyaka lesihlanu letako kute kukhutsate kulima kwebalimi labancane kanye nekutfutfukiswa kwemtfulitinsita wendzawo, emabhizinisi lamasha, bucwepheshe bagezi nemanti lenele kanye nekutfutfukiswa kwelusha.

src: Sena se kenyeletsa boitlamo boo ho dumellanweng ka bona ke khamphani ho sebedisa R1 bilione nakong ya dilemo tse hlano tse tlang bakeng sa ho hodisa dihwai tse nyenyane le ntshetsopele ya bafani ba lehae, dikgwebo tse ntjha, dithekenoloji tsa eneji le metsi tse hlwahlwa le ntshetsopele ya batjha.
tgt: Kutinikela kumisebenti kufaka ekhatsi kugwema kutsi kulahleke imisebenti ngekudendwa kwetisebenti emsebentini ngekungatikhetseli ngenca yalokuhlanganiswa kwaletinkampani kanye nekugcina emazinga ekusebenta kulenkampani kuleminyaka lesihlanu letako, kuyincenye yesivumelwano lesiveta lokusha lesisemkhatsini walenkampani nahulumende sekwesekela timboni, kutfutfukiswa kwemabhizinisi lamancane kanye nekuvetwa kwematfuba emisebenti.

src: Boitlamo ho tsa mesebetsi ho kenyeletswa le maikemisetso a ho qoba phokotso mosebetsing eo e seng ya boithaopo ya basebetsi ka lebaka la ho kopanngwa le ho baballa maemo a kgiro khamphaning bakeng sa dilemo tse hlano tse tlang, ke karolo ya tumellano ya bohlokwa pakeng tsa khamphani le mmuso ho tshehetsa ntlafatso ya indaseteri, ntshetsopele ya dikgwebo tse nyane le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi.
tgt: Etehlakalweni letehlukene, iKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kucala kusebenta kwemigomo yeMtsetfo Wekuchibela Imicudzelwano lowenta kutsi kube licala kutsi bacondzisi nebaphatsi bavumelane ngalokuyimfihlo kutsi balungise tintsengo, emathendza nobe timakethe.

src: Ntlheng e nngwe e ka thoko, Kabinete e lemoha ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha dipehelo tsa Sehlomathiso sa Molao wa Phehisano se etsang hore e be tlolo ya molao ya batsamaisi le bolaodi ho etsa mmommori wa ho henahena ditheko, dithenda kapa mebaraka.
tgt: Lemigomo iyincenye yetinyatselo tekucinisakulwanetinhlangano letikhulisa tintsengo ngalokungekho emtsetfweni lokulimata umnotfo kubuye futsi kubite batsengi tintsengo letishisiwe.

src: Dipehelo tsena ke karolo ya ho matlafatsa ntwa kgahlanong le maqulwana a senyang moruo le ho beha ditheko tse hodimo bakeng sa WEBTOKEN ipiletsa ho dikgwebo ka hara Aforika Borwa ho phehisana ho itshetlehilwe hodima ditheko tse tlase, ntlafatso e eketsehileng, boleng bo ntlafetseng ba thepa e fanwang kapa tshebeletso e phahameng ho bareki ho na le mmommori.
tgt: Simema emabhizinisi eNingizimi Afrika kutsi acudzelane ngetintsengo letiphasi, lokunyenti lokusha, lizinga lelincono lekudla lokuniketwako nobe tinsita temtfulitinsita laninika emakhasimende kunekuvumela ngalokuyimfihlo.

src: Kabinete lemohile kamoo lekala la dibanka le laolwang haholo ka teng Aforika Borwa – le lefatsheng, le tlhokeho ya Aforika Borwa ya ho imatahanya le maemo a matjhaba a kang Basel III le melao e kgahlanong le tshebediso ya tjhelete ka bolotsana ya Lebotho la Tshebetso la Ditjhelete (FATF), tseo esale di tjhaellwa monwana ke Kabinete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwemukele kutsi umkhakha wemabhange ulawulwa ngalokusezingeni lesitulu kanjani eNingizimu Afrika - nasemhlabeni wonkhe, kanye nesidzingo sekutsi iNingizimu Afrika ifanele kutsi ihambisane nemazinga emhlaba lafanana neBasel III kanye nemitsetfosimiso Lelwa nekwenta sengatsi imali letfolakele ngebugebengu itfolakale ngetindlela letifanele yeMbutfo Wekusebenta Wesinyatselo Setimali (i-FATF), lebeyivunywe yiKhabhinethi phambilini, yabuye futsi yesekelwa ngumtsetfo losisekelo lovunywe nguHulumende.

src: Mokgwa wa Twin Peaks le ona o tla laola boitshwaro ba mmaraka ka hara lekala la dibanka le a mang a phatlaletseng a ditjhelete.".
tgt: Inchubo ye-Twin Peaks itawuphindze ilawule kutiphatsa kwetimakethe emkhakheni wetemabhange nalobanti.".

src: Kabinete e amohela diphetho ho tswa ho Kopano ya Selemo ya Letlole la Ditjhelete la Matjhaba le Dihlopha tsa Banka ya Lefatshe ya 2016 e neng e tshwerwe tlasa mookotaba:“diphephetso tsa Lefatshe, Ditharollo tsa Lefatshe”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayemukela imiphumela yeMhlangano Wesikhwama Setimali Wemave Emhlaba kanye neweMacembu Elibhange Lemhlaba weNtfwasahlobo yanga-2016 lobanjwa ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi “Tinsayeya Temave Emhlaba, Tisombululo Temave Emhlaba”.

src: Katamelo ya dintlha tse tharo ya ho rotetsa kgolo maemong a lefatshe e ile ya sisinngwa, e le ho kgothaletsa dinaha ho sebedisa dibetsa tsohle tsa ho akofisa kgolo, ke hore, ditlhabollo tsa tjhelete, matlotlo le tsa sebopeho.
tgt: Kwahlongotwa indlela lemkhakhamitsatfu letawubasela ngemandla kukhula ezingeni lemave emhlaba, lekhutsata emave kutsi asebentise tonkhe tigwadluli tenchubomgomo kute phelwe kukhula, imali yahulumende lengenako kanye nekuntjintjwa kwetimiso.

src: Dinaha tse nang le sebaka sa ditjhelete le matlotlo di ile tsa kgothaletswa ho etsa haholwanyane bakeng sa ho matlafatsa tlhokeho leha ho le jwalo, ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha ditlharollo tsa sebopeho ho ne ho le hlokolosi bakeng sa bohle.
tgt: Emave lanendzawo yemali nemali yahulumende lengenako akhutsatwa kutsi asebente kakhulu kute akhuphule timfuno nanoma kunjalo, kufezekiswa kwekuntjintja kwetimiso bekubalulekile kuwonkhewonkhe.

src: Ho ba bangata sena se kenyeletsa matsete ho meralo ya motheo, ntjhafatso le ntlafatso ya tikoloho ya bolaodi, hara tse ding.
tgt: Kulinyenti loku kufaka ekhatsi kutjala imali kusakhiwonchanti, kulokusha kanye nekwenta kancono simondzawo sekulawula, emkhatsini waletinye tintfo.

src: Kabinete e hopotsa bakgethi bohle ba tshwanelehang ba so kang ba ingodisa le ho netefatsa dintlha tsa bona hore ba ka nna ba etsa jwalo ka ho etela Kantoro ya bona ya lehae ya Khomishene e Ikemetseng ya Dikgetho (IEC).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhumbuta bonkhe bavoti labafanele labasengakabhalisi futsi labangakacinisekisi imininingwane yabo kutsi basengabhalisa nobe bacinisekise imininingwane yabo ngekutsi bavakashele Lihhovisi leKhomishini Yelukhetfo Letimele (i-IEC) yendzawo yakubo.

src: Sena se a hlokahala ho netefatsa lebitso la hao lenaneng la bakgethi e leng se tla thusa bakgethi ba tshwanelehang ho sebedisa tokelo ya bona ya demokerasi ka la 3 Phato 2016.Kabinete e kgothaletsa bakgethi ho netefatsa hore ba kgotsofatsa ditlhokeho tsa ho fana ka diaterese tsa bona kantorong ya Lehae ya Khomishene e Ikemetseng ya Dikgetho (IEC).Dipotso ka ditaba tsa dikgetho di ka lebiswa setsheng sa mehala sa IEC ho 0800 11 8000, se bulwang Mantaha ho isa Labohlano, ho tloha ka 7 hoseng ho isa ka to 9 bosiu.
tgt: Loku kuyadzingeka kute kutsi kucinisekise ligama lakho eluhlwini lwebavoti lokutawenta bavoti labafanelekile kutsi basebentise lilungelo labo lentsandvo yelinyenti mhla ti-3 Ingci 2016.IKhabhinethi icela bavoti labafanelekile kutsi bacinisekise kutsi bayahlangabetana netidzingo tekuniketa lihhovisi leKhomishini Yelukhetfo Letimele (i-IEC) emakheli abo.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Transnet, Bolaodi ba Naha ba Botjhutjhisi, SABC le Mafapha a Thuto e Phahameng le Thupello, Dikamano tsa Matjhaba le Tshebedisano, le la Toka le Ntshetsopele ya Molaotheo ka ho nkuwa e le “Bahiri ba nang le Kgohedi ka ho fetisisa” ka hara Aforika Borwa ke khamphani ya matshwao, UNIVERSUKabinete e thoholetsa Letona la Saense le Thekenoloji, Naledi Pandor, ya amohetseng Kgau ya Bokgabane ho tswa ho Riphaboliki ya Bofederale ya Jeremane bakeng sa nyehelo ya hae ho tsa saense lefatsheng.
tgt: Imibuto lemayelana nelukhetfo ingacondziswa esikhungweni sekuchumana se-IEC ku: 0800 11 8000, lelivula njalo ngeMsombuluko kute kube nguLesihlanu kusukela ngensimbi ye-7 ekuseni kute kube yinsimbi ye-9 ebusuku.

src: Kgau e fuwa batho ba ho tswa lefatsheng ka bophara bakeng sa diphihlello tsa bona mapatlelong a sepolotiki, a kahisano le a mautlwela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela iTransnet, Umkhandlu Wetebushushisi Wavelonkhe, Inhlangano Yetekusakata Ngemoya YaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SABC) kanye neLitiko Letemfundvo Lephakeme Nekucecesha, Litiko Letebudlelwane Nekubambisana Kwemave Emhlaba, kanye neLetebulungiswa Nekutfutfukiswa KweMtsetfosisekelo ngekutsi abekwe ezingeni lekutsi “Abacashi Labahehana Kakhulu” eNingizimu Afrika yinkampani lebeka bacashi luphawu, UNIVERSUIKhabhinethi incoma Indvuna yeLitiko Letesayensi Netheknoloji, Naledi Pandor, lotfole umklomelo we-Order of Merit kuFederal Republic of Germany ngekufaka kwakhe sandla ekutfutfukisweni kwetesayensi emaveni emhlaba.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Motsamaisi-Kakaretso wa Lefapha la Merero ya Tikoloho Nosipho Ngcaba bakeng sa ho amohela Kgau ya 2015/16 Lifetime Achievement Eco-Logic ho tswa ho phatlalatso ya Enviropaedia.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela Umcondzisi Jikelele weLitiko Letemvelo Nosipho Ngcaba ngekutfola Umklomelo We-Eco-Logic Wemphilo Yonkhe Wanga-2015/16 lovela kumagazini yetemvelo, i-The Enviropaedia.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa setaki Kemang Wa Lehulere bakeng sa ho ba "Setaki sa sa Selemo" bakeng sa 2017 e leng se tshehetswang ke Deutsche Bank.
tgt: IKhabinethi ihalalisela sobuciko Kemang Wa Lehulere ngekuba "nguSobuciko Wemnyaka" wa-2017 lowesekelwa yiDeutsche Bank.

src: Wa Lehulere, ya sibollang kamano ya pontsho ya bonono ka hara Aforika Borwa ya kamora mmuso wa kgethollo, o tla pepesa dipontsho tsa hae a le mong Jeremane sebakeng sa Deutsche Bank KunstHalle ho la Berlin selemong se tlang.
tgt: Wa Lehulere, lohlolisisa kufaneleka kwalokukhonjiswa yiNingizimu Afrika ngemuva kwelubandlululo, utawukhangisa imisebenti yakhe yedvwana kwekucala eGermany eDeutsche Bank KunstHalle eBerlin kulomnyaka lotako.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Lefapha la Bohahlaudi bakeng sa ho hapa moputso wa Leano/Tshehetso ya Setjhaba e Ipabotseng ka ho fetisisa ho Dikgau tsa 2016 tsa Bohahlaudi bo nang le Boikarabelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela Litiko Letekuvakasha ngekuphumela kutfola umklomelo weNchubomgomo Yemmango/Kwesekela Lehamba Embili kuMiklomelo Yetekuvakasha Lokunesibopho yanga-2016.

src: Makgabane ana a abelwa lefapha la lekala la setjhaba, bolaodi kapa setheo se entseng boitelo bo hlakileng le nyehelo bakeng sa ho hodisa bohahlaudi bo nang le boikarabelo.
tgt: Lomklomelo uklonyeliswa litiko lemkhakha wahulumende, umtimba lophetse nobe nanobe ngusiphi sikhungo lesitinikele ngalokucacile sabuye futsi safaka sandla ekutfutfukiseni tekuvakasha etinesibopho.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa sebapadi sa kolofo Branden Grace bakeng sa ho hapa papadi ya hae ya pele ya PGA Tour ho RBC Heritage ho la Hilton Head, Amerika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela umdlaligaluva Branden Grace ngekuwina mcudzelwano wakhe wekucala we-PGA Tour e-RBC Heritage eHilton Head, e-UIKhabhinethi idzabukile ngekushona kwaBertie Lubner lowafaka sandla lesikhulu ekutfutfukeni kweNingizimu Afrika kutsi ibe ngumholi kutemabhuzinisi, umvelisi wemusa nesihawu kanye nasihlalo wemphilo yekubonga weNhlangano YemaJuda aseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e utlwisitswe bohloko ke lefu la Bertie Lubner ya entseng nyehelo e kgolo bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya Aforika Borwa jwaloka moetapele wa kgwebo, mosebeletsi wa batho le modulasetulo wa tlotlo wa bophelo bohle wa Mokgatlho wa maJuta a Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yendlulisele emavi ayo endvudvuto kubangani nemindeni yalaba labalishumi (Tiisetso Tselo, Sesi Mtshali, Sana Sibeko, Mphikeleli Malindi, Gugulethu Sithole, Vusi Nkabinde, Daphney Linda, Sicelo Kheswa, Sphamandla Gedle and Simphiwe Nhlapo) labashone kunhlekelele yengoti yebhasi babuya kuRali Yekwetfulwa KweManifesto ye-ANC eBhayi.

src: Kabinete hape e lakaleditse pholo ya kapele ho ba lemetseng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphindze yafisela labo labalimele kutsi belulame ngekushesha.

src: Kabinete e fetiseditse matshidiso a yona ho lelapa le metswalle ya Ngaka Herman Nditsheni Netshidzivhani, setsebi sa pele sa Aforika Borwa sa motho e motsho sa bokgoni ba pelehi.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi yendlulisele emavi ayo endvudvuto emndenini nakubangani ba-Dkt.

src: Jwaloka mothei wa tliliniki ya bokgoni ba pelehi ka hara Sepetlele sa Park Lane ho la Johannesburg, Netshidzivhani o thusitse maAforika Borwa a mangata ho qala malapa.
tgt: Herman Nditsheni Netshidzivhani, dokotela lokhetsekile wekucala lomnyama eNingizimu Afrika wetembeleko.

src: Kabinete e fetiseditse matshediso a yona ho lelapa le metswalle ya Dene Smuts, Setho sa Mehleng sa Palamente sa Democratic Alliance.
tgt: Njengemsunguli wemtfolamphilo wetembeleko eSibhedlela ePark Lane eJozi, Netshidzivhani wasita bantfu labanengi baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi babe nemindeni yabo.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa nyehelo ya hae e babatsehang bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya demokerasi ya rona ya molaotheo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yendlulisele emavi ayo endvudvuto emndenini nakubangani baDene Smuts, lobekaLilunga lePhalemnde leDemocratic Alliance esikhatsini lesendlulile.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le Moporesidente President Jacob Zuma bakeng sa ho lakaletsa Mama Winnie Madikizela-Mandela pholo e potlakileng le ho kgothaletsa ho hlomphuwa ha boinotshi ba lelapa nakong ena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imetfulela sigcoko ngekufaka sandla kwakhe kahle kakhulu ekutfutfukisweni kwentsandvo yetfu yelinyenti.

src: Winnie Mandela o hlomphuwa hohle ka lebaka la karolo ya hae ntweng ya tokoloho e nyehetseng ho phediso ya maano a kgatello le ho tlisa demokerasi Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ijoyina Mengameli Jacob Zuma ekufiseleni Make Winnie Madikizela-Mandela kwelulama ngekushesha iphindze futsi icela kutsi lomndeni uhlonishwe ngalesikhatsi lesi.

src: DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di ho ya ka netefatso ya mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang.
tgt: Winnie Mandela uhlonishwa kakhulu ngendzima yakhe layidlala ekulweleni kwetfu inkhululeko lokwafaka sandla ekucedzeni tinchubomgomo letigcilatanako kanye nekuletsa intsandvo yelinyenti eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Paul Steenkamp ho Lekgotla la Naha la Boeletsi ka Ntlafatso.
tgt: Paul Steenkamp kuMkandlu Wetekweluleka Ngalokusha Wavelonkhe.

src: Clarinda Elizabeth Simpson jwaloka Mohlanka ya ka Sehloohong wa Ditjhelete wa SENTECLumko Caesario Mtimde jwaloka Mohlanka ya ka Sehloohong wa Phethahatso wa Ditshebeletso tsa Lefatshe le Lekala la Phihlello la Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Clarinda Elizabeth Simpson njengeSikhulu Lesikhulu Setimali saseSENTECLumko Caesario Mtimde njengeSikhulu Lesiphetse seLuphiko Lwetemisebenti Lefananako kanye ne-Ejensi yeKufinyelela yaseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Ho thonngwa hape ha Moatefokate Rory Wayne Voller jwaloka Motlatsi wa Mokhomishenara wa Khomishene ya Dikhamphani le Thepa ya Mautlwela.
tgt: Rory Wayne Voller njengeLisikelaKhomishani leKhomishini Yetinkampani kanye Nemisebenti Yebuciko.

src: Katoloso ya konteraka bakeng sa Lungisa Fuzile jwaloka Motsamaisi Kakaretso wa Lefapha la Matlotlo.
tgt: Kwelulwa kwekontileka yaLungisa Fuzile njengeMcondzisi Jikelele weMgcinimafa Wavelonkhe.

src: Katoloso ya konteraka bakeng sa Nosipho Ngcaba jwaloka Motsamaisi Kakaretso wa Lefapha la Merero ya Tikoloho.
tgt: Kwelulwa kwekontileka yaNosipho Ngcaba njengeMcondzisi Jikelele weLitiko Letemvelo.

src: N Mafu jwaloka Motlatsi wa Motsamaisi-Kakaretso: Matlafatso le Botsamaisi ba Bankakarolo ka hara Lefapha la Mekaubere ya Sesole.
tgt: N Mafu njengeLisekela leMcondzidi Jikelele: Kuhlomisa Ngemakhono Nekulawulwa Kwalabatsintseko kuLitiko Letigayigayi Temphi.

src: TLM Makotoko jwaloka Mohlanka ya ka Sehloohong wa Tshebetso bakeng sa Lefapha la Merero ya Tikoloho.
tgt: TLM Makotoko njengeSikhulu Setkusebenta kuLitiko Letemvelo.

src: Ho kenngwa Tshebetsong ha Mananeo a Bohlokwa a Mmuso.
tgt: Kufezekiswa Kwetinhlelo Tahulumende Letibalulekile.

src: Kabinete e lemohile tlalehelo ya Letona la Ditjhelete ho Moporesidente, mabapi le kgatelopele ya dipuisano tsa Mmuso le lekala la poraefete le la mesebetsi ka moruo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawemukela umbiko lovela eNdvuneni yeTetimali locondziswe kuMengameli, lomayelana nenchubekelembili nekubonisana kwaHulumende nemkhakha lotimele netetisebenti mayelana nemnotfo.

src: Moporesidente o romme Letona hore le etelle pele ditherisano le balekane ba kahisano ho rala lewa le ho tla ka mekgwa ya ho hodisa moruo le ho baballa maemo a naha sekaleng sa mekitlane.
tgt: Mengameli ugunyate Indvuna kutsi ihole tinkhulumiswano nalabalingani betenhlalo kutsi bente indlelalisu babuye futsi batfole tindlela tekukhulisa umnotfo nekulondvolota silinganisotikweleti salelive.

src: Kabinete e thabile ka hobane mosebetsi ona o tswetse boikitlaetso bo bonahalang bo tla ntlafatsa menyetla ya naha ya moruo.
tgt: Kuyayitfokotisa Ikhabhinethi kutsi lomsebenti sewucinise imitamo letawenta kancono litsemba lemnotfo walelive.

src: Moporesidente o tsebisitse dintlha tse seng kae tsa boikitlaetso bo ka sehloohong ka Mantaha, tse kenyeletsang: (1) letlole le kopanetsweng la lekala la poraefete le la setjhaba bakeng sa Tshehetso ya Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane, (2) ho sebetsana le ditshita bakeng sa ho eketsa matsete hore ho tle ho akofiswe kgolo e kenyeletsang, (3) matsete a kopanetsweng ke mmuso le lekala la poraefete ho meralo ya motheo ho itshetlehilwe hodima boiphihlelo ba katleho ya Lenaneo la Bahlahisi ba Matla ba Ikemetseng le (4) ho matlafatsa Dikgwebo tsa Mmuso ho netefatsa maemo a tsona a ditjhelete a moshwelella le ho matlafatsa botjha karolo ya tsona bakeng sa ho kganna ntshetsopele.
tgt: NgeMsombuluko Mengameli umemetele imitamo leminyenti lehamba embili, lefaka ekhatsi: (1) sikhwama senhlanganisela yemkhakha lotimele kanye nemkhakha wahulumende seKwesekela Emabhizinisi Lamancane, (2) kulungisa tintfo leticindzela kukhula kwelutjalomali kute kutsi kusheshiswe umnotfo lofaka konkhe ekhatsi, (3) lubanjiswano lwelutjalomali kutakhiwonchanti lwemkhakha lotimele kanye nemkhakha wahulumende lolumiselwe ekuphumeleleni kweLuhlelo Lwekuphehla Emandla Lolutimele kanye (4) nekucinisa Emabhizinisi aHulumende kucinisekisa kutsi anemali lengapheli kanye nekucinisekisisa indzima yawo layidlalako ekugcugcuteleni intfutfuko.

src: Ditsebiso tsena ke bopaki ba seo naha ena e ka se fihlellang ha balekane bohle ba kahisano ba ka ikopanya mmoho ho sebeletsa ho fihlella morero o tshwanang.2 Kabinete e dula e na le boitshepo ba hore matlafatso e matla ya matlotlo, pokeletso e etsang nalane ya R1 trilione ke Tshebeletso ya Lekgetho ya Aforika Borwa le boitshunyako ba dintlha tse hlano ba nako e kgutshwane bo tsebisitsweng haufinyana tjena, kaofela di tshehetsa moralo wa Dintlha tse Robong hore ho tle ho netefatswe dintlafalo katlehong ya rona ya moruo.
tgt: Letimemetelo tisicinisekiso saloko lokungazuzwa ngulelive nangabe bonkhe bahlanganyeli bangasebentisana basebentele umgomo munye.2 IKhabhinethi iyachubeka nekutetsemba kutsi kuhlanganiswa kwetimali lokunemandla kwahulumende, kugcogcwa kwetigidzigidzi tetigidzigidzi-R1 lokungumlandvo tagcogcwa Luphiko Lwekugcogca Imali LwaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SARS) kanye netinyatselo tekungenelela letisihlanu tesikhatsi lesifishane letisandza kumenyetelwa, konkhe loku kuphelelisa luhlelo Lwemaphuzu Layimfica kute kutsi kucinisekiswe tingucuko letinhle kumnotfo wetfu.

src: Pokeletso e eketsehileng ya lekeno ke SARS e tla boela e thuse Mmuso ho fana ka ditshebeletso tse tla ntlafatsa boleng ba bophelo ba baahi ba ona.
tgt: Kugcogcwa kwamalingena lokukhulile yi-SARS kutawuchubeka kwente Hulumende kutsi etfule tinsita letiphucula lizinga lemphilo lato tonkhe takhamuti taseNingizimu Afrika.3 IKhabhinethi iyasemukela simemetelo lesentiwe yi-ejensi lelinganisa tikweleti, iMoody’s Investor Services, lekutsi kuleliviki leliphelile icinisekise silinganisosikweleti salelive kutsi singemazinga lamabili ngetulu kwengoti yelutjalomali lelizingancane.

src: Kabinete e amohela tsebiso ya lekala le methang maemo a mekitlane, Moody’s Investor Services, leo beke e fetileng le tiiseditseng botjha hore ho methwa ha mekitlane ke dikoto tse pedi ho feta sekala se tlase-tlase sa matsete.
tgt: Ekucinisekiseni silinganisosikweleti, iMoody's ikucaphele kutsi iNingizimu Afrika isondzela ezingeni lekuntjintja ngemuva kweminyaka yekuba butsakatsaka futsi tindlela tekuhlanganiswa lokunemandla kulwabiwomali lwanga-2016 kutawutintisa sikwelete sahulumende kuSambakhulu Semkhicito Wasekhaya (i-GDP) kulomnyaka.

src: Bakeng sa ho tiisetsa ho methwa hona, ba ha Moody ba lemohile hore Aforika Borwa e atamela ntlha ya phethoho kamora dilemo tsa kgolo e fokolang le mekgwa e bohale ya matlafatso ditekanyetsong tsa 2016 di tla tsitsisa sekoloto sa mmuso ho GDP selemong sena se hodimo.
tgt: Onkhe emacembu avumile kutsi kudzingeka kutsi kucinisekiswe imitamo yekubambisana kute kutsi inike emandla kuvuka kwemnotfo.

src: Re boela re lemoha hore mosebetsi wa Letona la Ditjhelete le balekane ba kahisano ho kenyeletsa motjha wa tshebetso wa ho methwa ha mekitlane ho tla hlwaya ditlhabollo tse ka bang teng le boitshunyako bakeng sa ho baballa mebaraka e matla ya ditjhelete ya Aforika Borwa le ho methwa ha maemo a sekala sa mekitlane.
tgt: Siphindze futsi siyakunaka umsebenti weNdvuna Yetetimali nebalingani betenhlalo ufaka ekhatsi umkhakha wekusebenta lotawutfola luntjintjo netingelelo tekulondvolota timakethe temali letinemandla taseNingizimu Afrika kanye nesilinganisosikweleti selizinga lelutjalomali lelingetulu kwelizinga lelincane lebungoti.

src: Moporesidente o ananela Dipuo tsa Ditekanyetso ka Matona ka ho latelana tse shebaneng le ditlhoko tsa maAforika Borwa kaofela.
tgt: Mengameli uyawutfokotela Mcombelelo lolwentiwe ngito tonkhe Tindvuna lolulungisa tonkhe tidzingo taseNingizimu afrika.

src: Ditlaleho tsa kgatelopele le meralo e tswang ho Dipuo tsa Ditekanyetso tsa Mafapha di bontsha hore Aforika Borwa ke setjhaba se keneng mosebetsing, ka mmuso o supang tsela, bakeng sa ho aha bophelo bo botle bakeng sa bohle.
tgt: Imibiko yenchubelembili kanye netinhlelo letivela kuMcombelelo weMatiko ikhombisa kutsi iNingizimu Afrika isive lesisebentako, lesiholwa nguhulumende, lesakha imphilo lencono yabo bonkhe bantfu.

src: Mekgwa e bonahalang e se e kentswe tshebetsong ho fokotsa sekgahla se sebe sa ho wa ha moruo wa lefatshe hodima moruo wa rona, le ho itokisetsa kgolo e matla ha tsamao ya moruo e bontsha ho loka.
tgt: Kumiswe ngemumo tindlela letitawunciphisa umphumela lomubi wekwehla kwemnotfo emhlabeni wonkhe jikelele, kanye nekulungiselela kukhula lokunemandla lapho imijikeleto yemnotfo igucuka iba ngulemihle.

src: Hape re sebetsa ka matla ho tlosa ditshita tsa ka lapeng tsa kgolo ya moruo.
tgt: Siphindze futsi sisebenta ngemandla kususa tintfo tasekhaya levimba kukhula.

src: Dipuo tsa ditekanyetso hape di bontsha hore mmuso, lekala la mesebetsi le dikgwebo di sebetsa mmoho, ho feta ka nako efe kapa efe, ho fumana ditsela tsa ho rotetsa botjha kgolo le kaho ya bophelo bo betere bakeng sa bohle.
tgt: Lomcombelelo uphindze futsi ukhombise kutsi hulumende, tisebenti kanye nemabhizinisi kuyasebentisana, kundlula tonkhe letinte tikhatsi, kutfola tindlela tekuvisetela ngemandla kukhula kanye nekwakha imphilo lencono yabo bonkhe.

src: Sena se kenyeletsa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ho matla ha Moralo wa Dintlha tse Robong, o tsebisitsweng ke Moporesidente Jacob Zuma ho Puo ka Maemo a Setjhaba ya 2015 hammoho le Operation Phakisa, e reretsweng ho potlakisa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha ditharollo tsa dibaka tsa ntshetsopele tse hlokolosi.
tgt: Loku kufaka ekhatsi kufezekiswa lokunemandla kweLuhlelo Lwemaphuzu Layimfica, lokwamenyetelwe nguMengameli Zuma eNkhulumeni yakhe Yebunjalo Belive yanga-2015 kanye ne-Operation Phakisa, lokwentelwe kusheshisa kufezekiswa kwetisombululo etindzaweni letibalulekile letitfutfukiswako.

src: Mananeo ana a sebetsana le dintlha tse hlokolosi ho tswa ho Lewa la Naha la Ntshetsopele, tse kang ho fokotsa bofuma le tlhokeho ya mesebetsi.
tgt: LoLuhlelo Lwekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe, njengekunciphisa buphuya nekungasebenti.5 IKhabhinethi icinisekise bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi lesimo sekubate imisebenti siyalungiswa nekufezekiswa kweLuhlelo Lwekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe (i-NDP) ngekungenelela kweLuhlelo Lwemaphuzu Layimfica lolufuna kufaka emandla kukhula lubuye futsi lukhuphule imisebenti emikhakheni lebalulekile yemnotfo wetfu.

src: Tshebedisano ya lekala la poraefete ke taba e ka sehloohong bakeng sa sephetho se atlehileng.
tgt: Kuhlangana kwemkhakha lotimele kubaluleke kakhulu kumphumela loyimphumelelo.

src: Mmuso o sebedisa dintlha tsohle tsa boikitlaetso tse teng ho kenyeletswa le Moralo wa Tshebetso wa Leano la Diindaseteri (IPAP) ho bopa tlhahiso e hohelang basebetsi haholwanyane le makala a ditshebeletso ho sebetsana le tlhokeho ya mesebetsi ho mpefaditsweng ho feta ke maemo a boima a moruo wa lefatshe le wa lehae.
tgt: Hulumende usebentisa yonkhe imitamo lekhona kufaka ekhatsi Luhlelo Lwekusebenta Lwenchubomgomo Yetimboni (i-IPAP) kwakha umkhicito lotsatsa tisebenti letinyenti kanye nemikhakha yetinsita lelungisa tekubabete kwemisebenti lokuchutjiselwe lutsi ekhatsi timo letimatimo tetemnotfo wemave emhlaba kanye newasekhatsi.

src: Letona la Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri, Rob Davies le thakgotse ho phetwa ka tatelano ha borobedi ha selemo ka seng ha IPAP 2016/17 ho isa ho 2018-19 ka la 9 Motsheanong 2016 femeng ya metjhini ya kwari ya tshepe eo beng ba yona e leng batho ba batsho ka 100% ho la Gauteng.
tgt: Indvuna Yetekuhwebelana Netetimboni, Rob Davies yetfule umnyaka wesiphohlongo wekuphindvwa kwe-IPAP kusuka nga-2016/17 kuya ku-2018-19 mhla tiyi-9 Inkhwekhweti 2016 lapho khona basunguli bekwentiwa kwetinsimbi nemishini kutawuba bantfu labamnyama nga-100% eGauteng.

src: Mmuso o toboketsa bohlokwa ba ho hodisa tshebedisano e momahaneng le dikhamphani tsa diindaseteri tse sehlohlolong tsa lehae tse itahletseng ka setotswana e seng feela ho ntshetsopele ya meralo ya motheo, dipalangwang le bothothi, empa ho parola le letoto le batsi la makala a itshupang ho tsa thekenoloji, a ka romellang thepa dinaheng tsa ka ntle le a ka hirang basebeletsi ba bangata ba moruo wa Aforika Borwa ka kakaretso.
tgt: Hulumende igcizelela kubaluleka kwekubambisana netinkampani tetimboni tendzawo letiphucuke ngalokusezingeni lelisetulu letingahlanganyeli nje kuphela ekutfutfukiseni sakhiwonchanti, titfutsi, nekufezekiswa kwemisebenti leminyenti, kepha nasemikhakheni leyehlukahlukene lenebucwepheshe lobusetulu, lelungele kutsengisela lamanye emave kanye nalenetisebenti letinyenti temnotfo lophelele waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Leha Diphuputso tsa Kotara ka Nngwe tsa Lebotho la Basebetsi bakeng sa kotara ya pele ya 2016 di rekotile keketseho ya kgiro ho ya ho 26.7% boemong ba kotara ka kotara, maemo a 2016 a kgiro a phahame ho feta ka batho ba 204 000 ba hirilweng ha ho bapiswa le kotara ya pele ya 2015.
tgt: Nanobe nje Luklayo Lwetisebenti Lwekota yekucala yanga-2016 lukhombise kukhula nge-27% kwelizinga lekubate imisebenti njalo ngekota, emazinga ekubate imisebenti anga-2016 asetulu nge-204 000 ebantfu labacashiwe nakucatsaniswa nekota yekucala yanga-20.6 IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kuniketelwa kweBeaufort West Youth Hub, eNshonalanga Kapa, nguMengameli Jacob Zuma, lokunika bantfu labasha sikhungo, lapho khona bangatihlomisa ngemandla.

src: Kabinete e amohela phano ya Setsha sa Batjha sa Beaufort West, ho la Kapa Bophirimela ke Moporesidente Jacob Zuma, se fana ka sebaka ho batjha, moo ba ka imatlafatsang teng.
tgt: Lesikhungo sinetisetjentiswa letehlukene letiniketa kutfutfukiswa lokuphelele kwebantfu labancane kanye nemmbango ngebubanti bawo.

src: Tulo ena e na le motswako wa dibaka tse fanang ka ntshetsopele e akaretsang ya batjha le bakeng sa badudi ka kakaretso.
tgt: Letisetjentiswa letikulesikhungo titawunika bantfu labancane lababuya emimangweni lephuyiyile ematfuba latawubenta kutsi bahlanganyele kancono futsi bafake ligalelelo lelakhako emimangweni yabo nakulelive.

src: Dibaka tse teng ka hara setsha sena sa batjha di tla neha batho ba batjha ho tswa metseng e futsanehileng menyetla ya ho nkakarolo ka tsela e betere le ho nyehela ka bokgabane ho badudi le naha.
tgt: Lesikhungo Semakhono lesinetisetientiswa letiphelele sichutjwa Likoloshi laseNingizimu Kapa stawucecesha-200 ngemnyaka bahlanganyenli beMbutfo Weluphiko Lwelusha Lwasemaphandleni Lwavelonkhe (i-NARYSEC) kutekulawula emabhizinisi, kusebentisa ngcondvomshini kanye nekutfutfukisa umntfwana eminyakeni yekucala.

src: Setsi sa Maitsebelo se nang le thepa ka botlalo e laolwang ke Koletjhe ya Kapa Borwa e tla fana ka thupello ya tsamaiso ya dikgwebo, tshebediso ya khompyutha le ntshetsopele ya thuto ya bana ba lokisetswang sekolo ho Lebotho la Naha la Tshebeletso ya Batjha ba Mahaeng (NARYSEC) ba 200 ba nkang karolo ka selemo.
tgt: I-NARYSEC luhlelo lwesikhatsi lesidze lapho khono kucondvwa lusha lwasemaphendleni, luyahlwaywa luphindze lunikwe emakontileka eminyaka lemibili.

src: NARYSEC ke lenaneo la nako e telele moo ho tobilweng feela batjha ba dibaka tsa mahae, ba thaothilweng le ho kena konterakeng ya dilemo tse pedi.
tgt: Lusha loluneminyaka yebudzala lesemkhatsini we-18 kuya kulenge-25 luyahlwaya bese lubhaliselwa kuceceshelwa emakhono lehlukene latawubahlomisa ngelwati lwengcondvo kanye nelwenta ngalokubonakalako, kutsi batakhele imisebenti yabo kanye nalabanye bantfu emimangweni yabo.

src: Batjha ba pakeng tsa dilemo tse 18 le tse 25 ba thaothwa mme ebe ba ngodiswa bakeng sa thupello maitsebelong a fapafapaneng a tla etsa hore ba hlomele, bobedi ka tsebo ya kelello le ya matsoho, ho hlahisa mesebetsi bakeng sa bobona le batho ba bang ka hara metse ya bo bona.
tgt: Lesikhungo seLusha singumjlamo wekulinga kufezekisa akuta sewube khona phambilini, futsi utawentiwa kulesifundza.7 IKhabhinethi iyawemukela Umhlangano Wesifundza Sase-Afrika weLubanjiswano LwaHulumende Loluvulekile (i-OGP) wanga-2016 losandza kubanjwa lebewungeniswe yiNingizimu Afrika ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi "Hulumende lovulekile weNtfutfuko Lechubekela Embili Ngalokungenamkhawulo e-Afrika" kusuka mhla ti-5 tiya kumhla ti-6 Inkhwekhweti 2016.Lomhlangano wenteke ngemuva kwetinyanga lestisikhombisa iNingizimu Afrika ibe nguSihlalomholi weLubanjiswano LwaHulumende Lovulekile.

src: Setsha sena sa Batjha ke porojeke ya Teko le ho ba ya pele ya mofuta wa yona, mme e tla namela diporofenseng tse ding.
tgt: Tinchumbomgomo tahulumende lovulekile tibaluleke kakhulu ekuzuzeni umkhakha lobanti kakhulu wemigomo yentfutfuko lechubekela embili ngalokungenamkhawulo, kuchumanisa kuvuleka nebuholi bekutfutfukiswa kwebantfu labaphuyile emhlabeni.

src: Kabinete e ananela Kopano ya Aforika ya Lebatowa ya Bomphato bo Bulehileng ba Mmuso (OGP) ya 2016 e neng e tshwerwe ke Aforika Borwa haufinyana tjena tlasa mookotaba "Mmuso o Bulehileng bakeng sa Ntshetsopele ya Moshwelella ya Aforika" ho tloha ka la 5 ho isa la 6 Motsheanong 2016.Pitso ena e tla dikgwedi tse supileng kamora hoba Aforika Borwa e be Modulasetulo wa Ketapele ya Bomphato ba Mmuso o Bulehileng.
tgt: Lolubanjiswano LwaHulumende Lovulekile kanye naHulumende Lovulekile nako kuyintfo lebalulekile letawusita umhlaba kutsi ucuze i-Ajenda yanga-2030 yeNtfutfuko Lechubekela Embili Ngalokungenamkhawulo.

src: Dipehelo tsa mmuso o bulehileng ke tsa bohlokwa bakeng sa ho fihlella letoto le batlang le e ba batsi la merero ya ntshetsopele ya moshwelella, ho hokanngwa ho buleha ho taolo bakeng sa ntlafatso ya ba tsietsing le ba futsanehileng lefatsheng ka bophara.
tgt: Lengcungcutsela yeSigodzi beyiyiNgcungcutsela yeSigodzi yeLubanjiswano Lwahulumende Lovulekile (i-OGP) lenkhulu kakhulu lehlelwe y-OGP lebenemiphumela lemikhulu yeseshini ngayinye kuyo yonkhe inkhomfa.

src: Bomphato ba Mmuso o Bulehileng le Mmuso o Bulehileng ke mothusi ya tla thusa badudi ba lefatshe ka bophara ho fihlella Lenaneo la 2030 mabapi le Ntshetsopele ya Moshwelella.
tgt: Ngokuhambisana nekutinikela kwabohulumende ekubambisaneni nakubuholi lobukahle, lengcugcutsela beyinebahlanganyeli labavela kuTinhlangano Temimango (ema-CSO) letehlukene temave emhlaba jikelele letimiselwe emimangweni emikhakheni leyehlukene ngaphandle kwema-CSO letayelekile labekaloku ayincenye yalolubanjiswano.8 IKhabhinethi iyakucaphela kuvunywa kuhlanganiswa kwetinkampani letintsatfu tekukhicita nekusabalalisa tinatfo temabhodlela kute kwakhiwe nkampani lenkhulu kakhulu kulelivekati yekukhicita nekusabalalisa tinatfo temabhodlela, iCoca-Cola Beverage Afrika.

src: Seboka sena sa Lebatowa e ne e le se seholohadi sa Bomphato ba Mmuso o Bulehileng (OGP) sa Lebatowa se kileng sa hlophiswa ke OGP se bileng le diphetho tse hlwahlwa ho tswa ho tulo ka nngwe nakong yohle ya khonferense.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasemukela sivumelwane setimo talokufunwa ngummango salokuhlanganiswa lokusemkhatsini wahulumende nemcembu ekuhlangasiswa eCoca-Cola Beverages Africa lesekela lemitamo yetfu yemnotfo lomkhulu wetimboni.

src: Ho ipapisitswe le boitlamo ba mebuso ba bomphato le taolo e ntle, seboka sena se hohetse bankakarolo ho tswa ho Mekgatlo ya Badudi (CSO) e fapafapaneng ho tswa lefatsheng ka bophara ba tsetsepetseng hara badudi ho parola le makala a fapaneng ka thoko ho di-CSO tsa kgale tseo esale e le karolo ya bomphato.
tgt: Lesivumelwane sivikela emazinga laphelele ekusebenta kulenkampani sikhatsi lesiminyaka lemitsatfu, sivikela tisebenti kuluphiko lwekubonisana ngemigomo nemibandzela yekudendwa emsebentini lokuphatselene nalokuhlanganiswa, sesekela inchubo yekusabalalisa ekhaya sibuye futsi sitinikele ekutfutfukiseni balimi labebancishwe ematfuba phambilini ngekwemlandvo kanye netfulitinsita balenkampani.

src: Kabinete e lemoha ho tjhaellwa monwana ho kopanngwa ha dipolante tse tharo tsa dinomaphodi ho bopa polante e kgolo ka ho fetisisa ya dinomaphodi ka hara kontinente, Coca-Cola Beverages Africa.
tgt: Ngetulu kwaloko, tigidzi letinge-R400 setinikwe kutsi tisite ngemali kutfutfukiswa kwetinkampani kumkhakha wetekulima kwatsi futsi letinye tigidzi letinge- R400 lutjalomali lwekukhulisa kusabalaliswa lwemkhicito lovela kumacembu emkhicito kanye nemakhono ekutsengisa kanye nekutfutfukiswa kwemakhono lahambisana nako nekucecesha.

src: Kabinete e amohela tumellano e mabapi le maemo a molemong wa setjhaba bakeng sa ho kopana pakeng tsa mmuso le ho kopanngwa ha Coca-Cola Beverage Africa le balekane ba yona ba kopano ba ka tshehetsang mekutu ya rona e meholwanyane bakeng sa ho hodisa diindaseteri ka hara moruo wa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: I-Appletiser letsandvwa kakhulu itawuchubeka nekukhicitwa lapha eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Tumellano ena e sireletsa palohare ya maemo a kgiro ka hara khamphani bakeng sa dilemo tse tharo, e sireletsa basebetsi ka hara yuniti ya ditherisano ho phokotso mesebetsing e amanang le ho kopanngwa, e tshehetsa ntlha ya hore letoto la thekiso ya thepa le etsahale ka hara naha mme e itlama ho ntshetsapele dihwai tse neng di tinngwe menyetla pele le bafani kamphaning.
tgt: Lesivumelwane sivula indzawo yefriji kuticandzisi takaCoca-Cola noma letinika batsengisi labatsengisa nantfu ngabanye: emaphesenti lalishumi atawuniketwa imikhicito letitsa kusuka kubakhiciti labancane etikhungweni tekutsengisela bantfu ngabanye lapho khona kuneticandzisi letiniketwa nguCoca-Cola.

src: Ho fetafeta moo, R400 milione e tshepisitswe bakeng sa ho thusa ka ditjhelete ntshetsopeleng ya dikgwebo ka hara dihlahiswa tsa temo le R400 milione e nngwe bakeng sa matsete a tla nneng a eketswe ho ntshetsapele phatlalatso ya dihlahiswa le dikgwebong tse nyenyane le ho ba barekisi ba banyenyane ka maitsebelo a bokgoni a amanang le ntshetsopele le thupello.
tgt: Loku kuvula iminyango kute kutsi kungene betemabhizinisi labasha kanye nalabasha labancane bemikhicito yetinatfo temabhodlela nekutisabalalisa, kusita kugwema tebhizinisi lenemkhawulo letenta kutsi emabhizinisi lamancane nalasemkhatsini avaleleke ngaphandle kwemakethe.

src: Lebitso la mantlha la Appletiser le tla nne le hlahiswe ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Kwengeta, lutjalomali lwesikhatsi lesidze lwalenkampani kulelive kutawentiwa kancano ngekusungulwa kwenhlokohhovisi yaletinkampani letihlanganisiwe eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Tumellano e bula sebaka ka hara dihatsetsi tse fanwang ke Coca-Cola ho barekisi ba banyenyane: 10% ya sebaka ka hara sehatsetsi bakeng sa dihlahiswa tsa baphehisani ho tswa ho bahlahisi ba banyenyane ka hara ditheo tsa barekisi moo ho nang le dihatsetsi tse fanwang ke Coca-Cola feela.
tgt: Lesivumelwane silandzela sivumelwane lesisandza kwentiwa yi-Annhauser Beush InBev lesiphatselene nekutsengwa kwe-SAB Miller.

src: Sena se bula mmaraka bakeng sa ba kenang kgwebong botjha le ba tshelang dinomaphodi ka hara mabotlolo ba batjha, e le ho thusa ho qoba mekgwa ya kgwebo e nang le ditshita tse etsang hore dikgwebo tse nyenyane le tse mahareng di tswe ka hara mebaraka.
tgt: Inkakhulu, ekugcizeleleni kucasha, bendzawo kanye nekutfutfukisa emabhizinisi lamancane, letivumelwane tikhomba kubaluleka kwekusimamisa bemabhizinisi lahlanganisiwe kanye netindzaba temmango bese kubekwa lizinga lekusebenta kwetinkampani leticabanga ngekuhlanganiswa lokufanana naloku.9 IKhabhinethi ikucaphele kwetfulwa kwe-Mpact Polymers yetigidzi letinge-R350 tesakhiwonchanti selibhodlela ebhodleleni ekubambisaneni neCoca-Cola.

src: Ho tlatseletsa, matsete a khamphani a nako e telele ka hara ntshetsopele ya moruo le kahisano ka hara naha e tla matlafala ka ho thehwa ha ntlokgolo ya setheo sena se kopanetsweng ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lomtamo uphendvula luhlakamsebenti lwetemtsetfo lwaHulumende lwekusebenta kumgomo weNdlelalisu Yavelonkhe Yekulawula Inkhukhuma Yetesimondzawo kute kukhutsatwe emabhizinisa ekhicita kabusha lesekulahliwe kwentiwe umkhicito lomusha.

src: Ka ho qolleha, bakeng sa ho toboketsa kgiro, ho rekisa ka hara naha le ntshetsopele ya dikgwebo tse nyenyane, ditumellano tsena di lebisa ho bohlokwa ba ho lekalekanya ho kopanngwa ha difeme le ditabatabelo tsa setjhaba le ho teka boemo bakeng sa dikhamphani tse lohothang ho kopanngwa kapa kgapo ya dikhamphani.
tgt: Lesakhiwonchanti siyincalisakula kulelivekati lase-Afrika sitawujikisa emathani la-29 000 tenkhukhuma yemabhodlela (e-polyethylene terephthalate) i-PET ngekhatsi kwemamithakhiyubhikhi lalinganiselwe la-186 000 yendzawo yekulahla inkhukhuma futsi kutawunciphisa sikhutsa (i-CO2) ngemathani la-53 000 ngemnyaka.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho thakgolwa ha polante ya Mpact Polymers ya R350 milione ya botlolo-ho-botlolo ka bomphato le Coca-Cola.
tgt: Ikoporasi Yekutfutfukiswa Kwetimboni (i-IDC) inikete imalimboleko yetigidzigidzi leti-R210 kanye netigidzi letinge-R30 te-21% yemasheya futsi Litiko Letekuhwebelana Netetimboni linikete sigaba 12(I) sesikhutsamtsele.

src: Boikitlaetso bona bo arabela ho moralo wa Mmuso wa semolao o sebetsang ka morero wa Lewa la Naha la Taolo ya Matlakala la Lefapha la Merero ya Tikoloho ho hodisa difeme tse hlabollang botjha thepa e sebeditseng.
tgt: Lesisakhiwonchanti sekukukhicita kabusha lobesekulahliwe kwentiwe umkhicito lomusha siniketa imisebenti yetisebenti letinge-80 kanye nemisebente le-1 000 yebagcogcinkhukhuma.

src: Polante ena ke ya pele ya mofuta wa yona ka hara kontinente ya Aforika e sebetsanang le ditone tse 29 000 tsa dibotlolo tse lahluweng tsa (polyethylene terephthalate) PET tse akanngwang ho poloko ya dimethara tsa khubiki tse 186 000 tsa sebaka sa ho lahla matlakala mme e tla nyehela ho phokotso ya ho ntshwa ha Khabone Daeoksaete (CO2) ho etsang se ka etsang ditone tse 53 000 ka selemo.
tgt: Kubambisana kwaloluhlobo kutinjini letibalulekile tekutfutfuka kwemnotfo, kwakha imisebenti letinkhulungwane emkhakheni wekukhicita kabusha lesekulahliwe kube ngumkhicito lomusha wetigidzigidzi lenge-Kwamanje, kukhicita kabusha emapulasitiki lalahliwe entiwe umkhicito lomusha kukodvwana nje kuniketa ematfuba emali lengenako yebagcogci laba-60 000.

src: Koporasi ya Ntshetsopele ya Diindaseteri (IDC) e fanne ka thuso ya kadimo ya R210 milione hammoho le R30milione bakeng sa karolo ya yona ya tekatekano ya 21% le Lefapha la Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri le fanne ka ditsiane tsa lekgetho tsa karolo 12(I).
tgt: Mpact Polymers, sakhiwonchanti lesisezingeni lelisetulu sekukhicita lokulahliwe kwentiwe umkhicito lomusa siyahambisana nemigomo ye-EU yetekuphepha kwekudla futsi kuyifekhthri yekucala e-Afrika lebuye futsi ihlangabetane nenchubo lephelele yaCoca-Cola yekucinisekisa yemabhodlela e-PET.10 IKhabhinethi iyamukela umbiko weNdlelalisu Lehlanganisiwe Yekulawulwa Kwabobhejane lokhombisa kutsi iNingizimu seyitijikisile tikeyi ekutingelweni kwabobhejane ngalokungekho emtsetfweni.

src: Polante e hlabollang thepa e sebedisitweng e fanne ka mesebetsi ho basebeletsi ba 80 le mesebetsi e 1 000 ho batho ba phuthang matlakala.
tgt: Kusukela ekucaleni kwalomnyaka nje kuphela sekubanjwe basolwa laba-206 labatingela bobhejane ngalokungekho emtsetfweni.

src: Ho theha bomphato bo tjena ke sebetsa sa bohlokwa bakeng sa kgolo ya moruo, ho hlahisa dikete tsa mesebetsi moruong wa ho hlabolla thepa e sebedisitsweng e nang le boleng ba R50 bilione.
tgt: Lendlelalisu Lehlanganisiwe Yekulawula yemukelwa yiKhabhinethi nga-2014 lokwaba nemphumela wekutsi Iklasta yeTekuvikela iphumelelise tindlelanyenti letehlukene, tingenelelonyenti temikhakha kute kuvikelwe bobhejane eNingizimu Afrika.11 IKhabhinethi ihalalisela lelive ngekungenisa i-Tourism Indaba yanga-2016 lebe yimphumeleo, lebeyibanjelwe eDurban KwaZulu-Natal, lephele ngeMsombuluko, 9 Inkhwekhweti 2016 lebe nekutsintsana lokunyenti lokwakakho lokube semkhatsini webakhangisi laba-1 047 lavavela emaveni ase-Afrika la-18 kanye nebatsengi laba-1 856 labavela emaveni emhlaba.

src: Hajwale, ho hlabolla botjha polasetiki e sebedisitsweng feela e fana ka menyetla ya lekeno bakeng sa batho ba fetang 60 000 ba phuthang matlakala.
tgt: Kulomnyaka, lenkhomfa, i-INDABA ingenise imihlangano le-3000 ngetulu kwaleyo lengeniswe kulomnyaka lophelile.

src: Mpact Polymers, ke polante ya maemo a hodimo e hlabolang botjha thepa e sebeditseng e imatahanyang le dipehelo tsa polokeho ya dijo tsa EU le ho ba feme ya pele e jwalo ka hara Aforika eo hape e kgemang le melawana ka botlalo ya Coca-Cola bakeng sa dibotlolo tsa PEKabinete e amohela tlalehelo e mabapi le Lewa le Kopanetsweng la Taolo ya Ditshukudu le bontshitseng hore Aforika Borwa e fihletse tse kgolo mabapi le ho tsonngwa ha ditshukudu.
tgt: Sekuphelele ibe-14 000 imihlangano yetebhizinisi lebekhona kulamalanga lamatsatfu e-INDABA, lokwenta kuzuza emandla ekuzuza kwetemnotfo lokubalulekile.

src: Esale qalong ya selemo sena feela ho se ho tshwerwe ditsomi tse seng molaong tsa ditshukudu tse 206.Katamelo ya Lewa le Kopanetsweng la Bolaodi e ile ya amohelwa ke Kabinete ka Phato 2014 moo ho bonahetseng ha Karolwana ya Polokeho e ne e kenya tshebetsong boitshunyako ba dintlha tse ngata, ba makala a mangata bakeng sa ho sireletsa dithukudu ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lomkhosi uphindze futsi wahanjelwa tintsatseli tavelonkhe netemave emhlaba letinge-576.Le-INDABA beyigcile kumabhizinisi lamancane, lasemkhatsini kanye nalamancane kakhulu (e-SMME) emkhakha wetekuvakasha akhangisa ngemikhicito netinsita temabhizinisi lamancane etekuhamba.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa naha bakeng sa ho tshwara ha Tourism Indaba ya 2016 e atlehileng Durban ho la Kwazulu-Natal, e phethetsweng ka Mantaha, la 9 Motsheanong 2016 ka dipuisano tse ngatanyana tse atlehileng pakeng tsa bapepesi ba 1 047 ho tswa dinaheng tse 18 tsa Aforika le bareki ba 1 856 ho tswa ho phatlalla le lefatshe.
tgt: Le-INDABA yesekele tindzima letidlalwa ngema-SMME ekutfutfukisweni kwemnotfo wemave lasatfutfukile kanye nalawo lasatfutfuka, ekukhuliseni umkhakha wetekuvakasha.

src: Kaofela ho tshwerwe dikopano tsa kgwebo tse 14 000 nakong ya matsatsi a mararo a INDABA, tse bontshang bokgoni ba molemo wa bohlokwa wa moruo.
tgt: Kuvulela ematfuba ema-SMME kungulenye yetintfo letibalulekile letikhutsata umnotfo kuloLuhlelo Lwemaphuzu Layimfica latawukhula abuye futsi antjintje lomnotfo aphindze futsi avule nemisebenti.
