src: Qeto ena ke karolo ya boitlamo ba mmuso ba ho fumana tharollo e kenyeletsang.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi incoma labatsintsekako ngekutsi bacinesikise kufezekiswa kwetivumelwano letentiwe yiNkhosi.

src: Dipuisano tsa Moporesidente le bankakarolo bohle di bakile hore dikolo le dikgwebo di sebetse ka tlwaelo.
tgt: Mengameli utinikele ekutsini utawubuyela emuva kulommango waseVuwani ayococisana nawo ngelusuku lekusatawuvunyelwana ngalo neSilo Inkhosi Toni Mphephu Ramabulana nabo bonkhe labatsintsekako kulendzawo.5 Ikhabhinethi icela batali nemmango kutsi besekele tinyatselo tekungenelela tematiko kucinisekisa kutsi bafundzi babuyela emaklasini futsi bagcila etifundvweni tabo nasekutfoleni tifundvo lasebasalele emuva kuto ngekusebentisa imitamo leyentiwa tikolwa.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa bankakarolo bakeng sa ho qobella ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha ditumellano tse hokahantsweng ke Morena.
tgt: Imibhikisho lenebudlova.1 Ikhabhinethi icela imimango kutsi iyekele kwenta budlova, kwesabisa nekuntjontja uma ivakalisa tikhalo tayo.

src: Moporesidente o itlamme ho kgutlela ho badudi ba Vuwani bakeng sa ho ikopanya le bona ka letsatsi le sa ntsaneng le tla behwa ke Motlotlehi Morena Toni Mphephu Ramabulana le bankakarolo bohle ka hara sebaka seo.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi igceka ngemandla budlova netento tekuntjontja nekumoshwa kwemphahla yemabhizinisi lokusandza kwenteka eColigny, Eldorado Park, nase-Ennerdale.2 Ikhabhinethi imema yonkhe imimango kutsi ivakalise tikhalo tayo ngendlela lefuna tisombululo ngaphandle kwekubhubhisa imphahla yesive noma kunyatsela emalungelo alamanye emalunga emmango.3 Mengameli wenta simemetelo nga-2015 ngesikhatsi eTfula Inkhulumo yakhe Yebunjalo Belive (i-SoNA), wacela Sicheme Setebulungiswa, Kuvikela Bugebengu kanye neTekuphepha (i-JCPS) kutsi ibukane nekucedza imibhikisho lenebudlova nalemoshako, Ikhabhinethi iphindza leso simemo futsi sekutsi labo labephula umtsetfo batawubukana ngalokuphelele nesandla semtsetfo.4 Ikhabhinethi icela bonkhe labatsintsekako kutsi bahlanganyele kumbono wekusombulula tincabano ngekushesha e-Ennerdale, Eldorado Park naseColigny.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho batswadi le badudi ho tshehetsa maitshunyako a mafapha ho netefatsa hore bana ba kgutlela dikolong le ho tsepamisa maikutlo le ho kgahlametsa nako e senyehileng ka maitshunyako a sebediswang dikolong.
tgt: Umtsetfo Wekuchibela Sikhungo Setemshoshampansi Wetetimali (i-FICA)5.1 Ikhabhinethi iyakwemukela kusayinwa nguMengameli Zuma kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibela Sikhungo Setemshoshampansi Wetetimali kutsi ube ngumtsetfo.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsabadudi ho nyahlatsa merusu, ditshoso le ho utswa thepa ha ba hlahisa dingongoreho tsa bona.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika njengencenye yenhlangano yemave emhlaba lelwa nemisebenti yetimali lengekho emtsetfweni, itawuhambisana nekungenelela kwemave emhlaba lokuhlose kulwa nekutfolwa kwetinsambansamba tetimali ngalokungekho emtsetfweni kanye nekwesekelwa kwebuphekulasikhuni ngetimali.2 LoMtsetfosivivinyo utawufaka ligalelo ekuciniseni kwenta tintfo ngekungafihli lutfo kanye nesizotsa kunchubo yetimali yaseNingizimu uphindze futsi wente kutsi kube lukhuni kakhulu kutsi tigebengu letibandzakanyeka ekungakhokheni umtselo, kutfola tinsambansamba temali ngalokungekho emtsetfweni kungena nekuphuma kwetimali lokungekho emtsetfweni kugwema kusebentisa tinchubo tetimali taseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Merusu le diketso tsa ho utswa thepa le tshenyo ya thepa ya dikgwebotse etsahetseng haufinyana tjena Coligny,Eldorado Park le Ennerdale di tshwelwa ka mathe ka matla ke Kabinete.
tgt: Wenta incenye yelamanye emathulusi lesinawo njengelive lesihlasela ngawo bugebengu lobentiwa bocwepheshe emkhakheni wahulumende newangasese.3 INdvuna yeTetimali yatise Ikhabhinethi kutsi kukhulumisana kusachubeka futsi kutawuphetfwa masinyane nje kucinisekisa inchubo yekumemetela imitsetfomgomo letawenta kutsi Umtsetfo we-FICA ucale kusebenta.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho badudi ho hlahisa matshwenyeho a bona ka mokgwa o batlang ditharollo ntle le ho senya thepa ya setjhaba kapa ho hatikela ditokelo tsa ditho tse ding tsa setjhaba.
tgt: Tincumo tekhabhinethi.1 Indvuna yeTetimali yatise Ikhabhinethi ngemihlangano yeNtfwasahlobo yeLibhange leMhlaba neSikhwama Semali Semhlaba (i-IMF), Imihlangano neBatjalimali kanye nemihlangano ye-WEF lemayelana ne-Afrika.

src: Moporesidente o entse kgoeletso ka selemo sa 2015 Nakong ya Puo ya Maemo a Naha, a ipiletsa ho Moifo wa Toka, Thibelo ya Botlokotsebe le Tshireletso (JCPS) ho sebetsana ka matla le boipelaetso bo tletseng merusu le tshenyo.
tgt: Wachubeka watisa mayelana neSivumelwano se-G20 netiphakamiso te-Afrika kanye netikhalo tebatjalimali nema-ejensi laBukana neMazinga eTemnotfo.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa kgoeletso ena ya hore ba tlolang molao ba tla tobana le letsoho le matla la molao.
tgt: Kube netingcoco letijulile mayelana nesimo semnotfo wemave emhlaba newesigodzi, kanye nalekufanele sikwente kubuyisela lokwehliselwa ezingeni letemnotfo lelingentasi.2 Ikhabhinethi iphindze yakucinisa kutsi iyachubeka nekutinikela kunchubomgomo yetimali temtselo levetwe kuNkhulumo yeLwabiwomali yanga-2017 kufezekiswa kwetingcucuko kute kwentiwe kancono kuphatsa etinkampanini tembuso kugcina umkhawulo wekusetjentiswa imali usezingeni lelifanele kanye nekucinisekisa kutsi tikweleti tahulumende atikhuphuki.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa bankakarolo bohle ho buisana ka morero wa ho rarolla ka potlako dikgang Ennerdale, Eldorado Park le Coligny.
tgt: Luhlelo lwahulumande lwekusheshisa kufezekiswa kwetingucuko letihlelekile lekuhloswe ngato kukhuphula kukhula kwemnotfo njengoba kubekiwe kuLuhlelo Lwemaphutu Layimfica luyachubeka nekuba ngulolufanele kubukana naletinye tetinsayeya letiphakanyiswe ngumtjalimali6.3 Ikhabhinethi iyawemukela umbiko losandza kwetfulwa yifemu i-EY Consultancy lomayelana neLutjalomali Ngco lweMave angaphandle e-Afrika.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Setsi sa Mautlwela a Ditjhelete.
tgt: Lombiko utsi iNingizimu Afrika ingulelinye lemave lanemnotfo lemikhulu nekutsi futsi yaba yesibili kuNkhomba yeKuheha yase-Afrika yanga-20.4 Ikhabhinethi yaphindze futsi yatiswa ngema-Ejensi laBukene neMazinga eTemnotfo mayelana nekuvakasha lokutako kwekuhlangana netinhlangano letinyenti kanye netikhulu tahulumende.5 Ikhabhinethi iluvumile Luhlaka loluBuyeketiwe lweLuhlelolisu lweTitfutsi Tasemaphandleni.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho sennwa ha Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Setsi sa Mautlwela a Ditjhelete (FICA) hore e be molao keMoporesidenteZuma.
tgt: Loluhlelolisu luphendvula etintfweni letifanele kutsi kube ngito letentiwa kucala kunaletinye tabomasipala besigodzi sasemaphandleni nebetifudza, ngekutsi kulungiswe Sakhiwonchanti seTitfutsi taseMaphandleni kanye netinsita letibeka umkhawulo tiwubekele kutfutfukiswa kwemnotfo netenhlalo.

src: Aforika Bowa jwaloka karolo ya badudi ba lefatshe e imatahantseng le ho lwantsha diketso tse seng molaong tsa ditjhelete, e tla imatahanya le boitshunyako ba matjhaba bo batlang ho lwantsha ho pata mohlodi wa tjhelete le ho thusa boferakanyi ka ditjhelete.
tgt: Kufezekiswa kwalelisu kutawufaka ligalelo ekutfutfukisweni kwemnotfo wamasipala newetifundza ngekwenta kancono kufinyelelwa kwetitfutsi temmango.

src: Bili ena hape e tla nyehela mabapi le ho matlafatsa ponaletso le seriti tsa tsamaiso ya ditjhelete ya Aforika Borwa le ho etsa hore ho be thata bakeng sa ditlokotsebe ho baleha ho lefa lekgetho, ho pata mohlodi wa tjhelete le ho pata phallo e seng molaong ya ditjhelete ba sebedisa mekgwa ya tsamaiso ya ditjhelete ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Loku kutawukhulisa kuchumana emkhatsini wetindzawo tasemaphandleni netasemadolobheni, ngemcondvo wekufaka tindzawo tasemaphandleni kumnotfo welive lobanti.6 Ikhabhinethi iyivumile Inchubomgomo Lephelele yeTitfutsi taseLwandle.

src: E bopa se seng sa disebediswa tse ngata tseo re nang le tsona jwaloka naha bakeng sa ho lwantsha botlokotsebe ba maemo a hodimo makaleng ka bobedi a poraefete le a mmuso.
tgt: Loku kukhombisa kutinikela kwaHulumende ekukhuleni, kutfutfuka kanye nekugucuka kwemkhakha wetitfutsi taselwandle waseNingizimu Afrika, kwesekela kutfutfukiswa kwemnotfo netenhlalo ube futsi ufaka ligalelo kutekuhwebelana kwemave emhlaba.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ke Letona la Ditjhelete hore ditherisano di ntse di tswela pele mme di tla phethelwa haufinyana ho netefatsamotjha wa phatlalatso ya melawana e tla kenya tshebetsong Molao wa FICDiqeto tsa KabineteLetona la Ditjhelete le tsebisitse Kabinete ka dikopano tsa haufinyana tjena tsa Selemo tsa Letlole laLefatshe la Ditjhelete (IMF)/ tsa Banka ya Lefatshe, dikopano tsa Leeto la Dipontsho le Batsetedi le tsa WEF ya Aforika.
tgt: Loku kuhambisana netintfo tahulumende letibekwa embili letimayelana neluhlelo lwe-Operation Phakisa ekukhuliseni Umnotfo waseLwandle.

src: Hape le tsebisitse ka ditshisinyo tsa Aforika ho G20 Compact le matshwenyeho a batsetedi le makala a Balekodi ba mekitlane.
tgt: Iphindze futsi ihambisane nemigomo lebanti yekukhutsata kukhula kwemnotfo kanye nekundlondlobalisa kwakheka kwematfuba emisebenti, njengobe kubekiwe ku-NDP kanye neLuhlelo Lwesakhiwonchanti Lwavelonkhe.7 Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kweLuhlaka Lwelisu Letitfutsi Letite Ngoti Kumvelo kute ummango uphawule ngalo.

src: Ho bile le dipuisano tse matla mabapi le tjhebahalo ya moruo wa lefatshe le wa lebatowa le seo re lokelang ho se etsa ho etsolla ho theolwa ha maemo a moruo.
tgt: Titfutsi tidlala indzima lebalulekile ekwenteni kutsi kuhwebelana kwemave emhlaba kuchubeke kahle ngendlela lesimamisa umnotfo, tenhlalo kanye nemvelo.

src: Kabinete e boeleditse hore e dula e itlamme bakeng sa boemo ba leano la ditjhelete tsa mmuso le tekilweng Puong ya Ditekanyetso ya selemo sa 2017, ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha diphethoho bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa taolo ya dikhamphani tsa mmuso ho baballa sekepele se amohelehang sa ditshenyehelo le ho netefatsa botsitso ba mekitlane ya mmuso.
tgt: Tinchubo tetitfutsi tingumgogodla wemisebenti yaseNingizimu Afrika yetemnotfo netenhlalo ngekwenta kutsi bantfu nemikhicito bakhone kuhamba.

src: Lenaneo la Mmuso la ho akofisa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha diphethoho tsa dibopeho tse reretsweng ho matlafatsa kgolo ya moruo jwaloka ha di tekilwe ho Moralo wa Dintlha tse Robong le dula le nepahetse bakeng sa ho tobana le dintlha tse ding tse hlahisitsweng ke batsetedi.
tgt: Nanoma kunjalo, imimoya lengcolile lekhicitwa ngumkhakha wetitfutsi ifaka ligalelo kusamba semimoya lengcolile letfunyiswa emoyeni (i-GHG), bese kutsi titfutsi temgwaco tona tifaka ligalelo lelikhulu kakhulu.

src: Kabinete e amohela tlaleho e lokolotsweng haufinyana ke feme ya boeletsi ya EY Consultancy mabapi le Matsete a Otlolohileng ka hara Aforika.
tgt: Lelisu lifuna kuphakamisa tinyatselo tekungenelela letitawunciphisa kutfuyiswa kwe-GHG ngekhatsi kwetinchubomgomo tekutfutfuka lokusimeme.8 Ikhabhinethi ivumile kutsi iNingizimu Afrika ijoyine i-Smart Africa Alliance.

src: Tlaleho e supa Aforika Borwa jwaloka setsi se seholo ka ho fetisisa sa moruo le ho behwa maemong a bobedi ho Lenane la Kgohedi la Aforika la selemo sa 2017.Kabinete hape e tsebisitswe ka leeto le tlang la Makala a Bolekodi ba mekitlane ho buisana le mekgatlo e mengata le bahlomphehi ba phethahatso ba mmuso.
tgt: Lena yinhlangano yekusebentisana leholwa yi-Afrika lenenjongo yekutfutfukisa tisombululo kanye nekwabela imitfombolusito yekubukana netinsayeya tentfutfuko lelivekati lelibukene nato.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Moralo wa Lewa le Shebilweng Botjha la Dipalangwang tsa Metse ya Mahae.
tgt: Kubeka Ithekhinoloji Yelwati Lwetekuchumana enkhabeni ye-ajenda yetentfutfuko yemave ase-Afrika yanga-2063.INingizimu Afrika itawuzuza ngekwetemnotfo netepolitiki ngekuhlanganyela kwayo kuSmart Africa.

src: Lewa lena le arabela ho dintlha tse ka sehlohlolong tsa bomasepala ba setereke le diporofense, ka ho tobana le phano e sa lokang ya Meralo ya Motheo ya Dipalangwang tsa Metse ya Mahae le ditshebeletso e fokotsang ntshetsopele ya moruo wa kahisano.
tgt: Ngekubeka timboni nemakhono aseNingizimu Afrika enkhabeni ye-ajenda yentfutfuko ye-Smart Africa, iNingizimu Afrika itawufaka ligalelo ekukhuleni kwemabhizinisi endzawo kulesigodzi.9 Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kumenyetelwa kweNchubomgomo yaVelonkhe yeLitiko Letemfundvo Lesisekelo yeLigciwane leNgculazi (i-HIV), Tifo Letitsatselwana Ngekwemacansi (ema-STI) kanye neSifo Sesifuba (i-TB).Inchubomgomo yanga-1999 yagcila ekucapheleni jikelele nakutinhlangotsi tekuvikela tebhayoloji nekwelashwa, futsi yagcila kancane kukuhleleka, nakuloko lokuchubela embili i-HIV kwetenhlalo kanye netindlela tekutiphatsa.

src: Ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha lewa lena ho tla nyehela bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya moruo wa lehae le wa porofense ka ho ntlafatsa phumantsho ya dipalangwang tsa setjhaba.
tgt: Lenchubomgomo iphakamisa indlela leyehlukile yekubukana neSandvulelangculazi (i-HIV) njengeludzaba loluyinkhaba lwekulawula kusetjentiswa indlela yetemphilo yemmango, kanye nekufaka ekhatsi kubekwa embili kwekwelashwa kwesifo sesifuba etikolweni, emkhatsini waletinye tintfo.

src: Sena se tla eketsa kgokahanyo pakeng tsa dibaka tsa ditoropo le tsa mahae, ka morero wa ho kenyeletsa tikoloho tsa mahaeng ka hara moruo o bataletseng.
tgt: Lenchubomgomoitawufaka ekhatsi bantfu labanyenti labafana nebafundzi, bothishela, kanye netikhulu, etikolweni tahulumende kanye nasetikolweni letitimele.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Leano le Pharaletseng la Dipalangwang tsa Mawatleng.
tgt: Imitsetfosivivinyo.1 Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kwetfulwa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibela Inkampani Yetikhumulo Tetindizamshini, wanga-2017 neMtsetfosivivinyo weKuchibela Tethrafikhi Yasemoyeni neTinsita neKutfola Indlela yekuhamba.

src: Sena se supa boitlamo ba mmuso bakeng sa kgolo, ntshetsopele le diphethoho tsa lekala la dipalangwang tsa mawatleng tsa Aforika Borwa, mabapi le ho tshehetsa ntshetsopele ya moruo wa kahisano ha ka nqa e nngwe le nyehela kgwebisanong ya matjhaba.
tgt: Kuchitjelwa kwaleMitsetfosivivinyo lemibili kwenta kutsi kube khona Simiso Sekulawula salomphelo.

src: Sena se tsamaelana le dintlha tse ka sehlohlolong tsa mmuso tse amanang le Operation Phakisa mabapi leho hodisa Moruo wa Mawatle.
tgt: Letichibelo tiphindze futsi tente kutsi kusungulwe emakomidi lekutawendluliselwa kuwo tikhalo, latawusebenta kusombulula tindzaba tetincabano letinyenti.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Moralo wa Lewa la Dipalangwang tse Hlwekileng bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: Imikhosi letako.1 Mngameli Jacob Zuma utawetfula inkhulumo yekuvula i-Indaba Yetekuvakasha yanga-2017 letawube ingeniswe esikhungweni setikhomfa e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre eDurban emkhatsini wamhla ti-16 nemhla ti-18 Inkhwekhweti 2017.Lena yi-indaba yemave emhlaba letawuphindze futsi ikhangise imikhicito kanye netinsita taseNingizimu Afrika emkhakheni wetekuvakasha nekwemukela bantfu.

src: Dipalangwang di bapala karolo ya bohlokwa mabapi le ho kgontsha kgwebisano ya matjhaba ka mokgwa o tla bang wa moshwelella ho tsa moruo, kahisano le tikoloho.
tgt: I-Indaba Yetekuvakasha yanga-2017 itawuphindze futsi ikhutsate futsi yesekele kugucuka lokuchubekako nekutfutfuka kwemboni yetekuvakasha yaseNingizimu Afrika ikakhulu indzima ledlalwa bosomabhizinisi kanye nebanikati bemabhizinisi lamancane.

src: Leha ho le jwalo, mesi e tswang lekaleng la dipalangwang e nyehela ho palo kaofela ya ho ntshuwa ha dikgase tse kotsi (GHG), moo makoloi e leng ona a nyehelang haholo.
tgt: Loku kungetulu kakhulu kwesilinganiso sekukhula semave emhlaba lesisemkhatsini sa-3% sangaleso sikhatsi.

src: Lewa lena le rerile ho sisinya maitshunyako a tla fokotsa mesi ya GHG ka hara dipehelo tsa ntshetsopele ya moshwelella.
tgt: Ngalesikhatsi se-indaba yeTekuvakasha, iNingizimu Afrika itawuzuza kulelinani letitfunywa letitawufika kulelive.2 Indvuna yeTemandla Make Mmamoloko Kubayi kulenyanga utawuhola umkhankhaso weNyanga yeMandla ngaphansi kwalengcikitsi “Kukhutsata tinhlobo letahlukene temandla letisimeme futsi letingabiti kakhulu kwesekela tingucuko temnotfo letinemandla’.

src: Sena ke tshebedisano e etelletsweng pele ke Aforika mabapi le ho hlahisa le ho abelana mehlodi ya ho tobana le diphephetso tsa ntshetsopele tse shebaneng le kontinente.
tgt: Atawuphindze futsi asebentise lelitfuba kwabelana nemmango kutsi tinhlelo tawo ticuketse ini kulomnyakatimali.

src: E beha Dithekenoloji tsa Tlhahisoleseding le Dikgokahanyo bohareng ba lenaneo la ntshetsopele la selemo sa 2063 la dinaha tsa Aforika.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi imema ummango kutsi uhlangenyele kuletinkhulumo temcombelelo wematiko lapho tetfulwa ngekwetinchubo tePhalamende.4 Litiko leTemanti neKuhanjiswa Kwekungcola Ngemanti litawungenisa Liviki leKuhanjiswa Kwekungcola Ngemanti emkhatsini wamhla ti-16 nemhla tinge-22 2017 ngaphansi kwalengcikitsi: “Kuhanjiswa kwekungcola ngemanti ngalokuhlantekile kweTemphilo neSitfunti”.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla kgola molemo ka bobedi ho tsa moruo le sepolotiki ka bonkakarolo ba yona ho Smart Africa.
tgt: Hulumende utinikele kunika bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika sitfunti ngekutsi abanike tinsita tekuhanjiswa kwekungcola ngemanti ngalokuhlantekile.

src: Ka ho beha diindaseteri tsa Aforika Borwa bohareng ba lenaneo la ntshetsopele la Smart Africa, Aforika Borwa e tla nyehela kgolong ya kgwebo ya lehae ka hara lebatowa.
tgt: Lokutawugcilwa kuko kuleliviki Luhlelo Lwekupheliswa Kusetjentiswa Kwemithoyi Yemabhakade.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwanaphatlalatso ya Leano la Naha la Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo ya (HIV), Ditshwaetso tse Fetiswang ka Thobalano (di-STI) le Lefuba (TB).Leano lena la selemo sa1999 le tsepamisitse maikutlo hodima ditemoso tse tlwaelehileng le dintlha tsa bophelo tsa bongaka tsa thibelo, le hanyenyane hodima mekgwa ya boitshwaro ya dibopeho le ya kahisano e hlohleletsang HIV.
tgt: Kuleliviki kutawuniketelwa imithoyi lesebentisa emanti kumimango yaMasipala weNdzawo waseNketoana, eFreyistata, nakuMasipala weNdzawo waseDawid Kruiper, eNyakatfo Kapa njengencenye yekusheshisa tinsita kususwe imithoyi yemabhakade.

src: Leano lena le sisinya tsela ya ho swaela lehakoreng la ho bona HIV jwaloka taba e bohareng ya bolaodi ho sebediswa katamelo ya bophelo bo botle ba setjhaba, hammoho le ho kenyeletswa ha TB jwaloka ntlha e ka sehlohlolong ka hara dikolo, hara tse ding.
tgt: Kunemisebenti leminyenti leyentekako leholwa Litiko Letebuciko Nemasiko lekuhloswe ngayo kukhutsata bunye be-Afrika.

src: Ho phatlalla ha tshebediso ho pharaleditswe ho ya baneng, matitjhereng le ho bahlanka, dikolong tsa mmuso le tsa poraefete.
tgt: Lemisebenti itawufika esicongweni mhla tinge-25 Inkhwekhweti 2017 lapho khona Mengameli Zuma utawungenisa umcimbi wesidlo sahulumende eSefako Makgatho Presidential Guesthouse.

src: DibiliKabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho hlahiswa haSehlomathiso sa Bili ya Khamphani ya Maemafofane, ya selemo sa 2017 le Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Ditshebeletso tsa Sephethephethe sa Moyeng le Tsamaiso ya Difofane Palamenteng.
tgt: Timenywa talomcimbi kutawuba baholi betinhlangano tebantfu labangasibo bakuleli kepha lababahlali bakuleli laseNingizimu Afrika Mengameli lahlangane nabo nga-20.

src: Diphetoho dibiling tsena tse pedi di reretswe bakeng sa ho fana ka Sebopeho sa Taolo sa moshwelella.
tgt: Kutfunyelwa kwembutfo wetekuvikela wavelonkhe waseningizimu Afrika (i-SANDF) uyosebenta kulenye indzawo Ikhabhinethi iyasemukela sincumo saMengameli Jacob Zuma sekwelulwa kwesikhatsi lesitawutsatfwa yi-SANDF eDemocratic Republic of Congo (e-DRC).

src: Diketsahalo tse tlangMoporesidente Jacob Zuma o tla fana ka puo ya pulo ya Indaba ya Bohahlaudi ya selemo sa2017 e tla tshwarelwa Setsing sa Matjhaba sa Dikopano sa Inkosi Albert Luthuli Durban pakeng tsa la 16 le la 18 Motsheanong 2017.Ena ke indaba ya matjhaba eo hape e tla pepesa dihlahiswa le ditshebeletso tsa Aforika Borwa ka hara lekala la bohahlaudi le bodulo ba baeti.
tgt: Loku kungumtamo wekufaka ligalelo kutekuthula nekutinta kulelivekati lase-Afrika ikakhulu sigodzi ngekuhambisana netibopho tetfu tekubukana nemave angaphandle nenchubomgomo yetfu yekuphatsa emave angaphandle yekufaka ligalelo ku-Afrika nemhlaba loncono.2 Samba lesi-1 371 semalunga e-SANDF sitfunyelwe e-DRC kuyokwesekela Imitamo Yenhlangano Yamhlabuhlangene Yekuletsa Kutinta.

src: Indaba ya Bohahlaudi ya 2017 hape e tla hodisa le ho tshehetsa diphethoho tse ntseng di tswela pele le ntshetsopele ya indaseteri ya bohahlaudi ya Aforika Borwa ka ho qolleha karolo e bapalwang ke baetapele ba dikgwebo le beng ba dikgwebo tse nyenyane.
tgt: Sikhatsi sekusebenta kwawo selulilwe sesuswa kumhla lu-01 Mabasa 2017 sayiswa kumhla tinge-31 Indlovulenkhulu 20.3 Kutfumela umbutfo wetfu wetekuvikela kulelivekati kwesekela lokuchubekako kwetinchubo tesigodzi nelivekati tekuphendvula nekukusombula tinhlekele, kukhutsata nekuvikela, kucinisa kuhlangana kwesigodzi, kukhulisa ngemandla kuhwebelana emkhatsini wemave ase-Afrika kanye nekuhola intfutfuko lesimememe e-Afrika.

src: Nakong ya indaba ena ya Bohahlaudi, Aforika Borwa e tla kgola molemo ho tswa palong ya baemedi ba tla kena naheng ya bo rona.
tgt: Emnyakeni wa-OR Tambo basikhombise emandla ekusebentela kuba neNingizimu Afrika lencono kanye nesive lesincono.

src: Letona la Eneji Mmamoloko Kubayi kgweding ena o tla etella peleletsholo la Kgwedi ya Eneji tlasa mookotaba,“Re kgothaletsa motswako wa eneji e kgonehang le ya moshwelella mabapi le ho tshehetsa diphethoho tse matla tsa moruo wa kahisano”.
tgt: Sitfola emandla ekuzuzeni kwabo, kutinikela kwabo, lutsandvo kanye nekuvuma kuchubekisela buntfu embili.

src: Letsholo le tla ruta, le bope temoso le ho buisana le setjhaba mabapi le bokgabane ba eneji, polokeho ya eneji, dintlha tsa eneji e nngwe e fapaneng le kamoo e leng tsa bohlokwa bakeng sa tshebediso ya malapa, dikgwebo le diindaseteri.
tgt: Umklomelo i-Order of Ikhamanga leliGolide (munye) i-Order of Ikhamanga leyiSiliva (basikhombisa) i-Order of Ikhamanga leyiBronze (munye), i-Order of Baobab leliGolide (munye) i-Order of Baobab leyiSiliva (babili) i-Order of Baobab leyiBronze (babili) i-Order of Luthuli leyisiliva (bange-29) i-Order of Luthuli leyiBronze (1) i-Order of Mapungubwe leyisiliva (babili) kanye ne-Order of the Companions of OR Tambo leliGolide (munye).2 Kukhishwa kweMbiko we-17 Wekhomishini yeTekucashwa Ngekulingana yiNdvuna yeTetisebenti, Mk Mildred Oliphant kukhombisa kucinisa inhloko ekushayeni ngelunyawo lwelunwabu kwetingucuko etindzaweni tekusebenta letinyenti letehlukene eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Dingangisano tsa Ditekanyetso tsa Mafapha tsa selemo sa2017ka Motsheanong2017 di hlahisa monyetla wa mafapha a ho hlahisa Palamenteng le setjhabeng ka kakaretso kamoo a tla sebedisang Ditekanyetso tseo a di abetsweng tsa selemo sa 2017.
tgt: LoMbiko ukhombisa kutsi sisesekhashane kakhulu nekuzuza tisebenti letimelela ngeliciniso sive setfu.

src: A tla sebedisa dintlha tsena hape hore a abelane le setjhaba hore ke eng seo mananeo a ona a se fupereng bakeng sa selemo sa hajwale sa ditjhelete.
tgt: Bantfu labamnyama, bomake nebantfu labakhubatekile basachubeka nekuba ngulabamelelwa kancane kuto tonkhe tinhlangotsi teKucashwa ngeKulingana.3 Lombiko ukhombise kutsi bantfu labamhlophe basetikhundleni tekuphatsa letiphakeme talelive benta-68% kumikhakha yahulumende naletimele, emahlandla laphindzeke kasitfupha ebantfu labanemdlandla ngekwetemnotfo.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho setjhaba ho itahlela ka setotswana ditlhakisetsong tsena kaha di hlahiswa ka motjha wa Palamente.
tgt: Bantfu labamnyama bente-14.4% walabaphetse etikhundleni letiphakeme.4 Nakubukwa sidzingo lesiphutfumako sekugucula umnotfo nekucinisekisa kukhula lokuphelele, loku akweneli mbamba.

src: Lefapha la Metsi le Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere le tla tshwara Beke ya Dikgwerekgwere pakeng tsa la 16 le la 22 Motsheanong 2017 tlasa mookotaba: “Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere bakeng sa Bophelo bo botle le Seriti”.Mmuso o itlamme ho tlisa seriti ho maAforika Borwa ka phano ya ditshebeletso tsa tsamaiso ya dikgwerekgwere.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyasemukela simememtelo seNdvuna yeTetisebenti sekutsi ibuketa ludzaba lwekusebentisa tindlela leticinile tekubukana nekungahambisani nemtsetfo.

src: Ntlha e ka sehloohong e tla tsepamisetswa maikutlo bekeng ena e tla ba taba e ka sehlohlolong ya Lenaneo la Phediso ya Mabakete.
tgt: Imilayeto.1 Ikhabhinethi ijoyina Mengameli Jacob Zuma ekuhalaliseleni Umn.

src: Sena se tla bonahala ka phano ya dintlwana tse sebedisang metsi Masepala wa Lehae waNketoana, ho la Freistata le Masepaleng wa Lehae wa Dawid Kruiper, ho la Kapa Leboya jwaloka karolo ya ho akofisa ditshebeletso bakeng sa ho fedisa matlwana a mabakete.
tgt: Emmanuel Macron, lokhetfwe kuba nguMengameli (kodvwa losengakacali kwenta umsebenti wakhe wekwengamela) waseRiphabhuliki yaseFrance, ngemuva kwekuphumelela kwakhe elukhetfweni lwaMengameli lwaseFrance lwamhla ti-7 Inkhwekhweti 2017.INingizimu Afrika ikulindzele kusebentisana nahulumende waseFrance ngaphasi kwebuholi baMnuMacron kuhlanganisa budlelwano lobucinile lesebuvele bukhona betepolitiki, bemnotfo nekuhwebelana emkhatsini weNingizimu Afrika neFrance.2 Ikhabhinethi ihalalisela umphatsidolobha waseJozi waphambilini, nasihlalo weNhlangano yaBohulumende Bekhaya eNingizumu Afrika (i-Salga), Parks Tau ngekubekwa kwakhe esikhundleni sekuba ngulomunye wabosihlalo wePhaneli Letimele Lesezingeni Leliphakeme yaMhlabuhlangene (i-UN) kutsi engamele kusebenta ngemphumelelo kwe-Habitat III.

src: Aforika Borwa e keteka Kgwedi ya Aforika tlasa mookotaba: Aforika e Betere le Lefatshe le Betere.
tgt: Loluhlelo lwemukelwe yi-UN kutsi lusheshise kutinikela kwemave emhlaba ekwenteni tindzawo letingemadolobha lokusimeme.3 Litiko Letekuhwebelana Netetimboni (i-dti) libuye ekhaya nemklomelo lohamba embili wekukhangisa wemave angaphandle kuMkangiso we-58 Wetekuhwebelana Wemave Emhlaba WaseZimbabwe (i-ZITF) .Loku kwemukela imitamo levelele yeLicembu laseNingizimu Afrika yekucinisekisa kutinikela kwalelive ekwakheni budlelwano neZimbabwe kuvete tinzuzo temnotfo letilindzelekile.4 Ikhabhinethi yendlulisele emavi endvudvuto kuhulumende kanye nakubantfu baseRiphabhuliki yaseTanzania mayelana nenhlekelele yengoti yebhasi leyendlule nemiphefumulo yebantfu labange-36, lekutsite labange-33 bekubantfwana.

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro, la 24 Motsheanong 2017, Tuynhuys, Motse Kapa.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi yahlangana ngaLesitsatfu, mhla tinge-24 Inkhwekhweti 2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Dintlha Tsa Hajwale.
tgt: Tindzaba tanyalo.

src: Kabinete e tshwenyehile ka diketsahalo tse ntseng di phahama tsa tlhekefetso le merusu kgahlanong le basadi ka hara setjhaba sa bo rona.
tgt: Ikhabinethi iyakhatsateka mayelana nelizinga lelikhulako letehlakalo tekuhlukunyetwa nebudlova lobentiwa kubomake eveni lakitsi.

src: Diketsahalo tsa haufinyana tjena tsa merusu ya balekane ba ratanang di bonahetse ha basadi ba sebete ba ema ka maoto ho bua kgahlanong le kgatikelo ya ditokelo tsa bona.
tgt: Tehlakalo letisandza kwenteka letifaka ekhatsi budlova betitsandzani tetente bomake labanengi labanemandla futsi labanesibindzi bakhulumele mayelana nekulwela kwephulwa kwemalungelo abo.

src: Kabinete e ananela hore jwaloka naha re ntse re tswela pele ho ba le setjhaba se laolwang ke banna mme ke kahoo ho nang le boipiletso ba hore ho sebetswe ho feta bakeng sa ho lwantsha koduwa ya dipolao tsa basadi le kgwebisano ka batho.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyakubona kutsi silive sisachubeka nekuba live lelibuswa ngulabadvuna futsi loku-ke kubita kutsi kwentiwe lokunyenti kute kutsi kuliwe nekubulawa kwabomake nekushushunjiswa kwebantfu.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho makala kaofela a setjhaba ho ipopa bakeng sa ho lwantsha koduwa ena, ho hanyetsana le mokgwa ofe kapa ofe wa merusu e etswang kgahlanong le basadi le bana, le ho sebetsa le sepolesa le tsamaiso ya toka bakeng sa ho tshwara baetsi ba diketso tsena.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi imema yonkhe imikhakha yemmango kutsi ibambisane kuliwe letehlakalo letinyenti tekuhlukunyetwa kwabomake, kuliwe nalo lonkhe luhlobo lwebudlova lolwentiwa kubomake nebantfwana, kuphindze futsi kusetjentiswane nemaphoyisa netebulungiswa kute kutsi letigilamkhuba tiboshwe.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o entse boipiletso ba hore ho emiswe ka tlhekefetso ya basadi le bana e ntseng e tswela pele.
tgt: Mengameli Jacob Zuma sewumemetele kutsi kuvinjwe kuhlukunyetwa kwabomake nebantfwana lokuchubekako.

src: Kabinete e laetse Sehlopha sa Tshireletso ya Kahisano, sa Ntshetsopele ya Badudi le Setjhaba ho tla ka lenaneo la tshebetso le tla kgannela naha ntweng ya ho emisa ka tlhekefetso ya basadi le bana.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi seyiyalele Iklasta yeKuvikelwa Kwetenhlalo, Nekutfutfukiswa Kwemmango Nebantfu kutsi isungule luhlelo lwekusebenta lolutawusetjentiswa lelive ekulweni kuhlukunyetwa kwabomake nebantfwana.

src: Kabinete e amohela sephetho sa Aforika Borwa sa Tekolo ya Maemo a Setjhaba ka Kakaretso le a Bophelo bo Botle ya 2016 e entsweng ke Lefapha la Dipalopalo la Aforika Borwa (Stats SA), e methang maemo a bophelo bo botle ba maAforika Borwa, le phihlello le boleng ba mananeo a bophelo bo botle.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyayemukela imiphumela yeLuklayo Lwebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika nelweTemphilo lwanga-2016 lolwentiwe Lihhovisi Lelubalobalo laseNingizimu Afrika, lolukala simo setemphilo sebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika, kanye netinhlelo tetemphilo letinotsile naletingutonatona.

src: Tekolo ena hara tse ding e tlaleha hore ho na le phokotseho ya 20% ya ho shwa ha masea le phokotseho ya 11% palong ya basadi le banna ba tsubang.
tgt: Loluklayo emkhatsini waletinye tintfo lubika kwehla kwelizinga lekushona kwebantfwana labancane nga-20% kanye nekwehla nga-11% kwelinani labomake nabobabe lababhema ligwayi.

src: Sephetho sena se bontsha hore maitshunyako a maano a behilweng ke tsamaiso ya Moporesidente Zuma a beha ditholwana tse ntle.
tgt: Lemiphumela ikhombisa kutsi tinchubomgomo tekungenelela letahlelwa nguhulumende kaMengameli Zuma tinemiphumela lemihle.

src: Kabinete, le ha ho le jwalo, e tshwenyehile ka palo ya maAforika Borwa e ntseng e tswela pele ho kena thobalanong e sa tshireletsehang le balekane ba bangata.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi, nanoma kunjalo, iyakhatsateka ngebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labasachubeka nekuya emacasini nebalingani labanyenti ngalokungakavikeleki.

src: Se ka etsang 32% le 42% ya basadi le banna ka tatelano se bontshitse hore ha ba e so ka ba kenela diteko tsa HIV leha mmuso o entse mekutu ya ho hlahisa temoso ka ho kenela diteko tsa HIV.
tgt: Bomake labange-32% nemadvodza lange-42% bakhombise kutsi abakate sebahlolwe kutsi banaso yini Sandvulelangculazi (i-HIV) noma cha nanoma nje hulumende enta imitamo yekucaphelisa nekukhutsata bantfu kutsi bahlole simo sabo se-HIV.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho nka boikarabelo bakeng sa bophelo ba bona bo botle le boitekanelo, ho kena thobalanong e tshireletsehileng le ho dula ba kenela diteko tsa HIV le mafu kaofela a tshwaetsanang le a sa tshwaetsaneng.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi babe sibopho setemphilo nekuphila kahle kwabo, baye emacasini ngalokuphephile futsi bahle njalo batihlola i-HIV nato tonkhe letinye tifo letitsatselwanako naletingatsatselwana.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho batswadi le bahlokomedi ho netefatsa hore bana ba bona ba thola diente kgahlanong le mafu a bana.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi imema bonkhe batali kutsi nebanakekeli bebantfwana kutsi bacinisekise kutsi bantfwana babo bagonyelwa tifo tebuntfwana.

src: Kabinete e dula e itlamme mabapi le ho etsa bonnete ba hore bana ba sireletsehile bakeng sa ho fedisa mahloko a tshwaetsanang a behang bophelo ba bana kotsing.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyachubeka nekutinikela ekucinisekiseni kutsi bantfwana bayagonywa kute kutsi bangangenwa tifo letitsatselwanako letiyingoti letingababulala.

src: Kabinete e tiisetsa batswadi le bahlokomedi hore meriana e fanwang ke Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle e bolokehile.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyabacinisekisa batali nebanakekeli bebantfwana utsi imitsi labayinikwa Litiko Letemphilo iphephile.

src: Kabinete e amohetse mokgahlelo wa pele o tsoseleditsweng wa Setsi sa Diindaseteri sa Vulindlela Heights Mthatha ho la Kapa Botjhabela.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi isemukele sigaba sekucala sekwentiwa kancono kwepaki yeMboni yaseVulindlela Heights eMthatha eMphumalanga Kapa.

src: Sena ke karolo ya Lenaneo la Tsoseletso ya Diphaka tsa Diindaseteri.
tgt: Loku kuyincenye yeLuhlelo lwalelive lweKwenta Kancono Emapaki Etimboni.

src: Ke ya bobedi ya mofuta wa yona ho la Kapa Botjhabela le ho ba ya botshelela ya diphaka tse ntseng di tsoseletswa ho phatlalla le naha.
tgt: Iyincalisakuvela yesibili eMphumalanga Kapa kantsi futsi iyipaki yesitfupha leyentiwa kancono kulo lonkhe lelive.

src: Mmuso o tsoseletsa diphaka tsa diindaseteri ho matlafatsa tlhahiso ya mesebetsi le ho netefatsa kgolo e kenyeletsang.
tgt: Hulumende wenta kancono emapaki etimboni kute kutsi kufukuleke kudaleka kwematfuba emisebenti nekucinisekisa kukhula kwemnotfo lokuzuzisa wonkhe umuntfu.

src: Ho suthisa mesebetsi ya moruo ho tloha ditsing tsa metse ya ditoropo hape ke karolo ya mekutu ya mmuso ya ho tlisa diphethoho moruong.
tgt: Kususwa kwemisebenti yetemnotfo etindzaweni tasemadolobheni nako kuyincenye yemitamo yahulumende yekugucula simo setemnotfo.

src: Tlhahisoleseding e mabapi le kamoo o ka nkang monyetla wa menyetla e teng diphakeng tsa rona tsa diindaseteri, ho fihlella tshehetso ya mmuso le mananeo a ditsiane, le menyetla ya matsete makaleng a fapafapaneng e a fumaneha ho WEBTOKEN kapa ka Setsi sa Mehala sa Lefapha Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri (dti) ho 0861 843 384.
tgt: Lwatiso lolumayelana nekutsi ungawasebentisa kanjani lamatfuba lakhona kumapaki etfu etimboni, kutfola lusito lwahulumende netinhlelo tetibonelelo tahulumende kanye nematfuba elutjalomali emikhakheni leminengi leyehlukene lutfolakala ku: WEBTOKEN noma kuSikhungo Sekusita Ebantfu seLitiko Letekuhwebelana Netimboni (i-dti) ku: 0861 843 384.

src: Kabinete e lemohile ka maswabi qeto ya General Motors South Africa (GMSA) (Pty) Ltd ya ho fedisa tlhahiso le thekiso ya makoloi a Chevrolet ka hara naha.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi isemukele ngekushaceka sincumo se-General Motors South Africa (i-GMSA) (Pty) Ltd sekuyekela kukhicita nekutsengisa timoto teluhlobo lwe-Chevrolet kulelive.

src: Sena se fupere ditlamorao tse bohloko bakeng sa ba tla lahlehelwa ke mesebetsi ya bona le bakeng sa moruo wa rona.
tgt: Loku kunemphumela lomubi kakhulu kulabo labatawulahlekelwa yimisebenti yabo kanye nasemnotfweni welive lakitsi.

src: Mmuso o dula o itlamme bakeng sa ho tshehetsa lekala la naha la tlhahiso ya makoloi, e leng le hlokolosi bakeng sa moruo le tlhahiso ya WEBTOKEN dti ba tswela pele ho sebetsa le bankakarolo kaofela ho bebofatsa sekgahla sa sena.
tgt: Hulumende uyachubeka nekwesekela umkhakha walelive lokhicita timoto, lobaluleke kakhulu kutemnotfo nasekudaleni ematfuba emisebenti.

src: Bakeng sa ho eketsa tlhahiso, tlhahiso ya mesebetsi le matlafatso ya dihlahiswa tse rekiswang ka ntle, haufinyana tjena re thakgotse mokgahlelo wa borobong wa Moralo wa Leano la Tshebetso la Diindaseteri (IPAP) bakeng sa ho tataisa mesebetsi ya rona.
tgt: I-dti iyachubeka nekusebentisana nalabatsintsekako kute kutsi kuncishiwe lelifutse.

src: Kabinete e ananela hore Isuzu, eo esale e le selekaneng le GMSA ka dilemo tse ngata ka hara Aforika Borwa, e tla nka ditshebetso tsa GMSKabinete e lemohile ho mpefala ha maemo a komello ka hara Kapa Bophirima le Kapa Botjhabela.
tgt: Kute kutsi sikhulise lizinga lekukhicita, kudala ematfuba ekucashwa kanye nekutsengisa imikhicito kulamanye emave, sisandza kwetfula sigaba semfica seLuhlelo Lwekusebenta Lwenchubomgomo Yetimboni (i-IPAP) kutsi lukhombe tinyatselo tetfu indlela.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho badudi ho tshehetsa dithibelo tsa tshebediso ya metsi tse tsebahaditsweng ke diporofense.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyakwemukela kutsi Isuzu, lebeyikadze isebentisana ne-GMSA yonkhe leminyaka eNingizimu Afrika, itawutsatsa ichubeke nemsebenti we-GMSIkhabhinethi iyasibona simo lesibi lesibangwa somiso eNshonalanga Kapa naseMphumalanga Kapa.

src: Moifo o bopilweng ka bahlanka ho tswa ho Lefapha la Metsi le Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere, Komiti ya Naha ya Taolo ya Dikoduwa o sebetsa mmoho le diporofense le mmuso wa lehae, esale o phathahane mabapi le ho netefatsa hore ditharollo tsa nako e kgutshwanyane ho isa ho tsa nako e bohareng di a akofiswa bakeng sa ho tiisetsa polokeho ya metsi ya porofense bakeng sa nako e telele.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi imema yonkhe imimango kutsi yesekele imikhawulo yekusetjentiswa kwemanti lengeniswe tifundza.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho kenyeletswa basebedisi ba malapeng, dikgwebo, lekala la merafo, makala a eneji le a temo ho sebetsa mmoho le ho sebedisa metsi ka polokeho.
tgt: Licembu lelifaka ekhatsi tisebenti teLitiko Letemanti Nekuhanjiswa Kwendle, Likomidi Lekulawula Tinhlekelele Lavelonkhe lisebentisana netifundza kanye nahulumende wendzawo, belimatasatasa licinisekisa kutsi tisombululo tethemu yesikhashana nalesemkhatsini tiyasheshiswa kute kutsi kucinisekiswe kutfolakala kwemanti esifundza ethemini lendze.

src: Kabinete e amohetse tokomane ya dipuisano e lokolotsweng ya Lewa Kgahlanong le Bobodu, e tla matlafatsa Lewa la Naha le Kgahlanong le Bobodu.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kufaka ekhatsi ebantfu emakhaya, emabhizinisi, umkhakha wetimbiwa, temandla netekulima kutsi basebentisane futsi basebentise emanti ngekuwonga kakhulu.

src: Kabinete e mema setjhaba ho etsa diphehiso tse ngotsweng ka websaete ya Lefapha la Meralo, Bodisa le Tlhatlhobo ya Tshebetso: www.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyemukele idokhumenti lekhuluma ngeNdlelalisu Yekulwa Nenkhohlakalo, lekutawumiselwa kuyo Indlelalisu Yavelonkhe Yekulwa Nenkhonhlakalo.

src: Ntwa kgahlanong le bobodu e dula e le e nngwe ya dintlha tse ka sehlohlolong tsa mmuso.
tgt: zaKulwa nenkhohlakalo kuyachubeka nekuba yintfo yahulumende lenkhulu lebekwa embili.

src: Bobodu le ho nyehla ha seriti ho ka bobedi makala a mmuso le a poraefete di na le kgahlamelo e kotsi hodima ntshetsopele ya naha ya bo rona.
tgt: Inkhohlakalo nekungatsembeki kwahulumende nemkhakha wangasese kunemiphumela lemibi kabi ekutfutfukeni kwelive letfu.

src: Kabinete e hlahisitse ngongoreho ka tlhaselo ya lefatshe ka marangrang a dikgokahano ya haufinyana tjena, e tlalehilweng e le tlhaselo e kgolo ka ho fetisisa ho fihlela hajwale.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ivakalise kukhatsateka mayelana nekuhlaselwa kumoshwe luhlelo lwabongcondvomshini lwemave emhlaba, lokusandza kwenteka lokubikwe njengekuhlaselwa lokukhulu kakhulu kwenchubo yabondvomshini yemhlaba lokungakate sekube khona.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa kaofela ho nka mehato ya tlhokomelo ha ba sebedisa mekgwa ya dikgokahanyo ya elektroniki le ho etsa ditumellano.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bacaphele nabachumana ngekwe-elekhthronikhi nanoma babhanga.

src: Ho sebedisa disebediswa tsa antivaerase ya khomphyutha kgafetsa tse tla hlahloba tikoloho e sa lokang inthaneteng le tsona di a kgothaletswa.
tgt: Kunconywa kutsi kusetjentiswe ema-software lalwa nemavayirasi lahambisana nesikhatsi lahlala njalo agadzile futsi ashayenyela tinhlelo te-inthanethi.

src: Kabinete e ngongorehile ka tse ntseng di etsahala haufinyana tjena Eskom.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyakhatsateka mayelana netehlakalo letisandza kwenteka e-Eskom.

src: Kabinete e ananela hore taba ya ho hirwa hape ha Monghadi Brian Molefe jwaloka Mohlanka e Moholo wa Phethahatso (CEO) wa Eskom e makgotleng a dinyewe le ka hara Palamente, mme ka hona e tla hlompha ditsamaiso tsena.
tgt: Kuyayitfokotisa Ikhabhinethi kutsi loludzaba lolumayelana nekucashwa kabusha kweMnu Brian Molefe njengeSikhulu Lesiphetse (i-CEO) e-Eskom selusenkantolo nasePhalamende, futsi iyayihlonipha lenchubo.

src: Moporesidente, le ha ho le jwalo, o thehile Komiti e Kopanetsweng ya Matona (IMC) e bopilweng ka Letona la Dikgwebo tsa Mmuso, la Eneji, la Ditjhelete le la Toka le Ditshebeletso tsa Tlhabollo ya Batshwaruwa.
tgt: Mengameli, nanoma kunjalo, sewusungule Likomidi Letindvuna (i-IMC) lelifaka ekhatsi Indvuna Yetemabhizinisi Ahulumende, yeTemandla, yeTetimali neyeTebulungiswa Nekucondziswa Kwesimilo.

src: IMC e kopuwe ho bokeletsa dintlha mabapi le ho tataisa Kabinete kamoo e tla sebetsanang le dintlha tse jwalo nakong e tlang.
tgt: Le-IMC icelwe kutsi igcogce emaciniso kute kutsi akhombe Ikhabhinethi indlela mayelana nekutsi kungabukwana kanjani netindzaba letinjena esikhatsini lesitako.

src: Moetapele ke Letona la Toka le Ditshebeletso tsa Tlhabollo ya Batshwaruwa, Monghadi Michael Masutha.
tgt: Itawuhlangiswa yiNdvuna yeTebulungiswa Nekucondziswa Kwesimilo, Michael Masutha.

src: Diqeto tsa kabinete.
tgt: Tincumo tekhabhinethi.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Tjhata e Shebilweng Botjha ya Matlafatso e Pharaletseng ya Batho ba Batsho Moruong bakeng sa Indaseteri ya Aforika Borwa ya Merafo le Diminerale ka selemo sa 2017.Letona la Mehlodi ya Diminerale Mosebenzi Zwane o tla fana ka tsebiso hang feela ha tjhata e se e kentswe koranteng ya mmuso.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kweMculu Lobuyeketiwe Wemkhakhubanti Wekuhlomisa Labamnyama Ngemakhono Etemnotfo yemboni yaseNingizimu Afrika yeTetimayini Netimbiwa nga-2017.Indvuna yeTimbiwa Mosebenzi Zwane utawetfula inkhulumo uma lomculu sewufakwe kugazethi.

src: Kabinete e amohetse Moralo wa Naha wa Maqhubu a Radio wa selemo sa 2017 o tjhaelletsweng monwana ke Lefapha la Meralo ya Motheo ya Dikgokahanyo le Ditshebeletso tsa Poso.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iluvumile Luhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwemagagasi Emsakato Wemoya lweLitiko Letakhiwonchanti Tetekuchumanisa Netinsita Teliposi.

src: Ho ajwa ha maqhubu ke Pitso ya Lefatshe ya Dikgokahanyo tsa Radio ho na le kgahlamelo ya bohlokwa kgolong ya moruo wa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lokwabiwa kwemtsamo wemagagasi emsakato wemoya yiKhomfa Yemave Emahlaba yeTekuchumana ngeMsakato weMoya kunelifutse lelihle ekukhuleni kwemnotfo waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Moralo wa Naha wa Maqhubu a Radio wa selemo sa 2017 ke mohlodi o pharaletseng wa kabo ya ho phatlalla ha maqhubu a radio bakeng sa ditshebeletso tse fapaneng tsa dikgokahanyo tsa radio.
tgt: Luhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwemagagasi Emsakato Wemoya lwanga-2017 lungumtfombo lomkhulu wemtsamo wemagagasi emsakato wemoya lowabelwa tinsita letehlukene tekuchumana ngemsakato wemoya.

src: Moralo o shebilweng botjha wa Naha wa Maqhubu a Radio wa selemo sa 2017 o netefatsa hore Aforika Borwa e matahantswe le Melawana ya Matjhaba ya Radio e tjhaelletsweng monwana e ileng ya amohelwa ka selemo sa 2015 ho Pitso ya Matjhaba ya Meralo ya Motheo ya Dikgokahanyo (ITU).
tgt: Luhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwemagagasi Emsakato Wemoya lwanga-2017 lolubuyeketiwe lucinisekisa kutsi iNingizimu Afrika iyahambisana neMitsetfo Yemave Emhlaba Yemsakato Wemoya leyemukelwa nga-2015 kukhomfa Yemhlaba Yebunye beTekuchumana ngeMsakato weMoya.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Lewa la Boipaballo ba ka hara Naha ba Metsing.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iluvumile Luhlelolisu Lwetekuphepha Emachibini.

src: Lewa lena, ka Bolaudi ba Boipaballo ba Mawatleng ba Aforika Borwa, le beha maemo le ho ntlafatsa ditsamaiso mabapi le ho dumella le ho etsa ditlhophiso tsa dilaesense bakeng sa diketswana tse sebedisang ditsela tsa rona tsa metsi tsa ka hara naha.
tgt: Loluhlelolisu, ngekusebentisa Umtimba Wetekuphepha Elwandle waseNingizimu Afrika, lubeka emazinga lubuye futsi luphucule tinchubo tekuniketa timvume nekuhlelela kuniketwa emalayisense etikebhe letisebenta emachibini.

src: Sena se tla netefatsa boipaballo ba dikepe tse nyenyane ditseleng tsa ka hara naha tsa metsi tsa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Loku kutawucinisekisa kuphepha kwetikebhe letincane emachibini aseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Lewa la Mebila la Tsamaiso ya Dithoto.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iluvumile Luhlelolisu Lwekutfutsa Imikhicito Ngetitfutsi Temgwaco.

src: Lewa lena le rerile ho hlahisa moralo o kopanetsweng wa taolo le tshebetso, o tla kgontsha Aforika Borwa ho fihlella maemo a hlwahlwa ka ho fetisisa a matjhaba a ditshebetso tsa mebila ya tsamaiso ya dithoto.
tgt: Loluhlelo luhlose kwakha luhlakamsebenti loluhlanganisile lwekulawula nekusebenta, lolutawenta kutsi iNingizimu Afrika ikwati kuzuza emazinga emhlaba lahamba embili ekusebenta kwetitfutsi temikhicito temgwaco.

src: Dikgothaletso leweng lena di tla matlafatsa bohlwahlwa ba qobello, ho hodisa boipaballo mebileng, ho matlafatsa tshireletso ya meralo ya motheo, ho fokotsa dikgahlamelo tsa tikoloho, le ho bopa moralo o kopanetsweng wa phehisano e laolwang ho ya ka boleng boo ka hara lekala la tsamaiso ya dithoto le ka tswelang pele ho sebeletsa ditlhoko tsa moruo wa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Tincomo kuloluhlelolisu titawenta kancono kusebenta kahle, tikhutsata kuphepha emgwacweni, kwenta kancono kuvikelwa kwesakhiwonchati, kunciphisa lifutse kutemvelo, kanye nekusungula luhlakamsebenti lwemncintiswano lolawulwa ngekwelizinga lelifanele lapho khona umkhakha wemikhicito lehanjiswa ngetitfutsi temgwaco ungachubeka ufeze tidzingo temnotfo waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana meralo ya Khamphani ya Mente ya Aforika Borwa bakeng sa dikhoine tsa sehopotso le tse tla sebediswa tsa dilemo tsa 2017 le 2018.Ka tshebedisano le Kabinete, ho hlahisitswe letoto le letjha le emelang botjhaba, tokoloho le demokerasi tlasa mookotaba: “Re keteka Aforika Borwa”.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iwavumile emadizayini eNkampani Leyakha Luhlavumali yaseNingizimu Afrika anga-2017 na-2018 etimendlela tekugubha umkhosi wekukhumbula netinhlavumali letitawesetjentiswa ngebantfu.

src: Tswalo ya Molwanedi wa Tokoloho ya dilemo di lekgolo Oliver Reginald Tambo e kgethilwe e le sehlooho sa pele se tla bontshwa.
tgt: Ngekubambisana neKhabhinethi, kwakhiwe luchungechunge lolusha lolumelela emasiko, inkhululeko kanye nentsandvo yelinyenti ngaphansi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Kugubha umkhosi weNingizimu Afrika”.

src: Ho hlahiswa ha R50 (1aonse, silifera ya seteling) e ntjha ya khoene, R500 (1aonse, 24 dikharata tsa gauta) ya khoene le R50 (metale wa motheo) ya khoene ho keteka sehopotso sa dilemo tse 100 tsa letsatsi la tswalo la OR Tambo.
tgt: Iminyaka elikhulu yekutalwa kwelishanhlitiyo leMzabalazo Oliver Reginald Tambo ikhetfwe njengentfo yekucala.

src: Meralo ya letoto la dikhoene tse latelang tsa dilemo tsa 2017 le 2018 tsa sehopotso di hlahisitswe:a. Letoto la dikhoene la selemo sa 2017: Mokete wa Dilemo tse Lekgolo tsa Oliver Reginald Tambob.
tgt: Kungeniswa kweluhlavumali lolusha i-R50 (i-1oz, sterling-silver), luhlabumali lwe-R500 (i-1oz, 24-carat gold) neluhlavumali i-R50 (base metal alloy) lwekugubha umkhosi weminyaka le-100 welusuku lwekutalwa kwa-OR Tambo.

src: Dikhoene tse tla sebediswa naheng tsa selemo sa 2017: khoene ya R5 e bontshang Tlotlo ya Metswalle ya OR Tamboc.
tgt: Kwakhiwe nemadizayini eluchungechunge lwetinhlavumali temkhosi wekukhumbula anga-2017 na-2018:a. Tinhlavumali tanga-2017: Kugubha Umkhosi Weminyaka elikhulu Wekutalwa Kwa-Oliver Reginald Tambob.

src: Letoto la dikhoene la selemo sa 2017 la Protea: Bophelo ba Mohale – Nelson Mandelad.
tgt: Luhlavumali lwemjikeleto lwanga-2017: Luhlavumali i-R5 lolukhombisa umklomelo we-Order of the Companions of OR Tamboc.

src: Letoto la dikhoene tsa 2017 tsa R1: Dihahabi tsa Aforika Borwa – Marabee.
tgt: Luchungechunge lwetinhlavumali teProtea lwanga-2017: Imphilo yeSigayigayi – Nelson Mandelad.

src: Letoto la dikhoene tsa selemo sa 2018 la Mokgatlo wa Thuto, Saense le Botjhaba wa Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UNESCO) la Motho le Sebaka sa Bophelo: Resefe ya Sebaka sa Bophelo ya Waterbergf.
tgt: Luchungechunge lweluhlavumali lwanga-2017 R1: Tilwanyana Letihumako taseNingizimu Afrika – Imfetie.

src: Letoto la dikhoene la selemo sa 2018: Mokgatlo wa Naha wa Sebopeho sa Naha ‘Boikitlaetso ba Dikatse tse Kgolo’ – Taug.
tgt: Luchungechunge lweluhlavumali lwanga-2018 lweBantfu neMvelo lweNhlangano ye-UN yeTemfundvo Tesayensi neMasiko (i-UNESCO): I-Waterberg Biosphere Reservef.

src: Dikhoene tsa selemo sa 2018: FIFA World Cup RussiaTDiketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: Luchungechunge lweluhlavumali lwanga-2017: ‘Luhlelo Lwemakati Lamakhulu Asendle’ – Libhubesi le-National Geographic Societyg.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho tshehetsa Beke ya Tshireletso ya Bana ho tloha ka la 28 Motsheanong ho isa ka la 4 Phuptjane tlasa mookotaba: “Bohle ha re tshireletseng bana bakeng sa ho ntshetsa Aforika Borwa pele”.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi besekele Liviki Lekuvikelwa Kwebantfwana kusukela mhla tinge-28 Inkhwekhweti kuya kumhla ti-4 Inhlaba ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Sonkhe asivikele bantfwana kute kutsi sichubele iNingizimu Afrika embili”.

src: Tshireletso ya bana ba rona ke mosebetsi le boikarabelo ba maAforika Borwa kaofela batswadi, bahlokomedi, batho ka bo mong le badudi.
tgt: Kuvikela bantfwana betfu kungumsebenti nesibopho sabo bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika batali, banakekeli bebantfwana, bantfu kanye nemmango.

src: Jwaloka ka setjhaba, ke mosebetsi wa rona ho etsa ho hongata ho netefatsa hore ba tsietsing ka ho fetisisa ka hara setjhaba sa rona ha ba hlekefetswe.
tgt: Singummango sinemsebenti wekutsi sente lokunyenti kucinisekisa kutsi bantfu belive lakitsi labasengotini yekuhlaseleka kalula abahlukunyetwa.

src: Ho diatleng tsa rona ho kgina motsamao wa ho nyahlatsa, ho hlekefetsa, merusu le ho ja bana tsuo.
tgt: Kusetandleni tetfu kutsi sivimbe kunganakwa, kuhlukunyetwa, kwentiwa budlova kanye nekucashatwa kwebantfwana.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa makala oohle a setjhaba ho sebetsa mmoho bakeng sa ho bopa metse e bolokehileng le ho itekanela hore bana ba rona e tle e be batho setjhabeng.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikhutsata yonkhe imikhakha yemmango kutsi isebentisane kute kutsi kube nemimango letse kuphepha kakhulu nalenemphilo kute kutsi bantfwana betfu bakhule futsi baphile ngendlela lefanele.

src: Nakong ya mokete wa dilemo tse lekgolo tsa OR Tambo, Aforika Borwa e tla tshwaya Kgwedi ya Batjha ka Phuptjane 2017 tlasa mookotaba: “Selemo sa OR Tambo: Re ntshetsapele Bonkakarolo ba Batjha Moruong.”Kgweding eo kaofela mmuso o tla kenela diketsahalo tse mmalwa ho kenyeletswa dipontsho tsa batjha, dipuisano le dibaka tsa baetapele ba dikgwebo ba batjha ho pepesa menyetla e teng bakeng sa batjha, le ho ba hlohlelletsa ho ikgapela ditlwaelo tsa thuto le boetapele tsa OR Tambo.
tgt: Ekugubheni umkhosi wemnyaka elikhulu wekutalwa kwa-OR Tambo, iNingizimu Afrika itawugubha Inyanga yeLusha ngeNhlaba 2017 ngaphasi kwalengcikitsi: “Umnyaka wa-OR Tambo: Kutfutfukisa Kuhlanganyela Kwelusha Kutemnotfo.”Kuyo lenyanga hulumende utawubamba tingcoco letinyenti letifaka ekhatsi imikhangiso yelusha, tingcoco netikhungo tetemabhizinisi telusha tekukhangisa ematfuba lakhona ebantfu labasha, aphindze futsi abafake inshisekelo yekutsi bajulise emagugu ekufundza newebuholi a-OR Tambo.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa batjha bohle ho fihlella mananeo a fapafapaneng a tshehetso le thuto ao mmuso o a hlahisitseng bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa menyetla le ho ntshetsapele bonkakarolo ba bona moruong.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikhutsata bonkhe bantfu labasha kutsi bafinyelele kwesekelwa lokunyenti lokwehlukahlukene netinhlelo tetemfundvo hulumende latente kutsi tibe khona kute kutsi kwentiwe kancono loko labalindzele kuphumelela kuko kanye nekutfutfukisa kuhlanganyela kwabo kutemnotfo.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho bahiri ho nka karolo kgoeletsong ya tloho le ngwana wa ngwanana mosebetsing ka la 25 le la 26 Motsheanong.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi imema bonkhe bacashi kutsi bafake ligalelo kulomkhosi lotako lobitwa ngekutsi i-Take a girl child to work mhla tinge-25 Inkhwekhweti namhla tinge-26 Inkhwekhweti.

src: Sepheo ke ho hlahisetsa banana ba etsang Kereiti 10 ho ya ho 12 makala a fapaneng a thuto.
tgt: Inhloso yalomkhosi kwenta bafundzi labangentfombatana beLibanga le-10 kuya kule-12 kutsi bavuleleke kumikhakha yemisebenti leyehlukene.

src: Moporesidente Zuma ka Labone, la 25 Motsheanong 2017, o tla tshwara mokete wa naha wa selemo sa 2017 wa Letsatsi la Aforika Ntlong ya Baeti ba Boporesidente ya Sefako Makgatho Pretoria.
tgt: Mengameli Zuma ngaLesine, 25 Inkhwekhweti 2017, utawungenisa kugujwa kwemkhosi wavelonkhe weLilanga le-Afrika wanga-2017 eSefako Makgatho Presidential Guesthouse ePitoli.

src: Sena ke phethelo ya diketsahalo le mananeo a tshwayang Kgwedi ya Aforika tlasa mookotaba: “Selemo sa OR Tambo: Re aha Aforika e Betere le Lefatshe le Betere”.
tgt: Loku kukupheleliswa kwemisebenti netinhlelo tekugubha umkhosi weNyanga ye-Afrika ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Umnyaka wa-OR Tambo: Kwakha i-Afrika Lencono neMhlaba Loncono”.

src: Sehopotso sa selemo ka seng sa Letsatsi la Aforika se tshwaya ho thehwa ha Mokgatlo wa Kopano ya Aforika (OAU) ka selemo sa 1963.Ha re phethela Kgwedi ya Aforika, Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela le maAforika a bo rona a dulang ka hara Aforika Borwa le dibakeng tse ding ka hara kontinente ho netefatsa tswelopele ya lebatowa la rona le Aforika ka bophara.
tgt: Kugujwa njalo ngemnyaka kwemkhosi wekukhumbula Lilanga le-Afrika kugubha umkhosi wekusungulwa kweNhlangano yeBunye be-Afrika (i-OAU) nga-1963.Lapho siphetsa Inyanga ye-Afrika, Ikhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi babambisane nebantfu bakitsi base-Afrika labahlala eNingizimu Afrika nakuletinye tindzawo talelivekati lase-Afrika kucinisekisa kundlondlobala kwesigodzi setfu kanye ne-Afrika yonkhe.

src: Ho mahetleng a bohle ba dulang ka hara meedi ya rona, maAforika Borwa le melata ka ho tshwana ho imatahanya le melao ya naha.
tgt: Kusemahlombe abo bonkhe bantfu labahlala ngekhatsi kweminyele yetfu, bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nebetive ngekufanana kutsi bagcina imitsetfo yalelive.

src: Mmoho re lokela ho lwantsha koduwa ya kgwebisano ka batho, dikwetelo, le tlhekefetso ya basadi le bana.
tgt: Sisonkhe ngekubambisana sifanele kutsi silwe nekubhebhetsaka kwekushushunjiswa, kutfunjwa, kanye nekuhlukunyetwa kwabomake nebantfwana.

src: Melaetsa ya thoholetso.
tgt: Imilayeto yekuhalalisela.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa moifo wa bongaka wa Yunivesithi ya Stellenbosch le Sepetlele sa Dithuto sa Tygerberg o bopilweng ka Moporofesara Andre van der Merwe, Ngaka Alexander Zuhlke, Moporofesara Rafique Moosa, Ngaka Amir Zarrabi le Ngaka Zamira Keyser.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ihalalisela licembu letekwelashwa leNnyuvesi yaseStellenbosch nesibhedlela i-Tygerberg Academic Hospital lelifaka ekhatsi Solwati Andre van der Merwe, Dkt.

src: Haufinyana tjena ba entse oporeishene ya bobedi ya ho kenya setho sa botona, hore e be setsi sa pele sa bongaka sa ho etsa mosebetsi ona habedi.
tgt: Alexander Zuhlke, Solwati Rafique Moosa, Dkt.

src: Katleho ya ketsahalo ena matsohong a moifo wa oporeishene ena ke bopaki ba boitsebelo ba boemo bo hodimo le botsebi bo teng ka hara lekala la kalafo ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Basandza kwenta luhlindvo lwesibili loluyimphumelelo lwekufakwa kwesitfo salabadvuna sangasese sangembili, lokwente lesikhungo setekwelashwa kutsi sibe sekucala ngca emhlabeni lesente loluhlindvo kabili futsi lwaba yimphumelelo.

src: Kabinete e thoholeditse Phaka ya Mokgwabo ya iSimangaliso bakeng sa ho amohela Kgau ya Boqhetseke ba Tlhatlhobo ho tswa ho Setheo sa Bahlanka ba Tshebediso ya Ditjhelete sa Aforika Borwa (SAICA) ka Dikgau tsa Boqhetseke ho Lekala la Mmuso pejana kgweding ena.
tgt: Lokuphumelela kwaloluhlindvo lebelwentiwa licembu letfu lekuhlindza kubufakazi belikhono nebucwepheshe lobusezingeni leliphakeme kakhulu lobukhona emkhakheni wetemphilo wahulumende eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kgau ena ke kananelo ya Phaka ya ho fumana bohlahlobi ba ditjhelete bo hlokang sekodi bakeng sa dilemo tse hlano ka tatelano.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ihalalisela iSimangaliso Wetland Park ngekuklonyeliswa Umklomelo Weluhlolomabhuku Lwekusebenta Ngalokusezingeni Leliphakeme Emkhosini Wemiklomelo Yekusebenta Ngalokusezingeni Leliphakeme weSouth African Institute of Chartered Accountants (i-SAICA) ekucaleni kwalenyanga.

src: iSimangaliso e ile ya tsebahatswa e le Setsha sa pele sa Lefatshe sa Botjhaba ka Tshitwe 1999.
tgt: Lomklomelo bewuwekubongela iSimangaliso Wetland Park ngekutfola imiphumela yeluhlolomabhuku lemihle iminyaka lesihlanu lelandzelanako.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa lenaneo la Working on Fire mabapi le ho amohela polaka ho tswa ho Mmuso wa Alberta Canada e le sehopotso sa thuso e fannweng ke lenaneo lena mabapi le ho laola mello ya hlaha ka hara Porofense ya bona ka selemo sa 2016.
tgt: ISimangaliso samenyetelwa njengeNdzawwo Yemagugu Nemasiko Yemhlaba yaseNingizimu Afrika yekucala ngeNgongoni 1999.

src: Working on Fire ke Lenaneo la Katoloso ya Mesebetsi ya Setjhaba (EPWP) le reretsweng bakeng sa ho fana ka menyetla ya mosebetsi ho banna le basadi ba batjha.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ihalalisela luhlelo lweKusebenta ngeMlilo ngekutfola umklomelo kuHulumende Wesifundza sase-Alberta eCanada wekukhumbula lusito lolultfola kuloluhlelo lwekulawula imililo yemadlelo eSifundzeni sakhe nga-2016.

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro, la 7 Phuptjane 2017, Tuynhuys, Motse Kapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yahlangana ngaLesitsatfu, mhla ti-7 Inhlaba 2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: DINTLHA TSA HAJWALE Kabinete e boeletsa kgoeletso ya Moporesidente Jacob Zuma bakeng sa hore maAforika Borwa a ipope kgahlanong le dikgoka le tlhekefetso ya basadi le bana, le ho ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho nka mehato e potlakileng ho fedisa koduwa ena ka hara metse ya bo rona.
tgt: TINDZABA LETIMCOKA EVENI.1 Ikhabhinethi iyaphindza igcizelela simemo saMengameli Jacob Zuma sekumema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bahlangane balwe nebudlova nekuhlukunyetwa kwabomake nebantfwana, iyaphindze futsi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi batsatse tinyatselo letiphutfumako tekucedza loluhlupho emimangweni yetfu.

src: Sena se latela leeto la Moporesidente Elsies River ho la Motse Kapa mabapi le ho tshehetsa Imbizo ya Ntwa e kgahlanong le Botlokotsebe.
tgt: Loku kulandzela kuvakasha kwaMengameli e-Elsies River eKapa ayokwesekela Imbizo Yekulwa neBugebengu.

src: Leeto lena hape le hlakisitse ho ba kotsing ha basadi le bana ka hara setjhaba sa rona.
tgt: Lokuvakasha kuphindze kwagcamisa kuhlaseleka kalula kwabomake nebantfwana emmangweni.

src: Moporesidente o ikemiseditse ho kgutlela sebakeng seo ho ya fatisisa diphephetso tse ngata tsa botlokotsebe le dipolao, ka ho qolleha tsa bana le kamoo balaodi ba qobello ya molao ba ka ntlafatsang ditshebeletso tsa bona ho badudi.2 Kabinete e amohela ho lokollwa ha Diphuputso tse Akaretsang tsa Malapa tsa selemo sa 2016, tse tswellang ho bontsha kgatelopele mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha mananeo a mmuso a ho ntlafatsa maphelo a maAforika Borwa, haholoholo badudi ba neng ba tingwe menyetla pele.
tgt: Mengameli uphindze wabuyela wayobuka lendzawo wayobuka letinsayeya letinyenti tebugebengu nekubulawa ikakhulu kwebantfwana nekutsi tiphatsimandla tekucinisekisa kulandzelwa kwemtsetfo tingatenta kancono kanjani tinsita tato kulommango.2 Ikhabhinethi iyakwemukela kukhishwa kweLuhlayo Lwemakhaya Lolwetayelekile lwanga-2016, loluchubekako nekukhombisa inchubekelembili ekufezekisweni kwetinhlelo tahulumende kwenta kancono timphilo tebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulu imimango lebeyincishwe ematfuba phambilini.

src: Dipalopalo di bontsha hore mmuso e etsa menyabuketso mabapi le ho fana ka bodulo, moo malapa a maAforika Borwa a dulang ka hara matlo a ‘RDP’ kapa matlo a tsheheditsweng ke mmuso a phahameng ho tloha ho 5% ka selemo sa 2002 ho ya ho 13,5% ka selemo sa 2016.
tgt: Lubalobalo lukhombisa kutsi hulumende uyaphumelela ekunikeni bantfu tindlu, linani lemindeni yaseNingizimu Afrika lehlala etindlini tesibonelelo sahulumende noma emakhaya latfola sibonelelo sembuso likhuphuke lesuka ku-5% nga-2002 laya ku-13,5% nga-2016.

src: Diphuphutso tsena hape di bontsha hore mananeo a mmuso a thuso ya kahisano a supa keketseho ho tloha ho 12,7% ka selemo sa 2003 ho ya ho 29,7% ka selemo sa 2016.Hape ho na le keketseho e bonahalang ho phumantsho ya metsi, motlakase le tsamaiso ya dikgwerekgwere, e leng letshwao la bohlokwa bakeng sa maikemisetso a Mmuso wa Aforika Borwa wa ho lokisa dimpe tsa mmuso wa kgethollo le ho fana ka ditshebeletso tsa mantlha ho batho kaofela.
tgt: Loluklayo luphindze futsi lukhombisa kutsi tinhlelo tahulumende nelusito lwetenhlalo lukhombisa kukhula kusuka ku-12,7% nga-2003 kwaya ku-29,7% nga-2016.Kukhona futsi nekukhula lokubonakalako kwesibalo sebantfu labafakelwe emanti, gezi kanye nebatfola tinsita tekuhanjiswa kwendle, lokuyinkhomba lebalulekile yekutimisela kwaHulumende waseNingizimu Afrika ekulungiseni tiphosiso tesikhatsi selubandlululo nekuniketa bonkhe bantfu tinsita letisisekelo.

src: Kabinete, leha ho le jwalo, e lemohile hore ha boingodiso thutong e phahameng bo ntse bo eketseha, leha e le ka monyebe, ebile feela 3,3% ya maAforika Borwa a ba Batsho a dilemong tse 18 ho ya ho tse 29 a neng a ithuta papisong le 18,8% ya baithuti ba maIndia/maAsia le 17,5% ya makgowa sehlopheng sa ba dilemong tsena.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi, nanoma kunjalo, ikucaphele kutsi nanoma nje sikhula sibalo sebantfwana lababhalisela kufundva kutikhungo temfundvo lephakeme, kepha sikhula kancane, bange-3,3% bantfu lamansundvu labaneminyaka yebudzala kusuka ku-18 kuya ku-29 bebafundza nakucatsaniswa na-18,8% webantfu labamaNdiya/labama-Eshiya na-17,5% webantfu labamhlophe lababontsanga.

src: Ke feela 3,5% ya ba Mmala ba neng ba ithuta nakong ya selemo sa 2016.Diphuputso ho ya pele di supile phokotseho ho tloha ho 23,8% ho ya ho 11,8% ya malapa a neng a phela ka tlala, e leng se bontshang kgatelopele mabapi le ho shebana le malapa a phelang bofutsaneng bo feteletseng.3 Kabinete e lemohile Diphuputso tsa Kotara ka Nngwe tsa Lebotho la Basebetsi bakeng sa kotara ya pele ya selemo tse bontshitseng hore moruo o ekeditse mesebetsi ka mesebetsi e 144 000.
tgt: Bange-3,5% kuphela bantfu labangemakhalatsi labebafundza nga-2016.Loluklayo luphindze futsi lwakhombisa kwehla nge-23,8% kwaya ku-11,8% wemindeni lehlangabetene nendlala, lokukhombisa inchubekelembili ekulungiseni imimango lephuye ngalokwendlulele.3 Ikhabhinethi ilwemukele Luklayo Lwekota Lwetisebenti lwekota yekucala yalomnyaka lukhombise kutsi temnotfo tengeta imisibenti le-144 000.

src: Dipalo tsena di thuntheditswe ke keketseho ya batho ba neng ba batla mosebetsi ba 433 000.
tgt: Lamanani asimamiswa kukhula kwelinani lebantfu labafuna imisebenti bantfu labange-433 000.

src: Kabinete e thathiselleditse boitlamo ba yona ba ho tswela pele ho theha selekane le lefapha la poraefete le basebetsi maitekong a yona a ho sebetsana le diphephetso tsa naha tsa tlhokeho ya mesebetsi.4 Kabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa ha Phaka ya Diindaseteri ya Babelegi e ntjhafaditsweng ho la Hammanskraal jwaloka karolo ya meralo ya mmuso ya ho akofisa ntshetsopele ya moruo le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi sebakeng seo.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyachubeka nekutinikela ekubambisaneni nemkhakha lotimele kanye newetisebenti emitameni yayo yekulungisa tinsayeya talelive tekungacashwa.4 Ikhabhinethi iyakwemukela kwetfulwa kwePaki Yetimboni iBabelegi eHammanskraal njengencenye yemasu ahulumende ekutfutfukisa umnotfo nekwakha ematfuba emisebenti kulendzawo.

src: Porojeke ena ya R42-milione ke karolo ya mmuso ya Lenaneo la Tsoseletso ya Diphaka Tsa Diindaseteri le e nngwe ya diphaka tse tsheletseng tse ntseng di tsoseletswa ho phatlalla le naha bakeng sa ntshetsopele e pharaletseng ya moruo le diindaseteri.
tgt: Lepaki lebite tigidzi letinge-R42 iyincenye yeLuhlelo lwahulumende Lwekuvuselela Emapaki Etimboni futsi ingenye yemapaki lasitfupha lavuselelwako kulo lonkhe lelive kulungiselela kutfutfukiswa lokubanti kwemnotfo netimboni.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa diindaseteri le dikgwebo tsa lehae ho sekaseka ho atolosetsa ditshebetso tsa bona ho ya sebakeng sena sa diindaseteri bakeng sa ho fumantshwa mekgwa e fapafapaneng ya tshehetso e teng bakeng sa ho hodisa dikgwebo tsa bona ho ya pele.5 Kabinete e tsebisitswe ke Letona la Ditjhelete, Monghadi Malusi Gigaba, mabapi le dipalo tsa moraorao tsa Palohohle ya Dihlahiswa tsa Aforika Borwa (GDP), e honyetseng ka 0,7% kotareng ya pele ya selemo sa 2017.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikhutsata timboni nemabhizinisi endzawo kutsi ticabange ngekuvula emagatja emabhizinisi ato kumapaki etimboni kute titfole tindlela letinyenti letehlukene letikhona tekwelekelela kutsi batfutfukise ngalokuchubekako emabhizinisi ato.5 Ikhabhinethi yatjelwa yiNdvuna yeTimali, MnuMalusi Gigaba, ngemanani Emkhicito Wonkhe Welive (i-GDP) weNingizimu Afrika, lonciphe nga-0,7% ekoteni yekucala yanga-2017.

src: Sephetho sena sa GDP se mpefetseng ho feta kamoo ho neng ho lebeletswe se tlase haholo ho feta Tjhebobotjha ya Ditekanyetso tsa selemo sa 2017, e neng e lepile kgolo ya GDP ya selemo sa 2017 ho ba 1,3%.
tgt: Lomphumela we-GDP lobe mubi kunaloko bekulindzelwe ungaphasi kakhulu kuneLubuyeketo Lwelwabiwomali lwanga-2017, lolwahabisa kukhula nga-1, 3% kwe-GDP yanga-2017.

src: Sena se bakuwe ke, hara tse ding, ho honyela ha tlhahiso, kgwebisano, diindaseteri tsa phano ya dijo le bodulo.
tgt: Loku kubangelwe, emkhatsini waletinye tintfo, kuncipha kwemkhakha wekukhicita, wekuhweba, wekupheka kanye newetetindzawo tekulala.

src: Leha ho le jwalo moruo o ile wa tshehetswa ke kgolo merafong le diindasetering tsa dikwari e eketsehileng ka 12.8%.
tgt: Nanoma kunjalo, umnotfo wesekelwa kukhula kwemkhakha wetimbiwa netenkwali letakhula nge-12.8%.

src: Diindaseteri tsa temo, meru le ditlhapi di ile tsa hlasimoloha kotareng ya pele ya selemo sa 2017 ka keketseho ya 22,2%.Ho na le matshwao a tshepisang a hore naha e ka itseka bakeng sa ho matlafatsa tjhebahalo ya yona ya kgolo ya moruo.
tgt: Tekulima, temahlatsi netinhlati takhula nge-22,2% ekoteni yekucala ya-2017.Kukhona tinkhomba tekuvuka kwemnotfo lelive lelingatigwadlula kute linike emandla umnotfo walo.

src: Tsena di kenyeletsa kgolo ya ho kenella lefatsheng, ho tsitsisa ditheko tsa phahlo, maemo a matle a tlelaemete, phepelo e tshepahalang ya motlakase le dikamano tse batlang di tsitsitse tsa basebetsi.
tgt: Loku kufaka ekhatsi kwenta kancono kukhula kwemnotfo wemave emhlaba, kuzitsisa tintsengo tetimbiwo, simo selitulu lesikahle, kuniketwa kwagezi lokwetsembekile kanye nebudlelwane lobuhle ekhatsi kwetisebenti nebacashi.

src: Jwaloka taba e potlakileng, Kabinete e ipiletsa ho dikgwebo, basebetsi le setjhaba ka kakaretso ho theha selekane le mmuso bakeng sa ho matlafatsa lenaneo la rona la kgolo le ho ntlafatsa tshepahalo bakeng sa ho kgina ho fokola le ho beha moruo maemong a batlang a phahame, ho fihlella kgolo ya moruo e kenyeletsang.
tgt: Ngalokuphutfumako, Ikhabhinethi imema emabhizinisi, tisebenti kanye nemmango ngebubanti bawo kutsi babambisane nahulumende ekuciniseni luhlelo lwetfu lwekukhula kwemnotfo kanye nekwenta kancono kutetsemba kute kuvinjwe kwehla kanye nekubeka umnotfo endleleni lephakeme kakhulu, kute kutfolwe kukhula kwemnotfo lokuphelele.

src: Ntlheng ena Letona la Ditjhelete le tla kopana le baetapele ba dikgwebo ka morero wa ho bopa mawa a ho lwantsha ho putlama ha moruo le ho fihlella kgolo e kenyeletsang.
tgt: Mayelana naloku Indvuna yeTimali itawuhlangana nebaholi bemabhizinisi ngekwemtamo wekwakha emasu ekulwa nekwehla kwemnotfo nekutfola kukhula lokuphelele.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana kopano ya boraditaba le Letona la Ditjhelete bakeng sa ho arolelana le maAforika Borwa maitshunyako ao mmuso o tla a etsang ka hara meralo ya ditekanyetso tsa hajwale.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ivume kwetfulwa kwenkhulumo kubetindzaba lokutawentiwa yiNdvuna yeTimali yabelane nebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika ngetinyatselo tekungenelela hulumende latawucala kutenta kuloluhlakamsebenti lwelwabiwotimali lwamanje.

src: Kabinete hape e thathiselletsa moralo o amohetsweng wa ditekanyetso bakeng sa naha.6 Lekala la tekolo la Fitch le la Standard & Poor’s a thathiselleditse ditekolo tsa Aforika Borwa tsa mekitlane ya ditjhelete tsa maatjhabeng tsa nako e telele tsa ‘BB+’.Sena se tla hara nako eo dipuisano tsa Letona Gigaba le lekala la poraefete bakeng sa ho netefatsa hore mosebetsi o kopanetsweng wa mmuso, dikgwebo, basebetsi le setjhaba ka kakaretso di ntseng di tswela pele, le hore maitlamo a entsweng a ya phethahatswa.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi icinisekisa ngalokuphelele luhlakamsebenti lwelwabiwomali lolwemukelwe lwalelive.6 Ema-ejensi labuka emazinga etemnotfo iFitch kanye neStandard & Poor alicinisekisile lizinga letikweleti lemali yangaphandle laseNingizimu Afrika lesikhatsi lesidze kutsi ngu-‘BB+’.Loku kwenteka emkhatsini wekukhulumisana kweNdvuna Gigaba nemkhakha lotimele kucinisekisa kubambisana kwahulumende, emabhizinisi, tisebenti netinhlangano temmango kuyachubeka, nekutsi tetsembiso letentiwe tiyafezekiswa.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa hore maAforika Borwa a lokela ho tswela pele ho sebetsa e le ntho e le nngwe, haholoholo dinakong tse thata le ho sebetsa ka thata ho feta ho netefatsa hore naha e tseke maemo a yona a tekolo ya matsete.7 Kabinete e ananela ditherisano tse thakgolwang kgetlo la pele tsa Komiti e Kopanetsweng ya Tsamaiso bakeng sa Mmaraka o Tshwanang wa Borwa (MERCOSUR) le Mokgatlo wa Lekgetho la Madiboho a Dinaha tsa Aforika e Borwa (SACU (SACU) tse neng di tshwerwe haufinyana tjena ka hara naha.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyakuphindza kugcizelela kutsi bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bafanele kutsi bachubeke basebente kanyekanye ngekubambisana, ikakhulu ngetikhatsi letimatima baphindze futsi basebente ngekutikhandla kucinisekisa kutsi lelive liyaphindza libuyelwa simo salo sesigaba setekutjala imali.7 Ikhabhinethi iyatemukela tingcoco letentiwe kuLikomidi Letekulawula Lelihlangene leNhlangano Yemave AseNingizimu Melika Langakhokhisani Umtselo Wekuhwebelana (i-MERCOSUR) kanye neNyonyane Yetekuphuma Nekungena Kwemphahla yaseNingizimu ne-Afrika (i-SACU) letisandza kubakhona kulelive.

src: Mekga e dumellane hore ka kopanelo e tla sekaseka menyetla ya ho hodisa Tumellano e ka Sehloohong ya Kgwebisano (PTA) ya MERCOSUR-SACU ka ho kenyeletsa makala a yona a kgodiso ya kgwebisano, mekgatlo ya kgwebo, lekala la poraefete, le matlo a bona a bonqosa le dikantoro tsa matjhabeng ka ho latelana.
tgt: Emave langamalunga avumile kubambisana ekubukisiseni ematfuba ekukhutsata Sivumelwane Setekuhwebelana Lesicontwako (i-PTA) se-MERCOSUR ne-SACU ngekufaka ekhatsi ema-ejensi abo lakhutsata kuhwebelana, imikhandlu yekuhwebelana, umkhakha lotimele, kanye nemahovisi emancusa emave angaphandle.

src: PTA ya MERCOSUR-SACU e neha ba romellang thepa ya lehae ka ntle monyetla wa ho kenella mmarakeng wa batho ba fetang 280-milione.
tgt: Sivumelwano se-MERCOSUR ne-SACU sinika batsengisi bendzawo labatsengisela lamanye emave litfuba lekutsi batsengele emave lanebantfu labangetulu kwetigidzi letinge-280 imikhicito yabo.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho ba romellang thepa ka ntle ho nka monyetla ona wa PTA kaha jwale dihlahiswa tsa mona hae di kgona ho kena lepatlelong la MERCOSUR ka dikgahla tse kgothaletswang tsa lekgetho.8 Kabinete e hlahisitse tshwabo ya yona ka qeto ya Amerika (USA) ya ho ikgula Tumellanong ya Paris.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi imema bonkhe balelive labatsengisa imikhicito yabo ngaphandle kulamanye emave kutsi basebentise lelitfuba le-PTA njengoba manje imikhicito yendzawo seyiyakwati kutsengiselwa emave langamalunga e-MERCOSUR ngemtselo wekuhwebelana lonesephulelo.8 Ikhabhinethi ivakalise kudzabuka ngesincumo se-United States of America (i-USA) sekuphuma kuSivumelwano saseParis.

src: Tumellano ya Paris, e tla sebetsa ka botlalo ka selemo sa 2020, e thehilwe hodima dinyehelo tse tekilweng ke dinaha ka botsona mabapi le merero ya lefatshe eo ho dumellanweng ka kopanelo ka yona.
tgt: LeSivumelwane saseParis, lesitawusebenta ngalokuphelele nga-2020, simiselwe kuminikelo lencunywe ngemave wona ngekwawo ngekwemigomo lavumelane ngayo njengemave emhlaba.

src: Aforika Borwa e ipileditse ho USA ho sekaseka botjha boemo ba yona le ho itlama botjha tsamaisong e kopanetsweng ke dinaha ka bongata.9 Memorandamo wa Kutlwano (MoU) pakeng tsa Novartis, Lekgotla la Aforika Borwa la Diphuputso tsa Bongaka le Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji, o betla tsela ya ho matlafatsa mothamo le boleng ba diteko tsa bongaka le ho aha bokgoni ba diphuputso ka hara kontinente.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika seyicele i-USA kutsi isibuyekete lesincumo sayo bese itinikela kabusha kulesivumelwano semave emhlaba.9 Isivumelwano Sekusebentisana lesisemkhatsini weNovartis, Umkhandlu waseNingizimu Afrika Wetelucwaningo Lwetekwelashwa kanye neLitiko Letesayensi Netheknoloji, sivula indlela yekufukula umtsamo nekhwalithi yekulinga tekwelashwa nekwakha emakhono ekucwaninga kulelivekati.

src: Tumellano e tla thusa bakeng sa mananeo a kopanetsweng a diphuputso mahlokong a kgethilweng a tshwaetsanang le a sa tshwaetsaneng, ho ntlafatsa phumantsho ya bakudi ba Aforika Borwa ya meriana e ntjhafatsang, le ho aha bokgoni ba naha le ba kontinente ba diphuputso le ntshetsopele.
tgt: Lesivumelwano sitawuvumela tinhlelo tekucwaninga letihlangene ngetifo letikhetsiwe letitsatselwanako naletingatsatselwana, kwenta kancono kufinyelela kwetigulane taseNingizimu Afrika imitsi yesimanje, kanye nekwakha emakhono ekucwaninga nekutfutfukisa alelive kanye newalelivekati.

src: Kabinete e dumela hore ho na le sebaka bakeng sa bolekane bo eketsehileng ba mmuso le ba poraefete, le ho kgodiseha hore tsena di ka bula tsela ya ho sebetsana le diphephetso tse ngata tse matla tseo re tobaneng le tsona.10 Kabinete e amohela Tlaleho ya selemo sa 2017 ho tswa ho Mokgatlo wa Khonkerese ya Matjhaba le Khonvenshene, e tswellang ho beha Aforika Borwa jwaloka sebaka se ka hodimo sa ho tshwara diketsahalo tsa kgwebo ka hara Aforika le Botjhabela bo Hare.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikholelwa ekutsini kusenematfuba lamanyenti ekubambisana kwemikhakha yangasese neyahulumende, futsi iyakholwa kutsi kungahola indlela ekulungiseni letinsayeya letinyenti letimcokalesibukene nato.

src: Aforika Borwa e dula e le se seng sa dibaka tse tummeng ka ho fetisisa sa bohahlaudi lefatsheng le ho tswela pele ho nka maemo a hodimo hape ho lenaneo la bophehisane la Foramo ya Moruo wa Lefatshe la ho eta le bohahlaudi lefatsheng jwaloka ha le lokolotswe ka Mmesa 2017.Kabinete e rata ho bona bongata ba ditoropo le metsemeholo e menyenyane ya Aforika Borwa e iketa bakeng sa dikopano tse nyenyane moo di ka kgonang ho imatahanya le ditlhokeho tsa ho tshwara dikopano.
tgt: 1.10 Ikhabhinethi iyawemukela Umbiko wanga-2017 weNhlangano Yemave Emhlaba Yetikhomfa Netingcungcutsela, lochubeka nekubeka iNingizimu Afrika njengendzawo yemikhosi yetemabhizinisi lephakeme e-Afrika naseMiddle East.

src: Sena se tla thusa ho ntlafatsa qaqolohano ho ya ka sebopeho sa naha bakeng sa bohahlaudi ka nqane ho ditsi tse kgolo le ho ala moruo o fehlilweng ke diketsahalo tsena ka tsela e batlang e lekalekana.11 Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela hore a fadimehele ditaba tsa leshano, ka ho qolleha keketseho ya ho maneha ditaba tse fosahetseng ho marangrang a ditaba a kahisano mabapi le banana le basadi ba lahlehileng, ba kwetetsweng le ba hapilweng ka mahahapa.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika iyachubeka nekuba yindzawo ledvume kakhulu emhlabeni yekuvakashelwa futsi iyachubeka nekuba sezingeni leliphakeme kuluhlu lemave emhlaba letekuhamba netekuvakasha lolukhishwe yiForamu yeTemnotfo yeMave Emhlaba (i-WEF) ngaMabasa 2017.Ikhabhinethi ingatsandza kubona emadolobha lamancane lamanyenti aseNingizimu Afrika efaka ticelo tekubamba imihlangano lemincane lapho khona angahlangabetana netidzingo tekungenisa.

src: Ho ropoha ha haufinyana tjena ha merusu KwaMashu, pela Durban ka lebaka la ditlaleho tse fosahetseng tsa hore bana ba nkuwa ka mahahapa sebakeng seo le ho belaellwa ha ho hapuwa ka mahahapa ha ngwanana Naledi, ho la Soweto ke batho ba tsamayang ka Toyota Quantum ho kenyeleditswe le nomoro ya yona ya boingodiso e ileng ya phatlalla ho marangrang a ditaba a kahisano, moo ho tholahetseng hamorao hore ha se nnete.
tgt: Loku kutawusita ekwenteni kancono kusatjalaliswa kwetekuvakasha tiphumele ngale kweminyele yemadolobha lamakhulu kuphindze futsi kusabalalise ingcebo lekhicitwe ngulemikhosi ngalokulinganako.11 Ikhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bacaphele tindzaba letingemanga, ikakhulu lokwandza kwekufakwa etinkhundleni tekucocisana nge-inthanethi kwetindzaba letingemanga temantfombatana nabomake labalahlekile, labatfunjiwe nalabashushunjisiwe.

src: Meritaoke ena, ditaba tsa leshano le ho tsamaisa tlhahisoleseding e fosahetseng ho baka pherekano ka hara metse ya bo rona le ho senya nako le mehlodi ya sepolesa.
tgt: Kubhedvuka kwebudlova lokusandza kwenteka KwaMashu, dvute neDurban lokumayelana nemibiko lengemanga yekutfunjwa kulendzawo kanye nekutfunjwa kwentfombatana lokutsiwa kwenteke eNaledi, eSoweto bantfu labahamba nge-Toyota Quantum lebekubhalwe netinombolo tayo tekubhaliswa yagcwala tonkhe tinkhundla temmango tekucocisana nge-inthanethi lokwatsi ngemuva kwesikhatsi kwatfolakala kutsi ngemanga.

src: Re ipiletsa ho batho hore ba seke ba pheta ho maneha le ho tsamaisa ditaba tsa leshano ho marangrang a ditaba a kahisano, ho fihlela ba tiisitse bonnete ba tsona.12 Kabinete e lemohile ka ngongoreho e kgolo ditlaleho tsa ditaba ka ‘diimeile tse nyenyelepisitsweng tse hlokang nnete’ tseo ho hopolwang hore di beha Matona, bahlanka ba mmuso le batho ba poraefete ka mosing ba belaellwa hore ba entse tse sa lokang.
tgt: Letindzaba letingemanaga nekwendlulisa lwatiso lolungemanga kwetfusa imimango yetfu kantsi futsi kucitsa sikhatsi nemitfombolusito yemaphoyisa.

src: Kabinete e dula e itlamme bakeng sa puso e hlwahlwa le ka nako e le nngwe, hape e ananela hore batho kaofela ba nkuwa ba hloka molato ho fihlela ba bonwe molato ho ya ka dipehelo tsa Molaotheo wa rona.
tgt: Sicela bantfu kutsi bayekele kufaka nekwendlulisa tindzaba letingemanga etinkhundleni temmango tekucocisana nge-inthanethi, kute kube ngulapho sebakucinisekisile kuba ngito kwato.12 Ikhabhinethi iyicaphele ngekukhatsateka lokukhulu imibiko yebetindzaba ‘yetincwadzigezi letishicilelwe ngete kwemvume lekuhloswe ngato kutsi kumbandzakanyeke Tindvuna, tikhulu tahulumende kanye nebantfu ekutsini kukhona lokubi labakwentile.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa bohle ba nang le tlhahisoleseding ka molato ofe kapa ofe o etswang ke bahlanka ba mmuso kapa Matona ho tsebisa makala a qobello ya molao hore ho tle ho etswe dipatlisiso.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi itinikele ngalokuphelele elulawulweni loluhle katsi futsi ngaso sona leso sikhatsi, iyakucondza kutsi bonkhe bantfu batsatfwa njengalabete licala kute kube ngulapho kuba nebufakazi bekutsi banelicala ngekwemibadzela yeMtsetfosisekelo wetfu.

src: Kabinete e hlokometse hore ho se ho na le dinyewe tse ritetsweng, mme sepolesa se ntse se etsa dipatlisiso tse lokelang.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi icela bonkhe labo labanelwatiso mayelana netento letingekho emtsetfweni tikhulu tahulumende noma Tindvuna kutsi batise ema-ejensi lacinisekisa kulandzelwa kwemtsetfo kute kutsi kwentiwe luphenyo.

src: Bohle ba anngweng ke diimeile tseo ba kgothaletswa ho sebetsa mmoho le makala a qobello ya molao.
tgt: Iyati kutsi akhona emacala lasavuliwe vele, futsi emaphoyisa enta luphenyo lolufanele.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o qheletse ka thoko tlaleho e phatlaladitsweng ke koranta ya Sontaha ya ho belaellwa hore o na le ntlo Dubai ho la United Arab Emirates.
tgt: Bonkhe labatsintfwa nguletincwadzigezi bacelwa kutsi basebentisane nema-ejensi lacinisekisa kulandzelwa kwemtsetfo.

src: DIQETO TSA KABINETE Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka ditlaleho tsa bo-4 tsa kgatelopele ya tshebetso tsa kotara ka nngwe bakeng sa 2016/17 (Pherekgong-Hlakubele 2017) mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha diphetho tse ka sehlohlolong.
tgt: Mengameli Zuma uticitsile tinsolo letashicilelwa liphephandzaba langeLisontfo tekutsi utsenge indlu eDubai e-United Arab Emirates.

src: Bodisa ba Kabinete hodima ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Lewa la Meralo ya Nako e Bohareng (MTSF) la 2014 ho isa ho 2019, bo baka phano ya ditshebeletso e ntlafetseng.
