src: Kabinete e thoholetsa ditho tsa setjhaba tse lemositseng Lefapha la Mesebetsi leo, hammoho le Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba, ba sebeditseng ka potlako ho sebetsana ka toka le mokgwa ona o sisimosang wa tshebediso e mpe ya bana.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyakugceka lokuhlukubeta lokungemukeleki nekusetjentiswa ngalokungafanele kwebantfwana labaphuyile.2 Ikhabhinethi incoma emalunga emmango lacaphelise Litiko Letetisebenti neLitiko Letekutfutfukiswa Kwetenhlalakahle, ngekubambisana lamatiko abese atsatsa tinyatselo ngekusheha abukana ngalokufanele nalesento lesibi kabi sekuhlukunyetwa kwebantfwana.3 Kuyayitfokotisa Ikhabhinethi kutsi labantfwana labatsintsekile sebasusiwe bayiswa etindzaweni tekuphepha nekutsi futsi Litiko Letetisebenti litawucinisa sitilobho ekuhlolweni nasekusebentisaneni netinhlangano leticinisekisa kulandzelwa kwemitsetfo kutsi kujeziswe letigilamkhuba.4 Bantfwana betfu balikusasa lalelive.

src: Kabinete e thabisitswe ke hore bana ba amehang ba falliseditswe dibakeng tsa polokeho le hore Lefapha la mesebetsi le tla matlafatsa ditlhatlhobo le ho sebetsa mmoho le makala a qobello ya molao ho tshwara baetsi ba sena ba molato.4 .
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyatigceka tonkhe tinhlobo tekucashwa kwebantfwana futsi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bahlale bacaphele ngato tonkhe tikhatsi futsi babike labo labo labephula tinchubomgomo teMtsetfosisekelo wetfu.5 Umtsetfo weTikolwa waseNingizimu Afrika, wanga-1996 (Umtsetfo-84 wanga-1996), ukanye neMtsetfo weBantfwana, wanga-2005 (Umtsetfo-38 wanga-2005), ucondzisa ngalokucacile kutsi bonkhe bantfwana labaneminyaka yebudzala lesemkhatsini kwesikhombisa nale-15 babophelelekile kutsi baye esikolweni.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe dibopeho kaofela tsa tshebediso ya bana le ho ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho dula ba fadimehile ka dinako tsohle le ho tlaleha ba tlolang dipehelo tsa Molaotheo wa rona.5 .
tgt: Ngekuya kwalomtsetfo, batali nebanakekeli bebantfwana bafanele kutsi bente siciniseko sekutsi bafundzi labakulelicembu leminyaka yebudzala babhalisiwe etikolweni futsi bayaya njalo ngetikhatsi letifanele noma-ke babukane nemiphumela yekungahambisani nalomtsetfo.

src: Ho ya ka molao, batswadi le bahlokomedi ba lokela ho netefatsa hore baithuti ba dilemong tsena ba ngodisitswe le ho ba sekolong kamehla kapa ba tobane le ditlamorao tsa ho se ikobele molao.
tgt: Emanti ayindlala eNingizimu Afrika futsi lokuchubeka kwetimo tesomiso kuletinye tincenye talelive kusikhumbuto kubo bonkhe bantfu sekonga onkhe ematfonsi ngekusebentisa emanti ngekuhlakanipha futsi kancane.

src: Aforika Borwa ke naha e nang le kgaello ya metsi mme maemo a komello a ntseng a tswela pele dikarolong tse ding tsa naha ke kgopotso ho batho bohle ya ho baballa lerothodi ka leng ka ho sebedisa metsi ka bohlale le ka paballo.
tgt: Nanoma nje imitamo yekonga emanti iyasita kuhhamula kucindzeteleka kumitfombo yemanti, imvula lene kancane kunalokufanele lebikwe eNshonalanga Kapa naKwaZulu-Natal bufakazi bekutsi kunyenti lokufanele kutsi kwentiwe kute kulondvolotwe emanti.

src: Leha mekutu ya ho baballa metsi e thusa ho fokotsa kgatello hodima mohlodi wa metsi a pula ya sehla e tlase ho feta tlwaelo ka hara Kapa Bophirima le KwaZulu-Natal ke bopaki ba hore ho lokelwa ho etswa ho hongata bakeng sa ho baballa metsi.
tgt: Licembu LeTindvuna Lelibukene neSomiso, leliholwa Litiko Letekubusa Ngekubambisana Netendzabuko, liyachubeka nekugadza timo tesomiso liphindze futsi lesekele ngalokudzingekako ngekusebentisa ematiko emkhakha lafanele kunciphisa lesimo.

src: Moifo wa Tshebetso wa Kopanelo wa Matona mabapi le komello, o eteletsweng pele ke Lefapha la Kopanelo ya Puso le Merero ya Setso, o tswela pele ho beha leihlo maemong a komello le ho fana ka tshehetso e hlokahalang ka makala a mafapha ho bebofatsa boemo bona.
tgt: Hulumende sewubeke eceleni tigidzi letinge-R74 tekuhhamula lesimo, letawusetjentiswa kulesomiso lesichubekako eNshonalanga Kapa.

src: Mmuso o beheletse ka thoko R74 milione e le letlole la pebofatso bakeng sa ho arabela mabapi le komello e ntseng e tswela pele ka hara Kapa Bophirima.
tgt: Litiko Letemanti Nekuhanjiswa Kwendle nalo lenta inchubelekelembili mayelana nemalungiselelo ekufezekisa i-Berg River to Voelvlei Augmentation Scheme.

src: Lefapha la Metsi le Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere le lona le hatetse pele ka boitokisetso ba ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Sekema sa Thusetso sa ho tloha Berg River ho ya Voelvlei.
tgt: Lirekhodi lesincumo seLuhlolo Lwelifutse Kumvelo lifanele kutsi likhishwe ekupheleni kwenyanga yeNyoni.

src: Letona la Metsi le Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere, Mofumahadi Nomvula Mokonyane, o se a laetse Bolaodi ba Tonele ya Trans-Caledon ho tla ka ditjhelete le ho kenya tshebetsong porojeke ena.
tgt: Indvuna yeTemanti Nekuhanjiswa Kwendle, MkNomvula Mokonyane, sewuyalele iTrans-Caledon Tunnel Authority kutsi icokelele timali siphindze sifezekise lomklamo.

src: Ba se ba qadile ho buisana le basebedisi ba baholo mme haufinyana ba tla buisana le Letona bakeng sa tumellano le Letona la Ditjhelete mabapi le ditekanyo tsa dikadimo bakeng sa porojeke ena.
tgt: Sebavele bacalile kukhulumisa nebasebentisi labakhulu futsi masinyane nje batawutsintsa Indvuna kute ivumelane neNdvuna Yetetimali mayelana nemali etawubolekwa etawusetjentiswa kulomklamo.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa dikgoeletso ho bohle ba ka hara Aforika Borwa ho netefatsa hore paballo ya metsi e ba teng jwaloka karolo ya bophelo ba bona ba letsatsi ka leng.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi igcizelela timemo leticondzswe kubo bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bacinisekise kutsi emanti ayongiwa njengencenye yetimphilo tabo temalanga onkhe.

src: Lesotho.
tgt: ILesotho.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le Mopresidente Zuma mabapi le ho tshwela ka mathe dipolao tse hlokang kelello tsa Molaodi wa Lebotho la Tshireletso la Lesotho, Mokgenerale Khoantle Motšomotšo.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi nayo njengaMengameli Zuma iyakugceka kubulawa ngesibhuku kweMphatsi weMbutfo Wetekuvikela waseLesotho, Jenene Khoantle Motšomotšo.

src: Ketsahalo ena ya morao-rao ya dikgoka ha e amohelehe.
tgt: Lesehlakalo sebudlova sakamuva asemukeleki.

src: Jwale ho matsohong a batho le boetapele ba Lesotho ho netefatsa hore kgutso le maemo a tlwaelehileng a kgutlisetswa ka hara Borena e le taba e potlakileng.
tgt: Manje kusemahlombe ebantfu nebaholi baseLesotho kucinisekisa kutsi ive laseLesotho liyazitsa futsi libuyela esimeni salo lesifanele ngekushesha.

src: Re dula re na le tshepo ya hore Ketapele ya Matona e Batlisisang Dinnete ya Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tse ka Borwa ba Aforika (SADC) e tla kgona ho thusa Lesotho ho teka maitshunyako a nepahetseng.
tgt: Siyachubeka nekwetsemba kutsi Imishini YeTindvuna Yekutfola Emaciniso yeNhlangano Yekutfutfukisa Emave LaseNingizimu ne-Afrika (i-SADC) itawukhona kusita iLesotho ekutfoleni tingenelelo letifanele.

src: SADC e dula e tiile mererong ya yona ya ho matlafatsa, ho tshireletsa le ho baballa demokerasi, kgotso, polokeho le botsitso ka hara lebatowa mme e sebedisana le boetapele ba Lesotho.
tgt: I-SADC iyachubeka nekutimisela ngemgomo wayo wekuhlanganisa, kuvikela nekugcina intsandvo yelinyenti, kuthula, kuphepha nekuzitsa kulesigodzi isebentisana nebaholi baseLesotho.

src: Libya.
tgt: ILibya.

src: Kabinete e amohela diphetho tsa Komiti ya Boemo bo Phahameng ya Kopano ya Aforika (AU) e mabapi le Libya Boemong ba Dihlooho tsa Dipuso le Mebuso e neng e tshwaretswe Brazzaville, ho la Riphabliki ya Congo.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyayemukela imiphumela levela kuLikomidi leLizinga leLiphakeme leBunye be-Afrika (i-AU) eLibya ezingeni leTinhloko teMbuso naHulumende, lebeyibanjelwe eBrazzaville, eCongo.. Mengameli Zuma uhlanganyele kuleLikomidi leLizinga leLiphakeme, lebelidzingidza futsi libuyeketa imitamo yekutfola sisombululo salomphelo ngenkinga yekungcubutana lokwenteka eLibya.. NjengeLilunga leLikomidi leLizinga leLiphakeme leLibya, iNingizimu Afrika yesekela yonkhe imitamo ye-AU lehlose kuletsa tisombululo tekuthula kuletinhlekelele taseLibya.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o ne a nkile karolo Komiting ya Boemo bo Phahameng, e tshohlileng le ho sheba botjha mekutu e lebisitseng ho tholeng tharollo ya moshwelella mabapi le diqabano tse tswellang ho ba teng ka hara Libya.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi igcizelela inkhulumo yaMengameli Zuma yekutsi iNingizimu Afrika seyikulungele kusita iLibya emitameni yangemuva yeKwakha Kabusha neKutfutfuka kwabelana naloko live lelitfu lelihlangabetene nako ekubuyisaneni, ekwakheni umtsetfosisekelo kanye nekuntjintja loMbuso ngekwentsandvo yelinyenti.

src: Jwaloka setho sa Komiti ya Boemo bo Phahameng e mabapi le Libya, Aforika Borwa e tshehetsa mekutu kaofela ya AU e reretsweng ho tlisa tharollo ya kgotso bakeng sa koduwa ya Libya.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iphindze futsi igcizelela kubaluleka kwekukhulumisana neLibya ngalokuchumene nalokunekuthula.

src: Pitso ya Mekga (CoP13)1.
tgt: Inkhomfa yeMave Angamalunga (i-CoP13)1.

src: Kabinete e ananela hore Aforika Borwa, jwalo ka mosaenedi ho Khonvenshene ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) ya Twantsho ya Mahwatata, e nka karolo Tulong ya bo-13 ya COP13 e ntseng e tswela pele hajwale Ordos, PRC ho tloha ka la 6 ho isa ka la 16 Loetse Ho lebeletswe hore pitso ena e tla phethela le ho amohela moralo o motjha wa lewa bakeng sa 2018-2030 e hlophisitsweng tlasa mookotaba “Re Lebisa Lefatsheng le Itekanetseng bakeng sa Meloko ya Hajwale le ya Kamoso”.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyakwemukela kutsi iNingizimu Afrika, njengalinye lemave lasayine Sivumelwano saMhlabuhlangene (se-UN) seKulwa Kugucuka Kwetindzawo Tibe Lugwadvule, ihlanganyele kuSeshini ye-COP13 ye-13 lechubekako kwamanje e-Ordos, PRC lecale mhla ti-6 iyawuphela mhla ti-16 Inyoni Kulindzelwe kutsi lenkhomfa itawuphetsa ibuye futsi yemukele luhlakamsebenti lolusha lolubalulekile lwanga-2018-2030 loluhlelwe ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi “Kucondza Emhlabenni Lonemphilo Wetitukulwane Tamanje Netesikhatsi Letitako”.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla sebetsa ka matla ho netefatsa hore maano a fetolwa ho ba diketso tse phethahalang.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika itawusebentela kwenta siciniseko sekutsi tinchubomgomo tentiwa tibe tinyatselo letiphatsekako.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla sebetsa le dinaha kaofela ka hara Aforika mabapi le ho ntshetsapele maemo a naha le a kontinente.
tgt: INingizimu itawusebentisana nawo onkhe emave ase-Afrika ekuchubekiseleni embili sincumo nemibono yalelive kanye neyalelivekati.

src: Karolo ya Boemo bo Phahameng ba pitso ena bo tla sekaseka le ho fana ka tataiso ya sepolotiki mabapi le diphephetso tsa dintlha tse ntseng di runya mabapi le mahwatata, ho theoha ha maemo a mobu le komello.
tgt: Sigaba seLizinga leLiphakeme salenkhomfa sitawucabanga sibuye futsi sinikete inkhombandlela yetepolitiki mayelana netinsayeya tetindzaba tekugucuka kwemhlaba ube lugwadvule, kwehla kwelizinga lemhlaba nesomiso.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho tshireletsa le ho hlokomela tikoloho bakeng sa ho e baballa bakeng sa meloko ya kamoso.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bavikele babuye futsi banakekele imvelo kute kutsi ilondvolotelwe titukulwane letitako.

src: Beng ba dipalangwang tsa setjhaba.
tgt: Labasebenta ngetitfutsi temmango.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe diketsahalo tsa dikgoka, ho tjheswa ha makoloi a beng ba thepa le diketso tsa ditshoso pakeng tsa Beng ba Ditekesi tsa Dimithara le Balekane ba E-Hailing tse etsahetseng Sandton, Johannesburg.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi igceka tento tebudlova, kushiswa kwetimoto netento tekwesabisa letisemkhatsini waBosomatekisi Bematekisi laneMamitha (ama-Meter Taxis) naBosomatekisi Lababambisene Bematekisi Labomabitwasabele (i-E-Hailing), eJozi.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho makala a qobello ya molao ho sebetsana le baetsi ba dikgoka le ditshoso ka hara dipehelo tsa Molaotheo.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi imema tinhlangano leticinisekisa kulandzelwa kwemtsetfo kutsi tibukane nebabhebhetseli bebudlova nekwesabisa ngekhatsi kweMtsetfosisekelo.

src: Diketsahalo tsena di sutha mekutung ya naha ya ho bopa maemo a kgwebo e lokolohileng le tlhodisano e hlokang leeme.
tgt: Letehlakalo leti tiyakhwesha kumitamo yalelive lehlelekile yekwakha simo sekuhwebelana ngalokukhululekile nekucudzelana ngalokufanele.

src: Balekgotla.
tgt: Emakhansela.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe ditlhaselo le dipolao tsa balekgotla ka hara diporofense tse ding le ho fetisetsa matshediso a yona ho malapa le metswalle ya ba bolauweng.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyakugceka kuhlaselwa nekubulawa kwemakhansela kuletinye tifundza iphindze futsi yendlulisele emavi endvudvuto emindenini nakubangani balabo lababulewe.

src: Sena se kgahlanong le dipehelo tsa boitshwaro tsa Molaotheo, le ho sutha demokerasing ya rona ya tswelopele le tokelo ya batho ya ho kgetha baemedi ba bona ba setjhaba.
tgt: Loku kuphambene nenkhambo yeMtsetfosisekelo, kuphindze futsi kuphumile endleleni yentsandvo yelinyenti letfutfukisako kanye nelilungelo lebantfu lekukhetsa labatawumelela sive.

src: Esale ho tloha qalong ya selemo, ho bile le mafu a mmalwa ka hara KwaZulu-Natal, mme haufinyana tjena, ho tlalehilwe mafu ka hara Kapa Botjhabela.
tgt: Kusukela umnyaka usasuka, kusandza kushona bantfu labanengi KwaZulu-Natal, kuphindze futsi kwabikwa labanye bantfu labashonile eMphumalanga Kapa.

src: Dikgoka tsena di nkile maphelo a balwanedi ba tokoloho ba batjha, ho kenyeletswa le Mongodi Kakaretso wa mehleng wa Liki ya Batjha ya ANC (ANCYL) Sindiso Magaqa, ya neng a sa ntsane a na le se sengata seo a ka se nyehelang mabapi le ho aha Aforika Borwa e tswetseng pele.
tgt: Lobudlova sebutsetse timphilo tetishanhlitiyo letincane, kufaka ekhatsi loyo longasekho lobekanguMabhalane Jikelele weNhlangano Yelusha Yakhongolose (i-ANCYL) Sindiso Magaqa, lobekasenalokunyenti langakunikela ekwakheni iNingizimu Afrika lephumeleko.

src: Re ipiletsa ho mekga ya dipolotiki ho kgothaletsa mamellano hara ditho tsa yona le ho ipiletsa ho badudi ho tshehetsa ba Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa ya Aforika Borwa (SAPS) diphuputsong tsa bona.
tgt: Simema emacembu etepolitiki kutsi akhutsate kubeketelelana emkhatsini wemalunga awo siphindze futsi simema yonkhe imimango kutsi yesekele Luphiko Lwetemisebenti Yemaphoyisa LwaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) ekuphenyeni kwalo.

src: Kgwedi ya Botjhaba.
tgt: Inyanga yeMagugu.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa kaofela ho tswela pele ho ananela Kgwedi ya Botjhaba ya selemong sena tlasa mookotaba: “Selemo sa Oliver Reginald Tambo: Re keteka Lefa la Tokoloho ya rona”.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikhutsata bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bachubeke bagubhe umkhosi weNyanga yeMagugu yalomnyaka ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Umnyaka wa-Oliver Reginald Tambo: Sigubha Inkhululeko yetfu Leligugu”.

src: Kgwedi ena e tsamaelana le dilemo tse lekgolo tsa letsatsi la tswalo la OR Tambo, Morati wa naha ya habo ya Aforika, ya bontshitseng boitelo bo sa thekeseleng ba ho sebeletsa batho ba Aforika Borwa, kontinente le lefatshe.
tgt: Lenyanga icondzene nemnyakalikhulu wekutalwa kwa-OR Tambo, Lishanhlitiyo lase-Afrika, lowakhombisa kungapheli emandla ekusebenteleni bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika, livekati kanye nemhlaba.

src: Hape re tshwaile sehopotso sa bo-40 sa lefu la Steve Bantu Biko, ya ileng a bolawa ka sehloho ke mmuso wa kgethollo.
tgt: Siphindze futsi sagubha umkhosi weminyaka le-40 wekushona kwaSteve Bantu Biko, lowabulawa ngesihluku ngumbuso welubandlululo.

src: Letona la Bonono le Botjhaba, Monghadi Nathi Mthethwa, o lokolotse lenaneo la mekete ya kgweding ena.
tgt: Indvuna yeTebuciko Nemasiko, MnuNathi Mthethwa, ukhiphe luhlelo lwekugubha lenyanga.

src: Diqeto tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Tincumo teKhabhinethi.

src: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka ditlaleho tsa pele tsa tshebetso tsa kgatelopele ya kotara ka nngwe bakeng sa 2017/18 mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha diphetho tsa dintlha tse ka sehlohlolong bakeng sa nako e dipakeng tsa Mmesa le Phuptjane 2017.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi yatiswa ngemibiko yenchubekelembili yekusebenta yekota yekucala yanga-2017/18 mayelana nekufezekiswa kwemiphumela lebekwa embili yesikhatsi lesisemkhatsini waMabasa neNhlaba 2017.

src: Mmuso o tswela pele ho etsa kgatelopele e bonahalang mabapi le ho kenya tshebetsong diphetho tsa dintlha tse 14 tse ka sehlohlolong, tse itshetlehileng hodima Moralo wa Lewa wa Nako e Bohareng (MTSF) 2014-2019, o re atametsang tabeng ya ho fihlella Tjhebelopele ya 2030 ya NDKabinete hape e ile ya tsebiswa ka dibaka tse ileng tsa ba le ditiehiso mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong le ho tsebiswa ka mehato e batlehang ho akofisa phano.
tgt: Hulumende uyachubeka nekwenta inchubekelembili ekufezekiseni imiphumela lebekwa embili le-14, letsetfwe kuLuhlaka Lwendlelalisu Lwethemu Lesemkhatsini (i-MTSF) lwanga-2014-2019, lolusisondzeta dvutane neKuphumelelisa Umbononchanti we-NDP wanga-2030.

src: Dikopano tsa boraditaba tsa Matona a Dikarolo ka ho fapana di tla tshwarwa ho tsebisa ka diphetho tsa ditlaleho tsena bekeng ya la 6 ho fihlela ka la 15 Mphalane 2017.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi yaphindze futsi yatiswa ngetindzawo letabambeleleka ekufezekisweni kwaphindze futsi kwahlolwa netinyatselo tayo letidzingeka ekusheshiseni kwetfulwa.

src: Sekejule se tla lokiswa kgafetsa le ho manehwa ho WEBTOKEKabinete e tjhaelletse monwana tshisinyo ya hore Aforika Borwa e tshware Dipontsho tsa Lefatshe tsa Kopano ya Telecom tsa Matjhaba tsa Meralo ya Motheo ya Dikgokahanyo tsa Mehala ka Loetse 2018.
tgt: Tinkhulumo tebetindzaba teMaklasta eTindvuna titawetfulwa kute kwatiswe ngemiphumela yalemibiko ngeliviki lamhla ti-6 Imphala kute kube ngumhla ti-15 Imphala 2017.

src: Tsena ke dipontsho tsa selemo ka seng le foramo bakeng sa mmuso le baetapele ba diindaseteri ho fuputsa diphephetso, dilekane le ditharollo, le ho hlwaya menyetla ya matsete le ditlwaelo tse ntle ka ho fetisisa bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya moruo wa kahisano ka Dithekenoloji tsa Tlhahisoleseding le Dikgokahanyo (di-ICT).Sena e tla be e le lekgetlo la pele ketsahalo ena e tshwarelwa Aforika.
tgt: Leshejuli itawulungiswa njalo ngetikhatsi letifanele bese ifakwa ku: WEBTOKEIkhabhinethi seyivume siphakamiso sekutsi iNingizimu Afrika ingenise Umbukiso Wemhlaba Wetekuchumana Ngetincingo Wenhlangano Yemave Emhlaba Yekuchumana Ngetincingo (i-ITU) ngeNyoni 2018.

src: Nakong ya ketsahalo ena, indaseteri ya ICT ya Aforika Borwa e tla thola monyetla wa ho pepesa dihlahiswa tsa yona ka ho latelana.
tgt: Lona ngumbukiso wemnyaka nenkhundla yabaholi bahulumende nebetimboni yekwehlwaya tinsayeya, kubambisana kanye netisombululo, bese kutfolwa ematfuba elutjalomali kanye netindlela letihamba embili tekusebenta tekutfutfukisa tenhlalo netemnotfo ngeThekhinoloji Yelwati Lwetekuchumana (i-ICT).Loku kutawuba kwekucala ngca kutsi lomkhosi ubanjelwe e-Afrika.

src: Lekala la naha la bohahlaudi le lona le tla kgola molemo nakong ena.
tgt: Ngesikhatsi salomkhosi, imboni yaseNingizimu Afrika ye-ICT itawunikwa litfuba lekukhombisa imikhicito yayo lefanele.

src: Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: Imikhosi Letako.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla etella pele kemedi ya Aforika Borwa ho Tulo ya bo-72 e Tlwaelehileng ya Kopano Kakaretso ya UN tlasa mookotaba “Re Tsepamisa Maikutlo Bathong: Re Tsitlallela Kgotso le Bophelo bo Khabane bakeng sa Bohle Polaneteng ya Moshwelella” ho la New York, Amerika.
tgt: Mengameli Zuma utawuhola litsimba laseNingizimu Afrika lelicondzise emabombo kuSeshini ye-72 Leyetayelekile yeMhlangano Lomkhulue we-UN ngaphansi kwengcikitsi letsi “Kugcila kuBantfu: Kuphokophela Kuthula neMphilo Lenesitfunti yabo Bonkhe kuPlanethi leSimeme” eNew York, e-United States of America.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla tswela pele ho sebeletsa ho fihlella diphetho ho UN ha e tla be e nka karolo Tulong ya bo-72.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika itawchubeka nekusebentela kuzuza kulungiswa kwe-UN lapho ihlanganyela kuSeshini ye-72 Mengameli Jacob Zuma njengaSihlalo weNhlangano Yekutfutfukisa Emave LaseNingizimu ye-Afrika (we-SADC), utawubita Ingcungcutsela ye-Double Troika yeBaholi beMbuso naHulumende mhla ti-15 Inyoni 2017 ePitoli LeNgcungcutsela ye-Double Troika itawubanjwa ngenca yetehlakalo tepolitiki nekuphepha letisandza kwenteka eLesotho.3 Litsimba laseNingizimu Afrika lelizinga leliphakeme litawenta ibhidi yalo yekucala eLondon mhla tinge-25 Inyoni 2017 yekutsi kudlalelwe lapha eNingizimu Afrika Indzebe yeMhlaba yeLibhola Lembhoco yanga-2023.

src: Aforika Borwa e na le rekoto e matla e nang le bopaki ya ho tshwara diketsahalo tse kang eno.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika inelirekhodi lelihle lelifakazelwako lekungenisa imikhosi yaloluhlobo.

src: Kabinete e lakatsa ho boeletsa tshehetso ya yona e matla ya Boiketo bona le ho ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ho tshehetsa Boiketo bona bo tla nyehela haholo mabapi le momahano ya setjhaba le kaho ya setjhaba le ho sebetsa hape jwaloka sethusi bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya dipapadi.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi itsandza kugcizelela kwesekela kwayo leBhidi ngalokunemandla futsi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bayesekele leBhidi letawufaka ligalelo lelikhulu ekubumbaneni kwentenhlalo nasekwakheni sive lokutawuphindze futsi kutfutfukise temidlalo.

src: Melaetsa.
tgt: Imilayeto.

src: Kabinete e lakaletsa baahi ba Jeremane katleho yohle ha ba itokisetsa dikgetho tsa Bofederale ka la 24 Loetse 2017 ho kgetha ditho tsa Bundestag ya bo-19, eo ka nqa e nngwe e tla kgetha Motjhanselara le ho bopa mmuso o motjha.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ifisela takhamuti taseGermany yonkhe imphumelelo emalungiselweni ayo elukhetfo lwavelonkhe mhla tinge-24 Inyoni 2017 lwekukhetsa emalunga ePalamende yaseGermany, i-Bundestag, ye-9, letawubese ikhetsa Shansela bese yakha hulumende lomusha.

src: Jeremane ke motsetedi e moholo ka hara Aforika Borwa, ya ikemiseditseng dikamano tse tswelang pele, tshebedisano le bolekane.
tgt: IGermany ingumtjalimali lomkhulu eNingizimu Afrika, lolindzele budlelwane lobuchubekako, kubambisana nekusebentisana.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso a yona ho Caribean hammoho le dikarolo tsa Cuba le Amerika ho latela tshenyo e bakuweng ke Sefefo sa Irma.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi yendlulisela emavi ayo endvudvuto kubantfu besifundza saseCaribbean kanye nabeetinye tindzawo taseCuba nase-United States ngemuva kwenhlekelele lebangelwe sivunguvungu, i-Hurricane Irma.

src: Re fetisetsa matshediso a tswang botebong ba dipelo ho baratuwa ba ba lahlehetsweng ke maphelo le thepa ya bona koduweng ena.
tgt: Emavi endvudvuto andluliselwa kutihlobo talabo labashonile nabalahlekelwe timphahla tabo kulenhlekelele.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le setjhaba mabapi le ho thoholetsa Kevin Anderson mabapi le ho fihlella makgaolakgang a US Open.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi nayo njengalo lonkhe lelive ihalalisela Kevin Anderson ekufikeni kwakhe emaphetselweni e-US Open.

src: Ke sebapadi sa pele sa moAforika Borwa ho fihlella makgaolakgang a bompodi bo boholo ba thenese esale ho tloha ka selemo sa 1994.
tgt: Ungumdlali wekucala waseNingizimu Afrika lofike emaphetselweni emchudzelwano lomkhulu welibhola lemphebeto kusukela nga-1994.

src: Re na le tshepo ya hore o tla tswela pele ho ahella hodima phihlello ya hae e kganyang le ho kgothatsa batjha ba bang ba nang le talente ba MaAforika Borwa.
tgt: Siyatetsemba kutsi sitawuchubeka sakhele kulobumengemenge bekuzuza nekufaka inshisekelo kulabanye bantfu labasha nebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labanelithalente.

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro, 27 Loetse 2017, Union Buildings, Pretoria.
tgt: IKhabhinethi beyihlangene ngaLesitsatfu, wamhla tinge-27 Inyoni 2017, e-Union Building ePitoli.

src: Dintlha tsa Hajwale.
tgt: Tindzaba Letimcoka Telive.

src: Kopano Kakaretso ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UNGA).
tgt: Umhlangano Jikelele waMhlabuhlangene (i-UNGA).

src: Kabinete e amohetse puo ya Moporesidente Jacob Zuma ho Tulo e Tlwaelehileng ya bo-72 ya UNGA New York, Amerika ka la 12 Loetse 2017, tlasa mookotaba “Re Tsepamisa Maikutlo Bathong: Re tsitlallela Kgotso le Bophelo bo Kgabane bakeng sa Bohle Polaneteng ya Moshwelella”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyemukele inkhulumo yaMengameli Jacob Zuma layetfule kuSeshini Levamile Ye-72 yeMhlangano Jikelele waMhlabuhlangene eNew York eMelika mhla ti-12 Inyoni 2017, ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi, “Kugcila Kubantfu: Kulwela Kuthula Nemphilo Lehloniphekile Yabo Bonkhe Bantfu Emhlabeni Losimeme.”.

src: Dipuisano di ne di tsepamisitse maikutlo hodima, hara tse ding, Merero ya Ntshetsopele ya Moshwelella (di-SDG) ho fetofetoha ha tlelaemete le ditaba tsa kgotso le tshireletso le diphethoho tsa UN, ka ho qolleha diphethoho tsa Lekgotla la Tshireletso la UMoporesidente Zuma hape o saenne Tumellano e mabapi le Thibelo ya Dibetsa tsa Nutleleya, e bontshang boitlamo bo tswellang ba Aforika Borwa mabapi le ho fihlella lefatshe le hlokang tshoso e bakwang ke dibetsa tsa nyutleleya le ho netefatsa hore thekenoloji ya nutleleya e sebedisetswa merero ya kgotso feela.
tgt: Tinkhulumiswano betigcile, emkhatsini waletinye tintfo, eTinjongweni Tentfutfuko Lesimeme (ema-SGD) kuntjintja kwesimo selitulu kuthula netindzaba tekuphepha kanye netingucuko kuMhlabuhlangene, kakhulu kuntjintja kweMkandlu weTekuphepha waMhlabuhlangene.

src: Mopresidente Zuma o ne a hlophisitse dijo tsa mantsiboya tsa ho keteka dilemo tse lekgolo ho hlompha mofu Moporesidente wa mehleng wa African National Congress (ANC), Monghadi Oliver Reginald Tambo.
tgt: Mengameli Zuma uphindze futsi wasayina Sivumelwane lesimayelana neKwala Tikhali Tenozi, lokuyintfo lekhombisa kutinikela lokuchubekako kweNingizimu Afrika emitameni yekutsi kube nemhlaba lophephile engotini yetikhali tenozi kanye nekucinisekisa kutsi itheknoloji yenozi isetjentiselwa tinjongo tekuthula kuphela.

src: Kabinete e leboha maAforika Borwa kaofela bakeng sa ho keteka Kgwedi ya Bojalefa ka Loetse le ho boeletsa molaetsa wa Moporesidente Zuma wa Letsatsi la Bojalefa hore bohle ba ka hara naha ba hahamalle kopano e matla le ka hara diphapang.
tgt: Mengameli Zuma bekente umcimbi wekudla kwasihlwa wekugubha iminyaka lelikhulu wekuhlonipha Mengameli waKhongolose, waphambilini longasekho Mnu Olive Reginald Tambo.

src: Jwaloka ha naha e phethela Kgwedi ya Bojalefa tlasa mookotaba “Selemo sa Oliver Reginald Tambo: ho keteka tokoloho ya letlotlo la bojalefa ba rona”, maAforika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho ahella hodima dipehelo tsa bophelo tse ka hara Molaotheo le ho matlafatsa mekutu ya ho aha setjhaba se hlokang bofuma, tlala, ho hloka bodulo le ho se lekalekane.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ibonga bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika ngekugubha Inyanga Yemagugu ngenyanga yeNyoni ibuye futsi iphindze nayo isho umlayeto waMengameli Zuma weLusuku Lwemagugu lotsi sonkhe kulelive sifanele kutsi silangatelele lubumbano ekwehlukahlukaneni kwetfu.

src: Bakeng sa ho tiisa moya wa bojalefa, Kabinete e amohela tumellano e saennweng pakeng tsa Aforika Borwa le Tanzania, e reretsweng ho baballa nalane ya ntwa ya tokoloho.
tgt: Njengaloku lelive seliphetsa Inyanga Yemagugu ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi, “Umnyaka wa-Oliver Reginald Tambo: Sigubha Inkhululeko Yetfu Lelifa,” bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bayakhutsatwa kutsi bakhe etikwalamagugu lachazwe kuMtsetfosisekelo kanye nekucinisa imitamo yekwakha sive lesikhululekile ebuphuyeni, endlaleni, ekwesweleni emakhaya kanye nasesimeni sekungalingani.

src: UN e fafielletse ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Porojeke ya Ditsela tse Lebisang Boikemelong ka hara Aforika.
tgt: Ekukhutsateni umoya wemagugu, Ikhabhinethi iyasemukela lesivumelwane lesisemkhatsini weNingizimu Afrika neTanzania, lokuhloswe ngaso kulondvolota umlandvo wemzabalazo wenkhululeko.

src: Ka ho ketekwa ha moya wa bonngwe le tshebedisano-mmoho hara mekgatlo ya tokoloho ya Aforika mme e tla baka ho ahuwa ha museamo, laeborari le dibaka tsa polokelo ya nalane.
tgt: Mhlabuhlangene ukwemukele kucala kusebenta kweluhlelo lweTindlela letiya kuNdiphethe kuMkamo we-Afrika.

src: Aforika Borwa, tlasa boetapele ba Letona la Bohahlaudi, Mofumahadi Tokozile Xasa, e nkile karolo ho Letsatsi la Lefatshe la Bohahlaudi (27 Loetse 2017) le ho Kgwedi ya Bohahlaudi, tlasa mookotaba, “Bohahlaudi ba Moshwelella – Sesebediswa sa Ntshetsopele”.
tgt: Ngumgubho wemoya wemfelandzawonye kanye nekusebenta ngekubumbana nekuhlanganyela emkhatsini wetinhlangano tenkhululeko tase-Afrika nekutsi loko kutawuholela ekwakhiweni kwemsamo, umtapomabhuku netilondvolotimlandvo.

src: Sena se fana ka lepatlelo bakeng sa ho tshehetsa diphethoho leanong, ditlwaelong tsa dikgwebo le boitshwaro ba basebedisi ba bohahlaudi, tse lebisitseng ho lekala la bohahlaudi la moshwelella, le ka nyehelang ka matla mabapi le ho fihlellwa ha di-SDNakong ya Letsatsi la Lefatshe la Bohahlaudi, dinaha le ditso tse fapaneng di keteka bongata ba diketsahalo tse itshetlehileng mabatoweng tse kang kgothaletso ya dikepele tse ikgethang le/kapa ho batalatsa ho fihlella dibaka, ho dumellwa ho kena ka bongata mahala diphakeng le dirapeng, le dipuisano tse fapafapaneng le bangkakarolo.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika, ngaphasi kwebuholi beNdvuna yeTekuvakasha, MkTokozile Xasa, ihlanganyele kuLusuku Lwetekuvakasha Lwemhlaba (mhla tinge-27 Inyoni 2017) kanye naseNyangeni yeTekuvakasha, ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi, “Tekuvakasha Letisimeme – Lithulusi Lentfutfuko.” Loku kwenta kutsi kusekelwe tingucuko kutinchubomgomo, tindlela tekuchuba ibhizinisi kanye nekutiphatsa kwetivakashi, kumkhakha wetekuvakasha losimeme kakhulu, lokungafaka ligalelo kakhulu ekufezekisweni kwema-SDNgeLusuku Lwetekuvakasha Lwemhlaba, emave lahlukene nemasiko lahlukene agubha lokunyenti lokwentiwako kwesifundza njengekugcugcutela ematharifi elikhetselo kanye/nome kuvula ematfuba ekukhona kufinyelela kutisetjentiswa, kufinyelela ngebunyenti eticiwini nasetivandzeni, kanye nekuchumana lokwahlukahlukene nalabatsintsekako.

src: Aforika Borwa e atlehile bakeng sa ho hodisa bohahlaudi ka dibaka tsa yona tse fapafapaneng tse nang le kgohedi tse kang diphaka tsa rona, mabopo a rona a lewatle a maemo a hodimo, le ditsha tsa bojalefa tse tjhaelletsweng monwana ke lefatshe.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika iphumelele ekugcugcuteleni tekuvakasha ngekusebentisa tisetjentiswa tayo letahlukahlukene letihehanako njengeticiwi tetfu, emabhishi etfu lanemjeka loluhlata sasibhakabhaka (lasezingeni lelifanele lelisetulu) kanye netindzawo temagugu letifakazelwa ngumhlaba.

src: Bokgoni ba Bohahlaudi ba ho amohela basebetsi e dula e le sebetsa se seholo kgahlanong le tlhokeho ya mesebetsi.
tgt: Emandla emsebenti wetekuvakasha ekucasheni tisebenti asikhali lesikhulu lesihlala sikhona njalo lesilwa nekuswelakala kwemsebenti.

src: Jwaloka sebaka sa bohahlaudi, Aforika Borwa e tobane le kgonahalo ya ho hodisa makala a yona a parolang le makala a mang a moruo ho kgonahatsa bokgoni bo matla ba moruo ka makala a mang a mehleng eo esale a le ka sehloohong a moruo.
tgt: Njengelive lelivakashelwako, iNingizimu Afrika ibukene nematfuba ekukhulisa imikhakha yayo yetekuvakasha kute kube netemnotfo letinkhulu ngekusebentisa loko lokubitwa ngekutsi yimikhakha yetemnotfo lemcoka yetendzabuko.

src: Ana a kenyeletsa bohahlaudi ba dibaka tsa mahae, tsa bongaka, tsa temo le tsa botjhaba.
tgt: Loku kufaka ekhatsi tindzawo tekuvakasha tasemaphandleni, tekwelapha, tekulima kanye netekuvakasha temasiko.

src: Tumellano ya ho beha ditheko tsa meriana ya HIKabinete e amohela tumellano e etsang pale ya ditefello e fihlelletsweng ke Letona la Bophelo bo Botle, Ngaka Aaron Motsoaledi, ka tshebedisano le mekgatlo e mengata ya matjhaba, ho akofisa boteng ba mokgahlelo wa pele wa pidisi e le nngwe ya kalafo ya HIHo akanngwa hore ho fokotswa ha tefello ho tla baka dipoloko tse ka fihlang ho R.7 bilione dilemong tse tsheletseng tse tlang.
tgt: Aaron Motsoaledi lafinyelele kuso, ngekuhlanganyela netinhlangano letinyenti temave emhlaba, kute kwentiwe ngekushesha kutfolakala kweliphilisi linye lelitsengekako leluhlelo lwekwelapha i-HIKutfolakele kutseni lokwehliswa kwentsengo kutawuholela ekutseni kongiwe tigidzigidzi letingetulu kwaleti-R.7 kuleminyaka lesitfupha letako.

src: Sena se tla thusa Aforika Borwa ho ngodisa bakudi ba bangata bakeng sa kalafo.
tgt: Loku kutawenta kutsi iNingizimu Afrika ibhalise tigulane letengetekile letitakwelashwa.

src: Tumellano ya ditefello e etsa hore moriana wa Dolutegravir, o kgothaletswang ke Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Bophelo bo Botle (WHO), o kgonahale bakeng sa mebuso ya dinaha tsa lekeno le tlase le le mahareng.
tgt: Lesivumelwane sentsengo senta kutsi lomutsi iDolutegravir, lonconywa yiNhlangano Yemhlaba Yetemphilo, ungabiti kakhulu ukhone kutsengeka, ungabiti kakhulu kubohulumende bemave labanemalingena lephasi kanye nalesemkhatsini.

src: Ho ya ka tumellano ya ditefello, Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle le rera ho tsebahatsa motswako wa ho nowa ho tsitsitseng ha meriana e meraro, Tenofovir, Lamivudine le Dolutegravir ka Mmesa 2018.
tgt: Ngekulandzela lesivumelwane sentsengo, Litiko Letemphilo lihlela kwetfula silinganisomutsi lesisha lesingagucuki lesiyihlanganisela yemitsi lemitsatfu, i-Tenofovir, iLamivudine neDolutegravir ngaMabasa 2018.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela a a seng a le maemong a ho kena ho tsa thobalano, ka ho qolleha batjha, ho tswela pele ho phela bophelo bo itekanetseng ba ho amohela mekgwa ya thibelo e kang ho dula ba kena thobalanong e bolokehileng ka ho ikgula thobalanong, ho tshepahala le ho sebedisa dikgohlopo, le ho kenela diteko tsa HIV kgafetsa.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labatimbandzakanya kutemacansi, ikakhulu lusha kutsi luchubeke luphile imphilo lekahle yekusebentisa tivikeli njengekuchuba temacansi letiphephile ngekugwema temacansi, ngekwetsembeka kanye nekusebentisa lijazi lemkhwenyana nekutihlola njalo i-HITemphilo.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa ha lehlakore le letjha la Sepetlele sa Cecilia Makiwane Mdantsane, ho la Kapa Botjhabela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kuvulwa kweluphiko lolushwa lwesibhedlela iCecilia Makiwane lesiseMdantsane, eMonti.

src: Ke mokolokotwane o lebisitseng ho kenngweng tshebetsong ha Inshorense ya Naha ya Bophelo bo Botle e tla baka hore ho be le phano ya tlhokomelo ya kalafo ya boleng, ka ho qolleha ho badudi ba futsanehileng.
tgt: Kuyinkhomba yelibanga lelikhulu leselihanjiwe leliya ekucaleni kwekusebenta kweMshwalensi Wavelonkhe Wetemphilo lotawuholela ekutseni kuniketwe tekunakekela ngetemphilo letisezingeni, ikakhulu kuleyo mimango lephuyile.

src: Sepetlele sena sa dithuto tse hodimo sa maemo a lefatshe ke matsete a ho fihlella tjhebelopele ya Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP) le di-SDG tsa UN tsa tlhokomelo ya kalafo ya lefatshe.
tgt: Lesibhedlela lesisezingeni lelikhetsekile leliphakeme siyintfo lebalulekile letawufezekisa umbononchanti weLisu Lavelonkhe Lekutfutfukisa (i-NDP) kanye nema-SDG aMhlabuhlangene ekunakekela ngetemphilo kwamhlaba wonkhe.

src: Sepetlele sena sa dibethe tse 526 se tshehetswa ke tsamaiso e kopanetsweng e tla matlafatsa phano ya tlhokomelo ya kalafo ya boleng.
tgt: Lesibhedlela lesinemibhedze lenge-526 sisekelwa luhlelo loluhlangene lolutakwenta kutsi kwetfulwe tekunakekelwa ngekwetemphilo lokusezingeni lelisetulu.

src: E sebedisa ntjhafatso ya thekenoloji ho fokotsa dinako tsa badudi tsa ho ema, e ntlafatsa ho hlahlojwa le ho thusa ka boitshunyako bo potlakileng ba kalafo bakeng sa bakudi.
tgt: Sisebentisa itheknoloji yemcondvo lomusha yekunciphisa sikhatsi sekulindza setigulane, yenta ncono kucilongwa kanye nekwenta kutsi kube nekungenelela ngekwetemphilo lokusheshisako etigulaneni.

src: Matsete ana a meralo ya motheo a R1 bilione a tla tshehetsa ntshetsopele ya moruo wa lehae ka hara makeishene.
tgt: Lesakhiwonchanti lesilutjalotimali lwesigidzigidzi-R1 sitawusekela intfutfuko yetemnotfo yendzawo emalokishini.

src: Ha re ntse re tsoseletsa meralo ya motheo ya boitekanelo ba setjhaba, hape re atolosa menyetla bakeng sa badudi ba lehae ya ho ntlafatsa maphelo a bona ka tlhahiso ya mesebetsi le ntshetsopele ya dikgwebo tsa lehae.
tgt: Njengaloku sivusetela sakhiwonchanti setemphilo yesive, siphindze futsi sivule ematfuba ekutsi imimango yendzawo yente ncono timphilo tayo ngekudala imisebenti nangekutfutfuka kwetemabhizinisi endzawo.

src: Kgwedi ya Ntshetsopele ya Kahisano.
tgt: Inyanga Yekutfutfukisa Tenhlalo.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ho tswela pele ho phahamisa ba hlokang lehlohonolo le tshwanang le la bona pele ho Kgwedi ya Ntshetsopele ya Kahisano ka Mphalane.
tgt: Ihabhinethi icela bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bachubeke nekuphakamisa labo labaswele kunabo ngembi kweNyanga Yekutfutfukisa Tenhlalo ngeMphala.

src: Kgwedi ya Ntshetsopele ya Kahisano e tshwarwa selemo ka seng ho hopola menyabuketso e mengata e entsweng ke naha, mabapi le ho fana ka thuso ya kahisano ho ba fumanehileng le ba tsietsing haholo ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Inyanga Yekutfutfukisa Tenhlalo iba minyaka yonkhe kute kukhunjulwe emabanga lelive leseliwahambile, ekunikeni lusito lwetenhlalo labaphuyile kanye nalabo labahlaseleka lula kakhulu baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla thakgola semmuso sehopotso sa Ntshetsopele ya Kgwedi ya Kahisano ka Labohlano, 29 Loetse 2017.
tgt: Mengameli Zuma utakwetfula ngekwemtsetfo kugubha umkhosi wekukhunjulwa kweNyanga Yekutfutfukisa Tenhlalo ngaLesihlanu, mhla tinge-29 Inyoni 2017.

src: Kabinete e lakaletsa ka mofuthu maqheku kaofela le batho ba hodileng Letsatsi le monate la Batho ba hodileng, le tla hopolwa ka Sontaha sa, la 1 Mphalane 2017.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ifisela tonkhe takhamuti letindzala nebantfu lasebakhulile injabulo ngaloLusuku Lwebantfu Labadzala, lolutawugutjwa ngeLisontfo, mhla lu-01 Imphala 2017.

src: MaAforika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho sebedisa kgwedi ya Mphalane ho ananela karolo le sehlabelo sa bohlokwa se entsweng ke batho ba hodileng mabapi le ho fihlella tokoloho ka hara naha ya bo rona.
tgt: Bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bayakhutsatwa kutsi basebentise inyanga yeMphala kubona indzima nekutinikela lokukhulu lokwentiwa bantfu labadzala ekutfoleni inkhululeko kulelive lakitsi.

src: Ke mosebetsi wa baahi mmoho ba bo rona, e seng feela mmuso, ho fana ka tlhokomelo e eketsehileng ho maqheku a rona le dihlopha tse tsietsing.
tgt: Ngumsebenti waleso naleso sakhamuti saseNingzimu Afrika, hhayi hulumende kuphela, kutsi anakekele kakhulu bantfu bakitsi labadzala kanye nalabo labahlaseleka lula.

src: Lenaneo la Mmuso wa Aforika Borwa la dithuso tsa setjhaba le thehilwe hodima tumelo e tiileng ya hore dithuso tsa polokeho ya setjhaba ke tokelo ya motheo ya botho mme di bohlokwa bakeng sa ho kgutlisa seriti sa baahi ba yona.
tgt: Luhlelo lolusita ngetenhlalo lwaHulumende waseNingizimu Afrika lwakhiwe etikwenkholelo lecinile letsi luhlelo lwesibonelelo semali sembuso lulilungelo lebuntfu lelisisekelo futsi limcoka ekuletseni sitfunti kutakhamuti talelive.

src: Dithuso tsa setjhaba di imolla mathata a ditjhelete a dimilione tsa malapa mme ka ho sebetsa mmoho le mmuso di matlafatsa ba tsietsing hore maemo a bona a bophelo a ntlafale a be le seriti.
tgt: Imali yesibonelelo yehlisa umtfwalo wetetimali kumakhaya latigidzi futsi kusebentisana nahulumende kuphakamisa labo labahlaseleka lula kute kutsi timo tabo tekuphila tibe ncono ngaloku nesitfunti.

src: Boitokisetso ba Dihlahlobo.
tgt: Emalungiselelo eluhlolo.

src: Kabinete e lakaletsa baithuti kaofela tse molemo, ka ho qolleha ba etsang Kereiti 12, jwaloka ha ba itokisetsa dihlahlobo tsa mafelo a selemo.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ifisela bonkhe bafundzi lokuhle, ikakhulu labo labenta Libanga le-12, njengaloku balungiselela kuhlolwa kwabo kwekuphela kwemnyaka.

src: Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo (DBE) le malala-a-laotswe bakeng sa dihlahlobo tsa materiki tse qalang ka la 16 Mphalane 2017 tse tla ngolwa ke baithuti ba fetang 798 000 ba ingodisitseng.
tgt: Litiko Letemfundvo Lesisekelo (i-DBE) selime ngemumo mayelana neluhlolo lwamatekuletjeni lolucala mhla ti-16 Imphahla 2017 lolutawubhalwa bafundzi lababhalisile labangetulu kwe-798 000.

src: DBE e fana ka tshehetso e eketsehileng ho baithuti ba materiki ka dithuto tsa tlatsetso hona sekolong kamora dihora tsa sekolo, le mafelong a beke le ka matsatsi a phomolo ya dikolo.
tgt: Litiko Letemfundvo Lesisekelo lesekela ngalokwengetiwe bafundzi bakamatekuletjeni ngemuva kwekuphuma kwesikolo kanye nangetimphelasontfo nangemaholodi ekuvalwa kwetikolo.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho batswadi le bahlokomedi ho fana ka tshehetso e batlehang ho baithuti ha ba ntse ba itokisetsa dihlahlobo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icele bonkhe batali nebondli kutsi besekele ngalokudzingekako bafundzi njengaloku batilungiselela luhlolo lwabo.

src: Beke ya Selemo ka seng ya Thusong Service Centre.
tgt: Liviki Lemnyaka Lwema-Thusong Service Centres.

src: Mmuso o phethetse ka katleho Beke ya Selemo ka seng ya selemong sena ya Thusong Service Centre, e etsahetseng ho tloha ka la 18 ho isa ka la 22 Loetse 2017 tlasa mookotaba: “Selemo sa OR Tambo – Re Ntshetsapele Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane, tse Mahareng le tse Kgolo ho di-Thusong Service Centre”.
tgt: Hulumende uliphetse ngemphumelelo Liviki Lemnyaka Lwema-Thusong Service Centres lalomnyaka, lelicale mhla ti-18 kwate kwaba ngumhla tinge-22 Inyoni 2017 ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Umnyaka wa-OR Tambo – Kwenta ncono Emabhizinisi Lamancane, Lasemkhatsini Nalamancane Kakhulu eTikhungweni teThusong.”.

src: Sena se bopile karolo ya Kgwedi ya Tshebeletso ya Mmuso le ho kgothaletsa Lenaneo la Thusong ka ho pepesa lenaneo le kopanetsweng la ho fihlella dibaka ka dibaka le bokgabane ba lona mabapi le ho arabela ditlhoko tsa baahi.
tgt: Loku kwente incenye Yenyanga Yetisebenti Tahulumende kwaphindze futsi kugcugcutela Luhlolo lweThusong ngekutsi kukhangise luhlelo loluhlanganisiwe loluhamba lufinyelele kubantfu kantsi imphumelelo yalo kutsi luphendvule tidzingo tetakhamuti.

src: Di-Thusong Services Centre di tlisa mokeke wa ditshebeletso tsa mmuso le tlhahisoleseding haufi le batho.
tgt: Tikhungo teThusong tiletsa tinsitakakalo tahulumende kanye nelwatiso dvute nebantfu.

src: Lenaneo lena le fihlella bakgolamolemo ba akanngwang ho dimilione tse tsheletseng selemo ka seng ka Lenaneo le Kopanetsweng la Phihlello ya Dibaka ka Dibaka la Phihlello, Beke ya Selemo ka seng ya Thusong Service Centre le mapatlelo a mang a Tsamaiso ya Dikgokahanyo le Tlhahisoleseding ya Mmuso (GCIS).
tgt: Loluhlelo lufinyelela cishe kubazuzi labatigidzi letisitfupha mnyaka wonkhe ngekusebentisa Luhlelo Loluhlanganisiwe Loluhamba Lufinyelele Kubantfu, Liviki Lemnyaka Lwema-Thusong Service Centres kanye naletinye tinkhundla teLuphiko Lwahulumende Lwetekuchumana Nekwatisa (i-GCIS).

src: Ka lenaneo lena, mmuso o tswela pele ho lokisa ho se lekalekane ha nako e fetileng ka ho tlisa ditshebeletso tsa boleng haufi le badudi bao pele ba neng ba qheletswe ka thoko ntshetsopeleng e tlwaelehileng ya moruo wa kahisano.
tgt: Ngekusebentisa loluhlelo, hulumende uyachubeka nekulungisa kungalingani kwasesikhatsini lesengcile ngekutsi aletse tinsitakalo letisezingeni kutsi tibe sedvute nemimango lebeyinganakwa ngaphambilini ibekelwe eceleni kwemkhakha lobanti wekutfutfukisa tenhlalo nemnotfo letimcoka.

src: Di-Thusong Service Centre hape di matlafatsa badudi ka maitsebelo le thupello e hlokehang bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa maphelo a bona, ka bolekane bo teng le mmuso, ditheo tse thuswang ke mmuso le lekala la poraefete.
tgt: Tikhungo Tema-Thusong Service Centres tiphindze futsi titfutfukise imimango ngemakhono ladzingekako kanye nekucecesha kute yente ncono timphilo tayo, ngekusebentisa budlelwane lobukhona nahulumende, tinkampane tahulumende kanye nemikhakha letimele.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa kgoeletso ya yona ho badudi ho tswela pele ho sebedisa di-Thusong Service Centre ho fihlella ditshebeletso tse kang tsa Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae, la Mesebetsi, la Toka, Lekala la Aforika Borwa la Dithuso tsa Setjhaba (SASA) le Letlole la Dikotsi tsa Mebila (RAF).
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyasiphindza futsi sicelo sayo lesicondzisa kumimangio kutsi ichubeke isebentise Tikhungo Tema-Thusong Service Centres kute ifinyelele kutinsitakalo letisisekelo njengaTasekhaya, Temisebenti, Tebulungiswa, iEjensi Yesibonelelomali Sembuso, neSikhwama Setingoti Temgwaco.

src: Myanmar.
tgt: TaseMyanmar.

src: Kabinete e tshwenyehile ka bothata ba badudi ba Rohingya ba balehileng malapeng a bona Myanmar.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikhatsatekile ngenhlupheko yetakhamuti taseRohingya letibaleke tashiya emakhaya ato eMyanmar.

src: Aforika Borwa e tshehetsa pehelo ya Mongodi-Kakaretso wa UN, Monghadi António Guterres, ya tobokeditseng boikarabelo ba Mmuso wa Myanmar ba ho fana ka tshireletso ho badudi bohle ba amehang, le hape ho kopa makala a thekolohelo ya botho ho fumantshwa phihlello ya badudi ba hlokang thuso le tshireletso.
tgt: INingzimu Afrika iyasesekela sitatimende lesikhishwe nguMabhalanejikelele waMhlabuhlangene, MnuAntónio Guterres, logcizelele sibopho saHulumende waseMyanmar aphephise yonkhe imimango letsintsekile, aphindze futsi acele ema-ejensi etebuntfu kutsi avunyelwe kufinyelela kumimango ledzinga lusito nekuvikelwa.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa mahlakore kaofela ho fedisa merusu le ho thibela ho tswela pele ha tshotleho ya batho le ho ipiletsa hore boemo ka hara Puso ya Rakhine bo rarollwe ho itshetlehilwe hodima molao.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi icela kakhulu onkhe emacembu kutsi acedze lobudlova kute kugwemeke kuhlupheka kwebantfu lokuchubekako iphindze futsi icela kutsi simo saseveni laseRakhine sisonjululwe ngekusebentisa tindlela temtsetfo.

src: Angola.
tgt: Tase-Angola.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le Moporesidente Zuma mabapi le ho thoholetsa Riphabliki ya Angola ka ho hlophisa Dikgetho tsa Naha tsa Ketsamolao tse atlehileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlanganyela kanye naMengameli Zuma ekuhalaliseleni iRiphabhliki yase-Angola ngekubamba Lukhetfo Lwavelonkhe Lwesishayamtsetfo ngemphumelelo.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o ne a kenetse Mokete wa Tlhomamiso ya Moporesidente João Manuel Gonçalves Lourenço Luanda ka Labobedi, la 26 Loetse 2017.
tgt: Mengameli Zuma uhambele Sibhimbi Sekubekwa kwaMengameli João Manuel Gonçalves Lourenço eLuanda ngaLesibili, mhla tinge-26 Inyoni 2017.

src: Aforika Borwa le Riphabliki ya Angola di na le nalane e tshwanang ya ntwa kgahlanong le bokoloniale le mmuso wa kgethollo.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika kanye neRiphabhliki yase-Angola anemlandvo lofananako wekulwa nebukholoni kanye nelubandlululo.

src: Esale ho tloha ka selemo sa 1994, dinaha tsena tse pedi di tswetse pele ho hodisa le ho atolosa maqhama a matla a bobedi bona.
tgt: Kusukela nga-1994, lamave lamabili achubekile ngekukhula andzisa budlelwane lobucinile emkhatsini wawo.

src: Angola ke e nngwe ya balekane ba baholohadi ba kgwebisano ba Aforika Borwa kontinenteng ya Aforika le ho tswela pele ho hodisa maqhama a yona.
tgt: I-Angola ingulomunye webalingani labakhulu labahwebelana neNingizimu Afrika kulelivekati lase-Afrika futsi buyachubeka nekukhula budlelwane emkhatsini walamave lamabili.

src: Tlhaselo ya bahahlaudi ba Netherlands.
tgt: Kuhlaselwa kwetivakashi taseNetherland.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe ho kgothotswa ha haufinyana tjena ha bahahlaudi ba Netherlands ba ileng ba salwa morao ho tloha Boemafofaneng ba Matjhaba ba OR Tambo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasihlaba sento lesisandza kwenteka sekubamba inkunzi tivakashi letivela eNetherlands letilandzelwe tisuka eSikhumulweni Setindizamshini Semave Emhlaba i-OR Tambo.

src: MaAforika Borwa kaofela a lokela ho tshwela ka mathe botlokotsebe bo kang bona bo tshosang lekala la rona le dulang le hola la bohahlaudi.
tgt: Bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bafanele kutsi babuhlabe bugebengu lobunjengalobu ngobe buyingoti kumkhakha wetfu wetekuvakasha lokhula njalo.

src: Kabinete e boetse e ipileditse ho Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa ya Aforika Borwa (SAPS) ho etsa leha e le sefe seo ba ka se kgonang ho tshwara baetsi ba botlokotsebe bona.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iphindze futsi yacela Luphiko Lwetemisebenti Yemaphoyisa lwaseNingizimu Afrika kutsi babambe labenti balobugebengu.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho setjhaba ho tla ka tlhahisoleseding leha e le efe e ka thusang balaodi ba qobello ya molao le ho etsa kgoeletso ya tshebediso ya letsoho le matla la molao bakeng sa ba tla fumanwa ba le molato.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi icela kutsi sive sivete lwatiso nome ngabe nguluphi lolungasita tiphatsimandla tekucinisekisa kugcinwa kwemtsetfo iphindze icela nekutsi sandla semtsetfo sisebente ngalokugcwele kulabo labatawutfolakala banelicala.

src: Ho thakgolwa ha buka ya melao ya setso ya Bakoena Ba Mopeli.
tgt: Kwetfulwa kwelibhuku lelitsi Umtsetfo Wendzabuko weBakoena Ba Mopeli.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa ho thakgolwa ha buka, Bakoena Ba Mopeli Customary Law of Succession and Genealogy, jwaloka phihlello ya mokolokotwane bakeng sa boetapele ba setso ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikushayela lihlombe kwetfulwa kwelibhuku, Bakoena Ba Mopeli Customary Law of Succession and Genealogy, njengenkhomba yelibanga lelidze nalelibalulekile leselihanjiwe ebuholini bendzabuko lapha eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Letona la Kopanelo ya Puso le Merero ya Botjhaba, Monghadi Des van Rooyen, le Motlotlehi Morena Letsie III, Hlooho ya Puso ya Borena ba Lesotho, ba ne ba kenetse ketsahalo ena ka Mantaha wa, la 25 Loetse 2017.
tgt: Indvuna yeLitiko Letekubusa Ngekubambisana Netendzabuko, MnuDes van Rooyen, kanye neNgwenyama Inkhosi Letsie we-III, Inhloko Yembuso waseLosotho, bahambele lomcimbi.

src: Lefapha la Kopanelo ya Puso le Merero ya Botjhaba le qadile ho hlophisa ditokomane tsa nalane ya dikarolo tse 13 tsa Borena/Bofumahadi ka selemo sa 2011.
tgt: Litiko Letekubusa Ngekubambisana Netendzabuko lacala kubhala umlandvo wemakhosi/wetindlovukati leti-13 nga-2011.

src: Buka ena e tla thusa ho utlwisisa nalane ya Bakoena Ba Mopeli le tlhahlamano ya madi bakeng sa ho baballa nalane ya rona.
tgt: Lelibhuku litawusita ekuvisiseni umlandvo nentalelwane ngekulandzelana ngenhloso yekulondvolota umlandvo wetfu.

src: Diqeto tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Tincumo TeKhabhinethi.

src: Porothokole ya Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tse ka Borwa ba Aforika (SADC).
tgt: Inchubondlela Yenhlangano Yekutfutfukisa Emave LangaseNgingizimu Ne-Afrika (i-SADC).

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho amohelwa ha Porothokhole ya SADC ya Taolo ya Tikoloho bakeng sa Ntshetsopele ya Moshwelella, ke Palamente.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kugunyatwa yiPhalamende kweNchubondlela ye-SADC lemayelana Nekulawula Temvelo kute kube Nentfutfuko Lesimeme.

src: Sepheo sa porothokhole ke ho kgothaletsa taolo ya tikoloho e parolang le meedi, e leng tabatabelo ya ditho tsa dipuso tsa SADAforika Borwa, jwaloka Modulasetulo wa SADC ho tloha ka Phato 2017 ho isa ka Phato 2018, e itlama ho matlafatsa mekutu ya lebatowa ya ho baballa mehlodi ya tlhaho ya ho parola le meedi le ho kgothaletsa ntshetsopele ya moshwelella ka hara lebatowa la SADSena se matahantswe le NDP, e behileng ka sehlohlolong ho tebisa kopanelo ya lebatowa la SADC hammoho le ho netefatsa paballo ya moshwelella ya tikoloho le diphethoho tse lekalekanang tse lebisang moruong wa khabone e tlase.
tgt: Inhloso yalenchubondlela kukhutsata kusetjentiswa kwemvelo ngalokusimeme nekulawula temvelo kwecela ngale kweminyele yalamanye emave, lokuyintfo emave langemalunga e-SADC lanenshisekelo nako.

src: Pitso ya Matona ya Bolekane bakeng sa Tshebetso mabapi le Moruo wa Tlhaho.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika, njengaSihlalo we-SADC kusukela ngeNgci 2017 kuya enyangeni yeNgci 2018, itimisele kucinisa imetamo yesigodzi yekulondvolota imitfombolusito yemvelo kanye nekukhutsata intfutfuko lesimeme esigodzini se-SADLoku kuhambisana neLisu Lavelonkhe Lekutfutfukisa, lelibeka embili kujulisa kuhlanganisa sifundza se-SADC kanye nekucinisekisa kutsi kusimama kwetemvelo kanye nekuntjintjela ngalokulinganako kumnotfo lokhipha kancane ikhabhoni.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tshwarwa ha Pitso ya Matona ya Bolekane bakeng sa Tshebetso mabapi le Moruo wa Tlhaho ka Loetse 2018.
tgt: Ihabhinethi ikuvumile kubanjwa kweKhomfa Yetindvuna yeLubanjwano Lwekusebenta mayelana Nemnotfo Longabhubhisi Imvelo ngenyanga yeNyoni 2018.

src: Lepatlelo lena le tshehetsa dinaha le mabatowa ho beha paballo ya moshwelella motsong wa maano a moruo le ditlwaelo bakeng sa ho ntshetsapele Lenaneo la 2030 la Ntshetsopele ya Moshwelella.
tgt: Lenkhundla yesekela emave netifundza kutsi tibeke kusimama kube yintfo lehamba embili kutinchubomgobo temnotfo naloko letikwentako ekutfutfukiseni i-Ajenda yanga-2030 Yentfutfuko Lesimeme.

src: Ke lenaneo la UN le kopanyang mmoho botsebi ho tswa Makaleng a mahlano a UN e leng Lenaneo la Tikoloho la UN Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa Basebetsi (ILO) Lenaneo la Ntshetsopele la UN Mokgatlo wa Ntshetsopele ya Diindaseteri wa UN le Setheo sa Thupello le Diphuputso.
tgt: Luhlelo lwaMhlabuhlangene loluhlanganisa ndzawonye bungcweti bema-ejensi lasihlanu aMhlabuhlangene labitwa ngekutsi: Luhlelo Lwamhlabuhlangene Lwetemvelo Inhlangano Yemave Emhlaba Yetemisebenti Luhlelo LwaMhlabuhlangene Lwekutfutfukisa Inhlangano Yamhlabuhlangene Yekutfutfukisa Tetimboni kanye Nesikhungo saMhlabuhlangene Sekucecesha Nelucwaningo.

src: Ho tshwara Pitso ya Matona ho tla ntshetsapele lenaneo lena, ka lapeng le kontinenteng ya Aforika, la kgolo e kenyeletsang mabapi le ho amohela motjha wa khabone e tlase le wa moruo o itsekang.
tgt: Kubamba IeKhomfa yeTindvuna kutawugcugcutela loluhlelo, lapha ekhaya kanye nakulelivekati lase-Afrika, nekukhula lokungukhukhulelangoco ngekuvuma umnotfo locinile lonekhabhoni lencane.

src: Boto ya Metsi ya Umngeni.1 Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka maemo a Boto ya Metsi ya Umngeni e leng ya bobedi e kgolohadi ka hara naha e nang le boleng selemo ka seng ba se ka fetang R2,4 bilione le ditekanyetso tsa Ditjeho tsa Tjhelete ya Sehlooho e fetang R7 bilione.
tgt: Umngeni Water Board.1 IKhabhinethi yahlolwa ngesimo seMngeni Water Board lokuyibhodi yesibili lenkhulu kulelive lenemalingena ngemnyaka lengetulu kwetigidzigidzi le-R2,4 kanye Nesabelotimali Selusebentisomali Yemali Yekucala Umsebenti yeminyaka lesihlanu lengetulu kwetigidzigidzi letisikhombisa temarandi.

src: Kabinete hape e tsebisitswe ka dipuisano tseo lefapha la metsi le tsamaiso ya dikgwerekgwere le neng le di tshwere le batsetedi ba lona.2 Bakeng sa ho tsitsisa dintlha tsa taolo tsa Boto, Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho thonngwa ha Boto ya Nakwana ha Letona le ntse le akofisa motjha wa ho thonya ka ho phethahala Boto ya Metsi ya Umngeni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphindze futsi yatjelwa ngalamafisha mayelana netinkhulumiswano litiko letemanti nekuhanjiswa kwekungcola ngemanti lelitibamba nebatjalitimali.2 Kute kube nekusimama etindzabeni tekubusa teBhodi, Ikhabhinethi igunyate kukhetfwa kweBhodi Yesikhashana ngesikhatsi Indvuna isachuba inchubo yekukhetsa emalungalatawusebenta ngalokuphelele eMngeni Ibhodi Yemanti.

src: Kabinete e kgotsofaditswe ke mosebetsi o etswang ke Letona mabapi le ho tsitsisa Boto ya Metsi ya Umngeni.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi inetisekile ngemsebenti weNdvuna leyiwentako ekusimamiseni Umngeni Water Board.

src: Dibili.
tgt: Imitsetfosivivinyo.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Tekolo ya Mobu.
tgt: Umtsetfosivivinyo Weluhlwayo Lwemhlaba.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Tekolo ya Mobu bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kweMtsetfosivivinyo Weluhlwayo Lwemhlaba kute kutsi sive siphawule ngawo.

src: Bili ena e fetola Molao wa Tekolo ya Mobu, wa 1997 (Molao wa bo-8 wa 1997).
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uchibela Umtsetfo Weluhlwayo Lwemhlaba, wanga-1997 (Umtsetfo we-8 wa-1997).

src: Dihlomathiso di matlafatsa metjha ya boikarabelo le taolo le ho fana ka thonyo ya ditho tse itseng tsa Boto ya Melawana ya Tekolo, e le ho matlafatsa taolo ya tekolo ya mobu ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Letichibelo tenta ncono tindlela tekutilandza nekwengamela futsi tenta kutsi kukhetfwe emalunga latsite eBhodi Yeluhlwayo Lwemitsetfosimiso, ngenhloso yekwenta ncono kuhlwaywa ngekwemtsetfosimiso kwemhlaba eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Bili hape e batla ho laola tekolo ya mobu ka hara Aforika Borwa ka ho matlafatsa Molekodi-Kakaretso e Moholo wa Mobu hore a shebane le ho beha leihlo boemong ba naha le tsamaiso hodima ditekolo tsa sebopeho sa mobu, sebopeho sa naha le tsa maemo a dimmapa, tlhahlobo ya dibaka tsa mobu le ditshebeletso tsa tlhahisoleseding ka lefatshe.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uphindze futsi uhlose kwenta kulawula kuhlwaywa kwemhlaba eNingizimu Afrika ngekunika emandla Umhlwayi Lomkhulujikelele kutsi ente umsebenti wavelonkhe wekwengamela nekulawula kuhlwaywa kuma kwendzawo, kuhleleka kwetintfo endzaweni, nelibalave lelikhombisa buniyo bemhlaba, imininingwane lephatselene nendzawo letsite kanye netinsita telwatiso lwemhlaba.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Melao ya Saense le Thekenoloji sa 2017.
tgt: Umtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibela Imitsetfo yeSayensi Netheknoloji wa-2017.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Melao ya Saense le Thekenoloji sa 2017 bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibela Imitsetfo yeSayensi Netheknoloji wanga-2017 kute kutsi sive siphawule ngawo.

src: Bili e sisinya ho tlisa tsamaelano le ho lokisa maemo a dipehelo tse laolang ditshebetso le taolo ya ditheo tsa setjhaba tse ikarabellang ho Letona la Saense le Thekenoloji.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uphakamisa kulinganisa nekuhambisa ngekuvumelana tindlelakwenta letilawula kusetjentiswa nekuphatsa tikhungo tesive letibika eNdvuneni Yetesayensi Netheknoloji.

src: Sena se tla netefatsa botsitso ditlhokong tsohle tse lokelang ho fihlellwa le metjha e lokelang ho latelwa ke ditheo jwaloka ha di amana le taolo.
tgt: Loku kutawucinisekisa kutsi kube nekungantjintji kuto tonkhe tidzingo lekumele kutsi kuhlangabetanwe nato netinchubo lekumele kutsi tilandzelwe nguletikhungo njengaloku tiphatselene nekwengamela.

src: Diketsahalo tse Tlang.
tgt: Imikhosi Letako.

src: Kgwedi ya Dipalangwang.
tgt: Inyanga Yetekutfutsa.

src: Jwaloka ha Mphalane 2017 e tshwaya Kgwedi ya Dipalangwang tlasa mookotaba: “Mmoho re ntshetsa Aforika Borwa Pele”, Kabinete e ipiletsa ho bohle ho sebetsa mmoho ho netefatsa hore meralo ya motheo ya naha ya dipalangwang e tswela bohle molemo le ho kgothaletsa basebedisi ba mebila ho nka boikarabelo le ho sebedisa boipaballo mebileng jwaloka karolo ya bophelo ba bona ba letsatsi ka leng.
tgt: Njengaloku inyanga yeMphala 2017 iyiNyanga Yetekutfutsa ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Sisonkhe Sichubela iNingizimu Afrika Embili.” IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu kutsi basebentisane ngekuhlanganyela kucinisekisa kutsi bonkhe bantfu bayazuza ngesakhiwonchanti setekutfutsa salelive futsi ikhutsata labo labasebentisa umgwaco kutsi batibophelele futsi balandzele umtsetfo wekuphepha emgwacweni njengencenye yetimphilo tabo temihla ngemihla.

src: Ka ho sebetsa mmoho re ka fokotsa dikotsi mebileng ya rona.
tgt: Ngekusebenta ngekuhlanganyela singatinciphisa tingoti letishwacisa lugogo letihamba nemiphefumulo leminyenti letenteka emigwacweni yetfu.

src: Nakong ya Kgwedi ya Dipalangwang, mmuso – o eteletswe pele ke Lefapha la Dipalangwang le ditheo tsa lona – o tla hlakisa melemo ya moruo ya lekala lena ka ho pepesa ditshebeletso tsa meralo ya motheo ho tsa bofofisi, mawatle, dipalangwang tsa setjhaba, tsa mebileng le diterene.
tgt: NgeNyanga Yetekutfutsa, hulumende – aholwa Litiko Letekutfutsa netikhungo talo – utawukhombisa emabalengwe etinzuzo tetemnotfo talomkhakha ngekukhangisa tinsitakalo tesakhiwonchanti setekutfutsa kutekundiza emoyeni, kutaselwandle, tekutfutsa sive, imigwaco nemivila yetitimela.

src: Ho thakgolwa ha naha ho tshwaretswe Lebaleng la dipapadi la Sinaba Daveyton ka hara Motsemoholo wa Ekurhuleni ka la 29 Loetse 2017.
tgt: Kwetfulwa kwavelonkhe kutawentiwa enkhundleni yetemidlalo eSinabawill eDaveyton edolobhenikati lase-Ekurhuleni mhla tinge-29 Inyoni 2017.

src: Matsete lekaleng la dipalangwang a hlasimolla ntshetsopele le ho hlahisa mesebetsi jwaloka karolo ya Aforika Borwa ya Moralo wa Dintlha tse Robong, o reretsweng ho hodisa moruo le ho hlahisa mesebetsi e hlokahalang haholo.
tgt: Lutjalotimali emkhakheni wetekutfutsa lukhutsata intfutfuko futsi ludala imisebenti njengencenye yeLisu Lemaphuzu Layimfica laseNingizimu Afrika, lokuhloswe ngalo kutsi kukhuliswe umnotfo luphindze ludale nemisebenti ledzingeka kakhulu.

src: Matsete ana a tla netefatsa ho ahuwa ha marangrang a dipalangwang tsa setjhaba a kopanetsweng ho phatlalla le naha.
tgt: Lolutjalotimali lutawucinisekisa kutsi kwakhiwa inethiwekhi yetekutfutsa sive lehlanganisiwe eveni lonkhana.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla tshwara Tulo ya bo-2 ya Khomishene ya Dinaha tse Pedi (BNC) ya Africa Borwa-ZimbabweMoporesidente Jacob Zuma o tla amohela wa mphato wa hae wa Zimbabwe, Mohlomphehi Moporesidente Robert Mugabe, ya tla ba teng Aforika Borwa ka la 03 Mphalane 2017 lebakeng la Tulo ya bo-2 ya BNC ya Aforika Borwa-Zimbabwe.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika itawungenisa Iseshini Yesibili Yekhomishini Yavelonkhe yalamave lamabili iNingizimu Afrika neZimbabwe (i-BNC).Mengameli Jacob Zuma utawube abambe umhlangano nemlingani wakhe, Umhlonipheki Mengameli Robert Mugabe, lotawube aseNingizimu mhla ti-3 Imphala 2017 mayelana neSeshini Yesibili yalamave lamabili iNingizimu Afrika neZimbabwe.

src: Tumellano ya ho theha BNC e saenwe ka Mmesa 2015 le ho hlomamiswa ka Mphalane 2016 Harare, Zimbabwe.
tgt: Sivumelwane sekusungula le-BNC sasayinwa ngaMabasa 2015 sacala kusebenta ngeMphala 2016 eHarare, eZimbabwe.

src: Aforika Borwa le Zimbabwe di na le dikamano tse ntle tsa bobedi bona tsa sepolotiki, moruo le kahisano tse fafielletsweng ka maqhama a nalane ya dilemo tse ngata.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika neZimbabwe inebudlelwane betepolitiki lobuhle, kutemnotfo nebetenhlalo lobusekelwa budlelwane betemlandvo lobucinile kusukela eminyakeni leminyenti kudzala.

src: Dinaha tse pedi tsena ha di arolelane feela dikamano tse matla tsa nalane empa le tshebedisano ho tsa moruo.
tgt: Lamave lamabili akabelani kuphela ngebudlelwane betemlandvo lobucinile kodvwa nekusebentisana kutemnotfo.

src: Zimbabwe ke e nngwe ya balekane ba Aforika Borwa ba bahlano ba ka hodimo ka ho fetisisa ka hara kontinente ka dipalopalo tse bontshang kgolo selemo ka seng.
tgt: Live laseZimbabwe lingulelinye kulasihlanu lemave lasetulu iNingizimu Afrika lahwebelana nalo kuleLivekati, kantsi lubalobalo lwetekuhwebelana lukhombisa kwenyuka ngemnyaka.

src: Ka selemo sa 2016, Diyantle tsa Aforika Borwa ho ya Zimbabwe di ne di akanyetswa ho R.3 bilione.
tgt: Nga-2016 imphahla iNingizimu Afrika leyitfumele eveni laseZimbabwe ilinganiselwa cishe etigidzigidzini letinge-R. Imilayeto.

src: Letsatsi la Tswalo – Mama Winnie Madikizela-Mandela.
tgt: Lusuku lwekutalwa – LwaMake Winnie Madikizela-Mandela.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le naha kaofela mabapi le ho lakaletsa Mama Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, ya tsebahalang jwaloka Mme wa Setjhaba, letsatsi la tswalo le monate ha a ne a qeta dilemo tse 81 ka Labobedi, 26 Loetse 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlanganyela kanye nelive lonkhe ekufiseleni Make Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, lowatiwa ngekuteketisa ngekutsi nguMake Wesive, injabulo ngelusuku lwakhe lwekutalwa njengaloku ngaLesibili, mhla tinge-26 Inyoni 2017 ahlanganisa iminyaka lenge-81.

src: Mama Madikizela-Mandela ke e mong wa diqhoku tsa ntwa ya tokoloho tse babatswang ka ho fetisisa.
tgt: Make Madikizela-Mandela ungulomunye wetishikashiki tenkhululeko taseNingizimu Afrika letatiwako.

src: Kabinete e mo leboha bakeng sa tshebeletso ya hae Ntweng ya tokoloho ya rona e lwanetsweng ka thata le ho mo lakaletsa selemo se latelang se tletseng mahlohonolo bakeng sa hae le baratuwa ba hae le ba lelapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyambonga ngekusebenta kwakhe eMzabalazweni wenkhululeko leyalwelwa kamatima futsi imfisela umnyaka lobusisekile yena kanye nalabo labatsandzako kanye nemndeni wakhe.

src: Banyana Banyana.
tgt: IBanyana Banyana.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Banyana Banyana mabapi le ho hapa Bompodi ba Basadi ba 2017 ba COSAFA kamora ho hlola ka 2-1 ho makgaola kgang kgahlanong le Zimbabwe ho la Bulawayo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela iBanyana Banyana ngekuphumelela kuMcudzelwano we-COSAFA wa-2017 Wabomake ngemuva kwekuncoba iZimbabwe ngemagoli lamabili kulinye (2-1) lapha kaBulawayo.

src: Banyana Banyana ba phahamisitse folakga ya naha ka motlotlo mme mesebetsi ya bona e tswela pele ho kgothatsa ba bang ba batjha ba maAforika Borwa ba nang le talente ya ho ipabola ka makgabane.
tgt: IBanyana Banyana iwuphakamisela etulu ngekutigcabha umjeka waseNingizimu Afrika nekutsi kudlala kwayo ngalendlela kuyachubeka nekufaka umdlandla labanye labasha labanelikhono baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bente kancono kakhulu.

src: Ho reketla ha lefatshe Mexico.
tgt: Kutamatama kwemhlaba eMexico.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le Moporesidente Zuma mabapi le ho fetisetsa matshediso ho Moporesidente Enrique Peña Nieto wa Dinaha tse Kopaneng tsa Mexico le batho ba Mexico ho latela ho reketla ha lefatshe, tsunami le kganyapa tse bakileng tshenyo, e bakileng mafu a fetang 225 le tshenyo e matla ya meralo ya motheo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlanganyela kanye naMengameli Zuma ekuvakaliseni kudzabuka kuMengameli Enrique Peña Nieto we-United Mexican States kanye nakubantfu baseMexico ngemuva kwenhlekele yesehlakalo sekutamatama kwemhlaba, itsunami kanye nesiphepho, lokuholele ekutseni kushone bantfu labange-225 kanye nemonakalo lomkhulu lodaleke kusakhiwonchanti.

src: DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di lokelwa ke ho tiisetswa ka mangolo a thuto le tumellano e amehang.
tgt: Kubekwa EtikhundleniKonkhe kubekwa etikhundleni kuya ngekucinisekiswa kweticu tabo kanye nekuvunywa lokufanele.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho thonngwa ha Boto ya Nakwana ya Boto ya Metsi ya Umgeni:a. Mofumahadi Ziphozethu Mathenjwa (Modulasetulo)b. Mofumahadi Nompumelelo Chamanec.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kubekwa kweBhodi Yesikhashana yeMngeni Water Board:a. Mk Ziphozethu Mathenjwa (Sihlalo)b. Mk Nompumelelo Chamanec.

tgt: Mnu Visvin Reddyd.

tgt: Mnu David Dikokoe.

tgt: Mk Zodwa Manasef.

tgt: Tshidi Hatashe kanyeg.

tgt: NeMnu Midiavhathu Tshivhase.

src: Ditho tse tla sebetsa ho Phanele ya Bolaodi ba Phethisetso:a. Monghadi Sandile Bubele Siyaka (sehla sa bobedi)b. Monghadi Ntshengedzeni Anthony Michael Tshivhase (sehla sa bobedi)c. Monghadi Christopher Ewing (sehla sa bobedi)d. Monghadi Ebrahim Aboobaker Moolla (sehla sa bobedi)e. Mofumahadi Nonzukiso Zukie Siyotula lef.

src: Mofumahadi Nocamagu Nomfundo Mbulawa.
tgt: NaMk Nocamagu Nomfundo Mbulawa.

src: Batsamaisi bao seng ba phethahatso ho Boto ya Inshorense ya Koporasi ya Mekitlane ya Thepa ya Diyantle ya Aforika Borwa - SOC Limited:a. Monghadi Dhevendren Dharmalingam (Modulasetulo)b. Mofumahadi Vuyelwa Matsiliza (o thontswe hape) lec.
tgt: Bacondzisi labangekho esigungwini se-Board of the Export Credit Insurance Corporation of South Africa SOC Limited:a. Mnu Dhevendren Dharmalingam (Sihlalo)b. Mk Vuyelwa Matsiliza (uphindze wakhetfwa) kanyec.

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro, la 18 Mphalane 2017, Tuynhuys, Motse Kapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi beyihlangene ngaLesitsatfu, ngamhla ti-18 Imphala 2017, e-Tuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Dintlha tsa Hajwale.
tgt: Tindzaba Letimcoka Telive.

src: Letsatsi la Tokoloho ya Boraditaba.
tgt: Lusuku Lwenkhululeko Lwebetindzaba.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le maAforika Borwa mabapi le ho hopola Letsatsi la Tokoloho ya Boraditaba ka Labone, 19 Mphalane 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi nayo njengebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika ibungata Lusuku Lwenkhululeko Lwebetindzaba ngaLesine, mhla ti-19 ku-Okthoba 2017.

src: Boraditaba ba bapetse karolo e hlokolosi ntweng e neng e le kgahlano le mmuso wa kgethollo, ba pepesa sehloho le bokgopo bo entsweng ke mmuso wa kgethollo.
tgt: Betindzaba badlala indzima lebaluleke kakhulu ekulweni nelubandlululo, kuveta lababulawa ngesihluku neludlame lebekwentiwa ngumbuso welubandlululo.

src: Selemo sena se tshwaya dilemo tse 40 esale mmuso wa kgethollo o thibela dikoranta tse neng di pepesa kgethollo tse kang the World, the Weekend World le the Voice.
tgt: Lomnyaka ngewe-40 kusukela hulumende welubandlululo wavala kusebenta kwemaphephandzaba lebekanenchubekela phambili lafana ne-World, Weekend World kanye ne-Voice.

src: Kajeno, tokoloho ya boraditaba e kenyeleditswe ka matla ka hara Molaotheo wa Aforika Borwa le ho dula e le letshwao la motheo la setjhaba sa bo rona se tswelang pele.
tgt: Namuhla, kukhululeka kwebetindzaba kukhutsatwa ngalokugcwele kuMtsetfosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika futsi kuyohlala kuyincenye lebalulekile kulelive letfu lelisatfutfuka.

src: Kabinete ho feta moo e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa ho tswela pele ho kgothaletsa phumantsho ya tlhahisoleseding le ho sebedisa tokelo ya tokoloho ya boraditaba ka boikarabelo ho thusa ho aha Aforika Borwa e kopaneng, e hlokang semorabe, e sa kgetholleng ho ya ka bong, ya demokerasi le e tswang pele bakeng sa bohle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibuye ikhutsate bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bachubeke batfutfukise kufinyelela kulwatiso nekusebentisa lelilungelo lekukhululeka kwebetindzaba ngendlela lefanele kute basite ekwakheni iNingizimu Afrika lebumbene, lengacwasi ngekwebuhlanga, lengacwasi ngekwebulili, lebuswa ngentsandvo yelinyenti futsi lenemphumelelo kubo bonkhe bantfu.

src: Moruo wa Mawatle.
tgt: Umnotfo Waselwandle.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Moporesidente Jacob Zuma mabapi le ho fana ka tlaleho ya kgatelopele ho bankakarolo ka ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Operation Phakisa bakeng sa Moruo wa Mawatle le ho ipiletsa ho bankakarolo bohle ho tswela pele ho aha selekane le mmuso bakeng sa ho bula bokgoni ba moruo ba mawatle a rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ishayela tandla Mengameli Jacob Zuma ngekwetfula umbiko walokuchubekako kulabo labantsintsekako ngekucala kwekusebenta kwe-Operation Phakisa:Umnotfo Waselwandle nekumema bonkhe labatsintsekako kutsi bachubeke basebentisane nahulumende ekuveteni ematfuba emnotfo lakhona kumalwandle etfu.

src: Moruo wa Mawatle o se o nyehetse se ka etsang 4.4% ho Palohohle ya Dihlahiswa tsa Naha (GDP) tsa Aforika Borwa mme tlaleho ya Moporesidente ho bankakarolo e bontsha ka matla mekutu e kopanetsweng le tshehetso bakeng sa balekane bohle ba mmuso ba itahletseng ka setotswana ka hara bokgoni bona bo batsi.
tgt: Umnotfo Waselwandle sewuvele wente ligalelo lelilinganiselwa ku- 4.4% kuMikhicito Wonkhe weNingizimu Afrika (i-GDP) kantsi umbiko waMengameli kulaba labatsintsekako ukhombisa ngalokugcwele kwekutsi umtamo lomkhulu nekusekelwa kwabo bonkhe labasebentisana nahulumende labangenelele kulamatfuba lamakhulu lavelako.

src: Diporojeke tsa Moruo wa Mawatle ho fihlela mona di se di butse matsete a kopaneng a R.6 bilione ho tswa mmusong le lekaleng la poraefete, le ho bopa mesebetsi e fetang 6 500.
tgt: Imiiklamo yeMnotfo Waselwandle kwanyalo seyivule imali lengemabhiliyoni lange-R.6 lesisiwe levela ngalokuhlanganisiwe kuhulumende kanye nemkhakha walabatimele, kantsi seyakhe ematfuba emsebenti langetulu kwa-6 500.

src: Matsete a maholo ka ho fetisisa Moruong wa Mawatle, a hlahisitsweng ka ditsiane tsa mmuso, a lebisitswe ho ntshetsopele ya meralo ya motheo, haholo maemakepe, ho tsa tlhahiso, kaho ya dikepe, kgodiso ya diphedi tsa lewatle le diphuputso tsa saense le lekala la kgase.
tgt: Kusisa lokukhulu kunakokonkhe lokuvela kuMnotfo Waselwandle, lolawulwa ngekukhutsatwa tinsita tahulumende, locondziswe ekutfutfukiseni tinsitanchanti, ikakhulukati emachweba, kukhicita, kwakha imikhumbi, tekulima taselwandle nekwenta lucwaningo lwesayensi kumkhakha wawoyela negesi.

src: Mmuso o rera ho theha sebaka se le seng se seholohadi sa kaho ya dikepe ka hara Aforika e ka borwa.
tgt: Tinhlelo tahulumende kusungula sikhungo sinye lesikhulukati sekwakha imikhumbi eNingizimu ne-Afrika.

src: Phaka ya Kaho ya Dikepe ya KwaZulu-Natal ka hara Boemakepe ba Durban e tla kotula bokgoni ho tswa matseteng a matjha, diyantle le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi.
tgt: IKwaZulu-Natal Boatbuilding Park letfolakala kulichweba laseDurban itawungenisa ematfuba kubasisi labasha, kutfunyelwa kwemikhicito ngaphandle nekwakha ematfuba emsebenti.

src: Leeto la Puso ho ya Zambia.
tgt: Kuvakasha kweMbuso eZambia.

src: Kabinete e amohela diphetho tsa Leeto la Puso la Mopresidente Zuma la ho etela Riphabliki ya Zambia ho tloha ka la 12 ho isa ka la 13 Mphalane 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamukela lemiphumela yeKuvakasha kweMbuso lokwentiwe nguMengameli Zuma eRiphabhulikhi yaseZambia kusukela ngamhlaka-12 kuya ku-13 Imphala 2017.

src: Dipuisano pakeng tsa Moporesidente Zuma le wa mphato wa hae wa Zambia Edgar Lungu di matlafaditse dikamano tse ntle tse ntseng di le teng tsa sepolotiki, tsa moruo le tsa botjhaba pakeng tsa dinaha ka bobedi, tse hlakiswang ke maqhama a matla a nalane ya dilemo tsa ntwa ya tokoloho.
tgt: Lokuchumana emkhatsini waMengameli Zuma kanye nemlingani wakhe waseZambia Mengameli Edgar Lungu kucinise budlelwane lobuhle lebebukhona kutepolitiki, umnotfo nemasiko emkhatsini walamave lamabili, lobusekelwe tibopho leticinile tangalesikhatsi lesesadlula kusukela ngaleminyaka yekulwela inkhululeko.

src: Dihlooho tsa Dipuso tse pedi tsena di butse semmuso setsha sa Naha sa Bojalefa sa OR Tambo Chelstone, ho la Lusaka, mabapi le ho tlotla nyehelo ya OR Tambo ntweng ya tokoloho ya Aforika e ka borwa.
tgt: LeTinhloko teMbuso letimbili tivule ngalokusemtsetfweni indzawo yemagugu i-OR Tambo National Heritage leseChelstone, eLusaka, ngekuhlonipha ligalelo lelafakwa ngu-OR Tambo lekulwela inkhululeko yemave aseNingizimu ne-Afrika.

src: Zambia e dula e le e nngwe ya balekane ba ka sehloohong ba kgwebisano le Aforika Borwa ka hara lebatowa le ka hara kontinente.
tgt: I-Zambia iyohlala ingulelinye lemave lahambembili kulesigodzi ekuhwebelaneni neNingizimu Afrika nakumhlaba wonkhe jikelele.

src: Tshebedisano ho tsa moruo pakeng tsa Aforika Borwa le Zambia e tswela pele ho hola, ka diyantle tsa Aforika tse yang Zambia tse akantsweng ho fihla ho R30 bilione ka selemo sa 2016.
tgt: Kubambisana kutemnotfo emkhatsini weNingizimu Afrika neZambia kuyachubeka nekukhula, imikhicito yaseNingizimu Afrika letfunyelwa eZambia ilinganiselwa kumabhiliyoni lange-R30 wemarandi nga-2016.

src: Dinaha tsena tse pedi di sebedisana mmoho dibakeng tse fapafapaneng, ho kenyeletswa kgwebisano le matsete, saense le thekenoloji, tshireletso, temo, tikoloho, eneji le bophelo bo botle.
tgt: Lamave lamabili asebentisana kumikhakha leminyenti, kufaka ekhatsi kuhwebelana nekusisa, isayensi netheknoloji, tekuvikela, tekulima, temvelo, emandla netemphilo.

src: Leeto la tshebetso ho ya Nigeria.
tgt: Kuvakashela iNigeria ngekwemsebenti.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Moporesidente Zuma mabapi le ho tlotlwa ka seemahale le hore mmila o rehellwe ka yena Nigeria, nakong ya leeto la tshebetso bakeng sa ho matlafatsa dikamano tsa moruo wa kahisano le mabaka a mang a tshebedisano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela Mengameli Zuma ngekuhlonishwa ngesitfombe lesibatiwe kanye nesitaladi lesibitwe ngeligama lakhe eNigeria, ngalesikhatsi avakashe ngekwemsebenti kuyicinisa budlelwano bekusebentisana kutemnotfo kanye nalamanye emabhizinisi.

src: Mmusisi wa Puso ya Imo, Rochas Okorocha, o tlotlile Moporesidente Zuma ka Kgau ya Tlhompho ya Imo, e leng kgau e kgolo ka ho fetisisa Pusong eo le ho abelwa ba entseng phapang ntshetsopeleng ya badudi ba habo bona.
tgt: Umphatsi weSifundza sase-Imo, Rochas Okorocha, uhloniphe Mengameli Zuma nge-Imo Merit Award, lekungumklomela lomkhulukati kulesifundza kantsi kuhlonishwa ngawo labo labente umehluko ekutfutfukiseni imimmango yabo.

src: Kopano ya bo-17 ya Rim ya Lekgotla la Matona a Dikgaolo tsa Lewatle la India (IORA).
tgt: Umhlangano we-17 waboNdvuna weMkandlu we-Indian Ocean Rim Association (i-IORA).

src: Aforika Borwa e nkile Bodulasetulo ba IORA nakong ya kopano ya bo-17 o tshwaretsweng Durban ho tloha ka la 14 ho isa ka la 18 Mphalane 2017.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika ibe nguSihlalo ku-IORA ngalesikhatsi salomhlangano we-17 lebewubanjelwe eDurban kusukela ngamhlaka ti-14 kuya ku-18 Imphala 2017.

src: Mookotaba wa Aforika bakeng sa nako ya yona ya bodulasetulo o re “Re kopanya Batho ba Aforika, Asia, Australasia le Botjhabela bo Hare ka Tshebedisano e Matlafetseng bakeng sa Kgotso, Botsitso le Ntshetsopele ya Moshwelella”.
tgt: Ingcikitsi yeNingizimu Afrika ngalesikhatsi sayo itsi “Kuhlanganisa bantfu base-Afrika, Asia, Australasia naseMiddle East Ngekusebentisa Kubambisana Lokunotsile Kwentela Kuthula, Kusimama Nentfutfuko Lelawulekako”.

src: Kabinete e boeleditse boitlamo ba yona ka bodulasetulo bona ho ntshetsa pele tshebedisano ya lebatowa mabakeng a kang a moruo wa mawatle matlafatso ya basadi moruong kgodiso ya dikgwebo tse nyenyane, tse mahareng le tse kgolo matlafatso ya batjha, le tshebedisano ho tsa thuto, saense le thekenoloji.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibuye yacinisekisa kutinikela kwayo ngalokuba ngusihlalo kuchubekisa kubambisana etigodzini nakumikhakha lefana nemnotfo waselwandle kusekela bomake ngemandla kutemnotfo kutfutfukisa emabhizinisi lasemancane, lasemkhatsini nalamakhulu kuniketa lusha emandla, nekusebentisana kwalabafundzile, kusayensi netheknoloji.

src: Dikopano tsa selemo ka seng tsa Letlole la Matjhaba la Ditjhelete (IMF) le Banka ya Lefatshe.
tgt: Imihlangano yemnyaka yeSikhwama Setetimali Temhlaba (i-IMF) neLibhange Lemhlaba.

src: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ke Letona la Ditjhelete, Monghadi Malusi Gigaba, ho latela bonkakarolo ba Aforika Borwa dikopanong tsa selemo ka seng tsa 2017 tsa IMF le Banka ya Lefatshe, tse neng di tshwerwe ho tloha ka la 13 ho isa ka la 15 Mphalane 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yabikelwa nguNdvuna weTetimali, MnuMalusi Gigaba, ngemuva kwekungenelela kweNingizimu Afrika emihlanganweni yemnyaka yanga-2017 ye-IMF neLibhange Lemhlaba, lebeyibanjwe kusukela ngamhla ti-13 kuya ku-15 Imphala 2017.

src: Dikopano di fane ka monyetla wa ho lekola kgatelopele ya matjhaba mabapi le dintlha tsa tswelopele le ho hlakisa maikitlaetso a Aforika Borwa bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya moruo wa kahisano, kgolo e kenyeletsang, tlhahiso ya mesebetsi le phediso ya bofuma.
tgt: Lemihlangano yaniketa litfuba lekuhlatiya inchubo yamhlaba wonkhe etindzabeni letiphatselene nekutfutfuka bese ichaza kancono umtamo weNingizimu Afrika wekutfutfukiswa kwemnotfo, kukhula lokufaka ekhatsi yonkhe intfo, kwakhiwa kwematfuba emsebenti nekunciphisa kuhlupheka.

src: Kabinete hape e tsebisitswe mabapi le kopano e neng e tshwerwe ke Letona Gigaba le makala a ikemetseng a tekolo ya mekitlane le batsetedi ho tiisetsa botjha maano a hajwale a Aforika Borwa le katamelo ya boitshwaro bo botle ba tshebediso ya ditjhelete tsa mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yabuye yatiswa ngemhlangano waNdvuna Gigaba lekawubambe naletikhungo letitimele letihlola lizinga letimali nebasisi kute kucinisekiswe tinchubumgomo letikhona nyalo eNingizimu Afrika kanye nendlela lekulawulwa ngayo timali takuleli.

src: Kabinete e kgotsofetse ka tiisetso botjha e fuweng batsetedi mabapi le meralo ya mmuso ya ho hodisa moruo le boitlamo ba mmuso ba ho sebetsana le dintlha tsa taolo dikgwebong tsa rona tsa mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yenelisekile ngalokucinisekiswa lokuniketwe basisi ngetinhlelo tahulumende tekukhulisa umnotfo nekutinikela kwahulumende ekulungiseni tinkhinga tekulawula kutikhungo tetfu letiphetfwe ngumbuso.

src: Pehelo ya Leano la Ditekanyetso tsa Nako e Bohareng (MTBPS) e tla tekwa Palamenteng, Motse Kapa, ka la 25 Mphalane mme e tla hlakisa meralo ya mmuso ya tshebediso ya ditjhelete dilemong tse tharo tse tlang.
tgt: Sitatimende Senchubomgomo Yekwabiwa Kwemali Emkhatsini Nemnyaka sitawetfulwa ePhalamende, eKapa, ngamhla tinge-25 Imphala kantsi sitawucacisa ngetinhlelo tekucitfwa kwemali yahulumende kuleminyaka lemitsatfu letako.

src: Ntshetsopele ya Meralo ya Motheo.
tgt: Kutfutfukiswa kwetinsitanchanti.

src: Kabinete e thoholeditse matlafatso e kgolo mabapi le ntshetsopele ya mmuso ya meralo ya motheo ka ho nehelana semmuso ka marokgo a mararo Botlokwa ho la Limpopo ke Moporesidente Zuma ka la 17 Mphalane 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ishayele tandla lokusekelwa ngemandla ekutfutfukiseni tinsitanchanti tahulumende ngekutsi kuniketwe ngalokusemtsetfweni emabhuloho lamatsatfu laseBotlokwa eLimpopo aniketwa nguMengameli Zuma ngamhla ti-17 Imphala 2017.
