src: Kabinete e Kopane ka Laboraro, la 15 Pudungwana 2017 Tuynhuys, Motse Kapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi beyihlangene ngaLesitsatfu, mhla ti-15 Lweti 2017 eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Dintlha tsa Hajwale.
tgt: Tindzaba Letimcoka Telive.

src: Matsete.
tgt: Lutjalotimali.

src: Kabinete e amohela matsete a Khamphani ya Makoloi ya Ford a R3 bilione ka hara Polante ya Silverton, Pretoria, Gauteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalwemukela lutjalotimali lwetigidzigidzi leti-R3 lweNkampani Yetimoto yakaFord lelufake kuSikhungomkhicito saseSilverton, ePitoli eGauteng.

src: Matsete ana a tla baka hore ho boptjwe mesebetsi e otlolohileng le e meng ya tlatsetso ka lebaka la keketseho e lebeletsweng ya tlhahiso ya motlolo wa yona wa Ford Ranger.
tgt: Lolutjalotimali lutakwenta kutsi kudaleke imisebenti ngco kuleSikhungomkhicito nakulamanye mabhizinisi lasebentisana naso ngenca yekwandza kwemkhicito lolindzelekile weluhlobo lwetimoto te-Ford Ranger.

src: Matsete ana a tiisetsa mosebetsi oo re tswelang pele ho o etsa jwaloka mmuso mabapi le ho hodisa moruo le ho sebetsana le diphephetso tsa tlhokeho ya mosebetsi.
tgt: Lutjalotimali lolufute lolu lucinisekisa umsebenti lesichubeka njalo ngekuwenta njengahulumende ekukhuliseni umnotfo kanye nekulungisa tinsayeya tekuswelakala kwemsebenti.

src: Ka sekema sa mmuso sa ditsiane tsa R.8 bilione ka hara Tlhahiso ya Makoloi le Lenaneo la Ntshetsopele, ho buletswe matsete a poraefete a R.5 bilione.
tgt: Ngekusebentisa sikimu sesibonelelo sahulumende setigidzigidzi leti-R.8 eLuhlelweni Lwekukhicitwa Nekutfutfukiswa Kwetimoto, kwadaleka lutjalotinmali lolutimele lwetigidzigidzi letinge-Loku kufaka ekhatsi simemetelo lesentiwe bakaToyota kutsi batakwakha tinhlobo tabo letinsha te-Toyota Hilux ne-Fortuner njengencenye yelutjalotimali lwetigidzigidzi leti-Kanye nekutsi futsi, nebaka-BMW bahlela kwakha sitolo setincenye temitimba yetimoto lesisezingeni lesibita tigidzigidzi leti-IBeijing Automobile International Corporation ihlela kufaka lutjalotimali lwetigidzigidzi leti-R11 kusikhungomkhicito lesakha timoto lapha eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Tsena di kenyeletsa tsebiso ya Toyota ya ho etsa dimotlolo tsa yona tse ntjha tsa Toyota Hilux le Fortuner e le karolo ya matsete a etsang R.1 bilione.
tgt: Sikhatsi Semtselo sanga-2017.

src: Hape, BMW e rera ho aha lebenkele la maemo a hodimo a etsang R6 billone a ditopo tsa makoloi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi itsandza kuvakalisa kubonga kwayo kubo bonkhe labakhokha umtselo lasebavele sebawangenisile emafomu abo emtselo emnyakamtselo wanga-2016/17.

src: Koporasi ya Matjhaba ya Makoloi ya Beijing e rera ho tsetela R11 bilione polanteng ya tlhahiso ya makoloi ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Imalingena letfolakala emtselweni icinisekisa kutsi hulumende akhone kuletsa tinsitakalo letidzingeka kakhulu kanye nekunika tibonelelo tetenhlalo tigidzi tebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labaswelako.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa diteboho ho balefi bohle ba lekgetho ba seng ba kentse ditokomane tsa bona tsa lekgetho bakeng sa selemo sa lekgetho sa 2016/17.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhumbuta labakhokha umtselo kutsi lusuku lolungumncamulajucu lwekungenisa emafomu emtselo nguLesihlanu tinge-24 Lweti 2017 futsi bayakhutsatwa kutsi bangenise emafomu abo emtselo.

src: Pitso ya Naha ya ho Thakgolwa ha Ntshetsopele ya Moruo wa Lehae (LED).
tgt: Ikhomfa Yavelonkhe Yekutfutfukisa Temnotfo Wendzawo (i-LED).

src: Kabinete e thabile mabapi le diphetho tsa Pitso ya Naha ya LED e neng e tshwerwe haufinyana tjena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayijabulela imiphumela yeKhomfa Yavelonkhe ye-LED lesandza kubanjwa.

src: E ne e tshwerwe tlasa boetapele ba Letona la Puso e Kopanetsweng le Merero ya Botjhaba, Monghadi Des van Rooyen le Letona la Ntshetsopele ya Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane, Mofumahadi Lindiwe Zulu.
tgt: Beyibanjwe ngaphasi kwebuholi kweNdvuna yeLitiko Letekubusa Ngekubambisana Netendzabuko, Umnu Des van Rooyen kanye neNdvuna Yetekutfutfukisa Emabhizinisi Lamancane, Mk Lindiwe Zulu.

src: E hlahisitse monyetla wa ho rala lenaneo le letjha la LED ya Aforika Borwa le tataiswang ke dintlha tse ka sehlohlolong tsa Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP).
tgt: Yadala litfuba lekusungula luhlelo lolusha LaseNingizimu Afrika Lwekutfutfukisa Temnotfo Wendzawo ngekuholwa nguloko lekumele kwentiwe kucala kweLisu Lavelonkhe Lentfutfuko (i-NDP).

src: Diphetho tsa yona di kenyeleditse ho thakgolwa ha Lekgotla la Ntshetsopele ya Moruo la Aforika Borwa (EDCSA) la pele, le rerileng ho etsa hore lekala la ntshetsopele ya moruo e be la seporofeshenale.
tgt: Imiphumela yayo yafaka ekhatsi kwetfulwa kwekucala Kwemkhandlu waseNingizimu Afrika Wekutfutfukisa Temnotfo (i-EDCSA), lohlose kwenta lomkhakha wetentfutfuko yemnotfo kutsi uhanjiswe ngebungcweti.

src: Jwaloka setheo sa seporofeshenale, EDCSA e tla tsamaisa le ho beha leihlo boitshwaro ba seporofeshenale ba bankakarolo ba bangata ba teng maikitlaetsong a fapaneng a ntshetsopele.
tgt: Njengemtimba wetingcweti, i- EDCSA itawulawula futsi yeluse kutiphatsa ngebungcweti kwetisebenti letinengi letitimbandzakanya emitameni leyahlukene yentfutfuko.

src: Kabinete hape e ananetse ho thakgolwa ho etsang nalane ha Beke ya Lefatshe ya Boetapele ba Dikgwebo (GEW) nomorong ya 22 ho la Sloane, e leng khempase e ntjha ya qalo, ka la 10 Pudungwana 2017, moo Letona Zulu a neng a amohetse kwakwariri ya lefatshe ya baetapele ba dikgwebo, Monghadi Richard Branson.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphindze futsi yakubona kwetfulwa lokuyinchophamlandvo kweLiviki Letemhlaba Wonkhe Letemabhizinisi (i-GEW) e-22 On Sloane, sikhungo lesisha, mhla ti-10 Lweti 2017, lapho Indvuna Zulu beyemukele khona sihlabani lesatiwako, u-Sir Richard Branson.

src: Khempase ena ke ya pele ya ho bulwa ke Marangrang a Boetapele ba Dikgwebo ba Lefatshe.
tgt: Lesikhungo sekucala kutsi sivulwe yiNhlangano Yemhlaba Wonkhe Yemabhizinisi.

src: E fana ka ditshebeletso tsa tshehetso ka kotloloho le ka inthanete ho phatlalla le Aforika hammoho le phumantsho ya matjhaba ya marangrang a batataisi, batsetedi le mekgatlo ya tshehetso ya baetapele ba dikgwebo.
tgt: Isita ngekunita ngco tinsitakalo tekusekela bosomabhizinisi base-Afrika yonkhana kanye nekutsi bakhone kutsi bafinyelele kubaluleki, ebatjalitimali kanye nekusekelwa tinhlangano temabhizinisi temave emhlaba.

src: Nakong ya GEW, batho ba ka etsang 10 milione ba nka karolo diketsahalong tse 35 000, mesebetsing le ditlhodisanong dinaheng tse fetang 165 ho phatlalla le lefatshe.
tgt: Ngesikhatsi seliviki le-GEW, bantfu labalinganiselwa etigidzini leti-10 labatimbandzakanye emicimbini, imisebenti nemicudzelwano lenge-35 000 emaveni langetulu kwe-165 emhlabeni wonkhe.

src: Tlaleho ya Khomishene ya Heher.
tgt: Umbiko weKhomishini yaHeher.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho lokollwa ka Mantaha, 13 Pudungwana 2017 ha Tlaleho ya Khomishene ya Dipatlisiso mabapi le Kgonahalo ya ho etsa hore Thuto e Phahameng le Thupello e be mahala ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikubonile kukhishwa ngeMsombuluko, mhla ti-13 Lweti 2017 kweMbiko weKhomishini Lephenya Ngekufaneleka kwekwenta kutsi Imfundvo Lephakeme Nekucecesha kutsi ibe Mahhala eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho hlahloba tlaleho ena le ditlamorao tsa yona bakeng sa naha ha dikgothaletso tsa teng di ntse di sekwasekwa ke mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bawufundze lombiko kanye nemitselela yawo kulelive ngesikhatsi hulumende asatibuka letincomo.

src: Moporesidente o tla etsa tsebiso ka tlaleho ena ha nako e ntse e tsamaya kamora ho sekwasekwa ke Komiti e Kopanetsweng ya Matona ya Matlole a Ditjhelete tsa Thuto e Phahameng le Komiti ya Ditjhelete ya Boporesidente.
tgt: Mengameli utawukhipha simemetelo lesimacondzana nalombiko khona nje madvute ngemuva kwekutsi Likomidi Lelihlanganisa Tindvuna Lekusita Ngetimali Imfundvo Lephakeme Nelikomidi LeMengameli Lesikhwama Setimali Tahulumende.

src: Mmuso o dula o ikemiseditse ho rarolla ditshita tsa phumantsho ya thuto e phahameng, mme e shebetse pele ho phethela tharollo ya moshwelella bakeng sa thuso ya ditjhelete tsa thuto e phahameng.
tgt: Hulumende utimisele kusombulula tihibe tekungakhoni kufinyelela kutfola imfundvo lephakeme, nekutsi futsi uphokopholele ekutseni atfole sisombululo lesisimeme sekusita ngetimali imfundvo lephakeme.

src: Maemo a hajwale a matamo ka hara naha e dula e le matshwenyeho kaha ho na le moyafalo e ngata ho feta pula.
tgt: Emazinga emanti emadamu lakhona eveni kwanyalo ayakhatsata ngobe kunekuhamuka lokukhulu kwemanti kunemvula lenako.

src: Taba ya hore Aforika Borwa ha e so fumane pula e lekaneng ho tsosolosa mehlodi ya rona ya metsi ho fihlella maemong a nepahetseng ho bolela hore naha hae e so tswe ka hara boemo ba komello.
tgt: Ngenca yesizatfu sekutsi iNingizimu Afrika ayikatfoli imvula leyanele kute kugcwale emadamu etfu kute kwenele emazinga emanti kusho kutsi lelive letfu lisengakaphumi esomisweni.

src: Bolepi bo bonela pele hore naha e tla fumana feela pula e ngata ho tloha maqalong a Pherekgong 2018.
tgt: Tangoma telitulu tibiketela kutsi lelive litawutfola imvula lenkhulu kusukela ekucaleni kwaBhimbidvwane 2018.

src: Kabinete e lakatsa ho netefaletsa setjhaba hore mmuso wa naha, mebuso ya diporofense le ya lehae e a thusana le ho sebetsa mmoho ho netefatsa hore Aforika Borwa ha e fellwe ke metsi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi itsandza kucinisekisa sive kutsi hulumende wavelonkhe, wesifundza newasekhaya bayabambisana ekusebentisaneni ngekuhlanganyela kucinisekisa kutsi iNingizimu Afrika ayiphelelwa ngemanti.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa mang le mang ho bapala karolo ya hae mabapi le ho baballa le ho sebedisa metsi ka bohlale le ka hloko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igcugcutela wonkhe umuntfu kutsi adlale indzima yakhe ekongeni emanti kanye nekuwasebentisa ngekuhlakanipha nangekuwonga.

src: Zimbabwe.
tgt: IZimbabwe.

src: Kabinete e tshehetsa boitshunyako ba Moporesidente Jacob Zuma, boemong ba hae jwaloka Modulasetulo wa Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tse ka Borwa ba Aforika (SADC) ho arabela maemong a Zimbabwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwesekela kungenelela kwaMengameli Jacob Zuma, ngekwesikhundla sakhe sekuba nguSihlalo weNhlangano Yekutfutfukisa Emave ase-Afrika LengaseNingizimu (i-SADC) mayelana nesimo saseZimbabwe.

src: O rometse Baemedi ba Ikgethang, Letona la Tshireletso le Mekaubere ya Ntwa, Mofumahadi Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula le Letona la Tshireletso ya Puso, Moatefokate Bongani Bongo.
tgt: Utfumele Litsimba Lelikhesetekile, Indvuna Yetekuvikela Netigayigayi Temphi, Mk Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula kanye neNdvuna Yekuvikeleka Kwembuso, u-Adv Bongani Bongo.

src: Ba tla kopana le Moporesidente Robert Mugabe le Sesole sa Tshireletso sa Zimbabwe.
tgt: Batawuhlangana neMengameli Robert Mugabe kanye neMbutfo Wetekuvikela waseZimbabwe.

src: Kamora moo, ba tla tsebisa Moporesidente wa Angola João Lourenço boemong ba hae jwaloka Modulasetulo wa Lekala la Dipolotiki, Tshireletso le Polokeho la SADKantoro ya Moporesidente e tla fana ka tse ntseng di etsahala mabapi le taba ena.
tgt: Emva kwaloko batawubese batjela Mengameli wase-Angola João Lourenço longuSihlalo weLuphiko Lwe-SADC Lwetepolitiki, Kuvikela Nekuphepha.

src: Sekwere Kilomithara sa Array (SKA).
tgt: I-Square Kilometre Array (i-SKA).

src: Kabinete e amohela diphihlello tsa ntshetsopele ya moruo le kahisano lebatoweng la SKA ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela loko losekuzuziwe kutemnotfo nentfutfuko yetenhlalo lokutfolwe kulolutjalotimali kutentfutfuko yenhlalo kulesifundza se-SKA yaseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Badudi ba dulang haufi le sebaka sa SKA ba tswela pele ho kgola molemo ka diporojeke tsa thuto le thupello e betere, matsete dikgwebong tse nyenyane le menyetla ya mesebetsi e eketsehileng.
tgt: Imimango leyakhelene endzaweni lesedvute ne-SKA iyachubeka ngekutsi izuze ngekutfola imfundvo lencono kanye nemiklamo yekucecesha, lutjalotimali kumabhizinisi lamancane kanye nematfuba etemisebenti landzisiwe.

src: Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji, tlasa boetapele ba Letona la Saense le Thekenoloji, Mofumahadi Naledi Pandor, o tla tshwara lenaneo la bonkakarolo ba setjhaba ho keteka diphihlello le badudi ba dibaka tse bapileng le Carnarvon, ho la Kapa Leboya ho tloha ka la 16 ho isa ka la 19 Pudungwana 2017.Diqeto tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Litiko Letesayensi Netheknoloji, leliholwa yiNdvuna Yetesayensi Netheknoloji, Mk Naledi Pandor, litawubaneluhlelo lwekutimbandzakanya kwemmango kute babungate imphumelelo bakanye nemimango leyakhelene neCarnavon, eNyakatfo Kapa kusukela mhla ti-16 kuya mhla ti-19 Lweti 2017.Tincumo teKhabhinethi.

src: Ditlaleho tsa Bobedi tsa Kgatelopele ya tshebetso ya kotara ka nngwe bakeng sa 2017/1.
tgt: Imibiko yenchubekelembili yekusebenta kwekota yesibili yanga-2017/1.

src: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka Ditlaleho tsa Bobedi tsa Kgatelopele ya kotara ka nngwe bakeng sa 2017/18 (Phupu ho isa ka Loetse 2017) ke dikarolo kaofela tse hlano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yachazelwa mayelana nemibiko yenchubekelembili yekusebenta kwekota yesibili yanga-2017/18 (Kholwane kuya enyangeni yeNyoni 2017) yawo onkhe osihlanu emacembu.

src: Sena se bopa karolo ya lenaneo le pharaletseng la Kabinete la bodisa le tekolo ya Lenaneo la Tshebetso le itshetlehileng hodima Moralo wa Lewa la Nako e Bohareng (MTSF) la selemo sa 2014 ho isa ho sa 2019.
tgt: Loku kwakha incenye lebanti yeLuhlelo Lwekwenta lwekucaphela nekulinganisa lweKhabhinethi lolutsatselwe kuLuhlaka Lwendlelalisu Lwethemu Lesemkhatsini (i-MTSF) 2014 kuta ku-2019.

src: Lefapha la Merero, Bodisa le Tekolo ya Tshebetso le dikomiti tsa Karolo ya Matona di tla bitsa dikopano tsa boraditaba ho pahlolla kgatelopele ya ditlaleho tsena.
tgt: Litiko Letekuhlela, Kucaphela Nekulinganisa kanye nemakomidi Emacembu eTindvuna atawubamba umhlangano nebetindzaba kute achaze ngenchubekelembili yalemibiko.

src: GCIS e tla hokahanya dikopano tsa boraditaba le ho phatlalatsa lenaneo la tsona ho WEBTOKEN ha nako e ntse e tsamaya.
tgt: Luphiko Lwahulumende Lwetekuchumana Nelwatiso (i-GCIS) lutawuchumanisa lomhlangano nebetindzaba bese lushicilela loko lokutawukwentiwa ku: WEBTOKEN kungasikudzala.

src: Ho behwa sehlohlolong mabapi le maikitlaetso a ho kgwahlapisa diaterese le phano ya diaterese.
tgt: Lwatiso ngekuchubeka kwetintfo lokumayelana nemtamo wekutfola emakheli nekufaka emakheli.

src: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka tlaleho ya kgatelopele mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Kahlolo ya Lekgotla la Molaotheo ya ho fana ka diaterese lenaneong la bakgethi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yatjelwa ngalamafishane mayelana nembiko wenchubekelembili ngekucala kwekusebenta kweSehlulelo Senkantolo Yemtsetfosisekelo sekufaka emakheli eluhlwini lwebavoti.

src: Kabinete e ananetse boimatahanyo ka botlalo le ditlaleho tsa kgatelopele ya dikgwedi kang tse tsheletseng tse iswang Lekgotleng la Molaotheo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yakushayela tandla kuhambisana ngalokuphelele kwemibiko yetinyanga letisitfupha yenchubekelembili leyangeniswa eNkantolo Yemtsetfosisekelo.

src: Ho fihlela lena Khomishene e Ikemetseng ya Dikgetho (IEC), ka ho sebedisana le makala a mang a puso, e fihlelletse katleho ya se ka fihlang ho 75% mabapi le ho bokella diaterese tsa batho ba ka nnang ba kenela dikgetho.
tgt: Kute kube ngunyalo Ikhomishini Yelukhetfo Letimele (i-IEC), ngekusebentisana nalamanye ema-ejensi embuso, seyiphumelele kugcogca ngemphumelelo 75% emakheli ebavoti.

src: Kabinete e tsebisitswe hape ka lenaneo le rerilweng ke Kantoro ya Poso ya Aforika Borwa (SAPO) ho thusa ba hlokang diaterese tsa bodulo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi futsi yatjelwa ngalamafishane mayelana neluhlelo lolusungulwe baka-SAPO ekusiteni labo labete emakheli alapho bahlala khona.

src: Kabinete e thabisitswe ke kgatelopele le ketso ya tshebedisano e entsweng ke SAPO, IEC le makala a mang a puso mosebetsing wa porojeke ya diaterese.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ijabulile ngalenchubekelembili kanye nangemsebenti wekuhlanganyela lowentiwa baka-SAPO, i-IEC kanye nalamanye ema-ejensi embuso ngalomklamo wekufaka emakheli.

src: Kabinete e boela e ipiletsa ho ba so kang ba lokisa diaterese tsa bona ho etsa jwalo nakong ya beke ya boingodiso bo tlang ba bakgethi ka Hlakubele 2018.Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphindza futsi icela labo labangakalweti lwabasesikhatsi lwatiso lwemakheli abo kutsi bakwente loko ngesikhatsi seliviki lekubhalisela kuvota lelitako ngenyanga yeNdlovulenkhulu 2018.Imicimbi Letako.

src: Tulo ya bone ya Khomishene ya Dinaha tse pedi (BNC) ya Aforika Borwa-Botswana.
tgt: Iseshini yesine yeKhomishini Yemave Lamabili yeNingizimu Afrika neBotswana (i-BNC).

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla nka leeto la tshebetso bakeng sa ho nka karolo le ho ba modulasetulo mmoho ho Tulo ya Bone ya BNC ya Aforika Borwa-Botswana e tla tshwarelwa Gaborone, ho la Botswana ka Labohlano, 17 Pudungwana 2017.
tgt: Mengameli Zuma utawube avakashe ngekwemsebenti ekutimbandzakanyeni kanye nekuba ngusihlalo ngekuhlanganyela kuSeshini Yesine yeNingizimu Afrika neBotswana yeKhomishini Yemave Lamabili letawubanjelwa eGaborone, eBotswana ngaLesihlanu, mhla ti-17 Lweti 2017.

src: Aforika Borwa le Botswana di kopana selemo ka seng boemong ba Dihlooho tsa Dipuso ka hara moralo wa BNC ho sheba botjha tshebedisano ya bobedi bona le ho tshohla dintlha tse amang dinaha ka bobedi.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika neleBotswana bahlangana ngemnyaka ezingeni Letinhloko Tembuso ngaphasi kweluhlakamsebenti lwe-BNC kute abukete kusebentisana emkhatsini walamave lamabili kanye nekucocisana ngetindzaba letiwatsintsa ngalokufanana lamave omabili.

src: Dinaha ka bobedi di na le dikamano tse kgahlisang tsa kutlwano tse bontshwang ke maqhama a botjhaba le bohaufi ba dinaha tsena.
tgt: Lamave lamabili anebudlelwane lobuhle ngenca yekuhlangana kwemasiko kanye nekwakhelana.

src: Di sebedisana mabakeng a mangata a kenyeletsang, dipalangwang, kgwebisano le matsete, bophelo bo botle, mabaka a tikoloho, jwalojwalo.
tgt: Ayasebentisana etintfweni letinyenti lokufaka ekhatsi, tekutfutsa, kuhwebelana kanye nelutjalotimali, temphilo, temvelo, njll.

src: Aforika Borwa ke e nngwe ya balekane ba baholo ba kgwebisano le Botswana, ka dikhamphani tse batlang di ba ngata tsa Aforika Borwa tse sebetsang ka hara naha eo.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika ingulelinye lemave lamcoka lahwebelana neleBotswana, lapho sikhandza khona tinkampani letinyenti taseNingizimu Afrika tisebenta kulela live.

src: Leeto la Moporesidente wa Puso ya Angola.
tgt: Kuvakasha ngekweMbuso kwaMengameli wase-Angola.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla amohela Motlotlehi, Moporesidente wa Riphabliki ya Angola, João Lourenço, bakeng sa Leeto la Puso le etsang nalane ka hara Aforika Borwa ho tloha ka la 23 Pudungwana 2017.
tgt: Mengameli Zuma utakwemukela Umhlonishwa, Mengameli waseRiphabhliki yase-Angola, João Lourenço, kuvakasha ngekweMbuso lokuyinchophamlandvo kusukela mhla tinge-23 Lweti 2017.

src: Sena e tla be e le Leeto la hae la Puso la pele ka hara naha ya rona kamora hoba a hlomamiswe.
tgt: Loku kutawuba kuvakasha kwakhe kwekucala kulelive letfu emva kwekubekwa kwakhe kutsi abe nguMengameli.

src: Dinaha ka bobedi di na le maqhama a nalane le a bomphato a ballwang dilemong tse fetileng tsa ntwa ya tokoloho ha Angola e ne e bolokile le ho tshehetsa balwanedi ba tokoloho ba Aforika Borwa dikampong tse fapafapaneng ka hara naha eo.
tgt: Lamave lamabili anebudlelwane lobacala kudzala ngesikhatsi sekuzabalazela inkhululeko ngesikhatsi live lase-Angola likhoselisa liphindze futsi lisekela tishikashiki temzabalazo lebetisetinkanjini letahlukahlukene kulela live.

src: Kgwebisano le tshebedisano ho tsa moruo pakeng tsa dinaha ka bobedi e ho hotse haholo, ho fihlella moo Aforika Borwa e leng molekane wa mantlha wa Angola ka hara kontinente.
tgt: Kuhwebelana nekubambisana kutemnotfo emkhatsini walamave lamabili kukhule kakhulu, ngendlela yekutsi live laseNingizimu Afrika lilive leliphuma embili kunawo onkhe lelihwebelana ne-Angola kulelivekati.

src: Dikhamphani tse ngata tsa Aforika Borwa di tsamaisa kgwebo ka hara Angola makaleng a fapafapaneng a kenyeletsang, a kaho, merafo, matlo, mabenkele, dijo le dino, dihotele le boikgathollo, dibanka le ditshebeletso tsa bongaka.
tgt: Tinkampani letinyenti taseNingizimu Afrika tichuba emabhizinisi ato e-Angola emikhakheni leyahlukahlukene lokufaka ekhatsi tekwakha, tetimayini, tetindlu, tekutsengisa, kudla nalokunatfwako, emahhotela nekukhibika, temabhange kanye netinsitakalo tekwelapha.

src: Nakong ya leeto la hae, Moporesidente Lourenço hape o tla tshwara Kopano ya Thuto ka Labohlano, la 24 Pudungwana 2017 moahong wa OR Tambo ho la Pretoria.
tgt: Ngesikhatsi avakashile, Mengameli Lourenço utawuphindza futsi etfule Sifundvo ngaLesihlanu, mhla tinge-24 Lweti 2017 eSakhiweni i-OR Tambo ePitoli.

src: Matsatsi a16 a Thibelo ya Diketso tsa Dikgoka.
tgt: Tinsuku leti-16 Tekwecwayisa.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le maAforika Borwa kaofela a emang kgahlanong le Diketso tsa dikgoka ho basadi le tlhekefetso ya bana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlanganyela kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labatsatse sincumo sekulwa nekuhlukunyetwa kwabomake nebantfwana.

src: Matsatsi a 16 a letsholo la Thibelo ya Diketso tsa Dikgoka kgahlanong le Basadi le Bana le tla etsahala pakeng tsa la 25 Pudungwana le la 10 Tshitwe 2017.
tgt: Lomkhankaso Wetinsuku leti-16 Tekulwa Nebudlova Lobentiwa kuBomake Nebantfwana utakwenteka kusukela emkhatsini wamhla tinge-25 Lweti namhla ti-10 Ingongoni 2017.

src: Sena ke selemo sa bo-19 sa letsholo lena ka hara Aforika Borwa mme le tla tswela pele tlasa mookotaba: “Mpalleng le Nna: Mmoho re Ntshetsapele Aforika Borwa e Hlokang Dikgoka”.
tgt: Lona ngumnyaka we-19 lomkhankhaso wentiwa lapha eNingizimu Afrika futsi utawuchubeka ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Nami Ngikhona: Sisonkhe Sichubela Embili iNingizimu Afrika Lete Budlova.”.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla thakgola letsholo la Matsatsi a 16 a Thibelo ya Dikgoka ho la Kapa Botjhabela ka Moqebelo, wa la 25 Pudungwana 2017.
tgt: Mengameli Zuma utakwetfula umkhankhaso weTinsuku Leti-16 Tekwecwayisa eMphumalanga Kapa ngeMgcibelo, mhla tinge-25 Lweti 2017.

src: Le tla tsepamisa maikutlo hodima phano e tswellang ya Dipuisano tsa Naha, tse kgothaletsang batho ho bua ka kgoba ya dikgoka tse itshetlehileng hodima bong.
tgt: Utawube ugcile kuTinkhulumiswano Tavelonkhe letichubekako, letigcugcutela bantfu kutsi bakhulume ngalenkinga yebudlova bebulili.

src: Sena se tla etellwa pele ke Letsatsi la Matjhaba la Banna ka Sontaha, sa la 19 Pudungwana 2017, le ipiletsang ho banna ho bapala karolo ya bona mabapi le ho aha setjhaba se bolokehileng le sa kahisano e momahaneng.
tgt: Lomkhankhaso utakwendvulelwa Lusuku Lwemave Emhlaba Lwemadvodza ngeLisontfo, mhla ti-19 Lweti 2017, lapho kucelwa khona onkhe emadvodza kutsi adlale indzima yawo ekwakheni sive lesiphephile nesibumbene.

src: Lefapha la Toka le Ntshetsopele ya Molaotheo le tla hlophisa letsholo la bobedi la diradio tsa badudi tlasa letoto la tsona la Let’s Talk Justice, le tlisang ditshebeletso tsa mmuso bathong ka ho neha bamamedi monyetla wa ho buisana le bahlanka ba mmuso ka ditaba tse ka sehloohong.
tgt: Litiko Letebulungiswa Nekutfutfukiswa kweMtsetfosisekelo litawube lenta umkhankhaso wesibili wemsakato wemmango ngaphasi kweluhlelo lolutsi Let’s Talk Justice, loluletsa tinsikatalo tahulumende kubantfu ngekutsi banike balaleli litfuba lekucocisana nebaphatsi mayelana netindzaba letisematseni.

src: Ho thakgolwa ha Lekgotla la Dinyewe la Ditlolo tsa Molao tsa Motabo nakong ya letsholo hape ho tla netefatsa phumantsho e betere ya tsamaiso ya toka.
tgt: Kwetfulwa kweNkantolo Yemacala eTemacansi ngesikhatsi salomkhankhaso kutawucinisekisa kutsi kuba nekufinyelela lokuncono eluhlelweni lwetebulungiswa.

src: Kabinete e na le tshepo ya hore ka ho sebetsa mmoho re ka qeta motsamao wa tlhekefetso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakholwa kutsi ngekusebenta ngekuhlanganyela singakucedza lokuhlukunyetwa lokuchubekako.

src: Ka mekutu ya rona e kopanetsweng re ka sebetsa ho thibela tlhekefetso ha ka nqa e nngwe re netefatsa setjhaba se bolokehileng bakeng sa basadi le bana.
tgt: Ngemitamo yetfu yekuhlanganyela singakhona kutsi sente lokutsi kute sivikele kuhlukunyetwa kodvwa sibe sicinisekisa kutsi bomake nebantfwana baphila eveni lelivikelekile.

src: Batho bohle ba Aforika Borwa ba kgothaletswa ho apara ribone tse tshweu e le letshwao la boitlamo bakeng sa ho fedisa kgoba ena ka hara setjhaba.
tgt: Bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bayakhutsatwa kutsi bahlome emaribhoni lamhlophe njengeluphawu lwekutibophelela ekucedzeni lenkinga esiveni sakitsi.

src: Boitokisetso ba Letsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDKabinete e ipiletsa setjhabeng kaofela ho nka karolo ho qaleng ha mesebetsi ya Labohlano la Ribone e Kgubedu pele ho Letsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDS ka la 1 Tshitwe le ho fihla mafelong a kgwedi eo.
tgt: Kwenta emalungiselelo eLusuku Lwemhlaba lweNgculazi (i-AIDS).

src: Ho apara diribone tse kgubedu ke letshwao la bonngwe le boitlamo mabapi le ntwa kgahlanong le HIV le AIDLetsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDS ke monyetla bakeng sa motse ka mong ho ikopanya ntweng e kgahlanong le HIV, ho bontsha tshehetso bakeng sa batho ba phelang ka HIV le ho hopola ba hlokahetseng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela wonkhe umuntfu kutsi atimbandzakanye kumalungesilelo landvulela Lesihlanu weTibhoni Lebovu (i-Redi Ribbon Friday) ngembikwkeutsi kucale Lusuku Lwemhlaba Lwe-AIDS mhla ti-01 Ingongoni kudzimate kube sekupheleni kwaleyo nyanga.

src: Ketsahalo ya selemong sena e tla tshwarwa tlasa mookotaba: “Tokelo ya ka ya ho Tseba Maemo a Ka, Thibelo ke Boikarabelo ba ka”, e hokahanang le mookotaba wa lefatshe: “Tokelo ya Bophelo bo Botle”.
tgt: Kufaka iribhoni lebovu kuluphawu lwekuhlanganyela kanye nekutinikela ekulweni neSandvulelangculazi (i-HIV) ne-AIDLusuku Lwemhlaba Lwe-AIDS litfuba lapho yonkhe imimango ibumbana khona ekulweni ne-HIV, kukhombisa kwesekela labo bantfu labaphila neligciwane le-HIV kanye nekukhumbula labo labangasekho.

src: Sena se matlafatsa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Lewa la Morero wa Naha la AIDS la Aforika Borwa, Lefuba le mahloko a Tshwaetsanang ka Motabo 2017 - 2022 (NSP), e leng tshiya ya bohlokwa kgatelopeleng ya Aforika Borwa e lebisitseng phihlellong ya tlhokomelo ya kalafo ya lefatshe jwaloka ha e hlahella ho NDP, e kgothaletsang setjhaba se itekanetseng, se matla le se nang le tekatekano.
tgt: Umcimbi walonyaka utawubanjwa ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Lilungelo Lami Kwati Simo Sami, Kuvikela Sibopho Sami”, lechumana nengcikitsi yemhlaba wonkhe letsi: “Lilungelo Kutemphilo.”.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho badudi ho kenela ho nka karolo bekeng e tlang ya Beke ya Naha ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo ya bo-7, e lebeletsweng ho tshwarwa ho tloha ka la 27 Pudungwana ho isa ka la 3 Tshitwe 2017.
tgt: Loku kucinisa kucala kwekusebenta kweNdlelalisu Lavelonkhe laseNingizimu Afrika le-HIV, Sifo Sesifuba (i-TB) kanye Nekugula Lokutsatselana Ngekuya Emacansini langa-2017-2022 (i-NSP), leliyinsika lemcoka enchubekeleni embili yaseNingizimu Afrika ekuzuzeni kunakekela ngekwetemphilo njengaloku kusho Lisu Lavelonkhe Lentfutfuko (i-NDP), leligcugcutela kutsi kube nesive lesiphilile, lesicinile nalesilinganako.

src: Tlasa boetapele ba GCIS, lepatlelo lena le kgothaletsa dipuisano tse kopanetsweng pakeng tsa ditho tsa Phethahatso le badudi.
tgt: Ngaphasi kwebuholi be-GCIS, lenkhundla igcugcutela kucocisana emkhatsini wemalunga eSigungu nemimango.

src: E etsahala ka hara mohopolo wa dilemo tse lekgolo tsa Oliver Reginald Tambo, ya neng a kgothaletsa tekatekano ya bong.
tgt: Lomcimbi wenteka ngaphasi kwemongo wendzaba yeminyaka lelikhulu yekutalwa kwa-Oliver Reginald Tambo, lowagcugcutela kutsi kube nekulingana ngekwebulili.

src: Diketsahalo tsena di reretswe ho tshehetsa letsholo la Matsatsi a 16 a Ntwa kgahlanong le Dikgoka le Tlhekefetso ya Basadi le Bana.
tgt: Loko lokutawukwentiwa kuhloswe kutsi ngako kwesekwelwe umkhankhaso Wetinsuku Leti-16 Tekwecwayisa.

src: Diketsahalo di tla manehwa khalendareng ya naha le ho arolelanwa websaeteng ya mmuso (WEBTOKEN).Dibili.
tgt: Imicimbi letawubakhona itawufakwa kukhalenda yavelonkhe kuphindze futsi kwabelanwe ngayo kuwebhusayithi yahulumende ku: WEBTOKEN.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya tsebiso ho ya ka karolo 74(5) ya Molaotheo wa Riphabliki ya Aforika Borwa wa selemo sa 1996.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kwesatiso ngekulandzela sigaba se-74(5) seMtsetfosisekelo waseRiphabhliki yaseNingizimu Afrika wa-1996.

src: Morero ka sena ke ho qala tsamaiso ya ditherisano tsa naha le diporofense ka merero ya ho tlisa diphethoho meeding ya diporofense mabapi le Masepala wa Lehae wa Matatiele ho la Kapa Botjhabela le dibakeng tse itseng tsa Ba Ga Mothibi ho la Leboya Bophirima.
tgt: Inhloso yaloko kucala inchubo yavelonkhe neyetifundza yekubonisana ngenhloso yekwenta kutsi kube netingucuko eminyeleni yetifundza macondzana naMasipala Wendzawo waseMatatiele eMphumalanga Kapa kanye nasetindzweni letitsite taseBa Ga Mothibi eNyakatfo Nshonalanga.

src: Maikemisetso ka ho ralwa botjha ha meedi ya diporofense ho hlahisitswe ke badudi ba dibaka tse boletsweng ba batlang ho kgutlisetswa diporofenseng tse mabapi.
tgt: Lenhloso yekufinyelela kusincumo ngemincele yetifundza sivela emimmangweni yaletindzawo lekukhulunywa ngato letinesifiso sekutsi tifakwe ngaphansi kwetifundza letingubomakhelwane.

src: Melaetsa.
tgt: Imilayeto.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa naha ya Fora jwalo ka thatohatsi e tla tshwara Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Rakbi wa selemo sa 2023 le ho leboha kemedi ya mmuso, e neng e eteletswe pele ke Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa, Letona la Dipapadi le Boithapollo Thulas Nxesi le Kopano ya Rakbi ya Aforika Borwa, bakeng sa mosebetsi wa ho kgothaletsa boiketo ba Aforika Borwa ba ho tshwara ketsahalo ena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalisela live laseFrance njengelive lelikhetfwe kutsi lisingatse Imidlalo Yendzebe Yemhlaba Yelibhola Lembhoco yanga-2023 futsi ibonga litsimba lahulumende, lebeliholwa Lisekelamengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, Indvuna Yetemidlalo Nekukhibika Thulas Nxesi kanye neNyonyana yaseNingizimu Afrika Yelibhola Lembhoco (i-SARU), ngemsebenti leyawenta ekukhangiseni live laseNingizimu Afrika kulomkhankhaso wekufaka sicelo sekutsi lisingatse lomcimbi.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Letona Pandor, ya abetsweng Kgau ya Titjhere e ka Sehlohlolong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela Indvuna Pandor, loklonyeliswe ngeMkomelo Wathishela Lophuma Embili.

src: Kgau ena e ile ya nehwa Letona Pandor ke Motjhanselara wa Yunivesithi ya Aforika Borwa, Moporesidente wa mehleng Thabo Mbeki.
tgt: Lomklomelo Indvuna Pandor uwunikwe yiShansela yaseNyuvesi yaseNingizimu Afrika (i-Unisa), Mengameli waphambilini Thabo Mbeki.

src: Kgau ya Titjhere e ka Sehlohlolong, e leng e nngwe ya mekgahlelo e mene, e ananela nyehelo ya titjhere leha e le efe e ipabotseng kapa e ntsheditseng pele ho ruta, ho ithuta, ntshetsopele ya maitsebelo le/kapa diphutso lekaleng la yona la botsebi.
tgt: LoMkomelo Wathishela Lophuma Embili, munye wemikhakha yawo lemine, kwatisa ligalelo lanome ngabe ngumuphi thishela lophuma embili lophume embili ekufundziseni, ekufundzeni, ekutfutfukiseni emakhono kanye/nome lucwaningo emkhakheni wakhe webungcweti.

src: Kabinete e babatsa mosebetsi o entsweng ke Seteishene sa Aforika Borwa sa Tsebo ya Dinaledi, e leng karolo ya moifo wa ditsomi tsa dipolanete wa Wide Angle Search for Planets o sibollotseng dipolanete tse tharo tse ntjha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idvumisa umsebenti lowentiwe i-South African Astronomical Observatory, lokuyincenye ye-Wide Angle Search for Planets lokuyinhlangano lefuna emaplanethi labatfole kutsi kunemaplanethi lamasha lamatsatfu.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa bankakarolo le bahlodi ba Dikgau tsa selemo sa 2017 tsa Govan Mbeki, tse tlotlang batho ba lekala la kaho ba ipabotseng ka phano ya matlo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela labo labatimbandzakanye futsi baphumelela kuklonyeliswa ngemklomelo we-Govan Mbeki Awards wanga-2017, wekuhlonipha labo labasebenta emkhakheni wetekwakha labaphume embili ekwakheni tindlu.

src: Kabinete e bokane bakeng sa kopano ya ho qetela ya selemo sa 2017 Union Buildings ho la Pretoria.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ihlangene yabamba umhlangano wayo wekugcina wanga-2017 e-Union Buildings ePitoli.

src: Diqeto tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Tincumo TeKhabhinethi.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Lewa la Naha la Lekala la Bohahlaudi (NTSS) 2016-2026 bakeng sa ho kenngwa tshebetsong.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ivumile kutsi Lisukuhlela Lemkhakha Wavelonkhe Wetekuvakasha (i-NTSS) lwanga-2016-2026 luphunyeleliswe.

src: NTSS e thehilwe hodima ditshiya tse hlano tsa lewa, e leng ho le bapatsa, ho thusa ka phihlello e bobebe bakeng sa bahahlaudi, ho matlafatsa boiphihlelo ba baeti, bolaodi ba dibaka tsa ketelo le melemo e pharalletseng.
tgt: Le-NTSS isime kutinsika letine letibalulekile, lekunguleti, kumaketha, kwenta kutsi tivakashi tifinyelele kalula, kwenta kancono loko tivakashi letihlangabetana nako, kulawula indzawo lekuyiwa kuyo kanye netinzuzo letimkhakhubanti.

src: Tokomane ka botlalo e fumaneha websaeteng ya Lefapha la Bohahlaudi: WEBTOKEKabinete e tjhaelletse monwana moralo bakeng sa ho thehwa ha Khamphani ya Naha ya Marangrang a Pharalletseng.
tgt: Umculu lophelela uyatfolakala kuwebhusayithi yeLitiko Letekuvakasha: WEBTOKEIkhabhinethi iluvumile luhlakamsebenti lwekusungula Inkampani Yavelonkhe Ye-intanethi Lesheshisako.

src: E tla boptjwa ka ho kopanngwa ha Sentech le Broadband Infraco.
tgt: Itawakhiwa ngekutsi kuhlanganiswe iSentech neBroadband Infraco.

src: Sena se tla thusa ka phano ya dintlha tse ikemetseng ka kopanelo ka mokgwa o hokahaneng le ho bopa mampodi wa marangrang a pharalletseng.
tgt: Loku kutawuchuba kutsi kucala kusetjentiswa tintfo letihlangane ngendlela lechumene bese kwakheka shampeni we-intanethi yavelonkhe lesheshisako.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Tlaleho ya Kgatelopele ya Pele ya Selemo ka seng mabapi le ho Kenngwa Tshebetsong ha Tokomane ya Moralo ya Ditokelo tsa Batho ba Nang le Boqhwala (WPRPD).
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iwuvumile Umbiko Wekucala Wemnyaka Wenchubekelembili Wekuphumelelisa Umtsetfo Lodzingidvwako weMalungelo Ebantfu Labaphila Nekukhubateka (i-WPRPD).

src: Tlaleho e akaretsa nako ya ho tloha ka la 1 Pherekgong ho isa ka la 31 Tshitwe 2016.Tlaleho e fana ka tekolo ya boemo bo phahameng ya tsela eo mafapha a mmuso a qadileng ho theha ditshupiso tsa leano la WPRPD ka hara ditsamaiso tsa ona tsa meralo, ditekanyetso, le phano ya ditshebeletso le ho tlaleha ka tatelano.
tgt: Lombiko ukhuluma ngesikhatsi lesisuka mhla lu-1 Bhimbidvwane kuya kumhla tinge-31 Ingongoni 2016.Lombiko uhlola ngalokusezingeni leliphakeme kutsi ematiko ahulumende asahambe kangakanani nekujulisa imigomo yenchubomgomo ye-WPRPD ekuhleleni kwawo lokufanele, kubhajetha, kwetfulwa kwetinsita kanye netinchubo tekubika.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Lewa la Moralo wa Leano la Boqhwala bakeng sa Tsamaiso ya Thuto le Thupello ya kamora Materiki bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kweLuhlakamsebenti Lwenchubomgomo Yelisukuhlela Yalabakhubatekile Yemfundvo Lephakeme neKucecesha kute kutsi sive siphawule ngayo.

src: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka sephetho sa ho Shejwa botjha ha Lenaneo la ho Thusa Boraditekesi ka Ditjhelete le hlophisitsweng ho tloha ka Pudungwana 2015 ho fihla ka Loetse 2016.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi yatiswa ngemiphumela yeKubuyeketwa kweLuhlelo lweKuhlela Kabusha Kwemkhakha Wematekisi lolwentiwa ngeLweti 2015 kwate kwaba yiNyoni 2016.

src: Lenaneo lena ke karolo ya Lewa la Dipalangwang tsa Setjhaba le Bataletseng, le reretsweng ho fana ka tsamaiso e kopanetsweng le ho ba hlwahlwa ha dipalangwang ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Loluhlelo luyincenye lweLuhlelolisu Lwahulumende Lwetitfutsi, lokuhloswe ngalo kutsi eNingiziu Afrika kube netekutfutsa letihlangane letiphephile naletisebenta ngemphumelelo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ntlha ya hore ho be le dipuisano le mosebetsi o mongata le mafapha a amehang pele Lefapha la Naha la Dipalangwang le ka kenya tshebetsong katamelo e hlabollotsweng botjha.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kutsi kufanele kutsi kube nalokunye kubonisana nekusebenta lokufanele kutsi kwentiwe ngematiko lafanele ngembi kwekutsi Litiko Letekutfutsa Lavelonkhe licale kusebentisa loluhlelo lolubuyeketiwe.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho lokollelwa setjhaba ha kgatiso ya bo-8 ya Ditshupane tsa Ntshetsopele (2016).
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kukhululelwa esiveni kwelushicilelo lwe-8 lweTinkhomba Tekutfutfukisa (2016).

src: Tlaleho ya Tshupane ya Ntshetsopele e tsepamisa maikutlo hodima ntshetsopele ya Aforika Borwa esale ho tloha qalong ya demokerasi mme e beha leihlo ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP): Tjhebelopele ya Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana mekgwa ya ho matlafatsa bolaodi ba boitshwaro ba basebeletsi ba setjhaba mabapi le bahlanka ba etsang dikgwebo le makala a puso.
tgt: LoMbiko weTinkhomba teKutfutfukisa ugcile ekutfutfukeni kweNingizimu Afrika kusukela kwacala intsandvo yelinyenti futsi ulandzelela kuphunyeleliswa kweLisu Lavelonkhe Lekutfutfukisa (i-NDP): Umbononchanti-20.

src: E fana ka sefutho ho Melawana ya Tshebeletso ya Mmuso ya selemo sa 2016, e thibelang basebeletsi ba mmuso hore ba se ke ba kena kgwebong le Puso.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi itivumile tindlela tekucinisa kulawulwa kwekujeziswa kwetisebenti tahulumende mayelana netisebenti letichuba emabhizinisi nemitimba yembuso.

src: Ho tloha ka la 1 Hlakubele, Lefapha la Matlotlo a Naha, le tsheheditswe ke Lefapha la Tshebeletso ya Mmuso le Tsamaiso (DPSA), le tla beha leihlo hodima boingodiso kaofela bo botjha ho marangrang a inthanete a Dathabeisi e Bohareng ya Bafani ba Ditshebeletso (CSD) kgahlanong le Tsamaiso ya Persale.
tgt: Tenta kutsi Imitsetfomgomo Yetisebenti Tahulumende yanga-2016 isebente, levimbela tisebenti tahulumende kutsi tichube emabhizinisi neMbuso.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Bolaodi bo Botjha ba Tshebetso le Tsamaiso ya Ntshetsopele ya Dihlooho tsa Mafapha, bo bontshang ka nepo kgokahano pakeng tsa motho ka bo mong le tshebetso ya setheo ka kakaretso.
tgt: Kusukela ngeNdlovulenkhulu, Temafa Wavelonkhe, tesekelwa Litiko Letemisebenti Yahulumende Nekuphatsa (i-DPSA), litawulandzelela konkhe kubhaliswa lokusha kuDathabhesi Yavelonkhe Yebatfulitinsita ku-inthanethi ngekuhlola Inchubo ye-Persal.

src: E tla qala ho sebetsa ka la1 Mmesa Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tsebahatswa le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Moralo wa Sekema sa ho Thaothwa ha Dirutehi tsa Tshebeletso ya Mmuso.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile Kulawulwa Kwendlela Lensha Yekuhlola neNchubo Yekutfutfukisa Tinhloko Tematiko, lokukhombisa ngalokunembako kuchumana lokusemkhatsini wemsebenti wemuntfu nekusebenta kwenhlangano.

src: Sena se bopa karolo ya lenaneo la ntshetsopele ka hara Tshebeletso ya Mmuso ho hohella dirutehi tse nang le talente ka hara Tshebeletso ya Mmuso.
tgt: Itawucala kusebenta kusukela mhla lu-1 Mabasa Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kungeniswa nekuphunyeleliswa kweLuhlakamsebenti Lwesikimu Sekwehlaya Baphotfuli Bemanyuvesi Batewusebentela Hulumende.

src: Moralo o kenyeletsa ho supa diphesente tsa dikgeo tsa mesebetsi tsa lefapha ka leng bakeng sa ho thaothwa ha dirutehi mesebetsing e haellang.
tgt: Loku kwenta incenye yeluhlelo lwekutfutfukisa ngekhatsi kuTemisebenti Yahulumende kute kucashwe lusha kuTemisebenti Yahulumende.

src: Letona la DPSA hape le tla matahanya moralo ona le Lenaneo la Tshebeletso ya Kgiro ya Batjha.
tgt: Loluhlakamsebenti lufaka ekhatsi kubeka eceleni emaphesenti etikhala letivulekile telitiko ngalinye kutsi tihlwayelwe labaphotfule emanyuvesi bemisebenti yemakhono layindlala.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana bakeng sa phatlalatso ya Ditsebiso tse latelang Koranteng ya Mmuso tse amanang le Tokiso ya Dikahlolo tsa Makgotla a Dinyewe, e reretsweng ho eketsa phihlello ya toka bakeng sa batho ba neng ba qheletswe ka thoko pele le metsana ya mahae e sa tholeng ditshebeletso tse lokelang.
tgt: Indvuna yeLitiko Letemisebenti Yahulumende Nekuphatsa naye utawenta luhlakamsebenti lwakhe luhambisane neLuhlelo Lwetemisebenti Yekutfutfukisa Lusha.

src: Tokiso ena e diterekeng tsa bomaseterata Freistata le Kapa Leboya, le ho tloswa ha Ditereke tsa Bomaseterata tse itseng ho Karolo ya Lekgotla le Phahameng la Dinyewe la Gauteng le ho di beha tlasa bodisa ba Karolo ya Lekgotla le Phahameng la Dinyewe la Leboya Bophirima.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kwaleTatiso kuGazethi yaHulumende letiphatsele neKuhlelwa Kabusha Kwetindzawo Letingaphasi Kwetinkantolo, lokuhlose kukhulisa emandla ekufinyelela bulungiswa betigodzi tasemaphandleni lebetikadze tinganakwa noma tingatfoli tinsita ngalokufanele.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Melawana ya Melao ya Bonamodi ho ya ka dipehelo tsa Molao wa Tshireletso ya Matsete, 2015 (Molao wa bo-22 wa selemo sa 2015).
tgt: Lokuhlelwa kabusha kutawentiwa etigodzini tabomantji eFreyistata naseNyakatfo Kapa, kanye nekususwa kwaletinye Tigodzi taMantji letitsite kuLuphiko lwaseGauteng lweNkantolo Lephakeme bese tibekwa ngaphasi kwemandla eNkantolo Lephakame yaseNyakatfo Nshonalanga.

src: Melawana ena e fana ka hore motsetedi ya nang le kgang mabapi le mohato o nkuweng ke mmuso o amang matsete, ho kopa Lefapha la Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri (dti) ho kenella ka mokgwa wa bonamodi o ka bang teng.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyivumile Imitsetfosimiso Yekungenelela ngekwemibandzela yeMtsetfo Wekuvikela Lutjalomali, wanga-2015 (Umtsetfo-22 wanga-2015).

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho bitswa le ho tshwarwa ha dipitso tse latelang:Pitso ya Ditherisano ya Naha ya Lenaneo la Ntshetsopele ya Basebeletsi ba Badudi ya selemo sa 2018 ke DPSA.
tgt: Lemitsefosimiso ibonelela umtjalimali lonenkinga mayelana nesinyatselo lesitsetfwe nguhulumende lesitsintsa kabi lutjalomali, kutsi acele Litiko Letekuhwebelana Netetimboni (i-dti) kutsi lingenelele ngendlela lefanele yekulamula.

src: Pitso ya bo-23 ya Selemo ka seng ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa Batjhutjhisi, e tla tshwarwa ke Bolaodi ba Naha ba Botjhutjhisi ho la Durban ka Loetse 2018.Foramo ya Lefatshe ya Saense ya selemo sa 2021 ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kutsi kubitwe kuphindze futsi kungeniswe letinkhomfa letilandzelako:Inkhomfa Yekubonisana yanga-2018 Yeluhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwetisebenti Letitfutfukisa Ummango ingeniswe yi-DPSInkhomfa ye-23 Yemave Emhlaba Yemnyaka Yebashushisi, letawungeniswa nguMkandlu Wetebushushisi Wavelonkhe eDurban ngeMphala nga-2018.Iforamu Yemhlaba Yesayensi eNingizimu Afrika nga-2021.

src: Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji le tla buisana le Komiti ya Tsamaiso ya Foramo ya Lefatshe ya Saense ka kgonahalo ya ho tshwara pitso ena.
tgt: Litiko Letesayensi Netheknoloji litawukhulumisana neLikomidi Lelichuba Iforamu Yemhlaba Yesayensi mayelana nekungenisa leforamu.

src: Dipuisano tsa Boemo bo Phahameng tsa 2017 tsa Kopano ya Aforika (AU), e tla tshwarwa ke DPSA ho tloha ka la 6 ho isa ka la 8 Tshitwe Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana bakeng sa meralo ya letoto la dikhoine tsa sehopotso tsa babokelli le potoloho hore di ntshuwe ka selemo sa 2018.Meralo ya dikhoine, le diphatlalatso tsa tsona, di tla hatiswa Koranteng ya Mmuso: 2018 2oz, 22-dikharate tsa gauta tsa Krugerrand 2018 24-dikharate tsa gauta tsa letoto la dikhoine tsa Natura (Kgolo ya Sube – Archosauria) 2018 24-dikharate tsa letoto la dikhoine tsa gauta tsa R1 (Dihahabi tsa Aforika Borwa – kgudu)2018 khoine ya ditshepe tse pedi ya R5 e potolohang (Dilemo tse Lekgolo tsa Nelson Mandela)2018 24-dikharate tsa letoto la dikhoine tsa Protea tsa gauta le steling sa silifera (Bophelo ba Mohale – Nelson Mandela)2018 letoto la steling sa silifera sa Korone ya R2 le letoto la Teke ya 2 ½ (Ditshibollo tsa Aforika Borwa – Ditshwantsho tsa mahlasedi a X-ray tse entsweng ka khompyutha le 2018 letoto la dikhoine tse kentsweng mebala tsa steling sa silifera (Dinonyana le Dipalesa tsa Resefe ya Tlhaho ya Waterberg).Dintlha tsa Hajwale.
tgt: Inkhulumiswano Yelizinga Leliphakeme Yenhlangano Yebunye Be-Afrika (i-AU) yanga-2017, leyangeniswa yi-DPSA kusukela mhla ti-6 kuya kumhla ti-8 Ingongoni 2017.

src: Sephetho sa Palohohle ya Dihlahiswa tsa Naha (GDP)Kabinete e thabisitswe ke kgolo ya moruo wa Afrika Borwa o hotseng ka sekgahla sa 2% tsa selemo ka seng kotareng ya boraro ya selemo sa 2017, ho tloha ho phahameng ho shebuweng botjha ha 2.8% kotareng ya bobedi.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kutsi nga-2018 kukhishwe tinhlavumali letitikhumbuto naletigcogcwako kanye naletitawusatjalaliswa.

src: Tshebetso ena e matla kamoo ho neng ho sa lebellwa ke ka lebaka la kgolo e matla e ntseng e tswela pele lekaleng la temo, le nyehetseng ka dintlha tsa diphesente tse moruong ka kakaretso ha ho shejwa kgolo ya 44.2% kotara-le-kotara.
tgt: Letinhlavumali, nekumenyetelwa kwato, kutawushicilelwa kuGazethi yaHulumende: 2018 2oz, 22-carat gold KrugerrandLuhlavumali lwe-Natura lwanga-2018 loluyi-24-carat gold (Kuvela kwema-dinosaur – Archosauria)Luhlavumali lwa-R1 lwanga-2018 loluyi-24-carat gold (Tilwanyana taseNingizimu Afrika letihuma ngesisu – lufundvu lolonemlomo lofana newahhokwe (i-parrot beaked padloper))Luhlavumali lolujikeletako lwa-R5 lwanga-2018 lolwentiwe ngetinhlobo letimbili temethali (Iminyakalikhulu yaNelson Mandela)Luhlavumali lweSicalaba lwanga-2018 lolwentiwe nge-24-carat gold ne-sterling-silver (Imphilo yaMatiwase – Nelson Mandela)Luhlavumali lwe-R2 Crown naTiki loyi-2 ½ lwanga-2018 lolwentiwe nge-sterling-silver (Tintfo Letisungulwa eNingizimu Afrika – Ithomografi Leyentiwe ngaNgcondvomshini (i-Computed Tomography)) kanyeLuhlavumali lwanga-2018 le-sterling-silver lolufakwe umbala laphelela (Tinyoni neTimbali teSichiwi Sekulondvolota Imvelo saseWaterberg).Tindzaba Talelive Letimcoka.

src: Tshebetso e matla ho tsa temo, e bileng le kgolo e matla ka dikotara tse tharo tse latelanang, ke ka lebaka la dimela tsa masimong (tse kang poone) dibakeng tsa pula ya lehlabula le dihlahiswa tsa ditshingwaneng.
tgt: Imiphumela Yemkhicito Wonkhe WeliveIkhabhinethi iyatfokota ngekukhula kwemnotfo walapha eNingizimu Afrika lokhule nge-2% wemnyaka ekoteni yesitsatfu yanga-2017, usuka ku-2.8% lebewubuyeketwa kuya etulu ngekota yesibili.

src: Merafo le difeme tsa tlhahiso di nyehetse kgolong e rekotuweng, moo merafo le dikwari di phahameng ka 6.6% le ho nyehela dintlha tse tsa diphesente kgolong ya moruo.
tgt: Lokwenta kahle kakhulu lokunemandla kwabangelwa kukhula lobekuchubeka emkhakheni wetekulima, lofake ligalelo la-0.9% ekukhuleni sekukonkhe ngemuva kwa-44.2% wekukhula ngekota, ngekota.

src: Lekala la motlakase ke lona le hulanyang maoto ka ho fetisisa, le theohile ka 5.5%.
tgt: Kwenta kahle kakhulu kutekulima, lokubone emakota lamatsatfu lalandzelanako ekukhula lokunemandla, kwabangelwa kukhicitwa ngelizinga leliphakeme kwetilimo tasemasimini (njengemmbila) etindzweni letitfola imvula ehlobo kanye nemikhicito yetijalo tasengadzeni.

src: Kgolo bakeng sa dintho tse sebediswang malapeng ya 2.6% ke ka lebaka haholo la ho reka thepa ya nako e telele, e bakileng keketseho ya dintlha tsa diphesente tse tsa keketseho ya 2.6%.
tgt: Timbiwa nekukhicita nako kufake ligalelo kulokhula lokubhaliwe, lapho khona tetimbiwa nekumbiwa kwenkwali kukhule nga-6.6% lokufake i-0.5% ekukhuleni.

src: Kgolo ena e neng e sa lebellwa le ho shejwa botjha ho phahameng ha sephetho sa kgolo ya kotara ya bobedi e bolela hore kgolo e ka fihla ho 0.9% ka selemo sa 2017.Sena se ka hodimo ho feta 0.7% e neng e lebeletswe nakong ya Pehelo ya Leano la Ditekanyetso tsa Nako e Bohareng (MTBP).
tgt: Umkhakha wetagezi nguwo lowehle kakhulu, nge-5.5%.

src: Mmuso o lokela ho netefatsa hore lebelo lena la kgolo le dula le le jwalo ka ho tswela pele ho kenya tshebetsong mekgwa e 14 ya ho matlafatsa tshepo e hahellang hodima ho ntlafatsa tshepo ya basebedisi le ho kgutlisetsa tshepo ya borakgwebo.
tgt: Kukhula kwalokusetjentiswa emindenini kwe-2.6% kwabangelwa kakhulu kusebentisa imali kumikhicto lecinile, lokwenta i-1.6% kusuka ekukhuleni nga-2.6%.

src: Lebenkele le Abelanang Tsohle la InvestSAKabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa ha Lebenkele le Abelanang Tsohle la InvestSA KwaZulu-Natal ke Moporesidente Jacob Zuma e le karolo ya mekutu ya ho ntlafatsa bobebe ba ho etsa dikgwebo ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Kukhula lokunemandla kunaloku lebekulindzelekile kanye nekubuyeketa kuya etulu kumiphumela yekukhula yekota yesibili kusho kutsi kukhula kungafinyelela ku-0.9% nga-2017.Loku kungetulu kuna-0.7% lobekalindzelwe ngesikhatsi seSitatimende Senchubomgomo Yelwabiwomali Lwethemu Lesemkhatsini (i-MTBPS).

src: Lena ke Lebenkele la boraro le Abelanang Tsohle le thakgotsweng ka hara naha.
tgt: Hulumende ufanele kutsi acinisekise kutsi lamandla ekukhula agcinwa anjalo ngekutsi kuchutjekwe kuphunyeleliswe letindlela leti-14 letifaka emandla ekutetsembeni lokwakhela ekwenteni kancono kutetsemba kwebatsengi kantsi futsi kungabuyisa kutetsemba kwebhizinisi.

src: Le reretswe ho bopa tikoloho e nepahetseng ka ho fana ka sebaka sa boikopanyo bakeng sa batsetedi hore ba fumane ditshebeletso tsohle bakeng sa ho akofisa diporojeke le ho fokotsa metjha e mengatangata ya mmuso ha motho a qala kgwebo.
tgt: I-InvestSA One-Stop ShopIkhabhinethi iyakwemukela kwetfulwa kwesikhungo lesinako konkhe, i-InvestSA One-Stop Shop KwaZulu-Natal nguMengameli Jacob Zuma njengencenye yemitamo yekwenta kancono kuchuntjwa kwemabhizinisi eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Dikamano tsa Aforika Borwa le AngolaKabinete e amohela ditumellano tse saennweng nakong ya Leeto la Puso Aforika Borwa la Moporesidente wa Angola João Manuel Gonçalves Lourenço.
tgt: Ihlose kwakha simondzawo lesivumako ngekutsi yente kutsi ibe yinye indzawo yekutsintsana yebatjalimali kutsi batfole kuyo tonkhe tinsita tekuphutfumisa imiklamo nekunciphisa bulukhuni lobuvetwa nguhulumende nawusungula ibhizinisi.

src: Ho saennwe ditumellano tse latelang: Memorandamo wa Kutlwano (MoU) mabapi le ho boptjwa ha Khomishene ya Boporesidente ya Dinaha tse Pedi, MoU wa Tshebedisano Lepatlelong la Tikoloho, Ditataiso tsa ho Kenngwa Tshebetsong ha pebofatso ya phumantsho ya divisa, Porothokhole ya Tshebedisano ya Sepolesa le Tumellano ya Thusano Mabakeng a Tsamaiso ya Makgetho a Madiboho.
tgt: Budlelwane neNingizimu Afrika ne-AngolaIkhabhinethi iyatemukela tivumelwane letisayinwe ngesikhatsi seKuvakasha kweNhloko yeMbuso eNingizimu Afrika lokwentiwe nguMengameli wase-Angola João Manuel Gonçalves Lourenço.

src: Seboka sa Bohlano sa AU le Kopano ya Yuropa (EU)Kabinete e amohela sephetho sa Seboka sa Bohlano sa AU le ESeboka sena se fanne ka monyetla bakeng sa Aforika Borwa ho matlafatsa mawa a dikamano tsa moruo le bodiplomate ka dipuisano tse fapafapaneng sebokeng sena le diketsahalong tse ka thoko tse kang Foramo ya Kgwebo le Seboka sa Batjha, ka ho tsepamisa maikutlo hodima kgolo ya moruo e kenyeletsang kgiro ya batjha le boetapele ba dikgwebo.
tgt: Kusayinwe letivumelwane letilandzelako: Imemorandamu yeKuvisisana (i-MoU) yekusungulwa kweKhomishini yaBomengameli Lababili, i-MoU yetekubambisana Emkhakheni Wetemvelo, Kuphunyeleliswa kweTinchubomgomo tekususa ema-visa, Sivumelwane seLubambiswano lweTemaphoyisa kanye neSivumelwane lesimayelana neKusitana eTindzabeni Temtselo Wetekuhwebelana.

src: Kgwebisano ya Bokgoba ya Bafalli ba batho batsho ba maAforikaKabinete e imatahanya le badudi ba matjhaba mabapi le ho tshwela ka mathe ditlaleho tsa ho fantiswa ha bafalli ba batho batsho ba maAforika ho la Libya jwaloka makgoba.
tgt: Ingcungcutsela yeSihlanu yeNhlangano yeMave ase-Afrika (i-AU) neyeNhlangano yeMave wase-Yurophu (i-EU)Ikhabhinethi iyayemukela imiphumela yeNgcungcutsela yeSihlanu ye-AU ne-ELengcungcutsela yaveta litfuba lekutsi iNingizimu Afrika yente kancono budlelwane bayo betemnotfo lobalulekile nebalamanye emave ngekukhulumisana ngetintfo letinyenti letehlukene kulengcungcutsela nakumikhosi yangekhatsi lefanana neForamu yeTemabhizinisi neNgcungcutsela yeLusha, ngekugcila kumnotfo lokhulako lofaka konkhe ekhatsi, kucashwa kwelusha netemabhizinisi.

src: Diketso tse jwalo tse hlokang botho di kgahlanong le mehopolo ya AU, le disebediswa tse amehang tsa Aforika le tsa matjhabeng, ho kenyeletswa Tjhata ya Aforika le Ditokelo tsa Botho le tsa Batho.
tgt: Luhwebo lwetigcila tebantfu base-Afrika labatitfutsela kulamanye emaveIkhabhinethi nayo njengamave emhlaba iyayigceka imibiko yekutsengiswa endalini kwebantfu base-Afrika labatitfutsela eLibya njengetigcila.

src: Kabinete e amohela tsebiso ka ba ka sehloohong ya hore ba tla hlophisa mokgwa wa dipalangwang le phalliso ho la Tripoli bakeng sa baphaphathehi le bafalli ba hlokang tshireletso ya matjhaba.
tgt: Letento tebulwane tiphambene nemigomo ye-AU, kanye netimiso letifanele tase-Afrika netemave emhlaba, kufaka ekhatsi Lucwebhu lwase-Afrika lweMalungelo eBuntfu neBantfu.

src: Ho ropoha ha ListeriosiseKabinete e ipiletsa ho batho bohle ho nka mehato ya ho itlhokomela – e jwaloka ho hlapa matsoho pele ba lokisa dijo le ho phema dijo tse tala kapa tse sa phehuwang – ho thibela ho nama ha Listeriosise, ha dipatlisiso di ntse di tswela pele bakeng sa ho tiisetsa mohlodi wa baktheria ena.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyasemukela simemetelo setiphatsimandla sekutsi kutawuvulwa sikhungo sekusita bakhoseli labandlula eTripoli labadzinga kuvikelwa ngemave emhlaba.

src: Lefu lena le bakwa ke baktheria e fumanwang mobung, metsing, dimeleng le dihlahisweng tsa lebese tse sa hlwekisiswang, mme le ka baka matshwao ao e kang ke a ntaramane e kopaneng le letshollo.
tgt: Kubhedvuka kwe-ListeriosisIkhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu kutsi bacaphele – njengekutsi nje bageze tandla tabo ngembi kwekutsi balungise kudla kanye nekugwema kudla lokungakaphekwa – kutsi kuliwe nekubhebhetseka kwale-Listeriosis, lapho luphenyo lusachubeka nekutfola lapho leligciwane lisuka khona.

src: Le ka phekolwa ka katleho ka diantibayothiki, haeba e ka hlokomelwa ka nako.
tgt: Lokugula kubangwa ligciwane lelitfolakala emhlabatsini, ematini, etitjalweni nakumikhicito yelubisi lengakahlantwa ngalokuphelele, futsi kungakuvetela timphawu letifanana netemkhuhlane letihamba nemsheko.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho tswela pele ho sebedisa metsi ka paballo kaha naha e ntse e tswela pele ho ba ka hara komello.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bachubeke nekusebentisa emanti ngekuwonga ngoba somiso sisachubeka kulelive.

src: Ho sa tsotellwe dipula tse ntseng di na, maemo a matamo a ntse a tswela pele ho theoha ka hara naha.
tgt: Nanoma nje litulu lisandza kuna, emazinga emanti emadamini kuvelonkhe ayachubeka nekwehla.

src: Sena ke ka lebaka la dithempheretjha tse hodimo hammoho le hore ha re so fumane dipula tse tsitsitseng.
tgt: Loku kubangelwa ngemazinga ekushisha lasetulu kanye nekutsi sisengakatitfoli timvula letina tichubeke njalo.

src: Kabinete e kgothatswa ke ditherisano tse hatetseng pele le bomasepala ba kolotang haholo tse lebisitseng tharollong ya sekoloto sa bomasepala.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyakhutsateka ngenchubekelembili yetingcongco nabomasipala labacwile etikweletini tekutsi kutfolakale sisombululo saletikweti tamasipala.

src: Dibili.
tgt: Imitsetfosivivinyo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa Palamenteng ha Dibili tse latelang.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kwetfulwa ePhalamende kwaleMitsetfosivivinyo lelandzelako:.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Dithuso tsa Kahisano ya selemo sa 2017Bili ena e fana ka melemo e ntlafaditsweng mabapi le dithuso tsa mmuso tsa ditshehetso tsa ditjhelete bakeng sa bana ba dikgutsana le ba tsietsing, ho kenyeletswa le ba dulang malapeng a eteletsweng pele ke bana.
tgt: Umtsetfosivivinyo weKuchibela Tibonelelo Tenhlalo wanga-2017.LoMtsetfosivivinyo uniketa tinzuzo letincono macondzana nesibonelelomali sebantfwana labatintsandzane nebantfwana labaphuyile, kufaka ekhatsi labo labahlala emakhaya laholwa bantfwana.

src: Bili ya Ditsebi tsa Thepa ya Matlo ya selemo sa 2017Bili e fedisa Molao wa hajwale wa Merero ya Makala a Matlo, 1976 (Molao wa bo-112 wa selemo sa 1976).
tgt: Umtsetfosivivinyo Walabatsengisa Tindlu Nemhlaba-2017LoMtsetfosivivinyo ucitsa lomtsetfo lokhona kwamanje Umtsetfo Wetindzaba Te-ejensi Yekutsengiswa Kwetindlu, wanga-1976 (Umtsetfo-112 wanga-1976).

src: E bopa tikoloho e kgontshang bolaodi bakeng sa ho matlafatsa mosebetsi wa moruo ka hara indaseteri ya matlo ha hape e sebetsana le tlhokeho ya ho netefatsa diphethoho ka hara lekala lena.
tgt: Wakha mitsetfo yekwenta ncono umsebenti wetemnotfo ngekhatsi kumboni yekutsengiswa kwetindlu ube futsi ubukana nesidzingo sekucinisekisa kugucuka kwetintfo kulomkhakha.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Moralo wa Naha wa Mangolo a Thuto ya selemo sa 2016Bili ena e matlafatsa Molao wa hajwale wa Moralo wa Naha wa Mangolo a Thuto, 2008 (Molao wa bo-67 wa selemo sa 2008).
tgt: Umtsetfosisivivinyo Wekuchibela Luhlakamsebenti Lwavelonkhe Lweticu Tetemfundvo wanga-2016LoMtsetfosivivinyo ucinisa lomtsetfo lokhona kwamanje Umtsetfo Wavelonkhe Weluhlakamsebenti Lweticu Tetemfundvo, wanga-2008 (Umtsetfo-167 wanga-2008).

src: E tsebahatsa mekgwa ya ho sebetsana le dintlha tsa mafosi le ho beha ditlamorao ho batho ba fanang ka mangolo a thuto a fosahetseng kapa mekgatlo e fanang ka mangolo a thuto a sa nepahalang.
tgt: Ungenisa timiso tekubukana netindzaba tekumelela kabi kanye nekuhlisibeta imiphumela yekwenta kabi yebantfu labangetfuli kahle ticu tabo tetemfundvo noma tinhlangano letikhipha ticu tetemfundvo letingasebenti.

src: Bili ya Botlokotsebe ba Matjhaba ya selemo sa 2017Bili e fana ka moralo wa ketsamolao o ntlafaditsweng ho sebetsana le botlokotsebe ba matjhaba bo entsweng ka hara Aforika Borwa le mose ho meedi ya rona.
tgt: Umtsetfosivivinyo Wemacala Emave Emhlaba wanga-2017LoMtsetfosivivinyo ubeka luhlakamsebenti lwekushaya umtsetfo lolwentiwe kancono lolutawubukana nemacala ebugebengu lentiwe ngekhatsi kwaleli laseNingizimu Afrika nangale kweminyele yetfu.

src: Hape e fana ka tshireletso le toka bakeng sa mahlatsipa a botlokotsobe ba matjhaba.
tgt: Uphindze futsi unikete kuvikeleka lokwentiwe kancono kanye nebulungiswa bemacala ebugebengu emave emhlaba.

src: Melaetsa.
tgt: Imibiko.

src: Kabinete e thoholeditse:.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ihalalisele:.

src: Moporesidente Uhuru Kenyatta ka ho hlomamiswa ha hae e le Moporesidente wa Rephabliki ya Kenya le hore ke sehla sa hae sa bobedi mmusong.
tgt: Mengameli Uhuru Kenyatta ngekubekwa esihlalweni sekuba nguMengameli weRiphabhuliki yaseKenya kanye nemgamu wakhe wesibili wekuba nguMengameli.

src: Kabinete e ikemiseditse ho ahella hodima dikamano tse tiileng tse teng pakeng tsa dinaha tsena tsa bo rona ka bobedi.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ilindzele kwakha budlelwane lobucinile lobutawuba semkhatsini futsi butfokotelwe ngulamave lababili.

src: Moporesidente Emmerson Dambudzo Mnangagwa ka ho hlomamiswa ha hae e le Moporesidente wa Rephabliki ya Zimbabwe.
tgt: Mengameli Emmerson Dambudzo Mnangagwa ekubekweni kwakhe esihlalweni sekuba nguMengameli waseRiphabhuliki yaseZimbabwe.

src: Kabinete e ikemiseditse ka ho tswela pele ka dikamano tse matla tsa tshebetso le Mmuso wa Zimbabwe.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ilindzele budlelwane lobuchubekako lobunemandla bekusebentisana naHulumende waseZimbabwe.

src: Majoro Seitebatso Pearl Block ka ho hapa Kgau ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) ya Moemedi wa Selemo wa Bong ka hara Sesole.
tgt: Major Seitebatso Pearl Block ekuwineni kwakhe Umklomelo weTemphi waMhlabuhlangane (we-UN) Wekukhulumela Tebulili.

src: Kgau ena e ananela boitelo le mekutu ya mmaballi wa kgotso mabapi le ho kgothaletsa dipehelo ka hara Lekgotla la Tshireletso la UN ho ya ka Tumellano ya 1325, e ipiletsang ho mekga yohle e lwanang ho tshireletsa basadi le banana kgahlanong le tlhekefetso ka motabo le dikgoka tse itshetlehileng hodima bong.
tgt: Lomklomelo wekubonga kutinikela nemitamo yemuntfu logcina kuthula ekukhutsateni lemigomo ngekhatsi kweSivumelwane Semkhandlu Wetekuphepha we-UN-1325, lomema onkhe emacembu langcubutanako kutsi avikele bomake nemantfombatana kubudlova bekuhlukunyetwa ngetemacansi nalobucondziswe kubulili.

src: Ya pele ke ya mokgahlelo wa Alebamo e Ipabotseng ka ho Fetisisa ya Mmino wa Lefatshe bakeng sa Alebamo ya bona ya Shaka Zulu Revisited: Mokete wa Sehopotso wa bo-30, mme ya bobedi ke ya mokgahlelo ho Alebamo e Ipabotseng ka ho Fetisisa ya Bana bakeng sa Songs of Peace & Love for Kids & Parents Lefatsheng ka Bophara.

tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyakugceka lokuhlasela lokungenangcondvo kwebantfu labanganacala.

src: Mmuso le batho ba Nigeria ho latela ho qhoma ha bomo ya moipolai ka la 21 Pudungwana 2017 e bolaileng batho ba fetang ba 50 le ho ntsha kotsi ba bang ba bangata.

src: Lelapa le metswalle ya qhoku ya Ntwa ya Tokoloho le motshwaruwa wa mehleng wa Sehlekehleke sa Robben, Monghadi Eddie Daniels, ya hlokahetseng haufinyana tjena.

src: Lelapa le metswalle ya Letona la Tshireletso le Mekaubere ya Sesole, Mofumahadi Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula, ka ho hlokahala ha ntate wa hae, Monghadi Douglas Mapisa.
tgt: Umndeni nebangani beLishanhlitiyo leTemzabalazo nalowake waba siboshwa sasesichiwini eRobben Island, Mnu Eddie Daniels, losandza kushona.

src: O hlokahaletse Sepetlele sa Cecilia Makiwane East London, ho la Kapa Botjhabela a na le dilemo tse 96.Diketsahalo tse tlang.

src: Sehopotso sa Dilemo tse Lekgolo tsa Nelson MandelaKabinete e imatahanya le maAforika Borwa mabapi le ho kenela sehopotso sa bone sa ho hlokahala ha Nelson Mandela ka la 5 Tshitwe 2013.
tgt: Umndeni nebangani beNdvuna yeMbutfo Wetekuvikela Netigayigayi Temphi, Mk Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula, ngekushonelwa ngubabe wakhe, Mnu Douglas Mapisa.

src: Ka selemo sa 2018 naha e tla tshwaya sehopotso sa dilemo tse lekgolo tsa bophelo ba Mandela mme maAforika Borwa kaofela a kgothaletswa ho imatahanya le mekete ya selemo kaofela ha re tla be re isa tlhompho ho e mong wa bara ba bohlokwa ka ho fetisisa ba Aforika.
tgt: Kukhunjulwa kweMnyakalikhulu waNelson MandelaIkhabinethi nayo njengebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika ikhumbula umkhosi wesine wekusishiya emhlabeni kwaNelson Mandela mhla ti-5 Ingongoni 2013.

src: Kabinete e leboha maAforika Borwa kaofela bakeng sa bonkakarolo ba bona diketsahalong tse fapafapaneng tsa sehopotso sa OR Tambo ho phatlalla le naha mme e shebile hore ho tla ba le bonkakarolo bo tshwanang ha re hopola qhoku ya rona le Moporesidente wa pele ya kgethilweng ka tsela ya demokerasi wa Aforika Borwa, Madiba.
tgt: Nga-2018 lelive litawube lihlanganisa umnyakalikhulu wemphilo yaMandela futsi bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bakhutsatwa kutsi bahlanganyele kulomgubho wemnyaka wonkhe lapho sihlonipha lenye indvodzana yeludvumo yase-Afrika.

src: Sehla sa MonyakaKabinete e lakaletsa maAforika Borwa kaofela sehla sa monyaka se tletseng thabo le se bolokehileng.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ibonga bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika ngekuhlanganyela kwabo kumikhosi leminyenti leyehlukene kulo lonkhe lelive yekukhumbula OR Tambo futsi ilindzele kutsi lizinga lekuhlanganyela lelifanana naleli lapho sikhumbula sikhonkhwane setfu kanye naMengameli waseNingizimu Afrika wekucala lowakhetfwa ngentsandvo yelinyenti, Mengameli, Madiba.

src: Re ipiletsa ho bohle ba tla kena mebileng ho netefatsa hore dipalangwang tsa bona di maemong a loketseng tsela.
tgt: Sikhatsi Semaholidi aKhisimusiIkhabhinethi ifisela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika sikhatsi semaholidi aKhisimusi lesiyintfokoto.

src: Basebedisi bohle ba mebila, bakganni le ditaaso ba lokela ho ikobela melao ya tsela.
tgt: Simema labo labatawube bahamba kutsi bacinisekise kutsi timoto tabo tifanele kuba semgwacweni.

src: Letona la Dipalangwang, Monghadi Joe Maswanganyi, o thakgotse letsholo la Arrive Alive Bela-Bela, ho la Limpopo ka la 5 Tshitwe.

src: Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa sa Aforika Borwa (SAPS) e tla kenya tshebetsong letsholo la yona la naha ka bophara bakeng sa sehla sa monyaka se bolokehileng mme bohle re na le boikarabelo ba ho tshehetsa SAPS ka ho ikobela molao le ho itshwara ka tsela e nang le boikarabelo.
tgt: I-SAPS iphumelelisa umkhankhaso wavelonkhe wesikhatsi semaholidi aKhisimusi lesiphephile futsi wonkhe muntfu unesibopho sekwesekela i-SAPS ngekugcina umtsetfo nekutsiphatsa ngendlela lefanele.

src: Lefapha la merero ya Lehae le tla tsebisa meralo ya sehla sa monyaka sa 2017/18 bakeng sa tikoloho ya meedi ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Litiko Letasekhaya litawumemetela tinhlelo tesikhatsi semaholidi aKhisimusi sanga-2017/18 seminyele yaseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Sena ke mabapi le ho thusa hore ho be bobebe le bolaodi bo matlafetseng ba ho tsamaya ha batho le thepa ho kena le ho tswa ka hara Aforika Borwa nakong ena e hlokolosi.
tgt: Loku kwentelwa kutsi kulawulwa kwekuphuma nekungena kwebantfu nemphahla eNingizimu Afrika kwenteke kahle futsi ngelizinga lelincono ngalesikhatsi sekuba matasatasa kakhulu.

src: Hape re ipiletsa ho batswadi le bahlokomedi hore ba se tlohele bana ba le bang kaha e le mosebetsi wa rona ho hlokomela bana ba rona.
tgt: Siphindze futsi sicela batali nebalondvoloti bebantfwana kutsi bangashisyi bantfwana bangakagadvwa njengoba sinesibopho sekunakekela bantfwana betfu.

src: Kabinete e thabile ha e le mona dihlahlobo tsa Materiki di tsamaile hantle ntle le diketsahalo tse tshwenyang mme e lakaletsa sehlopha sa selemo sa 2017 tse molemo ha ba ntse ba emetse sephetho sa bona sa makgaolakgang.

src: Kabinete e ile ya kopana ka Laboraro, mohla la 28 Hlakola 2018, Tuynhuys, Motse Kapa.
tgt: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 28 February 2018, at Tuynhuys, Cape Town.

src: Tse jang motse.
tgt: Issues in the environment.

src: Puo ya Ditekanyetso tsa Ditjhelete tsa Naha.
tgt: National Budget Speech.

src: Kabinete e ananela boitshepo bo tlokomang bo bonahaditsweng ke Ditekanyetso tsa Ditjhelete tsa Naha tsa 2018 tse ileng tsa tekwa Palamenteng, Motse Kapa, bekeng e fetileng.
tgt: Cabinet appreciates the overwhelming confidence expressed in the 2018 National Budget which was tabled in Parliament, Cape Town, last week.

src: Maemong a moraorao a ntjhafatso a hlwibitseng setjhaba sa habo rona se kgabane, Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho ikamahanya le mmuso ho hodisa moruo wa rona esita le ho thea mesebetsi ena e hlokehang ka ho fetisisa.
tgt: In the recent spirit of renewal that has gripped our great nation, Cabinet calls on all South Africans to partner with government to grow our economy and create much-needed jobs.

src: Phokotso ya tshebediso ya tjhelete e kaalo ka R85 bilione nakong ya dilemo tse tharo tse tlang, e bontsha boikitlaetso ba mmuso ho bokellweng ha ditjhelete esita le kabong e hlokolotsi ya mehlodi ya ho hodisa moruo.
tgt: The reduction in expenditure of R85 billion over the next three years demonstrates government’s commitment to fiscal consolidation and the prudent allocation of resources to grow the economy.

src: Dikgato tse tsebisitsweng tsa ho sisithehisa sekgahla sa keketseho ya mekitlane esita le ho kgina kgaello ya ditekanyetso tsa ditjhelete, di ntlafatsa moralo wa rona wa tsa ditjhelete ka bokgabane ebile di fa maAforika Borwa boitshepo matsapeng a bokamoso ba moruo wa rona.
tgt: The steps announced to slow the pace of debt accumulation and contain the budget deficit greatly improve our fiscal framework and give South Africans confidence in the future prospects of our economy.

src: Kabinete e kgodisehile hore bokenadipakeng bo tla bonahala kgolong ya moruo wa rona, bo tiise boemo ba moruo bo be bo tshireletse maemo a ho theoha ha botsetedi.
tgt: Cabinet is resolute that the interventions will reflect in our country’s economic growth, affirm its economic standing and safeguard its investment grade status.

src: Ditekanyetso tsa Ditjhelete tsa Naha tsa 2018 di tshehetsa bafutsana setjhabeng sa rona ka lenaneo le phethahetseng la thusetso ya setjhaba, le thuto ya boemo bo phahameng ya mahala bakeng sa baithuti ba tswang malapeng a futsanehileng.
tgt: The 2018 National Budget supports the poor in our society through a comprehensive social assistance programme and fee-free tertiary education for students from poor households.

src: Ho arabela dingongorehong tse hlahisitsweng mabapi le dikeketseho tse sisintsweng tsa Lekgetho la Boleng bo Ekeditsweng (VAT), Kabinete e lohotha ho atolla lenane la disebedisuwa tsa mantlha tse sa angweng ke VADilemo tse Lekgolo tsa Nelson Mandela.
tgt: As a response to the concern raised on the Value-Added Tax (VAT) increases proposed, Cabinet is considering expanding the list of basic goods that are zero-rated on VANelson Mandela Centenary.

src: Kabinete e kgema mmoho le Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa kgoeletsong ya hae ho maAforika Borwa, ya ho tiisa botjha boikitlaetso bo abelanwang ba ho sebeletsa setjhaba, jwalokaha re tswelapele ho keteka dilemo tse lekgolo tsa tswalo ya Moporesidente wa mehleng Nelson Mandela.
tgt: Cabinet joins President Cyril Ramaphosa in his call on South Africans to reaffirm a shared commitment to serve people as we continue to celebrate the centenary of the birth of former President Nelson Mandela.

src: Madiba ke Moporesidente wa pele wa Aforika Borwa ya Demokrasi mme o ne a tla qeta le dilemo tse 100 ka la 18 Phupu 2018.
tgt: Madiba is the first President of a Democratic South Africa and would have turned 100 years of age on 18 July 2018.

src: Madiba ke thatohatsi ya lefatshe lohle e tlotlehang lefatshe ka bophara e le Mampodi wa Ditokelo tsa Botho, ho se kgetholle ka morabe le ka bong.
tgt: Madiba is a global icon who is revered worldwide as a Champion of Human Rights, non-racism and non-sexism.

src: O bile le seabo sa bohlokwa ho kopanyeng maAforika Borwa, esita le ho kgothaletsa kopano ya demokrasi Aforika ka bophara le lefatshe ka bophara.
tgt: He played a critical role in unifying South Africans, and inspiring democratic unity across Africa and the globe.

src: Moketjana wa pele wa dilemo tse lekgolo tsa Nelson Mandela o bile nakong ya Seboka sa Kopano ya Aforika Addis Ababa, Ethiopia ka Pherekgong ya 2018.
tgt: The first celebration of Nelson Mandela’s centenary took place during the African Union Summit in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia in January 2018.

src: Diketsahalo tse ngatanyana di tla tshwarwa naha ka bophara monongwaha, ho hetla morao bophelong ba Tata Madiba.
tgt: A number of events will be held throughout the country this year to reflect on the life of Tata Madiba.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa ohle hore a ikamahanye le meketjana ya dilemo tse lekgolo a le mesebetsing, dikolong, dikerekeng le mekgatlong ya setjhaba.
tgt: Cabinet calls upon all South Africans to join in the centenary celebrations in their workplaces, schools, churches and civic organisations.

src: E etsa kgoeletso ho e mong le e mong wa rona hore re hate menyabuketsong ya Nelson Mandela ka ho sebetsa ka mekgwa ya rona e fapaneng ho aha naha e kopaneng, e se nang kgethollo ya morabe, le ya bong e bile e le e atlehileng.
tgt: It calls on each one of us this year to emulate the values of Nelson Mandela by working in our respective ways to build a united, non-racist, non-sexist and prosperous country.

src: Naha ena e boela e keteka dilemo tse lekgolo tsa e mong wa baradi ba kgabane ba Aforika, Mama Albertina Sisulu, ya ileng a nyehela bophelo ba hae a lwanela tokoloho ya basadi le ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: The country also celebrates the centenary of one of the great daughters of the African soil Mama Albertina Sisulu, who dedicated her life to fight for the emancipation of women and the liberation of South Africa.

src: Kopanong ya yona e latelang, Kabinete e tla rala lenaneo la ho keteka Dilemo tse Lekgolo tsa Mama Albertina Sisulu.
tgt: Cabinet will in the next meeting also outline a programme for the celebration of the Centenary of Mama Albertina Sisulu.

src: Komello.
tgt: Drought.

src: Kabinete e ananela matsapa a matla a entsweng ke Komiti ya Matona a Kopaneng ka komello, hammoho le ba amehang makaleng ohle a mmuso le kahisanong ho sebetsaneng le maemo a ntseng a ja setsi a komello a thefutseng dikarolo tse ngatanyana tsa naha.
tgt: Cabinet appreciates the relentless efforts made by the Inter-Ministerial Committee on Drought together with stakeholders in all spheres of government and society in dealing with the persistent drought conditions that have hit several parts of the country.

src: Ntle le taba ya hore Aforika Borwa ke naha e nang le leqeme la metsi, ditlamorao tsa phuthumalo ya lefatshe lohle di tswelapele ho ama mokgwa oo pula e nang ka wona, mme seo se etsa hore mothamo wa matamo a rona o dule o le tlase.
tgt: Apart from the fact that South Africa is a water-scarce country, the effects of global warming continue to affect the rain patterns, thus causing our dam levels to remain low.

src: Sehlopha sa Tshebetso sa Matona a Kopaneng se sebetsanang le Komello se tswelapele ho hlophisa mosebetsi dipakeng tsa mmuso wa naha, wa diprofense le wa bomasepala dibakeng tsohle tse thefutsweng ke komello.
tgt: The Inter-Ministerial Task Team on Drought continues to facilitate work between national government, provinces and municipalities in all drought-affected areas.

src: Sena se akga ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha dikgato tsa nako e kgutshwane, e mahareng esita le e telele ho rarolla le ho nolofatsa ditlamorao tse ka etsahalang tsa komello ena.
tgt: This includes implementing short, medium and long-term measures to address and mitigate the potential impact of this drought.

src: Mmuso o bokelletse tjhelete ya ho fana ka thuso ya nako e kgutshwane diprofenseng tse amehileng.
tgt: Government has made funds available to provide short-term assistance to affected provinces.

src: O fane ka dithuso tsa ditjhelete tsa kinolo maqakabetsing tse kaalo ka R473 milione esita le R6 bilione e tla eketswa selemong sa ditjhelete sa 2018/19 ho tlatseletsa meralong ya motheo ya metsi Kapa Bophirimela, Kapa Botjhabela le Kapa Leboya.
tgt: It has provided a relief grant worth R473 million and an additional R6 billion in the 2018/19 financial year to augment water infrastructure in the Western Cape‚ Eastern Cape and Northern Cape.

src: Mmuso o etsa kgoeletso ho bohle ho tswelapele ho sebetsa le mmuso ho bolokeng metsi, ka ho a sebedisa ka boikarabelo le ka paballo.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all to continue to work with government in conserving water by using it responsibly and sparingly.

src: Kabinete e dula e ntse e ikitlaelleditse ho etsa Aforika Borwa hore e be naha e tla kgethwa ke baeti le ke botsetedi ka ho tshwanang.
tgt: Cabinet remains committed to making South Africa a country of choice for visitors and potential investors alike.

src: Dipolao tsa Mapolesa.
tgt: Police killings.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona ho ba malapa le metswalle ya bahlanka ba bahlano ba sepolesa mmoho le lesole la mehleng, ba sa tswa fenethwa ka sehloho tlhaselong ya Motebo wa Sepolesa wa Ngcobo Kapa Botjhabela.
tgt: Cabinet expresses condolences to the families and friends of the five police officers and a former soldier who were recently brutally murdered in an attack on the Ngcobo Police Station in the Eastern Cape.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe polao efe kapa efe ya banna le basadi ba habo rona ba mapolesa.
tgt: Cabinet strongly condemns any senseless killing of our servicemen and women.

src: Ho shwa ha mohlanka a le mong wa sepolesa, lesole kapa motho e mong ofe kapa ofe ya sebetsang mosebetsi wa ho tshireletsa kahisano le batho ba habo rona, ha e a amoheleha.
tgt: The loss of one police officer, soldier or any other person who serves to protect society and our people is unacceptable.

src: Kabinete e ikitlaeditse, ka Letona la Sepolesa, ho etsa kahohlehohle kamoo e ka kgonang kateng ho matlafatsa metebo ya habo rona ya sepolesa, e le ho thibela ditlhaselo tse jwalo kamoso.
tgt: Cabinet has committed, through the Minister of Police, to do whatever possible to capacitate our police stations to prevent such attacks in the future.

src: Kabinete e boela e ipiletsa ho batswadi le setjhaba ka kakaretso ho netefatsa hore bana ba bolokehile ka nako tsohle, esita le ho sebedisana le makala a kenyang molao tshebetsong, ho tshireletsa ditokelo tsa bana ba rona.
tgt: Cabinet further appeals to parents and society at large to ensure children are kept safe at all times and to partner with law-enforcement agencies to protect the rights of our children.

src: Mokgwa ofe kapa ofe wa tlhekefetso kgahlanong le ngwana, o tlameha ho pepeswa o be o tlalehwe hanghang.
tgt: Any form of abuse against a child must be exposed and reported immediately.

src: Ha re sebetsa mmoho, re ka boloka dibaka tsa rona di bolokehile ra ba ra netefatsa hore baetsi ba ditlolo tsa molao ha ba fumane sekoti sa ho ipata.
tgt: By working together, we can keep our communities safe and ensure that criminal elements have no place to hide.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Moralo wa Leano le Lekotsweng Botjha la Pampiri e Tshweu ho tsa Dipalangwang tsa Naha le tla phatlalatswa bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba.
tgt: Cabinet decisions Cabinet approved the Draft Revised White Paper on National Transport Policy to be published for public comments.

src: Leano le habile ho fana ka mokgwatsamaiso wa dipalangwang o tlamahanngwang le merero e meng e amanang le lekala ho etsetsa hore ho fokotswe ditjeo tsa ho eta le tsa ho etsa kgwebo.
tgt: The policy aims to provide a transport system that is integrated with other related sector plans so as to reduce both the cost of commuting and doing business.

src: Le boela le nyalanya merero ya dipalangwang ya naha ena le ditlwaelo tsa dipalangwang tsa lefatshe lohle.
tgt: It also aligns the country’s transportation plans to the global transportation trends.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Pampiri e Tala Leanong la tsa Mebila la Aforika Borwa, e tla phatlalatswa bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba.
tgt: Cabinet approved the Green Paper on Roads Policy for South Africa to be published for public comments.

src: Leano le fana ka moralo o ka sehloohong o netefatsang hore mebila ya Aforika Borwa e laoleha betetshana, e batla e bolokehile mme e kenyeletsa mefuta yohle ya dipalangwang hore e fane ka mokgwa o tsitsitseng wa bolaodi ba mebila.
tgt: The policy provides the overarching framework that ensures South Africa’s roads are better managed, safer and include all modes of transport to deliver a sustainable approach to roads management.

src: Le tataisa melawana ya tsela, meralo ya motheo, polokeho, ditjhelete tsa mebila le dipalangwang tseo e seng makoloi.
tgt: It guides the road regulations, infrastructure, safety, road funding and non- motorised transport.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka diphumano tsa Tshekatsheko ya Naha ya Tswelopele ya Diphuputso le Boithutwane (R&D Survey).R&D ke karolo ya bohlokwa ya tswelopele ya moruo wa kahisano naheng ena.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the findings of the 2015/16 National Survey of Research and Experimental Development (R&D Survey).R&D is an integral part of the country’s socio-economic development.

src: Ana e bile matsapa a kopanetsweng a mmuso, diindasteri le ditheo tsa diphuputso.
tgt: This has been collective efforts of government, industry and research institutions.

src: Tlaleho e a fumaneha websaeteng ya Lefapha la Saense le Theknolji (DST) ya: WEBTOKEKabinete e ananetse metako e fapaneng ya lethathama la 2018 la tjhelete ya sehopotso e lewana, le tla hlahiswa ke khamphane ya Minte ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: The report is available on the Department of Science and Technology (DST) website: WEBTOKECabinet approved the designs of the 2018 commemorative collector’s coin series, which will be produced by the South African Mint Company.

src: Pokello ya 2018 ya metako e fapaneng e tla keteka Dilemo tse Lekgolo tsa Nelson Mandela.
tgt: The 2018 designs collection will be celebrating the Nelson Mandela Centenary.

src: Dipokello tsena di ne di leleketswe ke tjhelete e lewana ya sehopotso ya 2017 e neng e keteka Aforika Borwa tlasa mokotaba wa Tokoloho, Demokrasi le Botjhaba.
tgt: These collections were preceded by the 2017 commemorative coins that celebrated South Africa under the theme of Freedom, Democracy and Cultures.

src: Dibili.
tgt: Bills.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya Lebollo la Setho ya 2018 Palamenteng.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the Customary Initiation Bill of 2018 to Parliament.
