src: Bili e habile ho tshireletsa, ho kgothaletsa le ho laola karolo ya tsamaiso ya lebollo la setho.
tgt: The Bill seeks to protect, promote and regulate the governance aspect of the practice of customary WEBTOKEN provides national norms and standards aimed at the protection of life and the prevention of injuries and all forms of abuse experienced by initiates.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya 2016 ya Sehlomathiso sa Moralo wa Naha wa Mangolo a Thuto Palamenteng.
tgt: Cabinet approved for the submission of the National Qualifications Framework Amendment Bill of 2016 to Parliament.

src: Bili ena, e hlomathisang Molao wa Moralo wa Naha wa Mangolo a Thuto, 2008 (Molao wa 67 wa 2008), e matlafatsa Molao ka ho ntlafatsa dikgato tsa ho sebetsana le maemo a ho se bue nnete, e qobella hore ho be teng ditlamorao bathong ba sa bueng nnete ka mangolo a bona a thuto kapa mekgatlo e ntshang mangolo a thuto a seng molaong.
tgt: The Bill, which amends the National Qualifications Framework Act, 2008 (Act 67 of 2008), strengthens the Act by improving measures to deal with issues of misrepresentation, imposes consequences on persons who misrepresent their qualifications or organisations that issue invalid WEBTOKEN also proposes regulations to ensure that fraudulent qualifications are referred to the relevant professional bodies (database of individuals who misrepresented their qualifications).

src: E boela e sisinya hore ho be teng melawana ya ho netefatsa hore mangolo a thuto a boqhekanyetsi a fetisetswa mekgatlong ya seporofeshenale e tshwanelehileng (pokello ya lenane la batho ba sa bueng nnete ka mangolo a bona a thuto).
tgt: It also addresses the accreditation of foreign qualifications.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Bili ya 2017 ya Polokeho Ditereneng, e tla phatlalatswa bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba.
tgt: Cabinet approved the Railway Safety Bill of 2017 to be published for public comments.

src: Bili e habile ho ntlafatsa polokeho ya ditereneng esita le ho thea lekgotla la tsamaiso le lekolang mosebetsi wa Bolaodi ba Polokeho Ditereneng ba Aforika Borwa.
tgt: The Bill seeks to improve railway safety and create a governance structure to oversee the work of the Rail Safety Regulator of South Africa.

src: E boetse e amahanngwa le Leano la Naha la Diterene mabapi le ho matlafatsa bodisa ba polokeho, esita le ho kgothaletsa le ho qobella boteng ba polokeho ditereneng tsa rona.
tgt: It is also aligned to the National Rail Policy regarding the strengthening of safety monitoring, and the promotion and enforcement of safety in our railways.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Moralo wa Bili ya 2017 ya Taolo ya Ditshenyehelo Ditereneng, e tla phatlalatswa bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba le dipuisano.
tgt: Cabinet approved for the Draft Economic Regulation of Transport Bill of 2017 to be published for public comments and consultation.

src: Bili e rarolla taba ya dikgaello tsa taolo le bokgoni mabapi le phano ya mekgwatsamaiso ya dipalangwang e sa senyeng tjhelete ebile e le e sebetsang ka bokgabane.
tgt: The Bill addresses the regulatory and capacity gaps in respect of provision of a cost-effective and efficient transport system.

src: Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: Aforika Borwa, e le Modulasetulo, e tla tshwara Seboka sa Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tse ka Borwa ba Aforika (SADC) sa Matona a tsa Bosebetsi, Kgiro le Tshireletso ya Setjhaba, ho tloha ka la 1 ho isa ho la 2 Hlakubele 2018 Setsing sa Diboka tsa Matjhaba sa Motse Kapa (CTICC).
tgt: South Africa will be hosting the Southern African Development Community Ministers of Labour, Employment and Social Security, as Chair, from 1 to 2 March 2018 at the Cape Town International Convention Centre.

src: Mookotaba wa seboka o re: “Kgonahalo ya mosebetsi o motle: Ho ntshetsapele bohokahanyi, momahano le ho kenyeletsa ba bangata”.
tgt: The theme of the conference is: “Horizon decent work: Advancing connectivity, coherence and inclusivity”.

src: Ba tla nka seabo ba tla akga balekane ba kahisanong – dikgwebo tse kgolo, tsa bosebetsi hammoho le setjhaba.
tgt: Participants will include social partners – organised business, labour and community.

src: Boemong ba hae e le Modulasetulo wa SADC, Moporesidente Ramaphosa o tla kena maetong a dipontshano ho ya Angola, Botswana le Namibia ho tloha ka la 2 ho isa ho la 3 Hlakubele 2018.
tgt: President Ramaphosa in his capacity as the Chair of SADC will undertake consultative visits to Angola, Botswana and Namibia from 2 to 3 March 2018.

src: O tla felehetswa ke Letona la Dikamano le Tshebedisano ya Matjhaba, Lindiwe Sisulu le Letona la Lebotho la Tshireletso le Mekaubere ya Sesole, Nosiviwe Maphisa Nqakula.
tgt: He will be accompanied by the Minister of International Relations and Cooperation Lindiwe Sisulu and Minister of Defence and Military Veterans Nosiviwe Maphisa Nqakula.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla tshwara Seboka sa Lefatshe sa bo-17 se mabapi le Kwae kapa Bophelo bo Botle (WCTOH) ho tloha ka la 7 ho isa ho la 9 Hlakubele 2018 Motse Kapa, katlasa mookotaba o reng: “Ho kopanya lefatshe bakeng sa Moloko o Lokolohileng ditlamong tsa Kwae”.
tgt: South Africa will co-host the 17th World Conference on Tobacco or Health (WCTOH) from 7 to 9 March 2018 in Cape Town under the theme: “Uniting the World for a Tobacco-free Generation”.

src: Sena ke seboka sa pele sa ho tshwarelwa Aforika.
tgt: This is the first hosting in Africa.

src: WCTOH e etsa kgoeletso ya hore ho be teng kgato ya boitlamo ebile e fana ka lepatlelo la mebuso, mekgatlo ya setjhaba, makgotla a Matjhaba a Kopaneng, mekgatlo ya matjhaba, basebeletsi ba bophelo bo botle le ba bang ba amehang ho okgelana tsebo le ho thakelana malebela, haholoholo mabapi le batjha le basadi ba pepesehileng tshebedisong ya kwae.
tgt: The WTCOH calls for committed action and provides a platform for governments, civil-society organisations, United Nations agencies, international organisations, health workers and other stakeholders to discuss shared knowledge and experiences, particularly regarding to youth and women who are exposed to tobacco WEBTOKEN the conference contributes towards addressing the National Development Plan’s goals by creating awareness and education on the harmful effects of tobacco use, and the need to intensify tobacco control measures.

src: Ho tshwara seboka ho a thusa mabapi le ho tla le ditharollo tsa sepheo sa Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha ka ho etsa tlhokomediso le thuto ka ditlamorao tse kotsi tsa tshebediso ya kwae, le tlhokeho ya ho matlafatsa dikgato tsa taolo ya kwae.
tgt: On the 10 and 11 March the IEC will open the Voting Registration Centres for people to come and register and check their registration details.

src: Kabinete e kopa bakgethi bohle ba tshwanelehileng ho ya diteisheneng tsa bona tsa ho voutela, ho tsoseletsa lenane la bakgethi e le ho hlophisetsa dikgetho tse akaretsang tsa 2019.
tgt: Cabinet urges all eligible voters to visit their voting stations to update the voters’ roll in preparation for the 2019 general elections.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso, haholoholo ho ba tla be ba vouta lekgetlo la pele, ho netefatsa hore ba ba le seabo tokelong ya bona ya demokrasi ya molaotheo ya ho vouta, ka ho ya ba ilo ingodisetsa ho vouta.
tgt: Cabinet particularly calls on first-time voters to ensure they participate in their constitutional democratic right to vote by going to register to vote.

src: Mafelo ana a beke a boingodiso, ke katleho e kgolo mabapi le pheletso ya projeke ya dilemo tse pedi ya ho fumana diaterese tsa bodulo tsa bakgethi bohle ba ingodisitseng.
tgt: This registration weekend is a milestone towards the culmination of a two-year project to obtain the residential addresses of all registered voters.

src: Diteishene tsa ho voutela di tla bulwa dipakeng tsa 08:00 hoseng le 17:00 mantsiboya ho thusa bakgethi ba qalang hore ba ingodisetse ho vouta, le ho dumella bakgethi ba seng ba ingodisitse ba falletseng dibakeng tse ding hore ba ingodise botjha diterekeng tsa bona tse nepahetseng tsa ho voutela, ba be ba lokise dintlha tsa diaterese tsa bona lenaneng la bakgethi.
tgt: The voting stations will be open between 08:00 and 17:00 to assist new voters to register to vote, and allow registered voters who have relocated to reregister in their correct voting district and update their address details on the voters’ roll.

src: Melaetsa.
tgt: Messages.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa matitjhere ohle a ileng a tlotlwa moketjaneng wa Dikgau tsa bo18 tsa Naha tsa Botitjhere, o neng o le Johannesburg ka Moqebelo wa la 17 Hlakola 2018.
tgt: Cabinet commends all teachers who were honoured at the 18th National Teaching Awards which took place in Johannesburg on Saturday, 17 February 2018.

src: Dikgau di ne di ananela botitjhere le boetapele bo tswileng matsoho mekgahlelong e fapaneng, ho akga le Kgau ya Katleho ya Bophelo Bohle ya Nelson Mandela, le Kgau ya Moprofesara Kader Asmal.
tgt: The awards recognised outstanding teaching and leadership in several categories, including the Nelson Mandela Lifetime Achievement Award and Professor Kader Asmal Award.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona ho Motlatsi wa Letona Obed Bapela ka ho hlokahallwa ke mofumahadi wa hae Constance Bapela, ya neng a sebeletsa naha e le molekgotla nakong ya ho hlokahala ha hae.
tgt: Cabinet conveys its condolences to Deputy Minister Obed Bapela on the loss of his wife Constance Bapela, who served the country as a councillor at the time of her passing.

src: Kabinete e ikamahanya le Moporesidente Ramaphosa ho fetisetseng matshediso ho ba lelapa, metswalle le bomphato ba moikonomi wa sepolotiki ebile e le mongodi, Moprofesara Johannes “Sampie” Terreblanche, ya hlokahetseng a na le dilemo tse Kabinete e thoholetsa Letona Naledi Pandor ho ananelweng ha hae ke Yunivesithi ya Leiden e Netherlands e le Moeti ya Tlotlwang wa Oort wa Moporofesara wa Astronomi le Ntshetsopele.
tgt: Cabinet joins President Ramaphosa in conveying condolences to the family, friends and associates of the political economist and author, Prof Johannes “Sampie” Terreblanche, who passed on at the age of Cabinet congratulates Minister Naledi Pandor on her recognition by Leiden University in the Netherlands as an Oort Honorary Visiting Professor of Astronomy and Development.

src: Sena se etswa e le kananelo ya katleho e tswileng matsoho eo Letona le e entseng ka ho tlamahanya saense, haholoholo astronomi, e le sesebediswa bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya lefatshe lohle ebile e le molemong wa setjhaba.
tgt: This is in recognition of the Minister’s extraordinary accomplishment in harnessing science, particularly astronomy, as a tool for global development and societal benefit.

src: DithonyoDithonyo tsohle di emetse netefaletso ya mangolo a thuto esita le topollo e tshwanelehileng.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.

src: Lerato Mataboge e le Motlatsi wa Molaodi e Moholo (DDG): Kgwebisano le Botsetedi Aforika Borwa, Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Diindasteri (dti).
tgt: Ms Lerato Matabogeas Deputy Director-General (DDG): Tradeand Investment South Africa, Department of Trade and Industry (the dti).

src: Shandokane Evelyn Masotja e le DDG: Taolo ya tsa Boreki le Dikgwebo tse Kgolo, dti.
tgt: Ms Shandokane Evelyn Masotjaas DDG: Consumer and Corporate Regulation, the dti.

src: Vuyelwa Vumendlini e le DDG: Leano la Moruo la Matjhaba le Lebatowa, Lefapha la Matlotlo a Setjhaba.
tgt: Ms Vuyelwa Vumendlini as DDG: International and Regional Economic Policy, National Treasury.

src: Joseph Tebogo Leshope e le Mohlanka e Moholo wa tsa Tshebetso wa SENTECMof.
tgt: Mr Joseph Tebogo Leshope as Chief Operations Officer of SENTECMs Vuyo Zitumane as Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Amatola Water.

src: Vuyo Zitumane e le Mohlanka e Moholo wa Phethahatso (CEO) wa Amatola Water.
tgt: Adv Seeng Catherine Ntsaba-Letele as Chief Ombud of the Community Schemes Ombud Service.

src: Moadvokheiti Seeng Catherine Ntsaba-Letele e le Molekodi e Moholo wa Tshebeletso ya Molekodi ya Dikema tsa Setjhaba.
tgt: Mr Edward Mamadise as CEO of the National Regulator for Compulsory Specifications.

src: Edward Mamadise e le CEO ya Bolaodi ba Naha ba Ditotobatsuwa tse Tlamang.
tgt: Dr Sagren Moodley as the representative from the DST on the South African Council for Natural Scientific Professions.

src: Ngaka Sagren Moodley e le moemedi wa DST Lekgotleng la Diporofeshene tsa Saense ya Tlhaho la Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Reappointments to the Patent Examination Board:a. Ms Shanaaz Tiry Mahomedb.

src: Pehelo ka Kopano ya Kabinete ya la 14 Hlakubele 2018Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro, 14 Hlakubele 2018, Tuynhuys, Motse KapaDintlha tsa Maemo a jwale.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibambe umhlangano ngaLesitsatfu, mhla ti-14 Indlovulenkhulu 2018, eTuynhuys, eKapa Tindzaba Letimcoka.

src: Kgolo ya moruo.
tgt: Kukhula kutemnotfo.

src: Kabinete e amohela kgolo ya moruo ya 1.3% ka 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kukhula nge-1.3% kwemnotfo nga-2017.

src: Sena ke keketseho ya ho tloha ho 0.3% ka 2016.
tgt: Lokukhula kusuka ku-0.3% nga-2016.

src: Tshebetso ya moruo tlasa maemo a thata e lepa tse ntle bakeng sa menyetla ya kamoso ya moruo wa naha.
tgt: Lokukhula kwemnotfo ngaphasi kwetimo letimatima kwetsembisa lokuhle ngelikusasa letemnotfo walelive.

src: Manane a kgolo ke letshwao la hore moruo o mathuleng a ho phahama, moo Lefapha la Matlotlo a Naha le lebeletseng hore moruo o hole ka 1.5% selemong sena o be o akofele ho 2.1% ka 2020.
tgt: Letinombolo tekukhula tikhombisa kutsi umnotfo usebangeni lekwenyuka, njengaloku lihhovisi Temafa Avelonkhe lilindze kutsi umnotfo ukhule nge-1.5% kulomnyaka futsi wenyuke ngesivinini uye ku-2.1% nga-2020.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho makala ohle a setjhaba ho ahella hodima mokoka o motle wa 2017, a be a sebetse le mmuso ho lokisa meralo ya ona hore e be kgato e tiileng ya ho tsitlallela kgolo ya moruo le ho thea mesebetsi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela yonkhe imikhakha yesive kutsi yakhe etikwalelifutse lelihle lemnyaka wanga-2017, kanye nekutsi isebentisane nahulumende ekuguculeni emasu ahulumende abe tinyatselo letiphatsekako tekusimamisa kukhula kwemnotfo kanye nekudala imisebenti.

src: Tlhabollo ya Mobu Kabinete e amohela tshisinyo e ananetsweng ya ho hlomathisa Molaotheo wa Riphaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa 1996 bakeng sa ho dumella kamoho ya mobu ntle le ditlhapiso.
tgt: Tingucuko Kutemhlaba IKhabhinethi iyasemukela lesishukumiso sekuchibela Umtsetfosisekelo waseRiphabhliki yaseNingizimu Afrika wanga-1996 ngenhloso yekuvumela kutsi kube nekutsatfwa kwemhlaba nguhulumende unikwe ummango ngaphandle kwesincephetelo.

src: Haesale ho tloha ka 1994 mmuso o sebetsa ka matla ho sotholla masalla a ho nkelwa naha tlasa bokoloniale le mmuso wa kgethollo.
tgt: Hulumende usebente kamatima kusukela nga-1994 kubuyisela emuva lomshiyandvuku wekutsatfwa kwemhlaba ngaphasi kwekubuswa betive nelubandlululo.

src: Mmuso, o sebetsa o itshetlehile ka molao, o se o entse boholo ho netefatsa tlhahiso e tswelang pele ya ditswamobung, ha ka nqa e nngwe o akofisa motjha wa ho lokisa botjha bakeng sa ba anngweng ke ho nkelwa mobu.
tgt: Ngekusebenta ngekwemtsetfo, hulumende sewente lokukhulu kakhulu kucinisekisa kutsi umhlaba ukhicita ngalokuchubekako, ngaleso sikhatsi abe enta ngekushesha inchubo yekuncephetelisa labo labatsintseka ngenca yekutsatselwa umhlaba.

src: Taba ena e fetiseditswe ho Komiti ya Tjhebobotjha ya Molaotheo, e tlamehang ho tlalehela Palamente ka la 30 Phato 2018.
tgt: Loludzaba selwendluliselwe eKomidini Lebuketa Umtsetfosisekelo, lokufanele kutsi libikele Iphalamende mhla tinge-30 Ingci 2018.

src: Dikgothaletso tse iswang ho Seboka sa Naha di tlasusumetswa ke letoto la dipitso tsa nonyo ya maikutlo a setjhaba tse tla latelwa ke dikopano tsa komiti.
tgt: Letincomo letitawumikiswa kuLibandla Lavelonkhe kutawuya ngeluchungechunge lwemihlangano yekulalelwa kweluvo lwemmango tilandzelwe yimihlangano yelikomidi.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho bohle ba amehang hore ba tshwaele nakong ya mothati ona wa dipuisano, o tla tataisa ho utollweng ha ditharollo tse tla ntshetsa naha ya habo rona pele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe labo labatsintsekako kutsi baletse kuphawula kwabo ngesikhatsi salenchubo yekucocisana, lokutawuletsa tisombululo tekuchubela embili live letfu.

src: Re lemmuso o tsotellang o bile o sebetsa le batho, bohle ba amehang ba tla kenyeletswa nakong ya mothati ona.
tgt: Njengahulumende lonakekelako nalogcile kubantfu, bonkhe labatsintsekako kutawuboniswana nabo ngesikhatsi kwentiwa lenchubo.

src: Kabinete e boela e kopa setjhaba ho lesa ho inkela mobu ho seng molaong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyachubeka futsi icela imimango kutsi iyekele kungena emhlabeni ngalokungekho emtsetfweni.

src: Re naha e ikokobeletsang molao ebile e rata kgotso, ka mekgwa e amohelehileng ya ho rarolla diqaka, ho akga le qaka ya mobu.
tgt: Tsine silive lelihlonipha umtsetfo nalelitsandza kuthula letinetindlela letanele tekusombulula tinkinga, lokufaka ekhatsi indzaba yemhlaba.

src: Aforika Borwa e dula e butse menyetla bakeng sa kgwebo, mme botsetedi ho tsa temo le bohwai bo amohetswe.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika ivule tandla kutemabhizinisi, kanye nekutjala timali kutekulima futsi nekulima kwemukelekile.

src: Ho molemong wa Aforika Borwa hore e be le dihwai tsa kgwebo mme mothati ona o ka netefatsa hore re bile re na le manane a hodimo a dihwai tsa kgwebo tse atlehileng.
tgt: Kuyinshisekelo yelive laseNingizimu Afrika kutsi kube nebalimi labalimela kutsengisa kantsi lenchubo ingacinisekisa kutsi sinelinani lelikhulu lebalimi labalimela kutsengisa ngemphumelelo.

src: Porojeke ya setjhaba sa Nofingxana ya Double Drift Wildlife Economy.
tgt: Umklamo Wemnotfo i-Double Drift Wildlife wemmango waseNofingxana.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa ha Porojeke ya setjhaba sa Nofingxana ya Double Drift Wildlife Economy, Serapeng sa Diphoofolo tse Hlaha sa Double Drift Kapa Botjhabela ke Letona la Merero ya Tikoloho, Ngaka Edna Molewa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kwetfulwa kweMkamo Wemnotfo i-Double Drift Wildlife wemmango waseNofingxana, eSiciwini Sekongiwa Kwemvelo saseDouble Drift eMphumalanga Kapa yiNdvuna Yetemvelo, Dkt.

src: Sena se ne se kenyeleditse ho fana ka lengolo la bonga thepa ho Mokgatlo wa Likhaya Lethu Communal Property (CPA) lebitsong la Letona la Ntshetsopele ya Dibaka tsa Mahae le Tlhabollo ya Mobu, Mofumahadi Maite Nkoana-Mashabane.
tgt: Loku kufake ekhatsi nekunikwa litayitela kweLikhaya Lethu Communal Property Association (i-CPA) egameni leNdvuna Yekutfutfukiswa Kwetindzawo Tasemaphandleni Netingucuko Kutemhlaba, Mk Maite Nkoana-Mashabane.

src: Setjhaba sa Double Drift se ne se nkelwe ditokelo tsa bodudi le tsa makgulo ke Molao wa Mobu wa 1913.
tgt: Ummmango waseDouble Drift watsatselwa umhlaba wawo wendzawo yekuhlala neyekukhotsisa imfuyo yawo nguMtsetfo Wemhlaba wanga-1913.

src: Ka 1994, setjhaba sena se ile sa kenya tseko ya mobu e ileng ya rarollwa ka 2012, moo ho ileng ha thehwa Likhaya Lethu CPLikhaya Lethu CPA e na le ditho tsa Setjhaba sa Double Drift tse 1 500 mme e amohetse R6 milione e tswang Lefapheng la Merero ya Tikoloho, ho ntshetsapele boiteko ba kgwebo ya diphoofolo tse hlaha polasing ya Naudeshoek (1 400 ya dihektara).
tgt: Nga-1994, lommango wafaka sicelonkhokhelo semhlaba lowabuyiselwa nga-2012, lokwaholela ekusungulweni kweLikhaya Lethu CPLikhaya Lethu CPA lakhiwa ngemalunga la-1 500 eMmango waseDouble Drift futsi latfola tigidzi le-R6 letakhokhwa Litiko Letemvelo kutsi utfutfukise tebhizinisi yemnotfo wetemvelo lapha epulazini laseNaudeshoek (emahektha la-1 400).

src: Selekane se ile sa sebetswa ka Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Dibaka tsa Mahae le Tlhabollo ya Mobu.
tgt: Lokubuyiselwa kwemhlaba kwasetjentwa ngekusebentisa Litiko Lekutfutfukiswa Kwetindzawo Tasemaphandleni Netingucuko Kutemhlaba.

src: Banka ya VBS Mutual.
tgt: I-VBS Mutual Bank.

src: Kabinete e nketse hloohong tsebiso ya Banka ya Resefe ya Aforika Borwa mabapi le Banka ya VBS Mutual.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isivile simemetelo lesentiwe Libhangesilulu leNingizimu Afrika lesimayelana ne-VBS Mutual Bank.

src: Bohlokomedi bo thontsweng bo tla tshehetsa Banka ya VBS Mutual ho busetsa bokgoni ba yona ba maemo a ditjhelete bo be bo sebetsane le ditabatabelo tsa setjhaba esita le ba kwalletseng tjhelete VBKabinete e dula e ikitlaelleditse ho se tshwaneng le ho fetoleng lekala la tsa dtjhelete ntle le ho beha ditabatabelo tsa ba kwallang tjhelete tlokotsing.
tgt: Lolulawulo lolucokiwe lutawusekela i-VBS Mutual Bank kutsi ilungise tinsayeya talo tekuwa nekutsi futsi lente loko lokufunwa ngummango kanye nalabo labadiphozithe ku-VBIKhabhinethi isamile ekutseni isatinikele ekuntjintjeni umkhakha wetetimali nasekucinisekini kutsi banftu labanyenti badlala indzima kuwo ngaphandle kwekufaka engotini timali tebantfu letigcinwe emabhange.

src: Letsholo la botsetedi.
tgt: Umkhankhaso wekutjala timali.

src: Kabinete e amohela letsholo la ‘CEOs Know’ la Brand South Africa, ka tshebedisano le Boetapele ba Kgwebo ba Aforika Borwa, ho phahamisa Aforika Borwa jwaloka sebaka seo ho ka tsetelwang ho sona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawemukela umkhankhaso ‘we-CEO Know’ we-Brand South Africa, ngekuhlanganyela ne-Business Leadership South Africa (i-BLSA), kukhangisa laseNingizimu Afrika njengelive longatjala kulo timali.

src: Sena se ahella hodima meralo ya rona ya motheo e maemong a hodimo, ka Lebenkele le Rekisang Tsohle la InvestSA, bokgoni ba diphuputso le ntshetsopele, ntlafatso le motheo o tsitsitseng wa tlhahiso ho tshehetsa batsetedi.
tgt: Loku kuyindlela yekwakha kulesakhiwonchanti setfu lesisezingeni lemhlaba ngekusebentisa sikhungo lesinako konkhe, i-InvestSA One-Stop Shop, letikhono telucwaningo netekuntfutfukisa, kucamba kanye nemkhakha wetekukhicita lokukhulu kute kusekelwe batjalitimali.

src: Dibaka tse ntjha tsa kgolo le tsona di butswe moruong wa mawatle, ho eneji e hlwekileng, moruo o sa senyeng tikoloho le ho phopholetsa kgase ya shale.
tgt: Kuvulwe futsi netindzawo letinsha tekukhula kwemnotfo waselwandle, emandla lavusetelelekako, umnotfo longasiyo ingoti emvelweni kanye newekuhlwaya igesi ye-shale.

src: Letsholo lena le kenyeletsa Bahlanka ba Baholo ba Phethahatso (di-CEO) ba tswang dikgwebong tsa dinaha tse ngata empa di tsepame kahara Aforika Borwa, tse thakelanang tsebo ya tsona mabapi le botsetedi bo tswelang pele Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lomkhankhaso ufaka ekhatsi Tisebenti Letinkhulu (ema-CEO) lavela kutinkampani letihwebelana nemave emhlaba talapha eNingizimu Afrika ngekwabelana ngelwatinzulu lwabo lolumayelana nekutjala timali lokuchubekako lapha eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa kaofela ka moya wa “Thuma Mina” (Roma Nna) o fokang naha ka bophara hore ba be le seabo sa bona ka ho arolelana dipale tse monate mabapi le ho aha lebitso le letle la naha ya habo rona esita le ho hodisa boipiletso ba yona ba botsetedi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igcugcutela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika ngemoya lotsi “Thuma Mina” lovunguta eveni lonkhana kutsi badlale indzima yabo ngekutsi babelane tindzaba letinhle ekwakheni ligama lelihle lalelive letfu kanye nekuheha lutjalotimali kutsi lukhule.

src: Lenaneo la Phumantsho la Bahlahisi ba Motlakase ba Ikemetseng (di-IPP).
tgt: Luhlelo Lwekutsenga Lwebakhiciti Bemandla Labatimele (ema-IPP).

src: Kabinete e e etse hloko taba ya nyewe ya Lekgotla le Phahameng e hlahletsweng ke mekgatlo e mmedi eo e seng ya mmuso mabapi le qeto ya mmuso ya ho tekena ditumellano tsa theko ya motlakase le di-IPP tse Taba ena e tla phethelwa ke Lekgotla le Phahameng ka la 27 Hlakubele 2018.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isinakile simangalo seNkantolo Lephakeme lesifakwe tinhlangano letimbili letingekho ngaphasi kwahulumende (ema-NGO) lesimayelana nesincumo sahulumende sekusayina tivumelwane tekutsengiselana emandla nema-IPP lange-27.

src: Ka moya wa matla a molaotheo le taelo ya molao, ho tekena ho tjhetjhisitswe.
tgt: Ngemoya wekuvumela umtsetfosisekelo kanye nekusebenta kwemtsetfo, lokusayina sekuhlehlisiwe.

src: Kabinete e tiisa boikitlaetso ba ho rarolla diqaka tse amanang le mananeo ana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikucinisekisile kutinikela kwayo ekusombululeni loludzaba loluphatselene naloluhlelo.

src: Lenaneo la Phumantsho la Bahlahisi ba Ikemetseng ba Eneji e Hlwekileng ba Matla a Motlakase, le tla netefatsa hore basebedisi naheng ya rona ba fumantshwa eneji e theko e tlase ebile e le e hlwekileng, mme le tla tlisa matsete a hlokehang haholo kwano Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Loluhlelo Lwekutsengisa Lwebakhiciti Bemandla Lavusetelelekako Labatimele lutawucinisekisa kutsi batsengi kulelive letfu bakhona kutfola emandla lashiphile kanye nalahlobile, futsi lutawuletsa lutjalotimali loludzingeka kakhulu lapha eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Diporojeke tsena di tla fana ka mesebetsi ya moshwelella e 61 600, moo 95% ya yona e tla ba ya baahi ba Aforika Borwa, ho tsepamisitswe maikutlo haholo ho batjha.
tgt: Lemiklamo itawudala imisebenti yesiphelane lenge- 61 600, bese kutsi lenge-95% ayo ebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulu icondziswe kubantfu labasha.

src: Kabinete e tiisa botjha boikitlaetso ba yona ba selekane se tiileng sa lekala la mmuso le la poraefete ha re ntse re hahamallela mererong ya rona ya kamoso ya diphetoho ho tsa eneji esita le bophelo bo betere bakeng sa bohle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakucinisekisa kutinikela kwayo ebudlelwaneni lobucinile emkhatsini wahulumende netinhlangano letitimele njengaloku sifuna kufeza tinjongo tetfu tekuntjintja emandla akusasa kanye nemphilo lencono yetfu sonkhe.

src: Sena se a hlokahala ho tlisa botsitso bo batlehang haholo ba maano le bolaodi, le ho baballa boemo ba Aforika Borwa jwaloka sebaka se setle se ka kgethelwang botsetedi ho tsa eneji.
tgt: Loku kuyadzingeka ekuletseni inchazelo lecacile ledzingeka kakhulu ngetinchubomgomo kanye nemitsetfo lelawulako, kanye nekugcina iNingizimu Afrika njengelive lelinematfuba lamanyenti elutjalomali lelitsandvwa ngebatjalitimali bemkhakha wetemandla.

src: Listeriosisi.
tgt: I-Listeriosis.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso a yona a tswang botebong ba pelo ho metswalle le ba malapa a ba ileng ba hlokahala kamora ho tshwarwa ke Listeriosisi, mme e lakaletsa ba ntseng ba hlaphohelwa hore ba fole ka potlako.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa kudzabuka kwayo kubangani nemindeni yalabo labashonile ngemuva kwekuhlaselwa sifo se-listeriosis, futsi ifisela labo labagulako kwelulama ngekushesha.

src: Batho ba fetang 180 ba hlokahetse mme ho tlalehilwe diketsahalo tse 940 Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Bantfu labangetulu kwalaba-180 bashonile kantsi ngulabange-940 labahlaselwe ngulesifo lapha eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e kgothatswa ke matsapa a matla a Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle, Setheo sa Naha sa Mafu a Tshwaetsang (NICD) le Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Bophelo bo Botle (WHO) ho kgina kokwanahloko ya listeria hore e se ke ya jaleha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhutsatwe yimitamo lemikhulu leyentiwe Litiko Letemphilo, Sikhungo Savelonkhe Setifo Letitsatselanako (i-NICD) kanye neNhlangano Yemhlaba Yetemphilo (i-WHO) yekuvimba leligciwane le-listeria kutsi lingabhebhetseki.

src: Ho tswela pele ho matlafatsa matsapa ana, Letona la Bophelo bo Botle, Ngaka Aaron Motsoaledi, le tla kopana le Lekgotla la Baoki la Aforika Borwa (SANC) ka Labone, mohla la 15 Hlakubele 2018.
tgt: Aaron Motsoaledi, utawubamba umhlangano neMkandlu waseNingizimu Afrika Webahlengikati (i-SANC) ngaLesine, mhla ti-15 Indlovulenkhulu 2018.

src: Kabinete e ananela kgatelopele e ntle e entsweng mabapi le ho hlwaya le ho kotela sesosa sa ho ropoha ha Listeriosisi ena e bolayang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayemukela lenchubekelembili lenhle leyentiwe yekutfola nekususa lowo mtfombo lobanga kubhedvuka kwalesifo lesibulalako se-Listeriosis.

src: Kgato e latetsweng ya ho tloswa ha dihlahiswa tsa dijo tse tswang ditsing tse tharo tsa tshebetso ya nama tsa Enterprise le Rainbow – moo ho kokwanahloko e fumanweng teng – e ne e le nako ya bohlokwa ya ho kgina ho ropoha hona.
tgt: Kubuyiselwa emuva kwemikhicito yekudla lokwentiwa kutikhungomkhicito letintsatfu i-Enterprise neRainbow – lapho leligciwane litfolakele khona – kube sikhatsi lesimcoka sekuvimba lokubhedvuka kwalesifo.

src: Lefu lena le fumanehang dijong le hlwailwe kgetlo la pele ka Phupjane 2017.
tgt: Lesifo lesitfolakala ekudleni sabonakala kwekucala ngeNhlaba 2017.

src: Listeriosisi ke lefu le kotsi empa le ka thibelwang la ba la alafuwa ka katleho ka tshebediso ya diantibayothiki.
tgt: I-Listeriosis sifo lesibi kakhulu kodvwa siyavikeleka ngekuselapha ngemphumelelo ngekusebentisa sibulalamagciwane (ema-antibiotic).

src: Ba kotsing ka ho fetisisa ke basadi ba immeng, masea a manyane haholo, metsofe le batho bao masole a bona a mmele a fokolang haholo.
tgt: Labo labasengotini lenkhulu bomake labatetfwele, tinswane letincane kakhulu, bantfu lasebakhulile kanye nebantfu labanekusawoteka kwemtimba lokuntekenteke.

src: Batho ba bontshang matshwao a feberu, mesifa e opang, ho nyekelwa ke pelo kapa letshollo ba lokela ho ya ngakeng kapa ditliliniking tse haufi hanghang.
tgt: Bantfu labakhombisa timphawu temfiva, buhlungu betinyama, sicanucanu nome kuhudza kufanele kutsi bavakashele bodokotela babo nome umtfolamphilo losedvute ngekushesha.

src: Kabinete e na le tshepo ya hore Aforika Borwa e tla hlola ho ropoha ha lefu lena mme e kopa batho bohle ho lemoha melawana e mehlano ya boipaballo dijong nakong ena:Hatlela ka sesepa le metsi pele o tshwara dijo, le kamora ho sebedisa ntlwanaPhehisisa dijo mme o se ke wa ja dijo tse sa butswang kaha kokwanahloko e shwa ha dijo di butswitseO seke wa tshwara dijo tse tala le tse phehilweng mmohoBoloka dijo motjhesong o nepahetseng mmeEtsa bonnete ba hore dihlahiswa tsohle tsa lebese di hlwekile kapa bonnyane di hakonositswe o be o hlatswe dijo tse sa phehwang ka metsi a hlwekileng a phallang pele o di ja, kapa ka metsi a neng a bedisitswe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inelitsemba kutsi iNingizimu Afrika itakuncoba lokubhedvuka kwalesifo lokukhona futsi ikhutsata bonkhe bantfu kutsi bayigcine bayihloniphe lemitsetfo lesihlanu yekuphepha kwekudla ngalesikhatsi:Geza tandla ngensipho ngembikwekutsi uphatse kudla, nangemuva kwekubuya endlini lencanePheka kudla kuvutfwe kahle ungakudli kudla lokungakaphekisiswa kahle ngobe leligciwane le-Listeria liyafa nangabe kudla kuphekisiswe kahleUngakuphatsi ukuhlanganise kudla lokuluhlata nalokuvutsiweGcina kudla kusezingeni lekushisa lelifanele futsiWente sicinisekiso kutsi yonkhe imikhicito yelubisi iyafutfunyetwa kute kufe emagciwane nome-ke lokungenanti iyabiliswa futsi ukugeze ngemanti lahlobile konkhe kudla lokungaphekwa ngembikwekutsi ukudle nome-ke ukugeze ngemanti lacale abiliswa kucala.

src: Ba nang le qeaqeo efe kapa efe e amanang le Listeriosisi, ba ka ikopanya le NICD ho 011 386 Ditjhelete tsa dithuso tsa setjhaba.
tgt: Labo labangavisisi kahle macondzana ne-Listeriosis bangatsintsa lihhovisi le-NICD ku: 011 386 Tibonelelomali tembuso.

src: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka boemo ba ho ba malalaalaotswe ha Lekala la Aforika Borwa la Polokeho ya Setjhaba (SASSA) ba ho fana ka mmotlolo o kopantsweng habedi wa kabo ya ditjhelete tsa dithuso tsa setjhaba ho bakgolamolemo ka la 1 Mmesa 2018.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ichazelwe ngalamafishane mayelana nesimo sekulungela kwe-Ejensi yaseNingizimu Afrika Yesibonelelomali Sembuso (i-SASSA) kutsi inike indlela lensha lehlanganisa tindlela tekukhokha letimbili nome letingetulu yekwabiwa kwetibonelelomali kubazuzi mhla lu-01 Mabasa 2018.

src: Sena se tsamaelana le kahlolo ya Lekgotla la Molaotheo (ConCourt) e laetseng katoloso ya konteraka ya hajwale le Cash Paymaster Services (CPS) ho fihlela ka la 31 Hlakubele 2018.
tgt: Loku kuhambisana nesijubo seNkantolo yeMtsetfosisekelo (i-ConCourt) leyakhipha umyalo wekutsi kungetwe sikhatsi salenkontileka lekhona ne-Cash Paymaster Services (i-CPS) kute kube mhla tinge-31 Indlovulenkhulu 2018.

src: Kabinete e thasisetsa boikitlaetso ba yona lenaneong la mmuso la thuso ya tsa kahisano, le tsepameng setsiketsing sa dikgato tsa rona tsa phediso ya bofuma ebile le le bohlokwa pusetsong ya seriti sa batho ba habo rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaphindza futsi ikhombisa kutinikela kwayo eluhlelweni lwahulumende lwetibonelelomali tembuso, lolusekujuleni kwemitamo yetfu yekunciphisa buphuya futsi lucondze ngco ekubuyiseni sitfunti kubantfu bakitsi.

src: Kabinete e kgotsofetse ka hore bakgolamolemo ba dithuso tsa ditjhelete tsa setjhaba ba tla lefuwa ka la 1 Mmesa 2018.Dikarete tsa hajwale tsa SASSA di tla dula di sebetsa ho fihlela ka Tshitwe 2018.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inetisekile kutsi bazuzi betibonelelomali tembuso batawukhokhelwa mhla lu-01 Mabasa 2018.Lamakhadi aka-SASSA lakhona asesemtsetfweni kute kube yinyanga yeNgongoni 2018.

src: Mothati wa ho fetola dikarete tsa bakgolamolemo o tla etswa ka mokgwa o sa belaetseng ebile e le o sa tlo sitisa ho lefuwa ha ditjhelete tsa dithuso.
tgt: Inchubo yekuntjintja emakhadi ebazuzi betibonelelomali tembuso itakwentiwa ngendlela lensha lehlanganisa tindlela tekukhokha letimbili nome letingetulu lengeke itsikamete kukhokhelwa kwetibonelelomali tembuso.

src: Bakgolamolemo bohle ba tla fumana ditjhelete tsa bona tsa dithuso tsa mmuso ka makala a bona a ditefo a akgang dibanka, Posong ya Aforika Borwa (SAPO) le mabenkeleng a mang.
tgt: Bonkhe bazuzi betibonelelomali tembuso batawutfola tibonelelomali tabo etindzaweni tabo tekukhokhelwa lokufaka ekhatsi emabhange, ePosini laseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPO) kanye nakuletinye tindzawo tekutsengisa.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho ba se nang diakhaonte tsa banka ho leba makaleng a haufi le bona a Poso hore ba ilo bula diakhaonte.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela labo labete ema-akhawunti asebhange kutsi bavakashele emagatja e-SAPO lasedvute bayovula ema-akhawunti.

src: Kabinete e laetse SASSA, mmoho le Tsamaiso ya Dikgokahanyo le Tlhahisoleseding ya Mmuso (GCIS), ho etsa ka hohle kamoo e ka kgonang ka teng ho tsebisa bakgolamolemo bohle ka diphetoho dife kapa dife tse ka bang teng motjheng wa diphetoho tsa ho tloha ho CPS ho ya mmotlolong o motjha o kopantsweng habedi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inike i-SASSA umyalo kanye neLuphiko Lwahulumende Lwetekuchumana Netekwatisa (i-GCIS) kutsi bente konkhe lokusemandleni kutsi batise bonkhe bazuzi betibonelelomali nganome ngabe ngutiphi tingucuko letingabakhona ngesikhatsi salenchubo yekuntjintja kusukwa ku-CPS kuyiwa kulenye indlela lensha lehlanganisa tindlela tekukhokha letimbili nome letingetulu.

src: Kabinete e dula e ikitlaelleditse ho netefatsa hore mmuso o ikokobeletsa kahlolo ya ConCourt.
tgt: IKhabhinethi solo isatinikele ekucinisekiseni kutsi hulumende uyasigcina sijubo seNkantolo yeMtsetfosisekelo.

src: Dikantoro tsa SASSA di tla bulwa mme di tla be di le malala-a-laotswe ho sebetsana le dikopo tse ntjha.
tgt: Emahhovisi aka-SASSA atawube avuliwe futsi alungele kusebenta ngaleticelo letinsha.

src: Kabinete e kopa setjhaba sohle, haholoholo bakgolamolemo le ba malapa a bona, ho ikopanya le SASSA ho 0800 60 10 11 kapa ho etela kantoro e haufi ya SASSA, ha o batla ho tseba haholwanyane.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela onkhe emalunga emmango kutsi, ikakhulu lawo labazuzi kanye nemindeni yawo, kutsi batsintse i-SASSA ku: 0800 60 10 11 nome bavakashele lihhovisi labo laka-SASSA lelisedvute kute batfole lwatiso lolubanti.

src: Boingodiso ba bakgethi.
tgt: Kubhalisa kwebavoti.

src: Kabinete e ikamahanya le Khomishene e Ikemetseng ya Dikgetho (IEC) le Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa ho leboheng maAforika Borwa ohle a arabetseng kgoeletso ya ho ingodisetsa dikgetho kapa ho lokisa dintlha tsa diaterese tsa bona letsholong la bekeng e fetileng la boingodiso ba bakgethi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi, njengeKhomishini Yelukhetfo Letimele (i-IEC) kanye naMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, nayo ibonga bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labalale lesimemetelo sekubhalisela kuvota nome lokuhamba bayokulungisa imininingwane yabo yemakheli kulemphelasontfo lephelile ngesikhatsi semkhankhaso wekubhaliswa kwebavoti.

src: Sena ke mokolokotwane mabapi le boitokisetso ba dikgetho tsa botshelela tsa naha le tsa diporofense tse lebeletsweng ho tshwarwa ka 2019.
tgt: Lomkhankaso ubaluleke kakhulu emalungiselelweni elukhetfo lwesitfupha lwavelonkhe netifundza lokulindzeleke kutsi lube nga-2019.

src: Palo yohle ya baahi ba 2 767 139 e etetse diteishene tsa ho voutela mafelong a fetileng a beke.
tgt: Takhamuti leti-2 767 139 tivakashele tikhungo tekuvota kulemphelasontfo leyengcile.

src: Ho bakgethi ba fetang 2.76 milione ba etetseng diteishene tsa bona tsa ho voutela:Ba kahodimonyana ho milione ba ingodisitse botjha diterekeng tsa bona tse ntjha tsa ho voutelaBa kahodimo ho 800 000 ba fetoletse boingodiso ba bona diterekeng tse ntjha tsa ho voutelaBa ka bang 500 000 e ne e le bakgethi ba ingodisang lekgetlo la peleBoingodisong bo botjha ba bakgethi, 82% ya bona e ne e le ka tlasa dilemo tse 30 mme ba ka etsang 54% e ne e le basadiGauteng ke yona e neng e na le boingodiso bo botjha bo bongata ka ho fetisisa ka 23.69%, ha latela KwaZulu-Natal ka 18.78% le Limpopo ka 17.03%.
tgt: Kulabo bavoti labangetulu kwetigidzi le-2.76 labavakashele tikhungo tekuvota:Babe nje ngetulu kwe-1.3 yesigidzi lababhalisile futsi etikhungweni tabo tekuvota tesigodziLabangetulu kwe-800 000 bantjintje kubhalisa kwabo bayowubhalisa esigodzini sekuvota lesishaCishe laba-500 000 bekubavoti labebabhalisa kwekucalaKulabo labasha lababhalisile, labange-82% bebangephasi kweminyaka lenge-30 kantsi cishe labange-54% bekubomakeSifundza saseGauteng sibe nebantfu lababhalisa kwekucala labange-23.69%, salandzelwa iKwaZuulu-Natal nge-18.78% neLimpopo nge-17.03%.

src: Kapa Botjhabela e bile le boemo bo phahameng ba boingodiso ka 87%, ha latela Freistata hanyane ka hodima 82%, le KwaZulu-Natal, Limpopo le Kapa Leboya ka 79% ka tatelano.
tgt: Sifundza seMphumalanga Kapa sona sibe nebantfu labanengi lababhalisile, labange-87%, kwalandzela iFreystata yabanje ngetulu kwe-82%, neKwaZulu-Natal, Limpopo neNyakatfo Kapa nge-79% ngekulandzelana.

src: Bongodiso ka kakaretso ba Gauteng e ne e le 67.3%.
tgt: Bantfu sebabonkhe lababhalisele kuvota eGauteng bange-67.3%.

src: IEC e tlalehile hore jwale lenane la bakgethi le na le bakgethi ba 26 250 939, e leng se ka lekanang le 75% ya batho ba nang le tokelo ya ho kgetha, ho itshetlehilwe hodima dikgakanyong tsa Lefapha la Dipalopalo la Aforika Borwa (StatsSA) tsa dilemo tsa baahi.
tgt: I-IEC ibike kutsi luhlu lwebavoti nyalo selume kubavoti laba-26 250 939, lokulinganiselwa nje ku-75% yebantfu labafanele kuvota, ngekwetilinganiso teLihhovisi Lelubalobalo laseNingizimu Afrika tebantfu labaneminyaka lekuvumelako kuvota.

src: Baahi ba ka bang 300 000 ba etetseng diteishene tsa ho voutela, ba hara bakgethi ba ka fihlang ho milione bao IEC e neng e se na diaterese tsa bona pele ho mafelo ao a beke ya boingodiso.
tgt: Takhamuti letilinganiselwa kuleti-300 000 letivakashele tikhungo tekuvota cishe tisemkhatsini walabo bavoti labatigidzi le-2.8 i-IEC lebeyite emakheli abo ngesikhatsi salemphelasontfo.

src: Lenane la bakgethi le lokisitsweng ebile e le le nepahetseng le tiisa tshepahalo ya lenane la bakgethi mme le matlafatsa demokerasi ya rona ka ho netefatsa dikgetho tse lokolohileng, tse hlokang leeme ebile e le tse tshepahalang.
tgt: Luhlu lwebavoti lolungilo lucinisekisa kwetsembeka kwalolo luhlu lwebavoti futsi luphindze lucinise nentsandvo yetfu yelinyenti ngekucinisekisa kutsi kube nelukhetfo lolungavuni luhlangotsi, lolukhululekile nalolutsembekile.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ohle a sa kgonang ho etela diteishene tsa ona tsa ho voutela mafelong a fetileng a beke, ho etela kantoro e haufi ya IEC ho ya netefatsa esita le ho lokisa diaterese tsa ona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labangazange bakhone kutsi bavakashele tikhungo tabo tekuvota kulelmphelasontfo lephelile kutsi bavakashele lihhovisi le-IEC lelisedvute bayocinisekisa kanye nekwenta kutsi ibe sesikhatsini imininingwane yemakheli abo.

src: Ka nqa e nngwe, sesebedisuwa sa IEC sa inthanete ho WEBTOKEN le app ya yona, di dula di fumaneha ka dihora tse 24 ka letsatsi bakeng sa bakgethi ba ingodisitseng ho lekola le ho lokisa dintlha tsa diaterese tsa bona.
tgt: Nakungasinjalo, bavoti lababhalisile mabavakashele iwebhusayithi ye-IEC ku: WEBTOKEN imini nebusuku bahlole futsi balungise imininingwane yabo yemakheli.

src: Ditakaletso tse ntle ho moatlelete Mhlengi Gwala.
tgt: Tilokotfo letinhle kumgijimu uMhlengi Gwala.

src: Kabinete e ikamahanya le Letona la Dipapadi le Boithapollo, Mofumahadi Thokozile Xasa, mabapi le ho tshwela ka mathe ketso ya bosoto ya tlhaselo kgahlanong le moatlelete ya motjha dilemong, Mhlengi Gwala, ya hlasetsweng ka sakga ya difate ha a ntse a palame baesekele KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: IKhabhinethi nayo, njengeNdvuna Yetemidlalo Nekukhibika, Mk Thokozile Xasa, iyasigceka lesento sebucaba sebudlova lesentiwe kulomgijimi losesamusha, Mhlengi Gwala, lowahlaselwa ngelisaha lehhomlayidi ngesikhatsi ashova libhayisikili KwaZulu-Natal.

src: Kabinete e lakaletsa moatlelete enwa hore a fole ka potlako mme e fetisetsa diteboho tse mofuthu ho moifo wa bongaka wa Sepetlele sa St Augustine o ntseng o mo hlokometse.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ifisela lomgijimi kwelulama ngekushesha futsi ivakalisa kubonga kwayo kulelo tsimba labodokotela lasesibhedlela saseSt Augustine lelimnakekelako sikhuluma nje.

src: Ditlolo tsa molao ha di na sebaka setjhabeng sa habo rona mme Kabinete e ipiletsa ho badudi ho sebetsa mmoho le makala a qobello ya molao hore ho tshwarwe batlodi ba molao.
tgt: Bugebengu abemukeleki emmangweni wakitsi neKhabhinethi icela imimango kutsi isebentisane nema-ejensi lacinisekisa kugcinwa kwemtsetfo kutsi kuboshwe letigebengu.

src: Komello e tsebahatswa e le koduwa ya naha.
tgt: Somiso sesimemetelwe njengenhlekelele yavelonkhe.

src: Tlasa boetapele ba Letona la Kopanelo ya Mmuso le Merero ya Botjhaba Zweli Mkhize, mmuso o tsebahaditse boemo ba naha ba koduwa ho sebetsana le bothata ba naha ba komello le metsi.
tgt: Ngaphasi kweNdvuna Yetekubusa Ngekubambisana Netendzabuko Mnu Zweli Mkize, hulumende sewumemetele ngalokusemtsetfweni simo senhlekelele yavelonkhe kute kubukanwe nesomiso salelive nenkinga yemanti.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa kananelo ya yona ho bao ba tswelang pele ho boloka metsi ka hara Aforika Borwa, esita le matsapa a sa sisinyeheng a entsweng ke Komiti ya Matona a Kopaneng e mabapi le Komello, hammoho le ba amehang makaleng ohle a mmuso le a setjhaba, mabapi le ho sebetsana le maemo a sa sutheng a komello a thefutseng dikarolo tse ngatanyana tsa naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyababonga bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labasolomane bachubeke njalo ngekonga emanti kanye nemitamo lengapheli yeLikomidi Lelihlanganisa Tindvuna Lesomiso, kanye nalabo labatsintsekako kuyo yonkhe imikhakha yahulumende nemmango, ekulweni naletimo tesomiso lesichubeke njalo letihlasele tincenye letinengi talelive.

src: Ntle le taba ya hore Aforika Borwa ke naha e haellwang ke metsi, Kabinete e kgodisehile hore re dula re ntse re le sebaka se ratwang ke bahahlaudi.
tgt: Ngaphandle kwkutsi iNingizimu Afrika ilive leliswela emanti, Ikhabhinethi yenta siciniseko sekutsi sitawuhlala njalo silive bavakashi labakhetsa kulivakashela.

src: Diqeto tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Tincumo teKhabhinethi.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana hore Sehlomathisetso sa 1 se Hlomathisang Tumellano (Tshebedisano Botseteding) ya Porothokhole ya tsa Ditjhelete le Botsetedi (FIP) ya Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tsa Aforika e ka Borwa (SADC) e tekwe Palamenteng bakeng sa kananelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile kutsi Sivumelwane Lesichibela Seleko 1 (Kuhlanganyela lokumayelana Nelutjalotimali) seSivumelwano Setetimali Nelutjalomali (i-FIP) seNhlangano Yekutfutfukisa Emave LaseNingizimu Ne-Afrika (i-SADC) wetfulwe ePhalamende kute ucinisekiswe.

src: Sepheo sa FIP ke ho ntlafatsa maano a tsa ditjhelete le botsetedi a Dinaha tseo e leng Ditho, hore di tsamaisane le merero ya SADSena se tla netefatsa hore diphetoho dife kapa dife maanong a tsa ditjhelete le botsetedi Naheng e le nngwe eo e leng Setho ha di tlise diphetoho tse sa batleheng ho Dinaha tse ding tseo e leng Ditho.
tgt: Inhloso yale-FIP kwenta kutsi tinchubomgomo tetimali netekutjala timali teMave Angemalunga e-SADC tihambisane netinhloso te-SADLoku kutawucinisekisa kutsi nome ngabe ngutiphi tingucuko letikhona emigomeni yetetimali nekutjala timali kulinye Live Lelililunga le-SADC akubangi kutsi kuze kube nekulungiswa lokungakadzingeki kulamanye eMave Langamaunga e-SADLetichibiyelo kuhloswe ngato kugcina lilungelo labohulumende kutsi balawule ngendlela letsandvwa ngummango, kanye nekucinisekisa kutsi ayahambelana emalungelo netibopho tebatjalitimali nabohulumende.

src: Dihlomathiso tsena di habile ho baballa tokelo ya mebuso ya ho laola dintho molemong wa setjhaba, esita le ho tsitsisa ditokelo le ditshwanelo tsa batsetedi le mebuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kwetfulwa ePhalamende Kwemitsetfo Lesilinganisosimo Lesiphasi Lebuyeketiwe Naleyetsiwe Kabusha yaKamhlabuhlangene (i-UN) Yekuphatfwa Kwetiboshwa (“Imitsetfo yaNelson Mandela”).

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tekwa ha Melawana e Boemong bo Tlase e Shebilweng Botjha ya ba ya Rehwa Botjha ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) bakeng sa Tshwaro e Ntle ya Batshwaruwa (“Melawana ya Nelson Mandela”), Palamenteng.
tgt: Lokwetsiwa kabusha kwaLemitsetfo Lesilinganisosimo Lesiphasi kutsiwe “Imitsetfo yaNelson Mandela” yindlela yekuhlonipha umshiyandvuku waMengameli wetfu waphambilini, lowacitsa iminyaka lenge-27 ejele.

src: Ho rehwa botjha ha Melawana ya Boemo bo Tlase ya “Melawana ya Nelson Mandela” ho tlotla lefa la Moporesidente wa rona wa mehleng, ya qetileng dilemo tse 27 tjhankaneng.
tgt: Kuphindze futsi kwaba nekwengetwa mhlaba wonkhe kwengcikitsi yeLusuku lwaNelson Mandela Lwemave Emhlaba, lolukhunjulwa ngeMave Langamalunga e-UN mhla ti-18 Kholwane, ngenhloso yekugcugcutela timo tebuntfu emajele, kufundzisa ngekutsi tiboshwa nato tiyincenye yemmango kanye nekwatisa umsebenti lowentiwa tisebenti tasemajele njengemsebenti wetenhlalakahle.

src: Ho boetse ho bile le katoloso ya lefatshe ka bophara ya lepatlelo la Letsatsi la Matjhaba la Nelson Mandela, le hlomphuwang ke Dinaha tseo e leng Ditho tsa UN, ka la 18 Phupu, ho phahamisa maemo a botho a botshwaruwa, ho matlafatsa tlhokomediso mabapi le batshwaruwa hore ke karolo ya setjhaba esita le ho tlotla mosebetsi wa basebeletsi ba ditjhankana e le tshebeletso ya kahisano.
tgt: Lemitsetfo itawusita iNingizimu Afrika kutsi yenta ngekushesha ingucuko yekutsi kube luhlelo lwekucondziswa kwetimilo lwekutfutfukisa bantfu loluhambisana nemitsetfomgomo netinkhombandlela letahlukahlukene temave emhlaba.

src: Dibili.
tgt: Imitsetfosivivinyo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Bili ya Thibelo le Twantsho ya Ditlolo tsa Molao tsa Lehloyo le Puo ya Lehloyo ya 2018 hore e tekwe Palamenteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kwetfulwa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekuvikela Nekulwa Nemacala eNzondo Nenkhulumo Yenzondo wanga-2018.LoMtsetfosivivinyo uhlose kwenta kutsi bugebengu benzondo nenkhulumo yenzondo bube licala, kanye nekutsi kube khona tinyatselo tekuvikela nekulwa nalamacala.

src: Bili e habile ho bopa ditlolo tsa molao tsa lehloyo le puo ya lehloyo, esita le ho kenya tshebetsong mekgwa ya ho thibela le ho lwantsha ditlolo tsena tsa molao.
tgt: Uhlose kulungisa budlova lobucondziswe kubantfu ngenca yekubandlulula.

src: E rerile ho sebetsana le dikgoka kgahlanong le batho ka lebaka la kgethollo.
tgt: Utawunika emandla futsi kutsi iNingizimu Afrika itibophelele ngekwemtsetfo wemalungelo eluntfu emave emhlaba.

src: E tla boela e fana ka tshusumetso ditshwanelong tsa Aforika Borwa ho ya ka disebedisuwa tsa matjhaba tsa ditokelo tsa botho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kutsi kungeniswe ePhalamende Umtsetfosivivinyo Wesikhungo Savelonkhe iKamva Semakhono eBuchwepheshe Be-inthanethi (i-iNeSI) wanga-2018.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Bili ya Setheo sa Naha sa Boitsebelo ba Inthanete sa iKamva (iNeSI) ya 2018 hore e kenngwe Palamenteng.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo wekwenta kutsi i-iNeSI ibe sikhungo lesingatimela ngekwemtsetfo lesinemtsetfo waso wekulungisa tinsayeya tekuswelakala kwemakhono ebuchwepheshe be-inthanethi kulelive.

src: Bili e fana ka ho thehwa ha iNeSI jwaloka setheo se molaong se nang le boetsamolao boo e leng ba sona ho sebetsana le diphephetso tsa bokgoni ba boitsebelo ba inthanete (boitsebelo ba dijithale) ka hara naha.
tgt: Kutfutfukisa emakhono ebuchwepheshe be-inthanethii kubonwa njengeloko hulumende lakubeke embili latawucala ngako kukwenta ekwakheni umnotfo lozuzisa wonkhe umuntfu, kanye nekutsi kube nembuso lokhonako nalobeka embili intfutfuko.

src: Ntshetsopele ya bokgoni ba boitsebelo ba inthanete e nkuwa e le e nngwe ya dintlha tse ka sehloohong tsa mmuso mabapi le ho aha moruo o kenyeletsang bohle, esita le ho thea naha e nang le bokgoni ebile e le e tswelang pele.
tgt: I-iNeSI itawusebenta njengesikhungo savelonkhe lesikhokhela tingucuko, ekutfutfukiseni ematiko netikhungo tahulumende ngemakhono ebuchwepheshe be-inthanethi besimanje.

src: INeSI e tla sebetsa jwaloka sethusi sa tshebedisano le diphetoho, bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya boitsebelo ba dijithale le bokgoni ba ditlhophiso ka hara naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kwetfulwa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wesayensi Yetemanti, i-Hydrography, wanga-2018.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Bili ya Dibopeho tsa Metsing ya 2018 hore e lelekelwe Palamenteng.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uhlose kwatisa nekunika Lihhovisi laSosayensi Wetemanti simo setemtsetfo, lebesisolo sikhona kuLitiko Letekuvikela (Umbutfo waseNingizimu Afrika Wetekuvikela Wasemantini) kusukela kwasungulwa tinsita tasemantini lapha eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Bili e habile ho ananela le ho fana ka maemo a ketsamolao Kantorong ya Setsebi sa Dibopeho tsa Metsing, eo esale e le teng ka hara Lefapha la Lebotho la Tshireletso (Lebotho la Lewatleng la Aforika Borwa) haesale ho tloha tshimolohong ya ditshebeletso tsa dibopeho tsa metsing ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Utawusita kutsi Sosayensi Wemanti (i-Hydographer) waMbutfo waseNingizimu Afrika Wasemantini watiwe njengaSosayensi Wasemantini Wavelonkhe.

src: E tla thusa Setsebi sa Dibopeho tsa Metsing sa Lebotho la Lewatleng la Aforika Borwa ho ananelwa jwaloka Setsebi sa Naha sa Dibopeho tsa Metsing.
tgt: Utawucinisekisa kutsi tinsita tasemantini tiba nguletihlelekile futsi tentiwa tiba semtsetfweni loku kuhambisana neNhlangano Yemave Emhlaba Yaselwandle (i-IMO) kanye neSivumelwane Semave Emhlaba Sekuphepha Kwemphilo eLwandle, lokusivumelwane semave emhlaba selwandle lesibeka tilinganisosimo tekuphepha letiphasi ekwakheni, kutisetjentiswa kanye nasekusebenteni kwemikhumbi yekuhweba.

src: Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: Imicimbi Letako.

src: Kgwedi/Letsatsi la Ditokelo tsa BothoMekete ya sehopotso sa Kgwedi/Letsatsi la Naha la 2018 la Ditokelo tsa Botho e tla tshwarwa tlasa mokotaba o reng: “Selemo sa Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela: ho phahamisa le ho tebisa tlwaelo ya ditokelo tsa botho setjhabeng ka bophara”.Ketsahalo ena ya naha e tla tshwarwa ka la 21 Hlakubele 2018 Lebaleng la Kirikete la George Thabe, Sharpeville ho la Vereeniging.
tgt: Inyanga/Lusuku Lemalungelo EluntfuImicimbi yekugubha Inyanga/lusuku Lwavelonkhe Lwemalungelo eLuntfu nga-2018 itawubanjwa ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Umnyaka waNelson Rolihlahla Mandela: kugcugcutela nekujulisa lisiko lemalungelo eluntfu esiveni sonkhana.”Lomcimbi wavelonkhe utawuba mhla tinge-21 Indlovulenkhulu 2018 lapha eGeorge Thabe Cricket Pitch, eSharpeville eVereeniging.

src: Kabinete e kopa makala ohle ho hlompha letsatsi lena la Naha, le ketekang setso sa ditokelo tsa botho sa Aforika Borwa esita le ho tlotla batho ba kang Madiba ya ileng a intsha sehlabelo molemong wa phihlello ya topollo le tokoloho tseo re nang le tsona kajeno.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igcugcutela yonkhe imikhakha kutsi ilihloniphe lolusuku lwavelonkhe, lwekugubha lisiko lemalungelo eluntfu eNingizimu Afrika futsi kuhlonishwe nebantfu labafanana naboMadiba labatinikela kute sitfole lenkhululeko lesiyijabulelako lamuhla.

src: Beke ya Naha ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo ya ImbizoBeke ya Naha ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo ya Imbizo e tla ba ho tloha ka la 9 ho isa ho la 15 Mmesa 2018 tlasa mokotaba o reng: “Re le mmoho re Ntshetsa Aforika Borwa Pele”.
tgt: Liviki Lavelonkhe LetimbizoLiviki Lavelonkhe Letimbizo litawucala mhla ti-09 kuya ngamhla ti-15 Mabasa 2018 ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Sisonkhe sichubekisela iNingizimu Afrika embili.” Kulomnyaka, umgubho weminyaka Lelikhulu yaMandela uyincenye lenkhulu yeliviki lokutawube kugcilwe kulo, ngaphasi kwengcikitsi lengephasi letsi: “Bani sibonelo semisebenti yakhe.” Sigungu sahulumende sitawube sicocisana nemimango etincenyeni letehlukahlukene talelive.

src: Monongwaha, Mokete wa Dilemo tse Lekgolo tsa Mandela o bopa karolo e kgolo ya beke ya tsepamiso ya maikutlo, tlasa mookotaba o monyane o reng: “E ba karolo ya lefa”.
tgt: Tinhlelo teTindvuna letimayelana naloko letitawube tikwenta titawukhishwa ngesikhatsi lesifanele.

src: Kgiro ya Batjha Moporesidente Ramaphosa o lebeletswe ho thakgola bopulamadiboho ba kgato ya Ditshebeletso tsa Kgiro ya Batjha Setsing sa Thuthuhiso ya Dikgwebo sa Riversands ho la Diepsloot ka la 27 Hlakubele 2018.
tgt: Kusebenta kwalabasha Mengameli Ramaphosa ulindzeleke kutsi etfule umtamo wekulinga kusebenta weTinsita Talabasha Tekusebenta lapha eRiversands Incubation Hub eDiepsloot mhla tinge-27 Indlovulenkhulu 2018.

src: Kgato ena, ka tshebedisano le lekala la poraefete, e habile ho matlafatsa batjha ba milione dilemong tse hlano tse tlang hore ba kene kgabong ya moruo, mohlomong e le ditho tsa setlamo sa basebetsi kapa ba itsamaisetsa dikgwebo tseo e leng tsa bona kapa ba iphumanele tjantjello ya seo ba ratang ho ntshetsa dithuto tsa bona pele ka sona.
tgt: Lomtamo, ngekuhlanganyela nemkhakha lotimele, uhlose kutfutfukisa bantfu labasha labasigidzi sinye kuleminyaka lesihlanu letako kute kutsi badlale indzima kutemnotfo, mhlawumbe njengetisebenti nome bantu labatichubela emabhizinisi abo nome njengetitjudeni letichubeka nekufundza.

src: Maeto a tshebetso ho ya Mozambique le ZimbabweMoporesidente Ramaphosa o tla nka maeto a tshebetso ho ya Riphaboliking ya Mozambique le Riphaboliking ya Zimbabwe ka tatelano, ka Moqebelo wa la 17 Hlakubele 2018.
tgt: Kuvakashela eMozambique naseZimbabwe ngekwemsebentiMengameli Ramaphosa utawuvakashela ngekwemsebenti wakhe eRiphabhuliki yaseMozambique naseRiphabhuliki yaseZimbabwe ngeMgcibelo, mhla ti-17 Indlovulenkhulu 2018.

src: Maeto ana a tla tsepamisa maikutlo matlafatsang ya dikamano tsa dinahapedi le dinaha tse qollotsweng ka hodimo mona.
tgt: Lokuvakasha kutawube kugcile kakhulu ekuciniseni budlelwane emkhatsini walamave lamabili laphawulwe ngenhla.

src: Moporesidente o tla boela a thaka maikutlo ka dintho tse amanang kgotso le polokeho ka hara lebatowa esita le kontinenteng, a boele a tshohle ka dintlha tsa lefatshe tse molemong wa dinaha tsena.
tgt: Mengameli utawuphindza futsi abambe tingcoco letimayelana nekuthula nekuphepha kulesifundza nakulelivekati, kanye nekucocisana ngetindzaba letitsintsa umhlaba wonkhe labanenshisekelo ngato.

src: Melaetsa.
tgt: Imilayeto.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Ntsiki Biyela, Mosadi wa pele wa motho e motsho wa Aforika Borwa wa serathodi sa veine ya thakgotseng veine ya letshwao la hae la boitsebahatso.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ihalalisela Ntsiki Biyela, make lomnyama wekucala waseNingizimu Afrika longumphisi wewayini lowetfule iwayini yakhe.

src: Jwalokaha a na le lengolo la kgerata ya tsebo ya thitelo ya veine la Yunivesithing ya Stellenbosch hammoho le malebela a dilemo tse 13 a sebetsa, ka 2018 Diveini tsa hae tsa Aslina di tla rekisa dibotlolo tse 12 000 Dinaheng tse Kopaneng tsa Amerika, Jeremane, Taiwan le Ghana.
tgt: Uneticu temfundvo ngemagilebisi, i-viticulture, latetfweswa yiNyuvesi yaseStellenbosch kanye neminyaka le-13 yesipiliyoni sekusebenta, iwayini yakhe i-Aslina Wines ngemnyaka wanga-2018 utawutsengisa emabhodlela la-12 000 e-United States of America, eGerman, eTaiwan naseGhana.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Caster Semenya ka ho roba rekoto ya Aforika Borwa ya 1 000m ya dilemo tse 35 mabelong a Athletix Grand Prix a neng a tshwaretswe Tuks ho la Pretoria.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela Caster Semenya ngekutsi aphule lirekhodi laseNingizimu Afrika le-1 000m lebeselihlale iminyaka lenge-35 loko lakwente lapha e-Athletix Grand Prix emcudzelwaneni wetematubane lebewubanjelwe eTuks ePitoli.

src: Thope ya rona ya pabala e hapile lebelo leo ka nako ya 2:35:44, a hlola rekoto ya kgale ya 1983 ya Ilze Wicksell ka metsotswana e ka bang e mmedi.
tgt: Lentfombi idvume kulo lonkheleli iphumelele kulomjaho ngesikhatsi lesi-2:35:44, yephula lirekhodi lelidzala langa-1983 la-Ilze Wicksell cishe ngemizuzwana lemibili.

src: Kabinete e boela e thoholetsa Semenya ka ho fihlella peelo ya hae ya nako e telele ya ho fumana mangolo a thuto a yunivesithi, ha a ne a phethela lengolo la hae la Diploma ho tsa Saense ya Dipapadi Yunivesithing ya Leboya Bophirima ho la Potchefstroom.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphindza futsi iyamhalalisela Semenya ngekufeza sifiso sakhe lesidzala sekutsi atfole ticu tasenyuvesi ngesikhatsi aphotfula i-Ddiploma in Sport Science, lapha eNyuvesi yaseNyakatfo Nshonalanga ePotchefstroom.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona ho metswalle le ba lelapa ba Setho se Hlomphehang sa Palamente, Mofumahadi Loliwe Fazeka, ya hlokahaletseng kotsing ya koloi Kapa Botjhabela, bekeng e fetileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa kudzabuka kwayo kubangani nasemndenini weLilunga Lelihloniphekile lePhalamende, Mk Loliwe Fazeka, loshone engotini yemoto eMphumalanga Kapa, kuleliviki leliphelile.

src: Kabinete e boela e fetisa matshediso a yona ho baratuwa ba Lenqosa la Aforika Borwa naheng ya Sweden, Mofumahadi Faith Radebe, ya hlokahetseng ka Labobedi, mohla la 13 Hlakubele 2018.
tgt: IKhabhinethi futsi ivakalisa kudzabuka kwayo emndenini weLincusa laseNingizimu Afrika eSweden, Mk Faith Radebe, loshone ngaLesibili, mhla ti-13 Indlovulenkhulu 2018.

src: Pele ho moo e ne e le Mohlahlobi-Kakaretso wa Mautlwela Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Bekangumhloli Jikelele waphambilini Wetebunhloli eNingizimu Afrika.

src: DithonyoDithonyo tsohle di emetse ho netefatswa ka mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang ya tlhathlobisiso.
tgt: KucashwaKonkhe kucashwa kutawuya ngekucinisekiswa kweticu kanye nekwentiwa kweluhlolokufaneleka lolufanele.

src: Ngaka Philemon Mjwara e le Motsamaisi-Kakaretso wa Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji bakeng sa konteraka e ekeditsweng ya dilemo tse tharo, ho tloha ka la 1 Mmesa Mofumahadi Memme Sejosengwe e le Mongodi-Kakaretso Kantorong ya Moahlodi e Moholo bakeng sa konteraka e ekeditsweng ya dilemo tse tharo, ho tloha ka la 1 Mmesa Mofumahadi Thuli E Radebe, e le Motsamaisi wa Phethahatso Setsing sa Ntlafatso ya Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba bakeng sa konteraka e ekeditsweng ya dikgwedi tse tsheletseng.
tgt: Philemon Mjwara njengeMcondzisi Jikelele weLitiko Letesayensi Netheknoloji sikhatsi senkontileke leyengetwe iminyaka lemitsatfu, lecala mhla lu-01 Mabasa Mk Memme Sejosengwe njengaLobhala Jikelele eHhovisi leLijaji Lelikhulu sikhatsi senkontileka lesengetiwe seminyaka lemitsatfu, kusukela mhla lu-01 Mabasa Mk Thuli E Radebe, njengeMcondzisi Wesigungu eSikhungweni se-Centre of Public Service Innovation sikhatsi senkontileka lesengetwe tinyanga letisitfupha.

src: Monghadi Thilivhali Archibald Ramawa jwaloka Mohlanka e Moholo wa tsa Ditjhelete wa Setheo sa Naha sa Mehlodi ya Ditaba tsa Elektroniki sa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Umnu Thilivhali Archibald Ramawa njengeSisebenti Lesikhulu Setetimali (i-CFO) eSikhungweni Savelonkhe Sebetindzaba Te-elekthroniki eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Boto ya Sentech SOC Limited:a. Monghadi Magatho Mello (o thontswe hape e le Motsamaisi le Modulasetulo eo e seng wa Phethahatso)b. Monghadi Lumko Mthimde (o thontswe hape e le Motsamaisi eo e seng wa Phethahatso)c. Ngaka Sandile Malinga (Motsamaisi eo e seng wa Phethahatso) led.
tgt: IBhodi ye-Sentech SOC Limited:a. Umnu Magatho Mello (ucashwe kabusha njengemcondzisi longekho esigungwini nekuba nguSihlalo)b. Umnu Lumko Mtimde (ucashwe kabusha njengemcondzisi longekho esigungwini)c. Dkt.

src: Mofumahadi Elizabeth Malaka (Motsamaisi eo e seng wa Phethahatso).
tgt: Sandile Malinga (ngumcondzisi longekho esigungwini) kanyed.

src: Boto ya Broadband Infraco:a. Monghadi Mandla Ngcobo (o thontswe hape e le Motsamaisi le Modulasetulo eo e seng wa Phethahatso)b. Mofumahadi Nokuthula Selamolela (o thontswe hape e le motsamaisi eo e seng wa Phthahatso)c. Monghadi Gift Mphefu (Motsamaisi eo e seng wa Phethahatso)d. Mofumahadi Zandile Matilda Kabini (motsamaisi eo e seng wa Phethahatso) lee.
tgt: naMk Elizabeth Malaka (longasuye umcondzisi losesigungwini).

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro mohla la 25 Mmesa 2018, Tuynhuys, Motse KapaDitaba tsa Tikoloho.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi yahlangana ngaLesitsatfu, mhla tinge-25 Mabasa 2018, eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Mapato a baitseki le mekaubere.
tgt: Imingcwabo yetishoshovu netigayigayi.

src: Kabinete e leboha batho bohle lefatsheng ka bophara, haholoholo maAforika Borwa, ka karabelo ya bona e mofuthu ebile e le mosa nakong ya ho hlokahala ha ‘imbokodo’ Mama Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, Moitseki wa ntwa ya tokoloho Ngaka Zola Skweyiya le moetapele wa mokgatlo wa basebetsi Archie Sibeko.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ibonga bonkhe bantfu emhlabeni wonkhe jikelele, ikakhulu baseNingizimu Afrika, ngendlela lefutfumele nalenhle lababukene ngayo nekushona ‘kwe-imbokodo’ Make Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, sishoshovu seMzabalazo Dkt Zola Skweyiya nemlweli wemalungelo netenhlalakahle yetisebenti Archie Sibeko.

src: Baitseki ba rona ba nyehetse maphelo a bona boikitlaetsong ba Aforika Borwa e ntlafetseng, mme banna le basadi ba naha ya rona ba kgothatswa ba bile ba susumetswa ke ditshotleho tsa bona.
tgt: Tishoshovu tetfu tanikela timphilo tato ephupheni leNingizimu Afrika lencono kanye nemadvodza nabomake batfola inshisekelo ekuzabalazeni kwabo.

src: Kabinete e boetse e ikamahanya le Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa ho iseng hlompho ho mofu Mokaubere wa modiplomate, Moambasadara George Nene, ya sebeleditseng Aforika Borwa ka bokgabane le boitelo nakong ya hae ya ha a ne a le palehong, ho ngoka lebatowa le kontinente ya rona ho netefatsa tokoloho ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Ikhabinethi futsi ihlanganyela naMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ekuhlonipheni Sigayigayi selincusa lelingasekho emhlabeni, Lincusa George Nene, lelisebentele iNingizimu Afrika ngalokusezingeni lelisetulu nekutimisela ngesikhatsi lisekutfunjweni licoca nalesigodzi nelivekati letfu kutsi likhulule iNingizimu Afrika.

src: Biopelaetso ba Leboya Bophirima.
tgt: Umbhikisho waseNyakatfo Nshonalanga.

src: Kabinete e sekasekile boemo bo hlokang botsitso bo ropohileng Leboya Bophirima, bo ammeng ditshebeletso tse ngatanyana, haholoholo ditshebeletso tsa bophelo bo botle.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi icocisene kabanti ngalesimo sebugudlugudlu lesenteka eNyakatfo Nshonalanga, lesesitsintse kabi tinsita letinyenti, ikakhulu tinsita tetemphilo.

src: Jwaloka mmuso o tsotellang, Kabinete e ananetse mehato e mmedi ya hanghang ya bokenadipakeng ho busetsa kgutso le botsitso sebakeng seo.
tgt: Njengahulumende lonakekelako, Ikhabhinethi ivume tingenelelo letimbili letisheshako tekwenta kutsi kube nekutinta nekuthula kulesa sifundza.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho sebediswa ha Karolo ya 100(1) ya Molaotheo wa Riphaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa 1996, ho rarolla koduwa ena, haholoholo lekaleng la bophelo bo botle.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kusetjentiswa kweSigaba se-100(1) seMtsetfosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika sanga-1996 kulungisa letinhlekelele, ikakhulu emkhakheni wetemphilo.

src: Sepheo se ka sehloohong sa bokenadipakeng bona e tla ba ho:busetsa tshepo le boitshepo dipakeng tsa basebetsi le mmusothusa porofense ho ntlafatsa mekgwatsamaiso le bokgoni ba yona tlwaelong e ntjhanetefatsa boikamahanyo le moralo wa mmuso wa ketsamolao le taolotsitsisa tikoloho ya basebetsi, ho kgutlisa phano ya ditshebeletso ya nako e telele, ho netefatsa tshireletseho ya basebetsi le ho ntlafatsa tsamaiso ya ditjhelete.
tgt: Inhloso lenkhulu yalomgomo kutawuba:kubuyisela esimeni lesifanele kwetsemba nekutetsemba emkhatsini wetisebenti nahulumendekusita lesifundza kutsi sigucule tinchubo nemakhono kubunjalo lobushakucinisekisa kuhambisana nemtsetfo kanye neluhlakamsebenti lwahulumende lwekulawulakutintisa simondzawo setisebenti, kubuyisela esimeni lesifanele kusimama kwekwetfulwa kwetinsita, kucinisekisa kuvikeleka kwetisebenti kanye nekwenta kancono kulawulwa kwetimali.

src: Kabinete e boetse e laetse sehlopha sa tshebetso sa Matona ho etela Leboya Bophirima ho fumana dintlha tsa sebele.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iphindze yetfwesa umtfwalo licembu lekusebenta leTindvuna lelitawutfola emaciniso mayelana nalesehlakalo.

src: Matona a lebelletswe hore a fane ka tlaleho dibekeng tse pedi tse tlang.
tgt: Balindzeleke kutsi bangenise umbiko kulamaviki lamabili letako.

src: Tlaleho ena e tla thusa ho fumana haeba ho na le bokenadipakeng bo bong bo ka nnang ba hlokeha.
tgt: Lombiko lotawuletfwa utawusita ekutfoleni letinye tinyatselo tekungenelela letingenteka kutsi tisadzingeka.

src: Sehlopha seo sa Tshebetso se akga Matona a Thero, Bodisa le Tlhahlobo (Mohlophisi) Bophelo bo Botle tsa Ditjhelete Kopanelo ya Puso le Merero ya Setso hammoho le Setlamo sa Matona a Toka, Thibelo ya Ditlolo tsa Molao le Tshireletso.
tgt: Lelicembu leLisebentako lifaka ekhatsi Indvuna yeTekuhlela, yeTekucaphela neKulinganisa Kusebenta (Umchumanisi) yeTemphilo yeTetimali yeTekubusa Ngekubambisana Netendzabuko kanye neTindvuna teKlasta yeTebulungiswa, Tekuvikela Bugebengu kanye neTekuvikela.

src: Leha e lemoha ditletlebo tse hlahisitsweng ke setjhaba, Kabinete e seolla ka matla diketso tsa dikgoka, boinyafelo le bosenyi ba thepa tse neng di tsamaisana le mehwanto ya boipelaetso dibakeng tse ding tsa porofense.
tgt: Lapho isabuka kukhatsateka lokuvetwe yimimango, Ikhabhinethi itigceke kakhulu tento tebudlova, kweba nekumoshwa kwemphahla lokuhambisana nemibhikisho kuletinye tindzawo talesifundza.

src: Ditherisano tsa meputso lekaleng la setjhaba.1 Kabinete e ile ya tlalehelwa ka ditherisano tsa hajwale tsa meputso ya Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba.
tgt: Tingcoco tekubonisana ngemiholo yetisebenti tahulumende.1 Ikhabhinethi yabikelwa ngetingcoco letikhona kwamanje tekubonisana ngemiholo yeTisebenti taHulumende.

src: Kabinete e kopile Lefapha la Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba le Tsamaiso hammoho le komiti e fanang ka matla hore di sebetse ka boikitlaetso ho rarolla ho se utlwisisane ho teng mabapi le ditherisano tsa meputso.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi icele Litiko Letemisebenti Yahulumende Nekuphatsa kanye nelikomidi leligunyatako kutsi basebente ngekushesha basombulule lomnyamalongasi wekubonisana ngemiholo.

src: Seteraeke sa dibese.
tgt: Siteleka semabhasi.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho baamehi bohle lekaleng la dipalangwang tsa setjhaba ho fedisa seteraeke sa naha sa dibese ka potlako.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi imema bonkhe labatsintsekako emkhakheni wetigitjelwa temmango kutsi basheshise bacedze lesitelaka semabhasi.

src: Re kopa baamehi bohle hore ba kgutlele ditherisanong ho etsetsa hore ho tle ho fihlellwe tumellano e molemong wa bohle ba amehang esita le naha.
tgt: Sicela onkhe emacembu kutsi abuyele etafuleni ayobonisana kute kutsi bafinyelele esivumelwaneni lesitawuvuna onkhe emacembu kanye nalelive.

src: Merusu Lebaleng la Moses Mabhida.
tgt: Budlova eMoses Mabhida Stadium.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe diketso tsa merusu le bosenyi bo soto ba thepa tse entsweng ke balatedi ba bolo ya maoto kamora hore ba itahlele ka Lebaleng la Moses Mabhida, Durban, nakong ya papadi ya Liki e Kgolo ya Bolo ya Maoto (PSL) mafelong a beke.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyabugceka lobudlova nekumosha imphahla ngehlitiyo lembi lokwentiwe balandzeli bebhola labavele batseleka ebaleni enkhundleni yetemidlalo iMoses Mabhida Stadium nakudlalwa umdlalo we-Premier Soccer League ngemphelansontfo.

src: Ditheo tsa qobello ya molao di koptjwa ho netefatsa hore bohle ba bileng le letsoho bosenying le diketsong tsa merusu papading eo, ba nka boikarabello bakeng sa diketso tsa bona.
tgt: Ema-ejensi lacinisekisa kulandzelwa kwemtsetfo acelwa kutsi ente siciniseko sekutsi bonkhe labo labambandzakanyekako kulobugebengu netento tebudlova kulomdlalo bayabanjwa bajezizelwe letento tabo.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ya hore ho etswe dipatlisiso tse potlakileng le hore ho kenngwe tshebetsong mehato e tiileng ya tshireletso ho netefatsa polokeho ya babohi le bahlanka.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi icela kutsi kwentiwe luphenyo lolusheshako futsi kufezekiswe masinyane tindlela leticinile tekuphepha kucinisekisa kuphepha kwabo bonkhe babukeli netikhulu.

src: E kopa bohle ba amehang hore ba be le tshebedisano mmoho dipatlisisong, ho thibela hore kamoso diketso tse tjena di se ke tsa etsahala hape.
tgt: Icela bonkhe badlalindzima kutsi babambisane nebaseshi kute kutsi kuvikelwe kwehla kwaletehlakalo esikhatsini lesitako.

src: Diteishene tsa seyalemoya sa setjhaba.
tgt: Titeshi temisakato yemoya temmango.

src: Kabinete e amohela tumellano e fihletsweng ya ho hokela botjha diteishene tse 15 tsa seyalemoya tse neng di kwetswe ke Sentech hobane di sa lefa ditefello tsa kabo ya leqhubu la kgaso, ha ho ntse ho batlwa ditharollo tsa nako e telelele.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyasemukela sivumelwane lekufinyelelwe kuso sekutsi kuvulwe titeshi temisakato yemoya temmango leti-15 lebetivalwe yiSentech ngenca yekutsi betingakakhokhi timali tekusatjalaliswa kwesiginali, kube kusafunwa tisombululo talomphelo.

src: Tumellano e fihletswe kamora hore mmuso o be le kopano le Sentech, Foramo ya Naha ya Seyalemoya sa Setjhaba, Lekgotla la Ntshetsopele ya Mehlodi ya Ditaba le ho se Tshwane (MDDA) esita le Lekgotla le Ikemetseng la Dikgokahanyo la Aforika Borwa (ICASA).
tgt: Kufinyelelwe kulesivumelwane ngemuva kwekutsi hulumende ahlangane neSentech, Iforamu Yavelonkhe Yemsakato Yemoya Yemmango, I-ejensi Yekutfutfukisa Betindzaba Nekwehlukahlukana (i-MMDA) kanye neMtimba Lotimele Wetekuchumana WaseNingizimu Afrika (i-Icasa).

src: Lekala la seyalemoya sa setjhaba ke lepatlelo la bohlokwa la kgokahanyo le fang batho ba habo rona phihlello ho tlhahisoleseding, ebile e le tsela ya ho bopa setjhaba se nang le tsebo.
tgt: Umkhakha wemsakato wemoya wemmango yinkhundla yetekuchumana lebalulekile leyenta bantfu bakitsi kutsi bakwati kufinyelela lwatiso uphindze futsi ube yindlela yekwakha bakhimuti lobunelwati.

src: Bohle ba amehang ba dumellane ka ho kopana haufinyane ho tla le tharollo ya nako e telele e tla tlisa boitjaro diteisheneng tsena.
tgt: Onkhe emacembu avumile kutsi ahlangane masinyane kute atfole sisombululo sesikhatsi lesidze lesitawenta kutsi letiteshi tisimame.

src: Kopano ya Dihlooho tsa Mebuso ya Mokgatlo wa Dinaha tsa Selekane.
tgt: Umhlangano weBaholi baHulumende beMave eCommonwealth.

src: Kabinete e amohela kananelo ya Lenaneo la Tshebetso la Mokgatlo wa Dinaha tsa Selekane bakeng sa dilemo tse pedi tse tlang.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyakwemukela kwemukelwa kweLuhlelo lweKusebenta lweMave eCommonwealth lwaleminyaka lemibili letako.

src: Moporesidente Ramaphosa o etelletse pele Moifo wa Aforika Borwa Kopanong ya Dihlooho tsa Mebuso ya Mokgatlo wa Dinaha tsa Selekane (CHOGM 2018) tlasa mookotaba o reng: “Ho hahamalla Bokamosong bo Tshwanang” ho tloha ka la 19 ho isa ho la 20 Mmesa 2018.
tgt: Mengameli Ramaphosa uhole litsimba laseNingizimu Afrika labhekisa emabombo eMhlanganweni weBaholi baHulumende weMave eCommonwealth (i-CHOGM 2018) ngaphansi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Kulikusasa leLifananako” kusuka mhla ti-19 kuya kumhla tinge-20 Mabasa 2018.

src: Ha a teka Aforika Borwa e le se seng sebaka sa botsetedi se hlahelletseng ka mahetla mebarakeng e thuthuang, Moporesidente Ramaphosa o boetse a teka puo Kopanong ya Baetapele ba Aforika ba Foramo ya Kgwebo ya Mokgatlo wa Dinaha tsa Selekane, a ba a dula majwana le batsetedi ba baholo ba matjhaba hammoho le baetapele ba kgwebo.
tgt: Ekuveteni iNingizimu Afrika njengalelinye lemave emhlaba lasakhansa lelitsandvwa batjalimali, Mengameli Ramaphosa uphindze futsi wakhuluma neBaholi base-Afrika Engcogcweni Lehlelekile yeNkhundla yeTebhizinisi yeMave eCommonwealth, waphindze futsi wakhulumisana nebatjalimali nebaholi bemave emhlaba.

src: O boetse a fetisa memo ho batsetedi ba itlhommeng pele esita le baetapele ba kgwebo hore ba be teng Kopanong ya Botsetedi e hlophiseditsweng hore e tshwarwe hamorao selemong sena.
tgt: Uphindze futsi wamema batjalimali labahamba embili kanye nebaholi bemabhizinisi kutsi bete bahlanganyele kuNgcungcutsela yeLutjalomali lelindzelwe ngalabovu eNingizimu Afrika lehlelelwe kubakhona ngasekupheleni kwalomnyaka.

src: Tlasa boetapele ba Moporesidente Ramaphosa, moifo wa Aforika Borwa o boetse wa sebedisa monyetla ona o tlisitsweng ke CHOGM hore ba tswele pele ho thaothela bonkgetheng ba Aforika Borwa ho Lekgotla la Tshireletso la Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) bakeng sa sehla sa 2019 – 2020.
tgt: Ngaphansi kwebuholi baMengameli Ramaphosa, lelitsimba laseNingizimu Afrika liphindze futsi lasebentisa lelitfuba lelivetwe ngule-CHOGM lachubeka nekukhankhasela kutsi iNingizimu Afrika ibe ngulelinye lemave latawukhetswa libe lilunga leMkandlu Wetekuphepha waMhlabuhlangene (we-UN) ngethemu yanga-2019 – 2020.

src: Dikgetho tsena di hlophiseditswe ho tshwarwa ka la 8 Phuptjane 2018 ho la New York, Amerika (USA).
tgt: Lolukhetfo luhlelelwe kubanjwa mhla ti-8 Inhlaba 2018 eNew York, e-USLutjalomali.

src: Kabinete e amohela thonyo ya Mopresidente Ramaphosa ya maqosa a kgethehileng mabapi le botsetedi hore a dule majwana le batsetedi ba lapeng esita le ba dinaheng tsa bolata ka menyetla ya moruo e Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyakwemukela kutsi Mengameli Ramaphosa ukhetse titfunywa letine letikhetsekile kutelutjalomali kutsi tikhulumisane nebatjalimali bakuleli nebemave emhlaba mayelana nematfuba etemnotfo eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Maqosa ana a laetswe hore a hohele botsetedi ka tsela e tsepameng ebile e le e ditjeo di tlase.
tgt: Letitfunywa tinikwe umsebenti wekutsi tihehe lutjalomali ngendlela legcilile nalengabiti kakhulu.

src: Tjantjello ena ya botsetedi e tla fihla sehlohlolong ka ho tshwarwa ha seboka se seholo sa botsetedi ho ella mafelong a selemo, ho bokella tjhelete e kahodimo ho R1 trillion botseteding bo botjha ka dilemo tse hlano.
tgt: Lomshukumo welutjalomali utawuba nemphumela wekutsi kube nenkhomfa yelutjalomali lenkhulu ngasekupheleni kwalomnyaka yekutsi kwakhiwe tigidzigidzi tetigidzigidzi leti-R1 kulolutjalomali lolusha kuleminyaka lesihlanu.

src: Kgakolo ya Setsi sa Gauteng sa Ntho Tsohle tsa Botsetedi ba Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Kwetfulwa kwe-InvestSA One-Stop Shop eGateng.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa ka matla batsetedi ba lapeng le ba matjhaba hore ba sebedise ditsi tsa botsetedi tsa Ntho Tsohle tsa Diporofense, tse ntseng di kgakolwa ho potoloha le naha – moo sa morarorao e leng Setsi sa Ntho Tsohle sa Gauteng.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikhutsata ngemandla batjalimali bakuleli nebemave emhlaba kutsi basebentise tikhungo te-One-Stop Shop tetifundza letetfulwa kulo lonkhe lelive – sakamuva yi-One-Stop Shop yaseGauteng.

src: Setsi sa Ntho Tsohle tsa Botsetedi sa Aforika Borwa ke lenaneo la moporesidente la ho bapatsa le ho nolofatsa botsetedi Aforika Borwa.
tgt: I-InvestSA One-Stop Shop luhlelo lwelihhovisi laMengameli lwekukhutsata nekuchuba lutjalomali eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Hajwale, Setsi sa Ntho Tsohle tsa Botsetedi sa Aforika Borwa se se se kentswe tshebetsong ka katleho KwaZulu-Natal le Kapa Bophirima.
tgt: I-InvestSA One-Stop Shop seyivele ifezekiswe ngemphumelelo KwaZulu-Natal naseNshonalanga Kapa.

src: Ditsi tsa Ntho Tsohle tsa Botsetedi di ntse di fanwa diporofenseng tsohle, mme di tla sebedisetswa ho hlophisa le ho momahanya mabatowa a kgethehileng a moruo, ditheo tsa botsetedi ba diporofense, makgotla a lehae le mafapha a tshwanelehileng a mmuso a amehang ho tsa taolo, ngodiso, mangolo a tumello le ditaba tsa dilaesense.
tgt: Tikhungo telutjalomali te-One-Stop Shop tiyetfulwa kuto tonhe tifundza, futsi titawusetjentiselwa kuchumanisa nekuhlanganisa tindzawo letiketsekile tetemnotfo, ema-ejensi elutjalo esifundza, tiphatsimandla tendzawo kanye nematiko ahulumende lafanele lambandzakanyeka etindzabeni tekulawula, tekubhalisa, tetimvume kanye netemalayisensi.

src: Dikarete tse ntjha tsa Posong tsa-SASSA tsa Banka ya Posong.
tgt: Emakhadi lamasha e-SASSA newe-Postbank.

src: Kabinete e amohela katleho ya ho bula madiboho ya phano ya dikarete tse ntjha tsa Lekgotla la Tshireletso ya Setjhaba la Aforika Borwa (SASSA) diposong tse kgethilweng Kapa Bophirima, ho dumella majalefa a ditjhelete tsa dithuso tsa setjhaba ho fapanya dikarete tsa bona tsa hajwale hore ba fumane tse ntjha tsa Posong ya Aforika Borwa (SAPO)-SASSA tsa Banka ya Posong.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyakwemukela kufezekiswa ngemphumelelo kweluhlelo lwekulinga emakhadi lamasha e-Ejensi Yekucinisekiswa Kwetenhlalakahle (e-SASSA) emaposini lakhetsiwe eNshonalanga Kapa kuvumela bazuzi besibonelo sahulumende kutsi bakwati kuntjintja emakhadi abo labanawo kwamanje batfole lankha lamasha emakhadi e-SASSA, ase-Postbank nasePosini yaseNingizimu Afrika ((i-SAPO)-SASSA Postbank).

src: Baamohedi ba ditjhelete tsa dithuso tsa setjhaba le beng ba dikarete ba ntse ba kgona ho sebedisa dikarete tsa bona tsa hajwale ho fihlela ka Tshitwe 2018, empa Kabinete e kgothalletsa majalefa ho ya fapanya dikarete tsa bona tsa kgale ka ho etela SASSA kapa SAPO tsa bona tse haufi ho tloha ka la 2 Motsheanong ho fihlela mafelong a Lwetse Thuto e Phahameng.
tgt: Bazuzi besibonelelo sahulumende nebaphatsi bemakhadi basakhona kusebentisa emakhadi abo kute kufike Ingongoni 2018, kepha Ikhabhinethi ikhutsata bazuzi kutsi bantjintje emakhadi abo lamadzala ngekutsi bavakashele i-SASSA noma i-SAPO kusukela mhla ti-2 Inkhwekweti kute kube yiNyoni Imfundvo Lephakeme.

src: Kabinete e amohela kgatelopele e etswang ho kenngweng tshebetsong ha thuto ya mahala jwalokaha ho tobokeditswe ke Letona la Thuto e Phahameng le Thupelo.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyayemukela inchubekelembili leseyentiwe ekufezekiseni imfundvo yamahhala njengobe yandlalwe kabanti yiNdvuna yeTemfundvo Lephakeme Nekucecesha.

src: Phatlalatso ya keketso ya bohlokwa kabong ya motheo ya tjhelete ya NSFAS ho tloha ho R9,849 bilione ka 2017/18 ho ya ho R35,321 bilione ka 2020/21, e bontsha boikitlaetso ba Mmuso ho thuseng baithuti ba tswang malapeng a kojwana di mahetleng esita le a mokgahlelo wa basebetsi.
tgt: Kumenyetelwa kwekukhula lokukhulu kwemali leyabelwe i-NSFAS yasuka kutigidzigidzi leti-R9,849 nga-2017/18 kuya kutigidzigidzi letinge-R35,321 nga-2020/21 kukhombisa kutinikela kwaHulumende ekusiteni titjudeni letibuya emakhaya laphuyile nemindeni lehola imiholo lemincane.

src: Lenaneo la Tshehetso la Dikgwebo tse nyenyane, tse mahareng le tse nyanenyane (SMME).
tgt: Luhlelo Lwekusekela ema-SMMIkhabhinethi iyakwemukela kwetfulwa kweluhlelo Lwekutfutfukisa Tekucashwa ngekusebentisa Luhlelo Lwekwesekela lwetemabhizinisi lamancane, lasemkhatsini nalamancane kakhulu (ema-SMME), lokulubanjiswano emkhatsini weLitiko Letekutfutfukiswa Kwemabhizinisi Lamancane (le-DSBD) neNhlangano yaseYurophu (i-EU).

src: Kabinete e amohela kgakolo ya Phahamiso ya Khiro ka Lenaneo la Tshehetso ya diSMME, leo e leng selekane dipakeng tsa Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane (DSBD) le Kopano ya Dinaha tsa Yuropa (EU).
tgt: Itawesekela ema-SMME ngetinsita tekutfutfukisa emabhizinisi, kuwasita ngekutfola tindzawo nebantfu labangatsengisela mikhicitfo yabo, yenta kancono kufinyelela kwawo timali, kanye nekusita kunciphisa umtfwalo wekwemukela nekulawula wemabhizinisi lamancane.

src: Saense le Thekenoloji.
tgt: Tesayensi neTheknoloji.

src: Kabinete e rorisa bohle ba kentseng letsoho botenng ba ZACUBE-2, e leng sathalaete ya tjhubu e kgolokgolo ebile e le e hatetseng pele ka ho fetisisa Aforika.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi income bonkhe labo labambandzakanyekako ekuzuzeni i-ZACUBE-2, leyisathelayithi lehamba embili.
