tgt: Ngetulu kwaloko, Ikhabhinethi ikugcekile kuhlasela nekuntjontjela titolo ngetikhatsi tetibhelu njengendlela yekulwa nekutsengiswa kwekudla lokusolekako.

src: Kabinete e etsa boipiletso bo matla ho beng ba dikarete tsa kgale hore ba ilo di tjhentjha.
tgt: Letento tebugebengu angeke tibeketelwe futsi ema-ejensi lacinisekisa kugcinwa kweMtsetfo angeke angabate kubopha nekushushisa labo bantfu labatawutfolakala babhebhetsela noma benta letento tebugebengu.

src: SAPO e tla boela e nka mosebetsi wa tefo ya tjhelete ho baamohedi bao ba sa kgonang ho hula tjhelete metjhineng ya di-ATM kapa mabenkeleng.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi icela emalunga emmango lati lapho kunekudla lokusolekako kutsi ashayele lucingo loluphutfumako lwe-DoH ku: 011 386 2003/6 kanye ne-NCC ku: 012 428 Kukhokhwa kwetibonelelo tahulumende.

src: Bakeng sa ho tseba haholwanyane, baamohedi ba dithuso tsa ditjhelete tsa mmuso ba ka letsetsa mohala wa mahala wa SASSA ho 0800 60 10 11 dihoreng tsa mosebetsi.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyayemukela inchubekelembili leyentiwe yiNdvuna yeTekutfutfukiswa Kwetenhlalakahle Susan Shabangu, kulubanjiswano lolusemkhatsini we-Ejensi yaseNingizimu Afrika yeKucinisekisa Tenhlalakahle (i-SASSA) kanye neTeliposi taseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPO) kutsi itsatse ematomu kuCash Paymaster Services ichubeke nekukhokhwa kwetibonelelo tahulumende kusukela mhla lu-1 Imphala 2018.

src: Kabinete e lakaletsa bapalami ba ileng ba lemala ha diterene tse pedi tsa Metrorail di ne di tjhaisana Eloff Extension Selby, ka borwa ba Johannesburg, hore ba fole kapele ebile e etsa kgoeletso ya hore phuphutso ya sesosa sa kotsi e potlakiswe e le ho thibela phetapheto ya ketsahalo ya mofuta oo.
tgt: Kute kube ngumanje i-SASSA seyisuse emakhadi lamadzala e-SASSA yafaka lamasha laligolide lalinganiselwa kutigidzi letisihlanu kepha kusadzinga kutsi kuntjinjwe lamanyenti latinkhulungwane.

src: Dipalopalo tsa ditlolo tsa molao tsa selemo le selemo di thusa mmuso ho disa dibaka tsa bohlokwa, haholoholo phokotso ya ditlolo tsa molao tse mpempe tse tlalehilweng, jwalo ka ha ho tekilwe Moralong wa Lewa la Nako e Bohareng wa 2014-2019.
tgt: I-SAPO itawuphindze futsi ikhokhele labo bazuzi labangakakhoni kukhipha imali yabo kuma-ATMayelana nekutfola lwatiso lolubanti, bazuzi besibonelelo sahulumende bangashayela i-SASSA kulenombolo yamahhala ku:0800 60 10 11 ngetikhatsi tekusebenta.

src: Dipalopalo tsa ditlolo tsa molao di ka boela tsa sebediswa e le matshwao a kgalemo ho sa kganya, hore ho matlafatswe ditshebetso tsa thibelo ya ditlolo tsa molao le mawa a mafapha a fapaneng a mmuso.
tgt: Ingoti yesitimela Ikhabhinethi ifisela bagibeli besitimela labalimele ekungcubutaneni kwetitimela letimbili takaMetrorail e-Eloff Extension eSelby, ngaseningizimu yeJozi, kwelulama lokusheshako iphindze futsi icela kutsi kuphutfunyiswe luphenye lwembangela yalengoti kuvikela kwenteka kwalenye futsi.

src: Kabinete e ile ya hlajwa malotsana ka kgatelopele e entsweng bolaoding ba kgalemo ya basebetsi ba tshebeletso ya setjhaba, ba etsang kgwebo le ditheo tsa mmuso.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ivumile kutsi Luphiko Lwetemisebenti yeMaphoyisa (i-SAPS) lukhiphe Tibalobalo teBugebengu taVelonkhe tanga-2017/18.

src: Ho kgothaletsa diketso tsa toka le bosiyo ba leeme ho bahlanka ba baholo ba mmuso, ke karolo ya bohlokwa ya ho aha mmuso o bonaletsang o bile o na le boikarabello, jwalo ka ha ho lohothilwe ho Molaotheo wa Riphaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa 1996 esita le kaho ya mmuso o nang le bokgoni jwalo ka ha ho radilwe ho Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP): Tjhebelopeleng ya 2030.
tgt: Letibalobalo tebugebengu temnyaka tenta hulumende akwati kulandzelela imigomo lebalulekile, ikakhulu kuncishiswa kwebugebengu lobumatima lobubikiwe, njengobe kubekiwe kuLuhlakamsebenti lweLisukuhlela lweThemu Lesemkhatsini lwanga-2014-2019.

src: Kgatelopele e se e entswe mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Molawana wa 13 wa Melawana ya Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba (PSR) wa 2016, o hanelang basebetsi ba tshebeletso ya setjhaba ho etsa kgwebo le ditheo tsa mmuso, esita le Molawana wa 18 wa PSR wa 2018, o hlokang hore ditho tsa Tshebeletso ya Bolaodi bo Boholo (SMS) di pepese ditabatabelo tsa tsona tsa boikunuto ba tsa ditjhelete le tse ding.
tgt: Letibalobalo tebugebengu tingaphindze futsi tisetjentiswe njengetinkhomba tekucaphelisa kusesenesikhatsi kucinisa imisebenti yetekuvikela bugebengu netinhlelolisu tematiko ahulumende lahlukene.

src: Kabinete e boetse ya ananela hore Lekgotla la Phethahatso le nang le matla le tshwanelehileng la mafapha a mmuso, le lokela ho disa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Molawana wa 13 wa PSR wa 2016, le nke dikgato tsa kgalemo tse tshwanelehileng le be le kenye tlaleho ya tsona ho Letona la Lefapha la Tshebeletso le Tsamaiso ya Setjhaba (DPSA) mafelong a selemo se seng le se seng sa ditjhelete.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi yatisiwe ngengenchubekelembili leseyentiwe ekulawuleni kujeziswa kwetisebenti tahulumende letenta ibhizinisi nemitimba yahulumende.

src: Ka 2016 le 2017, DPSA e hlwaile basebetsi ba tshebeletso ya setjhaba ba ngodisitsweng e le bafani ba ditshebeletso ho Dathabeisi e Bohareng ya Bafani ba Ditshebeletso (CSD), jwalo ka ha e neelanwe ke Lefapha la Matlotlo a Setjhaba.
tgt: Kukhutsata tento tekulawula letilungile naletingito tetikhulu letikhulu tahulumende eluhlangotsini lolubalulekile lwekwakha hulumende longafihli lutfo nalotilandzako, njengobe kulindzelwe kuMtsetfosisekelo weRiphabhuliki yaseNingizimu Afrika wanga-1996 kanye nekwakhiwa kwembuso lonelikhono njengobe kubonelwe embili kuLisu Lekutfutfukisa Lavelonkhe (i-NDP): Umbononchanti-2030.

src: Mafapha a ile a koptjwa ho etsa tlhokomediso, ho netefatsa lesedi le ho tlaleha kgatelopele ka ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha dikgato tse nkilweng kgahlanong le bao ba molato.
tgt: Sekwentiwe inchubekelembili mayelana nekufezekiswa kweMtsetfomgomo 13 weMtsetfosimiso weTemisebenti yaHulumende (i-PSR) wanga-2016, lowalela tisebenti tahulumende kutsi tente ibhizinisi nemtimba wahulumende, kanye neMtsetfomgomo-18 we-PSR wanga-2016, lofuna Baphatsi laBakhulu (e-SMS) kutsi badzalule timali tabo kanye nalokunye lokubangenisela imali.

src: Mafelong a Mmesa 2018, 96% ya ditho tsohle tsa SMS di kentse dipepeso tsa tsona, di sebedisa Mokgwatsamaiso wa eDisclosure.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ivumile kutsi Siphatsimandla Lesikhulu seSigungu lesifanele sematiko ahulumende silandzelele kufezekiswa kweMtsetfosimiso 13 we-PSR wanga-2016, sitsatse tinyatselo letifanele tekujeziza siphindze futsi setfule umbiko kuNdvuna Yetemisebenti Yahulumende Nekuphatsa (i-MPSA) ekupheleni kwemnyakatimali ngamunye.

src: Kabinete e ile ya hlajwa malotsana ka kgatelopele e seng e entswe Mmotlolong wa Phano ya Ditjhelete Sekolong sa Naha sa Thupello ya Bahlanka ba Mmuso (NSG).
tgt: Umbiko wekucala ufanele kutsi wetfulwe ku-MPSA kungakendluli mhla tinge-31 Indlovana 2019.

src: Kabinete e ananetse sebopeho sa mananeo a tlamang a thupello, a tla kgakolwa ke NSG hore a thakgole bokenadipakeng bo potlakileng ba ntshetsopele ya bokgoni esita le ho etsa tshebeletso ya setjhaba hore e be le boporofeshenale.
tgt: Nga-2016 nanga-2017, Litiko Letemisebenti Yahulumende Nekuphatsa likhombe tisebenti tahulumende letibhaliswe njengebatfulitinsita kuSikhungo seLuhlu seBatfulitinsita leSiyinkhaba (i-CSD), lolwetfulwe Temafa Avelonkhe.

src: Tefo e otlolohileng bakeng sa mananeo a tlamang ho NSG e etswang ke mafapha a tshwanelehileng ho tswa ditjheleteng tsa ona tsa thupello, le yona e ile ya ananelwa.
tgt: Ematiko acelwa kutsi acaphelise bantfu, acinisekise lwatiso kanye nekubika inchubekelembili yekufezekisa tinyatselo letitsetfwe tekubukana nalabenta lokuphambene nemtsetfo.

src: Sena se tla lebisa tsamaisong ya setjhaba e hatelang pele, e hahamallelang pele ho fihlelleng Tjhebelopele ya 2030 ya NDP ka “ho aha naha e nang le bokgoni e hatelang pele, eo haeba e sebetsa mmoho le boahi bo mahlahahlaha, e tla etella pele tjantjello e matla kgahlanong le bofuma, leqeme la mesebetsi le ho se lekane setjhabeng.”4.
tgt: Ekupheleni kwaMabasa 2018, emalunga e-SMS lange-96% angenisa kudzalula kwawo asebentisa inchubo yekudzalula, i-eDisclosure System.

src: Kabinete e ananetse phatlalatso ya Tokomane ya Tataiso ho Saense, Theknoloji le Tshibollo ya 2018, bakeng sa hore setjhaba se tshwaele.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi yatiswa ngenchubekelembili leyentiwe kuModeli yekweSekela ngeTimali yeSikolwa saVelonkhe saHulumende (i-NSG).

src: Letona la Saense le Theknoloji, Mofumahadi Mmamoloko Kubayi-Ngubane, o tla fana ka tlaleho e phethahetseng ha mmela o ntse o puta.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ivume tinhlelo tekucecesha letitokwenta kancono letigunyatiwe naletiphocelelekile kutsi tilingwe kusetjentiswa yi-NSG kutsi ichube tingenelelo tekutfutfukisa emakhono ngalokunemandla iphindze futsi yente umsebenti wahulumende webungcweti.

src: Kabinete e boetse ya ananela phatlalatso ya Lewa la Katoloso la Dibaka tsa Naha tse Tshireleditsweng (NPAES) bakeng sa hore setjhaba se tshwaele.
tgt: Kuphindze futsi kwavunywa kukhokhelwa ngco ku-NSG kwetinhlelo letiphocelelekile ngematiko lafanele lacashako kubhajethi yawo yekucecesha.

src: NPAES ke morero wa lewa la dilemo tse 20 o itshetlehileng ka NDP, o tsepamisitseng maikutlo katolosong ya setsha sa dibaka tse tshireleditsweng, ka tjhadimo e tsepameng kgolong ya moruo, phetoho le botsitso ba nako e telele.
tgt: Loku kutawuholela kululawulo lwahulumende lolutfutfukisako naloluchubekela embili ekuzuzeni Umbononchanti-2030 we-NDP ngekutsi “kwakhe umbuso lonemandla nalotfutfukisako, lusebenta kanye netakhamuti letisebenta ngekutikhandla, kuchuba umshukumo longapheli mandla wekulwa nebuphuya, kungasebenti kanye nekungalingani ngekwetenhlalo.”4.

src: NPAES e talola kamoo ho ka bang le kgaello ka teng ya hore ho ajwe ka bokgabane basebetsi le mehlodi ya ditjhelete, ho fihlella katoloso ya dibaka tse tshireleditsweng ka ditjeo tse fihlellehang, boitjaro ba nako e telele ba ikholoji le ho ikamahanya le phetoho ya tlelaemete.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kweMtsetfo Lodzingidvwako weTesayensi, Itheknoloji kanye neKwakha Lokusha wanga-2017 kute kutsi ummango uphawule ngawo.

src: Marangrang a Aforika Borwa a dibaka tse tshireleditsweng a akga ditsha tsa lefa la lefatshe, dirapa tsa naha, dirapa tsa paballo, dirapa tsa paballo tse kgethehileng, ditikoloho tse tshireleditsweng, dibaka tsa mawatleng tse tshireleditsweng, dikgakeletsi tsa metsi dithabeng, dibaka tse kgethehileng tsa meru e tshireleditsweng, le dirapa tsa paballo ya meru.
tgt: Indvuna yeTesayensi Netheknoloji, Mk Mmamoloko Kubayi-Ngubane, utawetfula inkhulumo lephelele ngesikhatsi lesifanele.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Maemo a Ditherisano a Aforika Borwa bakeng sa Kopano ya bo13 ya Seboka sa ho Notla Mekga e yang Mmokeng wa Ramsar o mabapi le Diqanthana tse Diphuleng (Ramsar COP 12) e tla tshwarelwa Dubai, United Arab Emirates, ho tloha ka la 21 ho isa ho la 29 Mphalane 2018.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iphindze yavuma kushicilelwa kweLisikuhlela Lekukhuliswa kweTindzawo Letivikelekile taVelonkhe (i-NPAES) kute kutsi ummango uphawule ngalo.

src: Dipheo tse batsi tsa Mmoka wa Ramsar ke ho netefatsa boteng ba paballo le tshebediso e tjhatsi ya diqanthana tsohle tse diphuleng.
tgt: I-NPAES lisukuhlela lweminyaka lenge-20 lelihambisana ne-NDP, lolugcile ekukhuliseni tindzawo letivikelekile, ngekugcila kumnotfo, kutingucuko nekusimama.

src: Di thusa taolong ya mehlodi ya metsi e le karolo ya mokgwa wa boitlhahanelo taolong ya komello.
tgt: I-NPAES igcamisa kutsi imitfombolusito leyindlala lebantfu nemali ingabiwa kanjani ngalokwenele nangalokuyimphumelelo kute kuzuzwe kukhuliswa kwetindzawo letivikelekile ngalokungabiti kakhulu, kusimama kwetindzawo tekuhlalisana kwetilwane netitjalo kanye naletimelana nekugucuka kwesimo selitulu.

src: Kabinete e ananetse phatlalatso ya Bili ya Sehlomathiso sa Ditlhapiso tsa Dikotsi le Mafu tse Bakwang ke Maemo a Mosebetsing.
tgt: Tindzawo taseNingizimu Afrika letivikelekile tifaka ekhatsi tindzawo temafa nemagugu, emapaki avelonkhe, tichiwi tetilwane tasendle netitjalo, tichiwi letikhetsekile tetilwane tasendle netitjalo, tindzawo temvelo letivikele, imitfombo yemanti lesetintsabeni lekutfolwa kuyo emanti, ikakhulu emahlatsi lavikelekile, kanye nemahlatsi latichiwi temvelo.

src: Bili ena, e hlomathisang Molao wa Ditlhapiso tsa Dikotsi le Mafu tse Bakwang ke Maemo a Mosebetsing, 1993 (Molao wa 130 wa 1993) e ananela basebetsi ba malapeng, ba neng ba ntse ba teetswe kathoko Molaong, e le basebetsi ka sepheo sa hore ba fole melemo, esita le ho ntlafatsa melemo e seng e le teng.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi itivumile Tinhlangotsi teNingizimu Afrika teKucela neKubonisana teMhlangano we-13 weKhomfa yeMave Langena kuSivumelwane seRamsar seMachaphothi (iRamsar COP 13) lotawubanjelwa eDubai, e-United Arab Emirates, kusukela mhla tinge-21 kuya kumhla tinge-29 Imphala 2018.

src: Dihlomathiso tsena di ntlafatsa melemo e lefshwang ho basebetsi le beng ka bona, di bile di habile ho thusa basebetsi ba lemetseng le ba kulang hore ba hlabollwe ba be ba busetswe mesebetsing le setjhabeng.
tgt: Imigomo lemikhulu yeSivumelwane seRamsar kucinisekisa lesivumelwane kanye nekusetjentiswa ngenhlakanipho kwawo onkhe emachaphothi.

src: Bili ena e boela e hakolla taba ya bokgoni ba botlodi ba molao ho ya tshwepholo, ka ho tlosa tlhoko ena ya ho bontsha bokgoni ba botlodi ba molao molemong wa tshwepholo le dipatlisiso tse etswang pele.
tgt: Loku kufaka sandla ekuphatfweni kwemitfombo yemanti njengencenye yendlela yekubukana nekulawulwa kwesomiso.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho kenngwa ha Bili ya 2018 ya Sehlomathiso sa Bofofisi ba Difofane Palamenteng.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibela Kuncemphetelwa Mayelana neKulimala neKutfola Tifo Emsebentini wanga-2017 kute kutsi ummango uphawule ngawo.

src: Bili ena, e hlomathisang Molao wa Bofofisi ba Difofane, 2009 (Molao wa 13 wa 2009), e tla matlafatsa meralo ya tshireletso le taolo ya polokeho difofaneng, ho netefatsa boitjaro ba nako e telele esita le botsitso ba indasteri ya bofofisi ba difofane.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo, lochibela Umtsetfo weKuncephetelwa Mayelana neKulimala neKutfola Tifo Emsebentini, wanga-1993 (Umtsetfo-130 wanga-1993) ubonelela tisebenti tasemakhishini (emakhaya), lebetingakafakwa kuLomtsetfo, njengetisebenti ngenhloso yekuzuza, kanye nekwenta kancono letinzuzo letikhona kwamanje.

src: Sena se tla netefatsa hore Aforika Borwa e tswelapele ho fihlella boitlamo ba yona ba matjhaba lepatlelong la bofofisi ba difofane, e leng ntho e matlafatsang tshehetso ntshetsopeleng ya moruo wa rona e le sehotetso sa keketseho ya kgwebisano, bohahlaudi le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi.
tgt: Letichibelo tenta kancono tinzuzo letikhokhelwa tisebenti kanye nabomondliwa bato, futsi tihlose kusita tisebenti letilimele naletigulako kutsi tibuyiselwe esimeni lesifanele tiphindze futsi tibuyiselwe emsebentini nasemmangweni.

src: Bili ena e boela e fana, ho tse ding, ka boikemelo ba tshebetso ba kotsi ya sefofane le patlisiso ya ketsahalo eo, esita le ho lokisa diphapano le mafokodi.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kwetfulwa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo wekuChibela Bulungiswa beBanttfwana wanga-20.1 LoMtsetfosivivinyo uchibela Umtsetfo weBulungiswa beBantfwana, wanga-2008 (Umtsetfo-75 wanga-2008) kute kutsi kubuyeketwe umnyaka webudzala welizinga leliphasi wekukhona kwemntfwana kwenta bugebengu ngekulikhulisa lisuke eminyakeni le-10 liye eminyakeni le-12 budzala.

src: Kahare ho moeleo wa Kgwedi ya Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba, Beke ya Thusong Service Centre ya selemo le selemo ho tloha ka la 17 ho isa ho la 21 Loetse 2018 katlasa mokotaba o reng: “Thuma Mina: Ho isa Ditshebeletso tsa Setjhaba Bathong”, e fana ka lepatlelo le leng la hore mmuso o ise ditshebeletso tsa setjhaba bathong.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uphindze futsi wehlukanise ludzaba lwekuba nemandla ekwenta bugebengu eludzabeni lwekutsi bantfwana bajeziswe ngaletinye tindlela letenta kutsi bangabi nemacala nemarekhodi ebugebengu, ngekususa sidzingo sekutsi kube nebufakazi bekuba nemandla ekwenta bugebengu ngenhloso yekujeziswa ngaletinye tindlela letenta kutsi bangabi nemacala nemarekhodi ebugebengu kanye neluphenyo (imibuto) lwekucala.

src: Di-Thusong Service Centre ke ditsi tseo ho tsona ho fumanehang dintho tsohle bakeng sa phihlello ya ditshebeletso tsa mmuso le lesedi, mme di-Thusong Service Centre kaofela tse 133 naha ka bophara ke ditsi tsa tshepo, phihlello, tokiso ya menyetla, tekano le matlafatso ho bao ba neng ba kotetswe kgubung ya ntshetsopele ya moruo wa setjhaba.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kwetfulwa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo wekuChibela Tekundiza wanga-2018.

src: Mmuso o sebeletsa ho hokela Mokgwatsamaiso wa Taolo ya Mekoloko, o tla fokotsa mosebetsi wa lephallo e le ho thusetsa phokotsong ya nako ya ho leta.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo, lochibela Umtsetfo weTekundiza, wanga-2009 (Umtsetfo-13 wanga-2009), utawucinisa tekuphepha tekundiza, kuvikeleka kanye neluhlakamsebenti lwekulawula tekuphepha tesimondzawo kucinisekisa kutinta kanye nekutinta kwemboni yetekundiza.

src: Mokgwatsamaiso ona o tla hokelwa ditsing tsohle naha ka bophara, ka tsepamiso ya maikutlo e boelang e le kgokelong ya theknoloji ya lesedi la dikgokahano (ICT), e leng yona e thusang phanong ya ditshebeletso.
tgt: Loku kutawucinisekisa kutsi iNingizimu Afrika iyahlangabetana netibopho temave emhlaba emkhakheni wetekundiza, lokucinisa kwesekela kutfutfuka kwemnotfo njengenjini yekukhulisa tekuhwebelana, tekuvakasha kwakhiwa kwemisebenti.

src: Ketsahalo ena, e tlang Aforika lekgetlo la pele, e fana ka monyetla wa seabo se eketsehileng sa dinaha tsa Aforika, ho habilwe ho matlafatsa ICT Aforika jwalo ka ha e le moetapele wa ntshetsopele le tshibollo.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uphindze futsi wenta kutsi, emkhatsini waletinye tintfo, kube nekusebenta ngekutimela kwetehlakalo tetindiza kanye nekuphenywa kwetehlakalo, kanye nekulungisa kungafanani kanye netinkinga.

src: Seboka sa selemo le selemo se hohela baromuwa ba kahodimo ho 9 000 ho tswa lefatsheng lohle, ka baetapele ba mmuso le ba diindasteri ba phopholetsang ba bile ba hlwaya menyetla le ditlwaelo tse ntle, haholo tsa ntshetsopele ya moruo wa setjhaba ka ICDintho tsa bohlokwa tse tla tshohlwa di akga: 5G bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya theknoloji ya dijithale, tshebedisanommoho tshireletsong ya inthanete, ditshebeletso tsa ditjhelete tsa dijithale esita le disatalaete bakeng sa ntshetsopele e theknoloji ya dijithale.
tgt: Kungcikitsi yeNyanga yeMisebenti yaHulumende, Liviki lemnyaka lema-Thusong Service Centre kusukela mhla ti-17 kuya kumhla tinge-21 Inyoni 2018 ngaphansi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Thuma Mina: Kuyisa Imisebenti yaHulumende kuBantfu", kuniketa lenye inkhundla yekutsi hulumende ayise tinsita tahulumende kubantfu.

src: ITU ya 2018 ya Seboka sa Lefatshe sa Telecom e tshwarwa ka nako eo Aforika Borwa e kenyang tshebetsong diprojeke tsa bohlokwa tsa naha tse akgang Lewa la Naha la e-Government le tsepamisitseng maikutlo phetohong ya dijithale ya ditshebeletso tsa mmuso le ICT ya naha, Lewa la Tshebetso la Dikgwebo tse Nyane, tse Mahareng le tse Nyenyane (SMME), le tsetselelang ho utolla bokgoni ba lekala la Aforika Borwa la di-SMME tsa ICDisebediswa tsena di thea tikoloho e thusetsang kgolo ya lekala ebile e netefatsa boitjaro ba yona ba nako e telele.
tgt: MaThusong Service Centre atikhungo lotfola tonkhe tinsita kuto tekufinyelelwa kwetinsita nelwatiso lwahulumende, futsi ma-Thusong Service Centre la-133 lakulo lonkhe lelive atikhungo telitsemba, kufinyelela, kulungisa, kulingana nekuhlonyiswa emakhono kwalabo bebakadze babekwe eceleni bangekho kumkhakha lobanti wekutfutfukiswa kwetenhlalo netemnotfo.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona ho:lelapa le mahlonokong esita le setjhaba sohle sa Yunivesithi ya Theknoloji ya Tshwane (TUT) kamora ho hlokahala ha Katlego Monareng.
tgt: Hulumende umatasatasa ufaka Inchubo yeKulawula Ludvwendvwe letawunciphisa kuhamba kwenchubo kute kutsi kunciphe sikhatsi sekulindza.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ya hore ho theolwe moya ha sepolesa se ntse se batlisisa, ho netefatsa hore mang kapa mang ya molato ka ho shwa hoo, o tobana le letsoho la WEBTOKEN lelapa le metswalle ya batho ba robedi ba shwetseng ho phatloheng ho bileng femeng ya dibetsa ya Denel Somerset West Kapa Bophirimela.
tgt: Lenchubo itawufakwa kuto tonkhe tikhungo letikhona kulelive lakitsi kugcila kwayo kutawuba kulwatiso nekuchunywa kwetheknoloji yetekuchumana (i-ICT), lokuyintfo letawenta kwetfulwa kwetinsita kukhoneke kwenteka.

src: baratuwa ba bao ba ileng ba shwela mollong o kotsi o ropohileng moahong o abelanwang ke Mafapha a Mmuso wa Profense ya Gauteng a Bophelo bo Botle, Bodulo ba Batho le Puso ya Tshebedisanommoho.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyayemukela Ikhomfa yeMave Emhlaba ye-Telecom yanga-2018 yeNyonyane Yemave Emhlaba Yetakhiwonchanti Tetekuchumanisa (i-ITU) letawube ibanjelwe eDurban kusukela mhla tiyi-9 kuya kumhla ti-13 Inyoni 2018, ngaphansi kwengcikitsi letsi “Kucanjwa Kwalokusha kweKutfutfuka kweDijithali Lehamba Embili”.

src: Moporesidente Ramaphosa o ikamahantse le baetapele ba bang ba Aforika Harare ho ya inwesa ka nkgo.
tgt: Lomkhosi lota e-Afrika kwekucala ngca, uniketa litfuba lekuhlanganyela ngebunyenti kwemave ase-Afrika ekuciniseni te-ICT e-Afrika njengemshukumisi wentfutfuko nekucanjwa kwalokusha.

src: Kabinete e tshehetsa boikitlaetso ba Moporesidente Ramaphosa ba ho sebedisana le Zimbabwe ho ntlafatsa dikamano tsa nalane, sepolotiki le tsa boena, ka thasisetso e tsepameng matlafatsong ya tshebedisanommoho ya moruo.
tgt: Lekhomfa idvonse titfunywa letingetulu kwaleti-9 000 letivela kuwo onkhe emave emhlaba jikelele, lapho khona hulumende kanye nebaholi bemboni ye-ICT bahlolisisa futsi batfola nematfuba elutjalomali netindlelakwenta letincono tekutfutfukisa tenhlalo nemnotfo ngekusebentisa i-ICTindzaba letibalulekile lekutawukhulunywa ngato tifaka ekhatsi: Kutfutfuka kwedigithali ye-5G lehamba embili, kubambisana kutekuvikela i-inthanethi, tinsitakalo tetetimali tedijithali kanye nemasathelayithi entfutfuko yedigijithali lehamba embili.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Lekgotla la Saense le Diphuputso tsa Diindasteri (CSIR), haholoholo bafuputsi ba batshehadi, diphuputsong tsa bophelo bo botle tse etsetswang ho ntlafatsa mokgwatsamaiso wa bophelo bo botle wa naha ena.
tgt: Ikhomfa yeMave Emhlaba yeTincingo ye-ITU yanga-2018 ibanjwa ngesikhatsi lapho khona iNingizimu Afrika ifezekisa imiklamo lebalulekile lefaka ekhatsi Lisukuhlela lwaHulumende lwaVelonkhe lolugcile kutingcucuko tedijithali temisebenti yahulumende kanye neLisukuhlela lweKwesekela lwaVelonkhe lwe-ICT yavelonkhe yeteMabhizinisi Lamancane, laseMkatsini kanye nalaMancane Kakhulu (ema-SMME), lefuna kuvula emandla emkhakha weNingizimu Afrika we-ICT yema-SMMLamathulusi akha simondzawo lesitawuvumela kukhula kwalomkhakha kanye nekucinisekisa kusimama kwawo.

src: Tsena di akga:
tgt: Imibiko.

src: tjhipi e fofonelang lefu la tswekere e le ho disa bophahamo ba tswekere mading, ka ho sekaseka moya o tswang ka hanong (ii) ho etsuwa ha dibaktheriya tsa mmele hore di sebediswe tlhahisong ya ditsuonyana, tlhapi ya dusky-cob le ya abalone, di tla thusa tlhahisong ya dihlahiswa tsa tlholeho tsa diphoofolo, tse se nang antibayothiki, dikhemikhale le dithethefatsi tse hodisang ka potlako (iii) esita le ho tswelapele ho utolla diphuputso tsa disele.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi yendlulisela emavi ayo endvudvuto lajulile:kumndeni lolilako kanye neNyuvesi yeTheknoloji yaseTshwane (i-TUT) ngekwendlula emhlabeni kwaKatlego Monareng.

src: Kabinete e boela e thoholetsa Ngaka Evodia Setati, mofuputsi e moholo Lefapheng la Dithuto tsa Tlhahiso ya Morara le tsa Tlhahiso ya Veini la Yunivesithi ya Stellenbosch, ya hapileng Kgau ya Borasaense ba Basadi ba Ipabotseng moketjaneng wa selemo le selemo wa Dikgau tsa Basadi ba maAforika Borwa ho tsa Saense, o neng o tshwaretswe Polokwane ka la 23 Phato 2018.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi icela kutsi kwehliswe imimoya kube nekutinta lapho emaphoyisa asachubeka neluphenyo lwawo kucinisekisa kutsi loyo lobangele kushona kwakhe ngembi kwesikhatsi ubukana nesandla semtsetfo.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Caster Semenya ka makgabane a hae ha a ne a hapa makgaolakgang a hae a boraro a Liki ya Taemane lebelong la dimithara tse 800 Switzerland.
tgt: kumndeni nebangani bebantfu labasiphohlongo labashone ekuchumeni lokwenteke eDenel efekthri lekhicita tinhlavu tetibhamu eSomerset West eNshonalanga Kapa.

src: DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di lokela ho netefatswa ka mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang.
tgt: kumindeni yalabo labashone engotini yemlilo wekusha kwelibhilidi lelisetjentiswa ngekwabelana ngulaMatiko aHulumende weSifundza waseGauteng: Letemphilo, Lekuhlaliswa Kwebantfu neLetekubusa Ngekubambisana.

src: Kabinete e ile ya kopanela Union Buildings Pretoria, ka Laboraro, mohla la 19 Loetse 2018.Dintlha tsa Ha jwale.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi yahlangana ngaLesitsatfu, mhla ti-19 Inyoni 2018, e-Union Buildings, ePitoli.

src: Moruo.
tgt: TindzabaTalelive.

src: Kabinete e amohela thuso e nanabetswang ke ba kgwebo bakeng sa ho romelwa ha baporofeshenale ba lekala la poraefete mmusong.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyakubonga kutinikela lokwentiwe bosomabhizinisi ekwesekeleni kufakwa kuhulumende kwetingcweti temkhakha lotimele.

src: Sena se ropohile kopanong ya boitlhophisetso e neng e tshwerwe ke Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa le baetapele ba kgwebo, maqosa a kgethehileng a botsetedi le Mokgakolo wa Bahlanka ba Baholo ba Phethahatso (CEO), pele ho Seboka se tlang sa Mesebetsi le Botsetedi.
tgt: Loku kuvele emhlanganweni wemalungiselelo lobowubanjwe nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa akanye nebaholi betemabhizinisi, litsimba lelikhetsekile lelutjalomali kanye ne-CEO Initiative, ngembi kwekufika kweNgcungcutsela yeTemisebenti kanye neKhomfa yeTelutjalomali.

src: Kopano e dumellane ka hore tsosoloso ya moruo wa Aforika Borwa e batla ho kenngwa tshebetsong ho potlakileng ha mokgekgetho wa diqholotsi le ditlhabollo tse tshepisitsweng tse ntlafatsang kgolo.
tgt: Lomhlangano uvumile kutsi kuvuka kwemnotfo waseNingizimu Afrika kufuna kutsi kufezekiswe ngekushesha luhlelo lwetivusamnotfo waphindze futsi wetsembisa tingucuko letitawenta kancono umnotfo.

src: Ditshisinyo di ile tsa boela tsa tshohlwa mabapi le ho thea mokgakolo wa ntshetsopele ya meralo ya motheo e kenyang ditjhelete tse tswang lekaleng la poraefete esita le botsebi bo hodimo ba phano ya ditshebeletso.
tgt: Kuphindze futsi kwakhulunywa ngetihlongoto tekusungula umtamo wekwenta sakhiwonchanti letiheha kusitwa ngetimali ngumkhakha lotimele kanye netingcweti kutekwetfulwa kwetinsita.

src: Thahasello ya botsetedi.
tgt: Umshukumo welutjalomali.

src: Kabinete e boela e amohela thahasello ya botsetedi kwana Japan, e etelletsweng pele ke Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Indasteri (dti).
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iphindze futsi yemukela umshukumo welutjalomali wekuya eJapan loholwa Litiko Letekuhwebelana Netimboni.

src: Thahasello ena e habile ho hohela matsete a boleng ba US$ 100 bilione moruong wa Aforika Borwa nakong ya dilemo tse hlano tse tlang.
tgt: Lomshukumo uhlose kuhehela kumnotfo waseNingizimu Afrika lutjalomali lolungangetigidzigidzi te-US$100 kuleminyaka lesihlanu letako.2 IJapan beyiloku ingumlingani weNingizimu Afrika kutelutjalomali lobekakulaba-10 labahamba embili sikhatsi lesidze, lonetinkampani letingetulu kwaleti-140 letikhona lapha eNingizimu Afrika, letsatfwa njengendzawo leyinkhaba yemkhicito yesigodzi yase-Afrika.

src: Haesale Japan e le molekane wa ba leshome ba kahodimodimo wa batsetedi ba nako e telele Aforika Borwa, ka dikhamphane tsa yona tse kahodimo ho 140 tse sebetsang naheng ena ya rona, e bonwang e le kgubu ya lebatowa la tlhahiso ya ho kena Aforika.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikhutsata tinkampani kutsi titjale imali tiphindze futsi tikhule lapha eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Mananeo a thupello.
tgt: Tinhlelo tekucecesha.

src: Kabinete e amohela kgakolo ya projeke ya thupello ya R22-milione ke Letona la tsa Mesebetsi, Mofumahadi Mildred Oliphant, e tla thea mesebetsi makaleng a bofofisi, a kgwebo ya ho qwela metsing a lewatle esita le a temothuo.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyakwemukela kwetfulwa kwemklamo wekucecesha lobita tigidzi letinge-R22 yiNdvuna yeTetisebenti, Mk Mildred Oliphant, lotawakha imisebenti emkhakheni wetekundiza, wetekuhwebelana tekucwila untjuze ngephasi kwemanti kanye nakuwetekulima.

src: Projeke ena e sebetswa ka selekane le Setheo sa Ngaka John Langalibalele Dube esita le Letlole la Inshorense ya ba Feletsweng ke Mesebetsi (UIF), eo e leng setheo sa Lefapha la tsa Bosebetsi.
tgt: Lomklamo uchutjwa ngekubambisana sikhungo iDr.

src: Projeke ena e tla shadimana le ba kentseng letsoho ho UIF ba feletsweng ke mesebetsi.
tgt: John Langalibalele Dube Institute kanye neSikhwama seMshwalensi weKuphelelwa nguMsebenti (i-UIF), umtimba weLitiko Letetisebenti.

src: Sehlopha sa pele sa ba tla fola molemo se akga ba 50 ba kentseng letsoho ba tswang Boemafofaneng ba Virginia bo Durban ba 50 ba tswang projekeng ya kgwebo ya ho qwela metsing a lewatle e Scottsburg, KwaZulu-Natal, athe basadi ba mahaeng ba 100 ba tswang Emadungeni ba tla rupellwa hore ba thee koporasi ya ho lema le ho jala ditholwana, meroho le khothene tse holang ka mokgwa wa tlholeho, ho akga le ho lokisetswa ha thekiso ya tsona.
tgt: Lomklamo utawugcila kulabo bebakhokhela i-UIF lasebaphelelwa yimisebenti yabo.

src: Dikoporasi tsena di tekenne tumellano le Pick ‘n Pay bakeng sa ho e fepela ka meroho, hammoho le Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba bakeng sa ho fumana disebedisuwa tsa ho roka diyunifomo tsa dikolo.
tgt: Licembu lekucala lebazuzi lifaka ekhatsi labo bebakhokhela i-UIF labange-50 labavela eSikhumulweni seTindizamshini iVirginia eDurban labange-50 bavela kumklamo wetekuhwebelana tekucwila untjuze ngaphasi kwemanti eScottsburg, KwaZulu Natal, kanye nabomake laba-100 basemaphandleni e-Emadungeni batawuceceshelwa kutsi bente ikoporasi yekulima nekukhulisa titselo netibhidvo letite emakhemikhali kanye nakotini, kufaka ekhatsi inchubo yekwenta kancono umkhicito.

src: Kabinete e amohela pulo ya semmuso ya dikantoro tse ntjha tsa Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae tse Hluhluwe KwaZulu-Natal ke Moporesidente Ramaphosa.
tgt: Lamakoporasi asayine sivumelwane nePick n Pay sekuyitsengisela tibhidvo neLitiko Letekutfutfukiswa Kwetenhlalo kute atfole tintfo tekutfunga tinjinifomu tesikolwa.

src: Nanabetso ena e atollotsweng ya ditshebeletso tsa setjhaba dibakeng tse neng di kotetswe, e na le seabo sa bohlokwa ho dumelleng le ho tebiseng demokrasi le toka setjhabeng.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyakwemukela kuvulwa ngalokusemtsetfweni kwemahhovisi lamasha eLitiko Letasekhaya eHluhluwe KwaZulu-Natal, nguMengameli Ramaphosa.

src: Sena se etsa karolo ya boikitlaetso ba mmuso ho atametseng ditshebeletso bathong.
tgt: Tinsita tekuvolontiya letikhulisiwe letetfulwe emimangweni lebeyikadze ibekwe eceleni tadlala indzima lenkhulu lebalulekile ekwenteni intsandvo yelinyenti kanye nebulungiswa betenhlalo kutsi kusebente kanye nekwenta kutsi kujule.

src: Lenaneo la ho Fallela Kgasong e Ntjha ya Dijithale.
tgt: Loku kwenta incenye yahulumende yekutinikela ekuletseni tinsita tibedvute nebantfu.

src: Kabinete e kgotsofetse ka kgatelopele e entsweng ya ho falla ha naha ho tloha kgasong ya kgale ya analoko ho ya ho e ntjha ya dijithale.
tgt: Luhlelo Lwekutfutsa Tekusakata Tiye Ekusakateni Ngekwedijithali.

src: E le karolo ya ho bala nako e setseng ya ho ya ho Tshitwe ya 2018 bakeng sa ho Tingwa ha Kgaso ya Kgale ya Analoko Freistata, transmithara ya pele e Senekal Freistata e tla tingwa ka la 20 Loetse 2018.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyenetiseka ngenchubekelembili leseyentiwe ekutfutseni lelive lisuke kutekusakata ngekwe-analogi liye kutekusakata ngekwedijithali.

src: Malapa a nang le dithelevishene (TV) tse sebetsang ka analoko a batlang ho reka tse ntjha, a eletswa ka hore a reke tse nang le konopo ya dijithale e seng e hoketswe.
tgt: Njengencenye yekulindza ngalabovu Ingongoni 2018 kutsi iFreyistata icishe i-analogi, sendlulisimagagasi ekusakata sekucala eSenekal eFreyistata sitawucishwa mhla tinge-20 Inyoni 2018.

src: Malapa a nang le lekeno le kahodimo ho sekepele sa R3 200 ka kgwedi a na le kgetho ya ho reka TV e ntjha e seng e hoketswe dijithale ebile e le e nang le dikhoudara ya TV ya Dijithale e bopelletsweng kahare, e fumanehang mabenkeleng a maholo a rekisang thepa.
tgt: Lokuhambisana nesivumelwane lesentiwa neNyonyane yeMave Emhlaba yeTakhiwonchanti Tetekuchumanisa.

src: Ho ya ka kgoeletso ya Moporesidente Ramaphosa ya ho kginwa nakwana ha dipukutlo tsa mesebetsi ka lebaka la maemo a moruo naheng ena, Kabinete e thasisetsa boipiletso ba yona ho bahiri hore taba ya ho heletswa mesebetsing e mpe e be ntho ya ho qetela eo ba ka e nahanang, le hore mekgwa e meng e teng ya sejwalejwale ya ho notla ditjeo e shebisiswe ka hloko molemong wa ho boloka mesebetsi ka nako e telele.
tgt: Emakhaya lanabomabonakudze (ema-TV) lafuna kutsenga lamasha elulekwa kutsi akhetse lawo lasafakwe inkinobho yekuvula yedijithali.

src: Kabinete e bo tjhaella monwana bokenadipakeng ba Setlamo sa tsa Toka, Thibelo ya Ditlolo tsa Molao le Tshireletso, ba ho tshetshetha ka potlako ka lewa le phethahetseng la ho lwantshana le dintho tse fapaneng tse ropohang dipalopalong tsa ditlolo tsa molao tse sa tswa ntshuwa.
tgt: Emakhaya latfola imali lengenako lengetulu kwelizinga le-R3 200 ngenyanga angakhetsa kutsenga mabonakudze lomusha losavele afakwe idikhoda yamabonakudze losavele alungele kusebenta ngekweDijithali, labatfolakala kuto tonkhe titolo letinkhulu letibatsengisako.

src: Diketsahalo tsa merusu.
tgt: Kudzilitwa emsebentini.

src: Kabinete e ngongorehile haholo ka sekgahla sa merusu setjhabeng sa habo rona mme e etsa kgoeletso makaleng ohle, dibakeng tsohle esita le ditheong tsa qobello ya molao hore ho sebetswe mmoho ho netefatsa hore dikolo le dibaka tsa setjhaba di bolokehile ebile di tshireletsehile.
tgt: Ngekuhambisana nesicelo saMengameli Ramaphosa sekutsi kumiswe kuncishiswa kwemisebenti lokubangelwe simo setemnotfo walelive, Ikhabhinethi igcizelela kuncusa kwayo lekwente kubacashi kutsi kudendwa kwebantfu emisebentini kufanele kutsi kube sisombululo sekugcina, nekutsi letindlela letikhona futsi leticamba lokusha tekugcina tindleko tifanele kutsi tihlolisiswe.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa sa Aforika Borwa (SAPS) ka ho arabela ka potlako hore ho tshwarwe bao ba belaellwang ka ho ba le seabo merusung hara setjhaba, esita le ho fumanwa ba na le thepa e belaellwang ka hore e utswitswe.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyakwemukela kungenelela kweMaklasta eTebulungiswa, Tekuvikela Bugebengu kanye neKlasta yeTekuvikela kutsi bakhulumisane ngekushesha mayelana nekutfola lisu lelikhulu lekubukana netindzaba letinyenti letehlulekene letivela kutibalobalo tetebugebengu letisandza kwetfulwa.

src: Ha jwale ho ropoha ha bohloko bona ho tlasa taolo.
tgt: Letehlakalo tebudlova letenteke etindzaweni letehlukene talelive lakitsi atemukeleki futsi tiphikisana neMtsetfosisekelo wetfu.

src: Letona la Bophelo bo Botle, Ngaka Aaron Motsoaledi, o se a entse tsebiso ya hore masea le bomma ona sepetleleng sena ba tla fetisetswa Sepetlele sa Bana sa Nelson Mandela le Sepetlele sa Dithuto sa Charlotte Maxeke Johannesburg ka tatelano.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyaluncoma Luphiko Lwetemisebenti Yetemaphoyisa LaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) ngekuphakama masinyane kuboshwe labo labasolwa ngekubandzakanyeka kubudlova lobentiwe emimangweni kanye nekutfolakala banemphahla lesolakala kutsi bayebile.

src: Sena se fa lefapha la bophelo bo botle la profense monyetla wa ho hlwekisa tikoloho, esita le ho rarolla ditaba tsa sebopeho sa sepetlele, ntle le tshitiso ya letho.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ivakalisa emavi ekulilela imindeni yebantfwana labasitfupha labashone ngemuva kwekubhedvuka kweKlebsiella pneumoniae eSibhedlela iThelle Mogoerane eVosloorus.

src: Mokgekgetho wa diqholotsiKabinete e tshohlile yaba ya ananela mokgekgetho wa diqholotsi o sisintsweng, o sisinyang mehato ya ho tsosolosa moruo wa rona ho tswa ditshebetsong tse ngatanyana tse amanang le wona.
tgt: Loku kunika litiko letemphilo lesifundza litfuba lekukolobha liphindze libulale emagciwane kulendzawo, libuye futsi lilungise letindzaba tekuhleleka kwalendzawo.

src: Ditlhabollo tse amanang le VISAKabinete e boetse ya amohela tlaleho ya kopanelo e tswang ho Matona a Merero ya Lehae le Bohahlaudi ka tatelano, mabapi le ditlhabollo tse ngatanyana tse amanang le visa tse tla nolofaletsa bahahlaudi, bahwebi le barutehi ho tla Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Umgodla wetivusamfutfo (Stimulus Package)Ikhabhinethi ikhulumisene yaphindze futsi yavuma umgodla wetivusamfutfo lophakamisa tindlela tekuvusa umnotfo kumaphothifoliyo lamanyenti lahambelana naloko.

src: Ditlhabollo tsena di akga dihlomathiso melawaneng e sebetsang ho melata ya bana e etelang Aforika Borwa, tse tla phatlalatswa kaseteng ya mmuso ka Mphalane.
tgt: Umhlangano webetindzaba lomayelana nekwetfula lomgodla lotawuholwa nguMengameli Ramaphosa utawubanjwa ngaLesihlanu mhla tinge-21 Inyoni.

src: Ditherisano tsa ho nyahlatswa ha ditlhoko tsa di-visa le ho nyehliswa ha ditlhoko tsa di-visa bakeng sa dinaha tse itseng, le tsona di a phethelwa.
tgt: Kuhlelwa kabusha kwema-VISAIkhabhinethi iphindze futsi yatfola umbiko lohlanganyelwe lovela eNdvuneni yeLitiko Letasekhaya neyeTekuvakasha, lomayelana netintfo letinyenti tekuhlela kabusha ludzaba lwema-visa lokutawenta kutsi kube lula kutsi tivakashi, bosomabhizinisi kanye nebetemfundvo bete kuleli laseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Dibili tse latelang bakeng sa ho phatlalatswa hore setjhaba se tshwaele ka tsona:.
tgt: Lokuhlela kabusha kufaka ekhatsi kuchitjelwa kwemitsetfosimiso lephatselene nebantfwana bekuchamuka labasesebancane labangena lapha eNingizimu Afrika, letitawufakwa kugazethi ngeMphala.

src: Dihlomathiso tsena di habile ho matlafatsa mekgwa ya boikamahanyo mme di tla dumella ho ralwa ha dipeelo tsa lenane le badilweng tsa tekano mesebetsing ya makala a totobaditsweng.
tgt: Tingcoco tekubonisana ngekumiswa kwema-visa netidzingo tekuyekelwa kwema-visa tiyaphetfwa.

src: Letona la tsa Bosebetsi, ka pontshano le ba amehang lekaleng, ba tla kgona ho rala dipeelo tsa lenane le badilweng tsa tekano mesebetsing ya makala a totobaditsweng.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ivume kushicilelwa kwalemitsetfosivivinyo lelandzelako kute kutsi ummango uphawule ngayo:.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya 2018 ya Melao ya Lekala la tsa Ditjhelete: Dihlomathiso tsena di habile ho matlafatsa ditlhoko tsa poloko ya matlotlo bakeng sa dibanka, ho akga le dibanka tsa kopanelo le tsa dikoporasi, le tse ding tse itseng tseo e seng dibanka.
tgt: Umtsetfosivivinyo weTekucashwa ngeKulingana wanga-2017.

src: Diphetoho di tla netefatsa hore ha ho ka etsahala hore ditheo tsena tsa ditjhelete di be le mathata, di ka thuswa ka mokgwa o tshireletsang beng ba tjhelete ba tlokotsing ka hore ho se ke ha eba teng ditshita tse kgolo tsamaisong ya tsa ditjhelete le moruo ka bobatsi.
tgt: Lomtsetfosivivinyo uhlose kucinisa tindlelanchubo tekuhambisana netimiso utawenta kutsi kuncunywe emanani lahlosiwe ekucashwa ngekulingana lacondzene ngco nemkhakha.

src: Keteko ya Letsatsi la Bojalefa la 2018 katlasa mookotaba o reng: “Selemo sa Nelson Mandela: Ho ntshetsa pele phetoho lepatlelong la bojalefa ba Aforika Borwa”, e tshwarelwa Lebaleng la Dipapadi la Riverview Kokstad, KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Umtsetfosivivinyo weKuchibela Imitsetfo yeMkakha weTimali 2018: Letichibelo tihlose kucinisa kwentiwa kwemabhange kutsi abe baphatsi, kufaka ekhatsi emabhange lentelwe konga kuphela nemabhange emmango, nalokunye lokungesiwo emabhange.

src: Ena ke karolo ya lenaneo le le lelele la kgwedi kaofela la diketsahalo tse rarollang dintho tse amanang le phetoho, phahamiso le paballo ya mohlahlwe wa bojalefa le manoni a Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Letingucuko titawucinisekisa kutsi uma ngabe letikhungo tihlangabetana nebulukhuni, tingasitwa ngendlela levikela bafakimali labasengotini ngekutsikameteka lokuncane kwenchubo yetetimali nemnotfo lobanti.

src: Keteko ena ya Letsatsi la Bojalefa e etsetswa ho tlotla Adam Kok le ditjhaba tsa Makgerikwa ka sebete, boikitlaetso le matla a bona ka ho hanana le boipehi ba bokoloniale.
tgt: Lusuku Lwemafa neMagugu Kugujwa kweMkosi weLusuku lweMafa neMagugu lwanga-2018 ngaphasi kwalengcikitsi: “Umnyaka waNelson Mandela: Kuchubela embili tingucuko temafa nemagugu aseNingizimu Afrika”, utawubanjelwa eNkhundleni yeTemidlalo eRiverview eKokstad, KwaZulu-Natal.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho setjhaba hore se keteke kopano ya sona ka mohlahlwe wa sona, jwalo ka ha re sebetsa mmoho ho aha naha eo batho bohle ba yona ba hlomphanang ba bile ba tsotellana.
tgt: Lena yincenye yemisebenti yeluhlelo lwalenyanga yonkhe lelungisa tindzaba tetingucuko, kukhutsata kanye nekugcina temafa nemagugu aseNingizimu Afrika lehlukahlukene, kutatisa kwavelonkhe, kwakha sive kanye nekubumbana kwetenhlalo.

src: Ho kenyeng letsoho mabapi le dilemo tse lekgolo tsa tswalo ya Moporesidente wa mehleng Nelson Mandela, ka la 24 Loetse 2018 UNGA e tla tshwara kopano ya boemo bo hodimo mabapi le kgotso ya lefatshe lohle e tsejwang ka hore ke Seboka sa Kgotso sa Nelson Mandela, e le ho tlotla dilemo tse lekgolo tsa tswalo ya Madiba.
tgt: Lokugujwa kweMkosi weLusuku lweTemafa neMagugu kukuhlonipha Adam Kok kanye nesive sema-Griqua ngekuba nemandla, kutinikela kanye nekuba nesibindzi nanoma kumatima kusiphalata balwe nembuso webukolonali.

src: Kopano ena e reretswe ho ananela tsebiso ya selekane sa sepolotiki e duletsweng majwana ke Dinaha tseo e leng Ditho tsa UNGSena se etsahala kamora dipuisano tsa Baemedi ba Moshwelella mokgatlong wa UN ba Aforika Borwa le Ireland, ba sebetsang e le bahlophisetsi, hammoho le mebuso e mmedi ena ka dikateng tsa tsebiso ena ya selekane.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi imema sive kutsi sigubhe bunye baso ekwehlukahlukaneni kwaso lapho sisebenta ngekubambisana ekwakheni live lapho khona bonkhe bantfu balo banakekelana futsi bahloniphana.

src: Moporesidente Ramaphosa o boetse o lebelletswe ho ba le seabo Kopanong ya UN ya Boemo bo Hodimo mabapi le bohloko ba Lefuba (TB) mohla la 26 Loetse 2018.
tgt: Ekuphoseni litje esivivaneni kuleminyaka lelikhulu yaMengameli waphambilini Nelson Mandela, i-UNGA mhla tinge-24 Inyoni 2018 itawubamba umhlangano welizinga leliphakeme lobitwa ngekutsi yiNgcungcutsela yeKuthula yaNelson Mandela, ngenhloso yekuhlonipha lusuku lwakhe Madiba lwekutalwa lweminyaka lelikhulu.

src: TB ke bohloko bo ka sehloohong Aforika mme tse ding tsa dinaha tse thefutsweng ke TB ka ho fetisisa di khontinenteng ena.
tgt: Lomhlangano uhlelelwe kwemukela simemetelo setepolitiki lekuboniswe ngaso yiMibuso lengeMalunga e-UNGLoku kulandzela kubonisana kweBameleli Balomphelo baseNingizimu Afrika ne-Ireland, labasebenta njengebachumanisi, kanye nabohulumende kulokucuketfwe ngulesimemetelo.

src: Melaetsa.
tgt: Imibiko.

src: MatshedisoKabinete e fetisetsa matshediso a yona ho malapa a lahlehetsweng ke baratuwa ba ona ho swahlamaneng ha bese ho etsahetseng mmileng wa N1-25 haufi le Tobias, Masepaleng wa Setereke sa Waterberg Limpopo.
tgt: KudvudvutaIkhabhinethi yendlulisela emavi ayo endvudvuto emindenini lelahlekelwe ngulabatsandzekako bayo engotini yekugicika kwebhasi leyenteke ku-N1-25 ngaseTobias kuMasipala weSigodzi eWaterberg eLimpopo.

src: Kabinete e boela e lakaletsa bao ba lemetseng hore ba fole ka potlako.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iphindze futsi ifisela nalabo labalimele labasidzile kwelulama lokusheshako.

src: DithoholetsoKabinete e thoholetsa Letona la Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane, Mofumahadi Lindiwe Zulu, ka hore a amohelwe boemong bo hodimodimo ba Tlotlo ya Rio Branco (Ordem de Rio Branco), le Grand Cross ho tswa Mmusong wa Brazil.
tgt: KuhalalisaIkhabhinethi ihalalisela Indvuna yeTekutfutfukiswa Kwemabhizinisi Lamancane, Mk Lindiwe Zulu, ngekwemukelwa ezingeni leliphakeme kakhulu le-Order of Rio Branco (i-Ordem de Rio Branco), kanye ne-Grand Master nguHulumende waseBrazil.

src: Sena se entswe ka lebaka la matsapa a Letona a ntseng a tswelapele a ho ntlafatsa dikamano tsa dinaha tse pedi dipakeng tsa Brazil le Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Loku kuhlonipha imitamo yayo leNdvuna lengaphelimandla yekwenta kancono budlelwane emkhatsini weBrazil kanye neNingizimu Afrika.

src: Tlotlo ena ya Brazil e fuwa bao ba ipabotseng ka diketso tsa tshebeletso e tswileng matsoho esita le makgetha a setjhaba.
tgt: Lomklomelo wekuhlonishwa weBrazil uklonyeliswa labo labakhombise tento tekusebenta ngekutikhandla lokukhulu nangebunono emisebentini yekutfutfukisa imimango.

src: Letona Zulu e ne e le Leqosa la Aforika Borwa Brazil dipakeng tsa 2004 le 2008.DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di lokela ho netefatswa ka mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang.
tgt: Indvuna Zulu waba Lincusa leNingizimu Afrika eBrazil emkhatsini wa-2004 na-2008.Kubekwa etikhundleniKutawucinisekiswa ticu tetemfundvo nekuhlola kufaneleka kwabo bonkhe lababekwe etikhundleni.

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro, 10 Mphalane 2018 Tuynhuys, ho la Motse Kapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yahlangana ngaLesitsatfu, mhla ti-10 Imphala 2018 eTuynhuys eKapa.

src: Dintlha tsa Hajwale Letsholo la moruo le tsetelo Kabinete e amohela diketso tsa tshebetso tse jwalo ka boitlamo ba ho reka dihlahiswa tse entsweng kahare ho naha, katamelo e matla ho feta ya ho eketsa dihlahiswa tse rekiswang kantle ho naha, mesebetsi kgwebong ya temo le tshehetso bakeng sa dikgwebo tse nyane le tse mahareng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyatemukela tingenelelo letiphatsekako njengekutinikela ekutsengeni imikhicito yalelive, kwandzisa kakhulu indlela yekutsengisela emave angephandle imphahla, tingenelelo tenchubo yekukhicita kutekulima kanye nekwesekela emabhizinisi lamancane nalasemkhatsini.

src: Diphatlalatso tsena di hlahile Kopanong ya Mesebetsi ya matsatsi a mabedi e sa tswa tshwarwa, e tshwerweng tlasa Khansele ya Naha ya Ntshetsopele ya Moruo le Mesebetsi.2 Sephetho sa Kopano ya Mesebetsi se latela phatlalatso ya Morero wa Tsosoloso le Ntjhafatso ya Moruo, e rerileng ho tsosolosa kgolo ya moruo ya ho theha mesebetsi e hlokehang e le kannete.
tgt: Letimemetelo tivele ngesikhatsi kuneNgcungcutsela yeteMisebenti, lebeyibanjwe ngaphasi kweMkandlu Wavelonkhe Wekutfutfukisa Umnotfo Netisebenti (i-Nedlac).

src: Tumellano e Ntjha ya Merafo – e phethetsweng ka tshebedisanommoho le indasteri ya merafo, kgwebo le ditjhaba tse amehileng le baamehi ba bang – e hlakisa dintlha tsa bohlokwa tsa kgolo, phehello le phetoho.3 Kabinete e kopa baamehi bohle ho sebetsana le Tumellano ya Merafo e le ho phethela le ho theha botsitso kgwebong ya merafo.
tgt: Umphumela waleNgcungcutsela yeteMisebenti ulandzela simemetelo seLuhlelo Lwevusamnotfo neLuhlelo lwekuBuyisa, lokuhloswe ngalo kubuyisa kukhula kutemnotfo nekudala imisebenti ledzingeka kakhulu.

src: Ofisi ya Merero ya Lehae ya Kokstad le phano ya mangolo a beng ba matlo Kabinete hammoho le Mopresidente Cyril Ramaphosa ba lebohisa Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae bakeng sa ho bula ofisi ya Kokstad ho la KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Umculu lomusha weteTimayini – lowaphotfulwa ngekubonisana nemboni yetetimayini, temisebenti, imimango letsintsekile kanye nalabanye labatsintsekako – uchaza kudzingeka kwekukhula, kusimama kanye netingucuko.

src: Mopresidente o butse ofisi ya Merero ya Lehae jwalo ka karolo ya lenaneo la mmuso la ho atolosa kgato ya dibaka tsa phano ya ditshebeletso ya Merero ya Lehae ho kgotsofatsa ditlhoko tsa baahi bakeng sa dikarete tsa boitsebiso (di-Smart ID) le ditokomane tse ding.2 Ho feta moo, Mopresidente Ramaphosa o fane ka mangolo a beng ba matlo a 443 ho bajalefa ba Projeke ya Franklin Housing.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe labatsintsekako kutsi babonisane ngaloMculu weteTimayini ngenhloso yekuwuphotfula nekudala kutsi kube nekusimamama emkhakheni wetetimayini.

src: Ena ke karolo ya lenaneo la puseletso la ho netefatsa hore bajalefa ba fumana melemo e felletseng ya ho ba le ntlo mme ba kgona ho fihlella mmaraka wa semmuso wa matlo.3 Kabinete e boetse e nka monyetla ona ho kgothaletsa baahi ka matla hore ba late di-ID tsa bona hang ha ba fumana tsebiso ya ho di lata.
tgt: Mengameli uvule lelihhovisi letaseKhaya njengencenye yeluhlelo lwahulumende lwekwengeta tindzawo letaseKhaya tekuletsa tinsita tekuhlangabetana netidzingo tetakhamuti tekufuna bomatisi bemakhadi (e-Smart ID) kanye nalamanye emadokhumenti.

src: Tumellano ya phethelo mabapi le sepeketeramo Kabinete e amohela tumellano ya phethelo e fihletsweng tabeng e kenyelletsang Memo ya ho etsa Kopo bakeng sa kabo ya sepeketeramo sa tlhoko e phahameng.
tgt: Kwengeta, Mengameli Ramaphosa unike bazuzi bemklamo wetindlu, i-Franklin Housing Project, ematayitela lange-443.

src: Sena se fana ka botsitso ba pholisi lekaleng ka theknoloji ya tlhahisoleseding le dikgokahano (ICT).2 Tumellano ena ya phethelo e tsamaellana le pitso ya Mopresidente Ramophosa ya ho qala tshebetso ya kabo ya dilaesense tsa seyalemoya tsa sepeketeramo sa tlhoko e phahameng.4 E le ho kenya letsoho ka tsela tse eketsehileng ho tshebetso ya Tokomane ya Tataiso ya Pholisi e Kopantsweng ya Naha ya ICT, baamehi ba nang le kgahleho ba ka fana ka ditlatsetso tse ngotsweng ho fihlela la 8 Pudungwana 2018 ho pholisi e sisintsweng le tjhebo ya yona ho ba boholong.
tgt: Loku kuyincenye yeluhlelo lwekubuyisa kucinisekisa kutsi bazuzi batfola tinzuzo letiphelele tekuba nendlu kanye nekutsi batfole tindlu letisemtsetfweni labangakhona kutitsengisa.

src: Dikoporasi tsa pele tsa Aforika Borwa tse nyane tsa ditlhapi Kabinete e amohela dikoporasi tsa pele tsa Aforika Borwa tse nyane lekaleng la tsa ditlhapi, e leng dikoporasi tsa Port Nolloth le Hondeklipbaai ho la Kapa Leboya, tse hlomamisitsweng ke Letona la Temothou, Meru le Ditlhapi, Monghadi Senzeni Zokwana.2 Tlhomamiso e tshwaya ho kengwa tshebetsong ha pholisi ya ditheo tse nyane tsa ditlhapi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphindza futsi itsatsa lelitfuba igcugcutela kakhulu takhamuti kutsi tiyowulandza bomatisi bato ngekushesha emva kwekutfola satiso sekubalandza.

src: Ditokelo tsa ditlhapi di fa batjhehi ba ditlhapi ba lehae seriti, ba neng ba tjheha ditlhapi ka ntle ho molao, ka hore jwale ba se ba sireleditswe ka lekgetlo la pele.3 Ditjhaba tse pedi tsa boraditlhapi ba banyenyane tse tla una molemo pholising ena di fumane thupelo ya motheo mabapi le dikoporasi mme di thusitswe ho ngodisa dikoporasi bakeng sa ho etsa dikopo tsa ditokelo tsa dilemo tse 15 tsa ho tjheha ditlhapi.
tgt: Sivumelwane lesincunyiwe lesimayelana ne-spectrum IKhabhinethi iyasemukela lesivumelwane lesincunyiwe lokufinyelelwe kuso eludzabeni lolufaka ekhatsi Simemo sekwenta Sicelo sekunikwa spectrum lesidzingeka kakhulu.

src: Sehla sa lekgetho.1 Kabinete e lebohisa balefi ba lekgetho ba haufi ho dimilione tse tharo ba tlatsitseng diforomo tsa bona tsa lekgetho, tseo ho tsona tse fetang halofo di nehelanweng ka eFiling.
tgt: Lesivumelwane lesincunyiwe sihambelana nesimemetelo lesentiwe nguMengameli Ramaphosa sekucala inchubo yekunika imvume yekusakata ye-spectrum ledzingeka kakhulu.

src: Ka la 31 Mphalane, sehla sa lekgetho sa 2018 sea kwalwa bakeng sa balefi ba lekgetho ba nakwana le bao eseng ba nakwana ba kgethang ho faela lekaleng la Tshebeleto ya Lekgetho ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Ngekufaka ligalelo ekucaleni kwekusetjentiswa kweMtsetfo Lohlongotwako weNchubomgomo yaVelonkhe yekuHlanganisa i-ICT, emacembu lanenshisekelo anesikhatsi kute kube mhla ti-08 Lweti 2018 kutsi angenise kulabasemagunyeni kuphawula lokubhaliwe lokumayelana nalenchubomgomo lephakanyisiwe kanye nesicondziso senchubomgomo.

src: Balefi ba lekgetho bao eseng ba nakwana ba kgethang ho faela diforomo tsa bona ka eFiling ba ka etsa jwalo ho fihlela la 31 Pherekgong 20.2 Pokeletso e nepahetseng e sebetsang hantle e netefatsa matla a nahana a busang tjhelete ya yona, mme dinehelano tse etswang ka nako le ka nepo di netefatsa hore balefi ba lekgetho ba latela molao wa lekgetho.
tgt: Emakoporasi aseNingizimu Afrika ekucala lamancane etinhlanti.

src: Tjhelete ya lekgetho e thusa mmuso ho fana ka tjhelete bakeng sa diprojeke tsa naha tsa phano ya ditshebeletso le mananeo a mang a ntshetsopele ya setjhaba le moruo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawemukela emakoporasi aseNingizimu Afrika ekucala lamancane etinhlanti emkhakheni wetekudvoba, latiwa ngekutsi yiPort Nolloth neHondeklipbaai laseNyakatfo Kapa, latfulwa yiNdvuna yeTekulima, Temahlatsi Netinhlanti, Umnu Senzeni Zokwana.

src: Ditefo tsa digrante tsa setjhaba Kabinete e tlalehetswe ke Komiti ya Mafapha a Kopaneng: Digrante tsa Setjhaba, eo modulasetulo wa yona e leng Letona Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma.
tgt: Lokwetfula kukhomba kucala kwekusebenta kwenchubomgomo yetetinhlanti ngalokuncane.

src: Bajalefa bohle ba kontane ba lefuwang ke CPS ba fetiseditswe mme CPS e se e tsebisitswe ka phediso ya konteraka ho tloha ka la 30 Loetse 20.3 Kabinete e leboha mosebetsi o motle wa botsamaisi o neng o etelletswe pele ke Komiti ya Mafapha a Kopaneng e tsheheditswe ke Sehlopha sa Mosebetsi wa Botekgeniki sa Balaodikakaretso.
tgt: Lamalungelo ekudvoba anika badvobi bendzawo sitfunti, ngobe bebasolo badvoba ngalokungekho emtsetfweni kenje nyalo sebavikeleke kwekucala.

src: E boetse e fetisetsa diteboho tsa yona ho basebeletsi ba SAPO, Setheo sa Aforika Borwa sa Tshireletseho ya Setjhaba (SASSA) le, lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba la Meralo ya Dikgokahanyo le Ditshebeletso tsa Poso la Merero, Bodisa le Tlhatlhobo ya Tshebetso la Matlotlo a Setjhaba Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa ya Aforika Borwa (SAPS) le Tsamaiso ya Dikgokahanyo le Tlhahisoleseding ya Mmuso (GCIS).4 Kabinete e leboha bajalefa bohle ba digrante tsa setjhaba bakeng sa tshebedisanommoho ya bona nakong ya phetoho ena.
tgt: Lemimamngo lemincane lemibili ledvobako letawuzuza kulenchubomgomo seyitfole kuceceshwa lokusisekelo lokumayelana nemakoporasi futsi seyisitwe ngekutsi ibhalise emakoporasi ngenhloso yekufaka sicelo semalungelo ekudvoba iminyaka le-.

src: Kahlolo ya ntate wa Springs.1 Kabinete e amohela kahlolo ya monna ya hlekefetsang, ya tsejwang ka hore ke Kgodumodumo ya Springs.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyababonga labakhokhi bemtselo labacishe balinganiselwe etigidzini letintsatfu labangenise emafomu abo emtselo, kwatsi sigamu sabo sangenise emafomu abo ngekusebentisa i-eFiling.

src: O ahloletswe ho hlola dilemo tse 35 tjhankaneng bakeng sa teko ya ho bolaya mora wa hae, tlhekefetso ya bana le ho se tsotelle bana, hammoho le ho sebedisa le ho hweba ka dithethefatsi.
tgt: Ngamhla tinge-31 Imphala, sikhatsi sekutsela sa-2018 sekuvala kwalabo labangakhokhi umtselo ngendlela letikhawu kanye nalabo labakhokha umtselo ngetikhawu labakhetse kutsi batawuletsa emafomu abo emtselo egatjeni lemahhovisi eLuphiko LwaseNingizimu Afrika Lwekugcogcwa Kwemtselo (i-SARS).

src: Tlhekefetso ya bong e dula e le bothata bo boholo setjhabeng sa rona, jwalo ka ha re bone ka peto e sa tswa etsahala ya ngwana e monyane sebakeng sa ho jella sa Dros, Silverton.2 Kabinete e hatisella dikgoelletso tsa hore ditheo tsa tshebetso ya molao di etse tsohle tse matleng a tsona ho qosa baetsi ba ditlolo tsena tsa molao tse harosang dibete.
tgt: Labakhokha umtselo ngetikhawu labakhetse kuletsa emafomu abo emtselo ngendlela ye-eFiling bangakwenta loko kudzimate kube mhla tinge-31 Bhimbidvwane 2019.

src: E boetse e hoella le rona bohle hore re sebetseng mmoho ho emisa tlhekefetso ya ditokelo tsa bana le ditho tsa setjhaba tse sa bolokehang ka ho fetisisa.
tgt: Kugcogcwa kahle kwemalingena yemtselo nangemphumelelo kucinisekisa kutibusa ngekwetimali tahulumende, kantsi nekuletsa emafomu lagcwaliswe kahle futsi nangesikhatsi kucinisekisa kutfobela indlela yekwenta tintfo yebakhokhi bemtselo.

src: Boipelaetso ba Westbury Kabinete e amohela tshebetso ya Letona la Sepolesa Bheki Cele ho la Westbury, eo e leng karolo ya moralo o pharalletseng wa ho lwantsha bothata ba dithethefatsi le dintwa tse amanang le maqulwana sebakeng seo.2 Tshebetso ena e kenyelletsa ho romelwa ha Sehlopha sa Tshebetso e Radilweng sa Thibelo ya Botlokotsebe (TRT - Maberete) le boteng bo eketsehileng ba sepolesa.
tgt: Imalingena yemtselo isita hulumende kutsi akhokhele imiklamo yalelive yekuletsa tinsita kanye naletinye tinhlelo tekutfutfukisa tenhlalomnotfo.

src: Botlokotsebe.1 Kabinete e lebohisa ditheo tsa molao ka ho etsa dipatlisiso tse matla tsa makala a fapaneng tse amanang le diketsahalo tsa dimolong, mabenkeleng le dimoskeng tse lebisitseng ho ho tshwarwa ha babelaellwa ba Di ne di kenyelletsa Sehlopha sa Toka, Thibelo ya Botlokotsebe le Tshireletso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yatjelwa ngalamafishane Likomidi Lelihlanganisa Tindvuna: Tibonelelo Temali Yahulumende, sihlalo walo lokuyiNdvuna Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma.

src: Babelaellwa ba bararo ba tshwerwe mabapi le disebediswa tsa diqhomane sebakeng sa Durban, ho kenyelletswa le Mosque wa Verulam.
tgt: Kusukela mhla ti-01 Imphala 2018, bantfu labangetulu kwetigidzi letilishumi bakhokhelwa kusetjentiswa letinye taletindlela – Lihhovisi Leliposi laseNingizimu Afrika (i-Sapo)/i-Postbank i-Grindrod Bank kanye netitolo letifanana neBoxer, Shoprite, nePick n Pay.

src: Ho lebelletswe hore babelaellwa bohle ba tla shebana le diqoso tse kenyelletsang polao, teko ya polao le ho tlola Molao wa Diqhomane.2 Kabinete e netefalletsa maAforika Borwa hore ho lwantshwa botlokotsebe ho bohlokwa haholo le hore mmuso o tla tswelapele ho nka mehato e hlokehang ho netefatsa hore ho ba le tikoloho e bolokehileng hape e sireletsehileng bakeng sa baahi bohle ba Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Hulumende ukutsutse ngemphumelelo kukhokhelwa kwetibonelelo yemali yahulumende kusuka ku-Cash Paymaster Services (i-CPS) njengekuyalwa Sijubo seNkantolo yeteMtsetfosisekelo.

src: Diphetolo tsa mabitso: Makhanda Kabinete e amohela phetolo ya lebitso la Grahamstown, ho la Kapa Botjhabela, hore e be Makhanda, ho tlotla moprofeta wa moXhosa, rafilosofi le lesole le neng le lwana kgahlanong le bokoloniale.2 Phetoho ena ke karolo e bohlokwa ya leeto la rona la demokrasi mme e tla thusa ho aha katamelano ya setjhaba e eketsehileng le ho aha kutlwisiso e tebileng ya nalane ya rona eo re e arolelanang.
tgt: Bonkhe bantfu labebaholelwa imali lengukheshi i-CPS sebatfutsiwe kantsi na-CPS sewatisiwe futsi nangekuncanyulwa kwalesivumelwane kusukela mhla tinge-30 Inyoni 2018.

src: Diqeto tsa Kabinete Kabinete e amohetse mmotlolo o shebilweng botjha wa phano ya ditshebeletso wa Projeke ya Phetolo ya Phatlalatso ya Dijithale.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa kudvumisa kwayo ngalomsebenti wekwengamela lobewuholwa Likomidi Lelihlanganisa Tindvuna lebelisekelwa Licembu Lemasu Ekusebenta leBacondzisi Jikelele.

src: Mmotlolo ona o sebedisa mokgwa o kgannwang ke mmaraka/mabenkele ka tshebedisanommoho le dikamano le lekala la poraefete le indasteri.
tgt: Iphindze futsi ivakalise kudvumisa kwayo umsebenti lowentiwe tikhulu taka-SAPO, i-Ejensi yetekuCinisekiswa kweteNhlalakahle eNingizimu Afrika (i-Sassa)kanye, neLitiko Letekutfutfukiswa Kwetenhlalalakahle Letakhiwonchanti Tekuchumanisa Netinsita Teliposi letekuHlela, kuCaphela nekuLungisa, Temafa Avelonkhe Luphiko Lwembutfo Wemaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) neLuphiko Lwahulumende Lwetekuchumana Netekwatisa (i-GCIS).

src: Ka mokgwa ona, mmuso o ke ke wa hlola o nka karolo patlong ya mabokose a ‘set-top’, poloko ya tsona dibakeng tse kgolo tsa poloko, tsamaiso ya tsona le ho kengwa ha disebediswa tsena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibonga bonkhe bazuzi besibonelelo semali yahulumende ngekubambisana natsi ngesikhatsi kusentiwa loluntjintjo.

src: Sena se fa Aforika Borwa motjha wa ho phethela projeke ka tsela e kenyelletsang bohle, e theko e tlase hape e sebetsang hantle mme e fokotsang kotsi bakeng sa mmuso.
tgt: Iminyaka Lelikhulu ya-Albertina Sisulu IKhabhinethi yatjelwa ngalamafishane mayelana nemalungiselelo emcimbi wekugubha iminyaka lelikhulu yekutalwa kwaMake Albertina Sisulu lotawubanjwa ngenyanga yekutalwa kwakhe, Imphala.

src: Sena se tla sutumelletsa phetoho ya bobohi ba dijithale hore bo be palong e ka bang 85% le ho feta, ho lebisa ho ho tingwa ha diphatlalatsi tsa analoko.
tgt: Make Sisulu watalwa mhla tinge-21 Imphala 1918 kantsi Sihlalo we-IMC lebukene naleMigubho Yelikhulu Leminyaka, Indvuna Jeff Radebe, nguye lotawuchaza ngaloko lokutawukwentiwa lokuphatselene nalomgubho welikhulu leminyaka.

src: Kabinete e amohetse Tokomane ya Aforika Borwa ya Botebo bo Tshwanang, e tla nehelanwa ho Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN).
tgt: Kugwetjwa kwababe waseSprings IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kugwetjwa kwendvodza lengumhlukubeti, lebeyatiwa ngalokwetayekile ngekutsi Silwane saseSprings.

src: Tokomane ena e fana ka kgatelopele e nang le tlhahisoleseding ya mofuta o akaretsang, wa nnete le wa dipalopalo ho tatelo ya Aforika Borwa ya ditshwanelo tse hoketsweng ho ditumellano tse robong tse tekennweng tsa UN.
tgt: Budlova lobucondziswe kulabasikati buyinsayeya lenkhulu emmangweni wetfu, njengaloku kubonakele ngesikhatsi kugagadlelwa umntfwana lomncane lapha resitjurenti eDros eSilverton.

src: Diketsahalo tse TlangPolelo ya Pholisi ya Tekanyetso ya Nako e Bohareng (MTBPS)Letona la Ditjhelete Tito Mboweni le tla fana ka Polelo ya Pholisi ya Tekanyetso ya Nako e Bohareng (MTBPS) ka Laboraro, la 24 Mphalane 2018, le tla hlahisa diphetolo ho bajete ya naha ho netefatsa tshwarello ya tsa ditjhelete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphindza futsi icela labo labasemagunyeni ekucinisekisa kugcinwa kwemtsetfo kutsi bente konkhe lokusemandleni kutsi bayashushiswa bonkhe labo labenta lamacala ebugebengu lamabi ngalendlela.

src: Kgwedi ya Dipalangwang Lenaneo la selemo sena la Kgwedi ya Dipalangwang le tla hatisella bohlokwa ba disebediswa tsa dipalangwang, jwalo ka lekala la tsa lewatle, la difofane, la diporo le la ditsela jwalo ka dikganni tsa kgolo ya moruo.
tgt: Iphindza futsi icela wonkhe umuntfu kutsi kubanjisanwe ekuvimbeni kutsi kungaphulwa emalungelo ebantfwana kanye newalawo malunga emmango lahlaseleka lula.

src: Kabinete e kopa setjhaba hore se sebedise dipalangwang tsa setjhaba le ho kenya tshebetsong matsholo a polokeho mebileng selemo ho pota.
tgt: Umshuco waseWestbury IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kungenelela kweNdvuna Yetemaphoyisa Bheki Cele eWestbury, lokuyincenye yendlelalisu lelibanti lekulwa nalesishayo setidzakamiva nebudlova lobuhambisana nemacembu emigulugudvu kulendzawo.

src: Ha re sebediseng kgwedi ena ho keteka le ho busetsa tlwaelo ya mekgatlo ya ho tsamaya mmoho ho ya mosebetsing ho fokotsa sephethephethe mebileng ya rona.
tgt: Lesingenelelo sifaka ekhatsi kutfunyelwa kweLicembu Lemaphoyisa Leliceceshwe Ngalokuvelele (maBharethe) kanye nekubonakala ngalokugcamile kwemaphoyisa kulendzawo.

src: Polokeho mebileng ya rona e ntse e le bothata bo boholo, mme bakganni le ditaaso di lokela ho sebedisa mebila ka boikarabello.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela ummango waseWestbury kutsi kanye nayo yonkhe nje imimango kutsi isebentisane nemaphoyisa ekucinisekiseni kutsi sitisephula netimphandze tato tonkhe tento tebugebengu, tetidzakamiva netemigulukudvu kuletindzawo lapho tenteka khona.

src: Melaetsa Ditebohiso Theleskoupu ya seyalemoya ya Aforika Borwa, e leng MeerKAT, e tla kenya letsoho ho Breakthrough Listen, e leng letsholo la matjhaba le batlang matshwao a bophelo bo bohlale sepakapakeng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawabonga ema-ejensi lacinisekisa kugcinwa kwemtsetfo ngekwenta luphenyo lolujulile nalolufaka tindlela letinengi lolumacondzana netehlakalo letenteka emamoli, etitolo kanye nasemasontfweni eMamozilemu lokuholele ekutseni kubanjwe basolwa laba-19.

src: E supa botsebi ba rona bo tsejwang lefatsheng ka bophara le meaho.
tgt: Loku kufake ekhatsi LiKlasta Letebulungiswa, Letekuvikela Bugebengu neTekuphepha.

src: Theleskoupu ya seyalemoya ya Aforika Borwa ya dikotlolo tse 64 ya MeerKAT, e hlomamisitsweng ka Phupu selemong sena, ke theleskoupu e utlwellang haholo ho fetisisa lefatsheng lohle.
tgt: Labatsatfu kulabasolwa baboshelwe mayelana netisetjentiswa letivutsako endzaweni yaseDurban, lokufaka ekhatsi lisontfo leMamozilemu leliseVerulam.

src: Kabinete e lebohisa sehlopha sa bafuputsi ba Yunivesithi ya Wits se entseng phetolo e atlehileng ya nalane ho tlosa sebete ho tswa ho Mme ya nang le tshwaetso ya HIV ho ya ho ngwana wa hae ya senang HISehlopha sa dingaka se ne se kenyelletsa Moprofesara Jean Botha, Ngaka Francesca Conradie, Ngaka Harriet Etheredge, Ngaka June Fabian le Moprofesara Caroline Tiemessen.
tgt: Bonkhe labasolwa balindzeleke kutsi babukane nemacala lafaka ekhatsi kubulala kanye nekuzama kubulala kanye nekwephula Umtsetfo weTichumachumachumane.

src: Kabinete e lebohisa batho ba Equatorial Guinea ka ketekelo ya bona ya boipuso ba dilemo tse Aforika Borwa esale e na le dikamano tse phethahetseng tsa bodiplomate le Riphabliki ya Equatorial Guinea ho tloha ka la 5 Motsheanong 1993.Matshediso Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona ho lelapa, metswalle le basebetsimmoho ba Letona la Merero ya Tikoloho Boma Edna Molewa ya fetileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi itsandza kucinisekisa bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi kulwa nebugebengu yintfo lesembili eluhlwini lwetintfo lekumele kutsi kucalwe ngato tentiwe kanye nekutsi hulumende utawuchubeka atsatse tinyatselo letidzingekako kucinisekisa kutsi kuba nesimondzawo lesiphephile nalesivikelekile sabo bonkhe labahlala lapha eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Letona Molewa o ipabotse mesebetsing le matsholong a mangata, ho tloha ho tlatsetso ya hae ntweng ya tokoloho ho isa ho ntweng ya tekatekano ya basadi setjhabeng.
tgt: Kuntjintja kweligama: Makhanda IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kuntjintjwa kweligama iGrahamstown, lidolobha leliseMphumalanga Kapa, kutsi ibe yiMakhanda kute kuhlonishwe umpholofidi, linjulamcondvo lesive semaXhosa, naloyindvodza yemphi leyalwa nebukholoni.

src: E boetse e bile mampodi wa naha le wa matjhaba bakeng sa poloko ya tikoloho bakeng sa lefatshe le tswellang le ka arolelanwang le ho natefelwa ke bohle.
tgt: Loluntjintjo luyincenye lebalulekile yeluhambo lwetfu lwentsandvo yelinyenti futsi lutawusita ekwakheni kubumbana kutenhlalo kanye nekwakha kwatisa lokujulile kwemlandvo wetfu lesabelana ngawo.

src: Kabinete e lebisa matshediso ho mmuso le batho ba Indonesia.
tgt: Tincumo teKhabhinethiIKhabhinethi iyivumile indlela lebuyeketiwe yekwetfula kucala kusebenta kweMkamo weLuhlelo Lwekutfutsa Tekusakata Tiye Ekusakateni Ngekwedijithali.

src: Mmuso o se o tshepisitse tshehetso ya ona, moo ho hlokehang, mme Kabinete e tlotla basebetsi ba maAforika Borwa ba thuso ba nkileng karolo mesebetsing ya thuso Sehlekehlekeng sa Indonesia sa Sulawesi, se otluweng ke ho reketla ha lefatshe le tsunami.
tgt: Lendlela ilandzela sichamkelo lesichutjwa yimakethe/batsengi ngekusebentisana kanye nebudlelwane nemkhakha lotimele netimboni.

src: Kabinete e lebisa matshediso ho lelapa le basebetsimmoho ba Mofumahatsana Rowena Baird ya hlokahetseng bekeng ena.
tgt: Ngekusebentisa lendlela, hulumende ngeke aphindze atimbandzakanya ekutsengeni lama-set-top-box, kuwagcina, kuwahambisa kanye nekuwafaka.

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro, 24 Mphalane 2018 ho la Tuynhuys, Motse Kapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yahlangana ngaLesitsatfu, mhla tinge-24 Imphala 2018 eTuynhuys eKapa.

src: Dintlha tsa Hajwale.
tgt: Tindzaba Talelive.

src: Polelo ya Pholisi ya Tekanyetso ya Nako e Bohareng (MTBPS)1.1 Kabinete e amohela MTBPS ya pele ka Letona la Ditjhelete Tito Mboweni, e thehilweng hodima tumelo e matla ya hore Afrika Borwa e ka ntjhafatswa.2 MTBPS ya 2018 e totobatsa dikgetho tsa thata tsa moruo le lekgetho tse tjametseng mmuso nakong ya dilemo tse tharo tse tlang.
tgt: Sitatimende Senchubomgomo Yesabelotimali Sethemu Lesemkhatsini (i-MTBPS).

src: Kgolo ya moruo bakeng sa 2018 e fetoletswe tlase ho tloha ho 1.5% ho ya ho 0.7%, mme tikoloho ya lefatshe e dula e ntse e le thata bakeng sa meruo ya mebaraka e thuthuwang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayemukela i-MTBPS yekucala yeNdvuna yeteTimali Tito Mboweni, legcile embonweni locinile lotsi iNingizimu Afrika ingavuselelwa kabusha.

src: MTBPS ya 2018 e qala tshebetso ya morero wa Mopresidente wa tsosoloso ya kgolo ya moruo le puseletso, tse tla tshehetswa ke botsitso ba tsa lekgetho le ditjhelete.3 Mmuso o dula o itlametse botsitso ba tsa lekgetho, empa ho bile le phokotseho esale ho tloha ka puo ya Ditekanyetso ya 2018 ka Hlakola selemong sena.
tgt: Le-MTBPS yanga-2018 ikhomba bumatima kutemnotfo kanye netincumo letiphatselene netimali tahulumende, hulumende latawubukana nato kuleminyaka lemitsatfu letako.

src: Papisong le tikoloho e phephetsang ya moruo le tsa lekgetho, karolo e sisingwang ya lekeno e tswelapele ho beha sehlohlolong mananeo a tshebediso e hodimo ya tjhelete a tshehetsang ditshebeletso tsa thuto ya motheo, bophelo bo botle, boiketlo ba setjhaba, metsi, tlhwekiso le motlakase.
tgt: Le-MTBPS yanga-2018 inemtselela lomuhle kuloluhlelo lwaMengameli lwemvusamnotfo neluhlelo lwekubuyisa, lolutawusekelwa kutinta etimalini letiphatselene nahulumende kanye nekusimama etimalini.

src: Kopano ya Mopresidente ya Bophelo bo Botle Kabinete e amohela diphetho tsa Kopano ya Mopresidente ya Bophelo bo Botle tse reretsweng ho sebetsana le diphephetso tse fapaneng tseo sistimi ya setjhaba ya bophelo bo botle e tobaneng le tsona.
tgt: Hulumende utimisele macondzana nekusimama kwetimali letiphatselene nahulumende, kodvwa kube nekuyekelela kusukela kwetfulwa Sabelotimali sa-2018 ngeNdlovana kulomnyaka.

src: Diphetho di tla matlafatsa ditukisetso tsa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Inshorense ya Naha ya Bophelo bo Botle.
tgt: Hulumende utimisele ekwenteni kutsi kube nekusimama nekutsi futsi kwehle tikweleti.

src: Phetolo ya lefatshe Kabinete e amohela ho kenngwa tshebetsong ho tsitsitseng ha mananeo a phetolo le pusetso ya lefatshe a lokisang tlhokeho ya toka ya nako e fetileng le ho thusa ho hodisa moruo.2 Mopresidente Cyril Ramaphosa o etelletse pele mokete wa pusetso ya lefatshe, moo dihektere tse 4 586 tsa lefatshe di fuweng setjhaba sa KwaMkhwanazi ho la Empangeni, KwaZulu-Natal.3 Setjhaba sa KwaMkhwanazi se boetse se tla fumana dikapana tsa kamora phallo le tshehetso tse tla ba thusa ho fihlella tshebediso e hodimodimo ya leruo la lefatshe leo.
tgt: Ngekubuka simo lesimatima setemnotfo kanye simondzawo setimali letiphatselene nahulumende, lokwabiwa kwetimali lokuphakanyisiwe kubeka embili tindleko leticondzene netinhlelo tekutfutfukisa tenhlalo letisekela imfundvo lesisekelo, temphilo, tenhlalakahle, emanti kuhanjiswa kwekungcola ngemanti kanye nagezi.

src: Sena se tlosa ditjhaba ho tloha ho hoba dihwai tsa malapa a bona hore ebe dihwai tsa kgwebo le beng ba dikgwebo mekgahlelong e fapaneng ya matsete a lefatshe la bona.4 Mmuso o ikemiseditse ho tshehetsa boteng ba dikgwebo tse thuthuhang tsa temo, ho akgang diprojeke tse 262 tse amanang le phetolo ya lefatshe ho fa batjha le basadi molemo diporofenseng tsohle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayemukela imiphumela yeNgcungcutsela yaMengameli Yetemphilo lenhlose kulungisa tinsayeysa letahlukahlukene luhlelo lwahulumende lwetemphilo lolubukene nato.

src: Tshenyo ya disebediswa tsa setjhaba Kabinete e hlahisitse ngongoreho mabapi le tshenyo ya disebediswa tsa dipalangwang.
tgt: Letincumo letitawutsatfwa kuleNgcungcutsela titawucinisa emalungiselelo ekucala kusebenta kweMshwalensi weteMphilo waVelonkhe (i-NHI).

src: Sena se nyotobetsa boitlamo ba mmuso ba ho isa ditshebeletso ho ditjhaba tse neng di sotlehileng nakong ya kgale.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kucala kwekusebenta kwekubuyeketwa kwemhlaba kanye netinhlelo tekubuyisela kwawo kubanikati ngekulungisa umonakalo wesikhatsi lesengcile nekusita kutsi kukhule umnotfo.

src: Leha batho ba ka se kgotsofale ka tsela e kgolo, ha baa lokela ho senya thepa ya setjhaba.
tgt: Mengameli Cyril Ramaphosa bekahola umcimbi wekubuyiselwa kwemhlaba kubanikati, lapho emahektha langetulu kwala-4 586 emhlaba lanikwe ummango waKaMkwanazi eMpangeni, KwaZulu-Natal.

src: Tshenyo ena e hlokisa batho ba sotlehileng ditshebeletso tseo ba di hlokang e le kannete.2 Kabinete e kopa ditho tsa setjhaba hore di be sedi mme di sebetse mmoho le ditheo tsa molao hore ba ikarabellang diketsong tsena ba tshwarwe.
tgt: Ummango waKaMkwanazi utawuphindza futsi utfole tibonelelo letitfolakala emuva kwekunikwa umhlaba kanye nekwesekelwa lokutawubasita kutsi basebentise ngalokusezingeni lelisetulu emandla alomhlaba.

src: Kabinete e boetse e lemohile hore Sehlopha sa Toka, Thibelo ya Botlokotsebe le Tshireletso se tla sebetsana le taba ena ka nepo.
tgt: Loku kuyindlela yekutsi imimango isuke ekubeni balimi labalimela kutondla nje bona kodvwa balimele kutsengisa njengebanikati bemabhizinisi kuto tonkhe tinchubo tekukhicita ngalomhlaba wabo.

src: Tshebetso ya ho thonya Molaodi wa Botjhotjhisi ba Naha (NDPP)5.1 Kabinete e amohetse tsela e ntjha ya ho thonya NDPMopresidente Ramaphosa o thontse Sehlopha sa Keletso ho thonya batho ba tshwanelehang le ho tshwara dikopano tsa dipotso tsa mosebetsi le bona ho bona haeba ba tshwaneleha ho ka palama setulo sa Hlooho ya Bolaodi ba Botjhotjhisi ba Naha.
tgt: Hulumende utinikele kutsi asekele kusimama kwemabhizinisi etekulima lasafufusa, lokufaka ekhatsi imiklamo lenge-262 lehambisana nekubuyeketwa kwemhlaba kute kuzuze lusha nabomake kuto tonkhe tifundza.

src: Ditho tsa setjhaba di koptjwa ho ithuta kahlolo ena kaha tshebediso ya matekwane sebakeng sa setjhaba e thibetswe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise kukhatsateka kwayo mayelana nekonelwa phasi kwesakhiwonchanti setekutfutsa.

src: Mme ho feta moo, kahlolo ena ha e ya kenya thekiso ya matekwane molaong.2 Kabinete e ananela hore kahlolo eo e itsheheditse ka melao e meng e kannang ya sebediswa mabapi le ho sebediswa, ho tshwara le ho lema matekwane.
tgt: Loku kubuyisela emuva kutinikela kwahulumende ekuletseni tinsita emimangweni lebeyinganakwa phambilini.

src: Kopano ya Polokeho Dikolong.1 Kabinete e amohela Kopano ya Polokeho Dikolong e sa tswa tshwarwa tlasa boetapele ba Letona la Thuto ya Motheo Angie Motshekga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela sive kutsi sicaphele futsi sisebentisane nema-ejensi lacinisekisa kugcinwa kwemtsetfo kute kutsi labo labenta loko baboshwe.

src: Kopano e kopantse baamehi ba thuto le ba ditaba tsa kantle hore ba fumane ditharollo ditabeng tsa tshireletso tseo dikolo di tobaneng le tsona, le ho fumana tsela ya ho ba le dikolo tse bolokehileng ho feta.2 Sena se latela diketsahalo tsa dikgoka dikolong tse itseng, ho kenyelletswa le lefu le sehlooho la titjhere e dilemo di 24, Monghadi Gadimang Daniel Mokolobate, ya hlabilweng ka thipa ke moithuti Sekolong sa Sekhondari sa Ramotshere ho la Zeerust, Leboya Bophirima.3 Baamehi bohle ba dumellane hore dikgoka ka kakaretso, le dikolong ka ho qolleha, ha di a amoheleha mme ho hlokeha tshebedisanommoho e eketsehileng ho netefatsa hore dikolo eba dibaka tse bolokehileng bakeng sa baithuti hammoho le matitjhere.
tgt: IKhabhinethi, iyakucaphela futsi kutsi Iklasta yeBulungiswa Yetekuvikela Bugebengu netekuPhepha itawubukana naloludzaba ngendlela lefanele.

src: Dihlahlobo tsa Matriki Kabinete e lakalletsa baithuti bohle, haholo baithuti ba Kereiti ya 12, mahlohonolo nakong ena.
tgt: Inchubo yekubekwa esikhundleni kweMcondzisi weMkandlu Wetebushushisi Wavelonkhe (i-NDPP) IKhabhinethi iyemukele lendlela lensha yekubekwa esikhundleni kwe-NDPMengameli Ramaphosa ukhetse Iphaneli Yekweluleka kutsi ibone iphindze futsi ibambe ingcoco yeluhlolokhono nalabo bantfu lababonakala bafanele kutsi batsatse lesikhundla sekuba yiNhloko yeMkandlu Wetebushushisi Wavelonkhe (i-NPA).

src: Ka lekgetlo la pele, selemong sena lefapha le boetse le tla tsamaisa tlhahlobo ka Puo ya Matsoho ya Aforika Borwa boemong ba Puo ya Lapeng bakeng sa baithuti ba 58 ba sa kgoneng ho utlwa dikolong tse Ditlhahlobo tsena di tla nka dibeke tse hlano le halofo mme ho tla qetwa ho ngolwa ka la 28 Pudungwana.2 Baithuti naheng ka bophara ba boetse ba tla tekena boitlamo ba boikgethelo ho itlamela ho netefatsa seriti sa ditlhahlobo ka ho se nke karolo diketsong dife kapa dife tse mpe.
tgt: Lephaneli ibambe umhlangano wayo kwekucala kuleliviki kantsi ilindzeleke kutsi ingenise kuMengameli emagama alabo labahlungiwe mhla ti-07 Ingongoni Sijubo seNkantolo yeMtsetfosisekelo.1 IKhabhinethi icocile ngeSijubo seNkantolo yeMtsetfosisekelo lesimayelana nekusebentisa, kulima kanye nekuphatsa insangu kwemuntfu lomdzala ngasese kuti atisebentisele yena ngekwakhe kanye nelifutse lalesijubo.

src: Batswadi le bahlokomedi ba kgothalletswa ho tshehetsa baithuti nakong ena e bohlokwahadi leetong la bona la thuto.
tgt: Emalunga emmango acelwa kutsi asifundze kahle lesijubo ngobe kusetjentiswa kwensangu endzaweni yemmango akukavunyelwa.

src: Diqeto tsa Kabinete Kabinete e amohetse phatlalatso ya Dibaka tsa Mawatle tse Sireleditsweng (di-MPA) tse 20 jwalo ka karolo ya Operation Phakisa: Netweke ya Baemedi ba Moruo wa Mawatle wa di-MPA.
tgt: Kwengeta kuloko, lesijubo asizange sisho kutsi akusasilo licala kutsengisa insangu.2 IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kutsi lesijubo sibekwe ngekubuka leminye imitsetfo lengalandzelwa macondzana nekusetjentiswa, kuphatsa kanye nekulima insangu.

src: Kabinete e amohetse Lenaneo la Bobedi la Tshebetso (NAP) la Aforika Borwa le Shebilweng Botjha le ho Matahanngwa ho Lwantsha Ketso ya Mahwatata, Tshenyeho ya Lefatshe le ho Lwantsha Dikamo tsa Komello (2018-2030).
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayemukela leNgcungcutsela yeKuphepha eTikolweni lesandza kubakhona lebeyiholwa yiNdvuna yeTemfundvo Lesisekelo Angie Motshekga.

src: NAP e ikemiseditse ho kenya letsoho tshireletsong le tshebedisong ya nako e telele ya lefatshe la rona le dihlodilweng tse ding tsa naha.
tgt: Lengcungcutsela ihlangise ndzawonye betemfundvo kanye nalabatsintsekako bangephandle kute kutfolwe likhambi lelicondzene netindzaba tekuphepha tikolo talelive letibukene nato kanye nekuhlahla indlela leya embili yekwenta kutsi kube nekuphepha etikolweni.

src: Ho latela Seratswana sa 9 sa tumellano, baamehi ba hloka ho hlahisa, ho lokisa le ho kenya tshebetsong NAP jwalo ka karolo e bohareng ya moralo wa ho lwantsha tlhaho ya mahwatata le ho thibela dikamo tsa komello.
tgt: Bonkhe labatsintsekako bavumelene ngekutsi budlova nje jikelele, kodvwa kakhulu etikolweni, abemukeleki nekutsi kudzinga kutsi kubanjisanwe kucinisekisa kutsi tikolo tibayindzawo lephephile yebafundzi nabothishela.

src: Aforika Borwa e hlahisitse NAP ya yona ya pele ka 2004.Dibili.
tgt: Luhlolo lwamatekuletjeni IKhabhinethi ibafisela lokuhle bonkhe bafundzi, ikakhulu labo labafundza Libanga le-12, ngalesikhatsi.

src: Kabinete e amohetse phatlalatso ya Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Bana ho Kasete ya Mmuso bakeng sa maikutlo a setjhaba.
tgt: Kutawuba kwekucala kutsi, litiko kulomnyaka libhalise luhlolo lweLulwimi lwaseNingizimu Afrika lweTimphawu (i-SASL) ezingeni leLulwimi lwaseKhaya bafundzi labange-58 labangeva etindlebeni labasetikolweni letili-10.

src: Bili ena e labalabela ho matlafatsa kgokahano ya sistimi ya tlhokomelo ya bana le tshireletso ka tshebedisanommoho ya mafapha le makala.
tgt: Bafundzi kulolonkhe lelive batawusayina ngekutsandza sibopho nome sifungo sekwetsemba ngesikhatsi seluhlolo ngekutsi bangatimbandzakanyi kunome ngabe ngusiphi sento sekungatiphatsi kahle.

src: Ditokiso tsena di arabela Kahlolo ya Lekgotla le Phahameng la Gauteng Leboya ya Pudungwana 2017, moo teng Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba le laetsweng ho lokisa le ho tsebisa ditokiso tse hlokehang ho Molao wa Bana, 2005 (Molao 38 wa 2005) mabapi le tharollo ya semolao ya tsamaiso ya sistimi ya tlhokomelo ya bana ba sa nkwang semolao.
tgt: Batali nebondli bebantfwana bayagcugcutelwa kutsi basekele bafundzi ngalesikhatsi sabo lesimcoka eluhambeni lwabo lwetemfundvo.

src: Kabinete e amohela tsebiso ya Bili ya Tokiso ya Ditshebeletso tsa Poso ho Palamente.
tgt: Kubalulekile futsi bakhutsatwe bafundzi kutsi basicedze sikolo singabashipheli.

src: Bili e kenya tshebetsong Molawana o sisintsweng wa Pholisi e Kopaneng ya Naha ya ICT o ammohetsweng ke Kabinete ka Lwetse 2016.Diphetho tse rerilweng di tla etsa hore ho be le Ofisi ya Ditshebeletso tsa Poso ya Aforika Borwa e hlodisanang, e sebetsang hape e tshwarelletseng e fanang ka/e tsamaisang ditshebeletso tsohle le phihlello hammoho le phetoho ya lekala la diposo.
