tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kumenyetelwa ngalokusemtsetfweni kweTindzawo taseLwandle Letinge-20 Letivikelekile (ema-MPA) njengencenye ye-Operation Phakisa: Luhlakamsebenti Lolumelele ema-MPA eMnotfo waseLwandle.

src: Bili e boetse e fana hape le ka matla a ho fana ka diaterese tsa bodulo ho ditjhaba tsa mahaeng le tse dulang metseng ya marena.
tgt: Inzuzo yalokukhetfwa, kutsi, emkhatsini waletinye tintfo, kutawuvumela kutsi kube nentfutfuko kutekuvakasha letivikela imvelo kanye nekukhutsata kutsi kufinyeleleke kumitfombolusito lelawulekako lesimeme yetinhlanti letisilinganiso lesincane.

src: Bili e se e fetile mokgahlelo wa tshekatsheko ke setjhaba.
tgt: Lokukhetfwa lokuphakanyisiwe kuta ngemuva kwekukhulumisana emkhatsini walabatsintsekako labafanele.

src: Diketsahalo tse Tlang Kopano ya Matsete ya Matjhaba ya Aforika BorwaMopresidente Ramaphosa ka Labohlano, 26 Mphalane 2018, o tla tsamaisa Kopano ya Matsete ya pele ya Aforika Borwa e tla tshwarelwa Sandton Convention Centre ho la Johannesburg.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iluvumile Luhlelo lweKwenta lwaVelonkhe (i-NAP) lweSibili Lolubuyeketiwe Lacondzaniswa lwaseNingizimu Afrika lweKulwa neBugwadvule, Kwehla kweMandla eMhlaba ekuKhicita kanye nekuNciphisa Imitselela Lemibi yeSomiso (2018-2030).

src: Ena ke karolo ya diteko tse kopaneng tsa ho hohela ditsetelo le ho hodisa moruo wa rona.
tgt: Le-NAP ihlose kufaka ligalelo ekongeni kanye nasekusetjenytisweni ngendlela lesimeme kwemhlaba wetfu kanye naleminye imitfombolusito yemvelo.

src: Batsetedi ba Jeremane ba tla hlahisa diprojeke tsa bohlokwa tse di ntseng di tswelapele Dinaheng tsa CwA le ho batla menyetla e meng kontinenteng.
tgt: Ngekulandzela iSigaba se-9 salesivumelwane, emave alindzeleke kutsi asungule futsi acale kusebentisa i-NAP njengencenye lemcoka yendlelalisu lekulwa nebugwadvule nekunciphisa imitselela yesomiso.

src: Mopresidente o tla ya kopanong ka boemo ba Modulasetulo-mmoho wa Sehlopha sa Aforika sa Keletso sa G. Kopano ya G20 e mabapi le CwA e tla shebane le ditsela tseo ka tsona G20, dinaha tsa Aforika le ditsi tsa ntshetsopele di ka sebetsang mmoho ho phahamisa tsetelo ya poraefete le bonkakarolo ba moruo dinaheng tsa Aforika.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika yasungula i-NAP yayo yekucala nga-2004.Imitsetfosivivinyo.

src: Kopano e boetse e tla etsa hape le mosebetsi wa boitokiso lekaleng lena bakeng sa Kopano ya G20 e tla tshwarwa ho la Buenos Aires, Argentina.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kuGazethi yaHulumende kweMtsetfosivivinyo wekuChibela Letiphatselene neBantfwana kutsi ummango uphawule ngawo.

src: Beke ya Tsepamiso ya Imbizo ya Naha Ditho tsa Phethahatso di tla nka karolo lenaneong la GCIS la Beke ya borobong ya Tsepamiso ya Imbizo ya Naha ya tsamaiso ya bohlano ya demokrasi, e tla qala ka la 12 ho isa la 25 Pudungwana 2018.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uhlose kucinisa kusebentisana emkhatsini kwekunakekela bantfwana kanye neluhlelo lwekubavikela ngekusebentisa kuhlanganisa kusebentisana emkhatsini wematiko nemikhakha.

src: Sena se etsahala ka nako e tshwanang le Beke ya Tlaleho ya Lenaneo la Tshebetso la Kabinete.
tgt: Letichibelo tiphendvula Sijubo seNkantolo Lephakeme yaseNyakatfo Gauteng sangaLweti 2017, lapho Litiko Letekutfutfukiswa Kwetenhlalakahle layalwa kutsi lilungise liphindze letfule tichibelo letidzingekile eMtsetfweni weBantfwana, wanga-2005 (Umtsetfo Longunombolo ye-38 wanga-2005) acondzana nekulawulwa kweluhlelo lwekukhuliswa kwemntfwana ngumuntfu longasuye umtali.

src: Beke ya Tsepamiso ya Imbizo e tla fana ka monyetla wa hore ditho tsa Phethahatso ya Naha, hammoho le baetapele ba mmuso ba porofense le ba lehae ho tshware dikopano tsa setjhaba le di-Izimbizo naheng ka bophara, nakong ena, ho bontshahatsa ho kenngwa tshebetso ke mmuso ha Moralo wa Thero wa Nako e Bohareng wa 2014-2019 le ho arabela ditaba tse hlahiswang ke baahi, tse amang polokeho, kgolo le ntshetsopele ya ditjhaba.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo utawunika emandla Inchubomgomo Lehlongotwako yaVelonkhe yeThekhinoloji Yelwati Lwetekuchumana (i-ICT) leHlanganisiwe leyavunywa yiKhabhinethi ngeNyoni 2016.

src: Dibeke tsena tse pedi tsa dipontsho di etsahala hara diketekelo tsa dilemokgolo tsa bahale ba ntwa ya kgethollo e leng Mama Albertina Sisulu le Tata Nelson Mandela, bao bobedi ba neng ba dumela ka matla ho dipuisano le dikopano tsa kgafetsa le ditjhaba tseo ba di sebeletsang.
tgt: Imiphumela lehlosiwe kutsi kube neLiposi laseNingizimu Afrika lelikhona kuchudzelana, lelisebentako nalelisimeme leliletsa tinsita letibanti lelinekufinyeleleka kanye nekuntjintja kwemkhakha wetemaposi.

src: MelaetsaDitebohiso Kabinete e lebohisa Letona la Bophelo bo Botle, Ngaka Aaron Motsoaledi, ya fumaneng dikgau tse pedi tsa bohlokwa tsa Kochon, moketeng wa dikgau o neng o tshwaretswe The Hague, ho la Netherlands.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo futsi wenta kutsi kube nendlela yekunika imimango yasetindzaweni tasemaphandleni neyendzabuko emakheli.

src: Kgau ya pele ya Letona e ka boemo ba hae bakeng sa mosebetsi le boetapele ba hae ba dipolotiki twantshong ya lefuba (TB) lefatsheng ka bophara.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo sekuvele kuboniswene ngawo nemmango.

src: Kgau ya bobedi, eo Letona le tla e arolelana le Mohlomphehi Monghadi Nick Hebert, Setho sa Palamente (MP) ho la United Kingdom, e tla ba boemong ba bona jwalo ka badulasetulo ba Kopano ya Lefatshe ya TB ya di-MP ho tswa lefatsheng lohle.
tgt: Ikhomfa yaseNingizimu Afrika yeMave eMhlaba yeLutjalotimaliMengameli Ramaphosa ngaLesihlanu, mhla tinge-26 Imphala 2018, utawube angusihlalo wekuvulwa kweKhomfa yekucala yaseNingizimu Afrika yeLutjalotimali lapha eSandton Convention Centre eJozi.

src: Kgau ya Kochon e fanwa selemo le selemo ho batho le/kapa mekgatlo e kentse letsoho ka tsela e kgolo twantshong ya TB ekaba dinaheng tsa bo bona kapa lefatsheng ka bophara.
tgt: Loku kuyincenye yemitamo lehlangisiwe yekuheha batjalitimali kanye nekukhulisa umnotfo wetfu.

src: Kabinete a amohela Dikgau tsa Maeto a Lefatshe 2018 tse kgethileng Aforika Borwa jwalo ka Sebaka se Tswang pele sa Ketelo mona Aforika.
tgt: Kwengeta, labane labamelele lutjalotimali labakhetfwe nguMengameli batakwetfula umbiko kulekhomfa mayelana nenchubekelembili leyentekile.

src: Durban ho la KwaZulu-Natal e boetse e ananetswe jwalo ka Motseteropo o Tswang pele wa Ketelo Aforika mme wa hape le sehlooho sa bohlokwa sa Boemakepe bo Tswang pele ba Dikepe tsa Maeto ho la Aforika.
tgt: Ingcungcutsela yeMave Langemashumi Lamabili (i-G20) Mengameli Ramaphosa umenywe nguNdvunankulu waseGermany, Dkt.

src: Motse Kapa, ho la Kapa Bophirima yona e hapile kgau ya Sebaka se Tswang pele sa Mekete le Diketsahalo Aforika.
tgt: Angela Merkel, kutsi abemdzibi munye eNgcungcutseleni ye-G20 Yelutjalotimali – emabhizinisi aseGermany nemave angemalunga eSivumelwano ne-Afrika (i-CwA), kanye neNkhulumiswano yeteMabhizinisi, kokubili kutawubanjelwa eBerlin, eGermany mhla tinge-30 Imphala 2018.LeNgcungcutsela Ye-G20 Yelutjalotimali itawuhlanganisa ndzawonye emabhizinisi aseGermany kanye neMave angemalunga e-CwA kute ahlwaye ematfuba elutjalotimali ngaphasi kweluhlakamsebenti lweBudlelwane be-G20 ne-Afrika.

src: Filimi ena e buwang ka botlokotsebe e thehetsweng sebakeng sa Cape Flats e tsheheditswe ka ditjhelete ke Lefapha la Kgwebo le Indasteri ka morero wa lona wa Kgokelo ya Baetsi ba Difilimi ba Thuthuhang ba Batsho ba Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Batjalitimali baseGermany batakwetfula imiklamo lesezingeni lelisetulu kwanyalo leyentiwa eMaveni angemalunga e-CwA kanye nekuhlwaya ematfuba kulelivekati.

src: Sena se tla kenya letsoho ho hoheleng tsetelo e tswang kantle e otlolohileng ho indasteri ya difilimi ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Mengameli utahambela leNgcungcutsela ngemandla esikhundla sekuba nguSihlalo Ngekuhlanganyela weLicembu Lekweluleka lase-Afrika le-LeNgcungcutsela ye-G20 itawugcila etindleleni i-G20, emave ase-Afrika kanye netikhungo tentfutfuko letingasebentisana ngato ngekubambisana ekuheheni lutjalotimali lomkhakha lotimele kanye nekutimbandzakanya kutemnotfo wemave ase-Afrika.

src: Matshediso Kabinete hammoho le Mopresidente Ramaphosa ba fetisitse tlhomoho le matshediso:19.1 bakeng sa ho feta ha batho ba fetang 27, kotsing ya makoloi a mangata mmileng wa N1 Leboya ho la Limpopo.
tgt: Lomhlangano utawuphindza futsi wente emalungiselelo eNgcungcutsela ye-G20 letawubaseBuenos Aires, e-Argentina.

src: Basebedisi ba mebila ba kgothaletswa ho ba sedi mebileng ya rona le ho netefatsa hore ba latela melao ya tsela ka dinako tsohle.2 bakeng sa ho feta ha molwanedi wa tokoloho, Mama Agnes Msimang.
tgt: Liviki laVelonkhe Lekugcila Kutimbizo Emalunga eSigungu (iKhabhinethi) atawukutimbandzakanya kuLiviki laVelonkhe Le-9 Lekugcila Kutimbizo leLuphiko Lwahulumende Lwetekuchumana Netekwatisa (i-GCIS) lwalohulumende watsatsa lulawulo nga-2014, lelitawuba mhla ti-12 kuya mhla tinge-25 Lweti 2018.

src: Mama Msimang ene e le molwanedi ya itlammeng wa ditaba tsa bong hape e le Motlatsi wa Mehleng wa Mopresidente wa Mokgatlo wa Basadi wa African National Congress (ANCWL).
tgt: Lamaviki lamabili etimbizo enteka ngemuva kwemigubho yelikhulu leminyaka yemachawe eMzabalazo, Make Albertina Sisulu naBabe Nelson Mandela, bobabili bayinkhomba yekukhombisa kubaluleka kwekubonisana ngaso sonkhe sikhatsi kanye nekucocisana nemimango lebebayisebentela.

src: E ne e le e mong wa basadi ba bangata ba ileng ba etella pele ditjhaba Aforika Borwa ho pota kgahlano le puso ya kgethollo.
tgt: Aaron Motsoaledi, lozuze imiklomelo lemibili ye-Kochon, emcimbini wekunikwa lowo mklomelo lobewubanjelwe eThe Hague, eThe Netherlands.

src: Tshebeletso ya lepato e tla qala ka 08:00 kerekeng ya Our Lady of Cedars Catholic Church e Woodmead, Johannesburg.3 bakeng sa ho feta ha molwanedi wa tokoloho le moamohedi wa Kgau ya Naha ya Mendi bakeng sa Sebete ka Silifere, Monghadi Eric “Stalin” Mtshali.4 bakeng sa ho feta ha mohale wa ANC Moss Chikane.
tgt: Umklomelo wesibili, Indvuna itakwabelana nawo neMhlonishwa Nick Hebert, Lilunga lePhalamende (i-MP) lase-United Kingdom, ngetikhundla tabo tekuba bosihlalo ngekuhlanganyela be-Global TB Caucus yeMalunga ePhalamende emhlaba wonkhe.

src: Monghadi Chikane e bile MP ka 1994 kamora dikgetho tsa pele tsa naha tsa demokrasi.
tgt: Lomklomelo we-Kochon uklonyeliswa njalo ngemnyaka kulabo bantfu nome netinhlangano letibe negalelo lelimcoka ekulweni ne-TB emaveni ato nome emhlabeni wonkhe.

src: Ka 2005, o ile a thongwa jwalo ka Moambasadara wa Aforika Borwa ho la Jeremane.5 bakeng sa batho ba Sweden hammoho le balelapa la Mofumahatsana Lisbet Palme‚ 87‚ ya seng a fetile.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawemukela umcimbi wanga-2018 wemiklomelo yemhlaba yetekuvakasha, i-World Travel Awards 2018, lovotele live laseNingizimu Afrika njengeNdzawo Lephuma Embili e-Afrika longaya kuyo.

src: Mofumahatsana Palme e ne e le mohlolohadi wa Tonakgolo ya mehleng ya Sweden Olof Palme ya ileng a bolawa ka 1986 mme eo Mopresidente Ramaphosa a mo hlalositseng jwalo ka “Motswalle wa Aforika Borwa”.
tgt: IDurban leKwaZulu-Natal iphindze futsi yatiswa njengeLidolobhakati Leliphuma eMbili e-Afrika longaya kulo futsi latfola ligama lelihle lekuba yi-Leading Cruise Port e-Afrika.

src: DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di lokela ho netefatswa ka mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang.
tgt: IKapa eNshonalanga Kapa yona itfole ligama lekuPhuma Embili e-Afrika kuteMicimbi neMigubho.

src: Boto ya SENTECH SOC LIMITED:a. Mofumahatsana Maureen Makole Manyama (molaodi eo eseng wa phethahatso) leb.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kuboniswa e-United States mhla ti-02 Lweti 2018 kwelifilimu lalelive lelinesihloko lesitsi Nommer 37 lomkhiphi wemafilimu Joshua Bradley.

src: Mofumahatsana Precious Nompumelelo Sibiya (molaodi eo eseng wa phethahatso).
tgt: Lelifilimu lebugebengu lelivusa lusikisiki litsetjulelwe eCape Flats lisekelwe ngetimali Litiko Letekuhwebelana Netetimboni ngekusebentisa sikimu sekukhutsata bakhiphi bemafilimu labamnyama baseNingizimu Afrika labasafufusa, i-South African Emerging Black Filmmakers Incentive Scheme.

src: Ho thongwa-botjha ha Mofumahatsana Gugulethu Brightness Nokukhanya (Poppy) Khoza jwalo ka Molaodi: Difofane tsa Setjhaba wa Boto ya Aforika Borwa ya Setheo sa Difofane tsa Setjhaba.
tgt: Loku kutawuba neligalelo ekuheheni lutjalotimali loluvela emaveni angephandle kutsi lungene ngco embonini yemafilimu yaseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro, 7 Pudungwana 2018, Tuynhuys e Motse Kapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlangene ngaLesitsatfu, mhla ti-7 Lweti 2018 eTuynhuys eKapa.

src: Dintlha tsa Ha jwale Seboka sa Boporesidente se Kgahlano le Dikgola le Dipolao tsa Basadi Kabinete e amohela katleho ya dipuisano tsa Seboka sa boMoporesidente se Kgahlano le Dikgoka tsa bong le Dipolao tsa Basadi se tshwerweng ka la 01 le 02 Pudungwana 2018.
tgt: Ingcungcutsela Lephatselene Nekuhlukunyetwa Ngekwebulili Nekubulawa Kwalabasikati IKhabhinethi yamukela letingcogco letibe yimphumelelo teNgcungcutsela Lephatselene Nekuhlukunyetwa Ngekwebulili Nekubulawa Kwalabasikati lebeyibanjwe mhla lu-01 kuya kumhla ti-02 kuLweti.

src: Seboka se netefaditse potlako ya ho theha tumellano ka ho shebana le qaka ya dikgoka tsa bong, kgethollo e kgahlano le basadi le diphapano tsa bong.
tgt: Lengcungcutsela icinisekise lokuphutfuma bekwakhiwa kwesivumelwano sekubuketana naletikhinga tekuhlukunyetwa ngekwebulili, kucwaswa kwabomake nekungalingani ngekwebulili.

src: Mmuso o tjhaetse monwana ho hlahlobisa meralo ya naha ya hofedisa dikgoka tsa bong le ntshetsopele ya Moralo wa Tshebetso wa Naha wa ho lwantsha dikgoka tsa bong.
tgt: Hulumende uvumile kubuyeketa tinhlelo tavelonkhe kute kucedvwe kuhlukunyetwa ngekwebulili kanye nekubhalwa Kweluhlelo Lwekusebenta Lavelonkhe lekuhlukunyetwa ngekwebulili.

src: O tswella ho itlama ho sebetsa le bohle ba nang le seabo ho netefatsa hore re fedisa maemo a dikgoka tsa bong ka sekgahla – mme qetellong re di fedise ka botlalo.
tgt: Utawuchubeka nekuba yincenye yekwenta umsebenti nabo bonkhe labatsintsekako kucinisekisa kwekutsi sehlisa emazinga ekuhlukunyetwa ngekwebulili kantsi kubuye kupheliswe ngalokugcwele.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAfrika Borwa ho sebedisana mmoho ho fetola motheo wa maitshwaro, ditlwaelo le ditheho ho fedisa dikgoka tse kgahlano le basadi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi basebente ndzawonye kute bacale bagucule indlela yekwenta, kusebenta netikhungo letitawucedza kuhlukunyetwa kwalabasikati.

src: Letsete.
tgt: Lutjalomali.

src: Kabinete e amohela katleho ya Seboka sa Letsete se ileng sa nka sebaka ka Mphalane mane Sandton, Johannesburg.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamukela leKhomfa Yelutjalomali lebeyimphumelelo lebeyibanjwe ngenyanga yeMphala eSandton, eJozi.

src: Seboka sena sa Letsete se entse hore Afrika Borwa e kgone ho bokella ditshepiso tsa boitlamo ba ho tsetella R290 bilione mekgahlelong e fapaneng ya moruo.
tgt: LeKhomfa Yelutjalomali yente kwekutsi iNingizimu Afrika yetsenjiswe ngemali yekusisa letigidzigidziletinge-R290 yimikhakha leyehlukene yemnotfo.

src: Sena ke hodima ditshepiso tsa boitlamo ba ho tsetela tjhelete e fetang R400 bilione tse ileng tsa fumanwa nakong ya letsholo la letsete ka baemedi ba ikgethileng le ho tswa dinaheng tse fapaneng nakong ya maeto a mmuso.
tgt: Loku kungeta kulemali lengetulu kwetigidzigidzi letinge-R400 iNingizimu Afrika lebeyetsenjiswe ngayo ngemave lahlukene ngalesikhatsi avakashelwe mancusa elutjalomali.

src: Ho ne ho le barumuwa ba fetang 1 000 ba neng ba le teng Sebokeng sena, ho tswa dinaheng tse Meya le maikutlo e ne e le ya lethabo mme le naha ya bontshahatsa menyetla ya letsete le boiteko ba maano a thusang ho theha tikoloho e dumellang letsete.
tgt: Lekhomfa bewuhanjelwe tihambeli letingetulu kwa-1 000, letivela emaveni lange-35.

src: Kabinete e lebohisa sehlopha se sebeditseng Sebokeng sena mme e thabetse ho fumantshwa dipehelo tsa ka mehla ka ho phethahatsa boitlamo bo entsweng.
tgt: Umoya nenjabulo bekunyukile kantsi lakuleli likhangise ngematfuba lamasha ekusisa netinchubomgomo letisita kwakha simo lesilungele kusisa.

src: Jwalo ka ha Afrika Borwa le Afrika ka kakaretso di tswela ho phahamisa moruo wa kontinente, Kabinete e boela e amohela tlhomamiso ya Foramo ya Letsete ya Africa, le ntseng le nka sebaka ho fihlela ka la 09 Pudungwana 2018, Johannesburg.
tgt: Njengobe iNingizimu Afrika kanye ne-Afrika yonkhana bayachubeka kuhamba ngendlela lephakeme leholela ekukhuliseni umnotfo walelivekati, IKhabhinethi ibuye yamukele lokuvulwa kweNgcungcutsela Yelutjalomali yase-Afrika yekucala, lekwanyalo isachubeka kudzimate kube ngamhla ti--9 Lweti, eJozi.

src: Foramo ya Letsete ya Afrika e tshwerwe ke Banka ya Ntshetsopele ya Afrika.
tgt: LeNgcungcutsela Yelutjalomali yase-Afrika ihlelwe Libhange Lentfutfuko e-Afrika (i-African Development Bank).

src: E ikemiseditse ho aha katleho ka ho tlisa mmoho batsetedi ba makala a mmuso le a poraefete ho rala tsela e ntjha ya kgolo molemong wa Kontinente ya Afrika yohle.
tgt: Ihlose kwakhela emphumelelweni leseyivele ikhona ngekutsi ihlanganise ndzawonye basisi bemikhakha yangasese nahulumende kute basungule indlela lensha lekukhulisa umnotfo e-Afrika yonkhana.

src: Seboka sa G20 sa Afrika se neng se tshwerwe ha mmamorao tjena se tswella ho matlafatsa kgonahalo ya kgolo ka boitlamo bo fapaneng bo phahamisang letsete la poraefete le ho ba le seabo morung wa dinaha tsa Afrika jwalo ka karolo ya Mokgatlo wa Tumellano le Boiteko ba Afrika.
tgt: LoMhlangano we-G20 wase-Afrika losandza kubanjwa uchubeke nekusimamisa kukhula kwemnotfo wetfu ngekusebentisa kungenelela lokuhlukene lokube khona lokutfutfukisa kusisa kwabosomabhizinisi bangasese nekungenelela kumnotfo emaveni ase-Afrika njengencenye yeSivumelwano ne-Afrika (i-CwA).

src: Mokgatlo wa Tumellano le Boiteko ba Afrika e dulwasetulong ka kopanelo ke Afrika Borwa le Jeremane ka Sehlopha sa Dikeletso sa Afrika.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika ingusihlalo we-CwA ngekuhlanganyela neGermany ngenca Yelicembu Lekweluleka lase-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e ile ya boela e amohela ho bulwa ha Paka ya Indasteri ya Phuthaditjhaba e boleng ba R50 milione Foreistata e tla phahamisa tshebetso ya diindasteri le ho theha mesebetsi ya lehae le kgolo porofenseng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphindze yamukela Phuthaditjhaba Industrial Park lebite imali letigizi letinge-R50 lesandza kwetfulwa esifundzeni saseFreyistata letawutfutfukisa inchubekela phambili nekwakhiwa kwematfuba emisebenti yakuleli nekukhula kwemnotfo kulesa sifundza.

src: Kabinete e dumela hore bonamodi bona qetellong bo tla qala ho fokotsa diphephetso tsa tlhokeho ya mesebetsi tse tobaneng le naha, ka ho tsoseletsa moya wa tshepo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inelitsemba lekutsi lokungenelela kutawucala kwehlisa letinkhinga tekuswelakala kwemsebenti lelive letibuketane nato, nekubhebhetsekisa umoya lomusha lonelitsemba.

src: Theho ya Mesebetsi.
tgt: Kwakhiwa kwematfuba emsebenti.

src: Mmuso o tiisa boiteko ba ho theha mesebetsi e meng e mengata molemong wa batjha le maAfrika Borwa ka kakaretso, o tsipamisitse maikutlo meruong ya makeisheneng le mahaheng, le dikgwebong tsa basadi le batjha bao hangata e leng bona ba sotlwang ke diphephetso tsa maemo a moruo.
tgt: Hulumende uyangenelela ngekunyusa imitamo yekwakha ematfuba emsebenti kulusha nebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika yonkhana, kugcilwe emadolobheni nasemakhaya, kanye nemabhizinisi abomake nelusha lebavame kutfwala lomtfwalo wekubuketana netinselele letiphatselene nemnotfo.

src: Kabinete e tshepa hore mekgwa ena ya pakana ya ho hlaphohela, e tla kenya R50 bilione ho makala a bohlokwa a jwalo ka a temothuo, moralo wa setjhaba, meruo ya makeishaneng le mahaheng, e tla nehelana ka matla a hlokehang ho theha mesebetsi le ho thusa ho tlhaphohelo ya moruo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inelitsemba kwekutsi loluhlelo lwemvusamnotfo, lolutawungenisa imali lemabhiliyoni lange-R50 kumikhakha lebalulekile njengetekulima, tinsitanchanti tahulumende, iminotfo yemadolobha neyasemakhaya, lutawuletsa kukhutsata lokufanele kwekwakha ematfuba emsebenti nekutfola umnotfo losimeme.

src: Sena se eketsa diphetho tse phethahetseng tsa Seboka sa Mesebetsi moo mmuso, dikgwebo le basebetsi ba ileng ba itlama ho: reka dihlahiswa tsa lehae, ho kenya mekgwa e tsitlallelang ho eketsa diromelwakantle bonamodi tsamaisong ya boleng ba temothuo le tshehetso ya dikgwebo tse nyane le tse bohareng ho phahamisa mesebetsi.
tgt: Loku kungeta kulemiphumela lebonakalako yaleNgcungcutsela Yemisebenti lapho hulumende, emabhizinisi nebetemisebenti batinikele: ekutsengeni imikhicito yakuleli kusetjentiswe indlela lenemandla yekukhulisa tintfo letitfunyelwa ngaphandle kungenelela kuluchungechunge lwetekulima nekusekela emabhizinisi lasemancane nalafufusako kute kusimamiswe imisebenti.

src: Kabinete e dumela hore bonamodi bona bo bohlokwa ho lokiseng sephetho sa Dipatlisiso tsa Palo ya Basebetsi ya Kotara e nngwe le e nngwe sa kotare ya boraro ya 2018, e bontshitseng kgolo ka bobedi ho mesebetsi le keketseho palong ya batho ba hlokang mesebetsi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikholelwa ekutseni lokungenelela kubalulekile ekulungiseni lokutfolakele kuLuklayo Lwekota Lwetemisebenti lekota yesitsatfu yanga-2018, lolukhombisa kukhula kwemisebenti kanye nekukhula kwesibalo sebantfu labangasebenti.

src: Nakong ya dikgwedi tse tharo, ho thehilwe mesebetsi e 92 000.
tgt: Kuletinyanga leti-3, imisebenti leyengetiwe lenge-92 000 isunguliwe.

src: Empa ‘batho ba batlang mesebetsi ba neng ba nyahame nako e fetileng’ ba 131 000 ba ile ba kena mmarekeng wa mesebetsi hape kotareng eo, palo ya batho ba hlokang mesebetsi yona e ile ya eketseha, ka pento ya phesente ya phesente kang.
tgt: Noma kunjalo, bantfu labange-131 000 le ngaphambilini ‘bacedzelwa litsemba lekufuna umsebenti’ baphindze babuyela kuyofuna umsebenti kulekota, lizinga lebantfu labangasebenti libuye lakhula, nga-0.3% lafika ku-27.5%.

src: Ho ya ka Dipalopalo tsa Afrika Borwa (StatsSA) kgolo ya mesebetsi e bonahetse bohwebing ba ditshebeletso tsa kgwebo le kaho, le ha feela ho bile le tahleho ya mesebetsi merafong, tlhahisong, dipalangweng le basebetsing ba malapeng.
tgt: Ngekusho kweLihhovisi Letelubalobalo laseNingizimu Afrika (i-StatsSA) ematfuba emsebenti akhule emkhakheni wetinsita temabhizinisi netekwakha, ngalesikhatsi kulaleka kwematfuba emsebenti kutfolakele etimayini, kutemikhicito, tekutfutsa nasemakhaya.

src: Mesebetsi e lekaleng la semolao e ile ya fokotseha, ha mesebetsi e lekaleng le seng semolaong e ile ya hola.
tgt: Imisebenti kumikhakha lebhaliswe ngalokusemtsetfweni iphelile, ngalesikhatsi kumikhakha lengenasiciniseko ikhulile.

src: Keteko ya dilemo tse 20 ya Molao wa Tlhodisano Kabinete e elelwetse hore Molao wa Tlhodisano o tshwere dilemo tse 20 esale o thehwa ka Mphalane 1998.
tgt: Kubungatwa iminyaka lenge-20 yeMtsetfo Wekuncintisana IKhabhinethi inaka kwekutsi loMtsetfo Wekuncintisana uhlanganise iminyaka lenge-20 kusukela wacala kusebenta ngenyanga yeMphala nga-1998.

src: Nakong ena ya dilemo tse mashome a mabedi, balaodi ba tlhodisano ba ngodisitse katleho twantshanong ya dikhatele, tlhekefetso ya phahamelo dimaraka le tshireletso ya molemong wa setjhaba nakong ya ho kopantsha dimmaraka.
tgt: Kuleminyaka lenge-20, lalabaphetse tekuncintisana bente inchubekelembili lenhle kakhulu ngekulwa netinhlangano letikhulisa tintsengo, kungasetjentiswa kahle kwemandla mabhizinsi lamakhulu nekuvikelwa kwemmango ngalesikhatsi kuhlanganwa.

src: Balaodi ba ile ba nehelana ka dikotlo tse fetang R8 bilione dikhamphaning mabapi le ho tlola Mola.
tgt: Laba labaphetse babeke imali lengetulu kwetigidzigidzi le-R8 yetinhlawulo etinkapani letiphula Umtsetfo.

src: Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Moruo, ka tekanyetso ya Molao wa Tlhodisano, le ile la etsa R5 bilione ka tjhelete e ikgethileng ho phahamisa dikgwebo tse nyane, bafani ba lehae le ho kenyeletsa bahwai ba batho ba batsho moruong o tlwalehileng.
tgt: Lihhovisi laNdvuna Wekutfutfukisa Umnotfo, ngekusebentisa uMtsetfo Wekuncintisana, lakhe imali lengetulu kwetigidzigidzi le-R5 kusikhwama setimali letikhetsekile kute kutfutfukiswe emabhizinisi lasemancane, baphakeli bakuleli kanye nekungena kwebalimi labamnyama kulomkhakha wetemnotfo.

src: Kabinete e lebohisa balaodi ba tlhodisano ka mosebetsi o entsweng ho bula moruo molemong wa ba batjha tlhodisanong le ho kgothaletsa bohwebi bo thuthuhang le tlhodisano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongela labaphetse tekuncintisana ngalomsebenti lowentiwe kuvula umnotfo uvulelwe bantfu labasha nekutfutfukisa emabhizinisi nemincintiswano.

src: Kopano ya bo 18 ya Lekgotla la Matona a Mokgatlo wa Ntlheng ya Lewatle la India (IORA).
tgt: Umhlangano we-18 Wemkhandlu waboNdvuna we-Indian Ocean Rim Association (i-IORA) IKhabhinethi ibongela Litiko Letebudlelwane Nekubambisana Kwemave Emhlaba ngekubungata Umhlangano we-18 Wemkhandlu waboNdvuna (i-COM) we-Indian Ocean Rim Association (i-IORA) lowabanjelwa eDurban, KwaZulu- Natal ngamhla ti-02 Lweti 2018 ngaphansi kwalengcikitsi: Kuhlanganisa Bantfu base-Afrika, Asia, Australiasia naseMiddle East ngekusebentisa indlela yekusebentisana letfutfukisiwe nekuthula, Kusimama neKutfutfuka Lokusimeme”.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Lefapha la Dikamano tsa Matjhabeng le Tshebedisano ka ho tshwara ka katleho Kopano ya Lekgotla la Matona (COM) ya bo 18 ya Mokgatlo wa Ntlheng ya Lewatle la India (IORA) e neng e tshwaretswe Durban, KwaZulu-Natal ka la 02 Pudungwana 2018 tlasa mokotaba: Re kopantsha batho ba Afrika, Asia, Australasia le Middle East tshebedisanong e atolositsweng ya Kgotso, Botsitso le Ntshetsopele ya Mokoka”.
tgt: Munye walemiphumela yalomhlangano we-18 we-IORA beyiSimemetelo Lesikhetsekile sekuhlonipha Mengameli Nelson Mandela lekangulomunye webasunguli be-IORLoku kuholele ekutseni kusungulwe “luhlelo lwekucecesha le-IORA Nelson Mandela ‘Bani Ngumshiyandvuku nesibonelo semisebenti yakhe” lekulindzeleke kutsi luvulwe ngalokusemtsetfweni ngenyanga yaKholwane 2019.

src: E nngwe ya diphetho tsa kopano ya IORA ya bo18 e ne e le Phatlalatso e Ikgethileng ya ho tlotla Moporesidente Nelson Mandela eo e leng e mong wa bathehi ba IORSena se bakile ho thehwa ha lenaneo la borupellwa la “IORA Nelson Mandela ‘E ba Lefa’” le lebeletsweng ho thakgolwa semolao ka Phupu 2019.
tgt: Lomtamo uhlose kuniketa emandla nekuhlomisa bantfu labasha labayincenye ye-IORA ngelwati lwemsebenti kumikhakha yabo labayifundzelako.

src: Boiteko bona bo ikemiseditse ho matlafatsa le ho kgontsha batjha ba IORA ka bokgoni ba ho sebetsa makaleng a dithuto tsa bona.
tgt: Kulwa Nebugebengu IKhabhinethi yamukela Lesikhungo Sekulwa Netigebengu Letingemacembu lesisandza kuvulwa endzaweni yaseHanover Park, eNshonalanga Kapa, sivulwa nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa.

src: Ho Lwantsha Tlolo ya Molao Kabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa ha Yuniti e Kgahlano le Bokebekwa Hanover Park, Kapa Bophirima, ke Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa.
tgt: Loku kungete indlela yekungenelela kwahulumende kantsi kutasita kakhulu ekulweni netinkhinga tetigebengu letingemacembu kanye netidzakamiva lekubugebengu lobukhulako emimmangweni.

src: Tlatseletso ena ya bonamodi ba mmuso e tla thusa haholo ha ho nkwa diqeto tse shebaneng le bothata ba ditlolo tsa molao tse amanang le bokebeko le dithethefatsi tse e leng sewa setjhabeng sa rona.
tgt: Lesikhungo sinemalunga laceceshiwe ekusebenteni ngetimo letinebungoti njengoba babuya kusikhungo selicembu leliphendvula ngekushesha (ma-Bharete), lelicembu lelinemsebenti lokhetsekile (i-special task force) kanye nalesikhungo lesingenelela velonkhe (i-national intervention unit).

src: Baikemisetsong ya ho lwantshana le tlolo tsa molao, bonamodi bona bo eteletsweng pele ke mmuso bo tla kengwa hohle naheng.
tgt: Kulomtamo wekulwa nebugebengu, lomtamo walohulumnde wekungenelela utawundluliselwa kuvelonkhe.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho setjhaba ho sebedisana le kemedi ya tsamaiso ya molao ho boloka polokeho le tshireletso tse bohlokwa ntshetsopeleng ya setjhaba se fe kapa se fe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema imimmango kutsi isebentisane netikhungo temtsetfo ekugcineni kuphepha nekuvikeleka lekuyintfo lebalulekile kunoma ngumuphi ummango kutsi ukwati kukhula.

src: E itlamme ho netefatsa hore ditjhaba di tshireletsehile ditulong tsa bona tse fapaneng e bile di ikutlwa di tshireletsehile hohle mo ba leng ka naheng.
tgt: Iyachubeka nekutinikela ekucinisekiseni kwekutsi imimmango iphephile kantsi itivela iphephile etindzaweni labahlala kuto.

src: Sehla sa Lekgetho Kabineete e leboha balefi ba lekgetho bohle ka ho nehelana ka kgafo ya lekgetho ya bona ya selemo le selemo ka nako sehleng sa kgafo ya lekgetho sa 2017/18, se kwetsweng ka 31 Mphalane 2018.
tgt: Sikhatsi Sentsela IKhabhinethi ibonga bonkhe batseli bentsela ngekutfumela ngesikhatsi emafomu abo entsela yanjalo ngemnyaka nakulomnyaka wentsela wanga-2017/18, levalwe ngamhla tinge-31 Lweti 2018.

src: Lekeno le e ntsweng ka lekgetho e ntse e le wona mohlodi wa bohlokwa wa ditjhelete tse netefatsang hore mmuso o kgona ho nehelana ka ditshebeletso setjhabeng.
tgt: Imali lengenako leyakhiwe ngekutsatsa intsela itawuhlala ingiyo lengumtfombo locinisekisa kwekutsi hulumende angatfulela bantfu tnsita.

src: Morero wa Naha wa Thuso ya Tjhelete tsa Baithuti (NSFAS).
tgt: Sikhwama Savelonkhe Sekusita Bafundzi Ngetimali (i-NSFAS).

src: Kabinete e hopotsa baithuti bohle ba batlang ho kenya dikopo tsa Morero wa Naha wa Thuso ya Tjhelete tsa Baithuti (NSFAS) wa thuso ya ditjhelete ka 2019 hore dikopo tse hoketsweng di kwala ka la 30 Pudungwana 2018.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhumbuta bonkhe bafundzi lebafuna kubhalela kuSikhwama Savelonkhe Sekusita Bafundzi Ngetimali (i-NSFAS) kute batfole lusito nga-2019 kantsi kubhalela nge-inthanethi kuvalwa ngamhla tinge-30 Lweti 2018.

src: Ka la 01 Phato 2018, dikopo di ile tsa Bulelwa baithuti ba lakatsang ho ntshetsa dithuto tsa bona pele ka 2019 dithutong tse seng di amohetswe diyunivesithing tsa mmuso le dikoletjhe tsa Thuto ya Sethekgeniki le Mosebetsi wa Matsoho (TVET) tsa Afrika Borwa.
tgt: Ngamhla lu- 01 Inyoni 2018, Ticelo tavulelwa bafundzi lebafanele nalabafuna kuchubeka netifundvo tabo nga-2019 bente sifundvo lesivumelekile kunoma ngabe nguyiphi iyunivesithi yahulumende noma emakolishi Etifundvo Tebuciko Bemisebenti Yetandla kanye Nekuceceshwa (ma-TVET) eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Baithuti ba kgothaletswa ho kenya dikopo tse hoketsweng kapa ba etela setsha sa Lekgotla la Naha la Ntshetsopele ya Batjha (NYDA) se haufinyana pele ho letsatsi la ho kwalwa.
tgt: Bafundzi bayakhutsatwa kakhulu kutsi batfumele nge-inthanethi ticelo noma bavakashele lihhovisi Lesikhungo Savelonkhe Sekutfutfukiswa Kwelusha (i-NYDA) ngembi kwalolusuku lwekuvala.

src: Diqeto tsa Kabinete Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana Moralo wa Lewa la ho lelekisa lewa le molemong wa moruo wa Afrika Borwa lefatsheng ka bophara ho ya ka kamano ya kgwebisano, letsete le tshebetso ya indasteri.
tgt: Tincumo TeKhabhinethi IKhabhinethi ilivumele Luhlaka Lwemasu lekuvikela umnontfo waseNingizimu Afrika mhlaba wonkhe ngalokuphatselene nekuhwebelana, kusisa nekutfutfukisa.

src: Lewa le ikemiseditse ho netefatsa hore dikamano tsa matjhabeng di sebeletsa leano la dintho tsa lehae tse bohlokwa jwalo ka phokotso ya bofuma, tlhokeho ya mesebetsi le tekatekano.
tgt: Lelisu lihlose kucinisekisa kwekutsi tivumelwano nemave angaphandle tihambisana netinchubomgomo talelive njengekucedza buphuya, kuswelakala kwemsebenti nekungalingani.

src: Lewa le buela hore Afrika Borwa e lelekise nyalano ya ntshetsopele Afrika kaofela e tshehetswang ke letsete le eteletsweng pele ke lewa le ho aha balekane ba lewa ho phahamisa ajenda la yona.
tgt: Lelisu ligcizelela kwekutsi iNingizimu Afrika icalise intfutfuko letawuhlanganisa yonkhe i-Afrika lekutawusekelwa lisu leliphatselene nelutjalomali nekwakha budlelwano kute kukhuliswe luhlelo layo.

src: Le boela le tiisa bohwebi le dikamano tsa letsete le dinaha tse tswetseng pele le ho lelekisa matsete a ka hare, bokgoni le phetiso ya thekonoloji le diromelwa kantle tse kenyeleditsweng ditjeong.
tgt: Luhlanganisa budlelwano bekuhwebelana nelutjalomali nemave lasatfutfukile lufunela lutjalomali langekhatsi, kundluliselwa kwemakhono netheknoloji kanye nekutfunyelwa kwemphahla ngaphandle leyenta inzuzo lenyenti.

src: Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana tokiso ya mekgolo ya ditjeo-tsa-ho phela tsa selemo le selemo tsa ditho tsa Komishene ya Ditokelo tsa Botho ya Afrika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumele kukhushulwa kwemiholo wemalunga eKhomishini Yemalungelo Eluntfu yaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAHRC).

src: Molao wa Komishene ya Ditokelo tsa Botho ya Afrika Borwa, wa 2013 o bontsha hore meputso, ditjhelete tsa tlatsetso le tse ding tsa tlatsetso tsa ho phethela mosebetsi wa kantoro di phethiswe ke Moporesidente ka ho qoqa taba ena le Kabinete le Letona la Ditjhelete.
tgt: Umtsengekukhulumisana neKhabhinethi naNdvuna Wetimali.

src: Komishene e tla dulwasetulona ka kopanelo ke Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa le molekane wa hae wa Switzerland, Stefan Löfven.
tgt: NgekweMtsetfo Wekhomishini Yemalungelo Eluntfu yaseNingizimu Afrika, wanga-2013, nguMengameli loneligunya, ngembi kwekukhulumisana neKhabhinethi neNdvuna Yetetimali, lekukhuphula imiholo, tinzuzo kanye naleminye imigomo nemibandzela yemsebenti.

src: Komishene ya Maemo a Phahameng, e qadileng ILO ka 2017, e romuwe ho hlahloba phethoho e potlakileng e etsahalang tulong ya mesebetsi, ho sheba diphephetso tse ka sehloohong le se tlamehang ho etswa ho etsa hore mosebetsi wa kamoso o be betere le ho hloka leeme.
tgt: Inhlangano Yetemisebenti Mhlabawonkhe (i-ILO)Ikhomishini Lesezingeni Leliphakeme Mhlabawonkhe ngeLikusasa Lemisebenti yeNnhlangno Yetemisebenti Mhlabawonkhe (i-ILO) itawubamba umhlangano wekugcina kusukela ngamhla ti-5 kuya mhla ti-17 Lweti 2018.

src: Mosebetsi wa Komishene ya matjhabeng o ikamahantsha le tsepamaiso ya maikutlo ya mmuso ya ho theha mesebetsi e hantle e tsitsitseng, le boiteko ba ho netefatsa hore batjha ba Afrika Borwa ba na le botsebi bo hlokehang ho itlhomapele dibakeng tsa mesebetsi tse fetohang.
tgt: Sihlalo waleKhomishini ubambisane naMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa kanye nalomlingani wakhe waseSweden Stefan Löfven.

src: Dipontsho tsa Matjhabeng tsa Dihlahiswa tse Rekwang China (CIIE)Kabinete e amohela ho ba le seabo ha Afrika Borwa jwalo ka naha ya moeti ya ikgethileng ho Dipontsho tsa Matjhabeng tsa Dihlahiswa tse rekwang China (CIIE) mane Shanghai.
tgt: Lekhomishini Lesezingeni Leliphakeme Mhlabawonkhe, lesungulwe yi-ILO nga-2017, iniketwe umsebenti wekuhlolisisa letingucuko letiphutfumako letenteka emisebentini, ibuke letinkhinga letibalulekile nekutsi yini lengentiwa kugcina likusasa lemisebenti libe ncono futsi lingavuni licala.

src: Letona la Bohwebi le Diindasteri, Rob Davies, o eteletsepele barumuwa ba mekgatlo ya Afrika Borwa ba Barumuwa ba tsheheditswe ka ditjhelete ke Lefapha la Bohwebi le Diindasteri ka Lewa la Dimaraka tsa Dihlahiswa tse Tswellang kantle le Thuso ya Letsete (EMIA).Ho ba le seabo ha Afrika Borwa ho netefatsa hantle hore naha e phahamisa boiphihlelo ba bohwebi le letsete mme re thabetse ho ba le seabo ka ho bontshahatsa ho tswa makaleng, a kenyeletsang tshebediso ya dihlahiswa tsa temothuo, dieta le letlalo, enjenereng, dikhemikhale tsa peterolo, dikhomponete tsa ditereneng, tshireletso, ha mmoho le thekenoloji ya tlhahisoleseding le dikgokahano, ho kgutlela hae le dikopo tsa ho reka.
tgt: Lomsebenti waleKhomishini Yamhlabawonkhe uhambisana naloku hulumende lagcile kuko lekukwakha ematfuba emsebenti lokahle nalosimeme, nemitamo yekucinisekisa kwekutsi bantfu labasha baseNingizimu Afrika banemakhono ladzingekako kute kutsi bakhone kuphila kulemisebenti lenetingucuko.

src: Ditshupong tsa Dipontsho, Afrika Borwa e boetse e tshwere seboka sa letsete se tsepamisitseng maikutlo ho menyetla e lekaleng la tlhahiso.
tgt: I-China International Import Export (i-CIIE)IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela lokungenelela kweNingizimu Afrika njengelive lelimenyiwe ngalokuhloniphekile kulomcimbi wekukhangisa, i-China International Import Export (i-CIIE) lebanjelwe eShanghai.

src: Beke ya Ho Tsepamisa Maikutlo ho ImbizoDibeke tse pedi tse tlang tsa bolwanedi ka mmuso di tla tshwara Beke ya Naha ya ho Tsepamisa maikutlo ho Imbizo ya bo09, e hokahangwa ke Tsamaiso ya Dikgokahanyo le Tlhahisoleseding ya Mmuso (GCIS).
tgt: Ndvuna Yetekuhwebelana Netimboni Rob Davis, uhola litsimba letinhlangano leti-27 taseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Ditho tsa Kemedi ya Phethahatso ya Naha ha mmoho le baetapele ba mmuso wa porofense le wa lehae naheng ka bophara ho tla ba le dikopano tsa setjhaba le Izimbizo.
tgt: Lelitsimba lisekelwe ngetimali Litiko Lekuhwebelana Netimboni ngekusebentisa i-Export Marketing and Investment Assistance (i-EMIA) Scheme.

src: Lenaneo la tsamaiso le tla phatlalatswa ho WEBTOKEN ho tloha ka la 12 ho isa ho la 25 Pudungwana 2018.MaAfrika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho sebedisa polatefomo ena ho buisana le ba ka sehloohong ka dintlha tsa phano ya ditshebeletso ho netefatsa hore re sebetsa mmoho ho ntshetsengpele setjhaba sa rona.
tgt: Kungenelela kweNingizimu Afrika kwente kwekutsi lelive likhone kukhangisa ngemakhono alo ekuhwebelana nekusisa kantsi siphokophelele phambili kubona bakhangisi labavela kumikhakha, kufaka ekhatsi bekugaywa kwalokulinyiwe, ticatfula nesikhumba, tebunjiniyela, emakhemikhali aphethiloli, tetetitimela, tekuvikela, kanye netheknoloji yelwati lwetekuchumana, nekutsi babuye ekhaya neticelo tekutsenga.

src: Matshediso Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso a yona ho ba malapa le baratuwa ba bohle ba lahlehetsweng ke maphelo a bona nakong ya mello ka tatelano mane Tseleng ya Garden Route le ditulo tse e potapotileng, ha mmoho le Kapa Botjhabela.
tgt: Ngesikhatsi lomkhangiso uchuba, iNingizimu Afrika nayo ibungate umhlangano wekusisa lobukete kumatfuba lakumkhakha wekukhicita.

src: Mollo o ile wa nka bophelo ba Nico Heyns, eo e neng e le mofufisi wa difofane tsa “Working on Fire”.
tgt: Liviki Lavelonkhe Lekugcila Kutimbizo Lamaviki lamabili latako ekusebenta kwahulumende atawube akhombisa Liviki Lavelonkhe le-9 Lekugcila Kutimbizo, leholwa beLuphiko Lwahulumende Lwetekuchumana Nelwatiso (i-GCIS).

src: Kabinete e theoheletsa karabelo e potlakileng ya ditima mollo le basebetsi ba taolo ya dikoduwa, ha mmoho le Sesole sa Moyeng sa Afrika Borwa le “Working on Fire” ba ileng ba sebetsa ka boitelo le ho pholosa maphelo le ho tlisa malakabe a mollo tlasa taolo.
tgt: Emalunga Esigungu Lesiphakeme kanye nebaholi betifundza nabomasipala batawubamba imihlangano kanye neTimbizo nemmango eveni lonkhe.

src: Kabinete e boela e lebohisa Monghadi Mandla Mchunu wa Bolaodi bjo bo Ikemetšego bja Dikgokaganyo tša Afrika Borwa (ICASA) a ileng a kgethwa ho sebetsa Lekgotleng la Melao la ITU ha mmoho le Mme Doreen Bogdan-Martin ho kgethweng ha hae e le Molaodi wa Biro ya Ntshetsopele ya Meralo ya Dikgokahanyo, le ho ba mosadi wa pele wa ho ba karolo ya batsamaisi ba ka sehloohong ba ITU ho tloha esale e thehwa ka 1865.
tgt: Bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bayakhutsatwa kutsi basebentise lesikhatsi kutsi bacocisane nalabaphetse ngetindzaba letiphatselene nekwetfulwa kwetinsita kucinisekisa kwekutsi kuyasetjentiswana ekutfutfukiseni imimmango yetfu.

src: Afrika Borwa e ikokobeditswe ke tshepo eo e nehilweng ke dinaha tse ding ho sebetsa maemong a phahameng makaleng a ITU dilemong tse nne tse tlang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yendlulisa kukhala kwayo kulemindeni netihlobo talabo bonkhe labo labashonile ngalesikhatsi kunemililo lecubuke ku-Garden Route netindzawo letisedvute nayo, kanye naseMpumalanga Kapa.

src: Re tla sebedisa maemo ana ho sututsa ajenda ya ntshetsopele le kenyeletso ya setjhaba tlhahisoleseding dilemong tsa dijithale.
tgt: Lomlilo ubulele Nico Heyns, lebekangumshayeli wendiza yaka-“Working on Fire”.

src: Kabinete e boela e lebohisa Rephaboliki ya Demokrasi ya Federale ya Ethiopia ka ho kgetha Moporesidente wa yona wa pele wa mosadi, Motlotlehi Sahle-Work Zewde, eo ha jwale e leng yena feela Moporesidente wa mosadi kontinenteng ya Afrika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibonga lokuphendvula ngekushesha kwalabasebenti labacima umlilo netisebenti letisebenta ngetinhlekelele, kanye nebeMbutfo Wetekuvikela Wasemoyeni waseNingizimu Afrika ne-“Working on Fire” labasebente ngekungakhatsali ekuhlengeni timphilo nekulawula lomlilo.

src: Afrika Borwa e tla tswellapele ho matlafatsa dikamano tse amang mahlakore a mabedi le Ethiopia makaleng a mekgahlelong e mengata e kenyeletsang bohwebi, dikamano tsa dipolotiki le moruo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi indlulisa kukhala kwayo kuhulumende nebantfu base-Indonesia kulandzela lokuwa kwendiza lebulele bantfu laba-189 ngemuva kwekusuka edolobheni lelikhulu lase-Indonesia, iJakarta.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa ditebohiso ho Moporesidente wa Cameroon, Paul Biya, ya hlomamisitsweng lekgetlo la bosupa kantorong ya boporesidente.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela iNingizimu Afrika ngekukhetfwa nangekusekelwa ngalokuvakalako kutsi isebente eNhlanganweni Yetakhiwonchanti Tekuchumana Mhlabawonkhe (i-ITU) ngeMsombuluko, ngamhla ti-05 Lweti 2018 ngalesikhatsi se-Plenipotentiary Conference ye-ITU eDubai.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho batho bohle ba Cameroon ho sebedisana mmoho ho tlisa tharollo e nang le kgotso ka tsamaiso ya dipuisano tse kenyeletsang bohle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela MnuMandla Mchunu weMtimba Lotimele Wetekuchumana WaseNingizimu Afrika (i-Icasa) lokhetfwe kutsi asebente kuBhodi leLawula Imisakato ye-ITU kanye naMake Doreen Bogdan-Martin ngekukhetfwa kwakhe kutsi abe nguMcondzisi weLuphiko Lekutfutfukisa Takhiwonchanti Tekuchumana, kantsi njengamake wekucala ekubeni yincenye yebaphatsi labakhulu be-ITU kusukela yasungulwa nga-1865.

src: Kabinete e thabetse ho tebisa dikamano tsa dipolotiki mahlakoreng ka bobedi, moruo le bohwebi dipakeng tsa Afrika Borwa le Cameroon.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika iyatitfoba ngalokutitsemba lokubekwe ngulalamanye emave kutsi basebente kuletikhundla letinkhulu kuleminyaka lemine lelandzelako.

src: Moetlo ona ke wa sedumedi o nkang sebaka ho keteka tlholo ya botle ho bobedi, tsebo le bohlale ho boiphaphanyo ha mmoho le tlholo ya kganya lefifing.
tgt: Sitawusebentisa letikhundla kuchubekisa loluhlelo lwekutfutfukisa nekuba nemmango lofaka ekhatsi kuniketwa kwelwatiso kulesikhatsi setheknoloji yesimanje.

src: E se eka kganya ya Modimo e ka hlonolofatsa Afrika Borwa ka kgotso, phomello, nyakallo, katleho le kgotsofalo, mme mmoho re bapale karolo ya rona to hatiseletsa kgutso le kopano phapanong ya ditso le ditumelo tsa naha ya rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibuye yabongela iFederal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia ngekukhetsa mengameli wabo wekucala longumake, Umhlonishwa Sahle-Work Zewde, lekunguye kuphela mengameli longumake e-Afrika.

src: Dithonyo Dithonyo kaofela di lokela ho netefatswa ka mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika itawuchubeka kucinisa budlelwano lobusemkhatsini ne-Ethiopia etindzaweni letihlukene letifaka ekhatsi kuhwebelana, ipoltiki netemnotfo.

src: Ho thongwa hape ha Mme Nomfundo Maseti jwalo ka Setho sa Moshwelella sa Molaodi, se ikarabelang taolong ya Kgase ya Peipi, ho sebetsa Lekgotleng la NERSBatho ba latelang ba thongwe ho sebetsa Lekgotleng la Dikhamphani tsa Kaho:a. Absalom Mosabeni Molobe (Modulasetulo)b. Mme Maphefo K Mogodi (Motlatsamodulasetulo)c. Mme Zandile Yvonne Mathed.
tgt: IKhabhinethi itfumela tilokotfo tekuhalalisa kuMengameli waseCameroon Paul Biya, lofungiswe sikhatsi sesikhombisa asehhovisi.

src: Ngaka Keith Ivor Jacobsk.
tgt: Dkt Jenitha Badule.

src: Inge Maree Vieiram.
tgt: Ngwako Edward Hutamof.

src: Ngaka Prittish Dalao.
tgt: Mk Noninzi Qinag.

src: Ulandi Exnerp.
tgt: Gert Hendrik Meyerh.

src: Mme Florence Rabadaq.
tgt: Jerry Leigh Magoliusi.

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro, 21 Pudungwana 2018, Tuynhuys e Motse Kapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlangene ngaLesitsatfu, mhla ti-21 Lweti 2018 eTuynhuys eKapa.

src: Dintlha tsa Ha jwale Letsete.
tgt: Tindzaba Letimcoka.

src: Kabinete e amohela tlhomamiso e atlehileng ya Seboka sa Letsete sa Afrika se ileng sa tshwarwa ho tloha ka la 7 ho isa ho la 9 Pudungwana 2018 mane Setsing sa Dipuisano sa Sandton, Gauteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamukela lokuvulwa ngemphumelelo kweNgcungcutsela yeLutjalomali e-Afrika lebanjwe kusukela mhla ti-7 kuya ku-9 ngenyanga yeLweti 2018 eSandton Convention Centre eGauteng.

src: Mmeso le dikgwebo tsa Afrika, ditheho tsa ditjhelete tsa matjhabeng le balekane ba bang ba ntshetsopele ba tsipameng ho etsa Afrika moetapele ya ka sehloohong lefatsheng ho tsa botsetedi.
tgt: Bohulumende base-Afrika nemabhizinisi, tikhungo tetetimali mhlabawonkhe nalabanye balingani betentfutfuko bagcile ekwenteni i-Afrika ibe ngumgcele lolandzelako emhlabeni wonkhe kutelutjalomali.

src: Phethelong ya seboka ditumellano tse 45, tsa boleng ba US$32 bilione, di ile tsa phethelwa molemong wa kontinente.
tgt: Nakuvalwa lenkhomfa kube netivumelwano letinge-45, letibita US$32 wetigidzigidzi, lekuvunyelwene ngato kute kuzuze lelivekati lonkhe.

src: Tjheleteng eo, Afrika Borwa e tla e fumantshwa ke US$6.8 bilione ya botsetedi.
tgt: Kuloko, iNingizimu Afrika itawuzuza kusukela kutigidzi leti US$6.8 kulutjalomali.

src: Kabinete e kgothaditswe ke dipuisano tse bileng Sebokeng sa AU mane Addis Ababa, Ethiopia ka la 17 le 18 Pudungwana 2018, moo Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa a ileng a ba le seabo.
tgt: Ingcungcutsela yeMhlabuhlangene (i-AU) IKhabhinethi ikhutsatwe tingcogco letentiwe kulengcungcutsela ye-AU lebanjelwe e-Addis Ababa, kulase-Ethiopia ngamhla ti-17 ne-18 Lweti 2018, lapho Mengameli Cyril Ramaphosa bekangenelele.

src: Mokgahlelo ona o Ikgethileng o ile wa buisana ka ditsamaiso tsa tlhabollo tse ikemiseditseng ho theha AU e sebetsang, e hlophisitsweng le ho matlafatswa botjha, e kgonang ho fihlella maikemisetso a kontinente le dipheo tse hlahellang ho Ajenda 2063, eo e leng leano la mokgwatshebetso la ho fetola moruo wa setjhaba wa Afrika dilemong tse 50 tse tlang.
tgt: Lengcungcutsela Lesezingeni Leliphakeme idzingidze lenchubo lechubekako yekwakha kabusha i-AU lehlose kusungula indlela lesebentako, lehlelekile nalenemandla lamasha letawukhona kubeka phambilli tidzingo talelivekati netinjongo letibekiwe ku-Ajenda 2063, lekuluhlaka lwemasu lwekutfutfukisa umnotfo welivekati lase-Afrika kuleminyaka lenge-50 letako.

src: Ntjhafatso ya AU ke tshebetso e tswelangpele, ke tse ding tsa ditshitshinyo tse se ntseng di phethisitswe, haholoholo tse amanang le boitlamo ba hore dinaha tsa ditho tsa AU di be le taolo e kgolo ya ho nehela mokgatlo ka tjhelete.
tgt: Lokutfutfukiswa kwe-AU kuyinchubo lechubekako, naletinye tinchubo tayo setivele tentiwe, ikakhulukati letiphatselene nalokutinikela ekubeni emave angemalunga e-AU kube ngiwo asita lenhlangano ngemali.

src: Boholo ba dinaha di tswella ho tekena Tumellano ya Bohwebi bo Senang Ditshitiso Kontinenteng ya Afrika ho netefatsa hore Kontinente e lokolla tumellano ya bohwebi bo senang ditshitiso kontinenteng ka bophara.
tgt: Emave lamanye ayachubeka nekusayina leSivumelwano Sekuhwebelana Kwemave ase-Afrika Mahhala kucinisekisa kutsi lelivekati liyasisebentisa lesivumelwano sekuhwebelana kwemave ase-Afrika mahhala.

src: Selekane sa Lewa la tshebetso le Mokgatlo wa Dinaha tsa Yuropa (EU).
tgt: Budlelwano Lobunemasu nemave eLubumbano lwase-Europe (i-EU).

src: Kabinete e thabetse sephetho sa Seboka sa EU – sa bo7 sa Afrika Borwa se ileng sa tshwarwa ka la 15 Pudungwana 2018 mane Belgium.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyatfokota ngalemiphumela lemihle yaleNgcungcutsela yesi-7 ye-EU neNingizimu Afrika lebeyibanjwe ngamhla ti-15 Lweti eBelgium.

src: Diphetho le boitlamo bo ileng ba etswa sebokeng seo bo tlatseletsa tshebetso e sa tlwalehang ya ho beha kgolo ya moruo le ho theha mesebetsi bohareng ba ajenda ya naha ya Afrika Borwa.
tgt: Lemiphumela netetsembiso letentiwe kulengcungcutsela kwakhiwe lokukhutsala kwetfu lokungenhla kwekubeka kukhula kwemnotfo nekwakhiwa kwematfuba emsebenti enkhabeni yeluhlelo lwavelonkhe lwaseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Afrika Borwa ke yona feela naha ya Afrika le e nngwe ho dinaha tse 10 tsa matjhabeng tse nang le Selekane sa Lewa la tshebetso le EEU ke molekane wa kgwebisano le motsetedi wa naheng tse ding e moholoholo wa Afrika Borwa jwalo ka mokgatlo wa dinaha, e emetse 73.7% ya kakaretso ya dihb stoko tsa Tsetelo e Tobileng Naheng e nngwe naheng.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika ngilo kuphela live lase-Afrika nalinye lalamave lali-10 mhlabawonkhe laneBudlelwne Lobunemasu kanye ne-EI-EU ingumlingani lomkhulu kunabo bonkhe le iNingizimu Afrika ihwebelana naye nemtjalimali wangaphandle lomkhulukati njengemlingani, imelele 73.7% yesitoko Selutjalomali Lemave Angaphandle kulelive.

src: Bekeng ena Moporesidente Ramaphosa o ile a amohela Mopresidente wa Rephaboliki ya Federale ya Germany, Monghadi Frank-Walter Steinmeier, Leetong la Semmuso mona Afrika Borwa.
tgt: Mengameli Ramaphosa kuleliviki bekavakashelwe nguMengameli waseFederal Republic of Germany, MnuFrank-Walter Steinmeier, ngesikhatsi Avakashele eNingizimu Afrika ngekweMbuso, njengoba kunetinkapani taseGermany letingetulu kwe-600 letinemabhizinisi noma letinetikhungo tekukhicita kulelive, letidale imisebenti lelinganiselwa ku-100 000.

src: Germany ke e nngwe ya batsetedi ba matjhabeng ba baholoholo mona Afrika Borwa, ka dikhamphani tse fetang 600 tsa Germany tse laolwang ke dikhamphani tse ding kapa tsa tlhahiso ka hara naha, tse nyehelana ka mesebetsi e ka bang 100 000.
tgt: Lokuvakasha ngekweMbuso kubangele kutsi kusayinwe tivumelwano tekuhwebelna nekutjala imali emkhatsini walamave lamabili, kwaniketa nalabaholi lababili kutsi bacocisane ngetindzaba letibatsintsa bobabili nekusebentisana ngalokusondzelene njengemalunga langakagcwali Esigungu Setekuvikela Kumhlabubuhlangene (i-UN) sikhatsi lesineminyaka lemibili kusukela nga-2019 kuya ku-2020.

src: Leeto lena la Semmuso le ile la phethela ka ho tekena ditumellano tsa kgwebisano le botsetedi dipakeng tsa naha tsena tse pedi, le ho nehela baetapele ka bobedi monyetla wa ho buisana ka dintlha tsa ditumellano tsa naha le tshebedisano ka botlalo jwalo ka ditho tsa nakwana tsa Lekgotla la Tshireletso la Mokgatlo wa Dinaha tsa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) ka nako ya dilemo tse pedi ho tloha ka 2019 ho isa Kabobotjha ya Mobu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inake kwekutsi Ikomidinhlanganisela Yekubuyeketwa kweMtsetfosisekelo yasePhalamende ivume umbiko wayo lohambisana nekuchitjiyelwa kweSigaba 25 seMtsetfosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika wanga-1996.

src: Kabinete e amohetse hore Komiti ya Kopanelo ya Tlhahlobo ya Molaotheo ya Palamenteng e ananetse pehelo e tshihetsang ho fetola Mokgahlelo wa 25 wa Molaotheo wa Rephaboliki ya Afrika Borwa wa 1996.
tgt: Lokuchibiyela kutawenta kutsi umbuso ukhone kwaba umhlaba ngaphandle kwesincepheteliso ngekwetinshisekelo temmango.

src: Phetolo ena e tla etsa hore Mmuso o kgone ho phethahatsa kamoho ya mobu ntle le ditlhapiso molemong wa setjhaba.
tgt: Lombiko walekomidi ulindzeleke kutsi udzingidvwe Libandla Lavelonkhe kute kucociswane ngawo.

src: Pehelo ena ya komiti e lebetswe ho hlahiswa ka pela Seboka sa Naha hore ho ngangisanwe ka yona.
tgt: Inchubo yekuva timvo tebantfu yenta kutsi tinhlangano letihlukene tiletse tetfulo ngaloMtsetfosivivinyo kantsi kulalelwa kwetimvo tebantfu kwabanjelwa kuto tonkhe tifundza.

src: Tsamaiso ya dipuisano tsa setjhaba e bone mekgatlo e mengata e nyehelana ka dikgothaletso tsa Bili mme le dipitso tsa setjhaba di ile tsa tshwarwa diporofenseng tse robong kaofela.
tgt: Umtsetfosisekelo sewuke wachitjiyelwa emahlandla la-17 ngekusebentisa inchubo yekutsintsana nekufaka ekhatsi bonkhe bantfu.

src: Ho fihlela ha jwale, Molatheo o se o fetotswe makgetlo a 17 ka tsamaiso ya ho thonya maikutlo a baahi le ho kenyeletsa mehopolo ya bohle.
tgt: Hulumende utawuhlala atinikele kuluhlelo lwekulungiswa kahle kwemhlaba lokunetinshisekelo tabo bonkhe bantfu.

src: Mmuso o tswella ho itlama ka mokgwa wa kabobotjha ya mobu o nang le boikarabelo molemong wa bohle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyacinisekisa kwekutsi hulumende uyawuhlonipha umtsetfo kantsi, ngaso sonkhe sikatsi, batawenta ngekuhambisana neMtsetfosisekelo.

src: Kahlolo ya Lekgotla la Molaotheo.
tgt: Sincumo Senkhantolo yeMtsetfosisekelo.

src: Kabinete e amohela kahlolo ya Lekgotla la Molaotheo e phethetseng ka hore Molao wa Ntshetsopele ya Dihlahiswa tsa Petoroliamo le Dirashwa, wa 2002 (Molao wa 28 wa 2002) o laolang ho nehelana ka ditokelo tsa dimaene, o tlameha o balwe mmoho le Molao wa Tshireletso ya Ditokelo tsa Mobu tse seng Molaong, wa 1996 (Molao wa 31 wa 1996), o sireletsang ditokelo tsa baahi ba mobu o senang tshireletso ya molao.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamukela lesincumo seNkhantolo yeMtsetfosisekelo lencume kwekutsi Umtsetfo Wekutfutfukiswa Kwetimbiwa nePetroliyamu, wanga-2002 (Umtsetfo 28 wanga-2002) lobusa lokuniketwa kwemalungelo ekumba, kufanele ufundvwe ngekuhambisana Nemtsetfo Wekuvikela Emalungelo Emhlaba Langabhalisiwe, wanga-1996 (Umtsetfo 31 wanga-1996), lovikela emalungelo emhlaba lasengcupheni.

src: Katleho ya setjhaba sa Lesetlheng mane Bokone Bophirama e bontsha qalo ya ho lemoha ditokelo tsa mobu tsa batho ba Afrika Borwa ba neng ba hateletswe nakong e fetileng tseo ba neng ba di tingwe ka melokoloko.
tgt: Lokuncoba kwemmango waseLesetlheng eNyakatfo Nshonalanga kukhombisa sicalo sekunakwa kwemalungelo emhlaba lapho khona bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika lebebacindzetelwe bancishwe lamalungelo sikhatsi lesidze.

src: Moo merafo e amang bodulo, malapa le ditjhaba, bathong ba angwang ke merafo ka kotloloho ba tlameha ho nehelana ka tumello ho diphetho di fe kapa di fe tse ka amang ditokelo tsa bona tsa mobu.
tgt: Lapho khona kumba timbiwa kutsikameta indzawo yekuhlala, imindeni nemimmango, bantfu labatsintseka ngco ngenca yekumba timbiwa kufanele banikete imvume kunoma ngutiphi tingucuko letitsintsa umhlaba wabo.

src: Sephetho sa Bohlakisi Kabinete e amohela le ho lebohisa mafapha le dikgwebo tsa mmuso tse tswellang ho fumana sephetho se hlakileng sa bohlakisi.
tgt: Imiphumela yekuhlolwa kwemabhuku IKhabhinethi yamukela futsi ihalalisela ematiko netikhungo tahulumende letichubeka ngalokungagucuki ngekutfola imiphumela lehlobile yekuhlolwa kwemabhuku.

src: Sena se tla ka mora sephetho sa Pehelo ya Bohlakisi ba Tsamaiso ya Ditjhelete tsa Setjhaba ya Kantoro ya Mohlakisi Kakaretso (AG) Kimi Makwetu, ya selemo sa ditjhelete sa 2017/18.
tgt: Loku kuvele ngemuva kwekukhishwa kweMbiko Wekuhlolwa Kwemabhuku Etimali Tahulumende wemnyakatimali wanga-2017/18 nguMhlolimabhuku Jikelele (i-AG) Kimi Makwetu.

src: Empa Kabinete o ngongoriswa ke pehelo e bontshang mpefalo ka kakaretso sephethong sa bohlakisi ba mafapha a mang a mmuso wa naha le a porofense le dikgwebo tsa mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi noma kunjalo ikhatsatekile ngalombiko lokhombisa kwehla kwesibalo sematiko ahulumende wavelonkhe newetifundza netikhungo tawo atfole imiphumela lehlobile yekuhlolwa kwemabhuku.

src: Ho tekenwa ha molao wa Bili ya Phetolo ya Bohlakisi ba Ditjhelete tsa Setjhaba ke Moporesidente Ramaphosa, ho tla matlafatsa mosebetsi wa Kantoro ya AG, ho tla thusa ka boikarabellong ha batho ba tswellang ho iphapanyetsa leano la tshebetso ya puso.
tgt: Lokusayinwa kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibiyela Wekuhlolwa Kwemabhuku Ahulumende, ube ngumtsetfo nguMengameli Ramaphosa, kutawucinisa lomsebenti waleliHhovisi la-AG, utawusita ekutseni ubambise umtsetfo labo labachubeka nekunganaki tindlela letifanelekile tekuphatsa.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa mafapha le dikgwebo tsohle ho sebedisana le ho fumana bonamodi ba dintlha tsohle tse tshwailweng ke AG le ho hlahloba tshebetso kgafetsa le ho lokisa dintlha tseo pele ho nako ya bohlakisi hape.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhutsata onkhe ematiko netikhungo tahulumende kutsi basebentele kutfola tindlela tekulungisa kuto tonkhe letinkhinga letivetwe ngu-AG nekutsi babuke inchubekela phambili njalo kute balungise tinkhinga ngembi kwekutsi kufike sikhatsi lesilandzelako sekuhlola mabhuku.

src: Polokeho le Tshiriletseho.
tgt: Kuphepha Nekuvikeleka.

src: Kabinete e itlamme ho tshihetsa Letsholo la Naha la Polokeho Nakong ya Matsatsi a Phomolo le ileng la thakgolwa ke Letona la Seponesa Bheki Cele ka tlasa mookotaba wa “Operation Quiet Storm”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela kusekelwa kuloMkankaso waVelonkhe wekuPhepha ngaleSikhatsi Semaholide Akhisimusi lowetfulwe nguNdvuna Wetemaphoyisa Bheki Cele ngaphansi kwengcikitsi letsi “Operation Quiet Storm”.

src: Letsholo lena le ikemiseditse ho etsa Afrika Borwa tulo e bolokehileng ha e le mona re atumetse nako ya matsatsi a phomolo a mafelo a selemo.
tgt: Lomkhankaso uhlose kwenta iNingizimu Afrika ibe yindzawo lephephile njengoba sicondze esikhatsini semaholide ekuphela kwemnyaka.

src: Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa sa Afrika Borwa (SAPS) e tla tshwara ditshebeletso toropong, motseng le lekeisheneng le leng le le leng ho fihlela mafelong a Pherekgong 2019.
tgt: Luphiko LeMbutho Wemaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) litawenta umsebenti velonkhe kulelo nalelo dolobha, emakhaya nasemadolobheni kudzimate kube kusekupheleni kwaBhimbhidvwane 2019.

src: Ba tla tsepama letsholong la ho bonahatsa maponesa, ha ka lehlakoreng le leng ba ntse ba ntse ba sebedisana le masolo a tlhokomediso le thibelo ya ditlolo tsa molao tse ikgethileng.
tgt: Batawugcila ekuniketeni tinsita temaphoyisa letibonakalako, ngalesikhatsi batisa ngebugebengu lobukhetsekile nekuvikela lokwentiwako.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAfrika Borwa ho tswellapele ho sebedisana le sepolesa ho tshireletsa setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bachubeke basebentisane nemaphoyisa ekugcineni imimmango yetfu iphephile.

src: Batswadi le bahlokomedi ba eletswa hore ba be kelahloko ha ho tla ho tlhokomelo ya bana ba bona nakong ya matsatsi a phomolo.
tgt: Batali nebagcini bebantfwana bayacwayiswa kutsi banake ngalokundlulele nabanakekela bantfwana babo ngalesikhatsi Semaholide Akhisimusi.

src: Kabinete e boela e itlama ho tshihetsa Letsholo la Naha la Polokeho la Nako ya Matsatsi a Phomolo, le thakgotsweng ke Letona la Dipalangwang, Ngaka Blade Nzimande, Limpopo mafelong a beke.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibuye yacela kusekelwa kulomkhankaso Wekuphepha Emgwacweni Ngalesikhatsi Semaholide Akhisimusi nga-2018, lesungulwe nguNdvuna weTekutfutsa, Dkt Blade Nzimande, eLimpopo ngemphelasontfo.

src: Phatlalatso ena e tsamaisana le Seboka sa matsatsi a mabedi sa Polokeho Mebileng le Letsatsi la Mokgatlo wa Dinaha tsa Matjhaba a Kopaneng la ho Hopola Mahlatsipa a dikotsi tsa mebileng.
tgt: Lokusungulwa kushayisane naleNgcungcutsela Yekuphepha Emgwacweni leyenteka njalo ngemnyaka emalanga lamabili neLilanga le-UN Lamhlabawonkhe Lekukhumbula labo labashonele etingotini temgwaco.

src: Ke molemong wa tshireletseho ya maphelo a rona hore re bapale karolo ho netefatseng hore nako ya matsatsi a phomolo re tshireletsehile ka ho kganna ka maikarabelo le ho ikobela melao ya tsela.
tgt: Kubalulekile kutsi sonkhe lesiphilako sidlale indzima ekucinisekiseni sikhatsi Semaholide Akhisimusi lesiphephile ngekushayela ngekucophelela nekuhlonipha imitsetfo yemgwaco.

src: Borokgo ba Maputo-Catembe.
tgt: Libhuloho iMaputo-Catembe IKhabhinethi ibongela bonjiniyela baseNingizimu Afrika lebebakhona ngesikhatsi kwakhiwa libhuloho lelingumlandzo lelidze kunawo onkhe e-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e lebohisa dienjenere tsa Afrika Borwa tse bileng le seabo ntshetsopeleng ena e entseng nalane ya borokgo ba fanyeho bo bolelele ka ho fetisisa Afrika.
tgt: IMaputo-Catembe Bridge yakhiwe be-China Road and Bridge Corporation kantsi ihlanganisa iMaputo eMozambique neKwaZulu-Natal.

src: Borokgo ba Maputo-Catembe bo ile ba ahwa ke China Road and Bridge Corporation e le ho kopantsha Maputo Mozambique le KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Mengameli waseMozambique, MnuFilipe Nyusi, uvule lelibhuloho lelingemkhilomitha lamatsatfu budze iMaputo-Catembe Bridge, lelakhiwa iminyaka lendlula kulemine ngetigidzi letilinganiselwa ku-US$785.

src: Moporesidente wa Mozambique, Monghadi Filipe Nyusi, o butse Borokgo ba Maputo-Catembe bo bolelele ba dikilomitara tse tharo, bo ileng ba ahwa ka nako ya dilemo tse nne ka ditjeho tsa US$785 milione.
tgt: Lelibhuloho litawenta kutsi kube nekuhwebelana nekuvakashelana emkhatsini weMozambique neNingzimu Afrika kantsi sikhatsi sekuhamba kusuka eMaputo uye eKosi Bay KwaZulu-Natal emgceleni wase-East Coast sehlile kakhulu kusuka kumahora lasitfupha kuya kumizuzu lenge-90.

src: Diqeto tsa Kabinete Beke ya Tsebiso ya Bobehaditaba ka Lenaneo la Tshebetso ya Mmuso.
tgt: Liviki Lekwatisa ngeLuhlelo Lwekusebenta.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka dipehelo tsa tshebetso ka diphetho tse ka sehloohong nakong e qalang ka la 1 Mmesa 2018 ho ya ho 30 Loetse 2018.
tgt: IKhabhinethi itjeliwe ngalenchubekela phambili ngalemibiko yalemiphumela lebalulekile ngalesikhatsi kusukela ngamhla lu-1 iNkhwekhweti 2018 kuya mhla ti-30 Inyoni 2018.

src: Mafapha a sebetsang ka hara mekgahlelo ya ho kenya diphetho tse sehloohong tse 14 a tswelapele ho fihlela ditshebeletso tsa ona tse ikgethileng.
tgt: Ematiko lasebenta ngemaklasta kute asebentise lemiphumela leli-14 lebalulekile kute bachubeke nekutfola imiphumela yalabakwentako.

src: Diphetho tsena di tswa ho Moralo wa Lewa la Nako e Bohareng (MTSF) wa 2014-2019 le ho tswa ho Ponelope ya 2030 ya Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP).
tgt: Lemiphumela ivela kuloLuhlaka Lwendlelalisu Lwethemu Lesemkhatsini yanga-2014 - 2019 kuMbono wanga-2030 Weluhlelo Lwekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe (i-NDP).

src: Kabinete e ananetse mosebetsi o hlokehang ho tobana le diphephetso tse hahlamelang phethahatso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume letinyatselo letidzingekako tekubuketana naletinkhinga letitsikameta kucala kusebenta.

src: Dipehelo di phatladitswe wepsaeteng ya Lefapha la Merero, Bodisa le Tlhatlhobo ya Tshebetso (DPME) (WEBTOKEN).
tgt: Imibiko ishicilelwe kuwebhusayithi yeLitiko Letekucaphela Nekulinganisa Kusebenta Kwahulumende (i-DPME) letsi: WEBTOKEN Luhlelo Lwekutfutukisa Nekukhicitwa Kwetitfutsi (i-APDP).

src: Leano la Tlhahiso le Ntshetsopele ya Dipalangwang (APDP).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumele kukhuliswa kwe-APDP kusukela nga-2021 kuya ku-2035 ngetichibiyelo kute kusekelwe Loluhlelo Lolukhulu Lwetitfutsi eNingizimu Afrika (i-SAAM).

src: Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana katoloso ya APDP ho tloha ka 2021 ho ya ho 2035 ka diphetoho tse tla Leano le Hlokolosi la Dipalangwang la Afrika Borwa (SAAM).
tgt: I-SAAM igcile etindzaweni letisitfupha: Kukhulisa Mkakha Wetimoto Wasekhaya Kutfutfukisa Imboni Yetimoto Yesigodzi Kutsenga tingcenye tetimoto lapha eNingizimu Afrika Kutfutfukisa tinsitanchanti Kwenta kancono timboni, kanye Nekutfutfukisa iTheknoloji nemakhono lahambisanako.

src: SAAM e tsepame ho mekgahlelo e tsheletseng e leng Ntshetsopele ya dimaraka tsa lebatoweng Dihlahiswa tsa selehae Ntshetsopele ya meralo ya motheo Phetolo ya Diindasteri, le Thekelonoji le ntshetsopele ya bokgoni bo amehang.
tgt: Lokuchibiyela kuhlose kulokunye kukhutsata emazinga laphakeme nekungeta emazinga akuleli ekwakha ematfuba lamanyenti emisebenti.

src: Diphetoho tsena ho tse ding di tla kgothaletsa maemo a phahameng a nang le boleng ba selehae ho theha menyetla e meng e tla eketsa mesebetsi.
tgt: Kuhlola nekulandzelela loluhlelo netimboni letihambisana naloko nato tiyatfutfukiswa kucinisekisa intfutfuko ngekwalombono netinjongo te-SAANdvuna weTimboni neTekuhwebelana, Dkt Rob Davies, utawatisa betindzaba ngalokuchibiyela ngaLesihlanu, mhla ti-23 Lweti 2018.

src: Letona la Kgwebisano le Diindasteri (dti), Ngaka Rob Davies, o tla buisana le ba bo raditaba ka diphetoho tsena ka Labohlano, la 23 Pudungwana 2018.Dibili.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume Umtsetfosivivinyo Wemali Leyongetelelweko Yeluhlolo Mabhuku Lwahulumende wanga-2018, kutsi wetfulwe ePhalamende.

src: Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana ntlha ya hore Bili ya Bohlakisi ba Ditjeo tse Fetang Ditekanyetso ya 2018 e tla phatlalatswa Palamenteng.
tgt: Lomtsetfosivivinyo uvumela Umhlolimabhuku Jikelele kutsi atsatse tinyatselo tekulungisa kucinisekisa kutsi lokulahlekela uMbuso, lapho kufanele khona, kuyatfolakala nekundlulisela letinye tento tebugebengu kutsi tiphenywe.

src: Bili e tla nehela Kantoro ya Mohlakisi wa Kakaretso matla a ho nka mehato ho netefatsa hore ditahlehelo tsa ditjhelete tse hlahelang Mmuso, haeba ho kgonahala, di a busetswa le ho hlahisa tsohle tse belaelwang tse bakang tshebediso e bohlaswa ya ditjhelete hore di fuputswe.
tgt: Lomtsetfosivivinyo ubuye uhlose kuniketa AG emandla ekuhlola emabhuku angaphandle nekuhlola emabhuku indlela lasebenta ngayo, nekucondzanisa lamalungiselelo ekulawula kwa-AG kuhambisane neluhlelo lwekusebenta kahle lwanyalo.

src: Diketsahalo tse Tlang Letsholo la 100 # WomenOfFortitudeKa mora nako ya ho thunya, 100 # WomenOfFortitude e tla phahlalatswa mane Union Buildings, Pretoria ka la 22 Pudungwana 2018.
tgt: I-100 #WomenOfFortitudeKulandzela lesikhatsi sekukhetfwa, i-100 #WomenOfFortitude itawembulwa e-Union Buildings ePitoli ngamhla ti-22 Lweti 2018.

src: Komiti ya Matona ka Puso ya Kopanelo ya Mengwahakgolo wa Nelson Mandela le Albertina Sisulu e ile ya tsebahatsa letsholo la #WomenOfFortitude ka la 11 Mphalane 2018 jwalo ka le leng la diketsahahalo tsa Mongwahakgolo wa Mama Sisulu.
tgt: Lekomidi Lehlanganisa boNdvuna yekubungatwa Kweminyaka Lelikhulu yaNelson Mandela na-Albertina Sisulu imemetele mhla ti-11 Imphala 2018 kutsi umkhankaso we-#WomenOfFortitude ungomunye lotawuba ingcenye yemikhosi Yeminyaka Lelikhulu yaMake Sisulu.

src: Letsholo la #WomenOfFortitude ke mokgatlo wa basadi ba 100 la ho tsamaisa dipuisano ka hore basadi ba ka kgona ho tswella ka mesebetsi ya mohale enwa, Mama Sisulu le kajeno lena.
tgt: Lomkhankaso we- #WomenOfFortitude wabomake labali-100 labatawuhola letingcogco tekutsi bomake namuhla bangawugcina njani umlandvo waMake Sisulu.

src: Matsatsi a 16 a Boitseko bo kgahlano le Dikgoka tsa Bong (GBV)Lefapha la Basadi le hokela le tiiseletsa alakamani ya diketsahalo ya Letsholo la Matsatsi a 16 a Boitseko bo kgahlano le GBV ho tloha ka la 25 Pudungwana ho isa ho la 10 Tshitwe 2018.
tgt: Emalanga la-16 eKulwisana Neludlame Lwekuhlukumeta Ngekwebulili (i-GBV)Litiko Labomake lihlanganisa futsi lichumanise imigubho yahulumende Yemkhankaso Wemalanga la-16 eKulwisana Nekuhlukunyetwa Ngekwebulili (i-GBV) kusukela ngamhla ti-25 Lweti kuya ku-10 Ingongoni 2018.

src: Ditho tsa Tsamaiso ya Kakaretso ya Mmuso wa Naha ha mmoho le baetapele ba mmuso wa porofense le wa selehae ba tla ba le seabo diketsahalong tsa potefolio kapa lekaleng la naha ka bophara ka boiteko ba ho buisana le setjhaba.
tgt: Emalunga Esigungu Lesiphakeme kanye nebaholi bahulumende wetifundza nasemakhaya batawenta imicimbi lephatselene naleto tikhundla /umkhakha eveni lonkhe ngekubamba imihlangano yekukhulumisana nebantfu.

src: Mananeo a mmuso ka botlalo a ka fumaneha ho WEBTOKEN Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAfrika Borwa ohle ho sebedisa polatefomo ena ho ba le seabo diketsahalong tsena tsa mmuso tse haufinyana le bona.
tgt: Imininingwane lenabile yetinhlelo tahulumende ingatfolakala ku: WEBTOKEN IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi basebentise lesikhatsi bangenelele emicimbini yahulumende lesedvute nabo.

src: Setjhaba le mekgatlo ya basadi e kgothaletswa ho ba le seabo diketsahalong tsena nakong ena.
tgt: Imiphakatsi naletinye tinhlangano tabomake bayakhutsatwa kutsi bangayikhohlwa lemicimbi.

src: MaAfrika Borwa ohle a kgothaletswa ho sebetsa mmoho le ho mamela pitso ya #HearMeToo, ka ho mamela sello sa basadi, le ho etsa ho hong ho fedisa tlhekefetso ya mekgwa yohle le dikgoka tse kgahlano le basadi.
tgt: Bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bayacelwa kutsi basebentisane kutsi baphendvule kulesicelo lesitsi #HearMeToo, ngekulalela kukhala kwabomake, bese benta lokutsite kucedza lokubhebhetseka kwanoma luphi luhlobo lwekuhlukunyetwa kwabomake.

src: Ditebohiso.
tgt: Kuhalalisa.

src: Kabinete e lebohisa bahale bohle ba selehae ba dipapadi ba phahamisetsang folakga ya Afrika Borwa hodimo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela onkhe emachawe etemidlalo labhebhetelisa umjeka waseNingizimu Afrika uphaphele etulu.

src: Katleho ya ba itlhommeng pele mekgahlelong ya dipapadi, ile ya bontshahatswa ka ho ba putsa moketeng wa Dikgao tsa Dipapadi tsa 2018.
tgt: Lokuphumelela kwalabo labente kahle kulemikhakha lehlukene yetemidlalo, ibongwe kulomcimbi wanga-2018 Wemiklomela Yetemidlalo losandza kuba khona.

src: Caster Semenya wa Afrika Borwa o hapile Dikgau tse pedi tsa Kgauta ka ho hloha kgau ya Naledi ya Dipapadi ya Selemo ha mmoho le ya Mosadi wa Dipapa wa Selemo.
tgt: Caster Semenya waseNingizimu Afrika utfumbe emagolide lamabili ngekutiwinela indondo yemdlali lodvumile wemnyaka, i-Sports Star of the Year, kanye nendondo yemdlali longumake wemnyaka, i-Sportswoman of the Year.

src: Sesesi se hlwahlwa Chad le Clos se hlotse Kgau ya Monna wa Dipapadi wa Selemo.
tgt: Lona loyindadi eNingizimu Afrika Chad le Clos uphumelele indondo ye-Sportman of the Year.

src: Ndodomzi Ntutu o hlotse Kgau ya Monna wa Dipapadi wa Selemo ya batho ba holofetseng.
tgt: Ndodomzi Ntutu uphumelele indondo yemdlali wemnyaka lonekukhubateka, i-Sportsman of the Year with Disability.

src: Anrune Liebenberg o hlotse Kgau ya Mosadi wa Selemo ya batho ba holofetseng.
tgt: Anrune Liebenberg uphumelele indondo yemdlali wemnyaka longumake lonekukhubateka, i-Sportswoman of the Year Award with Disasbility.

src: Banyana Banyana ba hlotse Kgau ya Sehlopha se sebeditseng hantle sa Selemo.
tgt: IBanyana Banyana iphumelele indondo Yelicembu Lemnyaka.

src: Banyana Banyana ba hlotse papadi ya pulo kgahlano le Nigeria Ditlhodisanong tsa Mohope wa Dinaha tsa Afrika (AFCON) wa 2018.
tgt: IBanyana Banyana iphumelele umdlalo wayo wekucala lebawudlale ne-Nigeria ku-2018 Women’s Africa Cup of Nations (i-AFCON).

src: Bafana Bafana ba bapetse 1-1 kgahlano le Nigeria hore ba kgone ho bapala dipapading tsa AFCOSehlopha sa Rekebi sa Afrika Borwa se theoheleditswe ka dipapadi tsa sona mme re se lakaletsa mahlohonolo papading e tlang e kgahlano le Wales ka la 24 Pudungwana 2018.
tgt: IBafana Bafana idlale ngekulingana nga-1-1 neNigeria kumdlalo wekungena ku-AFCOLicembu leRugby laseNingizimu Afrika lishayelwa tandla ngendlela lelidlale ngayo kantsi sibafisela inhlanhla kulomdlalo wabo lotako nababukene neWales ngamhla ti-24 Lweti 2018.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAfrika Borwa hore ba tswelle ho tshihetsa basadi le banna ba dipapadi naheng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bachubeke basekele labomake nabobabe labadlala imidlalo kulelive.
