src: DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di lokela ho netefatswa ka mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang.
tgt: Kubekwa etikhundleniKutawucinisekiswa ticu tetemfundvo nekuhlola kufaneleka kwabo bonkhe lababekwe etikhundleni.

src: Khomishene ya Tshebeletso ya Lebotho la Tshireletso:a. Moatefokate Motlatjo Josephine Ralefataneb.
tgt: Ikhomishini Yetemsebenti Wembutfo Wetekuvikela:a. Adv.

src: Pehelo ya Kopano e Tlwaelehileng ya Kabinete e neng e tshwaretswe Union Buildings, Tshwane ka Labohlano, la 13 Tshitwe 2019Dintlha ka maemo a renang hajwale.
tgt: Sitatimende seMhlangano Lotayelekile weKhabhinethi lebewubanjelwe e-Union Buildings, ePitoli ngaLesihlanu, mhla ti-13 Ingononi 2019.Tindzaba Talelive.

src: Eskom.
tgt: Letiphatselene ne-Eskom.

src: Kabinete e tshehetsa ka botlalo matsapa ohle a reretsweng ho netefatsa phepelo e tsitsitseng ya motlakase naheng yabo rona.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyesekela ngalokuphelele yonkhe imitamo lokuhloswe ngayo kucinisekisa kuphakelwa kwagezi ngalokungatsikameteki eveni letfu.

src: Tabeng ena, Kabinete e laetse Letona la Dikgwebo tsa Mmuso Pravin Gordhan ho dula majwana le Mohlanka e Moholo wa Phethahatso Mong.
tgt: Ngaleyo ndlela, Ikhabhinethi igunyate Indvuna yeTemabhizinisi aHulumende Pravin Gorhan kutsi acocisane neSisebenti Lesikhulu Umnu Andre de Ruyter kutsi asheshe acale kusebenta kungakashayi lusuku lwakhe lwekucala kusebenta lebelubekiwe.

src: Andre de Ruyter hore a thakgole mosebetsi wa hae le pele ho letsatsi leo a neng a tshwanela ho qala ka lona.
tgt: Umnu de Ruyter kanye nelicembu lakhe lelulawulo batawubukana naletindzaba letikhatsatako letiphatselene nekuphatsa ngekushesha, kuswelakala kwelulawulo lwetetimali kanye nekusimamisa kusebenta kwe-Eskom.

src: de Ruyter mmoho le moifo wa hae wa bolaodi ba tla sebetsana le dintlha tse amang taolo, bolaodi ba ditjhelete ba be ba tsitsise ditshebetso tsa Eskom.
tgt: Loku kufaka ekhatsi kulungisa kusilela emuva lokukhulu kwekugcina tisesimeni tonkhe tikhungo letiphehla gezi letigugako kanye nekungakheki ngemfanelo kwetikhungo letiphehla gezi taseMedupi naseKusile.

src: Sena se akga ho sebetsana le tshallomorao e kgolo ya tokiso ya thepa e tsofalang ya diteishene tsa yona tsa motlakase esita le mafokodi a meralo ya motheo a diteishene tsa motlakase tsa Medupi le Kusile.
tgt: Lisekelamengameli David Mabuza utawubita Umhlangano Wekubonisana Ngetemandla lotawufaka ekhatsi Indvuna Yetetimali Tito Mboweni Indvuna Yetetimbiwa Netemandla Gwede Mantashe kanye neNdvuna Gordhan.

src: Motlatsi wa Moporesidente David Mabuza o tla epa Pitso ya Tsosoloso ya Eneji e nang le Letona la Ditjhelete Tito Mboweni Letona la Diminerale le Eneji Gwede Mantashe le Letona Gordhan.
tgt: Lelicembu litawubukana nanome ngabe ngutiphi tinsayeya tekuphakelwa kwemandla kulelive.

src: Moifo ona o tla sebetsana le diphephetso dife kapa dife tsa phepelo ya motlakase ka hara naha.
tgt: Temandla lavusetelelwako titawudlala indzima lemcoka ekuphakelweni kwetfu kwemandla kute kwengetwe kulemitamo ye-Eskom.

src: Eneji e hlwekileng e tla ba le seabo sa bohlokwa phepelong ya rona ya motlakase bakeng sa ho tlatseletsa matsapeng a Eskom.
tgt: Kutakulwa Kwebhizinisi Yetekuhamba Ngemoya yaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAA).

src: Bekeng ena e fetileng SAA e ile ya kenngwa tlasa Tlhabollo ya Kgwebo.
tgt: I-SAA kuleliviki leliphelile ibekwe ngephasi kwelulawulo Lwekutakulwa Kwebhizinisi.

src: Kabinete e na le tshepo ya hore bokenadipakeng bona bo tla thusa ho bea tshebeletso ena ya naha ya difofane maemong a matla, hore e be setheo seo kgabareng se tla tshetjwa ke maAforika Borwa ohle se be se hohele balekane ba tla se tshehetsa.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyetsemba kutsi lokungenelela kutawuphindza futsi kubuyisele esimeni lenkampani yavelonkhe yetekutfutsa ngemoya kutsi icine, ibe sikhungo lesinekucudzelana futsi ngekuhamba kwesikhatsi sitawuphindze futsi sibuyise kwetsenjwa kwaso ngibo bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nekuheha kulingana nebalingani.

src: Kabinete e ananetse thonyo ya Setsebi sa Tlhabollo ya Dikgwebo Mong.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikwemukele kukhetfwa kweSisebenti Sekutakulwa Kwebhizinisi Umnu Les Matuson lovela kubaka-Matuson Associates.

src: O tla sebetsa le Balekane ba Batho ba Batsho ba tla phatlalatswa ha mmela o ntse o puta.
tgt: Utawusebentisana neBlack Partners letawumenyetelwa khona nje madvutane.

src: SAA e tla fumana tjhelete enngwe ya tlatsetso ya R2 bilione e le thuso ya ditjhelete e tswang mmusong bakeng sa ho kenya letsoho mabapi le tlhophobotjha e potlakileng ya tshebeletso ena ya difofane.
tgt: I-SAA itawutfola tigidzigidzi le-R2 letengetiwe telusito lwetetimali letivela kuhulumende tekwelekelela ekwakheni kabusha kuko konkhe kwalenkampani yetekuhamba ngemoya.

src: Hape, baadimi ba hajwale ba SAA ba tla fana ka R2 bilione enngwe ya tlatsetso.
tgt: Nekutsi futsi, batjalitimali be-SAA labakhona batawusita ngetigidzigidzi le-R2 letengetiwe.

src: Kabinete e tshepa hore bokenadipakeng bona bo tla busetsa seriti sa tshebeletso ena ya difofane bo be bo thibele ho putlama ha yona ho neng ho tla ba le kgahlamelo e mpe ho bapalami, bafani ba ditshebeletso le balekane ba bang lekaleng la bofofisi mme haholoholo, ho basebetsi.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyetsemba kutsi lokungenelela kutawubuyisela esimeni ludvumo lwalenkampani yetekuhamba ngemoya kanye nekuvikela kuwa kwayo lokungabe kube nelifutse lelibi kubagibeli, kubatfulitinsita kanye nakulabanye balingani kumkhakha wetekuhamba ngemoya futsi kakhulu, kubasebenti.

src: Letona Gordhan le tla tlalehela Kabinete kgafetsa ka kgatelopele e mabapi le bokenadipakeng bona ba Tlhabollo ya Dikgwebo.
tgt: Indvuna Gordhan utawubika njalo nje kuKhabhinethi mayelana nenchubekelembili yalokungenelela Kwekutakulwa Kwebhizinisi.

src: Dikgohola.
tgt: Tikhukhula.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso a yona ho ba lahlehetsweng ke baratuwa ba bona ka lebaka la dikgohola tsa moraorao tse bonahetseng dibakeng tse fapaneng tsa naha.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi itfumela emavi ekudvudvuta kulabo labalahlekelwe ngulababatsandzako babo ngenca yaletikhukhula letisandza kubakhona etindzaweni letahlukahlukene talelive.

src: Mmuso o hlophisa bokenadipakeng ba makala a mangata ka Setsi sa Naha sa Bolaodi ba Dikoduwa, ho arabela tshenyong e bakilweng ke dikgohola tsena.
tgt: Hulumende uchumanisa kungenelela lokumhibaminyenti ngekusebentisa Sikhungo Savelonkhe Selulawulo Lwetinhlekelele kute kubukanwe nalenhlekelele lebangwe nguletikhukhula.

src: Kabinete e ananela tshehetso ya mekgatlo e fapaneng e etsang matsapa a thuso e potlakileng.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi isekela tinhlangano letahlukahlukene ngemitamno yato yekusita ngekushesha.

src: Ho pholoswa ha batho meahong le ho fallisetsa ba neng ba hloka bodulo diholong tsa setjhaba le dikerekeng, ho bontshitse moya wa sebele wa Ubuntu.
tgt: Kukhishwa kwebantfu etakhiweni kanye nekubeka bantfu labasuke etindzaweni tabo emahholweni emmango kanye nasemasontfweni kukhombise umoya weBuntfu sibili.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso setjhabeng ho mamela ditemoso le dikeletso mabapi le maemo a kotsi a lehodimo.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi icela sive kutsi sibolalela tecwayiso neticapheliso tesimo selitulu lesibi.

src: Metsi a dikgohola a phallang ka sekgahla a bea bophelo kotsing mme bakganni le ditaaso ba kgothaletswa ho ba sedi haholo ba be ba pheme ka hohlehohle ho sebedisa ditsela tse tletseng metsi.
tgt: Tikhukhula temanti lageleta ngekushesha tiyingoti emphilweni ngako-ke bashayeli nalabahamba ngetinyawo bayacwayiswa kutsi banakekele kakhulu futsi batigweme sanhlobo vele tindlela letinetikhukhula.

src: Badudi ba dulang dibakeng tse tlase pela dinoka le matamo, ba lemoswa ho ba sedi le ho ya dibakeng tse bolokehileng ka potlako ha ba bona matshwao a dikgohola.
tgt: Takhamuti letihlala etindzaweni letiphasi kwemifula kanye nemadamu tiyacwayiswa kutsi ticaphele futsi tiphangise tisuke natibona timphawu tetikhukhula tiye etindzaweni letiphephile.

src: O se ke wa bea bophelo ba hao tsietsing ka ho sesa matamong le dinokeng nakong ya dipula tsa ditlwebelele.
tgt: Ningabeki timphilo tenu ebungotini ngekuhlamba emadamini kanye nasemifuleni ngesikhatsi kuna timvula letinkhulu.

src: Sehla sa Monyaka wa Mafelo a Selemo.
tgt: Sikhatsi Semicimbi Yenjabulo.

src: Kabinete e lakaletsa maAforika Borwa ohle katleho le polokeho Sehleng sa Monyaka wa mafelo a selemo.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ifisela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika Sikhatsi Semicimbi Yenjabulo lesiphephile nalesinemphumelelo.

src: Re le maAforika Borwa re lokela ho tswelapele ho bontsha Ubuntu ho maAforika Borwa a habo rona mmoho le baeti nakong ena ya nyakallo.
tgt: Njengebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kufanele kutsi sichubeke sikhombise Buntfu kubantfu bakitsi baseNingizimi Afrika kanye nasetivakashini tetfu ngalesikhatsi sekujabula.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa ohle hore a hlomphe melao ya tsela ha a leba dibakeng tsa phomolo esita le nakong yohle ya sehla sena sa monyaka wa mafelo a selemo.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi bahloniphe imitsetfo yemgwaco ngesikhatsi bahamba baya etindzaweni tabo tekucitsa emaholideyi kuso sonkhe lesikhatsi semicimbi yenjabulo.

src: Boikarabelo ba ho fokotsa dikoduwa mebileng ke ba e mong le e mong wa rona.
tgt: Kusibopho salowo nalowo kutsi sicinisekise kutsi sinciphisa kufa ngebunyenti kwebantfu etingotini temigwaco.

src: Boikarabelo mebileng bo kenyeletsa ho se nwe o ntse o kganna, ho kganna ka lebelo le molaong, ho nahanela basebedisi ba bang ba mmila, ho kenyeletsa le ditaaso.
tgt: Kutiphatsa lokunekutibophelela emigwacweni kufaka ekhatsi kungashayeli unatsile, kuhlonipha litubane lemgwaco lelibekiwe, kucabangela labanye bantfu labasebentisa umgwaco, lokufaka ekhatsi labahamba ngetinyawo.

src: Ha re sebetseng mmoho ho boloka maphelo #LiveBeyondDezemba # Arrive Alive.
tgt: Asisebentisaneni kusindzisa timphilo #LiveBeyondDezemba #Fika Uphephile.

src: “Ditshebetso tse Bolokehileng tsa Sehla sa Monyaka wa mafelo a selemo” di se di qadile moo Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa sa Aforika Borwa (SAPS) e keneng kgabong nakong ena.
tgt: Tinhlelo tahulumende “Tekuphepha Tesikhatsi Semicimbi Yenjabulo” setivele seticale ngemandla kuTemisebenti Yetemaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) ngalesikhatsi.

src: Baahi ba kgothaletswa ho sebedisa mobile App ya MySAPS, e leng ya pele ya mofuta wa yona kontinenteng ya Aforika.
tgt: Takhamuti tiyagcugcutelwa kutsi tisebentise i-App umuntfu lahamba nayo i-MySAPS, leyiluhlobo lwekucala lapha kulelivekati lase-Afrika.

src: App ena e ntjha e thusa baahi ho iteanya le bahlanka ba qobello ya molao ka bokgabane ka ho loma sepolesa tsebe ntle le ho itsebisa, ho fumana diteishene le disebediswa tse haufi tsa sepolesa, esita le ho thusa lehlatsipa la ditlolo tsa molao ho romela melaetsa hanghang nakong ya tshohanyetso.
tgt: Le-App lensha isita takhamuti kutsi tichumane ngendlela lenemphumelelo netiphatsimandla tekucinisekisa kugcinwa kwemtsetfo ngekutsi titincite indlebe ngekungatidzaluli emabito ato, kutfola titeshi temaphoyisa letisedvutane kanye netisetjentiswa, kanye nekuvumela lohlukunyetwe bugebengu kutsi atfumele imilayeto ngekushesha nakunesimo lesiphutfumako.

src: Kabinete e boetse e ipiletsa ho batswadi le bahlokomedi ho netefatsa hore bana ha ba siuwe ba le bang nakong ena.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi futsi icela batali kanye nalabanakekela bantfwana kutsi bacinisekise kutsi bantfwana abasali bodvwa bangabhasojwa ngalesikhatsi.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa ho nka Sho’t Left ka ho etela dibaka tsa kwano lapeng tse nang le kgohedi e le ho tshehetsa diketsahalo tsa lapeng.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi igcugcutela bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi batsatse i-Sho’t Left bayowuvakashela tindzawo talelive letiheha bavakashi futsi basekele imicimbi yalelive.

src: Tshebediso ya batataisi ba ngodisitsweng ba bahahlaudi e tla netefatsa polokeho e be e matlafatse malebela a ho eta.
tgt: Kusetjentiswa labasebenta ngetekuvakasha lababhalisile nome labaluleka tivakashi kutawucinisekisa tekuvikeleka kanye nekukhutsata kuvakasha.

src: Dintlha tse tebileng tsa batataisi ba ngodisitsweng ba bahahlaudi di ka fumanwa diwebsaeteng tse fapaneng tsa Dikantoro tsa Bohahlaudi tsa Diprovense.
tgt: Imininingwane yalabeluleka tivakashi lababhalisiwe ingatfolakala kumawebhusayithi eHhovisi Letekuvakasha Lesifundza.

src: Diphetho tsa 2019 tsa Ditlhahlobo tsa Materiki tsa Naha (NSC).
tgt: Imiphumela Yeluhlolo lwanga-2019 Yamatekuletjeni (i-NSC).

src: Kabinete e leboha matitjhere, baithuti le batswadi ka ho sebedisana le mmuso ho netefatsa ho phethelwa ka katleho ha Ditlhahlobo tsa 2019 tsa NSDiphetho di tla phatlalatswa phirimaneng ya la 7 Pherekgong 2020 mme baithuti ba kgothaletswa ho etela websaete ya Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo (WEBTOKEN) kapa ba ingodise ka SMS ka ho romela dinomoro tsa bona tsa boitsebiso le Nomoro ya Tlhahlobo ho 3565.8 ho fumana diphetho tsa bona.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ibonga bothishela, bafundzi kanye nebatali ngekusebentisana nahulumende kucinisekisa kutsi luphotfulwa ngemphumelelo Luhlolo lwe-NSC lwanga-2019.

src: Diqeto tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Tincumo teKhabhinethi.

src: Moralo wa Taolo ya Dioli tsa Tlhaho.
tgt: Luhlelomsebenti Lwekulawula Emafutsa Lentiwa Ngetitjalo.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Moralo wa Taolo ya Dioli tsa Tlhaho, o tla fana ka matla bakeng sa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Lewa la Diindaseteri tsa Dioli tsa Tlhaho.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iluvumile Luhlelomsebenti Lwekulawula Emafutsa Lentiwa Ngetitjalo, lolutakwenta kutsi kube nekucala kusebenta kweNdlelalisu Yemafutsa Lentiwa Ngetitjalo eTetimboni.

src: Dioli tsa Tlhaho di ananelwa le matjhabeng ka ho ba disebediswa tse nang le khabone e tlase.
tgt: Emafutsa lakhiwa ngetitjalo ngekwemave emhlaba atsatseka njengemafutsa lanekhabhoni lencane langatsatsa sikhundla.

src: Di tswaka dioli bakeng sa dioli tse tlwaelehileng, mabapi le ho fokotsa disilafatsi tsa moya tsa tshebediso ya oli ya dipalangwang.
tgt: Ahlanganisa emafutsa e etimbiwa latayelekile ngenhloso yekunciphisa kungcoliseka kwemoya ngekusebentisa emafutsa etekutfutsa.

src: Moralo o fana ka dibaka tse hlano tse lokelang ho laolwa, e leng (1) Porothokhole ya disebediswa tsa motheo tsa tlhahiso.
tgt: Loluhlelomsebenti lwenta kutsi kube netindzawo letisihlanu tekulawulwa letibitwa ngekutsi (1) Indlelanchubo yalokutawusetjentiswa.

src: Porothokhole ena e bebofatsa kotsi ya lenaneo la dioli tsa tlhaho mabapi le kanetso ya dijo.
tgt: Lenchubo yehlisa bungoti betinhlelo temafutsa lentiwa ngetitjalo ekubeni khona kwekudla.

src: (2) Melawana e tlamang ya ho tswaka bakeng sa ho hlahisa botsitso ba tlhoko ya dioli tsa tlhaho.
tgt: (2) Imitsetfosimiso yekulawula kubhicwa ngenhloso yekwenta kutsi kube nesiciniseko sekufunwa kwemafutsa lentiwe ngetitjalo.

src: (3) Mokgwa wa ho kgutlisa ditjeo tsa ho tswaka dioli tsa tlhaho.
tgt: (3) Indlela yekubuyiselwa kwetindleko tekubhicwa kwemafutsa lentiwe ngetitjalo (4) Indlela yeselekelelomali sahulumende seMafutsa Lentiwe Ngetitjalo sekwelekelela balimi bemafutsa lentiwe ngetitjalo kanye nekwesekela benti bemafutsa lentiwe ngetitjalo.

src: (4) Mokgwa wa tshehetso ya ditjhelete bakeng sa Dioli tsa Tlhaho ka morero wa tshehetso ya dihwai tsa dioli tsa tlhaho le baetsi ba dioli tsa tlhaho.
tgt: (5) Silinganisosimo sekukhetsa imiklamo yekwentiwa kwemafutsa lentiwa ngetitjalo ledzinga selekelelomali sahulumende.

src: Tokomane ya moralo ona e ka fumanwa ka websaete ya Lefapha la Eneji: WEBTOKELekgotla la Naha la Tshireletso.
tgt: Ledokhumenti yaloluhlelomsebenti kungafinyeleleka kuyo ngekusebentisa iwebhusayithi yeLitiko Letemandla ku: WEBTOKEUmkhandlu Wavelonkhe Wetekuvikeleka Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kusungulwa kabusha kweMkandlu Wavelonkhe Wetekuvikeleka ngenhloso yekuhlela kabusha kuchumana kwayo yonkhe imisebenti lehambelanako yetekuvikeleka kulelive.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho thewa botjha ha Lekgotla la Naha la Tshireletso, ho tjhorisa kgokahano ya mosebetsi ohle o amanang le tshireletso ya naha.
tgt: Lomkhandlu utawubukana nekuvuma Indlelalisu Yavelonkhe Yetekuvikeleka, bomacalakwentiwa beTebunhloli taVelonkhe talelive kanye neTilinganiso taVelonkhe teTebunhloli.

src: Lekgotla le tla ikarabella kananelong ya Lewa la Tshireletso ya Naha, dintlha tse ka sehlohlolong tsa Mautlwela a Naha le Dikgakanyo tsa Mautlwela a Naha.
tgt: Sihlalo walomkhandlu kutawuba nguMengameli ngekwesikhundla sakhe sekuba nguMkomuzi Lomkhulu weTembutfo Wemphi kanye neweTekuvikeleka.

src: Modulasetulo wa Lekgotla e tla ba Moporesidente boemong ba hae jwaloka Molaodi e Moholo wa Mabotho a Sesole le Tshireletso.
tgt: Lalamanye emalunga emkhandlu kutawuba Lisekelamengameli Mabuza Indvuna Yetekuvikeleka Kwembuso Ayanda Dlodlo Indvuna Yetembutfo Wekuvikela Netigayigayi Temphi Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula Indvuna Yetasekhaya Aaron Motsoaledi Indvuna Yetebulungiswa Netemisebenti Yekulungiswa Kwetimilo Ronald Lamola Indvuna Yetemaphoyisa Bheki Cele Indvuna Yetetimali Tito Mboweni kanye neNdvuna Yetekubusa Ngekuhlanganyela Netendzabuko Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma.

src: Pampiri e Tshweu ya Merero ya Lehae.
tgt: Umtsetfo Lohlongotwako Wetasekhaya.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Pampiri e Tshweu ya Merero ya Lehae, hammoho le lewa la boemo bo hodimo le mmapa wa ho hlophisa botjha Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae e le mothusi ya hlokolosi bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya moruo le tshireletso ya naha.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iwuvumile Umtsetfo Lohlongotwako Wetasekhaya, kanye nendlelalisu lephakeme kanye nemkhombandlela wekumisa kabusha Litiko Letasekhaya njengesikhutsati lesimcoka sekutfutfukisa temnotfo kanye netekuvikeleka tavelonkhe.

src: Pampiri e Tshweu e itshetlehile hodima motheo wa leano bakeng sa mmuso wa sejwalejwale o sebedisang mekgwa ya dijithale, e re atametsang phihlellong ya merero ya e-Government le e-Commerce.
tgt: LoMtsetfo Lohlongotwako weyame kusisekelo senchubomgomo wekwentiwa simanjemanje nekwentiwa dijithali kwahulumende lokuyintfo lesisondzeta dvute netinhloso taHulumende losebentisa tindlela te-elekthroniki kanye netekuchuba Temabhizinisi ngendlela ye-elekthroniki.

src: Kabinete e anantse ho kenngwa ha Tumellano ya Madrid ya Matshwao a Matjhaba a Boingodiso (1989) Palamenteng bakeng sa kamohelo.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kungeniswa ePhalamende kweSivumelwane saseMadrid lesimayelana nekuBhaliswa Kwemave Emhlaba Kwetimphawu (1989) kutsi isigunyate.

src: Porothokhole ya Madrid e akaretsa tshireletso ya matshwao a boitsebahatso a kgwebisano.
tgt: LeNdlelanchubo yaseMadrid ikhava kuvikeleka kwetimphawu tekuhweba.

src: Matshwao a boitsebahatso a kgwebisano a aha temoho ya dihlahiswa le monyetla wa tlhodisano mabapi le papatso ya thepa le ditshebeletso kwano lapeng le matjhabeng.
tgt: Timphawu tekuhweba takha kwatiwa kweluphawukuhweba kanye nelusito ekukhangiseni timphahla kanye netinsita lapha ngekhatsi eveni kanye nasemaveni emhlaba.

src: Ho fihlella Porothokhole ya Madrid ho tla thusa ka ntshetsopele ya Leano la Thepa ya Bonono (IP) la naha.
tgt: Kuvumelana neNdlelanchubo yaseMadrid kutawenta kutsi kutfutfukisele embili Inchubomgomo Yetemphahla Lecanjiwe (i-IP) yalelive.

src: Le tla fana ka lepatlelo dikgwebong tsa Aforika Borwa haholoholo tse nyane, la ho sebedisa tsamaiso ya IP bakeng sa ho bapatsa thepa le ditshebeletso tsa bona matjhabeng.
tgt: Kutawunika temabhizinisi aseNingizimu Afrika ikakhulu emabhizinisi lamancane indlela yekusebentisa luhlelo lwe-IP kutsi bakhangise timphahla tabo kanye netinsita tabo emaveni emhlaba.

src: Lekala la Bapalami ba Diterene la Aforika Borwa (PRASA).
tgt: I-ejensi Yetitimela Tebagibeli yaseNingizimu Afrika (i-PRASA).

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho qhalwa ha Boto ya Nakwana ya PRASA esita le ho bea setheo sena tlasa tsamaiso.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kucitfwa kweBhodi Yesikhashana ye-PRASA kanye nekufaka lesikhungo ngephasi kwelulawulo lolutimele.

src: Aforika Borwa e hloka dibaka tsa diterene tse tshepahalang, tse bolokang tjhelete ebile e le tse phallang ha bobebe, tse sebetsang e le tshiya ya dipalangwang tsa setjhaba mabapi le ho hokahanya mefuta e fapaneng ya dipalangwang.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika idzinga kuhamba kwetitimela lokutsembekile, imivila yekuhamba kwetitimela lete tihibe lengumgogodla wetekutfutsa ummango ekuchumaniseni tindlela letahlukahlukene tetekutfutsa.

src: Sephetho sa moraorao sa Mohlahlobi-Kakaretso wa dibuka tsa ditjhelete bakeng sa 2018/19, se tlalehile ho hloleha ho hobe ha taolo ya PRASA, kgaello ya bolaodi bo hlwahlwa ba ditjhelete tsa PRASA ka hore e fumane Sephetho sa ho le Nyaya le Kolobe sa Bohlahlobi ba Ditjhelete.
tgt: Imiphumela yeMhlolimabhuku Jikelele yanga-2018/19 lasandza kuyikhipha ibike ngekwehluleka lokukhulu kutekuphatsa ku-PRASA, kuswelakala kwenchubo lenemphumelelo yekulawulwa kwetimali lokuholele ekutseni i-PRASA itfole Umbiko Weluhlolomabhuku Wekutihlangula.

src: Ka lebaka lena, Kabinete e ananetse thonyo ya Motsamaisi, Mong Bongisizwe Mpondo, ho tsamaisa merero ya setheo sena ka dikgwedi tse Bokenadipakeng bona bo tla thusa mabapi le ho busetsa tshebetso e hlwahlwa ya PRASHo Fallela ha Kgaso Mokgweng wa Dijithale.
tgt: Ngaleyo ndlela-ke, Ikhabhinethi yakuvuma kukhetfwa kweMphatsi lotimele, Umnu Bongisizwe Mpondo, kutsi aphatse tindzaba talesikhungo tinyanga leti-12.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka boemo ba lenaneo la ho Fallela Kgasong ya Mokgwa wa Dijithale mabapi le bolaodi ba poloko ya decoder, kabo le kgokelo.
tgt: Lesingenelelo sitawuba neligalelo ekubuyiseni kusebenta ngemphumelelo kwe-PRASKuntjintjela eKusakateni ngeDijithali.

src: E elelletswe moralo bakeng sa kgokelo ya thepa ya di-decoder e bolokilweng dipolokelong tsa Tshebeletso ya Poso ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi yatjelwa ngalamafishane mayelana nesimo seluhlelo lweKuntjintjela eKusakateni Ngedijithali lolumayelana nelulawulo lwekugcina idikhoda, kwabelwa kanye nelulawulo lwekufakelwa.

src: Kabinete e ananetse hore bakeng sa dikgokelo tse salletseng tsa di-decoder, bahokedi ba tla thonngwa boemong ba bomasepala.
tgt: Lucashelwe luhlelomsebenti lwekufakelwa kwesitoko semadikhoda lesigcinwe etindlini tekubeka timphahla eHhovisi Letemaposi aseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Mokgwa ona o shebilweng botjha wa phano o reretswe ho akofisa motjha o lebisitseng tabeng ya ho fallela mokgweng wa dijithale ho tloha ho wa analoko, esita le ho lokollwa ha High Demand Spectrum.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kutsi kufakelwa emadikhoda lokusasele, labawafakako batawukhetfwa esigabeni samasipala wendzawo.

src: Kabinete e boetse e ananetse thonyo ya Mong.
tgt: Lendlela leseyibuyeketiwe yekuletsa lensita, kuhloswe ngayo kwenta ngekushesha lenchubo yekuntjintja yekusuka ku-analogu kuyiwe kudijithali kanye nekukhishwa kweLuhlobo Lolufuneka Kakhulu.

src: Newyear Niniva Ntuli e le Motsamaisi le Mohlanka ya Ikarabelang wa Lekgotla la Tshebeletso ya Lefatshe ka Bophara le Phumantsho la Aforika Borwa, ka dikgwedi tse Tlaleho ya Tjhebobotjha ya Dilemo tse 25 tsa Matlafatso ya Basadi le Tekano ya Bong ka hara Aforika Borwa: 1994-2019.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iphindze futsi yakuvuma kukhetfwa kwaMnu Newyear Niniva Ntuli njengeMphatsi neSiphatsimandla Lesitilandzako se-Universal Service ne-Ejensi Yekufinyelela yaseNingizimu Afrika tinyanga letinge-.

src: Kabinete e ananetse tlaleho ena, e tla sebetsa e le Tlaleho ya Tumellano ya Beijing le Lepatlelo la Tshebetso la Beijing (Beijing +25) ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN).
tgt: Umbiko lomayelana neLubuyeketo Lweminyaka Lenge-25 Lwekutfutfukisa Bomake Nekulingana Ngekwebulili eNingizimu Afrika: 1994-2019.

src: Khomishene ya UN ya Boemo ba basadi e rerile ho etsa sehopotso sa bo-25 sa Tumellano ya Beijing le Lepatlelo la Tshebetso ka Tlhakubele 2020.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iwuvumile lombiko, lotawutsatseka njengeMbiko Wekubika Emuva kuSimemetelo saseBeijing nakuNkhundla Yekwenta (ye-Beijing+25) yaMhlabuhlangene(i-UN).

src: Aforika Borwa ke motekeni wa Tumellano ya Beijing.
tgt: Ikhomishini yaMhlabuhlangene Yesimo saBomake kumiswe kutsi igubhe umcimbi we-25 weSimemetelo saseBeijing neNkhundla Yekwenta ngeNdlovulenkhulu 2020.

src: Tlaleho ena e hlakisa kgatelopele dintlheng tse ngata mabapi le matlafatso ya basadi le matsapa a ho ngotla sekgeo sa ho se lekane ha bong.
tgt: Lombiko uchaza emabalengwe enchubekelembili etindzaweni letinyenti letimayelana nekutfutfukiswa kwabomake kanye nemitamo yekulinga kunciphisa ligebe lekungalingani ngekwebulili.

src: Leha e tiisa hore Aforika Borwa e na le bokenadipakeng bo phethahetseng ba melao le leano tse arabelang ho tsa bong ho lokisa botjha kgethollo ka bong, diqholotso tsa ho fetola nalane ya ho se lekane ha bong le ho rarolla taba ya ditlwaelo tse ntseng di tsitlalletse tsa bontate ba le ka sehloohong, le ho kgetholla ho ntseng ho le teng.
tgt: Nanome ucinisekisa kutsi live laseNingizimu Afrika linemtsetfo loyimphendvulo kutebulili kanye netingenelelo tenchubomgomo tekulungisa kabusha tenkholelo yebulili, tinsayeya tekugucula kungalingani kwebulili ngekwemlandvo kanye nelungisa tento letichubekako tekubeka labadvuna ebuholini bomake bangabekwa kanye nekuba nemcondvo lotsite ngalabanye bantfu.

src: Dikgoka tse Amanang le Bong (GBV) le Moralo wa Lewa la Naha wa Dipolao tsa Basadi (NSP) (2020-2030).
tgt: Budlova Lobucondziswe Kubulili Lobutsite (i-GBV) kanye Nendlelalisu Yavelonkhe Yekulwa Nekubulawa Kwabomake (i-NSP).

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka NSP 2020-2030, e fanang ka moralo wa lenaneo la mekga e mengata, leano la lewa le momahantsweng le lenaneo la moralo, ho netefatsa karabelo e hokahantsweng ya naha ho GBV ke mmuso le naha ka bophara.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi yatjelwa ngalamfishane mayelana ne-NSP 2020-2030, leyenta kutsi kube nenchubomgomo yendlelalisu lehlanganisa imikhakha leminyenti, kanye neluhlelo lweluhlakamsebenti kucinisekisa kuphendvula kwavelonkhe ku-GBV lokuhlangene kwahulumende kanye nelive lonkhana.

src: Kabinete e ananetse hore mananeo ohle a morero a thuswang ka ditjhelete, a tlameha ho kenngwa tshebetsong ke mafapha a fapaneng a amehang.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi yavuma kutsi tonkhe tinhlelo letisitwe ngetimali talelisu kufanele kutsi tifezekiswe ngematiko lahlukahlukene latsintsekile.

src: Kabinete, leha ho le jwalo, e laetse hore mosebetsi o mong o lokela ho etswa mabapi le ho batalatsa tlhophiso e lohothwang ya setheo le kgokahanyo ya mosebetsi ona.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi, nanome kunjalo, yabeka livi lesicondziso kutsi imisebenti lechubekako yentiwe ekwenteni ncono tinhlelembiso tetikhungo letiphakamisiwe kanye nekuchumana kwetinhlelembiso talomsebenti.

src: Matona ana a latelang a ile a laelwa ho etsa mosebetsi wa tlatsetso tabeng ena: Letona la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba Lindiwe Zulu Letona la Toka le Ditshebeletso tsa Tlhabollo ya Batshwaruwa Ronald Lamola Letona la Sepolesa Bheki Cele Letona la Basadi, Batjha le Batho ba Qhwadileng Maite Nkoana-Mashabane.
tgt: LeTindvuna letilandzelako tanikwa livi lekutsi tente umsebenti lochubekako macondzana naloku: Indvuna Yetekutfutfukisa Tenhlalo Lindiwe Zulu Indvuna Yetebulungiswa Netemisebenti Yekulungiswa Kwetimilo Ronald Lamola Indvuna Yetemaphoyisa Bheki Cele Indvuna yaBomake, Lusha Nebantfu Labakhubatekile Maite Nkoana-Mashabane.

src: Letona Nkoana-Mashabane o tla hokahanya setlamo sena.
tgt: Indvuna Nkoana-Mashabane nguye lotawubita lelicembu emhlanganweni.

src: Dikgothaletso tsa Phanele ya Boeletsi ya Boporesidente ya Tlhabollo ya Mobu le Temothuo.
tgt: Tincomo Tephaneli Yekweluleka Mengameli mayelana neKulungiswa Kabusha Kwemhlaba Netekulima.

src: Ka la 24 Phupu 2019, Kabinete e amohetse Tlaleho ya Phanele ya Boeletsi ya Boporesidente ya Tlhabollo ya Mobu le Temothuo tlasa bodulasetulo ba Ngaka Vuyokazi Mahlati, e entseng dikgothaletso tse Ka Komiti e Kopanetsweng ya Matona ya Tlhabollo ya Mobu e etelletsweng pele ke Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Mabuza, mafapha ohle a amehang a ile a koptjwa ho sekaseka dikgothaletso tse amanang le ditshebetso tsa bona ka tatelano a be a arabele ka tshwanelo.
tgt: Mhla tinge-24 Kholwane 2019, Ikhabhinethi yatfola Umbiko Wephaneli Yekweluleka Mengameli mayelana neKulungiswa Kabusha Kwemhlaba Netekulima sihlalo wayo kunguDkt.

src: Kabinete e se e tjhaelletse monwana ebile e tsheheditse tse 60 tsa dikgothaletso tsena.
tgt: Vuyokazi Mahlati, leyente tincomo letinge-73.

src: Ke tse robong feela tse sa tjhaellwang monwana mme tse tharo di ile tsa nkelwa hloohong.
tgt: Ngekusebentisa Likomidi Lelihlanganisa Tindvuna leliholwa nguSekelemengameli Mabuza, onkhe ematiko latsintsekako acelwa kutsi atifundze letincomo letiphatselene netikhundla tawo bese asayaphendvula ngendlela lefanele.

src: Mafapha a fapaneng a tla fana ka tsebiso e batlang e le toma dintlheng tse ileng tsa nkelwa hloohong empa di sa tjhaellwa monwana.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi seyivele itigunyatile yaphindze yatesekela tincomo letinge-60.

src: Kabinete e bone tlaleho ya GFIP (di e-toll) ya Moifo wa Tshebetso o eteletsweng pele ke Letona la Dipalangwang Fikile Mbalula.
tgt: Ematiko lahlukahlukene atawubamba umhlangano lophelele wekwatisa lomayelana naleto tindzawo letingazange tivunywa kanye naleto letacashelwa.

src: Qeto ya moshwelella e mabapi le dikgothaletso tsa Moifo wa Tshebetso jwaloka ha di fuperwe tlalehong, e tla etswa Selemong se Setjha.
tgt: Umklamo Wekutfutfukisa Umgwaco Longutsela Wayekela waseGauteng (i-GFIP).

src: Kgetho ya Bakgolamolemo le Leano la Kabo ya Mobu.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iwucaphele umbiko lomayelana ne-GFIP (umgwaco lotselelwako) weLicembu Lemsebenti leliholwa yiNdvuna Yetekutfutsa Fikile Mbalula.

src: Kabinete e ananetse phatlalatso ya leano lena bakeng sa hore setjhaba se tshwaele.
tgt: Sincumo sekugcina lesimayelana naletincomo taLelicembu Lemsebenti njengaloku ticuketfwe kulombiko sitawukhishwa ngeMnyaka Lomusha.

src: Leano le fana ka motjha o tshepahalang ebile e le o bonaletsang bakeng sa kabo ya mobu le kgetho ya bakgolamolemo.
tgt: Kukhetfwa Kwebazuzi Nenchubomgomo Yekunikwa Kwemhlaba.

src: Kabinete e ananetse phatlalatso ya Bili ya Ditshebeletso tsa Tshehetso ya Mahlatsipa ya 2019 bakeng sa hore setjhaba se tshwaele.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi yaluvuma lushicilelo lwenchubomgomo kutsi ummango uphawule.

src: Bili ena e fana ka katamelo ya bokenadipakeng bo kopanetsweng, ba mekgatlo e mengata mabapi le ditlhoko tsa mahlatsipa a ditlolo tsa molao le dikgoka.
tgt: Lenchubomgomo yenta kutsi kube nenchubo letsembekile nalengafihli yekunikwa kwemhlaba kanye nekukhetfwa kwebazuzi.

src: Ka bili ena mesebetsi le ditshebeletso tsa mafapha a fapaneng ho lefapha la Toka, Thibelo ya Ditlolo tsa Molao le Tlelastara ya Tshireletso le Tlelastara ya Kahisano, di tla hokahanngwa hantle e le karolo ya lethathama le le leng la boleng.
tgt: Lokucaphelekile kutsi, ilungisa kungalingani ngekwebulili ekunikweni kwemhlaba kanye nasekufinyeleleni kuwo, kanye nekweswelakala kwetindlela tekusita bahlali bemmango labaphuyile kanye nebahlali besigodzi kutsi bafinyelele kutfola umhlaba nangabe kube netinhlekelele temvelo kanye naletinye timo letiphutfumako.

src: Kabinete e Tjhaelletse Monwana hape le Leano la Ditshebeletso tsa Tshehetso ya Diphofu la Selemo sa Kabinete e boetse e ananetse Bili ya Ditsebi tsa Ditshebeletso tsa Kahisano ya 2019 hore e kenngwe koranteng ya mmuso bakeng sa hore setjhaba se tshwaele.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iluvumile lushicilelo lweMtsetfosivivinyo Yemisebenti Yekusekela Labahlukumetekile wanga-2019 kutsi ummango uphawule ngawo.

src: Bili e entswe bakeng sa ho atolosa taolo ya ditsebi tsa tshebeletso ya setjhaba ka ho ananela hore ho na le maemo a seporofeshenale le a bothusi ka hara mesebetsi ya tshebeletso ya kahisano.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo wenta kutsi kube nendlela lehlanganisiwe nalenetingenelelo letimhibaminyenti tetidzingo talabahlukunyetwe bugebengu kanye nebudlova.

src: Bili ena, hang ha e ba molao, e tla hlakola Molao wa Seporofeshenale wa Tshebeletso ya Kahisano, 1978 (Molao wa bo-110 wa 1978).
tgt: Ngekusebentisa loMtsetfosivivinyo lokutawukwentiwa kanye nemisebenti yematiko lahlukahlukene kuTebulungiswa, Kuvikelwa Kwebugebengu kanye neKlasta Yetekuvikeleka Neklasta Yetenhlalo itawuchunyaniswa kancono njengencenye yinye yetinchubo tekukhicita.

src: Hamamorao Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba le tla manolla dibili tsena tse pedi tse sisintsweng.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iphindze futsi yavuma Inchubomgomo Yetemisebenti Yekwesekela Labahlukumetekile yanga-20.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho kenngwa ha Bili ya Kamoho ya Thepa ya 2019 bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iphindze futsi yawuvuma Umtsetfosivivinyo Wetisebenti Temisebenti Yetenhlalo wanga-2019 kutsi ufakwe kugazethi kute ummango uphawule ngawo.

src: Bili ena e matlafaditswe ke ditshwaelo tsa dipuisano tse batsi le setjhaba le ho tswa dikarolong tse fapaneng.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo wasungulwa ngenhloso yekwandzisa kulawulwa kwetisebenti temisebenti yetenhlalo kanye nekubona kutsi tisemazingeni omabili ebungcweti kanye nelekusita khona lapha ekhatsi emisebentini yetemisebenti yetenhlalo.

src: Hang ha e fetiswa ho ba molao, Bili e tla fana ka metjha e tshwanang e tla latelwa ha kamoho ya thepa e kenngwa tshebetsong.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo nasewentiwe umtsetfo, utawucitsa loMtsetfo Wetemisebenti Yetenhlalo Yebungcweti lokhona kwanyalo, wanga-1978 (Umtsetfo we-110 wanga-1978).

src: E fana ka moralo wa semolao bakeng sa mafapha a mmuso le dikarolo tse ding tsa puso makaleng a mararo a mmuso bakeng sa ho sebedisa metjha e tshwanang ya kamoho ya mobu le ya meralo e meng ya motheo.
tgt: Litiko Letekutfutfukisa Tenhlalo kutawutsi esigabeni lesitako lichaze kabanti lemitsetfosivivinyo lemibili lephikisanako.

src: Kabinete e ananetse phatlalatso ya moralo wa Bili ya Ntshetsopele ya Mehlodi ya Peterole bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kungeniswa kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekutsatfwa Kwemphahla Nguhulumende Yabelwe Ummango wanga-2019 kutsi ummango uphawule ngawo.

src: Bili ena e habile ho bopa tikoloho e tla hodisa botsetedi ba lekala la peterole.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo wentiwa waba sezingeni lelincono ngenca yemibono letfulwe ngesikhatsi kubonisanwa kabanti nesive ngawo kanye futsi nangemibono levela etinhlanganweni letahlukene.

src: E fana ka tataiso mabapi le mesebetsi ya tshibollo le tlhahiso, e tla thusa kgolong ya moruo le diphetohong.
tgt: Nasewuphasisiwe waba ngumtsetfo, loMtsetfosivivinyo utakwenta kutsi kube netinchubo letifananako letitawulandzelwa nasekwentiwa lokutsatfwa kwemphahla nguhulumende yabelwe ummango.

src: E thea Lekgotla la Peterole la Aforika Borwa, le tla etsa dikgothaletso ho Letona la Mehlodi ya Diminerale le Eneji.
tgt: Unika luhlakamsebenti lwetemtsetfo kutsi ematiko ahulumende kanye naletinye tikhungo tembuso kulemikhakha lemitsetfu yahulumende kutsi tisebentise indlela lefananako yekutsatfwa kwemphahla yabelwe ummango kanye naletinye tinchubo tekutsatfwa kwetakhiwonchanti ngumbuso wabele ummango.

src: Kabinete e ananetse phatlalatso ya Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Matla a Ditjhelete le Mesebetsi ya Bomasepala bakeng sa hore setjhaba se tshwaele.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iluvumile lushicilelo lweMtsetfosivivinyo loluhlaka Wekutfutfukisa Imitfombolusito Yephethroliyamu Lengakahlutwa kute ummango uphawule ngawo.

src: Bili ena e hlomathisa Molao wa Matla a Ditjhelete le Mesebetsi ya Bomasepala, 2007 (Molao wa bo-12 wa 2007).
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo kuhloswe ngawo kugcugcutela simondzawo lesikhutsata lutjalomali kumkhakha wephethroliyamu lengakahlutwa.

src: E laola matla a bomasepala a ho teka ditefello tsa ntshetsopele mabapi le dikopo tsa ntshetsopele ya mobu tse kentsweng ho bomasepala.
tgt: Unika Inkhombandlela lemayelana nekuhlwaywa kanye newemisebenti yekuyikhicita lengaba neligalelo ekukhuleni kwetemnotfo kanye netingucuko.

src: Ditefello tsa ntshetsopele ke tse ding tsa disebediswa tseo bomasepala ba ka di sebedisang ho nyolla kotla ya ntshetsopele ya meralo ya motheo ya bomasepala.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uphindze futsi wente kutsi kube nehlukaniswa kwekulawulwa kwemitfombolusito yephethroliyamu.

src: Sena se thusa bomasepala ho etsa mesebetsi ya bona ya ho fana ka meralo ya motheo e tshwerweng hantle ebile e le e sebetsang bakeng sa ho katolla dikgoro tsa kgolo ya moruo.
tgt: Usungula i-Ejensi Yephethroliyamu yaseNingizimu Afrika, letakwenta tincomo eNdvuneni Yetetimbiwa Netemandla.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho kenngwa ha Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Lekala la Bohlahlobi ba Dibuka tsa Ditjhelete.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iluvumile lushicilelo lweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibela Emandla eTetimali taBomasipala Nemisebenti kute kutsi ummango uphawule ngawo.

src: Bili ena e hlomathisa Molao wa Porofeshene ya Bohlahlobi ba Dibuka tsa Ditjhelete, 2005 (Molao wa bo-26 wa 2005).
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uchibela Umtsetfo Wemandla eTetimali taBomasipala Nemisebenti, wanga-2007 (Umtsetfo we-12 wanga-2007).

src: Bili ena e sisinya hore Boto e Ikemetseng ya Taolo ya Bahlahlobi ba Dibuka tsa Ditjhelete e matlafatswe bakeng sa ho fana ka samane mothong ya nang le lesedi lefe kapa lefe le hlokehang bakeng sa ho phethela diphuputso mabapi le boitshwaro bo sa lokang ba bahlahlobi.
tgt: Ulawula emandla abomasipala kutsi utselise ilevi kutentfutfuko mayelana neticelo tentfutfuko kutemhlaba letifakiwe kumasipala.

src: Dihlomathiso di boetse di matlafatsa Letona la tsa Ditjhelete bakeng sa ho lekanya tjhelete e hodimodimo e ka lefiswang mohlahlobi ya fumanweng a le molato nyeweng ya kgalemo ya boitshwaro.
tgt: Kudvonselwa umtselo wentfutfuko nguletinye tetindlela bomasipala labangatisebentisa kusita ngetimali kutfutfukisa takhiwonchanti tabomasipala.

src: Kgoeletso ya ho kenela Dikgau tsa Boraditaba tsa Mokgatlo wa Dinaha tsa Aforika e ka Borwa (SADC).
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kungeniswa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibela Tebungcweti Bekuhlola Emabhuku.

src: Boraditaba ba Aforika Borwa ba memelwa ho kenela tlhodisano ya Dikgau tsa Boraditaba tsa SADC tsa 2020 pele ho la 28 Hlakola 2020.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uchibela Umtsetfo Wetebungcweti Tekuhlola Emabhuku, wanga-2005 (Umtsetfo we-26 wanga-2005).

src: Baqolotsi ba Ditaba ba lakatsang ho kenela tlhodisano ba ka fumana lesedi le tomanyana ho WEBTOKEN le www.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uphakamisa kutsi Ibhodi Letimele Yekulawula Bahloli Bemabhuku inikwe emandla ekubitela enkantolo nome ngabe ngumuphi umuntfu lonelwatiso nome ngabe nguluphi loludzingekako kuphotfula nome ngabe nguluphi luphenyo lolumayelana nekungatiphatsi kahle kwebahlolimabhuku.

src: Mohlodi wa Mabotle wa Aforika Borwa Zozibini Tunzi ka ho hapa sekola sa Miss Universe 2019 Atlanta, Amerika.
tgt: Betindzaba baseNingizimu Afrika bayamenywa kutsi bangenele umcudzelwano weMiklomelo Yebetindzaba ku-SADC kungakashayi mhla tinge-28 Indlovana 2020.

src: Restaurant Mosaic bakeng sa ho kgethwa e le lebenkele la dijo le maemong a hodimo ka ho fetisisa la Aforika Borwa ho Dikgau tsa Lefatshe tsa selemo le selemo tsa La Liste Paris, Fora.
tgt: Tintsatseli letifisa kungenela lomcudzelwano tingafinyelela kutfola lwatiso lolubanti ku: WEBTOKEN and www.

src: Amajita (Sehlopha sa naha sa bolo ya maoto sa ba ka tlasa dilemo tse 20 [U20]) ka papadi ya bona e matla kgahlanong le Zambia esita le ho tswa bobeding Mohopeng wa COSAFA wa U. DithonyoDithonyo tsohle di emetse ho netefatswa ka mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang ya tlhatlhobisiso.
tgt: Lobuhle waseNingizimu Afrika Zozibini Tunzi ngekuklonyeliswa sicoco sekuba nguLobuhle Wemhlaba 2019 lapha e-Atlanta, eMelika.

src: Lekgotla la Ntshetsopele ya Kgiro la Aforika Borwa:a. Moatefokate Richard Sizani (Khomishene ya Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba)b. Mofumahadi Phindile Mkwanazi (Sekolothupello sa Naha sa Mmuso)c. Mofumahadi Riefdah Ajam (Federeishene ya Mekgatlo ya Basebetsi ya Aforika Borwa)d. Mong.
tgt: Resitjurenti Mosaic ngekukhetfwa kutsi yiresitjurenti lesezingeni lelisetulu yaseNingizimu Afrika eMcimbini weMkomelo wemnyaka Wemaresitjurenti eMhlaba iLa Liste World Restuarant eParis, eFrance.

tgt: Tisebenti temaphoyisa letinsha leti-4 971 letitfweswe ticu ngaLesihlanu, mhla ti-13 Ingongoni 2019 letivela emakolishi ekuceceshelwa buphoyisa.

src: Bheki Ntshalintshali (Khonkerese ya Mekgatlo ya Basebetsi ya Aforika Borwa)f. Ngaka Octavia Mkhabela (O beile meja fatshe)g. Ngaka Chris Nhlapo (Yunivesithi ya Thekenoloji ya Peninsula ya Kapa)h. Ngaka Dudu Mkhize (Batjha ba Aforika Borwa ba Boenjinereng)i. Mong.

tgt: Ndvunankhulu wase-United Kingdom (e-UK) Boris Johnson kanye nenhlangano yakhe yetepolitiki i-Conservative Party ngekuphumelela Lukhetfo Jikelele lwase-UK lwanga-2019 futsi uhlose kuchubeka nekucinisa budlelwane emkhatsini walamave lamabili ngesikhatsi sekuba sesikhundleni kwakhe.

src: Pehelo ya Kopano ya Kabinete e neng e tshwerwe ka Laboraro, la 12 Hlakola 2020 Palamenteng, Tuynhuys ho la Motse KapaDintlha tsa Maemo a renang hajwale.
tgt: Sitatimende seMhlangano weKhabhinethi lobewubanjwe ngaLesitsatfu, mhla ti-12 Indlovana 2020 ePhalamende, eTuynhuys eKapaTindzaba letibalulekile taleLive.

src: Puo ya Maemo a Naha ya selemo sa 2020 (SoNA).
tgt: Inkhulumo yaMengameli yeBunjalo baleLive (i-SoNA) 2020.

src: Kabinete e ananela SoNA ya 2020 e tshetlehilweng ke Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa Tulong e Kopanetsweng ya matlo a mabedi a Palamente, Motse Kapa ka Labone, la 13 Hlakola 2020.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyayemukela i-SoNA yanga-2020 leyetfulwe nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa eMhlanganweni weTindlu Totimbili ePhalamende, eKapa ngaLesine, mhla ti-13 Indlovana 2020.

src: Puo ena e ile ya tshetlehwa kamora sehopotso sa bo-30 sa ho lokollwa ha Ntata Setjhaba, Tata Madiba, ya ileng a tswa Tjhankaneng ya Victor Verster ka la 11 Hlakola 1990.
tgt: Lenkhulumo yetfulwe ngemuva kwemkhosi we-30 kwakhululwa Babe weSive, Tata Madiba, lowaphuma akhululekile eJele iVictor Verster mhla ti-11 Indlovana 1990.

src: SoNA ya 2020 ya Moporesidente Ramaphosa e fanne ka Lenaneo la Tshebetso (PoA) la mmuso le hlakileng le reretsweng ho matlafatsa moruo wa naha o hlotsang ka ho lokisa metheo ya moruo.
tgt: I-SoNA yaMengameli Ramaphosa yanga-2020 inikete Luhlelo Lwekusebenta (i-PoA) lolubanti loluhlose kukhuphula lomnotfo walelive lontengantengako ngekutsi lulungise tintfo temnotfo letibalulekile.

src: Dikgweding tse mmalwa tse tlang ho tla kenngwa tshebetsong ditsela tse tla fetola ka botebo boemo ba ho fehlwa ha eneji le ditheko ka hara naha.
tgt: Kuletinyanga letimbalwa letitako sitawubona kufezekiswa tinyatselo letitawugucula ngemandla umgudvu wekukhicitwa kwemandla nekutsengwa kwemikhicito netinsita kulelive lakitsi.

src: Moporesidente o hlakisitse meralo ya ho matlafatsa tlhahiso ya lehae e tla matlafatsa dikgwebo tse nyane, tse mahareng le tse kgolo (di-SMME).
tgt: Mengameli ugcamise tinhlelo tekufukula imikhicito yakuleli letawunika emabhizinisi lamancane, lasemkhatsini nalamancane kakhulu (ema-SMME) emandla.

src: Se ka fetang 1 000 ya dihlahiswa tse hlahisitsweng ka lapeng di tla rekwa ho di-SMME tsena.
tgt: Imikhicito lengetulu kwale-1 000 lekhicitwa kuleli itawutsengwa ngekusebentisa wona lama-SMMLemitamo lena itawuba yincenye yetindlela letinsha tekwesekela bosomabhizinisi labalusha nekutisebenta.

src: Maikitlaetso ana a tla bopa karolo ya ditsela tse ntjhafetseng tsa ho tshehetsa boetapele ba dikgwebo ba batjha le hore ba itshebetse.
tgt: Emakhempasi alamakolishi lamasha eTifundvo teBuciko beMisebenti yeTandla neKucecesha (ema-TVET) latawakhiwa kulomnyaka atawusita ekuvaleni leligebe lelikhona emkhatsini wekweswelakala kwemisebenti nemakhono.

src: Dikhempase tse ntjha tse tla ahuwa tsa dikoletjhe tsa Setekginiki le Thuto le Thupello ya Mesebetsi (TVET) monongwaha di tla thusa ho ngotla sekgeo pakeng tsa tlhokeho ya mesebetsi le maitsebelo hara batjha.
tgt: Luphiko lweTinsita tekucashwa kweLusha, kanye nemkhakha lotimele, lutawucinisekisa kutsi bafundzi batfola litfuba lekwenta umsebenti mbamba emsebentini njengencenye yekuceceshwa kwabo.

src: Tshebeletso ya Kgiro ya Batjha (YES), hammoho le dikoletjhe tsa TVET le lekala la poraefete, di tla netefatsa hore baithuti ba bangata ba fumana boiphihlelo ba nnete ba mosebetsi e le karolo ya thupello ya bona.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iphindze futsi yemukela nesimemetelo sekusungulwa kwenkhundla ye-SheTradesZA letawusita emabhizinisi lachutjwa bomake kutsi ahlanganyele kumisebenti yekukhicita nasetimakethe.

src: Kabinete e boetse e ananela tsebiso ya ho theha lepatlelo la SheTradesZA le tla thusa dikgwebo tse tsamaiswang ke basadi ho nka karolo ho mathathama a boleng a lefatshe le mebaraka.
tgt: Imodeli yeKutfutfukisa yeSigodzi leyalingwa kulomnyaka lophelile kulinye lemadolobhakati nakubomasipala besigodzi lababili kulomnyaka itawufezekiswa kuto tonkhe tigodzi nemadolobhakati.

src: Motlolo wa Ntshetsopele wa Ditereke o ileng wa kenngwa tekong ngwahola ho motsemoholo o le mong le ho ditereke tse pedi tsa bomasepala o tla nehelanwa diterekeng kaofela le ho bomasepala ba metsemeholo.
tgt: Loku kutawuniketa yonkhe indlela yekwetfulwa kwetinsita emandla ekusebenta lecuketse lisu linye lelesekelwa ngito totintsatfu tinhlaka tahulumende.

src: Sena se tla matlafatsa motlolo o pharalletseng wa phano ya ditshebeletso o kenyeletsang moralo o le mong o tshehetswang ke dikarolo kaofela tse tharo tsa mmuso.
tgt: Inkhulumo yaMengameli ifake bonkhe inshisekelo yekubumbana nekutsi futsi kuchutjekelwe embili kuncotjwe tinsayeya tetfu kubuywe kwakhiwe intsandvo yelinyenti yeNingizimu Afrika lephokophelako.

src: Puo ya Moporesidente e susumeditse bohle ho kopana le ho fohla ho ya pele mabapi le ho hlola diphephetso tsa rona le ho aha demokerasi ya Aforika Borwa e atlehileng.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi imema yonkhe imikhakha yemmango kutsi isebentisane nahulumende ekufezekiseni i-PoA yahulumende.

src: Nakong ya dingangisano Palamenteng bekeng ena, ditho tsa Phethahatso di tla manolla PoA e tla nehelanwa selemong sena sa ditjhelete le ka nqane ho sona.
tgt: Ngesikhatsi setinkhulumomphikiswano eNingizimu Afrika kuleliviki, emalunga eSigungu Lesiphetse atawuchubeka ahlahlele le-PoA letawufezekiswa kulomnyakatimali wamanje nekukwendlula lapho.

src: Seboka sa Kopano ya Aforika (AU).
tgt: Ingcungcutsela yeBunye be-Afrika (ye-AU).

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Moporesidente Ramaphosa ka ho nka Bodulasetulo ba AU lebitsong la Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ihalalisela Mengameli Ramaphosa ngekubekwa esikhundleni sekuba nguSihlalo we-AU egameni leNingizimu Afrika.

src: Moporesidente o tla sebedisa mosebetsi ona wa hae ho kgothaletsa kgotso le botsitso, taolo e hlwahlwa, tekatekano ya bong le matlafatso ya basadi bakeng sa ho hodisa kgolo ya moruo wa Aforika.
tgt: Mengameli utawusebentisa indzima yakhe layidlalako kutfutfukisa kuthula nekusimama, buholi lobukahle, kulingana ngekwebulili kanye nekuhlonyiswa kwabomake ngemakhono ekukhulisa umnotfo wase-Afrika.

src: Ha morao monongwaha Tumellano ya Tikoloho ya Kgwebo e Lokolohileng ya Kontinente ya Aforika (AfCFTA) e tla thakgoha.
tgt: Ekuhambeni kwalomnyaka Sivumelwano seNdzawo yeLivekati le-Afrika yetekuhwebelana ngaloKukhululekile (i-AfCFTA) naso sitawucala kusebenta.

src: Tumellano ena e kopana ho ba mmaraka o le mong ho parola le dinaha tse 54 tsa batho ba ka bang 1,2 bilione ka palohohle ya dihlahiswa tsa naha e kopaneng e fetang US$3 trilione.
tgt: Lesivumelwano sichumanisa emave lange-54 abe yimakethe yinye yebantfu labalinganiselwa kutigidzigidzi leti-1,2 lanelinani lemikhicito netinsita letitigidzigidzi tetigidzigidzi letingetulu kwe-US$3.

src: Jwaloka Modulasetulo, Aforika Borwa e tla tshwara seboka ho phethela ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha porothokhole ya AfCFTAforika Borwa hape e tla sebeletsa ho lebisa ho Aforika e tsitsitseng le ya kgotso tlasa mookotaba: “Marumo fatshe: Re Bopa Maemo a Hlwahlwa bakeng sa Ntshetsopele ya Aforika”.
tgt: NjengaSihlalo, iNingizimu Afrika itawungenisa ingcungcutsela yekwephetsa indlelanchubo yekufezekisa le-AfCFTINingizimu itawuphindze futsi isebentele kuzuza iNingizimu lesimeme nalenekuthula ngaphansi kwalengcikitsi: “Akungadutjulwana ngeTibhamu: Kwakhiwe Simo Lesivuna Kutfutfuka kwe-Afrika”.

src: Kabinete e boetse e ananela tsosoloso ya Lenaneo la Bophara ba Boaforika.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iphindze futsi yakwemukela kuvusetelwa kwe-Ajenda yeKusabalala kweBantfu base-Afrika.

src: Boholo ba Bophara ba Boaforika, le maitsebelo le mehlodi tseo e nang le tsona, di baka tlhokeho ya mekgwa ya dipuisano tse hlwahlwa bakeng sa ho qhaneha bokgoni bona ba ho kgothaletsa ntshetsopele ya kontinente ena.
tgt: Bukhulu bekusabalala kwebantfu base-Afrika, kanye nemakhono nemitfombolusito lokuwacuketse, kubita tindlelanchubo tekukhulumisana letinemandla kute kutsi kusetjentiswa lamakhono ngalokuphelele kute kutsi kuchutjelwe embili kutfutfuka kwalelivekati.

src: Leeto la Semmuso la Jeremane.
tgt: Kuvakasha KweJalimane Lokusemtsetfweni.

src: Kabinete e ananela sephetho sa Leeto la Semmuso la Motjhanselara wa Jeremane Angela Merkel, le matlafaditseng dikamano tse ntseng di le teng bakeng tsa dinaha tsena tse pedi.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyakwemukela Kuvakasha lokuseMtsetfweni kweShansela yaseJalimane Angela Merkel, lokucinise budlelwane lobukhona emkhatsini walamave omabili.

src: Motjhanselara Merkel o etetse Aforika Borwa ka memo ya Moporesidente Ramaphosa ho tloha ka la 5 ho isa ka la 7 Hlakola 2020.
tgt: Shansela Merkel uvakashele iNingizimu Afrika ngekuya kwesimemo lesivela kuMengameli Ramaphosa kusukela mhla ti-5 kuya kumhla ti-7 Indlovana 2020.

src: Aforika Borwa e nkile monyetla ona bakeng sa ho arolelana menyetla e mengata ya botsetedi e teng ka hara naha.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika isebentise lelitfuba kwabelana ngematfuba lamanyenti elutjalomali lakhona kulelive lakitsi.

src: Sena se entswe nakong ya Foramo ya Kgwebo e kenyeletsang ka bobedi baetapele ba Aforika Borwa le kemedi ya borakgwebo e feleheditseng Motjhanselara Merkel.
tgt: Loku kwentiwa eNkhundleni yeteMabhizinisi lefaka ekhatsi baholi baseNingizimu Afrika nelitsimba lebetemabhizinisi lebeliphekeletela Shansela Merkel.

src: Jwale ka e mong wa batsetedi ba baholo Aforika Borwa, Jeremane e na le dikhamphani tse fetang 600 ka hara naha ya bo rona.
tgt: Njengalomunye webatjalimali labakhulukati lapha eNingizimu Afrika, Ijalimane inetinkampane letingetulu kwalitinge-600 kulelive lakitsi.

src: Khonvenshene ya Tshwarisano ya Kahisano ya Momahano ya Setjhaba le Kaho ya Setjhaba Kabinete e ipapisa le Moporesidente Ramaphosa mabapi le ho ananela sephetho sa Khonvenshene ya Tshwarisano ya Kahisano ya Momahano ya Setjhaba le Kaho ya Setjhaba e neng e tshwerwe tlasa mookotaba: “Dilemo tse Leshome tsa Bonngwe le Ntjhafatso: Re lebile Tshwarisanong ya Kahisano bakeng sa Momahano le Kaho ya Setjhaba”.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ihambisana naMengameli Ramaphosa ekwemukeleni imiphumela yeSivumelwano Sekusebentisa mayelana neKubumbana kweteNhlalo neKwakha Sive sentiwa ngaphansi kwalengcikitsi: “Umnyakalishumi weLubumbano neKuvusetela: Lokucondze kuSivumelwano Sekubambisana mayelana neKubumbana kweteNhlalo neKwakha Sive”.

src: Tlasa boetapele ba Lefapha la Dipapadi, Bonono le Botjhaba – hammoho le Kantoro ya Moporesidente le bankakarolo ba bang ba ka sehloohong – dikgwebo, mmuso, basebetsi le setjhaba ka kakaretso ba dumellane ho sebetsa mmoho ho aha setjhaba se kopaneng le ho kgothaletsa tokoloho, kgotso le polokeho hammoho le tlhompho ya ditokelo tsohle tsa botho.
tgt: Ngaphansi kwebuholi beLitiko Letemidlalo, Tebuciko Nemasiko – kanye neLihhovisi laMengameli kanye nalabanye badlalindzima lababalulekile – temabhizinisi, hulumende, tetisebenti kanye netinhlangano temmango bavumile kusebentisa kwakha ummango lobumbene kanye nekutfutfukisa inkhululeko, kuthula nekuvikeleka kanye nekuhlonipha onkhe emalungelo eluntfu.

src: Tshwarisano ya kahisano e ntshetsapele Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP), o kgothaletsang tlhokeho ya dilekane mabapi le ho hodisa Aforika Borwa, ha re sheba dikarohano tsa nalane ya ho se ahisane ho parola le setjhaba, ka ho qolleha ditabeng tsa semorabe, tse ntseng di tswella le kajeno.
tgt: Lesivumelwano sekusebentisana sichubela embili Lisu Lekutfutfukisa laVelonkhe, lelikhutsata sidzingo sekubambisana ekukhuliseni iNingizimu Afrika, uma kubukwa umlandvo wetenhlalo wekwehlukahlukana kuwo wonkhe ummango, ikakhulu emkhakheni wetebuhlanga, lokusolo kuchubeka nalamuhla.

src: Coronavirus.
tgt: Ligciwane i-Corona.

src: Kabinete e tiisetsa hore ditsha tsohle tsa kalafo tsa naha di fadimehile ka matla bakeng sa ho sebetsana le ho qhoma leha e le hofe ha Coronavirus.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyacinisekisa kutsi tonkhe tikhungo tetemphilo talelive lakitsi ticaphele ngemehlo elusweti kubukana nanoma ngusiphi sehlakalo seLigciwane i-Corona.

src: Ha ho na ditlaleho kapa ho qhoma ho belaellwang ha vaerase ena mme Kabinete e boeletsa molaetsa wa Letona la Bophelo ba Botle, Ngaka Zweli Mkhize, hore ho se ho na le ditsela tsohle tsa ho thibela ditshwaetso leha e le dife ka hara naha.
tgt: Kute imibiko noma tinsolo tekubakhona kwaleligciwane futsi-ke Ikhabhinethi igcizelela umlayeto weNdvuna yeTemphilo Dkt.

src: Madiboho a rona kaofela a fadimehile le ditsebi tsa kalafo di etsa ditekolo tsa dithemperetjha bakeng sa bahahlaudi kaofela ba matjhaba.
tgt: Zweli Mkize, kutsi tonkhe tinyatselo time ngemumo mayelana nekuvikela nanoma ngukuphi kwesuleleka ngaleligciwane lokungaba khona kulelive lakitsi.

src: Hodima moo, Aforika Borwa e tlile ka ditataiso tsa bongaka le ho di aba le ditlhaloso tsa ditlaleho ho dingaka le baoki ka bobedi makaleng a mmuso le a poraefete.
tgt: Yonkhe iminyele yekungena kulelive lakitsi icaphele ngewelusweti futsi tingcweti tetemphilo tihlola lizinga lekushisa kwemitimba yato tonkhe tivakashi takuleli lakitsi letichamuka kumave emhlaba.

src: Diprovense kaofela di na le meifo ya karabelo e malala-a-laotswe bakeng sa ho qhoma ho ka bang teng, mme di tonne mahlo bakeng sa ho hlwaya le ho laola ho runya ha diketsahalo tse ka hlahang ka tshohanyetso ka hara naha.
tgt: Kwengeta, iNingizimu seyente yabuye futsi yasabalalisa tinkhombandlela tekwelashwa nekuchazela bodokotela nebahlengi/bahlengikati ngalesimo kuyo yomibili lemikhakha wahulumende nalotimele.

src: Ho se ho hlwauwe dipetlele tse ngata ka hara naha e le ditsi tsa potetso le ho alafa mang le mang ya ka beng a tshwaeditswe ke Coronavirus.
tgt: Tonkhe tifundza setimise ngemumo licembu lelitawubukana nekubhedvuka kwaleligciwane, futsi bacaphele ngewelusweti kutfola kanye nekulawula timo letingakahloswa letingacubuka kulelive lakitsi.

src: Ka kantoro ya rona ya bonqosa ya Tjhaena, re dula re behile maemo leihlo mme re na le bonnete ba hore re ikemiseditse ho ntsha baithuti le baahi ba bang ba Aforika Borwa bao hajwale ba leng Wuhan, ho la Tjhaena haeba ho hlokeha.
tgt: Kuphindze futsi kwakhonjwa tibhedlela letinengi kulo lonkhe lelive lakitsi njengetikhungo tekuvalela nekwelapha nanoma ngubani longenteka kutsi wesuleleke ngaleLigciwane i-Corona.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana hore Aforika Borwa e amohelwe ho TAC e leng se tla kenngwa Palamenteng bakeng sa ho tjhaellwa monwana.
tgt: Ngekusebentisana neLihhovisi leLincusa letfu eShayina sisigadze ngewelusweti lesimo futsi siyatetsemba kutsi sikulungele kukhipha titjudeni naletinye takhamuti taseNingizimu Afrika lekwamanje tiseWuhan, eShayina uma kungavela sidzingo sekwenta njalo.

src: Mokgatlo wa Dinaha tsa Asia Borwa-Botjhabela (ASEAN) di kenyeletsa le leng la mabatowa a holang ka potlako ka ho fetisisa le ho itseka lefatsheng.
tgt: Sivumelwane seBudlwano Lobuhle neKusebentisana eNingizimu lengaseMphumalanga ye-Eshiya (i-TAC)6.1 Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kungena kweNingizimu Afrika kule-TAC letawetfulwa ePhalamende kute kutsi igunyatwe.

src: Ho amohelwa ho TAC e tla ba lewa la ho fa dikgwebo tsa Aforika Borwa monyetla wa ho fihlella lebatowa leo, le hore dinaha tsa ASEAN di fihlelle mebaraka ya Aforika Borwa le ya lebatowa la Ntshetsopele ya Badudi ba Aforika e Borwa (SADC).
tgt: Inhlangano yeMave laseNingizimu yeMphulanga ye-Eshiya (i-ASEAN) ifaka ekhatsi sinye setigodzi letikhula ngekushesha nalesinemandla emhlabeni.

src: Simphosiamo sa Botshelela sa Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) sa Semphato sa Thekenoloji ya Poloko ya Kgotso Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana hore Simphosiamo sa Botshelela sa UN sa Semphato sa Thekenoloji ya Poloko ya Kgotso se tshwarelwe Aforika Borwa ho tloha ka la 23 ho isa ka la 26 Phuptjane 2020.
tgt: Kungena kule-TAC ngekwelisubuciko kutawunika temabhizinisi aseNingizimu Afrika litfuba lekufinyelela lesigodzi, kanye nemave ale-ASEAN kufinyelela timakethe taseNingizimu Afrika neteNhlangano yeKutfutfukisa laseNingizimu ye-Afrika.

src: Simphosiamo se nyehela bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa kontinente mabapi le thibelo ya dikgohlano, poloko ya kgotso, tshireletso le kaho botjha le ntshetsopele kamora dintwa.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ivumile kutsi iNingizimu Afrika ingenise Inkhomfa ye-6 yeBudlelwane beMave Emahlaba yaMhlabuhlangene (ye-UN) yeTheknoloji kuTekugcina Kuthula kusukela mhla tinge-23 kuya kumhla tinge-26 Inhlaba 2020.

src: Selemong sena ho tla tsepamiswa maikutlo hodima ho batla ditharollo ka ho kgothaletsa tshebediso ya dithekenoloji tsa sejwalejwalo le mehopolo mererong e etellwang pele ke lebotho la UNakong ya simphosiamo ena, Aforika Borwa e tla kgona ho pepesa dihlahiswa tsa thekenoloji tse entsweng ka lapeng le bokgoni ba diindaseteri tsa naha ho tsa tshireletso.
tgt: Nanoma-nje emave lamanyenti ake awungenisa lomkhosi esikhatsini lesendlulile, loku kutawuba kwekucala ngca kutsi ungeniswe yi-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Bili ya Ditheko tsa Mmuso bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: Lenkhomfa ifaka ligalelo ekwenteni kancono lelivekati mayelana nekuvimbela kungcubutana, kugcina kuthula, kuvikeleka kanye nekwakha kabusha ngemuva kwekungcubutana nekutfutfuka.

src: Hang ha e se e fetohile molao, Bili e tla fedisa Molao wa Leano la Mawa a Ditheko ho ba neng ba Kotetswe, 2000 (Molao wa bo-5 wa selemo sa 2000) le ho hlomathisa melao e meng e amang ditheko.
tgt: Lokutawugcilwa kuko lonyaka kutawuba kutfola tisombululo ngekukhutsata kusetjentiswa kwematheknoloji esimanje kanye nemicondvo kumisebenti lechutjwa yi-UN.

src: Bili ena e sisinya lewa le le leng la bolaodi ba ditheko tsa mmuso.
tgt: Ngesikhatsi salekhomfa, iNingizimu Afrika itawukhona kukhutsata imikhicito yayo yetheknoloji lekhicitwa ngekhatsi kuleli lakitsi kanye nemakhono ekutivikela alelive.

src: E fana ka molao o ka sebetsang ha bobebe bakeng sa mawa a ditheko mabapi le ho tshehetsa merero ya mmuso ya moruo wa kahisano.
tgt: Umtsetfosivivinyo weKutsengwa Kwemikhicito neTinsita taHulumende.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tekwa ha Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Tekatekano ya Kgiro, ya selemo sa 2020 Palamenteng.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kweMtsetfosivivinyo weKutsengwa Kwemikhicito neTinsita taHulumende kute kutsi ummango uphawule ngawo.

src: Dihlomathiso di tla matlafatsa Letona la Lefapha la Kgiro le Basebetsi, ka ditherisano le bankakarolo ba makala, ho tsebahatsa dipehelo tse thusang bakeng sa ho teka merero e balehang ya Tekatekano ya kgiro ya makala a itseng.
tgt: Utawutsi ungaphasiswa ube ngumtsetfo, loMtsetfosivivinyo utawucitsa Umtsetfo weLuhlakamsebenti weKutsenga Lonconotwako, wanga-2000 (Umtsetfo we-5 wanga-2000) uphindze futsi uchibele leminye imitsetfo lephatselene nekutsengwa kwemikhicito netinsita tahulumende.

src: Se boetse se fokotsa morwalo wa taolo hodima bahiri ba banyane.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uphakamisa luhlakamsebenti lunye lwetekutsengwa kwemikhicito netinsita tahulumende.

src: Bili e kgothaletsa menyetla e lekalekanang le tshwaro e hlokang leeme ho tsa kgiro ka ho fedisa kgethollo e leeme.
tgt: Usungula siphatsimandla lesigunyatiwe kutsi silawule siphindze futsi sikhutsate Sigaba se-217 seMtsetfosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika wanga-1996 kuye wonkhe hulumende.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Ntlafatso ya Ditokelo tsa Kgiro ya Mobu.
tgt: Ungenisa umtsetfo lotse kutsamba kakhudlwana wemasubuciko lanconywako ekutsenga lokwesekela imigomo yahulumende netenhlalo netemnotfo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Ntlafatso ya Ditokelo tsa Kgiro ya Mobu bakeng ya tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: Umtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibela Tekucashwa ngeKulingana wanga-2020.

src: Bili e fana ka motjha o dumeletsehang wa molaotheo bakeng sa ho tiisa ditokelo tsa thuo le kgapo ya mobu ho phekola ho se nepahale ha dikarolo tse pedi ho ya ka molaotheo, tsa Molao wa Ntlafatso ya Ditokelo tsa Kgiro ya Mobu, 1991 (Molao wa bo-112 wa selemo sa 1991).
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kwetfulwa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo weKuchibela Imitsetfo yeKucashwa ngeKulingana wanga-2020.

src: Tlhophiso ya hajwale e ya kgetholla kgahlanong le basadi mabapi le ho fetolwa ha tokelo ya kgiro ya mobu ho ba thuo ya ona.
tgt: Letichibelo titawunika Indvuna yeTekucashwa Netisebenti emandla, ngekubonisana nebadlalindzima bemkhakha, kutsi kungeniswe imigomo leyenta tintfo tikhone kwenteka mayelana nekumiswa kwemigomo lebalekako yeKucashwa ngeKulingana lecondzene ngco nemkhakha lotsite.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Bili ya Kgwebo ya Dikepeng ya selemo sa 2020 bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: Kwentiwa ncono kweMtstefosivivinyo weKuchibela Kulungiswa Kuba neMalungelo Emhlaba.

src: Bili e reretswe ho fana ka matla ho tjhebelopele ya mmuso ya ho hlasimolla lekala la dipalangwang tsa mawatleng, le ho matlafatsa nyehelo kgolong le diphethohong tse matla tsa moruo.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kweMtstefosivivinyo weKuchibela Kwentiwa Kancono kweMalungelo Emhlaba, kute kutsi ummango uphawule ngako.

src: E imatahanya le dipehelo tsa bolaodi ba dikepe ho Leano le Pharalletseng la Dipalangwang tsa Mawatleng le ileng la tjhaellwa monwana ke Kabinete ka selemo sa 2017.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo wenta kutsi kube nenchubo levunywa ngumtsetfosisekelo yekuncuma emalungelo ekuba ngumnikati nekutsi kuhlalwe emhlabeni kute kutsi kulungiswe kungasebenti kwetigaba letimbili teMtsetfo Wekulungiswa kweMalungelo Emhlaba, (Umtsetfo we-112 wanga-1991).

src: Hang ha e se e tjhaelletswe monwana hore e be molao, Bili e tla fedisa melao e mengata e amanang le tsa mawatle.
tgt: Kuhleleka kwamanje kubandlulula bomake ekuguculweni kwemalungelo ekuba nemhlaba kube buniyo.

src: Bili e reretswe ho matlafatsa polokeho ditereneng tsa rona le ho netefatsa hore diterene e ba mokgwa o hohelang wa dipalangwang o tla boela o nyehele ka bokgabane moruong.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uphindze futsi ucinisekise kusetjentiswa kulo lonkhe lelive, lapho loMtsetfo bowungasebenti khona phambilini 'kuletabelo' iBophuthatswana, Ciskei, Transkei kanye naseVenda.

src: Bili e tjhaelletswe monwana kgetlo la pele bakeng sa ditherisano le setjhaba ka Hlakola 2018 mme ya lebiswa diprovenseng kaofela bakeng sa ditherisano le setjhaba ka Tlhakubele 2018.
tgt: Umtsetfosivivinyo weKusebentisa Imikhumbi weMaciko wanga-2020.

src: Bile e tjhaelletsweng monwana e lokelang ho tekelwa Palamente e nketse hloohong ditshwaelo tse amohetsweng nakong ya ditherisano le setjhaba.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekusebenta ngeMikhumbi weMaciko wanga-2020 kute kutsi ummango uphawule ngawo.

src: Metjha ya palamente e tla boela e thuisise botjha Bili ena pele e fetiswa ho ba molao.
tgt: Lomtsetfo ufuna kunika umbononchanti wahulumende emandla ekuvusetela umkhakha wetitfutsi taselwandle, kanye nekwenta kancono ligalelo lato ekukhuleni nasekugucukeni ngemandla kwemnotfo.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Boipiletso ba Dinyewe tsa Dipalangwang ya selemo sa 2018.
tgt: Uhambisana nemigomo yetemikhumbi yeNchubomgomo Lenkhulu yeTitfutsi taseLwandle leyavunywa yiKhabhinethi nga-2017.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tekwa ha Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Boipiletso ba Dinyewe tsa Dipalangwang ya selemo sa 2018 Palamenteng.
tgt: Uma sewuvunyiwe waba ngumtsetfo, loMtsetfosivivinyo utawucitsa imitsetfo leminyenti lephatselene netaselwandle.

src: Bili e hlomathisa Molao wa Boipiletso ba Dinyewe tsa Dipalangwang, 1998 (Molao wa bo-39 wa 1998) o sebetsanang le maipiletso a amanang le ditshebetso tsa diphomete tsa dipalangwang tsa tseleng tse jarang thepa (hajwale di bitswa dilaesense tsa tshebetso).
tgt: Umtsetfosivivinyo Wetekuphepha kweTetitimela wanga-2020.

src: Sehlomathiso sena se nkela hloohong diphethoho tsa maano, dintshetsopele le melao e metjha esale ho tloha ka selemo sa 1998.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kwetfulwa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wetekuphepha kweTetitimela wanga-2020.

src: Bili e tjhorisa le ho ntlafatsa metjha ya boipiletso, e leng se tla baka dipoloko tsa ditjeo le nako, le ho thusa beng ba dipalangwang tse tshelang meedi le tsa lehae ho tsamaisa bapalami ka bokgabane le ho iketsetsa bophelo.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo ufuna kucinisa tekuphepha kwetetitimela tetfu kanye nekucinisekisa kutsi kuhamba ngesitimela kuba yindlela yetekutfutsa lehehanako lephindze futsi ikhone kufaka ligalelo ngalokwakhako emnotfweni.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa dithoholetso tsa yona ho: moifo wa baithuti ba Aforika Borwa ba Kereiti 11: Sureshka Naidoo Caitlin Schwarer Nondumiso Ntshangase Nosipho Dube Mihlali Precious Stofile Ondele Bede Okhela Sigwela and Lizalise Dlomo, ba hapileng Tlhodisano ya bohlano ya Dikolo ya Matjhaba ya Dingangisano tsa Dinyewe tsa Samampapadi Poland.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo wavunywa kwekucala kutsi ummango uphawule ngawo ngeNdlovana 2018 futsi wakhishwa wayiswa kuto tonkhe tifundza kute kutsi ummango uphawule ngawo ngeNdlovulenkhulu 2018.

src: Sesesi sa Aforika Borwa Natalie du Toit bakeng sa ho kgethwa ho ya ho makgaolakgang hara baiketi ba bahlano bakeng sa Kgau ya Laureus Sporting Moment ya dilemo tse 20 tse fetileng (2000-2020).
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo lovunyiwe lotawetfulwa ePhalamende ufake ekhatsi emagalelo latfolwa ngesikhatsi ummango uphawula ngawo.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso a yona ho:lelapa le metswalle ya Profesara Joseph Shabalala, mohale wa sebini le mothehi wa sehlopha se hapileng Kgau ya Grammy Ladysmith Black Mambazo.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uchibela Umtsetfo weMkandlu Wekwendluliswa kweteTitfutsi, wanga-1998 (Umtsetfo-39 wanga-1998) lobukene netekwendluliswa letiphatselene nekufakwa kweticelo tetimvume tetitfutsi temgwaco (manje lesekubitwa ngekutsi ngemalayisense ekusebenta).

src: Mmino wa hae o susumeditse batho ba bangata lefatsheng ka bophara le ho kopanya maAforika Borwa.
tgt: Lokuchibela kufaka ekhatsi kuntjintja kwenchubomgomo, tintfutfuko kanye nemtsetfo lomusha kusukela nga-1998.

src: Moporesidente Ramaphosa o phatlaladitse Lepato la hae e le le Ikgethang la Semmuso la Mokgahlelo 2 bakeng sa ho tlotla Profesara Shabalala.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo ulinganisa uphindze futsi wente kancono tinchubo tekwendlulisa, lotawuba nemiphumela yekonga tindleko nesikhatsi, kanye netisetjentiswa letenta kancono tetitfutsi letiphumela ngaphandle kweminyele kanye netalapha kuleli lakitsi kuhambisa bagibeli ngalokongako kanye nekutiphilisa.

src: mmuso le batho ba Kenya ka ho hlokahala ha Moporesidente wa mehleng wa Kenya Motlotlehi Daniel Toroitich Arap Moi, ya sebeditseng jwaloka Moporesidente wa bobedi wa kamora tokoloho wa Kenya.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ihalalisela:licembu lebafundzi balapha eNingizimu beLibanga le-11: Sureshka Naidoo Caitlin Schwarer Nondumiso Ntshangase Nosipho Dube Mihlali Precious Stofile Ondele Bede Okhela Sigwela kanye naLizalise Dlomo, labaphumelele kuMncintiswano weSikolwa seMave Emahlaba weMoot Court we-5 ePoland.

src: lelapa le metswalle ya Mokapotene Thabiso Collins Tolo (49), Mokganni wa Bobedi wa Sefofane Tebogo Caroline Lekalakala (33) le Mohlahlobi wa Sefofane Gugu Comfort Mnguni (36), bao sefofane sa bona se ileng sa swahlamana sebakeng se dithabathaba haufi le Mossel Bay ho la Kapa Bophirima ka la 23 Pherekgong 2020.
tgt: Inhlambi yaseNingizimu Afrika Natalie du Toit ngekuvotelwa ate ayoba ngulomunye wemakhandidethi lasihlanu ekugcina kuNdondo yeMkankhaso weteMidlalo weLaureus kuleminyaka lenge-20 leyendlulile (2000-2020).

src: lelapa le metswalle ya Monghadi Marcelino dos Santos, e mong wa bathehi ba Lebotho la Tokoloho la Mozambique (FRELIMO), ya hlokahetseng a le dilemo di Moetapele enwa ya entseng nalane e ne e le e mong wa matshwao a bosetjhaba ba Aforika.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi itfumele emavi endvudvuto ku:mndeni nebangani baSolwati Joseph Shabalala, lichawe letemculo kanye nemsunguli welicembu iLadysmith Black Mambazo lelawina indondo lebitwa ngekutsi pheceleti Grammy Award.

src: DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di tla lokelwa ke ho netefatswa ha mangolo a thuto le tumellano e amehang.

src: Monghadi Basil Bryan Ford jwaloka Mohlokomedi wa Phethahatso le Molaodi wa Boikarabelo ba Tshebeletso ya Naha le Lekala la Phumantsho la Aforika Borwa.

src: Ditho tsa Boto ya Diphaka tsa Naha: a. Monghadi Zola Luxolo Fihlani b. Mofumahadi Gertrude Buyelwa Koyana c. Monghadi Faizal Docrat d. Monghadi Jeoffrey Mashele.

src: Ditho tsa Boto ya Institjute ya Diphapang ho tsa Tlhaho ya Aforika Borwa: a. Mofumahadi Phuthanang Cenea Motsielwab.
tgt: Mnu Busani Ngcaweni lobekwe waba nguThishelanhloko weSikolwa Savelonkhe Sahulumende.

tgt: Mk Yoliswa Makhasi lobekwe waba nguMcondzisijikelele weLitiko Letemisebenti Yahulumende Nekuphatsa.

src: Mofumahadi Letlhogonolo Noge-Tungamiraif.

src: Monghadi Gonasagren Ganesh Nair leg.
tgt: Mnu Luvuyo Keyise ubekwe waba nguMnakekeli Lomkhulu neSikhulu Sekutilandza we-Ejensi yeTebucwepheshe beteLwatiso lweMbuso.

src: Pehelo ya Kopano ya Kabinete e neng e tshwaretswe Palamenteng, Tuynhuis Motse Kapa, ka Laboraro mohla la 11 Tlhakubele 2020Dintlha ka Maemo a Renang Hajwale.
tgt: Sitatimende seMhlangano weKhabhinethi wangaLesitsatfu, mhla ti-11 Indlovulenkhulu 2020 ePhalamende, eTuynhuys eKapa Tindzaba letibalulekile taleLive.

src: Kokwanahloko ya Corona (COVID-19).
tgt: I-Coronavirus (i-COVID-19) Ikhabhinethi iyabacinisekisa bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi kwentiwa tonkhe taba tekucaphela phambilini kuvikela lelive kunoma ngukuphi kubhebhetseka ngemandla kwale-COVID-19.

src: Kabinete e boela e netefaletsa bohle ba Aforika Borwa hore ho nkuwa kgato enngwe le enngwe ya tshireletso, e le ho sireletsa naha kgahlanong le lephallo la COVID-19.
tgt: Zweli Mkize, ubikele Ikhabhinethi kutsi sekunetehlakalo leti-13 te-COVID-19 lapha eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Letona la Bophelo bo Botle, Ngaka Zweli Mkhize, o tlalehetse Kabinete hore ho na le batho ba 13 ba nang le COVID-19 Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lamuhla ekuseni, Indvuna yeTemphilo icinisekise kutsi kutfolakale letinye tehlakalo letinsha letine, lokwenta lelinani letehlakalo te-COVID-19 likhuphuke liye ku-17.

src: Hoseng hona, Letona la Bophelo bo Botle le netefaditse hore ditshwaetso tse ding hape tse nne tse ntjha di se di hlwailwe, mme lenane la ba nang le COVID-19 le nyolohetse ho O tla fana ka dintlha tse tebileng ha tsatsi le ntse le phahama.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi nayo igcizelela simemo lesentiwe yiNhlangano yeTemphilo yeMhlaba neNdvuna yeTemphilo Mkize, kutsi bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bachubeke nekusebentisa netento letiyindlela yekuvimba kwesulelana nekwandza kwaleligciwane.

src: Kabinete e thasisetsa kgoeletsong ya Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Bophelo bo Botle le ya Letona la Bophelo bo Botle Ngaka Mkhize, hore batho bohle ba Aforika Borwa ba dule ba ntse ba nka dikgato tsa thibelo, ho kgina ho tshwaetseho le ho jaleha ha kokwanahloko ena.
tgt: Letindlela tekuvikela tifaka ekhatsi kuvama kugeza tandla takho ngemanti lanensipho noma-ke usebentise sibulalimagciwane sekugeza tandla lesine-alkhoholi i-sanitizer, tiphindze futsi tifake ekhatsi kugwema kubamba emehlo, timphumulo nemlomo ngetandla letingakagezwa kanye nekuvala umlomo wakho ngethishu uma ukhwehlela noma uthimula bese uyayilahla leyo thishu.

src: Dikgato tsa thibelo di akga ho hatlela kgafetsa ka sesepa le metsi kapa ho sebedisa sebolayadikokwanahloko sa matsoho se nang le alkhohole, di boela di akga ho qoba ho itshwara ka matsoho a sa hlatsuwang mahlong, nkong le molomong, e be le ho ikwahela molomo ka pampitshana bonojana ha o kgohlela kapa o thimola, o nto lahla pampitshana bonojana eo.
tgt: Timphawu letivamile taleligciwane, yifiva, kukhwehlela nekuphefumula kamatima.

src: Matshwao a tlwaelehileng a kokwanahloko ena a akga mofikela, ho kgohlela le ho thatafallwa ke ho hema.
tgt: Uma ngabe unaletimphawu njengobe tichaziwe lapha ngetulu, bantfu belulekwa kutsi bahlale ekhaya futsi bafune lusito lwetekwelashwa.

src: Ha ho bonahala matshwao a tshwanang le a boletsweng kahodimo, batho ba eletswa hore ba dule malapeng mme ba batle thuso ya bongaka.
tgt: Sicela wonkhewonkhe kutsi bahloniphe lingasense letigulane letine- CODVID-19 kanye nemindeni yato.

src: Re boela re etsa tlhokomediso e matla kgahlanong le ho haswa ha lesedi la bohata le amanang le kokwanahloko ena, e le ho thibela ho jaleha ha tshabo, sepha le kgethollo setjhabeng sa habo rona.
tgt: Sicaphelisa ngemandla kutsi kungandziswa nanoma nguluphi lwatiso lolungesiwo emaciniso loluphatselene naleligciwane kute kutsi kuvinjwe kwandza kweluvalo, kukhishwa inyumbazana kanye nekubandlulula labanye emimangweni yetfu.

src: Batho ba nang le kgwao ba ka letsetsa mohaleng wa mahala wa Setheo sa Naha sa Mafu a Tshwaetsang ho 0800 029 999 mabapi le lesedi le tsepameng ka COVID-19.
tgt: Bantfu labakhatsatekile bangatsintsa Lucingo Loluphutfumako lweSikhungo saVelonkhe seteTifo Letitsatselwanako (i-NICD) ku-0800 029 999 kute batfole lwatiso lolungilo mayelana ne-COVID-19.

src: Kabinete e ikamahanya le Moporesidente Ramaphosa ho lakaletseng sehlopha se latang ba dinaheng tsa bolata esita le moifo wa Difofane tsa Aforika Borwa (SAA) mahlohonolo, ba tsamaile ka Labobedi ho ya Toropong ya Wuhan, Profenseng ya Hubei e China, ho ya lata maAforika Borwa a 122.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ijoyina Mengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ekufiseleni licembu lekubuyisa ekhaya kuleli lakitsi nelitsimba le-South African Airways (le-SAA) labafulatsele leli lakitsi ngaLesibili babhekisa emabombo kuLidolobhakati laseWuhan, kuSifundza saseHubei eRiphabhliki yeBantfu yaseShayina, kulandza babuyise kuleli bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika laba-122.

src: Sehlopha sa dingaka tsa Lefapheng la Bophelo bo Botle le Tshebeletsong ya Bophelo bo Botle ya Sesole sa Aforika Borwa, ke karolo ya sehlopha se latang ba dinaheng tsa bolata.
tgt: Licembu letemphilo leLitiko Letemphilo kanye neLuphiko lweteMphilo lweMbutfo Wetekuvikela waseNingizimu Afrika nabo bayincenye yalelitsimba lekubuyisa ekhaya.

src: Kabinete e bontshitse kananelo ya yona ho SAA ka thuso ya bona e matla mosebetsing ona wa ho.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi seyivakalise kubonga kwayo ku-SAA ngelusito lwabo lolukhulu kangaka kulomsebenti wekubuyisa ekhaya.

src: Sehlopha se latang ba dinaheng tsa bolata hammoho le maAforika Borwa a kgutlisetswang lapeng, ba lebelletswe ho fihla kwano naheng ka Labohlano lena, mohla la 13 Tlhakubele 2020.
tgt: Lelicembu lekubuyisa ekhaya nalabantfu baseNingizimu Afrika lababuyiswa ekhaya balindzeleke kutsi batseleke kulelive lakitsi ngaLesihlanu lona, mhla ti-13 Indlovulenkhulu 2020.

src: Ha ba fihla, ba tla bewa sebakeng se qollehileng ho tloha ka matsatsi a 14 ho isa ho a fellang ho a Nakong ena, motsamao wa batho le wa thepa ho keneng le ho tswa ditikolohong tsena tse qollehileng o tla notlwa.
tgt: Ekufikeni kwabo, batawuvalelwa bodvwana linanincane lemalanga la-14 kuya kulinanikhulu lemalanga lange-21.

src: Re etsa tlhokomediso e matla bathong hore ba se ke ba leka ho hang ho ama kapa ho etela ditikoloho tsena tse qollehileng.
tgt: Ngalesikhatsi lesi, kuhamba kwebantfu nemphahla kuphunywa kungenwa kuletindzawo tekuvalelwa kutawuncishiswa.

src: Hang ha nako ya ho bolokwa sebakeng se qollehileng e fela mme diteko di paka hore ha ho tshwaetso e teng ya COVID-19 baneng babo rona, ba tla lokollwa hore ba kgutlele mahabo bona.
tgt: Sicaphelisa bantfu ngemandla kutsi bangetami kutsintsana ngekwemtimba noma-ke balinge kuvakashela letindzawo teluvalelo.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa mosebetsi o motle o entsweng ke Komiti e Kopaneng ya Matona (IMC) e filweng mosebetsi wa ho sebetsana le COVID-19, e etelletsweng pele ke Letona la Bophelo bo Botle ebile e sebedisana le NICD, ho tsoma le ho tima mollo wa kokwanahloko ena, ha ka ho le leng ho ntse ho thuswa bao ba anngweng ke yona ebile re tswelapele ho hlaba setjhaba malotsana.
tgt: Uma-ke lesikhatsi sekuvalelwa sesiphelile futsi netinhlolo tacinisekisa kutsi sekute kwesuleleka ngeligciwane i-COVID-19 lokubhacile kwebantfu bakitsi, batawubese-ke bayakhululwa babuyela emuva emimangweni yabo lefanele.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa taba ya hore boholo ba diprofense bo tloelletse dipuisano tse amanang le ntlha ena ya COVID-19 matsohong a Letona la Bophelo bo Botle ka lebaka la bohlokolotsi ba yona ba naha le ba matjhaba.
tgt: Ikhabinethi iyawuncoma kakhulu umsebenti lowentiwe Likomidi leTindvuna (i-IMC) lebelinikwe umsebenti wekubukana ne-COVID-19, liholwa yiNdvuna yeTemphilo futsi lisebentisana ne-NICD, ekulandzeleleni nekuvimba leligciwane, lapho basasita labo labatsintsekile nekuhlala njalo batisa sive ngalokusha lokwentekako.

src: Re kopa diprofense tse ding tsohle hore di latele mohlala oo, ho netefatsa hore ho ba le molaetsa o ntswe leng ho be ho qojwe pherekano efe kapa efe e ka etsahalang ntle le maikemisetso, esita le melaetsa e sa hlophiswang hantle.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyakutfokotela kakhulu kutsi tifundza letinyenti tiyelekele luchumanolwatiso mayelana neludzaba lwe-COVID-19 etandleni teNdvuna yeTemphilo ngenca yekubaluleka kwalo ngekwavelonkhe nekwemave emhlaba.

src: Haufinyane Moporesidente Ramaphosa o tla hlaba mekga ya dipolotiki e emetsweng Palamenteng esita le baetapele ba dikereke malotsana ka COVID-19.
tgt: Sicela tonkhe letinye tifundza kutsi nato atente njalo kute kucinisekiswe kuphuma endzaweni yinye kwelwatisokuchumana futsi ngaleyo ndlela-ke kutawugwemeka nanoma ngukuphi kudideka lokungakahloswa nekwendluliswa kwemilayo lokungakachumani.

src: Kopano e kgethehileng ya Kabinete mabapi le COVID-19 e epelwa ho ba ka Sontaha sa la 15 Tlhakubele 2020, Tshwane.
tgt: Mengameli Ramaphosa masinyane-nje utawatisa emacembu etembusave ePhalamende kanye nebaholi bemasontfo ngale-COVID-19.

src: Moruo.
tgt: Umnotfo.

src: Kabinete e ile ya lekola taba ya ho ntshuwa ha tlaleho ya Lefapha la Dipalopalo la Aforika Borwa mabapi le Boleng ba Dihlahiswa Tsohle Moruong wa Naha (GDP), bo senotseng hore moruo wa rona o ritseditse phokotsehong ya kgolo nakong ya dihla tse pedi tse latellanang.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikubuyekitile kukhululwa kweMbiko weTelubalobalo lwaseNingizimu Afrika lomayelana neLinanimkhicito netinsita (i-GDP, lokhombise kutsi umnotfo wetfu wehlile.

src: Manane a bontshitse phokotseho ya GDP ka 1.4% Sehleng sa bone sa 2019.
tgt: Emanani akhombise kwehla kwe-GDP nga-1.4% eKoteni ye-4 yanga-2019.

src: Sena se latela phokotseho ya 0.8% Sehleng sa boraro sa sona selemo seo.
tgt: Loku kulandzela kuncipha nga-0.8% eKoteni ye-3 yawo lowo mnyaka.

src: Ntle le ho amohela ditlamorao tse bosula tsa ho timatima ha motlakase, Kabinete e dula e ntse e lomahantse meno ka hore e tla lokisa dintho tsa bohlokwa, e hahamalle pele ka dikarolo tsa bohlokwa tsa kgolo e be e etelle pele ditharollo tse kopanetsweng le balekane bohle kahisanong, ho etsetsa hore re bee naha motjheng wa kgolo ya moruo re le mmoho.
tgt: Nanoma-nje isibona lesimo lesibi lesibangelwa kusetjentiswa kwagezi ngekwabelana, Ikhabhinethi solo iyatibophelela ekulungiseni loko lokubalulekile, kulandzelela tindzawo tekukhula kwemnotfo letibalulekile iphindze futsi ichube umkhankhaso wetisombululo letihlangene nabo bonkhe balingani betenhlalo kute kutsi sisonkhe sibeke lelive endleleni lecondze ekukhuleni kwemnotfo.

src: Re matlafatsa botsetedi ba rona mme ho fihlela jwale diprojeke tsa matsete a boleng ba R9 bilione di se di phethetswe, mme diprojeke tse 27 tsa boleng bo kahodimonyana ho R250 bilione di mekgahlelong ya ho kenngwa tshebetsong, le tse ding tse ngata tse tla kena motjheng monongwaha.
tgt: Sicinisa lutjalomali lwetfu futsi kute kube ngulamuhla imiklamo lenelinanimali letigidzigidzi leti-R9 seyiphotfuliwe bese kutsi imiklamo lenge-27 letigidzigidzi letingetulu kwaletinge-R250 isesigabeni sekufezekiswa, kunaleminye leminyenti letawentiwa kulomnyaka.

src: Ditheko tsa deitha ya Vodacom.
tgt: Intsengo yedatha yaka-Vodacom.

src: Kabinete e amohela tsebiso ya Khomishene ya Ditlhodisano ka katleho ya tumellano e fihlelletsweng le Vodacom, mabapi le ho fokotswa ha ditheko tsa deitha ya yona.
