tgt: Issues in the Environment.

src: South African National Taxi Council (SANTACO) Western Cape taxi strike Cabinet was briefed about the ongoing impasse between SANTACO Western Cape and the City of Cape Town, which has escalated into a violent strike as a result of the impounding of taxi vehicles by the City of Cape Town.
tgt: South African National Taxi Council (SANTACO) Western Cape taxi strike Cabinet was briefed about the ongoing impasse between SANTACO Western Cape and the City of Cape Town, which has escalated into a violent strike as a result of the impounding of taxi vehicles by the City of Cape Town.

src: Cabinet condemns the violence and anarchy in Cape Town and has called on SANTACO to ensure that its protest action is peaceful and does not interfere with the rights of others.
tgt: Cabinet condemns the violence and anarchy in Cape Town and has called on SANTACO to ensure that its protest action is peaceful and does not interfere with the rights of others.

src: In this regard, we have noted that there were no violent incidents in the last 48-hours.
tgt: In this regard, we have noted that there were no violent incidents in the last 48-hours.

src: However, members of the South African Police Service and other law-enforcement agencies have been directed to ensue violent situation is under control to allow residents safe movement to school, work and their normal daily activities.
tgt: However, members of the South African Police Service and other law-enforcement agencies have been directed to ensue violent situation is under control to allow residents safe movement to school, work and their normal daily activities.

src: Cabinet was also briefed about the City of Cape Town’s imposing of taxi operating conditions which are at variance with both the National Road Traffic, 1996 (Act 93 of 1996) and the National Land Transport Act, 2009 (Act 5 of 2009), which regulate the traffic offences and applicable penalties, including the impounding of vehicles.
tgt: Cabinet was also briefed about the City of Cape Town’s imposing of taxi operating conditions which are at variance with both the National Road Traffic, 1996 (Act 93 of 1996) and the National Land Transport Act, 2009 (Act 5 of 2009), which regulate the traffic offences and applicable penalties, including the impounding of vehicles.

src: Cabinet has directed the Minister of Transport, Ms Sindisiwe Chikunga, to ensure that any taxi operating conditions that contradicts the laws of the Republic are removed.
tgt: Cabinet has directed the Minister of Transport, Ms Sindisiwe Chikunga, to ensure that any taxi operating conditions that contradicts the laws of the Republic are removed.

src: Fight against illegal mining.
tgt: Fight against illegal mining.

src: Cabinet welcomed the deployment of a special police unit, which is supported by the military, in Riverlea, Johannesburg, to deal with illegal mining in the area.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the deployment of a special police unit, which is supported by the military, in Riverlea, Johannesburg, to deal with illegal mining in the area.

src: In addition, Cabinet commended the arrest of over 194 suspects over illegal mining activities and directed law-enforcement agencies to urgently clamp down on this and other serious crimes in the country.
tgt: In addition, Cabinet commended the arrest of over 194 suspects over illegal mining activities and directed law-enforcement agencies to urgently clamp down on this and other serious crimes in the country.

src: The Department of Mineral Resources and Energy (DMRE) has committed to close all derelict open shafts and mine holes in Riverlea by the end of September 2023, whilst finalising plans to close other derelict open shafts and mining holes across the country.
tgt: The Department of Mineral Resources and Energy (DMRE) has committed to close all derelict open shafts and mine holes in Riverlea by the end of September 2023, whilst finalising plans to close other derelict open shafts and mining holes across the country.

src: The security situation in Niger.
tgt: The security situation in Niger.

src: Cabinet has noted the impact the security situation in Niger is having on air-travel between South Africa/Southern Africa and Western Europe, with negative implications for business and individuals alike and the airline industry that is just starting to recover from the devastating ravages of the Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic.
tgt: Cabinet has noted the impact the security situation in Niger is having on air-travel between South Africa/Southern Africa and Western Europe, with negative implications for business and individuals alike and the airline industry that is just starting to recover from the devastating ravages of the Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic.

src: Cabinet reiterated government’s condemnation of the coup in Niger and the call for the speedy restoration of a democratic order, and also noted the initiative to restore normality under the Economic Community of West African States.
tgt: Cabinet reiterated government’s condemnation of the coup in Niger and the call for the speedy restoration of a democratic order, and also noted the initiative to restore normality under the Economic Community of West African States.

src: Russia-Africa Summit.
tgt: Russia-Africa Summit.

src: President Cyril Ramaphosa was amongst other African leaders who attended the Second Russia-Africa Summit, in St Petersburg in the Russian Federation on 27 and 28 July 2023.
tgt: President Cyril Ramaphosa was amongst other African leaders who attended the Second Russia-Africa Summit, in St Petersburg in the Russian Federation on 27 and 28 July 2023.

src: This summit adopted the Russia-Africa Partnership Forum Action Plan which focuses on strengthening cooperation in areas of politics and security, economics, humanitarian matters, and interests of mutual benefit and prosperity.
tgt: This summit adopted the Russia-Africa Partnership Forum Action Plan which focuses on strengthening cooperation in areas of politics and security, economics, humanitarian matters, and interests of mutual benefit and prosperity.

src: On the sidelines of the summit, African Heads of State and Government who are part of the African Peace Initiative on the conflict between Russia and Ukraine held follow-up talks with President Vladimir Putin on the previously discussed confidence-building measures that will create conditions for a negotiated settlement to ending the war.
tgt: On the sidelines of the summit, African Heads of State and Government who are part of the African Peace Initiative on the conflict between Russia and Ukraine held follow-up talks with President Vladimir Putin on the previously discussed confidence-building measures that will create conditions for a negotiated settlement to ending the war.

src: Presidents Ramaphosa and Putin also held a bilateral meeting and discussed opportunities to increase trade between the two countries, and for the Russian Federation to increase investments in South Africa.
tgt: Presidents Ramaphosa and Putin also held a bilateral meeting and discussed opportunities to increase trade between the two countries, and for the Russian Federation to increase investments in South Africa.

src: BRICS Summit Hosting Readiness.
tgt: BRICS Summit Hosting Readiness.

src: Cabinet was apprised that it is all systems go in terms of South Africa’s readiness to host the 15th BRICS Summit in Johannesburg from 22 to 24 August 2023.
tgt: Cabinet was apprised that it is all systems go in terms of South Africa’s readiness to host the 15th BRICS Summit in Johannesburg from 22 to 24 August 2023.

src: The last of the BRICS Ministerial meetings – the BRICS Ministers of Agriculture Meeting – is currently underway, while the Ministerial Meetings of Foreign Affairs, Security, Trade, Industry, Education, Science, Labour, Communications, Health, and Urbanisation Forum have concluded their reports for the Leaders’ Summit.
tgt: The last of the BRICS Ministerial meetings – the BRICS Ministers of Agriculture Meeting – is currently underway, while the Ministerial Meetings of Foreign Affairs, Security, Trade, Industry, Education, Science, Labour, Communications, Health, and Urbanisation Forum have concluded their reports for the Leaders’ Summit.

src: The BRICS Outreach programmes for various sectors and communities have also been concluded.
tgt: The BRICS Outreach programmes for various sectors and communities have also been concluded.

src: These engagements provided governments, organisations, experts and academics from the BRICS nations an opportunity to discuss issues of mutual interest that will enable informed decision-making during the BRICS Summit.
tgt: These engagements provided governments, organisations, experts and academics from the BRICS nations an opportunity to discuss issues of mutual interest that will enable informed decision-making during the BRICS Summit.

src: National Development Plan (NDP) Ten-Year Review.
tgt: National Development Plan (NDP) Ten-Year Review.

src: Cabinet welcomed the Ten-Year Review of the NDP by the National Planning Commission that pointed out that the economy remained structured in a manner that does not serve the interests of all South Africans, which is a major reason behind increasing levels of poverty and inequality.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the Ten-Year Review of the NDP by the National Planning Commission that pointed out that the economy remained structured in a manner that does not serve the interests of all South Africans, which is a major reason behind increasing levels of poverty and inequality.

src: Government remains committed to restructuring and transforming the economy to serve the interests of all South Africans.
tgt: Government remains committed to restructuring and transforming the economy to serve the interests of all South Africans.

src: Energy.
tgt: Energy.

src: The 25th July marked the First Anniversary since President Ramaphosa announced the Energy Action Plan.

src: The policy seeks to address the historically institutionalised inequalities and disparities, which follow racial and economic access lines in theatre and dance.2 The policy aims to set a vision and practical policies, strategies, implementation mechanisms and time frames that will result in a sustainable and vibrant theatre and dance sector in all nine provinces, with South African dance and theatre makers representing the country with pride continentally and globally.
tgt: The policy seeks to address the historically institutionalised inequalities and disparities, which follow racial and economic access lines in theatre and dance.2 The policy aims to set a vision and practical policies, strategies, implementation mechanisms and time frames that will result in a sustainable and vibrant theatre and dance sector in all nine provinces, with South African dance and theatre makers representing the country with pride continentally and globally.

src: Essential Food Price Monitoring Reports.1 The Competition Commission has been monitoring essential food prices pursuant to price gouging concerns raised since the declaration of the State of Disaster in March 2020.
tgt: Essential Food Price Monitoring Reports.1 The Competition Commission has been monitoring essential food prices pursuant to price gouging concerns raised since the declaration of the State of Disaster in March 2020.

src: The continuation of essential food price monitoring is motivated by the need to ensure affordable and accessible essential food products for consumers.
tgt: The continuation of essential food price monitoring is motivated by the need to ensure affordable and accessible essential food products for consumers.

src: The Commission has noted the ‘rocket and feather’ effect, where prices are quick to rise often in excess of cost increases and slow to fall once cost pressures decline.
tgt: The Commission has noted the ‘rocket and feather’ effect, where prices are quick to rise often in excess of cost increases and slow to fall once cost pressures decline.

src: It has also flagged the concentrated nature of the food and retail markets as a concerning contributing factor.
tgt: It has also flagged the concentrated nature of the food and retail markets as a concerning contributing factor.

src: The Cabinet has noted the Commission’s recommended measures including market inquiries to address structural features in the market that lead to high food prices and low levels of competition.
tgt: The Cabinet has noted the Commission’s recommended measures including market inquiries to address structural features in the market that lead to high food prices and low levels of competition.

src: Cabinet has approved that the Economic Cluster must put in place an action plan on food prices, food secure and access to food.
tgt: Cabinet has approved that the Economic Cluster must put in place an action plan on food prices, food secure and access to food.

src: Ditaba tse Itlhommeng Pele Lekgotla la Kakaretso la Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UNGA) Kabenete e ananetse puo e tshetlehilweng ke Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa ho UNGA ya bo-78 e neng e tshwaretswe New York, Amerika ho tloha ka la 18 ho ya ho la 26 Loetse 2023.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyemukele inkhulumo yaMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa layetfule ku-UNGA ye-78 eNew York, eMelika kusukela mhla ti-18 kuya mhla tinge-26 Inyoni 2023.

src: Puo ya Moporesidente e ananetsweng ke ba bangata e tobokeditse boemo ba Afrika Borwa ba ho lwanela ditabatabelo le seabo se nang le tekano le matla tsa kontinente ya Afrika le Dinaha tse Ntseng di Tswela Pele, ka kakaretso, ho UN le dibakeng tse ding tse kopanyang dinaha tse fapaneng.
tgt: Inkhulumo yaMengameli leyemukelwe ngulabanyenti icinisekise loko leNingizimu Afrika lengiko ekuholeni embili ekukhankhaseleni timfuno, kanye nekutimbandzakanya ngalokulinganako nangalokuvakalako, kwelivekati lase-Afrika kanye neMhlaba wonkhe longaseNingizimu jikelele kuMhlabuhlangene kanye nakuletinye tinkhundla letahlukene.

src: Puo e boetse ya toboketsa maikemisetso a Afrika Borwa ho batleng tshehetso bakeng sa:
tgt: Lenkhulumo iphindze futsi yacinisekisa kutimisela ngekucina kweNingizimu Afrika ekuhlanganiseni kwesekelwa:a) kwekutinikela kabusha kwekusebentisana kwemave lahlukahlukene, lokususelwa emitsetfweni lecacile kanye nalesekelwa ngemphumelelo tikhungo.

src: tsoseletso ya boinehelo tshebedisanong ya dinaha, ho itshetlehilwe melaong e hlakileng mme tshebedisano ena e tshehetswa ke ditheo tse sebetsang hantle.
tgt: b) kwetingucuko letinsha kuMkandlu Wetekuvikela waMhlabuhlangene (i-UNSC), kute kuvakale umtsetfomgomo wekulingana ngekutimela kwetive kanye nekwenta kutsi i-UNSC ikhone kuphendvula ngemphumelelo lenkhulu kutinsayeya letikhona tepolitiki.

src: ho tliswa ha diphetoho Lekgotleng la Tshireletseho la Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UNSC), molemong wa ho hlakisa motheo wa tekano ya dinaha tse ikemetseng le ho thusa UNSC ho arabela ka katleho maemo a teng pakeng tsa dinaha tse fapaneng.
tgt: c) kwemave lacebile kutsi enyuse kweseka ngekwetimali i-Ajenda 2030 yeNtfutfuko Lesimeme kanye nekufezekisa tinjongo tawo tetingucuko tesimomvama selitulu ngendlela lephelele nalehlanganisiwe, lokufaka ekhatsi kusebentisa ngekuphutfuma sikhwama se-Loss and Damage Fund semave lahlaseleka lula lakhahlametwe kakhulu tinhlekelele tesimomvama selitulu, njengaloku kwavunyelanwa ngako kuSeshini ye-27 yeNkhomfa yeMacembu lebeyibanjelwe eGibhithe ngaLweti 2022.

src: hore dinaha tse tswetseng pele di eketse thuso ya tsona ya ditjhelete molemong wa ho kenya tshebetsong Morero wa 2030 wa Ntshetsopele ya Moshwelella, le hore di fihlelle maikemisetso a tsona a diphetoho tsa tlelaemete ka mokgwa o phethahetseng le o momahaneng, ho kenyeletsa tlhokeho ya ho potlakisa ho kenya tshebetsong Letlole la Tahlehelo le Tshenyehelo la dinaha tse kotsing tse anngweng habohloko ke dikoduwa tsa tlelaemete, jwalokaha ho dumellanwe Sesheneng ya Seboka sa Dinaha le Mekgatlo sa bo-27 se neng se tshwaretswe Egepeta ka Pudungwana 2022.
tgt: Mengameli Ramaphosa uphindze wacinisekisa kutinikela kweNingizimu Afrika ekuchubekeni kwayo kulungisa indzaba yekugucuka kwesimomvama selitulu kanye nekubeka lelive njengemholi kutemandla lavusetelelwako, emandla lahlobile kanye nekwakha timboni letisimeme.

src: Moporesidente Ramaphosa o tobokeditse le boinehelo ba Afrika Borwa ba ho tswela pele ka ho sebetsana le diphetoho tsa tlelaemete le ho beha naha boemong ba boetapele ntlheng tse amanang le motlakase wa mehlodi ya tlhaho, motlakase o hlahiswang ka metsi, le ho thehwa ha diindasteri tsa ho ya ho ile.
tgt: Mengameli Ramaphosa uphindze futsi wakhuluma ngeNgcungcutsela Yekuvikela Telubhubhane Kulungela Nekuphendvula, ngekwesikhundla sakhe njengeLichawe Lelubumbane lwase-Afrika Lekuphendvula macondzana neSifo Seligciwane Lekhorona (i-COVID-19).

src: Moporesidente Ramaphosa o boetse a tshetleha puo Sebokeng sa ho Ntshetsa Pele Thibelo ya Sewa, ho Itokisetsa sewa le ho se Lwantsha, jwaloka Moetapele wa Kopano ya Afrika Twantshong ya Lefu la Vaerase ya Corona (COVID-19).
tgt: Luhlelo lwaseNingizimu Afrika lwetinkhulumiswano emkhatsini wemave lamabili ngaphandle kwe-UNGA ye-7.

src: Lenaneo la Afrika Borwa la Dikopano le Dinaha tse Ding ka Thoko ho UNGA ya bo-78 Moporesidente Ramaphosa o etelletse pele moifo wa mmuso ka thoko ho UNGA ya bo-78, molemong wa ho tshwara dikopano tse fapaneng le dinaha tse ding tseo sepheo ka tsona e leng ho matlafatsa dikamano tsa mawa, dipolotiki, matjhaba le tsa kgwebisano.
tgt: Ngaphandle kwe-UNGA ye-78, Mengameli Ramaphosa uhole litsimba lahulumende lelibambe imihlangano leminyenti lesemkhatsini wemave lamabili lokuhloswe ngayo kucinisa budlelwane belisubuciko, betepolitiki betebuncusa kanye nebekuhwebelana.

src: Moporesidente o kopane le Volodymyr Zelensky wa Ukraine ba buisana ka kgatelopele e bonahalang mehatong ya ho aha boitshepo e etellwang pele ka mokgwa wa Boiteko ba Kgotso ba Afrika, le tse ding.
tgt: Mengameli ubambe umhlangano nemlingani wakhe wase-Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky bacocisana ngemphumelelo leseyentiwe lemayelana netinyatselo tekwakha kwetsembana kweTinyatselo Tekuthula e-Afrika kanye naletinye tintfutfuko.

src: Moporesidente Ramaphosa o boetse a tshwara dikopano le: Moporesidente Recep Tayyip Erdoğan wa Türkiye, mabapi le ho tiiswa ha dikamano pakeng tsa Afrika Borwa le Turkey, le ho buisana ka maiteko a kgotso a amanang le ntwa pakeng tsa Russia le Ukraine.
tgt: Mengameli Ramaphosa uphindze futsi wahlangana: NeMengameli Recep Tayyip Erdoğan waseTürkiye, mayelana nekucinisa budlelwane emkhatsini weNingizimu Afrika neTurkey, kanye nekucocisana ngalamafishane mayelana naletingenelelo tekuthula ngalokushayisana emkhatsini weleRashiya nelase-Ukraine.

src: Moporesidente Bola Tinubu wa Nigeria, ka ho matlafatsa maqhama pakeng tsa Afrika Borwa le Nigeria.
tgt: Mengameli Bola Tinubu waseRiphabhliki yaseNigeria, macondzana nekucinisa budlelwane emkhatsini weNingizimu Afrika neleNigeria.

src: O boetse a behwa sehlohlolong ka boiteko bo etellwang pele ke Mokgatlo wa Moruo wa Dinaha tsa Bophirima ba Afrika mabapi le ho tsohelwa ha puso matla Niger, le ka maiteko a ho kgutlisa puso ya demokrasi lebatoweng la Sahel.
tgt: Uphindze futsi watfola lwatiso lakamuva lolumayelana neMmango Wetemnotfo loholwa ngeMave aseNshonalanga ye-Afrika mayelana nekuketulwa kwembuso waseNiger kanye nemitamo nje jikelele yekubuyisa esimeni umtsetfo wentsandvo yelinyenti eSahel.

src: Moporesidente Emmerson Mnangagwa wa Zimbabwe, ka maiteko a mmuso wa Zimbabwe a ho tiisa kahobotjha ya naha eo kamora dikgetho tsa morao tjena.
tgt: Mengameli Emmerson Mnangagwa waseRiphabhliki yaseZimbabwe, mayelana nemitamo yahulumende waseZimbabwe yekuhlanganisa kwakhiwa kabusha kwalelive ngemuva kwelukhetfo lokwavumelanwa ngalo lolusandza kuba khona.

src: Moporesidente Ramaphosa o boetse a ba le seabo Dipuisanong tsa Kgwebo tsa Amerika (US) le Afrika Borwa tsa Kgwebisano le Botsetedi, tse neng di kenyeletsa baetapele ba tsa kgwebo ba Afrika Borwa le Amerika.
tgt: Mengameli Ramaphosa uphindze futsi watibandzakanya kumhlangano weTekuhweba emkhatsini weMelika (i-US) neNingizimu Afrika neMhlangano Wetebhizinisi Nelutjalomali, lofake ekhatsi baholi betemabhizinisi baseMelika nebaseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Amerika e na le dikhampani tse fetang 600 Afrika Borwa, mme puisano tsena di ne di le bohlokwa matlafatsong e ntseng e tswella ya maqhama pakeng tsa Afrika Borwa le Amerika.
tgt: Njengaloku kunetinkampani taseMelika letingetulu kwe-600 letisebentela lapha eNingizimu Afrika, lokucocisana bekumcoka kulokuchubeka kwekucinisa budlelwane emkhatsini weNingizimu Afrika neMelika.

src: Nakong eo ho tsebahaditswe semmuso hore Kopano ya bo-20 e mabapi le Tshebedisano Kgwebisanong le Moruong ya Amerika le Dinaha tse borwa ba Lehwatata la Sahara, Afrika (AGOA), e tla tshwarelwa Johannesburg ho tloha ho la 2 ho ya ho la 4 Pudungwana 2023.
tgt: Ngalesikhatsi, kwentiwe simemetelo lesisemtsetfweni lesitsi Inkhundla ye-20 Yekuhlanganyela Kutemnotfo Nekuhweba emkhatsini weMelika ne-Afrika Lengentasi kweSahara, (Inkhundla ye-AGOA) itawubanjelwa eJozi kusukela mhla ti-2 kuya mhla ti-4 kuLweti 2023.

src: Kopano ena e tla boela e be le ‘Pontsho ya tse Entsweng Afrika’ e tla pepesa metjha ya dihlahiswa ya mabatowa, Afrika.
tgt: Lenkhundla itawufaka ekhatsi ‘Umbukiso Walokwentiwe e-Afrika’ lokutawubukiswa tinchubo tekukhicita kwesigodzi kulelivekati.

src: Moporesidente Ramaphosa o bile teng tsebahatsong ya tshebedisano pakeng tsa Novo Nordisk le Aspen.
tgt: Mengameli Ramaphosa uphindze futsi waba ngufakazi wesimemetelo sekusebenta ngekuhlanganyela emkhatsini we-Novo Nordisk ne-Aspen.

src: Ka tshebedisano ena ho tla hlahiswa insulin, khampaning ya Aspen e hlahisang meriana, Gqeberha, Kapa Botjhabela.
tgt: Lokusebenta ngekuhlanganyela kutawuholela ekukhicitweni kwelikhambi lekwelapha ushukela i-insulin etikhungweni te-Aspen letiseGqeberha, eMphumalanga Kapa.

src: Sepheo ka tshebedisano ena ke ho fana ka tekanyo tsa insulin tse fetang dimiliyone tse 16 isao, mme di tla eketswa ka 2026.
tgt: Lokusebenta ngekuhlanganyela kuhloswe ngako kuphakela tilinganisomutsi telikhambi lekwelapha ushukela letingetulu kwetigidzi leti-16 nga-2024.

src: Sena se tla matlafatsa phihlello ya pheko ena kontinenteng ka bophara, eseng Afrika Borwa feela.
tgt: Loku kutawukwenyusa kakhulu kufinyelela ekwelashweni nge-insulin hhayi kuphela lapha eNingizimu Afrika, kodvwa kulo lonkhe lelivekati.

src: Motlakase.
tgt: Temandla.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho nehwa ha Khampani ya Naha ya Phetiso ya Afrika Borwa dikopo tsa dilaesense tsa ho hweba le ho tlisa/romela, ke Bolaodi ba Naha ba Eneji Afrika Borwa, mme sena se bula ditsela tsa ho fumana motlakase lebatoweng.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikwemukele kunikwa kweticelo temvume tekuhweba nekutfumela emaveni langephandle/nekutsenga kulamanye emave langephandle nguMlawuli Wavelonkhe Wetemandla waseNingizimu Afrika Inkampani Yavelonkhe Yekwendlulisa yaseNingizimu Afrika, ngekuvula indlela yekutsenga emandla ngale kulesigodzi.

src: Ho kgutla ha tshebetso Yuniting ya Bone ya Seteishene sa ho fehla Motlakase sa Kusile kamora hore e lokiswe ho kgutliseditse dimekawate tse 800 keriting.
tgt: Kubuyela kwekusebenta kweYunithi ye-4 yaseSikhungweni Sekuphehla Ugezi saseKusile emva kwekugcinwa esimeni sekusebenta lobekuhleliwe kubuyise ema-megawatts lange-800 kugridi yetfu.

src: Ketsaholo ena e bohlokwa ntlafatsong ya ho fehlwa ha motlakase bakeng sa keriti ya naha, le twantshong ya ho kgaolwa ha phepelo kgafetsa.
tgt: Lenkhomba yalosekwentiwe imcoka ekwenteni ncono emandla ekuphehla kugridi yavelonkhe kanye nekulungisa kwenteka njalo kwekucishwa kwagezi ngenhloso yekuwonga.

src: Kabinete e boetse ya tsebiswa ka kgatelopele Diyuniting tsa 1, 2, le 3 tsa Kusile tse kgutletseng tshebetsong pele ho nako e behuweng.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi yaphindze futsi yatjelwa ngalamafisha mayelana nenchubekelembili yekubuyiswa kwekusebenta kweMayunithi 1, 2 na-3 aseSikhungweni Sekuphehla Ugezi saseKusile ngembikwesikhatsi lebesihleliwe.

src: Kabinete e ananetse diqeto tsa hlahlobo ya Tshebeletso ya Matsete ya Moody’s e reng ho na le botsitso Eskom, e leng botsitso bo tla ntlafatsa ho tshepelwa ha Eskom ho lefa ditjhelete tseo e di adimilweng, mme sena se thuse khampani ena ho itokisetsa ho kenya tshebetsong merero ya yona ya ho lokisa disebediswa tsa ho fehla motlakase.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikwemukele kuhlolwa kwelizinga lelisimeme lekusebenta kwe-Eskom lokwentiwe yi-Moody’s Investors Service, lokuyintfo letakwenta ncono kwetsembeka kwalesikhungo sagezi kanye nekutsi sikhone kuhlela ngaphambilini ekufezekiseni kugcina esimeni sekusebenta lokuhleliwe kwemayunithi aso ekuphehla gezi.

src: Paballo ya Metsi Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka matsapa a ho sebetsana le mathata a metsi a amang dibaka tse ngata naheng ena.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi yatjelwa ngalamafisha mayelana nemitamo yekulungisa tinsayeya tekweswelakala kwemanti lokunemtselela etindzaweni letinyenti kulelive.

src: Letona la Metsi le Bohlweki, Monghadi Senzo Mchunu le boramotse ba metsemeholo e meng Gauteng ba tla fana ka tsa moraorao mabapi le maiteko a ho tsitsisa phepelo ya metsi provenseng.
tgt: Indvuna Yetemanti Nekuhanjiswa Kwekungcola, Mnu Senzo Mchunu kanye nabosodolobha balamanye emadolobhakati eGauteng batawuniketa lwati lolwakamuva lolumayelana netingenelelo tekusimamisa kuphakelwa kwemanti kulesifundza.

src: Kabinete e hopotsa bohle hore Afrika Borwa ke naha e nang le kgaello ya metsi.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ifisa kukhumbuta wonkhe umuntfu kutsi live laseNingizimu Afrika live leleswela emanti.

src: Maafrika Borwa le bohle ba naheng ena ba tlameha ho baballa metsi le ho a sebedisa ka hloko.
tgt: Bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nawonkhe wonkhe kulelive kufanele kutsi onge emanti futsi awasebentise ngekuwonga.

src: Ditaba tsa Kgwebisano Kopano ya Khomeshene ya Dinaha tse Pedi ya Afrika Borwa le Lesotho (BNC) le Dihlopha tsa Matona.
tgt: Ikhomishini Yetive Letimbili iNingizimu Afrika neLesotho (i-BNC) kanye neMhlangano Weklasta Yetindvuna.

src: Kopano ya Afrika Borwa le Lesotho ya BNC le Dihlopha tsa Matona e neng e tshwerwe ho tloha ka la 25 ho ya ho la 28 Loetse 2023 e ne e tsepame tshebedisanong ho tsa moruo, dintlha tse amang meedi le bolokolohi ba ho itsamaela ha batho, ba ho tsamaiswa ha thepa le ditshebeletso pakeng tsa dinaha ka bobedi.
tgt: Umhlangano weKhomishini Yetive Letimbili iNingizimu Afrika neLesotho kanye neMhlangano weKlasta Yetindvuna lebewubanjwe kusukela mhla tinge-25 kuya mhla tinge-28 Inyoni 2023 ugcile ekubambisaneni kutemnotfo, tindzaba letiphatselene nekuwela umnyele, kanye nekuhamba ngekukhululeka kwebantfu, timphahla kanye netinsita emkhatsini walamave lamabili.

src: Moporesidente Ramaphosa le Tonakgolo Samuel Ntsokoane Matekane e tla ba baduladitulo Kopanong ya Pele ya BNC pakeng tsa Afrika Borwa le Lesotho ka Labone la la 28 Loetse 2023.
tgt: Mengameli Ramaphosa naNdvunankhulu Samuel Ntsokoane Matekane batawube babosihlalo ngekubambisana kuSeshini Yekuvula kwe-BNC emkhatsini weNingizimu Afrika neLesotho ngaLesine, mhla tinge-28 Inyoni 2023.

src: BNC e tla shebana le tse amanang le maqhama pakeng tsa dinaha tsena tse pedi, tshireletso le polokeho, metsi, dipalangwang, motlakase le kgwebisano.
tgt: Le-BNC itawufaka ekhatsi budlelwane betebuncusa, tekuvikela nekuvikeleka, temanti, tekutfutsa, tagezi netekuhwebelana.

src: Patlisiso ya Maemo a Tlhodisano Dikgwebong tse Inthaneteng.
tgt: Luphenyo Lwetenkhundla Yemakethe Lesemkhatsini Ye-inthanethi.. Ikhabhinethi iwutfolile umbiko lovela kuKhomishini Yetekuchudzelana mayelana nolokutfolile kanye netento tekulungisa letimayelana neLuphenyo Lwetenkhundla Yemakethe Lesemkhatsini Ye-inthanethi.

src: Kabinete e fumane tlaleho e tswang Khomesheneng ya Ditlhodisano e mabapi le diphetho le mehato ya tokiso ka Patlisiso ya maemo a Tlhodisano Dikgwebong tse Inthaneteng.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iwuncomile umsebenti wekhomishini ngekulungisa kukhatsateka kwekwenganyelwa sikhondlakhondla sinye kwetinkhundla letisemkhatsini tedijithali, lokufaka ekhatsi tebhizinisi nge-elekthronikhi, ema-ejensi ekuhamba laku-inthanethi, kuletfwa kwekudla, titolo tema-app, batfulitinsita labahleleke ngemikhakha kanye netinjini tekutfungatsa lwatiso ku-inthanethi.

src: Kabinete e thoholeditse mosebetsi wa khomeshene wa ho shebana le dingongoreho tsa monopholi mapatlelong a dikgwebo tsa inthanete a kenyeletsang dikgwebo, mekgatlo ya inthaneteng ya boeti, tsamaiso ya dijo, mabenkele a di-app, dipapatso tsa dihlahiswa le ditshebeletso le motjha wa ho batla lesedi inthaneteng.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi inike sicondziso Tindvuna tematiko ahulumende lafanele kutsi tichubeke ticubungule letincomo tekutfutfukisa, tibuke imitselela yetinchubomgomo kanye nekwenta tingucuku letinsha letidzingekako tetinchubomgomo letitawukwenta kutsi kube nekutibandzakanya lokuvakalako kwebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nemabhizinisi lamancane, lasemkhatsini kanye nemabhizinisi lacashe bantfu labambalwa kubhizinisi ye-inthanethi lekhulako.

src: Lefu la Dikgoho.
tgt: Umkhuhlane wetinyoni.

src: Kabinete e hlokometse ho qhoma ha jwale ha vaerase e bakang lefu la ntaramane ya mefuta ya (HPAI) H5 le H7 indastering ya dikgoho Afrika Borwa.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikunakile lokubhedvuka lokukhona kwemkhuhlane weligciwane lelibanga kugula kakhulu (i-HPAI) i-H5 ne-H7 embonini yetinkhukhu lapha eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kapa Bophirima le KwaZulu-Natal di hlasetswe ke ho qhoma ha HPAI H5 ha HPAI H7 e tlalehwa diprovenseng tsa Gauteng, Limpopo, Mpumalanga le Bokone Bophirima.
tgt: Inshonalanga Kapa neKwaZulu-Natal babe nekubhedvuka kwe-HPAI H5 kwatsi i-HPAI H7 yona yabikwa kutsi ibhedvuke eGauteng, eLimpopo, eMpumalanga naseNyakatfo Nshonalanga.

src: Ho kentshwe tshebetsong mehato ya ho laola ho ata ha mafu ana mme beng ba dipolasi ba kgothaletswa ho latela metjha e behilweng ya ho lwantsha lefu lena.
tgt: Tinyatselo tekulawula kubhebhetseka kwalokubhedvuka setime ngemumo nebalimi bayagcugcutelwa kutsi bahloniphe tinyatselo tekuvikeleka letincunyiwe.

src: Ho qhoma ha lefu lena ho sitisa paballo ya dijo mme ho ka nna ha kenngwa tshebetsong mehato ya kgwebisano ya ho romela dihlahiswa kantle le ho laola phumaneho ya mahe a qhotswang, a jewang le nama ya kgoho.
tgt: Lokubhedvuka kubeka kubakhona kwekudla ebungotini kanye netinyatselo tekuhweba ngendlela yekutsenga kulamanye emave langesheya kulawula kubakhona kwemacandza latalako, emacandza latayelekile kubatsengi kanye nenyama yenkhukhu tingafezekiswa.

src: Lefapha la Temo, Kabobotjha ya Naha le Ntshetsopele ya Metse ya Mahae, Bolaodi ba Dihlahiswa tsa Bophelo bo Botle Afrika Borwa le indasteri di hlahloba dikopo tsa ho ngodiswa ha diente tse ka sebediswang, ka mehato ya ho ikobela melao e nkang polokeho, tshebetso e ntle le boleng di le bohlokwa bakeng sa ho ngodiswa ha diente tseo.
tgt: Litiko Letekulima, Kulungiswa Kabusha Kwemhlaba Nekutfutfukiswa Kwetindzawo Tasemaphandleni, Umtimba waseNingzimu Afrika Lolawula Imikhicito Yetemphilo kanye nemboni bahlola ticelo tekubhalisa imitsi yekugoma lengabakhona, kanye netinyatselo tekuhambisana letiphatselene nekuphepha, kusebenta ngemphumelelo kanye nelizingasimo kubekwe kumcoka kakhulu nawubhalisa imitsi yekugoma lenjalo.

src: Ntwa e Momahaneng Kgahlano le Bosenyi Kabinete e ananetse ho behwa sehlohlolong ka ntwa kgahlano le bosenyi, le setjhaba sa behwa sehlohlolong ke Letona la Mapolesa Mokgenerale Bheki Cele, le Popeho e Kopanetsweng ya Tshebetso le Mautlwela ya Naha.
tgt: Kulwa nebugebengu ngendlela lehlanganisiwe Ikhabhinethi ilwemukele lwatiso lakamuva lolumayelana nekulwa nebugebengu, loluphindze futsi lwaniketwa sive yiNdvuna Yetemaphoyisa, Jenene Bheki Cele, kanye Nekusebenta Ngekuhlanyanyela Kwavelonkhe NeLuhlaka Lwetebunhloli.

src: Motjha wa makala a fapaneng hodima ho rafa le ho falla ho seng molaong Kapa Leboya ho bakile hore ho tshwarwe batho ba 867, bongata ba bona e le ba tswang Lesotho, Zimbabwe, Mozambique le Maafrika Borwa a seng makae.
tgt: Kusebenta kwetinhlangotsi letinengi mayelana nekumba timayini ngalokungekho emtsetfweni nekungena eNyakatfo Kapa kuholele ekuboshweni kwebantfu labange-867, linyenti labo libuya eLesotho, eZimbabwe, eMzambiki nalabanye baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e bile ntswe leng le mekgatlo e kenyang molao tshebetsong e reng Maafrika Borwa a patang disenyi tse rafang di sa dumellwa a tla nkelwa mehato ya molao.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ivakalise luvo lwema-ejensi lacinisekisa kugcinwa kwemsetfo kutsi bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labafihla tigebengu letitibandzakanya ekugubheni timayini ngalokungekho emtsetfweni batawubukana nesandla semtsetfo ngalokuphelele.

src: Maemo a Fetelletseng a Lehodimo.
tgt: Simo selitulu lesibi.

src: Maemo a lehodimo a fetelletseng a naha ke sesupo sa kameho ya diphetoho tsa tlelaemete maphelong a rona le tlhokeho ya mehato ya moshwelella e lokelang ho nkuwa e kenyeletsang diphetoho tlhahisong ya motlakase nakong eo ho tsitlalletsweng ntshetsopele ya ho ya ho ile.
tgt: Simo selitulu lesibi salelive sigcizelela umtselela wetingucuko tesimomvama selitulu etimphilweni tetfu kanye nesidzingo sesinyatselo lesisimeme sekucedza ikhabhoni emnotfweni wetfu kodvwa sibe silandzela intfutfuko lesimeme.

src: Kabinete e ntse e behwa sehlohlolong ka tshenyo e bakilweng ke difefo tse matla le merwallo Kapa Botjhabela, Kapa Bophirima le Gauteng, mme ho na le ditlhokomediso tsa hore maemo ana a ka fetela diprovenseng tse ding.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyatiswa kabanti mayelana nemonakalo lobangwe tiphepho letimatima netikhukhula eMphumalanga Kapa, eNshonalanga Kapa naseGauteng, lokunetinkhomba letitsi kungenteka tisabalalele nakuletinye tifundza.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho baahi ho dula ba le sedi bakeng sa ditlhokomediso tse ding tsa maemo a feteletseng a lehodimo, a ka bakang tshenyo e nngwe e mpe naheng.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi icela imimango kutsi ihlale icaphelele kakhulu tecwayiso tesimo selitulu lesibi, lokungenteka kutsi siletse lomunye umonakalo eveni lonkhe.

src: Mmuso o tswela pele ho tshehetsa ba ditshebeletso tsa tshohanyetso le ditsi tsa taolo ya dikoduwa tsa pholoso le ho fana ka dithuso ho ba di hlokang.
tgt: Hulumene uyachubeka nekwesekela tinsita letiphutfumako kanye netikhungo tekulawula tinhlekelele kwenta imisebenti yekuhlenga kanye nekunika kwesekela kwebuntfu.

src: Mmila wa Winnie Mandela Kabinete e ananetse ho rehwa botjha ha Mmila wa William Nicol Sandton e eba Mmila wa Winnie Mandela jwaloka mohato wa bohlokwa ho ngolweng botjha ha nalane ya Afrika Borwa le ho bontsha seabo sa ba lwanetseng tokoloho ya rona.
tgt: Umgwaco lomkhulu i-Winnie Mandela Avenue.

src: Diqeto tsa Kabinete Leano le Lokisitsweng la Nama ya tse Hlaha la Afrika Borwa Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Leano le Lokisitsweng la Nama ya tse Hlaha la Afrika Borwa, leo sepheo ka lona e leng ho hlophisa le ho tlisa diphetoho indastering ya nama ya tse hlaha.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikunakile kwetsiwa kabusha kwemgwaco i-William Nicol Drive eSandton nga-Winnie Mandela Avenue njengesinyatselo lesimcoka sekubhala kabusha umlandvo waseNingizimu Afrika kute kukhonjiswe ligalelo lalabo labalwele inkhululeko yetfu.

src: Sepheo ka leano ke ho matlafatsa lekala la nama ya tse hlaha jwaloka lekala le ka fanang ka nama nako e telele le le ka bang le seabo kgolong ya moruo ka ho theha mesebetsi.
tgt: Lomcimbi wenteke ngesikhatsi sinye lebekungabe lusuku lwekugubha lusuku lwakhe lwekutalwa lwa-Winnie Madikizela-Mandela leminyaka lenge-87 mhla tinge-26 Inyoni 2023.Tincumo TekhabhinethiLisubuciko laseNingizimu Afrika Lolubuyeketiwe Lwetenyama Yenyamatane.

src: Afrika Borwa e boemong ba pele kontinenteng ya Afrika ka tlhahiso ya nama ya tse hlaha.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikwemukele kufezekiswa kweLisubuciko laseNingizimu Afrika Lolubuyeketiwe Lwetenyama Yetinyamatane, lokuhloswe ngalo kwenta imboni yenyama yetinyamatane kutsi ibe semtsetfweni futsi iguculwe.

src: Leano lena le tla netefatsa hore ho thehwa mesebetsi e 202 666 indastering ya nama ya tse hlaha pele ho feta 2030.
tgt: Lelisubuciko lihlose kucinisa umkhakha wetenyama yenyamatane njengemetfuli wekubakhona kwekudla kanye nemkhakha wekukhula kutemnotfo longasita kudala imisebenti.

src: Leano le tla phatlalatswa websaeteng ya Lefapha la Meru, Botshwasi le Tikoloho e leng: WEBTOKELeano le Leholo la Lekala la Bohahlaudi Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana ho amahanngwa ha Morero wa Tsoseletso ya Lekala la Bohahlaudi le Morero o motjha o Moholo wa Bohahlaudi.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika ibekwe yaba yekucala lapha kulelivekati lase-Afrika ngekukhicita inyama yetinyamatane.

src: Karolo ya bohlokwa ya Morero o Moholo ke ho bebofatsa kameho ya sewa sa COVID-19 lekaleng la bohahlaudi.
tgt: Lelisubuciko lihlose kucinisekisa kudaleka kwemisebenti lesimeme leti-202 666 kumkhakha wetenyama yenyamatane nga-2030.

src: E boetse e fana ka tataiso ya kamoo bohahlaudi bo ka tsoseletswang kateng le ka ho phethahala naheng ena.
tgt: Lelisubuciko litawushicilelwa kuwebhusayithi yeLitiko Letemahlatsi, Tekudoba Nemvelo ku: www.

src: Dibili.
tgt: gov.

src: Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana tlhahiso ya Bili ya SABC ya 2023 palamenteng.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kwentiwa kwekutsi Lisu Lekuvusetela Kabusha Lemkhakha Wetekuvakasha lihambisane neLisu Lelikhulu Letekuvakasha lelisha.

src: Ha e se e le molao, Bili e tla hlakola Molao wa jwale wa Kgaso wa 1999 (Molao wa 4 wa 1999).
tgt: Incenye lebalulekile yaLelisu Lelikhulu kunciphisa imitselela lemibi yelubhubhane lwe-COVID-19 kulomkhakha wetekuvakasha.

src: Diphetoho tsena di tla matlafatsa tshebetso e kgabane kgasong ya setjhaba.
tgt: Liphindze futsi linike indlela lephelele yekuvusetela kabusha tekuvakasha kulelive.

src: Bili ena e boetse e hlahisa hore ho be le diphetoho mokgweng wa SABC wa ho iketsetsa ditjhelete le mokgwatshebetsong wa dilaesense tsa dithelevishene.
tgt: Nanome Lisu Lekuvusetela Kabusha Tekuvakasha lasungulelwa kuchuba inchubo yekuvusetela kabusha lomkhakha, kugcina imisebenti kanye nekuvikela tindlela tekutiphilisa, leLisu Lelikhulu litawutsatsa lomsebenti liwubeke kulelinye lizinga futsi lichube ematfuba lamasha kulomkhakha.

src: Moralo wa Bili ya Tlhomathiso wa Ditshebeletso tsa Metsi Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana phatlalatso ya Bili ya Tlhomathiso wa Ditshebeletso tsa Metsi hore setjhaba se ntshe maikutlo ka yona.
tgt: Lelisu liphakamisa emasubuciko ekungelela lasikhombisa kucinisekisa kutsi umkhakha wetekuvakasha ubuyela etinsukwini tawo ngesikhatsi usaseyimphumelelo, nekutsi ube sizindza sekudala imisebenti nemabhizinisi.

src: Diphetoho Molaong wa Ditshebeletso tsa Metsi wa 1997 (Molao wa 108 wa 1997) di tla netefatsa hore ba fanang ka ditshebeletso tsa metsi ba nehelana ka metsi a boleng bo hodimo e le karolo ya dipehelo tsa dilaesense.
tgt: Imboni yetekuvakasha ineligalelo lelimcoka kutemnotfo futsi yesekela imisebenti lenge-725 000 ngembikwalolubhubhane lwe-COVID-19.Imitsetfosivivinyo.

src: Moralo wa Bili ya Tlhomathiso ya Naha ya Metsi Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana phatlalatso ya moralo wa Bili ya Tlhomathiso ya Naha ya Metsi hore setjhaba se ntshe maikutlo ka yona.
tgt: Umtsefosivivinyo Wenhlangano Yetekusakata Ngemoya yaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SABC) wanga-2023.

src: Bili ena e lokisa Molao wa Naha wa Metsi wa 1998 (Molao 36 wa 1998).
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikuvumile kungeniswa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosisekelo we-SABC wanga-2023.

src: Diphetoho tsena di tla ntlafatsa melawana mme di netefatse hore mehlodi ya metsi ya naha e laolwa, e sireletswe le ho baballwa hantle.
tgt: Nasewuphasiswe waba ngumtsetfo, loMtsetfosivivinyo utawuholela ekutseni kucitfwe loMtsetfo Wetekusakata Ngemoya lokhona, wanga-1999 (Umtsetfo Nombolo 4 wanga-1999).

src: Setshwantsho sena sa molao se boetse se etsa ditshisinyo tse mabapi le ho fediswa ha ho se lekane kabong ya metsi ho bakilweng ke kgethollo, mme se fana ka metjha ya kahare ya ho rarolla dikgohlano e sebetsang hantle le ka potlako.
tgt: Letichibelo titawucinisa kusebenta ngelikhono kwalomsakato wesive.

src: Khiro Mangolo a thuto a ba hirwang a a netefatswa mme ho netefatswe le hore ha ba e so ka ba tlola molao.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uphindze uchubeke uphakamise kutsi kube netingucuko kumodeli ye-SABC yekusita ngetimali kanye naseluhlelweni lwekunika timvume te-TV.

src: Monghadi Sihle Ngubane jwaloka Motsamaisi Kakaretso: Botsamaisi ba Ditshebetso Mesebetsing ya Bohatisi ya Mmuso.
tgt: Umtsetfosivivinyo Wesikhashana Wekuchibela Tetinsita Temanti.

src: Mme Mmolaeng Mooki jwaloka Motsamaisi Kakaretso: Ditshebeletso tsa Tshehetso Mesebetsing ya Bohatisi ya Mmuso.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi yakwemukela kushicilelwa kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibela Tetinsita Temanti kutsi ummango uphawule ngawo.

src: Khiro ya Balaodi bao e seng ba Phethahatso Botong ya Mokgatlo wa Inshorense ya Dikotsi tse Ikgethang wa Afrika Borwa.
tgt: Tinhloso letimcoka taloMtsetfosivivinyo tekucinisa kutilandza kubatfulitinsita temanti kanye nekwetfula kutsi kungafihli lutfo.

src: Khiro ya Balaodi bao e seng ba Phethahatso Botong ya Banka ya Ntshetsopele ya Afrika e Borwa.
tgt: LoMtsetfosivivinyo ubeka tilinganisozinga telinanincane tekusebenta kwebatfulitinsita betinsita temanti, lekufanele kutsi ticinisekiswe tiphatsimandla Tetinsita Temanti kutsi tiyagcinwa.

src: Monghadi Bongani Nqwabana (o hirilwe hape).
tgt: Umtsetfosivivinyo Wesikhashana Wavelonkhe Wekuchibela Temanti.

src: MatshedisoKabinete e lebisitse matshediso malapeng le metswalleng ya: Monghadi Aziz Goolam Hoosein Pahad (82), eo e neng e le moitseki kgahlano le mmuso wa kgethollo le eo e bileng Motlatsa-Letona la Ditaba tsa Kantle wa pele wa mmuso wa Demokrasi wa Afrika Borwa ho tloha ka 1994 ho ya ho 2008.
tgt: Inyanga Yetekutfutsa kulonyaka itawukhunjulwa ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Siyakha – Sakha sakhiwonchanti lesincono kute sikhulise iNingizimu Afrika.”.

src: Molefthenente Mokhomanda Gillian Elizabeth Hector, Master Warrant Officer William Masela Mathipa, le Warrant Officer Class One Mmokwapa Lucas Mojela, ba hlokahalletseng mosebetsing ba le sekepeng SAS Manthatisi, pela Kommetjie, Kapa Bophirima.
tgt: Inyanga Yetekutfutsa yanga-2023 itawugcila kulutjalomali lolukhulu kusakhiwonchanti setekutfutsa, kanye nekucela kutsi kube khona lokwentiwako kuvikela sakhiwonchanti setekutfutsa kutsi singebiwa futsi singahhwatjulwa.

src: Maemo a Renang 2023 Bommampodi ba Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Rugby Kabinete e ile ya lebohisa di-Springboks ka tlholo ya tsona ya Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Rugby wa 2023 e ileng ya etsa hore Afrika Borwa e be yona feela naha e hapileng Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Rugby ka makgetlo a mane le ya bobedi ho hapa mohope oo ka ho latellana.
tgt: A. Tindzaba Letibalulekile Talelive Tihlabani Tendzebe Yemhlaba Yelibhola Lembhoco Yanga-2023 IKhabhinethi ihalalisele Emabhokobhoko ngekuphumelela kutsatsa Indzebe Yemhlaba Yelibhola Lembhoco yanga-2023 leyenta kutsi iNingizimu Afrika ibe ngilo lodvwa live lelitsetse Lendzebe Yemhlaba Yelibhola Lembhoco emahlandla lamane nekutsi litsatse lendzebe tikhatsi letimbili ngekulandzelana.

src: Historing ya rugby Afrika Borwa, sehlopha sena sa di-Springboks ke sona se nang le merabe e fapaneng ka ho fetisisa ho latela boemedi ba palo ya batho ya Afrika Borwa.
tgt: Emlandvweni welibhola lembhoco, lelicembu leMabhokobhoko ngilona libhice tinhlanga letehlukene kunawo onkhe emacembu ngekwebuhlanga bebantfu labakhona eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Sebopeho sena sa sehlopha sa merabe e fapaneng hase ketso e iketsahalletseng feela, empa ke boiteko bo rerilweng ke basebetsi ba tsamaiso le ba kwetlisang ba di-Springboks ho kgetha sehlopha se kenyelletsang bohle.
tgt: Kuhlanganiswa kwalelicembu lelibhice kangaka akuzange kumane kwenteke nje, kepha kwaba yimitamo leyentiwa ngulabaphetse kanye netisebenti leticecesha lelicembu leMabhokobhoko yekutsi bakhetse licembu lelifaka bantfu labehlukene.

src: Qeto eo e bontshang sebete sa mokwetlisi Rassie Erasmus le sehlopa sa hae e tswela pele ho bontsha Maafrika Borwa le lefatshe lohle, hore motho e mong le e mong ya nang le bokgoni, haeba a fuwa monyetla le tshehetso, a ka hlahella – le bopaki ba hore re Matla Mmoho.
tgt: Leso sincumo semceceshi Rassie Erasmus nelicembu lakhe lesabonisa kuba nesibindzi siyachubeka kubonisa takhamuti taseNingizimu Afrika kanye nemhlaba wonkhe kwekutsi wonkhe umuntfu lonelikhono, uma anikwa litfuba nekusekelwa, angaba mkhulu - lokusiciniseko sekutsi Sinemandla Lamakhulu Uma Sihlangene.

src: Sa bohlokwa le ho feta, mamello le boikemisetso ba di-Springboks lebaleng la dipapadi, ho phethahatsa moelelo wa nnete wa se bolelwang ke ho ba Moafrika Borwa, e leng se etsang hore naha ena e kgolo e eme kgahlanong le ditshitiso tsohle le mathata e le hore e hlahe e le mohlodi.
tgt: Lokumcoka kakhulu, kucina nekutimisela kweMabhokobhoko enkhundleni yemdlalo kucuketse liciniso leliyingcikitsi yebuve baseNingizimu Afrika, loko lokwenta lelive lelihle kangaka liphakame limelane nebumatima kuze baphumelele bancobe.

src: Tse ding tsa dibapadi tse hlwahlwa tsa sehlopha sena sa di-Springboks di ile tsa lokela ho hlola mathata tseleng ya tsona e lebisang katlehong e kgolo.
tgt: Labanye bebadlali balelicembu leMabhokobhoko kubite kutsi bamelane netitsa lebetisendleleni yabo yekuphumelela.

src: Kabinete e ile ya lebohisa Siyamthanda “Siya” Kolisi, mokapotene wa di-Springboks tse hapileng ka makgetlo a mabedi Mohope wa Lefatshe bakeng sa ho etella pele sehlopha ho se lebisa boemong ba Greatest of All Time (GOAT) mme ho keteka ho lokela ho tswela pele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphumisele kuhalalisa kwayo kuSiyamthanda “Siya” Kolisi, longukapteni weMabhokobhoko Lotsetse Indzebe Yemhlaba kabili ngekuhola licembu lelibe kulelizinga lelibitwa nge-Greatest Of All Time (GOAT), lekungako lemigubho kumele ichubeke.

src: Foramo ya AGOA Kabinete e thabetse tiisetso ya botsamaisi ba Amerika le seboka ka boikemisetso ba tsona ba ho atollosa AGOA, e leng se tlisang bonnete ho setjhaba sa matsete sa dinaha tse tshwanelehang bakeng sa AGOKabinete e boetse ya amohela ho tshwarelwa ha Foramo ya AGOA ya 2023, lekgetlo la pele Johannesburg ho tloha ka la 2 – 4 Pudungwana 2023 moo ho bileng le bankakarolo ba emetseng dinaha tsa Afrika tse 32 ba tswang mmusong, kgwebong, mekgatlong ya setjhaba le mekgatlong ya basebetsi hammoho le baemedi ba mmuso wa Amerika.
tgt: Umhlangano we-AGOA IKhabhinethi isemukele sincumo sebaphatsi beMerikha kanye nemhlangano ngekuba nenhloso yekwelula sikhatsi se-AGOA, lokuyintfo leletsa sicinisekiso kubahlanyeli betimali kulawo mave lavumelekile ku-AGOIKhabhinethi beyiphindze yakwemukela kutsi leli lisingatse uMhlangano we-AGOA wanga-2023 eJozi kusukela mhlaka-2 kuya ku-4 kuLweti wanga-2023, lobenetihambi letivela emaveni langu-32 ase-Afrika letifaka ekhatsi bohulumende, bosomabhizinisi, umphakatsi wonkana kanye nekwekucala nalabamele tisebenti kanye nalabamele hulumende waseMerikha.

src: Kabinete kamehla e tiisa hore AGOA e fana ka monyetla wa hore Amerika e matlafatse maqhama a moruo le Afrika mme kahoo e lokela ho ekeletswa nako ya ho ba tshebetsong ka nako e bonahalang, e nang le moelelo, ho etsa hore e be le mosola le tshusumetso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi beyikadze ikuphakamisa kwekutsi i-AGOA iniketa litfuba lekutsi iMerikha icinise budlelwane bayo ne-Afrika kutemnotfo nekutsi ngaloko kumele ikuchubekise sikhatsi leseluliwe, nekutsi iciniswe kuze ibe nemiphumela futsi igcame.

src: Seboka sa Matona a Bohahlaodi a BRICS Kabinete e thabetse sephetho se atlehileng sa Seboka sa Matona a Bohahlaodi a BRICS sa 2023 se neng se tshwaretswe Cape Town, se ileng sa etsa hore dinaha tseo e leng ditho di sebedisane ka ho felletseng ho ntshetsa pele bohahlaodi ba ka hare ho BRICS, ho ntlafatsa ditsela bakeng sa motsamao o betere wa bohahlaudi le kgokahanyo hara dinaha tseo e leng ditho.
tgt: Umhlangano WeTindvuna te-BRICS kuTekuvakasha IKhabhinethi ikwemukele kuphetfwa kweMhlangano We-2023 BRICS WeTindvuna KuTekuvakasha lobe yimphumelelo, lobewubanjelwe e-Cape Town, lapho emave layincenye yalenhlangano atibophelele ekubambisaneni lokujulile kanye nekutfutfukisa kuvakashelana kwe-BRICS, kusungula imizila letawutfutfukisa kuvakashelana kancono nekuchumana kwemave layincenye yalenhlangano.

src: Sena se tla matlafatsa le ho feta lefapha la Afrika Borwa la bohahlaodi le seng le ntse le bontsha matshwao a ho ntlafala.
tgt: Loku kutawucinisa umkhakha wetekuvakasha eNingizimu Afrika losewuvele ubonisa timphawu tekuvuseteleka.

src: Bakeng sa dikgwedi tsa pele tse 8 tsa 2023, naha e ile ya ba le baeti ba dimilione tse e leng se ileng sa bontsha keketseho ya dipersente tse ho tloha ho nako e tshwanang ka 2022.
tgt: Etinyangeni letingu-8 tekucala kulomnyaka wa-2023, lelive libe netivakashi letingu-5.5 wetigidzi letifikile, loku yinkhulo lengu-63.4% uma kucatsaniswa nesikhatsi lesifanako emnyakeni wa-2022.

src: Ngodiso ya Dikgetho IEC e phatlaladitse la 18 le la 19 Pudungwana 2023 e le mafelobeke a pele a ho ingodisetsa ho kgetha bakeng sa Dikgetho tsa Kakaretso tsa 2024.
tgt: Kubhalisela Kuvota I-IEC seyimemetele imphelasontfo yekucala mhlaka-18 na 19 kuLweti 2023 kutsi ibe yekubhalisela Kuvota Elukhetfweni Lwavelonkhe lwa-2024.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho bohle ba tshwanelehang ho kgetha ho ingodisetsa ho kgetha bakeng sa Dikgetho tsa Kakaretso tsa 2024 diteisheneng tsa hao tsa ho kgetha tse haufinyane.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhutsata bonkhe labavunyelwe kuvota kutsi babhalisele kuvota Elukhetfweni Lwavelonkhe lwa-2024 etindzaweni tekuvota lesitedvute.

src: Ngodiso ya ho kgetha ya inthanete e butswe ho tloha ka Hlakola 2023 mme baahi ba koptjwa ho sebedisa setsi sena ho ingodisa kapa ho ntlafatsa dintlha tsa bona.
tgt: Kubhalisa nge-intanethi kwebavoti kwavulwa kusukela ngeNdlovana 2023 futsi takhamuti tiyakhutsatwa kutsi tisebentise letinsita kuze babhalise noma balungise imininingwane yabo.

src: Maafrika Borwa a kentseng dikopo tsa di-ID a kgothalletswa ho etela ofisi ya Meroro ya Lehae ya sebakeng sa habo bona bakeng sa ho ya di nka.
tgt: Takhamuti taseNingizimu Afrika letifake ticelo tema-ID tiyakhutsatwa nato kutsi tivakashele emaHhovisi Elitiko Letasekhaya kuyowalandza.

src: Ho na le dikarete tsa di-smart ID tse fetang 500 000 tse lokelang ho latwa diofising tsa Merero ya Lehae naha ka bophara.
tgt: Kunema-ID langemakhadi langetulu kweti-500 000 lasolo angakalandvwa emaHhovisi Elitiko Letasekhaya eveni lonkhe.

src: Motlakase Letona ofising ya Mopresidente le ikarabellang bakeng sa Motlakase le fane ka dintlha tse hlakileng ka boemo ba motlakase naheng.
tgt: Gezi Indvuna leseHhovisi LaMengameli lephetse lindzaba taGezi ikhulume kabanti nesive ngesimo sagezi eveni.

src: Kabinete e ile ya thoholetsa boiteko ba Mmuso wa Profinse ya Gauteng o sebetsang le Eskom ho tsosollosa motlakase dibakeng tsa Gauteng tse nnileng tsa ba lefifing ka lebaka la boshodu kapa ho senyeha ha di-transformer.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyidvumisile imitamo yaHulumende Wesifundza se-Gauteng losebenta ne-Eskom kulungisa gezi etindzaweni letise-Gauteng lebetihlushwa kuhamba kwagezi ngenca yekubiwa noma kubhidlita ema-transformer.

src: Bosiung bo fetileng, di-transformer tse tsheletseng tse ntjha tsa motlakase di ile tsa kenngwa Kagiso, sebakeng sa West Rand ka mora hore baahi ba sale ba se na motlakase ka dilemo tse fetang tse tharo.
tgt: Ebusuku bayitolo, kukhanyiswe ema-transformer agezi lasitfupha eKagiso, lese-West Rand emva kwekutsi takhamuti takhona tihleli ngaphandle kwagezi iminyaka lengetulu kwalemitsatfu.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho baahi bana hore ba sirelletse disebediswa tsena tsa bohlokwa boshodung, le tshenyong tse bakwang ke dikgokelo tse seng molaong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema lemiphakatsi kutsi ivikele letakhiwo ekubiweni, kumoshwa kanye nemonakalo lokubangwa kokhela gezi ngalokungekho emtsetfweni.

src: Tjhefo ya Dijo Kabinete e tshwenyehile ka ho ata ha bana ba kudiswang ke tjhefo ya dijo eo ba e fumaneng ha ba ja dijo tse felletsweng ke nako le tse silafetseng tseo ba di rekileng mabenkeleng a spaza le ho barekisi ba seterateng.
tgt: Kudla lokunebutsi IKhabhinethi ikhatsatekile ngakuvama kwekutsi bantfwana badle kudla lokunebutsi ngoba badla kudla losekudlulelwe sikhatsi, nalokonakele lokutsengiswa etipaza nasetitaladini.

src: Kabinete e kgothaditswe ke boiteko ba tshebetso ya molao ba ho tiisa hore ho latelwa melao ya polokeho ya dijo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakhutsateka ngemitamo yebemtsetfo kucinisa tekuphepha nekulandzelwa kwemigomo yekudla.

src: Seboka sa Matjhaba se Buang ka Diketso tsa ho Falla se Kwetlisang Boramotse le Marena Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka Seboka sa Matjhaba se Buang ka Diketso tsa ho Falla se Kwetlisang Boramotse le Marena se neng se tshwerwe ke Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae ka bonkakarolo ba Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Dikgwebo tse Nyenyanane, Lefapha la Puso ya Kopanelo le Ditaba tsa Borena Lefapha la Bodulo ba Batho le marena le boramotse ho tswa bomasepaleng ba ditoropo le ba ditereke, se neng se tsepamisitswe ho ditlamorao tse bakwang ke ho falla ho seng molaong, ho kenyelletsa tsamaiso ya mabenkele a spaza.
tgt: Umhlangano Wekucecesha Kutfutsela Kulamanye Emave Nebaholi Bemadolobha kanye Nebendzabuko IKhabhinethi yatjelwa kafishane ngalomhlangano wekucecesha lowabanjwa Litiko Letasekhaya nalowahanjelwa yi-DSBD, i-COGTA, Litiko Letekuhlaliswa Kwebantfu kanye nebaholi bendzabuko, nebaholi bemadolobha labaphuma kubomasipala bemadolobha kanye netigodzi, lebewubuka tindlela tekuncandvwa kwemiphumela yekungena eveni ngalokungekho emtsetfweni, lokufaka ekhatsi kusebenta kwetipaza.

src: Sephetho se ka sehloohong se akaralletsa ho kenyelletswa ha melawana ya dintho tse fapaneng bakeng sa ho lokisa mathata a amanang le phethahatso ya melawana ya kgwebo ke bomasepala le balaodi ba setso.
tgt: Imiphumela lesembili ifaka ekhatsi kucalwa kweluchungechunge lwetichibelo temitsetfo yekubukana netingcinamba letiphatselene nekutsi bomasipala kanye netiphatsimandla tendzabuko bacinise tichibelo temitsetfo yemabhizinisi.

src: Ho tla ba le ditlhahlobo tsa hanghang tse kopanetsweng tsa dikgwebo, ka ho kgetheha tsa mabenkele a spaza ke mafapha a mosebetsi, a bophelo bo botle, a ntshetso pele ya dikgwebo tse nyenyane le dihlopha tsa tlhahlobo ya ho falla tsa Merero ya Lehae, bakeng sa ho qobella boikamahanyo le melao e sebetsang.
tgt: Kutawuba khona kuhlolwa kwemabhizinisi, ikakhulu tipaza ngulabaphuma ematiko etekusebenta, temphilo, kusungulwa kwemabhizinisi lamancane kanye nemacembu ebahloli beLitiko Letasekhaya, khona kutawucinisa kulandzelwa kwemigomo ngekusebentisa imitsetfo lefanele.

src: Tlhahlobo ho mabenkele a spaza metseng le makeisheneng, le mekgwa ya ho a ngodisa e tla sebediswa ke baetapele ba setso le bomasepala.
tgt: Kutawentiwa luphenyo lwetipaza etindzaweni tasemakhaya kanye nasemalokishini, lokuhambisana netindlela tekutsi tibhaliswe lokutawentiwa baholi bendzabuko kanye nabomasipala.

src: Ho boetse ho na le boiteko ba ho tshehetsa balaodi ba setso ho boloka tlaleho ya batho ba tswang kantle ho naha metseng ya bona.
tgt: Kuphindze kube khona nemitamo yekusekela tiphatsimandla tendzabuko kwekutsi bagcine luhlu lalabaphuma kulamanye emave emiphakatsini yabo.

src: Molao wa laesense ya kgwebo o fetotswe bakeng sa ho tshehetsa bohle ba lakatsang ho hweba mafapheng a sa laolweng ke mmuso.
tgt: Imitsetfo yekubhaliswa kwemabhizinisi nayo iyaguculwa kuze kusekelwe bonkhe labo labafuna kutsengisa kulomkhakha wekutisebentela.

src: Ntwa ya Kopanelo Kgahlanong le Botlokotsebe Kabinete e babatsa SAPS ka kotlo e kgolo ho mekgatlo ya matjhaba ya dithethefatsi ka mora ho fumana khokheine ya boleng ba dimilione tse R80 tse ileng tsa tshwarwa ka la 20 Mphalane 2023 ntlong ya polokelo Boemakepeng ba Dube Trade ka hare ho Boemafofane ba Matjhaba ba King Shaka.
tgt: Kulwa Nebugebengu Lokuhlangahlangene IKhabhinethi iyayincoma i-SAPS ngekuncandza ngemandla kwalabo lababambisana ngekutsengiswa kwetidzakamiva lokulandzela kutfolakala kwe-cocaine lengabita emarandi latigidzi letingu-80 leyatsatfwa mhlaka-20 kuMphala 2023 endzaweni yekugcina imphahla e-Dube Trade Port ngekhatsi kweSikhumulo Setindiza I-King Shaka.

src: Matsatsi a mabedi pele ho kgapo eo, khokheine e nngwe ya boleng ba dimilione tse R70 le yona e ile ya fumanwa ka khontheinareng Boemakepeng ba Durban.
tgt: Emalangeni lamabili landvulela kutsatfwa kwaletidzakamiva, kwatsatfwa lenye i-cocaine lengabita emarandi latigidzi letinge-70 kukhonteyina eSikhumulweni Semikhumbi eThekwini.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa SAPS bakeng sa mosebetsi wa bona wa ho sitisa le ho senya tlolo ya molao e hlophisitsweng ya matjhabeng e leng tshokelo e kgolo ho setjhaba sa habo rona le ho naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ishaya tandla ngemsebenti we-SAPS wekuphatamisa nekuhliphitwa kwetinhlelo tebugebengu emkhatsini wemave lokumisa kabi kakhulu imiphakatsi yetfu kanye nesive.

src: Letsholo la Tshireletseho Nakong ya Matsatsi a Phomolo le se ntse le beha ditholwana ka ho tshwara ha mapolesa babelaellwa ba fetang 140, ho kenyelletsa le eo ho thweng ke nkokonono ya morafo o seng molaong, le ho hapuwa ha dithunya tse se nang laesense.
tgt: Umkhankaso lobitwa nge-Operation Safer Festive Season wetekuphepha ngesikhatsi semaholide sewuvele uveta titselo ngoba emaphoyisa sekabophe basolwa labangu-140, lebafaka ekhatsi longungcondvongcondvo wekumbiwa kwetimayini ngalokungekho emtsetfweni, nangekutsatsa tibhamu letingenawo emalayisensi.

src: Ketelo ya ho Hlahloba ya Mopresidente Kabinete e thabetse Ketelo ya ho Hlahloba ya Mopresidente Masepaleng wa Emfuleni, e ileng ya latelwa ke dikopano le setjhaba nakong ya ketelo ya Mohlala wa Ntshetsopele ya Ditereke ya 2022.
tgt: Luhambo Lwamengameli Lwekuyohlola Kuchubeka Kwemsebenti

src: Ketelo ya 2022 Emfuleni e qoollotse mathata a tlhokomelo e mpe ya ditshebeletso ke masepala.
tgt: .IKhabhinethi ikwemukele Kuhambela kwaMongameli welive kuMasipala wase-Emfuleni lwekuyohlola kuchubeka kwemsebenti, lobekulandzelela emva kwetingcoco letabakhona nemphakatsi ngesikhatsi sekuchutjwa kweLuhlelo Lekutfutfukisa Tigodzi (i-DDM) nga-2022.

src: Ka ho kenella ha Lefapha la Metsi le Bohlweki, ho bile le tswelopele e bonahalang tabeng ya ho rarolla mathata a ditshebeletso tsa metsi le bohlweki tse felletseng ka ho putlama ha tsamaiso ya Metsi a Ditshila Vaal.
tgt: Kuvakashela e-Emfuleni nga-2022 kwaveta tingcinamba tekugcinwa kwesakhiwonchanti ngumasipala.

src: Mosebetsi o entswe bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa phano ya metsi, tshebetso e nepahetseng ya tsamaiso ya metsi a ditshila mme kahoo ha fediswa bothata ba metsi a dikgwerekgwere tse ditshila a mathang diterateng le dijareteng tsa batho.
tgt: .Ngekungenelela kweLitiko Letemanti Netekuhlanta, kwaba nenchubekela embili leyabonakala ekubukeni tingcinamba letiphatselene netakhiwonchanti temanti kanye nekuhlanta letabangela kungasebenti kwe-Vaal Water Waste.

src: Tswelopele e hlokomelehang nakong ya ketelo ena e kenyelletsa ntlafatso diphaepheng tse ngata tsa bohlokwa le diteisheneng tsa ho pompa metsi, ho ntjhafatswa le ho tiiswa ha ditsela, hammoho le tlhahiso e kgolo ya mabone a seterateng bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa kganya le polokeho.
tgt: Kunemisebenti leseyentiwe kutfutfukisa kwabiwa kwemanti, kusebenta kahle kwetakhiwonchanti temanti langcolile kanye nekucedvwa kwenkinga yemangcoliso lagijima etitaladini nasemabaleni etakhamuti.

src: Leano Bakeng sa Tsamaiso ya Thepa Afrika Borwa Lefapha la Dipalangwang le tswetsepele ho qala dipuisno ka Leano le mabapi le Tsamaiso ya Thepa Afrika Borwa, e le karolo ya mehato ya ho rarolla mathata ao lefapha la tsamaiso ya thepha le tobanang le ona le ho matlafatsa boiteko ba ho ntlafatsa moruo wa Afrika Borwa.
tgt: Inchubekela embili leyabonakala ngesikhatsi salokuvakasha ifaka ekhatsi kuphuculwa kwemaphayiphi kanye netiteshi tekufutsa emanti lamaningi, kulungiswa nekuchitjelwa kwemigwaco, kanye nekutfutfukiswa kwekukhanyisa nekuphepha ngekutsi kufakwe emalambu etitaladini.

src: Ntshetsopele ya Mehaho le Tlhokomelo Kabinete e thabetse tswelopele e entsweng ho ntshetsopele ya mehaho le tlhokomelo ka ho phethwa ha kaho ya marokgo a mahaeng a 36 tlasa Welisizwe Rural Bridges, le kaho e ntseng e tswelapele diprojekeng tse 20 dibakeng tsa bodulo ba batho, ditseleng le metsi.
tgt: INkhombandlela Yenchubo Yetekutfutfwa Kwemphahla eNingizimu Afrika Litiko Letekutfutsa selicale tinkhulumo letimayelana neNkhombandlela Yenchubo Yetekutfutfwa Kwemphahla eNingizimu Afrika, lokuyincenye yetaba tekubhekana netingcinamba letibukene nemkhakha wetekutfutsa nekuhanjiswa kwemphahla kanye nekuciniswa kwemitamo yekuvusetela umnotfo waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Ho Thakgolwa Botjha ha Ditsela tsa Matjhaba tsa South African Airways (SAA) Kabinete e thabetse ho thakgolwa botjha ha ditsela tsa matjhaba tsa SAA ka ho kenyelletsa botjha maeto a sefofane dikhonthinenteng tse ding a yang São Paulo, Brazil, e leng se boetseng sa tshwaya ho kgutla ha tshebeletso ya nako e telele ka ntle ho Cape Town le Johannesburg.
tgt: Kutfutfukiswa Nekugcinwa Kwetakhiwonchanti IKhabhinethi iyemukele inchubekela embili leyentiwa kutfutfukiswa kanye nekugcinwa kwetakhiwonchanti ngekutsi kuphetfwe kwakhiwa kwemabhuloho langu-36 etindzaweni tasemaphandleni ngephasi kwemkhankaso i-Welisizwe Rural Bridges, kanye nekwakhiwa lokusachubeka kwemiklamo lengu-20 yetekuhlaliswa kwebantfu, imigwaco, kanye nemanti.

src: Ho kgutla ha SAA ditseleng tsa matjhaba ho tla tlatsetsa ka ho toba kgolong ya ketelo ya matjhabeng naheng ya rona, le ho kgolo lefapheng la bohahlaodi ka mora tshenyo e bakilweng ke sewa sa COVID-19.
tgt: Kubuyiselwa Kwemizila Yekuya Kulamanye Emave Kwe-South African Airways (i-SAA) IKhabhinethi ikwemukele kubuyiselwa kwemizila yekundizela kulamanye emave kwe-SAA ngekutsi kuphindze kucalwe tindiza emkhatsini welivekati kuya e-São Paulo, e-Brazil, lokukhombise kubuya kwemizila lemidze lesuka e-Cape Town kanye naseJozi.

src: Afrika Borwa e Thakgotse Drone e Kgolo ka ho Fetisa Afrika Kabinete e lebohisitse ba Sesole le khampani ya difofane ya Milkor ka katleho ya yona ya ho thakgola sefofane se sa hlokeng ho palangwa hore se fofiswe (UAV) sa Milkor 380, e leng se behang Afrika Borwa hara dinaha tse tswelang pele ho etsa kgatelo pele theknolojing ya di-drone.
tgt: Lokubuyela kuletindlela tekundizela kulamanye emave kutawufaka sandla ekuphakamiseni kukhula kwekuhambela kwalamanye emave kuleli, kanye nekukhula kwemkhakha wetekuvakasha kulandzela umonakalo lowadalwa yi-COVID-19.

src: Milkor 380 ke drone e kgolo ka ho fetisisa e entsweng Afrika mme e tla sebediswa ke masole ha ho na le dintwa, ha ba disa moedi, ha ba disa dimela le diphoofolo tse hlaha, ho kenyelletsang twantso ya ho tsoma ho seng molaong.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika isungula idroni lenkhulu kunawo wonkhe e-Afrika IKhabhinethi ihalalisele inkampani yaka-Milkor yeTekuvikela kanye netekundiza, ngekuphumelela kusungula I-Milkor 380, lekuyindizamshini lengashayelwa ngumuntfu, leyente kutsi iNingizimu Afrika ibalwe kanye nalamanye emave lachubeka ngemandla kutebuchwepheshe bemadroni.

src: Ditlhahlobo tsa Metriki le tsa Sekolo tsa Qetellong ya Selemo Kabinete e thabetse qalo e tsamaileng ka thello ya ditlhahlobo tsa 2023 tsa National Senior Certificate (metriki), tse qadileng ka la 30 Mphalane 2023.
tgt: Le-Milkor 380 yidroni lenkhulu kunawo onkhe lekakhiwe e-Afrika futsi itawusetjentiswa kuhlasela ngumkhakha wetekuvikela, kulawula imincele, nemitamo yekonga imvelo lefaka ekhatsi kuncandza kutingela ngalokungekho emtsetfweni.

src: Batswadi le bahlokomedi ba kgothalletswa ho tswela pele ba tshehetsa baithuti nakong ena ya bohlokwa.
tgt: Batali kanye nebagcini bayakhutsatwa kwekutsi bachubeke kusekela bafundzi ngalesikhatsi lesimcoka kangaka.

src: Diqeto tsa Kabinete Boemo Palestina Kabinete e swabisitswe ke ho hana ha mmuso wa Iseraele ho hlompha molao wa matjhaba le ho tswela pele ho nyenyefatsa diqeto tsa Matjhaba a Kopaneng bakeg sa ho kenya tshebetsong ho emisa ntwa ntle ho kotlo.
tgt: Tincumo teKhabhinethi Simo SasePalestine IKhabhinethi ijabhile ngekutsi hulumende we-Israyeli ale kuhlonipha umtsetfo wemave nekuchubeka kucekela phasi tincumo teNhlangano Yamhlabuhlangene tekumisa kulwa ngaphandle kwekujeziswa.

src: Ditsela tsa ho baleha bakeng sa batho ba Palestina di ntse di thibetswe ka phello ya ditlamorao tse bohloko bakeng sa bana, basadi le baahi ba se nang molato.
tgt: Imizila yekuletsa lusito kubantfu basePalestine solo ivaliwe, intfo lenemiphumela lemibi kubantfwana, basikati kanye netakhamuti letingenacala.

src: Ditlhaselo tsa batho ba Palestina ka difofane tsa mmuso wa Iseraele, di tswelapele mme palo ya batho ba shwang e a eketseha mo e kenyelletsang basadi le bana.
tgt: Lokugadla ngetindiza kwahulumende we-Israyeli lokucotfula bantfu basePalestine, kuyachubeka kantsi nesibalo salabafile lokufaka ekhatsi basikati nebantfwana siyenyuka.

src: Matsatsing a mabedi a fetileng, lefatshe le ile la sheba ho se letho leo le ka se etsang le shebelletse ha tlhaselo ya difofane e ba matla ho Gaza le ho West Bank moo dikolo, dipetlele, diambulense le mahae a baahi hammoho le ditsela tseo ho thweng di sireletsehile tse yang ka Borwa ho Gaza di thuntshwa.
tgt: Kulamalanga lamabili ledlulile, umhlaba bewumile ubuka ungakhoni kwenta lutfo ngekugadla emoyeni lokunemandla eGaza naseWest Bank lokubhubhise tikolwa, takhiwo temphilo, ema-ambulensi kanye netakhiwo teluntfu kanye nemigwaco lekutsiwa iphephile kuya eNingizimu neGaza.

src: Bakeng sa dintlha tsena, Kabinete e entse qeto ya ho bitsa bodiplomate bohle ba Afrika Borwa ho tswa Tel Aviv ho tla hlalosa hore hantlehantle ke eng se etsahalang mono.
tgt: Ngenca yaloku, iKhabhinethi itsetse sincumo sekubita bonkhe labaseTel Aviv labamele lelive kuze bacocisane.

src: Kabinete e boetse e hlokometse dipuo tse nyenyefatsang tse tswelang pele tsa lenqosa la Iseraele ho Afrika Borwa, Monghadi Eliav Belotsercovsky, kgahlahonong la Maafrika Borwa, boetapele ba Afrika Borwa ka hare le ka ntle ho mmuso ho kenyelletsa le setjhaba se buang kgahlanong le polao e sehlooho e etswang ke mmuso wa Iseraele kgahlanong le Mapalestina.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphindze yakubona kuchubeka kwetinkhulumo letinetinshanshu talolincusa le-Israyeli kuleli, Mnz.

src: Dipuo tse nyenyefatsang tsa Lenqosa Belotsercovsky di fapane le dipolelo tsa manqosa a mehleng a mabedi a Iseraele ho Afrika Borwa (Illan Baruch le Dr. Alon Liel) a nnileng a dula a tsitsitse ha a hlalosa diketso tsa mmuso wa bona kgahlanong le Palestinians e le Kgethollo le Lehloyo la Morabe o mong.
tgt: Eliav Belotsercovsky, lebekatibhekise kutakhamuti teNingizimu Afrika, nakubaholi beNingizimu Afrika labakuhulumende kanye nangaphandle kwakhe, lokufaka ekhatsi imibutfo yeluntfu lekhuluma lokuphambene nalokubhujiswa kwebantfu basePalestine lokwentiwa nguhulumende we-Israyeli.

src: Dipuo tsa nyenyefatsang kgahlanong le ba buang kgahlanong le tlhekefetso le baetapele ba naha di etsa hore boemo ba lenqosa Belotsercovsky e be bo sa hlokomelweng le ho feta.
tgt: Letinkhulumo teLincusa Belotsercovisky letinekucekela phasi ticatsaniswa nalokwaphawulwa ngulabake baba ngemancusa e-Israyeli kuleli (Illan Baruch naDkt.

src: Kahoo Kabinete e laetse Lefapha la Dikamano tsa Matjhaba le Tshebedisano hore le fetisetse molao wa mmuso ka molao wa metjha ya bodiplomate wa ho se thabele se etswang ke lenqosa lena la bodiplomate.
tgt: Alon Liel) lebebangayekeli kuchaza tento tahulumende wabo kubantfu basePalestine batifananisa neMbuso Welibandlululo.

src: Polelo ya Leano la Bajete ya Tekanyetso ya Nako e Mahareng Kabinete e thabetse Bajete ya Tekanyetso ya Nako e Mahareng ya 2023 (MTBPS), e faneng ka tekanyo e tshepahalang ya boemo ba moruo ba hona jwale mme ya bontsha ho tshwarella ka tiyo ha mmuso ditjheleteng tsa naha hara dikgaello tse boima tsa tjhelete.
tgt: Letinkhulumo leticekela phasi letibhekiswe kulabo labaphumisela kuphambana kwabo nalokubulala lokunelunya kanye nebaholi balelive kwenta sikhundla saBelotsercovsky sichubeke kungameleki.

src: Diqeto tsa MTBPS di ntlafatsa moralo wa ditjhelete wa rona di ntlafatsa kgolo ya moruo ha ka nako e tshwanang di lekalekanya boitlamo ba rona setjhabeng bo tshehetsang mafutsana naheng ya rona.
tgt: Ngenca yaloko iKhabhinethi seyikhiphe umyalo wekutsi Litiko Lebudlelwane Kanye Nekuhlanganyela Nemave ledlulise kungaphatseki kahle kwahulumende weNingizimu Afrika ngalesento salelincusa lisebentisa tindlela tebuhlobo nalamanye emave.

src: Leano la Ntlafatso le Kahobotjha ya Moruo di bile le seabo ho ditholwana tse ngata tse ntle ho moralo wa ditjhelete moruong wa rona.
tgt: Inkhulumo Yenchubo Yemaphakelotimali Esikhatsi Esisemkhatsini IKhabhinethi isemukele Sitatimende Senchubo Yemaphaketimali Esikhatsi Esisemkhatsini (i-MTBPS), lesibeke elubala kuhlolwa kwesimo semnotfo saletinsuku yaphindze yabonisa kubambelela kwahulumende mayelana netimali talelive esikhatsini lapho kungena kwayo kunetihibe.

src: Ho Ahuwa ha Seporo sa Terene ya Lebelo le Phahameng Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana Ho Ahuwa ha Seporo sa Terene e Tsamayang ka Lebelo le Phahameng mme Letona la Dipalangwang le la Ditjhelete ba tla tshohla taba ya ditjhelete tse tla hlokahalang bakeng sa ho kenya monahano ona tshebetsong.
tgt: Tincumo leticuketfwe ngule-MTBPS tiyaluphakamisa luhlelo lwetimali temnyaka kukhutsatwa kwekukhula kwemnotfo kube kulinganisa nekutibophelela kwetfu eluntfwini lokusekela labo labasengcupheni esiveni sakitsi.

src: Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana ho potlakiswa ha marangrang a diphaseje tsa Johannesburg ho ya Durban bakeng sa boithuto bo felletseng ba kgonahalo e jwalo, le ho tloha Johannesburg ho ya Polokwane ho isa Musina, le Johannesburg ho ya Mbombela di tla behwa mmarakeng.
tgt: 3.Kwakhiwa Kwemzila Wetitimela Letinelitubane Lelikhulu IKhabhinethi seyiphasise Luhlelo Loluluhlaka Lwekwakhiwa Kwemzila Wetitimela Letinelitubane Lelikhulu kantsi imitselela yekucaliswa kwaloluhlelo kutawudzingidvwa Tindvuna Tetekutfutsa kanye Netetimali.

src: Moralo wa Tokomane ya Leano la Mmuso ho Boahi, Ho Falla le Tshireletso ya Baphaphathehi Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana kgatiso ya Tokomane ya Leano la Mmuso ho Boahi, ho Falla le Tshireletso ya Baphaphathehi bakeng sa maikutlo a setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi seyiphasise kubekwa embili kwemzila losemkhatsini weJozi kanye naseThekwini kwekutsi kube neluphandvo loluyibukisisako lendzaba, kulapho imizila emkhatsini weJozi nePolokwane naseMusina, kanye nalesemkhatsini neJozi neMbombela yona itawufakwa emakethe.

src: Moralo wa Leano lena o reretswe ho fana ka motheo bakeng sa tataiso ya ho fana ka bodulo le boahi ho batho ba tswang kantle ho naha, hammoho le tshireletso ya baphaphathehi le ya phaphathehi ba dipolotiki ka hare ho Afrika Borwa, ka ho lemoha dithahasello tsa tshireletso ya naha tsa Rephabliki le ho ikobela tumellano ya matjhaba le melao ya ho falla eo Afrika Borwa e leng karolo ya yona.
tgt: Umhlahlandlela WeLiphepha Lelimhlophe Lelimayelana Nekuvikelwa Kwebuve, Kungena Eveni kanye Nekukhosela IKhabhinethi seyiphasise kushicilelwa kweLiphepha Lelimhlophe Lelimayelana Nekuvikelwa Kwebuve, Kungena Eveni kanye Nekukhosela kuze sive sibeke imibono yaso.

src: Tlaleho ya Selemo sa bo6 ya Kgatelopele ya Tokomane ya Leano ho Ditokelo tsa Batho ba Holofofetseng Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana ho phatlalatswa koranteng ya mmuso ha Tlaleho ya Selemo sa bo6 ya Kgatelopele ya Tokomane ya Leano ho Ditokelo tsa Batho ba Holofofetseng ho kenngwa tshebetsong.
tgt: Lomhlahlandlela Wenchubo uhlose kubeka luhlaka lweticondziso tekuniketwa kwebuve nemvume yekuhlala kuleli kulabaphuma kulamanye emave, kanye nekuvikelwa kwalabakhosele kuleli laseNingizimu Afrika ngekubalekela timphi nekufuna kufihla inhloko ngenca yemphatfo yemave abo, ibe ingakhohlwa ngulokufunwa yiRiphabhliki mayelana netekuphepha kwelive ibuye ilandzele tivumelwano nenchubo yemave lecondzene netekuhamba emkhatsini wemave iNingizimu Afrika letibophelele kuko.

src: Phatlalatso ya tlaleho ena e tla tsamaisana le sehopotso sa matjhaba sa Kgwedi ya Tlhokomediso ya Ditokelo tsa Batho ba Holofetseng ho tloha ka la 3 Pudungwana ho isa ho la 3 Tshitwe.
tgt: Umbiko Wesitfupha Wemnyaka Wenchubekela Embili Lomayelana Nekusetjentiswa KweLiphepha Lelimhlophe Lemalungelo Ebantfu Labakhubatekile IKhabhinethi seyiphasise kutsi Umbiko Wesitfupha Wemnyaka Wenchubekela Embili ngekusetjentiswa kweLiphepha Lelimhlophe Ngemalungelo Ebantfu Labakhubatekile ushicilelwe kugazethi yahulumende.

src: Tlaleho ya tswelopele e boetse e bontsha kgolo morerong wa tekatekano ya khiro ho tloha ho bonyenyane ba dipersente tse 2 ho isa ho tse 3 bakeng sa batho ba holofetseng ho tloha selemong sa ditjhelete sa 2024/2025, ho isa ho bonyenyane ba dipersente tse 7 tsa morero wa tekatekano ya khiro bakeng sa batho ba holofotseng ka 2030.
tgt: Lokushicilelwa kwalombiko wenchubekela embili kutawucondzana nekugujwa kweNyanga Yekwatisa Ngemalungelo Alabakhubatekile lokucala mhlaka ti-3 kuLweti kuya kumhla ti-3 iNgongoni.

src: Dibili Moralo wa Bili ya Tsosoloso ya Afrika le Letlole la Tshebedisano ya Matjhaba (ARF) Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana tlhahiso ya Phetoho ya Bili ya ARF Palamenteng.
tgt: Lombiko wenchubekela embili uphindze ubonise timphawu tekukhula kwesibalo lesingephasi semgomo wekulinganisa labacashiwe lesisuke ku-2% laya ku-3% webantfu labakhubatekile, sicondze ku-7% nakufika umnyaka wa-2030.

src: Bili ena e reretswe ho fetola Molao wa ARF (Molao wa bo51 wa 2000) le ho theha Mokgatlo wa Ntshetsopele ya Maqhama ya Afrika Borwa, o tla sebetsa jwalo ka thuluse bakeng sa ho tshehetsa ntshetsopele ya Afrika Borwa le tshebedisano le dinaha tse mabapi ka ho kgothalletsa demokrasi, bookamedi bo molemo, thibelo le tharollo ya dikgohlano, ntshetsopele ya moruo setjhabeng le kopanyo.
tgt: Imitsetfosivivinyo UMtsetfosivivinyo Loluhlaka weSikhwamamali Sekuvusetela i-Afrika Nekusebentisana Kwemave Ngemave (i-ARF) IKhabhinethi seyiphasise kufakwa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibiyela we-ARLo Mtsetfosivivinyo uhlose kuchibela uMtsetfo we-ARF (Umtsetfo we-51 wange-2000) nekusungula i-Ejensi Yekutfutfukiswa Kwekubambisana eNingizimu Afrika, letawusetjentiswa njengendlela yekusekela kutfutfuka kanye nekubambisana kweNingizimu Afrika kanye nemave lahlobene nayo ngekuphakamisa inchubo yentsandvo yelinyenti, kubusa ngebucotfo, nekuncandza nekucatululwa tindzaba tembango eveni, kutfutfukisa tenhlalakahle nemnotfo kanye nekuhlanganyela.

src: Ho Thonngwa Pele batho bohle ba thonngwa, ho hlahlobisiswa mangolo a bona a thuto le a mang a hlokahalang.
tgt: Kubekwa Etikhundleni Kutawucinisekiswa ticu tetemfundvo nekuhlola kufaneleka kwabo bonkhe lababekwe etikhundleni.

tgt: Kubekwa kwa-MnuEbrahim Rasool esikhundleni sekuba nguSihlalo we-Development Bank of Southern Africa.

src: Diketsahalo tse Tlang Puisano ya Ntwa Kgahlanong le Bobodu Puisano ya Ntwa Kgahlanong le Bobodu e tla tshwarwa ka la 8 le la 9 Pudungwana 2023 Birchwood Hotel e Ekurhuleni bakeng sa ho hlomella setjhaba twantshong ya bobodu tumellanong le Leano la Naha la Ntwa Kgahlanong le Bobodu la naha ya rona.
tgt: Imicimbi Letako Ingcoco Yekumelana Nenkhohlakalo Ingcoco yekumelana nenkhohlakalo itawubanjwa mhlaka ti-8 namhla ti-9 kuLweti 2023 eHhotela i-Birchwood Ekurhuleni kutogcugcutela umphakatsi ekulweni nenkhohlakalo ngekuhambisana neNdlelalisu Yekumelana Nenkhohlakalo Eveni.

src: Kabinine, ka Pudungwana 2020, e tjhaetse monwana Leano la Naha la National Anti-Corruption Strategy (NACS 2020-2030).
tgt: Ngenyanga yeLweti 2020, iKhabhinethi yaphasisa iNdlelalisu Yekumelana Nenkhohlakalo Eveni (i-NACS 2020-2030).

src: Lena ke leano la naha le reretsweng ho theha setjhaba se lokokohileng bobodung ha ka nako e tshwanang le kgothalletsang baahi hore ba se ke ba mamella bobodu mme ba ikobele ditaelo tsa molao.
tgt: Lena kuyindlela yelive lehlose kusungula umphakatsi longenankhohlakalo iphindze ikhutsate sive kutsi singayibeketeleli inkhohlakalo futsi sigcine umtsetfo lobekiwe.

src: Letsholo la Matsatsi a 16 la 2023 la Thibelo ya Tlhekefetso ya Basadi le Bana Selemo sena se tshwaya sehopotso sa bo25 sa ho nka karolo ha Afrika Borwa ho Letsholo la Matsatsi a 16 bakeng sa Thibelo ya Tlhekefetso ya Basadi le Bana, se tla ketekwa tlasa sehlooho se reng: “Ho tiisa mehato ya ho fedisa Tlhekefetso ya Bong le Polao ya Basadi (GBVF): Ho se siye mang kapa mang morao”.
tgt: Umnkankaso Wemalanga Langu-16 Wekumelana Nekuhlukubetwa Kwebasikati kanye Nebantfwana wange-2023 Lomnyaka lesikuwo wekukhumbula minyaka lenge-25 yekuhlanganyela kweNingizimu Afrika kuloMkankaso Wemalanga langu-16 Wekumelana Nekuhlukubetwa Kwebasikati Nebantfwana lotawugujwa ngephasi kwesicubulo lesitsi: “Kukhutsatwa Kwetento Tekucedza Budlova Lobucondziswe Kubulili Lobutsite Nekubulawa Kwebasikati (i-GBVF): Asishiyi Muntfu Ngaphandle”.

src: Letsholo lena la lefatsheng ka bophara le ba teng ho tloha ka la 25 Pudungwana, Letsatsi la Matjhaba bakeng sa ho Fedisa Tlhekefetso kgahlanong le Basadi ho isa ho la 10 Tshitwe, Letsatsi la Matjhaba la Ditokelo tsa Botho.
tgt: Lomkhankaso wemhlaba utawucala kusukela mhlaka ti-25 kuLweti, ngeLilanga Lemave Lekucedza Kuhlukubetwa Kwebasikati kuze kube ngumhla ti-10 kuNgongoni, lekuLilanga Lemave Lemalungelo Eluntfu.

src: Le reretswe ho fedisa tlhekefetso kgahlanong le basadi ha ka nako e tshwanang le tshehetsa ditokelo tsa botho.
tgt: Lomkhankaso uhlose kucedza kuhlukubetwa kwebasikati kodvwa kube kuphakanyiswa emalungelo eluntfu.

src: Foramo ya bo14 ya Dipuisano tsa Maano Afrika Borwa e tla ba moamohedi mmoho ho Foramo ya bo14 ya Dipuisano tsa Maano e sebedisana mmoho le UNESCO International Teacher Task Force bakeng sa Thuto (TTF) ka Pherekgong 2024 tlasa sehlooho se reng “Ho rarollo bothata ba kgaello ya matitjhere le ho etsa hore mosebetsi ona o kgahle”.
tgt: Umhlangano Weli-14 Wengcoco Yenchubomgomo INingizimu Afrika itawubambisana neLicembu Lemave laboThishela le-UNESCO (i-TTF) kusingatsa uMhlangano Weli-14 Wengcoco Yenchubomgomo ngenyanga yaBhimbidvwane 2024, lotawubanjwa ngephasi kwesihloko lesitsi “Kubukana nekungabikho kwabothishela ngalokwenele nekwenta lomsebenti wekufundzisa ube ngulokhangisako”.

src: Foramo ena e tla kopanya basebetsi ba mmuso, di-NGO, matitjhere le ditsebi tsa thuto bakeng sa ho tshohla ditaba tsa bohlokwa tse mabapi le maemo a tshebetso bakeng sa matitjhere, ditaba tsa boikemelo le boikarabelo ba matitjhere hammo le kamoo ho ka etswang hore botitjhere e be mosebetsi o kgahlang.
tgt: Lomhlangano utawubutsanisa tisebenti tahulumende, bothishela kanye netingcweti temfundvo kutodzingidza ndzaba letiphatselene nesimo sekusebenta kwabothishela, tindzaba tekukhutimela kwabothishela ekusebenteni kwabo kanye nekutiphendvulela nekwenta umsebenti wekufundzisa ukhangeke.

src: Naledi ya lebelo la Moto GP Brad Binder eo hona jwale a tshwereng rekoto ya maemo a hodimo a primiyamo bakeng sa Afrika Borwa ka mora ho ba ya itlhommeng pele hara bahlodi ba bararo ba qetileng lebelo la Thailand Grand Prix.
tgt: Sihlabani semjako we-Moto GP, Brad Binder, losenyalo ente umlandvo wema ephodiyamu yalabahamba embili wamela iNingizimu Afrika kulandzela kuphumelela kwakhe waba kulabatsatfu labasembili emjahweni i-Grand prix eThailand.

src: Mampodi wa pele ya phahamisang ditshepe ya tsamayang ka wheelchair wa Afrika Borwa Macethandile Kulati bakeng sa ho sirelletsa sekola sa hae ho 2023 International Federation of Body Builders and Fitness World Championship Slovenia.
